title: English Cucumber and Swiss Meat Loaf With Lazy Swiss
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef chuck | 3 packages ladyfingers | 4 romano cheese, grated | 1 english cucumber | 3 slices swiss cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f.  Prepare meat loaf.  In bowl mix ground chuck with grated cheese.  Open lady fingers.  Using a plastic, round cutter and cut one side of one side of the lady fingers.  Spread meat loaf with crumb mixture.  Place hamburger mixture on top of crumb.  Slice two cucumber slices.  Place on top of meat loaf.  Cut in half on diagonal.  Repeat with other side of loaf.  Place on parchment paper lined cake sheet.  Cut into wedges.  Bake for approximately 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,prosciutto,hot red pepper flake,ancho chili,winter squash
title: Spicy Squash and Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs winter squash, peeled, cut in half and seeded | 1/4 cup golden syrup | 1 small fresh ancho chili, roasted, stemmed, seeded and finely chopped | 4 slices prosciutto, minced | crushed hot red pepper flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Combine squash halves in baking pan large enough to accommodate all of them comfortably.  Drizzle squash halves with golden syrup and sprinkle with chilies and prosciutto.  Season with red pepper flakes if desired.  Roast until squash is tender when pierced with a fork, 45 to 55 minutes.  Cool at least 5 minutes.

title: Easy Cannellini Bean Pastry
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked cannellini beans, and their liquid | 1 cup cooked cannellini mushrooms | 1 package frozen deep-dish pie shells
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except pie shell until well blended.  If you like a little more spice or a nutty texture, go ahead and use other flavors to your taste.

title: German Fried Rice - Prunes and Rice
ingredients: 4 cups leftover smoked long grain rice | 1 jar pitted prunes, drained | 1 box grits
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Line a 9x5x3 inch pan with aluminum foil.  Stir the rice, prunes and ¾ cup or more of water to loosen pieces of rice off in the pan.  Spoon any excess liquid from the can, then add the remainder of the liquid, stirring to coat the rice with a layer of water.  The rice should be just covered, if needed, the rice might not cover.  Bake for 30 minutes and remove the foil and the lid.  Bake for an additional 10 minutes or until the rice is golden and hot.  Cut into squares, serve hot as is, or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet red snapper,vegetable oil cooking spray,lemon peel,green bean,caraway seed,walnut
title: Fish With Lemon-Walnut Crumbed Green Beans #RSC
ingredients: 4 - 6 ounces tilapia fillets or 4 -6 ounces other firm flesh firm white fish fillets | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1 lb green beans or 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed | 1 1/2 tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh lemon peel | 1 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped walnuts ( optional ) | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped walnuts
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Spray a large nonstick skillet with a cooking spray.  Rinse & remove fish from package with a slotted spoon.  Spray the prepared skillet or skillet with cooking spray.  Add the green beans, lemon peel and caraway seeds.  Saute over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes or until tender crisp.  Remove from heat.  Sprinkle the walnuts over the fish & green beans.  Sprinkle with coarsely chopped walnuts.  Broat fish on a large platter.  Serve warm.

title: Cajun Tilapia
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 1/2 cup orange zest | 1 mango - peeled, seeded and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1/2 cup crushed ice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Place tilapia fillets in the prepared baking dish, and coat both sides with orange zest, then season with cajun seasoning.  Arrange mango slices over the fillets.  Pour crushed ice into the dish, and cover dish with aluminum foil.  Bake in the preheated oven 50 minutes, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

title: Beef and Onions With Mustard Sauce
ingredients: 2 medium yellow onion, halved, ends tipped, then split each half lengthwise into 3 pieces | 3 beef tenderloin steaks ( about 1 1/2 to 2 pounds total ) | 1/2 cup dry rice wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f place oil cascöd on a sheet of reynolds wrap aluminum foil and lightly spray foil with cooking spray.  Insert skewers in center cavity of each steak allowing two pieces per piece to extend about ½ inch above edges of foil.  Place steak on foil and roast for 15 to 18 minutes or until thermometer registers 160°f.  Turn steak and roast for 15 to 18 minutes or until thermometer registers 160°f transfer to cutting board and let sit for 5 minutes.  Slice steaks crosswise against grain of the meat and arrange on a platter.  Drizzle onions and mustard sauce over steak and serve.

title: Brandy Honey
ingredients: 5 tablespoons brandy | 1 cup liquid honey
instructions: Place honey and brandy in a small saucepan over medium low heat.  Cook, stirring constantly, until honey is reduced and begins to color, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and pour into mugs.  If desired, pour honey on top as a sauce.

title: Baked Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
ingredients: 1 small savoy cabbage | 2 cups chopped veal | 1 can chickpeas or ( 250 g ) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 6 ounces large shrimp, shelled and deveined | 1/4 cup sultana | 6 sheets cooked large shrimp, halved crossways
instructions: Preheat oven to 150°c or 120°c if fan forced.  Cut out the central core of the cabbage and discard.  Rinse out the core.  Core and set aside.  Wash and thinly slice the cabbage into about 6 - 8 even pieces.  Set aside.  Heat 3 tbsp oil in a frying pan add the veal, chickpeas, shrimp and sultanas and then cook over moderate heat until the meat is browned.  Divide cabbage between six pieces of baking paper and arrange at least 5, or more per serving, into a single layer on top of the meat.  Add 1 tbsp more oil to the meat and fry the parcels in batches until browned all over.  Transfer the meat to a heatproof plate and put aside.  Increase the heat, add 1 tbsp more oil and fry the parcels for 2 - 3 mins, then remove from the pan, drain on kitchen paper and set aside.  Continue with the rest of the meat and fry the sultanas again, then add to the meat.  Pour in the pan juices and bring to the boil, then put to the side.  Preheat the oven to 180°c bring a kettle of water to the boil and add the cabbage leaves, return to the boil and boil for 3 - 5 mins, or until just tender.  To serve, slice the rolls on the diagonal on a hot platter and spoon the rolls on top.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,zucchini,green enchilada sauce,chicken bouillon cube,red wine vinegar
title: Grilled Zucchini
ingredients: 2 zucchini, about 1 pound | 5 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 can green enchilada sauce
instructions: Cut zucchini in half lengthwise and cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices.  Toss well in a large bowl with pineapple juice, vinegar, and bouillon cubes.  Cover, and marinate 1 hour in the refrigerator.  Preheat grill for medium high heat.  Lightly oil grate.  Place zucchini on grate, cover and grill until zucchini is tender, about 4 minutes per side.  Top each zucchini slice with a spoonful of enchilada sauce.  If desired, wrap with a paper towel to absorb excess moisture.

title: Peppercorn Quesadilla
ingredients: 2 -3 scallions, chopped | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 1 cup cheddar cheese | pepper, to taste
instructions: Put 1/4 cup cheese in the center of a warm dinner plate.  Sprinkle with pepper to taste.  Add about 2 tablespoons minced scallions to top of the cheese.  Place 4 tablespoons minced minced scallions on top of the cheese.  Top with another 2tablespoons minced scallions.  Spread the remaining cheese on top and serve immediately.

title: Cream Cheese Sticks (Vegan-Friendly!)
ingredients: 12 ounces cream cheese, room temperature | 2 cups celery roots ( about 3 medium stalks ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom or 1/4 teaspoon cardamom powder
instructions: Finely grate or shred roots of celery, removing any outer leaves.  Mix together all ingredients, including cream cheese.  Serve at room temperature.  Variation, for a softer stick, add 1/2 tsp paprika to the cream cheese.

title: Pancetta Broccoli, Swiss Chard and Meatball Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces pancetta, finely diced | 12 ounces frozen chopped broccoli, thawed | 1 bunch swiss chard, about 6 cups coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons finely chopped small fresh chili peppers ( optional ) | 3 oranges | 1 tablespoon asafoetida powder, dissolved in 1/2 cup water | 1 lb lean ground meat | 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Cook pancetta in large skillet over medium heat, stirring often, until crispy.  Remove pancetta with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel lined plate.  Combine broccoli, swiss chard, chile, remaining pancetta, orange and asafoetida in a large bowl.  Using a long matchstick, carefully peel peel membrane from oranges.  Scrape orange peel into bowl.  Add meat, parsley and pancetta along with any liquid from pan.  Mix well and shape into 20 meatballs.  Cook on rack in 350f oven for 45 minutes until internal tempions reach 165f.  Makes 7 servings.

title: Easy Baked Ricotta Egg Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 cups fresh living ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons powdered instant vanilla essence | 2 eggs ( i prefer egg ) | 1 beef bouillon cube | 1/4 cup crushed ice
instructions: Beat all together and set aside.  Spread open faced sandwich tin like normal with a sprinkling of butter.  I recommend buttering them to the size of your sandwich tin.  Cut in half crossways and arrange a piece of cheese on each piece.  Pour boiling water into tin to 2cm above sandwich tin wall.  Bake in oven for 2 hours or until eggs are set.  Serve with your favourite condiments.  Good with warm milk and fruit compote.

title: Mexican Watermelon Salsa
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cubed fresh watermelon, with peels | 1/4 cup old el paso mild mexican chile powder
instructions: Pour 1/2 cup watermelon, chile powder and old el paso chili powder into a bowl.  Toss well.  Cover and refrigerate until serving time.

Random Ingredients: green chile,bamboo shoot,nonfat yogurt,apricot preserve,water,wheat flour,basil leaf,brown lentil
title: Brown Lentil Chapati (Indian Snack)
ingredients: 1 quart nonfat yogurt | 1 cup brown lentils | 1 1/4 cups brown water | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and sliced | 1 can chopped green chiles | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaves | 1 1/4 cups apricot preserves | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh green chile | 1 1/4 cups plain wheat flour
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together yogurt, lentils, browning, water, bamboo, green chilis, and basil leaves.  Divide mixture evenly between 2 round cake pans lined with wax paper, and press gently into pans.  Cover pans with wax paper, and refrigerate at least 1 hour and up to 2 days.  Spread jam over each serving to glaze.  To bake, preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Bake in the preheated oven 40 minutes, or until edges of cookies are crisp and browned.  Remove breads from pans, and cut into halves, or wedges, if desired.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,yellow bell pepper,vermicelli,red lentil,garlic,cannellini bean,pita bread,lemon
title: Pasta Fassoulia - Pita Bread
ingredients: 300 g dried chickpeas ( or other small dried chickpea ) | 200 g red lentils ( or other mixed sprouts, also known as `` chorizo '' ) or 200 g brown lentils ( or other mixed sprouts, also known as `` chorizo '' ) | 1 liter cannellini beans, well drained and rinsed | 4 -6 pita bread | 4 -6 cloves minced fresh garlic | 2 lemon slices | 1/4 cup diced yellow bell peppers or 1/4 cup red bell pepper
instructions: Place the chickpeas and lentils in a pot with water to cover and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 40 mins until the beans have opened and the broth is very tender.  Remove from the heat and allow to stand for 5 mins to cool a bit.  Strain the broth and allow to cool.  Once the beans are cool enough to handle, crush them with your hands and transfer to a food processor.  Add the chickpea mixture and the beans to a large skillet.  Add the cannellini beans, garlic and pepper.  Heat through for a couple minutes.  Toast pita until they become fragrant and puffed slightly.

title: Healthy Tarragon Toast
ingredients: 1 packet french bread | 250 g iceberg lettuce | 2 tablespoons iceberg lettuce, minced | 1/2 cup bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons icing sugar | 1 pinch tarragon
instructions: Slice bread in slices.  Tear lettuce leaves, add in sprouts and coat with icing sugar, sprinkle with tarragon.  Dip into egg wash and fry till golden.  Serve with cocktail sticks as a side dish and salad.

Random Ingredients: minestrone soup,prosciutto,vegetable stock powder,tahini,apricot,kielbasa,peanut butter,cilantro stem
title: Capellini Soup (Halibut)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces | 2 teaspoons vegetable stock powder | 1 can condensed minestrone soup | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 1 1/2 teaspoons tahini | 1 can condensed peanut butter ( half and half ) | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro stems | fresh cilantro stem ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Place the kielbasa in a large skillet, and brown over medium high heat, breaking into pieces with a spoon, about 10 minutes.  Drain off grease.  Sprinkle the vegetable stock powder over the kielbasa mixture and cook over medium high heat, stirring, about 5 to 7 minutes.  Spread the peanut butter onto a plate and microwave until thick and creamy, about 1 minute.  Stir in the tahini and serve hot.  Garnish with cilantro sprigs, if desired.

title: Hot Mexican Eggs
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1/4 cup salsa ( i use green chunky salsa with trader joe's brand ) | 1/4 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 1 lime ( cut into wedges )
instructions: Scoop out yolks of 1 lime, using a spoon to remove as many of the white shells as you can.  Then scoop out yolks and place with yolks back into serving bowl.  Fill the hollowed out egg halves with the egg mixture.  Sprinkle cheese on top and squeeze juice over the top.  Squeeze lime juice over everything.  Serve with warm tortillas as a garnish or serve with chips as a dip or to dip.

Random Ingredients: ouzo,self rising flour,sea salt black pepper,caper,red wine vinegar,vanilla extract,cardamom pod
title: Ouzo and Capers Greek Waffles
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour or 1 cup all-rising flour | 2 teaspoons ouzo | 1 -2 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 -2 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 4 cardamom pods, capsules not bruised | 1 -4 teaspoon capers, drained | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Sift the flour into a large bowl.  Add the ouzo, vanilla, vinegar, cardamom pods, capers, and pepper and stir until well combined.  Knead for 7 minutes using your hands.  Set aside for 20 minutes to rest.  Heat a waffle iron.  Scoop 1 tbsp batter onto the top of the waffle and lightly push and flip the waffle.  Cook until brown the bottom is dry and batter is bubbly, 3 - 4 minutes.

instructions:
Name:- ##
 Moroccan Beef Roast or Shish Kebabs 
 
## Ingredients ##
 2 kg beef chuck roast ( very lean ) | 1 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 teaspoon za'atar spice mix | 2 dried red chilies, soaked ( I find the chiles in the spice section of the grocery store ) | 1 tablespoon dried mint or 1 tablespoon dried mint leaves | 1 sheet puff pastry.  Roll the pastry to size of the tray on the table.  Cut each sheet into 3 squares.  Cut each square into 3 squares.  Using the blunt end of a sharp knife, slice the roast beef diagonally as you cut.  If the beef has sinew, remove the excess fat or the sharpness of the beef cubes.  Cut each square diagonally into 3 - 4 pieces.  Combine stock, soya sauce, za'atar powder, chillies, mint and 1 teaspoon of salt in a large dish / plastic bag.  Add the meat, seal well, then marinate in the fridge for 24 hours.  Preheat oven to 200c, 400f, gas mark cook beef for 30 mins in the oven for 30 minutes if you are in a baking type dish / pan / oven dish. Cover with aluminium foil if you want to keep the foil on the top, or as i do, bake for 25mins to brown top evenly.  Cut the puff pastry into quarters, and line the baking tray with pastry sheets.  Using a sharp knife, cut into diamond shapes / diamonds / diamonds / rectangles / triangles / triangles.  These squares should take about 20 25mins to cook, but can be cooked as before until the pastry is cooked / browned with brown colour.  Turn onto plates and then eat immediately.

title: Pepper Coconut Pancakes (Papaya Pancakes)
ingredients: 1 large ripe papaya | 1 tablespoon rice | 1 tablespoon sweet red pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup soymilk ( plain non dairy milk is ok ) | 1 teaspoon white flour | lemon wedge ( to garnish, optional )
instructions: Peel papaya and discard the seeds and membrane from it.  Cut in half lengthwise and scoop out the core and pulp, set aside.  Blend the papaya pulp, rice, sweet red pepper, soy milk and flour in a blender until smooth.  The mixture should be relatively thick but still fluid.  If it is too thin, add a little water to obtain the desired consistency.  Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium high heat. .  Add 1 tablespoon of batter and swirl to coat the pan.  When bubbles form, flip the pancake.  Cook on the other side for about 1 minute.  Garnish with lemon wedges.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: red bean,vanilla wafer,cocoa powder,olive,peanut butter,tomato puree,egg yolk
title: Quick Chocolate Balls with Red Beans
ingredients: 1/2 liter red beans, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1 egg yolk | 3 ounces peanut butter | 60 g crushed canned tomatoes in puree | 1 tablespoon vanilla wafer, finely crushed | 1 tablespoon olive, grated
instructions: Preheat a shallow ovenproof bowl and a baking tray on the stove.  Combine the beans, cocoa and egg yolk in a large bowl.  Use a fork to mix together well.  Press the mixture into a 20cm by 18cm slab pan with a removable base.  Chill slightly.  Meanwhile heat the peanut sauce, stirring every 2 minutes, for 2 - 3 minutes until softened.  Add the tomatoes and vanilla and combine well.  Scoop half of the chilli sauce into the bowl of a food processor.

title: Broiled Tomatoes and Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 1 loaf sourdough bread | canadian bacon ( sliced ) | 2 plum tomatoes | 1 lb cooked frozen mixed vegetables ( i like baby carrots or broccoli and cauliflower ) | 3/4 cup cashews, crushed ( or other nuts of choice )
instructions: Cut top off bread loaf and remove crusts and cut off bread with scissors or a loaf cutter.  Open loaf and cut a slit around the inside of loaf in desired pattern.  This will help keep the bread from falling off when broiling.  Spread canadian bacon slices evenly on bread and place under broiler until crispy and then remove from oven.  Spray broiler tray with cooking spray, then line with foil, making sure no foil around and over cuts into the bread when broiling.  Slice tomatoes into thick slices or small slices place the sliced tomatoes on foil lined broiler tray so the bread does not stick.  Broil until lightly browned turning as needed then slice into thin sliced or wedges.  Can be served warm or at room temperature i like to take this on a party, and then serve.  Any leftover slices are great served over mashed potatoes or rice as an appetizer with good french bunless you cut bread in half so there is a bread portion of bread to complete the meal as is.

title: Lemony Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 tablespoon prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 5 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Trim fat and tenderise meat.  Combine mustard, lemon zest, anchovy paste & salt in a glass dish.  Add meat.

Random Ingredients: hot red chili pepper,worcestershire sauce,apple cider,garbanzo bean,spinach
title: Spinach Chickpeas With Apple Cider
ingredients: 3 cups dried garbanzo beans ( i like chickpeas ) | 2 stalks spinach | salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 3 -4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 -3 large hot red chili peppers, such as fresno or 2 -3 large dried chipotle peppers, to taste and seeded
instructions: Soak beans in cold water in a large bowl overnight.  Preheat oven to 375°f rinse beans and drain well.  Combine beans, 1 tablespoon water, and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt in a heavy medium saucepan.  Add spinach, enough water to cover by 1 inch.  Bring to a boil, cover partially and boil 1 minute.  Drain well.  Transfer to a large bowl, add enough hot water to cover, and let stand 30 minutes.  Rinse, pat dry, and cut into quarters.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons water and 1 1/2 teaspoons salt.  Rub or oil lightly inside and out with a sharp knife.  Arrange spinach in a circle on an ovenproof plate.  Spread evenly with worcestershire sauce.  Sprinkle with chiles.  Bake, covered, 40 - 50 minutes or until beans are tender.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,vodka,heavy whipping cream,bow tie pasta
title: Bow Tie Chicken with Vodka Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup vodka | 1 pound boneless chicken breast, cubed | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 cups uncooked bow tie pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Combine vodka and chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Cover, and bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes.  Stir chicken, cream, and pasta together in a bowl.  Spoon the chicken mixture over the pasta.

title: Slow-Cooker Braised Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 8 lamb shanks
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f.  Lightly spray the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with oil.  Spread the pine nuts out on a dry towel lined surface to dry while oven is preheating.  Combine the cream and the reserved spice mix in a heavy bottomed pot over medium low heat, stirring constantly to blend.  Bring to a simmer and discard the spices.  Remove from the heat and pour 1/3 of the cream mixture into a bowl.  Using the back of a spoon, scrape as much of the cream sauce over the lamb shanks, reserving a small amount for dipping.

title: Artichokes on a Stick
ingredients: 14 artichoke hearts, shelled and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon ginger paste, grated ( see note )
instructions: Place the artichokes in mixing bowl of electric mixer.  Add the ginger paste.

title: Sweet Rice With Corn Niblets
ingredients: 400 g corn niblets | 1 tablespoon curry paste | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 teaspoons lime zest, finely grated | 1 tablespoon stock, coconut ( for dressing )
instructions: Boil the un boiled corn niblets in about 100 ml water and gently stir in the curry paste.  Once the corn has softened, peel off the skin and then drain the corn and return the broth to the pan.  Add the vinegar and lime zest to the pan, increase heat and bring the liquid to the boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer for a couple of minutes and then add the corn niblets and cook for a further couple of minutes until they are tender and the broth reduces a little.  Serve hot with plain sticky rice.

title: Dale's Easy  Sautéed Pork & Lentils
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils | 200 g pork ( in cubes ) | 400 g cherry tomatoes or 400 g grape tomatoes
instructions: Wash and drain lentils into a colander.  Save 2 tbsp of water and pour into a heavy based pan/sauté pan/saucepan with a lid add the chopped pork.  Keep the heat high but don't let the pan or it will boil over.  Meanwhile, cut the tomatoes or grape tomatoes in half and add to the simmering pork/lemon mixture.  Keep frying the pork while the lentils are cooking.  Once the pork has turned into a golden brown color, add the lentils and tomatoes and continue frying until the lentils are softened.

Random Ingredients: parsley,cornstarch,spinach,mint leaf,golden raisin,dijon mustard,lemon pudding mix
title: Spinach and Raisins Dressing with Lemon Pudding
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry | 1 1/2 cups golden raisins, halved | 1 box lemon pudding mix | 1/4 cup cornstarch | 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard
instructions: Mix spinach, raisins, pudding mix, cornstarch, parsley, mint and mustard together.  Cover and refrigerate 12 hours or overnight.  Just before serving, whisk together with reserved dressing.

Random Ingredients: anchovy paste,mango chutney,garlic paste,cream tartar,spanish onion,salad leaf
title: Gourmet Mango & Anchovy Dip
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cream of tartar ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 1 large ripe mango chutney | 1/2 large spanish onion, chopped | salad leaves
instructions: Stir the cream of tartar and garlic paste with the anchovy paste until well combined.  Peel, seed and coarsely chop the mango chutney.  Finely chop the onion and add to the cream of tartar.  Add the salad leaves to taste and stir well just before serving.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,white onion,grain white rice,worcestershire sauce
title: Baked Rice and Onions
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 large sweet white onion, cut into 1 1/2 x 2 inch pieces | 1 medium green pepper, cut into 1 1/2 x 2 inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine the rice, worcestershire sauce and onion in a bowl.  Transfer the mixture to an 11x7 inch glass baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: orange,ginger ale,tomato green chile pepper,farfalle pasta,meat substitute,chicken,icing sugar,poblano chile
title: Pumpkin Sausage Rollatini
ingredients: 1 box farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 1/2 cups chicken fat free sausage, browned ( see note ) | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can pumpkin puree, not pumpkin pie filling | 8 ounces frozen meat substitute | 1 orange, zested and juiced | 2 poblano chiles, roasted, seeded and cut into long strips | icing sugar ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  Brown and crumble sausage.  Drain all but 1 - 2 tablespoons of grease from skillet, reserving 1/2 cup.  Brown sausage in skillet on low for 3 - 5 minutes or until golden.  Drain and set aside.  Heat 1/2 cup of oil in skillet.  Add pumpkin, meat substitute and orange zest and 1/2 cup of orange juice, stirring well.  Drain meat mixture into sausage and pumpkin mixture.  Simmer about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until heated through.  Stir in chopped poblano strips.  If using, sprinkle with icing sugar to serve.

Random Ingredients: cocoa,french bread,pesto sauce,dijon mustard,pineapple chunk,corn oil,heavy cream,chunky salsa
title: Pesto Fondue
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1 inch cubes | pesto sauce, mix | 1 cup chunky salsa | 2 teaspoons dijon-style mustard | 1/2 cup heavy cream | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 cup drained and crushed pineapple chunk
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Pour bread cubes in and marinate the bread cubes in the pesto to soften.  Dip bread cubes in fondue to coat bread with the fondue.  Heat cream and salsa together in a large skillet or sauce pan until the mixture just begins to simmer.  Stir in mustard and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is light brown and fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Stir in the cream/salsa mixture, pineapple, and reserved pesto mixture.

Random Ingredients: white pepper powder,cream mushroom soup,seasoning salt,sage,beef bouillon powder
title: Patsy's Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons beef bouillon powder | 1 soup can condensed cream of mushroom soup | seasoning salt to taste | white pepper powder to taste | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Place the cubed meat in a saucepan with a lid, and pour in soup and water.  Bring to a simmer over medium high heat, stirring frequently.  Season with seasoning salt, white pepper powder, and sage.  Bring to a simmer, and then let simmer for 5 minutes.  Serve over noodles, rice, or mashed potatoes, if desired.

title: Beer and Chocolate Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 pound dry penne | 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped | 1/4 cup beer | 1/4 cup chilled whipping cream | 1/4 cup chilled whipping cream | 2 tablespoons vinegar

title: Easy Meatball Quesadillas

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.

Mrs.
    - Dash Barbecue Fajita Cookies

instructions: Preheat grill.  Combine all ingredients except for brandy in large bowl.  Mix well.  Cut cookie dough into 6 pieces.  Roll each piece into a flat circle.  Grill on grill for 3 minutes each side.  Serve with desired toppings.

title: The Real Deal Asian Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 4 large free range egg whites | 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter | 12 ounces ground pork | 1 tablespoon korean chili flakes | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Scramble egg whites in a large bowl.  Set aside.  Using a wire whisk, add half the peanut and half the chili flakes with the egg.  Blend and set aside.  Add remaining peanut, chili, and sundried tomato to the bowl remaining in the bowl.  Gently fold.  Heat two tablespoons of oil in a non stick frypan over high.

title: Artichoke (Artichoke and Anchovy) Jam
ingredients: 1 lb artichoke, cleaned | 4 green cardamom pods
instructions: Cut the artichokes in quarters and boil them in water with cardamom pods until they are soft but not too mushy.  When all have been boiled add them and continue boiling till they are tender again.  Take out the cardamom pods and set them aside for garnish.  Place one or two ounces of the artichoke liquid into a food processor, add 5 - 6 ounces of anchovies and process till they make a smooth paste adding the reserved artichoke liquid if it dries out too much.  Pour this paste into a sterilized jam jars and seal and store in a dark or cool place.

title: Lamb Cannelloni
ingredients: 6 ounces lasagna noodles | 2 medium scallions, chopped | 1 boneless loin lamb | herbs
instructions: Place the salt into a large pan with 200ml water and bring to the boil.  Add in the lasagna, stir well, cover the pan and cook the lasagna for 3 to 4 minutes.  Take the lasagna off the heat and leave for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, using a small sharp knife, cut the lamb into very thin slices.  When the lamb has been cooked and the lasagna has cooled completely, slice it in half lengthways and set aside.  Pre heat your oven to 190c/fan170c/gas lay the lasagna slices on a tray or baking tray.  Place under the grill until golden, 3 to 5 minutes.  Drain the lasagna, then lay the lamb pieces on top and season to taste.  Sprinkle with a little herbs and drizzle over the remaining olive oil.  Place in your preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese has melted and the lamb is hot and cooked through.

title: Challah Melt Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ground pecan halves | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg | 1/4 cup texas toast thick bread, crusts removed | 1 1/2 tablespoons frozen shopped ginger, thawed, drained and thinly sliced | 3/4 1/2 tablespoon instant tea ( optional ) or 3/4 tablespoon dry instant coffee ( optional )
instructions: Combine pecans, cinnamon and nutmeg in a small bowl.  Spread texas toast evenly with pecan mixture.  Top with ginger slices and pour over tea/pecan mixture.  Add more nuts if desired.  Cut into four wedges.

title: Cholent
ingredients: 1 lb dry pinto beans | 2 cans sauerkraut | freshly ground pepper, to taste | 8 fresh mint leaves | 1 bunch fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Sort beans, wash well.  In a large pot add beans with all other ingredients except mushrooms.  Bring to boil, cover and reduce heat.  Simmer over low heat 10 - 15 minutes or until rinsed, stirring occasionally.

title: Simple Shortbread
ingredients: 4 ounces flour | 1 egg, beaten well
instructions: Sift the flour and the sugar into a bowl or pie plate.  Make a hole in the centre and break the egg into it.  Add just enough flour to form a smooth paste.  Turn mixture into a bowl cover and set aside to rest for 10 - 12 hours.  Press into the greased and floured pan.  Turn the bread over as soon as it is set, allow the excess to run off.  Place in the fridge again until cool.  Cut into bars or squares.

title: Pork and Pine Nut Fajitas
ingredients: 1 lean boneless pork roast | 1/4 cup flour tortillas, heated in a pan and tortillas heated until light brown, split | 8 -10 peri-peri, fresh | 1 package sliced fresh spinach leaves, washed and chopped, packed | 1 tablespoon pine nuts, lightly toasted | 1 teaspoon fresh chili ( minced, roasted, or jalapeno seeded, or minced, to taste )
instructions: Place pork roast in a large skillet.  Cover and cook over high heat approximately 10 minutes or until nicely browned.  Turn meat.

title: Sweet and Sour Pork Chops
ingredients: 4 pork chops, trimmed | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 8 -10 fresh mushrooms, cleaned | 1 cup fresh strawberries, washed and finely sliced | 1/2 cup fresh purple cherries, sliced | 1/4 cup fresh pineapple, cut into four wedges | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Toast raisins in a frying pan.  Heat oil in a fry pan.  Brown the chops.  Remove chops to a warm serving platter.  Add raisins to oil in pan, then cook quickly over medium heat or until lightly browned.  Remove to serving platter.  Add mushrooms to oil and sauté until lightly browned, then add the strawberries and cherries, stir until just glazed.  Return chops to pan.  Add vinegar and heat through.  Pour over chops.  Serve immediately.

title: Spiced Sweet Spaghetti
ingredients: 500 g spaghetti | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 3 tablespoons mango chutney | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chili oil ( to taste )
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.  Meanwhile, combine curry powder, chutney and mango chutney in a small bowl.  Add in chopped cilantro leaves.  Stir until combined well.  Drain spaghetti and place on a large serving plate.  Pour hot curry noodle mixture over and garnish with cherry tomatoes, chopped mango chutney if desired.

title: Easy Tiramisu
ingredients: 250 g ladyfingers | 2 cans red enchilada sauce | 1 - 1 1/2 cup red enchilada sauce ( depending on desired thickness )
instructions: Place ladyfingers and one can of red enchilada sauce in a flat baking dish.  Top with remaining half can of red and green enchilada sauces.  Cover with foil and refrigerate for 30 45min.

Random Ingredients: navy bean,seasoning salt,lime juice zest,bicarbonate soda,coriander seed,self rising flour,lettuce leaf,beef stock
title: Bakinwell's Famous Refried Beans
ingredients: 600 g dried navy beans | 2 1/2 cups beef stock | 1 lime, juice and zest of ( use the grated peel of 1 lime ) | 3 1/2 cups unbleached self-rising flour | 3/4 cup chopped coriander seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning salt or 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Place the beans in a pan, cover with salted cold water and bring to the boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer until just tender, about 1 hour.  Drain and cool under running water.  Peel away any grit from the beans and place on a lightly floured surface.  Knead the flour and coriander seeds in a pestle and mortar or with a sharp knife.  Add the zest, lime juice and stock and stir to combine.  Mix in the cooled beans and refrigerate for about an hour or longer.  Preheat the oven to 180c/360°f.  In a frying pan cook the coriander seeds in half the bacon fat until they are aromatic and beginning to darken slightly.  Add the sodden beans and cook for a few minutes, until heated through.  Meanwhile, put the flour and seasoning salt in a bowl.  Stir in the pepper and ginger and mix well.  Put a large blob of the bean mixture and some of the bean mix into your palm and spread over the base of a large ovenproof dish.  Make a hollow in the centre of the filling by smoothing it out flat on your finger.  Make another hollow with the beans and the remaining filling.  Sprinkle over some chopped coriander.

title: Courgettes - Zucchini
ingredients: 2 lbs courgettes, well trimmed | 3 inches fresh lemon juice, about 2 lemons
instructions: Place the courgettes in a large, heavy stewing saucepan.  Pour over enough hot water to cover by 2 inches.  Cover with a tight fitting lid and boil gently for 5 - 7 minutes.  Remove from heat and, when cool enough to handle, peel the stalks gently off the outer green skins with a vegetable peeler.  Scrape out the flesh and reserve it.  Slice thinly and arrange in a large, pale ovenproof dish.  Add the lemon juice and bring to the boil over moderate heat, stirring well.  Pour over the vegetables and simmer gently for about 30 minutes, or until they are tender and beginning to soften.  Serve warm.

title:
Simple Bacon Wrapped in Prosciutto.

ingredients: 1 ham hush | 1 -2 ounce prosciutto

title: Lemon Rice Balls (Arroz Doce)

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, cocoa, rice, bay leaves and lemon.  Place the mixture onto a piece of plastic wrap or waxed paper and roll into 1 inch balls.  Place the balls on a lined baking sheet.  Refrigerate overnight.  Remove from the fridge about 1 hour before serving.  Store in the fridge until ready to serve.

instructions: Pre heat oven to 190°c.  Mix bicarb salt and baking powder.  Use this to brush the roast.  Place roast fat in small roasting dish or roasting tray that has been coated in spray oil.  Bake for approximately 2 hours or until brown and crisp.  Slice and serve with salad.  You can also serve this as a snack with breads or toast.

title: Alsatian-Style Savory Stuffed Pork

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Using 2 forks, mix together pork, beef, mayonnaise, cinnamon, lemon juice and almonds milk until combined well together. Place stuffed pork on an oven safe baking dish.  Bake for 30 minutes or until stuffing is warm and bread is browned.

title: Vegan Cheese Fondue

instructions: Blend all the ingredients in a food processor until smooth.  Serve in a bowl and enjoy.

title: Pasta Dessert

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine bamboo shoots and black pepper.

instructions: Place chili in blender or food processor and puree.  Add chile puree, ground rose water, and half of the tomato or vegetable juice.  Blend until smooth.  Add remaining tomato/vegetable juice and blend again.  Pour into glass dish and chill 1 hour or for up to 6 days.

Heat 2 to 3 inches of oil to 375 degrees f in a deep fryer or large heavy skillet.  Carefully slide the pizzas into the hot oil, working in batches if necessary to thin them out.  Remove when deep fryer is very hot, and drain on paper towels.  Serve warm.

instructions: Mix the cake mix with the ground pork and chorizo.  Pat into a 9 x 13 pan and bake at 300 degrees for approximately 40 minutes. Grill the beef and sandwich rolls, brushing on some of the mayonnaise and brushing with the remaining mayonnaise.  Serve hot with vegetables and salad.

instructions: Put a small amount of olive oil in a large tagine.  Add chicken, picante sauce, lentils, honey, garlic and salt and pepper and toss to distribute.  Cover and simmer on low heat, stirring occasionally, stirring occasionally until chicken is cooked through, approximately 45 minutes.

I do this alot the day before & it will all come together very good.

title: Grilled Garlic French Toast

Preheat a griddle or griddle over moderate heat.  Brush the top side of the bread slices with egg mixture and cook the slices, turning, until toasted on one side and golden on the other, about 3 minutes.  Serve immediately.

instructions: Heat the cream in a large pan over medium high heat.  Cook and stir the chicken bouillon until it has dissolved.  Add the cardamom pods to the cream and pour into the soup. title: Pistachio D'Amandes' Pouchards

instructions: If using pistachios, grind them in a heavy skillet over moderate heat until they are a shade darker and just beginning to brown around the edges but still a few shades darker, about 5 minutes. ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 2 stalks celery & leaves, minced | 6 tablespoons chopped canned chipotle peppers | 8 ounces cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 cup drained zucchini, cut into 1/2 inch chunks | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 16 ounces fresh frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: In heavy skillet, cook ground beef, celery and chipotle peppers over medium heat 4 - 5 minutes or until no longer pink, stirring to crumble.

title: Sugar Snap Chili Sauce
ingredients: 1 -2 dried red hot chili peppers | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 3/4 cup stock or 3/4 cup broth
instructions: Soak chili peppers in hot water for 15 minutes.  Drain.  Rinse with hot water until the water is clear.  Remove the stems and seeds.  Slice the chili peppers open, remove the seeds, and throw away the stems.  Add the chilies to your blender with the broth and puree to a paste.  This sauce will be used on your buns when serving.

title: Crunchy Pumpkin Seeds Pasta Salad (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked medium shell pasta | 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds | 1 egg noodles, cooked, drained | 1 cup shredded low fat low-fat fat fromage frais | 1 cup low-fat fromage frais | 1/3 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Place all ingredients except for fromage frais and vinegar in a large salad bowl.  Place in fridge until ready to serve and serve cold.

Random Ingredients: cashew,tiger shrimp,rice,hoisin sauce,romaine lettuce heart,arborio rice
title: Pearl Shrimp Wraps for 2
ingredients: 1/2 lb raw tiger shrimp, peeled, shelled and deveined | 4 cups arborio rice or 4 cups carnaroli rice | 1/3 cup light hoisin sauce | 1 tablespoon cashews | 1 romaine lettuce hearts or 1 red lettuce heart | cooked rice ( optional )
instructions: Soak shrimp in water for 10 minutes.  Drain.  Set aside.  Place rice, hoisin sauce and cashews in a rice cooker, food processor, or large mixing bowl.  Process until very smooth.  Spoon rice mixture into lettuce leaf or hearts.  Fold in shrimp, if using.

title: Potato and Meat Tacos
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 2 cups shredded lettuce | 3 lbs cooked meat ( or poultry )
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1/2 inch slices.  Heat oil in a frying pan.  Fry potatoes until lightly browned.  Put in serving dish.  Cover with lettuce and meat, dividing evenly.  Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Mung Beans - Mung Beans and Cheese in Crust
ingredients: 3 cups mung beans | juice | 8 -10 ounces strong cheese, grated ( optional )
instructions: Wash the mung beans and rinse them completely. .  If they are dirty, put them in a colander and drain for a while until the water becomes clear again.  The best way to remove the dirt is to leave them over night.  Drain.  If you would like a milder consistency, put the cheese in a small bowl, cover with plastic wrap and put in the oven at 350 for 30 min, stirring every 5 minutes.  Check after 5 min when the cheese is melted and the beans and mash with a potato masher.  If you want your beans more chunky, add a bit of milk as a paste.

Random Ingredients: japanese curry roux,oyster,water tuna,ginger garlic paste
title: Paleo (Tuna) and Oyster Stew
ingredients: 1 pound water-packed tuna, cut into 1 inch pieces | 3 tablespoons water-packed oyster | 1 tablespoon japanese curry roux | 1 teaspoon minced fresh ginger garlic paste
instructions: Combine tuna and water in a bowl and stir together.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Drain liquid.  Place oysters and curry roux in a saucepan, and place over high heat.  Cook and stir until the roux is very dark and smells like burned coffee, about 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in ginger.  Serve immediately.

title: Basic Shortbread
ingredients: 450 g plain flour | 450 g caster sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c/375°f.  Place the flour on a large board and make a well in the middle.  Rub the sugar into the flour until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Add a little more flour then 1 tbsp at a time until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs.  Turn the dough out onto a floured board and knead lightly.  Cut away all the sides of the dough, and knead for 3 or 4 minutes until the mix resembles breadcrumb consistency.  Line a large baking tray with baking paper.  Turn dough onto a floured board, and knead again lightly.  Use a rolling pin to roll out the dough until fairly thin.  Use cookie cutters to cut the dough into shapes and place on the tray.  Use a metal spoon to press down the top and edges of each round.  Bake the shortbread on the middle rack of the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until pale golden.  Remove from the oven and set aside to cool for about 10 minutes.  Remove the shortbread and allow to cool.  Once cooled, cut out and place on wire rack and store in airtight container.  When cool, these will keep for up to 3 days at room temperature.

title: Chef's Mediterranean Cream Dessert
ingredients: 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/3 cup sour cream | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/3 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced
instructions: In a blender or food processor combine the parmesan cheese, sour cream, and vanilla.  Beat until smooth.  Add olives and pulse until the mixture comes together.  Transfer mixture into bowl, cover, and chill for several hours or overnight to blend flavors.  Serve over ice cubes, topped with a bit of extra parmesan cheese if desired.

title: French Bread and Butter Snack Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 tablespoons applesauce | 3 teaspoons dried shiitake mushrooms | 2 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1 1/4 cups fine dry bread crumbs ( preferably whole wheat ) | 4 medium fresh bread, loaves | 2/3 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1 1/4 lbs mixed dried fruit, picked over | 5 tablespoons golden raisins
instructions: Heat oven to 450 fahrenheit degrees.  To make the butter.  Place all ingredients into a pan and bring slowly to a boil.  Cook 2 minutes until the butter just starts to bubble.  Remove from heat.  Let cool and pour to a resealable container.  Cool until warm but not solid.  To make sandwiches.  Place 4 slices of bread on a lightly greased baking sheet.  Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon each of the dried fruit and raisins.  Dot each slice with 1 tablespoon of butter.

title: Irish Boiled Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs rump roast, cut into 3 pieces | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the lemon juice, ground cloves and ground cloves.  Brush a roasting pan with the lemon juice mixture and set aside.  Place the roast pieces, fat side down, in the pan, fat side up, and place pan in the oven.  Bake for 1 hour at 275 degrees f, basting occasionally with drippings from the pan.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,anise seed,picante sauce,puff pastry,coconut cream,green bell pepper,virgin olive oil,kidney bean
title: Solo Plantation Empanadas
ingredients: 4 large puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 1 cup green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 cup shredded coconut cream | 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Lay the pastry out and cut 4 circles out and place on the prepared sheet.  Using the back of a teaspoon, make small depressions in the centre of each circle so that they can stand upright.  Bake in the oven for 10 minutes or until golden.  Allow to cool then transfer to a container.  Drain well and keep in the fridge.  Combine beans, picante sauce, bell pepper, coconut cream, lime juice, anise seeds and olive oil in a bowl.  Set aside.  Place the cooled pastry circles onto a flat surface and roll them out until nearly paper thin.  Place on a baking sheet and spoon filling into each empanada and roll to form a cigar shape.  Place each empanada on the baking paper.  Brush the edges with some of the bean/picante sauce mixture.  Cook in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, until golden.  Remove from oven, cut in half and serve warm.

title: Birds of aaa (Belizean Hot Chocolate)
ingredients:
12 dried chile oil ( e.
    -g.
    - spirot ) | 8 cups chicken broth | 14 whole cloves | 5 small bay leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a 4 quart saucepan, combine chile oil, chicken broth and the bay leaves.  Bring the mixture to boil over medium high heat.  Reduce heat and simmer, skimming surface foam as needed for about 10 to 15 minutes.  Discard bay leaves and cloves.  Let mixture cool, skim off fat and refrigerate overnight.

title: Baked Fish Balls (Vietnamese)
ingredients: 1 kg chuck or 1 kg stewing veal | 400 300 icing sugar ( more or less ) or 6 tablespoons icing sugar ( less or less ) | 1/4 cup fish sauce ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed pepper flakes | 200 ml fat-free half-and-half or 200 ml light cream
instructions: Cut meat into small chunks.  Mix with a little oil, fish sauce, pepper flakes.  Put into a large bowl or lidded jar.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave in a cool place for 30 minutes for the flavours to develop.  Heat oven to 180°c/350°f.  Line a baking tray with foil, grease with butter, then line with baking paper.  Stir 1 tbsp of icing sugar into half & half lightly and pour evenly onto tray.  Sprinkle over meat.  Bake in oven for 45 - 50 minutes until firm.  Let cool slightly before turning out onto platter.  Tip, i make my meat balls the night before and leave them to rest before cooking in the oven too.

title: Horseradish Canapes
ingredients: 1/2 cup thickened cream or 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 2 -3 tablespoons horseradish | 1 tablespoon sweet pickled jalapeno, with seeds, finely diced | 2 tablespoons pickled horseradish, extra | 1 tablespoon low-fat chicken stock | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar
instructions: Blend the cream or sour cream, jalapenos, horseradish, sweet pickled jalapenos, pickled horseradish, chicken stock and vanilla sugar in a food processor until smooth.  Cover the mixture and chill for several hours or overnight.  Serve chilled.

title: Easy Thai-Style Omelette
ingredients: 4 eggs | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce ( nam pla )
instructions: Heat omelette pan and spray with cooking spray.  Crack an egg, make a circle, poke an open egg, spread it out into an omelette shape place in middle of omelette circle.  Let uncooked egg run around the edges of omelette, it will cook quickly.  Cook for two minutes, omelette is ready.

title: Halloumi Quesadip (Haloumi Cheese Skewers)
ingredients: 12 pieces halloumi cheese | 1 fresh jalapeno pepper ( or more )
instructions: Cut each half into 6 pieces and cut a slit down one side.  Make sure the cut sides are in so the cheese stays flat.  Soak the halloumi in cold water for at least 45 minutes.  Drain, squeeze out excess water, and slice into small chunks.  Arrange on a metal plate in a circle.  Sprinkle with a small amount of jalapeño or other seasoning.  Grill a few minutes, turning once, until heated through and the cheese starts to brown.

title: Chinese Black Bean Soup
ingredients:
1 lb black beans | 3/8 cup basil leaves, chinese ( or fresh if you have them.
    - ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger, fresh, grated | 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger | sausages, sliced | fresh basil, chinese ( optional )
instructions: Cook beans until soft and mushy.  Place all other ingredients in food chopper or processor & puree until smooth.  Add water as needed.

title: Roasted Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup salsa ( mild or medium-hot ) | 1/4 cup virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon cumin
instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry the jar of salsa.  Heat up the olive oil in a large saute pan while the oil is heating.  Add cumin to taste.  Just before salsa is ready add to the olive oil and heat thoroughly.  Pour salsa onto a dish towel.  Add oil on top and enjoy.

title: Maraschino Jelly - Kolaches
ingredients: 6 ounces cream cheese | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained
instructions: Heat cream cheese until soft.  Fold in 1 package of maraschino cherries.  Roll jelly in cherry molds until coated.

title: Peppered Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef tenderloin, about 1-1/2 inches thick, trimmed, cut crosswise into 1/3 inch slices | 1 1/2 - 2 cups panko breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup parmigiano, grated | 3 tablespoons apple juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray.  Mix panko with parmigiano and spread onto beef slices.  Place beef on cookie sheet.  Brush with apple juice.  Put in oven and bake for about 15 minutes, brushing occasionally with panko mixture.  Turn after 15 minutes and bake for another 5 minutes, brushing frequently with remaining panko mixture, or until internal temperature reaches 130 degrees.  Cover loosely with foil and let stand for 5 - 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Oriental Slaw
ingredients: 1 cup coleslaw dressing | 1 teaspoon ground anise
instructions: Combine coleslaw dressing and anise.

Random Ingredients: steak,cabbage,cornmeal,white mushroom,bell pepper,potato starch,red chili pepper,celery
title: Stove Top Beef & Vegetable Deep-Fried
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb piece steaks | 1 package white mushroom | 3 packages potatoes starch mixed with 1 cup water | 1/4 cup cornmeal | 3 tablespoons ground red chili pepper | 1/4 cup celery, minced ( optional ) | 1 package cabbage, finely shredded | 1 cup bell pepper, chopped
instructions: To make sauce, peel mushrooms and remove woody parts and coarsely chop.  Place mushrooms in large pot with water.  Bring to boiling.

title: Roasted Capsicum Balls
ingredients: 1 red capsicum, seeded and finely chopped | 75 g flour ( plain or gluten-free ) | 1 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/3 cup falafel, powder ( all purpose )
instructions: Preheat oven to c.  Line baking tray with non stick baking paper.  Toss capsicum with flour, mix well.  Shape half the mixture into balls.  Flatten slightly, and place on baking tray.  Mix oats with falafel powder, mix well and spread evenly over capsicum balls.  Bake in oven for about 15 minutes, or until topping is golden.

title: Quick Chinese Tea
ingredients: 1 cup instant rice | 2 tablespoons brown rice | 1/4 ounce tea leaves or 1/4 ounce regular green tea leaves | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1/2 ounce pine nuts | cooking onion | peanuts ( optional ) or peanuts ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in a non metallic container.  To serve, add to rice mixture along with nuts/nuts.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,sausage,rice noodle,cauliflower,fish,lime juice,green grape,black olive
title: Sausage & Cauliflower Noodles (21 Day Wonder Diet : Day 19)
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, sliced into 1cm pieces | 2 ounces dried rice noodles ( i prefer jasmine ) | 1/4 cup fish, minced ( recommended -- neil perry ) | 75 g cooked pork sausages | 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds ( toasted ) | 1 tablespoon black olives, sliced | 1 teaspoon lime juice ( to taste ) | 1 green grape, for garnish
instructions: Boil the cauliflower in salted water for 5 mins or until tender.  Drain and chill until cold.  Cook the rice noodles.  Drain and put to one side.  Meanwhile, heat a non stick frying pan over a medium heat.  Add the sausages, black sesame seeds and olives and cook for 2 mins or until lightly coloured.  Drain the rice noodles and add to sausages and stir to combine.  Heat the grill pan and spray with oil.  To serve, line the plates with the rice noodles, then place sausages and cauliflower on top.

title: Beef Stew With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 - 1 lb stewing beef, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup oyster sauce ( to taste ) | 3 -4 fennel bulbs, cut into 1-inch slices | 1 can or bottle irish stout beer ( such as guinness )
instructions: Add beer to the pan.  Add beef cubes in batches if necessary and brown lightly on all sides.  Add 1/2 cup oyster sauce.  Simmer for approximately 5 minutes.  Serve hot over egg noodles or rice, or noodles.

title: Lemon Mint Jelly Sticks
ingredients: 8 medium dried hot green chili peppers, stems removed | 1/2 cup chicken broth | 8 teaspoons mint jelly | 8 teaspoons cornstarch dissolved in 1/2 cup boiling water | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, crushed | 2 -3 lemons, cut into slices
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle crush the chilies, keeping them smooth.  In a small bowl combine the chicken broth, mint jelly and cornstarch mixture.  Add the crushed coriander seeds and stir until well combined.  Spoon the mixture into 1 inch wide, long sticks of lemon peel.  Refrigerate until set, 3 - 4 hours.  Drain the remaining marinade.

title: Mangoes and Feta Stuffed Buns
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dry active yeast | 1 3/4 cups plain flour, plus extra for kneading | 1 cup finely minced mango | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1 cup shredded monterey jack pepper cheese | 12 slices mozzarella cheese ( i like to use fresh mozzarella for mine ) | 1 cup crushed maraschino cherry ( i like a mixture of red currants and blueberries for a nice burst of fruit punch ) | 1 cup finely minced fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Mix the yeast with a small cup warm water in a large bowl.  Sift the flour into a measuring cup, add 2 to 3 tablespoons of the mango liqueur and whisk in until you get a soft dough that can be gathered into a ball.  If the dough has thickened, add more flour.  If it doesn, add more liqueur and a bit of flour.  If it has thinned off too much, add a little water.  Let it rest for about 5 minutes.  If it has thickened, add a little more flour.  Put an oven rack in the middle and preheat the oven to 400°f mix the cheeses in a bowl.  Pour enough flour into a measuring cup to measure 2 cups.  Mix the herbs into the bread, add more if desired.  Stir in the yeast into the bread.  Turn out on a lightly floured surface and knead the mixture until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes.  Roll out the dough until about 1/4 inch thick.  Using a cutter, cut out 2 x12 inch strips and arrange them close together on a baking sheet.  Bake for about 10 minutes until firm.  Brush the tops with some melted cheese and bake for about 5 minutes more until golden for texture and color.  Allow to cool for at least 30 minutes before eating the buns.

Random Ingredients: alfalfa sprout,molasses,sun tomato,serrano pepper,cake flour,garlic juice,bean
title: Sun Dried Tomato Dessert

instructions: Add all ingredients in a medium size skillet and heat until bubbly and slightly thickened.  You can even put as thick as you like it.  You can even cook this over low heat, or as is.  But not until warm.  Garnish with fresh toppings or enjoy by placing all ingredients together in a nice serving bowl or plate.  Enjoy.

title: Pickled Watermelon With Spaghetti

    - sugar if you prefer's taste ) | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon rice wine or 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 lb spaghetti
instructions: Rinse watermelon and cut in slices.  Arrange them on a platter or in a container with plastic wrap or a lid.  Sprinkle with bouillon, vinegar and rice wine.  Cover the container with plastic wrap.  Chill for at least 4 hours and up to 3 days.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add spaghetti and cook for 10 minutes.  Drain and toss with liquid.  Serve warm.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.

title: Taco Pasta and Figs
ingredients: 1/2 lb white pearl onion | 1 lb fresh fig, sliced | 2 tablespoons lemon peel, grated | 1/4 cup low-sodium taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 12 ounces beer | 12 ounces rigatoni pasta | 2 ounces hot plain white pearl onions
instructions: Dice all ingrdients.  Bring a large pot of water and salt to a boil.  Add pasta and cook until al dente.  Drain pasta.  Add onions and pearl onions to drained pasta.  Add 1 cup dressing, and heat gently, allowing to warm through.  Pour remaining dressing over pasta and serve on warmed plates.

title: Crunchy Pasta Bake
ingredients: 2 cups broken wheat bread | 8 ounces cream cheese frosting | 8 ounces semishell pasta | 1/2 cup red wine | 1/2 cup chili paste or hot sauce | 1 cup mild cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Mix pasta, red wine, and chili paste.  Place bread on ungreased cookie sheet.  Top with cream cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with cheddar cheese.  Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Cheddar Cheese Mash
ingredients: 1 small potato ( yukon golds or yukon gold ) | 3 tablespoons butter | 1 cup grated aged sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Wash potato well.  Slice potato 1/4 inch thickness.  Boil until tender.  Drain potato in a sieve.  Place potato in a mixing bowl.  Melt the butter in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat.  When butter has foamed over medium heat, add potato.  Sprinkle with cheese and cook until heated through.  Note, you can add the cheese right before the potatoes are fully cooked, stirring after about 4 minutes.

title: Buttered Lime Cake With Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 tablespoon garam masala | 2 1/2 cups half-and-half | 4 firm-ripe butter cakes, sliced 1/4-in to 1 1/2-in thick | 2 limes, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  In a small bowl, combine garam masala and half the cream and chill while preparing layers.  Place sliced slices of buttercake on a large baking sheet, in two rows.  Sprinkle generously with half the garam masala and remaining cream and spread 1/4 to 1 1/2 cup of the cream over each.  Press lime slices into cream and bake until golden at the edges, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Let cool for 3 minutes before moving onto racks, with a spatula to help them catch.

title: Pork Chops and Broth
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fat free evaporated skim milk | 2 teaspoons nonfat dry milk | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme sprigs | 4 low fat pork loin chops, trimmed
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the fat free evaporated milk, dry milk, and thyme sprigs.  Place the pork chops in the pan, and turn to coat both sides with the mixture.  Cover the pan loosely and refrigerate 2 hours, turning the chops after 4 hours.  Preheat the broiler for high.  Remove chops from the dish, and discard any excess marinade.  Spray a broiler safe pan with nonstick cooking spray, and pour in the broth mixture.  Place the pan on the preheated broiler and broil 5 minutes, basting with pan juices.  Cook 5 minutes more, or until chops are tender and no pink remains.

instructions: Place the watermelon cubes in a large bowl and add boiling water to cover.  Drain well and set aside to chill for 1 - 2 hours.  Meanwhile, mix together the rest of the ingredients in a jar, except for the pecorino romano and onion.  Add a little hot water to thin the mixture if necessary, but not to make it too runny.  When the cheese is fully mixed in the cheese, stir in it to coat the cubes, being careful not to let the mixture boil.

title: Jamaican Seasoning

instructions: Combine all of the ingredients, except the salsa, stirring with a whisk to blend.  Add salsa to taste, but stir until mixed well, if necessary.  Let sit in a cool, dark place for at least an hour to develop the flavors.

instructions: Mix powder with custard until smooth and creamy.  Stir in sugar and triple sec.  Allow to firm up for about an hour or more before using.  Store covered and keep in the refrigerator.

title: Aloo Gobi (Beef and Spinach Curry)

instructions: Heat oil in a large frying pan on high heat.  Add onions and fry for around 3 minutes.  Add meat, spinach, spinach leaves and tomato puree.  Mix well.  Fry for about 3 minutes on medium, or until cooked to your taste.  Add chaat masala and stir well.  Serve with steamed rice.

title: Tex-Mex Chicken and Rice

instructions: In a blender or processor, puré olives and green onions until well blended.  In small bowl combine 2 tbsp of the cornstarch with about 2 tbsp of the hot oil from the skillet.  Whisk to blend.  Add 1 tbsp of cornstarch mixture and stir to blend.  Add rest of the cornstarch mixture and stir to blend.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and no longer cloudy.  Whisk in remaining 1 tbsp cornstarch, adding a little at a time to prevent sticking.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Place the chicken pieces in a large casserole dish or baking dish just large enough to hold them in one layer.  Top with the sauteed olive mixture, add 1 cup of the hot sauce, 1/2 of the diced tomatoes and 2 tbsp of sliced olives.  Cover and bake in a preheated 325 degree f oven for 40 minutes or until chicken is cooked and sauce thickens a little.

Random Ingredients: tortilla chip,italian sausage link,chianti wine,jasmine rice,oyster sauce
title: Tortilla Chips and Sausage
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds italian sausage links, casings removed | 1 1/2 cups chopped chianti wine | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | fresh tortilla chips | 2 cups jasmine rice, cooked
instructions: In a large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat, breaking up sausage with a spoon, until no longer pink, 2 to 3 minutes.  Stir in chianti wine and oyster sauce, bring to a boil.  To serve, arrange hot chips on a platter and coat with the sausage mixture.

title: Okra & Caramelized Okra
ingredients: 1 lb frozen whole okra | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 1 lb penne
instructions: Boil the penne in plenty of water.  Meanwhile, rinse and defrost the okra.  Drain the penne.  Add the okra and vinegar to the cooked penne and mix together.

title: Aluminum Cheese Appetizer, from Good Eats
ingredients: 1 loaf bread, sliced | 1 package cream cheese, room temp | aluminum foil
instructions: Prepare crust.  Heat oven to in small bowl mix cream cheese and aluminum foil until well blended.  Remove crust from loaf pan onto lightly oiled cookie sheet.  Cover with cheese mixture.  Press with fork.  Bake 30 - 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Asian Five-Spice Powder Chicken Stock

instructions: Mix together in a blender the five spice powder and the chicken broth.  Bring to a gentle simmer & pour into hot sterilized jars, leaving plenty for fragrance to spill over.  Leave to mature for 8 weeks.

instructions: Place the beans, syrup and tomato halves in a saucepan.  Boil over medium high heat for 5 minutes.  Stir in the almond paste until heated through – this will take about 3 - 4 minutes.  Pour into a serving dish and sprinkle with cardamom.

title: Cheese Jelly

If desired, cut it into small pieces and place on a baking tray in a single layer.  Using a pastry brush, spread the jam over the cheese.  Brush the edge of your pastry with the mirin.  Bake for several minutes or until the cheese is brown and bubbling.  Allow to cool slightly.  Drizzle the warm cheese with some of the jam.  Serve the jelly immediately.

title: Homemade Corned Heirloom
