title: Ancho Meat Filling for Raviolis (Mushroom & Chicken)
ingredients: 2 cans ancho chile powder, drained | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1 teaspoon dried ancho chile powder | filling | meat, meat flavor, to your taste | parchment paper, to roll your dough | 2 teaspoons wishbone italian dressing | 3 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º f.  Mix first 3 ingredients well.  Cut a slit in the side of your bread.  Place mixture inside.  Close slit and form into a log if necessary.  Bake approximately 20 to 25 minutes.  While still hot, drizzle with desired amount of the dressing.  When cool, cut bread diagonally while still warm.  May be stored airtight.

Random Ingredients: cremini mushroom,pearl barley,vegan margarine,lump crabmeat,tamarind pulp,orange juice zest,cooking spray,ancho chile
title: Lump Crab Bars
ingredients: 12 ounces can lump crabmeat | 1 tablespoon dried ancho chiles | 2 tablespoons vegan margarine or 2 tablespoons butter | 3/4 cup quick-cooking spray | 1/2 cup pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 2 cups cremini mushrooms, sliced | 2 teaspoons orange juice or 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp, pulp
instructions: Place crab meat, chiles and butter in a large food processor or blender.

title: Authentic Mexican Chicken and Noodle
ingredients: 10 -12 boneless skinless chicken thighs | 3 cups cooked noodles | 1 cup arugula | 8 poblano chiles, seeded halved and seeded | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 12 ounces light beer
instructions: Season chicken pieces with garlic powder and salt and pepper.  Brown in skillet on both sides until brown and tender, about 6 to 8 minutes.  Set aside.  Place noodles in bowl of food processor with half the arugula and chop coarsely.  Toss with chicken.  Toss with cooked noodles.  Add poblano and cloves, and toss.  Serve at once over noodles.

title: Avocado and Wild Mushroom Guacamole
ingredients: 1 small ripe avocado, unpeeled | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon asafoetida powder | 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoon white mushrooms, chopped
instructions: Using a fork or a vegetable peeler, peel the avocado then cut it lengthwise into 16 slices.  Use a spoon scrap the avocado into a bowl until all of the avocado is cut up like fallen pieces.  Place the avocado in a small bowl and sprinkle with a little asafoetida.  Stir to combine.  Using a mortar and pestle stir the avocado and mushroom into the guacamole.  The mixture should have a mealy consistency.  Serve topped with your favorite toppings.  Note, you can also use a combination of these ingredients such as chard leaves, scallions, or even spinach instead.

title: Grilled Keed (Middle Eastern)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 2 lbs kishke ( turkishke ), skins removed
instructions: Heat the chili oil in a small frying pan, then place the dry keifes in one hand.  With the other hand, poke a hole in the middle of the kifes and push gently.  When the surface appears dry, turn over, place on a baking sheet and grill about 30 minutes, brushing as it drys.  Remove from heat and brush with the same method you used to make the kites.  Return to the grill and close the lid.  Let sit, uncovered, 25 minutes before cutting into wedges.

title: Vermicelli with Black Beans
ingredients: 1 package vermicelli | 2 cans black beans drained with liquid reserved | 3 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 1 dash hot pepper sauce
instructions: Cook vermicelli in boiling water, stirring occasionally until just tender, about 1 minute.  Drain, and rinse under cold water.  Set aside.  Rinse black beans and set aside.  Mix fish sauce and pepper sauce together in a bowl.  Set aside.  Drain vermicelli, and cut into 1 inch strips.  Drain and set aside.  Arrange strips on a large platter and sprinkle with fish sauce mixture.  Spoon black bean and black bean mixture over top.  Serve warm or chilled.

Random Ingredients: red chili powder,kalamata olive,broccoli,cream chicken soup,herb,green curry paste,ladyfinger,hazelnut
title: Green Chicken & Vegetable Enchiladas With Thai Cream
ingredients: 500 g ladyfingers | 400 g green curry paste | 400 g cream of chicken soup | 400 g roasted sweet almonds, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons chopped mixed fresh herbs | 1 small red chili powder | 200 g chopped broccoli | 100 g kalamata olives | 1/4 cup chopped toasted hazelnuts
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c / 375°f place one handfull of dried ladyfingers on a flat surface.  Using the other hand, carefully roll the ladyfingers so they are completely flat and evenly covered.  Trim all the fingers from any excess hanging around the edge.  Slightly flour the fingers as you work, then place in an oven tray with 2/3rds of water on top and a little spray oil.  Spread about 1 tbs of curry paste on each ladyfinger, then roll all the way around, to make an enchilada.  Place onto a non stick baking sheet in the oven and cook for approximately 12 minutes.  Remove on a plate.  Take out a little bit of the water from the oven and pour a little more in to the pan.  Reduce the oven heat to 190c / 375f / gas.  Meanwhile combine the soup & ½ cup water in a saucepan and mix well until smooth.  Add the remaining curry paste and stir until everything is combined.  Add the green curry paste and stir until combined.  Pour the soup mixture in the bottom of a shallow baking dish and stir through the chopped nuts.  Cover with a single layer of the rolled french fried beans and a layer of rolled stuffed ladyfingers.  Repeat this process and then place on top of the stuffed ladyfingers.  Sprinkle with chopped cilantro.  Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until crispy and golden.

title: Sage and Almond Tacks
ingredients: 3/4 cup finely minced onion | 1/4 cup finely minced aluminum foil | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seed
instructions: Heat grill pan or skillet until very hot.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer onion and salt to paper towels.  In a small bowl, drain onion and salt.  Sprinkle ground cardamom over ground cardamom and mix.  Spread 1/4 cup of the ground onion on a paper towel lined baking sheet.  Drizzle with about 1/4 cup of the ground onion mixture.  Wrap tightly with the towel and allow to dry overnight.  Sprinkle a bit of the remaining ground onion on each sheet.  Using an electric mixer, coarsely grate the onion onto a sheet of wax paper.  Place in refrigerator for at least one hour, tossing occasionally.  Sprinkle a bit more of the ground onion as desired on the top as desired.  Wrap tightly in the paper towel and store at room temperature for up to 1 week or freeze for up to 2 weeks. .  Note, for a softer texture, chill the onion in the refrigerator.  Tastes good after chilling for several hours in an air tight container.

title: Chinese Mushroom Rolls
ingredients: 150 g chinese mushrooms | 1 large pastry shell | 3 tablespoons coriander powder | 20 g oil
instructions: Wash and clean mushrooms and slice very thin.  Take a pastry pan and cover with water.  Put in mushrooms and a small amount of oil and cover.  Add in the coriander and mix well.  Put in the oven on 350 degree for 90 minutes.  Take out and cut into squares.  Enjoy.

title: A Trinidadian Curried Calamari (Marinated Calamari)
ingredients: 1/3 cup chopped mixed squid | 2 large poblano chiles ( the tiny, hot ones ) | 1 pinch ground allspice | 1/2 cup shortening | lettuce, for seasoning
instructions: Remove the black veins from the poblanos.  Place them in a blender or food processor with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and about 1/4 cup of water.

title: Ukrainian Cold Pickled Callet
ingredients: 1 bottle sweet relish | 1 cucumber, peeled and sliced | 1 tomatoes, sliced | 1 stalk celery, sliced | 1/2 blackberries
instructions: Combine relish and cucumber in a large bowl.  Slice tomato into rings, sprinkle with celery and blackberries.  Cover with relish mixture.  Serve chilled.

title: Mango & Strawberry Snack Sandwiches
ingredients: 12 slices bread, very good quality | 12 sliced strawberries | 1 cup dried breadcrumbs
instructions: Toast bread, but not too dry.  You can also toast in a toaster under the broiler.  If you are using strawberries, cut up a little and coat with bread crumbs.  Place strawberries in toaster.  Drizzle with 1/2 teaspoon of honey or soured cream if you want.  Spread 1 tablespoon of the toasted crumbs over the top of each slice of toast.  Remove from oven and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,lentil,mustard seed,garlic clove,shortening,asafoetida powder,red chile,buttermilk
title: Spicy Onion Lentils (Chauli Ki Dal)
ingredients: 1 cup split peas or 1 cup lentils | 1/4 cup self rising flour | 1 pinch asafoetida powder | 1 red chile ( to taste ) | 1 garlic clove ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup fresh buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon prepared mustard seeds or 2 teaspoons dried mustard | 1 tablespoon shortening, melted | 1/2 teaspoon crushed dried red chile
instructions: Cook the lentils in lightly salted water for about 12 minutes or until tender.  Drain, transfer to a bowl and mash with a fork or potato masher.  Beat in the flour and chilli powder until smooth.  Stir in the onion, a little at a time, and beat well after each addition.  Stir in the milk, mustard seed, and melted shortening.  Mix well and allow to rest for 3 to 5 minutes.  Check seasonings and serve.

Random Ingredients: white bread,sherry,yellow miso,curd cottage cheese,roquefort cheese,tea
title: Roquefort Welsh
ingredients: 1 slice white bread, crust removed cut in half & crust finely crumbled | 1/4 lb curd cottage cheese | 1/4 lb roquefort cheese | 2 tablespoons curds ( cottage cheese ) | 1 tablespoon sherry | whole white bread, to serve
instructions: Place bread in a bowl & pour over boiling water.  Leave to soak for a few seconds then drain.  Mix cheese, sherry & remaning amount of liquid from the bread.  Grease a large ovenproof dish & cover with half the cheese mixture.  Cover with rest of cheese mixture.  Press bread lightly with your hands.  Cover the dish & bake in a preheated oven for aproximately 45 mins or until golden.

title: Pork Tarkari
ingredients: 2 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 - 2 pounds boneless pork chops, cut into 6 slices | 1 can beer | 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place the ginger garlic paste and beer into a small bowl and stir.  Cover the pork with the marinade and refrigerate overnight.  Place the pork in a roasting pan.  Pour the beer around the pork so that it coats each piece of pork.  Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake at 300 degrees f. , basting occasionally, for 2 to 2 1/2 hours.  Remove the foil for the last 20 minutes of cooking.

Random Ingredients: napa cabbage,graham cracker,worcestershire sauce,salt pepper,lime,green cardamom pod,balsamic vinegar
title: Sweet and Sour Kimchi
ingredients: 1/4 lb napa cabbage, shredded | 1/4 cup grape jelly or 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce, your choice | 1 -2 green cardamom pod | 1 lime | salt and pepper | 1/3 cup balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice, about 1 lime
instructions: Rinse the cabbage and drain.

title: Creamy Sriracha Chili Sauce (For Beef & Chicken)
ingredients: 1 cup chipped beef broth | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 tablespoon dark chocolate, shaved | sriracha sauce, to taste
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat to medium low.   simmer 20 minutes or until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Serve on your favorite dishes with your favorite dipping sauces.

title: Schweizer Chicken
ingredients: 3 chicken breasts, halved | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon paprika
instructions: Combine the soup, cream, sugar and cocoa in a frying pan and heat over medium heat.  Add the chicken and cook for about 15 minutes, or until cooked through and thoroughly melted.

Random Ingredients: basil,scotch bonnet chile pepper,jarlsberg cheese,sriracha sauce,queso fresco,red onion,oat
title: Chile Rellenos Rolled in Oats
ingredients: 20 slices jarlsberg cheese | 10 slices queso fresco | 1 large red onion, sliced thin | 2 scotch bonnet chile peppers | 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped | 1 cup oat, unsweetened or 1 cup parchment, cut into small squares | sriracha sauce ( for taste )
instructions: Place 4 - 6 slices cheese on each cut into 4 rllenos.  Top each roll with some rllenos and spread with a thin layer of queso fresco, scotch bonnet, red onion and basil.  Wrap cheese tightly with foil.  Bake at 375 degrees for 25 - 35 minutes until cheese is melted.  Serve with sriracha.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,lime juice,bell pepper,tomato jalapeno,tilapia fillet,raisin
title: Grilled Tilapia With Sweet and Hot Chilies and Raisins
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs tilapia fillets, uncooked | 2 tablespoons lime juice ( about 2 avg limes ) | 3/4 cup chopped sweet bell pepper | 3 tablespoons raisins | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, grated | 1/2 jalapeno, chopped ( about 2 teaspoons )
instructions: Place the tilapia fillets between 2 pieces of plastic wrap and pound with a meat mallet to 1/2 inch thickness.  Using the flat side of the meat mallet, make 6 thin slits along one side of the fish.  Brush lime juice over fish and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Cover with plastic wrap and let marinate, refrigerated, for 30 minutes.  Heat grill.  Remove plastic wrap.  Place bell peppers on grill rack and grill, turning once, for 5 - 7 minutes or until just tender to the touch.  Transfer to serving platter.  Sprinkle with raisins and dark chocolate and jalapeno.  Top with warm steamed vegetables.

title: Prawns a la Diablo
ingredients: 2 pounds shrimp - peeled, deveined and washed | 2 cups marinara sauce | 1 fresh chipotle pepper, chopped | 2 pounds beef chuck, cut into chunks | 1 bunch fresh strawberries
instructions: Place water into a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Add the shrimp, and return to boil.  Cook 15 minutes.  Drain.  Place the shrimp in a slow cooker.  Place the marinara sauce and chipotle pepper on top of the shrimp.  Place the beef chunks over the marinara sauce.  Cover, and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.  Towards the end of the cooking time, remove the beef chunks from the sauce.  Set aside to cool.  When the shrimp have cooled, drain them, and crack them back into the sauce.  Chop the strawberries and place into a bowl.  Chop the rest of the strawberries, and remove the rind from the strawberries.  Place the juice of the beef chunks into the sauce.  Stir, cover and cook on low for at least 30 minutes, or until thickened and the strawberries are tender.

title: Indian Cashew Nuts
ingredients: 1 bag of salted raw cashews | 1/2 cup yellow mustard seeds | 1 can green chilies | 3 green onions, green only, chopped for garnish
instructions: Toast cashews in a dry pan over med.  Heat for 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and transfer nuts to a food processor/blender and process.  Add mustard seeds and chilies and process again on high until they begin to crackle.  Add green onions and blend until just mixed with the other spices.  If the mixture is too thick, add a little water, a little or more, until desired consistency.

title: Fresh Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh blueberries ( or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons dry sherry ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped roasted unsalted peanuts, toasted
instructions: Drain fruit, reserving 1/4 cup juice.  Combine juice with reserved juice, sherry and peanuts.  Sprinkle with remaining berries and mix well.

title: Saffron Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 600 g baking potatoes ( peeled ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon saffron ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon mango chutney
instructions: Using a small sieve, sprinkle the saffron evenly over the potatoes, then leave to soak in the vinegar for 1 - 2 hours.  Cut into about 1 cm dice, then cook the potatoes in a medium sized pan with a good pinch of salt until tender but still firm, in the remaining vinegar and add the saffron and mix thoroughly, add mango chutney and cook for about 3 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: italian tomato,kale,cream cottage cheese,chinese five spice powder,mint,salt pork
title: Cottage Cheesy Kale Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh kale, washed and chopped | 2 italian-style diced tomatoes | 1/2 cup cream-style cottage cheese | salt to taste | 1 pinch chinese five-spice powder | 1 pinch dried mint
instructions: Place kale in a microwave safe bowl and coat with cooking spray.  Cover, and microwave on high for 1 minute, then remove lid and cook for another 3 to 5 minutes, or until kale is tender.  Remove kale from the microwave, stir once, and let cool until easy to handle.  Chop kale into pieces, add tomatoes, cottage cheese, salt, chinese five spice, and dried mint, and mix well.  Chill until serving.

title: Pollo Con Miele (Sliced Chicken with Garlic)
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts | 4 loaves italian bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Wash chicken breasts thoroughly and dry well.  Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking pan.  Cover each breast with a layer of the garlic bread and bake for about 45 minutes.  If you have a cooking thermometer, it should register about 170 degrees f between the joints.  Remove the chicken from the oven and cover it with aluminum foil.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean jalapeno pepper,onion salt,pea,green zucchini,fusilli
title: Zucchini and Shredded Pepper Fusilli
ingredients: 8 ounces dried pinto beans or 8 ounces jalapeno peppers | 1 lb fresh fusilli ( rigatoni or rotini ) | 1 large onion salt | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 small green zucchini, grated ( about 8 ounces )
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil.  Meanwhile, rinse beans and peppers under cold water until water forms a s cloudy, cloudy, but not transparent surface.  Drain well and place in a large stainless steel or vingear pot.  Add about 1/2 cup water.  Heat to just below steaming.  Meanwhile, cook pasta in boiling water until al dente.  Drain.  Meanwhile, peel vegetables.  In a large bowl, toss pasta with beans, peppers, onion salt and peas.  Serve topped with zucchini slices.

title: Banana Pepper Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 small banana pepper | 1 dash dark soy sauce | 1 dash worcestershire sauce
instructions: Wash and destem the banana pepper.  Heat medium frying pan with a low setting on medium.  Use tongs to flip the pepper in the hot pan.  Use a slotted spoon to remove the pepper from the pan when the pepper is soft and the skin is starting to blacken.  Repeat the same procedure on the other side when the pepper is soft.  It should only take two to three attempts to peel off the skin.  Serve on a plate lined with rice, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, if using that sauce.

title: Okra Soup
ingredients: 12 okra | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup
instructions: Cut okra in half and scoop out pulp.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add okra and cream of chicken soup.  If soup is too thin, add 1/2 cans of stock/water.  Once soup is boiling, reduce heat to low and let simmer for a while longer.  You want okra to be soft and soup thickens, but not brown.  Serve in soup bowls.

title: Irish Fruit Tortilla
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hot paprika, hot hungarian and sweet | 1 teaspoon brown butter | 8 slices thick slices long grain mustard | 1/4 cup mixed green asparagus | 1 tablespoon sultana | 4 medium slices crisp cooked red asparagus or 4 slices crisp cooked green asparagus | 4 slices tortillas
instructions: To assemble, sprinkle paprika on one side of each slice of bread.  Heat butter in a skillet over medium low heat.  Cook bread on one side of a bread slice, until bottom is light golden brown and beginning to crisp.  Turn over and place on a plate.  Flip the other slice of bread and lightly butter the other side.  Spread each slice of toast with 1 teaspoon of the sweet white paprika and 1 teaspoon of brown butter.

Random Ingredients: accent seasoning,orange zest,ouzo,plum tomato,jalapeno pepper,tortilla,pearl barley,heavy whipping cream
title: Barley Rice Ala Abuela
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1 plum tomato, diced | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped | 2 drops orange zest | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 tablespoon ouzo, divided | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning | 4 tortillas, warmed
instructions: Cook the pearl barley according to package directions.  Meanwhile, lightly oil a medium saucepan, and cook the plum tomato and jalapeno pepper for five minutes.  Remove from the heat.  Add 1 1/2 tablespoons of the cream and ouzo.

title: Simple Microwave Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili paste | 1 -2 teaspoon garam masala | 2 -3 drops hot peppers, cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a small dish and stir.  Microwave for 25 seconds.  Stir again then microwave for another 5 minutes.  Stir till it is all mixed well and no liquid can be absorbed.

Random Ingredients: guacamole,phyllo pastry,tomato juice,white onion,rice noodle,lentil,palm sugar,coconut
title: Sweet Lentil and Rice Phyllo Pie
ingredients: 8 sheets phyllo pastry, halved | 3 cups drained cooked lentils | 3/4 cup tomato juice | 3/4 cup coconut, shredded | 1/3 cup unsalted palm sugar | 1/2 cup sweet white onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dry rice noodles, soaked in warm water for 20 minutes and drained | 1/4 cup guacamole
instructions: Line a greased 12” pan with a large sheet of phyllo, keeping remaining sheets covered.  Microwave on high for 20 seconds.  Stir lentils, tomato juice, coconut, palm sugar, white onion, and rice noodles in a large bowl.  Microwave on high for 25 seconds, stirring and breaking up rice noodles while heating.  Spread half of this mixture evenly over phyllo sheets.  Top with half of lentils and half of remaining tomato mixture.  Repeat layers.  Cut remaining phyllo sheets into 6 equal squares.  Cover with damp towel while making the rest.  Microwave on high for 25 seconds, or until pastry is golden and phyllo is crisp.  Spread guacamole on top, cut into squares, and serve.

title: Smoky Fig Jam  - Chocoholic
ingredients: 8 -10 firm ripe figs | 12 -12 slices ham | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1 pinch liquid smoke | 2 teaspoons tamarind paste | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | 1/2 cup orange juice or 1/2 cup lime juice
instructions: Pare figs & cut into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Heat up the pad of the barbeque grill.  Cook figs and ham until golden brown.  Mix remaining ingredients till they get fragrant.  Pour all paste into jars.  Add figs & ham & let cook a little while.  Remove from grill, add sweet tea and let set for one hour.  Can be served with rice & bread.  Note, if you use the dried figs, you may want to add fresh fruit slices before serving, as the flavour gets stronger with storage.

title: Pork-And-Meat Cannelloni
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups stone ground meat | 1/2 cup minced salted pork ribs | 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 1 package lasagna noodles, broken into 6 pieces about 1/2 inch thick | all-purpose flour in a large mixing bowl
instructions: Grease the bottom of a 9 x 12 inch or 12 inch baking pan with cooking spray.  Mix meats and pinches of gelatin together on small plate.  Sprinkle meat mixture evenly over the bottom of prepared pan.  Arrange 3 sheets of broken lasagna over.  Sprinkle 3 pieces of meat and gelatin evenly over the gelatin and then add 2 more sheets of broken lasagna along with 3 more broken layers of broken meat and gelatin.  Continue layering 3 sheets of broken pieces of broken meats and gelatin.  Top with 3 more broken lasagna, but not overlapping each other.  Continue layering 3 sheets of broken broken broken broken pieces of broken broken meats and gelatin until all ingredients are used, ending with a broken layer of broken broken broken broken broken broken meat and gelatin on top.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours or until mixture thickens enough to spoon and becomes fluffy and easy to handle.  Remove wrap.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,oil,watermelon ball,splenda sugar substitute,rice,tomato,graham cracker crumb
title: Sweet Potato and Watermelon Roll
ingredients: 3 russet potatoes | 2 tablespoons oil | 1 can watermelon balls | 1 loaf frozen rice or 1 loaf frozen sweet potato | 1 can crushed tomatoes | 1 can russet potatoes ( optional ) | 1/3 cup splenda sugar substitute, for topping or 1/3 cup sugar if preferred | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Slice potato about 1/8 inch thick.  Place in saucepan, cover with water, cover and heat to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender, approximately 40 minutes.  Drain potato, return to saucepan, cover and simmer until cool enough to handle when cut, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Mash potato until smooth and return to saucepan and stir in watermelon.  Stir in crushed tomatoes, russet potatoes, splenda, ½ cup rice, and 1 - ½ tbsp water.  Bake in 350° oven until hot and bubbly, about 30 minutes.  Sprinkle top with shredded graham crackers.

title: Chile Oil
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried chile pepper, seeded or 1 tablespoon fresh chili pepper, seeded and roughly chopped | 1 onion, peeled and coarsely chopped ( or 1 green onion )
instructions: Heat the oil over a medium heat and fry the chilies, onion and chilli powder for about 5 mins until the mixture is well coated with the oil.  Tip out the oil and discard.  Pour the oil into hot, sterilized, non metallic ramekin dishes.  Cover with foil, seal and seal.  Leave in the fridge for about 4 hours, and up to 20 minutes before use.  Note, chile oil can be used for frying, or to flavour fish, salads and roasts.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,lasagna noodle,ra el hanout spice
title: Faux Pharao (Randy-Spice Lasagna)
ingredients: 20 frozen lasagna noodles, preferably whole and cut in half | 3 roma tomatoes, each cut lengthwise into 8 slices | 2 tablespoons ras el hanout spice
instructions: Thaw the lasagna lasagna briefly at room temperature by breaking it into individual pieces with kitchen shears.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Lay out a piece of parchment paper on a large rimmed baking sheet or large baking sheet you will be using for the lasagna pan.  Tear each piece of lasagna in half lengthwise, and set aside.  Using a very sharp scissors slice the tomatoes crosswise into 8 slices, then slice each half in half crosswise again.  Arrange a row of tomato slices across the parchment paper overlapping the tomato slices to create a flat surface with 1/2 inch in the middle.  Spoon 1 teaspoon of ras el hanout spice evenly over the tomato layer, along with about a scant 1/2 teaspoon of salt.  Add 5 ras el hanout spice blend to 1 - 2 tablespoons of water to bring to a depth of 1/8 inch.  Place lasagna sheets in another large baking sheet or pan.  Spread the sheet with a thin layer of salt.  Repeat the process with another thin layer of ras el hanout and another generous layer of ras el hanout.  Repeat the process with the remaining sheets and a scant 1/4 teaspoon of salt.  Arrange the lasagna sheets on the baking sheet in a single layer.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: ice,coriander seed,mango,beef tenderloin steak,peppercorn,gold tequila,chive,puff pastry
title: Smoked Beef Wellington
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steak, about 3 pounds | 6 tablespoons mango flavored gold tequila or 6 tablespoons orange-flavored gold tequila | 1 cup frozen puff pastry, thawed ( or 6 ounces puff pastry sheets ) | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 1 tablespoon peppercorn | 1 cup fresh sherry wine or 1 cup dry chablis | 2 tablespoons chives, snipped
instructions: Remove the top rib from the steaks and butterfly them lengthwise.  Place the steaks in a bowl and cover with plastic film and weight on top, for 12 to 14 hours.  Meanwhile, heat a grill pan or other nonstick stove over medium high heat.  Toast the coriander and peppercorns.  In a small heavy skillet melt the tequila over low heat and cook until it's a syrupy white liquid.  Set aside.  Remove the steak from the marinade and dry off excess with a paper towel.  Cut into slices and then cut the steaks into strips.  Heat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Place the pastry on a baking sheet.  Brush lightly with the olive oil and sprinkle evenly with the cilantro.  Wrap the beef strips around the pastry.  Roll the pastry tightly around the steak to seal it and place on the sheet where it'll eventually be used for the sauce.  Brush with the olive oil and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown on top.

Random Ingredients: fruit juice,red wine,self raising flour,broth,margarine,graham cracker crumb
title: Mock Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup self-raising flour | 1/4 cup margarine | 1 cup boiled red wine | 1 cup cooked chicken stock or 1 cup broth | margarine or oil | 1 cup crushed graham cracker crumbs or 1 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 cup fruit juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  In a bowl sieve flour.  Add margarine.  Cut in until fine crumbs.  Mix in milk and wine.  Combine chicken or stock with crumb/breadcrumbs.  Stir in butter mixture.  Grease 2 loaf tins with margarine or oil.  Line the baking dishes with baking paper.  Spoon mixture into tins.  Place in oven.  Bake for about 40 mins.  When cooked slice and serve.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,penne pasta,kidney bean,szechuan peppercorn,xanthan gum,ancho chilies,linguine
title: Sizzling Sizzling Macadamia Noodles
ingredients: 9 ounces penne pasta | 15 ounces kidney beans, drained and rinsed and split into halves | 2 dried ancho chilies ( optional ) | 9 ounces szechuan peppercorns ( timur powder ) | 2 small spring onions, chopped into 2 inch lengths | 1/3 cup xanthan gum, or to taste | 1 teaspoon szechuan peppercorns ( timur powder )
instructions: Heat a large pot of lightly salted water to boiling over high heat.  Add pasta and cook, stirring often, until tender but firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.  Drain well and set aside.  Place kidney beans, dried ancho chilis, sichuan peppercorns, and spring onions in a large bowl and stir to coat.  Pour bean mixture over pasta.  Sprinkle with timur and szechuan peppercorns.  Toss to coat well and serve right away.

title: French Toast With Thyme & Vanilla
ingredients: 4 thick slices italian bread, lightly toasted ( french or italian ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 1 -2 teaspoon dried thyme leave
instructions: Peel and thinly slice vanilla bean.  Heat oil and 1 tblspns.  Canola oil over medium heat in a 12 inch nonstick skillet, cook the bread in batches until lightly browned, about 2 minutes per side.  Cover with a lid, cook until just beginning to crisp, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Transfer to a plate and tent loosely with foil to keep warm.  Slice vanilla bean thinly and place in bowl with warm bread pieces.  Squeeze remaining tbls.  Vanilla bean seeds out of vanilla bean and return to pan.  Heat all but oil over medium high heat.  When hot, add the chopped vanilla bean and thyme.  When the mixture shimmers, add the warm croutons and toss to combine well.  Cook, turning croutons over in pan 1 or 2 minutes until heated through. Remove from heat and serve right away.

title: White Bean Snack

title: Carne Asada Marinade

instructions: Combine all ingredients on a tray place in fridge to allow flavors to meld, then dig in.

title: Welshman's Mustard Mustard for Sandwiches

instructions: Preparation, mix the brown mustard and golden syrup well.  Spread the ground mustard onto a small, warm surface and spread the mustard lightly on the mustard. instructions: Start boiling water and cook pasta according to the packet's directions.  While boiling, dice water chestnuts and fry with the rest of the the dry mustard.  Then add all the other dry ingredients.  Saute until heated through.  Meanwhile cut up tomatoes into large chunks and add to the boiling water.  Simmer gently for about 3 minutes to let some of the liquid out.  Drain pasta and add to the sauteed tomato mixture.  Mix together and put back in the pot for a minute or two to really bring out the spices.  Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,thai chili sauce,chocolate,tabasco sauce,black olive,mexicorn
title: Mexicorns With Chocolate and Garam Masala
ingredients: 1 cup mexicorn | 6 pieces bittersweet chocolate | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 1 teaspoon thai sweet chili sauce | 1/2 ounce black olives, halved
instructions: Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil over medium high heat.  Boil until the mexicorn is pliable, about 4 minutes.  While the mexican water is heating, wrap the chocolate in a bowl and microwave on high power for 1 minute or until just melted and smooth.  When the chocolate is melted, stir in the black pepper, tabasco and chili sauce until smooth.  Add the mexican corn and black olives and toss to coat.  Serve at once.

title: Jicama Salad
ingredients: 1/2 bunch jicama, peeled and cut in half | 1/2 cup plain yogurt
instructions: Toss jicama and yogurt together in a salad bowl.  Cover and chill 1 hour.

title: Easy Beef Carbonara
ingredients: 1 -2 lb beef chuck, trimmed of all visible fat | 1 can chicken broth | 1/4 cup club soda | 5 cups rigatoni pasta, cooked
instructions: Cook rigatoni al dente according to package directions.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees and place a large pot of water on high heat.  In a large skillet, sear the beef on all sides until browned.  You may want to add more water if necessary.  Drain any fat and reserve for later.  Deglaze the skillet with the chicken broth and club soda.  Bring to a boil and add the beef into the broth.  Cook for 6 - 7 minutes.  Transfer beef into a large casserole dish.  Add cooked rigatoni to pot and coat with gravy.  Cover and bake 30 minutes.

title: Rice Nests
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 3/4 cup sultana, roasted | 3 ounces mixed sprouts, roasted | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed | salt and lemon, juice of | ghee ( for frying ) | 2 ounces chopped ripe olives or 2 ounces vegetable oil | whipped cream ( optional )
instructions: Drain the rice and place it in a shallow roasting tin.  Add the sultanas.  Sprinkle with salt and lemon juice, tossing to mix.  Put in a preheated oven of 350 deg f/180 deg c.  Cook for 30 minutes.  Leave the oven door open, then put the rinsed rice in a bowl.  Add the olives or oil, stir and serve sprinkled with cream if you wish.  You could also sprinkle with additional sultanas.  This is really an unusual recipe, and not strictly necessary, but it's quite popular amongst friends and it makes a nice addition to the nadales we eat with pickles, salsa, and other dishes.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,tofutti better than cream cheese,orange zest,cumin powder,graham flour
title: Fooey Tofu Triangles
ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 orange, zest of, very finely chopped | 1 package fooey tofu ( better-than-creamy you can find at trader joe's ) | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon ground cumin powder | 2 ounces white mushrooms, quartered and cleaned
instructions: Makes a lot of tofu use the oil of your choice in this recipe.  I've found that deep fryer work best.  Beat the cream cheese together with the orange zest and the cumin powder until smooth.  Slice the tofu into triangle shapes about 1/8 thick.  Dip each triangle one at a time into the cream cheese, then dredge in the cumin and cinnamon mixture on each side.  I use disposable plastic bags which i just wrap them over the tofu.  Heat up your non stick frying pan to medium and spray with olive oil spray and fry the triangles for 1 minute on each side.  They should be golden brown on the outside and soft on the inside, but not burnt.  Enjoy with a dollop of sour cream and if you want to eat them in a bowl, you can drizzle a little oil over the tofu.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,asiago cheese,lemon juice,vegetable oil cooking spray,black olive,honey barbeque sauce,triple sec,dark rum
title: BBQ Olive Trifle
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 1/2 - 3/4 cup dark rum | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 -2 tablespoon honey barbeque sauce | 1/2 cup vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup asiago cheese, grated | 1/4 cup light-colored honey barbeque sauce | 2 -3 tablespoons grated dark rum | 4 -8 black olives, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Heat bbq to medium.  Dip ladyfingers in rum and allow to cool.  Place the softened ladyfingers in a clear glass bowl that has been coated with non stick cooking spray.  Top with 1/4 cup of the barbeque sauce.

Random Ingredients: mustard,peanut butter,seasoning salt,provolone cheese,white wine vinegar
title: Peanut Butter Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 teaspoons white wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 teaspoon mustard | 1 cup shredded provolone cheese
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the vinegar, peanut butter, seasoned salt and mustard.  Fold in the provolone cheese.  Refrigerate until serving.

Random Ingredients: lime juice,yogurt,beef bouillon cube,quinoa,italian sausage,cream horseradish sauce
title: Italian Sausage Dressing
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs italian sausage, casings removed | 2 large beef bouillon cubes | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup horseradish sauce | 1 large lime, juice of, freshly squeezed | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained well | 1 cup yogurt, sour cream or 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large resealable bag.  Squeeze and drain juice from sausages into bag and add to bag.  Toss well to coat.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Shake any remaining brine from bag before serving.

Random Ingredients: cold water,oat,italian plum tomato,red thai chile,orzo pasta,caper
title: Orzo and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1 package orzo pasta | 2 quarts cold water | 5 ounces sun-dried tomatoes | 10 large italian plum tomatoes | 5 tablespoons capers | 2 dried red thai chiles, seeded and slivered ( or to taste )
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions.

title: Low Fat Portabella Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup french dressing | 1 teaspoon sugar crystals | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1 portabella mushroom cap
instructions: Dribble the portabello mushroom cap into a bowl with the french and turmeric using the back of a spoon.  Allow to sit until the turmeric has dissolved into the liquid, 2 to 3 minutes and stir constantly.  Pour on some of the dressing.  Toss until coated.

Random Ingredients: black olive,wonton wrapper,pesto sauce,meat,farfalle pasta,white sugar,vegetable bouillon granule,sugar
title: Steak Rolls
ingredients:
600 g steak, cut into strips | 250 g farfalle pasta | 1 teaspoon vegetable bouillon granules | 1 teaspoon white sugar | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce, extra | 1 tablespoon white sugar | wonton wrapper ( i used egg roll, i get them from king's market ) | 1/4 cup black olives, sliced | 1/4 cup mixed vegetables ( i like red potatoes, carrots, zucchini, peas, zucchini etc.
    - )
instructions: Cook the meat until brown, drain off the grease.  Return the meat to the the pan, add the other ingredients, except the wrappers and filling.  Combine the filling ingredients.  Put about a teaspoon of the filling along the centre of the won roll wrapper, and roll it up.  Take the wrapper off the filling and place them in a warm oven for 10 - 15 minutes.  Serve with extra pesto sauce and sliced olives on top.

title: The Best and Easiest Polenta ever
ingredients: 1 cup yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon mortadella, a powdered cheese | 1 lb ground turkey ( or you may use turkey or chicken ) | 1 teaspoon vodka ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon tomato paste ( optional )
instructions: Prepare the polenta.  In medium bowl mix the cornmeal, mortadella and turkey.  If you are using meat, add the vodka.  Stir into the flour mixture lightly but thoroughly.  Use a spoon to form the polenta into small balls.  Spray a large oven proof skillet with cooking spray.  Set the skillet on burner in medium heat and let it brown for about 20 minutes.  When your skillet is hot, place the meatballs on top of this so they don't stick together and they don't stick together.  Cook for 10 minutes on each side, until the outside edges are lightly browned.  Serve immediately, or serve immediately.  This can also be served with other meal like a quick tomato soup, ditalini bisale, or your favourite pasta.

title: Jerk Rolled Whole Wheat Emulsifying Greens and Celery Pie
ingredients: 1 lb fresh greens, rinsed well and coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 3 -6 stalks celery, cleaned with leaves, ends snipped off, very coarsely chopped | 15 leaves fresh chard leaves, washed with lots of stems cut away | 1 teaspoon gelatin, softened in | 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning ( to taste )
instructions: In a small frying pan, heat oil over medium low heat.  Add garlic and sauté while stirring continuously for about two minutes.  Add greens, celery, chard, gelatin and cajun seasoning.  Bring to boil, stirring frequently.  Cover and reduce heat to very low.  Cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until greens are completely wilted.  Cool to room temperature.  Transfer to oven safe dish, cut in 10 or 12 inch squares or rectangles.

Random Ingredients: italian spice,lemon zest,tart apple,red radish,caper,annatto seed,vanilla bean
title: Mellow Apple-Apple Toga
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs tart apples | 2 cups red radishes, sliced | 2 tablespoons whole capers, drained | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 tablespoon pure vanilla bean | 1 teaspoon dried italian spices | 1 teaspoon anchovy ( optional )
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  Peel apples and cut into wedges.  Place wedges in a shallow baking dish.  Mix together the remaining ingredients except the apples, and sprinkle over the apples.  Bake in a 400f oven for 20 - 25 minutes, or until apples are tender, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese garlic herb,beef cube steak,celery salt
title: Quick Steak Rollups
ingredients: 1 lb beef cube steak ( about 4 steaks ) | 1 package cream cheese with garlic and herb spread with garlic and herbs | 1 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Rinse beef in cold water, dry well on paper towels.  Cut meat in 10 slices and pat dry.  Roll meat in salt and herb spread mixture.  Arrange on plastic wrap and refrigerate.  When very cold, remove from freezer about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Eggplant Dippers With Thai Sour-Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 medium eggplants, peeled, cut in half and lengthwise | 1/4 cup grand marnier | 1 bunch fresh tandoori basil, lightly packed | 1/3 cup brandy | 1/3 cup plain unsweetened yogurt | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Spray a 9x13 baking dish or a 13 by 9 inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Place the eggplant cut side down on the bottom rack of the oven and roast until very tender, about 45 minutes.  Turn off the oven but leave the oven door slightly open.  Turn the oven again up to 400 degrees.  Put the eggplant in a colander and squeeze all the excess liquid away, leaving 1 tablespoon of aubergine flavor behind.  Cut along the edges of the eggplant with a knife until it breaks into small chunks and put in a bowl.  Stir together the grand marnier, tandoori basil, brandy and cream.  Set aside.  Pour half and half into a medium saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Add the yogurt, whisking constantly for 2 minutes, until thick, creamy and creamy.  Remove from the heat.  Ladle about 1/4 cup of sauce over each eggplant slice, spreading to coat.  Diners can nestle the eggplant in a dollop of sauce in their shallow bowls.  Note, recipe states to stir the eggplant with the sauce until coated.  The dish can be prepared to this point a few hours ahead and refrigerated until the flavors have blended, about 20 hours.  Remove from the oven and serve warm.  Tip, the sauce can be made up to 2 days ahead and chilled.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Chambord
ingredients: 1 ounce chambord raspberry liquor | 1 teaspoon sugar
instructions: Fill a shaker with ice.  Add raspberry liquor and sugar, if desired, and shake until sugar dissolves.  Strain into a chilled wine glass.  Drink.

Random Ingredients: pasta,fennel seed,sauerkraut,peanut butter,fontina cheese,thyme leave,coconut milk
title: Cranachan Pasta With Sauerkraut and Peanuts
ingredients: 3/4 3/4 lb fresh pasta or 3/4 lb dried wheat noodles | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/4 teaspoon thyme leave | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed | 14 1/2 ounces sauerkraut, drained | 14 1/2 ounces coconut milk | 1 1/2 ounces fontina cheese, sliced
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, drain.  Meanwhile, melt the peanut butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Mix in the thyme and fennel seed.  Add the sauerkraut, coconut milk and the pasta.  Mix well to combine.  Spoon onto a serving platter or individual plates.

title: French Bread Pockets
ingredients: 1 frozen bread dough
instructions: Bake dough in a preheated 450 degree oven.  Assemble stuffing in a bowl with 1 t.  Of chicken stock and 1 t.  Of peas.  Wrap.  Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes or until puffy.

title: Mexican Cashew Balls
ingredients: 3/4 cup cashews, with skin | 1/2 cup hazelnuts | 1/2 cup sesame seeds, toasted | 1/4 cup cocoa powder, heaping- 3 tablespoons
instructions: Set a pot of water to boil, add nuts and hazelnuts, and boil for 1 1/2 minutes, stirring now and then then.  Drain nuts well.  In a food processor, grind cashews and hazelnuts into a fine paste, then stir into nut paste, then mix in sesame seeds.  Add cocoa powder, a tablespoon at a time, until completely incorporated.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon cube,oat,green cardamom pod,chicken thigh,white breadcrumb,caper
title: Mediterranean Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs ( trimmed of excess fat ) | 1/3 cup white breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon capers, drained | 1/8 teaspoon cardamom pod ( crushed | 1/3 teaspoon green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon water
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into about four pieces and toss with the bread crumbs, capers, cardamom, and beef bouillon.  Cook in a dutch oven until the chicken is browned and has a nice coating of crumbly crumbs, approximately 30 minutes and then remove chicken from the pan.  Add water to the pan and bring to a boil.  Return the chicken to the pan and reduce the heat to low.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,sage leaf,baby bok choy,celery,mexican tomato,ouzo,asafoetida powder,serrano pepper
title: Spiral Soup With Tomatillo Beans and Choy
ingredients: 1 serrano chile pepper, seeded | 2 serrano chile peppers | 1 cup celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon ouzo or 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaves | 12 small baby bok choy | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Line a broiler pan with foil.  Place the chile pepper on the pan, skin side down, on the broiler pan.  Broil 2 to 4 minutes, until softened.  Peel off the skin and cut into strips.  Chop the chiles.  Set aside.  Bring 1 gallon water to a boil in a large soup pot.  Add the chile and celery and boil 1 minute.  Remove the chile and celery from the water.  Set aside to soak for the time stated on the seasoning packet.  Remove the blackened stem, and discard.  Chop the chiles.  Mash the bean mixture with ouzo, soy sauce, salt and serrano pepper.  Set aside.  Dice the tomatoes.  Arrange the bok choy on a serving platter.  Pour soup with tomato mixture on top.  Sprinkle with asafoetida.  The soup should have a thin consistency and be not liquid.  Serve immediately.

title: Ginger Crunchy Corn
ingredients: 15 ounces corn kernels ( canned ok ) | 1 chicken stock cube | 1/4 teaspoon ginger juice | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dark cocoa
instructions: Put corn kernels in a pan over medium heat.  Pour in the liquid the chicken stock cube has dissolved in the water.  Stir till the liquid has thickened.  Pour into bowl, add ginger juice and dark cocoa.  Mix.  Serve immediately.

title: Italian Sausage With Chicken
ingredients: 6 links italian sausage | 16 ounces frozen boneless chicken tenders | fresh herb ( oregano, basil, parsley, rosemary, sage )
instructions: Wrap each link of sausages in the crockpot, and cook on high 7 hours, or low 8 hours.  Remove from crockpot and place all dried ingredients in blender or food processor, and pulse until crumbly.  You can also do this in a bowl, if your food processor is not non metaly.  Slice the sausages into slices 1/2 inch thick.  Arrange them in a serving bowl, and garnish with fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: salt,orange juice zest,trout,provolone cheese,pimiento,pesto sauce,pork sparerib
title: Smoked Trout and Porter Schnitzel
ingredients: 4 smoked trout ( cut into 4 serving pieces ) | pimiento in olive spread ( optional ) | pimento stuffed olive | 1/2 tablespoon grated orange zest | 8 slices provolone cheese | salt | pesto sauce, for drizzling
instructions: Remove the belly cavities and cavities of the smoked trout and place them on a rack in a roasting pan to allow the meat to brown.  Heat a little oil in a frying pan and brown the fish.  Place on warm platter and pour 2 tbl of the pesto over each piece of meat.  Sprinkle with grated orange zest and decorate with pimento stuffed olives, orange slices and provolone cheese.  Pour the remaining pesto over the top and serve.

title: Hominy With Cheese & Sauce (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 5 cups hominy, washed | 2 cups flat leaf parsley, chopped | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce or 2 teaspoons chili sauce
instructions: Place the hominy, chopped parsley and chile sauce in a large saucepan over low heat and cook for 30 minutes.  Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.  The hominy should be soft, but not mushy.  The texture should be similar to porridge or a risotto.

title: Tofu Brik II
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu, drained and pressed | 2 tablespoons flax seeds | 2 pounds boneless beef chuck, cut into cubes
instructions: Preheat an oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with parchment paper.  Place the tofu in a colander and squeeze out excess liquid.  Cut the tofu in half crosswise, making sure all of the slices are flush with the middle of the cubes.  Sprinkle the tofu with the flax seeds and toss to coat thoroughly.  Place the cubes in the prepared baking dish seam side down.  Rub the marinade onto the tofu.  Bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the tofu cubes are crisp and browned.

Random Ingredients: pork tenderloin,fennel bulb,sake,plain nonfat yogurt,green bean
title: Yogurt Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin | 2 fennel bulbs, trimmed and sliced | 1 - 1 1/2 lb fresh green beans or 1 -1 1/2 lb fresh snow pea, trimmed | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon sake or 1 tablespoon apple juice
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Cut pork tenderloin into 1/2 inch thick slices and arrange on broiler pan.  Broil 3 - 4 inches from heat, and turning once, for 15 - 20 minutes, or until no longer pink in the center.  Remove from oven.  Let rest 5 - 7 minutes.  Meanwhile, steam and cut fennel into 1/2 inch wedges.  Wash and chop beans.  Heat skillet over medium heat.  Add pork.  Cook and stir 2 minutes.  Add fennel and cook 2 - 3 minutes longer until pork is cooked through.  Add beans.  Stir until cooked through.  Combine yogurt and sake and stir into pork mixture.  Heat through.  Divide among 12 dinner plates.  Serve warm.

title: Creole Barbecue Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs whole wheat spaghetti | 1 cup catalina salad dressing | 1 cup celery, sliced | 1 cup triple sec
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente.  Drain and set aside.  Mix rest of ingredients together.  Toss salad with hot cooked pasta just before serving.

Random Ingredients: bacon,coconut,cream tartar,sesame seed,cannellini bean,xanthan gum,lebanese cucumber,chicken leg thigh
title: Indonesian Chicken & Cannellini Bean Salad
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, chopped | 2/3 cup desiccated unsweetened dried coconut | 1/2 cup desiccated coconut | 1 lebanese cucumber, deseeded and finely chopped | 200 g cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1 chicken leg thigh, trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/180c fan forced / 200c/gas 4/180c lightly grease and line a large baking tray with baking paper.  Place bacon in a large non stick frying pan, cook over medium heat for 3 - 4 mins, until beginning to brown.  Add 1/3 cup of coconut and stir through, remove from heat and set aside.  Place remaining coconut, cucmber, beans and xanthan gum in a large bowl, combine with remaining coconut and season with salt and pepper.  Lightly slash the top of the chicken drumsticks with a sharp knife and place in the coconut mixture.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds and toss together.  Transfer to prepared tray, baste with coconut and bake for 35 - 45 mins or until the chicken is cooked and cooked through and the coconut is golden, crisp and creamy.  Cut into thick slices and serve with salad.

Random Ingredients: plain flour,grapefruit juice,cod fish fillet,nori,salad green
title: Sushi Roll With Fruit and Nori
ingredients: 1 tablespoon plain flour | 100 ml grapefruit juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons salad greens | 2 cod fish fillets, cut into pieces | 3 sheets nori
instructions: Mix flour and juice in shallow dish.  Dip fillet in juice.  Arrange in alternate layers of lettuce, fruit.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,double cream,red chili powder,rye bread,cardamom,nori,rotisserie chicken,elbow macaroni
title: Crunchy Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups prepared elbow macaroni | 4 slices rye bread | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning | 1 1/4 cups extra light rotisserie chicken, strips | 2 teaspoons red chili powder | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 6 tablespoons double cream | 1 piece nori, seaweed paper
instructions: Prepare your basic crusty loaf by spraying a non stick frying pan with non stick cooking spray.  Set aside.  Cook your basic shell according to the package directions.  Set aside.  You may also use a 9x13 baking dish if you have a convection oven.  Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.  While the shell is cooking cut your bread into 1/2 inch cubes and toast in the oven or microwave.  Place the cooked crusty bread in a large bowl.  Pour about 2 tablespoons of taco seasoning over the bread.  Rinse your taco seasoning in a seperate bowl and set aside.  Spray your chicken strips with non stick cooking spray and set aside.  Heat a non stick non stick skillet in the oven.  Once it's very hot add your taco seasoning and stir for about 1 minute, moving the pan around.  Add your chicken strips to the pan and stir fry for about 1 minute.  Then add the rotisserie chicken and stir fry for about 3 more minutes.  After 1 minute, sprinkle on the red chili powder and cardamom and mix through the chicken.  Stir fry for about 30 seconds.  Add your tomato sauce, stir through and mix thoroughly.  Turn the heat to low.  Pour your prepared shell into the meat mixture.  Stir until all of the shell is covered with the meat mixture.  Cover tightly with foil, place in the oven and remove the foil.  Return to the oven to warm everything through.  Turn your oven off but leave the door slightly open.  Turn on your oven to 425 degrees f.  Now you have to turn your oven on again to get the oven hot.  Place your nori seaweed paper in a large heat proof or cardboard bowl and place them on a cookie sheet.  The seaweed paper will be easy to remove from the oven.  Open your preferred bread and place in a microwave safe bowl with your preferred amount of water.  Allow to come to temperature until it starts to foam.  Remove the wrap carefully and place your nori seaweed paper on your counter.  Place your rice bowls on top of each other on the cookie sheet.  Now if a bread cube is in your bowls then do your best to carefully remove your nori.  Spread your cheesy taco meat on 1 side of the nori to cover the meat.  Add your chicken strips on the empty side you just used to prepare the taco meat, add your shredded carrots, tomatoes, onions or anything else you might like to eat.  Add your tomato and onion mixture to the nori.  Then turn your oven to 400 degrees f.  Put the bread bowls face down and close the door to allow everything to heat through and eat.  Each person can then pile the meat, cheese mixture together.  Eat as is or, over rice if preferred.

Random Ingredients: olive,maraschino cherry,purpose flour,red onion,onion powder,clam,broccoli floret,salsa
title: Quick-Fix Seafood Fajitas
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive, chopped | 1 small red onion, chopped | 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 10 ounces minced clams, drained | 3/4 cup salsa | 3/8 cup diced broccoli floret | 3/8 cup maraschino cherries
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well.  Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add the seafood mixture and cook for 3 - 4 minutes, stirring with a wooden spoon or spatula.  Serve the fajitas on a platter and garnish with additional chopped cherry to serve.

title: Beef and Bacon Stoup
ingredients: 4 lbs stewing beef, cut into 2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon turmeric | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth ( optional ) | 8 ounces dry vermouth ( optional ) | 1 head broccoli floret | 3 ounces brie cheese, cubed ( optional )
instructions: Brown beef in oil over high heat.  Add paprika, turmeric and 2 t cocoa.  Cook for a few more seconds.  Add vermouth and cook for 1 minute.  Add broccoli.  Cook for 1 minute more.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and cook on high pressure for 15 minutes, then quick release and turn off heat.  Let stand at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Cottage Cheese, Shallot and Amaretto Pie
ingredients: 1 can cottage cheese | 1/4 cup brandy or 1/4 cup whiskey, heated | 1 medium shallot ( or 2 shallots or 1/4 cup chopped green onion ) | 3 -5 tablespoons amaretto | 1 teaspoon dried chopped marjoram or 1/2 fresh marjoram, chopped ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard | 1 unbaked pie shell
instructions: Place cottage cheese in blender and process to fine crumbs.  Add hot brandy or whiskey and process until smooth, but not liquidy.  Transfer mixture to bowl and stir in shallots.  Stir in amaretto, marjoram and mustard.  Pour into shell and sprinkle tops with extra dried marjoram or chopped green onion top with remaining crumbs.  This dish freezes well.

title: Lamb and Melon Stew
ingredients: 1 large cantaloupe, halved, seeded and cut into large chunks | 300 ml lamb stock, if using lamb you may not need it | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon lime rind, finely grated
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, peel the zested rind from lime then squeeze the juice into the stew to get the zest.  Add the stock and the red pepper and leave to simmer gently until melon cubes soften slightly.  Stir in the vanilla.  Grate the rind over the top and serve.

title: Papaya Fruit Salad
ingredients: 4 -5 cups mixed dried fruit, cut into cubes | 1 cup vinegar, not apple juice
instructions: Arrange the fruit in a large bowl.  In a small saucepan, add the vinegar.

title: Lamb Shank with Golden Syrup
ingredients: 12 lamb shanks | 1/3 cup golden syrup | 2 drops red food coloring
instructions: Place lamb shanks on a rack into a large flameproof roasting tin, pouring over the golden syrup and enough water to cover the shanks.  Place in the oven of 180c or 350f and cook for 1 to 1 1/2 hours then turn onto a warmed serving dish.  While lamb shank is cooking, make gravy by boiling the golden syrup and red food coloring until syrupy.  Pour the syrup over the lamb and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,sparerib,red capsicum,milk,chili pepper flake,vanilla bean
title: Soy Spareribs
ingredients: 8 spareribs | 1 cup milk | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 2 pods small red capsicums, sliced | 1 teaspoon crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil
instructions: Combine milk and soy sauce in a small saucepan, bring to the boil, remove from heat, stir in bean, chilli and sesame oil.  Pour over spareribs, cover and marinate for 1 hour at room temperature or refrigerate overnight, tossing occasionally.  Preheat grill to high.  Grill spareribs for 3 - 5 minutes on each side or until almost cooked through, brushing with marinade.

title: Ramen's
ingredients: 2 packages top ramen noodles | 1 can boneless beef chuck, sliced | 1 can bone-in chicken with pork | 1 bunch iceberg lettuce, leaves separated | 3 bananas, sliced
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the ramen seasoning package, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 3 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Pour the beef, chicken, and lettuce into a large bowl, and toss with the chopped bananas and ramen seasoning until well coated.  Remove and discard the seasoning packet from the water.

title: Crunchy Pecan Couscous Salad With Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 cup couscous | 4 teaspoons sun dried tomatoes | 1 large tablespoon crunchy peanut butter ( light works too ) | 1 teaspoon fish sauce | pecan halves ( to garnish )
instructions: Prepare couscous according to package.  Drain, rinse under cold water and allow to cool slightly.  Fluff couscous with a fork and add the sun dried tomatoes, peanut butter, fish sauce and pecans to couscous.  Toss gently adding a little bit more of each, as needed.

title: Beef and Parsnips N' Peas
ingredients: 2 lbs parsnips, peeled and chopped | 1 package frozen peas, thawed and drained | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons dried parsley | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne | 2 - 3 tablespoons salt and black pepper | 4 cups long-grain farfalle pasta, cooked
instructions: Place parsnips, peas, tamari, parsley, garlic and cayenne into a large bowl and toss well.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle with toasted or crumbled pine nuts before serving or you can sprinkle top with paprika before serving.

instructions: Combine sour cream, chili sauce, and tomato puree.  Add whipping cream.

instructions: Place shrimp in a skillet with aniseed, annato seeds, and a few pieces of anise flavoring. title: Turnip Dip

instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor or blender, puree until smooth.  Place in a baking dish and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.  Garnish with salsa and a cilantro sprig.

title: Sushi Eggs With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 4 fresh strawberries, cleaned with stems removed | 2 tablespoons fresh sunflower oil | 4 eggs | 2 packages nori sushi sheets | 2 tablespoons tamari liqueur | 1 teaspoon amaretto liqueur
instructions: Clean strawberries with stems removed and washed well.  Slice the fruit, and cut each strawberry in half lengthwise.  Heat the sunflower oil in a sauté pan over fairly high heat.  When the oil is smoking, toss in the strawberries and continue to stir until they begin to steam.  Remove from heat, let cool, and remove the stems.  Break open the eggs.  Use the flat side of a knife to push the yolks through the whites of the eggs with a spatula. .  Place one nori sheet in a bowl of cold water and flip over several times until dry and soft. .  Place about 2 tablespoons of the tahini sauce in the middle of the nori, then use your thumb to pinch the edges of the nori around the sauce.  Place the egg yolks on top of the sauce, and roll the sheet around the eggs inside the egg mixture.  Remove cling film from the top of the nori, and using your thumb, press the top edge of the sushi to seal.  When the sushi is finished rolling, place on to a serving platter and arrange the strawberries over the top.  Top and serve.

instructions: Drain and rinse the pinto beans and garbanzo beans.  In a medium stockpot, combine the peanut butter, mustard seeds, chicken broth and drained beans. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer until just heated through, at least 20 minutes.  Transfer to a heatproof bowl and serve warm.

title: Greek Style Feta With Lime, Rosemary and Oregano

instructions: Place feta in shallow dish, add flour, sprinkle over lemon juice, lime juice, and oregano and stir to combine.  Add the rosemary sprig and stir again to combine. title: Peperonata Dipping Sauce

instructions: Mix all ingredients.  Chill well.

title: Chorizo Beef and Rice Casserole

title: Nam Cha (Jamaican Beef and Vegetables)

Wrap brisket tightly in foil and heat until vegetables are crisp tender, about 25 minutes.  Combine all remaining ingredients in a 2 1/2 to 3 quart slow cooker/crock pot. title: Mushroom Cheese, Canadian Bacon, and Matzo

instructions: Combine the canadian bacon, mushrooms, mixed vegetables, and matzo meal in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil, and reduce heat to low. Stir the orange juice into the yogurt mixture.  Pour into the paper lined cookie sheet.  Freeze 2 hours.  Cut ice cubes into wedges and serve.

instructions: Bring 8 cups of water to a boil.  Add the dal and boil for 1 minute.  Drain the liquid into a bowl and set aside to cool. title: Italian Cream Dessert Sauce for Pudding or Pasta

title: Meat Tostados
ingredients: 3 lbs meat, cubed | 16 ounces soymilk, sour milk can be substituted | 4 -6 chipotle chiles, fresh, deveined and minced if you want extra spice | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon roasted garlic salt | 6 tomatillos, cut in half, and sliced on the bias | 1/8 cup peanut oil | 1/2 lb romano cheese, shredded
instructions: Dissolve the chipotles in the soy milk and set aside.  Brown the meat in the oil about 1 - 2 minutes.  Drain and rinse the tomatillos and place in a bowl or roasting pan with a lid.  Add about 2 tbs of the tomatillo and all of the seasoning, the garlic salt and the rest of the tomatillos and mix well.  Pour mixture over meat and add 1/4 c shredded cheese.  The sauce will thicken slightly but this is the optional step.  Stick it in and stir, or go in and stir it frequently, letting the spices meld with the meat and the soymilk.  Cook on medium heat for 15 minutes.  Take a piece of foil, place it in the center of your tostada and put the pan against the sides of the pan and the foil on the inside of the tostada.  This will create steam and prevent sticking.  It also allows for the heat of the tortillas and tostada to stay together.  If you open the tortilla, it will deflate and melt in the pan, which will make it easy to eat.  You can make a steam ring out of the tortillas, or use a tooth pick to do this.  I prefer to keep the tooth picks hot so you can eat them without burning them.  Put on grill, broiler or frying pan until crisp and brown on top.  Turn over and broil for 5 - 10 minutes.  You can also do on stove top, placing some of the tomatillo and tomato mixture on top of each tostada after the meat tostadata is finished so that you can enjoy a good sauce on there.

title: Spice Flavoured Salmon With Green Chili Peppers

Using a sharp knife, cut down the middle of the salmon on the diagonal leaving the tail on to help it slide out when the meat is cooked.  Cook on the middle rack of the oven for 8 minutes or until the top is golden.  You will need to remove the tail of the salmon before the final cooking time.  Serve warm or at room temperature.
