Put the brandy/muscat into a small pan and boil it until it has reduced by half, then put the pieces into a large bowl with a lid.  When the tofu is completely dry, pour the brandy into the bowl with the tofu and stir well so that all the tofu is coated with the liquid.  Cover to retain some moisture, then taste the brandy for sweetness.  It should be a little sweet.  Taste for sweetness.  If you want less tartness, add sugar.  When ready to serve, strain the tofu from the brandy/muscat and pat dry.  Serve it on warmed plates.  Dollop with the reserved brandy/muscat and sweet muscat wine, if desired, and garnish with more toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions.  Store in refrigerator in an airtight container.

title: Sultanas Ochs (Vietnamese Carmalise Powder)
ingredients: 2 cups sultanas or 2 cups currants | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder ( i recommend penzey's )
instructions: Grind the sultanas to a fine paste using a mill or mortar and pestle.  In a small bowl add the turmeric, and mix well.  Add the sultana paste and mix well, stirring frequently.  Store in tightly sealed tin in a cool, dark place for 2 weeks or freeze for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,great northern bean,ladyfinger,cold water,onion salt
title: Chocolate Girl's Crock Pot Pizza Beans
ingredients: 3 lbs great northern beans ( great northern beans preferred ) | 2 cans kidney beans | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon onion salt | 15 soft ladyfingers | 2 tablespoons cold water
instructions: Brown beans and 1/2 c water in large pot.  Mix water, onion salt and 1/2 c browned beans.  Put remaining browned beans in crock pot.  Pour remaining soup and mix into beans.  Cook on low for 8 hours.  I have also left the beans on the stove for an hour and a half.

title: Coconut Balls in Vodka
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 can unsweetened coconut | 1 -2 ounce vodka | 1 can or bottle sun-dried tomato juice
instructions: Mix all together except tomato juice in a large bowl.  Add tomato juice.  Form into balls the size of a walnut.

title: Aussie Mango Soup #RSC
ingredients: 1 can condensed chicken broth | 2 pears | 1 packet reynolds wrap foil | mango chutney ( for garnish )
instructions: Blend everything except chutney until smooth.  Pour into a glass bowl and let sit until flavors blend.  Serve with chutney for garnish.

title: Cucumbers With Mozzarella and Capers
ingredients:
1 cucumber, peeled, seeded, and sliced paper thin | 1 tablespoon butter | 1/4 cup reduced-fat chicken stock ( from canned this essential ingredient.
    - please note that at most times a stock can be used.
    - the low fat does not add to the cheese ) | 1 teaspoon low-fat molasses | 1/4 cup grated fontina cheese or 1/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 1/4 cup minced capers
instructions: Dressing, use a whisk to mix all ingredients together.  In a separate bowl, slice cucumber paper thin.  Remove skin.  Slice in long thin strips.

Random Ingredients: red potato,green cardamom pod,sea salt,head garlic,yellow bell pepper
title: Roasted Indian Yellow and Red Potatoes
ingredients: 2 red potatoes, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 2 tablespoons whole green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 large head garlic, peeled, and cut into halves | 2 large yellow bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Line baking sheets with aluminum foil, and place the potatoes inside.  Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, place the sea salt, cardamom pods, and garlic cloves in a large baking dish, and turn the oven off.  Poke each of the garlic cloves with a fork to release their aroma.  Pour the roasted potatoes onto the foil, and sprinkle the green bell pepper pieces on top.  Seal in the oven, and roast in the preheated oven until vegetables are tender and dark brown, about 1 hour.

title: Faux Pesto-Fried Whole Beef With a Twist
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground sirloin or 1/2 lb thinly sliced rare beef | 2 tablespoons pesto ( use a good variety! ) | 1 can coconut milk | 1 1/2 cups lightly steamed couscous | 3 -4 fresh basil leaves, washed in cold water and spun dry ( or 2 tbsp dried basil ) | 4 cups thinly sliced fresh basil leaves | 2 -3 medium apples, peeled, cored, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons vegetable oil ( or other neutral flavoring oil )
instructions: Cut the sirloin into thin strips.  In a large skillet, heat a tblsp.  Of oil.  Add it and cook it until it is golden brown.  Drain off the oil.  Add the pesto and stir a few seconds to combine and cook a few seconds more, to deglaze the pan.  Add coconut milk, stir and lower the heat.  Add the couscous & stir until it is absorbed.  Add most of the basil and stir.  Add the meat and toss until well coated with the pesto mix mixture.  Serve immediately.  Note, if you don't use italian pesto, you can also refrigerate the meat and use it to dip your fish.  For your fish, just remove it from the freezer a few minutes prior to serving it.

title: Solo Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 button mushrooms | 18 cherry peppers
instructions: Scoop out the centres of the mushrooms with your thumb.  You should be able to form a hollowed mushroom cap with a hole poked through the mushroom.  Repeat to make 6 smaller ones.  Chop the tops off the cherry peppers.  Place them in a microwave safe bowl and cover with cling wrap.  Put in the microwave, leave for 3 - 5 minutes, or until soft and tender.  Drain mushrooms, reserving the juice, and chop fine.  Combine mushroom caps with cherry peppers, mix well.  Serve.  Note, these taste best with tomato sauce for dipping.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,coriander powder,pecan half,sun tomato oil,pork shoulder blade roast,sesame seed
title: BBQ Carnitas (Mexican Pork with Pecans)
ingredients: 1 pound pork shoulder blade roast, fat trimmed | 1/4 cup sun dried tomato packed in oil, drained ( not oil packed ) | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/4 cup buttermilk | 2 tablespoons light buttermilk | 1/2 cup pecan halves, chopped
instructions: Cut pork in half lengthwise.  Toss pork with sun dried tomatoes, sesame seeds, coriander, buttermilk and pecans.  Grill until desired doneness, about 30 minutes, turning to brown evenly.

title: Chinese five-Spice Powder for Fish
ingredients: 6 tablespoons chinese five-spice powder | 1 piece fresh ginger root, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Stir together the five spice powder and ginger with the worcestershire sauce in a bowl until the mixture is evenly dispersed.  Place the mixture into a resealable plastic zipper bag, or use your hands.  Close the bag and shake thoroughly to mix the spices.  Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,chipotle chile adobo,oil,black peppercorn,baguette,baking potato
title: Chipotle Garlic Chips
ingredients: 1/2 lb baguette, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/3 cup chipotle chile in adobo, finely minced | 1 teaspoon whole black peppercorn | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons rice vinegar | 1 cup oil, for frying | 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled
instructions: Toast the baguette cubes in a dry skillet over medium low heat until brown, approximately 10 minutes.  Transfer to a plate and let cool.

Random Ingredients: chicken broth,whipping cream,pumpkin seed,chipotle pepper,orange juice concentrate,coriander
title: Chipotle Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups canned chicken broth | 3 tablespoons canned orange juice concentrate | 4 ounces canned chipotle peppers, chopped | 2 teaspoons ground coriander | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 tablespoons poppy seeds ( optional )
instructions: Puree 1/2 cup broth, orange juice concentrate, chipotles, and coriander with a blender in a blender until smooth.  Set aside.  In a skillet, heat cream on medium heat until thickened, 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in poppy seeds a few at a time, tasting constantly.  Gradually add additional broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring continuously.

title: Tandoori Microwaved English Tea
ingredients: 12 ounces green chili paste ( i bought them at indian grocer ) | 1 tablespoon dry mustard | 1/4 cup black tea
instructions: Put the english tea and dry mustard into a large microwave safe bowl and stir well.  Place bowl on a tray and cook in the microwave on high for 3 - 5 minutes.  Remove bowl and stir well.  Set aside and repeat steps 5 - 7 until the tea is cold and strong.  Enjoy.

title: Spicy Beef Satay
ingredients: 500 g rump steak, sliced | 1 tablespoon peanut butter | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 2 1/2 tablespoons enchilada sauce
instructions: Combine remaining ingredients in medium bowl and stir until well combined.  Place meat in a non stick frying pan or teriyaki pan over medium heat and cook until meat is just cooked through.  Add prepared satay to pan and place under a medium heat to sear until heated through.

title: Green Tomato and Feta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb green tomatoes, halved and seeded | 1 lb broccoli floret | 2 cups pineapple, peeled, cored and diced | 3/4 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced | 1/2 cup cilantro stem, finely chopped | 2 cups feta, crumbled | 1/2 cup vinegar
instructions: Toss green tomatoes, broccoli, pineapple, olives, cilantro and feta in a bowl with the vinegar.  Place salad in a serving dish, sprinkle with chopped cilantro.  Note you could leave out the feta.  Add more feta if you like.

title: Turnips, Onions and Lamb
ingredients: 1 kg lamb ( cut into large chunks ) | 1 kg turnip ( cut into large chunks ) | 2 cups water | 3 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Place 1 kg meat and salt in a large saucepan or wok and cover with water.  Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 3 hours or until meat is tender.  Add the turnips and continue cooking uncovered for another 30 minutes, or until meat is tender.  Meanwhile, blend the oyster sauce with 1 cup water.  Remove the meat from the saucepan and stir into it then return the meat to the saucepan.

title: Linguine With Peanut Butter and Ham Shanks
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine or 1/2 lb fettuccine | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs ham shanks | 4 fresh poblano peppers, seeded and cut into chunks | 2 teaspoons adobo seasoning | 1 -2 tablespoon peanut butter | grated rind of one whole poblano pepper
instructions: Start a large pot of water to boil.  Place the ham shank in the boiling water for approximately 5 minutes and then drain and set aside.  Prepare the peanut butter by putting the peanut butter into a bowl, stir it to combine and set aside to use as a dipping sauce later.  In the same clean bowl, rinse the poblano peppers under cold water, and then remove the poblano slices and discard the seeds.  Thinly slice them and set aside.  Cut the ham shank lengthwise into about 1/4 inch pieces.

title: Simple and Delicious Pork Sandwich -- Cuban Style
ingredients: 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 pound finely sliced country-style pork, cut into thin strips | 12 slices french bread, toasted
instructions: Pour limeade concentrate into a large bowl and set aside over medium heat.  Heat a skillet over medium high heat, and cook pork slices until evenly caramelized, about 3 minutes per side.  Top bread with pork slices and top with a few spoonfuls of the limeade concentrate.

title: Roasted Okra and Apples
ingredients: 4 large okra, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1 pound yellow cake mix, cut into 3-inch squares | 3 granny smith apples, cored and sliced into 1/4-inch thick rings
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Bring a large pan of lightly salted water to boil.  Place okra into the boiling water and cook until tender, 2 to 5 minutes.  Drain, cool, and cut into 1/2 inch squares.  Place cake mix into a large bowl of lightly salted boiling water.  Cook, stirring constantly, until cake is just set but not yet dry, 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain okra, and sprinkle evenly with dry okra.  Arrange apple slices on top of okra in the bowl.  Sprinkle with additional dry okra and apple slices.  Serve warm.

title: Joanne's Creamy Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 1 1/2 cups instant tea | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh or frozen sweetened onions
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the rigatoni, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Place the instant tea and 1/2 teaspoon of onion powder into the bowl of a blender, and blend until smooth, about 45 seconds.  Stir in the chopped onion.  If mixture starts to get too thick, gradually blend in a small amount of water, about 1/4 cup at a time.

title: Homemade Infused Cream
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | fennel seed, crushed
instructions: Prepare the cream according to the directions on the bottle, if no cream bag is available.  After removing the stem from the can of soup, mix the can with the cream of chicken in a bowl. .  Pour the contents of the bowl into another container with a thin coating of fennel seed.  After dipping your fingers into the fennel seeds, gently press the seeds into the cream so it's covered evenly.  Repeat this with the second container of soup.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 12 hours before serving.  Serve over noodles.

title: Turkey Burger
ingredients: 1/4 cup japanese-style bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon ground turkey
instructions: Place bread crumbs in a shallow bowl.  Rub turkey fat into bread crumbs with your hands, coating well.  Place in refrigerator to rest.

title: Bread and Butter Spread With Anise Seeds
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread | 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 teaspoon anise seed ( optional ) | 5 tablespoons honey
instructions: Soak the bread slices in warm water for 10 - 20 minutes or until completely dry, using a mortar and pestle.  Place the sultanas in a small mixing bowl with anise seeds.  Mix well, then add the bread and liquid mixture, and mix again thoroughly.  Place in a bread maker and follow manufacturer's instructions.

title: Easy Wedges
ingredients: 4 large eggs | 1 jar of your favorite sweet barbecue sauce ( i use campbell's sweet baby ray'brand ) | 1 package of your favorite baked peel | 1 large lime | 1 container cool whip or ( 2 1/2 ounce ) container whipped cream, chilled
instructions: Whisk eggs well, place in a large mixing bowl.  Add sweet barbecue sauce and stir to combine.  Cut lime into wedges, using a round or square cookie cutter to cut the slices into 8 wedges each.  Place in a 13 x 9 x 2 casserole dish.  Drain 1/2 litle glaze from casserole and paint over the wedge.  Repeat layering til all wedges are.  Poke holes in with a fork, pour on remaining glaze and bake at 350°f until lightly coloured, about 30 - 45 minutes.  Cut and cool completely, slice through top to bottom.  Serve with remaining whipped cream.  Refrigerate leftovers or freeze.  This would be nice served cold at room temperature with warm biscuits as a meal.

Random Ingredients: granny smith apple,red chile,jellied cranberry sauce
title: Red Apples in Cranberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 small granny smith apples, cored | 1 jar jellied cranberry sauce | 2 -3 red chiles, seeded and chopped
instructions: Peel, core and chop the apples.  Place the apples and cranberry sauce in the crock pot.  Add the chillies along with the chilis.  Stir.  Cover and cook on low for 6 - 7 hours.

Random Ingredients: pecan,anaheim chile pepper,pumpkin puree,saltpeter,porcini mushroom,spaghetti sauce,cardamom pod
title: Pumpkin and Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 3/4 pounds pumpkin puree | 5 cups spaghetti sauce | 2 pounds fresh porcini mushrooms | 1 green anaheim chile pepper | 3 medium cardamom pods | saltpeter, or as needed | 1 bunch pecans
instructions: Place the pumpkin flesh into a large pot and fill with enough water to cover the pumpkin.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 2 hours.  Drain and allow to steam dry for a few minutes.  Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f.  While the pumpkin cooks, combine the spaghetti sauce, porcini mushrooms, onion, and green bell pepper in a pot and bring to a boil.  Season with cardamom, salt, saltpeter, or as needed.  Remove from heat and allow to heat for about 30 minutes.  Once the pumpkin cooks, remove the pan from the heat and allow to stand, covered, for about 15 minutes.  Place the pumpkin and sauce mixture in an oven safe baking dish and top with pecans.  Bake in the preheated oven until sauce is bubbling and pumpkin is tender, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cranberry juice concentrate,cream chicken soup,ice cube,white wine vinegar,white cornmeal,lemon,golden syrup
title: Cranberry Polenta
ingredients: 1 cup white cornmeal | 2 cups chicken soup | 3/4 cup cranberry juice concentrate | 4 tablespoons lemon rind, finely grated | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 32 ounces sour cream or 32 ounces creme fraiche | 6 ice cubes
instructions: In a food processor, blend ingredients until you have a smooth, creamy mixture.  Put mixture into a 9 inch metal cake pan, like a pie plate and either refrigerate or freeze until firm, about at least four hours.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Pour polenta into a glass pie dish or shallow baking dish.  Bake until a fork goes into the center of the polenta, about 40 to 45 minutes, or until lightly golden brown and cracked on the top.  Cool to room temperature.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chicken thigh,paprika,grain rice,salt black pepper,steak,snow pea,ancho chile
title: Arroz Verde
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks | 8 ounces fresh snow peas, trimmed | 4 dried ancho chiles | 3 tablespoons smoked paprika | 3 tablespoons medium grain rice | 1 - 1 1/4 teaspoon salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | steak, for sandwich and toasting bread
instructions: Trim excess fat from beef and slice 2 inches thick crosswise from the blade of a sharp knife, cutting through the meat to within 1/4 inch of the opposite edge of the meat.  Cut the 1 to 1 1/4 teaspoons chiles crosswise into 3/4 inch wide strips and soak them in hot water for 15 minutes.  Remove the chiles and rinse them with cold water, drain, and set aside.  Remove stems and seeds from 3 chiles, break them into quarters, and scrape out and discard seed strings with a teaspoon.  Cut one of the strips into 1/4 inch wide strips, trimming away the root end and most of the black membrane.  Wash and dry the remaining 3 chiles.  Heat a 1 inch of oil in a large skillet over moderately high heat until it foams instantly, then fry the snow peas in batches with a pinch of salt and pepper, stirring to brown them on all sides, for about 4 minutes or so.  Place chiles on paper towels to drain, cut along the rim of the skillet, add the meat strips, and fry, turning over the strips, for 3 minutes or so, or until they are crisp.  Remove and drain on paper towels.  Cut the remaining strips into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Serve the meat with the vegetables and rice sprinkled with paprika, bread, and the chiles.

title: Sour and Spicy Five-Spice Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 2 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1/3 cup olive, sliced
instructions: Remove all giblets from chicken & discard.  Trim all excess fat or extra fat.  Sprinkle 1 1/2 tspps.  Of the five spice powder over chicken and scatter the rest of the five spice.  Place the chicken in a large roasting tin or casserole.  Spread the sliced olives on top of the chicken.  Cover with a tight fitting lid or tightly cover with aluminum foil.  Place in a preheated oven and cook for 1 1/2 hours remove from the oven and allow to sit for 10 mins.  Remove from the foil and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: lasagne noodle,green chili pepper,spice,cream cheese,ricotta cheese,sage leaf,thyme sprig
title: Green Manchego Lasagne
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagne noodles | 8 slices cream cheese, whipped | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 1 cup diced green chili pepper | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh thyme sprig | 1 tablespoon minced chives or 1 tablespoon chives | 3/4 - 1 teaspoon seasoned mixed spice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f boil noodles in a large kettle filled with lightly salted water for 4 - 5 minutes.  Drain.  In large bowl, combine whipped cream cheese, ricotta, green chiles, thyme, chives and seasonings.  Add noodles and combine well.  Spread half of cheese mixture evenly in a 9x13 baking dish.  Top with remaining cheese mixture and bake until top is bubbly and hot and top is golden brown and crisp, about 30 - 35 minutes.

title: Italian Crumb Pastry
ingredients: 1 cup toasted pecans | 2 cups miniature-cracker crumbs | 1 cup plain unsweetened soymilk | 1/4 cup catsup | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1/4 cup chopped italian parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped olives | 1 recipe pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f grind pecans in food processor until fine.  Combine pecans, crumbs, soymilk, catsup, nutmeg, and parsley in a medium bowl.  Press mixture evenly into bottom of pastry crust.  Arrange olives around crust.  Sprinkle with crumb mixture.  Bake until golden, 20 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,jalapeno pepper,white bread,baking powder,catsup,cumin powder,cottage cheese
title: Baked Shrimp
ingredients: 8 ounces raw shrimp | 8 ounces small curd cottage cheese | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/4 teaspoon baking powder | 1 pinch of jalapeno pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup catsup | 1 slice white bread, cubed
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp, then pat dry with paper towels.  In a mixing bowl mix cottage cheese, 1 tsp cumin and baking powder, jalapeno pepper and catsup.  Stir in shrimp with marinade.  Mix in crouton, top with remaining crumbs.  Place bread on a baking sheet and bake at 400ºf for about 15 - 20 minutes until golden and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: water,vegetable oil,onion powder,kielbasa,sharp cheddar cheese,quinoa,milk powder,savory
title: Quinoa Cheddar Nests
ingredients: 6 cups water | 1 cup quinoa, rinsed and drained | 6 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1/3 cup finely chopped onions or 1/3 cup dried onion flakes | 1/4 cup kielbasa, cooked and cubed | 3/4 cup low-fat milk powder, or 1/4 cup dry milk | 2 tablespoons dried savory | 1 3/4 cups shredded low-fat sharp cheddar cheese or 1 3/4 cups shredded low fat sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Place rice in a wide, shallow bowl and cover with water.  Drain completely.  Microwave water, quinoa, oil, onion and kielbasa in a large microwaveable mixing bowl on high, uncovered, 2 to 3 minutes, or until quinoa is tender.  Stir in drained rice and milk, savory and cheese to combine.  Spoon into a sprayed 12 cup muffin tin, pressing out excess.  Carefully fill each muffin tin half way with rice mixture to make 3 nests.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high power, using 600w.  Microwave on high power until cheese is melted, about 5 to 8 minutes.  Remove from microwave and sprinkle with additional cheese.  Let cool 3 to 5 minutes, watching carefully to avoid the cheese burning.

Random Ingredients: rose wine,topping,grain rice,chicken breast half,cumin,clove,cream chicken soup
title: Creamy Cumin Chicken
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 10 ounces condensed cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup rose wine | 2 tablespoons ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 cups cooked long-grain rice | 1/2 cup low-fat sour cream | 3 -4 tablespoons reduced-fat low-fat sour cream
instructions: Place chicken breasts in lightly greased 9x13 baking dish.  In a medium bowl, combine the soup, wine, cumin and cloves.  Spread over the chicken breasts.  Cover dish and bake at 350ºf for 1 hour or until chicken is done and no longer pink in the center.  Remove from oven and cool for 10 minutes or until slightly cooled.  Cut chicken between bones into 1/4 inch slices.  Spoon the soup over chicken and rice.  Top with sour cream and serve with crackers or bread to be.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,hot paprika,horseradish,pork tenderloin,coriander seed,ranch salad dressing
title: Savory Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons coarsely crushed coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons hot paprika | 1 1/2 pounds pork tenderloin, thinly sliced | 1 bottle ranch-style salad dressing | 1 teaspoon grated horseradish
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the coriander.  Cook and stir until fragrant and beginning to brown, about 30 seconds.  Stir in the paprika, then add the pork and saute until browned on the outside, 1 to 2 minutes per side and no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes.  Spread the salad dressing on top of the pork.  Sprinkle with horseradish and return to medium high heat.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: italian flat leaf parsley,pea carrot,baby bok choy
title: Italian-Style Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons italian flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3 baby bok choy, sliced 3/4 inch thick | 2 teaspoons peas and carrots, cut in half
instructions: Toss ingredients together.  Serve.

title: Passover Art Culinary Soup  (Chádigay)
ingredients: 15 ounces red kale, packed roughly | 1 vegetable bouillon cube | 16 ounces champagne ( i've also used other white wine instead ) | 3 tablespoons dry mizithra cheese or 3 tablespoons gouda cheese, shredded | sliced garlic ( in brine, for garnish ) | 1 slice galangal ( in strips, in a pinch, the size and thickness of a quarter, you need more to saute ) | 1 cup matzo meal
instructions: Wash greens and snap off stems.  Cut in half if large.  Cut large leaves into manageable pieces.  Cut in half if smaller.  Place water in a microwave safe container and add bouillon cube.  Microwave on high power for 1 minute.  When cube is ready and its contents are warm, place in a large microwave safe bowl.  Add champagne.  Cover bowl with lid.  Microwave on high power for 1 minute then turn down power to medium.  Cook for 40 minutes or until al dente.  Place cheese in bowl with greens.  Cover bowl with lid.  Microwave on high power for 5 - 60 seconds, mix cheese and greens thoroughly.  Add mustard leaves, chopped garlic and galangal.  Mix thoroughly.  Stir and microwave until cheese is melted.  Do not boil.  Serve immediately.

title: Mesir Ezhi - Green Stuff from El-Aria
ingredients: 14 ounces yoghurt | 3 -4 poblano chiles ( canned or fresh ) | 3 -4 tablespoons chopped pistachios
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Cut off and discard stem end and seeds from poblanos.  Fill a small baking dish with 1/3 cup water.  Sprinkle chilies with salt and toss to coat.  Place in water, cover and bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 35 - 45 minutes.  Remove cover and continue baking until mixture is brown and tender inside and slightly blackened at the edges.  Remove chilies, remove poblanos and set aside.  Add yoghurt to chilies, return to oven to get it hot.  Remove from oven, drain liquid out and discard solids.  Place back on stove for about 10 minutes, stirring and turning the mixture every 2 minutes.  Place 1/2 cup of the yogurt mixture in a large bowl.  Add poblanos and 1 - 2 tbsp pistachios.  Stir to mix.  Stuff into individual chilies.  Place stuffed chilies on a baking sheet and top with remaining yogurt mixture.  Sprinkle with remaining pistachios. .  Bake in a hot oven until brown and melted.  Serve with a salad.

title: Dill Pickle-Hot Dog
ingredients: 1 cup yellow pepper ( or any sweet variety ) | 12 slices dill pickles | 1/8 - 1/4 cup chili oil
instructions: Wash and dry your bell peppers.  Arrange the slices of pickles on a grill pan and heat them up in a microwave or oven.  While you are heating up the pickles, heat the chili oil until hot.  When you remove the pickles from the grill, brush lightly with hot oil.  Place the coated pickles on your grill pan or frying pan, and heat until the pickles are hot and crisp.  These pickles are tasty and delicious on toast.  Also, after flipping the pickles place them on a platter or toaster as a topping for your hot dogs.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,bailey irish cream,heavy whipping cream,buttermilk,spanish onion
title: Baileys Sweet & Creamy Spanish Onion Mousse
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs spanish onions ( about 2.
    -5 medium sized onions ) | 1 1/2 cups buttermilk ( or plain yogurt of your choice ) | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: Wash your onions and cut into chunks about 1/2 inch and 3/4 inch long.  Place in water until they are very soft.  Drain.  Set them aside to rest.  Preheat oven to 150 degrees f.  In a bowl, mix the buttermilk and cream together until smooth.  Place the drained onions in a colander and toss with the drained onions.  Spread mixture in the bottom of a 2 cup metal baking dish.  Sprinkle with just a little salt.  Bake for 45 minutes, covered.  Remove from oven.

title: Artichokes a La Napoleanes
ingredients: 1 lb artichoke, washed | 4 egg yolks | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | chicken fat ( optional ) or olive oil ( optional )
instructions: Drain artichokes well and chop about the size of your finger.  Heat fat over medium heat in a skillet.  Add artichokes, salt and cinnamon.  Mix well and cook about 5 minutes.  Add the egg yolks, cover the skillet and cook over low heat about 5 minutes, or until mixture thickens and egg is mixed well.  Serve with rice.  Note, for vegetarian use only the chicken fat or olive oil.

title: Lea's Easy Bread Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs white bread | 8 lemons, juice and zest of | 8 tortillas, torn ( for salad )
instructions: Put the bread into a large mixing bowl with the lemon juice add the zest and enough water to cover the bread.  Let this sit in the refrigerator approximately 8 to 10 hours or overnight.  After about 10 - 15 minutes the bread should be toasty, and slightly firm.  Let the dish cool down.  Cut pieces of bread off of crusts and use a slotted spoon scoop out the bread from the bread and set the pit in the middle and divide it into smaller pieces and then return it to the bowl and toss it well.  Serve cold.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,hard egg,cherry,sherry wine,cottage cheese,lump crabmeat,egg,olive oil
title: Baked Shells With Crab and Egg
ingredients: 20 medium hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1 1/2 cups small lump crabmeat | 8 tablespoons olive oil | 1 1/2 cups small curd cottage cheese | 1/3 cup sherry wine | 1 1/2 cups chopped canned tomatoes with chili pepper flakes | 2 eggs, lightly beaten | 1 cup chopped stuffed olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In a large bowl, combine cooked eggs, imitation crabmeat, oil, cottage cheese, sherry, tomato, eggs, and olives.  Mix well.  Spoon mixture into a well buttered shallow 1 1/2 quart baking pan.  Bake for 25 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white shoepeg corn,steak,vodka,savory,orange juice,green bell pepper,head cabbage
title: Smokin' Hot Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs round steaks, cut into 3/4 & quot, cubes | 1 small head of cabbage, cut into wedges, divided | 1 small green bell pepper, chopped | 1 can white shoepeg corn, undrained | 1/4 blood orange juice | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 1/2 cup vodka
instructions: Put beef into a large saucepan or dutch oven.  Sprinkle with 1/2 the cabbage, bell pepper and corn.  Toss and add rest of the veggies.  Add 1/2 the vodka and orange juice. Random Ingredients: miracle whip,salsa,anchovy fillet,mustard seed,flat leaf parsley,beef stew meat,pineapple ring,burrito seasoning mix
title: Spicy Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 packet of burrito seasoning mix ( not sure of size ) | 1 can pineapple rings or 1 1/2 cups crushed pineapple | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley | 2 anchovy fillets, chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 teaspoon dry mustard seeds ( from anchovies ) | 2 teaspoons miracle whip ( optional ) | pineapple rings, for sandwich ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the pineapple rings in a large sauce pan and heat to boil.  Once it boils, reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 - 30 minute's until meat is tender and sauce thickens.  Top burritos with remaining pineapple rings and serve immediately.

title: Red Curry Wrapped in Bacon (Mark Bittman)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon red curry paste or 1 teaspoon yellow curry paste | 1/2 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon paprika | 125 g smoked prosciutto or 125 g other crispy ham, chopped
instructions: Combine the curry paste, soda and paprika in a medium ceramic or glass bowl.  Stir in the ham and mix well.  Using a wooden, metal spoon scrape away any excess air.  Microwave for 45 seconds or until the bacon is glazed and heated through.  Allow the bacon to cook in this way, for about 1 - 2 minutes, stirring once or twice.  Serve with steamed white and black steamed rice.

title: Crabby Romaine Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups imitation crabmeat, cut into chunks | 1 cup romaine lettuce | 1/2 cup roasted sweet red pepper, slices | 1/2 cup button mushrooms, sliced in half
instructions: Place imitation crabmeat in the center of a lettuce leaf.  Top with sweet red pepper slices.  Fold top and bottom to form a burrito.  Serve with favorite accompaniments.

title: Cotija Cheese With Green
ingredients: 1/4 cup crumbled cotija cheese | 3 green cardamom pods
instructions: Split cardamom pods.  In a small skillet toast them.  Place on a serving platter and put a couple of tablespoons of the cotija in small pieces.  Serve on top of the crumbled cheese, if desired.  Note you can add 1/4 cup chopped fresh tomato for a topping.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,penne pasta,chicken,shell macaroni,coconut cream,banana,italian herb seasoning,sauce
title: Coconut Mac
ingredients: one box small shell macaroni | 1 box penne pasta | 1 1/2 cups chicken, cooked | 1 small package sliced bananas | 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 can coconut cream | 8 ounces shrimp sauce | 2 tablespoons mixed italian herbs seasoning | 1 tablespoon hot sauce ( i use tabasco because it has a strong flavour )
instructions: Combine pasta, chicken and spices in the order directed.  Cook on stove over medium heat until pasta is done.

title: Pork Flavoured Basmati or Rice
ingredients: 1 cup rice | 1 1/2 cups chicken bouillon | 1 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional )
instructions: Wash rice under running water.  Add all ingredients to a large pan.  Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer, cover and cook until all liquid liquid is absorbed.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,tomato paste,spanish onion,cherry pie filling
title: Spicy Tomato & Green Chili
ingredients: 2 cans sliced hot green chili peppers | 1 can tomato paste | 1 large spanish onion, chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 1 can cherry pie filling
instructions: Combine tomato paste and onion in large non stick skillet until well mixed.  Heat over medium heat until mixture is hot but not boiling, simmer for 5 minutes.  Stir in chili peppers and cherry pie filling.  Heat through.  Serve as desired.

title: Plum Conserve
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs plums, plucked | 4 star anise | 3 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs cherries, pitted | 1 teaspoon baking soda | powdered icing or sugar
instructions: Remove seeds from plums and place in a large pan with star anise and vinegar.  Pour boiling water over the fruit and boil for about 45 mins, stirring often until liquid is reduced by half.  Remove plums from heat and leave to stand until required.  The liquid may be cooled before spooning into hot sterilized jars.  Fill sterilised jars and press lids to the top with wet finger covers.  Seal with boiling water following manufacturer's instructions.  Process for 10 mins in boiling water until they can be picked off the edge with a skewer.

Random Ingredients: sunflower oil,bay leaf,orange peel,maple syrup,mexican corn,almond essence
title: Corn With Oil, Mexican Sweet & Almonds
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups whole grain mexican-style corn | 5 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 orange peel | 2 -3 drops almond essence ( optional )
instructions: Heat the oil then reduce to low heat.  In a large bowl mix the corn, orange peel, syrup & bay leaf.  Pour oil into a heavy based pan.  Add corn & orange peel.  Toss in the almond & almond essence if using.  Cook for 15 - 20 mins shaking the pan occasionally.  Remove from heat & serve hot.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,red wine vinegar,ginger powder,whiskey,macaroni,cocoa powder,green chilies
title: Prawns With Macaroni
ingredients: 2 cups macaroni, cooked | 1 green chilies, diced | 1 tablespoon ginger powder | 3 teaspoons red wine vinegar ( i use 2 tablespoons but it is up to you ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons whiskey | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Cook macaroni as per pkg directions.  Drain and keep hot.  Meanwhile combine all the ingreients except the macaroni.  Once macaroni is cooked drain and add to the dressing.  Mix well.  Serve over macaroni with crackers.

title: Tikka Sauce
ingredients: 3 yellow onions | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 3 cups peanut sauce or 3 cups tikka shiraz sauce
instructions: Peel and cut onions into chunks.  Dissolve the cornstarch in 3/4 cup water and mix into the remaining water.  Pour the sauce in a large, heavy saucepan.  Heat over medium heat until boiling.

Random Ingredients: curry leaf,italian parsley,creme fraiche,sole fillet,bread crumb
title: Curried Sole
ingredients: 4 sole fillets | 4 tablespoons italian-style parsley sprigs, chopped | 1/4 cup soft bread crumbs | 1/4 cup creme fraiche | 3 slices crusty buttered bread crumbs
instructions: Place sole in shallow 1 quart glass baking dish.  Combine parsley, bread crumbs, cream fraiche and parsley sprigs.

Random Ingredients: ginger beer,cake flour,chicken wing,extra virgin olive oil,oat,cachaca,beef chuck,white flour
title: Cachaca Beer & Honey Pulled Chicken Wings
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/3 cup white flour | 1 teaspoon ground ginger ( bottled or canned ) | 1/2 cup guacamole or 1/2 cup cachaca | 4 lbs chicken wings | 2 cups oat | 2 cups ale or 2 cups bourbon
instructions: To make sauce, in large bowl, mix together flour, oil, ginger, guacamole, and beer or bourbon.  Cut wings into thirds and tie into knots.  Place in crockery dishes and pour over sauce.  Cover.  Cook for 3 hours or till wings are browned and crisp.  Remove from crockery dishes, drain and chill in refrigerator overnight.  Bring to simmering point and cook 10 minutes.  Serve with rice and raisins, if desired.

Random Ingredients: tomato garlic,golden syrup,water,vegetable oil cooking spray,beef roast,ancho chilies,red pepper flake
title: Quick Beef 'n' Red Sauce
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable oil or 2 teaspoons cooking spray | 1 package beef roast, trimmed, cut into 1-inch pieces | 6 1/2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1 can diced ancho chilies | 1 can diced tomatoes with garlic | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon golden syrup
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over moderately high heat.  Sprinkle the roast with salt and pepper.  Add the beef to the pan.

title: French Stilton Cottage Garden Gift
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups stock | 1/2 cup stilton cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons limoncello | 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup grand marnier ( or orange juice )
instructions: Place the water and Stilton into a saucepan over medium high heat.  Cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent any sticking.  Reduce heat to low, stir in limoncello and confectioners' sugar and simmer for 10 minutes, or until thickened.  Serve warm.

title: Quick & Simple Vegetarian Chili
ingredients: 300 g pinto beans | 150 g white mushroom | 200 ml white grape juice ( if using grape concentrate omit the water called for in the ingredients section )
instructions: Place pinto beans in a pot of boiling water and boil for 20 minutes until just tender.  Drain and rinse the beans in cold water.  Remove the skins then rinse them under cold water until they are cold.  Cut the mushrooms into halves or quarters.  Dice the mushrooms, then place them into a frypan over a medium heat.  Remove the lid and the mushrooms from the pan, add the grape juice to the frypan and bring to the boil.  Add the dried beans to the frypan, gently mix together.  Cook for 5 minutes, or until the beans are coated with the hot chilli sauce.  Serve immediately.  The chilli can be eaten straight away, but the flavours improve and improve on standing.

title: Mushroom-And-Lover's Mushrooms
ingredients: 24 large cremini mushrooms ( cremini aubergines or other brown mushrooms of your choice ) | 8 cups mangoes, cut into cubes
instructions: Chop mushrooms very fine.  Put in a crock pot, stir in mango cubes until mixed.  Cook on high for about 4 hours.

title: Saffron Balls (For Ramblinha or Love Letter Recipes)
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon saffron
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly except saffron in a large bowl.  Cover and chill for an hour.  Shape balls from the mixture into small balls.  Heat a ghee in a frying pan over medium flame.  Cook till golden brown.  Dip the balls in saffron, then in crumb mixture.  Fry them in the ghee till golden on either side.

Random Ingredients: greek olive,dark sesame oil,beef bouillon cube,nutmeg,graham cracker crumb,pork shoulder
title: Pork Pie from Tyler Florence
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder or 3 lbs tenderloin | 2 cans greek olives, drained | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 14 ounces ready made greek olives, sliced fine and rinsed | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1/10 cup graham cracker crumbs, divided
instructions: Place pork shoulder or tenderloin in large roasting pan, add water to cover, add 3 bouillon cubes, then the olives.  Bake in preheated 375f oven for 20 to 30 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Heat oven to 350f.  Heat sesame oil in a large covered saucepan.  Add remaining 3 bouillon cubes plus 1/3 cup water.  Bring to boil, stirring.  Add graham cracker crumbs, stirring until well mixed.  Pour filling into baked pastry shell.  Dot with remaining cracker crumbs.  Cover loosely with foil.  Bake for about 1 hour or until pork is tender.  Serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Creamy Caccitos
ingredients: 1 cup light plain yogurt | 2 tilapia fillets | 1 can crabmeat, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 f degrees.  Place the tilapia fillets in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Combine yogurt and crabmeat in a large bowl.  Pour yogurt mixture over the tilapia fillets and gently stir to coat each fillet thoroughly.  Arrange fillets in baking dish.  Bake at 350 f degrees for 30 minutes, or until fish flakes when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,ancho chile,kale,tomato juice,yellow squash,garbanzo bean
title: Vegetable Kale Chili
ingredients: 2 cans garbanzo beans ( with liquid ) | 3 bunches kale | 1 can stewed tomatoes with juice | 1 can yellow squash, drained | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning | 2 tablespoons crushed ancho chiles
instructions: In a large pot, add all ingredients and simmer on high heat for about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until kale is tender and kale is cooked.  Mash with masher until desired consistency.  Serve with pita bread or tortilla chips.

title: Seedless Refried Beans
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups cooked kidney beans | 3 serrano peppers, seeded and chopped | 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Combine the beans, serrano peppers, toasted sesame seeds, and mace in a microwave safe bowl.  Heat the mixture in the microwave on high setting for 2 minutes, or until bubbly.  Pour the bean mixture into a serving dish, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.  Serve warm.

title: Grill Zucchini
ingredients: 4 slices bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces | 4 zucchini, halved lengthwise, then halved crosswise into 1/4 thick slices
instructions: Place zucchini in a bowl and sprinkle with salt.  Heat a grill pan over high heat for 10 seconds, then place bacon pieces on top.  Place 2 or 3 zucchini on the rack of an ungreased grill pan, and cook until zucchini is crisp.  Turn, season with salt and grill for 3 to 5 minutes, or just until zucchini is tender.  Serve.

title: Easy Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 can tomato juice | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet on low.  Add your can of tomatoes to the skillet.  You may have to do this to each can to be a little bit bigger.

title: Crispy Peanut Shells
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated crescent roll dough, room temperature and defrosted | 2 teaspoons peanut oil
instructions: Unroll 3 tubes of the crescent roll dough on a work surface.  Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat until it shimmers, about 1 minute.  Remove the crescent rolls from the can and spread half of the crescent dough in a thin layer on each flat plate or round cake pan.  Top with a second flat plate and top with the remaining crescent roll dough.

title:
St.
    - Louis Beef and Pepper Enchilada Soup
ingredients: 1 green and red bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, chopped | 4 ounces sliced pickled jalapeno peppers or 4 ounces diced jalapeno peppers, drained | 1 lb ground sirloin steak ( at least 80 % ) or 1 lb ground turkey ( at least 80 % ) | 4 ounces red enchilada sauce | 8 leaves fresh chives, finely chopped | 5 2/3 cups beef broth or 5 2/3 cups chicken broth | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon granules or 2 teaspoons instant granules
instructions: In a 3 1/2 or 4 quart dutch oven, combine the green and red bell peppers, jalapenos or tomatoes, beef, enchilada sauce, chives and bouillon.  Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover and simmer over low heat until the meat is cooked through, about 1 1/2 hours.  With a slotted spoon, remove the meat to the top of the soup, discard the chives.  Ladle hot soup onto plates.  Serve hot with a large spoonful of hot soup.

title: Irish Tuna and Mango Stew
ingredients: 1 can whole baby clams, drain | 1 can tuna, drained | 1 can mangoes, drained | 1/2 cup dark beer | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced fresh green chilies | 3 cups cubed hash brown potatoes
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine clam, tuna, mango, beer, vinegar, chiles and potatoes.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Slow Cooker Kielbasa and Salsa

instructions: Arrange the kielbasa in the bottom of a slow cooker.  Combine the rotel, ginger garlic paste, and salsa.

title: Steak Flambe
ingredients: 4 steaks, 4 oz each | 3 tablespoons cream cheese, softened | 20 button mushrooms | 1/4 cup orange peel, coarsely chopped | 1 can coconut rum | 1 potato
instructions: Trim meat of all fat.  With 1 tbls cream cheese mixed with mushrooms and orange peel, mix well.  Spread a thin coating of cream cheese on the top of each steak.  Bake in a 400f degrees oven for 30 minutes.  Place potatoes on a hot grill, brush with the remaining cream cheese.  Grill on each side about 5 minutes until browned.  Serve steaks with rum sauce.

title: Homemade Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 1/2 cup milk | 1 tablespoon finely chopped white onion | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste | 10 fresh large grape leaves, rinsed and dried | 1 package frozen phyllo pastry dough, thawed and sliced into circles
instructions: Heat the milk in a small skillet over medium low heat.

title: Beef and Warm Eggplant Salad
ingredients: 2 slices eggplant, about 1/2-inch thick | 1 tart apple, such as fuji, granny smith's or 1 fuji, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, pitted and sliced | 1/4 cup plain nonfat yogurt | 1 small cucumber, chopped | 3/4 lb boneless sirloin steak, sliced thin | 2 eggs, hard boiled and sliced | maple syrup, for drizzling
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place eggplant slices, apple slices in a single layer on a broiler pan.  Broil 4 from heat, turning once or twice, until lightly charred and slightly blackened, 1 to 3 minutes per side.  Transfer vegetables to a bowl and let cool slightly.  While warm, cut all but 1 slice of apple into thin matchsticks.  In a food processor, combine yogurt, cucumber, and steak slices.  Process until just combined.  Place steak on a broiler pan and roast under preheated broiler 2 to 3 minutes on each side, or until desired degree of doneness is reached.  Whisk eggs in a bowl.  Divide egg mixture among 4 plates.  Top with steak, onions, and cucumber dressing.  Drizzle with maple syrup.

title: Grilled Halibut
ingredients: 4 -6 ounces halibut fillets | 1 white sweet yellow pepper, chopped | 1 small leek, chopped | 1 tablespoon peanut butter
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat.  Spray a small skillet with nonstick spray.  Rinse fillets and pat dry with paper towels.  Add the sweet pepper, leek and peanut butter to the olive oil.  Sauté until fish is browned and the vegetables are softened.  Divide fish among the 4 servings, and serve with warm bread to dip.

title: Quick and Easy Poppy Seed Cookies
ingredients: 2 cups poppy seeds | 1 1/2 cups flour ( or as needed )
instructions: In a medium sized bowl add poppy seeds and salt.  Mix well.  Add flour little by little to make a smooth dough.  Drop by spoonfuls on a greased cookie tray.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Carnivian Grill Grill Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb thin sliced steak ( thin sliced or whatever it will be cut ) | 1 package thin spaghetti sauce, your favorite variety | 10 -12 thin slices deli roast beef, sandwich size pieces or 10 -12 thin sandwich sized slice hoisin sauce | 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed of excess water | 1 can coconut milk | 1/2 orange, cut into segments for eating ( or use 2-3 slices of lime ) | 4 -6 leaves of fresh mint ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons seasoning salt
instructions: In a large skillet heat all the coconut milk until simmering.  Pour into a bowl and stir in a few tablespoons of orange juice as a dipping sauce.  Add the mushrooms and orange segments and stir together.  Place the slices of meat on a large plate and add a little olive oil to fry them on both side, in a pre heated pan or skillet.  Sear the meat for approximately 2 minutes each side.  Remove from the pan and set aside.  Add the mushrooms and olives to the pan and let soften for approximately 2 - 3 minutes.  Return the steak to the pan and add the spaghetti sauce, letting it heat through for approximately 5 minutes.  When the beef slices are done drain them in a colander and put them on a plate.  To serve put 3 - 4 slices of meat on each of 4 dinner plates.  Sprinkle your favorite topping over the meat, and top with some cooked spaghetti noodles or some chopped lettuce, chopped tomato etc.  Serve right away.  The broth will make the difference here is a tip to make sure your pasta is not too busy and the meat is not falling apart.

title: Spicy Bread Salad With Hot Dressing Recipe
ingredients: 8 -10 slices of the best quality artisan-style soft bread or 8 -10 slices of the best quality fresh bread | 4 teaspoons canola oil ( or other oil ) | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( or 1/2 teaspoon of red pepper flakes ) | 1 cup ice cream, room temperature ( or the flavor level of your choice, to your taste ) | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca, such as wondra or 3 tablespoons of all-natural unsweetened peanut butter ( or more )
instructions: Put the slice of bread on a cutting board.  You should have about 4 slices and about 8 slices.  Drizzle the canola oil on the slices and sprinkle the chili flakes on top.  Set a pan over medium heat, then let the oil to come to a boil.  Remove from heat and add the ice cream or peanut butter.  Taste for seasoning, add more seasonings, if desired.  If your ice cream is at room temperature, you need to warm it up again, then you have to add it to the mixture.  Put the slices of bread on a serving plate or cutting board and drizzle with some of the dressing and serve immediately.  Alternatively you can assemble the slices by placing them next to each other and using the dressing at the table.  This can be made in advance as well, such as making the dressing the night before and allowing to marinate.

title: Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasting chicken | 1 tablespoon basil | 1 tablespoon cardamom | 1 teaspoon coriander | 2 teaspoons cinnamon sugar | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 2 tablespoons chicken stock cubes ( or more if needed ) | 1 corn on the cob, husked and cut away
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c, gas mark 3 remove and place chicken breast side up into a roasting tin.  Rub with basil, cardamom, coriander, cinnamon sugar, ketchup and rice vinegar.  Score chicken breast with a sharp knife to allow a little of the marinade to run into the meat.  Place corn cobs with the husk on a cutting board and place into the middle of the chicken breast.  Prick the breast in several places with a fork.  Insert some skewers along the side of the chicken.  Bake for 45 - 50 minutes until cooked through.  Remove from the oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach Salad Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh spinach leaves | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the spinach.  Dough will be soft and sticky.  Wrap the leaves loosely with a damp cloth and place in the refrigerator for about one hour.  Drain and squeeze all excess liquid from the spinach leaves.  Combine the spinach in a bowl.  Combine the dark soy and soy sauce in a small bowl, stirring well then pour over the spinach.  Mix before serving note, you can use fresh green leaves which should be washed thoroughly before each use.

title: Pumpkin Taco Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb shelled green peas | 1/2 cup crushed tortilla chips ( regular size ) | 1/4 cup chopped mixed nuts | 1 tablespoon canned pumpkin puree
instructions: Blend all, mix well and serve.

title: Guatemalan Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa | 2 cups soymilk | 10 ounces queso fresco, crumbled ( mexican queso fresca ) | 1 1/2 cups double cream
instructions: Rinse quinoa, in 2 cups water, bring to a boil.  Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, remove quinoa from heat, uncover and set aside.  While quinoa is cooking, heat soymilk.  When quinoa is sufficiently cool, stir in queso fresco cheese and double cream.  Pour into casserole with quinoa as a layer and bake at 400 degrees until quinoa is heated throughout and cheese is melted.

title: Baked Cantaloupe W- Coconut Cracker
ingredients: 1 cup maraschino cherry, finely chopped | 1 cup fresh coconut, coarsely grated | 1/2 cup fettuccine, uncooked | 16 ounces cantaloupe, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Arrange cantaloupe on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle with cherries and coconut.  Bake covered in oven for 10 minutes.  Remove peel from cantaloupe with a paring knife and carefully cut into thin slices.

title: Tikka Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 teaspoon dried celery salt
instructions: Combine the salt with the yogurt and herbs.  Stir through until smooth.

title: Sweet and Hot Peppered Penne With Spicy Peppered Peppers and Onions
ingredients: 16 ounces penne rigate | 1 1/2 teaspoons reduced-sodium instant minced garlic and fresh minced garlic | 2 teaspoons bottled chili flakes | 1/2 teaspoon good quality curry powder
instructions: Cook penne rigate according to package directions.

title: Breadcrumbs for the Slow Cooker or Delight
ingredients: 3 slices white bread | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/4 cup ghee | 1/2 loaf bread, sliced into cubes
instructions: Place the 3 slices of bread on a cookie sheet in the oven.  Use the ghee in the skillet to make bread crumbs.  Place the 2 slices of bread on top of each other and press down lightly with your hands to press the bread slightly to form bread crumbs.  Set aside in the 300 degree oven to cool completely.  Turn the oven on to its lowest setting.  Place the 3 slices of bread in a clean baking pan and brush tops lightly with the ghee.  Place the bread crumbs in the oven for about 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and immediately turn crumbs.  Continue on to make bread crumbs until all has been cooked and serve in warm pita breads.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash With Maraschino Caramel
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs butternut squash | 1 jar maraschino cherries, drained and juice reserved
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 f.  Cut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out seeds with a melonballer.  Toss squash with cherry juice and maraschino cherry halves.  Place on sheet tray and bake one hour.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,curry powder,nonfat milk,brandy,apple juice,red wine
title: Normandy Brandy Churros
ingredients: 4 links hot chorizo sausage, removed from the casings | 1 cup nonfat evaporated milk | 1/2 cup brandy ( or rum if you can find it ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 cup red wine | 1/2 tablespoon apple juice ( optional )
instructions: Toast chorizo in skillet over medium heat.  While chorizo cooks, mix together all ingredients in a medium bowl.  Cook to desired consistency.  Spoon into chorizo coated ramekins, wrap in foil, and chill for at least an hour before serving.

title: Chinese Radishes with Mixed Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 kg mixed radishes | 1 red pepper | 2 tablespoons bicarbonate of soda | 2 bunches radish | 200 g frozen pak choi
instructions: Wash the mixed radishes and cut into thick, thin slices.  Slice the pepper and radishes into thin strips.  Place all the vegetables into a large bowl, sprinkle with the soda and mash in to mix.  Fill into 8 serving bowls and leave to stand for 20 minutes.

title: Hawaiian Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup light olive oil | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons white grape juice or 2 tablespoons rum | 1 teaspoon vanilla flavoring | 1 egg | 1/2 lb whole wheat loaf
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Brush the inside of a 9x5x3 loaf pan with the olive oil and place the loaf pan in a roasting pan filled with about 3/4 of the pan's depth.  Dice the pineapple, grape juice, and vanilla in a small bowl.  Mix well with a fork and beat in the egg.  Pour the egg into the large bowl of a mixer fitted with the paddle attachment.  Add the bread in small batches of about 3 tablespoons of the bread in a thin stream, mixing each addition after each addition, until each loaf has been used.  When all the bread has been added, mix it until it is incorporated.  Tear into small pieces and add to the remaining marinade.  Add additional vanilla, sugar, lemon juice, and rum.  Stir just until evenly mixed, to make sure all the bread is evenly coated.  Bake 25 - 30 minutes or until golden and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.  Cool 20 minutes, then carefully unmold loaf over a plate, and invert onto a serving platter.  Remove the plate from the pan and allow to cool to room temperature.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef flavor ramen noodle,dijon mustard,swiss cheese,liquid honey,purpose flour
title: Honey Mustard Swiss Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 2 packages beef-flavor ramen noodles | 6 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon liquid evaporated honey | 1 1/2 cups swiss cheese, grated and divided | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
instructions: Prepare ramen according to package directions with no seasoning added.  Drain noodles.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,manchego cheese,italian bread,deli roast beef
title: Grilled Cheese Beef Sandwich
ingredients: 3 slices deli roast beef | 1 teaspoon grated fresh lemon peel | 3 tablespoons grated reduced-fat manchego cheese | 2 slices italian bread
instructions: Spread 3 tablespoons cheese over 1 slice of bread, then top with the meat and lemon peel.  Top with remaining slice of bread and cut in half diagonally.  Heat grill or broiler.  When grill is ready, lightly oil the grate.  Serve sandwich with any remaining dressing.

Random Ingredients: pasta,fillet,apricot brandy,ice,topping,curry powder,rice wine vinegar,chorizo sausage
title: Tortilla Curry

instructions: Toast the almonds by placing them in a single layer on paper towels and shaking them gently to remove residual oil.  Remove skin from leeks and cut the leeks in half lengthwise. Continue cooking the soup for about 45 minutes, just until the leeks are clear, stir occasionally, and then remove from heat.  To make the soup, place the dill weed in a mortar and pestle and pound to a paste with a mortar and pestle.  Add the other 2 tablespoons of almonds and continue pounding until well mixed.  Add the dill paste and chicken juice and continue pounding.  After 30 minutes of cooking, set another 10 minutes of cooking.  The soup should be thick. Place the snow peas on a microwave safe dish and heat for 1 minute, then transfer to a bowl of hot water.  Stand them covered in the microwave until softened, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Shake the rice around the snow peas so that there are no gaps or holes.  Drain the rice, and scatter rice onto a serving platter, then place the pork and snow peas around the peas.  Serve.  This would also be good with fruit or asparagus spears.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,black pepper,parmigiano reggiano cheese,basil leaf,pesto sauce

ingredients: 1 cup good quality basil leaves | 1/2 cup good quality pesto sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 cup finely shredded parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( or more ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chili powder | 2 -8 fresh basil leaves ( to taste ) | 1 -2 teaspoon black pepper
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients together in a food processor, and process until well blended.  Strain through cheesecloth into a bowl, pressing pesto into mixture with a spoon to desired consistency. .  Store unused portion in fridge.

title: Cabbage Revelation Salad
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 10 -12 slices prosciutto | 1 jar dried apricots, cut up or 3/4 cup fresh apricot | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Heat oil in pan.  Cut cabbage into slices.  Using a sharp knife slice off the core of the cabbage, and shred it.  Then, with the knife still on top of the cabbage, slice a small piece of prosciutto down the center, place it on end of each slice of cabbage, and roll up.  Place it in a 9x13 baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Pour over all rolls.  Cover, and place in refrigerator overnight, stirring occasionally.  The day you are ready to serve, drain off excess liquid, and serve.

Random Ingredients: rice wine,mushroom,rice noodle,chicken breast half,chicken wing,red chili pepper,jalapeno pepper
title: Chicken Pad Thai

instructions: Cook and stir the jalapeno peppers, chile pepper, chicken breasts and chicken wings in a skillet over medium heat until the chicken juices run clear, 3 to 8 minutes.  Stir the mushrooms, rice wine and cooked rice noodles into the skillet and heat until the wine is nearly evaporated, about 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Halibut With Apple, Arugula and Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 small green or yellow onion, sliced into thin rings | 2 medium aubergines, peeled and sliced | 1 medium kielbasa sausage, halved lengthwise ( turkey, or kielchounis ) | 1 apple, peeled, cored and sliced into 1/4 inch thick slices | 1/2 lb halibut fillet | 1/2 lb fresh kale, washed and coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Combine onion, aubergines and sausage in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.

title: Yummy Nori Rolls

instructions: Combine sesame oil and oil.  Add cabbage and anchovies and toss together.  Lay seaweed sheets out flat.  Place 1/4 cup of filling along the seaweed along each seaweed leaf.  Roll up, jelly roll style and tuck ends into the rolls.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 30 minutes.  Cook noodles following package directions.  Drain.  Serve with sauce sprinkled over the top.

Random Ingredients: date,half,mango chutney,mirin,great northern bean,coconut cream,rice flour,oyster sauce
title: Easy Weeknight Rice Flour Mango and Date Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 200 g chopped dates | 250 g chopped plain dried great northern beans | 1 cup half-and-half | 200 g creamy coconut cream | 1 cup grated low-fat plain rice flour ( such as bob's red mill, not instant ) | 1/4 cup mirin | 1/4 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon sweet mango chutney
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200c / 400f / gas mark put your dates, beans and half and half in a large baking dish and cook over a very low heat for 3 - 4 minutes. Pour the mixture over the dates and beans and stir until the rice is evenly incorporated.  Put it in the oven to bake for 20 - 25 minutes, stirring it around every so often so it doesn't burn or stick at all.  Turn off the oven.  Mix together the mango chutney and chutney.  It's now ready to serve.

title: Smoked Pasta

instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, and drain.  Toss pasta with peppers, and chipotles in remaining ingredients.

title: Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 head garlic, peeled | 2 packages taco seasoning mix | 1/2 cup dried oregano | 1/4 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 container cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Place garlic on a baking sheet.  Bake 25 minutes or until light brown.  Drain.

title: Egg Noodle Meatballs
ingredients: 1/4 lb egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup catsup | 1/4 cup sultanas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Form meatball ingredients into meatballs.  Place in a lightly greased shallow baking dish, making sure each is well coated.  Bake for 25 - 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: black olive,black coffee,pineapple chunk juice,chinese five spice powder,golden syrup,littleneck clam,purpose flour,hamburger bun
title: Chinese Littleneck Clams
ingredients: 6 littleneck clams, scrubbed | 1 can pineapple chunks in juice | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon chinese five-spice powder | 1 1/2 lbs hamburger buns | 1/4 cup all-purpose flour | 1/2 cup black beans ( or green beans ) | 1/2 cup black olives, chopped
instructions: Discard the shells and reserve the clam juice.  Wash the clams thoroughly.  In medium saucepan, cover the clams with cold water and bring to a simmer over high heat.  Cook the opened clams for about 5 min. , remove them, reserving some clam liquor, and set them aside.  In a small bowl, combine the pineapple with the syrup and five spice powder and set aside.  On a well floured work surface, roll the hamburger until it is 1/4 inch thick.  Cut it into 1 inch squares and, using your fingers, rub the flour into the hamburger for 1 minute.  Then add the reserved clam liquor to the hamburger.  Break up the clams by hand into the clam juice.  Arrange the clams in a 4 quart casserole, top with the reserved pineapple and their juice and cover with the bread crumbs.  Place in a 350 degree oven and bake for 15 min. , uncovered.  Turn the heat off and sprinkle with black beans and green beans.  Turn the clams out onto a serving dish and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,canola oil,orange peel,oyster sauce,fillet,double cream,green cardamom pod,pork back rib
title: Chinese Spicy Broiled Pork Ribs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 4 pork back ribs | 1 large orange peel, sliced | 3 green cardamom pods, split | 4 serrano chilies, seeded and sliced into slivers | 1 cup double cream | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon double cream
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Place ribs in the skillet and brown them well on all sides.  Transfer the ribs to a roasting pan and tent each with orange peel, orange liqueur, and green cardamom pods.  Whisk the cream and oyster sauce together in a bowl.  Pour half of the cream mixture over each rib.  Bake in preheated oven for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, basting every hour.  The ribs will be well cooked to the tooth when finished, about 25 minutes, but a meat thermometer inserted near the bone should suffice.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,okra,shrimp,red apple,rice vinegar,guava nectar
title: Okra Salad
ingredients: 20 okra, trimmed | 1 package roasted guava nectar | 10 sweet red apples, cored and cut into slices | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, sliced | 3 tablespoons rice vinegar | 3 tablespoons guava nectar
instructions: Cut okra in half lengthwise, and then cut halves in half crosswise.  Place in a large bowl.  Scatter guava nectar over okra, and top with apples.  Combine sun dried tomatoes and 2 tblspn of rice vinegar.  Drizzle over salad.  Poke holes in top of salad with a fork.  Sprinkle with remaining rice vinegar.

title: Corn and Black Bean Phyllo Pizza (Cowboy Wonder Diet)
ingredients: 4 cups corn, canned | 1 can black beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 2 packets biscuit discs ( wonder diet ) | 4 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f and grease a 12 cup pizza pan with pam.  Layer 3 sheets of dough in the pan until you have used 6 sheets and cover with a further layer.  Repeat the layers three more times ending with the dough.  Use a sharp knife to cut the pizza into 12 equal squares.  Bake for 12 minutes until golden.  Spread a thin layer of the corn/black beans over the pizza and serve with a slice of fruit or crunchy vegan yoghurt.

title: Pernil Pork Sausage With Prawns (Guisados)

instructions: Preheat grill.  Bake the pork loin, prawns and prawns, respectively, as preferred until the meat is browned and cooked through, approximately 1½ hours, depending on its size.  Meanwhile, lightly fry stone ground mustard in a frying pan, until cooked.  Drain off any excess oil then add the steak sauce and cook until heated.  When the meat is cooked, remove from the bar.  Slice the pork in 1 cm rounds and add to the pan with all of the prawns.  Stir in the banana slices, then warm through for about 3 minutes.

title: Coconut Salmon

instructions: Place each piece of fish in a glass bowl.  Pour 1 can of coconut cream over top.  Add jalapeno pepper slices.  Chill for 2 to 3 hours.  Remove skin and bones from fish.  Serve on a large platter lined with lettuce.

title: Oven Baked Sweet Potatoes #10FIX
ingredients: 4 sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch dice | 2 tablespoons light brown rice | 1 1/2 teaspoons fresh nutmeg | sea salt and black pepper or salt, to taste
instructions: Combine potatoes, brown rice, and mixed spice in a large casserole dish.  Add enough water to come halfway up the sides of meat or potatoes in the dish.  Cover and bake 375 degrees for 50 - 60 minutes.  Remove cover and bake another 15 - 20 minutes, until potatoes are tender.

Random Ingredients: yeast,havarti cheese,mint,orange,dark soy sauce,red chili powder,egg
title: Havarti Cheese-Mint Buns
ingredients: 250 g strong white havarti cheese | 1/2 bunch of fresh mint | 1/4 cup grated orange rind | 1 teaspoon dried mint | 1 teaspoon red chili powder, ground | 2 teaspoons fresh yeast | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 2 eggs
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a glass or ceramic bowl with a little of the red chili powder.  Add the white wine and enough lukewarm water to dissolve the yeast. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and cover with a clean tea towel.  Let rise a further 15 minutes.  Preheat the oven to 190 degrees celsius.  Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray and grease with oil.  Brush the dough with egg and slash around with a knife.  Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Linguine With Spicy Couscous

instructions: Preheat oven to 400of or 180°c.  In a baking paper lined tray, combine couscous, worcestershire sauce and hot pepper.  Break up any clumps in couscous until well mixed.  Spread couscous onto tray and bake about 10 - 12 minutes or till golden brown and firm.  Serve warm or cool.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: green grape,cocoa powder,rice wine,coriander seed,peppermint candy

Combine rice wine, cocoa powder, coriander seeds and pepperjack or other decorative flavoring.  Pour in the chocolates and process on high until the mixture is smooth.

title: Lemongrass Spinach

instructions: Mix bulgur and remaining ingredients except nuts, and top with toasted nuts on serving platter.

title: The Best French Bread Pizzas Ever
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 can tomato juice | 2 tablespoons peanut butter ( not imitation )
instructions: First i use my old fashioned, but the 3x5 bread can also be used.  Toast is usually in my supermarket.  Slather the inside of the bread with the peanut butter.  Then spread the tomato juice over the bread and sandwich with two toothpicks.  Variation, i put my peanut butter slices on the bread until they are crispy.

title: Pumpkin and Guinness Soup

instructions: Pour guinness into a saucepan and add the pumpkin, soup, and herbs.  Bring to boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 minutes.  Add apricot preserves and cook an additional 20 minutes.  Pour through a strainer and serve garnished with raspberries.

Random Ingredients: peanut oil vegetable,lard,tabasco sauce,shell pasta,wheat pita bread,basil leaf
title: Garlic Fried Pasta
ingredients: 350 g small whole wheat pita breads | 1 teaspoon peanut oil or 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon lard, melted | 100 g small shell pasta
instructions: If using fresh pasta, cook your pasta according to the packet directions.  Alternatively, cook the pasta as per the pack instructions with the oil, basil and pepper and drain off the excess water.  Cut the pita bread in half, lengthwise, and fill with the cooled pasta and then lightly fold up, pressing the mixture to help it stick together.  Heat the oil in a frying pan, add the bread on both sides, and fry on both sides until golden brown.  Drain on kitchen paper and keep warm.  Add the remaining ingredients to the pan, mix well to combine, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, until heated through.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,risotto rice,maple syrup,strawberry,romano cheese,vegetable oil
title: Strawberry Swiss Cheese Stuffed Rice
ingredients: 8 ounces swiss cheese, sliced into thin strips | 3/4 cup risotto rice, rinsed under cool water | 1 can crushed tomatoes with green chiles | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | vegetable oil, for oven rack | 1/4 cup romano cheese, shredded ( not grated )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine 1 cup of the cheese slices with the rice and tomatoes if desired.  Stuff 1/2 to 3/4 of the rice mixture into each of the narrow, long hollow mini ramekins or souffle cups.  Brush with warm maple syrup.  Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the romano cheese.  Carefully place stuffed ramekins into a 13x9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Pour hot water, about 1 inches in the bottom of the dish, into which the ramekins and rice were placed.  Bake at 375° for 50 minutes, then cool in the baking dish on a wire rack for 10 minutes.  Gently remove the inside of the ramekins, then cool slightly.  Place the ramekins or souffle cups on a platter.  Cover loosely with plastic wrap and a heavy foil.  Microwave on high power about 3 minutes or until heated through.  Spoon the cheeses into the ramekins.  Serve.

title: Cheese, Tomato & Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oregano garlic pepper seasoning | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 1/2 cups tasty cheese | 1 large lettuce
instructions: Combine seasonings in bowl.  Place over a bowl and toss to combine.  Cut cheese into 3 squares and place under running water for 1 minute to soften.  Place in bowl.  Take lettuce leaves and cut in a crosshatch pattern on one side of cheese.  Place tomato slices on top.  Spoon sauce on top and serve at once.

title: Ginger and Mango Fool
ingredients: 350 g mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 600 ml white beans, cooked ( cooked beans drained weight ) | 1 tablespoon gingerroot, chopped | 2 mangoes, diced ( peeled and sliced ) | food coloring | 300 g cheese, grated
instructions: Combine mascarpone cheese, triple sec and mango and set aside.  Combine mango, ginger, food colouring in a bowl and mix well.  Set aside.  Spread half of the bean mixture onto bottom of a shallow glass pyrex dish.  Layer half of the cheese mixture over half of the bean mixture then repeat with remaining half of the bean mixture.  Top with remaining cheese mixture and place into a preheated moderately hot oven for about 30 minutes.

title: Mustard Onion Cream Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces of cream of mushroom soup | 1 container sour cream | 1 teaspoon mustard powder
instructions: In a sauce pan on medium heat combine the sour cream and soup.  Add the mustard and let boil away.  Stir well.  Take off heat and stir in half of the drained cream of mushroom mixture.  Put in a small crockpot/silken bowl/dutch oven and enjoy.

title: Orange and Rotina Pasta
ingredients: 3 ounces orange rind ( skin on ) | 8 ounces rotini pasta | 7 ounces plain flour | 5 ounces white bread
instructions: Pour boiling water into a pan of roughly 15 ºcelsius/ ºc or a small roasting tin.  Cut the rind into thin strips using scissors.  Drain the pasta in a well measured bowl and toss them with the flour.  Melt half the remaining butter in a large frying pan.  Toss in the orange rind and cook over a medium heat, stirring regularly, until coloured very deeply.  Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside. .  Add another ounce of the flour, one piece at a time, stirring with a wooden spoon until it is just incorporated into the butter.  Gradually stir in the remaining butter until a firm paste forms, taking care not to colour further.  Toss in the pasta and cook for a couple of minutes, adding the rind and any juice from the orange.  Cook for a further 2 minutes and then tip into a warm serving dish.  Serve immediately, or place in the freezer.  When ready to serve, reheat the rest of the butter in the pan and use to serve separately.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,cremini mushroom,chicken bouillon cube,buttermilk,button mushroom,graham cracker crumb,part mozzarella cheese
title: Polpette De Terre (Frozen Polpette)
ingredients: 1 package shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 package frozen small button mushrooms | 1 package fresh cremini mushrooms | 3 cups vegetable stock | 3 chicken bouillon cubes | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 loaf baked graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Thaw and thinly slice mushrooms.  Place about 3 cups of water in a medium saucepan on low heat.  Break up the boullion cubes in the water with a spoon, and place the boullion on a plate to keep warm.  Heat oven to 400°.  Place 4 - 6 crusty or regular size pieces of parchment in a freezer bag.  Combine all ingredients in a medium deep dish pie plate.  Place on parchment on 2 cookie sheets, and freeze for at least 1 hour.  Remove from freezer and add more buttermilk to desired consistency.  Remove from freezer.  Place on a parchment, large, piece of aluminum foil or a baking sheet and spray baking sheet with cooking spray.  Pour the polpette mixture onto the parchment.  Sprinkle toppings evenly on top of that, making a very slight layer of grated cheese on top.  Bake for 20 minutes.  After 15 minutes, check, and when cheese is slightly browned on top, if browned a little, place a piece of foil over the top for additional to make a crunch more of the cheese and the polpette for a nice, crispy crust.

title: My Best French Onion Soup
