instructions: In a large non stick frypan put margarine and heat to medium high.  Add onions and broth.

title: Couscous for One
ingredients: 1/4 lb smoked sausage or 1/4 lb hot italian sausage | 1 1/4 teaspoons paprika or 1 1/4 teaspoons mild paprika | 1 1/4 teaspoons celery salt | 1 tablespoon finely chopped epazote, leaves ( optional )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients.  Use 1/2 teaspoons for each serving.  Serve as is or spread on baked or toast.

title: Spicy Sushi
ingredients: 4 cups bread flour | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice ( reserve juice for later use ) | 1 can jicama, julienned ( sliced thin with skin left on ) | 1 can beef broth | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1/2 teaspoon harissa
instructions: In a dutch oven, heat oil/saute the jicama, then add the beef broth and simmer until jicama is crisp tender. When meat is fully cooked and drained, combine with the meat and add the preserves and stir together well.  Stir in the harissa.  If the mixture is too thick, add small amount of broth.  Put rice/julienned tomatoes on a plate and roll up the sushi.  Put in a plate with tape on top with foil, or a bowl on the bottom to catch any spills.  These can be served hot or cold, however they are still very crisp and delicious.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.  While pasta is cooking, heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat.

title: Mustard Fruit Spread

instructions: Grind mustard with a mixer until very fine.  Add fresh fruits and blend well.  Cover, let stand for 1 hour before serving.

title: Healthy and Delicious Tofu Breakfast

instructions: Cut tofu into bite sized pieces.  Spread 1/2 the guacamole on a large plate.  Spread 1/2 the toffee over the guacamole.  On top of that spread the rest of the guacamole.  Chop chili and tomatoes into small pieces.  Sprinkle over toffee.  Serve with a nice smile and enjoy.

instructions: Preheat broiler and position rack in upper third of oven.  Whisk together cayenne, lime juice, and lime sugar in small bowl. Serve with cocktail sticks, or kakchugaru, or any other dipping sauce that tastes good to go with your meal.

title: Mexican Stuffed Zucchini

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bake zucchini halves in the preheated oven for about 40 minutes, or until tender and beginning to brown.  Place the zucchini, prosciutto rounds, corn kernels, soy sauce and guacamole in medium sized casserole dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until heated through and starting to crisp.  Serve on warm plates.

title: Jumbo Shrimp on Toast

instructions: Preheat oil in 12 x 9 inch baking dish on griddle.  Put one bread slice on griddle and cook until it just barely changes color from light tan to tan.  Turn over.  Put one shrimp in center and top with other slice.  Sprinkle evenly with cake flour.

title: Lobster and Crab Cabbage

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix together the halved mushrooms and lobster halves with the white mushrooms, lobster tails, chinese cabbage and napa cabbage. title: Homemade Kebab Powder
ingredients: 1/2 kg ra el hanout spice mix | 1 -2 bunch fresh rosemary leaf
instructions: Place the oil and water to boil in a small container.  Add the kabab.  When the water starts boiling add all the moroccan seasoning, mix and pour the water out through a sieve. Allow the kabab to ‘re ‘re ‘re infused before serving so as to ‘clean’ the kabab mix from all the sides.  Note, this oil may also be reused with other spices such as sunflower seeds, cinnamon, thyme, cloves and other aromatic oils.

title: Maple Syrup Smoked Italian Sausages

instructions: To make maple syrup as described in directions, use only maple syrup that is not sweetened, but the syrup that does not stick to the sausage. title: Easy Venison (Or Chicken) and Pea Jaffles

Grill chicken with venison and peas for 5 minutes.  Add venison/pea mixture and turn.  Grill additional 5 minutes or until pork is well browned.  Serve with dates or walnut halves.

title: Mexican Gorgonzola Rigatoni With Steak and Black Cardamom
ingredients: 1 flank steaks | 2 1/2 ounces taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons minced gorgonzola | 1 tablespoon chopped arbol chili powder | 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground pepper sauce | 1/2 teaspoon hot pepper sauce | 1/4 teaspoon black cardamom pods | 1 lb rigatoni pasta or 1 lb other pastas
instructions: Grill or broil flank steak to your preferred doneness, 6 to 8 minutes per side for medium rare.  Allow to cool slightly, then slice against grain as thinly as possible.  Prepare sauce while steak is cooking in a large skillet over high heat, stirring constantly with a wood spoon, tilting pan as needed to scrape up any brown bits.  Remove steak from heat. Add a handful of gorgonzola or other desired garnishes, such as chile powder, hot sauce and freshly ground black pepper, and stir until well combined.  Add sliced steak back to skillet. ingredients: 400 g ready made puff pastry | 500 g dried cranberries ( cranberries'are very tasty ) | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Pre heat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Line the 8x6x3 inch baking tray of a standard casserole dish with baking paper.  Line the tray with baking paper.  To make the cranberry pie base, use a sieve or sieve to sieve the fresh cranberries into a mixing bowl.  Put in the bicarb soda and toss so they are mixed.  Turn onto a lightly floured surface and roll into a thick circle.  Use a knife and lightly flatten slightly to fit the prepared dish.  Spread the cranberry pie base around the edge and prick all over with a fork.  Bake uncovered for 50 - 60 minutes until golden brown.  Cool slightly and break up any small pieces to decorate.  Tip.  As an alternative to the cranberry pie filling, you can use 2 pints of cooked cranberries, 2 cups of cooked fresh cranberries and 2 cups of cooked fresh peas.

title: Poblano Chile Salsa (Poblano)
ingredients: 2 poblano chiles, roasted and peeled | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup white vinegar | 2 lemons
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f.  Remove stems and seeds from chilies.  Wake chilies in oven for 15 to 20 minutes.  Wash chilies thoroughly under running water and blot dry.  In sauce pan, heat chilies and vinegar until blended.  Add chilies and cook 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, cover and chill overnight in fridge.  Serve with your favorite mexican recipe.

title: Easy Semolina Dressing(Or Dip )
ingredients: 1 cup unbleached semolina | 1 cup beef broth | 1 cup catsup | 2 tablespoons sumac ( i like arabian kabsa ) | 2 tablespoons unbleached semolina | 1 1/2 teaspoons catsup | 3/4 cup grated sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Boil the semolina in the beef broth until just soft, about 10 minutes.  Add the remaining ingredients, taste test for seasoning by adding more catsup, or a little sugar and molasses.  Stir together and adjust until to your preference.  Serve with vegetables, meat, etc.

Random Ingredients: sea salt,dill weed,raspberry juice,double cream,raspberry,fennel seed
title: Fennel Nests from the North Pole With Crushed Cream
ingredients: 2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 3 tablespoons mixed dried fennel seeds | 1 1/3 cups raspberry juice | 1/2 pint light double cream | sea salt | raspberries, to decorate ( optional )
instructions: Place the seeds in a blender container with the lemon and fennel.  Pour in the raspberry juice and process until well mixed.  Pour in the cream and process again until all the cream is formed.  Season to taste with sea salt.  Divide among the nippet moulds, cover, and chill.  Decorate with raspberries if desired.

title: Aunt Gun-Marie's Leeks Fried Green Beans
ingredients: 2 large leeks | 3 tablespoons oil | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan.  Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and discard root end.  Thinly slice them crosswise into 3/4 inch strips.  Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a skillet.  Add the sliced leeks and stir fry for 1 minute.  Add the tomato paste and stir fry for another 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon oil in the pan.  Add the green beans and stir fry for 5 minutes or until the greenbeans are tender and almost crisp.

title: Easy Pounded Cilantro
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | fresh cilantro stem ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry cilantro stems.  Place a large clean tablecloth or a paper towel on your work surface which you are using for the work surface.  Wearing plastic wrap, make several diagonal slits about 1 1/2 apart on your work surface.  Brush the cilantro with oil.  Sprinkle generously with salt.  Roll the cilantro in the palms of your hands so that it releases a small amount of water to help remove it from the stems as they roll.  Wrap your hands or a towel with a towel.  Place the wrapped cilantro in the center of your work surface and begin working with one or two leaves at a time.  Using your hands, bring the stem ends up to the tip of the rolling pin and press lightly.  Remove and set aside with the flat end of a large knife in your hand.  Place the flat end of the knife on your work surface now.  Place your flat end of the knife over the rolling pin so the entire blade is holding the cilantro.  Use the point where the knife easily slips from the side of the tablecloth.  Use the flat blade or a spatula to spread the cilantro all the way around the blade of the knife.  Use a spoon or a small, wet knife to spread the vegetable oil around the blade so it is evenly distributed.  The oil from the cilantro can be used for making this quick patties.  If the mixture is very moist, moisten it slightly with water or flour.  With one or two hands, form the flattened mixture into a 1 1/2 inch thick patty.  Repeat until all the patties have been shaped and arranged in a thin sheet about 4 inches wide and 2 1/2 inches high.  Allow the sheet to rest undisturbed for 20 minutes before cooking.  Heat a gas or charcoal grill.  When the fire is hot, place the sheet on the grill and cook on high, for about 3 minutes, until you see a light haze of smoke coming from the chimney.  When your gas or charcoal grill is hot, place the sheet with the hot chimney for about 2 additional minutes.  If using kitchen tongs, hold the cooked patties and close the lid, pressing the center of the grill with one hand against the side of the grill so the heat can get in the center of the patties.  Flip and continue cooking for 1 or 2 minutes, until the meat is browned evenly and the juices run clear.  If you want more smoke, cover the whole grill with aluminum foil.  Allow meat to rest for another 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,dill,green chili pepper,hazelnut,mango chutney,baby green,nori,extra virgin olive oil
title: Green Chile & Hazelnut Raita W- Mushrooms (Laver)
ingredients: 1 green chili pepper, halved deseeded and finely chopped | 1 bunch baby greens | 1 cup hazelnuts, toasted, skinned and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup hazelnut-flavored mango chutney | 10 sheets nori, toasted and chopped | 6 sheets lasagna noodles, toasted | extra virgin olive oil, as required | 2 tablespoons freshly chopped dill
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c.  Line a large baking tray with non stick baking paper and place chilli, greens and nuts on it.  Toss gently until mixed and sprinkel with chutney.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and transfer to the oven for 15 - 15 minutes until greens are wilted and starting to lightly blacken.  Meanwhile, cook noodles following packet instructions then drain.  To serve, spread 1 tbls.  Olive oil on a sheet of nori, on both sides.  Spread 1 tbls.  Shallot, one toasted hazelnut and one toasted hazelnut and green chili, a sprinkling of chutney.  Lay 4 noddles on top of the chili, then spread remaining ingredients on top.  Place 3 noodles on top of the greens and spread lastt of hazelnut and green chili and serve immediately.

title: Creamy Vegetarian Fried Raita
ingredients: 500 g chicken drumsticks, boneless and skinless | 600 g broccoli, broken into florets | 2 tablespoons curry paste | 1 tablespoon soymilk ( optional ) | 300 mm polenta | 150 ml polenta | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: If using soymilk, combine it with oil, soymilk, curry, and optional protein, for flavour.  Place a pan of water on heat on a medium heat and bring to a simmer for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the drumsticks for 5 minutes in a microwave for 3 minutes, or until cooked through.  Cook the broccoli on the same heat as the drumsticks until tender and remove from the heat, and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 200c.  Slice the polenta into 1 - 3 mm thick slices.  Place the polenta slices on a baking tray, spread evenly, and toast in the oven for 5 minutes, or until pale golden.  Remove from the oven and set aside.  In a clean roasting pan, place the vegetable oil and cook the curry paste on a medium low heat for 2 - 3 minutes.  Stir in the soymilk or milk and simmer for 5 minutes or until the oil starts to separate again.

Random Ingredients: pineapple,naan bread,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pomegranate juice,liquid smoke flavoring,corn niblets
title: The Best Pomegranate Grilled Sandwich Ever
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pomegranate juice ( from 1/3 cup pomegranate seeds in can ) | 1 1/4 cups blood orange juice or 1 1/4 cups pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1/8 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | corn niblets | naan bread, slices ( optional )
instructions: In a small pot, combine the pomegranate juice, orange juice, liquid smoke and cheese.  Bring to a low simmer.  Place the bread in your blender and puree to a smooth creamy consistency.  Pour the pomegranate mixture into a shallow container or pita or warmed pita bread.  Arrange the grilled bread slices on top of the pomegranate mixture.  The bread should be toasted and crisp on the outside.  Remove from the grill and serve hot, with a drizzle of pomegranate mixture.

title: Mock Lettuce (Lettuce)
ingredients: 5 lettuce leaves ( washed and dried ) | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1/2 cup dry white wine
instructions: Wash and dry lettuce and dry lightly.  Toast mustards in frying pan.  As soon as they become grainy, toss into mustard.  Add white wine and mix well.  Serve in lettuce bowls.

title: Spicy Fish Bites
ingredients: 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 2 teaspoons dried chopped chilies | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon finely chopped parsnip | 1/4 cup corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Line baking sheet with parchment paper.  Spray 1 flat baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  In medium bowl, combine ginger, chilies, lemon peel, parsnip and corn flakes.  Add fish and mix well with fingers.  Place about 1 tablespoon of fish mixture on each wonton wrapper.  Brush edges of won ton wrapper with water.  Place on baking sheet.  Bake 10 - 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.

title: Moo Dang (Vietnamese Dipping Sauce)
ingredients: 1/2 cup shortening | 3 tablespoons red onions or 3 tablespoons shallots, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 teaspoons sweetnamese chili paste ( i like san choy brand )
instructions: Curry paste, pre heat your oven on its hottest range.  In the bowl of your electric beater, combine the shortening, onions, cumin and chili paste until thoroughly combined, but not thoroughly melted.  Mixture should be crumbly but rather moist with very little moisture.  Add a little water, a little at a time, to make a thick paste.  Transfer to a small bowl.  Use immediately or store covered in the refrigerator for up to a week.  Will freeze well.

Random Ingredients: black peppercorn,red currant jelly,tea,coriander powder,brussels sprout,vermouth,baking soda,lentil
title: Lentils & Brussels Sprouts in a Teapot
ingredients: 200 g split lentils | 2 tablespoons red currant jelly | 140 g teapot mixed tea | 2 tablespoons dry vermouth | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 bunch fresh coriander sprout
instructions: Place the lentils & currants in a large pan and add enough water to cover them by about 3.  Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low & cook 40 - 50 minutes, or until tender. Bring to the boil then allow to reduce to simmer before adding the sprouts.  Cover & cook 5 mins or until tender.

Random Ingredients: cherry tomato,rice flour,beef bouillon cube,green cardamom,turmeric powder,thyme sprig,tofu
title: Aarsi’s Ultimate Tofu Ball

instructions: In a non reactive bowl, combine the diced tofu, thyme, bouillon, turmeric and the cherries and tomato pieces.  Form palmfuls of rice flour into an even ball with small cracks on the top of the flour.  Flatten the balls slightly with a rolling pin or an elongated spoon, or with the palm of your hand.

title: Simple Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of potato soup | 2 packages feta cheese ( crumbled ) | 1 large spanish onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Grease a 5 1/2 or 6 quart casserole dish.  Spread cream of potato soup on the bottom of the casserole dish.  Cover soup with onion and 1 1/2 1 1/2 lb of crumbled feta cheese.  Cover with the rest of cheese.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for one hour, remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

instructions: Heat a small, heavy skillet over medium heat.

title: Spiced Nuts

instructions: Open the canned stewed tomatoes and mash until lumpy.  Add tomato paste and mix with the tomatoes.  Heat cream and kiwis in large pan until just just heated through.  Remove from burner and add to mixture.  Place about 2 tbsp mixture in each tortilla and top with diced kiwi and green chilies until well incorporated.

title: Peachy Beef Sirloin in Mushroom Sauce

instructions: Brown sirloin in a skillet with vegetable oil over medium heat and discard excess fat.  Add all ingredients to skillet, except mushrooms, and cook until mushrooms are tender, adding additional stock or broth if needed to keep moist.  Serve over rice.

title: Beef Rib Tenderloin Lasagne With Fruit and Nuts
ingredients: 3 3 lbs beef short ribs or 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 1 cup bacon drippings or 1 cup oil | 1 tablespoon coffee or 1 tablespoon dry white wine | 1 teaspoon dried mixed fruit, crushed | 1 cup canned fruit, drained of juice or 1 cup juice reserved | 16 ounces canned mushrooms, drained and thinly sliced | 18 whole cherry peppers, cut in half ( i use a large can of san marzano, drained of juice ) | 15 lasagna noodles or 15 individual curly egg noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Trim excess fat from ribs.  Cut into 2 inch x 1 inch slices.  Brush lightly with bacon drippings or oil.  Place in a shallow pan and roast uncovered on the middle rack of oven for about 1 1/2 hours.  Let cool for 10 minutes.  Remove from oven, discard skin and cut into strips.  Pour into a saucepan and add coffee, mixed fruit and heat until hot.  Add mushrooms and heat until hot.  Stir in the chopped fresh fruit.  Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain in colander.  To assemble, lay noodles on a large serving platter and put meat on top of noodles.  Top with sauce.  Garnish with a few green peppers.

title: Lamb Chops With Poblanos and Chile Chiles

Brush them with butter flavoring, if you like.  Bake at 400°f approximately 15 minutes or until slightly softened.  Serve on hot buttered croissants.  Toast chili powder in toaster or small to medium frying pan over medium heat.  Serve with croissant roll and chili powder.

title: Spicy Mexican Bread Dip

8 ounces fritos corn chips, coarsely crushed ( about 1.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place fritos into a shallow 2 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Combine gruyere cheese, green pepper, parsnips, soup, ginger and broth in a blender or food processor. Bake 15 minutes, until heated through and the fritos are hot and bubbly.

title: Beer Couscous and Honey Dressing

instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the horseradish and couscous.  Gradually stir in the beer, mixing well.  Halve the strawberries and arrange around the base of the couscous.  Top with the dressing.

instructions: Puree the chillies, kaffir lime leaves, vinegar, and sugar syrup in a blender or food processor until smooth.  With the blender running, gradually add the oil. title: Horseradish and Pepper Tartlets

    - ) | 4 teaspoons nonfat milk | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish, drained | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish, drained | pepper | 3/4 cup virgin olive oil

Place the 1 sheet frozen puff pastry on top and press it out into the baking dish.  Bake pastry for about 10 minutes, or until puffed and lightly golden brown.  Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan and cook until heated through.  Allow to cool slightly.  Remove pastry from oven and sprinkle with horseradish and pepper.  Top with horseradish mixture.  Cut into six portions.

title: Sweet Low Fat Chicken (Or Beef)

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Coat the chicken pieces in the bread crumbs, then pat dry with paper towels, and then cut the chicken into 1/2 inch slices.  Place the apple, green bell pepper, and orange zest in a baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes.  Stir the chicken and tomato pulp together, then pour the hot stew over them.

title: Cashew Soup Mix II

instructions: Place the cashews in a small saucepan with enough water just to cover.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then immediately remove from heat.  Let stand five minutes, then drain.  Place the peas in a bowl.  Add more water if mixture is dry and add, along with the cashews and sugar,.  Stir until the sugar dissolves.  Sprinkle with cayenne pepper.  Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, until chilled.  Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

instructions: Heat wok or large skillet over medium high flame.  Sauté beef until no pink remains.  Move beef to cutting board.  Toss with panang paste. title: Quick & Easy Chinese Noodles

Add remaining ingredients and stir until well mixed.  Serve over hot tortellini, tossing to coat.  Makes 8 servings.

instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees c if using oven trays bake snapper pieces in oven 10 minutes.  Cool in the trays. Add 1/4 cup of sugar/spice cream if you wish to sweeten it up.

title: Taco Dogs

instructions: Combine all ingredients and shape into 6 inch diameter patties.  Brown in a skillet over medium heat 4 - 5 minutes per side or until no longer pink outside.

instructions: Place soymilk and apple in blender.  Cover and blend on high speed 30 seconds or just until apples are very finely diced and apples are ground through the blender.  Sprinkle with star anise pods and 1 cup bread crumbs, mixing until bread crumbs are well incorporated.  Mix in salt.  Roll 1 tablespoon of crumbs into a disk.  Roll in remaining crumbs. title: Easy Baked Beef Kebab
ingredients: 2 slices white bread, crusts removed | 1 tablespoon nigella seeds | 16 ounces beef brisket, cooked and shredded ( about 8 ) | 1 package frozen peas | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, minced | 2 tablespoons butter, melted
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºf.  Brush bread with a little water.  Toast until golden, 1 to 2 minutes.  Combine nutella and remaining ingredients in a bowl.

title: Tomato Sticks

instructions: Heat sherry in large saucepan until sherry is just beginning to foam.  Stir in mushroom soups and heat to a boil.  Cut ribs into 1 1/2 inch pieces.  Add ribs to saucepan, add rice and salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer 15 - 20 minutes, or until rice is tender.  Mix soup in blender until smooth.  Add chard, stirring until leaves are finely chopped.  Serve stew in soup bowl atop cooked rice.

title: Shrimp and Grapes
ingredients: 2 lbs shrimp, peeled, deveined and washed | 1 1/4 cups chicken broth, can use beef broth | 1/2 cup green seedless grape, halved
instructions: Rinse shrimp in cold water and dry.  Combine all ingredients in medium saucepan.  Cover and cook over low heat until shrimp are just pink, about 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Lentils Bake
ingredients: 30 g dried lentils | 1 medium onion, chopped | 375 g stew meat | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour | 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese, grated
instructions: Boil lentils in water for 20 - 40 mins or until tender.  Drain and rinse well.  Put lentils and meat into large, microwave safe dish or tin.  Add 2 - 3 tbsp water or any remaining water, onion soup mix and flour.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,balsamic vinaigrette,beef chuck,golden syrup,kohlrabi,kidney bean,jalapeno chile,cumin powder
title: Beef and Kohlrabi Casserole (Baked)
ingredients: 1 lb beef chuck, cut 1/8 x 7inch | 8 ounces kohlrabi ( about 6 small ) | 2 cans kidney beans, drained | 1 can condensed golden syrup, undiluted | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinaigrette, more if desired | 1 pickled jalapeno chile ( optional )
instructions: Line bottom of a 2 1/2 or 3 quart baking dish with waxed paper.  In a medium mixing bowl, combine beef, kohlrabi, kidney beans, golden syrup, cream of mushroom soup, cumin, and dressing.  Place on waxed paper lined baking dish. .  Cover with waxed paper.  Freeze overnight.  About 45 minutes before baking, remove waxed paper from baking dish.  Bake uncovered in a 400°f oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,meat,green onion,molasses,graham cracker crumb,cream celery soup,baking potato
title: Crock Pot Irish Shepherd Pie
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground meat | 2 lbs baking potatoes ( the kind in the freezer section of your local deli ) | 3 cans cream of celery soup | 3 packages fresh or frozen mixed vegetables ( if frozen, thaw first ) | 1 cup light molasses | 1 bunch green onion, finely chopped | 1 package frozen fully cooked meat, cubed | 1 cup irish cream ( or molasses or other heavy cream to be used in place of cream of celery soup and sour cream in the original )
instructions: Brown the ground meat and drain grease.  Pour in the cream of celery soup and add the frozen mixed vegetables.  Cover and cook on the low setting for about 6 hours.  While this is cooking, mix the frozen meat with the irish cream.  In a separate bowl, add the graham cracker crumbs and mix.  Turn the oven off and let stand, covered, for 10 minutes.  Sprinkle both sides of the meat with graham cracker crumbs.  Then, layer the meat mixture in the crockpot with the graham cracker crumb mixture.  Then, layer on the frozen mixed vegetables.  Top with remaining frozen meat mixture.  Cover and cook on high setting for about 2 hours until the meat mixture is very hot.  Serve in a bowl garnished with green onion.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile,sugar snap pea,red pepper flake
title: Pea-Stuffed Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 2 packages sugar snap peas | 1/2 pound tomatoes with green chiles, seeded and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
instructions: Cut ends off of sugar snaps and trim ends.  Starting at the tip of 1/2 inch up side of peas, remove a 2 inch slit and scrap pulp, leaving about 1 inch in the root end.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,broth,irish whiskey,romaine lettuce,baking soda,celery root,beet,white sugar
title: Irish Mustard Beet Salad
ingredients: 4 large beet, sliced 1/4-inch thick ( or any combination of the two ) | 4 cups romaine lettuce, chopped | 3 roma tomatoes, chopped | 1/2 cup celery root, diced | 1 1/2 cups canned fried beets ( not canned ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 3 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 cups hot broth | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f line two baking sheets with tin foil.  Place the beet slices on the prepared pan and bake for 30 - 40 minutes, until tender, still slightly firm.  Remove from oven, and cool.  Using a slotted spoon, remove beets from skins, and cut into matchstick sized pieces.  Place the lettuce and beet pieces into a large bowl, and add the tomatoes, celery root, and beets.  Sprinkle with taco seasoning.  In a small bowl, stir together the sugar, hot broth, and baking soda, and pour over salad.  Toss gently until the mixture is evenly coated.  Serve chilled or room temperature.

Random Ingredients: island dressing,self rising flour,almond,cottage cheese,madeira wine
title: Cottage Cheese Sticks With Aijolote and Almond Breading
ingredients: 250 g cottage cheese | 125 g self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon madeira wine | 1 tablespoon of madeira wine | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds | 3 -4 teaspoons toasted slivered almonds, for topping
instructions: Melt the 2 tbs.  Mix together the 2 tsp.  Diluted madeira, the remaining 2 tbs.  Of madeira, the flour 3/4 tsp.  Of sliced almonds and 2 tsp.  Of slivered almonds.  Mix till smooth.  Set aside 1 tbsp.  Of the cottage cheese mixture to sprinkle on top of each stick of sticks at serving time.  Sprinkle on the remaining slivered almonds.  Eat right away or keep refrigerated till serving.

Random Ingredients: butter,rye bread,dill weed,snow pea,red wine vinegar
title: Swedish Smoked Sandwiches With Dill
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons butter | 1/3 cup red wine vinegar | 8 slices thinly sliced rye bread | 8 thin slices smoked swedish smoked swedish cheese ( about 3 ounces ) | 4 tablespoons snipped fresh dill weed
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan over moderate heat.

title: Mustard Bread
ingredients: 1 cup packed grain white cornmeal | 1 cup prepared mustard ( coleman's preferred )
instructions: Whisk cornmeal, mustard and 1 cup water in medium bowl to blend.  Gradually stir in mustard mixture. .  Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Spread bread in greased 13 x 9 inch cake pan.  Sprinkle with coarse salt.  Bake bread in preheated 425 f oven, until puffed and golden, stirring once, about 1 hour.

title: Basil Fennel and Fennel
ingredients: 2 bunches mixed fennel | 20 dried basil leaves | 20 fenel, with stems
instructions: Bring 4 to 5 cups water to boil in large heavy saucepan.  Add fennel to boiling water and cook until tender, about 6 minutes.  Remove fennel leaves.  Drain and discard fennel stems, reserving liquid.  Slice fennel into 1/4 inch strips.  Meanwhile, toss basil leaves with a tablespoon or more of flour.  Spread leaves on a shallow serving dish and arrange half the fennel slices on top.  Sprinkle with basil and remaining fennel.

Random Ingredients: sugar snap pea,iceberg lettuce,oregano leaf,mushroom,almond extract
title: Mushroom-Sugar Snap Pea Salad
ingredients: 4 cups sliced mushrooms | 1 cup peeled sugar snap pea | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano leaves | 1/4 - 1/2 cup slivered almonds, toasted | 1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into 8 pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, toss mushrooms and snap peas with oregano and almonds until well coated.  In a large serving bowl, stir together lettuce and sugar snap peas.  Toss salad with dressing.

title: Sun Dried Tomato Pizza
ingredients: 1 prebaked pizza crust | 1/2 cup dry sun-dried tomato, chopped coarsely | 1/4 cup self raising flour
instructions: Mix ingredients into a loose dough, place on greased oven tray about 30 minutes before cooking.  Remove when cooked and slightly puffed.  Cut into 12 wedges.

title: Mushroom & Clam Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces minced clams, drained well | 14 ounces minced white clams, drained well | 14 ounces minced fresh mushrooms | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon paprika | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried mushroom | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground dried coconut
instructions: Heat the grill on high or in a ridged grill pan set to high.  For the salad, combine the minced clams, chopped white clams, cleaned fresh mushrooms and the vinegar in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil, and cook for one minute to drive off the alcohol.  Add the sugar, paprika, dried mushrooms and dried coconut.  Cook for one more minute, stirring.  Remove from the heat and drizzle with olive oil.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,guinness stout,egg noodle,italian sausage,malt vinegar,colby cheese
title: Simple Saucy Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage | 8 ounces egg noodles | 1 1/2 cups colby cheese or 1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese, shredded | 8 ounces guiness colby cheese or 8 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 2 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/4 cup guinness stout
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Slice sausage links in half lengthwise.  Remove casings.  In skillet, over medium heat, cook sausage and drain off excess fat.  Add cooked sausage, the noodles and half the cheese.  Stir until well blended.  Pour guiness colby cheese into large casserole dish.  Sprinkle with rest of cheese.  Bake uncovered for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,white pepper,tamarind pulp,pepper,pork tenderloin,asparagus spear,cream celery soup
title: Crock Pot Chana
ingredients: 6 frozen asparagus spears ( about 24 spears ) | 1 large pork tenderloin, trimmed and cut into bite sized pieces | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1 can evaporated low-fat pepsi ( or pepsi enough to equal 1/3 cup total ) | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 3/4 teaspoon white pepper | 1/2 teaspoon tamarind pulp ( optional )
instructions: Preheat crock pot for 5 - 6 hours on high.  Remove asparagus from freezer, slice into 2 - 3 inch lengths, place in bowl of ice water, add 1/4 cup of reserved asparagus cooking water.  Mix in celery soup and add peas.  Sprinkle white pepper and tamarind if using.  Add asparagus back to crock pot on high for 20 - 30 minutes or until heated through.

title: Kumara Gratin
ingredients: 500 g kumara, peeled, cut into 3cm slices | 1 cup milk | 1/2 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon finely chopped walnuts | 1 tablespoon grated palm sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 12 kumara, peeled, cut into 3cm slices | 1 -2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 large yellow squash, cut into 3cm slices
instructions: Grease 2 baking trays and preheat oven to 200 deg celsius.  Place kumara and milk in a large saucepan over medium high heat.  Cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until kumara is tender.  Dissolve catsup in 2/3 cup boiling water and stir into kumara mix.  Stir in walnuts, sugarmeg and mace and stir well.  Pour mixture into prepared trays and sprinkle top with half the coloured squash slices.  Repeat layers until remaining ingredients are used.  Bake in oven for 35 - 40 minutes or until heated through and bubbling.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,chickpea,hard egg,chicken breast,banana leaf,garlic salt
title: Pita Bread (Pebil)
ingredients: 4 -6 large hard-boiled eggs | 1 1/2 cups cooked chickpeas | 1 sliced banana leaf | 4 chicken breasts ( boiled is ok too ) | 1 teaspoon crushed garlic salt | cooking oil
instructions: Cut up chicken breasts, put in bowl with the chickpeas and garlic salt.  Chop up onion and fry till translucent, set aside.  Slice bananas into 2 inch lengths and fry in oil.  Serve on plate with pita bread on top of everything.

title: Irish Whiskey Crown (Shake - Corning)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons raisins ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons triple sec | 2 -4 dried hot red chiles ( optional ) | 2 -3 bay leaves
instructions: Drain raisins and put them into a small jar.  Add the triple sec and chillies.  Fill the jar and close tightly.  It may be stored in the fridge for up to a month.  Shake bottles again if not using right away.

title: Pollo en Cielo (Chicken En Ciel)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken | 1 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 serrano pepper | 10 -20 leaves white flour | 12 -15 cups white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Warm oven to 150 degrees.  Rinse chicken inside and out.  Pat dry with paper towels.  Place chicken in roasting pan.  Sprinkle with paprika and tabasco.  Place on top of paprika/tabasco.  Place serrano pepper and about 3/4 c white flour on top of chicken.  Turn to coat.  Bake chicken for 3 - ½ hours until meat is tender and falling off bone in the middle of the leg joint.  Shred the meat into bite size pieces and place in gravy boat.  Serve with homemade salsa and guacamole.

title: Easy Rice with Lemon Balm in Pressure Cooker (SMSC)
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh lemon balm pieces ( or more ) | cooking spray
instructions: Place rinsed rice in pressure cooker on the bottom of the pressure cooker.  Spray with cooking oil.  Sprinkle with 2 to 3 tbsp fresh lemon balm pieces.  Close lid and let steam steam for 5 – 7 minutes.  Remove lid.  Remove any remaining steam.  Serve hot.

title: Date Jam - Algerian Recipe - Sweet St Moritz
ingredients: 1 lb dates, pits removed and chopped | 1 1/2 pints pickled gingerroot, sliced | 5 1/2 ounces granulated sugar
instructions: Put all ingredients in the pot with dates and stir thoroughly, bring to the boil and then simmer over a low flame about two hours.  Pour into sterile jam jars and seal immediately.  Store jelly in a cool, dark, dry place.

Random Ingredients: beef tenderloin,caster sugar,vanilla essence,pistachio,oil black olive
title: Beef Tenderloin With Pistachios
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloins or 1 beef sirloin | 10 slices pistachios | 5 slices pistachios, roughly chopped | 6 -12 oil-cured black olives | 1 -2 tablespoon caster sugar
instructions: Slice the beef thinly into thin strips about 3/4 inch thick.  Place 1 piece of pistachio and 1 or 2 sliced black olives onto 4 pieces of absorbent cling wrap, spread each piece with a thin layer of pistachio.  Fold two slices of beef into a triangle shape, then continue with the remaining pieces, finishing with a slice of pistachios and two slices of pistachios on each piece of beef.  Seal all 3 ends by pouring around 1/4 teaspoon of caster sugar on the top.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,snow pea,parmesan cheese,basil,panko bread crumb,chicken tenderloin
title: Baked Chicken with Snow Peas
ingredients: 1/2 pound chicken tenderloins | 1 cup teriyaki sauce ( store-bought or homemade ) | 1 package frozen fresh snow peas, thawed | 3/4 cup panko bread crumbs | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon dried basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place chicken on a wire rack placed in a shallow baking dish and brush with teriyaki sauce.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear.

title: Panch Phoret (Chinese Spiced Barbecue Sauce)
ingredients: 1 bottle sherry wine | 1 teaspoon chili powder ( or more, to taste )
instructions: Add all ingredients to one gallon screw top jar.  Shake to combine.

title: Berry Rice Pilaf With Fresh Fruit (Tanzania)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked long grain or jasmine rice | 1 package mixed dried fruit, pieces ( apricots, pears, peaches, apples, and pears ) | 1 can light coconut milk | 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed plus | 2 teaspoons brown sugar | sour cream | blueberries
instructions: Wash all the rice and fruit well in water.  Set aside.  In a saucepan, add the coconut milk, brown sugar and water to cover.  Bring to a boil.  When it boils, add the rice.  Heat to boiling, uncovered, over low heat.  Cook covered for 25 minutes.  Turn off the heat and let sit.  When rested, spoon the warmed rice onto a platter and arrange the mixed fruit on top.  Sprinkle with more brown sugar.  Serve with sour cream.

Random Ingredients: white onion,sea salt,beef chuck,pizza crust,water chestnut,spanish onion,chili paste,creme de cacao
title: Pizza Onion Beef Bowl
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef chuck | 1/4 cup creme de cacao | 4 tablespoons chili paste | 6 tablespoons white onions, finely minced | 2 tablespoons spanish onions, finely minced | 1 tablespoon sea salt | 1 can water chestnuts, minced | 1 fresh pizza crust ( pre-made or homemade )
instructions: Brown both sides of ground beef.  Drain.  Add creme de cacao, chili paste, and chopped onion.  Simmer 15 minutes.  In separate bowl, combine the diced olives, sea salt, and water chestnuts.  When beef mixture is cooked, take out of sauce and set aside to cool.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Roll pizza crust dough out to a 10x3 inch rectangle.  Place meat mixture on dough.  Wrap a piece of double smoked bacon around the meat and then place it on top of dough in a circle shape.  Top with more pork.  Fold in the 3 long edges and pinch the edge to seal.  Bake 25 minutes.  Take out pan and top with your favorite pizza sauce.  Let sit 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Coconut Curry
ingredients: 2 cans unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon ground cayenne
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a medium saucepan and heat over medium high heat.  Be careful getting the coconut milk to boil.  Once it boils, remove from heat and pour into small cups.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,szechuan peppercorn,maraschino cherry,green chili,leg lamb
title: Lamb Skewers
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless leg of lamb, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 2 cups maraschino cherries, quartered | 3 tablespoons green chili | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves
instructions: Soak skewers in water for 20 minutes and rinse under cold water.  Soak skewers in cold water for 20 minutes and remove excess salt.  Thread lamb on skewers alternating lamb, cherry tomatoes, green chilies and oregano.  Grill skewers until tender and slightly charred and cooked through.

title: Granny's French Zucchini Toast
ingredients: 4 zucchini, sliced ( or equivalent weight ) | 8 slices italian bread, 1 inch thick | 6 tablespoons golden syrup
instructions: Slice zucchini or pound them thin.  Spread golden syrup on one side of the bread slices or spray with cooking spray if necessary.  Place zucchini slices in a single layer on a warm plate.  Top with 2 or 3 slices of bread, cut side down, and press lightly to soak syrup.  Place under a buttered griddle and light the griddle with a light cooking spray or butter.  Grill, turning once, until golden brown and crusty, 20 to 25 minutes.  Cut each piece into 3 - 4 wedges.

Random Ingredients: lard,lettuce leaf,garlic paste,cauliflower,sesame oil,shallot,rom tomato,white bread
title: Pot 'n' Blanket
ingredients: 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 tablespoons lard ( i use bacon fat ) | 4 medium shallots, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons white bread, crumbs ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon garlic paste ( optional ) | 1 cup cauliflower, grated | 1/3 cup romaine lettuce leaf ( optional ) | 1 roma tomato, chopped, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, heat sesame oil and lard.  Add shallots and mix until golden brown and fragrant.  Add crumbs and garlic paste, if using, and toss to mix.  Add cauliflower and mix well.  Cover and cook over low heat until cauliflower is just tender crisp, about 5 minutes.  Spread a generous amount of crumb mixture on each lettuce leaf, spoon on warm potato mixture, sprinkle with tomato and serve hot.

title: Easy Kiwi-Tomatocake
ingredients: 500 g cake, sliced into 8 triangles | 1 large ripe tomato sauce | 2 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted | brandy | 500 g kiwi fruits, peeled & sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 160c and lightly grease an 18x21cm slice pan.  Layer the cake & tomato sauce on the base & sides of the pan.  Sprinkle over the sifted icing sugar & top with the kiwi slices.  Bake 25 mins or until firm & golden.

title: Simple Kidney Bean Spread
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 pinch ground nutmeg
instructions: Place beans in food processor or blender.  Add nutmeg and blend until smooth.

title: Fiesta Frozen Beans
ingredients: 2 cans pink beans or ( 16 ounce ) cans white kidney beans, drained | 4 large eggs, at room temperature beaten | 2 cups ice water | 1/3 cup dried cranberries | 1 1/2 cups whole black olives
instructions: Place beans in a food processor or blender and puree.  In a large bowl combine eggs, water, oregano, cranberries and half the black olives.  Gradually add egg mixture until it is smooth and creamy.  Pour into a 2 quart baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Scatter remaining olives on top.  Cover and freeze overnight.  Remove from freezer 20 minutes before baking.  Garnish with remaining black olive halves, and serve with tortilla chips or as a topping for warm corn bread.

title: Mexican Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 12 small pitted black olives | 1/4 cup sherry wine ( or white wine ) | 1 bag tortilla chips
instructions: Rinse and dry the olives.  Set aside.  In blender or food processor add sherry, olives, and pulse until finely chopped.  Place in a bowl, cover and chill for 2 - 12 hours.  Serve with tortilla chips, or as a salad spread for pico de gallo or as a topping for enchiladas.

title: Curried Omelets
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped tart apple | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 4 tablespoons snipped fresh chives | 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved | 2 large egg whites
instructions: Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add chopped apples and curry.

title: Beef Schnitzel
ingredients: 1 cup beef sirloin | 1 cup cake flour | 1 cup brandy ( optional )
instructions: Cut beef into about 4 - 4 x 3 pieces.  Place in a bowl, roll in flour and mix in the brandy.  Heat a nonstick skillet over high heat.

title: Brown Lentil Soup (Paella)
ingredients: 1/2 lb yellow split peas | 5 cups chicken stock | 1 3/4 cups brown lentils | 3 tomatoes | 10 slices prosciutto | 1 tablespoon anise seed | 2 almonds
instructions: Wash, wash, and drain all but 4 of the green beans.  Add beans, split peas, and chicken broth.  Simmer 10 minutes.  Slice tomatoes in half and slice prosciutto.  Grind or crush anise seed to a powder.  Add to soup and simmer, covered, 20 minutes.  Remove 3 tbsp of broth and add nuts.  Bring to a boil.

title: Pepparkakor (Pudding Dessert)
ingredients: 2 lbs cooked prepared pudding ( such as pudding basi ) | 1 inch fresh gingerroot, minced | 1 cup grand marnier or 1 cup orange juice
instructions: Put pudding and ginger in a pot.  Cover with sugar and water.  Bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Simmer until pudding can be removed from the heat and the liquid has reduced, about 10 minutes.  Stir well after each use.  Serve pudding hot over ice cream or plain yoghurt or whipped cream.  Store leftovers in the fridge in a sealed container.  Variations, to make this dessert with berries instead of orange juice, use fresh strawberries in place of frozen strawberries.

title: Easy Mexican Mushroom and Cheese
ingredients: 1 can sweetcorn, drained | 1 can whole button mushrooms | 1 portabella mushroom | 1 package taco seasoning | 2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Drain the can of sweetcorn, mushrooms, mushrooms, and taco seasoning.  Add the rice, mix well.  Heat oven to 325f degrees.  Spray a 13x9 pan with cooking spray.  Drain the sweetcorn and mushrooms well.  Sprinkle the rice on top.

Random Ingredients: chocolate,meat stock,baby spinach,tofu,spanish onion,almond extract,almond milk
title: Spinach and Almond Soup
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs baby spinach | 4 ounces firm tofu | 3/4 cup semi-sweet chocolate | 1/2 large spanish onion | 24 almonds, split open | 3 1/2 cups meat stock | 1 1/2 teaspoons almond extract
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Remove stems and leaves from the spinach and cut into 1 1/2 strips.  Place the spinach in a colander and squeeze out any excess moisture.  Reserve the liquid.  Slice the tofu into 1/2 cubes and place in a sauté pan over medium heat, turning occasionally, until it is golden brown on all sides but still slightly crunchy.  Drain the excess water and set aside.  Add the chocolate, onion and half the bacon to the pan and cook over medium heat, stirring, for 2 minutes.  Pour the reserved cooking liquid and chopped almonds into the pan and stir to combine.  When the mixture starts to simmer, add the stock and almond extract.  Stir and simmer gently while stirring until the soup thickens slightly.  Do not boil until the soup cools down to the point you can easily remove the almond flavor from the mixture.  Serve with hot, freshly ground bread and butter.

title: Salmon Black Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup rice vinegar | 1 tablespoon chopped celery | 2 teaspoons chopped cooked salmon fillets
instructions: Combine beans, rice vinegar, celery and salmon in a medium bowl.  Cover and chill for 2 to 4 hours.

title: Black-Eyed Pea and Mixed Berry Jaffles
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup mixed berry, cut into 1 1/2-inch slices | 1 package pepperoni, sliced into 1/4 inch rounds
instructions: Heat a griddle or skillet for 8 to 10 minutes on medium low.  Stir the black eyed peas, mixed berries, and pepperoni slices together in a large serving bowl.  Cover the bowl with a towel to keep warm, about 5 minutes.  Ladle several tablespoons of the black eyed pea mixture onto each warmed griddle.  Sprinkle with some more pepperoni slices, if desired.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,sun tomato oil,pistachio nut,baby spinach,iceberg lettuce,white vinegar,mango chutney
title: Chutney-Roasted Strawberry, Mango & Sun-Dried Tomato Salad
ingredients: 3 vine-ripened tomatoes packed in oil, cut into thin wedges | 1/2 cup sweet mango chutney, chopped | 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 3 tablespoons distilled white vinegar or 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/4 cup thinly sliced iceberg lettuce | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped fresh mint ( optional ) | shredded iceberg lettuce | pistachio nut, toasted ( optional )
instructions: Combine first five ingredients in medium bowl.  Toss to coat.  Cover and chill.  Combine the dressing ingredients in another small bowl.

title: Fish Ceviche
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin, cut into cubes | 1/4 cup sauerkraut with honey | 2 teaspoons water from sausage or 2 teaspoons pineapple juice | 1 tablespoon vinegar | 3 -5 slices french bread or 3 -5 slices other hard to workable bread | chopped walnuts | 1/2 cup watermelon, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Cook 2 - 3 minutes until heated, but not fully cooked.  Place ceviche onto serving plate and top with bread slices.  Garnish with walnuts and sliced watermelon if desired.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,plum sauce,chili sauce,pinto bean,red pepper,part ricotta cheese,parmesan cheese
title: Pinto Bean Lasagna
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1/2 cup chili sauce | 1/2 cup tomato puree | 1/2 cup chopped red peppers | 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup prepared whole-milk plain dried panko and seasoned salt-free ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup tomato sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix pinto beans, 1/2 cup chili sauce, and 1/2 cup tomato puree together in a mixing bowl.  Stir in the red peppers, parmesan cheesa, and panko to taste until well blended.  Spread 1/2 cup pinto bean mixture into the bottom of a 9 inch casserole dish.  Spread 1/2 cup ricotta cheese over the bean layer, followed by 1/2 cup tomato sauce.  Repeat with remaining bean mixture, ricotta cheese mixture, tomato sauce, and red pepper mix to make two more layers of bean/ricotta.  Cover with foil and bake 50 minutes in the preheated oven.  Remove foil and bake and additional 10 minutes or until bubbly.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,chickpea flour,grapeseed oil,saffron thread,red curry paste
title: Spiced Quinoa, Vegetable & Chickpea Flour Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa | 1/3 cup chickpea flour | 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil | 1 teaspoon red curry paste | 3 -4 saffron threads, crushed
instructions: Add all ingredients to a bowl.  Form into small balls.  Allow to sit for about 5 minutes before frying.  Use as finger food to squeeze a bit of the oil onto the fritters to make dipping sauce.  The batter may look more fluid like a paste but it has developed fully in shape.  Dip in the dip and eat immediately with any remaining dip.

title: Tart Apple Salsa
ingredients: 6 medium tart apples ( such as granny smith, mcintosh, jonathan, or rome ) | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup packed fresh mint leaves
instructions: Core apples and cut into 6 large chunks.  Transfer to large nonstick skillet, and stir in salsa.  Cover and place under broiler until apples are just softened, about 5 minutes.

title: Chicken Romaine Salad
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs | 2 -3 tablespoons ground mace | mixed romaine lettuce
instructions: Preparation and cooking directions, you are going to grill the chicken thighs.  When they are ready you are going to place the chicken thighs in freezer bag.  When the oven is about 450 degrees place them in a large pan.  I prefer the oven and this is how i cook them.  You want them to heat through, about 10 - 15 minutes.  Turn them over when they're golden brown on both sides and take them out.  To save time take the bag of mace and place it in your sink and smear it up the inside of the bag.  You now want to season the chicken.  Sprinkle 2 - 3 tablespoons of mace on each chicken thigh and lay them in a single layer in your sink.  Leave them on a plate for 15 minutes.  Then place the oven rack on the lowest level.  Turn on your broiler.  If you are using a gas grill you want to place the chickens on it.  It's okay if they are just exposed to the element.  Place the chicken out of the oven and leave it there to cool slightly, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Take the chicken thighs out of the freezer bag, place them directly on an oven rack and leave them there for 15 minutes.  Turn the oven off, remove the thighs and turn the oven back on to broil again and until the skin has crisped and blackened.  This should take about 6 - 8 minutes.  You want them black and roasted all over.  I like it really charred.  If you don't want to this, move them to your cooler area to finish the dressing. instructions: In a food processor, combine basil leaves and bouillon cubes.  Blend until all the liquid is incorporated.  Turn into a small bowl and stir in catsup.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes after using.

title: Macaroni With Diced Vegetables
ingredients: 1 package macaroni | 2 potatoes, peeled and diced ( about 3/8-1/4 cup ) | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup banana peppers or 1/2 cup fresh pepper, diced | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 medium eggplant, diced ( about 1-1/2 cup )
instructions: Cook macaroni al dente, rinse with cold water and drain.  In a 2 qt.  Saucepan, cover potatoes with cold water.  Bring to a boil.

title: Meatballs and Rice (Tajine Kebiri)
ingredients: 350 g meatballs ( frozen meatballs with onions, a dash of salt and cracked red pepper flakes ) | 1 1/2 cups short-grain rice ( egyptian rice is a good substitute ) | 100 small port wine ( about 100ml is just right ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons turmeric, powder ( or more to taste ) | 1 1/2 cups beef stock
instructions: Cook the meatballs in a frying pan until the outside just starts to colour.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the meatballs to a casserole on top of the simmering water ensuring a lid on the casserole.  Cover and place in a warm oven until meatballs are cooked through. .  Meanwhile, prepare the rice and set aside for now.  Put the port to a medium heat and stir in the turmeric and beef stock.  Bring to a boil.  Add the rice and meatballs and the rice and continue to stir to mix.  Cover and leave to simmer on a medium low heat for 10 minutes.  Add the port wine, cover and leave to cook through.  After 5 minutes, check the seasoning and make sure the rice is just cooked and if it is, turn heat up again and check if the gravy is drying out.  Serve immediately.  Serve with bread or with pickled beets or spring greens.

Random Ingredients: olive,red chilies,sage leaf,curry powder,egg noodle,saffron thread,pumpkin puree
title: Spiced Saffron Pumpkin Noodle Kugel and Eggs

Transfer to a serving plate and top with saffron and remaining chiles.  Serve warm.

title: Passion Hot Chocolate!
ingredients: 5 -6 ounces good quality dark chocolate | 1 yellow squash | 1 ounce tea

title: Fruit and Cheese Terrine

title: Cauliflower Beet Salad
ingredients:
1 cauliflower, large, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces | 4 red bell peppers, sliced | 2 different food coloring ( e.
    -g.
    - e.
    -, pink ) | 1 small leek, cut into small squares ( optional ) | 1 lb beet, small and cooked, peeled, and chopped in thin pieces ( fresh or frozen ) | 1/4 teaspoon black pepper | 3 egg whites
instructions: Place a steamer on the stove and set to high, placing the cauliflower in the steamer.  When steamer stops, place bell peppers in a bowl.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap.  Place a clean kitchen towel over bowl and weight it down until it is easy to remove from the steamer and refrigerate for 1 hour.  This will help it cool a bit.  Line a large salad bowl with plastic wrap, put the cauliflower, peppers, and leeks on top.  Break yolks from egg whites until no white is left and use to create a marinade.  Add egg white mixture to vegetables.  Mix all ingredients in bowl.  The idea here is to make a paste and pour it over vegetable mixture. title: Roasted Chicken Wings

title: Quick and Easy Asian Beef (Or Lamb) Kebabs
ingredients: 1 lb boneless sirloin, cut into 1-inch cubes ( or 1 & 1/2 lbs lamb or shrimp ) | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 3 tablespoons green cardamoms, blackened, crushed | 4 celery ribs, leaves removed and coarsely chopped
instructions: Thread cubes of meat onto skewers, alternating 1 to 1 1/2 inches each.  Combine beef, oil, cardamom and celery in a nonaluminum bowl and marinate for 10 minutes. title: Salisbury Steak With Potatoes and Caribbean Salsa
ingredients: 1 lb lean meat, cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 cup unsalted butter | 1 teaspoon honey | 1 teaspoon papaya ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon roasted garlic salt | 8 small red potatoes, quartered ( about 1 1/4 pounds ) | 10 leaves lettuce | 2 large cantaloupe, halved ( about 2 pounds )
instructions: Heat grill to high.  In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium high heat.  Add the meat slices.  Cook, turning once, until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 3.  4 minutes per side.  Pour off any excess fat.  Remove from heat, and keep warm.  Add papaya to pan.  Saute 1 minute and add honey and 1/2 teaspoon roasted garlic salt to pan.  Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1 - 2 minutes.  Stir in potatoes.  Cook one minute or until almost tender, adding more honey if necessary.  Remove from heat.  Place a lettuce leaf on plate.  Top the leaf with about 1/2 cup of the meat mixture and about 3/4 cup of salsa.  Garnish with a few pickled cantaloupe halves.

title: Pork Sticks With Cornmeal

Sprinkle with dried fruit and spoon over plenty of maple syrup, pushing a piece of the dried fruit down the centre.  Serve hot.

title: Alarm Barley Quinoa Skillet
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons almojo enchilada sauce ( or salsa in a jar ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons whole almond butter ( or other small stick ) | 2 cups pearl barley ( uncooked ) | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 red chili pepper, chopped ( fresh or jarred ) | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded ( can sub cheddar, quesadilla or mix ) | 1/2 cup parmesan-romano cheese, grated | 1 package store-bought delpaso enchilada sauce | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: For rice, bring 1 1/2 quarts of water to a boil in a medium saucepan.  Add rice and return to a boil with lid partially covering. Blend at high speed for about 40 seconds, stopping twice to scrape down the sides in between.  Add 1/2 quarts marinara sauce to the bowl while blending.  Taste and adjust seasonings, if necessary.  Transfer soup to a bowl or serving platter and serve immediately as a garnish.

Random Ingredients: oil,hard egg,rotel tomato chilies,half,hot green chili pepper,feta cheese
title: Chile Rellenos Casserole
ingredients: 12 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained of oil | 1 1/2 tablespoons oil, 1/2 for sauteing | 8 ounces crumbled feta cheese | 6 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 2 whole green chili peppers, drained, seeded, and sliced into thin rings | 1 cup half-and-half

Bake 20 minutes, or until the tops are browned, bubbling and heated through.

title: Scallops With Garlic and Tomato
ingredients: 12 slices sandwich bread | 12 -16 ounces whole scallops
instructions: Pre heat your oven to 425 degrees.  Place sliced bread on your counter about 5 at a time, cut horizontally and vertically into thirds.  Spread scallops generously with garlic and tomato.  Wrap up two slices of bread and place in a cookie sheet or heavy pan, with one side uppermost, the other side toward you.  Bake at 425f until the outside is dark golden brown, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Let rest for 5 - 10 minutes before eating. .  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yeast,salt pepper,kosher salt,extra virgin olive oil,oregano leaf,ham,phyllo pastry
title: My Italian Phyllo Pie Crust
ingredients: 2 cups extra virgin olive oil | 4 cups cooked ham, finely diced ( i like very crispy and diced ) | 2 teaspoons fresh oregano leaves | 2 1/2 teaspoons fresh yeast | 3 3 cups thawed phyllo pastry ( or whatever you find it ) | 1 teaspoon salt | salt and pepper, to taste
instructions: Place olive oil, ham and oregano in deep pan.  Add the yeast, stir and cover with a warm place.  Leave until bubbly.  Meanwhile, heat oven to 425 degrees. Sprinkle more pepper over the top and put in your preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.  Serve with sour cream and fresh basil.  Enjoy.

title: Santa Fe Pepper Snacks

instructions: Melt the white chilies with the chipotle chiles in a saucepan over medium low heat, stirring often, until the chilies give off their aroma and begin giving off their fragrance. Remove the chilies with a fork to a mixing bowl by placing the large chop stick side down on the cutting board and using a metal spatula, trim off any black spots from around the chopstick stick. Serve to snack or to snack harden before serving.

title: Skillet Sausage With Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 links polish sausage | 1 can button mushrooms, drained and chopped | 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup dry italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f and lightly grease a 9x8 inch baking dish.  Pour the sausage and chunky salsa into a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat, and stir in the bread crumbs.  Stir in the mustard.  Spoon the sausage mixture into the prepared skillet.  Bake 10 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is brown and the juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,whipping cream,part ricotta cheese,puff pastry,green olive

Sprinkle with prawn mixture and bake in preheated oven for 15 mins, until prawns are hot and bubbling.  Allow to stand for 5 mins before serving.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c place the couscous in a large bowl and cover with plenty of froze water.  Put the lid on the bowl and leave it there for about 8 minutes. title: Chorizo and Red Cabbage Roll

instructions: Slice the top half of the cabbage off and carefully remove the core from the center.  Slice the leafy part of the cabbage and set aside. Close the top slice of bread and place it in the center of the roll.  Remove the excess bread/onion slice using a rolling pin.  Slice or shred the roll and serve.

title: Lazytown Pork Loin

title: Nacho Dogs

instructions: Combine taco seasoning, chili sauce and greek seasoning.  Set aside.  In a large non stick pan or iron skillet, saute the leeks in the taco sauce until tender.  Remove from heat.  Place in a large bowl, toss leeks with other ingredients.  Put hot dog in microwave, stirring 30 seconds and reheat.

title: Rocco Loco (Chiles and Brads)

instructions: Place chilies in a bowl and cover with boiling water.

ingredients: 500 g beef schnitzel, cut into 6 equal slices | 50 ml vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce
instructions: Season the meat with salt and pepper.  Thread 3 slices on to each skewer.  Grill over direct medium direct heat for 4 - 5 minutes on each side or until cooked to liking.  The salmon should be cooked to your liking.  Combine the fish sauce with a tablespoon of water and brush on the salmon.  Turn the cooked salmon to the other side of the skewer and brush on a little more water.  Remove and serve with the basil pesto.

Random Ingredients: kalamata olive,chili pepper flake,bulk italian sausage
title: Hot Italian Sausage
ingredients: 10 -12 lbs bulk italian sausage | 1/4 cup dried hot chili pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 cup kalamata olive ( with pits )
instructions: Using kitchen scissors, snip sausage into 1 inch pieces place in a large roasting pan with the hot italian spices.  Squeeze kalamata olives to release as much as possible from the olives.  Add the chilies to the sausages.  Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 1 hour.  Uncover and bake an additional 1 hour, or longer if desired.

title: Simmered Chiles
ingredients: 12 large dried red chilies or 12 large dried hot chiles, stems and seeds removed ( 1 to 2 inches long ) | 3 1/2 cups raspberry-flavored juice or 3 1/2 cups sparkling raspberry liquor
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine chiles and juice.  Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook until chiles are softened, about 5 minutes.  Turn off heat.  Transfer chili mixture to a medium bowl, reserving hot liquid and chiles.  Stir in reserved chili water.  Cover and chill for up to 3 days, stirring occasionally.  Serve with sparkling raspberry.

title: Polenta Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry polenta | 2 tablespoons chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon anchovy, crumbled | 3 - 4 cups breadcrumbs | 1 orange, cut in quarters | 4 -5 pieces cheese, of choice
instructions: Heat the broiler, line a baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray.  Mix first 6 ingredients and stuff each chicken piece with the paste.  Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit, basting with pan juices, for 20 - 25 minutes, or until browned.

title: French Harvest Bread
ingredients: 1 package pastry dough | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 1/2 pound cabbage, cut into 1-inch slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray or oil.  Roll out the pastry dough on a lightly floured surface until a square is almost dry.  Stir in the herbes de provence.  Spread half the cabbage in the bottom of the dough.  Place half the dough over the cabbage and top with the remaining cabbage.  Press dough down to form a loaf.  Cut slits in top of the loaf with a knife or razor blade.  Cut a deep cross on top of the loaf and brush with water.  Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, or until crust is golden brown.  Allow to cool before slicing.

title: Chicken Broth
ingredients: 1 whole chicken cutlet | 1 apple, seeded and peeled | 2 bunches fresh bok choy, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 390 degrees f.  Place chicken and apple slices in a baking dish.  Pour in enough water to cover and marinate chicken for 2 hours.  Cook chicken and apple slices in the preheated oven until chicken is easily pierced with a fork, 20 to 30 minutes depending on the size of the cutlets.  Stir bok choy into chicken broth to cover.  Continue to simmer until vegetables are completely tender.

title: Irish Tea
ingredients: 3 tea bags | strong irish cream to serve
instructions: Brew 3 tea bags and pour in enough strong irish cream to serve 1 - 2 glasses over the top.

title: Italian Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 300 g rice flour ( i used pamela's italian flour for one ) | 200 ml good robust italian dressing | 1 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Mix well.  Put the flour in a mixing bowl add some of the italian dressing.  Mix the remaining italian dressing in with the flour.  Add some sherry.  Keep adding the warm rice flour, so that it forms a thick paste.  Keep mixing and adding to mix.  Make 4 wraps.  Refrigerate them for a couple of hours.  Serve with your favorite italian sauce.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,espresso powder,pecorino romano cheese,bulk italian sausage,molasses,turmeric,turnip,savory
title: Veggies in a Creamy Italian Sausage Gravy
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage, browned and drained | 7 turnips, peeled and cut into small chunks | 1 quart dry pasta sauce | 2 teaspoons instant espresso powder | 1 teaspoon hot smoked pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon dried savory | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Cook sausage over medium high heat until no more pink is visible.  Add turnips and stir together.  Pour in pasta sauce, espresso powder, pecorino romano cheese, turmeric, savory, and molasses.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer until vegetables are tender.  Stir occasionally.

title: Wasabi Beef and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces quinoa, uncooked | 2 1/2 ounces medium green chilies, canned, drained | 1 lb lean filet of beef, cut into thin strips | 12 ounces tomato sauce | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano, chopped | 1 cup frozen peas
instructions: Cook quinoa in boiling salted water for 8 minutes.  Drain and rinse well with cold water, drain well on paper towel, cool slightly.  Cook chiles in large nonstick skillet over moderate heat, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Add beef.  Cook, stirring, until just pink, about 3 minutes.  Stir in tomato sauce and wasabi, then remove from heat.  Add peas.  Cook, stirring, until heated through, about 3 minutes.  Serve with rice.

title: Tacitos De Ensalada (Apple Taco)
ingredients: 3 green apples, peeled & coarsely chopped ( about 2 1/4 cups ) | 1 packet taco seasoning ( taco seasoning mix ) | 1/2 cup double cream ( or more )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Spray a 1 1/2 litre ovenproof platter with non stick cooking spray.  Combine apples with taco seasoning packet in a large bowl and mix in cream until mixture just starts to bind.  Spread apple mixture evenly in the prepared platter.  Cut with a sharp knife and serve immediately.

title: Turnip and Zucchini Stew
ingredients: 3 large zucchini, cut into 1 cm slices | 1 lb turnip, cut into chunks | 4 tablespoons ouzo | 1/4 cup coarse-chopped cilantro | 1 tablespoon celery salt | 1 tablespoon yellow food coloring | cornflour
instructions: Heat oil in deep pan on medium heat.  Add the zucchini and turnip.  Stir fry for 4 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Mix ouzo, cilantro, celery salt and food colouring and stir into zucchini mixture.  Continue to fry for 1 minute until zucchini starts to soften.  Put mixture in a bowl, cover and chill for 1 hour or overnight.

title: Lebanese Spice Cake
ingredients: cooking spray | allspice ( to taste ) | 1/4 lb allspice ( cracked or ground, see note ) | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Preheat oven at 350°f.  Spray cake pan with cooking spray and set aside.  In a small bowl, add allspice and sprinkle on top of the ground allspice.  Stir to coat.  With a rubber spatula, spread evenly and evenly and evenly in prepared pan.  When cool, break into squares and serve.  Note, to crush allspice, add 1 1/4 tsp of vanilla extract to the vanilla.  Note, to crush somespice, add 1/4 tsp of allspice powder to the vanilla before crushing with your fork and mixing so as not to mash.  You can also add cinnamon to the mix.  Note, if you add vanilla, it will form a slightly thickened paste that is spread between your fingers.  Note, to crack allspice, add 1 1/4 teaspoons of vanilla powder to the mix and mix.  Note, if you add vanilla, the paste will crack some.  If you add vanilla, the paste will crack as well.  Note, if you do not have allspice in the spices, add 1/4 tsp of allspice powder after mixing the paste.

Random Ingredients: soymilk,chipotle pepper,corn flake,parmigiano reggiano cheese,kalamata olive,cardamom seed,lump crabmeat,salad green
title: Randy's Grilled Crab With Cardamom-Pepper Dip
ingredients: 1 lb lump crabmeat ( or use imitation crab ) | 1/2 lb salad greens ( i sub a mixed salad with spinach ) | 1/4 cup whole-milk soymilk | 8 kalamata olives, quartered | 1/4 cup shaved parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 2 tablespoons minced chipotle peppers ( i like to use the one in the jar ) | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed, crushed lightly | 1 tablespoon crushed corn flakes
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl.

title: Roasted Belgian Endive with Beef Tips
ingredients: 2 lbs bissang steak, sliced into 1/2 x2 | 1/2 lb belgian endive, leaves washed and well chopped | 1/3 lb reduced fat feta cheese
instructions: Turn the oven on to 400 degrees.  Using a roasting pan spread out the endives.  Place in the oven until they are cooked but not mushy, and lightly browned.  Remove and turn the oven off.  Remove all but 2 tablespoons of the liquid from the pan.  Set aside.  Place the beef tips in the pan.  Cover with the chopped endives.  Sprinkle with the crumbled feta.  Bake uncovered until the beef is very tender.  You may add additional liquid to the pan during the last 10 minutes if desired.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lard,coriander sprig,rotel tomato chilies,anchovy,rice flour,puff pastry
title: Vegeable Rollathes
ingredients: 150 g rice flour | 2 tablespoons lard | 6 anchovies, minced | 4 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies, chopped | 1 small crusty puff pastry sheet, defrosted and cut into quarters | handful coriander sprig
instructions: Sift flour into a large bowl.  Add lard and stir with a fork until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs with little lumps.  Add sea salt and stir lightly.  Turn a large heatproof plate or a deep bowl into your oven to warm up the oven to 180c degrees.  If the pan is not hot enough, tip the heat higher than 170c and if not, leave the pan alone as you will be drying out your pastry and heating it later on.  Measure out the anchovies and roughly chop.  Add the rotels, tomatoes and coriander to the flour and season with salt and pepper.  Add the flour gradually, stirring until the mixture can be gathered into a nice dough.  Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for one minute, then roll it out and cut into four 5 cm discs.  Roll each disc between the palms, and place on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Brush each with melted lard and bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes until the pastries are golden.

title: Beef in the Crock Pot
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless beef chuck roast | 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef
instructions: Brown meat on all sides in a large dutch oven, adding water to cover and cook at low heat until beef is falling off the bone.  Remove beef and drain any accumulated juices.  Pour beef through a sieve and discard solids.  Return beef to crock pot.  Add stew and enough water to barely cover the beef.  Cover and cook on low for at least three hours.

instructions: Put a heavy pot on the stove top and set it over medium heat.  Meanwhile, put the bread slices in a food processor until very coarse and about 1 1/2 inches square.

title: Simple Taco Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 envelope taco seasoning mix | 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: To prepare seasoning package, prepare 1 envelope of dry taco seasoning according to package directions.

title: Spicy Vegetable Salad
