instructions: Combine all salad ingredients, except chopped fresh cilantro leaves, in a large bowl and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate while preparing vegetables.  Right before serving, add chopped cilantro leaves, if using, and toss.

title: Crock Pot Portuguese Dipping Sauce--(Lomo Saltado)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef or 1/2 lb ground pork | 2 tablespoons beef bouillon cubes
instructions: In large skillet, brown ground beef or meat and bouillon cubes together.  Drain and transfer to crock pot.  Mix well, add sugar if needed.

title: Merlot Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 8 ounces beef tenderloin | 4 green onions, chopped | 1/3 cup merlot | 1 dash ground pepper
instructions: Score desired depth 1/2 inch from top of beef.  Combine remaining ingredients, pour atop beef, and marinate 2 hours or longer covered in refrigerator.  Grill beef 8 to 10 minutes a side or until desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,soy sauce,chicken liver,paprika,baby red potato,mustard
title: Easy Red Potato Chicken Livers
ingredients: 1 head chicken liver | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 3 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon paprika | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | baby red potatoes
instructions: Slice chicken livers thin and boil until brown.  Drain and set aside.  Add rest of ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes.  Slice potatoes and add to mixture.  Cook for another 5 minutes and serve.

title: Pork Shoulder and Barbecue Fajitas
ingredients: 1 boneless pork shoulder roast | 8 flour tortillas | 8 large hamburger buns
instructions: Place roast in a slow cooker.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup shredded cheese or shredded lettuce.  Roll up and secure with toothpicks.  Cook on high for 5 hours or on low for 5 to 4 hours.  Shred meat with 2 forks.  Slice off ends of corn tortillas, and heat in a microwave for 30 seconds.

Random Ingredients: bacon,glace cherry,almond extract,white vinegar,chicken meat,tamarind pulp,lard
title: Sweet, Savoury, and Sour Glace Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 lb thick sliced bacon, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup lard, for frying | 2 cups blanched almonds | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 8 ounces chopped cooked chicken meat | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1/4 cup tamarind pulp
instructions: In a skillet over moderate heat, add the bacon, lard, almonds, and almond extract.  Cook, stirring frequently, for 3 minutes or until heated through and lightly browned.  Remove from the skillet, cool, and chop.  In a large saucepan over moderately high heat, add the chicken, vinegar and tamarind pulp.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until the liquid is syrupy and the meat is cooked through.  Spoon the sauce over the chicken and serve.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,breadcrumb,white wine vinegar,corn tortilla,apple cider vinegar,margarine
title: Easy Baked Applesauce Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 8 soft corn tortillas | 2 tablespoons margarine, melted | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/2 - 1/2 cup white wine vinaigrette ( or to taste )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In small bowl combine vinegar and olive oil.  Dip tortillas in oil, then in bread crumbs.  Arrange in single layer in baking dish.  Brush or spray tortillas with olive oil.  Sprinkle with worchestershire sauce and cider.  Bake about 10 minutes, or until crisp and golden.  Sprinkle with white wine vinegar.  Serve hot or warm.

title: Gurkensalat (Zucchini in Dill Sauce)
ingredients: 1 lb zucchini | 4 sprigs fresh dill
instructions: Cut a slice off the top of each zucchini.  Cut the zucchini flesh lengthwise and crosswise into 1/4 slices.  Slice off the ends and discard.  Rinse in cold water and drain on paper towels.  Place the zucchini slices in a steamer or large saucepan with plenty of about 3 quarts boiling water.  Cover lightly and steam on medium heat for 15 minutes.  Add the dill sprigs, cover, and steam for a further 5 - 7 minutes.  Use a slotted spoon to transfer the zucchini to a serving dish and cut each in half.  Serve hot.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash With Tarragon Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 2 butternut squash, halved, seeded | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh tarragon | 14 ounces canned rotel tomatoes & chilies, drained | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon | 7 ounces crumbled light rye bread
instructions: Place butternut squash halves into an oven proof casserole dish, drizzle with a little olive oil and bake in a moderately hot oven for approx 20 mins, turning halfway through or until cooked through.  Meanwhile, make the dipping sauce.  Place a few tarragon sprigs in a small bowl, mix well with the rotel tomatoes and stir until softened.  Add 1 tblspn mint leaves and 2 tblspn tarragon and season.  Toss together lightly and spoon the topping over the butternut squash halves.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Roasted Sweet Stuffed Chive
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 1 jar stuffed olives | 3 2/3 cups low fat cottage cheese or 3 2/3 cups cream cheese ( 1-2 % ) | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh chives
instructions: Preheat and set oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Mix together the olives, cottage cheese and chives.  Tear off 2 - ½ inch lengths of twine from each pork shoulder.  Insert stuffing mixture inside each piece & tie tightly.  Brush outside and outside of the roast with some marinade.  Place on a rack in a roasting pan.  Roast until tender, about 2 hours, basting occasionally with the pan drippings.

title: Baked Kufta
ingredients: 1 small lamb, cut into 2 inch pieces ( kufta ) | 1 cup broth
instructions: Lay the lamb pieces in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  In a saucepan, bring the broth to a rolling boil.  Dump the kuftas in the broth.  Return liquid to a boil, cover and braise in the oven for 2 1/2 hours.  Remove keuftas from baking dish, and discard excess fat.  Cut into slivers and serve with yogurt.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,ramen noodle,sugar,sage leaf,salt,chinese duck sauce,peanut oil,barbecue sauce
title: Chinese Barbecue Noodle Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 lb chinese barbeque stir fry noodles ( thin or jumbo is fine ) | 12 -20 large fresh sage leaves ( or dried leaves or a combination ) | 6 tablespoons chinese duck sauce ( can also use your own ) | 1/4 cup barbecue sauce | 2 tablespoons sugar | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon salt ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil ( or other oil, as for stir frying ) | vegetable oil, for stir frying
instructions: Prepare barbeque noodles per the package instructions.  Separate and slice the sage very thin.  Mix the pork, noodles, and sauce in a large bowl.  Add the sugar, salt, pepper and sage.  Toss well to combine.  Heat the oil in a deep skillet to 325°f / 170°c.  Add the noodles and fry until nicely browned, but not burned or dry.  Keep tossing every minute, and have a fork or spatula ready for the next step.  Serve w/pork or beef.

title: Wasabi Cheese
ingredients: 600 g wasabi paste | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Place all the ingredients into an electric blender and blend until well combined.  Pour into a small pan to keep the cheese from sticking to the blade.  Wipe the outside of the pan with a kitchen paper to remove any dirt or residue.  Place on the top shelf of a bain marie until it starts to darken.  Turn down the heat to medium and leave for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice at least before removing from the pan.  If the cheese is to thin, leave until it reduces into a creamy consistency, ideally for around 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and leave to cool completely.  If it is too thick, stir in a small film of water to loosen crystals up.

Random Ingredients: pasta sauce,dill,beef kidney,ice cube,dill sprig,ginger paste,almond essence,chili oil
title: Steamed Beef Cube Pasta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili oil | 1 -2 slice ginger paste | 1 -2 cup beef kidney, cooked | 1 tablespoon pastina sauce | 3 -5 ice cubes | pam cooking spray or ghee | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | fresh dill sprig, to garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a wok.  Add ginger paste.  If using ginger, add now.  Stir fry until it turns golden brown.  Add beef kidney and stir fry till it is cooked.  Add pasta sauce and 2 cups of water.  Stir.  Add frozen peas and cook.  Add fresh dill and decorate with fresh dill sprigs.  Serve hot with steamed green cardamom pods on the side.

title: Rotini Con Snow Pea
ingredients: 450 g rotini pasta, dried | 450 g snow peas, trimmed and thinly sliced | 450 g plain flour
instructions: Pour boiling water over the dried pasta to cover.  Drain and return to the pan.  Cover and leave to stand for 1 hour.  Meanwhile, steam the snow peas over a pan of boiling water for 5 minutes or until just tender, then drain.  Meanwhile, mix together the flour and pasta.  Add the snow peas and mix thoroughly, then set aside to cool.  Shape the pasta mixture into small balls.  Roll them in the flour and fry in a little oil lightly.  Add the pasta to the snow peas and gently toss.  Serve at once.

title: Hard Boiled Eggs and Mustard
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs | 1 packet long grain mustard ( dijon )
instructions: Wash egg yolks and leave them whole.  Place yolks in a heat proof bowl.  Dip boiled eggs in hot water, draining thoroughly.  Spread mustard on egg whites and add extra to taste.  Cover with cling film and leave to stand for 1 hour.  Using a metal spoon, carefully loosen egg whites from the egg yolks.  Serve straight away on warm plates or cold from the oven.

title: Sassy Chocolate Chips
ingredients: 1/4 cup milk chocolate chips | 1/8 cup cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f in a microwave safe bowl, melt the chocolate chips.  Stir well.

Random Ingredients: mace,onion flake,italian salad dressing mix,tarragon vinegar,strawberry,nutmeg
title: Sparkling Italian Strawberry Onions
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs fresh strawberries, stemmed, seeded & chopped | 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 1 tablespoon dried italian salad dressing mix | 1 teaspoon fresh ground nutmeg | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon vinegar | 1/8 teaspoon mace, ground
instructions: Place strawberries and onion flakes in a large glass bowl.  Add salad dressing, nutmeg, tarragon, and mace.  Toss to coat.  Cover, and place in refrigerator 1 hour.  Before serving, allow 2 to 3 hours for fresh strawberries and to thicken up any sauce left.

Random Ingredients: apricot preserve,cottage cheese,mint leaf,ancho chile,oregano,lavender,beef roast,shortcrust pastry
title: Ancho Chile Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef roast | 2 tablespoons fat | 2 tablespoons dried lavender | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup slivered dried apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves | 18 dried hot arbol chiles, minced | 4 sheets shortcrust pastry, thawed ( pillsbury )
instructions: Make filling, place chiles in a bowl, cover with hot water, and let stand 20 minutes.  Drain chiles, reserving water.  Heat fat.  In a 1 1/2 quart electric slow cooker, add meat, lavender, oregano, apricot preserves and chiles.  Cover.  Cook on high 5 to 6 hours or high 8 to 10 hours.  Remove meat from slow cooker, reserving any liquid in cooker.  Remove chiles and reserve liquid.  Strain chile liquid through a sieve or food mill.  Pour chile liquid back into cooker.  Cover.  Cook on high for about 45 minutes or until thickened.  Stir in mint.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Roll out pastry to ¼ inch thickness.  Cut into 6 - 8 squares.  Place 2 tbsp filling on each square and fold pastry over to enclose filling.  Place on greased 12 x 5 baking sheet, bake at 350°f for 15 minutes or until top is golden.  Serve hot.

title: Mushroom Rice Skillet
ingredients: 2 cups water | 3 cups long grain rice, rinsed, drained | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 2/3 cup bottled hot sauce | 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/3 cup graham wafer crumbs
instructions: Heat water and rice in a 5 qt saucepan to a boil.  Reduce heat.

title: Spiced Banana Peppers and Toasted Apricots
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast, 2 packages | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 2 cups crushed roasted tomatoes with fruit ( canned plum, canned or fresh ) or 2 cups canned tomato sauce | 2 ounces smoked paprika or 2 ounces hot paprika | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon mixed spice | crackers
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together yeast and jam.  In a large saucepan, heat crushed tomatoes and spice until warm.  Add to the yeast mixture and beat just until well mixed, approximately 3 to 4 minutes.  Stir in jam.  Pour mixture into a well buttered square baking dish sprayed with cooking olive oil.  Cover with wax paper and let rise in a warm place till double in bulk, about 2 hours.  Punch down dough.  Transfer on a lightly floured work surface and knead a couple of times, adding a few tablespoons water if the mixture seems dry.  Divide dough into 8 pieces and roll each into a ball.  Place about 4 balls on top of each other on top of each other, leaving a 1 inch border of dough at the top.  Roll out about 1/8 inch thick.  Arrange on baking sheet and let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until light brown in spots.  You should bake these in the middle of the oven with the internal temperature at about 45 minutes.  Place the baking sheet on a baking rack to cool slightly, before removing to cool completely, about 15 minutes.  Serve warm, sprinkled with melted or chopped nuts, or with cool crusty french bread or crackers.

title: The Best Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups pitted dates | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 2 1/2 cups tapioca, cooked and slightly soft | 1 1/2 cups xanthan gum | 1 teaspoon crushed dried red chiles
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix ingredients in a casserole dish.  Bake in preheated oven until thickened.

title: Pear Salad With Lemon and Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh lemon rind, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon fresh lime rind, thinly sliced | 6 tablespoons port wine | 12 large shrimp, cooked, shelled and deveined | 1 tart apple, cut into bite size pieces | 12 sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and thinly sliced
instructions: Mix rind, lime rind, port wine and shrimp.  Arrange pear wedges, apple slices and sun dried tomatoes in 4 salad plates.

title: Lebanese Zinger
ingredients: 6 tablespoons fresh lime juice, divided | 2 -3 tablespoons dried chili powder, to taste | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom powder | 1/3 teaspoon freshly grated lemon zest
instructions: Place half of the lime juice, chili powder, cardamom, and lemon zest in a small glass bowl with a lid.  Mix well and cover and set aside to marinate for at least ten minutes, or overnight.  Remove the lime zest and the remaining lime juice.  Place the zest in your food processor.  Add the remaining ground lime, and blend till creamy.  Store refrigerated.  You can re stir the lemon zest into the lemon sauce if you prefer, like i do, although it will not flavor the dish any more than an hour.

Random Ingredients: gingerroot,anise seed,tabasco sauce,dark rum,cream chicken soup,salt pepper
title: Randy's Famous Caramelized Rum Sauce for the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 lb dark rum | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons anise seed | 1 teaspoon grated fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon salt and pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in the pressure cooker.  Close lid securely.  Turn on the vent and lock the pressure cooker, and let it come up to full pressure.  Let it simmer for 8 minutes.  Remove from heat and release pressure, fluff up with a fork once the alcohol has completely melted into the mixture.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Ginger Chili Sauce for Chicken and Veggies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon gingerroot, minced | 1 1/2 cups sweet chili-garlic sauce
instructions: Combine the ginger and chili sauce in 2 cup measuring cup.  Cover, and let stand 10 - 12 hours.  Rinse and discard the ginger mixture.  Use leftover ginger mixture in basting sauce.

title: Italian Barley Patties
ingredients: 2 cups pearl barley | 5 tablespoons fine breadcrumbs | 1 -2 teaspoon white wine vinegar
instructions: Mix the barley and bread crumbs together and roll into little balls.  Roll the balls in the vinegar and fry them in oil until golden brown.

title: Apple Fried French Fries
ingredients: 3 large eggs substitute | 2 cups shredded romaine lettuce | 6 thick slices deli sliced fresh apple | 1/4 cup chopped green onion | 2 teaspoons minced fresh chives | 2 slices pepperoni, chopped | 1 ripe french fries
instructions: Pour eggs in a wide, shallow dish.  Add romaine lettuce, apple slices, green onion, chives and pepperoni.  Dish rolls and place on a rack in a 450 degree oven until eggs are set, about 10 minutes.  Serve with desired toppings.

title: Yia's Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups jasmine rice ( dry ) | herbs | herbs | parsley sprigs
instructions: Soak dry rice in 1 cup luke warm water for 40 - 60 minutes.  Add herbs, pinches of herbs and mix thoroughly.  Drain soaked rice and dry thoroughly.  Add rice to your food processor and process to creat a smooth dough or pattie like dough.  If dough is too moist, add more water.  Wash hands and pat out rice with wet towel.  Brush with melted butter.  Cut into strips or diamonds.  Roll out to desired length of rice.  Serve on a platter with herbs and pinches of herbs.

title: Chocolate-Spiced Fish
ingredients: 4 halibut fillets | 1 can green chilies, chopped | 1 cup toasted pecans, chopped | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1 tablespoon red pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine chilies, nuts and cocoa in a small bowl, stirring to blend.  Heat a skillet over medium high to high heat.  Coat fish with spice mix.  Cook 3 - 4 minutes on each side, just until fish is just cooked through.  Serve fish with sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,oil,baking potato,arugula leaf,vegetable broth,canola oil,beef bouillon powder
title: Beef and Potato Fritters
ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil | 2 cups baking potatoes | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon powder | 2 cups vegetable broth | 2 tablespoons dried arugula leaves | 2 drops chicken bouillon granules | 10 cups hot oil for frying
instructions: Heat canola oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.  Cook potatoes in hot oil until tender and brown, about 20 minutes.  Drain, and cool, then slice into 1/4 inch thick fries.  Pour vegetable broth into a large bowl, and dissolve chicken bouillon powder.  Add arugula and bouillon, and stir until mixed.  Fry fritters in hot oil, about 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,butternut squash,whipping cream,salsa,bean sprout,yellow squash
title: Ww Apple Butternut Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 tart apples, cored, peeled, and diced | 1 cup shredded butternut squash or 1 cup butternut squash | 1 yellow squash, peeled and diced | 2 cups prepared hot fresh salsa, divided ( i use pace ) | 2 tablespoons whipping cream | 1/2 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Pour about half of the salsa into a 9x9 inch baking dish.  Place the apples, butternut, and yellow squash in a large bowl.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs ground sausage | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods | 1 teaspoon ground rosemary | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 -2 hot dried chipotle chile in adobo, minced
instructions: Heat a small amount of oil in a skillet.  Add the cardamom pods and rosemary.  Cook until the rosemary needles start to darken, about 2 minutes, stirring frequently.  Transfer the pan to a plate and set aside for now.  Heat the oil in the empty skillet over medium high heat.  Add the sausage and cook until browned.  Drain the fat from the sausage and add the chipotle pepper and chipotles, stirring until the pepper is fragrant.  Reduce heat and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring frequently.  Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl.  Stir the cooked sausage mixture into the hot peppers, then let cool 10 minutes.  Cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,apple juice,italian sausage link,orange peel,white peppercorn
title: Coriander Sausages (Aka Spicy Italian Sausages)
ingredients: 12 italian sausages ( sweet sausages ) | white peppercorns, crushed | orange peel, grated | fresh coriander powder | 1/4 cup unsweetened apple juice
instructions: Grind white peppercorns in a spice grinder till fine.  Mix in grated orange peel and chopped coriander powder.  Brush casings with apple sauce and sprinkle with italian spices powder.  If any stuffing spills out then add additional olive oil.  Close the sausages securely.  You can also cook them in the juices or use a crockpot as the stuffing for salads.

Random Ingredients: broccoli stem,rye bread,fast rising yeast,dark brown sugar,white chocolate,stewing beef,rice flour
title: Stuffed Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 lb stewing beef | 1 ounce of white chocolate ( we use hershey's ) | 2 packages fast rising yeast | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 3 cups rice flour | 3 cups broccoli stems ( i actually just steam them until they wrinkle ) | 4 slices rye bread ( i use thinly sliced bread )
instructions: Soak the beef cubes in hot water for 15 minutes drain and set aside.  Place the chocolate in a heat proof bowl over a pan of simmering water.  When melted, add the beef cubes and stir until coated with the melted chocolate.  In a large bowl dissolve the yeast completely in the warm chocolate mixture.  Add the brown sugar and stir until dissolved.  Add the beef, ginger and 1 cup of the rice flour until you have a firm dough, adding the leftover 2 cups of rice flour by the cup as you do so.  Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, about 5 minutes, adding more flour or water if the dough is too sticky.  If you don't want to go all the way to the board and starting with your hands or your hands of dough, knead the dough into a ball that is about 1/4 to 1/2 inch in diameter and 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick.  Place the dough in an oiled bowl and place a dinner plate on top of the dough making sure it is well oiled and not over oiled.  Cover that bowl with plastic wrap and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours.  When dough has risen, divide the dough in three and roll each into a long strip about 2 - 3 inches long.  Roll each strip from the wide end into a log about a inch in diameter.  Slice the loaves into 1/8 slices.  Place on the baking sheet, cover with plastic wrap, and leave to rise another 30 minutes.  When the beef is nearly done, bake one slice of bread at a time in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 15 - 20 minutes or until golden brown and crispy on top.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: yellow bell pepper,cream mushroom soup,french bread,garam masala powder,allspice berry
title: Lori's French Onion Soup
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 yellow bell pepper, or more to taste, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon allspice berry | 1/8 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Stir cream of mushroom soup and yellow bell pepper together in a mixing bowl until heated through, but do not boil.  Stir allspice berry, garam masala powder, and white pepper into soup mixture.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,jasmine rice,red wine vinegar,sesame oil,cashew,shell pasta,cajun seasoning
title: Faux Pasta Salad II
ingredients: 3/4 cup uncooked small shell pasta | 1 cup uncooked jasmine rice | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and liquid reserved | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons cashews, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until tender.  Drain and rinse under cold water.  Drain again.  Cook rice according to package directions, but stir in water chestnuts 1 minute.

title: Nana's Sausage and Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: 2 packages andouille sausage, cut into 1inch slices | 6 tablespoons crunchy peanut butter | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl until well blended.  Spread in a 9x9 inch loaf pan and bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.

title: Malt and Vinegar Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges | 1 pinch salt | 1/4 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Place potato wedges in pan and cover with cold water.  Cook uncovered at medium heat for 35 minutes until tender enough to pierce with a fork.  Drain and set aside to cool.  Turn oven to 350°f.  Place potatoes in a large bowl and stir in salt.  Using wet hands, pat potato mixture down in a large glass baking dish, about 1/4 inch thick.  Drizzle potatoes with vinegar and coat in mixture.  Bake in oven for about 30 minutes until crispy.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,allspice,anchovy paste,italian dressing,ice cream,sherry,rye bread
title: Sesame Pretzels
ingredients: 1 loaf rye bread | 3 tablespoons sesame seeds, toasted | 1 tablespoon anchovy paste | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 1 teaspoon sherry | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | ice stick | 1 gallon ice cream
instructions: Cut bread loaves into 1/2 inch thick slices and place onto a parchment lined baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,tomato sauce,filet mignon steak,masa harina flour,green bell pepper,flour,banana
title: Beef Tamale Filling
ingredients: 1/2 lb sliced asparagus | 1/2 lb sliced green bell pepper | 1/2 lb sliced banana | 3 tablespoons masa harina flour | 1 1/2 cups green beans | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 cup filet mignon steaks ( about a pound )
instructions: In a saucepan, cook all ingredients except steak, and simmer, uncovered, for 7 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Roll steak in masa, coating evenly.  Brown in a large skillet, approx 10 minutes or until done,.  Use 1/2 cup masa as a garnish to each taco and serve.

Random Ingredients: dashi powder,vinegar,salt pepper,red pepper flake,phyllo dough,tequila,italian seasoning
title: Easy Awesome Phyllo Pizza!
ingredients: 1 cup dashi powder | 1/4 cup vinegar ( or any sweet white vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning ( or a mix of both ) | 1/2 tablespoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon salt & pepper | 1 teaspoon tequila ( or other ) | 24 sheets phyllo dough
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Mix all the other ingredients in a small bowl, and set aside.  Using a pastry bag for this, take pastry dough out of the plastic bag and cut out 12 squares, then place 2 heaping teaspoons of the dashi mixture in the middle on each square.  Fold the corners over the dashi mixture, tucking them around a little.  Place on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper, and brush each top.  You can also bake these in a regular oven as well.  I like to do these the day before as i have a huge left over phyllo dough.  Remove from oven, brush with lime, and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, or until crispy on the outside and crispy on the inside. .  For a different look you can also use other flavors of tequila, orange juice, pineapple juice or fruit juice.  Feel free to use different fillings to add to taste.

title: Vanilla Stars
ingredients: 100 -200 g grapes leaves, frozen | 1 liter vanilla bean, frozen
instructions: Thaw grapes leaves and scrape out all the pulp.  Place into clean stainless steel bowl, wrap with clean cloth or paper towels and place in the freezer for at least 2 hours.  Place frozen vanilla beans.  Using a fine mesh strainer add the vanilla beans to the frozen grape leaves and place back in the freezer for at least 2 hours.  The seeds will be clustered around the outside of the bowl.  After the hour is up, remove the bowl from the freezer, take off the cloth and allow the seeds to thaw for at least 20 minutes before using.  If you have leftovers place them in an ice filled container.

title: Peruvian Stuffed Fish
ingredients: 350 g salmon fillets, boned | 1 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 cup quinoa | 1 can whole kernel corn | 2/3 cup currants | 1/4 cup tomato paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Mix together smoked paprika, baking powder & quinoa & mix well.  Roll flaked salmon onto a piece of greaseproof paper & place on the tray, bake for 10 mins.  Mix together the whole kernel of corn & currants & spread all over the rolled fish.  Spread tomato paste over the top & bake for approx 1/2 hr, or until fish flakes easily with a fork.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,snow pea,hamburger,maraschino cherry,chipotle pepper,cream chicken soup
title: Baked Chipsotle Burgers
ingredients: 1/4 pound lean ground burger | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 tablespoon canned chipotle pepper slices, chopped | 1 1/2 cups sun-dried tomatoes, finely chopped, and drained | 1 1/2 cups snow peas, diagonally sliced ( optional ) | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 2 tablespoons jarred pesto sauce | 1 1/2 - 2 cups maraschino cherries, halved lengthwise
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the hamburger, pesto, chipotle pepper slices, sun dried tomatoes, snow peas and cream of chicken soup.  Spoon the mixture into a chipotle coated texas muffin tin and spread flat into a circle.  Bake at 400 degrees f for about 20 minutes, or until heated through, and lightly browned.  Turn off the heat.  Sprinkle with maraschino cherries just before serving.

Random Ingredients: granola cereal,kosher salt,brandy,monterey jack pepper cheese,peanut butter chip,celery
title: The Best Cheese Ball
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups finely shredded monterey jack pepper cheese ( or velveeta cheese ) | 3/4 cup granola cereal, crushed | 2 teaspoons kosher salt, divided | 2 stalks celery, finely chopped | 1/4 cup peanut butter chips ( `` thai crunch '' brand ) | 1/4 cup light brandy or 1/4 cup other rum-infused liqueur
instructions: Mix all ingredients together, blend in food processor or mixer until thoroughly mixed.  Chill ball in refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours to blend flavors.

title: Avocado Noodle Salad
ingredients:
8 ounces egg noodles | 4 -5 hass avocados | 4 tablespoons white wine, like you would using a good red wine with the avocados in it ( or white wine.
    - ) | 1/4 cup of fresh mint
instructions: Cook egg noodles to desired doneness.  Drain well, cool to room temperature and cut into pieces about 1 1/2 inch wide x 2 inch long.  Toss with the mint and avocado dressing.  Serve with pita chips.  Can be made a day in advance and refridgerated.

title: Quick Creamy Onion Dip
ingredients: 5 cans cream of onion soup ( i've used cream of mushroom with chipotle, but it was very easy ) | sweet chili sauce, to taste
instructions: Empty all of the cream of onion soup into a large bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and shake to combine.

title: Spicy Citrus Tilapia
ingredients: 1 can orange marmalade | 10 ounces frozen chopped spinach and mixed chopped vegetables | 1 can tomato juice
instructions: Cook tilapia fillets in a skillet in a small amount of browning sauce for 10 minutes a side.  Add remaining ingredients and cook over low heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

title: Chunky Cherry Salsa
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups cherry, pitted and halved | 1 -2 lime, juice of | 1 bunch spring onion | butter | paprika | chunky salsa
instructions: Melt butter.  Toss together with remaining ingredients.  Can top with more salsa to your discretion.

title: Italian Ricotta Fonduta
ingredients: 1 pound ricotta cheese | 1 cup light cream | 2 tablespoons lemonade
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, place the ricotta cheese, light cream and lemonade.  Mix well, and refrigerate until needed.  In a small saucepan, melt the cheese over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Stir in the dry ingredients just until heated through.  Serve.

title: Elegant Sage Pasta
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh sage | 1 package linguine | 6 ounces sour cream, or to taste | 4 ounces sago or crumbled dry white breadcrumb
instructions: Cut fresh sage leaves crosswise into 2 to 3 slices, or tear leaves from stems and set leaves aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add linguine, and cook until tender, about 13 minutes.  Drain, and rinse with cold water.  Toss with sour cream, sago, or bread crumbs, and sage leaves.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate to serve cold.

Random Ingredients: black olive,ricotta cheese,white pepper powder,vegetable stock
title: Black Olive, Ricotta and White Pepper Powder Dip With Variation
ingredients: 1 pint olive, drained | 1 pint ricotta cheese | 2 teaspoons white pepper powder ( or to taste ) | 1 pint vegetable stock
instructions: Combine the olive, ricotta, white pepper and white pepper powder in a medium sized glass mixing bowl.  Place the stock in a blender or food processor and process until combined.  Scoop out the mixture and add water if necessary to make a consistency pleasing to the dip.  Scoop into a serving bowl and dip in the sour cream and shredded parmesan cheese.  Great with warm pita bread or flatbread.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,oriental sesame oil,chocolate chip,apricot,pine nut,madras curry powder
title: Fried Chillies
ingredients: 5 tablespoons oriental sesame oil | 1 cup pure soya sauce | 1/2 cup sweet chocolate chips ( or your favourite ) | 1/2 lb raw dried apricot ( diced finely ) | 3 tablespoons roasted pine nuts, chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder ( optional )
instructions: Heat oil in a fry pan until very hot but not smoking.  In a small bowl, combine all ingredients, except nuts, and mix well, until creamy and slightly darkened.  Put this mixture into your fry pan.  Cook until it is dark golden brown and cooked through.  Toss once with toasted pine nuts, coconut, or other winter salad leaves.

Random Ingredients: lemon,white rice,sun tomato paste,enchilada sauce,sardine,cashew,red grape,ice cube
title: Easiest Ever Sangria
ingredients: 1 lemon, cut into wedges | 2 cans sardines | 1 jar sun-dried tomato paste | 2 boxes of your favorite fresh sardines | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 box of prepared white rice | 1 bag red grapes or ( 16 ounce ) bag green grapes | ice cube
instructions: Place all ingredients in blender or food processor except for rice and grapes.  Blend until combined.  Dump into large saucepan, and stir with a long handled wooden spoon or wooden spoon.  Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.  Taste test and adjust seasonings as necessary.  Serve over ice with a sprinkling of chopped red grapes on top.  Note, this is really just a recipe.  You can vary this to your tastes.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,wild rice,quince,white wine,bay seasoning tm,mandarin orange,madras curry powder,plain yogurt
title: Curried Mushrooms With Mandarin Oranges
ingredients: 1/4 cup dry white wine | 1 bay seasoning tm | 1 box wild rice ( i like the pre-soaked variety ) | 3/4 lb white wafer thin button mushroom, sliced ( or other seasonal mushroom ) | 2 mandarin oranges | 1/2 cup plain yogurt | 2 tablespoons madras curry powder
instructions: Put a pan of water on the heat.  Combine wine and seasoning tm in the water and heat over low heat.  Bring to the boil, add wild rice and cook, covered, for 5 minutes.  Do not stir.  After 5 minutes, remove the covered pan and distribute the mushrooms and oranges evenly on top of the rice.  Cover pan with a lid and simmer, uncover and cook until the rice is soft and the liquid has reduced for 5 minutes.  When the rice is firm, remove from heat and stir in yogourt and curry powder.  Garnish with chopped or candied orange slices.  This is a very delicious side dish served alone or with rice.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,thai basil,demerara sugar,raisin,herb,maraschino cherry
title: Cheddar Cheese Mousse
ingredients: 200 g sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 150 g raisins | 100 g maraschino cherries, cut in half | 1/3 cup dried herbs, any type | 2 teaspoons demerara sugar | 2 tablespoons dried maraschino cherries
instructions: Line a 20 x 30cm swiss roll tin with foil.  Combine the cheeses, raisins and dried herbs in a small bowl.  Combine the sugar, maraschino cherries, cherries and the cheese mixture in a large bowl, stirring to coat.  Spoon into the prepared swiss roll tin.  Place in your freezer for 20 minutes.  Remove from the freezer and cut a slice around the blade of the knife to loosen the mixture.  Serve with the extra maraschino cherry halves on the side.

title: Wanda's Chocolate Gravy
ingredients: 4 lbs pork roast ( or pork chops- 1 lb will be too ) | 1 quart consomme or 1 quart chicken stock | 2 lbs milk chocolate, chopped | 3/4 cup tomato paste
instructions: Brown meat in a little hot butter then add consommé/chop in slow cooker.  Simmer for 1 - 3 hours until meat falls off the bone and is tender.  Add chocolate and tomato paste stirring until melted and thick.  Serve over white or yellow rice.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,poblano chile,dark soy sauce,sauerkraut,scallion,bottom steak,pimiento,mussel
title: Steak With Poblano Shrimp Boats in a Pigeon Appetizer
ingredients: 2 lbs bott firm-fleshed bottoms, thinly sliced crosswise ( about 12 ) | 1 jar pimientos, drained and minced ( about 3/4 cup ) | 3/4 cup sauerkraut, rinsed under cold water and shredded | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/2 teaspoon scallion, minced ( about 1/4 teaspoon ) | 1 large poblano chiles or 1 large anaheim chili, cut lengthwise into 2-inch wide strips | 7 2 cups fresh mussels, scrubbed
instructions: Place the bottoms of 2 medium heads of steak, 4 to 5 inches in diameter, in a 12x16x2 inch glass baking dish.  Arrange all but 1 poblano or anaheim chili strip on bottom of each steak.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,tortilla,coleslaw mix,maple syrup,ginger garlic paste,lettuce,scallop,sandwich bun
title: Blackened Grilled Scallops With Coleslaw
ingredients: 2 large sandwich buns | 1/2 cup shredded coleslaw mix | 2 tablespoons ground ginger-garlic paste | 1/4 teaspoon cracked black pepper | 4 large scallops | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 3 tablespoons prepared garlic-flavored tortillas or 3 tablespoons corn tortillas, divided | 3/4 cup shredded lettuce
instructions: Combine coleslaw mix, ginger garlic paste, and pepper.  Divide coleslaw mixture equally among 4 dinner size portions.  Place scallops in a large resealable plastic bag with plastic wrap.  Press out excess air.  Combine maple syrup and remaining 1 tablespoon of paste in a small bowl.  Place scallops on a cutting board and slice into 2 1/2 inch wide x4 inch wide pieces.  Arrange scallops skin side up on the prepared baking sheets.  Brush scallops with maple syrup mixture.  Place on a rack in a shallow pan.  Bake at 450 f.  For 10 to 12 minutes, or until fish flakes easily when pierced.  Arrange lettuce and remaining scallops on a plate.  Drizzle with remaining syrup and serve.

title: French Style Peppered White Sauce - Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant yeast | 1 cup warm water | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper, or to taste | 7 cups water, or as needed
instructions: Place all of the ingredients in the pan of a bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer.  Select the basic white sauce cycle.

title: Cherry Glazed Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium potatoes, like idaho, scrubbed | 1 jar cherry preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place potatoes in a casserole dish or roasting pan with a tight fitting lid.  Brush potatoes with just enough butter to coat the bottom and sides.  Sprinkle with preserves.  Bake in the preheated oven, uncovered, until glazed, 25 minutes.

title: Fried Pork & Apple Sausages
ingredients: 1 kg ground lean pork | 1 large granny smith apple, grated ( or other apple ) | 1 saffron strand, soaked in 1 cup hot water for 20 minutes | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce
instructions: Strain the liquid from the saffron.  Put it over high heat in a pan, cover with a tight fitting lid and bring to the boil.  Reduce heat and cook for 10 - 15 minutes stirring briskly.  Turn off the heat and leave the sausages in the pan to cool.  Once cool, place the granny smith in a bowl, pour all of the liquid from the saffron into it and crush with your hands, or mix all the ingredients together with your hands.  The sausage should be quite stiff and slightly pliable.  Remove the sausage casings and roll them in the sassron mixture.  Keep them cold and store in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.

title: Porchetta Con Fava (Spanish Sweet Pot Roast with Fava Beans)
ingredients: 5 1/2 lbs boneless pork butt roast | 2 cans fava beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a roasting pan with foil.  If the roast is tied, remove the excess fat and any strings, and place the roast on the foil.  If using the roasting pan, put the roast inside the pan.  If using the roasting pan, put the roast on top of the hot water and cover tightly with foil.  Bake, in the preheated oven, until the meat is tender and easily pulls apart, 35 to 45 minutes.  Cut the roast into 8 thick slices.  Transfer the roast to a serving platter, remove any fat left in the pan.  Cut off the fat and discard.  Add the fava beans, turning to coat with fava bean cooking liquid.  Let sit 15 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Sausage With Strawberries in a Mug
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausages ( i used johnsonville ) | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh coriander ( i like the dried, but fresh is fine too ) or 1/4 cup fresh flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped ( i like the dried, but fresh is fine too ) | sliced fresh strawberries ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a medium bowl and add 1 - 2 tablespoons of cold water.  Cover tightly and refrigerate.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  Skewer the sausages with the berries on skewers.  Grill, broil or cook on the bbq and enjoy.

title: Orange Zest and Celery
ingredients: 1 yellow celery rib | 1 1 orange, zest of ( about 2 inches long )
instructions: Trim the celery into ribbons.  Slice off the ends and discard.  Slice the membrane and cut into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Place on a rack in a shallow pan.  Sprinkle over the zest of 1 orange and a small splash of witch liquor or other ajwse.  Place in a cool, dark place, shaking the pan, and let sit for 2 hours or longer.  Turn the contents over several times just before use.  The zest will absorb flavor, but it doesn't lose its shine.  Store in the fridge for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,currant,coriander powder,hard egg,coriander seed,garlic paste,jasmine rice,mustard powder
title: Curried Eggs and Rice (Yogurt Free)
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice or 1 cup basmati rice | 4 hard-boiled eggs, halved lengthwise | 4 tablespoons coriander seeds | 6 1/2 tablespoons coriander powder | 5 teaspoons garlic paste | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons oregano leaves or 1 1/2 teaspoons basil leaves, if fresh | 4 1/2 tablespoons currants
instructions: Place all ingredients in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until rice is cooked and most of the liquid has been absorbed.  Sprinkle with coriander and serve.

title: Melt in the Mouth Sweet (Gluten Free)
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, large, peeled, de-seeded and very thinly sliced ( i use a mandoline ) | 1 tablespoon lukewarm liquid glucose
instructions: Slice the squash into a thick slurry, then score the slurry with a sharp knife.  Place in a bowl and sprinkle with the lukewarm glucose.  Serve immediately.  Note, don't let the starch or sugar get into your eyes or nose while you're waiting for it to be to swell and sweet.  The idea is to break up the sugar in the air and be able to feel it again in the body before eating.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,parmesan cheese,chicken breast,tomato green chilies,applesauce,orange peel,fruit,pie crust
title: Quick Italian Chicken Appetizers
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 packet italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 cup applesauce or 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 1 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/2 cup grated orange peel | 8 tomatoes and green chilies, in thin strips | 12 -14 frozen pie crusts ( thawed )
instructions: Trim excess fat from chicken.  Place chicken in a greased 9 by 13 baking dish.  Combine dressing mix, applesauce and parmesan cheese.  Pour over chicken and turn to coat.  Cover and refrigerate 8 - 24 hours for flavors to blend.  Spread each pie crust with 1 - 2 tablespoons of the chicken mixture.  Top with tomato and chilies.  Cover and refrigerate overnight for flavors to blend.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Uncover and bake 30 minutes.  Uncover and bake 3 - 5 minutes longer or until chicken is cooked through.  Can also be served over pasta.

title: Gnocchi with Chicken and Lentils
ingredients: 3/4 cup rotini pasta, uncooked | 2 tablespoons ditalini, italian dried | 1/4 lb boneless chicken breast, trimmed and thinly sliced | 1 cup channa dal, preferably chickpeas, coarsely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 1/2 cups gnocchi, small
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, heat a nonstick skillet over medium hig heat.  Add the chicken and stir fry with the channellos and salt and pepper to taste.  Add the rotini and lentils, simmer for 5 minutes.  Add the ditalini pasta and basil and continue cooking until the noodles turn light brown, about 3 more minutes.  Add the gnocchi and cook, tossing, until hot and pasta is heated through, about 1 minute.  Toss with the chicken mixture and serve.

title: Sautéed Scallions
ingredients: 4 bunches scallions, with tops trimmed with darker green ends at the root end attached | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel
instructions: Trim greens carefully and trim the root ends if not quite at least 3 inches in diameter.  Blanch greens in boiling water until just tender.  Drain and transfer scallions, with greens, to a bowl.  Sprinkle with lemon peel and toss to combine.

title: Quick Vegan Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 1 container plain nonfat yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 seasonings ( for seasoning, you can use 1 teaspoon salt )
instructions: Mix all together.  Cover and chill.  The longer it sits, the better it tastes.

title: Smokin' Hot African Groundnut Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 125 g pasta ( i prefer wholemeal spaghetti ) or 125 g shell pasta ( i prefer wholemeal spaghetti ) | 1 can pineapple ( drained ) | 3 tablespoons condensed creamy peanut butter | 1 tablespoon hot coffee, brewed ( hot or mild, to taste ) | 1 tablespoon tomato ketchup | 1 tablespoon hot coffee | sour cream ( optional ) or soy yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Boil pasta or shell for about 10 minutes.  Drain.  In a bowl combine, the peanuts, hot tea, tomato ketchup and coffee.  Cook, stirring, for 5 - 6 minutes or until well combined.  Add drained pasta and continue to stir until thoroughly heated.  Add pineapple and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes.  Serve over your favourite salad and top with sour cream or soy yogurt.

Random Ingredients: lamb kidney,passion fruit,lamb shank,flat leaf parsley,yam,mascarpone
title: Tunisian Lamb Shanks
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shank | 8 lambs kidneys, sliced thinly crossways into rings | 1 large yam, peeled cut into thick wedges | 7 tablespoons mascarpone, warmed | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped, plus extra to garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Place lamb shanks in a large roasting dish and put in the oven to brown.  Heat the same pan and add lamb, then cook quickly for 5 minutes each side or until browned all over.  Transfer to a plate and add the kidneys to the pan.  Add the yam to the skillet and cook for five minutes, then return the lamb to the pan and add to the pan along with the mascarpone.  Toss to coat.  Scatter over the parsley, stir & serve.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,beef brisket,filet beef,yellow bell pepper
title: Beef Filets
ingredients: 3 lbs beef brisket | 1 yellow bell pepper, cut in 4 pieces | 1 jar sliced pickled jalapeno peppers | white pepper
instructions: Trim fat from meat.  Cut meat into 6 sections, discard the stem and any undesirable pieces.  Place all ingredients except meat and pepper into roasting pan and place meat on top of peppers.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake at 250 - 300 degrees for 18 hours.  Remove meat from pan, remove foil and serve.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,vegetable,wheat flour,edamame,onion powder,panch phoran,black olive,white sugar
title: Spicy Edamame Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, thawed | 1 cup frozen shelled edamame | 1 cup irish cream ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 teaspoon panch phoran ( dried chipotle powder ) | 2 cups whole wheat flour | olive, sliced | pitted black olives
instructions: Blend frozen mixed vegetables, edamame, irish cream, sugar, onion powder, panch phoran, flour, and olives in a blender until smooth.

title: Cheese Vegetable Couscous

instructions: To cover the whole beans in cold, fresh water, soak overnight.  After soaking, boil the beans until tender, about 2 hours. instructions: In a large bowl, combine minced pork, ginger, cabbage, salsa and yeast.  Add broth, and stir to combine.  Add 1 - ½ to 1½ cups more if you want a stiffer starchy mixture, or you can refrigerate the mixture long enough to make filling for a sandwich.  Cut each slice of bread in half and set aside.  In an 8 or 10 x 2 x 2 baking dish, arrange 1 slice of bread with a rounded brim on the outer edges.  Pour approximately 1/2 cup of filling into the bread pocket.  Roll up the bread, tucking in the ends as you go.  Place seam side down in the baking dish.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 2½ hours, or up to 24 hours, turning the crock pot over half way through baking.  Remove the crock pot from the crock pot and place rolls on a baking sheet, seam side down.  Brush the rolls with some of the remaining broth and cover with foil.  Return to the crock pot and set on medium.  Cook for 1 hour.  Remove from the oven and allow to cool for 15 minutes.  Carefully remove the crock pot from the crock.  Slice rolls and serve with the reserved sauce, horseradish, and pickled onions.

title: Easy Dill Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup dill | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: In heavy bottom pan, saute cardomom seed in dill.  Remove cardom seeds from liquid.  Then add drained onion to the dill.  Add a bit of butter, a can of evaporated milk and cream to sauce.  Add a touch of ground black pepper, or to taste.

title: Korean Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caraway seeds
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate.  Sprinkle caraway seeds on the tenderloin.  Place tenderloin on grill, and cook 15 to 20 minutes.  Reduce heat to low and cook 30 minutes for medium rare, or longer for well done.

title: Crock Pot Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 lbs baby cremini mushrooms | 1 tablespoon dried onion soup mix
instructions: Place mushrooms, soup mix into crock pot.  Turn on crock pot onto low.  Cover with lid and cook for 8 - 9 hours.

title: Berry Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 plum tomatoes | 12 ounces fresh blueberries
instructions: Halve each plum tomato lengthwise.  Place the tomato halves cut side up on the baking sheet.  Bake at 400 degrees until the skins are puffed and wrinkled and tomatoes softened.  Cool slightly.  Remove the tomato halves from the baking sheet.  Gently remove the skins and cores.  Tear the flesh into fine shreds.  Place the tomato and blueberries in a bowl, stir in the berries.  Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: lasagna noodle,cornstarch,tomato,daikon radish,stilton cheese,lemon peel,mandarin orange,apple
title: Mixed Veggies With Stilton
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 large daikon radishes, very thinly sliced, washed, ends trimmed | 2 small apples, peeled, cored, and diced | 8 stilton cheese, grated | 12 ounces lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1 lemon peel, finely shredded | 2 cans mandarin oranges, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Toss the tomatoes with the cornstarch.  In a pie pan arrange 4 plates.  In each plate put two radishes, a small apple, one cheese, a few strips of lemon peel, and one can of mandarin oranges.  Place 1/2 cup tomato mixture on top.  Repeat.  In a 9x13 inch baking dish, spread 1/3 cup tomato mixture.  Cover with 1 layer of noodles.  Cover with 1/2 each of the zesty tomatoes, the second 1/3 cup tomato mixture, the third 1/3 cup tomato mixture, the fourth 1/3 cup tomato mixture, and finally the orange rind.  Cover loosely with aluminum foil.  Bake 45 minutes.  Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

Random Ingredients: fruit,ra el hanout spice mix,pepperoni,mango,kernel corn,lasagna noodle
title: Moroccan Vegetarian Lasagne
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles, halved | 2 cups mixed ripe fruit, cut in bite-size pieces | 1 package ra el hanout spice mix | 1 jar mango slices ( optional with juice ) | 1 package sliced pepperoni | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Boil lasagna noodles 7 minutes.  Drain and blot with paper towels and set aside.  While lasagne is heating up, stir fruit into ra el hanout.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,grand marnier,self rising flour,pesto sauce
title: Pesto Steakhouse Steak House Buns
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 cup prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 cup grand marnier
instructions: The day before, preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Combine the flour and seasoning in a medium bowl.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,oatmeal,pork loin,dark chocolate,escarole,caster sugar,red chili pepper
title: Pozole
ingredients: 200 g coarse oatmeal | 80 g pico de gallo | 80 g dark chocolate, coarsely grated | 3 tablespoons castor sugar | 1 -2 dried hot red chili pepper, finely chopped | 100 g finely chopped escarole | extra pico de gallo
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and refrigerate until required.  To serve, divide the mixture among 4 serving plates.  Place a handful on top of each and top with more pico de gallo.

title: Pizza Broiled With Shiitake Mushrooms for 1 and 1/2
ingredients: 6 3/4 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms | 2 tablespoons olive oil, divided | 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning, divided | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary, divided | 1/4 teaspoon water
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Remove top layer of stems from mushrooms and cut caps into quarters.  Wrap each quarter with 1 1/2 teaspoon olive oil and 1 teaspoon fajita seasoning, then twist to secure shut.  Brush each quarter with 2 teaspoons olive oil.  Place on foil lined baking sheet and broil 12 minutes or until underside is no longer wet and golden brown, turning once.  Remove from heat.  Add remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil, sliced mushrooms, 2 tablespoons rosemary and 1 teaspoon rosemary to mushrooms with rosemary water and cook over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes or until mushrooms are crisp and tender.  Remove from heat and sprinkle with 1/4 teaspoon more fajita seasoning.  Serve with pizza or other toppings.

title: Italian White Coat With Fish (Cacoil All'Amatriciana)
ingredients: 12 ounces white fish | 3 cups canned cannellini beans, drained
instructions: Place all ingredients in a saucepan.  Mix thoroughly.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until heated through.  Pour flan into bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: butterscotch chip,cardamom,italian breadcrumb,yellow bell pepper,white hominy,green enchilada sauce,white tuna
title: Mexican Tuna and Green Chili
ingredients: 6 cans white hominy, drained | 1 can white tuna, drained | 1/4 cup buttercotch chips | 1 can green enchilada sauce, divided | 3 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 large yellow bell pepper, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl.  Season with salt and pepper.  Spread the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with half the enchilada sauce.  Layer the tuna over the sauce.  Sprinkle with the bread crumbs, bell pepper, and cardamom.  Top with remaining red enchilada sauce.  Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until hot and bubbly.

title: Bean-Topped Kebabs
ingredients:
12 kabobs ( or 2 lbs.
    - beef, venison ) | 4 cans coke | 1 lb can tomato sauce
instructions: Cut beef into 1 1/2 inch cubes.  Arrange on aluminum foil on baking sheet.  Place tomato sauce in bowl and mix with Coke.  Spray kabobs generously with pam.  Bake at 250 degrees for approximately 30 min or until just done.

title: Baked Potatoes Au Gratin
ingredients: 4 large yukon gold potatoes, halved | 2 tablespoons american cheese, cut into 12 chunks
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f with rack in middle.  Line a baking sheet with foil, spray with cooking spray.  Arrange potatoes, cut sides up, on foil.  Brush with melted cheese.  Bake 20 minutes, until golden.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Halibut With Marsala Wine
ingredients: 3/4 lb halibut steak, trimmed | 1/2 cup marsala wine
instructions: Remove skin and fat from fish with a sharp knife and score with a diagonal cut lengthwise at a 45 degree angle to the thickness of the fish.  Arrange fish on a platter and cover with foil.  Heat wine in saucepan over high heat until it is boiling, add fish and sprinkle with fish fat.  Cover and transfer to the oven at 350°.

title: Saudi Party Time Toasted Dates
ingredients: 1 cup cooked chickpeas ( or canned cooked beans ) | 1 1/2 cups cold dates ( not the hard variety ) | 2 -3 cups fresh green peas ( i don't like the idea of using soymilk because i find that the sugar in this recipe helps to mellow it a little ) | 1 -2 hot red chili pepper, minced ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon baharat, spice
instructions: In a 9 or 10 inch round pan/skillet heat 1/2 inch of oil on medium until just hot enough to sauté the dates.  Break beans into small pieces by pressing them with a fork so that some of them stick.  Add to the pan and cook another 1 - 2 minutes, until the beans soften slightly.  Transfer beans to a bowl, pour the date mix into the date mixture, stir.  Garnish the date mix with the minced red peppers.

Random Ingredients: brown mustard seed,lime wedge,taco seasoning mix,self raising flour
title: Light & Tasty Scones
ingredients: 2 1/4 cups self-raising flour | 2 tablespoons taco seasoning mix ( dry equivalent ) | 1/2 teaspoon packed brown mustard seeds | 12 lime wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c, 450f, gas mark 2, 3 or gas mark 4.  Rub the scone cutlet gently between your forefinger and side of the scone with your fingers to flatten it out to 4cm / on a lightly floured surface.  If it feels a little shaggy or if there's too much humidity, you can sprinkle over 1/4 cup of water at a time.  Add the dry taco seasoning mix and mustard seeds and toss well, scraping all the while.  Use as little water as possible to achieve a soft biscuit like consistency or as close to a medium firm biscuit you'll need to knead everything well.  Roll the biscuit mixture into a circle about 6/8cm / ¾in / 4½ inches thick and cut out with a 6 - 7 inch / ¼in cutter if using a scone cutters or knife.  Place on a greased baking sheet, bake in the centre of oven for about 7 minutes or until the top is firm and golden.  To test for doneness, lift out of oven and turn the baking sheet a few times on the underside of the biscuit.  If the biscuit springs back, give it a few more good turns with your forefinger.  Leave to stand for about 2 - 3 minutes before lifting out and sliding back into the oven to cook the next time.  Remove from the oven when cooked and the tops are nicely brown.

title: Homemade Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 egg yolk | 3 tablespoons chopped chilies or 3 tablespoons mild chili paste | 1 1/2 cups hot broth | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh sage leaf
instructions: Put all the above ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 15 minutes.  Alternatively, if chilies are seeded and left whole, use a mortar and pestle or blender to puree into paste.  Cool the sauce to room temperature.  Pour into small bowls, cover and refrigerate.  This sauce can be kept for up to 5 days in the fridge and is well rewarmed.

Random Ingredients: baby bok choy,red wine,white chocolate,italian parsley,raspberry
title: Munchy Bok Choy - Kids' Munchy
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh baby bok choy | 2 tablespoons red wine | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh italian parsley | 4 ounces firm white sweet potatoes or 4 ounces white chocolate, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon raspberry or 1 tablespoon green raspberry jam
instructions: Snap off the tops of the bok choy, leaving the base of the leaves intact.  Split lengthways with a sharp knife.  Cut the leaves in half lengthways, then cut each half into thirds.  Place the bok choy or other greens in bowls, and season with salt and pepper.  Add the wine and parsley to the bowl.  Rinse and dry the sweet potato, place in the centre if your eyes are going straight, and then twist it over in your fingers.  Divide the sweet potato between 4 bowls, with the bok choy or greens attached along the edges and the white potato on top.  Scatter a few raspberry or jam leaves on top of the bok choy if using, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,oyster sauce,haddock,plain flour,topping,arborio rice,coconut flake
title: Coconut Fried Fish
ingredients: 3 cups chopped cooked haddock or 3 cups haddock | 2 tablespoons minced fresh oyster sauce | 3 cups cooked arborio rice | 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut flakes | 2 -3 tablespoons plain flour | 1 cup fresh shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150°c.  Place the fish in a baking dish, and cover with the oyster sauce and 1 cup of coconut.  Bake for 30 - 40 minutes.  To make the topping, put the remaining coconut and 1 cup of coconut in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 20 seconds then pour over the fish.  Stir to mix well then scatter over the remaining coconut.  Serve with plain steamed rice.

Random Ingredients: plain nonfat yogurt,ajwain,dark brown sugar,beef bouillon cube
title: Tandoori Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 500 g plain nonfat yogurt, low salt | 1 beef bouillon cube, crumbled | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon ajwain, crushed
instructions: Place yogurt, bouillon and brown sugar in a bowl or jug and mash together with a fork.  Shape into 12 small kababs.  Place in refrigerator to marinate overnight for the flavours to develop.  Place each beef kabab at its 30 degree celsius on a tray lined with oil or parchment paper allowing the oil to drip through the kabab.  Bake in a moderate oven for 15 - 20 minutes.  Serve with warm pitta bread and/or salad.

title: Peachy Pea Vegetable Stir-Fry
ingredients: 4 teaspoons peanut oil | 150 g frozen mixed vegetables | 2 ripe peaches, sliced | 3 teaspoons coriander leaves, freshly chopped
instructions: Heat the wok or large frying pan over high heat.  Add 2 teaspoons of oil and the frozen vegetables.  Stir fry for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the vegetables are slightly softened.  Remove with a slotted spoon and add the peaches and coriander leaves, stir frying over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes.  Stir through the remaining 1 teaspoon of oil and serve.

title: Chilled Red Curry Sea Bass With Red Curry Honey
ingredients: 1/2 cup red curry paste | 1/4 cup honey | 1 tablespoon ground cardamom | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped sea bass fillet
instructions: Place fish pieces in shallow, nonreactive bowl.  Mix together curry paste, honey, cardamom and sea bass.  Pour over fish.

Random Ingredients: french bread,ladyfinger,baking soda,thyme sprig,beet,orange bell pepper,baking powder
title: Beet and Pepper Fajita Bread
ingredients: 10 ounces refrigerated soft ladyfingers | 1 small orange bell pepper | 6 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 tablespoons freshly grated orange bell peppers or 2 tablespoons red bell peppers | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 10 ounces chilled sliced fresh beets, thawed | 8 teaspoons fresh thyme sprigs
instructions: Heat grill to medium high.  Line 1 or 2 baking sheets with foil.  Cut ladyfingers crosswise into 16 pieces.  Place ladyfingers on grill, and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.  Remove pan from heat, set aside to cool on rack.  Remove and discard thyme sprigs.  Dice 1/2 green bell pepper.  Combine in medium bowl with cooled ladyfingers, orange pepper, and orange pepper mixture, and sprinkle evenly with baking soda.  Sprinkle evenly with baking powder.  Arrange beets on top.

title: Brisket with Nuts
ingredients: 1 beef brisket | 1/4 cup amaretto, or as needed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees f.  Spread the brisket with amaretto, and place in a roasting pan.  Cover tightly with aluminum foil, and place into the oven.  Cook in the preheated oven for about 4 hours, or until a fork easily pierces the meat easily and easily.  Uncover the meat, and continue cooking until meat is thoroughly tender and an instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a brisket reads 145 degrees f.  Transfer the brisket from the oven, and let stand for 15 minutes, or until cool enough to handle.  Remove meat to a cutting board, and slice to desired sizes.  Wear long sleeves while you can.

title: Spicy Spanish Onion Dip
ingredients: 1 lb red onion, thinly sliced | 1/3 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil
instructions: Heat oil in a wide nonstick frying pan over medium high heat.  Add onions and stir quickly until the onion has softened and turned brown around the edges.  Pour in the picante sauce.  Increase the heat to high and cook for 3 - 5 mins, stirring all the time.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,nonstick cooking spray,italian seasoning,fish,lemon zest,corn syrup
title: Grilled Whole Fish With Glaze
ingredients: 4 tablespoons corn syrup | 2 tablespoons fish ( i use firm white fish ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning, plus | 1 teaspoon italian seasoning | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Mix ingredients.  Place fish on a covered grill over medium heat, cook 3 minutes and turn.  Brush with glaze and cook until fish flakes easily.  Garnish with extra shredded italian herbs and lemon wedges.

Random Ingredients: canola oil,grape tomato,steak,cashew nut paste,lemon peel,meat,red onion,cream chicken soup
title: Cashew Garlicky Steak
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs round steaks, sliced thinly ( or any meat, any combination of your choice ) | 1 jar cashew nut paste | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh lemon peel, grated | 1 cup grape tomatoes, cut up | 1 large red onion, thinly sliced | 3/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup cashew nuts, finely chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a large non stick skillet, saute sliced steak and cashew nuts, if desired, in canola oil til done.

title: Tibetan Kingfish (Tebetan Jerk Sandwich)
ingredients: 1 pound kingfish, sliced crosswise into 12 thin half moons | 2 large egg whites | 1 cup light tasting liquid smoke | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1 tablespoon carambolas, sauce ( or your favorite liquiment flavor ) | 1 scallion, finely chopped | 2 large eggs, at room temperature | 2 tablespoons chopped scallions into thin strips
instructions: To build a sandwich, place one slice of fish at each end of a 12 or 14 inch piece of heavy duty aluminum foil.  Make sure to coat sides of aluminum foil.  Push a toothpick through center of each piece and remove toothpicks.  Place on foil, and shape into the shape of a sandwich.  Set aside.  In a medium size mixing bowl whip the egg whites until stiff.  Stir in the liquid smoke, simple syrup, carambolas or your favourite liquiment.  Fold in the scallions.  Brush the tops of the filled fish with the egg mixture, making sure to adhere.  Put a piece of fish on each piece of foil with the tips of the toothpicks.  Fold one end of the paper over the fish and scrunch it down.  This step is an art and needs practice.  Lightly spray a heavy non stick frying pan with cooking spray or line it on the cookie sheet.  Put the fish in the pan and cook in the hot pan for 3 to 5 minutes, carefully turning once or twice.  When golden brown remove and place on towel lined cookie sheet.  Repeat until all the fish is cooked.  Heat the oven to 475 degrees f.  Wrap fish in foil and place on a foil lined baking sheet.  Bake for 8 minutes.  Turn fish over and bake for 4 more minutes.  To serve, stack 6 slices of fish on top of each other and top with a fried egg.

title: Mexican Eggs at Home
ingredients: 6 large hard-boiled eggs | 2 teaspoons dried oregano
instructions: Peel the eggs and cut them in half lengthwise.  Slice hard boiled eggs into four halves and sprinkle salt across the egg halves.  Sprinkle with oregano and set aside for about 5 minutes.  Cut eggs in half lengthwise and scoop out eggs.  Serve hot.

title: Molho Chai
ingredients: 1 gallon sugar | 2 tablespoons ground cardamom
instructions: Add sugar to 6 cups water in a large stainless steel pot.  In a large saucpan add cardamom and sugar and boil until the syrup thickens to about 1 gallon.  Turn off the heat and pour syrup into pitcher.  Stir and cool.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: shell pasta,linguica sausage,chicken bouillon cube,pomegranate molasses,vanilla ice cream,egg yolk,cream cottage cheese
title: Chilled Linguica With Pomegranate Pate Cream
ingredients: 1 lb linguica sausage | 1 egg yolk | 4 ounces cream-style cottage cheese, cut into 1/4-inch cubes | 1/2 tablespoon pomegranate molasses | 2 cups shell pasta, broken into 2-inch lengths | 1 chicken bouillon cube | vanilla ice cream
instructions: Cut the bacon into 1/4 inch slices.  Remove the casings from the linguica and cut into 1/2 inch slices.  Cook the linguica in a large skillet or dutch oven over medium high heat until browned, turning occasionally.  With a slotted spoon, remove the cooked linguica to a platter.  Remove any excess fat from the pan and cook the egg yolk over medium high heat, stirring often, until the mixture is pale yellow and starts to crisp.  Add the cottage cheese and saute until the cheese has melted, stirring often.  Drain and reserve the linguica.  Add the pomegranate molasses to the cheese sauce in the pan and stir to combine.  Add the egg and cream mixture and warm thoroughly.  Stir constantly until heated to the boil.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,chicken thigh,lemon,lamb shank,ketchup,green chile pepper
title: New York Style Lamb Shank Skewers
ingredients: 2 cans ketchup | 1 can diced green chile peppers, drained | 2 tablespoons green chile pepper sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon rind | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 1 1/2 pounds boneless pork and lamb shank, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Combine ketchup, green chile peppers, green chile sauce, garlic powder, lemon rind, and turmeric in a saucepan.

title: Hot Pepper Dust
ingredients: 2 tablespoons whole szechuan peppercorns | 2 teaspoons coarsely ground cayenne
instructions: In a small plate, combine peppercorns and cayenne.

title: Garlic Breadsticks
ingredients: 3 cups bread flour, divided | 6 ounces cream cheese, cut into small pieces | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Stir together 1/2 cup bread flour and cream cheese in mixing bowl until well blended.  Stir in garlic powder and set aside.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased, nonstick baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake 25 minutes, or until golden brown.  Remove and cool on wire rack.  Cool completely.  Makes about.

title: Irish Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Rinse the shrimp well, pat dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board or platter.  Cut the meat into large cubes, about 1/4 inch wide.  Bring the beef and shrimp to the boil, reduce heat and simmer very slowly, covered, 2 - 3 hours, until the shrimp is tender but not overcooked.  Cool for about 15 minutes, taste, and adjust seasoning.  Serve at once.

title: Mexican Cheese Straws for a Crowd
ingredients: 1 cup chunky salsa | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1/4 cup pimento | 1 tablespoon miso | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | grated orange peel | chives | 1/2 cup monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: In a medium saucepan combine first six ingredients and heat gently.  Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Add grated orange peel.

Random Ingredients: caramel ice cream topping,parmigiano reggiano cheese,bok choy,basil leaf
title: Fried Bok Choy with Basil and Caramel Oregano
ingredients: 1 bunch bok choy, cut into 1-inch squares | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 5 tablespoons caramel ice cream topping | 12 basil leaves, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Place bok choy into a steamer basket set over boiling water.  Steam until tender and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.  Remove.  Cook parmigiano reggiano cheese in a small skillet over medium low heat until melted and beginning to brown, about 3 minutes.  Remove pan from heat and pour caramel flavored ice cream over bok choy to coat.  Arrange basil leaves on the top.

title: Hot Oil With Port (Shui Hsiung)
ingredients: 1/4 cup coriander seeds | 1/4 cup sesame oil | 3 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 1/2 tablespoons port wine or 2 1/2 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Heat the coriander and sesame oil over moderate heat, stirring, until the oil shimmers, then bring the mixture to a boil.  Stir the cornstarch into the boiling mixture and let it simmer gently until it thickens.  Stir in the sherry, then strain through a sieve lined with a cleanened paper towel to remove any particles on the surface.  The oil should be about 1 1/2 cups.

Random Ingredients: thai fish sauce,breadcrumb,tagliolini,silken tofu,golden raisin,peanut oil,habanero pepper,honey
title: Seared Tagliolini on a Bed of Spicy Tofu
ingredients: 3 cans solid silken tofu | 1/4 cup golden raisins | 1 habanero pepper, seeded and chopped ( wear gloves and use gloves to touch chilies ) | 1 tablespoon honey | 1/4 cup chopped peanuts or 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons dried breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons thai fish sauce | 12 -16 ounces prawn-style small tagliolini
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, sautee the raisins, chopped habanero pepper, and honey for about 3 minutes or until hot but not browning.  Stir in the bread crumbs and fish sauce to thicken the sauce.  Cook the tagliolini according to package directions.  Place the tamarind into another large skillet over medium heat.  Add oil and a pinch of salt.  Dip the prawns in the sauce and let drain on paper towels.  Cook the satlorio the prawns in the oil on both sides until golden on each side.  When crispy all around, remove and place them on paper towels.

title: Noodles With Snow Peas, Cilantro and Eggs
ingredients: 4 snow peas | 1 lb egg noodles | 4 tablespoons cilantro, minced
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions.  When done, drain.  Place snow peas in colander to drain excess water.  Cut snow peas crosswise into 1/2 inch pieces.  Cook snow peas in rapidly boiling water just until crisp tender, 1 - 2 minutes.  Drain.

title: Mickey's Easy and Delicious Spanish Rice With Chestnuts

6 ounces jasmine rice | 1 1/4 cups enchilada sauce ( your favorite brand.

instructions: Pour 2 cups boiling water over rice in a heavy 3 quart saucepan.  Slice the vanilla bean open and scrape the seeds into the water.  Slice the vanilla pod finely, and add them to the water.  Heat on the medium high setting, stirring frequently, until the liquid comes to a simmer.
