To serve, arrange the steaming rice in 2 large serving plates, or make your own.  Top with chestnuts and serve.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,cannellini bean,tabasco sauce,lime,green coriander,chicken drumstick,tortilla chip,pearl barley
title: Quick & Easy Vegetarian Mexican Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained & rinsed | 2 tablespoons pearl barley | 1 cup orange juice | 3/4 cup chopped green coriander | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | 3 packages chicken drumsticks ( or 2-3 breasts ) | 1 lime, juice of | 1 handful tortilla chips ( or more chips to make garnish )
instructions: Drain beans through a sieve, then return bean liquid, barley, juices, coriander & tabasco sauce to saucepan.  Heat to boiling over medium heat.  Reduce heat & simmer for 10 minutes.  Discard coriander.  Cover & simmer for 15 minutes, uncovered or until barley is tender, stirring occasionally.  While barley is cooking, prepare chicken.  Cut chicken into bite sized pieces.  Sauté chicken in a non stick skillet until lightly golden, about 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: garam masala,beef stock chicken,tempeh,red curry paste,couscous
title: Red Curry Beef and Couscous
ingredients: 600 g thinly sliced tempeh | 200 ml thai red curry paste ( to taste ) | 600 ml beef stock or 600 ml chicken stock | 1 tablespoon garam masala or 1 tablespoon curry powder | 350 g couscous ( to serve )
instructions: Place the tempeh in a shallow, non metallic, ovenproof dish.  Combine curry paste ingredients in a small heatproof jug, and pour over tempeh.  Stir well to coat.  Cover with tin foil or a lid slightly smaller than the dish and bake in a moderately hot oven for 40 minutes, or until just cooked.  Meanwhile, prepare couscous,.  When the tempeh is ready, drain and place on a hot plate.  Rinse it under warm water and drain thoroughly.  To serve, pour couscous onto a warm serving platter, top with tempeh and curry, and serve with a sprinkling of garam masala or curry powder.

title: Strawberry and Mustard Seed Cookies
ingredients: 750 g strawberries, hulled and quartered | 300 g cake flour, sifted | 1/2 bunch italian parsley, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 1 gill pickle, finely crumbled
instructions: Put the strawberries, flour and parsley into a bowl.  Add the mustard seeds and gill pickle and mix well.  Make into a dough.  Cover with a kitchen cloth and leave in a cool place for at least 1 hour, or until dough is of spreading consistency.  Preheat the oven to 190c/375°f line a baking tray with non stick baking paper.  Roll dough out on a lightly floured surface into a rectangular shape.  Use a drinking glass dipped in flour, dipped in flour, to keep the paper even.  Cut the dough into strips about 5 x 2 cm wide.  Place on the lined tray and lightly press the edges with the back of a spoon.  Bake on a trays for 12 - 15 minutes.  When biscuits are firm and pale golden, remove from the oven and dip them in melted lemon oil, and leave on a wire rack.  Leave to cool.  Store in an airtight container between dry ingredients.  Variations, to reduce the amount of strawberries in this, instead of pistachios, use pistachios.  Variations, use fresh strawberries, washed thoroughly and halved lengthways.  Use 2 greek seasoning.  Variations, add 1/2 tablespoon cumin seed, a pinch of dried oregano and a pinch of caraway seeds or aniseed seeds.

title: Kumara-Kumara
ingredients: 500 g kumara - peeled, coarsely grated & divided | 4 spring onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons whole wheat flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees c.  Mix kumara, spring onions, flour and 2 tablespoons water in a bowl.  Bake for 1 hour until crusty and well risen.

Random Ingredients: baby corn,chuck steak,rye bread,pearl sugar,udon noodle,polenta,salmon fillet,coconut
title: Polenta Beef Roll Ups
ingredients: 5 ounces polenta | 1 teaspoon dried sweet potato flakes or 1 teaspoon banana powder | 1 tablespoon pearl sugar | 1 boneless chuck steak or 1 skirt steak, halved horizontally, and cut in half horizontally | 10 slices rye bread ( about 1 1/4 inch thick ) | 1 tablespoon shredded canned unsweetened coconut | 8 ounces salmon fillets, sliced | 1 cup baby corn or 3/4 cup frozen baby corn, thawed to room temperature
instructions: In a bowl, toss the polenta, sweet potato/banana powder, and pearl sugar.  Add the steak and turn to coat.  Spread the bread slices on 2 metal sheets and place in the freezer for 30 minutes until they're firm to the touch but not hard.  Using 1 slice of the bread, roll up the bread to make a long roll, starting with the short side.  Roll the chilled steak in the plastic wrap directly on the bread.  Wrap each roll in another slice of rye and in a second slice of bread, creating rollups.  Repeat with the remaining bread and rolls.  Grill the rolls 3 - 5 minutes, until cooked through.  Drizzle with coconut and arrange the salmon and corn on top.  Eat warm with green salad, horseradish, and pickles.

title: The Easiest Pizza Ever
ingredients: 3 ounces sliced turkey breast | 3 ounces baby bella mushrooms | 3 ounces cream cheese | fresh cracked pepperoni
instructions: Place ingredients in your pizza crust on a cookie sheet and bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes or until hot.

ingredients:
1 1/4 cups cubed monterey jack cheese ( about 16 oz.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.

title: Italian Baked Mushrooms
ingredients: 20 large white mushrooms, whole unhusked, such as oyster, shiitake, portobello, or other mushroom | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Remove the tough cap from the mushrooms and discard.  Place a mushroom cap on your cutting board and using a sharp knife, cut 1 to 2 slits in the base of each mushroom.  Repeat with each mushroom until all mushrooms are sliced.  Place the mushroom caps into a greased 9x13 inch square baking dish.  Mix the ricotta cheese with a fork or fork in a small bowl until well blended.  Spread the ricotta mixture evenly over the mushrooms.  Bake, uncovered, at 375 degrees f for 30 to 40 minutes, or until light brown.

title: Spicy Salmon
ingredients: 6 fresh salmon fillets | 2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f.  Line a non stick shallow ovenproof dish with foil.  Arrange the salmon fillets in a single layer in the dish.  Sprinkle with the chili powder.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.  Serve with fresh cream and vegetables.

Random Ingredients: tart apple,oyster sauce,bean,masa harina,spaghetti,mint leaf,pecan,peanut butter
title: Pecan Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti | 2 cans baked beans, in light syrup | 1 tart apple, chopped | 1 tablespoon masa harina | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped | 1/2 cup mint leaf, chopped | 1/4 lb pecan halves, finely ground | 1 teaspoon oyster sauce, in can | 1 tablespoon peanut butter, creamy type
instructions: To make sauce.  Place nuts in a pan and toast over medium heat.  When pecans are golden, remove from heat and let cool.  Add the rest of the dressing.  Cook pasta according to directions, drain.  Add beans, apple, chilli and nuts and mix well.  Taste.  Add more chilli if necessary.  Add peanut butter, oyster sauce and stir quickly.  Remove from heat, garnish with mint leaves.

title: Sweet Corn from the Microwave
ingredients: 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 3 tablespoons corn, drained
instructions: Put the corn, golden syrup and salt into a microwaveable bowl.  Cover the bowl and microwave on high power level for 12 - 15 minutes, rotating the bowl after 5 minutes, until thitosou you see kernels form and the corn is cooked.  Serve immediately or cool completely, covered.  Tip.  Tip.  This corn is particularly tasty when you fry it on top of a baked potato or griddle.  If served immediately, reheat the corn just before adding the sweetcorn.

Random Ingredients: malt vinegar,beef consomme,confectioner ' sugar,coriander leaf,irish whiskey
title: Spiced Whiskey Short Ribs
ingredients: 6 lbs beef consomme | 1 cup malt vinegar | 1 cup irish whiskey ( optional ) | confectioners'sugar | fresh coriander leaves
instructions: Combine the whiskey and vinegar in a pan.  Bring to boil and reduce by half.  Cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Drain.  Remove the fat which rises to the top when you pull at it with a slotted spoon.  Return the whiskey to the pan.  Add the sugar and continue to heat.  Do not boil.  Remove from the heat.  Spoon a portion on each of your short ribs to form the base of a double layer.  Put the pan in your freezer for 10 minutes before serving.  Place the whisky base in a double layer of hot buttered casserole dish.  Add a layer of short ribs.  Put some confectioners sugar on top.  Repeat this process for all the ribs until all the short ribs have been used.  Top with coriander leaves.  Chill overnight.  Best when served the next day.

title: Smoked Salmon and Yams
ingredients: 600 g yams | 8 small smoked gammon or 8 small shrimps | 2 shallots, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Scrub the yams well.  Cut the gammon or shrimps in half lengthways and sprinkle over the gammon or shrimps.  Sprinkle over the shallots and add the baking soda.  Place under a grill until the gammon or shrimps are cooked.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts, cut into thick bite sized pieces | 1 cup teriyaki sauce | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 -3 cups fresh fruit ( strawberries, peaches and apricots can be subs ), chopped into bite-sized pieces ( strawberries, peaches, mandarin oranges )
instructions: Marinate chicken pieces in teriyaki for 1 hour.  Heat oven to 400°f.  Place chicken pieces in a baking pan.  Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until tender.  Remove from oven.  Deglaze pan with teriyaki sauce, scraping up browned bits from the bottom of the pan.  Add lemon juice, marjoram and the fruit.  Pour over chicken.  Serve hot.

title: Rasgullas (Raisins and Potatoes)
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, sliced | 2 lbs raisins | 2 lbs tiny red potatoes ( about 15 ) | 1/2 lb ricotta cheese | 8 large slices white bread
instructions: Preheat an oven 350°f grease a 8x8 inch baking dish.  In a large bowl, arrange all the ingredients in layers and toss to coat thoroughly.  Arrange the bread on a work surface.  Divide evenly with 2 pieces of potatoes, 1 slice of bread and 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture over each layer.  Spread the rest of the cheese mixture over the potatoes.  Bake, basting every 10 minutes, until the top is light brown.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,red bell pepper,chickpea,apple,peanut oil,matzo meal
title: Roasted Red-Covered Chickpeas
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 2 red bell peppers | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 3/4 cup matzo meal | 2 apples, peeled and cut into 8 wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Place 1 piece of red bell pepper on the foil.  Top with 1/2 cup chickpeas, and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons vanilla extract.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup matzo meal.  Arrange the remaining red bell pepper on top and season with 1/4 teaspoon each salt and pepper.  Spoon the matzo meal mixture over the bell peppers, and fold over to form a closed packet.  Bake for 50 minutes in the preheated oven, until the bread is browned and the peppers have tenderized.

title: Veils, Hazelnuts & Onions
ingredients: 1 lb thin green beans, trimmed, rinsed | 1/2 lb onion, sliced | 1/4 cup hazelnuts ( optional )
instructions: Saute onion until just starting to brown.  Stir in beans and heat through.  Sprinkle with nuts and serve warm, plain or as suggested in intro by chef travis wabo chi on zaar.

title: Lentil and Olive Smoothie
ingredients:
100 g of good quality lentils | 1 cup cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons buttermilk | 80 -100 g frozen whipped topping, thawed ( eg.
    -.
    -honeydew ) | 1 tablespoon saffron strand ( optional ) | 1/4 cup peach schnapps ( optional ) | water | cracked black pepper
instructions: Place the lentils into a large mixing bowl, add all the other ingredients and mix well.  Add the buttermilk and mix again.  Seal and refridgerate until ready to use.  Keep on the freezer to prevent a drop in the morning.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,orange juice concentrate,sea salt
title: Orange Juice Salad With Maple Croutons
ingredients: 2 cups orange juice concentrate, thawed and undiluted | 2 tablespoons sea salt | 2 tablespoons chopped flat leaf parsley
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the orange juice concentrate, salt and parsley.  Transfer the orange juice concentrate mixture to a small bowl.  Stir in the grated orange rind and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,couscous,cream cheese,orzo pasta,pearl barley,scotch bonnet pepper,egg
title: Couscous and Orzo Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/2 cup orzo pasta | 1 scotch bonnet peppers or 1 jalapeno pepper | 200 g cream cheese | 1 egg | lime wedge | 2 -3 tablespoons couscous
instructions: Rinse the barley and cook in a pot with water, pepper and salt until soft.  Drain and cool.  Add the eggs, mix well and make the creamy filling.  Cut up the cream cheese into four pieces and melt in a bowl in the microwave.  Add the cooled barley and orzo and stir until incorporated.  Chill overnight and serve.  Decorate with lime wedge and couscous if desired.

title: Krisli's Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 sheets boston lettuce leaves | 2 tablespoons gouda cheese, shredded | 1 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons liquid smoke
instructions: Separate the lettuce leaves.  Remove all leaves from the water to the sink.  Place a handful of the cheese and walnuts in a large serving bowl.  Add 1 tablespoon of liquid smoke.  Add the lettuce leaves and toss well.  Serve with additional liquid smoke as desired.

Random Ingredients: raisin,cream tartar,monterey jack pepper cheese,salt pepper
title: Nacho Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb parmesan cheese, freshly shredded | 24 ounces cream of tartar | salt & pepper | 1 lb monterey jack pepper cheese, 1-inch cubes ( or as needed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Mix cream of tartar with salt & pepper then set aside in refrigerator.  Once thoroughly mix cheeses together then cut into quarters and line the bottom of a casserole dish or loaf pan on the bottom.  Spread half of cream of tartar mixture on top of this.  Sprinkle half of the raisins on top of cream of tartar mixture, and continue spreadering cheese over raisin mixture.  Cover with the rest of the cream of tartar mixture, and repeat layering until all of the cheese is used.  Bake for 35 - 45 minutes, until golden brown on top and cheese is crisp on the edges.  Cut into pieces for dipping.

title: Baked Green Chile
ingredients: 2 lbs green chilies | 2 lbs grated cheddar cheese ( cheddar cheese, monterey jack or emmenthaler cheese )
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Wrap cheese in foil and put it in a 400 degrees oven.  Stir often and watch it bake until cheese is melted.  Turn off oven.  Put chilies in a casserole dish and top with melted cheese.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes until the cheese starts to crisp up and the chilies are heated up a bit.

title: Gkai Pad Kamin (Crawfish Pilaf)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken wings, separated | 1 lb crawfish | 1/2 lb parsnip, peeled and cubed | 1/2 cup cassava ( pumpkin pie spice ) | 1/2 gallon tarmandine pulp ( dumplings ) | 5 cardamom pods | 1 stick cinnamon | tamarind pulp
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2 litres of water to a boil, add chicken wings, crawfish, parsnips, cassava, cassava and cardamom pods to the water.  Skim any foam that forms on top, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until chicken is tender and crawfish is darkish in color.  Remove chicken and discard the bones and skin.  Break apart any clumps with your fingers.  Skim any fat from the broth in the soup.  Strain fat through a strainer placed over a bowl and refrigerate until solidified.  Remove cardamom pods and cinnamon sticks, and strain juice through a heat grinder for a few seconds until cardamom pods are very fine.  Add tamarind pulp and heat a large skillet over high heat.  Add the cooked chicken and cook it until well warmed through, stirring constantly.  Remove chicken meat onto a plate lined with paper towels, and discard the fat.  Slice meat thinly and serve.

title: Couscous With Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tablespoon couscous | 1/4 cup sliced cabbage | 2 chicken thighs or 2 vegetable sticks
instructions: Prepare couscous by placing all ingredients in a bowl.  Melt some vegetable oil in a frying pan on med high heat.  Put chicken into it and cook till juices run clear.

title: Jam Candies
ingredients: 24 jell-o-colored jam ( you need 24 to 48 cookies ) | 2 -3 cups white sugar ( or enough to coat your fingers ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 -3 teaspoons dried poultry seasoning ( optional )
instructions: Slice your jelly rolls/cans.  If you want to make this for the Christmas holidays, prepare your cookie dough, mix together sugar, cardamom, spice and optional spices.  Take a cookie, and cut a hole into the center, put the cinnamon hole in the center, and put about 1 tsp of almond sugar in your jam hole.  Place the hole with the sugar into the oven on your lowest setting, until the sugar melts.  Remove the cookies from oven and place on a paper towel.  Let it cool for 15 to 20 minutes, or longer if your jam is a little darker at the edges.  After they are all cool, take them out, and store them in an airtight container.

title: Cauliflower Parcel Dip with Prosciutto (Quick and Easy!)
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower floret | 1/4 cup ricotta cheese | 12 slices prosciutto ( very small slices ) | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons lime rind, grated
instructions: Cook cauliflower in boiling water until tender about 8 - 10 mins or just crisp tender.  Drain and rinse with cold water to cool.  Drain well and pat dry.  Place one slice of prosciutto on each plate/dip.  Mix ricotta with curry paste.  Place drained cauliflower on top and spoon on the dip.  Serve with lime rind.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,parsnip,sesame seed,peach,barbecue sauce,pork tenderloin,double cream
title: Baked Parsnips With Smoked Pork
ingredients: 1 kg parsnip, peeled | 500 ml fresh double cream | 2 teaspoons mustard powder | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds ( optional ) | 125 g smoked pork tenderloin, sliced thinly ( or other smoked pork, of your choice ) | 1 teaspoon sweet sesame seeds, toasted on both sides ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Quarter parsnips lengthways and quarter diagonally on the diagonal.  Toss with cream, mustard, barbecue and sesame seeds.  Spoon some onto each of 2 individual ovenproof serving plates.  Place under and bake for approx 25 - 30 minutes, or until meat reaches 165c and vegetables are tender.  Serve remaining cream topping with baked parsnips, smoked pork, and a sprinkling of sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: shallot,salt pork,asiago cheese,red grape,white flour,lemon peel,rice noodle,mustard powder
title: Cold Melange With Mustard, Asiago, and Grapes
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles, soaked in cold water | salt pork, thinly sliced | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/3 cup gruyere asiago cheese, grated | 3 tablespoons finely shredded lemons peel | 12 ounces red seedless grapes, quartered | 1 large shallot, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons white flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Sprinkle salt pork over top and place on rack in shallow baking pan.  Bake till dry and crisp, about 45 min, stirring occasionally.  When done, let stand on rack to let cool.  When cool, scrape off all but 2 tbsp of fat remaining and reserve.  Pour off and discard any rind from lemons.  Set aside 1 tbsp of the juice and set up 2 tbsp of cheese in a small bowl and set aside.  Slice thin enough to measure 1 tbsp.  Reserve about 1 tbsp of the grated cheese for the mustard.  Place noodles over boiling water and boil for about 5 minute, or until just tender but still firm to bite.  Drain, then leave them in cold water until all the water is absorbed but not cooked away.  Drain noodles again, pressing between paper towels to drain well.  While noodles are still hot, spread a strip of cheese over each noodle.  Divide the drained noodles evenly on top of cheese, then top with the asiago and the remaining cheese.  Combine remaining cheese with the reserved lemon juice in a small bowl, and spread on top of noodles.  Add a few grapes on top of filling and finish with garlic bread.

title: Bleu Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf blue cheese ( any variety or type ) | vegemite, to taste
instructions: Dip the bob evoo and veg cheese in the bleu cheese.  Cook on the grill with just a few splashes of vegemite just to smeer it up.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,sharp cheddar cheese,cream chicken soup,yellow cornmeal
title: Mexican Cheese Polenta Pie
ingredients: 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: In a 2 1/2 1 or 5 1/2 quart casserole dish stir together the grated cheddar cheese and cream of chicken soup until well blended.  Spread sauce over the bottom of the prepared dish.  Sprinkle the soup mixture evenly over the cheese mixture.  Top with cornmeal.  Bake at 375 degrees for 20 - 30 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Slow Cooker Marinated Shanks
ingredients: 3 pounds sirloin | 2 pounds bread crumbs | 1 bottle maraschino cherries, drained | 32 pounds beef shanks
instructions: Trim excess fat from shanks.  In a large bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, cherries, and shanks.  Mix in the shanks, one at a time, to coat.  Place in a plastic bag, or use the lid of a slow cooker.  Repeat the layering process once more, using the reserved bread crumbs to coat the shanks.  Place the meat in a large stockpot, cover, and place over high heat.  Bring to a boil, and reduce heat to a slow simmer.  Cook until the meat has fallen off the bone, about 1 1/2 2 hours.

title: Irish Lamb Stew
ingredients: 3 lbs lean stewing beef, cut into 3/4 inch cubes | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 3 tablespoons madeira wine or 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1 cup dry red wine | 1/2 cup instant potato flakes | 2 cups lamb fat
instructions: Combine beef, baking soda, and madeira in a large nonreactive bowl.  Slowly add wine to beef mixture and stir to coat thoroughly, then stir in potato flakes.  Place in a 3 quart casserole with a lid.  Cover tightly and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 1 hour.  Remove cover, increase heat to 400 degrees f and bake an additional 30 minutes or until meat and vegetables are fork tender.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,cheese,wonton wrapper,chinese five spice powder,salt,snow pea,beef,granny smith apple
title: Chinese-Applesauce Won Tons
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 4 tablespoons dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 tablespoon granny smith apple, grated | 1 package wonton wrappers | 1 can snow peas, sliced | 1 cup cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º f.  In a large skillet, bring the ground beef, 5 spice powder and vinegar to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover with a lid and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir in the salt and the grated apple and the won tons.  Remove from heat and cool slightly.  Place 2 tablespoons of the won ton mixture at either the tip of your finger or in the center of an wonton wrapper.  Moisten the edge of the wrapper with water and fold the wrapper in half and pinch the edges together, forming a closed triangle.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.  Serve with steamed green vegetables.

title: White Wine & Vegables in Mayo
ingredients: 1 lb assorted frozen mixed vegetables | 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 jar white wine
instructions: Cook vegetables for about 12 - 15 minutes in boiling water, stirring once or twice.  Place the mixed vegetables in a colander and run cold water over them to catch all the cooking.  The amount of water that will be used is based on the size of the vegetables.  The amount of vegetables used will vary depending on your method of preparing the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,coconut,canadian bacon,simple syrup,enchilada sauce,parmesan cheese
title: Chunky Cranachan Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta ( bowtie shaped pasta ) | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup coconut ( or fresh shaved coconut ) | 2 slices canadian bacon ( diced ) | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | parmesan cheese or romano cheese, for topping
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook farfalle according to package instructions.  While the pasta is cooking, combine enchilada sauce, coconut and bacon in a small bowl.  Drain the pasta, reserving 1/3 cup pasta water.  Add the cooled pasta to the sauce mixture and combine well.  Gently stir in the optional toppings listed above.  Garnish with parmesan to serve.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower floret,orange peel,bay scallop,red pepper,raspberry,celery salt,navy bean
title: Seared Scallops With Roasted Cauliflower Salad (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 12 ounces navy beans | 2 lbs whole celeryishes, thinly sliced | 2 large red peppers, cored, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch strips | 1 1/2 cups cauliflower florets ( about 2 small ) | 2 oranges, peeled and sliced into slivers with peel | 1 bay scallop | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
instructions: Sort and rinse navy beans.

title: Spicy Banana Sauce
ingredients: 3 bananas, peeled and chopped | 1/2 white onion | 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 tablespoon sweet chili sauce | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat over to 375 degrees.  In a 2 quart blender combine all ingredients.

title: Sweet Vinegar
ingredients: 2 cups granulated sugar | 1 cup rice wine vinegar
instructions: In a small saucepan, mix all the ingredients, bringing to a boil and stirring gently once or twice.  Let cool for 10 minutes, removing from heat and stirring once or twice.  Remove a teaspoon of the mixture a a little at a time and scrape it off into a glass bowl.  Pour into hot sterilized jars, leaving 2/3 to 1/2 inch headspace.

title: Hot Rooster Sauce
ingredients: 10 -12 -18 ounces rotel tomatoes ( or any other tomato ) | 1 pinch cream of tartar
instructions: Remove a tomato from packaging and run a thumb through the inside of the jar.  It should open like a book.  You will see the skin pulling apart and stuff leaving you clean, clear of the tomato.  Use the spoon to mash up the juice and heat it through gently.  Once this is done, add salt, if necessary.  This can be kept in the fridge for up to 8 months although its flavor improves with age time.

title: Foil (For Fish Fritters)
ingredients: 500 g green coriander, cleaned | 4 medium sized green chilies, washed ( i use red chillies ) | 1 kg medium sized fish ( such as sole or scrod )
instructions: Wash the corriander.  Wash and coarsely chop it.  Wash and coarsely chop the green chillies.  Dry fry the corriander, chilies and fish in medium high heat, till the fish is well cooked.  Drain off excess fat and leave to one side.  Spray a little oil on a pan.  Pour some oil into the pan and heat until it's hot.  Quickly drop the fried fish into the oil.  Do not overcrowd the pan.  If you're using a very thick fish like king prawns, don't crowd it inches when they start to turn white and are floating on top of the fish, flip them over to cook the other side.  If you are using all purpose, no overcrowding the pan, just drop them into a medium sized saucepan of hot oil on one side, then flip it over to add the remaining fish.  Serve hot.

title: Peppered Swiss Steak
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs filet of beef, cut 1-inch thick, very thin | 3 pinches italian breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon gingerroot | 3 cups half-and-half cream, well chilled | 1 cup frangelico or 1 cup heavy cream | 1 jalapeno, seeded and thinly diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Put beef in a large zip seal plastic bag.  Add 1 cup of the cream, ginger and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.  In a shallow dish, blend with a whisk.  Drain beef and gently press beef with a spatula to coat.  Arrange beef on foil lined baking sheet.  Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until done to your liking.  Turn slices.  If needed, add remaining cream during the last 15 minute of cooking.

title: Beef Tenderloin Steak and Cheese in Packet
ingredients: 1 beef tenderloin steaks, 1 to 1 1/2 pounds | 1 container cottage cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place steak onto a rack in a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven until thermometer inserted into the center registers 125 degrees f, about 15 minutes.  Remove from oven, cover with aluminum foil, and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.  Slice beef across the grain with a sharp knife and transfer to a serving platter.

title: Yogurt With Vanilla (Kuwaiti)
ingredients: 1/2 lb thick creamy yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Blend the yogurt well.  Divide it evenly into 8 portions.  Form each portion into a round ball and shape into a circle on a skewer about 5 inches long and 5 inches in diameter.  Wet your hands lightly with warm water and place the kuwaiti on the skewer.  Press the circle gently for 1 - 2 seconds then turn on the other side.  Wet your hands with warm water and gently pinch the kuwaiti into a uniform ball.  Repeat with remaining balls.  Place the bowl on a dry flat plate.  Refrigerate for an hour at least.  Remove from the refrigerator and put a plate on top to let the excess water drain out.  Place the kuwaiti with all its contents in the serving bowl, and cover tightly with cling wrap.  Set aside for at least 1 - 2 hours.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,chicken thigh fillet,rigatoni pasta,yeast
title: Rigatoni With Chicken
ingredients: 7 g sachet dry yeast | 600 g rigatoni pasta | 300 g chicken thigh fillets, cut into large pieces | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: To make your own yeast, put the yeast to 1/2 cup of warm water and leave for 5 minutes until frothy.  Put the water to boil and put it on to boil.  Put in your pasta, chicken and dark soy sauce, mix and leave to rest in a warm place for approx 10 mins and then pour into a large dish.  In another mixing bowl, dissolve the sachet of yeast in the water, stir into the water until dissolved and let stand for 15 minutes.  Pour into the bowl with the yeast and mix until well coated.  Leave to cool.  Pour the sauce into greased ramekins or a medium sized baking dish.  Cover with clingfilm and leave to prove in a warm place for a few hours or overnight.  Preheat the grill to medium.  Turn off the grill and brush with oil.  Place the ramekins onto the grill until they have turned white and crispy on both sides.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black bean,tofu,black olive,sirloin,olive black green,egg noodle,chile powder
title: Black Bean and Tofu Noodle Meatloaf
ingredients: 1 package dried black beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 pound ground sirloin | 1 package firm tofu, cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 1/2 tablespoons black olive oil, divided | 1 egg noodles | 2 cans chopped black olives, drained | 1/4 cup shredded chile powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Place beans, sirloin, and tofu in a large bowl and mix thoroughly.  Spread bean mixture on the bottom of a 9x5 inch loaf pan, leaving at least a 1 inch border around the edges.  Stir the egg noodles and olives into the meat mixture until well blended.  Spread evenly over the bean mixture.  Sprinkle with chile powder.  Cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for 90 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is lightly browned and the center is firm to the touch.  Cool 10 minutes before slicing.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,parsnip,pineapple chunk,hamburger patty,brown gravy mix,parmesan cheese,chicken broth,vanilla
title: Beef and Pineapple
ingredients: 4 -6 hamburger patty | 4 -6 slices pineapple chunks | 2 packages brown gravy mix | 1 can beef broth ( optional for thicker gravy ) | 1 can chicken broth ( optional for thin gravy ) | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1 teaspoon parsley, dry | parmesan cheese ( optional )
instructions: Brown hamburgers in skillet but do not drain when ready.  Stir the gravy mix, beef broth, water, and 1 tsp vanilla into hamburgers.  Simmer for two hours.  Top with parmesean cheese before serving.  Serve over hot buttered egg noodles.  I recommend plain buttermilk noodles.  For thicker gravy mix in one can of cornstarch with 1/4 cup cold water.  Stir until smooth.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chile pepper,queso fresco,beef,asparagus spear
title: Beef and Asparagus with Chipotle Dip
ingredients: 20 ounces frozen asparagus spears, thawed and drained | 1 pound ground beef | 1 jar roasted and barbeque sauce ( chipotle ) | 1 cup chopped monted jack or other hot pepper, drained
instructions: Arrange asparagus in a 3 quart slow cooker.

title: Oriental Vegetable Sausage
ingredients: 300 g coleslaw mix | 200 g button mushrooms, sliced | 1 spring onion, sliced | 1/2 small cabbage, cut into chunks | salt and pepper
instructions: Remove woody centre vein from cabbage and slice into quarters.  Slice spring onion into 3rds.  Heat oil in large frying pan until very hot.  Add chopped spring onion and fry until translucent.  Add button mushrooms and fry until soft.  Season with salt and pepper and brown.  Pour in coleslaw and continue frying until everything is soft.  Serve at once with bread.

title: Fried Sea Bass

instructions: Make the tomato sauce by combining the tomato puree and fish puree in a non reactive sauce pan.  If you find it too sweet add a little sugar, if using sweetener.

title: Beef, Mac & Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef | 1 teaspoon minced garlic powder | 1/2 yellow bell pepper ( chopped ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1/4 cup applesauce ( unsweetened ) | 1/4 cup double cream or 1/4 cup milk | 2 teaspoons dijon-style mustard ( or to taste ) | cooked elbow macaroni
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the macaroni in a crockpot and cook on low until beef is tender.  Add macaroni and cook on high until macaroni is heated through.

title: Pork Loin with Wine Vinegar and Rice (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 pork loin, trimmed | 1 jar pasta sauce | 3 tablespoons wine vinegar | 3 cups instant rice ( uncooked ) | 2 1/2 cups tomato pasta sauce
instructions: Place pork loin in crock pot.

title: Chinese Cabbage Salad
ingredients: 1 head chinese cabbage ( small head ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Steam the cabbage for about 5 minutes.  Remove.  Dice the cabbage.

Random Ingredients: cauliflower,kaffir lime leaf,carrot,green chili pepper,lentil,malt vinegar
title: Red Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dried lentils | 1 green chili and 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 3 tablespoons malt vinegar | 1/4 cup carrot, shredded | 2 kaffir lime leaves, shredded | 1 small cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Place cooked lentils in a large bowl, cover with water and cook for about 30 minutes.  Drain the lentils and place in a large mixing bowl.  Add the green chilli, vinegar, carrot, lime leaves, and red chilli.  Mix lightly with a fork.  Add the cauliflower and mix well.  Refrigerate overnight before serving.  Stir before serving.

title: African Peanut Butter Banana Chili
ingredients: 1/4 cup crunchy peanut butter ( or natural ) | 2 teaspoons mild chili paste | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( or to taste ) | 1 medium banana, chopped | 1/2 cup fresh corn, cut out and finely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup slivered almonds, blanched and slivered at the last minute ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl blend all ingredients.  Serve with chopped fresh coriander or mint chutney.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,white fish fillet,purpose white flour,mint leaf
title: Fennel Crusted Fish
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose white flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 2 tablespoons dried mint leaves, crumbled | 1/4 lb white fish fillet, cut into 1/4 inch slices
instructions: In a small bowl, toss the flour and fennel seeds with the mint leaves, then sprinkle the herb mixture evenly onto the fish.  Place fish onto a rack in a baking pan, lightly oil the baking pan.  Preheat the oven to 450 f degrees, then bake for 15 to 18 minutes for medium rare, 30 to 35 minutes for well done.  The fish should be just cooked through and crispy outside and slightly firm inside.

title: Mexican Cherry Cheese Sticks (Chefs Recipe)
ingredients: 4 cups grated mozzarella cheese ( about 5 1/2 pounds ) | 24 fresh cilantro roots, stemmed ( about 12 large leaves worth ) | 8 -12 cups cherry or 8 -12 cups other pitted ripe olives
instructions: Peel the mozzarella.  Trim the bottoms off the cilantro roots.  With the help of a melon baller or small, sharp knife, remove the root pieces, taking care to keep the roots intact.  Tear off a piece of peel from a large bunch of stems just larger than the mozzarella, taking care to leave about 1/2 inch of headspace.  If desired, set aside.  Place the cilantro roots, peeled of any foreign matter, in a large pot of cold water, just enough to cover.  Bring to a boil over medium heat, and boil until soft.  Drain and set aside.  Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f.  Take a piece of the mozzarella stick about 1 inch thick and cut along their length with a sharp knife.  Use a spoon to keep the mozzarella from sticking to it, and place in a baking pan or other baking dish.  Sprinkle the mozzarella with about 1/4 to 1/2 cup of the mozzarella cheese, and then sprinkle with about 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Top with a piece of cilantro stem.  Repeat with pieces of mozzarella and cilantro stems and a handful of olives.  Repeat with remaining mozzarella and cilantro stems, olives and mozzarella cheese.  Bake 15 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.  Serve warm.

title: Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 package sourdough bread, torn into pieces | 3 cups plum tomatoes, seeded and chopped | 1 small green pepper, seeded and chopped | 7 ounces raisins, snipped | 2 small shallots, sliced thin
instructions: Toss bread with tomatoes through coarse sieve.  Add green pepper and raisins.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes.  Stir, or let cool completely.  Serve with chips.

Random Ingredients: water chestnut,red wine,mint leaf,salad seasoning mix,granny smith apple,yeast
title: Minted Apples, Water Chestnuts & Smoked Sausages in Mead
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons instant yeast, dissolved | 1/4 cup warm water | 1/4 cup dry red wine or 1/4 cup non-alcoholic red wine vinegar | 1 package smoked sausage | 2 lbs granny smith apples, unpeeled | 1 can water chestnuts, drained and sliced or 1 cup chopped drained canned water chestnuts | fresh mint leaves ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir together yeast & warm water & set aside for 10 minutes.  In a large bowl, toss yeast mixture with wine or vinegar & set aside 1 hour.  Remove sausage casings & slice into rounds.  Core apples & cut into 2 inch pieces.  In a wok or deep skillet, heat about 1/4 inch of water over medium high heat.  Add apples & sausages & stir fry or stir fry about 4 minutes or until apples are softened.  With a slotted spoon, remove apples to a bowl & set aside.  Place apples & sausage in the warm wine or vinegar mixture & continue cooking, covered, for 20 minutes or until apples are soft, stirring often.  Add water chestnuts & mix thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,orange bell pepper,red currant jelly,buttermilk biscuit,salad green,cumin seed
title: Nam Jim (South African Rusks)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cumin seeds | 1 orange bell pepper, cut into thin rounds | 1 red currant jelly | 1 lb fresh salted salad greens | pompous flat-leaf parsley, washed | buttermilk biscuit
instructions: Place cumin seeds in a small pan over high heat and fry, shaking the pan often, until the cumin has darkened to a dark brown color and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes.  Pour into a small bowl and set aside.  Place the pepper rounds and currant jelly in a small pan and stir in water to cover.  Bring to boil over medium high heat and reduce to medium low.  Simmer 5 minutes, remove and discard the pepper skins, and cool, but do not boil.  Preheat the grill to medium.  Remove the rusks from the bowl with a slotted spoon leaving enough liquid to roll out onto a lightly floured surface into a log about 12 inches long.  Sew the greens on your hands as close to the trimmed surface as possible with the tip of a sharp knife.  Cut into 6 to 6 slices roughly the size of the biscuit, and place them on a board, overlapping the slices slightly.  Cut a hole in the center of each slice, using a toothpick to make a crisscross pattern and insert some into the hole.  Repeat and continue the process until you have six rusks.  Place the rolled out rusks on a foil lined cookie sheet and brush generously with buttermilk biscuit crumbs.  Place under the grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until puffy and firm.  Serve hot, drizzled with redcurrant jelly and accompanied by spicy chutney.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,spanish onion,currant,chili flake,bitter,cashew nut,cardamom seed,horseradish
title: Dried Cured Spanish Onions
ingredients: 4 cups spanish onions ( about 10 oz ) | 1 bunch fresh rosemary leaf | 3 tablespoons dried currant | 1 tablespoon chili flakes | 3 tablespoons horseradish ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons cardamom seeds, crushed | 1/2 cup cashew nuts, chopped to 1/2-inch | 2 teaspoons bitter ( optional )
instructions: In a pot of boiling water, melt the 4 cups of onions and the rosemary leaves.  Let stand until onions are softened but not browned.  Drain, then place in a large ovenproof dish.  In a skillet over medium heat, melt the horseradish.  Place the onions and chopped rosemary leaves in the horseradish, and cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are completely glazed.  Set aside and cover to keep warm.  Pour off the horseradish water.  Drain the soaked onions, and place in a large saucepan with the remaining ingredients.  Stir to combine.  Cover and simmer over low heat until onions are tender, about 1 hour.  Remove the cover, stir and simmer, stirring frequently, for an additional 5 minutes over high heat.  To serve, cover with a thin film of hot buttermilk.

title: Baked Chick Peas
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 tablespoon chickpeas ( roasted ) | 600 ml tonic water
instructions: Place the sugar and chick peas in an oven dish, heat on top of the stove for 1 - 2 minutes.  Pour over the water and stir to mix.  Cover with a cover, and place in 400f oven.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: lamb,scotch whisky,gouda cheese,phyllo pastry,cornstarch,beef stock broth
title: Individual Scotch Lamb Pies #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 cup beef broth | 1/2 cup scotch whisky | 2 scotch whiskey | 16 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Coat 8 pastry sheets with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.  In a medium mixing bowl, combine lamb, ground beef, cornstarch, and beef broth.  Season with salt and pepper and mix to thoroughly combine.  Drain any excess liquids from meat and set meat mixture aside.  Unroll phyllo pastry sheets and cut off 3 to 4 inch pieces or use a 9x13x2 cookie cutter to get 8 inch circles.  Place 3 sheets in a pie dish that has been lightly sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Cover pastry with a damp towel and set aside.  Cut off 1 inch and lightly coat the remaining pastry with another damp towel.  Working with a few at a time, press one end of the pastry sheet onto the bottom of the pie dish and then the other ends on the rim.  Repeat process until all pieces are used.  Place 1 tablespoon meat mixture on the bottom of the pie plate and then top with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 tablespoon beef stock.  Add 2 shavings of whisky and 1 pinch of salt and pepper.  Carefully, fold pastry over filling.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,black bean,onion powder,wine,olive,no salt tomato sauce
title: Drunk Red Beans and Onions
ingredients: 1 can no-salt-added black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 can no-salt-added tomato sauce | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 serrano pepper, chopped | 1 can olives, sliced | 1 teaspoon wine
instructions: In a 2 quart casserole dish, add beans, tomato sauce, onion powder, serrano pepper, olives, and wine.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours.

title: Chinese Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into bite size chunks | 3 cups pineapple juice | 1/2 cup low-sodium beef broth or 1/2 cup canned low sodium beef broth, divided | 1 tablespoon instant minced choy sum | 1 lb thin spaghetti
instructions: Place the beef, pineapple juice, 1/2 cup broth, and choy sum in a large slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 8 to 10 hours, or on high heat setting 5 to 6 hours. .  Meanwhile, in a separate skillet, cook the spaghetti according to package directions, until al dente.  Drain.  Add pasta to the beef mixture and toss to combine.  Serve with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,chili pepper flake,penne,chicken bouillon,peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Pasta in Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 600 g penne ( or rotelle or other short pasta ) | 250 g crunchy peanut butter | 1 1/4 liters good chicken stock ( homemade stock is easier to use so be forewarned that this is not a typo ) | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes
instructions: Heat oven to 200 c or 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Cook pasta according to package directions.  While the pasta is cooking in a pot of salted boiling water, combine the peanut butter and stock in a bowl and stir until the peanut butter melts.  When the pasta is ready, drain and add the peanut butter mixture, chili flakes and chicken stock to the hot noodles.  Check seasoning and then return pasta to pot.  Serve with lots of freshly chopped basil and some grated nutmeg for an extra kick.

title: Paprika Stuffed  French Toast
ingredients: 5 -6 slices italian bread | 1/2 cup unsalted, raw cashew nuts | 1/2 teaspoon instant espresso | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder | 1/2 fresh mango, finely grated | 1/4 cup sunflower oil
instructions: In a shallow dish mix the ground espresso, paprika, garlic powder, cashews and mango together.  Dip bread slices into the spiced espresso until lightly soaked.  Heat oil in a skillet or griddle.  Dip bread pieces into the spiced espresso and allow to sit in the oil.  Fry until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,chocolate chip,white sugar,tart apple,molasses,celery,italian breadcrumb,egg
title: Apple Covered Easter Bread
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened chocolate chip | 2 3/4 cups italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 1/2 lbs tart apples, peeled and sliced 1/2-inch thick | 1 cup diced celery | 2 eggs | 1 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 cup molasses
instructions: Preheat oven to 300.  Line 8x8 inch baking pan with foil and butter foil.  Melt chocolate in a large bowl over top of hot water, stir just until melted.  Remove bowl from heat, stir in bread crumbs until well moistened.  Mix apples, raisins, celery.

Random Ingredients: allspice,cumin powder,flour tortilla,beef bouillon,mirin,cream chicken soup
title: Tibetan Beef Wrap
ingredients: 2 lbs thinly sliced beef bouillon | 3/4 cup sweetened condensed cream of chicken soup | 6 flour tortillas | 1 tablespoon allspice | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Sprinkle bouillon over beef and add all ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Pour into a large nonstick skillet large enough to wrap tightly.

title: Napa Dave's Spiced Mince With Nuts (Mark Bittman) from Nuitlacoche
ingredients: 8 ounces sliced almonds ( toasted or not, about 5-6 ounces ) | 1 1/2 lbs mincemeat, lean | 2 cups frozen small heads of broccoli, defrosted, rinsed and chopped ( about 2 medium ) | sweet chili sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Heat a 10 inch, round cake pan in the oven on top shelf with a rack.  Toast the almonds in the oven over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  Brown the mince in a 5 1/2 to 6 1/2 quart dutch over containing 1/4 inch water, stirring occasionally, until browned and crumbly, 12 to 15 minutes.  Drain off the fat and set aside.  Add the broccoli to the hot butter and cook over moderate heat with the mince for 2 minutes more, stirring constantly.  Add the cooked mince and stir over moderately high heat for 2 minutes.  Add the sweet chili sauce and simmer over low heat until thickened.  Stir a few times.  Taste and adjust the seasoning.  Transfer the mince and broccoli mixture to a bowl.  Stir in the nuts.  Arrange the nuitlacoche on a warm platter and surround it with the mincemeat mixture.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,red potato,heavy cream,icing sugar,ice water,yellow pea
title: Creamy Lemon Pea and Potato Salad
ingredients: 200 g yellow split peas | 1 red potato | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 2 teaspoons lemon juice ( zest and juice ) | 375 ml heavy cream | 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon ice water | 1 teaspoon lemon juice
instructions: Wash peas.  Remove strings.  Dice potato.  Boil for 10 minutes, then drain and rinse in cold water.  Place peas and potato in a bowl.  Add icing sugar and zest, and stir to combine until smooth.  Make peaks from cream with the icing sugar and ice water, and drizzle over potato/pea mixture.  Cover and chill for at least 4 hours.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: red leaf lettuce,lettuce leaf,ice,red wine vinegar
title: Romaine's Famous and Simple Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1 - 1 1/3 cup red leaf lettuce, packed | 1 iceberg lettuce leaf | ice
instructions: Place 2 lettuce leaves on four plates.  Make sure they are not all covered.  Put 1/4 cup of vinegar in bowl, and stir to mix.  Toss in half of the iceberg lettuce.  Dip into ice, then squeeze evenly over lettuce.

title: Roasted Poblano Chile
ingredients: 2 large poblano chiles, stems removed | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place the poblano chiles on a baking sheet and place in the oven until the skin is charred.  Place the chiles in a bowl and rub with the liquid.  The chiles will be very soft, so place under running water and remove with a knife to cool.  The skins will loosen, and the skins can easily crackle on top.  The skins can then be removed by pressing with the flat side of a knife.

title: Low Calorie Corned Beef Brisket With Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs corned beef brisket | 12 slices prosciutto | 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk ( or to taste ) | 1/3 - 1/2 cup icing sugar ( to taste ) or 1/3-1/2 cup confectioners'sugar ( to taste )
instructions: Spread a thin layer of butter on a baking sheet.  Wrap a piece of prosciutto over both sides of the brisket in a paperclip and place on the sheet.  Cut diagonal slits at the 2 sides of the brisket on both sides.  Place the brisket, fat side down on a cooling rack lined with wax paper, or a piece of foil that will fit snugly over the meat.  Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Unwrap the prosciutto and slice thinly.  Meanwhile, heat the milk or water over low heat and add the biscuit mix.  Boil until the biscuit mix is hot and slightly thickened.  Transfer the brisket to a platter.  Pour off as much water as possible into the pan with the brisket and pour over the hot biscuit mixture.  Allow to drain for 3 - 4 minutes.  Coat the top of the brisket pieces with the reserved biscuit mix and refrigerate for at least 5 hours or overnight, covered.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

Random Ingredients: thai chile pepper,french bread,madras curry powder
title: Curried Garlic Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, sliced | 2 tablespoons madras curry powder | 2 fresh thai chile peppers, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Lay the sliced french bread on a cookie sheet.  Spread sliced chile peppers evenly over the french bread.  Spread curry powder over the top of the bread slices.  Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white pepper,sauerkraut,vanilla sugar,chicken breast,cold water,lettuce,black tea,cocoa powder
title: Chicken and Sauerkraut
ingredients: 4 -6 chicken breasts, with or without bone | 4 -6 ounces sauerkraut ( or other good sauerkraut ) | 1/2 ounce unsweetened cocoa powder | 4 -6 ounces low-sodium black tea ( i like decaf ) | 4 -6 leaves lettuce | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar or 1 teaspoon instant vanilla extract | 4 -6 fluid ounces cold water | white pepper
instructions: Prepare the chicken, preheat oven to 400°f.  In an oven safe dish marinate the chicken for 30 - 45 minutes to an hour at room temperature.  Place the chicken in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes, depending on your oven.  When chicken is done, allow it to rest for five minutes so you can let a little of the fat from the meat.  Remove meat from the bones and slice it up.  If your pan is big enough, you might want to use a meat slicer to make the meat thinner.  If your pan is smaller, just add it to your pan, or cut the meat up into slices.  Once finished, place the sliced chicken chunks in a pan and cover with the cold water.  If you are using cocoa you will want to melt the cocoa into the water, so mix your salt in with the 4 fluid oz of cold water.  Now just pour a little hot water over the cocoa and dissolve it.  You will still have some cocoa left in the pan and to add to the stock later later, mix the cocoa with the hot water to make a paste.  Place all ingredients back into the pan on medium heat.  I like to leave the chicken bones at the end of the cooking process, then serve with the sauce.

title: Margarito
ingredients: 2 cups tomato juice | 3 cups golden tequila | 1/2 cup cooking oil | 1 package shredded fresh coconut ( not frozen ) | chopped lettuce
instructions: Combine tomato juice, tequila, oil, coconut and lettuce.  Stir until well mixed and pour into rims of small glass containers or martini glasses.  Cover tightly and chill in the refrigerator.  To serve, turn over in the bottom half of a cocktail glass.

title: Pub Style Bulgar Soup
ingredients: 500 ml teabags bulgar wheat ( cracked wheat ) | 1 liter veggie broth | 350 ml beef stock or 350 ml vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon cracked wheat | 200 g hamburger or 150 g salami, sliced | 15 ml brandy | 1 sprigs fresh tea, leaves ( to serve ) | 175 g plain flour | 175 ml buttermilk
instructions: Place the teabags, stock and cracked wheat in a large saucepan.  Bring to the boil and reduce heat.  Simmer gently for at least 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, brown the hamburger / salami slices and set aside.  Toast the cracked wheat until golden on both sides.  Transfer to a serving bowl and stir in the brandy.  Serve the soup hot with a slice of cracked wheat on top and fresh tea leaves to garnish.

Random Ingredients: half,tuna water,heavy whipping cream,liquid honey,cumin powder,fruit,taco seasoning,apricot preserve
title: Tuna Mousse
ingredients:
1 cup half-and-half | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream or 1/2 cup whipping cream, chilled | 1 package taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 canned tuna in water, drained | 1/2 cup apricot preserves ( i've found that some of the preserves go into liquid, so it's worth it.
    - ) | 1/4 cup dried fruit, chopped, divided ( or more )
instructions: Whisk the half and half, cream, and taco seasoning till combined.  Combine in a blender along with cumin powder, honey, tuna, and preserves.  Puree till smooth.

Random Ingredients: topping,italian seasoning,grapefruit juice,dark rum,basmati rice,natural bran,red chile
title: Peppered Rice Blend with Rum and Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 cup white basmati rice | 2 tablespoons natural bran ( fiber-free okra ) | 1/2 cup seedless grapefruit juice | 1/4 cup dark rum | 1 tablespoon chopped dried red chile | 2 dashes italian seasoning | 1/2 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Combine rice, bran, grapefruit juice, rum, dried chili, and italian seasoning in a bowl.  Gently stir in the whipped topping.  Chill completely in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Chinese Colcannon
ingredients: 600 g yellow capsicums, sliced | 750 ml very thin ice, chilled | 1 teaspoon dry sherry
instructions: Put ice in a blender and blend until very smooth.  Stir in the sherry, then pour into chilled colcannon glasses or similar size glasses.  Top with shaved red capsicum and serve.

title: Chunky Onion and Onion Rub
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes | 3 tablespoons cocoa | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme sprigs | 1 teaspoon unsweetenedened cocoa | 1/4 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Toast the mustard seeds in a dry skillet over low heat, until they start to pop.  Transfer the seeds to a small bowl.  Stir the cinnamon, dry onion flakes, 1 teaspoon cocoa powder, mustard seeds, unsweetened cocoa, and thyme sprigs into the skillet.  Cover, and set over low heat while whisking every so often so they don't burn.  Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the dip reaches your desired consistency, and is quite dry.  Cool to room temperature.  Transfer to a sealed container, and refrigerate at least 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,grain rice,hard egg,port wine,bean sprout,clove,green bean
title: Egg and Rice Cakes
ingredients: 100 g long grain rice | 100 g green beans, ends trimmed, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons port wine | 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 hard-boiled egg, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons bean sprouts, chopped | 4 tablespoons graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Place rice, beans, port and garlic in a medium saucepan and bring to the boil.  Stir over low heat until all ingredients are coated thoroughly with garlic, about 20 minutes.  Increase heat to a high, stir, then cover the pan and cook over medium heat until liquid has been absorbed.  Uncover pan and continue to cook without lifting the lid until rice is just tender, 2 to 10 minutes longer.  Transfer to a large bowl.  Mix egg with the crumbs and season to taste.

title: Cheater's Salsa
ingredients: 1 package soft vegetable shortening, or more as needed | 2 cups chunky salsa | 1 tablespoon curry powder
instructions: Mix butter, salsa, and curry powder together in a bowl until butter is in pieces no larger than a marble.  Place a large skillet over medium heat.

title: Easy Microwave Poppy-Seed Fried Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup white vinegar | 3 cups cooked basmati rice | 1 teaspoon poppy seeds, or as desired ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Pour 1 tablespoon vinegar into a skillet with a lid, and warm to 130 degrees f.  Dip rice into boiling water, and immediately stir in poppy seeds.  Cover, and return to the microwave.  Cook 1 minute.  Cool to room temperature, 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Spice-Aduck: Apple Tatin
ingredients: 5 tablespoons gelatin | 1 small cooking apple, unpeeled, peeled and finely diced ( about 1-2 cup ) | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro | 3 1/2 tablespoons fennel seeds or 2 teaspoons chopped fresh fennel | 2 cans stewed whole tomatoes
instructions: Prepare gelatin according to package instructions.  Meanwhile, preheat the oven over medium high heat.  Add fruit, cilantro and fennel seeds.  Cook over medium heat, stirring often, about 5 minutes, or until hot.  Bring to boil and stir in gelatin.  Reduce heat and simmer, stirring often, 3 - 5 minutes more.  Scrape the mixture into a buttered 2 1/2 qt baking dish, sprinkle with remaining fennel seeds.  Cover and refrigerate 1 - 2 hours.  To serve, remove the dish from the refrigerator and invert the custard into a serving dish.  Serve hot or chilled.

Random Ingredients: apricot,soy chorizo,yellow mustard seed,beef stock broth,green olive brine,pistachio
title: Pistachio-Grated Beef and Green Olive Relish
ingredients: 1 cup dried apricot | 1/2 cup green olives in syrup | 1/2 cup pistachios, chopped | 1/2 cup soy chorizo ( or other sausage ) | 1 cup beef stock or 1 cup beef broth | 1 teaspoon yellow mustard seeds
instructions: Place apricots in a bowl and pour hot water over them to cover.  Soak for 20 minutes.  Drain, peel and chop.  Combine the soaked apricots, olives, pistachios and chorizo in a food processor or blender and pulse until the chorizo is finely chopped.  Add the beef broth or beef broth and process until well mixed.  Season with mustard seeds.  Refrigerate until ready to use.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,cornflour,thai red curry paste,egg white,coriander powder
title: Red & Green Curry Powder
ingredients: 5 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 1/2 cups fresh porcini mushrooms | 1 egg white, whisked into | 3/4 teaspoon cornflour
instructions: Heat 1 tsp of hot water in a non stick pan, stir in the red curry paste, coriander and mushrooms, cook for 6 - 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Leave to cool.  In a small bowl, whisk egg white until soft peaks form.  Gradually add in the cornflour and remaining hot water until well combined, mix until smooth.  Fold in the cooled red and green curry paste mixture.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Store in an airtight container in the fridge for upto 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,salt black pepper,phyllo dough,grenadine syrup,nutmeg,simple syrup
title: Pineapple Hawaiian Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 32 phyllo dough, thawed if frozen | 8 ounces pineapple juice | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 2 tablespoons grenadine syrup | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | grated nutmeg, garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Unroll phyllo in a large bowl, and trim down the ends if desired.  Roll each piece of phyllo into a large rectangle about 3 to 1½ inches wide.  Use parchment paper to prevent rolling down to the top of the sheet.  Poke holes all around the phyllo with a fork and place 1 sheet of phyllo diagonally into a 9x13 inch baking dish, overlapping as needed.  Top phyllo with 1 more sheet of phyllo, then cover with damp kitchen towels and set aside.  Unroll phyllo and cut diagonally into strips 3 - 3 inches wide.  Keep remaining phyllo covered with a damp kitchen towel while you complete the rest of the phyllo.  Place a toothpick in the center of each strip, and spread pineapple juice evenly in a criss cross pattern across it.  Sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper.  Cover phyllo in a single layer, and score 1 cross way down into each strip.  Cut two more strips across diagonally into triangles.  Cut triangles diagonally into triangles.  Arrange triangles on parchment paper in a single layer on the preheated baking sheet.  Sprinkle evenly with grenadine and light sprinkle of nutmeg.  Cover with a kitchen towel and bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, until phyllo is golden and crisp.

title: Ciabatta
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour ( white wholemeal flour ) | 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass ( white part only ) | 2 tablespoons light soya sauce ( regular may be used ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1 1/4 - 1 1/2 lbs lard ( see notes )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients except lard together in a bowl.  Cut in the lard very thinly.  With floured fingers, press the flour into a ball and knead for about 1 - 2 minutes until the dough is smooth.  Cover with plastic wrap and refridgerate until ready to use. instructions: Prepare steamer basket by lining with greased wax paper and placing a piece of cheesecloth in the bottom.  Place the steaming basket over the steamer basket, and steam in the steamer basket with the lid on until thick and transparent, about 10 minutes.  Remove from steamer basket, and set aside to cool.  Peel broccoli, cut in 6 wedges, and steam in a steamer basket over boiling water until very firm, about 7 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  Pour cream into a small bowl, and whisk in espresso powder.  Set aside to cool, add warm cream to bowl and whisk until frothy.  Pour cream mixture into a shallow nonstick baking dish or pie plate that is large enough to fit all 4 slices of bread.  Dip bread into cream mixture, coating both sides.  Arrange 2 bread slices over top of each other in a steaming basket.  Steam sandwiches 3 to 6 minutes or until light brown on both sides.  Serve warm.  Garnish plates with assorted desired garnishes and enjoy.

title: Cranberry Glaze for Fried Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup fresh cranberry juice | 2 tablespoons lard | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf, minced
instructions: Pour the cranberry juice and lard in a small bowl and stir in the basil.  Pour a small amount of the glaze on to each fried pasta, top with croutons or shredded vegetables.

title: Rigatoni with Lamb and Cucumbers
ingredients: 1 lamb shank | 1 can sliced cucumbers, drained | 1/4 cup palm sugar | 11 ounces rigatoni pasta, uncooked
instructions: Spray pan with vegetable oil cooking spray.  Spray lamb shank with vegetable oil cooking spray.  Place in pan, browning on all sides.  Push shank to the side, add palm sugar.  Brown on all sides.  Boil rigatoni according to package directions.  Place all vegetables over meat, pour in sauce and heat through.

title: Grilled Fish Salad on a Stick
ingredients: 1 lb firm white fish fish fillet ( cod, haddock, halibut, cod or salmon may be used ) | 2 tablespoons fresh oregano leaves, chopped | 1 large banana | 1/4 cup fish sauce | 2 tablespoons olive
instructions: Cut fish into 2 inch pieces.  In a small nonstick skillet, heat fish over medium heat in just enough water to cover, 2 - 4 minutes.  Remove from heat and drain.  Wash and dry fruit.  Slice banana in half lengthwise.  Cut pieces across the stem so slices stay together.  Arrange fruit attractively on a platter.  Add fish.

title: Fig and Dill Fritters
ingredients: 12 fresh figs, chopped finely | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill | 5 tablespoons icing sugar | 5 tablespoons chopped figs, finely chopped | 5 tablespoons white flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon water chestnut, sliced finely
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients together really well.  Place the mixture between your palms and mix until everything is evenly mixed in and the mixture comes together again.  Keep this dough in the refrigerator for 1 hour.  Form the mixture into golf ball sized patties and use a fork to lightly coat them with flour.  Cook on a pre heated grill on medium for about 7 - 9 minutes, turning occasionally until the cakes are cooked through.  Allow to cool slightly, then serve garnished with a few whole green fingers.  Enjoy.

title: Crispy Lime Pie
ingredients: 1 package frozen corn, thawed | 1 can sweet corn, drained | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1 lime, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix together corn, sweet corn, and confectioners' sugar in a medium bowl.  Roll half the lime wedges into the remaining lime wedges to decorate the crust.  Place one half of the lime wedge into each crust.  Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,chicken bouillon cube,kidney bean,worcestershire sauce
title: Italian Beans
ingredients: 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 ounce chicken bouillon cube | 1 can kidney beans, undrained | 4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Brown and drain sausage, add the rest of the ingredients and simmer on low heat for 2 hours on low heat or on stove top.  The longer you cook, the more flavor you will have.

title: Hot Italian Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 container fresh tuna, drained ( i substituted canned drained tuna ) | 1 cup peeled jicama | 1/2 cup sweet mixed pickled cherry tomatoes | 2 cloves | 4 ounces shredded pecorino cheese or 4 ounces shredded parmesan cheese | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 cup scallion or 1 cup green onion, chopped | 1 small head of cabbage, shredded
instructions: Chop scallions, and put in 3 separate bowls.  Drain tuna, removing any excess meat and leaving about 1/2 cup of juice.  Rinse tomatoes and pickles and cut into wedges.  Slice cabbage, and separate tops from leaves, cutting into smaller pieces, and put in larger bowls.  Slice the cabbages into 1/4 slices, about 2 large ones and 2 small ones, and put in larger bowls.  Soak the yeast in a little warm water, then sprinkle over the cheese.  Combine tuna, scallions, and cherries in a bowl.  Add the yeast mixture and combine well.  If you don't have yeast, it may be mixed with a bit water and added to the tuna mixture when combining.  Refrigerate the tuna solution, stirring occasionally if you haven't used all of the liquid already. .  After the flavors have been blended, pour into 3 sterilized jars.  Top with the cheese, and cover with lids and screwbands, screwbands or rubber grips.  Let stand in a warm place for 8 days.  To serve, rinse the cabbage, and toss in a bowl with the lemon juice.  Add to the tomato mix in smaller bowls.

Random Ingredients: avocado,crescent dinner,peanut oil,walnut,sun tomato,wheat flour,saffron strand,red lentil
title: Cake With Lentils and Sun Dried Tomatoes(Shrikhand Ma'aroon)
ingredients: 2 cans crescent dinner rolls ( i use the kikkoman brand 7-counts ) | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato | 1 pinch saffron strand | 1/4 cup red lentil, soaked in water for 30 minutes | 1/4 cup peanuts, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup walnuts, roughly coarsely chopped | 1 avocado, sliced thinly | flaky wheat flour
instructions: Open the cans of crescent rolls and unroll from 1/2 & 1/2 and place onto a large cookie tray.  Spray the pan with cooking spray and place it on the tray.  Separate the two cresent rolls in two, roll about one third of a cup or small cup of walnuts into a ball and then flatten out into a 4 inch circle, set aside.  Slice the sun dried tomatoes into rounds, drain the soaking water and place into an ovenproof dish and set aside.  Season the sun dried tomatoes with a pinch salt.  Combine the lentils, peanuts, walnuts, lentils mixture, and saffron strands in the bowl that you will be using and mix well.  Spread 1/4 cup of the lentil mixture onto the bottom of a cresent roll half and place in the centre of the cresent dough.  Top with the remaining dough, spread the lentil mixture evenly, wrap and seal the dough around the lentil mixture.  Place the cresent roll on a floured baking tray, spread the chopped avocado over the dough and bake in a moderately hot oven for 10 - 15 minutes until the cake is heated through and it is hot.  Serve warm or at room temperature.  Store for up to six days before using for best results.

title: Spanish Littleneck Clams
ingredients: 1 cup halved ripe raspberries | 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon lemon extract | 1/8 teaspoon smoked paprika | 1 pound littleneck clams, scrubbed and debearded | 1 cup chopped fresh raspberries
instructions: Rinse the clams then in a large bowl of cold water, cover and let sit until the clams open, about 2 minutes.  Discard any clams that do not close when tapped.  Drain clams, shaking the bowl to get rid of any sand that forms.  Place the raspberries in a small bowl, add the olive oil, lemon extract, paprika and 1/4 cup rind and toss to combine.  Scrub the clams under cold running water until the clams open.  Wash and dry them a few minutes.  Remove the clams from the shells, removing any which are still closed.  Rinse and drain the clams.  Fill a large pot with water, add just enough to cover the clams and bring to a boil.  Add the clams and any shell fragments to the water and cook them, covered, over high heat for 3 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove them and add them to a large platter or serving platter.  Gently toss the raspberries into the warm broth and discard any clams that did not open.  Pour the clams and raspberries over the clams and serve.

Random Ingredients: italian seasoning,port wine,onion soup mix,pork loin
title: French Dip Pork Loins
ingredients: 4 -6 large pork loin | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1/4 cup port wine | 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Brown pork loins in hot pan with onion soup mix.  Mix remaining ingredients together and add to pork loins, turning well.  Bake uncovered at 350 for 60 - 65 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 155 degrees.

title: Tender Korean Potatoes
ingredients: 500 g potatoes, scrubbed but peeled | 2 tablespoons tamari soy sauce | 1 red peppers or 1 green pepper, cut up ( optional )
instructions: In a large frying pan put steamed potatoes, 2 tbsp tamari and pepper.  Mix well and bring to boil.  Cover and reduce to simmer.  Cook, stirring occasionally until potatoes are tender about 30 - 45 minutes.

title: Orange Beef With Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 lb stewing beef, cut into slivers | 2/3 cup basmati rice, cooked | 1/3 cup yoghurt, yogurt, low-fat | 2 1/2 cups ice water, divided | 2 tablespoons radishes, chopped, divided | 1 cup broccoli, diced | 1/4 cup mango, diced, peeled
instructions: Mix all ingredients and set in the refridgerator.  Add more ice water, if needed, to create a slurry.  Heat and serve in bowl with sliced radish and a sprinkle of sliced mango.

title: Mexican Spinach
ingredients: 4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 8 cups fresh spinach leaves, cleaned and dried | 1/4 cup tequila | 1 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Place the yeast in a large bowl in a warm place for 5 to 7 minutes or until bubbly.  Toss in the spinach and enough water to yield 3 1/2 cups.  Allow to stand for 1 to 2 minutes.  Rinse with cold water and drain.  Rinse with cold water.  Transfer to a large bowl and sprinkle with tequila.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm place until doubled in volume, about 3 hours.  Punch down, cover with a towel, and let stand 10 minutes to steam.  Remove plastic wrap and set aside for 15 minutes to steam excess moisture.  Discard any loose moisture.  Cut spinach into large chunks.  Return the spinach to the bowl and mix well.  Cover and set aside until it is very bubbly again, about 20 minutes.  While the spinach is steaming, heat the canola oil in a 12 inch skillet over moderate heat until hot, but not smoking.  Add the spinach mixture and cook, stirring to combine, for 3 to 4 minutes or until the spinach becomes bright green and slightly crisp.  Do not overcook.  Remove skillet from heat and let cool for 5 minutes.  Serve warm, garnished with sprigs of tarragon or thyme.

title: Sate Spring Rolls

instructions: Prepare the spring roll wrappers according to pack instructions or your own recipe.  Combine the coconut milk, brown gravy mix and soy sauce in a small saucepan and heat until warmed through.  Add in the chillie pepper and set aside.  Fry the asparagus in one tbsp of oil with half of the spring roll wrapper at a time for 1 - 2 minutes until the tips are crispy and starting to brown.  Remove from the heat, drain and set aside.  Fill each spring roll wrapper with about 4 tbsp of the filling, and roll up the wrapper around the sausages, pinching the ends as you go.  Repeat with all the spring roll wrappers.  Preheat an oven to 220c / 400f / gas brush each spring roll wrapper with some oil and cook asparagus rolls at 1/2 c / 400f / gas for about 3 - 4 minutes.  Serve the rolls straight away.  Tip.  You can use the coconut milk recipe in a jar or a tub.  If using a blender, you can simply cut the mixture in a food processor, along with a little milk or water to make a smooth sauce rather than a paste.  Tip, be careful when adding milk or water as you don't want a thick sauce.  Note 1, make sure you wash or soak your spring roll wrappers in hot water.  You want the wrappers to have room between each other for rising.

instructions: Peel and finely chop apple, remove core and cut in half then in half again.  Cut into very thin slices, cutting off excess moisture. Slice the remaining apples thinly and divide among serving bowls.  Spoon the chicken over the bread and toss.  Serve in a separate bowl.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Sprinkle the dried oregano on the onions, and distribute evenly over the entire package of onions.  Place the jar of onion rings cut side down on a large piece of aluminum foil, and place the sheet in the oven.  Bake in the preheated oven until the onions and dried oregano are the color on top.  Watch carefully, they're not ready just watch and they'll burn.  Remove the foil, and cool for 30 minutes, then cut into large pieces and spread on a serving loaf.  Serve at room temperature, or refrigerate for 2 days.

title: Frozen Mint & Ketchup

instructions: Heat ketchup and corn syrup in a metal bowl, until mixture turns dark brown.  Stir in chopped mint leaves.  Serve with ice.

title: Brown Lentil Guacamole - Vegan

instructions: Wash lentils and rinse well.  Then soak for about 20 minutes in plenty of water to which a bit of tamarind pulp has been added.  Rinse well and then drain. Spread lentils into a bowl or platter and let cool for 5 - 10 minutes.  Squeeze avocado from skin into the lentil mixture.  Cut avocado in 1/2 pieces and place in the bowl.  Add tabasco sauce.  Stir.  Sprinkle with chiles.  Serve immediately.  Note, the chiles can also be added to the lentil mixture without adding other seasonings.

title: Mexican Pasta Salad

When ready to serve, toss with the pasta and garnish with lemon wedges.

ingredients: 1 leg of lamb | 3 tablespoons natural-style peanut butter | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth | 1/2 cup milk chocolate | 20 prunes, pitted ( or use half of each ) | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 -3 ladyfingers
instructions: Trim the meat, remove any visible fat, and cut into pieces about 1 3/4 inch thick.  In a small frying pan, combine peanut butter and broth and bring to a boil. title: Carnival Pesto Tart Shells, Filled With Fruit & Achiote

instructions: Drain the prawns by placing them in warm water to soften.  Remove a few prawns from the water and put them in a medium bowl.  Add the basil pesto to the prawns and mix well.  Set aside.  To make the avocado achiote sauce mix everything together.  The avocado should have a little bite to it and it will be used up to a cup later. Chill for 5 hours or until serving time, then decorate with fresh fruit and toasted basil leaves and serve.

title: Bahama Mama Dessert

To serve, remove plastic wrap and spoon rum/rum mixture into glasses.  Garnish with coconut slices.  Note, i use jamaican mixed fruit dip.

instructions: In a bowl, mix the hazelnuts with the mustard, bouillon and olive oil.  Brush on each piece of meat and grill over medium heat for 10 minutes, basting as necessary, while turning and brushing with the vinaigrette while grilling.  Serve hot with the toasted hazelnut mixture.

instructions: Cook whole pappardsle whole in rapidly boiling water about 15 minutes.  Drain and rinse. Stirring constantly to remove any stray paste from the bottom of the pan add 1 celsius of cold water.  Cook the pasta about 10 minutes and drain.  When pasta is cooled, mix with the chipotle paste in a serving bowl.  Serve with parmesan if desired.

title: Grilled Steak With Shrimp and Poblano Chiles
