instructions: Prepare grill.  Combine butter and garlic salt in a small saucepan.  Heat over medium flame until butter is melted, about 1 minute.  Place steak, poblano pepper, and shrimp in a single layer on a greased grill rack.  Grill over high heat until shrimp turn pink, about 2 minutes per side.  Transfer steaks to cutting board and thinly slice.  Brush both sides with butter mixture.  Wrap.

title: Bibing Lettuce Chips
ingredients: 4 sheets pan-fried matzo | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/8 teaspoon white sugar | 1 head boston lettuce, rinsed well with cold water
instructions: Lay 1 sheet of fried nori on a dry towel.  Sprinkle with sugar.  Spread 1/4 of the fried nori on top of sugar on it.  Spread 1/4 of the oil onto the nori with a rolling pin or rolling pin.  Take a small sharp knife and carefully stretch it to about a quarter inch thickness.  Slice into about 2 inch squares.  Repeat with remaining nori and sugar.  Place on a towel lined cookie sheet.  Wrap the nori tightly in the nori and press to separate the layers while it preheats.  Repeat with each nori and remaining nori, oiling each one a few times.  In a large deep skillet, heat the remaining oil over high heat until very hot but not smoking.  Arrange two pieces of nori in the hot oil, laying them in a single layer so they can touch but not be crowded.  Flip after 2 to 3 minutes.  Cook for 1 minute, flip and cook 1 minute more.  Continue with remaining pieces, adding oil more if necessary.  Remove from the pan when golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Transfer to a paper towel lined plate.

title: Italian Saffron Rub for Meat

instructions: Using a mortar and pestle or the flat end of a table knife, combine all the saffron strands.  Add the fenugreek and hot sauce. When hot enough, add the meat and lightly salt.  Cook for 10 - 12 minutes until the internal temperature of the meat is about 160 degrees f, the internal temperature should be 160 degrees f and the meat should not be pink inside.  Remove from heat, cover and allow to stand to cool for about 15 minutes before serving.

title: Salsa Cabbage

instructions: Separate cabbage leaves, then wash and remove seeds in a colander.  Cut into quarters and clean.  Set aside.  Heat ghee in a large pan.  Add raisins. title: Peanut Butter With Herbed Rice Chunks

instructions: In a large bowl, combine peas, rice wine and chopped chocolate chips.  Add parmesan cheese.  Note, if using dry chocolate chips, stir frequently so as to not burn the chocolate.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Sprinkle with more parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Red Chili Wrapped Focaccia
ingredients: 2 heads lettuce leaves, washed and dried, torn into pieces | 3 red chili peppers, seeds removed, sliced finely
instructions: Warm the lettuce leaves over a low heat in a large nonstick frying pan, until wilted.  Add the chili or green chillies and continue to stir fry until they are a little soft.  Remove from heat.  As the focaccia mixture crisps, take a tablespoonful at a time and gently press it lightly with your fingers to remove excess moisture.  You want the focaccia to be pliable, but still able to form into a round ball.  Place in a serving platter, with the lettuce leaves and garnish with the slices of red chili.  Serve immediately.

title: Fiesta® Onion Dip

instructions: Peel & cut the onion into 1/8 dice.  Drain the onion.

title: Breadcrumbs in a Flash - Jackie French
ingredients: 2 lbs white bread ( crusts are fine and should come off the bread before bread ) | 2 cups unsalted dry roasted peanuts ( optional ) | 1 cup canola oil
instructions: Preparation time does not include baking time.  The bread should be very stale so it doesn't need to be stale.  It is alright to use a mixer if it does, but not essential.  Slice the bread into 2 or 3 smaller squares, about 1/4 or so thick enough for the breadcrumbs.  Cut 1/3 off the top of each section of bread.  Using a spoon or a pastry brush, drizzle the bread with a little peanut oil and put the next 3 slices of bread in it.  Then, using a fork, rub the bread together, trying not to tear off the crusts.  Then with a spatula, place the crumbed crumbs in a bowl, then cover with plastic wrap in the refrigerator.  The oil should not be able to reach the top of the bread.  The breadcrumbs might not be well coated, so leave the bowl at least a little to get the hang of it.  This bread can also be fried using a small amount of coconut oil or oil.  Fry the crumbs in hot oil until golden brown.  Drain them on paper.  Ideally, use a paper towel afterwards on account of the oil.  Allow the breadcrumbs to dry slightly before storing.  Variation, substitute 1/2 cup olive oil.  If you use a blender, then this may be easier to do.  Add 1 tbsp canola oil and grind to a smooth paste.  Note, if you use a mortar and pestle, you may grind it fine or you may use a spice mill or an electric coffee grinder.  The oil should have a smooth, somewhat oily taste.  Some recipes for this are full of oil, while others use a blender.  The peanut oil is very delicate so use more or less to reach this degree of sourness you want.

title: Korean Hamburgers(Bomonde Kalbi)

title: Cheese and Zucchini Gratin

Sprinkle with the cheese, lemon rind, celery seed and thyme leaves.  Bake in a moderately slow oven for 45 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve immediately, warm or at room temperature.

title: Anticuchos (Anticuchos)

Spread half of the baked beans with molasses, then scatter the whole can with the chiles over the beans.  Top with the muenster slices and wrap them in a foil wrapper.  Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted, about 30 minutes.

title: Steak with Beer, Onion And Garlic
ingredients: 3 pounds sirloin tip roast | 2 red onions, cut into slivers | 1 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed | kosher salt and pepper to taste | chili paste with garlic | 1 can dark beer
instructions: Score top of a deep, heavy bottomed roasting pan several times with a sharp knife.  Place roasting pan over medium high heat.  Heat until smoking.  Sprinkle the top of the roast with kosher salt and pepper.  Brown roast on both sides in the hot oil.  Be careful, this requires a high heat. Bake the roast, turning occasionally, until the internal temperature of the meat is 155 degrees f, about 2 - 2 1/2 hours.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 130 degrees f.  Remove the roast to a cutting board, and slice in 1/2 inch slices.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.

title: Pineapple Ham and Pineapple Spaghetti

When you want to eat it warm from the oven, or let it stand for about 10 minutes before serving, cut the ham into squares, then chop the ham into squares.  Serve with rice.  You may also serve this warm or cold, depending on how much flavor you want to have from the ham.

title: Quick Microwave Soya Yogurt

instructions: First microwave the soymilk for 20 seconds.  Take it out from the oven.  Put the soymilk in a bowl.  Add the kasuri methi and mix.  Add the chopped jicama and mix well.  Cover it with damp paper towel and let it sit for a few mins on low power level.  Turn off Microwave.  Transfer the mixture into another bowl.  Garnish it with a little extra kasuri methi.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Cranberry-Cherry Glaze

Let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely before storing in a covered container.

title: Mango-Chefta (Mixed Mushroom and Barley Puree)

instructions: Place rabbit and grated coconut in a pan.  Pour enough coconut milk to just cover the rabbit.  Boil on high until the liquid begins to evaporate. This is tasty enough for a main course at your next party, but it can also be used as a stuffing for chicken, sausage, sausages or other types of meat.

ingredients: 15 1/2 fluid ounces espresso, chilled | 1 tablespoon palm oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 2 teaspoons green pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso or 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 1/4 cups ice cubes, crushed
instructions: To make 1st measure, in a cocktail shaker filled with ice, pour 1/2 cup espresso into a large mug or 2 tall glasses filled with ice.  Add palm oil, liquid smoke, green pepper, and 1/4 tsp espresso.  Shake and strain cocktail into cocktail glass.  Use the remaining 1/4 cup espresso for garnish.

title: Easy Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 4 -5 tablespoons beef base or 4 -5 tablespoons beef consomme | 1 1/2 cups beef consomme | 2 tablespoons dashi | 1 cup grated pecorino romano cheese or 1 cup grated italian cheese
instructions: Heat the beef base in the pan.  In a medium bowl combine consume, cheese and dashi.  Add to meat mixture and simmer 1 hour over low heat.  Add in the cheese and let set 20 - 30 minutes or longer for the flavors to blend.

Random Ingredients: broccoli floret,sandwich bun,greek yogurt,red chili pepper,panko breadcrumb,hot water
title: Broccoli-Yogurt Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons panko breadcrumbs | 1 1/2 lbs broccoli florets, steamed with skin on | 2 tablespoons hot water | 1 teaspoon red chili pepper, deseeded and chopped | 1 cup hot sandwich bun, toasted
instructions: Combine the yogurt and panko.  Place the drained broccoli in a food processor and process until finely chopped and well mixed.  Add the hot water and chilies.  Blend again and season with salt and pepper.  Stir until the broccoli is well mixed in and the puree is smooth.  To serve, pile on the broccolic and top with the remaining toasted bun.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,white wine vinegar,phyllo pastry,kahlua,pie crust
title: Spicy Chocolate Bites
ingredients: 4 sheets pie crust | 20 leaves phyllo pastry, thawed according to package directions | 1/4 cup honey | 1/4 cup good quality white wine vinegar | chili pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  On an ungreased cookie sheet, lay out the pie crust sheets evenly.  Carefully transfer one sheet of phyllo into the center of a sheet of the phyllo and spread with another sheet.  Repeat layering and layering steps one more time, using two sheets each of phyllo, sugar, chili flakes, vinegar, and white wine vinegar in a tractor tread pattern on the edges of the crust to make sure the filling is spread to one even layer.  Fold the unused dough over the top and around the edges to create a log shape with two edges showing at the bottom.  Place the log on the cookie sheet and brush the remaining olive oil onto the top of the log.  Bake for 15 minutes then remove from the oven and brush with additional olive oil.  Allow the log to cool for 10 minutes before slicing, and serve while hot.

title: Aubergines in Sherry
ingredients: 4 aubergines | 2 tablespoons sherry wine or 2 tablespoons cooking wine
instructions: Using a large roasting tin, place all the ingredients in a large pan over a high heat, stir the saursse with a wooden spoon until the saursse is heated through.  Cover the pan tightly with foil and place the tin in the middle of the oven.  Bake in a preheated oven for around 45 minutes at 190c or until the aubergines are soft.  Remove from the oven and leave to stand, covered for at least 10 minutes before taking them out.  Discard any juice and peel on the skin.  Cut into wedges and serve with fresh bread and butter.

title: Artichokes With Capsicum (Crispy Artichokes)
ingredients: 400 g artichoke hearts ( small pieces, canned in a jar if you want to conserve the recipe ) | 1 large red capsicum ( red bell pepper )
instructions: Cut capsicum into 1 cm squares.  Crush artichokes into 1 cm thick pieces.  Add chopped artichokes to a fry pan with oil.  Cook over medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes until capsicum is tender.  Add capsicum to pan.  Add water to cover capsicum and artichoke mixture.  Bring to boil and boil rapidly until water is reduced by one third.  Serve with couscous.

title: Grandma Sylvia's Sausage Spread
ingredients: 1 package bulk pork sausage | 1 teaspoon dried oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place sausage in a large, heavy bottomed frying pan.  Heat over medium low heat until all of the fat has been absorbed.  Drain any excess fat from the sausage.  Crumble sausage into the pan.  Stir in oregano.  Cook and stir until mixture is thickened, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon peel,napa cabbage,chicken wing,red curry paste,sirloin,almond,ancho chile powder
title: Spicy Beef Salad #2
ingredients: 4 lbs sirloin | 1 head napa cabbage | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 5 1/2 ounces chicken wings | 1/4 cup almonds, toasted | 1/4 cup lemon peel | 7 tablespoons crushed ancho chile powder
instructions: Slice sirligoin crosswise and then into 1/4 inch wide strips on a cutting board.  Mix 1/4 cup hot water and curry paste in a large dish.  Add the sliced sirligini and cabbage and allow to marinate at room temperature for at least an hour.  Drain any excess water from the beef.  Dry meat with paper towels.  Combine 1/4 cup hot water with the almonds, lemon peel and ground chiles in a mixing bowl.  Pour the marinade over the meat and stir to coat evenly.  Allow to marinate in the refrigerator approximately an hour before serving.  Serve with rice and fresh flat bread.

title: My Favorite Cheese Phyllo Pizza
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh mozzarella cheese | 3/4 cup chopped walnuts | 1/2 teaspoon ketchup | 1/2 cup chopped green onion | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 4 sheets frozen phyllo pastry | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped semolina or 1/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Melt the gruyere or walnuts in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat and stir in the ketchup if using.  Spread onto a baking sheet.  Sprinkle onion and walnuts over gruyere or walnuts.  Sprinkle romano over pizza.  Bake in 400 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes until bubbly.  Cut phyllo in half and unfold.  Brush with some of the melted gruyere or walnuts, then cut a 3 inch layer into the dough.  Repeat layering process until all dough has been used.  Top with additional cheese, more walnuts, and any remaining cheese.  Bake in 400 degree oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Australian Zucchini and Prune Salad
ingredients: 1 zucchini, chopped | 1/2 cup halved dried prunes | 1/4 cup baby spinach or 1/4 cup baby kale | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon rind, grated | 1/3 cup beer ( lager style, like guinness ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon chinese five spice powder
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Enjoy.

title: Kielbasa (Sausages)
ingredients: 1 pound lean bacon | 1 pound link beef sausage | 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour for coating
instructions: Slice the smoked bacon slices into 1/2 inch pieces and set aside.  Place the meat into a large saucepan over medium high heat and place in a single layer.  Pour the bacon pieces on the top of the meat.  Place a heavy cast iron skillet in the skillet.  Place a lid on the skillet.  Cook, stirring often, slowly and constantly, for about 45 minutes.  Use a slotted spoon to remove the meat to a large bowl, leaving the fat in the skillet.  Use a slotted spoon to drain the fat from the skillet.  Place the sausage slices onto a plate and cover to keep warm.  Add a cup or more of water to the skillet and bring to boil.  Pour in enough flour to make a thick paste and stir until smooth.  Remove from heat and pour into a heavy skillet.  Cook and stir over medium heat for a few minutes to thicken the gravy.

title: Okra Wrapped in Fried Okra
ingredients: 1 package frozen okra | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1 tablespoon grand marnier ( optional ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons italian seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons egg substitute
instructions: Cook okra according to package directions.  Meanwhile, mix fish sauce, grand marnier, italian seasoning, and egg substitute in a small bowl.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add okra.  Cook, stirring often, 5 minutes or until golden brown and okra is tender.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: ice water,green olive,beef stew meat,coleslaw mix
title: Texas Beef Salad II
ingredients: 4 pounds beef stew meat, cubed | 1 package coleslaw mix | 1/2 cup ice water | 1 can sliced olives, drained
instructions: In a glass baking dish, mix stew meat, coleslaw mix, ice water and olives.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: Gluten Free and Dairy Free Chocolate Fondue
ingredients: 1 stalk celery ( to garnish ) | 1 1/3 cups skim milk chocolate | 4 tablespoons dry vermouth | 3 tablespoons apple juice | 1 tablespoon dried herbes de provence | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum ( optional ) | 12 asparagus spears ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: Cut celery in half, then cut diagonally into 2 lengths and then into 1/4 wedges.  You should have approximately 12 to 14 pieces.  Place celery and candy pieces into a bowl and cover with boiling water and let stand for 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain and transfer to another bowl, along with chocolate and vermouth and allow melted and cooled slightly, then stir in apple juice, herbes de provence and xanthan gum for a few seconds until combined.  Place reserved melted chocolate in a small bowl and add to top of melted chocolate.  Place an asparagus spear onto top of melted chocolate and drizzle with melted chocolate for a pretty effect.  You can also toss them in and dip into the fondue too.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,extra virgin olive oil,italian sausage,bean,red onion
title: Italian Sausage, Beans & Onions With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb italian sweet sausage | 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 medium red onion, thinly sliced | 1 bag mixed fresh sauteed beans | 2 -3 cups fresh mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Slice the sausage into 1 in long, thin rounds.  Cook the sausages in extra virgin olive oil until done, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Heat olive oil in a large skillet on medium heat.  Add the onion, brown well.  Add the sausages and mushrooms and cook an additional 5 - 6 minutes, or until browned.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,mint leaf,brown onion,dijon mustard,lingonberry preserve,garlic
title: Lingonberry Mustard
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dijon mustard | 4 cloves garlic, thinly sliced | 3 tablespoons brown onion, minced | 1 cup lingonberry preserves, divided | 3 tablespoons dry irish cream | 4 large fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and set over medium heat.  Add mustard, garlic and onion to pan and sauté, stirring frequently until onion is soft, about 12 minutes.  Add 1/2 cup preserves and remaining preserves to pan and gently stir to mix and heat through, about 2 minutes.  Add mint leaves and gently stir to coat.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,creamy peanut butter,extra sharp cheddar cheese,brown sugar,italian parsley
title: Peanut Butter Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon creamy peanut butter | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 head lettuce leaves ( optional )
instructions: In food processor, combine the peanut butter, peanut butter and brown sugar.  Process until smooth.  Stir in parsley.  Set aside.  Cut each lettuce head in half, and separate the leaves, if desired.  Place half of the peanut butter mixture on each leaf.  Fold, and roll up tightly.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: coleslaw mix,water,chili paste,rock salt,honeydew melon,serrano chilies,parsnip
title: Honeydew-Peppered Coleslaw
ingredients: 1/2 lb coleslaw mix or 1/2 lb other greens, such as spinach, cabbage, or red cabbage | 1/4 lb parsnip, peeled and thinly sliced ( kippered ) | 2 -3 serrano chilies, stemmed and finely minced ( less, if desired ) | 1/4 lb honeydew melon | 1/2 teaspoon hot chili paste ( such as sambal oelek ) | 2 -4 tablespoons water | 1 teaspoon rock salt or 1 teaspoon sea salt, to taste
instructions: Cut slashes across brine end of melons.  Insert wooden picks into brine and place around edge of a large bamboo or glass bowl with melon.  Drain juice from melon, then add juice.  If desired, mix well.  Cover and refrigerate at least one hour to bring flavors together.  When ready to serve, remove strings and cut slits in melon, if desired.  Serve with coleslaw.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,provolone cheese,white sugar,jalapeno pepper,chicken bouillon cube,cardamom seed,red chili powder,curry powder
title: Portuguese Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cannellini beans | 3/4 cup chicken bouillon cube | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar | 1/4 teaspoon curry powder | 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seeds | 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 jalapeno pepper, diced | 1/4 cup grated provolone cheese
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans, then transfer to a serving bowl.  In a medium bowl, combine the chicken bouillon, white sugar, curry powder, cardamom, red chilli, and jalapeno.  Stir in the reserved bean mixture and cheese.  Chill before serving.

title: Cherry Sour Cream Cheese Rollups
ingredients: 12 ounces cream cheese, softened | 1 cup sifted cake flour | 1/8 teaspoon celery salt | 1/8 teaspoon pepper | 2 fresh maraschino cherries or 2 canned cherries
instructions: Mix cream cheese and flour together.  Stir in seasonings with cherries.  Roll into balls.  Slit top and bottom of each roll to prevent the sour cream cheese mixture from oozing out while rolling.  Allow to chill until ready to use, but before serving.

Random Ingredients: manchego cheese,pickling salt,green chili,lettuce leaf,mushroom stem,linguine,cream mushroom soup
title: Linguine with Mushrooms, Goat Cheese and Green Chilis
ingredients: 1 package linguine, uncooked | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/2 cup shredded manchego cheese | 1/4 cup pickling salt, or more to taste | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, drained | 1/4 cup chopped green chili | 2 1/4-ounce cans sliced pickled mushroom stems and pieces, drained
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions.  Drain, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid.  Combine reserved liquid, cream of mushroom soup, cheese, pickling salt, mushrooms, green chilies, and noodles in a large saucepan, and heat to boiling.  Stir soup mixture into cooked linguine, and heat to boiling, but not boiling.  Stir in reserved mushroom cooking liquid one at a time.  Garnish with stems of scallions.  Serve in warm soup bowls.

title: Aussie Baked Cheese
ingredients: 600 g of grated swiss cheese | 250 g soft unsalted buttery cheese | 1/3 cup palm sugar or 1/3 cup coarsely grated raw sugar
instructions: Line a 8 cm round cake tin with aluminium foil.  Spread the soft buttery cheese over 1/3 of the tin, leaving 1 cm covering over all the cheese.  Spread the grated cheese over the cheese.  Bake in a preheated oven for 20 mins or until set and golden.  Allow to cool slightly then spread the grated sugar over the top.  Serve with any favourites.

title: Bakewell Refrigerator Seasoning Mix  (Olive Oil)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons baking soda | 2 tablespoons dried oregano
instructions: In a large bowl add all of the ingredients and mix together.

Random Ingredients: orange blossom water,steak,tuna,sage,pineapple chunk,phyllo pastry,cilantro leaf,ketjap manis
title: Tuna and Pineapple Pizza(Bun Yum)
ingredients: 500 g tuna, cooked & sliced into chunks | 1/2 cup pineapple chunk ( the fresh can in chunks or chunks is fine ) | 1/2 teaspoon sage | 1/2 teaspoon cilantro leaf ( dried if fresh ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange blossom water | 1/4 teaspoon ketjap mani ( soy sauce ) | 4 sheets phyllo pastry | 1/4 - 1/2 cup steamed shredded soy cheese or 1/4-1/2 cup manchego cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c /gas slice the tuna into quarters lengthways and place on a tray lined with baking paper.  Set aside while you prepare the rest of the pizza.  Mix together the chopped pineapple, the remaining ingredients, seasonings and sauce and place on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Place over a tray and bake for about 20 minutes.  Remove from the oven and remove tray from the oven and brush lightly with the marinade.  Set aside for 5 minutes then top with the shredded cheese.  Continue to bake for another 2 minutes until cheese is completely melted.  Allow to cool slightly before slicing into squares.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,white pepper,pork sausage,kidney bean,chili oil,yellow onion
title: Chocolate and Hot Sausage Chili
ingredients: 2 cups canned kidney beans ( drain well ) | 1 large yellow onion, diced | 2 lbs pork sausages | 2 teaspoons white pepper | 1 tablespoon cilantro or 1 tablespoon parsley, chopped | 1 1/3 tablespoons chili oil
instructions: Brown sausages in olive oil over medium heat in skillet, breaking up as you go.  Add kidney beans, diced onion and white pepper.  Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes.  Mix in chopped parsley and cilantro.  Simmer 30 minutes more, stirring occasionally.

title: Southwest Spanish Rice and Squash (Pumpkin)
ingredients: 4 poblano chiles | 4 yellow squash | 1 envelope taco seasoning | 1 cup basmati rice or 1 cup rice | 4 tablespoons salsa and taco seasoning ( your favorite recipe and tabasco )
instructions: In large skillet on medium high, heat poblanos, squash and taco seasoning in small amount of cooking oil, stirring often.  When the poblanos and squash look slightly charred on each side, remove from skillet and place in a food processor with 1/4 cup water for puree.  Pour into skillet with puree in skillet, stir.  Cover.

title: Tomato Primavera (Tranos in Tomato Cream)
ingredients: 1 lb quinoa | 1 1/2 lbs cabbage, finely shredded | 28 ounces crushed tomatoes in puree, canned | 2 -3 bay scallops, whole but left whole ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain the quinoa well.  Place cabbage in a large pot and bring to a boil.  Cook over high heat until cabbage wilts slightly, about 5 minutes for the cabbage, and 10 minutes for the quinoa.  Place quinoa in a colander and press out excess water.  Drain excess water and reserve.  Place quinoa, cabbage and tomatoes in a 4 quart saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, until the quinoa is tender and liquid has been absorbed.  Stir occasionally.  Remove and discard bay scallops, if using.  Spoon the remaining sauce into warm bowls and top with scallops.

title: Roasted Turkey Italian Sausage
ingredients: 1/2 lb all-pourpose dried small italian sausages or 1/2 lb sweet italian sausage, casings removed ( 16 - 19 meatballs ) | 1/2 cup dried fruit peel or 1/2 cup candied mixed peppercorn | 1/4 cup black olives, pitted, halved | 1/4 cup dried mixed fruit peel | 6 cups cooked turkey, thinly sliced, with skin | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped mixed peppercorns | 8 ounces mostaccioli pasta, cooked ( linguine or rotelle )
instructions: Place sausages in a large, sealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,turkey,ham,lemon wedge,vanilla ice cream,white wine vinegar,applesauce,sirloin
title: Caribbean Turkey Meatballs
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs ground sirloin | 2 tablespoons red peppers, finely chopped ( i used canned diced fire roasted red peppers ) | 8 ounces lean ham, finely chopped | 8 ounces applesauce, can use a combination in place of applesauce | 3 tablespoons applesauce | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons vanilla-flavored ice cream | lemon wedge ( optional )
instructions: Mix the ground sirloin together with the red pepper, ham, applesauce, applesauce, vinegar, and vanilla.

title: Corn and Oyster Dip
ingredients: 1 lb fresh corn, kernels ( fresh corn is best, frozen corn will work too ) | 1 lb raw oyster | 1 spanish onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Place the corn in a 9x13 inch dish.  To clean and dry the corn, rinse the corn under cold water.  Dry it.  Soak the oysters in just enough water to cover until the shell becomes hard, then remove the shell and set aside.  Split the shell in half lengthwise, then remove the choke by cutting a slits or a blade along one side.  Hold each half shell with one hand and use the knife to pull the corn out of the shells.  Put the corn back into the shell, then spread the oysters over top in a decorative manner.  Add a layer of onion slices.  Dot with pieces of breadcrumbs.  The last layer should be of bread crumbs.  You can make this in advance and let it stand at room temperature covered for up to 2 hours before serving.  Serve it warm, sprinkled with the bread crumbs and accompanied by the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: dill,colby cheese,phyllo pastry,flat leaf italian parsley,cardamom pod,apricot preserve,cilantro stem,turbinado sugar
title: Vegetable Phyllo Triangles
ingredients:
1 cup fat-free apricot preserves | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro stems ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar ( aka.
    - sugar in the raw ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 2 packages frozen pastry sheets ( 9 sheets ) | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh dill | 16 fresh, large fresh, cilantro stems ( optional )
instructions: Place apricot preserves in medium bowl.  Stir in parsley, cilantro, 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar, cardamon, and remaining 2 1/2 tablespoons turbinado sugar until well blended.  Place 3 sheets frozen phyllo in a large resealable plastic bag.  Top with half the apricot mixture.

title: Okra with Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pinch shrimp paste | 1 pound butternut squash, peeled and cubed | 1 package frozen okra, thawed and drained | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | toppings for topping
instructions: Stir the shrimp paste and shrimp paste into the squash.  Transfer squash to a large skillet with enough oil to cover the bottom.  Layer okra and okra into the skillet.

title: Tostones
ingredients: 1 cup corn oil | 1 red and white rind of orange | chunky salsa
instructions: Break rind from the orange with a vegetable peeler.  Wash in several changes of water.  Dry thoroughly.  Using a vegetable peeler, peel away all white pith and pith at the outside edges.  Cut off about 1/2 inch of rind from the orange with a thin slice of orange on the rind.  Carefully scrape away the browned rind, exposing skin.  Cut 1/2 inch pieces off the rind with a sharp knife.  Heat the corn oil in a skillet to 360 degrees f using caution, as the oil can splatter.  Deeply fry the pieces 4 to 6 at a time.  They will look very pale, but will turn golden and crisp once fried.  Remove them and drain on paper towels.  Serve hot.  Note, if you get a piece with pith left over, it can be used for tacos.  Also, if you use corn oil to fry onions, you can fry the onions.

title: Pumpkin Cheese Ravioli
ingredients: 1/2 cup vermicelli | 1 cup pumpkin | 1 cup chopped fresh pumpkin | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/2 cup prepared chutney | 8 graham cracker crusts
instructions: In a medium bowl combine vermicelli, pumpkin, pumpkin and soy sauce.  Mix well.  Spread into graham cracker crusts.  Bake at 400 for 15 minutes, or until golden.

title: Faux Crunchy
ingredients: 3/4 cup shredded coconut oil | 1 1/2 pounds cucumbers, peeled and coarsely chopped | 2 1/2 cups marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups purple onions, chopped, divided | 1 head iceberg lettuce, rinsed and dried
instructions: In a large bowl, mix coconut oil, cucumber, marshmallows, half of the onions, and 1 cup lettuce.  Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Chile Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: Heat a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Pour enough oil in the pan to almost cover the bottom of the pan.  Drop the asafoetida powder into the pan while shaking the skillet from time to time to avoid burning the asafetida.  When the asafoetida has firmed up and turned dark golden brown, about 10 minutes, reduce heat to medium low, and grind the mixture into a paste using an electric coffee grinder.

title: Cornflake Pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup corn flakes, lightly crushed | 12 baby carrots, finely grated | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 tablespoon oil
instructions: Combine the corn flakes and carrots in a bowl.  Stir in the flour and oil with a fork.  The mixture should be dry but not crumbly.  Let rest for a few minutes.  Heat a large non stick frypan until very hot.  Spread a ladleful of the batter to the middle of the pan, making a 1/4 inch thick patty.  It should be 2 inches in diameter.  Cook the pancake one or two at a time for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the underside appears dry.

title: Salsa-Salsa Fritters
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup demerara sugar | 1 jar picante sauce or 1 jar salsa, of your choice
instructions: Warm the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the sugar and simmer 1 minute.  Remove from heat and stir in the salsa until well blended.  Serve the hot fritters with the salsa.

title: Dundee Pinto Bean and Salmon Spread
ingredients: 1 can pinto beans, rinsed and well drained | 2 1/2 ounces sour mixed fruit chili hot chutney | 3 ounces fresh ricotta cheese | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: Mix together the drained beans, chutney, ricotta and salmon.  Place in a bowl with a lid or on a large flat baking tray.  Wash hands and pat dry the inside of the bowl and spoon mixture in the middle.  Seal the bowl or wrap well.  Place on a plate and refrigerate and allow to chill in the refrigerator for about 3 hours or overnight.

title: Roast Beef with Horseradish - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 lb roast beef | 1 tablespoon horseradish ( i use boursin horseradish which has been prepared horseradish and is thick and has a strong flavour ) | 2 teaspoons sugar | 1 slice bread ( i use brioche thick plain bread ) | 1 teaspoon dried flat leaf parsley
instructions: Trim any fat of the meat.  Use a sharp knife to slice the meat into thin slices, about 3/4” across.  Put beef, horseradish and sugar in a small bowl.  Sprinkle with the bread and parsley, tossing just until it's coated.  Place it in the crock pot, and turn on low.  Cook an hour or two on high, or until the beef is very tender.  I usually leave it on low for at least 5 hours, as it always has to be cooked to your liking note, if cooking on low, i leave the beef on high for about 1 hour, then turn it on high for another hour or two.  The meat should be meltingly and crusty.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,gruyere cheese,coffee,cake flour,cream chicken soup,madras curry powder,spice
title: Madras Curry Cheesecake
ingredients: 500 ml cream of chicken soup | 300 g confectioners'sugar | 8 -10 g madras curry powder, such as madras ( i use madras curry powder, but most store brandy gives that special apear ) | 4 tablespoons cake flour | 2 large round cake flour ( if you use round, cut it into four equal squares of baking paper ) | 100 g gruyere cheese, grated, plus extra for sprinkling on top ( optional ) | 300 ml sweetened condensed milk | 200 ml hot dark instant coffee, such as decoction
instructions: Mix cream of chicken soup and confectioners' sugar in a blender until smooth.  Add curry powder and beat well.  Pour half of the soup mixture into a round cake pan and spread out evenly with a spatula.  Top with half of the cheese and spread over half of the soup mixture.  Cover the cheese with half the soups mixture.  Spread over soup.  Add rest of the soups and then the rest of the soup and cheese.  Make sure everything is evenly spread over the soups.  If you use a round cake pan, lay on a baking paper lined cookie sheet and spread over the soups.  Make sure the surface is smooth and does not cling up to the cookie sheet.  Allow to rest while you do the next step.  Preheat oven oven to 300º.  Make the coffee syrup and cream the coffee according to the instructions given on the package.  Pour coffee syrup and cream over the soups completely covering the soups completely.  Sprinkle grated gruyere cheese over the cheese.  Press down on the cookie to make sure the cheese has set through.  Place into the center of the oven and bake for 45 - 50 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from oven, spread the rest of the soups over the whole cake in the center and allow to cool before taking it out of the oven.  Cut into squares.  Serve or store in an airtight plastic container in the fridge.

title: Creamy Banana Pepper Dip
ingredients: 2 bananas peppers, chopped | 2 cups mayonnaise | 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup mayonnaise | 1 can chopped green chili salsa
instructions: Cook sliced bananas in hot water until firm but not mushy.  Drain.  In a food processor, combine green chili salsa and mayonnaise.  Process until smooth.  Add bananas and blend until well blended.  Transfer mixture into a casserole dish.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,black bean sauce,mache,flat leaf parsley,macaroni,brown onion,tomato puree
title: Stir-Fry Macaroni and Bean Salad
ingredients: 250 g macaroni | 1 brown onion, finely chopped | 1/2 red pepper, finely sliced | 410 g cannelloni beans in tomato puree | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon black bean sauce | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente.  Drain pasta, toss with combined pasta, onion & pepper.

title: Kiwi Diced Red Capsicum and Kiwi Salad
ingredients: 4 kiwi | 2 red capsicums, cut in 1 cm cubes | 3 cups cooked rice wine vinegar | 250 ml hot broth | 1/4 cup mixed dried fruit, thawed | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon amaretto
instructions: Slice kiwifruit into very thin, wide strips.  Place capsicum strips across base of serving plate, top with capsicum, toss.  Combine the vinegar, broth, apricot & cream of tartar in small saucepan.  Bring to boil, stirring until smooth.  Divide amongst serving bowls, top with kiwifruit & cocoa & drizzle with warm marinade.

title: Cornflake Crisp
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups corn flakes | 1/2 cup creamed horseradish | 1/2 teaspoon prepared horseradish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix corn flakes, creamed horseradish, and prepared horseradish together in a bowl with a fork.

Random Ingredients: walnut,almond,pork loin roast,egg yolk,navy bean,lemon lime beverage
title: Langostracian (Pork Loin With Navy Beans)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork loin roast | 3 cups navy beans, soaked overnight | 5 large egg yolks | 1 cup slivered almonds | 2 cups sweetened condensed lemon-lime beverage ( such as sprite ) | 1/2 cup diced walnuts

title: Dubliner Ham
ingredients: 2 lbs ham | 1 tablespoon bouquet garni | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1 pint double cream
instructions: Remove the membrane from the ham and cut into cubes.  Place into a large pan of boiling water and simmer covered for 15 minutes.  Remove the ham from the water and put to one side and leave to stand.  Remove the fat and skin.  Sprinkle the inside of the pan with the bouquet garni and whiskey, and pour in the cream.  Add a little extra stock if it starts to curdle.  Bring to the boil then simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Lobster Tail and Asparagus (Chinese Style)
ingredients: 20 lobster tails | 10 sticks fresh asparagus | 1 tablespoon lemon | 1/2 tablespoon szechuan peppercorns | 2 teaspoons whole cloves | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh dill
instructions: Prepare the lobster tails as follows, boil 3 fresh lobster tails for 2 minutes, drain and set aside in a clean bowl.  Remove the lobsters and asparagus from the shells and discard.  Cut the lobster tails in half.  Rinse the lobster tail under cold water, and then slice each half into 3 pieces.  Remove the white membrane from the asparagus.  Blanch the asparagus in boiling water until just crisp and tender.

title: Linguica
ingredients: 1 lb linguica ( or other thick pasta ) | 1/2 lb cubed cooked ham | 1/2 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Cook linguica in a large pot of boiling water to al dente stage, about 10 minutes.  Drain and cool linguica over a bowl of ice water until cold, 3 - 5 minutes.  Drain linguica and set aside.  Sprinkle cubed ham over linguica.  Mix lime juice and remaining ingredients.  Place linguica in serving bowl and serve.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash & Poblano Chile Strips
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, halved, seeded & cut in 1-inch pieces | 1 large poblano chile
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat.  Spray the broiler rack with nonstick cooking spray.  Brush squash with oil.  Thread squash and poblano on four metal skewers. .  Place skewers on grill.  Cook until squash is tender and squash is darkly roasted, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork loin,chili pepper flake,shell pasta,apricot preserve,water,grain rice,puff pastry,mexican corn
title: Pork Stuffed Pastry With Mexican Spices
ingredients: 1 cup cooked long-grain rice, cooled | 2 -3 cups finely chopped smoked pork loin | 1 cup apricot preserves | 1 cup water | 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes ( gochu garu to taste or adjust to personal taste ) | 3 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed or 2 pints readymade puff pastry | 3 cups water | 1 cup mexican-style corn or | 1 cup frozen mexican style corn
instructions: Cook rice in 3 cups water, stirring till it is just about cooked though.  Drain well.  Mix rice with pork, apricot preserves and 1/2 tablespoon each of chili pepper flakes and the water.  Spread mixture on one sheet of the puff pastry, leaving 1/4 inch at the edge of the dough.  Fold the remaining pastry over the filling.  Using the other half of the puff pastry to cover the top, lightly prick some holes in the dough using a fork.  Cut a slit into the pastry just radiating along the edge from the center of it to prevent steam from escaping.  Repeat for all the pastry and filling.  Line a baking sheet with foil and brush it lightly with water.  Brush pastry with water and sprinkle on any remaining filling.  Bake at 375 degrees or until pastry is golden brown.

title: Almond-Peanut Butter Wrapped in Prosciutto
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh prosciutto | 6 tablespoons smooth peanut butter ( smooth, creamy or crunchy ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Remove the ham from the refrigerator and cut in 4 equal pieces.  Roll each piece into a ball with a tablespoon of peanut butter.  Put the two pieces on a serving platter, fold end over the top and continue with other piece of ham.  Sprinkle with vanilla sugar and almond essence.  Serve immediately or store in refrigerator.

title: Rotel-Cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 can rotel ( drained ) | 2 tablespoons molasses | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 small maui onion
instructions: Boil a bit of water.  Cut cauliflower in half then remove core put on a tray.  In a small bowl, mix molasses, rice wine and maui onion.  In another cup pour water and 1/2 of the molasses mixture, mix.  Put cauliflower/rotels in bowl and pour molasses liquid over.  Put to boil with lid on.  Let cook for 20 minutes.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: roasting chicken,baking soda,green onion,horseradish,cream cheese spread,pork loin roast
title: Smoky Roast Pork Po' Boy
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens, quartered | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1/2 teaspoon prepared horseradish | 4 packages cream cheese spread | 4 green onions, chopped | 1 cup sliced smoked pork loin roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Prepare a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Place chicken quarter side up into the bottom of the dish.  Sprinkle baking soda over chicken.  Place horseradish on top of chicken to flavor the dish.  Stir cream cheese, green onions, and smoked pork together in a bowl.  Spread cream cheese mixture over chicken.  Transfer chicken to the prepared baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the pulled pork is 160 degrees f, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,greek yogurt,cheese,tomato green chile pepper,thyme sprig,wheat flour,beef stew meat
title: Carne Guisada (Stew)
ingredients: 1/2 pound beef stew meat, cubed | 1/2 teaspoon thyme sprigs | 1 can petite diced tomatoes with green chile peppers, drained | 1 container greek-style yogurt | 2 tablespoons wheat flour | 1 can diced plum tomatoes with green chile peppers | 2 tablespoons shredded cheese
instructions: Place the cubed stew meat and thyme in a saucepan, and fill with water to cover.  Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: green olive,beef chuck,tuna,chili powder,lemon juice,milk,chicken thigh
title: Tuna-Dipped Beef and Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 3 cans refrigerated deli tuna ( about 3/4 cup ) | 2 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut in 1 1/2-inch cubes | 3 cans chicken thighs, drained | 1/3 cup canned sliced green olives, drained | 1/3 cup canned chopped green olives, drained | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice | 2 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 1 1/2 cups powdered milk
instructions: Combine tuna juice, chuck, chicken, olives, lemon juice, chili powder, and 1 cup powdered milk.  Stir.  Arrange 1/3 of tuna mixture in a 15 x 10 baking pan coated with cooking spray, overlapping.  Repeat layers.  Bake at 375°f 1 hour or until instant read thermometer reads 160°c.  Remove cover from pan.  Drizzle with remaining glaze.  Cut casserole into fourths.

title: Korean Grilled Eggs
ingredients: 4 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 2 shallots, minced | 2 pimento pepper, minced | 1 boneless sirloin, sliced | 8 hard-cooked eggs, peeled
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, warm sesame oil.  Stir in shallots, green chile peppers, and pimentos pepper.  Cook and stir 30 seconds.  Add sirloin.  Cook 5 to 10 minutes, or until no longer pink and juices run clear.  Push sirloin and green onion slices into bean sprouts to form a crusty base.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: quinoa,tabasco sauce,clam juice chicken stock,caraway seed,kaffir lime leaf,passata
title: Hot Chilled Quinoa and Clams
ingredients: 600 g quinoa, rinsed | 2 cups clam juice or 2 cups chicken stock | 1 -2 tablespoon crushed caraway seed | 1 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 3 kaffir lime leaves | 150 ml jarrata, cut into thin wedges ( thick italian rolls )
instructions: Place quinoa, clam juice and carraway seeds in a large pan or stockpot.  Stir over medium heat for 5 minutes or until stock boils.  Add kaffir leaves and reduce heat to low.  Cover and allow quinoa to swell for 3 - 4 hours or until all liquid is absorbed and grains are tender.  Stir once or twice during cooking.  Transfer to a large bowl and stir in 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1 cup of warm water.  Cover and refrigerate until cold and cold enough to handle.  Toss with a mixture of 1 tablespoon of melted margarine and 1 tablespoon of cooking oil.  Season with salt, pepper, sugar, pepper and paprika.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: simple syrup,cream mushroom soup,beef eye,lingonberry,cream cheese
title: Lingonberry-Sour Creamed Eye Beef Roast
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese, softened | 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1 beef eye roast | 1 can lingonberries
instructions: Mix softened cream cheese, cream of mushroom soup, syrup and roast beef together.  Spoon into a loaf pan and top with lingonberry.  This can also be placed in a crockpot as well, and cook on high for 4 hours or until tender.

title: Sumac-Marinated Shiitake Mushrooms on Skewers for Two
ingredients: 12 dried shiitake mushrooms | 1/4 cup sumac ( or more )
instructions: Remove stems, wash, wipe dry and trim stems.  Remove gills on mushroom caps.  Place mushrooms in a glass or ceramic dish.  Add sumac, cover and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours.  Soak skewers 8 hours or over night at room temperature.  Preheat grill, oil or butter rack.  Thread mushrooms directly onto skewers.  Grill or broil for about 4 minutes or as desired.

title: Adobo
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground beef | 3 tablespoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 teaspoon ground annatto seed | 1 can coconut milk
instructions: Mix all ingredients together except the coconut milk.  Form mixture into small balls on a greased cookie sheet lined with wax paper.  Bake in a preheated 350 f oven for 25 minutes or until cooked.  Heat coconut milk until boiling then reduce to a thick paste.  Serve with meat and coconut flavored rice.

title: Ancho Chile Sauce ( for Chicken or Pork in a Crockpot)
ingredients: 12 ancho chiles, stems discarded, rinsed very well | 2 cups vinegar or 2 cups lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high, until hot.  Add chiles.  Fry for 5 - 10 minutes, or until very very dark brown.  Remove from pan and cool, removing the seeds and most of the membrane.  Cut chiles into small pieces and place in a food processor with enough sugar or vinegar to moisten and pulse until mixture is a medium thick paste.

title: Spiced Salmon Salad and Honey Soy Sauce
ingredients:
1 lb cooked diced small fresh meat ( salmon, swordfish, etc.
    - ) | 10 cherry tomatoes | 10 leaves green leaf lettuce, shredded | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped and divided | 1/4 cup honey-roasted hoisin sauce | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh fenugreek leaves or 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek leaves
instructions: Combine all salad ingredients and mix together with remaining stuffing ingredients.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,cream chicken soup,cayenne pepper,chicken broth,chocolate gingersnap
title: Hot Chocolate Chicken
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 cup chicken broth | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper | grated chocolate gingersnaps
instructions: Combine soups and chicken broth in slow cooker.  Cook on high setting for 5 - 9 minutes.  Sprinkle with cayenne and sprinkle with a little grated chocolate.

Random Ingredients: amaretto,king crab leg,tabasco sauce,coriander powder,deli ham
title: Baked Halvah
ingredients: 1/2 lb deli ham, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb king crab legs | 1/2 cup amaretto, warmed | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1 dash tabasco sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  In a bowl combine the ham, crab legs & 1/3 cup of warmed amaretto.  Place a round piece of cheese cloth in a baking dish & put it carefully under the cloth.  Spread the ham mixture evenly over the cheese cloth.  Poke several holes in the cloth with a fork, forming a border that will cover the ham.  Bake for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven, uncover & sprinkle with coriander, then dash of tabasco.

Random Ingredients: onion,zucchini blossom,cauliflower floret,sirloin steak,egg,almond extract,mushroom,chili sauce
title: Korean Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak, sliced thinly across the grain ( or a combination of beef and chicken ) | 2 medium onions, sliced into rings | 1 cup cauliflower floret | 2 zucchini blossoms, sliced into rounds | 1 package sliced fresh mushrooms ( i use shitake's ) | 1 egg | 2 tablespoons chili sauce | 1 1/4 teaspoons almond extract | 1/2 cup blanched almond
instructions: Toss sliced beef with egg and almond extract.  Marinate beef in chili sauce for at least 3 hours.  After cooking, mix ingredients together and cook till beef is tender.

title: Japanese Vegetables
ingredients: 1 rutabaga, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch cubes | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup canola oil for frying | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Place rutabagas in a medium saucepan of lightly salted water.  Bring to a boil, and cook 5 minutes, or until tender.  Drain, and rinse with cold water.  Drain again.  Transfer rutabagas to a large bowl, and add the diced bamboo shoots.  Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Pour in enough oil to cover the rutabagas by 2 to 3 inches in height.  Place the vegetables into the hot oil.  Carefully and carefully place the vegetable into the hot oil, and fry on all sides, turning occasionally, until golden brown, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat, and drain on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: bouquet garni,italian salad dressing mix,beef roast,cauliflower
title: Roast Beef With Cauliflower, Garlic, and Italian Salad Dressing Mix
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups italian salad dressing mix | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef roast, trimmed of visible fat and cut into chunks | 3 heads cauliflower, cut into florets | 2 teaspoons bouquet garni, see note
instructions: Spray a large pot with vegetable oil spray, or lightly coat the bottom of the pot with oil.  Stir in the salad dressing mix and bring to a boil, then place the meat in a large slow cooker with the cauliflower.  Sprinkle with bouquet garni.  Cover and cook on low setting for 8 - 10 hours, or cook on high setting for 7 - 8 hours.  Remove from slow cooker, remove the meat from the broth and keep warm.  Shred the meat and serve with cooked vegetables and juices.

Random Ingredients: scallop,spanish olive,splenda sugar substitute,chicken breast half,spanish onion
title: Chicken Yummilicious With Spanish Olives and Scallops
ingredients: 4 thin sliced boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 8 large spanish olives, pitted and coarsely chopped | 2 large spanish scallops, scrubbed well | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute or 1 teaspoon sugar | 1 small spanish onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Combine dressing ingredients.  Arrange chicken and olives on broiler pan.  Broil under the broiler 4 minutes.  Meanwhile place onion on a piece of plastic wrap, place it on top of the scallops.  Slice chicken and place on top of the onions.  Spoon dressing over meat and onion.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,swiss chard,topping,dark brown sugar,curry leaf
title: Spicy Swiss Chard Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch swiss chard, washed to remove tough stems | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon curry leaf | 1/2 cup fat free greek yogurt | fat free whipped topping ( optional )
instructions: Wash and cut chard into 1/4 inch dice.  Combine with other ingredients in a medium bowl.  Cover and chill, preferably overnight.  Serve with fat free whipped topping if desired.

title: Coconut Pancakes
ingredients: 8 ounces plain fine breadcrumbs | 1 cup thick coconut milk
instructions: Mix the coconut milk and bread crumbs in a small bowl and stir the mixture well.  Dip the pancake into the coconut milk mix until it is covered with the bready paste coating.  Heat frying pan on medium heat.  Spray pan with non stick cooking spray.  Put approximately 1/10 of the mixture in the pan and spread out so that each side is smooth.  Turn the pancake over and cook on the other side.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,feta cheese,habanero pepper,green capsicum,canola oil,wheat bread,parsnip
title: North African Capsicum Feta Patties
ingredients: 250 g greek feta cheese, crumbled | 2 tablespoons fresh parsnips, finely chopped | 1 -2 chopped green capsicum | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 3 saffron threads ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon canola oil ( extra ) | 1 pinch saffron thread ( optional ) | 2 slices whole wheat bread, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Combine feta, parsnips, capsicum, 1 teaspoons of the oil in a bowl add saffron.  Mix to combine.  Shape patties, 1 2cm thick, into 2cm diameter patties.  Heat extra oil in a non stick frying pan.  Cook patties until golden brown on each side.  Serve sprinkled with reserved saffron.  Can be served hot, also if desired, with a tossed salad.

Random Ingredients: white onion,green pepper,orange,ancho chile powder,basmati rice
title: Ancho Rice
ingredients: 1 can or bottle white onions or 1 cup white pearl onion, in syrup, undrained | 1 cup basmati rice, cooked | 3 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder | 1/2 green pepper, diced | 1 small orange rind, sliced
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high.  Add oil.  Add onions, rice, chile powder, green pepper, and orange peel.  Heat to boiling.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 15 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.

title: Raspberry Bavarian Style Steak
ingredients: 3/4 cup raspberry flavored frozen raspberries | 1 can beef broth
instructions: Stir raspberries and beef broth together in a bowl.

title: Salsa Verde Molcajete
ingredients: 2 roma ( plum ) tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped | 1 cup salsa verde | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili oil
instructions: Mix the tomatoes, salsa, and sugar in a bowl.  Heat chili oil in a skillet over medium heat.

title: Bulgogi Udon or Tuna-Blackened Meatball Soup
ingredients: 20 -24 ounces tuna in olive oil or 20 -24 ounces white canned tuna, drained | 4 -6 cups dashi or 4 -6 cups low sodium stock | 1/2 - 3/4 lb ground beef or 1/2-3/4 lb ground lamb | 1/3 cup cashews, broken | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace ( optional ) | 4 -6 -6 sprigs black olives ( optional )
instructions: If using meatballs, put all the ingredients except the cashews and black olives in the pan, cover, and cook until the meat is no longer pink in the middle, 20 - 30 minutes.  If using a stockpot, remove the lid and cook all the ingredients until they are well mixed or heated through.  Serve topped with cashews and black olives, if desired.

Random Ingredients: tortilla,tart apple,parmigiano reggiano cheese,mushroom,grape leaf,vegetarian fish sauce,granny smith apple,broccoli stem
title: Mushroom and Noodle Party
ingredients: 2 tart apples | 2 granny smith apples | 3 fresh broccoli stems | 2 mushrooms, cleaned and sliced ( optional ) | 1 bag shredded fresh spinach leaves | 1/4 cup vegetarian fish sauce | 2/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese, divided | 1 package gluten-free tortillia chips ( about 20 chips )
instructions: Grill or poach apples and granny smith apples until soft.

title: Cheese Noodles & Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 can 98 % fat-free cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon oil | 1/8 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1/2 cup shredded cheese ( monterey jack, cheddar or cheddar )
instructions: Boil a large pot of water and add noodles.  Cook for 5 minutes then drain.  Stir mushroom soup and oil into noodles until well warmed and creamy.  Stir in paprika, nutmeg and cheese until mixture thoroughly blended.  Serve over noodles.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,creme fraiche,onion salt,double cream,green cardamom pod,carrot
title: Cardamom & Carrot Chutney
ingredients: 1 large carrot, peeled, grated | 10 1/2 fluid ounces double cream | 5 green cardamom pods | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon creme fraiche or 1 tablespoon sour cream | 1/8 teaspoon onion salt
instructions: Cut the carrots into matchsticks and place them in a bowl, with a splash of water.  Set aside.  In a small saucepan combine the cream, cardamom pods, vinegar and creme fraiche or sour cream and bring to the boil over medium heat, stirring with a wooden spoon.  Add the onion salt and simmer gently for 5 minutes or until the liquid is reduced by half.  Serve hot at room temperature with thick bread and fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: lettuce,cucumber,orange zest,russet potato,blueberry,self rising flour,gruyere cheese,cayenne
title: Blueberry Cottage Pie
ingredients: 1/2 lb unpeeled russet potato, peeled | 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne | 2 cups grated gruyere cheese or 2 cups asiago cheese, divided | 1 orange, zest of | 3/4 cup crumbled blueberries | lettuce | 1 cucumber, peeled, seeded, and thinly sliced
instructions: Cut russet potatoes in half crosswise.  Cut top half in half crosswise.  Turn halves and cut other side into 6 wedges.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Place potatoes on baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until tender.  Meanwhile, blend flour and cayenne.  Sprinkle gruyere cheese on the grated cheese.  Top with the orange zest, cut side up.  Bake another 5 - 7 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Meanwhile, cut a 6 inch circle in the center of the potato wedges.  Fill the circle with the remaining cheese.  Place on top of the cheese.  Bake 5 - 7 minutes until golden brown.  Serve with the lettuce, cucumber slices, a spoonful blueberry cobbette and a salad.  Crusty bread goes very well with this.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,fennel seed,pork shoulder,celery seed,dark brown sugar
title: Smokey French Canadian Pork
ingredients: 6 lbs pork shoulder | 1 cup apple juice | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar
instructions: Heat oven to 325f.  Mix all ingredients.  Place shoulder in a roasting pan and add mixture.  Cover and roast for 4 hours or until done.

Random Ingredients: part ricotta cheese,taco flour tortilla,cornstarch,almond,raspberry liqueur
title: Crispy Raspberry Tortilla Wedges #RSC
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1/2 cup part-skim ricotta cheese | 2 tablespoons raspberry liqueur ( or orange juice ) | 8 -12 soft taco-size flour tortillas | fresh raspberry liqueur, to drizzle ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine ricotta, raspberry liquor, and corn starch.  Add more or less to desired consistency using your taste.  Dredge 4 tortillas at a time in cornstarch, shaking off excess.  Transfer to a nonstick skillet and lightly dust with more cornstarch.  Cook over medium heat, flipping once, until lightly browned, about 2 minutes each side.  Remove and allow to cool before removing from skillet.  Pile the wedges onto a small platter.  Drizzle tops with a little more raspberry liquor, if desired, or dip tortilla into the sauce.  Wrap tightly in a kitchen towel or waxed paper and refrigerate up to 3 days to firm up before serving, or overnight, or up to 3 days ahead.  Serve with a few raspberry liqueur on the side for dipping.

title: Italian Tomato Tarts
ingredients: 16 ounces frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 can italian-style stewed tomatoes, undrained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f unfold the pastry and cut rounds with a 3 inch round cutter.  Divide tomatoes among the pastry rounds, placing them on a large baking sheet.  Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Ww 3 Points - Costa Cashew Cheese and Green Salsa Dip
ingredients: 12 ounces velveeta cheese, cubed | 1/2 lb tomatillo, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons cashew nuts, chopped ( i use peanuts ) | 1/4 teaspoon pure vanilla extract | 1/4 cup frozen green salsa | 1/2 cup chopped roasted peanuts
instructions: Crumble velvetta cheese into a large bowl.  Add tomatillos, cashews and vanilla.  Mix until cheese is melted and no chunks of cheese remain.  Place salsa in microwave and microwave until melted and chunky, 1 minute.  Stir in cheese mixture and continue cooking until heated through 10 minutes.  Place in serving dish and sprinkle with nuts.

title: Hot and Crunchy Mexican Nachos
ingredients: 4 cups crushed tortilla chips, your flavor | 1 jar mild diced green chili peppers ( green or poblano peppers ) | 1 cup irish cream
instructions: Prepare tortilla chips and set aside.  Pour enough olive oil to coat bottom of saucepan.  Heat oil over medium high heat.  Add green chilies and fry, turning frequently, until the chilies begin to soften, 2 to 4 minutes.  Remove chilies from the oil and fry tortilla chips, 1 at a time, until brown and crisp on the edges about 1 1/2 minutes.  Turn and fry for another minute or two, or until crisp spots appear on both sides.  Remove from the pan onto plates, reserving about 1/2 cup of the chips drippings in the skillet.  Spread the crisped chips evenly on top.  Add 1/4 cup of the chili infused liqueur and a scattering of fried green chilies.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: onion soup mix,cilantro leaf,beer,bay leaf,oregano,albacore tuna,lemon peel
title: Beer and Tuna Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 can albacore tuna, drained | 1/2 cup onion soup mix | 1/8 teaspoon fresh oregano, leaves from oregano sprigs | 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, minced, divided | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon peel, minced | 1/4 cup beer | 3/4 teaspoon bay leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except the bay leaf, stirring well with a whisk or a rotary until well blended and heated through.  Pour into an ungreased 8 inch square baking pan.  Sprinkle with remaining herbs and drizzle with beer.  Bake, uncovered at 400°f for 30 minutes, or until heated through and the tops are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,miso,hazelnut,kiwi fruit,cilantro,orange peel,red chili,cremini mushroom
title: Hot and Spicy Japanese Mushroom Salad
ingredients: 200 g cremini mushrooms | 4 kiwi fruits | 1/2 cup fresh roasted hazelnuts | 1 red chili, deseeded and finely diced | 2 tablespoons light miso | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 2 teaspoons fresh cilantro, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon orange peel, finely grated and sprinkled over the salad greens
instructions: Finely dice the mushrooms, kiwi fruit and hazelnuts.  Mix together the chili, miso, oil, cilantro and orange.

title: Vanilla Instant Chinese Hot Fudge
ingredients: 1 pint hot chili, no seeds | 1 package vanilla instant pudding mix | 2 tablespoons mirin
instructions: Open the package of hot chinese hot fudge, or any other kind of instant pudding that is of the right size.  Pour into small heat resistant bowl and set aside.  Place the hot chinese hot fudge into a metal bowl or other long, shallow pan.  Using a spoon, scrape the hot fudge into a small microwave safe bowl.  Pour in the mirin and microwave, stirring every 30 seconds, until all of the chinese hot fudge is gone.  Pour enough of the hot fudge over the hot fudge to coat.  Let cool for five minutes.  Break out the block of hot fudge and place it in a clean container with a tight fitting lid.  Use a knife to cut the block into 6 equal pieces, or as you prefer, if desired, into squares.

title: Ham Corn Rarebit Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb sweet ham or 1 lb deli style ham | 12 slices rye bread, thinly sliced on the diagonal | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 1/2 cups baby corn, cooked | 1 cup yellow squash, cooked, cut into thin wedges | 1 cup lettuce, shredded
instructions: Place the ham on a piece of parchment or waxed paper.  Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise over it.  Place 2 slices of rye bread on top and top with mayonnaise.  Top with vegetables.  Scoop on any leftover mixture.  Add remaining rye bread slices and wrap each sandwich in plastic wrap.

Random Ingredients: cumin seed,kalamata olive,stir fry vegetable,veal,green onion,lasagna noodle,mustard powder,tapioca
title: Veal and Olive Lasagna (No-Yeast)
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground veal | 1 cup stir-fry vegetables | 1/2 cup kalamata olive ( sliced thinly ) | 3 green onions | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 1 1/2 teaspoons mustard powder | 1 can refrigerated lasagna noodles | 1/4 cup canola oil or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to cook and stir veal, vegetables, olives, and green onions in a large skillet until veal is browned, about 10 minute drain well.  Stir in cummin and mustard.  In a 9x13 baking dish, layer as follows.

title: Sardines in a Garlic Sauce (Siciliano Di Beppo)
ingredients: 8 ounces cooked sardines, drained, flesh chopped | 1/3 cup spanish olive, pitted, chopped ( preferably spanish olives )
instructions: Mix the chopped fresh sardines and 1/3 cup of the olives to make a creamy sauce.  Heat a dry frying pan over medium heat.  Add the sardines and cook, covered, stirring often, until they are softened, about 4 minutes.  Toss in the remaining olives and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Serve.

title: Spinach Europa
ingredients: 4 slices whole wheat flour | 100 g fresh spinach leaves, coarsely chopped | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon white bread, crumbs
instructions: Place flour, spinach, egg yolk, and bread crumbs into a bowl, and mix to combine.  Add enough water to the mixture to form a moist dough.  Turn out onto a floured surface, knead the dough, and cut into 4 equal pieces.  Place each piece onto a floured baking sheet.  Bake for 25 minutes at 200°c.  Turn out onto a serving dish, and serve hot.

title: Quick and Easy Egyptian Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 5 red yellow peppers | 4 hard-boiled eggs, shelled
instructions: Peel the skin off of the red and yellow peppers, slice the tops off and remove seed.  Cut peppers into 1 inch pieces, removing most of the stem.  Place peppers in a non metallic bowl and cover with boiling water.  Let stand 30 minutes, then drain and rinse in cold water until thoroughly coated.  Transfer peppers to a bowl and cover with boiling water about 1 inch/1 inch deep.  Wash the bowl with cold water, removing the stems and peels.  Heat the ramekins in a 375 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes until steaming stops.  Arrange the pepper pieces evenly in the ramekins around the inside of the peppers.  Crack one egg into the hole.  If desired, add 1/2 teaspoon of water to the mixture.  Bake the peppers in the 350 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until the egg whites are firm.  They may also be served hot with plain, buttermilk or milk.  This pepper dish can be prepared ahead and chilled completely.

Random Ingredients: chive,red pepper flake,oyster sauce,green bell pepper,jalapeno
title: Jalapeno Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup minced green bell pepper | 1 tablespoon minced fresh jalapeno | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon minced fresh chives | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the green pepper, jalapeno, oyster sauce, chives and red pepper flakes.  Serve in small dipping bowls at room temperature.

instructions: Combine the curry paste, vinegar and rind in a bowl.  Add the leek, mushrooms, lemon juice and mix well.  Add salt, pepper, and ice to taste, mix to taste and then chill for 30 minutes.  Serve with boiled or steamed jasmine rice.

instructions: Dice apples, if they are large, into 1 inch sized cubes or larger. Bring to a boil, then cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 2 minutes, then set aside to cool.  Add nuts to the nut mixture in the bowl and toss well.  Pack the apples into a large resealable plastic bag and press out any excess air.  If desired, tie with kitchen string to form a pouch.  Pour the apple nut mixture into the bowl and allow to cool at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Carefully snip off air pockets and stir in additional 1/4 cup vegetable or chicken stock if needed.  Cover with plastic film and refrigerate for up to 1 day, shaking occasionally.  The nuts can be eaten right away or refrigerated for up to 3 days, keeping in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks or until serving.  When ready to serve, spoon hot nuts onto a bed of greens or use as a topping or side, if desired.

title: Jicama and Pecan Korma-Sukpa
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs jicama | 300 -500 g coconut flakes, toasted | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 3 tablespoons soymilk or 3 tablespoons sour milk | 1 -2 cup pecans or 1 -2 cup walnuts
instructions: Peel the jicama carefully, if possible.  Cut off any large chunks, and place them in a large saucepan containing cold water.  Bring to the boil, and cook for 5 minutes, or until tender when pierced with a knife.  Drain and allow to cool.  Peel the pecans while they are still warm, and place in a large bowl.  Peel the coconut while it is still warm, grated, and place in a large bowl.  Cut the jicama in half lengthwise, and then across into large, thin half inch long pieces.  Combine the ground coconut with the soaking liquid in the bowl with the pecans.  Line an 8 x 8 inch pan with foil and grease the foil, then line the pan with the foil to make it easy to fold over and over again.  This prevents steam burns from forming at the top.  Fill the bowl with the coconut milk, or just measure the liquid out, and add a spoonful at a time, stirring between each addition until well blended.  Add the reserved spice mix to this, and stir for a minute until well blended.  Pour the korma mix into the pan, and bake in the oven, covered, for 45 minutes at 350°f.  Remove foil, and continue to bake uncovered for 15 - 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
