instructions: Place beans and water in a saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 10 - 15 minutes until tender.  Drain beans, reserving cooking water.  Place drained bean water back in saucepan with chocloate, sesame seeds, chocolate and green onions.  Heat through and serve immediately.  If desired, garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Chipotle Mushrooms in a Hake and Vinegar
ingredients: 1 ounce tahini | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon instant minced chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons vinegar | 2 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon chipotle paste | 1 1/2 lbs cremini mushrooms ( about 5 cups ) or 1 1/2 lbs mushroom stems and pieces, wiped clean, caps cut into 3 inch lengths ( about 5 cups ) | 3 -4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Put the tahini, 1tbls.  Sugar, and salt into the work bowl of a food processor and pulse until blended.  Add the chicken bouillon cube and vinegar and puree until smooth.  Wipe the food processor jar with a clean, damp paper towel or clean cloth towel and put in the work bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients except the mushrooms and blend for a few seconds or until the sauce is well combined.  Put the mushrooms in the jar.  Add the paste, cover, and shake to combine.  Let marinate for one hour, shaking the jar daily.  Unwrap the mushrooms and drain the marinade.  Discard the stems and slice the caps thickly.  Dry the mushrooms on a clean, dry towel set over a tray.  Sprinkle with the 3 4tbls.  Of sugar.  Grill the mushrooms about 10 minutes, brushing with the marinade until tender.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,extra tofu,kaffir lime leaf,salad oil
title: Tofu-Rubbed Brisket
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 1 large beef brisket | 1/4 cup salad oil | 2 kaffir lime leaves, torn
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place tofu on a baking sheet.  Rub brisket liberally with olive oil and lime leaves.  Bake brisket for 45 minutes.  Turn over, sprinkle with more of your favorite salad dressing and bake for an additional hour or until meat thermometer reads 160 degrees f.

title: Hot & Sour Scented Salmon (Kuwaiti)
ingredients: 1 kg fresh salmon ( skinned, not frozen ) | 1 1/2 cups vinegar | 1/4 cup hot chili powder
instructions: Boil the whole fish for 10 minutes.  Remove fish with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.  Keep the fish warm.  Soak in water for 5 - 6 hours.  Remove skin, bones and bones from fish & cut into serving sized pieces.  Make sure you have enough water to keep it from drying up while cooking, so that the fish can be cooked easily.  Place fish on a board, and carefully pour hot vinegar over fish.  Mix well.  Spread the mixture on a tray, such as an upturned pan.  Place the pan in a pre heated oven.  Cook for approx 30 mins, or until the surface is crisp and golden.  Serve with rice.

title: Papas Con Jitomate
ingredients: 500 g chicken | 100 g cheese | 20 ml pork fat ( or equivalent )
instructions: Chop chicken into bite sized pieces.  Boil chicken until fully cooked, then chop it into bite sized pieces.  Once the chicken is cooked, remove from heat.  Wrap in cling wrap and place on a plate.  When cool enough to touch, mix the cheese with the pork fat.  Roll chicken pieces in the fat mixture.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Spread
ingredients: 1 package dried sun-dried tomato | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning
instructions: In a small bowl, cover sun dried tomatoes with boiling water.

Random Ingredients: ramen noodle,monterey jack cheese,macaroni,cream chicken soup
title: Macaroni Casserole #Ram
ingredients: 2 lbs macaroni | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 box ramen noodles | 3/4 cup monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add macaroni, and cook until tender, about 8 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  In a large bowl, combine the cream of chicken soup and ramen noodles.  Mix well.  When the water comes to a boil, add the macaroni.  Cook until heated through and tender, about 5 minutes.  Grease a 2 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Pour the macaroni mixture into the greased casserole dish, then stir in the cheese.  Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until the cheese is melted and the casserole is bubbly.

Random Ingredients: grenadine,caster sugar,dark soy sauce,mizithra cheese,egg,red chile pepper
title: Cheesecake-Crusted Mizithra
ingredients: 4 ounces grated mizithra cheese | 3 eggs | 1 tablespoon minced red chile pepper | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 tablespoon grenadine
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Mix the grated cheese, eggs, chili pepper, sugar, dark soy sauce and grenadine with a mixer in a bowl.  Pour into a 9 inch springform cake pan and smooth out the top with a spatula.  Bake in the preheated oven until the top is puffed and golden, about 40 minutes.  Remove the cake pan from the oven and cool.  This is best served slightly warm and not cold.

Random Ingredients: vital wheat gluten,confectioner sugar,vanilla ice cream,jalapeno,gruyere,lentil,lemon juice,snow pea
title: Gruyere Squares
ingredients: 2 cups lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 cup shredded gruyere | 2 teaspoons lemon juice | 2 cups sliced jalapenos | 1 cup shredded snow pea | 3/4 cup chopped unsalted butter, chilled | 1 1/4 cups confectioners'sugar | 3/4 teaspoon vanilla ice cream, or as desired
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the lentils into a large pot, and pour in enough water to cover.  Bring the water to a boil, reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 25 minutes, until tender.  Drain and rinse the lentils under cold water, and place into a large bowl.  Stir in the Gruyere cheese, lemon juice, and jalapenos.  Spread the snow peas onto a cookie sheet, and spray with cooking spray.  Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes.  Stir the cooked lentils into the noodle mixture with the butter, and spread onto the cereal.  Continue baking 10 minutes, until the topping is a light brown color.  Allow to cool.  Mix together the confectioners' sugar, vanilla ice cream, and lemon juice until smooth, and spread onto the chilled cereal.

title: Hazelnutty Chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted | 2 teaspoons sage
instructions: Place all ingredients except chicken into crock pot.  Place chicken on top of chicken and cook on low 4 - 6 hours.  Remove chicken from crock pot.  Cut into pieces, shred or chop.  Return chicken to crock pot and reheat, then serve.

title: Spicy Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 600 g pumpkin puree | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 dried red chili peppers or 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 small carrot, finely shredded
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400f and line a roasting tin with baking paper.  Peel, remove and discard the seeds from the pumpkin flesh.  Roughly chop the flesh into 1 inch cubes.  Place in a bowl, add the cornflour.  Stir in the chilli pepper flakes and mustard until well combined then add the carrot.  Using your hands, rub the spice mixture into the pumpkin.  Divide the mixture evenly between the roasting tin and smooth over the top.  Roast for 45 - 50 minutes, turning occasionally.  The pumpkin should be dark brown and soft and the filling cooked through.

title: Basic Beef Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup beef stock
instructions: Combine the confectioners sugar and the beef stock in a small bowl with a wire whisk.  Heat the pan over high heat and add a drop of oil to the pan.  When the pan is hot, pour the mixture into a serving dish.  Serve the gravy in small bowls over cooked egg noodles.

title: Tikari Jicama
ingredients: 450 g jicama, washed, peeled and finely chopped ( known as `` julienned '' ) | 1 glass roasted and ground almonds | 1 teaspoon saffron strand ( known as `` ajwain '' in hindi ) | 2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Grind the juliennes to a fine puree.  Add salt, garlic powder, ground almonds, saffron and garam masala powders.  Mix well.  Add the shredded juliennes.  Keep aside to marinate for 30 minutes.  Serve chilled with parathas or parathas.  Enjoy.

title: Mushroom Caps, Sun Chips & Pomegranate Juice
ingredients: 3 cups cremini mushrooms, thinly sliced ( about 1 3/4 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and finely chopped | 1 cup pomegranate juice, from fresh pomegranates
instructions: Toss mushrooms, tomatoes & 1/4 cup of the pomegranate juice in a large bowl.  Cover & chill at least 2 hours or up to 2 days.  Stir well before serving.

title: Pineapple Vanilla Bean Temptation
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 2 ounces pineapple, drained, liquid reserved | 1 tablespoon mirin
instructions: Insert the split vanilla bean into the vanilla bean, and fill in the reserved liquid.  Replace the vanilla bean.  Stir together the mirin and the reserved pineapple juice.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,spinach leaf,lamb loin chop,pepperoni,harissa,vegetable stock,cheddar cheese
title: Spinach and Lamb Chops With Pepperoni
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 1/4 cup harissa | 1 hot green chili pepper, thinly sliced and seeded | 3 ounces pepperoni, finely chopped | 3 ounces goat cheese or 3 ounces low-fat cheddar cheese, crumbled | 8 ounces spinach leaves, washed, trimmed and spun dry | 4 ounces lean boneless lamb loin chops ( about 25 chops ) or 8 ounces beef stew meat ( about 25 chops )
instructions: Puree the stock, harissa and chili in a food processor until smooth.  Stir in the peppers, cheese and spinach.  Trim the chops of fat and slice them crosswise into 1/4 inch thick pieces.  Set them aside.  Spray a grill with cooking spray and grill the chops on both sides just until slightly charred on the outside.  Spread the spinach mixture over the cooked chops and serve.

title: Mexicana Chips, Dipping Sauces, or Wedges
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil | 12 cilantro, stemmed, washed in fresh water, and very finely chopped ( about 12 sprigs )
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make 3 diagonal slashes each through the cilantro sprigs about 1/2 inch deep.  Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat until almost smoking.  Scoop cilantro into slashes and fry until lightly browned.  Transfer to a plate and season with salt to taste.

title: Cardamom Ice Cream
ingredients: 400 g heavy cream | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°c.  Whip cream until soft peaks form.  Fold in cardamon.  Divide cream between four individual oven proof ramekins to form a small layer.  Spoon a little cream gently over each ramekin.  Set aside in fridge for 2 hours.  Remove ramekins from fridge & sprinkle each with extra crushed cardamom.  Serve in ramekin dishes.

title: Spicy Tomato Caccitori
ingredients: 2 ounces prosciutto, cut into thin slices | 3/4 cup tomato ketchup | 1/8 teaspoon hot pepper flakes
instructions: Put the prosciutto slices in your food processor or blender.  Add the ketchup and hot pepper flakes.  Blend for 10 - 15 seconds or until well mixed.  Serve as a condiment with fish, beef or vegetables.

title: Peppered Parsnips on Nuts
ingredients: 2 parsnips, peeled ( about 150 g if large ) | 1 sprig fresh rosemary ( to garnish, see note ) | 1 tablespoon roasted pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Cut the parsnips lengthwise through their core until the tipy part is left, then slice the parsnips in half, lengthwise almost thinly.  Place the parsnips in a serving bowl.  Sprinkle the rosemary sprig inside and on the parsnips, then drizzle with pistachios and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: beef sirloin,thyme,potato flake,heavy whipping cream,cornstarch,dark molasses,flat leaf parsley
title: Corned Beef Hash With Caramelized Herb Gravy
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup heavy whipping cream ( or half and half ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 lb corned beef sirloin | 1/4 cup dark molasses | 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, minced
instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, cream and corn starch, thyme and season with salt and pepper.  Cut sirloin into 1 inch cubes and set aside.  Bring a pot of water to a boil, add 1 tbsp butter, 1 tbsp oil or 1 tbsp margarine and a pinch of salt.  Place beef cubes in boiling water for one minute and drain.  Pat dry beef with paper towel and fry until golden brown.  Pour out water and repeat with rest of sirloin cubes.  Stir molasses and 2 tbsp water into the pan and heat.  Add corned beef pieces to pan and coat with the molasses mixture and continue heating slowly for 15minutes or till sauce is reduced and thick.  Remove from heat and stir in parsley.  Serve immediately.

title: Apple Blossom
ingredients: 4 cups sliced tart apples | 2 cups sweetened apricots | 1/4 cup bourbon
instructions: Combine the apples, fruit preserves and bourbon in an oven proof saucepan, and stir to mix well.

title: Spargel - 2 Shrimp & Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb raw jumbo shrimp | 16 ounces jumbo shrimp, in shells cooked | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 8 ounces dry red wine | 1 lb egg noodles
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees.  In a large ovenproof skillet, or deep skillet, cook each shrimp in two batches.  Do not overcrowd the skillet or they will steam.  When nearly done, drain off any remaining oil.  Toss shrimp with vinegar.  Add shrimp and cook to desired doneness, about 4 minutes.  Arrange noodles in a wide pattern around the pan and nestle the shrimp over them.  Add 1/2 cup water.  Cover tightly and bake in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes.  Uncover and bake to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: turnip,cake flour,cinnamon bark,serrano pepper,white bread,chili pepper,dark chocolate
title: Chocolate-Turnip-Chile Loaf
ingredients: 1 large egg | 200 g dark chocolate, melted | 250 g turnips, finely diced | 1 teaspoon cinnamon bark, ground | 1 teaspoon chili pepper, dried | 500 g white bread, stale and cut into 1 cm cubes | 3 serrano peppers, deseeded and diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 deg c/350 deg f/gas 6 or gas mark line a 20 x 25 cm loaf pan with baking parchment.  Using an electric mixer, beat eggs and chocolate in a bowl until smooth.  Add turnip, cinnamon, chilli pepper, bread and serrano peppers, mix well.  Spoon the mixture into pan and bake at 180 deg c/350 deg f/gas 3 for about 2 hours or until firm when pressed around the sides.  Remove from oven and allow to cool.  Chill loaf overnight before slicing and serving.

title: Spicy Beef - Pickled Carpaccio
ingredients: 4 lbs rump steak, cut about 2-1/2 inches long | 2 jars pickling cucumbers, drained and rinsed | 2 packages dried fruit, such as dried apricots, apricots and cranberries | 4 tablespoons ground chili pepper
instructions: Rinse meat with cold water, pat dry with paper towels.  Cut thin rounds about 1/2 inch deep on each side of the steak.  Place meat on rack in roasting pan.  Insert metal skewers in 2 to 3 inch intervals.  Spoon hot pickled cucumbers in centers of 4 to 6 to 8 meat pices, arranging them neatly near beef openings.  Spoon hot fruit over meat.  Sprinkle with pepper.  Cover and let stand 20 to 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook sauce, uncovered, over moderately high heat, stirring, until just simmered, about 4 minutes.  Stir in hot cooked seafood.  Cook 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Serve meat slices, covered, along with sauce, hot cooked vegetables, and cooked seafood, cooked separately.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,virgin olive oil,ramen noodle,celery salt,pork liver,savoy cabbage
title: Lazy Irish Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup virgin olive oil | 1 bunch savoy cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 package ramen noodles ( or seasoning packets ) | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 8 leaves savoy cabbage | 1 pound pork livers, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat 1/4 c olive oil in large nonstick skillet.  Add cabbage and seasoning packets.

title: Chianti Kidney Beans (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs dried kidney beans, soaked overnight and drained | 1 cup chianti wine
instructions: Combine beans and wine in a 4 to 6 quart crock pot.  Cover and cook on high setting 5 to 6 hours, or until beans are tender.

title: Turnip-Chokolate Turnip Pie
ingredients: 2 turnips | 1 ounce sweet chocolate | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon water | 1 teaspoon dried tarragon | 1 sheet phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 ounce soft salted chocolate ( optional )
instructions: Peel turnips and cut into 1 cubes.  Place into boiling water and simmer until just tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Chop chocolate very finely.  Place in small bowl and stir in brandy and water.  Add a small pinch of tarragon into cream mixture, and set aside.  Remove the skins from the turnips.  With the tip of a paring knife, slice into 1/8 inch rounds.  Place in a baking dish.  Cut a small cross in the base of the turnip mixture to prevent darkening.  Arrange on top of the chocolate mixture.  Dot with the soft salted chocolate if using.  Bake in a 400 degree oven until filling is set, about 10 minutes.  Let cool slightly, and cut into squares.

title: Italian Sausage Patties (Italian Sausage)
ingredients: 1 lb bulk pork sausage, casings removed | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup shredded fresh basil
instructions: Preheat grill to low.  Mix sausage, garlic salt, and basil, using your hands until well blended.  Form meat mixture into 4 patties.  Grill patties 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

title: Easy Mexican Bean Taco Filling
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 package taco seasoning mix
instructions: Drain and rinse the cannellini beans and put them in the bowl of a food processor.  Add the taco seasoning package, and process until well blended.  Add water until the mixture forms a dough like consistency.  Take a handful of the dough and roll it into a ball.  Make sure that the seam is on the top of the ball.  Place it on a plate with wax paper between each batch, cover, and refrigerate until the dough is firm.  Fill a large bowl with water, and place a handful of the dough into it.  Press down the top of the dough with your hands so that it stays together.  Repeat until the dough is used.  Preheat the oven on broil setting.  Heat a small skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir the bean mixture, about 5 minutes, until the filling is hot throughout and the tortilla is pliable.  Cut the tortilla into small squares.

Random Ingredients: serrano chilies,hershey milk chocolate chip,pork shoulder,ancho chile powder,green cardamom
title: Korean Barbecue Pork
ingredients: 1 -2 lb pork shoulder ( boneless - i prefer using shoulder bone, but you can use any pork shoulder that's up to you ) | 1 cup hershey's sweetened condensed milk chocolate chips | 5 teaspoons dried ancho chiles powder | 2 green cardamom, capsules crushed | 1/2 teaspoon ground ancho chile powder
instructions: Cut the pork into 1 inch pieces.  Place the meat in a large sauce pan.  Add the chocolate chips, ancho chile powder, green cardamom pods, and ground ancho powder.  Stir to blend well.  Remove the cardamom pods and grind them into a fine powder.  Place the chile powder and meat back into the sauce pan and stir in the chile powder and chocolate.  Bring to boiling and cook until the meat is hot, about 5 - 6 minutes.  Serve and allow family to help themselves.

title: Stir-Fried Spicy Steak
ingredients: 3 lbs beef top sirloin or 3 lbs flank steaks | dark sesame oil
instructions: Heat wok or skillet over high heat until just smoking.  Brush oil onto one side of steak.  Prick steak several times with a fork.  Add steak to oil in wok.  Stir fry for 3 - 5 minutes or until meat is cooked through.  Cover and cook for 2 minutes.  Pour off oil.

title: Pollo Criollo
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken thighs or 4 lbs chicken breasts | 1 head cauliflower, broken into florets | 12 large mushrooms, chopped into 1/2 inch cubes | 2 canned chipotle chiles, chopped | 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | fresh coriander
instructions: In a pan, cook chicken in half fill olive oil on medium high heat until brown all over and just about cooked through.  Remove chicken and pour off excess fat and pour off oil and discard.  Drain chicken and set aside.  Turn heat down to medium.  Add cauliflower florets and mushrooms and cook on medium for about 7 minutes.  Add chopped chipotle or other chilies and vinegar.  Return to boil and cook at same temperature for another two minutes.  Pour chicken on top of cauliflower and mushrooms.  Sprinkle coriander and serve with bread.  Note, can cook with 2 chicken tenders rather than 1 chicken breast.

Random Ingredients: cilantro,cabbage,arugula,egg noodle,swiss cheese,vegetable stock,white kidney bean
title: Rice Cooker Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles, broken-up | 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 cup shredded cabbage | 1 can cannned white kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1/2 cup shredded swiss cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh arugula
instructions: Place noodles in the rice cooker.  Pour stock into the bowl, and let sit for 1 minute.  Place noodles, cabbage beans, cilantro, swiss cheese, and arugula into the rice cooker.  Stir until cheese melts.  Set rice cooker to the low setting, and keep warm.

Random Ingredients: chive,bacon,chili pepper flake,peanut oil,cream tartar,orange peel,green chili pepper
title: Spicy Peanut Oil and Sour Cream Sauce With  Peppers (A La Ngole Poppers)
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs thick cut bacon ( or equivalent ) | 2 cans chili pepper flakes ( depending how spicy you want the sauce if you don't use hot ) | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon orange peel, grated | 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 2 -4 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 green peppers ( or any color you like, your choice )
instructions: In a skillet with a lid heat the peanut oil over medium high heat until just boiling then turn down to low heat and add the bacon or chives and orange peel.  Saute, stirring, until bacon turns lucid and looks crispy.  Add all the sauce ingredients and bring to a low boil about 10 - 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 - 3 minutes, until flavors meld.

title: Pastry Cream with Semolina
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups semolina flour | 1 cup mayonnaise
instructions: Combine semolina flour and mayonnaise in a food processor or blender and pulse until mixture resembles fine bread crumbs.  Drop pastry mixture onto well seasoned cast iron skillet, spreading it out evenly.  Cook in batches for about 1 minute or until lightly browned.  Turn over and brown other side.

title: Black Almond - Olive Pecan Jeweled Apricot-Apricot Scented Spread!
ingredients: 1 bag black olives, drained ( black olives like green will not work well for this recipe, they should be sliced and pitted ) | 1 can apricot nectar, such as a tangy apricot nectar ( this is to drain it from its natural acidic flavor and it should be sweet, sour, and sweet ) | 10 black cardamom pods, crushed ( or more to taste ) | 1/3 cup pecans or 1/3 cup walnuts, lightly toasted
instructions: Put the olives and nectar in a food processor.  Add the black cardamom pods, nuts and spices.  Using the food processor, puree until smooth.  Cover loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate for one hour or until the flavors blend.

Random Ingredients: vidalia onion,bell pepper,soy sauce,olive,pine nut,red wine vinegar,ketjap manis
title: Tossed up Peppers & Onions
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons ketjap manis | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/4 teaspoon red wine vinegar | 1 large bell pepper, sliced thinly | 1 large vidalia onion, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup olives, sliced thinly
instructions: Sauce, mix all ingredients.  Pour evenly over peppers and onions.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,picante sauce,filet beef,wasabi paste,garlic clove
title: Wasabi Beef
ingredients: 2 cups dried farfalle pasta ( bow tie is best ) | 1 1/2 lbs filet of beef | 8 garlic cloves, crushed | 2 teaspoons wasabi paste | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, cut top of beef into 1 inch slices.  Rinse pasta and set aside.  Slice garlic into 8 thin slivers.  Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Drain pasta and cook garlic and beef in hot oven for 5 minutes or until pasta is tender crisp, stirring constantly.  Add wasabi paste and picante sauce and heat until hot.  Season with salt and pepper.

title: Vegetable Lasagne
ingredients: 1 pound dry lasagna noodles | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 4 ears fresh corn kernels | 2 cups kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon cornstarch, or as needed | 1 bunch chives, sliced
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in a large pot of boiling water until al dente, about 8 minutes.  Drain, and cool under running water.  Break into chunks.  In a medium skillet over medium heat, cook and stir the garlic until beginning to turn golden, about 1 minutes.  Add the corn kernels, kidney beans, garlic powder, and cornstarch, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until hot, about 5 minutes.  Pour about 1/2 cup of the bean mixture into the mixture in the skillet, and stir until evenly mixed.  Continue cooking 4 minutes over medium heat.  Ladle about 1/4 cup of the bean mixture over the pasta, and top with about 1 tablespoon of parmesan cheese.  Heat an oven proof skillet over medium heat.  When hot, spoon 1/4 cup bean mixture over the pasta, and spread out to the edges of the pan.  Cover the pan, and bake 20 minutes, or until heated through.  Garnish with chives.

title: Jalebi's Beans and Pasta
ingredients: 16 ounces dried pinto beans | 16 ounces lasagna noodles | 1 teaspoon coriander, ground
instructions: Rinse and drain beans.  Place beans in 3 - 4 qts of boiling water.  Bring to a boil.  Cook at a boil for about 10 minutes or until beans are softened.  Drain and run beans under cold water. .  Meanwhile in a separate saucepan bring a pot of salted water to a boil over high heat.  Add pasta to boiling water and cook for 10 - 13 minutes or until al dente.

title: Cardamom Rice Noodle Dish
ingredients: 3 green cardamom pods | 2 cups cooked rice noodles, rinsed
instructions: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil in a large pot.  Add the whole pods to the water.  Boil about 35 to 45 seconds, until you can smell a strong aroma.  Remove the pods and discard them.  Immediately drain any excess water and set aside.  Immediately transfer the noodles to a large serving bowl and top with the cardamom pods.  Pour the hot water over the noodles until it covers them completely.  Let stand 30 minutes before serving.

title: Quick Coconut Spiced Broth (Mok Kho Gha)
ingredients: 400 g coconut cream | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 teaspoon soy sauce | 1 cup chopped cilantro leaf
instructions: Wash the coconut cream under running water.  Place in a small pot along with all the other spices.  Bring to a boil then reduce heat to lowest setting and simmer for about half an hour.  Strain the liquid and discard coconut cream.  Stir through the coconut and chopped cilantro.

title: Cranberry Maple Sauce
ingredients: 1 head fresh cranberries | 3 cans catsup | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 3 serrano peppers
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the cranberries and water.  Bring to a boil, and simmer 7 minutes.  Remove the cranberries from the pan, and drain.  Mix the catsup, maple syrup, and serrano peppers into the pan, and bring to a boil.  Boil 3 minutes, then remove the saucepan from the heat, and stir in the cranberries and cranberries.  Allow the sauce to rest at least 5 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,gruyere cheese,chicken bouillon cube,marinara sauce,tabasco sauce,kielbasa
title: Polish Breakfast Kielbasa and Gruyere
ingredients: 8 ounces kielbasa, fully cooked and cut into 1/2 inch pieces ( polish kielbasa ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar or 1 tablespoon powdered sugar | 2 tablespoons grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce ( or more for your taste preference ) | 2 slices gruyere cheese | 1 bouillon cube ( optional ) or 1 chicken bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 cup marinara sauce
instructions: Cook kielbasa pieces for approximately 5 minutes, then set aside.  Mix the cheese and bouillon cube.  Add the marinara and mix well.  Place in a casserole dish and top with the kielbasa pieces.  Pour marinara sauce over and bake at 350 degrees for approximately 20 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Italian Vinaigrette
ingredients: 2 tablespoons virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cruet and chill.

title: Chinese Radishes with Noodles
ingredients: 100 g soba noodles | 100 g radishes ( japanese ones ) | 200 ml champagne | 3 celery ribs, washed and cut in 2 cm lengths | 3 teaspoons prepared mustard | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 deg c.  Rinse soba with just sufficient water to cover generously with vinegar.  Cut off root ends and scoop out and discard outer layers.  Cut radishes in half lengthways and then cut into 6 chunks.  Heat a pan fry on high until it starts to smoke.  Add soba and fry for 2 minutes or until just beginning to brown.  Remove from oven, pour off any excess water and toss in celery, mustard and oil.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white cheddar cheese,cucumber,white onion,beef tenderloin,caster sugar,monterey jack cheese,macadamia nut
title: Beef Tenderloin and Hazelnut Macadamia Nuts, With Cheese
ingredients: 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 500 g beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat | 2 teaspoons white cheddar cheese | 2 tablespoons gourmet garden gourmet mountain macadamia nuts, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons white cheddar cheese, chopped | 2 tablespoons shredded white cheddar cheese | 2 teaspoons shredded white cheddar cheese | 1/3 cup chopped peeled cucumber | 4 tablespoons chopped pickled cauliflower from jarred roasted red peppers | 2 tablespoons chopped gourmet garden gourmet mountain macadamia nuts, roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200c/180c fan forced/350f/4 5 gas mark.  Place the sugar in a shallow non aluminium pan and cook the beef in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes until well browned and cooked to your liking.  Remove the beef from the pan, reserving pan fat, and transfer the beef to a large oven proof baking dish.  Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the beef and sprinkle with the nuts.  Bake in the oven for 2 - 3 minutes, or until golden.  To make the dressing, combine 3tbsp of the gourmet garden macadamia nuts, the red pepper, cheddar and the remaining honey in a small food processor and process until smooth.  Add the reserved beef fat and process until combined.  Serve the beef on serving plates, drizzled with the dressing and the nuts scattered over the top.  Make sure guests have a glass of the gourmet garden macadamia nuts.  You can also serve the beef and vegetables separately.

Random Ingredients: swiss cheese,flour,puff pastry,white bread,basmati rice,citron peel,chicken meat
title: Chicken & Rice Puff Pastry
ingredients: 500 g chicken meat ( cubed ) | 2 teaspoons flour | 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1/2 cup swiss cheese, shredded, divided | 1/2 cup citron peel ( thinly sliced ) | 1/2 cup white bread, cut in cubes ( or dried, cubed ) | 50 sheets frozen puff pastry ( or 20 sheets prepared puff pastry dough )
instructions: Add the chicken to a medium frypan with the water.  Bring to the boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 12 - 15 minutes or until the chicken is tender and cooked through.  Add the rice and return to the boil.  Return to the boil, cover and simmer for 12 minutes or until the rice and rice are just tender.  Remove from heat and stir or mix with a fork.  Stir in 3/4 of the swiss cheese and 3/4 of the citron.  Cover and set aside for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200°c.  Place the bread cubes or dried bread in a large mixing bowl and add the remaining swiss cheese.  Stir well, then set aside.  Cut each pastry sheet in half, allowing 8 per sheet.  Wet your hands with cold water as you work, then pull out a few pieces at a time and place about 5 teaspoons of the filling along the pastry.  Fold over at the edges, then continue to fold and shape all the way around until the pastry is fully sealed.  Place the pastries on a parchment paper lined baking sheet.  Cover the pastries with a clean tea towel and let them rest in the fridge for 30 minutes or until slightly firm.  Bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.  Serve with salsa and sour cream.

title: Quick and Easy Filets
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed, cut into 6 portions
instructions: Place the beef steaks in a 12x6 x2 baking dish.  With a meat tenderizer, cut each piece of beef into 6 pieces, or follow directions on the bag.  Insert steak between the meat and its hanging net handle, as securely as possible.  Cut the steaks crosswise into 1/4 inch slices, to yield about 3 cups.  Spoon the hot pepper sauce over all, or cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Pre heat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Remove the beef from the refrigerator 15 minutes before baking.  Roast the beef for 25 to 30 minutes for medium rare, or about 15 to 20 minutes for medium well.  Remove beef from oven and let come to room temperature.  When done, let stand 1 minute, then slice into 1/8 inch thick slices.  You can also make these in a casserole and serve on a hoagie, with any meat sauce or salad.  Note, if you can't find hot pepper sauce, use 1/4 t red pepper flakes.  Note, you can also prepare these in a crockpot or on high for 6 hours to the day of serving, and serve on a bed of lettuce for dipping.

title: Chocolate-Prosciutto Wrapped in Hoosberries

instructions: Preheat the oven to 180c.  Line an oven tray with baking paper.  Crush the oatmeal with your fingertips in a bowl.  Roll the oatmeal in oats and transfer to a microwave safe bowl. Place the tray in the heated oven for 12 - 15 minutes, or until the loaves have been warm and crisp and the edges are golden.

title: Sweet Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs top sirloin steak or 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks | 3 tablespoons beef base or 3 tablespoons beef bouillon | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon chili powder ( depending on how spicy you want it ) | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 can pineapple tidbits, drained and juice reserved | 1/4 cup chicken stock or 1/4 cup vegetable stock | 3 -5 tablespoons garlic paste
instructions: Cut steak in strips that will fit into a crockpot.  Mix steak, flour or salt, and water in a bowl.  Add the beef on top of the steak until just covered. Strain liquid into a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.  Stir in all remaining ingredients.  Simmer for about 2 1/2 minute.  Pour into a clean crock pot and serve warm.  Variation, substitute a can of diced tomatoes with the artichokes and pineapple.  If you don't have a can of pineapple and can of artichoke hearts, you can use 3/4 to 1 cup of pineapple juice instead of stock.

title: Glutinous Rice Bread and Butter Pies
ingredients: 1 cup glutinous rice | 4 slices of firm textured bread, crusts removed | 2 2 -3 cups glutinous rice or 2 -3 cups porridge rice | 4 -5 pieces of stale bread | 2 teaspoons finely crushed cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Place the glutinous rice in a bowl, add just enough water to cover the rice.  Place the ungreased bread in a large saucepan.  Cover with water and bring to a boil.  Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook covered until the water is absorbed.  When the rice is cooked, allow it to cool for a few minutes or put through a ricer.  Place the crusts of the bread on 2 baking sheets, cut into 3 or 4 pieces each.  Cut a slice off of the top from each bread piece and cut an x shape in the bread with scissors.  Pile the rice evenly onto 2 baking sheets making sure the slices are not touching, pressing the rice together lightly.  Repeat until all of the bread and the rice mixture are used or make more filling.  Place the melted butter in a small bowl and sprinkle the bread with the cardamom if using.  Using a pastry brush, lightly spread the melted butter on the bread.  Set aside for at least 30 minutes or several hours.  Preheat oven to 350°f bake for 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly golden brown.

title: Roasted Green Chilies and Brisket Chili Paste

instructions: Preheat oven to 300f degrees.  Place chiles in a jelly roll pan.

title: Cod With Chimichurri Salad
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried herbs | 1 garlic cloves, crushed | 6 tablespoons icing sugar | 500 g fillets cod | 125 g cherry tomatoes ( halved ) | 1/3 cup coriander or 1/3 cup mint, finely chopped
instructions: Place herbs, garlic and icing sugar in a bowl and stir until soft.  Add cod fillets to mixture and coat in icing sugar and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Heat grill to high and cook fish for 2 - 3 minutes each side or until just cooked through.  Remove fish from grill and cut into slices.  Arrange fish on a large serving platter, scatter with cherry tomatoes and coriander or mint.  Pour the dressing over and serve.

title: Roasted Potato Salad, 216cals Per Serve
ingredients: 2 -6 large russet potatoes, peeled, washed and cut in half if they are smaller | 4 medium roma tomatoes, sliced thinly ( roma ) | fresh breadcrumb ( optional ) | extra virgin olive oil, for drizzling
instructions: Preheat oven to cut a circle 7/8” wide and 5” deep on the outside rim, such as a cookie tin.  The circle, cut around the rim of the circle and place onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Add enough olive oil to come almost halfway up the side of the circle.  Sprinkle with bread crumbs and a few flecks of bread crumbs, if desired.  Cook, turning the potatoes with tongs, until golden brown, about 20 - 30 minutes, turning as necessary.  While the potatoes roast, toast under a preheated grill until a rich, dark brown crust forms.  Drizzle with a few spoons of olive oil if needed.  You can do this the first day or two.  Remove from pan and shake the pan to loosen the browned crust, then set on a plate to let cool.  When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, cut off the ends of the potatoes and place into a small bowl.  Place the tomatoes and bread crumbs in a separate bowl and toss to coat.  Sprinkle the outside of the potato mound with remaining crumbs, if using.  Transfer the mound of potato salad onto a platter.  Garnish plate with a little parsley, drizzle with olive oil and serve at once, or let cool and serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Farmer's Cheese With Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 9 medium navel oranges, quartered | 2 medium white pearl onions | 1/4 cup white pearl onion, peeled | 1 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 7 ounces vodka | 6 cups warm water | 20 ounces farmer cheese, grated
instructions: Preparation, put the orange quarters, onions, and cardamom in a saucepan, with the potatoes in cold water to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer gently until liquid just begins to be syrupy.  Remove from heat, drain the onions and pearl onions, and set aside.  Strain liquid through a fine sieve into a mixing bowl.  Let cool. title: Gramma's Easy Salsa

instructions: In a medium bowl combine the green chilies and cranberries and stir.

title: Mixed Sprouts & Chips (Majareeba Kala Bathc
ingredients: 4 bunches mixed sprouts ( i use mixed sprouts, try 2 bunches if you like ) | 2 pieces cucumbers ( peeled, cut into thin strips, then lengthwise ) | 1 piece chocoholiched chocolate chip | 25 g ghee ( melted butter ) | 1 tablespoon chopped parsnip ( optional )

title: Mom's Chicken Burgers (Slow Cooker)

instructions: In a large, deep, nonreactive mixing bowl, blend together all of the ingredients except the bread cubes. Add the bread cubes and continue to mix it into the mixture.  You can spread the mixture in a slow cooker but it should not be too thick.  Cook on low 6 hours, on high 2 hours and then turn to high for 5 more hours until thickened.

title: Smoked Salmon with Chilli
ingredients: 450 g salmon fillets, skin removed | 1 cup pumpkin seeds | 125 g unsalted cashews | 250 g salted roasted cashews | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 teaspoons dried rosemary | tortilla chips
instructions: Preheat the grill to high, or preheat your oven to 180°c/350°f.  Put the pumpkin seeds on a baking sheet.  Bake for 10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until toasted.  Set the nuts aside.  Toss with the cashews and 2 tbsps of the chilli.  Remove the salmon from the oven, and allow to sit for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, stir together the remaining chilli and ketchup.  Spread the ketchup onto the salmon fillet, then place in the grill, skin side down.  Grill for 3 - 5 minutes until cooked through.  Sprinkle the toasted pumpkin seeds over the top and continue to grill for a few minutes, until aromatic.  Serve the salmon fillet with the chilli on top of the chilli.

title: Wild Rice and Kielbasa Parcels

Drain the mushrooms and reserve the liquid.  Cut off the stems and finely chop, along with the mushrooms. Preheat the oven to 350°f generously coat a baking dish with olive oil and lay out 1 sheet of reynolds wrap miniature flatbreads.  Place 1 kielbasa piece on the lower center of the pastry sheet in an even layer.  Sprinkle half of the diced kielbasa meat and the diced mushroom strips on top.  Spoon in 1 1/2 tablespoons of the couscous and sprinkle in 1/2 tablespoon of oregano.  Spoon about half of half of the sliced mushrooms on top of the kielbasa.  Repeat the layers two more times, topping with kielbasa meat and mushrooms in between the layers of kielbasa, couscous and mushrooms.  Continue the process until you have used up the amount of filling and kielbasa and mushrooms.  Lay a second layer of pastry dough in the pan, brushing the top with olive oil to stop it from sticking.  Cut a few slits in the surface of the pastry to vent steam.  Make a small hole in the edge to allow steam to escape.  Brush the top pastry sheet with extra olive oil to keep the dough from tearing during baking.  Bake the pastry in the oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from the oven and top evenly with the remaining sliced kielbasa meat, juice from 2 oranges, cream and salt, to taste. title: Mixed Strawberries

title: Cornflour Chips (Taro Sweet)

title: Green Olive Soup

title: Homemade Beer

title: Viscontini

title: My Mum's Chicken & Dumplings

Transfer it to a warm serving platter or bowl.  Cover with a clean cloth and let cool to warm completely.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pork,poblano chile,lamb,celery salt,ginger root,nicoise olive,chinese egg noodle,salmon

ingredients: 1/8 pound ground pork | 1/8 pound ground lamb | 1 teaspoon ground ginger root, minced | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt, or to taste | 1 poblano chile, thinly sliced | 1 can chinese-style fried egg noodles | 1/2 cup nicoise olives, chopped, or as needed | 2 tablespoons sliced pickled ginger root

Random Ingredients: red cabbage,soy sauce,blueberry,beet,plain flour,red bean,savory,cranberry juice
title: American Red Bean Salad

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together.  Serve chilled.

title: Spinach Salad With Prosciutto and Lemon Apricot Dressing
ingredients: 6 ounces prosciutto, cut into julienne strips | 2 tablespoons oil, extra light olive oil or 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil | 4 ounces baby spinach, washed dried, stems trimmed | 3 ounces apricot preserves | 1/4 cup custard powder | 1/8 teaspoon allspice | 1/8 teaspoon citron, chopped and sprinkled over salad

Remove from heat and place in a large serving bowl.  Whisk preserves with custard powder, allspice and citron in a small bowl.  Drizzle over salad and toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours.  Before serving, sprinkle with additional sugar and more lemon if desired.

title: Faux Rice
ingredients:
1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 2 tablespoons instant arborio rice ( not minute rice ) | 1 teaspoon grated lime zest | 2 large dried fruit, such as raisins, chopped, dried cherries, dates, grapeberries, etc.
    - for desired crispiness
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine soup, rice, zest.  Heat over medium heat stirring constantly.  Turn heat to low and wait about 10 minutes.  Add dried fruit.  Let sit 5 minuted before serving.

Random Ingredients: bread,white sesame seed,coconut,galliano,white cheddar cheese,cranberry juice
title: Creamy Jewels
ingredients: 10 pieces white sesame seeds | 3 lbs white cheddar cheese, shredded | 3 tablespoons ground turkish white cheddar or 3 tablespoons arabic white cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup dried cranberry juice | 1 cup freshly grated unsweetened coconut | bread, cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Spray the inside of a 3 to 4 quart baking dish with cooking spray.  Spread each piece of sesame seeds on a cutting board.  Toast sesame seeds in oven approximately 5 min, just until they begin to crackle.  Remove from oven and let stand.  Coarsely grind seeds with a mortar and pestle.  Crumble the white cheddar cheese and stir in ground turkish or arabic white cheddar or cheddar cheese.  Press into the bottom and 1 inch up the sides of the prepared baking dish.  Combine cranberry juice, fresh grated coconut and chopped toasted sesame seeds in a medium bowl and pour around the cheese mixture in the baking dish.  Smooth the top as much as possible.  Bake in the preheated oven approximately 45 minute.  Set aside and let cool slightly before removing the dish from the oven.

title: Easy Beef Ghee Kabobs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks, cut 3/4 inch thick ( cut 2/3 to 3/8 inches thick ) | 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup grated orange rind ( candied peel ) | 2 tablespoons golden raisins | 1 cup fresh lime juice | 1/2 cup melted ghee
instructions: Combine cilantro, oregano, orange rind, raisins, and lime juice in small bowl.  Combine melted ghee and 2 tbs lime juice in large bowl.  Add meat.

title: Homemade Mexican Wine
ingredients: 1 bottle white wine | 1 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Pour wine in a large glass bottle, and add the chili powder.  Stir.  Cover the bottle, and refrigerate for 6 to 8 days.  Strain the wine into a large glass bottle or a clean jar.  It will keep for up to 10 days.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,okra,cold water,wasabi paste,mint leaf,portabella mushroom cap,pepper,garlic paste
title: Spicy Okra (Or Crab or Pork Chops) (Microwave)
ingredients: 2 portabella mushroom caps, sliced in a thin diagonal slice | 2 okra, cut in 1 1/2 inch chunks | 2 tablespoons minced garlic paste ( to taste, i use jarred if you don't have ) | 1/2 teaspoon wasabi paste ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon lemon juice or 1 teaspoon lime juice | 1/2 cup cold water | shredded mexican blend cheese | freshly cracked pepper
instructions: Put mushrooms into a microwave bowl.  Put the garlic in the same bowl and stir well.  Add the mushrooms and okra which have been sliced in slices, wasabi, lemon or lime juice, and cold water.  Cover and microwave on high for 10 - 12 mins or until the okra is tender.  Stir well.  Sprinkle cheese on top and microwave a little bit more, to melt the cheese.

title: Sienis Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 small beef stew meat | 1 can snow pea pods, drained | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 1 tablespoon dried mint | topping
instructions: Cut meat into 3cm cubes.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes or until ingredients are hot.  Serve with steamed carrots, green beans and rice.

title: Spanish Bread
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 3 plum tomatoes or 3 jalapeno tomatoes, sliced thinly | 3 tablespoons ketjap manis | 1/3 cup sherry wine
instructions: Cut baguette in half horizontally at one side, then cut in half again with a very sharp knife or pizza cutter.  Spread each side of each half with ketjap manis.  Place bread halves onto a baking sheet and bake at 300 degrees till light and crisp and hot.  Watch them closely they burn fast.  When toast looks dry place slices onto serving plate.  You can keep hot this will make your house smell good and smell good.

title: Seed Dip
ingredients: 1 kg raw peanuts | 1/2 kg raw jalapeno pepper | 1/2 kg fresh anaheim chilies | 1 1/4 kg parsnips | 2 kg ham ( i prefer a lean ham ) | 2 fresh anaheim chilies | 1 head roasted red peppers
instructions: Boil the peanuts until just soft.  Drain and cool.  Peel, core and grind the peppers.  Place peanuts in a mortar and mash with a pestle, then add the other ingredients in a large bowl and mix together well.  Cover and chill and refrigerate for 1 - 5 days.

title: Wild Mushroom and Bamboo Shoots
ingredients: 4 cups trimmed wild mushrooms or 4 cups trimmed shiitake mushrooms | 1 1/4 cups sliced bamboo shoots | 1/3 cup sliced red leaf lettuce
instructions: Wipe mushroom caps clean with damp paper towels.  Arrange mushrooms, bamboo shoots and lettuce on 4 serving plates.  Drizzle with cooking spray and season to taste with salt and pepper.  If making ahead of time, place covered plate directly on top of ingredients.  Cover.  Let stand 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

title: Garlicky Crock Pot Lamb Fingers
ingredients: 500 g leg of lamb | 1 bunch radish, cut on diagonal into fingers
instructions: Trim off any excess fat or sinew from the lamb.  Make sure to get a thorough coating of fat, the best coating is paper toweling.  Score the surface of the lamb with a sharp knife in a criss cross pattern.  Insert two cuts into each slit and put one piece of radish down the centre of each breast.  Roll each breast into a finger shape and place on a plate.  Refrigerate until required.  Place onto a wire rack over a flat platter and dry overnight in the fridge so as to get the fat off the top.  The next day, pre heat the oven to 220c/170c/gas lay your lamb on a chopping board and lay flat on your board.  Using your hands you will stretch and then flatten the lamb all the while leaving the fat showing.  You want it to be thin but not so tight that you can't see anything through.  Put on a rack into a roasting tin/cookie tray with the fat underneath.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Bake for 2 hours.  Remove and let sit 5 minutes, then invert the whole tray onto a hot serving plate.  Remove all the fat and then pour any extra fat from the tray into a gravy boat, pour over the lamb fingers and enjoy.

title: The Best Caesar Salad Dressing for Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1/4 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1 pinch baking powder
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, garlic granules, salt, pepper, and baking powder until thoroughly blended.  Chill completely before serving.

title: Gorgonzola Baked Belly Baked Beets
ingredients: 4 beet, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 cup butter gorgonzola, crumbled | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh dill weed | 1/2 teaspoon minced ginger root | 1 teaspoon pepper | 1 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese | 2 scallions, thinly sliced | 1 pinch dried dill weed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine beet, butter, gorgonzola cheese, dill, ginger, pepper, and parmesan cheese in a bowl.  Arrange sliced beets into a casserole dish.  Pour about 1/2 of the belly mixture over beets.  Sprinkle with scallions.  Repeat layers of beet mixture and betta cheese mixture.  Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven.

title: Spaghetti With Peas
ingredients: 500 g peas | 2 tablespoons sofrito
instructions: To boil the peas place 3 - 4 tbsp of sofrito in a pan then boil rapidly for a few minutes.  Take off the heat then add enough water to the pan to cover or until you get about two litres.

title: Spicy Bacon Wrapped Spicy Snack!
ingredients: 1/2 lb bacon | 1/3 cup dill, chopped | 1 serrano pepper, cut into narrow strips | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine, for spreading
instructions: Place bacon in skillet on medium low heat.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until bacon is golden brown.  Add dill, serrano pepper and butter and heat through.  Take bacon and pat dry with paper towels.  Using one hand, hold down pepper slices and pull at each end.  Take the bacon out of the skillet and place at the top of bacon.  Wrap with foil and place on cutting board.  Serve with sour cream, pickles, jalapenos or cheese.

Random Ingredients: bulb garlic,anchovy paste,thyme sprig,sharp cheddar cheese,ice water,clear honey
title: Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1/2 bulb of garlic | 1/2 bunch fresh thyme sprig | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 2 tablespoons clear honey | 2 tablespoons ice water | 8 ounces reduced-fat sharp cheddar cheese, grated and mixed with finely chopped salad greens
instructions: Put the garlic and thyme sprigs into a pestle and mortar and whizz on high speed until they become a lovely, smooth paste in about 40 seconds or so.  Grind in the anchovy paste and honey and blend until very smooth.  Put the ice water into a bowl, add the cheese and mix well.  Add the cheese to the pestle and lime juice and mix.  Toss the dressing with the salad and serve at once.

title: Thai Red Curry Paste
ingredients: 20 leaves of fresh mint, finely shredded | 2 cans red curry paste
instructions: Place red curry paste in a blender with a little boiling water.  Blend on high until it becomes like a paste.  Put in refrigerator, it will be a little solid.  After it is chilled, put it into sterilized jar.

title: Grilled Spicy Beef
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, trimmed of visible fat | 1 container mascarpone cheese, room temperature | 2 fresh dill pickles, sliced
instructions: Place steaks in a shallow heavy duty food storage plastic bag with 2 tablespoons of the mascarpone.  Add pickles and coat with remaining mascarpone.  Seal bag and chill for at least 2 hours but no longer than 8 hours.  Remove steaks from bag and grill 5 inches from medium hot coals.  Grill 3 to 5 minutes per side or until meat is medium rare.  Serve with remaining mascarpone.

title: Poblano Chile Hot Sauce
ingredients: 12 fresh poblano chiles ( remove stems and seeds ) | 1/2 cup hot ham stock | salad dressing
instructions: Fill a food processor with the chiles.  Add the ham stock, pulse until smooth.  Transfer the mixture to a medium size sauce pan.  Turn the heat to high, boil and continue cooking uncovered until desired consistency is achieved, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,chicken thigh,cilantro leaf,lemon juice,spaghetti squash,heavy whipping cream,asafoetida powder
title: Vaca's Spicy Chicken Cacciatore
ingredients: 2 lbs spaghetti squash, halved and seeded | 3 teaspoons asafoetida powder | 2 1/2 - 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1/4 cup light italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | lemon juice | cilantro leaves ( for garnish )
instructions: Place the spaghetti squash in a saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until half cooked.  While the squash cooks, combine the asafetida powder, chicken, and 1/2 cup of the italian dressing mix in a zip top bag.  Shake off the excess water.  Drain the spaghetti squash, transfer it into a large bowl, and toss it with the remaining 1/2 cup of dressing mix.  Squeeze the water out of the squash, then toss it in also.  Place the squash mixture into the skillet, and allow to cook at low heat for 30 - 40 minutes, or until spaghetti is done.  While the spaghetti is cooking, whip the remaining italian dressing in a small saucepan until well blended.  When the spaghetti squash is done, drain thoroughly, and transfer it to a large serving platter.  Spoon some of the spaghetti squash and chicken mixture among the platter, then scatter the cilantro leaves on top.  Serve it warm, or chilled.

title: Italian Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 2 ounces sausage | 2 jalapeno chiles, seeded and sliced
instructions: Brown the hamburger and sausage.  Remove sausage from pan and spread sausage/laced sausage on hot bread slice.  Top with sliced chilies.  You may serve with salsa and sour cream.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,mayonnaise,white sesame seed,curry paste,gouda cheese,curry powder
title: Curried Beef Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds beef stew meat | 3/4 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon mild curry paste | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder | 1 teaspoon white sesame seeds | 12 slices sliced smoked gouda cheese
instructions: Place beef in a medium skillet and cook over medium high heat until the beef is browned and the juices run clear, about 15 minutes.  Drain the excess fat.  Return the meat to the skillet and stir in the mayonnaise, curry paste, curry powder, and sesame seeds.  Serve the meat and any accumulated juices with a slice of gouda cheese in the center of each wrap.

Random Ingredients: gelatin,olive oil,feta cheese,vanilla,ciabatta,coconut milk,chipotle powder,dark sesame oil
title: Pancakes With Chipotle Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1 package ciabatta, cut into 4 - 5 slices | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon gelatin, soaked in | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 12 ounces light coconut milk | 3/4 cup feta cheese, crumbled | 1/2 teaspoon low-sodium instant vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon chipotle powder
instructions: Lightly oil the inside of a 9 inch springform pan for frying.  Line the bottom and sides of the pan with half the ciabatta slices, then cover with overlapping slices of the pancake batter.  Refrigerate until set, about 1 hour.  In a small saucepan, mix together the remaining ciabatta and olive oil.  Sprinkle the gelatine over, and set aside to soften for a few minutes.  Place the coconut milk, cheese, vanilla and spices in a medium saucepan and warm over medium heat.  Stir until smooth and heated through, about 2 minutes.  Dip each slice of pancake pancake in the coconut cream, allowing a few slices on the to float to the surface.  Serve immediately.

title: Tasty and Yummy Tea!
ingredients: 1 cup loose tea | 1 inch fresh ginger, peeled and finely grated ( optional )
instructions: Put the tea and ginger into an 8 oz cup that's upside down on to a tea towel.  Put the tea and water into the cup, or a steamer if you don't have one.  Leave the heat on the lowest possible, so that you just see steam.  You will need to steam the tea for 2 - 3 hrs, or until the tea is just beginning to boil.  Do not stir remove the tea from the heat.  The tea will start to smell very strongly of ginger.  Leave for about 10 minutes as the tea might start to linger.  After 2 - 3 mins, remove the tea from the heat and let it sit for 5 mins on the tea towel with it being.  Pour the tea into glasses and enjoy.

title: Walnut Crumble
ingredients: 3/4 cup walnuts, toasted | 1 cup sugar | 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 2 slices white bread, crusts removed ( use crusty bread if that is all you have ) | lemon wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 160°c combine the walnuts and sugar in a food processor or blender and process until coarsely ground.  Add fish sauce and process to combine.  Pour into a shallow ovenproof dish.  Line the bread slices with the walnut mixture, pressing into the bread.  Sprinkle with lemon wedges.  Bake in the oven for 15 - 20 minutes, depending on thickness of the crust, or until golden.

Random Ingredients: baking potato,white flour,tomato green chile pepper,basmati rice,potato,mexican cheese,cranberry,za'atar spice mix
title: Baked Mexican Potatoes and Cranberry Pilaf
ingredients: 8 baking potatoes, quartered | 1 large baking potato, quartered | 1 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons fresh basil, chopped | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers | 1 can diced tomatoes with liquid, drained | 1 package za'atar spice mix | 1 cup cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with non stick aluminum foil, spray with non stick cooking spray.  Place quartered onions in a baking dish with tops. In a mixing bowl combine flour, za'atar, and parsley.  Dredge potato in flour mixture and arrange pieces on top of onion, then set them aside.  In a skillet cook potatoes in 1/2 c water about 10 minutes and spoon off excess liquid.  Drain on paper towels.  Spoon tomatoes into a 1/2 c sauce pan with liquid, potatoes and parsley.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat.  Simmer 10 minutes stir rice into tomato mixture and pour into dish.  Cover and bake for 35 to 40 minutes or till bubbly.  Serve with additional za'atar if desired.

title: Chile Ziti
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked ziti pasta or 12 ounces penne | 2 1/2 - 3 cups rotisserie-cooked chicken breasts, cubed | 1 stalk celery, sliced | 2 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 2 medium hot green chili peppers, diced 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup salsa | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Cook ziti pasta according to the package directions.  Remove to bowl.  If using chicken instead of chicken, add to ziti.  In a dutch oven, heat the chili peppers over medium heat.  Add the celery and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until translucent but crisp.  Stir in the sauce and cook until well combined.  Stir in the ziti to the broth.

title: Lentil Chili Style
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 6 whole jalapeno peppers | 3 tablespoons ground sumac
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add rinsed and drained lentils and jalapenos.

title: Cuban Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf ciabatta, sliced into 1/2-inch thick slices | 2 limes
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium.  Use a cookie cutter or pastry wheel or pizza peel to cut a slit about 1 1/2 inch deep into the top of the bread.  Arrange the slices of bread onto the grill with the slit facing up.  Grill until browned, about 5 minutes.  Squeeze 2 or 3 limes over the bread.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: soy sauce,chocolate ice cream,fish stock,ciabatta,tamari,salmon fillet,mango
title: Smoked Salmon and Mango Panini
ingredients: 4 ciabatta | 1 kg salmon fillet, skin removed and cut into chunks | 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 85 g mangoes, coarsely chopped | 1 liter chicken stock | 1 cup tamari ( gluten free soy sauce ) | 250 ml coconut-flavoured fish stock
instructions: Preheat your grill, brush the ciabatta with some tamari.  Place over an oven tray and grill for 6 minutes or until toasted.  Transfer to your liking.  Add the salmon into the base of an ovenproof dish.  Add 2 handfuls of mango, and then scatter over the remaining mango.  In a jug add the chicken stock, tamari and coconut flavoured fish stock.  Pour over the top of the salmon mixture.  Return to your oven and cook for 20 - 30 minutes or until the salmon is cooked and the sauce thickened and sticky.  Allow to stand for about 5 - 10 minutes to allow the salmon to absorb any stock.  Slice the ciabatta on the diagonal into 1cm thick wedges.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,cornflour,golden delicious apple,chive,cream cheese,parsley leaf,vegetable
title: Apple and Chive Cheese Sausages
ingredients: 8 golden delicious apples | 2 tablespoons cornflour | 1 tablespoon light cream cheese | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 1 tablespoon parsley leaves, chopped | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar | 600 g mixed vegetables, of your choice
instructions: Peel and core the apples and cut into slices.  Place them in a non stick frying pan and sprinkle the cornflour over them.  Cook over a medium heat for about 10 minutes or until the apples have released some of their juice.  Allow the apples to cool.  Mix cream cheese with chives, parsley, sugar, and light brown sugar.  Add the apple and chive mixture and mix together well.  Cook the sausages in a lightly greased, non stick frying pan for 10 - 15 minutes or until the mixture of cheese and apples is hot and the topping is a light yellow.  Serve hot as a starter or side dish with fresh vegetables.

title: Ginger and Ginger Preserves
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs watermelon rinds ( about 8 rinds ) | 1 lb fresh ginger ( about a 5 inch piece )
instructions: Trim root ends of rinds.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,parmigiano reggiano cheese,salmon steak,lettuce leaf,malt vinegar,celery
title: Tropical Citrus Salmon
