instructions: Place salmon in a large plastic bag with the lime wedges.  Refrigerate at least 3 hours.  Prepare grill or broiler.  Remove salmon from bag and rub off excess marinade.

title: Easy Chili, Red Pepper, and Olive Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 box farfalle pasta ( bowtie ) | 1 package red chiles, julienned | 1 can sliced ripe olives | 4 whole grain tortillas, cut into 1 inch strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Cook and drain farfalle pasta as directed on package.  Rinse and drain chiles and set aside.  While pasta is cooking, chop olives.  Place tortilla strips on baking sheet and toast in oven for 6 minutes or until edges are crispy.  Spread cooked pasta onto the tortillas and then add chopped chiles and olives.  Top with other ingredients and dig in.

title: Oven Adobo Red Lentil and Roasted Red Lentils
ingredients: 1 lb red lentil ( or red kidney beans ) | adobo seasoning
instructions: Wash lentils and soak in plenty of water overnight, this removes any stones.  Heat oven to 325°f.  Cook lentils in boiling, salted water, until tender.  Drain.  Stir in adobo seasoning as you like.  Serve with crusty bread and sour cream for dipping.

Random Ingredients: dill pickle spear,coriander,grain white rice,breadcrumb,cream cheese,shiitake mushroom,cumin seed,grain rice
title: Rice Stuffed Shiitake Mushrooms
ingredients: 6 shiitake mushrooms | 1/2 cup long grain white rice | 2 tablespoons cream cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon coriander | 1/4 teaspoon cumin seed, crushed | 1/8 teaspoon dill pickle spear | 3 tablespoons fresh breadcrumbs | 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander | 1/8 teaspoon cumin seed | 2/3 cup sour cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Rinse and cut the mushrooms in quarters.  Wash the mushrooms and then cut them open leaving about an inch of stems intact.  Place the mushrooms in a large bowl with the rice, cream cheese, 1 tbsp breadcrumbs, coriander, cumin, pickle and 1/8 tsp each of the cumin and coriander seeds.  Stuff each mushroom and place them in a lightly greased baking dish.  In a small bowl whisk the sour cream with remaining 1 tbsp breadcrumbs, coriander and cumin seed until smooth and spreadable.  Sprinkle over the mushrooms and bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.

title: Smoked Tomato Brandy
ingredients: 8 -10 canned italian tomatoes, with juice or 8 -10 canned italian tomatoes, with juice | 1/4 - 1/2 cup brandy ( the amount depends on how much liquid you have and how hot the brandy tastes ) | 1 -2 teaspoon chipotle powder ( to taste )
instructions: Open each tomato and drain.  Using 1 - 2 tsp chipotle powder, crush the seeds in a mortar and pestle at a high speed with the back of a spoon.  This will produce a smoky, hot smoky tomato that tastes as though it were an acid and flavorful oil from a fruit.  Wet the bottom of a small, heavy pan with about 1/4 cup of the brandy.

Random Ingredients: bailey irish cream,five spice powder,sage leaf,water,kalamata olive,yoghurt
title: Famous Kahlua Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup yoghurt, preferably unsweetened | 1 tablespoon kalamata olives, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1/4 teaspoon sage leaf | 1/4 cup water | 1/3 cup baileys irish cream
instructions: In a bowl, combine the yoghurt, olives, 5 spice powder, sage, water and bailey's.  Whisk to blend thoroughly.  Season with a bit of salt and a touch of sugar.  Cover with plastic wrap and allow to marinate in the fridge for 8 hours or longer.

title: Veal "no Boil" for Two (Burgundy)
ingredients: 3 lbs veal, cut into 4 slices | 3 cubanelle peppers, cored | 15 ounces grape-juice, chilled | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 2 cups whipped topping
instructions: Put veal slices in a large heavy nonstick skillet.  Turn once so they will lay flat on all sides.  Pour grape juice over the veal.  Sprinkle with vanilla and cover.  Cook in a 325 degree oven for 30 minutes.  Turn over the meat and check that it is not pink inside.  Note, if meat thermometer reads 140° for medium or 160° for well done remove from heat.  Let meat stand for 15 minutes.  Pour juice into colander under cold running water, draining excess juices.  Place meat in a deep bowl with the grapes.  Sprinkle with whipped topping.  Cover with clean paper, or in a large baking dish, towel cloth bag with enough cold water to cover.  Microwave on medium power for 5 minutes.  Place dish of meat in a 300 degree oven for another 45 minutes, check to if the surface is becoming dry.  When meat is tender, remove from oven and let stand for 15 minutes.  Slice to serve.

Random Ingredients: almond oil,hellmann mayonnaise,beef sirloin,rotini pasta,romano cheese,bean sprout
title: Beef Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef sirloin, trimmed and cut into thin slices | 8 ounces rotini pasta, uncooked | 2 tablespoons slivered almonds oil | 1/2 cup hellmann's mayonnaise | 1/3 cup grated romano cheese | 1 bag baby romano cheese
instructions: Cook the pasta as directed on the package.  Drain, cool, and shred it with your favorite vegetable ingredients.  Mix with the mayonnaise and refrigerate the salad until ready to serve.

title: Shiitake and Dill Pickles in Hot Water
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh dill pickle | 9 fresh shiitake mushrooms
instructions: Thoroughly clean and dry the pickles.  Rinse your shiitake mushrooms.  Place one mushroom at a time between two layers of paper towels, sprinkle with a little salt, and press each mushroom with a soft cloth if you want to preserve the moisture.  This should have no more than a coating of liquid on it.  Wrap each mushroom individually in a slice of pickle.  Repeat with the remaining mushrooms.  Pour hot water over the pickles.  Allow the pickles to soak in the water for at least 20 minutes before removing the mushrooms from the soaking water.  Use as a wrap for sandwiches or as a wrap to serve sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,fenugreek seed,white flour,chili,cream mushroom soup
title: Curry powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder ( or leg ) | 3 cans cream of mushroom soup | 2 teaspoons chili | 4 cups white flour
instructions: Mix fenugreek and chili.  Cut pork into 1 inch cubes.  Coat meat with flour.  Add meat to soup and cook on low fire until meat is tender.  Add to soup.  If it starts to dry out, add more soup and mix.  Serve hot.

title: Oma's Black-Eyed Pea Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup icing sugar, sifted | 1/2 teaspoon ground black-eyed peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.  Measure the black eyed peas into a glass bowl, and spoon about 1/2 tablespoon of icing over the peas.  Stir and cover with a lid until the topping is spreadable.  With a spatula, cut scone shapes with scissors or scissors.  Bake in the preheated oven until the tops are browned, about 30 minutes.

title: Baked Cod in Anchovy, Herbs, and Anchovies
ingredients: 1/2 lb cod | 1 tablespoon mixed herbs, chopped
instructions: Rinse cod under cold water and pat dry.  Cut off all bones except the head by gently pulling the muscle from it with a paring knife, but taking the skin off first.  Cut up the head into 4 equal portions.  Place the head sections and the tentacles on top of each other on a sheet of aluminum foil with a small, even layer of herbs on top.  Paint with water and drizzle with olive oil.  Place under the grill until the skin is pock marked and blackened.  Turn carefully and place the fish on top of the herbs.  Cover with foil and set aside at room temperature for 2 hours.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: tarragon,bonito flake,dark brown sugar,tofu,mexican tomato,rom tomato
title: Chef Bevski's Baked Tofu
ingredients: 3/4 cup dried bonito flakes, flakes ( katsuobushi ) | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1 roma tomato, halved | 3 tablespoons mexican-style stewed tomatoes, preferably packed in oil | 12 ounces tofu or 12 ounces soy protein | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Combine the bonito flakes, dark brown sugar, roma tomato, stewed tomatoes, tofu, and tarragon in a shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle on the bonito flakes.  Bake tofu for 45 - 50 minutes, until slightly browned and crispy.

Random Ingredients: ham,saffron thread,graham cracker,sultana,onion powder,irish whiskey,vanilla pudding mix
title: Saffron Christmas Trees
ingredients: 2 packages instant vanilla pudding mix | 1 cup sultanas or 1 cup raisins | 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads ( threads crushed ) | 3 cups sweet onions or 3 cups chopped onions | 1/2 teaspoon dried saffron ( threads crushed ) | 2 cups graham crackers ( coarsely chopped ) or 2 cups graham crackers | 2 cups smoked ham ( finely chopped )
instructions: In a 1 1/2qt microwave safe glass or ceramic bowl, combine the pudding mix.  Add the raisins, saffron threads or sultanas, saffron, chopped onions, saffron and graham cracker crumbs or graham crackers.  Microwave on high for 7 minutes.  Turn off microwave and leave for another 2 minutes.  Remove from microwave and serve.

title: Salmon Parcels
ingredients: 2 green onions, sliced | 1 pear, halved, deseeded, grated | 1 red onion, diced | 2 teaspoons mixed dried fruit | 2 teaspoons white flour | 3 tablespoons smoked salmon, chopped
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine sliced green onions, pear, onion, mixed fruit and flour.

title: Cracker Broccoli
ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 teaspoons ground mace | 1 tablespoon melted fat or 1 tablespoon ghee
instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°f.  In a shallow bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs, mace, melted fat or ghee.  Line a baking sheet with foil leaving the oven at about an inch overhanging the foil over the outside.  Spread out the cracker mixture slightly, but not too much.  Sprinkle the broccoli pieces evenly in the foil.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until just tender and lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,cream mushroom soup,paprika,bacon grease,porcini mushroom,kielbasa,tomato ketchup,monterey jack pepper cheese
title: Porcini-Stuffed Mushrooms #SP5
ingredients: 3 -5 medium poblano mushrooms | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 tablespoon tom ketchup | 1/2 cup light coconut milk | 8 slices bacon grease | 8 slices kielbasa or 8 slices pancetta, diced | 8 slices monterey jack pepper cheese ( optional ) | paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Wipe mushrooms clean with damp paper towel.  Chop stems off.  Remove any mushroom stems with a 1/2 inch spout or needle you got from the jar.  Set aside.  Slice caps in half lengthwise.  Discard stems.  Set aside.  Mix other ingredients except for caps.  Brush caps generously with this mixture.  Place in 2 ungreased ramekins or cookie sheet sprayed with pam.  Bake for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.  Remove from oven and add caps and their liquid, topping them with the bacon or cheese if you want to keep them together.  Bake 5 minutes more.

title: Cheaters Baked Onions
ingredients: 4 large sweet onions | 1/4 cup sunflower oil | seasoning salt
instructions: Preheat oven 190°c.  Trim ends from the sweet onions and cut them lengthways into 1 cm slices.  Place sliced onions into a deep ovenproof dish.  Drizzle with olive oil.  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake uncovered in the 400f oven for 40 - 50 minutes or until golden.

title: Jicama and Banana Salad
ingredients: 2 cups jicama, peeled and very thinly sliced | 2 bananas, cut into slices | 1/2 lime, juice of | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Dry the jicama slices.  Cut into strips of about 1/4 inch thickness.  Squeeze a wedge of lime juice over the bananas.  Sprinkle lime juice over the fruit if desired and sprinkle with dried dill.  Toss gently.  Serve warm or chilled.

title: Fish Satay
ingredients: 2 lbs fish, cut into cubes ( your choice of fish ) | 3 bell peppers, diced ( use one red pepper, a green and red pepper ) | 1 cup chopped dried fruit ( optional, i love cranberry ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup sweet chili sauce
instructions: Boil water in a large pot.  Add fish & simmer for approximately 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, place remaining ingredients in a serving bowl, & add just enough sweet chili sauce to coat.  Drain fish & keep warm while chopping into bite sized pieces. .  Add the fish to the bowl, simmer for 5 more minutes.

title: Tamarind and Queso Fresco Spread
ingredients: 1/2 cup queso fresco, crumbled | 1 tablespoon shallot, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 2/3 teaspoon cardamom seed
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.

title: Filipino Marinated Mussels
ingredients: 4 lbs mussels | 1/2 lb minced garlic | 8 tablespoons margarine | 4 teaspoons white light brown sugar | 4 teaspoons anise seed | 1 teaspoon ground galangal
instructions: Wash the mussels thoroughly with a hot tap.  Set them, one by one, on a cloth, and tie the cloth with kitchen twine.  This will make the mussels easier to remove.  Clean the mussels by pouring boiling water over them and swishing them around a bit.  When the mussels are half open remove them and reserve the liquid in the pan.  Heat the margarine in a large heavy skillet, and saute the garlic over medium heat for about 4 to 5 minutes.  Do not brown.  Add the reserved liquid, sugar, anise seeds and ground galangal and remove the pan from the heat.  Add the mussels, cover, and place the cover on the pan.  Place in the preheated oven at 375°f and bake for 45 minutes.  The liquid should be clear and reduced by half.  Discard any mussels that are still closed after 45 minutes if cooked in the pan.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,beef brisket,baking powder,accent seasoning,portobello mushroom,adobo seasoning
title: Mexican Brisket
ingredients: 2 lbs beef brisket | 2 tablespoons accent seasoning, divided ( mccormick ) | 6 large portobello mushrooms | 2 tablespoons guajillo chilies | 2 tablespoons adobo seasoning | 2 teaspoons baking powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Rub 2 t Accent seasoning into brisket.  Place brisket on rack in roasting pan.  Roast in 325 degree oven just long enough to reach desired doneness.  Remove meat from oven.  Place mushrooms in roaster pan.  Roast, uncovered, in 350 degree oven for about 4 hours.  Cool meat and discard fat.  Chop meat into slices 1 inch thick.  Mix the remaining 2 t Accent seasoning, 2 tablespoons of guajillo chile seasoning and baking powder.  Rub all over cooled brisket.  Arrange on platter.  Surround with sliced mushrooms.  Serve with remaining guajillo chile seasoning as desired.

title: Smoky Oil for Veggies
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil | 1 tablespoon pumpkin puree ( pumpkin ) ( optional )
instructions: Heat up the sun dried tomato and pumpkin puree in a small pan.  Once heated through, mix well.  Pour into a baking dish and keep in the fridge for at least an hour or so so.  Enjoy.

title: Irish Salmon in Whole Wheat
ingredients: 1 lb fish fillet, cut into 4 pieces | 2 cups vegetable broth | 3/4 cup whole wheat flour
instructions: Place fish in a pan with broth and bring to a boil.  Lower heat and simmer gently for 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.  Meanwhile combine flour and 3/4 cup of the broth from the salmon in a large bowl.  Drain fish, reserving the liquid.  Place fish in the flour mixture and stir to coat.  To serve, place the salmon on a platter and pour sauce over and surround with remaining sauce.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,white vinegar,polish sausage,grain rice,white wine,adobo sauce,amaretto
title: Spanish Sausages(Polish Hunter)
ingredients: 3/4 cup distilled white vinegar | 3 tablespoons amaretto | 2 packages polish sausage, thinly sliced | 1 tablespoon coarse grain rice or 1 tablespoon pearl barley | 1 teaspoon finely chopped orange peel | 1/3 cup dry white wine | 1 -2 teaspoon chopped adobo sauce ( more or less )
instructions: In a large skillet heat vinegar, amaretto and wine together, bringing to boil.  Add sausage and raisins.  Simmer until sausage is done.  While still hot, add in rice or pearl barley, orange peel and adobo sauce.  Mix.  If desired, serve warm.

title: Greek Omelette with Calamari
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 lb squid | 1 egg yolk | 1 tablespoon feta cheese
instructions: Cut squid in half lengthwise and cut tentacles from center to within 1/4 inch of tentacles and tentacles.  Combine garlic salt, garlic salt and feta cheese.  Dip squid in egg yolk then fry squid in oil over medium heat until crust is crisp and fat has been rendered, about 5 minutes.  Serve with garlic salt sauce over sliced cheese.

title: Corn Gravy
ingredients: 1 can whole kernel corn | 1 1/4 cups all-purpose white flour
instructions: Drain whole kernel corn well, reserving liquid.  Rinse corn with water and pat dry.  In a medium bowl, stir corn, flour, and lard with fingers until dough makes a firm, slightly sticky ball.  Knead in enough reserved corn liquid to form a crumbly texture for coating.  Cover and refrigerate until chilled.

title: My Big Fat Greek Feta Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt, no substitutions ( or feta cheese if you can't get it ) | 1/2 cup fat free feta cheese, crumbled
instructions: Whisk together the yogurt and cheese.  Serve with chips, vegetables, whatever you enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,jalapeno pepper,rice flour,port wine,plain yogurt,butternut squash,horseradish,italian parsley
title: Roasted Butternut Squash With Horseradish Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash, about 18-20 minutes roasted until very soft, about 3/4 pound, peeled | 1 cup plain yogurt, lightly beaten | 1 1/4 cups horseradish | 2 tablespoons rice flour | 12 slices italian parsley | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 jalapeno pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 tablespoon port wine
instructions: Cut squash lengthwise into 8 wedges with a sharp knife and put them in a roasting pan.  Lightly brush or spray squash with oil.  Roast until beginning to char, about 30 minutes.  Remove and cool slightly.  Blend yogurt with horseradish, rice flour, parsley, cardamom, jalapeno and port, if using.  Remove squash and allow it to cool, about 15 - 15 minutes.  Serve with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: tilapia fillet,topping,lime wedge,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Tilapia Ties
ingredients: 1 tilapia fillet | 4 fresh lime wedges ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf italian parsley ( optional ) | 4 thin slices limes, for garnish
instructions: Preheat a panini grill to medium heat.  Remove the tilapia fillet from the refrigerator, unwrap and cut into 6 equal pieces.  Poke a few holes in each piece with a fork so the fish will cook faster.  Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.  Place a wedge of italian parsley into each toothpick.  Lightly drizzle with half a lime wedge.  Place the fish on the grill.  Cook, turning once until fish easily flakes with a fork and starts to flake with a fork.  Turn once more.  Transfer to a serving platter garnish with lime wedges.

title: Rice Paper Wrapped Sausages
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean sausage | 4 artichoke hearts, small, peeled, drained | 1 tablespoon saffron | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke | 1/2 teaspoon vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon salt ( optional ) | 1 leaf lettuce
instructions: Dry off and discard the hard ends from the sausage.  Chop the sausage into 1/2 inch rounds.  Drain and reserve the artichoke hearts.  Stir together the sausage, artichoke hearts, saffron, liquid smoke, vinegar, salt and pepper.  Lay the sausage rounds on several slices of lettuce.  Add 1/4 inch at a time, rolling up the lettuce around the sausage to form an oblong cylinder.  Wrap each cylinder tightly to keep the lettuce from unrolling.  Seal the roll by tucking in the ends.  Wrap each tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.  To serve, unwrap and slice into about 3 to 4 slices per slice.

Random Ingredients: apple,chicken breast half,icing sugar,za'atar spice mix
title: Apple and Za'atar Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( bone in ) | 1/4 cup za'atar spice mix ( or a mix of curry powder and chili powder ) | 1 apple ( i prefer sweet apple ) | icing sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place 1 chicken breast half skin side down in a glass pie dish.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle za'atar over chicken breast and bake until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear, approximately 15 - 20 minutes.  In the meantime, dice apple and remove skin from chicken.  Shred chicken into bite size pieces.  Place apple and za'atar in a small bowl.  Stir to combine.  Arrange chicken pieces over a bed of the apples/za'atar mixture in a single layer.  Drizzle with juice from apple.  Serve at once, garnish with icing sugar, if desired.

title: Wasabi Cheese Spread
ingredients: 16 ounces muenster cheese or 16 ounces other mild white cheese | 16 ounces wasabi powder
instructions: Mix together in a small bowl.  Serve with crackers and pretzels or french bread pieces.

Random Ingredients: parsley sprig,chicken stock broth,picante sauce,yogurt,chili paste,chicken stock
title: Pollo Con Picante
ingredients: 2 medium yukon chilie onions or 2 medium other white onions, finely diced | 3 cups chicken stock, from the cooked chicken | 2 teaspoons chili paste | 1 cup picante sauce, from the jar of picante sauce | 1 cup chicken stock, from the boiled chicken | 1/4 cup lowfat yogurt, whisked with | 3 -4 parsley sprigs
instructions: In a 1 1/2 to 2 quart saucepan, cover the onions with water to 1 inch above the onions.  Bring to a boil over medium heat.  Cover, remove from the heat and let stand 1 hour.  Drain the water and discard.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer onion to a blender or food processor.  Add the chicken stock and chili paste to the blender.

title: Gooeysters
ingredients: 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 tablespoons finely minced cilantro | 8 -10 medium shrimp, cooked | 1 vanilla bean | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon chopped unsalted cheese ( or cheddar cheese )
instructions: Combine the flour and 2 tbsp cilantro in a bowl.  Stir in shrimp, vanilla bean, oyster sauce, and cheese until well coated.  Drop the mixture into hot vegetable oil and fry until golden brown on one side.  Flip over and cook 1 - 2 minutes longer.  Remove and drain on paper towels.  These will look shuckers when cooked, with no crispy or burnt tops to please.  Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Style Hot Chicken Broth
ingredients:
6 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon cubes | 3 -4 jalapeno peppers | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili powder ( depending on how hot you want it.
    - i prefer medium )
instructions: Place chicken and peppers in a saucepan. .  Crush the blackened spices with your hands.  Stir the ground spices into the broth.  Place saucepan on stove & bring it to a boil.  When it starts bubbling, stir the broth.  Turn off heat and let sit 10 minutes.

title: Tiramisu for Wimpshire Wants to Eat - Crock Pot
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh pork shoulder, with fat | 1 ounce kahlua or 1 ounce rum | 3 ounces gruyere cheese, grated
instructions: Cut the meat into cubes or chunks removing as much fat as possible.  Pour the liqueur/rum over the meat, mix together well and marinate overnight at room temperature in the refrigerator and then bake on the lowest setting for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Serve with grated gruyere cheese.

Random Ingredients: vegetable stock,baby shrimp,lard vegetable oil,chili flake,mint leaf,virgin olive oil,broccoli
title: Tortilla With Shrimp in Salsa Verde
ingredients: 400 g baby shrimp, medium-sized | 2 tablespoons lard or 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 1/2 cups vegetable stock, low sodium and low sodium | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes | 100 g broccoli, medium-sized | 2 tablespoons parsley, flat leaf, rough chopped | 1 tablespoon mint leaf, fresh coarsely chopped
instructions: Peel the shrimp, tail them, and slice the body in half.  Heat the lard or oil in a heavy based heavy based saucepan over medium heat.  When it is hot, add the shrimp pieces and fry, patted dry, for about 7 minutes, or until they are lightly crisp.  Add the stock, chili flakes, and half the broccoli and half the parsley and return to the boil.  Lower the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.  Taste for seasoning and adjust if necessary.  Meanwhile, cook the remaining broccoli and remaining parsley in boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes or until just tender.  Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the mint.  Using a slotted spoon, arrange the shrimp, broccoli, and remaining parsley on four serving plates and spoon over the salsa verde.

title: Paal Payasam
ingredients: 300 g kielbasa ( polish kielbasa ) | 200 ml sultanas | 100 g sour cream or 100 g fresh sour cream | 5 green cardamom pods, cracked open | 500 g frozen whipped topping, thawed
instructions: Cut kielbasa in slices about 1/4 inch thick.  Place on microwave safe dish.  Pierce with a knife or chopsticks.  Sprinkle with sultanas and top with the sour cream.  Microwave on high for 2 minutes until hot, adding more as needed.  Serve with cardamom chips and fresh fruit.

title: Copenhagen Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lbs plum tomatoes | 2 lbs leeks | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons cheese, grated | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Peel, core and finely dice the tomatoes, leeks and apples.  Put them in a heavy saucepan with the apple juice, garlic and lemon juice.  Bring to a boil over moderate heat then simmer gently until slightly reduced.  Take off the heat, strain through a fine sieve.  Put the potatoes into a large deep pan and cover with boiling water.  Cook over high heat for 15 - 20 minutes until tender.  Drain well and return them to the pan.  Mash them with a potato masher or a blender until they are a fine consistency.  Serve at once.  Variation, for a different look use 1/2 pound of fresh leek, cut in 1 inch lengths, and finely chopped into a fine dice, or use 4 slices of fresh leek.

title: The Perfect Indian Cinnamon Broth
ingredients: 2 quarts boiling broth | 2 cinnamon sticks
instructions: Pour the broth and cinnamon sticks into a large pot.  Bring the broth to a boil, and cook uncovered overnight.

title: Black-Eyed Peas With Blueberries
ingredients: 2 2 cups black-eyed peas or 2 cups frozen black-eyed peas | 1/8 - 1/4 cup blueberries or 1/8-1/4 cup strawberry
instructions: Boil the peas for 5 minutes, add blueberries and cook for a further 5 minutes.

title: Blue Zest, Blue Sauce Base
ingredients: 6 cups finely chopped fresh orange zest | 1 3/4 cups blue food coloring | spices, to taste
instructions: Place the orange zest in a large bowl.  Sprinkle with some water, and stir until evenly coated with the zest water.  Repeat with the blue food coloring, until the color is completely mixed with the color.  Use the food coloring wisely or it will dilute too much.  Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours before using.  Keep in a jar tightly covered at room temperature for up to a week.

Random Ingredients: coffee,provolone cheese,juniper berry,cotija cheese,sauerkraut,hot sauce,chocolate chip
title: Sausage Reuben Dogs
ingredients: 5 lbs sauerkraut | hot sauce ( optional ) | 8 ounces chocolate chips ( i recommend hershey's ) | canned coffee | 1 1/2 lbs provolone cheese ( chopped roughly, a 50gram jar will do ) | 1 package grated cotija cheese | 6 whole juniper berries
instructions: Line the bottom of a crockpot with the sauerkraut.  Pour hot sauce or cheese over the top of all, add juniper berries & cotija cheese.  Set cooker on low.  Set timer for 5 hrs.  Remove the sauerkraut & set aside.  Mix the chopped provolone & cotija in a small bowl.  When it's done, put the sauerkraut on the sausages & heat up some more.  Serve the sauerkraut with the provolone/cotija mixture & enjoy great served the next day.

Random Ingredients: taco sauce,celery salt,green pepper,nonstick cooking spray,yellow rice
title: Saucy Rice and Veggies
ingredients: 3 cups instant yellow rice | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 -2 tablespoon taco sauce, to taste | green pepper, chopped | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Cook and stir the rice with the celery salt and taco sauce.  Cover, remove the cover, and allow to steam for 5 minutes.  Spray a 10 nonstick skillet with cooking spray.  Cook 1 cup of the rice mixture over medium heat until slightly thickened.  Stir in 1/2 cup of the green pepper, then pour in the rest of the rice.

title: Potato Kneff
ingredients: 3 lbs russet potatoes | 3 tablespoons saffron
instructions: Wash potatoes thoroughly and slice into 1 x 2 pieces.  Place in large bowl and drizzle with oil.  Cover bowl and refrigerate 2 hours.  After 2 hours, add saffron.  Keep covered with foil and bake 30 minutes at 300 degrees and remove from oven.  Turn oven on top and broil potatoes until fork tender and crispy on both sides.  If they burn or turn over, cover bowl and let cool to room temperature.  I like to serve this over mash.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,water artichoke heart,tequila,pineapple juice,garlic salt,asiago cheese,pasta sauce
title:
S.
    -A.
    -  Green Chile Pasta
ingredients: 2 cans chopped green chilies, drained | 1 bottle pasta sauce | 2 cans water-packed artichoke hearts | 1/2 cup tequila | 1 can pineapple juice | 1/4 cup asiago cheese | garlic salt
instructions: Mix all ingredients, and refrigerate for at least two hours for flavors to blend.  After chilling, serve over your favorite pasta with grated cheese or as a garnish.

title: Rigatoni with Okra and Okra
ingredients: 1 pound rigatoni pasta | 1 pound frozen okra | 1 1/2 cups small shell pasta | 1 1/2 teaspoons minced fresh tarragon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine rigatoni pasta, okra, and shrimp in a large pot.  Fill pot with water, and bring to a boil.  Cover, and spread out onto a greased baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven for 90 minutes.  Remove from oven, and stir in tarragon.  Sprinkle with salt, if desired.

title: Broccoli Lovers Lasagna
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli floret | 1 lb jicama | 9 lasagna noodles | 1 can crushed plantains, drained ( optional )
instructions: Boil water for lasagna noodles.  Cut jicama into about 2 inch cubes.  Place in ice box over ice box for about 5 - 10 minutes to loosen shell.  Peel skin off tomatoes.  Drain.  Place tomatoes and jicama into a bowl with a little water and mash with a fork.  Add broccoli and mash together.  Cover and set aside.  Take the lasagna noodles out of the freezer and lay flat on cooling racks on counter or counter top.  Microwave veggies for about 7 - 8 minutes, or until hot and bubbled.  Top with veggies and spread about 1/8 of the tomato mixture on the bottom of the lasagna.  Lay 1/5 of the noodles across the mixture, overlapping them slightly.  Repeat layering until the pan is full and top layer is completely covered.  Microwave on high for about 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from oven and cover with cheese of your choice.  Microwave again on high and cover for another 5 minutes to melt cheese.

title: Mushroom Mustard Hot-Up
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1 yellow pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup yellow sweet pepper, chopped | 1 cup button mushrooms, chopped | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 cup prepared mustard powder
instructions: Combine the mustard powder with the onions.  Stir in the peppers and mushrooms.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Easy White Beans and Cheese
ingredients: 2 cans white kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 3 tablespoons cooking sherry
instructions: Combine the beans with sherry in a saucepan over low heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer until heated through.  Serve hot over your favorite pasta.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,black cardamom pod,cream tartar,irish cream,tabasco sauce,flour,liquid smoke
title: Quick Irish Cream
ingredients: 8 tablespoons flour | 8 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1/2 cup liquid smoke | 4 tablespoons instant minced onion powder | 1 1/2 cups irish cream, chilled | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 6 black cardamom pods, crushed ( may substitute 1/8 tsp ground cardamom )
instructions: Combine ingredients in a bowl.  Sift dry ingredients together in another bowl, and add to cream mixture stirring gently.  Do not make sour cream thinner than you may call for serve with bread slices.

title: Quick Chicken Rice Soup
ingredients: 2 cups raw rice | 3 cans chicken stock | 1/2 cup cream or 1/2 cup half-and-half ( i omit the cream )
instructions: Boil rice in chicken stock according to directions.  When rice is cooked, stir in cream or half and half and heat through.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,spaghetti,bamboo shoot,red pepper,filet mignon,curry paste,pear,bacon dripping
title: Curried Beef (Spaghetti)
ingredients: 1 package uncooked spaghetti ( rings ) | 4 slices rindless bacon | 4 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 4 teaspoons curry paste | 1/2 cup diced red pepper | 2 slices canned pears, chopped | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 1 bottle beef drippings
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente, drain.  In a large skillet, brown bacon until crisp.  Remove bacon from skillet, and set aside.  Brown ginger garlic paste.  Mix ginger garlic paste into drippings.  Add curry paste and pepper, and cook for 10 minutes.  Add pear, pineapple, and bamboo shoots.  Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.  Add spaghetti, and cook until heated through.

title: Lazy Rice with Collards
ingredients: 3/4 lb collard greens, trimmed and cut in half crosswise | 1/3 lb medium egg noodles | 6 cups hot cooked long-grain white rice
instructions: Place collards in a single layer in a large saucepan and cover with 3 cups hot water.  Bring to a boil, cover pan, and simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp tender.  Drain well.  Rinse collards under cold running water.

title: Salsa Fresca 2009
ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes, halved | 1 pint fresh tomato, cored, halved | 1/2 lemon, juice and zest of | 1/4 cup raisins | 8 ounces american cheese, grated
instructions: Boil tomatoes in a pot of salted water until soft, about 7 minutes.  Immediately drain.  Peel the tomatoes and puree in a blender with enough water to form a smooth puree.  Remove the seeds using the back of a spoon and add the tomatoes to a heavy medium sauce pan.  Add the lemon zest and raisins.  Heat over medium heat until all hot, but not boiling.  Add the grated cheese and simmer 15 minutes.  Taste.  If it's too acid, add little warm water.

Random Ingredients: red curry paste,orange juice,honey,taco seasoning,white wine,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Crab Cakes With Chili, Orange and Wine
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs crabmeat ( real or imitation ) | 1 teaspoon taco seasoning, divided | 2 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 teaspoons red curry paste, divided ( can use regular curry, not the hot-spicy kind ) | 1/4 cup dry white wine ( or use sherry ) | 1 tablespoon finely shredded mexican blend cheese ( or to taste )
instructions: Place crabmeat in a zip loc bag.  Sprinkle on the 1/2 teaspoon of taco seasoning.  Shake to coat.  Refrigerate for 30 minutes.  Mix orange juice, curry paste, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon taco seasoning well.  Spoon about 2 tablespoons of mixture into a small bowl, then set aside.  Place remaining crabmeat in a small skillet or wok.  Brown over medium heat, and stir frequently.  Drain off any excess fat.  Add the wine and 2 teaspoons of taco seasoning to skillet.  Cook until liquid is reduced by half, then stir in the orange juice mixture.  Remove from heat, and sprinkle on the cheese.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,puff pastry,sharp cheddar cheese,baking powder,beef chuck,white wine vinegar
title: Packs of Beef on the Stone With Caramelised Cheddar
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, very thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 9 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 2 tablespoons dark rum | puff pastry sheet, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Spray a large baking sheet with oil.  Mix the beef, baking powder, vinegar, cheese, rum and half of the cheese in a bowl until well combined.  Place the pastry sheet on top and brush with a little more oil.  Roll out the second sheet of pastry on a lightly floured surface to a 10 x 6 inch rectangle and transfer to the oiled baking sheet.  Use a sharp knife to cut into strips approximately ½ inch wide and 6 or 7 inches long.  Using a pastry brush, moisten the outside edge with water and pinch the strips with your fingers.  Bake until nicely browned, about 20 minutes.  Remove and let stand for 5 minutes.  Use a toothpick to serve.

title: Chicken Legs-Flesh With Octopus
ingredients: 4 chicken legs | 12 salted anchovy fillets | 1 fresh squid | sea salt
instructions: Rinse the chicken legs.  Scrub each with salt and put the legs in cold water.  Cover and stand at room temperature for 45 minutes.  Change the sand and bring to a boil until the skin flaps.  Remove from the water and place the chicken legs on a flat dish.  Clean the salted anchovies in a piece of cheesecloth.  Cut in half lengthwise.  Rinse and drain the squid well on paper towels.  Cut the tentacles from the body and discard the skin and tentacles.  Slice in half lengthwise.  Serve at once.

title: Htipiti (Lettuce, Egg, Tofu and Avgolemono Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb firm tofu, drained and pressed | 1 egg yolk | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb, plus additional for coating | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cauliflower florets | 1/2 cup fresh raspberry ( preferably non-dairy ) or 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1/4 strips about 1/4 inch wide x 3 - 4 inches long x 1 1/2 inches long, and about 1/4 inch wide.  Pulse the tofu to a coarsely textured consistency with a box grater, food processor or blender.  Add the bread crumbs and egg yolk and mix until well blended.  Add the mayonnaise, garlic and pesto and mix until a uniform texture is achieved.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Toss the cauliflower with the vgolemono if using and the remaining tablespoon of pesto.  Spread 1/3 of the cauliflower mixture on each salad plate, top with the remaining cauliflower and mound over the pesto.  Scatter with the crumbs and serve immediately.  The tofu salad can be made 1 week ahead and chilled, covered.

title: Easy English Cold Pepper Nori Shish Kabobs

ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork or 2 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in bite-sized pieces | 1 tablespoon green curry paste | 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( or soup of choice or homemade ) | veal, chopped into small pieces ( optional )
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, cook pork in curry paste until just done.

title: Pimiento and Pork Strips
ingredients: vegetable oil or peanut oil | 1 jar pimientos, chopped well
instructions: Cut pimentos into strips about 2 inches long and 1/8 inch wide.  Heat the oil in a heavy skillet until quite hot but not smoking, pour in the pimento strips, working them quickly because they will sizzle.  When they are just beginning to sizzle stir in the pimientos.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,cashew,salt pepper,caster sugar,vanilla ice cream,american cheese,chocolate square
title: The Big Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 8 ounces american cheese, grated | 8 ounces white american cheese, grated | 8 ounces cashews | 4 ounces frozen mexican blend cheese, thawed, drained and roughly chopped | 4 ounces chocolate squares, grated | 2 1/2 cups vanilla ice cream | salt and pepper
instructions: Put 6 ounces english chees, 4 ounces white american cheese, cashews, four ounces mexican cheese and chocolate squares in the bowl of a food processor.  Process until well combined.  Scoop the fondue into the moulds and freeze until firm.  Transfer to a serving dish and place in the fridge.  In a clean pan heat remaining 4 ounces of white american cheesewith a little oil.  Sauté until the fondue starts to bubble.  Remove from heat, keep warm.  To serve, remove fondue from moulds and heat in fondue pot over low heat.  Place 4 ounces of white american cheese, four ounces of white American cheese, 4 ounces cashew, 4 ounces frozen mexican cheese, 4 ounces chocolate and a handful of chopped parsley in a large fondue pot.  Sauté the fondue just until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,broccoli,red bell pepper,tea,brown mustard seed
title: Smoky Broccoli and Red Pepper
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli, cut into florets | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, chopped | 2 1/4 teaspoons mustard seeds | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons packed brown mustard seeds
instructions: Bring a large saucepan of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add broccoli and pepper and cook until just tender, about 3 minutes.  Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.  Combine mustard seeds and brown mustard powder in a small bowl and use to season the steaks, if desired.  Drain the steak well and transfer it to the steaks.  Pour the picante sauce over the steaks and spread in a thin layer.  Cover and let marinate while proceeding with recipe.

title: Yellow Apple Dip (From Young Dinners Academy)
ingredients: 8 yellow onions | cooking oil ( for frying ) | vanilla ice cream ( or other dessert topping ) | 1 fresh peach, cut in wedges or, for serving
instructions: Wash and peel the onions into very long strips.  Slice into fairly thin slices and sprinkle with salt.  Set aside.  Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a non stick frying pan and fry the onions until golden brown and well coloured, about 30 - 60 minutes.  When onions are just golden, drain excess oil from the pan and set aside.  Heat 1 tbsp of oil in the frying pan and fry the pear slices or, if using dried peach wedges, fry in batches.  Remove the cooked fruits with a slotted spoon to a plate lined with paper towel and wipe out the frying pan.  When all the ingredients are done, set aside.  Remove the frying pan from the heat.  Stir in about 1 tbsp cooking oil from the pan and heat on low heat for about 2 minutes.  Add a little more cooking oil, if necessary, to make the mixture a rich and flavourful consistency.  Serve warm with warm vanilla ice cream or other dessert topping.

title: Blueberry and Butterscotch Sliced Chana
ingredients: 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled if desired | 12 ounces dried peas ( about 3 cups ) | 1/2 cup chopped pickling spices | 1 cup dry blueberries ( about 2 cups ) | 1 cup frozen butterscotch chips | 2 tablespoons sweet hungarian paprika | 12 ounces riced butterscotch chips
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Meanwhile, scrub potatoes and cut into 1/2 inch dice.  Remove skins from peas, if any, then put in a colander and rinse briefly with a couple pinches of salt.  Add peas, pickling spice, blueberries and butterscotch chips and stir to combine.  Pour potato mixture into a 3 1/2 quart crock and mix.  Cook on high 2 1/2 hours, or until potatoes are tender.

title: Black Pepper Strawberries
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh strawberries, cleaned and hulled ( about 8-10 whole, stemmed ) | 2 quarts fresh black peppercorns
instructions: Trim and discard pith from strawberries.  Remove any large berries.  Cut the strawberries into pieces as close to the size of small peppercorns as possible.  Pour the brine into a large, heavy nonreactive dutch oven.  Add the peppercorns. .  Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally.  Reduce heat to simmer.  Simmer, loosely covered, for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice.  Add the strawberries, reserving enough brine to moisten to a glaze.  Cover and simmer for another 15 minutes or so until the strawberries are tender and the juice is reduced to a syrupy consistency.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: purpose flour,pesto sauce,coconut milk,vodka,vegetable oil cooking spray,pork tenderloin,avocado,dijon mustard
title: Guinness Pork With Avocado Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin or 1 lb pork butt | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons purchased vinaigrette dressing or 2 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons vinaigrette dressing or 2 tablespoons prepared vinaigrette | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 large avocados, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oven to 350°f and spray large baking sheet with veggy cooking spray.  Cut pork into four serving pieces.  Cut into two inch chunks, then place in a bowl of large fork size chunks or cubes.  Add 2 tablespoons vinaigrette dressing and toss until evenly mixed.  Arrange in a single layer on baking sheet.  Bake until nicely browned, about 20 minutes.  Turn pork over and bake until additional internal temperature reaches 165°f, about 20 to 25 minutes.  Meanwhile, coat a large frying pan with cooking spray.  Add 1/2 cup vinaigrette and warm over medium high heat until hot.  To make avocado vinaigrette, heat the remaining vinaigrette in a medium nonstick saucepan over medium heat until hot.  About 7 minutes.  Meanwhile, coat remaining 2 tablespoons dressing in a small bowl.  To assemble pork, place meat cutlets on baking sheet and sprinkle with flour.  Coat with vinaigrette and turn to coat.  Bake pork slices until instant read thermometer inserted into center of meat reads 160°f, about 5 minutes.  Remove pork from the oven and increase temperature to 350°f.  Brush both sides of the chops with vinaigrette.  Heat remaining vinaigrette in a large skillet over medium high heat until warm.  Place on a plate, drizzle with remaining vinaigrette, and serve alongside pork.

title: Gourmet Turnip Casserole #5FIX
ingredients: 5 packages mozzarella cheese | 5 packages cotija cheese | 1/3 cup red wine | 1 lb frozen turnip, peeled and chopped | 3 packages miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Coat a 10 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Layer first three ingredients in the order recommended by your crème bruise.  Top with mozzarella all over, sprinkling cotija over all.  Dot cotija with a little butter.  Cover and bake for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and top with marshmallows.  Return to baking dish and bake for an additional 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Smoked Salmon Croquettes
ingredients: 2 eggs | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons margarine ) | 1 cup cranberry juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili oil | 1/2 teaspoon dried rum | 1/2 cup grand marnier | 200 g smoked salmon, skin removed
instructions: In a stand mixer, beat eggs until light yellow and fluffy.  Add sugar, cocoa powder and margarine and mix well.  Add other ingredients and mix well.  In a non stick frying pan or a baking sheet, place 1 tablespoon of oil and warm it on medium heat.  Add 1 tablespoon of oil in the pan and allow it to heat up to 80 degree f.  When frying, spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture onto a hot frying pan and tilt the pan so that most of the liquid coats the bottom.  Once the first side is medium brown, flip and fry the other side.

title: Baked Ziti With Tomatoes
ingredients: 8 medium ziti pasta | 1 pint cherry tomatoes ( with juice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° f.  Bake ziti and cherry tomatoes for 30 minutes, until they have softened.  Turn oven temperature up to 400 f.  And bake for 45 minutes longer.  Serve while partially covered with foil, and a nice salad.

title: Ouzo
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 12 ounces tofu | 1/4 cup greek yogurt | 12 lasagna noodles, broken | 1/2 cup ouzo
instructions: Rinse rice in a fine mesh strainer under cold water, rubbing the rinsed rinsed rice until the water runs clear.  Combine rice, tofu and ouzo in a large saucepan or dutch oven over low heat.  Cover and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Drain and rinse noodles.

Random Ingredients: broccoli,graham cracker crumb,olive oil,tomato paste,white sugar
title: Tomato Broccoli in Broth
ingredients: 2 large fresh tomatoes | 1 cup broccoli | 2 teaspoons olive oil | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1/4 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Cut an x in the tops of tomatoes with scissors, or slice the tomatoes into thin wedges.  Boil the broccoli, drain and let cool.  Cut into small bite size pieces.  Mix together sugar and cracker crumbs in a small bowl.  Drain tomatoes reserving as much juice as possible.  Coat tomatoes with cheese crumb mixture.  Coat vegetables lightly in cheese crumb mixture pressing down on tomato with fingers.  Preheat broiler and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, flipping midway through.  Serve.

title: Crusty Cardamom Biscuits
ingredients: 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl.  Stir in the cardamom and stir well.  Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface.  Pinch off a 1/4 inch piece of dough and roll out to 1/8 inch thick.  Cut out hearts with a 2 inch biscuit cutter.  Place on a lightly greased baking sheet and prick top with a fork.  Set aside to rise for 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Brush biscuits with water and sprinkle with salt.  Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden.  Cool on baking sheets for 1 minute.

title: The Best Russian Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat ( i prefer chicken ) | 2 cans black olives, drained and chopped | 2 bay leaves | 1 -2 red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1 cup cheese, grated ( optional ) | 1 container vodka | 1 onion, finely chopped
instructions: Mix meat, olives, bay leaf, chilies and spices except cheese in a large bowl.  Make sure all ingredients are thoroughly mixed, and the mixture is thoroughly blended.  Stuff in your favorite pasta shape and place back in refrigerator while you cook the pasta.  When it is time to serve, bring pot of water to boil and salt for pasta.  When sauce is ready, mix pasta and sauce with your favorite sauce.  Serve immediately, or refrigerate if not serving immediately.

title: Couscous
ingredients: 1 eggplant | 2 shallots | 2 tablespoons peanut butter | 2 tablespoons mixed chopped fresh parsley sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds
instructions: Peel the eggplant and prick lightly with fork.  Put into an uncovered steaming pot or bowl in the microwave and cook over high heat, turning once or twice, until very tender, about 20 minutes.  Slice the eggplant and slice crosswise into thin strips about 1 and 1/2 cm thick.  Set aside, set aside.  Fry shallots until they just start to take on color, add peanut butter.  Heat through.  Stir in chopped parsley.  Sprinkle with fennel seeds.  Stir until peanut butter is melted.  Arrange eggplant in a ring on a plate and drizzle with the peanut sauce.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,poblano chile,grand marnier,brown basmati rice,caper
title: Chile Rice With Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups brown basmati rice, preferably long grain | 3 cups water | 2 ounces dried plump capers | 4 canned poblano chiles, seeded and sliced | 1/4 cup grand marnier
instructions: Bring the rice and water to a boil in a saucepan over high heat.  Reduce the heat to low and simmer, partially covered, until all of the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes.  Transfer the rice to a colander and let cool for 5 minutes.  Stir in the capers, poblano chiles, and grand marnier, if using, and let the mixture sit for about 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: cilantro stem,yeast,monterey jack cheese,lime juice zest,lobster stock
title: Portobello Con Queso (Cheese Spread)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon yeast | 1 1/3 cups lukewarm lobster stock | 1/2 teaspoon fresh lime juice or 1/2 teaspoon zest | 1/4 cup monterey jack cheese, grated | 1 fresh cilantro stem, for garnish ( packed )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast with 1 tbs of the lukewarm stock in a large mixing bowl.  Stir in the remaining 1 tbsp lukewarm stock and the lime juice and zest.  Stir in the cheese and cilantro and blend well.  Turn the mixture into a lightly oiled bowl and cover loosely with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.  When ready to use transfer the mixture to the work surface and knead for 10 minutes until the dough is very smooth and elastic.  Place the dough in work bowl and knead it again for 2 minutes.  Transfer to a plastic container, cover and put in the refrigerator for 1 hour or until it has doubled in size.  Drain the lobster meat from the shell, coarsely chop and mix with the cheese mixture.  Form into a ball shape and place on a buttered cookie sheet.  Place in a 350 degree oven for 20 minutes or until the top is crusty and golden brown or cook the outside on a foil lined cookie sheet.

title: Italian Sausages With Peaches and Yogurt
ingredients: 12 -14 italian sausages, sweet | 1 cup yogurt ( use low-fat, or yogurt type ) | 1/3 cup mayonnaise | 1 tablespoon peeled grated gingerroot ( about 1/2 grated fresh ginger ) | 1 teaspoon distilled white vinegar | 1 bunch fresh parsley leaves, chopped | 1 3/4 lbs mixed greens, assorted, such as spinach, dill, and black beans ( or arugula )
instructions: Remove casings from sausages and cut lengthwise into 1/8 inch slices on the diagonal.  Combine yogurt, mayo, ginger, and vinegar in a medium bowl.

title: Mexican Onion Cheese Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 cup cornstarch | 2 tablespoons light chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 3/4 cup shredded monterey jack cheese or 3/4 cup asadero cheese | 1 can apricots, drained chopped
instructions: Place cornstarch in a medium bowl.  Add chili sauce and cayenne.  Heat a small nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Spray surface with cooking spray.  Layer cheese and half of onions in the pan.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from oven and top with remaining onions and sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake at 400° for 5 - 10 minutes longer or until golden brown.

title: Chive Vegetables
ingredients: 6 tablespoons minced chives | 2 zucchini, sliced
instructions: Mix chives and zucchini together and sprinkle top generously with chives.

title: Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon horseradish | 1 tablespoon hot sauce
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl and serve.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,fenugreek seed,hunt tomato sauce,pea,cottage cheese,baby shrimp,grand marnier
title: Baby Shrimp With Garlic & Pesto
ingredients: 20 baby shrimp ( cooked ) | 2 tablespoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1/4 cup olive oil | 1 can hunts tomato sauce | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups peas | 1/4 teaspoon grand marnier ( optional )
instructions: Pulse the following in a food processor until fine, to your preference. .  Add the rest of the ingredients in and mix until well combined.  Note, i usually add about 1/2 cup of chopped green beans for presentation and for color, i use frozen frozen peas.

Random Ingredients: turkey sausage,clear honey,chili pod,saltine cracker,cherry,caper,head cabbage
title: Danish Sausage, Cherry and Caper Cabbage
ingredients: 1 smoked turkey sausage | 1/2 head cabbage, cored and cut into wedges | 1 pint cherry or 1 pint grape | 1/2 teaspoon ground chili pod | 2 teaspoons clear honey | 2 teaspoons capers, drained | saltine crackers
instructions: Place the sausage in a pan and cook over the heat for 12 - 15 mins until browned and cooked through.  Drain, remove any excess fat and slice the sausage into thick slices.  Add the cabbage to the pan with the cherries, chili pods, honey and capers.  Simmer for 15 mins until the cabbage is soft but still holding its shape.  Serve hot with saltine crackers.

Random Ingredients: orzo pasta,confectioner sugar,mozzarella cheese,chili paste,nonstick cooking spray,bourbon
title: Mexican orzo Balls II
ingredients: 1 cup nonstick cooking spray | 4 ounces orzo pasta | 1/4 cup prepared chili paste with mushrooms, or more to taste | 1/4 cup crumbled reduced-fat mozzarella cheese | 2 tablespoons fat-free montreal whiskey or 2 tablespoons bourbon | 1/2 teaspoon confectioners'sugar for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Bring a pot of water to a boil.  Add orzo, stirring occasionally, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Transfer orzo to a bowl, and mash until light and fluffy.  Mix in chili paste and diced cheese.  In a small bowl, stir whiskey with confectioners' sugar until incorporated.  Add to orzo mixture, and toss until coated.

title: Vegetable Pies
ingredients: 1 small eggplant | 1 carrot, peeled and shredded | 2 stalks celery & leaves, chopped | 1 ounce suet, grated | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable broth | 1 tablespoon fresh chili leaves ( optional ) or 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed dried chilies ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c and grease a large oven proof dish. Squeeze mixture from eggplant and combine with mixed suet mix.  Spoon mixture into prepared dish.  Mix together the stock, chili and dried chilies and sprinkle over pie.  Cook for 15 minutes or until slightly browned on top and golden.  Cut into squares to serve.

title: Rita's Lettuce and Pistachio Salad
ingredients: 1 head lettuce | 500 g gruyere or 500 g swiss cheese ( about 10 slices ) | 12 tablespoons yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon garlic granules | 1 pinch saffron | 3 tablespoons crushed pistachio nuts ( or to taste ) | 1 cup shredded gruyere | 1/2 cup thinly sliced carrot
instructions: Preparation place head of lettuce on a salad plate, and place cheese slices on top.  Drain the excess water/oil from a small plate.  Mix the yogurt and garlic granules into a thick paste using a whisk or your hands.  Spread the yogurt mixture over top.  Add the saffron, nuts and cheese slices.  Toss to mix.  Cover with a lid or cling wrap and put in the fridge to chill for a minimum of 1 hour.

title: Spicy Poppy Seed Spread
ingredients: 1 cup poppy seeds | 2 cans chopped red chile peppers, drained | 2/3 cup nonfat sour cream | 2 teaspoons prepared horseradish, or as needed
instructions: Mix poppy seeds, chile peppers, sour cream, horseradish, and red chile pepper sauce together in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cajun seasoning,white bread,vanilla bean,leek,dark brown sugar
title: Fruit and Chips
ingredients: 2 leeks | 5 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla beans, split lengthwise | 16 slices white bread
instructions: Trim and cut the leeks crosswise into very 1 3/4 inch pieces.  Place in a large skillet with a lid and cover with water.  Over low heat bring to a boil and cook until just tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain and reserve the cooking liquid.  Rinse the leeks under cold water until cool enough to handle.  Discard all the white and light green part of the leeks.  Cut them crosswise into 1/4 inch wide strips.  Combine all the remaining ingredients but the bread in a skillet and bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally to prevent bits from sticking to the bottom of the pan.  Remove from heat and add the bread slices.  Let stand about 15 minutes to soak up the flavors.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Rose Curried Spinach Salad

instructions: Drain spinach, carrot and peas/carrots and dry fry with hot butter.  Stir in remaining ingredients and serve cold on a bed of salad greens.

title: Simple Beef Ribs With Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 1 bag mangoes, chunks | 1 can corned beef country style rib sauce | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1/4 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  In 13 x 9 inch dish, spread cresent rolls.  Unroll cresent rolls.

title: Spiced Roast Pepperoncini
ingredients: 4 1/2 - 5 lbs pepperoncini peppers, fresh | 2 cups water | 14 ounces chunky salsa ( i use the chunky salsa, not the jalapeno or pico de gallo ) | 1 1/2 cups strong coffee | 2 teaspoons ginger juice
instructions: Cut peppers lengthwise into 2 - 3 thin slices.  Place the pepperoncini in a deep roasting pan.  Pour 3 cups water over the pepperoncini and cover with aluminum foil or a double thickness of aluminum foil.  Bake at 450 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes.  Remove foil and baste the peppers with 2 tablespoons of the salsa.  Add a few drops of ginger juice if desired.  Increase oven temperature to 425 degrees.  Bake for 30 - 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.  Let rest for 5 - 10 minutes prior to eating.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,pepperoni,jalapeno chilies,white corn,italian breadcrumb,cauliflower floret,kielbasa,maraschino cherry
title: Stuffed Italian Bread-N-Taster #5FIX
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower floret | 1 package pepperoni | 1 package kielbasa ( we like sweet and spicy ) | 1 can white corn | 1/2 cup italian breadcrumbs | 4 -5 ounces pepperoni | 1 jar maraschino cherries | fresh jalapeno chilies ( optional )
instructions: Saute diced peppers into small pieces on a low heat in a dry skillet till peppers begin to soften.  In colander toss the kielbasa into the skillet till cooked and browned, drain on a towel, then pat it dry with a paper towel.  Cook kielbasa and pepperoni till desired texture of meat is gone, drain and set aside.  In large bowl combine cauliflower, pepperoni, corn, bread crumbs, chilies add meat mixture till mixed well, cover, set aside for at least 1 hour in fridge, it makes it easier to stuff. title: Frijoles Negros

instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder and black beans together.  Pour into a pastry bag fitted with 2 inch wide tip.  Add a pinch of salt to bag.  Press air out of bag and pipe the batter into bag.  Refrigerate for one to eight hours for the flour to be absorbed.

title: Aloo Seeding (Mashed Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 pound beets, peeled and cubed | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste
instructions: Place the potatoes in a large bowl or container with a lid.  Cover with water, and refrigerate for 8 hours.  Drain the water from the potatoes, but do not rinse.  Place the beets in a large pot, and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil, and cook until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain the beets, and mash in a bowl with 2 tablespoons water or tamarind paste.  Grate the beets through the grater using a coarse grater, or mash well in a food mill.  Transfer the mashed potatoes into a container using a lid.

Random Ingredients: cream cheese,spring onion,rice vermicelli,white toblerone chocolate bar,veggie crumbles,rice vinegar,hot pepper,sauerkraut
title: Toblerone Cheesecake With Veggie Crumbles

instructions: Crust, make rice vermicelli according to directions.  Drain and allow to cool for 20 minutes.  Preheat oven 375degrees f.  Assembly, make an x on top of the bottom of the graham cracker, to resemble the tines of two opposite cheeses.  Sprinkle 1/4c of the veggie crumbles evenly across the cracker.  Next layer with 2 - 3 tbs of the cream cheese and 1 - 2 oz of the sauerkraut and another 3 6oz of sauerkraut.  Continue to alternate layers once or twice with a total of 3 - 4 tbs of veggie crumbles and remaining 2 ozs of sauerkraut, crumbles, remaining cream cheese and remaining sauerkraut.  Bake for 15 minutes and let cool for 5 minutes.  Top with remaining sauce and serve topped with sliced toblerone.  Garnish with chopped spring onion if desired.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,urad dal,bamboo skewer,rosemary sprig,manchego cheese
title: Udham Ka Upma (Saffron and Cheese Soup)

instructions: Soak the saffron in warm water for several hours or overnight,.  Drain well, pressing out excess water.  Add the cheese in large, round, heavy soup bowls.  Add the rosemary and saffron halves to the soup.  Wash and soak the soaked, soaked prawns until soft, and add to the soup.  When you are ready, garnish with the saffron.  Note, if you don't have the manchego cheese or the fresh rosemary sprigs, you might cut the top part and sprinkle with it at the beginning of the cooking process.

title: Apple Ginger Tarts

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Grate or chop apples.  Combine apple, ginger, 1 teaspoon mace, and food coloring with remaining 1/2 teaspoon mace.  Stir until thick.  Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the apple mixture into each tart shell.  Gather a little of the ginger for sprinkling on top, and sprinkle 1 tablespoon on top of each tart.  Chill tart shells in refrigerator for 2 hours.  Glaze, stir remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger in a small saucepan over medium heat until fragrant.  Remove from heat, and stir in crystallized ginger.

title: Pasta & Cauliflower With Anchovies (Pasta E Fagioli)

instructions: Cook pasta with plenty of salted water until al dente, remove from the heat and leave to drain thoroughly. Drain the pasta and add to the pan, toss together and season to taste.  Stir through the cheese and serve straight away.

title: Chinese Restaurant Green Tea
ingredients: 1 ounce dark sesame oil | 2 -3 tablespoons ale ( or as needed ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil ( or as needed )
instructions: Heat a dry wok over a high heat until bubbles form around the edges.  Add the 1 oz.  Sesame oil or as needed.  Place the 2 t of ale or other preferred sweetener into the wok and stir fry for about 10 seconds.  Pour in the sesame oil.  Stir around until most of the sesame oil has been absorbed by the ginger and the mixture starts to bubble.  Carefully pour the remaining 1/2 oz.  Sesame oil in a slow stream so it doesn't get too thick, about 1 tbsp.  Serve immediately and keep in an airtight tin.

title: Apple Chipotle Calzone
ingredients: 200 g penne pasta | 175 g guacamole | 200 g cooked peeled cubed apple or 200 g diced canned chipotle chilies | 100 g grated pecorino cheese | 250 g dry mustard seeds | 300 ml mango, thickly sliced and chopped | 2 -4 tablespoons apple cider vinegar
instructions: Cook pasta with 2 cups cold water and a pinch of salt.  Drain.  Transfer to a large mixing bowl and beat well.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Dump into a large glass, plastic or ceramic baking dish.  Using a spoon, stir to combine.  Bake at 200 grades c for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.

title: Fry Bread Tacos

instructions: Heat 1 cup peanut oil in a large skillet, until very hot but not smoking.  Add the chocolate, stirring constantly, until it is melted.  When well mixed in, set aside to cool slightly.  Remove one sheet of reynolds wrap from a 12 x 9 inch rectangle of reynolds wrap with a single layer of waxed paper.
