Transfer this mixture to a resealable container and allow to chill thoroughly.  Sprinkle each barbeque barbeque grill with reynolds wrap®, allowing the wrap to extend over the grill grate.  Grill for 6 - 8 minutes or until tender.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,lemon peel,lemon juice,grain white rice
title: Lemon Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon peel, finely grated | 1 tablespoon grated lemon peel | 2 tablespoons rice | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1 cup long grain white rice, cooked
instructions: Place all ingredients in a covered bowl or strainer and toss until rice is well coated using some of the cooking oil.  Let rest for 10 - 15 minutes, then fluff rice with a fork.  Can be served over a bed of greens.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,black olive,mix,sirloin,cayenne powder,breadcrumb,yukon gold potato
title: Chocolate-And-Olives Stuffed Squash
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed ground sirloin | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne powder | shredded yukon gold potato ( you can also use zucchini if it has them or add about a cup of mashed potatoes and 1/4 cup of water ) | 10 large black olives, minced | 1 1/4 ounces dark chocolate, grated | 1/3 cup good quality dry breadcrumb, to sprinkle over top
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a small loaf pan with greaseproof paper.  In a large bowl, combine beef, breadcrumbs, cayenne and potato with hands.  Knead mixture together really well and form into a ball.  Pat dough into loaf pan.  Bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center of the loaf comes out dry.  Remove from loaf pan.  In a small saucepan, melt chocolate over low heat.  Spread it over the top of the baked pumpkin with a fork and sprinkle with remaining breadcrumb.  Place stuffed loaf onto a baking sheet.  Bake on middle rack of oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until golden brown around the edges.

title: Tortellini With Cheese
ingredients: 500 g cheese tortellini | 400 g mixed vegetables ( zucchini, carrots, mushrooms, mushrooms and celery ) | 400 g cabbage, shredded | 400 g red capsicums, sliced | 4 egg yolks | 125 g dried cranberries
instructions: Boil water in a large pan, add the cheese and heat through do not boil.  Meanwhile, add all other ingredients except egg yolk to a large saucepan and cook over a medium heat, covered, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and cooked through.  Season and serve with crusty bread.  Can be used for the filling as well.  A good filling for salmon and other seafood.

Random Ingredients: orange,bell pepper,heavy whipping cream,liquid smoke,chipotle chile,chicken broth
title: Chipotle Cream Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 4 tablespoons canned chipotle chiles, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 oranges | 1 bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch squares ( red bell pepper or green bell pepper or both )
instructions: Chop the oranges in half and cut them into thin slices.  Whip the cream well, in a medium size bowl, until it forms soft peaks, about 2 minutes/heat the broth in a small saucepan over medium heat until warmed.  Beat the cream and orange slices into the hot broth, then add the chipotles, liquid smoke, and pepper.  Bring the heat up to high, and simmer 15 to 20 minutes.  Stir the soup a few times while it simmers.  If it seems like too thick, a little bit of chicken broth may be poured and blended into the soup.

title: Chickpeas and Nacho Fritters(Vegetarian)
ingredients: 15 ounces chickpeas | 1 1/3 teaspoons ground fenugreek seeds ( saifunf ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground poultry seasoning | corn chips
instructions: Soak chick peas in ample cool water for 30 minutes.  Drain and rinse the peas.  Combine the ground fenugreek and poultry seasoning in a small bowl, add the soaked, drained chick peas and combine gently.  Stir the mixture well.  Chill until serving time.  Serve in crisscross fashion with corn chips.

title: Santa Fe Bread Appetizer
ingredients: 1 piece bread | 1 1/2 tablespoons chocolate syrup | 2 cloves fresh chipotle chiles, minced | 1/2 cup green olives, sliced | 1 nori ( seaweed ), cut into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place bread slice onto prepared sheet, and drizzle with chocolate syrup.  Top with a few minced chipotle chile peppers, and top with green olives.  Sprinkle with nori strips.  Bake in preheated oven until bread is warmed through, 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Hot Fondue - a British Sweet
ingredients: 12 ounces steak, from any part of your knuckle, cut into strips | 1 pint strawberry, washed, hulled, chopped | 1 green apple, peeled, cored & chopped | 14 ounces teabags | salt and black pepper | superfine sugar
instructions: Fry the steak strips quickly in the hot fat.  Place into a fondue pot with the strawberries and apple, add the steaks and stir to coat well.  Cook 1 hr at simmering point and add the teabags.  Bring to the boil, then immediately remove the soup tins.  Stir well until a smooth sauce forms.  Adjust the seasoning to taste with salt and pepper, serve with a knob of butter, sprinkle with the sugared sugar, and serve with boiled new potatoes or green vegetables.

Random Ingredients: coriander powder,spring onion,tomato sauce,vanilla essence,shortening,jicama,emmenthaler cheese,green bean
title: Emmental With Green Beans & Jicama Mash
ingredients: 225 g green beans | 225 g small jicama | 1 1/2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 -3 tablespoons shortening, melted | 1 teaspoon tomato sauce ( ketchup ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 -2 teaspoon grated fresh ginger and garlic | 1 tablespoon spring onion, chopped into little pieces
instructions: Cut beans and jicama, then steam in boiling, salted water for about 3 minutes.  When just tender, drain and mash very well.  Add remaining ingredients, mix well.  Transfer to an ovenproof dish.  Bake in a moderate oven until the top has turned golden brown.  Cut into squares and serve with yoghurt.

title: Spicy Pine Nut Snack Balls
ingredients: 2 cups pine nuts, skins removed | 1 pinch asafoetida powder
instructions: Toast nuts on a medium heat in a dry skillet for a couple of minutes until golden brown.

title: Danish Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 roma ( plum ) tomatoes | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1 bunch fresh fresh dill
instructions: Cut tops off the tomatoes and discard.  Cut a slit down the core and clean the seeds with a teaspoon.  Place them on a microwave safe glass baking dish and cook in the microwave for 20 seconds.  Stir and continue cooking for 4 minutes, or until the tomatoes are soft.  Stir in thyme.  Remove tomatoes and stir them into the yogurt.  Sprinkle with dill.  If desired, drizzle more yogurt over the tops.

Random Ingredients: cumin powder,cilantro leaf,pork roast,mustard seed,pimiento,flat leaf parsley,spaghetti,mexican cheese
title: Mexican Pork & Spaghetti
ingredients: 3 lbs pork roast | 1 jar pimientos | 2 tablespoons cumin powder | 1 lb spaghetti | 1/2 cup flat leaf parsley | 1/2 lb mexican blend cheese | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup cumin powder | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 cup cilantro leaf ( fresh )
instructions: Place ground pork and pimentos in a large skillet and cook, stirring and mashing the vegetables and adding toasted cumin, parsley and mexican blend cheese and chopped parsley.

title: Sweet Ham-Pecan Nests With Parsnips
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni or 1 lb other sweet pasta | 2 lbs sweet ham, diced | 2 cups mixed white sesame seeds | 1 cup brown sugar | 1 cup white sesame seeds | 1 cinnamon stick | fresh parsley or mint ( to garnish )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook until al dente drain.  In a very large nonstick skillet over medium high heat brown the ham, adding the white sesame seeds and brown sugar.  Serve with a scattering of black and green leaves of mint.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,lemongrass,pork roast,lady finger cooky,kasuri methi,self rising flour,french bread,lamb chop
title: Tandoori (Lamb Chops)
ingredients: 2 kg lamb chops | 1 1/2 kg pork roast | 2 teaspoons kasuri methi | 3 stalks lemongrass | 250 g self rising flour | 300 g french bread | 375 g lady finger cookies
instructions: Dry roast the mashes with a rolling pin.  Place on greased oven trays.  In a saucepan on low heat put the kasuri methi.  Slice lemongrass stalk, add to saucepan and leave on low heat for 3 minutes.  Take pork chops out of the pan.  Make sure the chops are well covered.  Spread lemon grass on the pork chops, then spread kasuri methi on them.  Make sure you do this on both sides.  Put the chops back onto stove, put the pork chops onto the pan.  Make sure all the meat is well covered with the marinade.  Leave on medium heat for 2 hours.  Put french bread, cut up and french fingers on the pan.  Now put the oven on 180 celsius and bake for 10 minutes.  Check the internal temperature, make sure the pork chops are done.  Add more lemongrass if needed.  Take out the french bread, tear in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast,rice noodle,red table wine,worcestershire sauce,hazelnut,italian parsley
title: Chicken and Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 1 cup red table wine | 1 cup hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon dried italian parsley | 2 packages rice noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place chicken in a large, deep baking dish.  Add wine, bring to a boil then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of worcestershire sauce, dried parsley and remaining 1 tablespoon of worcestershire sauce.  Cover and bake for 50 minutes or until meat juices run clear, stirring occasionally.  Meanwhile, cook rice noodles in boiling slated water until tender crisp, about 6 minutes.  Drain and rinse under cold water.  Drain noodles well and return to baking dish.  Add chicken mixture and remaining 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce to noodles and mix well.

title: Easy Chili-Cheese Squares
ingredients: 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 tablespoon chili powder
instructions: Preheat over to 350 degrees.  Line baking sheet with parchment paper.  Combine spaghetti sauce and graham cracker crumbs in a bowl.  Mix well.  Press mixture by spoonful onto baking sheet.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: Tamarind Shapes
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces tamarind paste | 5 ounces button mushrooms
instructions: Mince the mushrooms and add to the tamarind paste.  Seal, taste and add salt if desired.  Cover and chill.

title: Simple Lamb Lassie
ingredients: 1 3/4 kg lamb, trimmed & lean | 1 liter vegetable stock | 400 g mixed beans, thawed if frozen
instructions: Put lamb into a large saucepan w/the stock and bring to the boil, skimming any scum that rises to the surface.  Add the beans and cook over low heat for approx 1 hr, covered, stirring occasionally, until lamb is tender and sauce has thickened slightly.  Season to taste with salt & freshly ground black pepper.  Stir in any remaining stock and cook for 1 - 2 mins until heated through.

title: Blueberry Wine Lasagna
ingredients: 12 lasagna noodles, cooked | 1/2 cup blueberry wine
instructions: Combine wine and blueberry wine to make sauce.  Place noodles on cookie sheet and cover with sauce.  Bake at 375 in oven for 20 - 25 minutes.  Allow to cool, covered in sauce, and serve.

Random Ingredients: oil,extra virgin olive oil,cherry tomato,canola oil,italian bread,sun tomato oil
title: Sun-Dried Tomato Canola Oil Bruschetta
ingredients: 1/4 cup canola oil | 1/4 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 1 can cherry tomatoes, drained | 1/2 cup toasted sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 4 cloves garlic, peeled and roughly chopped | 2 french bread rolls, loafs halved lengthwise ( or other cut of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons canola oil
instructions: To make the sun dried tomato canola oil dressing, combine canola oil, sun dried tomatoes and cherry tomatoes in a small bowl and mix thoroughly.  To make the french bread sandwiches, spread each bread half with 1 tablespoon canola oil.  Spread each bread half with half of the canola oil dressing.  Cut or tear the italian bread into thin slices and place on a baking sheet.  To serve, top each slice of toasted bread with 1 tablespoon canola oil dressing, followed by the tomato cherry tomato canola oil dressing and a few sun dried tomatoes.

title: Lamb Rillettes
ingredients: 4 lamb, rashers ( approx 4 ounces each ) or 4 boneless lamb chops, cut into medium-sized chunks ( approx 4 ounces each ) | 2 tablespoons clarified butter | 1/2 cup finely chopped leek | 1/2 cup whole natural yogurt | 4 tablespoons jam, heated | 4 fresh cherry tomatoes, halved | 8 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium size frying pan, melt 2 tablespoons of the clarified butter.  Add the lamb, leeks and yoghurt until lamb is cooked, about 10 to 15 minutes.  Transfer skillet to low setting and cook for 8 to 15 minutes, stirring regularly.  Transfer lamb to a warm bowl.  Spread half of the warmed jam on a plate, such as the edge of a large serving platter.  Dollop the lamb mixture into the jam, covering lamb uniformly.  Place the cherry tomatoes on top and spread remaining 4 tablespoons butter on the plate.  Spoon sliced cheese on top, pressing down firmly, and cover with the remaining ham on top.  Cover the cheese with foil, to keep warm while preparing ramekins.  Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Uncover and bake ramekins for 15 minutes until edges of ramekins begin to brown.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,bread,breadcrumb,sun tomato oil,red curry paste,goat cheese,lobster tail,topping
title: Salad and Goat Cheese Tartlets
ingredients: 200 g salmon tails, cut into 4 equal pieces | 200 g soft fresh goat cheese | 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 2 teaspoons red curry paste | 100 g breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons fresh raspberries | 2 tablespoons fresh bread, crumbs | 1 1/2 tablespoons crumbs | topping ( optional ) | parsley ( optional )
instructions: Bake salmon for 10 - 15 minutes or until just slightly opaque, remove from oven and turn oven temperature down to 180°c.  In a bowl combine all other ingredients and mix until they are well blended.  Pat mixture into to a 12 x 8 inch log shaped on parchment paper lined baking sheet.  Bake for 30 minutes.  To serve, cut into 4 equal slices from log.  Top each tartlet with slices of goat cheese and raspberries and parsley for a special treat.

title: Aussie Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stew meat | 3/4 teaspoon chile, powder | 3/4 teaspoon molasses | 1 1/2 tablespoons barbecue sauce or 1 1/2 tablespoons salad oil | 1 ounce streaky bacon ( optional ) | 1 -2 tablespoon soda water, hot | 2 tablespoons salad oil
instructions: Cut meat into bite sized chunks.  Mix the seasoning and pour over the meat.  Mix together lightly.

title: Easy and Fast Kielbasa
ingredients: 2 lbs polish saffron threads, soaked in warm water for at least 12 hours | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon or 1 teaspoon instant chicken stock granules | 1 lb kielbasa, uncut, cut into 1-inch rounds
instructions: Drain soaked saffron.  Place in a large bowl.  Add the chicken bouillon or stock or granules.  Using your hands, rub the saffron between your hands.  Add the kielbasa.  Use a plastic bag for this part of the saffron.  Tie the bag to make a pouch.  Poke holes all over the kielbasa.  If possible, cover with oil or melted margarine.  Set over medium heat.  When the kielbasa starts to sizzle, place the pouch over medium heat to brown the kielbasa with splattering oil.  Drain kielbasa on paper towels and serve with pita bread or a salad.

title: Ham, Ketchup And Cheese
ingredients: 1/2 lb deli ham, sliced into thin bite size strips | 1 cup cherry fresh sliced in half ( kalamata olives ) | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons lemon peel, grated | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 2 bay leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients except ketchup sauce in small microwave safe dish, microwave on high 1 minute.

title: Quinoa Wrapped Salisbury Steak (Antoine Bourekia)
ingredients:
1 cup quinoa | 1 teaspoon grenadine ( a simple syrup mixed with sugar ) | 1 tablespoon yoghurt, sour | 7 sausages ( fully cooked and sliced into 4 ) | 2 teaspoons ghee | sliced yellow pepper ( optional ) | 1 lb thinly sliced mild german sweet sausage ( i used heller's brand.
    - use kålaki if you like )
instructions: Heat ghee in skillet.  Add kålaki sliced sausages and sliced pepper.  Add the quinoa, greeked syrup mixture and stir to combine until mixed and warmed through.  Top with the sliced raw sausage and serve.

Random Ingredients: lime wedge,plain nonfat yogurt,cake flour,extra sharp cheddar cheese,yellow bell pepper
title: Creamy Yellow Pepper and Yogurt Cake
ingredients: 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt, plain is best | 1/2 cup extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded ( or to taste ) | 1/4 cup yellow bell pepper, finely chopped ( i use red or green ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons cake flour | 1/4 cup lime wedge, finely minced
instructions: In a blender or food processor add yogurt and mix until smooth.  In a medium bowl combine cheese and bell pepper.  Add spice mixture and mix until well combined.  Place on a serving dish, sprinkle with minced lime and chill at least two hours.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,soy sauce,pinto bean,baby spinach leaf,virgin olive oil
title: Ww Points 4 Points - Low-Sodium Bean and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pinto beans or 1 cup kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 1 1/2 cups baby spinach ( fresh or frozen, thawed and drained ) | 1/2 cup light soy sauce | 1/3 cup vidalia onion chili-garlic sauce | 1 teaspoon virgin olive oil
instructions: Put beans into a large salad bowl.  Scatter spinach over beans.  Whisk together light soy sauce, chili garlic sauce and oil.  Spoon dressing over the veggies and evenly mix.  Tip, stir well before serving if you use frozen spinach you may need to add a little water or olive oil.

title: Cheesy Prawns and Macaroni Bake
ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni, preferably small | 250 g white cheddar cheese, finely sliced | 300 g shrimp, shell and deveined | 2 teaspoons dried marjoram | 300 -300 g couscous, cooked
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.  Heat the oven to 200°c / 350°f/ gas mark 7.  Grease a large ovenproof, shallow ovenproof dish with a little of the extra fat from the prawns.  Grate the cheese into the pan, then toss in the shrimp to coat with the cheese.  Put the pasta into the oven and cook for 6 - 7 minutes, until the cheese has melted.  Meanwhile, cook the prawns in boiling water in a large pan for 1 - 2 minutes or until cooked.  Drain and set aside.  Place half the macaroni into a pan, and stir through the remaining macaroni.  Remove half the shrimp from the shells and set aside.  Sprinkle the marjoram over the prawns.  Drain the pasta and return to the pan.  Add the remaining prawns and remaining cheese and stir through.  Spoon into the prepared dish.  Pour over any reserved prawns, and sprinkle with the remaining marjoram.  Bake in the oven for 20 - 30 minutes, until the topping is browned and crisp and the prawns are cooked.

title: Spicy Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 lb yellow pepper | 4 flour tortillas
instructions: Brown stew meat in skillet with a little water and pepper and pepper until meat is brown, and vegetables are soft.  Cook tortillas in a pan with a little cooking spray.  Spoon the meat mixture.  Roll up and put in a warm tortilla and garnish with cheese and sour cream.  You can also serve with fresh cilantro.

title: Caesar Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh breaded anchovies | 1/2 pound shredded monterey jack cheese | 10 ounces fresh bean sprouts | 1/4 cup chopped walnuts
instructions: Cut the anchovies in half horizontally.  Cut each half into quarters.  Arrange the pieces on a serving plate.  Cut the cheese into 8 triangles.  Arrange the sprouts in a cross, over the cheese.  Drizzle the anchovies on top of the sprouts.  Sprinkle the walnuts over the sprouts.  Chill before serving.

title: Tuna Risotto With Burrios
ingredients: 350 g tuna steaks | 1 cup arborio rice ( risotto rice ) | 1 cup boiling watercress leaf | 1/2 cup plain flour | 1 packet biscuits
instructions: Cook rice by steaming in a pot adding boiling watercress.  Rinse with hot damp tea towel and drain well.  Cut into small chunks, return to pan and stir over high heat until warm.  Stir in tuna and fluff up the tuna with your fingers.  Put a spoonfull of rice mixture in the centre of warmed biscuit and wrap the biscuit around the tuna and risotto.  Microwave, uncovered, on high for 1 - 2 minutes.

title: Pistachio-Mint Bark
ingredients: 1 cup hulled pistachio | 1 teaspoon minced shallots or 1 teaspoon minced white onion | 1/4 teaspoon sriracha sauce | 8 -10 sprigs of fresh mint
instructions: Put all the ingredients in your food processor and pulse until they are a fine, crumbly mass.  Pour the mass into a storage jar and refrigerate to chill for up to 2 months.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,heavy whipping cream,oyster sauce,prosciutto,almond extract,espresso powder,golden syrup
title: Pine Cream Rice Balls (Vegan)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 3/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1/2 cup brewed espresso powder | 1 teaspoon instant espresso powder, dissolved in | 1 tablespoon water | 1/4 cup chopped prosciutto ( use vegetarian if you have it ) or 1/4 cup scallions ( use vegetarian if you have it ) | 1 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Stir in heavy cream, almond extract, golden syrup, and espresso powder mix.  Let cool.  Shape rice mixture into 1 inch balls, and set aside.  Heat the water and espresso powder in small saucepan.  Dip each ball in coffee syrup and arrange in a single layer on a plate.  Pour hot water over balls until completely covered.  Sprinkle with ham or scallions and soy sauce.  Serve warm.

title: Roasted Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 1 lb macaroni | 1/2 cup blue cheese, crumbled | 1/4 cup red pepper sauce, from a jar roasted red peppers ( not the bottled kind )
instructions: Bring 1 inch water to a boil in a large pot.  Add macaroni and cook until al dente.  Drain in a colander, rinse under cold water and cool completely.  In a large bowl, mix together macaroni, cheese, cheese sauce, and roasted red peppers.  Toss with olive oil and season to taste with black pepper.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend flavors.  Toss again before serving.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,ra el hanout spice mix,saffron,white cabbage,green chilies,purpose flour,filling
title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1/4 kg white cabbage, washed, shredded and chopped | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1/4 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon ras el hanout spice mix | 3 -4 green chilies, slit lengthwise | vegetable oil or corn oil, as required to fry | prepared filling, as required
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the cabbage, flour, saffron, ras el hanout spice mixture and green chillies.  Heat oil in a kadai.  Dip the cabbage mixture in the batter and deep fry it in hot oil on medium flame for 4 - 5 mins until the colour of the cabbage changes colour.  Remove from kadai and serve with prepared meat curry.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: beef gravy,peanut,sage leaf,cajun seasoning,ginger juice,tomato green chilies,veal
title: Easy Meaty Bolognaise
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 can stewed tomatoes and green chilies | 2 tablespoons fresh ginger juice | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves | 1 tablespoon peanut | 1 tablespoon beef gravy ( your favourite-i use bolognaise sauce ( a taste of home ) or 1 tablespoon gravy from a packet of maggi, if you're really into spice )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and chill for about an hour before serving.  This is very tasty on a bun or with potatoes or what ever you choose and you may top it with shredded cheese, fresh chopped chives, chopped fresh basil, or your favourite chopped tomato salad.

title: Chickpea Flour Blend
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups chickpea flour ( besan ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons granulated celery seeds | 3 teaspoons grand marnier, or other fruity flavored liqueur
instructions: Whisk together the flour, celery seeds, and grand marnier in a bowl until thoroughly blended.

Random Ingredients: ladyfinger,red potato,cocoa,red snapper fillet,vanilla bean,yellow pepper,couscous
title: Spiced Fish With Red Potatoes, Couscous and Snowflake Ice
ingredients: 1 lb red snapper fillets, halved lengthwise | 4 teaspoons cocoa | 2 tablespoons red potatoes, cut into half-moons | 1 1/2 pints yellow sweet peppers, cut into chunks | 2 red potatoes, cut into half-moons | 4 tablespoons red potatoes, cut into half-moons | 1/2 vanilla bean | 16 ladyfingers ( about 5- to 7oz pack )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.

Random Ingredients: currant,taco seasoning mix,poblano chile,mint leaf,cooking spray,cayenne
title: Chiles Stuffed W-Taco Stuffing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon taco seasoning mix | 1/2 small fresh poblano chile, finely chopped, seeds and white ribs discarded | 1 tablespoon dried currants | 1 teaspoon dried mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Make sure the taco seasoning mix is packed and thoroughly distributed.  If your chiles are large, remove the stem, devein and discard them.  In a medium bowl, mix the taco seasoning with the poblano chile and currants, mint leaves, cayenne and optional ingredients, until well combined.  Using your hands, spread mixture evenly onto a piece of wax paper, dampen wax paper and pat each chile into a 6 inch round.  You should have about 12 disks.  Chill for at least 15 minutes before using so any air pockets that have lodged in their air will do.  Preheat oven to 450f, place the stuffed chiles on a foil covered baking sheet and bake until the chiles are very soft, about 10 minutes, basting often.  Remove from oven and let cool to lukewarm.  Using a sharp knife, carefully remove the seeds and membrane and discard, if desired.  Using a small spoon, carefully remove and discard the membrane from inside the chiles, leaving just a small amount of the tomato's pulp.  Remove and discard the seeds and membrane if desired.  Place the chiles in a food processor or blender and pulse until coarsely chopped.  Add about 1 teaspoon of the reserved tomato pulp and pulse until combined until well incorporated.  Add just enough tomato pulp to achieve the desired consistency, about 1 minute.  Pack 2 - 3 tablespoons of the taco stuffing at a timestime and spoon into the openings.  Repeat with the remaining filling and wrappers.  Use a paper cone as a piping bag to pipe the prepared stuffing into the chiles to form an opening that can be stuffed into the turkey.

Random Ingredients: green olive,szechwan pepper,mirin,skirt steak,red pepper,dijon mustard
title: Grilled Skirt Steak - Szechwan Style
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon mirin ( japanese sweet wine ) | 2 tablespoons szechwan pepper | 2 tablespoons red pepper, roasted ground in a mortar | 2 lbs skirt steaks, thinly sliced about 1/2-inch thick ( about 12- to 18 slices ) | 3 tablespoons green olives, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons sweet red peppers, sliced thin
instructions: Whisk first 4 ingredients together in a small bowl.

title: Apple Blossom
ingredients: 2 lbs apples, peeled, cored and quartered | 12 sprigs dill | 1 pinch msg ( to taste, i like it with some turmeric )
instructions: Pour 1 cup water into large bowl large enough to accomodate the apples in it.  Add the dill sprigs and season with salt and msg.  Cover and let stand in a cool place for 20 - 30 minutes.  Uncover and set aside to finish cooking.  Note 1, i've never used msg before, and i imagine it might be very unpleasant to use.  I've even had fun with msg powder in it.  Note 2, apple blossoms can be frozen up to six months.

title: Lemongrass and Pesto Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 14 ounces prepared pesto sauce, preferably homemade | 1 stalk fresh lemongrass
instructions: Cut the lemongrass into thin slices, and remove white ribs as well as the white part.  In a medium bowl, mix together the pesto and lemongrass.  Season with salt.

title: Thai Chicken Baked Rachael Ray
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 1/2 lbs assorted assorted fresh fish | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 3/4 cup creme fraiche | 3 tablespoons finely crushed roasted peanuts | 12 sprigs rosemary | kitchen bouquet | 3/4 cup quinoa
instructions: Remove giblets, neck, belly cavity, and wing tips from chicken wings.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,peanut oil,iceberg lettuce,pineapple juice,beef stock bouillon,stewing beef
title: Stir Fry Hawaiian Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs stewing beef ( or other tender cuts sliced in strips ) | 3 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/4 cup brown rice ( uncooked ) | 4 cups beef stock or 4 cups bouillon | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 2 tablespoons brown rice ( uncooked ) | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( or use a 10-head bag of lettuce )
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Drain cooked rice and toss with oil to coat.  Combine beef, rice and broth in a large skillet.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes over medium low heat or until beef is just tender.  Remove from heat and stir in pineapple juice.  Serve salad topped with lettuce.

title: Granny's Lemon Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters | 1/3 cup cornflour | 1 teaspoon lemon pepper
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water until tender, drain well and return to same pot add remaining potatoes, lemon pepper and cornflour stir and heat through.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,okra,brown button mushroom,saffron,active yeast,meat,tomato paste,apple
title: Okra & Vegetable Bread for the Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 2 cans tomato paste | 1 1/2 cups whole kernel corn, undrained | 1 can okra, drained | 1 egg | 3 cans smoked meat | 1 apple, thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon saffron
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 cup water, and set aside in a warm place until frothy, about 20 minutes.  Combine tomato paste, corn, okra, egg, and remaining ingredients in your pressure cooker.  Set over high heat, and bring to a boil.  Switch off and wait 3 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Beef and Cheese Pies
ingredients: 600 g veal, cubed | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, chopped | 3 ounces cheese, coarsely grated
instructions: Place veal and parsley in a bowl, stir well.  Add meat and enough water to cover.  Toss gently until all is coated.  Divide between 4 greased pies, sprinkle with cheese.  Bake at gas 5 for 25 minutes or until cooked, but not browned.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti,vanilla sugar,red potato,turnip,cornstarch,genoa salami,ranch dressing,picante sauce
title: Savory Italian Pasta Salad
ingredients: 2 lbs red potatoes, halved and sliced | 8 ounces genoa salami, sliced thin | 1 lb spaghetti or 1 lb spaghetti and potatoes, cooked, drained and rinsed | 1 lb turnip, peeled and diced | 1/2 lb spaghetti or 1/2 lb spaghetti, cooked and drained | 1/2 cup ranch dressing | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 jar picante sauce
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the potatoes, salami and turnips with a potato masher to a spreadable consistency.  Stir in the remaining ingredients until thoroughly coated.  Cover and chill overnight before serving.  Best when chilled.

title: Thai Style Poppy Seeds
ingredients: 200 g poppy seeds | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 2 -3 long red chili peppers ( depending on your taste )
instructions: Take off seeds and dry seeds.  Grind until they look like coarse sand, or coarse grains.  Mix with sugar and grind until it becomes a paste consistency.  Store in the plastic container.  Enjoy.

title: Simple Nuts
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons hot oil | 5 tablespoons finely chopped fresh chives | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped serrano peppers
instructions: Heat up oil.  When it just sizzles, stir fry chives and serrano peppers for a couple of seconds and then add to oil.  Immediately remove from heat.  Stir in peanut oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.

Random Ingredients: sauerkraut,beef,pam cooking spray,basmati rice,quinoa,apple cider vinegar
title: German Beef and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked instant rice | 1 lb ground beef, browned and drained | 1/2 cup uncooked quinoa | 1/2 cup sauerkraut, packed tightly | pam cooking spray | 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
instructions: Heat sauerkraut in microwave on high 15 seconds.  Add cooked rice, ground beef and browned quinoa and combine.  Spoon mixture into 2 quart casserole coated with pam and vinegar.  Bake at 350 degrees 10 - 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Sweet Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 pound cooked and cubed pork shoulder, or more to taste | 2 cans great northern beans, drained | 1 cup white sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Place pork in a 9x13 inch baking dish that has been coated with cooking spray.  Arrange beans in a circular pattern atop the pork.  Cover with water by about 1 inch, about 1/2 inch deep.  Bake in the preheated oven until pork is easily shredded, about 1 1/2 hours.  Remove pork from oven, and shred using two forks.  Return meat to baking dish, stir in sugar, and continue baking until beans begin to caramelize, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Moroccan Peanuts
ingredients: 6 ounces fresh peanuts ( or salted peanuts ) | 1 tablespoon roasted cumin seed, coarsely mashed with a mortar and pestle
instructions: Place the peanuts in a fine mesh sieve, pressing with the back of a large, nonstick frypan over medium high heat until very lightly browned.  Drain the peanuts and transfer them to a large mixing bowl.  Add the cumin seeds and mix to combine.  Pour the peanuts and spice mixture over the peanuts.  Chill the peanuts at least 10 minutes, so they will be easy to stir in when they are fried.  Store in an airtight container.  Use with caution.  Enjoy.

title: Golabeesh
ingredients: 1 cup olive | 1 1/2 cups cashews, raw | 1 cup riesling wine or 1 cup white wine | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Heat a non stick skillet over medium heat.  Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the pan, and when olive oil is hot add cashew nuts.  Be careful so cashew nuts don't burn.  Sprinkle crushed red pepper flakes over cashews, add riesling, and cook 2 minutes longer.

Random Ingredients: green pea,pecorino romano cheese,baking potato,cardamom powder,pear,flax seed,tortilla
title: Tortilla Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flax seeds | 3 baking potatoes, diced | 1/2 cup green peas | 15 -20 slices of fresh pear | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 6 -8 tortillas
instructions: Sprinkle with flaxseed.  Bake at 350 for 20 minutes.  Allow to cool.  Mix with other salad ingredients and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Curry Vegetables
ingredients: 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon instant minced garlic | 1 lb fresh peas and carrots | 1 1/2 ounces dark chocolate
instructions: Heat a large frying pan on medium high, setting the heat as high as it can come.  Toast finely the garlic with a little curry powder, or a little pepper.  Add the peas and carrots and stir to mix, then leave on medium high, stirring a few times.  Stir until the sauce thickens a little and the carrots are cooked to your liking.  Turn the heat down and just stir through the dark chocolate.  This could be served over brown rice, as is or as a side dish with any main dish.

Random Ingredients: sage leaf,yukon gold potato,double cream,breadcrumb,balsamic vinegar,tomato puree,parsley,tarragon
title: Potato and Tomato Pie
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced | 4 tablespoons plain breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, chopped | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 1 teaspoon sage leaf, chopped | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 1 cup tomato puree | 1/4 cup double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 375f degrees.  Place potatoes in a shallow large baking dish and add water to cover.  Stand potatoes in liquid for 10 minutes.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  Using 2 spoons, spread bread crumbs over the potato.  In a small bowl, combine tarragon, parsley, sage, vinegar, tomato puree and cream.  Remove potatoes from water and mash thoroughly, adding a little water at a time if required to make a paste.  Spoon into the baking dish and smooth top.  Cover and cook for 1 hour 30 minutes.  In a thin slice, place a dollop of yoghurt on top.  Serve with crusty bread.  Goes well with potatoes.

title: Quick & Easy Party Dip
ingredients: 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup, undiluted | 12 cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon coriander powder
instructions: Mix soup and cherry tomatoes together.  Serve with biscuits, triscuits or bread to dip.

title: Cauliflower Rum-Glazed Cornstarch Caskets
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk or 1 cup soy milk | 1/3 cup rum ( bacardi light rum is the best ) | 1 2/3 cups small cauliflower florets, separated | 1 packet vanilla instant pudding mix ( i prefer rice krispies ) | 2 teaspoons cornstarch or 2 teaspoons arrowroot
instructions: Heat buttermilk or soy milk in a saucepan over medium heat.  Meanwhile, in a small bowl whisk sugar/spice mixture and cornstarch together until sugar dissolves.  Stir in pudding mix.  Add cauliflower and whisk until just coated.  Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spoon mixture into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray, spreading evenly.  Bake, in a 400 degrees oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve warm.

title: Home Made Pasta With Bay, Garlic and White Beans
ingredients: 1 lb medium shell pasta, such as ditalini | 1 bay leaf | 1 -2 tablespoon white made fromage frais ( optional )
instructions: In a 3 - 4 quart dutch oven, or similar pot, cook the pasta, according to package directions.  Do not rinse before serving or the pasta will turn bitter.  Add water to cover the pasta if necessary.  Add the bay leaf and white made fromage frais, if using, and heat.

title: Oriental Grated Cheese (Aubergine)
ingredients: 1 cup soya sauce | 2 cups shaved pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f and place a parchment paper on a baking sheet.  Pour about half of the soya sauce into the baking sheet, then stir.  Sprinkle the cheese in a thin layer over the butter in a small bowl.  Sprinkle the cheese on top.  Pour the remaining soya sauce evenly over the cheese.  Bake in the oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pork,cocoa,kirsch liqueur,italian parsley,water chestnut,gruyere cheese,chocolate square
title: Triple Chocolate & Swiss Meatballs With Swiss Chocolate
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa | 1/8 cup unsweetened kirsch liqueur ( or substitute with 2 tbsp dry white wine or water ) | 1/2 lb coarsely ground pork | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley toasted and minced fresh parsley | 2/3 cup water chestnut, minced | 1/2 cup gruyere cheese, grated ( about 1/3 cup ) | 6 ounces semisweet chocolate squares, finely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  In a small bowl, stir together the cocoa and liqueur, then set aside to cool.  In a large bowl, mix the pork with dried italian parsley, water chestnuts, and gruyere cheese.  Add the chocolate morsels mixture and toss to combine.  Form the mixture into about 28 1/2 ounce meatballs.  Place meatballs on a plate, cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to firm up slightly.  Bake meatballs for 20 - 25 minutes or until no longer pink in the center.  Remove from the oven and serve.

title: Chinese Looneyed Venison Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/3 pound ground venison | 3 packages dry chinese noodles | 1 bottle sweet chili sauce | 3 avocados - peeled, pitted and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f.  Brown venison for about 30 minutes in a large skillet over high heat.  Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add noodles, and cook until tender, about 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: white bean,beef chuck,cooking spray,turmeric,pecorino romano cheese,tabasco sauce
title: Italian Beef Stew
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 3 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 teaspoons ground coriander or 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 2 teaspoons tabasco sauce ( optional ) | 19 ounces white beans, drained and rinsed well | 3 ounces pecorino romano cheese, shaved
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Spray 9x5 inch loaf pan lightly with cooking spray.  Combine 1 teaspoon turmeric and 1 pound beef in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,grain mustard,kale,boston lettuce,vanilla sugar,breadcrumb,kernel corn
title: Kale-Corn Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked kale, finely chopped ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 cans kernel corn | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup cake flour, plus extra for rolling | 2 -3 leaves fresh whole grain mustard | 4 leaves boston lettuce
instructions: Combine all ingredients except breadcrumbs, mustard and lettuce in large bowl.  Shape into 12 rolls and wrap in wax paper towel.

Random Ingredients: ice water,worcestershire sauce,adobo seasoning,guacamole,limeade concentrate,cointreau liqueur,pork roast
title: Wine Tacos
ingredients: 12 ounces pork roast | 2 tablespoons cointreau liqueur | 1/2 cup guacamole | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | adobo seasoning, for seasoning | 1 cup ice water
instructions: Place pork roast in crock pot with cointreau.  Mix together water, limeade, and worcestershire sauce.  Pour over meat and crock pot.  Cook until all liquid has evaporated.  While meat is cooking, place guacamole, limeade concentrate, and adobo seasoning in bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal blade.  Pulsate until smooth.  Pour over pork in crock pot.  Cook on high for 4 hours.  Turn to low and cook another 1 1/2 hours.  Remove meat and shred into pieces using two forks.

Random Ingredients: veal,beef broth,red grape,baking soda,cabbage,phyllo dough,italian parsley
title: Cheat's Bieroches
ingredients: 1 package frozen fat-free beef broth | 3/4 cup carrot, coarsely grated | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | 1 cup cabbage | 1/4 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 1/2 lb ground veal | 5 sheets frozen phyllo dough, thawed, and defrosted
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine beef broth, carrot, baking soda, cabbage, parsley, and ground veal in medium bowl and mix well.

Random Ingredients: kahlua,ciabatta,matzo meal,green bell pepper,pancake syrup,shiitake mushroom
title: Italian Patty Melts
ingredients: 1 ciabatta | 2 green bell peppers | 1 lb shiitake mushroom | 2 cups matzo meal | 1/4 cup kahlua ( optional ) | 1/2 cup pancake syrup
instructions: Split ciabatta lengthwise.  Chop bell peppers and mushrooms.  Place chopped peppers, mushrooms, and matzoh meal, in a large plastic bag.  Mix together well.  Seal tightly and shake to coat.  Place on pan and bake at 400 about 15 - 20 minutes, till slightly golden on the bottom.  Remove from oven.  Let cool.  Slice into 1/4 thick rounds.  Top with patty.  Brush with pate syrup and a drizzle of Kahlua for nice look.

title: Tender Noodle Tapas
ingredients: 2 ounces of uncooked noodles | 1 dash white wine or 1 dash champagne | 1 dash cognac | 3 parsley sprigs | lemon extract
instructions: Put all ingredients except the lemon extract in a pan with just enough water to cover the noodles.  Cover and simmer on a very gentle hear for about 20 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Allow the noodles to drain in a colander.  Stir the drained noodles into the noodles with the lemon extract, and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,broccoli rabe,fennel seed,burrito flour tortilla,thyme
title: Baked Lentils and Broccoli Rabe Enchiladas (Ww Core)
ingredients: 1 lb red lentils | 1 lb broccoli rabe, cleaned, stemmed and cut into 1-inch pieces | 4 teaspoons dried thyme | 1 teaspoon fennel seed | 8 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  In a large bowl rinse lentils and broccoli rabe.  In 4 quart saucepan combine lentils & broccoli rabe along with thyme & fennel.  Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to low & simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place tortillas on a baking sheet & bake for 10 minute or until warm, pliable and flexible.  Carefully spoon lentils & broccoli rabe mixture down the center of a tortilla & roll up the tortilla.  Arrange the rolled tortillas in an 8 x 8 baking dish & sprinkle the enchiladas with the remaining fennel seeds.  Bake for about 15 min or until heated through.  Serve immediately from the baking dish.

title: Sausage and Kielbasa With Apricots and Apricots
ingredients: 4 beef sausages | 8 -10 cups fresh apricot marmalade ( i use homemade ) | 1/2 package sliced kielbasa ( can sub other sausage too ) | 8 tablespoons sour cream | 1/4 cup chopped fresh thai basil
instructions: In a slow cooker, combine sausages, apricots, kielbasa, sour cream, and basil.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for 6 to 8 hours or on high heat setting for 4 to 5 hours.  Serve over noodles or as a meat and vegetable accompaniment.  For more of an alcohol free version, use the apricot marmalade.

title: Malaysian Whole Wheat Pancakes
ingredients: 2 2/3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cardamom seeds | 1 teaspoon ajwain ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 3 drops plum sauce ( to taste ) | 1/4 cup raisins ( to taste )
instructions: Heat wok until very hot.  Add plums and raisins.  Sprinkle in cardamom seeds and mix well.  Add sugar and mix well.  Add flour, mix well.  Remove from heat.  Add plum sauce and mix well.  Spoon the mixture into a greased, heavy skillet and spread evenly.  Flatten with a metal rolling pin.  Fry lightly over medium heat till browned.  Turn and brown.  Allow to brown slightly.  Repeat this until all mixture is used.  Serve hot.

title: Creole Tortilla Strips
ingredients: 10 tortillas | 1/4 cup vegetable shortening | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f.  Cut the tortillas into 20 strips.  In a nonstick skillet, melt the shortening and creole seasoning over medium high heat.  Slightly brown the tortilla strips, about 3 minutes.  Transfer to a plate, add the shortening mixture to the tortilla strips, and toss to coat.  Serve warm.

title: Spanish Spinach Soup With Tomatoes and Smoke
ingredients: 300 g baby spinach | 400 ml vegetable stock | 2 large egg whites, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup finely chopped tomatoes
instructions: Line a large heatproof bowl with greaseproof paper.  Place the spinach and stock in a saucepan and bring to the boil, then simmer slowly until the spinach wilts, then add the egg, stirring well.  Spoon the spinach mixture into bowls and scatter with the tomatoes.

Random Ingredients: coriander,corn flake,walnut,yellow pea,rosemary leaf,dark brown sugar,asiago cheese
title: Pea, Walnut and Asiago Stuffed Pastries
ingredients: 100 g chopped walnuts | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary leaves ( or a tsp dried rosemary leaves ) | 225 g frozen yellow pea, thawed if using fresh peas, drained and picked over | 350 g asiago cheese, grated | 1/2 cup coriander, loosely packed | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons corn flakes, extra, for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Spray two oven trays with oil cooking spray and scatter with walnuts and rosemary.  Roast for 5 mins, stirring once, or until golden and fragrant.  Remove and set aside to cool.  Using a food processor add asiago, coriander, sugar, cornflour and black pepper, process to a smooth paste.  Stir through toasted walnut mixture.  Place filling in a pastry bag fitted with medium plain tip.  Pipe pastry into 20 25cm trays and then flatten until even, about 5cm/1in each diameter.  Bake for 12 - 14 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: French Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, scrubbed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 1 teaspoon french mustard | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Prepare the potatoes by scrubbing them with a potato peeler.  Place them on a microwave safe dish and drizzle the maple syrup on top.  Cover with aluminum foil and cook for about 15 minutes.  Remove the potato from the microwave and brush with a little water.  Place the potatoes, uncovered, on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until lightly browned.  Turn the potatoes out onto a baking sheet and brush them with a little water.  Bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until golden brown.  While the potatoes are baking, spread miniature marshmallows on a large plate.  Place the drained potatoes on top of the marshmallow and drizzle with french mustard.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sauce,dark rum,pinto bean,turnip,bailey irish cream,sesame seed,red potato,ancho chile powder
title:
Chili Con Carne.
    -.
    -.
    -the Bahamas
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb turnip, peeled and cut into quarters ( about six large ) | 1 lb red potatoes, cut into 3/4-inch dice ( about three medium ) | 1 1/4 ounces aji pancake chile powder | 1 tablespoon hot sauce, such as tabasco recommended | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried ancho chile powder | 1/2 cup sauerkraut or 1/2 cup dark beer | 1/2 cup toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Put all ingredients into a large dutch oven, except the sauerkraut.  Cover and bake at 400°f, uncovered, for about 8 minutes, stirring and turning every 5 minutes, or up to 45 minutes, until vegetables are tender.  Uncover and bake for 10 minutes.  Stir in the sesame seeds.

title: Puerto Rican Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 cups mixed hot peppers ( such as red or green seeded and chopped-may have to drain ) | 1 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon capers | 2 ounces canned capers | 1/8 cup chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: To clean the peppers, cut off stems and seeds, and carefully scoop out the inner curved part of the peppers under water.  Use the blunt end of a knife to trim off the seeds.  You can chop the peppers using a food processor, if you prefer.  In a heavy skillet over medium heat, combine 2 cups water with the remaining ingredients, making sure the capers are well mixed with the liquid.  Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly and peppers are tender.  Place the chopped peppers in a dish and pour sauce over.

title: Fish Empanadas
ingredients: 300 g halibut ( canned is fine ) | 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour or 1 cup pastry flour | 1 1/2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Drain fish.  Mix together the flour, cumin and breadcrumbs until you have a mixture that is of a wet consistency.  Pour over fish, cover.  Heat a little olive or sunflower oil in a frying pan and fry the fish until golden brown on both sides.  Serve with a salad, tomato and chilli sauce.

title: Peel and Eat Tofu on Skewers
ingredients: 4 ounces firm tofu | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2 teaspoons finely chopped peaches
instructions: Soak 6 bamboo skewers in water for 10 minutes.  Soak tofu for 10 minutes and cut into 1 cubes, leaving fat in the tofu for those tasty skewers.

title: Pumpkin Tartlets
ingredients: 1 can white beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can pumpkin puree | 1 1/2 pints tart apples, peeled and diced | 1 teaspoon hing
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Stir beans, pumpkin, apples, and hing together in a bowl.  Bake tartlets in the preheated oven until apples are tender and filling has been absorbed, 25 to 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,self rising flour,active yeast,beef,corn oil,scallion,balsamic vinegar
title: Alton Brown's Mini Chipotle Shreds
ingredients: 3 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 1/2 cups scallions, finely chopped ( white and light green parts ) | 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons corn oil | 1 1/2 cups cooked corned beef, shredded ( i used the bulk cooked deli meat ) | 4 tablespoons chipotle chiles ( from can in adobo sauce and el pato )
instructions: Dissolve the yeast in 3/4 cup warm water for 5 minutes, then stir in the scallions and vinegar.  Combine the flour with oil and salt in a large mixing bowl with a pinch of salt and a few grinds of black pepper.  Stir in the flour mixture.  Stir in the meat, and knead well until smooth.  Place in the refrigerator, uncovered, and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Divide dough into 2 equal pieces and roll out between two sheets of waxed paper into thin, 8 inch circles.  Place on a lightly greased and floured baking sheet.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper, and cover with another sheet of waxed paper.  Lightly oil a mini muffin pan.  Cover with plastic wrap and set aside.  Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place half of the chilies in hot, dry skillet over medium high heat.  Turning once, until blackened all over and their flesh is no longer red.  Place chilies in a small bowl and cover with boiling water.  Let cool for a minute or two, then drain on paper towels.  Repeat with the remaining chilies.  Arrange half of the chilies in the mini cup or a tea towel.  Bake in preheated oven until beginning to brown, about 12 minutes.  Transfer to a platter and cover with plastic wrap to keep warm while you bake the rest of the dough.  Return skillet to medium heat and cook the remaining chilies.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper and spread them over the chilies.  Serve with chipotle.

Random Ingredients: chili oil,coriander seed,brandy,leg lamb,green enchilada sauce,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Easy Crock Pot Lamb Carnitas
ingredients:
1 leg of lamb ( can use other cuts of meat such as leg of lamb, shoulder etc.
    - ) | 3 tablespoons coriander seeds, crushed | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3 tablespoons brandy ( i use rum ) | 2 cans green enchilada sauce ( i use rotel ) | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 tablespoon chili oil
instructions: Slice meat across grain into long slivers.  Place meat in 3 1/2 to 6 quart slow cooker.  Sprinkle on coriander and set aside.  Blend all other ingredients together in a small bowl using your fingertips until everything is evenly mixed.  Pour over the meat.  Cover and cook on low for 7 - 9 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Baked Yellow Beans
ingredients: 4 cans yellow beans, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup diced yellow pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Grease a 2 quart casserole dish.  Mix together the yellow beans and yellow pepper in a bowl.  Stir in the vegetables.  Spread mixture evenly into the prepared casserole dish.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.

title: Chinese Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla-flavored soymilk ( or vanilla-sweetened soymilk which has been strained ) or 2 cups almond milk ( or vanilla-sweetened soymilk which has been strained ) | 1 tablespoon grated fresh gingerroot
instructions: Mix the soymilk, grated gingerroot, and vanilla soy milk together in a bowl until the mixture forms smooth, fluffy, and slightly thickened.  Transfer to a metal baking pan in medium sized pieces and freeze until firm, at least 10 minutes.

title: Easy Shrimp
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1 jar spaghetti sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Arrange shrimp in the bottom of an ungreased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Pour spaghetti sauce over shrimp.  Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes.  Remove foil and sprinkle shrimp with remaining sauce.  Bake and additional 15 minutes to blend flavors.

title: Creamed Currants
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 3/4 cup currants, whole or chopped
instructions: Heat the cream in a medium saucepan until it just begins to simmer.  Reduce heat to low or medium low and add the currants.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,biscuit,mccormick grill seasoning,salt black pepper
title: Nonna's "chili Fry Pizza Strips"
ingredients: 3 slices biscuit, plain | 3 teaspoons mccormick grill seasoning | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper, chili, crushed | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking tray with foil or parchment paper.  Cut each biscuit slice into 3 thin triangles.  Arrange triangles on the baking tray.  Stir the grill seasoning and crushed chili pepper together.  Sprinkle over the biscuit base.  Bake in the preheated oven for 5 to 7 minutes, or until golden.  Allow to cool.  Serve with salsa.

title: Penne with Chicken and Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, cored and quartered | 2 cups chicken stock | 1 pound dry penne
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the penne, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Stir chicken stock into the pasta in the pot.  Bring to a simmer over medium heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and the sauce has thickened, 2 to 5 minutes.

title: Classic Ladyfingers
ingredients: 24 ladyfingers | 1/2 cup queso fresco, crumbled
instructions: Spread 1/4 cup queso fresco on each ladyfinger.  Arrange on a cookie sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.  Sprinkle with queso fresco.  Bake in 350 degree f oven until puffed and golden.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck,grain white rice,green bell pepper,yellow onion
title: Baked Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 pound boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 2 cups uncooked long grain white rice | 1 yellow onion, chopped | 1 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread beef cubes in a 9x16 inch baking dish, and arrange yellow onion and green bell pepper in a tight layer.  Place the baking dish in the oven, and bake beef and vegetable mixture, with a lid, on the middle rack of the oven, for 1 hour.  Remove lid, and sprinkle rice over the roast.

Random Ingredients: pico de gallo,pandan leaf,sun tomato,serrano chili,apple juice,ranch dressing mix,chinese five spice powder,sea salt
title: Crock Pot Mexican Chicken
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken | 3 tablespoons pico de gallo | 4 ounces of undrained sun-dried tomatoes | 1 1/2 ounces dried ranch dressing mix | 1/4 cup apple juice ( or apple cider ) | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 1 serrano chili, minced | 1 pinch sea salt
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot.  Sprinkle seasonings over chicken.  Pour pico de gallo, sundried tomatoes and ranch dressing mix evenly over the chicken.  Cover with apple juice or cider, or apple cider.  Cook on low 8 hours depending on size of pieces of chicken.  Remove cover and cook 10 minutes longer or until tender.

title: Lentils With Chantilly Pesto
ingredients: 1/2 cup lentils, coarsely chopped | 3/4 cup yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/4 inch strips | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1/2 cup light coconut milk, well stirred
instructions: Combine lentils and bell peppers in a saucepan and add enough water to cover.  Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer for about 25 minutes or until lentils are tender.  Drain.  Add pesto and coconut milk and simmer uncovered for about 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened.  Serve.

title: Rosemary and Cumin Puree
ingredients: 3 tablespoons roasted and ground almonds or 3 tablespoons cumin seeds | 1 1/2 cups vanilla instant pudding mix | 1 tablespoon rosemary leaves
instructions: Spread nuts on a baking sheet and toast in a 450°f oven for 5 - 7 minutes or until lightly browned.  Whisk together instant pudding mix and rosemary.  Quickly add in sugar and nutmeg.  Serve immediately.

title: Irish Kale Shakes
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, stemmed and stemmed ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/4 cup ketchup | 2 teaspoons irish whiskey or 2 teaspoons rye whiskey | 8 kaffir lime leaves, plus 1 large green
instructions: Blanch kale for 1 minute in boiling water then plunge into ice cold water to stop cooking.  When cool, remove leaves from stalks and set aside.  In a small bowl, stir together ketchup and whiskey.  To assemble, lay kale on a plate and spoon half of the ketchup mixture on kale.  Top with 1 kaffir lime leaf and roll with lime to loosely wrap around kale.  Repeat with remaining kale.  Serve with pumpernickel bread.

title: Beer Chips With Lime Chips (Ensalada De Beer Chip
ingredients: 4 flour tortillas or 4 corn tortillas | 1 1/4 cups beer | 1 cup bread flour | lime wedge
instructions: Heat your broiler.  Place bread flour in a large plastic bag, pour in beer.  Shake until beer is completely absorbed.  Make sure it's absorbed.  Place bread chips on a baking sheet, and dip them in flour until lightly greased.  Place chips on broiler pan or in foil lined broiler pan.  Broil until golden and crisp.  Allow bread to cool.  Eat immediately or put in paper bag until later.
