instructions: Spread baguette slices with toasted slivered almonds.  Top with toasted slivered almonds.  Sprinkle with lemon zest.  Place baguette slices on a baking sheet.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 5 minutes, or until lightly toasted.

Random Ingredients: thyme,kidney bean,black coffee,salami,crabmeat,blueberry pie filling,breadcrumb,beef stew meat
title: Hot Maryland Crab Cakes
ingredients: 3 cups crumbs | 1 pound cubed beef stew meat | 1 package imitation crabmeat, flaked | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dried thyme | 1/4 cup strong black coffee | 3 cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can blueberry pie filling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix together the crust crumbs and hamburger.  Stir in crabmeat, bread crumbs, thyme and black coffee.  Shape into small patties.  Place the patties on to a lightly greased baking sheet.  Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until heated through.  Spoon the kidney beans and pie filling into the heated beans.  Bake 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: heavy cream,beer,cornstarch,broth,coffee bean,green tomato,spinach leaf,grain mustard
title: Cantonese Blanco-Smoked Mustard and Coffee Beans
ingredients: 1 cup fresh spinach leaves | 4 green tomatoes, chopped | 4 tablespoons brewed coffee beans | 2 tablespoons whole grain mustard | 2 teaspoons light cornstarch | 1 1/4 cups broth | 1/3 cup heavy cream | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 6 tablespoons dark beer ( optional )
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Combine the spinach, tomatoes, coffee beans, and mustard in a large bowl.  Make a well in the center and pour in broth, cream and beer.  Stir in the whipped cream and transfer the bowl to a rimmed baking sheet.  Sprinkle with coarse salt.  Broil the blanco and grill until the blanco is bubbly and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

title: Black Bean Pizza(Savory or Not!)
ingredients: 1 prepared pizza crust ( i use boboli ) | 1 can black beans | 1 teaspoon dry mustard | 1 -12 cooked shrimp
instructions: Drain black beans, rinse with cold water and spread them on the pizza crust.  Spread mustard on the black beans, add sliced shrimp.  Top with remaining two cans of black beans, spread them on top of crusts and bake at 375°f for 15 and then let me know how it turns out.

title: Cheap & Easy Risotto Rolls
ingredients:
2 cans refrigerated crescent rolls | 0.
    -5 can cotto beans or ( 16 ounce ) can kidney beans, and liquid | 1 bunch green onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon minced garlic clove | 1 teaspoon chopped sage | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 cup long-grain rice, rinsed & drained | 1 cup coffee ( strongly brewed ) | 2 tablespoons tortillas, softened
instructions: Unroll one of the cans of crescent rolls into a separate rectangle shape.  Separate the crescent roll dough into two rectangles and separate again on a baking sheet.  Combine the cotto beans liquid, garlic, sage, tomato paste and rice in a medium saucepan.  Bring to a boil, stirring often.  Reduce heat and simmer until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.  Meanwhile, place a piece of cheddar cheese on the bottom of each crescent roll rectangle.  Add approx 1/2 1/2 cup of hot rice to a small pan or skillet.  Stir frequently with a fork.  As the bottom of the filling is getting crispy, quickly add about a cup of the rice mixture to the hot pan.  Once rice is thoroughly hot and the rice is hot, spread the rice mixture onto the cheese.  Top rice mixture with more rice, and allow cheese to melt, before rolling each crescent roll.  Repeat with remaining crescent rolls.  Slice the rolls in half and serve.

Random Ingredients: kidney bean,peanut,pork roast,garlic,white creme de cacao,garlic powder
title: Texas Carnitas
ingredients: 2 pounds lean pork roast | 3 tablespoons white creme de cacao | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 2 cans kidney beans, rinsed and drained | 2 cloves garlic powder | 2 cups chopped fresh unsalted peanuts | 1/2 cup crushed peanuts
instructions: Place the pork roast in a large pot and cover with water.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium low and simmer until meat is no longer pink in center and very tender, about 3 hours.  Drain and shred the pork into thin strips.  Stir the creme de cacao, 2 cloves minced garlic, beans, 2 minced garlic powder, peanuts, and crushed peanuts into the roast and marinate for at least two hours.  Serve as directed.

title: Cherry Braised Beef (Crockpot)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs stewing beef, cut into cubes | 1 bottle prague-flavored stewing beef bones, such as guineabaisse | 2 quarts cherry or 2 quarts any red oak, and oak pickles, in their husks, washed and patted dry | 1/2 cup dry quinoa, rinsed well
instructions: Place the meat, bones, prague spice, and enough water to cover the meat in the crockpot.  Cook on high for 4 to 5 hours, until the meat is tender and the bones can be easily pierced with a knife using the tines of a fork or kitchen shears.  Stir in the rinsed and patted dry quinoa.  Cover and cook on low for at least 2 hours or on high for up to 2 hours, adding additional water as desired.  Stir before serving.

title: Four Cheese With Juniper Berries
ingredients: 3 ounces comte cheese, grated
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Combine cheese and juniper berries in a bowl with a teaspoon or a tiny amount of water.

title: Italian Dukkah
ingredients: 2 cups toasted pecans | 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 1 cup toasted pistachio nut
instructions: In a dry skillet, toast the pecans over moderate heat, shaking the skillet occasionally, until fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Stir in the red pepper and fennel seeds and cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.  Set aside and let cool.  Pulse the pistachios in a food processor or mortar and pestle until coarsely ground.  Add toasted pecans and process briefly.  Stuff the dukkah with pistachios.

title: Brazilian Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 pounds pork shoulder | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Place pork shoulder in a container with a lid, and pour enough vodka over pork to cover.  Cover, and refrigerate for 3 days, turning occasionally.  Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat.  Place pork on skewers that have soaked in water for 30 minutes.  Cook pork on the heated grill, and move pork around.  Cook, turning occasionally, for about 5 hours.  Baste with reserved vodka after 3 hours of grilling.  An instant reading thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees f.

title: Sweet Pretzels
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups packed golden raisins | 1 1/2 cups puffed bread dough ( plain or gluten free ) | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 8 bamboo skewers
instructions: Heat oven to 425 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or with foil.  Place the raisins, puffed bread dough and baking powder in a large bowl of a stand mixer.  Cover with a towel and let sit for 5 minutes.  Using your hands, mix the dough to coat the raisins in the mixture.  Using a pastry brush, coat the bread dough with the puffy dough.  Using one hand, carefully remove the dough from the bowl of dough.  Using your hands, stretch the dough in circular motions until the dough is fully stretched.  Place the dough onto the parchment paper covered baking sheet.  Using a sharp knife, cut crosswise into 1/4 inch wide wedges.  Repeat with the remaining dough.  Bake at 425 degrees for 18 - 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: pine nut,shiitake mushroom,sandwich bun,wide egg noodle
title: Mushroom and Noodle Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 package dry wide egg noodles, cooked and drained | 1 can sliced shiitake mushrooms, drained | 8 slices sandwich buns | 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot.  Saute mushrooms until tender, about 5 minutes.  Place one slice of bread on each of four toasted sandwiches.  Spoon one fourth of noodles over bread, then top with a half slice mushroom and another slice.

title: Kale & Pineapple Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 cup low-fat pineapple juice | 2/3 cup fresh peas | 2 tablespoons sweetened cherries or 2 tablespoons chopped green cherries | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder or 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 small baking potato, cut lengthwise in 8 slices | 4 low-fat flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Combine pineapple juice, peas, cherries, and baking powder or salt in a saucepan over medium heat.  Bring to a boil.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach,banana,season salt,sherry wine,apricot,chili flake,black bean,egg
title: Seared White Beans With Spinach and Bananas
ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces dried black beans, soaked according to package directions | 1 egg, beaten | 1/2 teaspoon chili flakes ( or to taste ) | 1 pinch seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons sherry wine | 3 tablespoons prepared tapioca-stuffed pickapeppa ( or other sweet white bean paste ) | 3 cups baby spinach | 1 small banana, sliced
instructions: Cook black beans until they are just tender, but still firm.  Drain the beans and allow them to cool down a bit.  When the beans are warm, put them in a big bowl, add the egg, chili flakes, salt, sherry, chopped pickapeppa or other small sweet white bean paste, and stir gently to mix.  Put the washed spinach in a skillet, add just enough water to cover the leaf, and simmer over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the spinach is soft and creamy.  Put the spinach mixture in the serving bowl and top with the banana slices.

Random Ingredients: guajillo chilies,vanilla sugar,pepper flake,marsala wine,chili pepper flake
title: Chili Powder Paste
ingredients: 4 dried guajillo chilies, seeded and sliced in rounds ( such as anaheim, california and serrano chilies ) | 5 teaspoons chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon hot pepper flakes | 2 teaspoons raw paprika or 2 teaspoons pure vanilla sugar | chili powder ( optional )
instructions: Combine the sliced chili with all other ingredients in a small skillet and stir over medium heat for about 5 minutes.

title: Farmer Cheese Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless chicken | 1/3 lb farmer cheese | 1/4 cup wheat germ | pork rib roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove fat from boneless chicken and add the chicken to the freezer for 15 - 20 minutes.  Slice into bite size pieces then toss with the farmer's cheese, wheat germ, and a bit of water.  Place on a roasting rack and bake for 1 hour.  Turn oven off and let sit for 20 minutes.  Serve with your favorite vegetable and crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: hickory barbecue sauce,lamb shank,red wine vinegar,pistachio nut,plain yogurt,bacon,baguette
title: Slow Cooked Lamb Shank With Peppered Yoghurt Dip
ingredients: 4 lamb shanks | 4 slices bacon | 2 tablespoons hickory flavored barbecue sauce | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar | 1/2 cup grated fresh pistachio nut | 3/4 cup pistachio nut sandwich roll
instructions: Place lamb shanks in slow cooker.  Place bacon and bbq sauce in a large, high sided skillet.  Cook over medium high heat until bacon is crisp, about 3 minutes.  Turn bacon pieces over and cook about 1 - 2 minutes more.  Combine yogurt, vinegar, and pistachios in bowl.  Spread yogurt mixture over lamb.  Cover and cook on high setting until lamb is cooked through, but not falling off the bone, 7 to 8 hours.  Transfer lamb to platter.  Spoon remaining yogurt mixture over lamb and sprinkle with pistachios.  Serve immediately after removing from slow cooker.

title: Green Chili Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 cup meat, any type | 1 cup queso fresco | 3 green chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup bourbon or 1/2 cup whiskey | 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in | 1/2 cup bourbon
instructions: Combine meat, half of the cheese, pepper, chilies, and cream or whiskey in a medium size pot.  Simmer over low heat until cheese is melted, about 20 minutes.  Do not boil.  Add dissolved bouillon.  Stir, cover and simmer another 5 - 10 minutes.  Serve warm with sour cream, shredded lettuce, shredded hot pepper and jalapeno slices.

title: Tomatillo Sour Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 package tomatillo, husked and finely diced | 2 tablespoons ghee, divided | 2 cans condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 2 teaspoons finely shredded lime zest | 1 teaspoon fish sauce
instructions: In medium bowl, combine tomatillos, 2 tablespoons ghee, and cream of chicken soup.  Stir to blend.  Stir in lime zest and fish sauce.  Cover and refrigerate, stirring occasionally, for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Devil Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup oil | 1 egg white | 3 slices of dried bread | 1 tablespoon shrimp paste | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 cups chicken stock ( can be made with chicken stock to make 2 1/2 cups ) | 1 container mixed vegetables, mixed thawed
instructions: Mix together the first ten ingredients, add shrimp paste and sherry to taste and blend well.  Make into ping pong sized balls, you can leave them in the refrigerator for half an hour, after the balls have chilled it can be to your own personal taste.  Fry over medium high heat, turning the balls, for a few seconds on each side.  Drain on paper, serve with rice.

title: Chipotle Wontons
ingredients: 1 package wonton skins | 1/4 cup poppy seeds | 1/2 cup ground chipotle pepper, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees f.  Spread poppy seeds onto wonton skins.  Stir chipotle pepper into poppy seeds.  On a baking sheet, place wonton skins, close together, and bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven.  Allow to cool 5 minutes before removing from baking sheet.

title: Easy Fish Tacos
ingredients: 2 fish, fresh | 3 slices cooked veal | 1/4 cup light whipping cream ( or half & half ) | 3 -4 drops taco seasoning | cornmeal | green chili pepper, chopped ( i use jalepeno ) | crouton
instructions: Remove any bones & obvious visible white from the fish.  Cut into chunks & soak in warm water for 20mins to make pliable. .  Cut a slit down the back of the fish to open mouth.  Open out fish.  Put a tablespoon of cream or half & half in the centre & add the taco seasoning.  Top with a few slices veal.  Serve with cornmeal or croutons for dipping.

Random Ingredients: goat cheese,canola oil,chicken breast half,broccoli floret,lasagna noodle,liquid smoke,tahini,amaretto liqueur
title: Easy Chicken Lasagne
ingredients: 1 container refrigerated lasagna noodles | 1 cup canola oil | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 1 cup tahini | 1 package crumbled goat cheese | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur | 4 cups fresh broccoli florets | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and stir in the lasagna noodles.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Heat the canola oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir the chicken in the hot oil until the chicken has browned and is no longer pink inside, about 10 minutes.  Stir the tahini into the chicken.  Place a few pieces of the chicken in a microwave safe dish and pour the 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur over the chicken.  Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high until fully melted, about 3 minutes.  Mix the broccoli into the chicken mixture and season with liquid smoke.  Spread half of the cooked noodles over the bottom of an 11x13 inch glass baking dish.  Top with half of the chicken mixture.  Spread half of the remaining noodles over that and spread with half of the goat cheese, and spread with the remaining chicken mixture.  Top with remaining noodles.  Top with remaining goat cheese, amaretto liqueur, and shredded pepper.  Cover with foil.  Bake in the preheated oven until bubbling and the top is browned, 45 minutes to 1 hour.

title: Cranberries or Pears With Apples (Dorie Greenspan)
ingredients: 3 lbs fresh cranberries or 3 lbs fresh pears, diced | 1 medium apple, diced
instructions: Soak cranberries in warm water until soft.  Drain and put through food processor or blender.  Add apple and puree well.

title: Kythoni
ingredients: 1 cup frozen green pea | 1 tablespoon fresh green cherries
instructions: Cook the peas in a pan of boiling water for 2 minutes, or until all the water is absorbed.  Drain.  Rinse with cold water, then transfer to a food processor and puree.  Return to the pan with the green cherries and cook for 1 minute, stirring to coat.  Serve hot.

title: Easy Beef and Parmesan
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 2 tablespoons minced coriander | 1/2 cup unsweetened parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon molasses
instructions: Combine the coriander and cheese.  Mix well.  Drain ground chuck.  Add the ground chuck.  Form into large balls 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Saute in olive oil or butter, over medium heat, stirring constantly with wooden spoon until browned.  Cover.  Remove from pan and keep warm.  Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Place meat balls on cookie sheets.

title: Grilled Pineapple
ingredients: 12 ounces pineapple | 1/4 cup soya sauce | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt | 1 strip orange zest ( i use yellow )
instructions: Cut pineapple lengthwise 1/16 thick.  Brush with soy sauce and sprinkle with celery salt.  Grill until tender.  Remove from heat and slice crosswise into slices.  I serve with a sweet & sour sauce.  A slice of pineapple works well.

title: Cheater's Biryani (Crazy Sweet Potato Rice Balls)
ingredients: 2 lbs large white potatoes, peeled, chopped and soaked in water overnight | 1/4 cup dried fenugreek seeds, crushed ( optional ) | 1 cup loosely packed fresh basil, picked from stems ( flat leaf ) | 1/2 cup green olives, drained and coarsely chopped ( optional ) | 1/4 cup shallot, minced ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups uncooked basmati rice, soaked in hot water and drained
instructions: Combine the potatoes, fenugreek, basil, olives, shallot, and cooked rice in a food processor or grinder and process until it is finely chopped but not grainy.

Random Ingredients: rice vinegar,italian salad dressing mix,parmigiano reggiano cheese,basmati rice,beer,bourbon
title: Bourbon Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup uncooked basmati rice, rinsed and drained | 1 can beer | 1/2 envelope dry italian salad dressing mix | 1/2 cup bourbon | 2/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/3 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In large skillet, combine uncooked rice, beer, salad dressing mix, bourbon, and rice vinegar.  Bring to boil.

Random Ingredients: grape,fennel seed,quinoa,seasoning salt,yellow bell pepper,shiitake mushroom,cooking oat
title: Quinoa and Mushrooms (Kounoupithi Yahini) - Sumac Za'atar
ingredients: 250 g quinoa | 4 dried shiitake mushrooms | 400 g yellow bell peppers | cooking oat, to coat | 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 4 tablespoons seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt, according to taste
instructions: Wash and dry quinoa thoroughly.  Place in a rice cooker and press cook.  When the quinoa is ready, place the mushrooms and pepper in a large bowl and set aside.  Remove the quinoa from the cooker and rinse it well.  Place all vegetables in a separate pot and cover with water.  Bring to boil and simmer for 15 - 18 minutes or until veggies are slightly tender.  Dressing, combine oat, fennel, seasoning salt and seasoned salt and mix well.  Adjust seasoning.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Chipotle's Breaded Crumbs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup chopped shallot | 1/4 cup raisins | 1 tablespoon chopped dried ancho chile | 2 teaspoons taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh basil leaves | 2 tablespoons melted ghee or 2 tablespoons fat
instructions: Stir first 5 ingredients in a small bowl.  Add in chili, taco seasoning, basil and 1 t.  Butter.

Random Ingredients: saffron,guacamole,lasagna,lipton onion soup mix,salt,tomato sauce,beer,adobo seasoning
title: Niki's Beer Lasagna
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh lasagna sheets | 12 ounces tomato sauce | 4 ounces adobo seasoning | 2 ounces saffron | 1 ounce salt ( optional ) | 1 1/2 ounces yeast and 2 packets lipton onion soup mix | 1 can beer | 1 packet guacamole
instructions: Wash lasagna sheets and roll over at least once.  Place them a few at a time in a colander, salt, mix, remove.  Place in large bowl and cover with wet towels or towels to rise slightly.  Leave for at least an hour.  After the first few, place a towel on towels and dry them off.  After that, remove the stringy ends and wash off again, remove.  Mix the tomato sauce with garlic, saffron, adobo salt, onion soup mix and beer until everything is mixed together.  Dip each piece of lasagna every 2 minutes or so on each side with some of the tomato and onion mixture.  Put a portion of the sauce into the bottom of a 9x13 pan.  Put a thin layer of sauce over the sauce.  Sprinkle half the lasagna over the sauce.  Then put another layer of sauce, another layer of sauce and another layer of sauce.  Then put another layer of lasagna, sauce and the whole rest of sauce.  Top with the guacmanole and bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and let set for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Italian Sausages With Cashews, Italian Nuts and Cashews
ingredients: 1 lb italian sausage | 20 cashew nuts ( salted peanuts, if possible )
instructions: Cut sausage into 1/2 inch pieces.  Place in frying pan and cook slowly until lightly browned, remove from pan and set aside.  Stir nuts into sausage and cook until browned, remove from pan and set aside.  Fry cashew nuts until golden and crisp on bottom, remove and set aside.  Cook all sausage and nuts over very low heat stirring constantly, until nuts are crunchy and sausage is heated through.

Random Ingredients: cumin,spinach,extra sharp cheddar cheese,liquid smoke,sage leaf,ice,quinoa,fontina cheese
title: Quinoa Pizza With Chipped Spinach & Artichokes
ingredients:
1 can spinach, drained | 1/16 - 1/4 teaspoon dried sage leaves, crushed | 1/4 - 1/2 cup quinoa, cooked | 1 - 1 1/2 cup shredded extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 1 tablespoon extra-sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons reduced-sodium liquid smoke | 1/8 teaspoon cumin, ground | 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano leaves, crushed ( mexican, if available ) | 2 cups ice | 1/8 teaspoon cumin, crushed ( italian or creole ) | 3 -6 tablespoons fontina cheese, shredded and divided ( or mozzarella cheese, etc.
    - )
instructions: Set oven to broiler setting.  Prepare pizza stone according to manufacturer’s directions.  Combine all ingredients in a bowl with a fork.  Spoon mixture into baking stone and sprinkle on 1/8 teaspoon of dried oregano.  Set pizza stone in the bottom rack of the oven.  Place pizza directly on the rack and broil for 3 - 5 minutes, until crust is lightly browned.  Let cool 5 minutes, then cut into 6 - 8 wedges.  Serve pizza hot with remaining salsa, sour cream, and a dollop of cheese on top.  Enjoy.

title: Egg Noodles Hungarian Style
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 2 -3 cups egg noodles
instructions: Take out most of the fat, and cut it into cubes or bite size pieces.  Mix well into large mixing bowl.  Place beef pieces into meat, and toss in egg noodles or other pasta.  Cover, and refrigerate over night.

Random Ingredients: vegetable protein,date,romaine lettuce leaf,sprite,clam,baking chocolate square,fennel seed
title: Crazy Un-Grammy Fajita Loaf
ingredients: 1 package dried clams, cleaned | 10 dates, pitted | 1 teaspoon fennel seed, crushed | 2 large baking chocolate squares | 1 package veggie protein | 12 romaine lettuce leaves, washed | 1/2 cup sprite | 4 romano-free flavored dried espresso beans ( optional ) or 4 espresso beans, warmed ( optional )
instructions: In a dutch oven on medium heat, place the clams and dates in the pan.  Sprinkle the fennel seeds over the surface of the clams/dates.  Place the chocolate in a microwave safe bowl.  Add enough water to cover chocolate.  Heat chocolate, choc and liquid until chocolate is melted and chocolate is dissolved.  Spread chocolate mixture on top of the clams or dates.  Sprinkle the romaine leaves over the top.  Pour hot espresso/espresso/spice mixture into the dutch oven.  Lightly toast beans in microwave or fry pan.  Use a knife or spatula to flip the clams/dates in the pan.  It will be nice and hard to cut through.  The more you turn them, the more tender you will be.  When the bread is done, open up the bread and check the texture with a toothpick or the length of the loaf depends on how many clams you open.  If bread does not open halfway, you are going to have mushy bread left.  If bread is about 4 - 5 inches from the rim of the pan, you should be able to cut all the way through it.  The longer it is open, the better it is.  If bread is still hard, it should be loose and dry.  Cool for about 10 minutes.  Carefully remove bread with a slotted spoon and place to a large plate.  Cut into wedges or wedges.  Serve with the jelly beans and the coffee.

title: Ersatz Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 lb farfalle pasta, cooked as directed on package | 1 lb tomatoes with juice, chopped | 3 ounces prosciutto, thinly sliced | 1/2 lb baby carrots | 1/3 lb white mushroom, sliced | 3 tablespoons raisins | 1/2 tablespoon cinnamon | 1 tablespoon cilantro, minced
instructions: Toss farfalle with tomato juice, raisins, cinnamon, and cilantro.  Let stand 15 min while you cook proscuitto.

Random Ingredients: cinnamon,plum tomato,red bean,chicken bouillon cube,gingerroot,red bell pepper
title: Red Beans Habasadas
ingredients: 1 lb dried red beans, soaked overnight | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, dissolved in | 1/2 cup boiling water | 1/2 cup fresh crystallized gingerroot, chopped | 1 small red bell pepper, chopped | 1 tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Rinse beans and place in a large saucepan.  Add 1 cup water and bouillon cubes and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer about 1 hour or until beans are very tender.  Add ginger and bell pepper and simmer about 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, puree the tomato in a food processor.  When beans are tender, transfer to a blender with puree and puree until smooth.  Heat through and serve warm.

title: Cambodian Noodles
ingredients: 2 skinless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup vodka | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 bag fresh fettuccine | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Place the chuck, vodka, and turmeric into a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 to 15 minutes, until meat is nicely browned.  Place fettuccine into a large pot of lightly salted boiling water, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger | 4 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 -2 teaspoon ajwain or 1 -2 teaspoon other allspice
instructions: Mix the all ingredients well.  If you're like me and are using a mortar and pestle, use a slotted spoon and use a slotted spatula to make it into a hamburger patty shape.  Spread the patty on the heated griddle pan.  Cook until the allspice starts to stick to the bottom of the patty.  Be careful not to burn the patty spread the heated golden syrup on a finger of the pattie as this will stop it from sticking to the pan during the cooking process.

title: French Beans
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces kidney beans or 4 1/2 ounces great northern beans | 10 3/4 ounces canned water chestnuts, drained | 3 ounces light sprinkle seasoning salt ( can use regular salt ) | 2 1/2 ounces fresh tarragon, leaves only or 2 1/2 ounces dried tarragon | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper
instructions: In large saucepan, combine beans, water chestnuts, tarragon, white pepper, and seasoning salt.  Heat to boiling.

title: Lacquered Sea Bass and Fresh Grapefruit Salad With Sweet Smoked Ragu
ingredients: 1/2 fresh grapefruit | 3 tablespoons sweet smoked linguiced tea | 24 slices of fresh smoked fish on the back of the fish ( sea bass, cod, catfish, or salmon ) | 20 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | additional sweet safflower top flavor infused with sweet sesame seeds
instructions: Remove the juice from the grapefruit by placing a peel and a stem in each grapefruit.

Random Ingredients: white balsamic vinegar,accent seasoning,brown rice,green chili pepper
title: Brazilian Sweet Onion & Green Chilli Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 medium sized green chili pepper ( about 1 1/2 inches long ) | 1 1/2 cups white balsamic vinegar, good quality | 1 1/2 teaspoons accent seasoning ( mccormick montreal brand ) | 2 cups cooked brown rice
instructions: Slice the chile, removing the seeds from the central vein.  Scrape out the seeds.  Remove the white pith at either side.  Heat the vinegar on medium heat.  Once the vinegar reaches a boil, add the accent and cook for 30 seconds.  Immediately add the rice and salt and toss, combining well.  Pour into a bowl, cover and chill until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: pesto sauce,fast rising yeast,golden raisin,mix,fish sauce,pumpkin pie spice,ghee,spring onion
title: Sweet and Tangy Pesto Panini
ingredients:
500 g fast rising yeast | 250 g hot fish sauce | 140 g ghee ( or ghee oil ) | 2 cups spring onions, sliced into thin strips | 100 g golden raisins | 1 1/2 cups thick and creamy pesto sauce ( available at asian specialty stores.
    - ) | 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice | 1/2 cup thick and creamy pesto sauce
instructions: Place yeast in warm water and leave for 10 minutes until frothy.  Pour 1/2 cup warm water into a large bowl, add hot fish sauce.  Add ghee or oil and stir to dissolve.  Stir in the spring onion strips, raisins, pesto and remaining warm water till smooth.  Add the yeast and mix well.  Turn the dough off the mixer.  Using the dough hook mix in the hot liquids and mix for 5 minutes.  Put dough in an oiled bowl, cover and let rise till doubled or until dough doubled in size. .  On a floured board, knead dough gently.  Place dough on an oiled baking tray and knead lightly till smooth.  Shape into a round loaf.  Place the dough in an oiled baking tray and sprinkle some pumpkin pie spice on top.  Bake at 400° for 40 - 45 minutes or till brown.

Random Ingredients: red potato,kosher salt,cumin powder,lime wedge,pistachio,active yeast,black pepper
title: Mexican Potatoes (Potatoes) and Poached Cactus Wedges
ingredients: 3 cups red potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4 ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 cups kosher salt, divided | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios or 1/4 cup pine nuts | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 2 tablespoons lime wedges, for garnish | ground black pepper
instructions: Place potatoes and 1 teaspoon salt in a 5 to 6 quart pot.  Cover and set aside at room temperature overnight.  Drain potatoes well and transfer to a large bowl. Random Ingredients: cinnamon,italian herb,bell pepper,rye bread,raspberry jam,orange bell pepper
title: Grilled Bell Pepper & Raspberry Salsa
ingredients: 3 bell peppers, cut into thin strips ( red, green or yellow ) | 3 oranges, peeled, cut in half lengthwise & hollowed out ( large ) | 2 raspberries in light syrup or, 1/2 cup raspberry jam | 1/4 cup mixed italian herbs, chopped | 1/4 cup candied bell pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon ( optional )
instructions: Toss bell pepper strips with raspberries, jam, herbs & spices in a bowl.  Let sit 5 minutes to blend flavors, to allow flavors to develop.  Grill or broil peppers until charred all over, about 7 - 10 minutes.

title: Shrimp Cocktail
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, shells removed | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar | 1 jar pimientos, drained ( green or red )
instructions: Rinse shrimp and peel.  Drop shrimp into boiling water, and cook for one minute.  Immediately drain shrimp and set aside in a bowl of ice water.

Random Ingredients: five spice powder,penne,string bean,brown sugar,mozzarella cheese,white sugar,cajun seasoning,barley
title: Cajun Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package dry penne | 1 bunch string beans | 1 bunch small fresh string bean | 1 cup light brown sugar | 1/2 cup white sugar | 3 tablespoons cajun seasoning | 3 tablespoons five-spice powder | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.

title: Cornmeal Crackers
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach, rinsed and crisped | 1/2 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  Lightly butter a large baking sheet or line with aluminum foil.  Combine the spinach, cornmeal, and a touch of water in a bowl.  Place baking sheet in the oven during the oven's preheat for about 1 hour, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a bowl easily comes out clean.  Remove from oven and cool.  Using a fork or a fork, toss the crumbs until the cornmeal becomes the texture of coarse meal.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Chinese Dumplings
ingredients: 20 -24 wonton wrappers | 4 -5 cups cabbage ( shredded ) | 1 large chinese mushroom ( sliced thin ) | cabbage | chinese mushroom
instructions: Mix all ingredients except the cabbage in a large bowl.  Place about 1 cup of filling in center of wrapper.  Moisten edges with cold water and seal edges with a fork.  Place in a pot of boiling water.  When they float, take them out and place in a colander and press well so they do not stick too much in the pot.  Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.  Put a little cabbage on top of each dumpling.  Wipe excess water off the cabbage and put a little of the cabbage on top of the dumpling.  You can add a little more cabbage on top if you like, but i prefer to use about half the cabbage.  This recipe makes a lot and is usually only served with cabbage on top of the dumplings.  The cabbage can also be left out for flavor.

title: Noodles With Chicken and Cabbage
ingredients: 1/4 cup corn oil | 3 chicken legs, skinned, and skinned ( can sub breast meat ) | 1 large head cabbage, cut into 1/ 2-inch wedges | 12 ounces egg noodles, about 7 ounces | 1/2 - 3/4 cup farmer cheese, such as farmer cheese
instructions: To make noodles, bring large pot of water to boil and stir in 1 t.  Corn oil.  Add chicken and cook 4 minutes.  Using slotted spoon, transfer chicken to bowl.  Drain chicken, reserving oil, add a drizzle of oil back to pot and add 1 cup of pasta cooking water.  Cook over medium heat for several minutes until pasta is al dente.  Remove chicken from pot and set aside.  To make noodles, cook cabbage in large pot of salted boiling water until just tender, about 3 minutes.  Drain.  Return cabbage to pot.  Add noodles and chicken, toss to combine with cabbage.  Add in 1/2 c cheese and mix well.  If serving buffet style, stir often and serve with additional cheese and a drizzle of oil.

title: Red Currants Chips
ingredients: 4 cups red currants | 1/2 cup olive oil or 1/2 cup vegetable oil | 1/3 cup italian dressing ( can use miracle whip ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Place redcurrants, oil, dressing and nutmeg, in a medium sized bowl.  Toss to coat.  Cover and chill until ready to use.

title: Mango Jalousie on Phrikas
ingredients: one 14-ounce container plain yogurt | 1 -2 tablespoon chili paste | 1/2 cup natural bran | 1/2 cup plain dried mango | 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 - 1/3 cup natural bran | 1 dash fresh ground pepper | 1 -2 whole natural kosher salt or 1-2 pinches coarse salt
instructions: In a tall glass bowl, combine the yoghurt, chili paste, bran, mango, salt, and pepper.  Stir to blend.  Fill glasses 1/3 full, or more if your glass doesn't accommodate it.  Cap with plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time.  This can be served immediately, but it can be frozen in individual glass ziploc bags for up to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,basmati rice,tomato paste,dill,pork stew meat,sultana,pea
title: Tandoori Beef Cardamom Rice
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice ( or white naan ) | 1 lb pork stew meat, cut into 1-inch chunks ( can use more ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/2 cup sultana | 1/2 cup frozen peas | 1 tablespoon tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dried dill
instructions: Place rice in a bowl or strainer and rinse under cold water.  Drain.  Place pork in the bowl or strainer and squeeze out as much water as possible.  In a small bowl, stir together the rice and ingredients for spice paste.  In a nonstick skillet, coated with oil spray, place rice and pork and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently until evenly browned.  Remove from heat and cover for 3 - 4 hours, until rice is fully cooked and all liquid absorbed.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Thai Dipping Sauce for Beef Steak (Thai Shaking Beef)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cold water | 1 1/2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil
instructions: Whisk ingredients in a small bowl.  Pour into a shallow dish.  Let sit at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate several hours to blend flavors.  Note, this recipe can be prepared ahead and refrigerated for upto 1 day.  Heat coals or a grill to medium high.  Brush steaks lightly with oil when ready to cook.  Grill steaks to desired doneness, 2 - 2 minutes per side, depending on your preference in thickness.  Slice beef, serve hot with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: asiago cheese,broccoli floret,salsa,parmigiano reggiano cheese,cider vinegar,orange juice concentrate
title: Quick and Easy Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 package frozen broccoli florets | 2 cups prepared salsa | 1/4 cup orange juice concentrate, undiluted | 1/2 cup cider vinegar | 1/4 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese | 1/3 cup grated asiago cheese
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions.  Combine salsa and orange juice concentrate in a medium bowl.  Add vinaigrette and stir well.  Pour over vegetables.

title: Italian Rice Noodle Salad
ingredients: 6 ounces rice noodles | 1 cup cooked roast | genoa salami, chopped | guacamole | roasted garlic sprouts | lettuce, chopped | watercress, chopped | roasted garlic, grated
instructions: In a pot of boiling water, cook the noodles until al dente, rinse under cold water and drain.  Add the noodles, roast, salami, guacamole and aioli.  Dress with lettuce and watercress before serving.

title: Shrimp Gyros
ingredients: 2 cups greek yogurt | 2 tablespoons sherry, plus | 1 tablespoon sherry | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon rice vinegar | 2 lbs shrimp, cooked, shelled, deveined, and cut lengthwise in half ( raw )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except shrimp in a saucepan.  Cook over medium heat until mixture is hot and bubbly.  Serve the shrimp and mixture over rice.

title: Sue's Rouladen
ingredients: 2 -3 lbs flank steaks | 1/2 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 2 tablespoons cocoa, to be dusted | 1/2 - 3/4 cup pistachios, chopped | 1 tablespoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon saffron, crushed | 6 -8 pieces alpine foil, per diner ( or other similar type of deep frying fat ) | aluminum foil, if necessary | 3 -4 links polish sausage
instructions: Mix together the cocoa, pistachios, sugar, grand marnier and saffron.  Set aside.  Cut flank steak into approximately 30 slices, about 3/4 thick.  In a large skillet, brown meat in pan with all the sugar and oil.  As meat is browned, remove from pan and set aside.  Add 1/2 cup water to pan and add saffron mixture.  As soon as water comes to boil, add in the sliced flank steak.  When the meat has come to a boil again, drain off.  Pour into fondue pot and re heat.  Serve with your favorite side dishes or rice.  Serve with warm polish or peasant bread.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,wonton skin,oyster sauce,golden raisin,self raising flour,crouton,dark chocolate
title: Won Ton Wrapped Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 dozen round wonton skins, left over from cooked oysters | 1/2 lb plain dark chocolate, chopped | 2 cups white button mushrooms, sliced | 2 cups self raising flour | 1/2 cup golden raisin ( golden raisins ) | 1/3 cup oyster sauce | 30 g dark chocolate
instructions: Warm oven to 220c/gas line a baking tray with baking paper.  Take 4 wonton skins from the oysters and place on the baking tray, make a circle with each.  Place 2 tbsp of the chopped chocolate in the centre of each and place 3 mushroom on top and 2 tbsp of the raisins and put 2 tbsp of the chopped dark chocolate in to each.  Repeat with the remaining wonton skins and mushrooms.  Using your hands, roll the dough into a log.  Wrap in the prepared baking paper and put back in the oven.  Turn on the broiler to high and set the baking tray aside.  Place the remaining 2 tbsp of chopped dark chocolate in to a small saucepan and warm it by pouring enough water into the saucepan without stirring.  Sprinkle over the rolled out dough and leave to stand for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, roll out the remaining dough into a large rectangle and then cut into 15 slices.  Pile a sixth slice of dough on the center of each to make a sandwich of the mushrooms and raisins and fill the rest with the filling.  Wrap each sandwich in the foil and leave for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat the oven to 220c/gas melt the 30 grams of dark chocolate in a bowl over a pan of simmering water.  Remove the wrap from the oven.  Put on a cutting board, with a shallow hole in the centre and with hands, roll the wrap from the back of the hand into an oval shape with a hole in the centre and roll the wrap in the chocolate.  Repeat until all the wraps have been rolled up.  To decorate, place a wonton wrapper in the centre of a piece of foil to make a hole in the centre and fill it with a little chocolate mixture.  Top with a final wonton wrapper and pinch the edges together ensuring that the filling is hidden from each side.  Place the on top of the baking tray seam side down and brush with the egg wash.  Cook for 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,red chili,ginger,grape,tamari soy sauce,raspberry
title: Tasty Grape and Ginger Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup grape, washed | 1/2 cup ginger, shaved ( from a jar ) | 1 cup monterey jack cheese | 1 red chili, seeds removed | 1/2 cup tasmania grapes ( i just used blue blossom grapes ) | 1/2 cup tamari soy sauce
instructions: Wash, peel, and chop grapes into bite size pieces.  Peel and chop ginger into bite size pieces, chop julienne and shred monterrey jack cheese.  In a bowl combine the ingredients except the tomato and mix well.  Toss grapes with spices.  Serve cold on a plate with salad leaves and a side of rice.

Random Ingredients: turnip,palm sugar,madras curry powder,kaffir lime leaf,chili sauce
title: Sweet Potato, Turnip and  Chermoula Salad
ingredients: 5 medium turnips, washed, peeled and diced | 40 ml palm sugar or 40 ml brown sugar | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder | 10 kaffir lime leaves, washed, ends and outer leaves removed | sweet chili sauce, to serve ( i prefer vietnamese sweet chili sauce )
instructions: Preheat the grill.  Mix all ingredients, except kaffir lime leaves in a serving bowl and season well.  Allow to marinate 1 to 2 hours at room temperature or refrigerate up to 6 hours.  Brush the cut side of the lime leaves on a board and slice on a long, thin metal surface into slivers.  Grill the slices on grill marks, until charred on both sides.  Transfer to a heatproof plate.  Serve sprinkled with kaffir lime leaves.

title: Chili-Scalded Hominy Poached Eggs
ingredients: 6 fresh anaheim chilies, with seeds peeled | 8 ounces dried quick-cooking oats | 12 fluid ounces hominy ( drained well ) | 3 sheets frozen shortcrust pastry, thawed
instructions: Remove stems from chilies and discard.  Slice off tops of chilies.  Place chiles into a bowl and cover with boiling water over medium high until softened and released and released some of the juice, about 1 to 2 minutes.  Dry juice will run off, but not completely clear.  Drain chilies and chop coarsely.  Preheat oven to 400°f in a large skillet, place oats and enough water to come up to 3/4 inch.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat and cook, stirring constantly, until a light haze appears on top, about 2 minutes.  Add chilies.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover and cook, stirring often, until liquid bubbles again, about 15 minutes.  Drain juice and transfer liquid to a bowl.  Add drained chilies and juice and toss to combine.  Line an 8 inch square baking pan with pastry.  Break egg sheets into half.  Spoon in mixture and smooth surface.  Place on a baking sheet dusted with flour.  Bake, uncovered, until edges of pie are lightly browned, about 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: turnip,pico de gallo salsa,kosher salt,coriander powder,hard egg,peanut butter
title: Nuts and Eggs With Turnips & Salsa
ingredients: 2 lbs turnips ( peeled and coarsely chopped ) | 2 cups pico de gallo salsa ( homemade or jar ) | 3 tablespoons peanut butter | 1 tablespoon coriander powder | 1 teaspoon kosher salt | 3 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Cook turnips in boiling salted water until tender.  Drain and transfer to a bowl.  Grate turnips using a box grater or potato masher and return to the same large pot.  Add salsa, peanut butter, coriander and salt and beat together until well blended.  Add the eggs and toss well.  Serve immediately or cool.  Yields about two cups.

title: Pimentos Con Prune
ingredients: 15 pitted prunes | 1 cup salsa | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking tray with tin foil.  Spread the prunes out in a colander to drain excess moisture.  Place in a small bowl with salsa and parmesan cheese.  Mix together the cornstarch and the 1 tablespoon cold water.  Add the mixture slowly, mixing well.  Roll and spread prunes in cornstarch mixture, place on tray and bake 15 minutes, or until prunes are crispy and golden.

title: Easy Baked Rice!
ingredients: 1 cup white rice, cooked, cold | 1 cup custard powder | 2 tablespoons orange juice, fresh squeezed
instructions: Mix the rice and orange juice.  Mix in the custard powder.  Pour into a baking dish lined with greased paper.  Bake in a hot oven at 200 - 200 c for 30 minutes or until cooked and golden.

Random Ingredients: scotch bonnet pepper,red chilies,hot red pepper flake
title: Hot Peppered Chiles
ingredients: 6 -7 small hot red chilies | 4 medium dried red chilies | 2 teaspoons scotch bonnet peppers, seeds removed
instructions: Place the chilies on a dry non stick skillet or wok, making sure the edges are not more than 3/4 inch high, and wok rack is preferable to accommodate an extra 10 - 15 minutes to dry properly.  After a couple minutes, add one teaspoon of oil to the hot chilies.  As soon as the chilies begin to sizzle, add one teaspoon of oil, and turn the heat to high.  When all of the chilies are hot and starting to crackle, transfer them to a spice grinder, pulsing them into fine bits.  Set on a medium dry plate and sprinkle with the scotch bonnet peppers.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: asparagus spear,celery rib,onion salt,wild rice,maraschino cherry
title: Wild Rice Crust Pizza #RSC
ingredients: 1 package wild rice, prepared according to package directions | 1 celery rib, cut in small dice | 1 small onion, diced | 1 can asparagus spears, drained, rinsed and finely chopped | 4 maraschino cherries, fresh, halved
instructions: Prepare wild rice according to package directions.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl combine the rice, celery, onion, asparagus and cherries.  Spread the mixture evenly on a large pizza pan or baking sheet.  Bake in a preheated oven at 400 degrees f for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees f and continue baking for 30 minutes, until the center of the crust is golden brown.

title: Sausage Linguine

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook linguine at a boil until about halfway cooked, about 11 minutes.

title: Chops Stuffed With Lamb Chops

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Lightly season the chops with salt and pepper if desired.  Place them on a plate, and spoon hazelnuts into a shallow bowl.  Dip chops in hazelnuts, then roll in the hazelnuts to coat.  Arrange in a shallow baking pan.  Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, and internal meat thermometer reaches 145 degrees f, about 25 minutes.  Remove chops to a platter, drizzle with your favorite dressing, and serve with your favorite salad.

title: Homemade Flavored Corn Pudding
ingredients: 1 can organic corn, drained | 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce | 3/4 cup molasses | 1/2 teaspoon grated turmeric | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 3 eggs, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup good brandy ( optional )
instructions: Put the corn in a blender jar and cover with applesauce.  Add a pinch of turmeric, a pinch of saffron, a beaten egg and brandy.

title: Sausage-Smoked Salmon Appétizer
ingredients: 1 link smoked salmon fillet | 100 g of natural goat cheese | 100 g feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla pod | 20 ml applesauce | 2 slices bread
instructions: Spread applesauce over the top of the salmon piece and wrap the slice of bread around it completely.  Bake in oven for 15 mins or broil for 1 min until nicely browned.

title: Rhubarb Chutney
ingredients: 1 lb fresh rhubarb | 1 1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder
instructions: Cut rhubarb in 2 inch pieces.  Place in a bowl.  Sprinkle with garam masala powder.

Random Ingredients: tamarind paste,portabella mushroom,chicken wing,red cabbage,bailey irish cream,beef chuck
title: Chocolate Beef and Portabella Mushroom Tajine
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, trimmed | 4 slices beef chuck | 1/2 cup bahlua or 1/2 cup baileys irish cream | 1/2 cup tamarind paste | 1 cup portabella mushroom, sliced | 1 cup red cabbage, sliced | 3 packages portabella mushrooms
instructions: Trim all fat from the beef.  Cut beef steak into small cubes.  Place beef in crockpot.  Add all other ingredients, including the mushrooms.  Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: baby carrot,pineapple chunk,lime juice zest,coconut cream,provolone cheese,rose petal
title: Pineapple and Rose Petals With Pineapple Salad
ingredients: 3 baby carrots, sliced thin | 5 baby carrots, sliced thin | 1 can pineapple chunks or ( 21 ounce ) can pineapple tidbits, drained well and drained well | 1/2 lime, juice and zest of, grated | 4 tablespoons coconut cream | 4 slices provolone cheese | ground rose petal ( optional ) or rose pepper ( optional )
instructions: Put the all ingredients in a bowl and toss lightly so as to coat all the vegetables, but not to break up the pineapple mush.  Chill.  Serve right away.  May be served with a few slices of pineapple.  Or let cool and serve on italian bread and a green salad for an extra kick.

title: Shrimp and Cheese Pie
ingredients: 300 g whole milk ricotta cheese | 125 g sliced pitted olives | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons olive ( optional ) | 250 g uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Pour into a pie dish.  Cook for 30 minutes at 180°c, then serve the pie warm.

title: Pastry Sauce for Pastry Bread
ingredients: 3 cups pastry flour | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 tablespoons vinegar
instructions: Mix the flour and vinegar and knead together to form dough.  Roll out on floured board into a 12 x 7 rectangle.  Spread with vinegar and cut with sharp knife into 1 strips.  Bake 25 - 30 min at 400°.

Random Ingredients: greek olive,veal,red chili pepper,shallot,oyster sauce,prawn,white wine vinegar,orange twist
title: Prawns and Prawns With Chilli-Oriental Vinaigrette
ingredients: 500 g prawns, raw & peeled | 1 small red chili pepper, seeded & finely chopped | 60 ml white wine vinegar | 2 shallots, finely sliced | 60 ml oyster sauce ( lee kum kee brand ) | 80 ml dry white wine vinegar | 80 g roasted red chili peppers, thinly sliced | 120 g greek olives, pitted & sliced
instructions: Peel the prawns & prawns, leaving the heads intact.  Cut the heads into 2cm pieces & split into two.  Put the prawns, chilli, vinegar, shallots & oyster sauce into a wok or large frying pan over medium high heat.  Stir, then lower the heat & simmer, uncovered for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add wine & stir over low heat for 1 minute.  Stir in roasted chilies & olives & simmer for 1 minute, then serve with prawns & pasta.

title: Wild Rice & Beef Casserole
ingredients: 3/4 cup wild rice, raw | 3/4 cup red wine, decent quality | 6 small scallions, finely chopped or 3 tablespoons white onions, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons mint leaves, finely chopped | 2 teaspoons jalapeno chiles, finely chopped | 1 lb ground chuck | 1/2 cup oatmeal, fine-chopped | 5 tablespoons red wine, cheap is ok | ice, as required
instructions: If using fresh wild rice mix in a plastic colander, set on cutting board, top with cold water and press firmly with your fingers.  Then press out all excess moisture.  If using dry rice mix on cutting board, mix in green onions, mint, chiles, and beef.  You can use an electric beater, meat grinder, blender if you have one, or mix in the oatmeal and red wine to a smooth, slightly thicker mixture.  Roll into long sticks 2 1/2 inches long.  Wrap tightly with wax paper and store in refridgerator.  Place a sheet of aluminum foil on the bottom of a pan which has been lined with parchment paper and pre heated on the stove.  On a medium heat cook the beef, rice mixture and the oatmeal until rice is cooked.  I use a 4 pound stew, but any meat will do.  I use 1 lb of stew.  I do not measure the meat mixture.  Put mixture into a container using a fine mesh sieve or the cheese cloth method.  When rice is done place in a bowl & allow to cool 5 - 10 minutes before removing the blocks.  Spoon off most of the excess liquid & serve with a green salad and fresh bread.  If using cheese cloth method, you don't need anything as it is an extra time for the cheese cloth to soak up the liquids.  Note, i have used all of the above in place of the beef mixture.  The reason i didn't add the salt was that my wild rice could become too salty for my taste & the addition was because the uncooked wild rice could turn the rice too salty for my taste & the beef mixture was already boiling.  After adding the salt, remove the cheese cloth from the bowl/container.  Place the raw rice into the bowl/container with the beef mixture, pressing the meat mixture gently.  You can also use the cheese cloth method, slicing the rice in half before pouring into a clean bowl.  I've had similar recipes which are wonderful looking and satisfying with a little kick of flavor.

title: Potato Dipping Sauce

instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Cook potatoes in boiling water for 15 minutes or until tender but firm.

title: Spicy Sausage With Cherry Slices

instructions: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan, add nut oil, stirring occasionally.  Add cherries and syrup.  Simmer until cherries are soft, 15 to 30 minutes.  Stir in saki and cook over medium heat until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in beer.  Fill each pita with sausage and cherry mixture.

title: Onion Kippered Sauce
ingredients: 7 tablespoons kirsch ( red wine vinegar ) | 1 teaspoon dehydrated onion flakes
instructions: Whisk kirsch, onion flakes and dehydrated onion in small bowl.  Use immediately or store in refrigerator.  Use as directed in a recipe for french dressing.  The ratio of onion to kirsch will not be entirely as dictated.

title: Cafe Rio Artichokes
ingredients: 4 artichoke hearts, quartered | 3/4 cup brewed coffee | 1 can mixed vegetables, drained | 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, drained and chopped | 1 tablespoon mustard seeds | saltines or corn crackers
instructions: Place artichokes, coffee, mixed vegetables, chipotle peppers, mustard seed, saltines and crackers in a large saucepan.  Heat to boiling then reduce heat to simmer, cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Stir, ladle hot milky liquid into hot rice before serving.

title: Coconut Crusted Tilapia (Ceviche) With Port and Chickpeas

instructions: Remove fish from freezer 1 hour before baking.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  In a shallow baking dish or baking dish, combine the ingredients for the crumb topping.  Place the tilapia fillets in the dish, skin side down.  Sprinkle remaining ingredients over the top.  Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.

title: Italian Breakfast Casserole Sauteed Escarole

instructions: In a saute pan, heat oil over medium heat.  Add roma tomatoes and sauté for 2 minutes.  Add sauerkraut.  Let the sauerkraut thaw for about 10 minutes.  Pour soup into a mixing bowl.  Stir in escarole and drained sunflower seeds.  Place casserole in a 400 degree f oven for 35 - 40 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

instructions: In a large pan, bring several cups of water to a boil.  Add the barley and stir over medium heat for approximately 5 minutes.  Drain the barley and rinse well under cold water until the water runs clear.  Return the barley to the pan and stir in the mustard.  Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat and simmer over a low heat for approximately 20 - 25 minutes or until the barley is tender and has absorbed all of the water.  Meanwhile, in a bowl, combine the jelly.  Stir in the ketchup, water chestnuts, leeks and cherry tomatoes.  Add the mustard and barbecue sauce mixture to the cooked barley and stir together.  Serve the salad warm or at room temperature and sprinkle with fresh chopped coriander if desired.

title: Cheesy French Fry

instructions: In a small frying pan fry bread in catsup until golden brown.  Put on a plate pour cheese on top.

title: White Wine Vinaigrette Dressing

instructions: Whisk together the orange juice and vinegar in a small bowl.  Season to taste with salt.  Chill.

title: Pepper Jelly Snacks

instructions: In a large microwave safe bowl, microwave gelatin on high power for 1 minute.  Stir in tomatoes, onion, and sugar, and microwave for 1 minute.  Let cool a little before stirring again.

instructions: Whisk 1/4 teaspoon oil in a medium bowl.  Add coleslaw mix.

instructions: Combine soda bread crumbs, peas, and beans.  Add steak and cook on medium heat until browned.  Serve in a soup bowl.  Garnish with shavings of ginger and parsley.

title: Sicilian Cold Noodles

Make sure each plate has a lot of napkins on the table to prevent people from accidentally eating up to your table.

title: Kielbasa with Pear Nests
ingredients: 8 thick slices round steak | 1/2 lb kielbasa, cut into 2 1/2 to 3/4 inch slices | 2 cans pears, peeled, sliced | 8 ounces angel hair pasta, cooked and drained
instructions: Place steak on cutting board and with a meat tenderizing mallet or rolling pin, pound flat into 1/2 inch thick pieces.  Place kielbasa in a 10 skillet with large pears.  Place in a deep skillet with a cover of about 1 inch of water.  Cover and cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes or until browned, stirring once or twice.  Add pasta and cook for 3 minutes or until heated through.

title: Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 3 -5 large tomatoes | 1 teaspoon minced chipotle chile
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Peel the tomatoes if desired.  Wrap tomatoes in foil and bake for a few minutes until they can be peeled off, but are not mushy.  Place the tomatoes on a pan and sprinkle with salt.  Remove some of the papery skin if desired, it adds flavor.  Roast tomatoes in oven for 15 minutes, turning them over to finish cooking.  Note, if you are using them for a longer cooking time, you can just leave in the oven.

title: Spicy Cherry Pie Rolls
ingredients: 1 sheet ready rolled puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup chopped glace cherries | 1/4 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the pastry on a well floured surface, and roll it out to about a 1/4 inch thickness.  Cut a 2 inch circle from the pastry.  Roll out another 2 inch circle, the same size as the previous one, and cut out three more circles.  Lay pastry on a well floured surface, and carefully peel off the thick, unstuffed pastry circle from over the pastry.  Place the halved cherries into the center of rolled pastry, filling the space evenly.  Sprinkle the chili flakes over the top.  Fold the right side of the pastry over the filling, and roll out the pastry again to seal the edges of the pastry.  Cut each roll into 6 pieces.  Cut a slit diagonally across the top of each pastry roll.  Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Rigatoni with Ramen Noodles and Beef and Veggies
ingredients: 1 package rigatoni pasta | 6 ounces ramen noodles ( dry, about 10 ounces )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring it to a boil.  Stir in the ramen noodles and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender but still slightly firm, about 5 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Return the ramen noodles to the pot and toss with the beef and veggies.  Serve immediately.

title: Lemon & Lime Syrup
ingredients: 180 g chocolate, melted | 1/4 cup lemon juice | 1 1/2 teaspoons golden syrup ( if using a 50/50 mix of dark and white sweetener ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons lime juice
instructions: Line a 1cm deep ovenproof dish with baking paper that the paper covered with slightly overlapping overhanging overhangs.  Combine all remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour into dish.  Cover the dish and leave for 3 hours, or until firm.  Allow to set slightly before cutting, to allow flavours to develop.  You won't need to cut the mix if served cold.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: cranberry,bamboo shoot,phyllo pastry,sun tomato oil,apricot jam,turkey,pork rib,yellow bell pepper
title: Easy Meat and Pork Sausage Parcels
ingredients: 10 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed | 1 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 2 cups chopped smoked turkey or 2 cups sweet pickled pork ribs | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 1/4 cup chopped bamboo shoot | 1/4 cup finely chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained | 3/4 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 2 1/4 cups cubed fully cooked pork ribs
instructions: Place two sheets of plastic wrap or waxed paper on a clean work surface.  Spread 1 thawed phyllo sheet on top of a second sheet.  Remove 1 sheet of phyllo from the plastic wrap, keeping the last phyllo sheet from sticking.  Lay a third phyllo stack on top of the third phyllo sheet.  Repeat with remaining phyllo.  To assemble, spread 1/4 cup jam in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Line the pastry with 2 sheets of phyllo, leaving a 1 inch gap on the sides.  Brush with 1/2 teaspoon jam, leaving some extending over the sides.  Spread 1/2 cup jam over the phyllo, followed by 2nd phyllo sheet, brushing with 1/2 teaspoon jam.  Repeat with remaining phyllo, jam, ham, and final phyllo sheet, brushing with 1/2 teaspoon jam.  Fold the corners over the stuffing and cut a 3x3 inch piece of pastry in half diagonally across the pie.  Cut pastry at a 45 degree angle from one of the long sides to the left and right of the left in the center.  Place seam side down in the prepared baking dish.  Repeat with remaining ingredients except the sun dried tomato.  Pour hot water into dish to just cover the phyllo stack.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  To serve, preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Remove plastic wrap and bake for 20 - 30 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp.  Sprinkle with parsley to serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken,anise seed,provolone cheese,red pepper flake,sesame seed,beet,chicken meat,lobster meat

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the chicken, beets, lobster meat, roasted beets, chicken, beets, red pepper flakes, and anise seed in a large covered baking dish. title: Chili Bread Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup chili oil | 2 teaspoons capers, rinsed | 1 loaf focaccia bread | 1 tablespoon mixed fresh herbs
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine all ingredients.  Cover and let sit 1 hour for flavors to develop.  Serve cold.

title: Quinoa, Crawfish & Canadian Bacon Tostadas
ingredients:
1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 6 ounces canadian bacon, thinly sliced | 1 cup quinoa | 3 tablespoons canadian bacon-flavored canned pumpkin spice ( or substitute 1/4 tbls.

instructions: Combine the first five ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Heat a heavy skillet over medium low heat.  Pour spaghettini and 2 tbls.  Of the spice mixture evenly on the skillet.  Cook until the quinoa begins to swell and the oil begins to shimmer, about 3 minutes.  Place the sage leaves in a small strainer and drain any excess liquid.  Fold into the quinoa and serve.

title: Curried Quinoa
ingredients: 2 cups quinoa | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder ( more or less according to your taste )
instructions: First, take your quinoa from the package or bag and rinse under cold water.  Put in a medium stock pot and add enough water to cover the quinoa by an inch or two.  Add the curry powder and stir in to coat the quinoa.  Turn on the heat low, cover and simmer, tightly covered for 15 minutes.  Remove and allow to sit for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Ginger and Red Pepper Lasagna
ingredients: 32 ounces lasagna noodles | 8 ounces fresh ginger, peeled and sliced | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Cook the noodles to tenderness as directed, but do not overcook.  While noodles are cooking, bring a large pot of water to the boil over high heat.  Add the ginger and boil for 2 minutes.  Drain the noodles.  Toss together the noodles, ginger, red pepper flakes and 1/2 teaspoon salt in the bottom of a large baking dish.  Top with lasagna noodles, drizzle with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and drizzle with the red pepper sauce.  Mix lightly.  Cover and bake at 400f for 30 minutes, stirring once or twice.

title: Spiced Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 package coleslaw mix | 1 spanish onion
instructions: Slice onion and cook in a nonstick skillet with a pinch of salt.  When onions are soft, add spanish onion.  Cook for a minute or two.  Add coleslaw mix and cook for another few minutes.  Enjoy.

Steam for 1 - 2 minutes, or until the wakame is crisp tender and the coating begins to darken slightly.  Transfer to a platter and repeat with the remaining wakame.  Serve warm.  Enjoy.

instructions: In a large non stick frypan over medium heat, combine the chilli, vinegar, nutmeg and half of the prawns and cook for a further three minutes or until pink. Keep a close eye on it this can also be done in the crockpot on low for about three hours, or until everything is really melting.  Serve with crackers, bread or vegetables.

title: Salmon with Brandy and Soy

Make the soy sauce by combining the brandy, liquid pectin and soy milk.  Stir until well blended.  Place the salmon in a saucepan and add the soy sauce mixture.  Bring the sauce to a gentle boil, and remove from the heat.  In a medium bowl, place your favourite topping.

If using your oven, wrap the chanti in plastic wrap and refrigerate for up to 6 hours before serving.  This could be served warm or at room temperature.

title: A Perfect Simplest Arabic Spice (No Eggs)
ingredients: 1 bunch garlic clove, very finely shredded | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder, you may not need it all
instructions: You will also need an oven mitt for high heat.  Place the garlic cloves in a mini cup or small bowl, and sprinkle the cardamom powder over the top.  Pour enough water in to just coat the top and bottom of the bowl.  This will absorb the garlic's moisture completely.  This will make the garlic less likely to burn.  When the water is absorbed, the garlic will be clear and transparent.  This may take anywhere from 10 - 15 minutes to one and a half hours depending on size and size of cloves.  Remove garlic from water and allow to cool completely.  You may need to use your hands to dry the garlic.  Place the dried garlic in a small non metal container, and freeze until desired consistency is reached.  You may need to add up to 1/2 pint or half at a time for this, depending on the size of your cloves.  Once you have reached desired consistency, remove from the freezer.  Place a small piece of wax paper on your counter.  Using a pastry brush or spoon, lightly spread out a circle of wax paper with a thin brush.  Using a fork, coat the bread surface of the dough with the remaining oil.  Then use the fork to carefully place your egg on the dough, making sure that all of the egg is covered evenly.  You will probably need about a quarter of this to coat all of the egg.  Take another small piece of wax paper, and place 1/2 inch of oil in the center.  The oil will be just about to heat up the bread.  You just need to brush the egg on each side. .  After about a minute, place the bread on the paper, place another circle of wax paper on top, add another couple of egg slices, and drizzle some more oil on and over the top.  You just want some oil on the bottom.  With your hands, grab a piece of the egg as you're going to cook it and then press the egg pieces into the bread.  It's going to look a bit messy but it will eventually melt into the bread.  Cook for about 3 minutes after 3 seconds of flipping.  Be careful not to overcook the bread, or the bread will be tough and chewy.  Place the toast on a paper towel lined tray to drain off the excess oil, allowing the egg to cool.

title: Nigella's Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon nigella seeds ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons uncooked rice noodles | 40 ladyfingers ( or egg shapes, or whatever shapes you like ) | 2 containers whole chicken or ( 900 ml ) containers chicken and noodles ( if using egg shapes ) | 1 sheet phyllo pastry or ( 18 x 11 inch baking sheet )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Heat a skillet over medium heat.  Add nigella seeds, rice noodles, and ladyfingers. Spoon 1/4 cup of the noodle/mixture into the center of the phyllo sheet.  Cut out a 2 x 3 inch long piece of phyllo on the angle from the edge nearest you, keeping the strips wide enough to wrap around the filling inside the sheets.  Fold each corner in at the center to make a triangle, making sure it stays contained within the phyllo.  Repeat steps 7 through 8 with the remaining sheets of phyllo and filling.  Lay 5 more sheets on top of each other.  Spread the phyllo dough with remaining noodles or chicken.  Using a sharp knife, cut a slice from the corner of pastry into 3 or 4 squares.  Fold the bottom corners towards the center and roll from the center out as tight as possible.  Cut the triangle in half so triangles will be able to wrap around the stuffing while still being triangular and not in the nuts.  Place the triangles on a parchment lined baking sheet or jelly roll sheet.  Pierce the triangles all over with a fork.  Bake triangles for about 20 to 25 minutes or until pastry is puffed and golden.  Allow to cool slightly before serving.

title: Baked Stuffed Tomatillos

instructions: Place potatoes or sweet potatoes into a large pot or deep saucepan, and cover with water.  The water should be approximately 2 below the bottom of the potatoes. When done, drain potatoes, and allow to cool slightly.  Cut a small slither off each tomatillo wedge.  Scoop out the flesh with a spoon, and discard seeds. .  Place into a medium bowl and toss with 1 teaspoon ginger paste, 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder, mace, and grated cheese.  Preheat to 475 degrees f / 220 degrees c.  Wrap each tomatillo wedge with a slice or 2 piece of cheese, and place on a small baking sheet.  Bake the stuffed potatoes until heated through, 10 - 15 minutes.  Remove from the oven, and sprinkle each with a pinch of ginger paste and a sprinkle of chopped chinese five spice powder.  Serve immediately.  Note, to remove excess water from the potatoes, place them on a large, non stick pan, cover with foil, and bake on low medium heat until tender. instructions: Place all ingredients into a food processor or blender and process until smooth.  Pour into a medium bowl and refrigerate until set, at least 2 hours.

instructions: Combine all ingredients except okra and bread.  Spread onto bread slices.  Sprinkle with cocoa powder and serve with toothpicks.

title: Tyropita
