instructions: Put everything in a ziploc baggie or bowl, cover and marinate in the refrigerator until serving time and it can be eaten as finger sandwiches.

title: Hot Pepper Dijon Vinaigrette
ingredients: 4 fresh hot peppers ( red, green, orange or pimentano peppers ) | dijon dijon mustard
instructions: In a small bowl, combine peppers.  Let stand at least 3 hours while preparing other ingredients.  Dry peppers on paper towels.  Store peppers in a dry jar.  Dry peppers can be refrigerated for up to 1 week.

title: Chilli Yoghurt Dip
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain yogurt, drained | 1/4 cup dried apricot jam | 2 tablespoons lime juice | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon tamarind pulp | 1/2 green pepper, chopped ( if using a milder chilies ) | 1/2 chili, chopped, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Place yogurt, jam, lime juice, vanilla and tamarind pulp in a food processor and process until smooth.  Pour into a serving bowl and stir in pepper, if using.  Decorate with green spring onion rings and serve with toasted pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: salt,sherry,lemon zest,avocado,green chili,couscous,hot red pepper flake,english muffin
title: Couscous Fajitas with Avocado & Green Chiles
ingredients: 4 english muffins ( cut from the loaf or 8 small rolls ) | 1 cup couscous ( i recommend my recipe with this recipe ) | 1 tablespoon hot red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons unsalted dry sherry | 1 teaspoon lemon zest, grated | 1 -2 large green chili, chopped ( milder is better ) | 1 ripe avocado, peeled and mashed ( for garnish ) | salt
instructions: Place the english muffin halves or the rolls on a cookie sheet and toast under a hot broiler, turning once, until slightly crisp on the tops but the bread in the middle will still stay crisp.  While the toasts are still warm, toast the couscous under the broiler in a toaster or a skillet set over medium heat, keeping the broiler on.  Stir the red pepper into the couscous and then add the sherry.  Remove from the heat, stir in the lemon zest and chill for a moment and check the seasoning.  To serve, place a heaping dollop of the avocado and a sprinkling of green chiles on each toasted muffin half, then top with the couscous mixture.

title: Almond Noodle Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles | 2 hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1/4 cup slivered almonds | 1 1/3 cups soymilk | 2 cloves garlic, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Place noodles in a large pot with just enough water to cover them.  Bring to a boil.  Cook about 5 minutes, or until tender.  Drain, and rinse with cold water.  In a large bowl, using clean hands, mix everything together.  Place in refrigerator for 1 - 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: tea,navy bean,onion soup mix,brown onion,white pepper,chuck
title: Beef & Bean
ingredients: 2 lbs lean chuck | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 bottle light brown's white pepper ( do not substitute regular pepper if you do not have it ), chopped in | 1 can navy beans, undrained | 1 onion, chopped | 1 ounce tea | ground white pepper
instructions: In crock pot, place meat, seasoning, and beans.  Cover, and set to low.  Cook 6 - 8 hours serve with rice or other suggested sides.

title: Chicken, Pecan and Pecan Casserole
ingredients: butter | 4 tablespoons cornflour | 1/2 cup double cream | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 1/2 cup pecans, chopped
instructions: Butter an ovenproof dish.  In a medium bowl wisk the cream with the cornflour until dissolved.  Add some boiling water to the cream to make a smooth creamy mixture.  Stir in the cream until smooth.  Tear the chicken into even sized chunks and toss with the pecans to coat well.  Spoon the creamy chicken over the chicken and bake in a moderate oven for approx 35 minutes or until cooked through and the crumb topping starts to crisp up.

title: Pork Shank (Russian Shish Kabob)
ingredients: 1/4 cup semolina | 1/2 cup mayonnaise | 1 cup beer | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 5 pounds pork loin, cut into 6 pieces | 2 containers marzipans
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine semolina, mayonnaise, beer and salt.  Place pork pieces in a large plastic bag and stir to coat.

title: Garlic Prawns
ingredients: 500 g prawns, raw ( shelled, cleaned and split in half ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 6 -8 cardamom pods, powdered
instructions: Heat oil in a wok.  Add garlic and ginger paste.  Saute for 10 minutes or till oil separates on the side of the wok.  Add prawns.  Stir fry for 5 minutes.  Add cardamom powder.  Stir in 1 cup water, allow to boil for a minute or two on low heat or till the water starts leaving the sides of the wok.  Serve with steamed rice.

title: Adzuki Bean Burritos
ingredients: 600 g adzuki beans | 10 g fresh coriander leaves | topping | 1 tablespoon dried adzuki beans ( red bean paste ) | 1 tablespoon rolled oats | garnish ( optional )
instructions: Soak the beans overnight in plenty of water.  Drain.  Put the drained beans into a pan large enough to contain the water.  Scatter the corriander, adzuki beans and dried beans over the beans then put the lid on the pan.  Simmer until cooked.  Stir occasionally.  Remove from heat then remove the lid.  Stir the beans around.  Cover with a dampened tea towel.  When the beans are cool, remove the corriander leaves and discard them.  You can use a blender or food processor for this method.  To make the topping mix the dried adzuki beans and rolled oats together.  When cool mix them with the topping.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for up to two days, stirring every so often to help prevent mixture from sticking to the bottom.  You can serve the burritos with topping mixed with extra grated white sugar if desired.

Random Ingredients: pasta,drambuie,onion soup mix,active yeast,self raising flour
title: Drambuie Pizza Base
ingredients: 100 g self-raising flour | 1 packet dry onion soup mix | 1 packet instant drambuie | 1 packet dry active dry yeast | 1 cup boiling water
instructions: Heat oven to 200°c in a large bowl mix flour and onion soup powder.  Dissolve the yeast in the boiling water.  Add to the flour mixture, stir for 20 seconds until combined.  Turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 2 minutes until smooth, elastic, and well mixed.  Place in a large and lightly oiled bowl to rise.  Cover with a clean towel and leave in a warm place for a hour or until doubled in size.  Preheat oven to 550°f place the dough on a floured surface and knead for 3 minutes.  Roll out thinly, and place on a lightly oiled pizza base.  Pour over the drambuie sauce and sprinkle with the finely chopped onion.  Bake for 10 minutes, or until bubbly.  Allow to cool for 2 minutes before slicing.

title: Beef and Barley Stew
ingredients: 600 g small marinated leftover roast beef | 3 tablespoons oil ( i use the olive oil ) | 1 packet pearl barley | 200 ml cold water | 400 ml canned tuna
instructions: Sauté beef with water, barley and tuna.  Add salt and pepper to taste, and enjoy.

title: Coconut Beef Coconut Beans
ingredients: 2 tablespoons beef stock cubes | 400 ml sweetened coconut milk | 400 ml canned kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon fresh peach, chopped
instructions: Add the beans, stock, and peaches, and mix well.  Cover and cook slowly on the stovetop for 30 mins until the beans are tender, and the liquid has reduced.  Serve with steamed rice, and a tasty salad.

Random Ingredients: liquid honey,beef sirloin steak,milk ricotta cheese,salt pork,ham,miso,baby shrimp,nonstick cooking spray
title: Grilled Shrimp and Beef Rolls
ingredients: 1 package whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks, cut 1/2 inch thick | salt & fresh ground pepper | nonstick cooking spray | 1 can baby shrimp, drained and coarsely chopped, reserve juice | 4 ounces thinly sliced ham, cut into 1/4 inch thick slices | 2 tablespoons liquid honey | 2 tablespoons miso, dissolved in 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine ricotta and 1/2 cup reserved juice in a medium bowl until well blended.  Season with salt and pepper.  Arrange a sheet of waxed paper on a flat surface.  Place a ricotta mixture on an unbuttered surface.

title: Pollo Borracha - the Secret Winner!
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken wings, frozen | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped unsalted pistachios ( or other nuts of choice ) | 1 bunch fresh herb, leaves picked from stems | 1 tablespoon soya milk | 1 tablespoon fresh key lime juice | 1/2 packet sazon seasoning
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Bake chicken wings in preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Allow chicken wings to cool and remove any bones and excess fat.  Slice chicken wings into two parts across the bone, depending on preference.  Combine the pistachios, chopped nuts, milk and sazon.  Stir well to blend ingredients, and add more milk if needed.  Pour about half the sauce mixture over the chicken, coating the chicken.  Arrange mixture all around the chicken on top of the sauce, spreading the rest of the sauce over the chicken.  Cover and bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.  Remove cover and bake for 20 more minutes or until chicken is cooked through.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: tamari,lettuce leaf,rice noodle,couscous,salt black pepper,romaine lettuce
title: Noodle Salad With Tamari Cakes
ingredients: 8 ounces rice noodles, prepared according to directions | 1/4 cup tamari or 1/4 cup soy sauce | 1/4 cup rice flavored tamari | 4 tablespoons extra-strong tamari or 4 tablespoons soy sauce | 3 tablespoons extra-strong tamari or 3 tablespoons tamari, plus extra for garnish | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 head lettuce, preferably baby cos lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water until just tender, then drain and rinse under cold water, drain and set aside. Random Ingredients: walnut,scallop,red chilies,cilantro leaf,pork roast,phyllo pastry,ketchup,anise seed
title: Caribbean Pork and Shrimp Pies
ingredients: 6 ounces pork roast, cut into strips about 1-inch wide ( preferably country-style ) | 1/2 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 8 sheets phyllo pastry ( defrosted if fresh ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons ketchup ( preferably heinz ) | 2 large red chilies, finely diced | 1/2 cup walnuts, finely chopped | 3/4 cup cilantro leaf, finely chopped | 10 ounces scallops, cooked and peeled
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place pork strips in a small bowl.  Sprinkle with anise seeds.  Sprinkle over phyllo sheets, cover loosely, and place in oven for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, combine ketchup and remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Remove phyllo sheets from oven and place in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Working with about 3 phyllo sheets at a time, fold phyllo in half on each side, then stack 5 sheets on the counter top.  With a sharp knife, create 1 sheet stack in the center of phyllo, then use a brush to brush on the remaining 5 phyllo sheets.  Cut stack stack in half diagonally, then place on 1/2 sheet of phyllo and brush with more of the ketchup mixture.  Repeat with remaining phyllo stacks, adding another sheet of phyllo to the bottom of the dish if necessary.  Cut stack diagonally across the grain into 3 strips.

Random Ingredients: red capsicum,leek,pine nut,lettuce,beef sirloin tip,granny smith apple,walnut
title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 250 g beef sirloin tips, thinly sliced | 2 granny smith apples, peeled and grated | 4 teaspoons walnuts, coarsely chopped | 1 large leek, white portions only, sliced | 1 red capsicum, chopped | 2 leaves lettuce | 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil
instructions: If you are planning on using a sandwich maker, this is the way we do it.  Combine the beef with the walnuts in a bowl and mix well.  Form the mixture between the 2 palm edges of your hands into a log.  Wrap the log in aluminium foil and refrigerate until ready to cook.  If you are using a grill, heat the oil in a skillet over high heat.  Add the beef and cook until lightly browned, about 3 - 4 minutes each side.  Add the apple, leek and capsicum to the beef, reduce the heat and cook, stirring, for 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Divide the beef mixture among the wraps, drizzle with the olive oil and scatter with the chopped walnuts.  Serve immediately.  Tip, if you are planning on freezing, wrap the wrap in aluminium foil to prevent a soggy texture that may easily be forced through the wrap.

Serve with rice or fried noodles.

title: Kurdish Black-Eyed Peas

instructions: To cook dried black peas, add 3 cups water and 2 teaspoons salt.

title: Cheesy Black Forest Bread Wedges

instructions: Slice bread 1/4 inch thick.  Sprinkle both sides of each slice with ginger and half of cheese.  Place in a bread machine according to manufacturer's directions.  Add another 1/4 cup cheese and another 1/3 cup cheese into each slice.  Top each with cherries and remaining 1/4 cup cheese.  Set crust for 5 minutes before slicing to crisp or at the table.

title: Salmon and Protein Shake-Cream (Pixie Rain)
ingredients: 2 cans salmon, drained ( or equivalent weight of fish ) | 2 cans bamboo shoots, sliced with juice | 500 ml soy milk ( or use 1/2 can coconut milk with 3/4 cup water ) | 1/2 cup chocolate syrup ( sweetened condensed milk or braggs amino acids ) | 1/2 lb snow peas, sliced with seeds for garnish ( to garnish ) or 1/2 lb green beans ( to garnish ) | 1/4 cup shelled pumpkin seeds ( optional )
instructions: Drain the salmon and cut into pieces or cubes.  Drain the bamboo shoots and add both cans of soy milk or water to the soy milk.  Mix well and set aside.  In a seprate bowl, add the sugar maple syrup or braggs to the 1/2 cup of chocolate syrup.  Mix well and set aside.  In a nonstick frying pan, add the snow peas or green beans and allow to boil, or microwave briefly until soft.  Drain the cooked snow peas and beans and add to the soy milk mixture.  Mix well.  Add chopped salmon and mix.  To serve, spoon the spicy banana ice cream onto a large serving plate.  Pour the salmon and sauce over the top.  Garnish with snow peas and/or green bean sprouts, if desired.

title: Spinach with Pomegranate Jelly
ingredients: 6 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 red chili pepper, deseeded and finely chopped | 2 lemons, juice of ( about 3 tbs ) | 150 g spinach, sliced ( stalks trimmed, washed and chopped ) | 4 tablespoons kombu ( japanese soy sauce ) | 200 millilitons corn | 100 millilitons pomegranate juice
instructions: Put everything together except corn and pomegranate juice in a pan and heat gently.  Do not boil.  Add cornmeal gradually and stir until mixed.  Pour into a greased mould, or jelly mould of your choice.  Leave in fridge until set.

title: Herbes De Provence Herb Sticks
ingredients: 8 tablespoons pesto sauce | 1 teaspoon herbes de provence | 7 tablespoons mashed potato starch | 6 tablespoons potato starch, or more if needed ( optional ) | 2 bunches fresh edible silver foil, torn into pieces, or more as needed | 2 bunches fresh lettuce leaves | 2 fresh serrano peppers, diced, or more to taste, seeded if desired
instructions: Mix herbes de provence together 3 tablespoons potato starch and potato starch in a bowl, stir in the herb mixture until smooth.

title: Old English Rabbit
ingredients: 2 ounces old english cheddar cheese | fresh sage leaf
instructions: Cut 2 ounces of english cheddar into thin bite sized pieces.  Put these into boiling water.  Take them out when they are just beginning to float.  You may need to cover them slightly with a tea towel at this stage.  It may take as many as 3 - 4 trips to the pan as a meal.  When done remove and drain.  Pour remaining cheese into small saucepan.  Heat until melted.  Pour over the cheddar and stir to coat the cheese.  It is probably worth the effort.

title: Red Cabbage Mold

instructions: To make the mandarin filling, mix together all the ingredients.  Place all ingredients in a container with plastic wrap on top and add the liquid to make it smooth.  Let the plastic wrap dry for about 20 minutes.  Then pour about 1 cm of filling into each hollowed out of casserole and cover with a lid.  Then place in a 350°f.  Oven or until the crust has caramelized a little.  Turn the casserole onto a rack and let sit overnight in the refrigerator.  It will become firm and more delicious after a few hours.  Makes about 2 - 3 pies.

title: Apricot-Cream Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 2 tablespoons light sour cream | 1 small stalk celery leaves, finely shredded
instructions: In a small heat proof bowl, stir together the jam and the sour cream.

title: Santa Fe Grilled Ham With Crunchy Basil Spread
ingredients: 1/4 cup heavy cream or 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup lightly packed soft basil ( preferably arugula ) | 2 tablespoons fresh tarragon vinegar ( or use a vinegar and 1 1/2 teaspoons dried tarragon ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon canned chipotle chile, chopped | 5 slices smoked ham ( 1/2 inch thick ) | 6 cups fresh corn kernels, washed
instructions: Make the sauce, in a large bowl, mix the cream, basil, tarragon vinegar, and chiles.  Set aside.  Make the ham, lay the ham on a cutting board and cut it into 3/8 inch thick slices.  Arrange slices of ham in the center of a large piece of heavy duty foil or parchment paper.  Spread the basil cream mixture between the slices, overlapping them slightly.  Fold the foil over the ham so that it is completely wrapped in the cheese.  Wrap the edges of the foil tightly around the ham slices, making sure no air pockets are apparent.  Pour enough warm water into a large pot to come halfway up the far side of the foil packet.  Place the foil packet, seam side down, in the water.  Slowly bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes.  Pour any accumulated juices from the water into a bowl and reserve.  Remove the foil packet from the heat again and set aside. .  Let cool, stirring occasionally, then place on a platter.  Serve the sauce, if desired, warm slightly, but do not boil or it might become soggy.  To serve, transfer a portion of sauce to a small dish or platter and place 4 portions on top.  Serve with a sprinkling of a fresh grated cheddar and the corn chips or serve as an appetizer.

title: Chunky Italian Cod

instructions: Put the fish in a shallow roasting pan or heavy skillet.  Add the sake or vinegar to the tomato sauce and mix well.  Pour over the cod, cover tightly and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 30 minutes.  Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes, basting occasionally with the tomato sauce.  Sprinkle the cocoa over the cod when ready to serve.

title: Shrooms on Toast
ingredients: 500 g raw mushrooms, cleaned, washed and cut in half | 4 slices pistachios, halved
instructions: Place mushrooms in a flat dish.  Sprinkle with pistachios.  Lightly fry in oil.  Serve with yoghurt or plain yoghurt and chutney.

title: Crowdie’s Rouladen
ingredients: 1 broiler-fryer chicken | 1 cup prepared pizza sauce | 1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, washed but not dried | 1 can condensed beef broth | 1 teaspoon saffron | mango, wedges for serving
instructions: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes.  Place in a medium saucepan with the pizza sauce and condensed beef broth.  Bring to a boil, uncovered, over medium heat.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.  Stir in saffron and simmer another 5 minutes.  Set aside and let stand for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to come together.  Serve chicken mixture over your favorite green or red salad.

title: Alfredo Sauce for Salmon
ingredients: 2 ounces dill weed | 1/2 ounce cognac
instructions: Gently stir together the dill weed and cognac.

instructions: Combine tomato paste and mushrooms and marinate beef slices in this mixture until ready to serve.

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and refrigerate for 2 hours to blend flavours.  Use the chilled cream for cream torte if desired.

Top with jicama.

title: Phyllo Beef Roll Ups
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 box beef base | 3/4 cup grain white rice | 3 -5 sheets phyllo pastry | 2 tablespoons hazelnut-flavored liqueur or 2 tablespoons brummel & brown | 1 tablespoon hazelnut-flavored liqueur | 24 ounces frozen whole-milk chocolate and irish gold blend beef roll ups
instructions: Meat.  In a saucepan bring 3 quarts of water with beef base to a bare simmer.  Add beef cubes and simmer gently until meat has absorbed the liquid and is tender, about 45 minutes maximum.  Drain off liquid.  Cool completely.  Cook rice and proceed with pastry.  Assembly.  When beef is cool enough to handle, pull meat off the bone and chop into 1/4 cubes using a meat mallot or a box grater with a finely shredded blade.  Set aside.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Lay 2 sheets of phyllo pastry on a clean dry surface and place 2 tbsp of the beef on each.  Then lay 1 tbsp of beef on each.  Next, lay 1 tbsp of beef on each and repeat using up 3 more sheets of phyllo.  Spread 1 tbsp of beef on each sheet of phyllo pastry.  Make space in between the beef and phyllo pastry by cutting through it all the way to the bottom of the phyllo dough rectangle.  You want to keep the phyllo pastry hanging over the top edge of the rectangle.  Repeat with remaining phyllo sheets and beef and pastry.  Bake until phyllo pastry is brown with the meat and filling all the way through, about 25 minutes.  Remove meat and filling and from oven.  Spoon on 1/4 cup of hazelnut flavored liqueur.  Allow to cool for 5 - 10 minutes and serve with chocolate and irish gold blend cream.

Random Ingredients: sugar syrup,chili paste,dark rum,wheat flour,bread,premade puff pastry
title: The World's Greatest Spicy and Fragrant Shallow Pizza!
ingredients: 1 1 lb premade puff pastry | 1 pint bread ( i like red crust ) | 3 tablespoons ground chili paste | 3 tablespoons sweet chili paste | 2 tablespoons sugar syrup | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark rum
instructions: Line a flat or oval tray with baking paper.  Roll out the puff pastry and line the tins.  Set aside.  Using a sharp knife, cut a 2 x 1/2 inch slice off the top of the crust.  Set aside.  Cut a 1 inch piece of wax paper around the base of the dough.  Carefully place the piece of paper onto the paper and lightly flour it until it's a little less than 1/8 inch thick.  Using the back of a table fork, press the dough into the paper and base.  Trim and evenly score 1 1/2 inch circles out of the pastry. . .  Repeat this process until you have 5 x 4 inch circles.  Brush the crust with a little olive or water.  Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of both ground chili paste and 1 tablespoon of sweet chili paste onto the dough.  Lightly spread a 1/2 inch line of chopped chillies onto the dough, then evenly spread your mix.  Press down the line and trim the rest of the chillies until they are 2 or 3/4 inch thick. .  Cut the crusts into smaller sizes, using a 3 inch round cutter.  Lightly score all of your pizza.  Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of ground chillies, 2 tablespoons of sweet chili paste, 1 tablespoon of sugar syrup, 1 tablespoon of dark rum and 1 tablespoon of sea salt on the top.  Don't over sprinkle the nutmeg on top yet.  Bake in the oven at 230 deg celsius for 15 20minutes, depending on the crust sizes.  After you cut the crusts, brush the pies with olive or water.  Top with your favourite topping.

title: Onion Jam (Pollo Con Queso)
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons walnut oil | 2 lbs boiling onions ( a sweet white, like vidalias or vidalia onions will do ) | 20 ounces tomato paste | 4 tomatoes, chopped | 1 bunch watercress, chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a large, heavy pan or a small, heavy skillet.  When hot enough to smoke but not smoking, add onions and stir gently until they are a rich golden color and soft at the edges.  Scrape onions into a colander over a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap to keep submerged.  Peel off the outer layer of onions and reserve, then press onions together with a spatula to release most of the liquid.  Put in a blender or food processor and blend with onions.  Measure out 1 1/3 cups of this mixture and measure it out onto a wax paper.  Cover with a clean cloth and chill at least overnight.  Meanwhile steam remaining onions in the tomato paste, covered, in a skillet over medium heat for about 15 minutes, stirring frequently.  If not quite done, uncover and continue to cook for a few minutes.  Remove the lid.  Scrape bits of tomato paste from pot and stir in enough water to obtain desired consistency.  Pour this mixture back in to pot.  Bring to a boil and boil until mixture is reduced to 3 cups, approximately 15 - 20 minutes.  Pour this into saucepan.  Pour into a wide, shallow bowl or an oval crockpot.  Set crockpot on low and cook until all water has evaporated and a jam like consistency has formed, approximately 90 minutes. .  Add watercress and cook about 10 to 15 minutes more, stirring occasionally, until watercress turns bright green.  Cool slightly and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,red chili pepper,sage,pita bread,chipotle pepper,coriander,tofu,prosciutto

Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat with the chipotle and prosciutto.  Add the tofu, proscuitto, chilies, tomatoes, oregano, and coriander.  Cook, stirring, for 2 to 5 minutes, or until heated through, coating the tofu evenly with the sauce.  Cut the pita wedges. title: Mexican Tomatillo Catsup

instructions: Cut stems off of tomatillos and rub husks with oil and set on a platter or rimmed cookie sheet covered with a damp towel to dry. instructions: Fill a large pot with water, and bring it just to a boil over high heat.  Place half of the clams in the bowl of a large glass bowl.  Scrub the outside of the clams, and put the clams in a pan of boiling water.  When the clams open, they are done.  Drain and set aside.  Meanwhile, in a large skillet, combine the cornmeal and salt.  Place the clams in the skillet.  Fill the pan generously with cold water.  Bring the water to a boil, then set the timer to 5 minutes.  Dry off any clams that do not open.  Plunge the hot clams into the fritters, and toss.  To be sure, pour a small amount of hot water over them before serving.  Serve with a couple of slices of avocado and horseradish.

title: Palm Sugar Powder
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 500 ml palm sugar | 1 teaspoon powdered asafoetida powder
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.  Heat oil in a frying pan.  Once the oil is heated, add asafetida powder.

title: Matzoh With Shredded Turkey
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground turkey | 1/2 cup matzo cake meal | 2 slices bread | 1/2 cup shredded cucumber
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Cook ground turkey in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring to crumble, until no longer pink.  Stir in matzo cake meal.  Remove from heat.  Cut a slit about 1/4 inch deep from the center of each bread slice, then place slices on a baking pan.  Place a small amount of stuffing into the middle of each bread slice.  Bake in a 425°f oven for 5 minutes or until bread is golden.

Random Ingredients: oregano,red chilies,white chocolate,pecorino romano cheese,chicken bouillon cube,yellow squash,plain nonfat yogurt,vanilla extract
title: Chiles Fresca
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon chicken bouillon cube ( depending on the number of cubes you use ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 small yellow squash, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 1 small yellow squash, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced | 2 -3 small dried red chilies | 7 tablespoons plain nonfat yogurt | 2 tablespoons grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a skillet over medium high heat, add a tablespoon of the chicken bouillon or vegetable stock, and add the oregano and dried chiles.  Stir and cook until the chiles turn a dark green color and begin to soften, about 5 minutes.  Add in the squash and fry, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.  Stir in the yogurt and cook until curds are melted and ingredients are warm through, about 1 minute.  Stir in in the cheese, vanilla and a sprinkle of powedered pecorino.  Serve immediately.

title: Limoncello
ingredients: 1 ounce vodka | 1 ounce amaretto | 1 ounce breadcrumbs | 1/4 cup pitted ripe cantaloupe
instructions: Pour a scant tbls.  Of vodka into a glass.  Next, add the amaretto and stir.  Add the bread crumbs to make a coarse coating.  Cut the cantaloupe into thin strips and add them to the vodka.  Gently shake and stir the cantaloupe to coat the peel in the coating.

title: Dry Onion Confits
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs small dried onions ( about 2 1/2 inches wide ) | 6 -12 cardamom pods, lightly crushed ( about 2 1/2 teaspoons ) | salt and pepper
instructions: Place the dried onions in a large bowl or a heavy duty resealable plastic bag and sprinkle with the cardomom pods.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours to overnight.  Remove the onion and discard the bag.

title: Delicious Mushroom Pie
ingredients: 12 ounces puff pastry | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 teaspoon dried hing | 8 ounces mixed mushrooms, chopped | 1/3 cup fat-free ricotta cheese or 1/3 cup reduced fat cottage cheese
instructions: Prick pastry all over with a fork.  Fully roll pastry out onto a board and use a cookie cutter to cut out 15 pie shaped circles.  Mix apple juice and herbs and pour into pastry circles.  Add mushrooms and arrange mushrooms on top of the cheese.  Place on lightly greased oven tray and bake in a preheated 220c oven for 15 - 25 minutes or just until pastry is golden.  Serve with salad.

title: Mexican-Style Chiles & Squash With Banana & Provolone
ingredients: 4 large ripe tomatoes or 4 large tomatoes | 1 large yellow squash ( yellow squash or squash may be substituted ) | 1 cup sliced peeled avocado ( or green mixture ) | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pecans or 1/2 cup walnuts, toasted | 1/2 head chopped white american cheese ( i love kraft singles ) | 1/2 cup shredded lowfat deli-style swiss cheese | 1/2 cup italian salad dressing ( homemade is best! ) | 1 can fat-free vegetable broth
instructions: Slice all the vegetables 1/8 inch thick and place on a greased baking sheet that is sprayed with cooking spray.  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake in a 375 oven until the edges just start to brown, about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Combine the salad dressing and broth and whisk until well incorporated.  Pour over the hot vegetables and let sit 2 - 4 minutes.  Top with the shredded cheese.  Broil until cheese is melted to your liking.  Serve warm.

title: Sopa Doi (Pipi Soup )
ingredients: 1 large bell pepper | 4 cups chicken stock
instructions: Simmer the stock with the bell pepper for about 20 minutes.  Chop the bell pepper very finely and add to the soup.  If the soup is too thick, stir in 1 tablespoon sugar.  Cover and simmer slowly until the soup is thick serve with bread to soak up the flavours.

title: Salmon, Chickpea Salad With Chutney
ingredients: 6 tilapia fillets | 1 cup canned chickpeas ( reserve liquid ) | 3/4 cup low-fat yogurt | 2 tablespoons light chutney | 1/4 cup lettuce leaf | 1 yellow bell pepper | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cooked salmon | 1/4 cup chutney, extra-virgin
instructions: Pour liquid from chickpeas into a small saucepan.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, stirring frequently, and cook 1 minute.  Drain chickpeas, reserving liquid.  Rinse chickpeas with cold water, remove membrane.

title: Lobster Clam Bisque
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup fresh breadcrumb | 3/4 cup heavy cream | 6 tablespoons mild curry paste, divided | 1/2 cup minced green onion | 1 can minced clams with juice
instructions: Combine the first 3 ingredients, and pulse lightly.  Combine the cream and curry paste, and bring to a boil.  Drain off any excess liquid.  Ladle 1/2 cup of the hot cream mixture into a blender.  Add the clams to the blender, and blend into the mixture.  Return the clam milk to the blender, and process until smooth.  Return to the pot that you set aside the cream mixture and the beans.  Stir in the shrimp mixture.  Heat through, stirring often, don't allow to boil or the shrimp to turn a grayish color.  Serve in soup plates with a sprinkling of cilantro or green onions.

instructions: Lay the grilled chicken and tomatos flat on a cutting board so they have a flat flat shape.  Spread the tomato paste onto the chicken.  Layer the tortillas on the plate a little at a time, sprinkle with the minced lime zest and drizzle on a little sunflower oil.  Stack up the tortillas and slice down the center making a taco.  Repeat this until you have about 20 or 25 taco squares.

title: Cheese & Butternut Squash Tartlets With Two Variations
ingredients:
1 tablespoon cornstarch, approximately ( may add a tsp.
    - more of either ) | 2/3 cup light mayonnaise ( can sub miracle whip or jel ) | 1 tablespoon italian chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1 cup canned italian plum tomatoes ( one 398 grams or 1 1/2 cups homemade ) | 2 tablespoons garlic-flavored prosciutto or 2 tablespoons prosciutto, chopped ( i use the deli ham in a italian-style ham roll ) | 1 1/2 lbs butternut squash, peeled and cut into 1/2 slices ( or other winter squash - 1 1/2 c ) | 2 cans of drained canned plum tomatoes | 1 ounce thinly sliced prosciutto
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f combine the cornstarch and 1/3 cup of light mayonnaise in a small bowl to blend.  Stir the mixture to combine and then spread the mixture over the inside of a well buttered pie dish.  Bake in the center of the oven for 15 minutes, or until the shell is golden.  Meanwhile, combine the sauce ingredients in a small saucepan over medium heat.  Reduce the heat until the mixture is slightly thickened and simmer for about 3 minutes. Place the slices of ham, prosciutto, and sliced squash on top.  Drizzle each tartlet with some of the sauce.  Bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes, or until the crust is golden and bubbly. Random Ingredients: panko breadcrumb,soy cheese,salt black pepper,semolina,thyme leaf,fig
title: Fig and Soy Crumbs
ingredients: 500 g dried figs, washed, dried and coarsely chopped | 200 g panko breadcrumbs | 100 g soy cheese | 1 tablespoon dried thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon dried panko breadcrumbs | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Place the figs in a pan with a bit of water over the heat and bring to the boil.  Turn down the heat slightly and cook until the liquid has reduced about 5 to 7 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  In a large bowl, mix together the panko, soy cheese, thyme, panko, salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.  Using your hands or a pastry blender, mix in the figs and fig liquid until they are slightly sticky.  Shape the mixture into a ball.  Lightly oil a baking sheet and divide the dough in half. Bake in the middle of the oven for 10 minutes then reduce the temperature to 180c and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden and crispy.  Serve warm.  Variation, after reducing the heat slightly, cover the breadcrumbs with the panko and sprinkle over the thyme.  Then, when baking is complete, spread the breadcrumbs on top and serve.

title: Quick and Easy Olive Brush

Turn on oven to 480 degrees.  Beat well and pour into two greased bread pans.  When done, you should have a nice golden crust.

title: Savoury Eggs

Turn heat to medium and add the tomatoes and mushrooms and mix well.  When the tomatoes are soft and starting to brown, remove them from the pan.  Place the eggs on top of the mushrooms and add salt and pepper to taste.

instructions: Combine all ingredients except the cheese and the twine in a bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.  Preheat grill to medium heat. title: Chicken Legs With Lima Beans, Tortillas, and

instructions: Heat a dry 10 inch skillet over medium heat until hot but not smoking, about 2 minutes.  Combine bisquick, oregano, and salt in a large bowl.  Arrange chicken in a single layer on hot skillet, skin side down.  Cook until underside is golden brown, 7 to 10 minutes.  Transfer chicken to a plate.

title: Spinach Filled Flatbread

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil.  Add spinach and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the water has been mostly absorbed.  Meanwhile, combine graham cracker crumbs and 4 cups of water in a bowl.

title: Poblano Chile Pasta

instructions: Cook rigatoni as directed on box using poblanos.  Drain.  Chop poblano.  Add chiles and gelatin to water in large pot over medium heat and boil for five minutes.  Toss with hot pasta and serve.

title: Pressed Saffron Bread from the Microwave
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, cut into 4 slices | 3/4 lb salami, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup saffron, pulverized in the microplane
instructions: Place bread slices on a foil lined rimmed baking sheet.  Drizzle bread slices with olive oil and sprinkle with saffron.  Microwave on high until hot, about 2 minutes or so, taking care to keep it moving.  Watch carefully so that the bread doesn't become soggy.  Cool bread slices, cut into quarters and serve.

title: Wasabi Poached Parrots
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9 inch double crust pie ( see note ) | 4 medium size firm white pearl onions, peeled | 1 teaspoon wasabi paste
instructions: Place onions in a non stick, deep saute pan.  Heat to just under medium heat and saute until translucent.  Place pearl onions in a sieve, add wasabi and let dry completely.  Place potatoes on top of onions and cover with saran wrap for 1 minute.  Turn over, repeat the procedure with remaining potato and onions.  Remove scum from surface and pour dry liquid over potatoes.  Let stand for 10 minutes and serve hot with wasabi dip.

title: Roasted Celery
ingredients: 4 pounds celery, thickly sliced | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1 bunch fresh chervil, chopped
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Spread the celery over the hot baking sheet.  Sprinkle with green bell pepper and chervil.  Roast in the preheated oven until vegetables are tender, about 45 minutes.

title: Saffron Mushroom Mushrooms

instructions: Heat a heavy medium skillet over medium heat.  When it begins to smoke slightly, pour in can of tomato sauce.  Add saffron.  Stir a few times, making sure it mixes thoroughly.  Bring to a simmer and let it reduce to desired consistency.  Let mushroom sit for a few minutes before serving.

Garnish individual cups with the mini marshmallows and a dollop of whipped cream.

title: Blueberry, Ham and Shrimp Salad

ingredients: 2 lbs boneless pork shoulder roast | 20 ounces fresh tortellini | 1/4 cup walnut oil | 1 medium lemon, juice of | 3 tablespoons rice flour | 1 cup fennel bulb, finely chopped
instructions: Prepare your tortellini according to package’s instructions.  Heat the oil in a nonstick dutch oven over medium high heat.  Remove the pork from the pan and set aside.  To the pan add in the browned pork, lemon juice, and salt and pepper to taste.  Cook for approximately 15 minutes, turning so that the pork is browned evenly for every side and bottom of pan. Add in the tortellini and continue to simmer until it is cooked through and the tortellini is cooked.  Enjoy.

title: Brown Lentils and Carrots
ingredients: 75 g dried brown lentils, sorted, washed | 450 g baby carrots, cut into thin wedges
instructions: Place all ingredients together in a saucepan and cover with water, bring to the boil.  Reduce heat, and simmer, partially covered, for 10 - 15 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: oyster sauce,perch,bean thread noodle,vanilla ice cream
title: Stir-Fried Glass Noodle With Chicken and Prawns
ingredients: 300 g perch, small, white stalks ( prawn ) | 300 g bean thread noodles | 8 fluid ounces vanilla ice cream | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce
instructions: Shell the meat from the prawns and cut into thin strips.  Cut each perch into 1½ inch lengths.  Mix the prawn strips in a bowl with the noodles.  Whisk together the ingredients for the sauce and pour over the noodles.  Toss and serve.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,cumin,taco seasoning,baking soda,hot paprika,cumin powder,chili pepper flake,head cabbage
title: Smoky Taco Baked Green Cabbage
ingredients: 2 cans minced chili pepper flakes | 1 head of cabbage | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon cumin powder | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 2 tablespoons crushed chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon hot paprika | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced
instructions: Remove outer leaves from cabbage and chop coarsley.  Place cabbage in greased baking dish.  Mix all other sauce ingredients together adding some taco seasoning to taste.  Pour over cabbage and bake at 350 degrees for 30 - 40 minutes.  Garnish with slices of red onion, and salsa.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,cilantro leaf,broth,kidney bean,island dressing,yogurt,fenugreek seed,picante sauce
title: Kidney Beans With Crispy Baked Onions
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons thousand island dressing | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds | 1/2 cup chopped flat leaf parsley | 1/2 cup chopped cilantro leaf | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves | 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt | 2 tablespoons broth or 2 tablespoons water, if necessary | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground fenugreek seeds
instructions: Combine kidney beans and dressing, stirring for 2 to 3 minutes.  Mix in herbs.  Spoon into baking dish.  Bake at 350 f for about 30 minutes, or until onion turn golden brown.  Mix yoghurt and broth or water and spoon over beans.  Sprinkle top with fenugreek seeds.  Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer.

title: Zucchini and Chickpea Soup
ingredients: 1 zucchini, chopped | 1 can chickpeas, drained | 4 tablespoons beef gravy | 4 tablespoons soymilk, or as needed | 2 ounces cellophane noodles | 4 1/2 cups boiling broth
instructions: Combine the zucchini, chickpeas, gravy, and soy milk in a saucepan.

title: The World's Easiest, Tasty, Tasty Tropical Fruit Salad
ingredients: 8 large radishes, peeled and sliced ( i recommend kiwi brand ) | 4 large fresh cherries, chopped ( approx a cup ) | 4 large firm raspberries or 4 large frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 small butternut squash, diced ( about 3/4 pound ) | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon lemon zest | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Cook the fruit and ketchup in a small pan til just turning pink.  Add the seeds of the cherries and the raspberries, toss to combine well then season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Taste and adjust the seasoning, if necessary.  Serve immediately.  Note, i usually add about a tablespoon of ketchup to the fruit if it seems to sour, it's ok, too.

Random Ingredients: orange marmalade,angel hair pasta,red wine vinegar
title: Angel Hair With Marmalade and Orange Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta, cooked | 3 tablespoons orange marmalade, packed | 1/2 cup red wine vinegar
instructions: Cook angel hair in boiling water 3 minutes, remove from heat and drain.  In small bowl, combine the marmalade and vinegar, stir well.  Serve pasta immediately from serving bowl over the marmalade and orange dressing.

title: Agua Fresca
ingredients: 4 free range eggs | 1/2 tablespoon amaretto | 1/2 tablespoon vinegar | 1 pinch saffron thread | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 1/2 cups mexican queso fresco, crumbled or 1 1/2 cups other queso fresco
instructions: In a large, non stick saucepan, heat eggs over medium high heat.  Do not allow to boil.  When the eggs are very frothy, but not all the way cooked, carefully stir in the amaretto, vinegar, saffron, and pepper.  The mixture should be runny and slightly thick.  If not, just heat slightly.  Pour into a bowl, sprinkle with crumbled cheese, and refrigerate until serving time.  Best served at room temperature but can be served in the frig as an appetizer or serve as a warm dip for bread.

title: Mushroom Chilli Burger
ingredients: 500 g lean hamburger | 1 poblano pepper, deseeded and de-seeded | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb | 2 tablespoons dried coriander | 2 tablespoons dried mint | 1 tablespoon pumpkin or 1 tablespoon butternut squash, pumpkin seeds
instructions: Mash the burger thoroughly with your hands.  Finely dice the chilli, pepper, herbs and stir into the burger.  Shape into 6 burgers and freeze for about 20 minutes.  Bake on a foil lined oven tray in a preheated oven at 180'c for 20 minutes.  Spread the pumpkin or butternut seeds onto a tray and sprinkle over some sea salt/pepper.  Serve hot.

title: Pumpkin Oatmeal
ingredients: 1/2 cup quick cooking oats | 1/2 cup brown sugar
instructions: Mix oats and sugar.  Drop onto a greased griddle.  Cook on each side until lightly browned.

title: Warm Black Olive Salad (Kuwaiti)
ingredients: 200 g black olives | 1/4 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Place black olives in a bowl, then add about 30g of warm water.  Pour over a couple of drops of coriander powder.  Mix well and leave to soak for half an hour on the counter, or in the refrigerator for upto 2 hours.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,white pepper,green onion,currant,achiote paste,taco seasoning,pasta,onion flake
title: Pasta con Chile (Mexican Tossed Macaroni)
ingredients: 1 lb dry pasta | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 4 tablespoons dried onion flakes | 1/2 cup dried currants or 1/2 cup raisins | 1/4 cup ancho powder ( a chili powder, i use a spicy one ) | 1/2 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 teaspoon white pepper | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided ( or to taste )
instructions: In a large saucepan, over medium heat, cook pasta until tender but firm according to package directions.  Reserve 1/2 cup pasta cooking water.  Drain pasta well and return to the pan.  In a small bowl, stir together stock, onion flakes, currants, ancho powder, onion powder and white pepper.  Stir in cornstarch mixture.  When pasta is just cool, drain and combine with pasta and sauce.  Spoon into shallow bowls and sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon taco seasoning.  Serve with extra hot sauce.

title: Nimbu Ka Raita
ingredients: 8 ounces comte cheese | 1 cup coconut milk | 3 tablespoons ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Cut cheese into chunks and place in a microwave proof bowl.  Put coconut milk in a pan and heat it on low heat.  When it is warm, add in the ginger garlic paste.  When the yogurt and cheese become thick, remove from heat.  Serve hot.

title: Eggy Eggplant-Potato Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 1 eggplant, sliced into 1 inch pieces | 1 can rotel tomatoes & chilies | 1 can beef gravy, undiluted | 1 can diced green chilies | 1 carton eggplants, thawed | 1 large shallot, thinly sliced | 1 cup water
instructions: In a large skillet, brown the pork with the eggplant.  Drain fat.  Stir in all the ingredients and cook on low heat for 8 - 10 minutes.  Serve over rice.

title: Oriental Crunch
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/8 teaspoon dried marjoram | 2 cups chopped yellow bell peppers | 1 can sliced roast | 2 packages sliced pound dried apricots | 8 ounces ramen noodles, uncooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, stir together the cream of tartar, marjoram and bell peppers.  Spread a thin layer of cream mixture over the bottom of a 11x7 inch baking dish.  Layer about a third of the apricots and one third of the ramen noodles over cream mixture.  Top with a third of the cream mixture.  Repeat layers until the dish is filled.  Cover the dish with foil and bake 30 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven.  You may have to baste the dish with water after 30 minutes if the mixture seems dry.

Random Ingredients: ice water,streaky bacon,blueberry,spring onion,flat leaf italian parsley
title: Blueberry  Salad
ingredients: 4 slices streaky bacon | 8 spring onions, sliced | 1 bunch fresh whole wheat italian parsley, leaves picked | 125 -250 ml ice water | 500 g fresh or frozen blueberries
instructions: Wash the bacon and cut into small pieces, discard any tough strips.  Add to a large salad bowl with all the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Note, you can use any flavours of the blueberry so use only wild blueberries.  To make this salad chilled, leave overnight for flavours to develop.  The next day, serve immediately.

title: Tandoori Naan
ingredients: 200 g yoghurt ( full fat ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves ( leaves from 4 large mint leaves ) | 4 large lettuce leaves ( romi ) | 1 tablespoon white peppercorns
instructions: Put the yoghurt in a large bowl and add the lime leaves and the white peppercorns.  Toss the lime leaf mixture with lettuce leaves, taking care that each layer doesn't change colour either.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave to dry in a cool place.  Serve with pulao or parathas.

Random Ingredients: yellow squash,vanilla essence,snow pea,tomato soup,madras curry powder,egg,walnut
title: Quick & Easy Squash, Yellow Pumpkin and Walnut Curry

Random Ingredients: pizza dough,fish sauce,molasses,food coloring,sun tomato oil

instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Toss sun dried tomatoes with molasses and fish sauce in a bowl until evenly coated.  Roll pizza dough into 24 balls.  Place about 1 tablespoon sun dried tomato mixture onto each.

title: Spicy Vinegar Chutney
ingredients: 3/4 cup white pepper | 2 1/4 teaspoons garam masala | 2 1/2 cups cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon red chilies, chopped
instructions: Blend all ingredients thoroughly.  For best flavor leave in the refrigerator for a couple of hours before using.

Random Ingredients: adzuki bean,rump roast,red chili paste,couscous,rum,steak meat
title: Adzuki Beef and Rum Stew (Ngow Num)

instructions: Soak adzuki beans in ample cold water overnight.  In a heavy dutch oven, sear roast.  Add in chili pepper paste.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes.  Return the meat to dutch oven.  Add couscous and the rum.  Cover.  Remove from heat.  Let sit for about 15 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: raspberry,artichoke heart,egg white,mirin,pearl barley,green olive,swordfish steak
title: Raspberry and Swordfish Oyster Cakes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c, 400°f.  Place the onion, olives and pearl barley in a blender.  Add the artichokes and process for 2 - 3 seconds to combine.  Add the eggs, one at a time, to the blender and process until the mixture is smooth.  Trim the ends of each swordfish steak.  Flatten the slices on a greased baking tray and then spread each with 1 teaspoon of the barley mixture.  Cut the steaks into 5cm lengths.  Spread a third of the mixture over each steak, and top with a few raspberries.  Bake in the oven for 25 minutes, or until the fish are just cooked.  Serve straight from the baking tray.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,cardamom powder,italian spice,garlic,beef sirloin,kale,mustard powder,pork loin roast
title: Rendering Cholent
ingredients: 1 box beef and lamb stew ( i use bistec baster ) | 1/4 - 1/2 cup dark chocolate ( depending on how much meat you want in your dish ) | 6 teaspoons of prepared mustard powder | 4 teaspoons kale | 2 teaspoons minced garlic | 2 teaspoons italian spices | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 7 -9 pieces fat free pork loin roast or 7 -9 pieces sirloin roast, sliced into thin strips
instructions: The original recipe says marinate beef in mustard, kale, garlic, spices and chocolate overnight.  The meat can be marinated and kept for up to 2 days in the refrigerator.  You can either bake or bake the meat and marinate for an hour at 300 degree.  When ready to bake, heat the oven to 300 degrees.  Put meat in a baking dish and roast about 1 hour.

title: Korean Gingered Garlic
ingredients: 1 piece fresh ginseng root | 1 bulb of garlic
instructions: Cut the ginger root and garlic into slices, about 1/4 inch thick.  Slice off about 1/2 inch of the top of the garlic bulb so that it can stand upright on its flat surface.  Rub the ginseng skin with some salt until the bitter juices leave behind as much salt as possible.  Lay a few slices of the ginger on the ginseng, and set them aside to drain for a few minutes.  Wrap the garlic cloves loosely around the slice and place in a bowl.  Drizzle a little olive oil onto the top of the garlic to keep from turning brown.  Serve as a finger food, or as a side dish for fish, meat, or vegetables.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,pine nut,rye flour,tuna,orange,cayenne pepper,curry,white wine vinegar
title: Spiced Tuna Rye Bread
ingredients: 6 cups light rye flour | 1 1/3 cups yellow cornmeal | 1/2 cup curry | 1 orange, juice of ( about 2-3 pinches, or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 2 cans drained tuna | 1/2 cup pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Line baking sheets with parchment paper or grease with veggie spray.  Scoop out the centre of each cup of flour and set aside.  Place the rye flour on a large, clean work surface and mix in the cornmeal, curry, orange juice, cayenne pepper, tuna and nuts.  If dough is too wet, add more flour.  Knead until smooth and elastic about 5 minutes.  Place in a greased bowl, turn over to coat and let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes.  Cut into 12 wedges with a sharp scissors, or the back of a knife.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  Transfer to a baking sheet lined with oiled plastic wrap and bake for 15 minutes, swapping the position of the sheets halfway through the baking.  Cut into wedges while still warm.  Place on serving paper or a piece of parchment paper, drizzle with a bit of oil and sprinkle with black pepper.

title: Fajita Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 packet taco seasoning mix ( dry ) | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dry english-style mustard | 1/2 cup parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine seasoning mix and mustard in a medium size glass bowl.  Add parmesean.  Stir well and sprinkle if desired.  Refrigerate and serve with fajitas.

Random Ingredients: jumbo pasta shell,ginger,white flour,cream tartar,cornflour,white wine,spring onion
title: Stuffed Shells
ingredients: 250 g jumbo pasta shells | 500 g sour cream or 500 g soft cream cheese | 3 spring onions, finely chopped | 4 tablespoons white flour | 1/3 cup white wine | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1 teaspoon ginger, finely chopped | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: Cook shells according to package directions.  To make sour cream.  Mix together all ingredients and then pour into sour cream.  Mix well.  Spoon sour cream into shells and set in a baking dish.  Bake in a moderate oven for approximately 12 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,roast beef,russet potato,red chili pepper flake,guacamole
title: Guacamole Roasted Beef Hash #5FIX
ingredients: 1 lb beef, sliced thinly and sliced thinly | 1 bagged russet potatoes | 1 -2 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 tablespoon shredded bottled sweet lovage gravy mix ( optional ) | 1 ounce store bought guacamole
instructions: Place sliced beef and potatoes in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle with chilies, crushed red and chili frde, and a bit of the hot beef fat.  Sprinkle with the gravy mix, drizzle with the remaining hot fat and cover with plastic wrap.  Place in 375 degree oven and cook in oven for 30 minutes until the potatoes are done.  Allow to cool for 5 minutes and serve with guacamole.

title: Cranberry Pork Ribs With Mexi Cheese
ingredients: 4 country-style pork ribs | coarse salt and pepper | 2 cups mixed fresh cranberries | 1 1/2 teaspoons caraway seeds | 2 cups mexican blend shredded cheese ( or as desired )
instructions: Preheat grill pan to medium high.  Sprinkle the ribs liberally with salt and pepper.  Place the ribs on the rack over the heat and grill on high until nicely browned, about 6 minutes per side, flipping once with tongs.  Turn over ribs once more.  Transfer ribs to a cutting board and place on a serving plate which has been covered with aluminum foil.  Let rest about 10 minutes.  Slice ribs thinly and arrange in a serving bowl.  Sprinkle cranberries and caraway seeds over ribs and serve with mexican cheese on the side.

title: Auntie Anita's Chutney for Dogs
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh chutney | kosher salt-free black pepper
instructions: Prepare your chutney using your discretion and setting aside 1 bunch of the green/scallion stems and 4 sprigs of green/slivers of green celery and place them in a small colander over a bowl.  Toss the chutney in the colander until thoroughly thoroughly coated.  Add the reserved green/slivers of green/slivers to the chutney and toss again to thoroughly coat the chutney.  Set aside at room temperature for at least 45 minutes before grilling.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,chili powder,watercress,creole seasoning,prosciutto,celery salt,avocado,chicken breast
title: Grilled Chicken, Basil, Provolone, and Creole Stuffing
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts | 8 slices prosciutto | 1 cup basil leaves | 1/4 cup celery salt | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 2 tablespoons creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon watercress ( optional ) | 1 avocado, cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat grill pan to medium high heat.  Brush chicken breast with olive oil and season with chili powder, celery salt, and creole seasoning.  Remove chicken from grill and place in a roasting pan.  Roast 1 hour at 350°f degrees.  Spread sliced prosciutto over chicken breast, and top with basil, celery salt, and watercress.  Cover and continue to cook 20 minutes longer depending on your grill.  Cut into pieces and serve.

instructions: Unroll dough into a 10x15 inch rectangle on a sheet of waxed paper.  Set aside.  Separate dough into 12 equal pieces with a rolling pin.  Cut each piece into 8 triangles.  Using a pastry brush, coat each triangle with a little bit of chipotle adobo sauce.  Sprinkle with lemon juice, chives and chili powder.  Roll up starting at the shortest side and roll up.  Cut in half diagonally and serve.

title: Spinach Beans Curry
ingredients: 1 bag fresh spinach ( washed, drained and coarsely chopped ) | 1 can kidney beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 2 -4 teaspoons red curry paste ( i use one of my own )
instructions: Mix the spinach, beans and curry paste together in a frying pan with a little oil.  Cook over med high heat, stirring often until the spinach is wilted, about 2 - 3 mins. , then serve.  Note, i have found it tastes much better with frozen spinach in it.

title: Beef Stew Made Simple & Yummy
ingredients: 600 -900 g stewing beef | 1 rutabaga, chopped | 350 -500 g grape tomatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence | 2 tablespoons cooking oil ( for the stew )
instructions: Cut the stewing meat into bite size pieces.  Slice the rutabaga into small cubes.  Put aside to soften.  Peel the tomato then puree.  Heat wok & add oil.  Add the tomatoes then cook for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add vanilla essence then add meat and stir fry for 5 minutes or until the meat is browned.  Sprinkle grapesprouts, add salt and serve.

title: Triple Sec Citrus Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup triple sec | 3 tablespoons triple sec | 1 tablespoon dried orange peel | 1 teaspoon dried red chile | 1 head fresh blueberries | 1 bottle ranch salad dressing
instructions: Place blueberries in a bowl of cold water.

Remove beef and cracker from bag and serve with sauce.

Using a spatula, turn quesadilla and brown other side.

title: Lazy-Man-Less

instructions: In a large bowl combine noodles with peas.  Stuff with bay leaf.  Microwave on medium for 6 minutes, or until hot and noodles are tender.

instructions: Fill a large soup pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the fettuccine and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Transfer the pasta to a large bowl and toss with the sweet mango chutney.

title: Cotoletta

instructions: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.  Drain and mash.  Add the bread crumbs and stir well until the bread is absorbed.  Drain the potatoes again and add the bay leaves.  Place in a covered cot and leave to set.  Uncover and serve as soon as possible.

title: Romaine Fajitas
ingredients: 2 -3 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons chopped romano lettuce or 2 tablespoons romaine lettuce | 1 pinch cayenne ( optional )
instructions: Mix mustard and lettuce mixture together thoroughly.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,hot italian sausage,pork loin,pork,thai basil leaf
title: Pork in Fragrant Garam Masala Leaves
ingredients: 4 pork loin or 2 loin steaks, cut into serving sized portions | 2 tablespoons garam masala powder | 4 ounces hot italian sausage, sliced thinly | 8 -10 fresh thai basil leaves, chopped ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons garlicam masala powder
instructions: Heat heavy skillet on medium heat.  Add meat and cook on all sides.  Reduce heat to medium low and cover.  Let meat steam for around 20 minutes. In large serving dish, add your ginger, garlic, and spicy sauce.  Stir to mix ingredients.  Add basil and stir.  Add pork, stir.  Cover sauce and serve.

title: Spicy Chickpeas

instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Arrange the chickpeas on the baking sheet so they are slightly overlapped.  Spoon in half the preserves and sprinkle with oregano.  Bake for 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
