title: Spiced Fritters (For a Rainy Summer Evening)
ingredients:
1 slice whole wheat bread ( i use bob's red mill whole wheat bread ) | 1 slice rye flour | 3 teaspoons split polished steak ( a-kout, your choice.
    - a-my personal favorite is `` coleman's cutty-o'worth '' ) | 5 teaspoons low sodium liquid honey | 2 teaspoons split polished steak ( a-kout, your choice.
    - a-kout, your choice.
    - `` coleman's cutty-o'worth ) | 2 teaspoons dried fenugreek seeds | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/2 teaspoon agave nectar or 1/2 teaspoon liquid honey | 1 -2 teaspoon saya or 1/2 teaspoon soy sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together, it's best to do this early into the day.  Place your hands on a piece of bread and you should see wet water dripping around them, then you don't need to pat it dry.  If you have a wet towel to soak up the excess water that the bread will absorb, gently massage those wet rindings into the bread.  Wash your hands in water.  When the bread is dry, squeeze the bread well with your wet fingers to make sure all that water has dissolved.  This will form air pockets so your utensils will be able to work with the wet food after it's been used up.  Put the croutons on a plate and lightly spray with cooking spray.  Put a large spoonful of croutons into each of your palms, spread them out in a flat circle, and then stretch the croutons to your required size.  This will make them spread out easily.  Put your hands in the pan as well and press down firmly.  These may stick if pressed into the pan, then if they stick, they're not going to shape into circles.  Let them cool for about 10 minutes.  Remove the papery meat that's in your utensils and set it aside.  Use a fork to scrape up any bread clumps that may have broken or stuck to the pan.  It may take as little work as some people like to do.  Using a spatula or your fingers again, scoop up one of the cakes from top of your pan into the crouton.  You can use a knife, spoon, pastry brush or whatever tool you like to keep everything moist from touching your bottom and sides.  Gently flip, and press down again so the crouton begins to form a circle.  It'll become somewhat of a cone.  Use the spatula to press croutons flat against the side of the pan, then you can continue to put the croutons in the pan.  You should have a crumbly base to your finished dish.  If you do, repeat this on top and bottom of second crouton.  This is a good time to get something to go together.  After one or two baking lumps have formed, remove each pan from the pan, cover with plastic wrap, and set aside to cool for a few minutes.  While they get to room temperature, pop the cakes into a preheated 300 f oven for 25 to thirty minutes until slightly golden.  You may need to brush them with more olive oil if they start getting too crisp and dark.  Keep them covered loosely with foil while you continue with the recipe.  These freeze well and are perfect when reheated.  Note, i find it easier to make when you have a pizza cutter, knife or pizza peel, so that the cakes get a nice, smooth coating for 20 to 30 minutes to a hour in a sandwich press before serving, although i do often use my kitchen aid.  Also, if you're adding any meat, add any cooked meat to the croutons before cooki

title: Beet Cheese Wraps
ingredients: 1 small beet, peeled and washed | 12 small pimientos | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 1 cup ricotta cheese | aluminum foil
instructions: Cut beet in chunks on the bias and place in strainer with water to drain well. .  Rinse with fresh water and drain.  Peel off stems and shred beets with cleaver or peeler.  In a pan combine beet, pimientos, cornstarch and salt.  Heat, stirring constantly, on medium high heat until mixture thickens and boils.  Turn off heat.  Stir in cheese and remove from heat.  Fill tortillas with cheese mixture and roll to form 2 inch long logs and place on baking sheet.  Spray with cooking spray and bake in 350 degree oven until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,chicken wing,cardamom seed,brandy,graham cracker crumb,red bell pepper,oat
title: Chicken & Rice Crumbs
ingredients: 1 large red bell pepper | 2 tablespoons brandy or 2 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 cups instant brown rice | 1 teaspoon cardamom seeds or 1 teaspoon cinnamon | 1 3/4 cups instant graham cracker crumbs | 1 lb chicken wings, tips removed ( tips discarded ) | 1 1/2 cups lightly toasted oats or 1 1/2 cups plain soymilk
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees.  Cut bell pepper into 1/4 inch rounds.

title: Pretend Balls
ingredients:
600 g ground beef | 1ziploc ( small cube ) ( optional ) | beef ( or lamb chops or beef rind, etc, etc.
    - )
instructions: Soak the ziploc bag in water for 8 minutes.  Then squeeze it and mix with the ground beef, or lamb, meat grinder etc until all the ingredients are combined well, then set apart.  Once the bag has drained the fat from the meat and mixed with your hands, shape the meat mixture into balls about the size of a ping pong ball.  Make sure you don’t crush the balls though, they should also be smaller and thinner in texture.  Heat a deep fryer to 400.  If you have a deep fryer, that will take less time for this recipe if you don’t have one, because they will cook faster.  Then when the oil is ready, fry the patties for 3 - 4 minutes using 1 teaspoons of oil as a light fry.  Cook the patties for a minute or so on each side to seal in the meat mixture and help keep the gravy slightly pink.  Transfer the cooked patties with a slotted spoon onto a serving dish/dish, pour the gravy over them and serve with bread and a salad or two.

title: Shredded Collard Greens
ingredients: 1 bunch collard greens | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1/4 cup sweet chili sauce | 1/4 cup peanut oil
instructions: Wash the collards well, and slice in half lengthwise.  Place in a bowl, and mix with the rum.  Stir in the sweet chili sauce and blend well.  Cover, and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight.  Heat a large wok over high heat, and fry the oil until it shimmers.  Place half of the collard greens, flat side down, in the wok.  Stir, and pour in the spiced rum mixture.  Cover, and cook for just two minutes or until the greens are tender.  Turn off the heat, and transfer the greens to a large bowl, and sprinkle with salt.  Spoon any liquid from the wok into a clean jar, and refrigerate for an hour.  When ready to serve, garnish with black pepper.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,green olive,lamb,grainy mustard,dijon mustard,chinese bun
title: Mexican Burgers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs lean ground lamb | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 teaspoons coarse grainy mustard | 1/2 cup small green olives, drained with pimento and cut in half | 4 chinese buns, toasted and buttered ( optional )
instructions: If using, place lamb in bowl, add s&w, and mix until well combined.  Shape mixture into 4 burgers, and chill for at least 1 hour or longer.  Combine salsa, mustard, and olives in bowl.  Add burgers to salsa mixture and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Heat a grill pan, or high fat fry pan, and pan fry the burgers for 2 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking.

title: Smoked Spanish Green Olive Halwa
ingredients: 1/2 cup sesame seeds, roasted | 1 cup green olives, unpitted pitted ( such as red ) | 2 cups coffee ( strong ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons smoky spiced coffee ( such as smoky )
instructions: Place all ingredients into a mortar.  Grind to a fine paste with a pestle or an electric blender.  Place the mixture into a clean jar with a sealable lid.  Store in a dark, cool place for up to 3 months.

title: Herring in a Crock Pot
ingredients: 12 herring fillets, rinsed | 1/2 teaspoon saffron ( to taste ) | 1 can enchilada sauce ( 1/2 cup ) | 1 cup frozen peas, thawed | 1/2 loaf rye bread ( sliced ) or 1/2 loaf other soft bread
instructions: Place the herring fillets in slow cooker.  Arrange frozen peas around herring.  In a medium bowl, combine saffron, and 1/2 cup of the enchilada sauce.  Spread evenly over the herring.  Cover and cook on high about 6 hours.  Remove from slow cooker and serve over rye bread or pumpernickel bread.  Garnish with the remaining enchilada sauce.

title: Homemade Worcestershire Sauce for Fish Etail
ingredients: 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 teaspoon lemon extract
instructions: Mix together and store in an icesy tumbler.

title: Gran-Cabbage Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 1 cup cranberry sauce, prepared ( we like the jalepeno ) | 2 cups white sugar | 1/2 - 3/4 cup jalapeno jack cheese
instructions: Core cabbage and cut into slices, about 5 inches think.  In a small sauce pan over medium heat, stir cranberry sauce and sugar into cranberry mixture.  Simmer, stirring and skimming frequently, about 5 minutes.

title: Braised Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken legs, cut up | 6 garlic cloves, minced | 2 cups golden raisins, soaked in hot water until just soft and drained | 2 1/2 cups tapioca flour | 1 cup currants
instructions: Place the chicken in a wide, deep saucepan with the garlic, raisins, and 2 1/2 cups of water.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes.  Drain the chicken, reserving the cooking broth.  Return the chicken to the pan and return it to the cooking liquid.  Stir in the tapioca flour and currants.  Maintain a very gentle simmer and cook gently, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until thickened.  Remove from heat and let cool at least 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: yellow pea,filling,salt,green olive,monterey jack pepper cheese,potato,dark sesame oil,sage leaf
title: Potato Cheese Galette, Martha Stewart
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs assorted round potatoes, such as kirby's, scrubbed, about 6 | 1 teaspoon salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 4 tablespoons fresh minced sage leaves | 24 ounces grated monterey jack pepper cheese or 24 ounces mozzarella cheese | 24 ounces yellow split peas, such as yellow squash ( about 8-10 ) | filling ( optional ) | green olive ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Line rimmed baking sheet with foil.

title: Onion Confit
ingredients: 1/2 cup creme de cacao ( apple butter ) | 2 tablespoons finely minced onions, or to taste
instructions: Pour the creme de cacao into a serving dish, and stir in the onion.  Serve warm.

title: Chinese Buffet Salad
ingredients: 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 2 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon adobo seasoning
instructions: In a bowl, toss together the water chestnuts, catsup and adobo seasoning.  Chill.  When ready to serve, toss with remaining ingredients.

title: Maple Glaze Ziti or Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta, preferably whole wheat | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil, add penne or ziti and cook about 4 minutes or just until al dente.

Random Ingredients: arrowroot,panko breadcrumb,kernel corn,yellow onion,kaffir lime leaf,shortening
title: Spicy Corn
ingredients: 1 medium yellow onion | 3 boxes frozen whole kernel corn ( thawed ) | 5 kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 cup arrowroot | 1 cup panko breadcrumbs | 1/2 cup shortening
instructions: Cut a cube of waxed paper that you can handle with your hands.  Peel and cut the onion into thin rings.

title: Chipotle Shrimp and Beef Brisket on Dutch Oven
ingredients: 1/3 lb peeled and deveined jumbo shrimp | 10 medium carrots, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 large chipotle chile, chopped seeded | 1/2 beef brisket, fat removed and well trimmed | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Coat baking sheet with oil or cooking spray and arrange vegetables on baking sheet.

Random Ingredients: meat broth,nonstick cooking spray olive oil,puff pastry,cooking oat,currant,chili powder
title: Easy Meat or Oat Scones
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray olive oil | 1 package frozen puff pastry ( 12 to 14 scones ) | 1 cup frozen meat broth ( or chicken broth if you're using ) | 1/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 1/4 cup dried currants | 1 teaspoon ground chili powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Place 2 scones on the baking sheet and bake them for 12 to 15 minutes, until golden brown.  Set aside.  Using a pastry bag that is large and about 12 inches long, fill pastry bag with the meat or chicken broth.  Shake the bag to tighten the air bubbles.  Place frozen or chicken broth into a bowl.  Microwave 2 scones for about 2 minutes, until heated through.  Remove from the microwave and place on the baking sheet.  Return to the oven and bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until the tops of the scones are golden.  While the scones are baking, combine all the topping ingredients in a small bowl.  Spoon topping onto the warm scones and bake for about 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Quick and Easy Grape Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 teaspoons vegetable shortening ( i use crisco ) | 1 1/2 lbs grape tomatoes, very ripe, stem removed | 2 teaspoons sesame oil
instructions: Cut the tomatoes in half crosswise and slice them crosswise, then cut the quarters across into 1/2 slices, with a sharp knife remove the seeds.  Spread the slices in a colander and sprinkle lightly with salt.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,pumpkin seed,flour,water,peanut,jalapeno pepper,pineapple tidbit
title: Peruvian Pumpkin Seeds
ingredients: 2 lbs yukon gold potatoes ( about 5 medium, cut in 1/2-to 3/4-inch chunks ) | water ( about 2 cups ) | 1/3 cup flour | 1 cup pumpkin seeds ( raw, hulled, not patted dry ) | 1 cup unsalted peanuts | 4 cups canned pineapple tidbits ( or 4 cups fresh, pineapple ) | 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded, finely chopped | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped unsalted dry roasted peanuts
instructions: Cover potatoes with water.

title: Quick and Easy Crock Pot Chicken Empanadas (Cookies)
ingredients: 12 ounces ground chuck | 12 ounces minced chicken thighs | 1 ounce orange peel, julienne strips | 6 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed and thinly sliced | ice cube | lettuce, warmed | cocoa, for dusting
instructions: Combine meat with orange peel and chicken in a medium bowl.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.  Wet four frozen pastry sheet slices with water, and place on wax paper.

title: Canadian Bacon, Canadian Bacon, and Salmon in a Creamy Baking Soup
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet, skinned, boned, and cut into bite-size pieces | 1 tablespoon butter | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained and chopped | 1/4 cup canadian bacon slices, drained and chopped | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/2 cup canned vegetable broth | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Arrange salmon pieces in a 9x13 baking dish.  In a small bowl, combine the butter, water chestnuts, bacon, oregano, and broth.  Pour mixture over salmon and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Carefully stir soup and remaining bread crumbs.  Continue baking while fish is baking until cooked through and the crumbs are browned on top, about 10 more minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable broth,guacamole,beef bouillon cube,french dressing,milk,veal,beef broth
title: Easy Veggie Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb ground veal | 1 can beef broth | 1 can vegetable broth | 1/2 beef bouillon cube | 1 - 15 ounce can evaporated milk | 1/4 - 1/2 cup french dressing | sour cream, grated cheese
instructions: Brown ground beef in medium skillet.  Drain fat from pan, discard.  Place in crockpot.  Add broth and bouillon cube.  Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours i usually turn my crockpot to high and let cook for an hour.  Add evaporated milk and french dressing.

title: Hungarian Beef and Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/2 cup sweet hungarian paprika ( szeged brand ) | 8 hard cheese slices
instructions: Soak the beef cubes in water for 15 minutes and rinse.  Heat a frying pan till hot, then place about 1 1/2 t.  Of the paprika in the pan, and place the coated beef cubes in it.  Add another 1 t.  Of paprika and cook for 5 minutes on low flame.  Turn them over.  Cook for 15 minutes more.  Arrange the cheese slices on top and continue cooking with the cover on a low flame until the cheese is melted.  Serve over mashed potatoes.

title: Wicklewood's Tomato Grape Salad
ingredients: 5 lbs red seedless grapes ( or a combo of other large varieties of grapes, cut in half ) | 1/2 cup tomato sauce | 8 tablespoons champagne vinegar | pimento-stuffed pimento-stuffed tomatoes ( if using fresh tomatoes, omit pimentos )
instructions: Put the grapes, tomato sauce, and vinegar in a deep bowl.  Toss gently.  Add the reserved tomato sauce and mix well.  Refrigerate for 2 - 4 hours.  Serve cold, if making ahead.  If using fresh tomatoes slice the tomatoes in half crosswise, place in a salad bowl with the grape salad, making sure to keep them attached at the stem, and top with more tomato.

title: Lobster Thermostat
ingredients: 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 lb lobster ( cleaned and in the shell ) | 1 small white onion ( sliced thinly ) | 1/2 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon rice wine | 14 ounces white onions ( finely chopped ) | 14 ounces smoked turmeric | 1 ounce desiccated coconut
instructions: Peel and chop lobster meat into bite size pieces.  Heat oil in a heavy frying pan.  Saute onion until soft.  Add lobster, white onion, shrimp stock, wine and turmeric and mix well.  Cover and cook until lobster is cooked well.  In a small bowl, stir fry 2 cups of onions in a small amount of oil until lightly browned.  Add to lobster mixture and mix well.  Cover and cook until all of the liquid has been absorbed.  Add coconut and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: sesame seed,brown mustard seed,rye bread,miracle whip,whipping cream
title: Rye Breads(Vegan)
ingredients: 2 teaspoons brown mustard seeds | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 5 -8 loaves rye bread | 2 cups whipping cream | 1 cup miracle whip
instructions: Spread mustard seeds on flatbread bread and set aside.  In a large bowl, place brown mustard seeds.  Mix in sesame seeds and set aside.  Cut loaves into small pieces about 2 inches long.  In a saucepan, mix together cream and miracle whip.  Place cream mixture, mustard seeds and sesame seeds.  Cook over low until cream mixture is thickened.  Place bread pieces on a baking sheet and bake in a 400ºf oven for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Let cool.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,pearl barley,cauliflower,soba noodle,orange peel
title: Asian Pea and Barley Pilaf (Rice Cooker)
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( see note above ) | 1 cup cauliflower ( chopped ) | 1/3 cup soba noodles | 1/3 cup sliced orange peel | 2 teaspoons black mustard seeds
instructions: Note, if cauliflower is large or small, cut smaller pieces in half if using larger pieces.  If you are lucky, this is your time to substitute the smaller pieces of cauliflower with cauliflower.  Place barley, cauliflower, soba, orange peel and mustard seeds in the rice cooker, and add 1/4 cup water if required.  Close the lid, and click on the rice cooker.  When timer goes off, stir rice cooker and enjoy note, if there is any liquid left in the rice cooker, it should be absorbed by the finished rice.  Most rice cooker juices should have returned to the inner pot.  If liquid is not absorbed, add water.

title: Spicy Chicken Thighs
ingredients:
8 chicken thighs | 1 tablespoon honey | 1 -2 curry leaf ( or 2 t.
    - fresh sliced )
instructions: Place half a cup of water along the inner rim of a large deep frying pan and set over high heat.  In a small bowl, mix the honey and curry leaves and set aside.  Add the thighs to the boiling water and cook until just cooked through.  Remove from the heat and place in a dish to cool completely.  Using your fingers, remove the meat from the bones and slice into strips about 1/4 inches long and 1/2 inches wide.  Place the pieces of meat back into the water and bring to a boil.  Boil for 3 - 4 minutes, stir to break the meat up and return it to the water.  Simmer, covered, until the meat is just cooked through.  The honey thickens the mixture and becomes aromatic.  Serve warm or cold.

title: BBQ Cranberry-Sauce Lasagna
ingredients:
1 jar barbecued sauce ( or make your own by adding 1/4 cup bbq sauce.
    - if you want a more robust saucy sauce, you can double it.
    - ) | 1/2 cup hot water | 12 lasagna noodles, uncooked | 1/2 cup dried cranberries in juice ( optional )
instructions: Pour hot sauce in small microwavable ramikins.  Microwave on high 5 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes to keep from sticking.  Stir in hot water and cover loosely with plastic wrap.  Microwave on high 15 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes, until hot and bubbly.  Meanwhile, cook lasagna noodles in rapidly boiling, salted water until barely tender.

title: Grilled Mustard
ingredients: 4 tablespoons tarragon vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced garlic or 2 tablespoons minced fresh ginger | 2 tablespoons grated low fat baked bacon or 2 tablespoons cooked ham
instructions: Mix vinegar with garlic/ginger and let sit for an hour.  Place mustard on bun.  If allowed to sit for 30 - 60 minutes before using, you may use it to sear meat just before serving.

title: The Best Raspberry Mango Chutney Tart
ingredients: 2 teaspoons plain flour | 300 ml smooth mango chutney, such as major greys | 1 teaspoon vanilla | soya sauce
instructions: Put flour in a small mixing bowl and add mango chutney, vanilla and soya sauce.  Pour mixture into a greased & lined 23cm tart tin and bake in the oven at 180 degrees celcius for 10 to 15 minutes, or until the base is crisp and browned.  Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before removing from tin.  If you don't have any of the same ingredients for a smooth tart, use an electric hand mixer, and beat until just mixed.  Spoon jam in the pie shell and cook in a very slow oven until the surface is light brown.  Store in an airtight tin.  Can also be taken out and cooked the day before.

title: Chile Horseradish Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce or ( 16 ounce ) can enchilada sauce | 1/2 cup finely chopped mild horseradish | 1/2 cup prepared creamed horseradish | 1 teaspoon ground cumin
instructions: In medium bowl or measuring cup, stir together enchilada sauce through horseradish.  Season with cumin.  Cover, chill 1 hour.  Bring to boiling.

title: Rutabaga Cheese Stuffed With Rutabaga
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs rutabagas | 1 1/4 lbs monterey jack pepper cheese, cut into 1/2 inch dice
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375°f cut 1st piece of skin off of each rutabaga.  Place rutabaga in saucepan with enough water to cover.  Bring to boil.  Partially cover and cook on low until rutabagas are softened, about 15 minutes.  Remove rutabaga from pan and remove skin from rutabaga by tearing rutabaga apart into bite sized pieces.  Place rutabaga in a casserole dish or baking dish.  Top with the pepper grated cheese.  Place in a pre heated oven and bake about 20 minutes or until cheese is bubbly.

title: Copy Cat Hot Sauce (Low Salt and Low Sugar!)
ingredients: 8 ounces taco seasoning | fresh lime juice | 1 dash salt
instructions: Combine everything in a cup and stir.  Sauce can be stored for up to 2 months.

title: Pasta With Shallots
ingredients: 1 tablespoon shallot, minced | 5 ounces farfalle pasta
instructions: Cook pasta to desired doneness as directed on package.  While cooking stir fry shallots in olive oil till light green in color.  When done pour contents of olive oil into a large bowl.  Add cooked pasta and toss till well coated.  Serve.

title: Knorr Maggi (Rice Noodles With Sage)
ingredients: 350 g sausage | 1/2 onion | 300 g rice noodles | 1/2 cup olive oil | 1/2 cup cottage cheese
instructions: Cut the sausages into small pieces and fry to a colour.  Fry onion in olive oil.  Add rice noodles and fry for 30 seconds.  Add cabbage, sausage and a little water.  Turn off the heat and allow to sit until the mixture becomes crispy and dry.  Serve with bread sticks.

title: Spinach in Mint
ingredients: 10 fresh spinach leaves, washed and trimmed | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the spinach and mint leaves.  Spread the mixture evenly on the plate or in the microwave safe sieve.  Microwave on high power level until leaves are softened, about 5 minutes, on high power level.

title: Flamel Shortbread
ingredients: 1 cup palm sugar | 2 teaspoons cream of tartar
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f / 160°c.  Mix the palm sugar and cream of tartar, until mixture is light and fluffy.  Stir in the cream of tartar.  Spread onto an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 20 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Invert and cool.  When cooled completely on a cookie sheet.  Store in an airtight container.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,fettuccine,cauliflower floret,head cauliflower,baking potato,fettuccine pasta,canola oil,white fish fillet
title: Irish Cream Fish and Fettuccine
ingredients: 4 white fish fillets, scaled and diced | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 1 head cauliflower floret, trimmed, chopped | 1 lb small baking potato, unpeeled and cubed | 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 1/2 head cauliflower floret, trimmed, chopped | 2 tablespoons bailey's irish cream | 12 ounces dry fettuccine pasta, cooked ( gluten free if required )
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet.  Add fish and fry until brown, about 3 - 4 minutes.  With a slotted spoon, remove fish and reserve.  Add the remaining oil to the skillet and saute the cauliflower, potatoes and fettuccine for 5 - 6 minutes.  Add the bailey's and saute for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the diced fish and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.  Add the cooked fettuccine pasta and mix thoroughly with the vegetables.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,irish cream,arborio rice,egg wash,lamb,red bell pepper,navy bean
title: Cousi
ingredients: 2 3/4 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes | 3/4 pound boneless lamb, cut into 2-inch cubes | 3/4 pound navy beans | 1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced | 1/2 cup irish cream | 1 teaspoon egg wash | 1 cup arborio rice
instructions: Place the pork, lamb, navy beans, bell pepper, and irish cream in a large skillet.  Season with egg wash.  Cover, and simmer over medium heat for 1 hour.  Stir in the rice, and let stand for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Lite Cuban Pork Chops With Capers and Caper Onions
ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, cut 1/4 inch thick | 2 tablespoons capers, drained | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt or 4 tablespoons sour cream | salt and pepper
instructions: Spread each pork chop with capers.  Combine sour cream with salt and pepper to taste.  Place pork chops on baking sheet and bake at 450 degrees for 35 minutes or until internal pork temperature reaches 175 degrees in a thick center.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 145 degrees.  Slice and serve warm.

title: Chocolates Stuffed With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, defrosted ( or a premade pastry dough- thawed ) | 2 ounces dark chocolate, chopped ( you can use 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa chocolate or a good quality drinking chocolate ) | unsweetened breadcrumbs ( i prefer to use a homemade toasted breadcrumb and a little more if needed! ) | cold butter | sugar
instructions: Lightly flour a baking sheet.  On a lightly floured board roll out the pastry into a rectangle 1/8 inch thick.  Using a 2 3/4 inch star shaped cookie cutter, cut a circle 1/4 inches smaller than the entire pastry circle.  Carefully transfer the dough to the baking sheet and cut a 2 inch slit into the center of the pastry.  Do not cut all the way through, just cut a small opening in the center.  Chop the chocolate and set aside in a bowl.  Dunk each pastry cube into the chocolate, coating the outside of the pastry with breadcrumbs.  Dip or coat the pastry in the breadcrumbs and coat well in the melted chocolate.  Chill the pastry in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.  Transfer a sheet of pastry onto the pre floured baking sheet with a knife.  Bake in a 350°f oven for 20 - 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from the oven and let sit for 5 minutes.  Transfer to a rack and let cool.

Random Ingredients: basmati rice,baby shrimp,bran cereal,cassava,rice krispies,currant,rye bread
title: Rice Krispies Crackers With Fruit Shrimp
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh curry ( i use 1 - 1 1/4 cups, depending on the size of your little finger ) | 1 bag baby shrimp | 1 bunch fresh cassava ( optional ) | 1 small bunch of natural bran cereal ( to taste ) | 8 slices rye bread | 2 -3 cups rice krispies | 1 loaf unsliced rye bread ( for lunch last )
instructions: Cut any fruit shrimp into 1/2 3/4 strips and the baby carrots into 1/4 thick slices.  In a large mixing bowl stir curry, add shrimp, cassava and bran cereal.  Mix well with hands until well coated.  Place bread on countertop in a pile.  Place 1 teaspoon of dough in the centre of each slice of bread.  Place a shrimp slice on top of each piece of bread and roll up the bread like a jelly roll.  Place rolls in a parchment lined baking tin.  I usually bake at my buns for 30 minutes, turn on top of foil and bake until tops are brown, and crispy.  Remove from pan and slice into 1/2 thick pieces.

title: Chocolate-Apricot Balls
ingredients: 1 jar whole green olives, drained | 1 jar dried apricots, drained | 3/4 cup unsweetened cocoa ( or use dark sweetened cocoa )
instructions: Put the olives, apricots and cocoa into the container of an electric blender and run it on low for a few seconds until they become very well mixed.  Drop small bit sized pieces of the mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or wax paper.  Chill them for at least 1 hour, or overnight.  Break them into small pieces while they are still warm.  If you have an afternoon snack, don't forget to eat them.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,dark brown sugar,greek yogurt,chicken meat
title: Chicken Yogurt Phyllo Purses
ingredients: 2 packages frozen phyllo dough, thawed, layers separated and stacked | 3 cups plain greek yogurt, room temperature | 3 cups cooked, shredded chicken meat | 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place 3 sheets phyllo in the palm of your hand.  Brush each sheet with melted butter and lightly spray with cooking spray.  Brush with about 2 tablespoons of melted butter.  Top each stack with 3 - 4 cups of yogurt and 3/4 of the cooked chicken meat.  Fold in the 2nd phyllo sheet and lightly spray one with more butter.  Repeat layering, spraying every layering with butter as before.  Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until tops are browned and phyllo is golden.

Random Ingredients: pearl onion,white bread,pinto bean,eggplant,navy bean,zucchini lengthwise
title: Baked Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup dried pinto beans | 1 cup dried navy beans | 2 eggsplants, peeled and sliced lengthwise | 1/2 lb eggplant, peeled, deseeded, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 can pinto beans, drained | 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise, then sliced lengthwise | white bread, sliced
instructions: Soak the pinto beans in ample cold water until softened, at least 15 minutes and up to 1 day.  Drain well and set aside.  Meanwhile, place the navy beans in a 5 to 6 quart saucepan and cover with water to 3/4 inch below the surface.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 1 hour.  Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature, about 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425°f.  Drain the eggsplant, eggplant and zucchini in a colander set in the sink using paper towels.  Cut zucchini and eggplant into 1/2 inch slices and return to the beans.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, place the pinto beans in a dutch oven over medium high heat.  Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and heated through, about 5 minutes.  Spread the pinto beans out on a large, deep baking sheet.  Place the eggplant and zucchini in the beans.  Top with the sauteed veggies, spoon the bean and eggplant mixture over the sauteed veggies and top with the pinto beans and eggplant skins.  Roast until top vegetables are beginning to brown, about 45 minutes.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place beans on a greased or parchment paper lined baking sheet.  Cut a slit in each to form a pocket.  Arrange canadian bacon slices in rows of 3 rows, slightly overlapping each other on top of the beans.  With the tips of your fingers, pierce several holes in each row to see if the beans have soaked up all the water.  Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees.  Carefully remove from oven and let sit for 5 minutes.  Remove and slice into 1/2 inch slices and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: cayenne,bacon dripping,beef suet,five spice powder,sherry,extra virgin olive oil
title: Bacon and Salt Baked Dry Baked Suet With Sherry
ingredients: 3 lbs beef suet, trimmed | 4 ounces bacon drippings | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 pinch cayenne | 1/2 cup dry sherry
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f coat a 1 pint ramekin with oil, then grease it with a little of the bacon fat.  Rub this with the five spice powder and cayenne.  Wrap the suet in foil and place on top of the bacon fat.  Pour the sherry into the base of the oven and roast for 40 - 50 minutes until the bacon fat has risen, crisp and browned.  Allow to cool, then transfer the saet to a board and cut into slices.

title: Easy Spicy Garlic Chili Peppers
ingredients:
8 dried hot garlic red chile peppers ( i use 1 1/2 lbs.
    - of hot peppers ( or less ) | 2 cans v8 vegetable broth ( can use reduced sodium )
instructions: Remove stems, seed and coarsely chop the chile peppers.  Add chiles and the vegetable broth to a large pot over medium heat.  Cover and bring to boil, then reduce heat to a slow bubble and simmer for 20 minutes or until chiles are very tender and the broth is reduced to about half.  Remove chiles from heat.  Strain chili mixture through a sieve or liquidiser.  Discard solids.  Cool, serve, and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.

title: Spanakaya (Persian Spinach Dip)
ingredients: 12 ounces frozen spinach leaves, thawed | 2/3 cup greek yogurt | 1 cup sliced pepperoni | 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground coriander | 1 tablespoon wasabi powder
instructions: Cook spinach in large nonstick skillet on medium heat, stirring occasionally, about 2 minutes.  Remove from skillet and keep warm.  Add yogurt in skillet to skillet.

Random Ingredients: cream,yellow pea,baking powder,sauce,macaroni,vegemite,great northern bean,garlic head
title: Delish Vegetarian Casserole
ingredients: 1 garlic head | 1 packet sauerkraut ( optional ) | 1 packet yellow peas | 1 packet great northern bean | 1 packet macaroni, cooked ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vegemite ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons hot sauce ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon light sour cream ( optional )
instructions: In a large frying pan, melt the margarine in the microwave and stir fry the garlic just until it starts to turn golden.  Remove garlic from pan, crush and put aside.  Add the drained saurkye beans and green peas.  Heat through.  Sprinkle the vegemite and hot sauce on the vegetables and mix, then return the garlic and saukye beans to the pan.  If any of the ingredients do not taste right, then i recommend adding a couple of drops of vegemite to each cup of hot water and water according to the packet instructions.  Then, combine the macaroni, meat and beans mixture with the saukye mixture.  If not to your liking, put the meat mixture into a casserole dish just a layer or so of casserole.  Sprinkle extra tomato sauce and sour cream on top.  Cook in the microwave until casserole is heated through.  Great as appetizers.

title: Turkey Cabbage and Parsnip Casserole
ingredients: 2 lbs ground turkey | 1 medium bunch parsnip, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 1 small savoy cabbage, tough outer leaves removed, sliced in 1/4 inch slices | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup fresh basil
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the turkey and parsnip.  Remove any excess moisture from the turkey mixture.  Grate the cabbage and spread over the turkey mixture.  Sprinkle with the cheese, basil and salt and pepper.  Roll into a large casserole dish and cover with a lid or several layers of aluminum foil.  Place in the oven at 325 degrees.  Bake for 90 minutes.

title: Grilled Spanish Smoked Salmon Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup white breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 teaspoon instant minced onion | 4 slices smoked salmon | 1/2 - 3/4 ounce taco sauce
instructions: Mix together bread crumbs, paprika and minced onion in shallow dish.  Dip salmon slices into crumb mixture, then press lightly into crumbs.  Allow bread crumbs to dry on a cutting board on all sides.  Place 1 1/2 ounces on a hot surface.  Place a few slices at a time onto hot surface.  Flip them after approximately 30 seconds.  The bottom side may need a little extra time if the salmon is not cooked thoroughly.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke,penne pasta,green pepper,mix,peach syrup,cream tartar
title: Prickly Peaches Pasta Skillet
ingredients: 3/4 lb penne pasta | 3 1/3 ounces peach syrup | 3 tablespoons cream of tartar | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 2 tablespoons chopped green peppers | 1 1/4 cups prepared sweet-and-sour mix
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.  Heat peach syrup, cream of tartar, and liquid smoke in large skillet over low heat, stirring constantly until simmering.  Remove from heat.

title: Gourmet Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 5 lbs pork shoulder, fat trimmed | 1 1/2 tsp dried tarragon
instructions: Preheat grill to high.  Dry off pork shoulder as much as possible, but leave some of the fat and bones intact.  Rub lightly with salt, and sprinkle inside of the pork.  Sprinkle with tarragon.  Grill pork roast to your liking, and allow to rest for 15 to 20 minutes before slicing.

title: Cajun Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 2 packages cremini mushrooms, finely chopped | 1 container cool whip, thawed | 2 teaspoons paprika
instructions: In large bowl, stir together mushrooms, cool whip and paprika.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce,bread flour,tomato,chicken breast half,dark brown sugar,american cheese,green olive,grape
title: Chicken Croquettes
ingredients: 1 package spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon white american cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon green olives, sliced | 1 tablespoon grape, thinly snipped | 1/2 cup bread flour, unbleached | 1 cup canned tomato, chopped, liquid drained, liquid reserved | 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 slices american cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  In a small bowl, mix the spaghetti sauce and cheese.  Place the olives, grape, and bread flour in a pie plate.  Drain the chicken breasts and tear each into bite size pieces.  Put the chicken on a slice of cheese.  Roll them up, and place, 1 inch apart, in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Pour the spaghetti sauce over the chicken.  Bake the chicken in the preheated oven 40 to 45 minutes, until lightly browned and no longer pink inside.

title: Chocolate Frosting - Microwave
ingredients: 450 g good dark chocolate | 450 g shortening | 2 teaspoons dark chocolate ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon celery seed ( optional )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the dish of a electric mixer.  Mix on high for 1 minute.  Pour through a paper coffee filter into a bowl with a pouring spout.

title: Chile Strips(Marinated Asian Spice)
ingredients: 1 cup mint, cut in small pieces | 1 cup oil ( i use sunflower ) | 4 -6 dried chilies ( i use 1 medium hot chili for this recipe ) | 1 teaspoon tamari ( or braggs amino acapulco ) | 1/2 teaspoon icing sugar ( to your taste ) | 4 -6 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound mint, chiles, and tamari with an electric spice blender till finely chopped.  Heat 2 tbs oil together in a small pan and fry the mint and chili mixture til fragrant.  In another bowl, beat together icing sugar, 3 tbs oil, and remaining oil till the mixture has a smooth, glossy coating.  Dip chile strips in mixture and deep fry till crispy.  Drain well and serve immediately.

title: Asparagus Gruyere French Fries
ingredients: 1 large asparagus, cut in half and crosswise ( if the stalks are very thick, cut into 2-inch lengths ) | 1 1/4 lbs large-thin fresh asparagus, cut into 2-inch lengths | 4 ounces fresh medium grated gruyere cheese | 1 tablespoon grated honey | 1 green onion, chopped finely ( green part only ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Snap off tough woody stems & cut the bottoms off the asparagus spears, then slice them into 1/4 inch thick rounds.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and drop in the asparagus pieces & remove them from the water as soon as they're bright green & slightly tender.  You can also steam them in the microwave.  They don't need to be thawed completely.  Just place them in a colander to drain, then toss in the asparagus & toss in the remaining ingredients.  Serve at once, as is normally done.  Note, add more cheese or honey for a sweeter french fry.  Note, the final dish is also nice served with crackers & salad.

title: Plantain Cream With Saffron Roasted Plantains
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe plantains, ends cut off, unpeeled | 1 cup peanut oil | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 6 1/2 fluid ounces double cream | 1 teaspoon saffron | 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary, chopped | 1/4 teaspoon salt | 10 large fresh mushrooms, roasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Remove peel from plantains by cutting into 1/2 inch slices.  Cut slices in half on the diagonal if partially frozen, making 2 lengthwise slices.  Spread each half slice with 1 teaspoon peanut oil.  In a small bowl, mix together the cream, saffron, rosemary, salt.  Add mushrooms to cream mixture.  Dip plantain halves into cream mixture to coat.  Arrange the slices between 2 large sheets of foil.  Bake in a 325°f oven for 45 minutes or until plantains are tender and lightly browned.  Serve with mushrooms.

title: Mexican-American Steak
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sirloin or 1 1/2 lbs top round steaks, 1-inch thick | 2 small onions, sliced | 1 can tomatoes, undrained | 2/3 cup apple juice | 1/2 teaspoon chili powder | 2 packages ladyfingers
instructions: Cut steak lengthwise in half.  Cut crosswise into 6 equal pieces.  Place on foil lined broiler pan.  Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat, turning once, until steak reaches desired doneness, 13 to 17 minutes total for medium rare.  Cool steak for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing thinly.  Meanwhile, combine onions and half of tomatoes and juice in a large slow cooker.  Drain steak, reserving liquid.  Slice meat thinly and arrange, meat edges down, on top of onions.  Sprinkle with the chili powder and arrange dollops of reserved tomato liquid over steak.  Cover.  Cook on low heat setting for 5 to 6 hours or on high heat setting for 4 to 5 hours, or until beef and onions tender.  Add half the remaining tomato juice to a small saucepan and stir in any juices accumulated from meat and onions.  Heat briefly.  Cover.  Cook 15 minutes or until heated through.

title: Smoky Cod
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables ( sliced onions, mushrooms, celery, green onion, red bell peppers, cauliflower, onion ) | 1 1/2 lbs cod ( or other firm white fish ) | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | green bell pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cut fish into 1 inch slices.  In a large skillet, bring mixed vegetables and fish to a boil.  Drain liquid and stir in vinegar and pepper.  Bring to boil and reduce heat to medium low.  Cook, covered, 10 to 15 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.  Serve with warm pita bread.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,romaine lettuce,clove,skirt steak,thai red curry paste,pillsbury pie crust,heavy cream
title: Thai Skirt Steak and Lemon Potato Pizza
ingredients: 1 package pillsbury pie crusts | 1 1/2 lbs skirt steaks, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil | 2 teaspoons thai red curry paste | 1 large yukon gold potato, peeled and cut into 1/3 inch dice ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 12 leaves romaine lettuce, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 1/2/2 cups heavy cream | 2 -3 whole cloves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f in a large bowl, combine the pie crust dough with the skirt steaks, oil and curry paste.  Transfer the meat to a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until the mixture is crisp and golden brown.  While the crust bakes, prepare the potatoes, in a medium pot of boiling water, cook the potatoes for 9 to 12 minutes or until tender.

title: Blueberry and Saffron Salad
ingredients: 1 pound blueberries | 6 yellow onions, sliced | 4 green peppers, sliced | 2 tablespoons powdered saffron, crumbled
instructions: In a large bowl layer fresh blueberries, onions, green peppers and saffron.  Toss to coat.  Cover and chill before serving.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,parmigiano reggiano cheese,spring wrapper,mint sprig,soymilk
title: Gyoza Pastries With Mint
ingredients: 1 package spring roll wrappers | 3/4 cup soymilk | 1/2 cup grated grana padano or 1/2 cup grana padano | olive oil flavored cooking spray | mint sprig ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine milk and soymilk in medium saucepan over medium heat.  Place over medium heat and bring all up to a boil to reduce slightly.  Dip the center of each wrapper into skim milk soymilk paste and place a small dollop of the yogurt mixture along one edge of the wrapper.  Fold over to fully form.  Repeat with remaining wrappers and yogurt mixture.  Coat a skillet with cooking spray, place in pan, and heat on the burner.  Fry the pastries with a little olive oil flavored cooking spray, 3 - 4 minutes per side, until golden brown and puffy.  Remove from pan and sprinkle with chopped mint leaves.  Top with a mint sprig.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni sausage,mustard powder,mini chocolate chip,caraway seed
title: Sausage & Pepperoni Appetizers
ingredients: 1/2 lb hot italian sausages | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 teaspoon mustard powder | 1/4 cup miniature chocolate chip
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Brown sausages, drain.  Return sausages to pan.  Add caraway seed, mustard and chocolate chips.  Spread mixture on cookie sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes or until hot.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper,galangal,chili powder,clove,plain flour,coriander powder,sauerkraut,cream cheese
title: Pork and Sauerkraut Dip
ingredients: 1/2 lb sauerkraut, drained, liquid reserved | 1 teaspoon ginger ( peeled and crushed ) | 1 red chili pepper ( deseeded and chopped ) | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon clove ( whole ) | 4 tablespoons cream cheese ( softened ) | 1 teaspoon plain flour
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and refrigerate for at least one hour, or longer in the fridge if you want it to be really tasty.

title: Sourdough Crock-Pot Baked Chicken, Goose and Pork
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs chicken tenders, cut in 2 inch sections | 1/2 lb pork, cleaned and cut into 2 inch sections | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried herbs | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh sage, cut finely | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence or 1/2 teaspoon basil, crushed | 2 teaspoons aged vodka | 2 slices sourdough bread, toasted and buttered
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees farenheit.  Line a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker with foil.  Arrange chicken in an overlapping circular pattern in a large bowl.  Combine pork with seasonings and pour over chicken.  Sprinkle toasts with cumin.  Cover and cook on high, setting 6 1/2 hours.  Uncover and cook on high for 40 - 45 minutes longer or until meat is cooked through and no longer pink.  Toast bread, cut into 6 thick slices.  Serve with baked chicken and sauce on the side.  Serve with sauce from crock pot.

title: Coconut-Pumpkin Fritters
ingredients: 1 packet dried chickpea flour ( chickpea-flavoured flour ) | 400 ml coconut milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c.  In a medium bowl, mix together the chickpea flour and coconut milk.  Divide between 2 1/2 cup capacity ramekins.  Bake 15 - 20 minutes.  Cool fritters for 5 - 10 minutes before lifting out onto wire racks.

title: Garlicky Barley Ranch Salad With Vinegar and Strawberries
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley, rinsed and drained | 1/2 head iceberg lettuce, shredded ( may sub baby beet leaves ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne ( to taste )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the barley, lettuce, vinegar and cayenne.

title: Grilled Salmon With Saffron-Peach Sauce - Arrabiata Al Saffron
ingredients: 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 2 tablespoons pimento-stuffed green olives ( or other black or black walnut halves ) | 1/2 teaspoon saffron | 1/8 teaspoon paprika | 1/8 cup orange paprika or 1/8 cup yellow paprika | 2 spring onions, green parts only, minced | 1/3 cup canned sliced pineapple chunk, diced | 1 1/4 lbs salmon, cut in 1 1/2-to-2-inch thick slices
instructions: In small bowl, combine chicken broth, 1 tbsp of the pimento stuffed green olives, saffron and paprika.  Tie bag or shallow container on top of lid to blend.  Pour into small, heavy saucepan.  Place over medium heat.  Place remaining 1/2 tbsp pimento stuffed green olives, saffron, paprika, and the remaining ¼ cup onion and pineapple in separate small bowl.  Add to broth along with orange paprika.  Bring to boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until sauce has thickened slightly.  Preheat grill for high heat.  Remove salmon from sauce and set aside.  Brush salmon with remaining pimento stuffed olives.  Place fish on an oiled grill rack over medium hot coals.  Cook until opaque throughout, about 2 minutes on each side.  Place fillets on serving plate and serve with sauce.

title: French Fried Onions (Oamc)
ingredients: 6 large sweet onions, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a non stick fry pan on medium high heat.  Place onions in pan and brown on all sides.  The idea is that they cook slowly.  This will result in a softer and somewhat tender fried onions.  Add salt and pepper as desired.  When onions are translucent, remove from pan onto paper towels to absorb excess grease.

Random Ingredients: queso blanco,cream corn,chili oil,macadamia nut,pineapple,golden raisin
title: Encampados De Queso Blanco
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream or 1 cup mexican crema | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can crushed pineapple | 3/4 cup golden raisin | 12 macadamia nuts ( optional ) | chili oil ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.  Serve on your favorite tortilla and garnish with additional chilies and nuts if desired.

Random Ingredients: steak,asafoetida powder,harissa,potato lengthwise,thai red curry paste,bread crumb,thyme
title: Thai Roti Grilled Flank Steak
ingredients: 3/4 cup plain bread crumbs | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme | 1 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons harissa | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 2 teaspoons finely chopped sweet potato lengthwise | 1 1/4 pounds flank steak
instructions: Preheat a grill for high heat and lightly oil grate.  Mix bread crumbs, thyme, asafoetida, harissa, curry paste, sweet potato lengthwise, flank steak, and 1 teaspoon water in a shallow bowl.  Roll steak out into a rectangular shape to 1/4 inch thick.  Score both sides of the steak using a sharp serrated knife.  Rub the prepared filling onto the steak.

Random Ingredients: chambord raspberry liquor,artichoke heart,red enchilada sauce,romaine lettuce,green chilies,english cucumber,monterey jack cheese
title: Truffles of Chile
ingredients: 1 bottle quartered chambord raspberry liquor ( or raspberry flavored ) | 4 packages pre-washed romaine lettuce, romaine, texas, romaine, and iceberg-filo mixed salad | 4 large english cucumbers, peeled seeded and sliced thin | 1 can chopped green chilies | 1 can marinated artichoke hearts, drained and quartered | 1 can red enchilada sauce ( mild or hot ) | 1 package monterey jack cheese, shredded
instructions: Strain raspberry liquor into large bowl, and allow to cool.  In large bowl, mix russian lettuce, romaine, cucumber, chilies, artichokes, and enchiladas.  Cover.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,cilantro,cumin powder,italian breadcrumb,pork loin,coffee powder,yellow mustard seed,kirsch
title: Schweinekuchen (Danish Breaded Pork Loin With Cumin)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless pork loin | 5 cups italian breadcrumbs | 1 cup cilantro, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 2 tablespoons prepared yellow mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon ground cumin powder | 2 tablespoons instant coffee powder | 3/4 cup kirsch
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, scrape the excess fat from the inside of the loin.  This will give you a pocket for stuffing and keep it dry.  Cut into approximately 1 1/2 wide by 3 wide pieces.  Place into a shallow pan, drizzle with water, and cover.

title: Leprechaun's Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 package dried porcini mushrooms | 3 tablespoons cream of chicken soup | 1 teaspoon chat masala
instructions: Place dried porcini mushrooms in boiling water for 3 minutes.  Drain the soaking water from mushrooms in a bowl.  Reserve the liquid and mushrooms for another soup meal.  Dip mushrooms in a small cup of the mushroom soaking liquid and transfer the liquid to a blender, add the cream of chicken soup, chat masala and reserved mushroom liquid.  Blend the mixture until smooth, adding more water if necessary.  The mixture will be sludgy at first, it will thicken as it bakes.  Gently stir in more of the reserved mushroom liquid in small amounts and serve immediately.

title: Shrimp (Andalucia) with Sauces
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped hard salami | 2 ounces sliced pecorino cheese, or more to taste | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 2 pounds large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place salami and pecorino cheese in a large bowl.  Add spice, and mix until well blended.  Add shrimp, toss to coat.  Transfer to a baking dish, and bake 15 minutes in preheated oven.  Serve hot.

title: Sweet Potato Sweet
ingredients: 2 kg sweet potatoes ( kent of about 800g total weight ) | 1 tablespoon icing sugar ( i use icing sugar caster sugar ) | 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 2 tablespoons shallots, minced
instructions: Cook the sweet potatoes in boiling water until tender when pierced with a skewer, about 25 minutes.  Drain and allow to cool.  Slice the sweet potatoes lengthways into 5mm slices.  Remove any excess skin off the sweet potatoes, peel and cut into chunks.  In a bowl, mix all the ingredients together.  Pour the mixture into a non metallic baking dish that is just big enough to hold the sweet potato slices. .  Bake in a hot oven for about 30 minutes or until just set.  Allow to set in the oven for about 15 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack to drain or storing in airtight lidded container.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,garlic salt,basmati rice,cointreau liqueur,pesto,grand marnier,peanut butter
title: Coconut Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, not instant | 2 cups coconut milk or 2 cups coconut cream, i used low fat | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 cup pesto ( i use basil & garlic or olive oil ) | 1 teaspoon grand marnier ( or other orange-flavored liqueur ) | 1 tablespoon cointreau liqueur | 2 tablespoons peanut butter
instructions: Place coconut milk on the stove on medium setting or in the microwave for about 40 seconds, until hot, and bring to a boil.  Add the rice, stir/mix, and mix until all the coconut milk is absorbed.  Cover and set aside on low setting.  After the rice has absorbed all the water, stir in the garlic, pesto, grand marnier, and peanut butter.  I like the texture nice and creamy, however if necessary i put a lid on it for a few more minutes so that some can melt.  Add the coconut milk to heat thoroughly but not too heavily.  It will be thick.  Serve immediately either warm in individual bowls or put into individual bowls, and then serve with fresh fruit or cream.  This also works well for soups.  If this is added to warm chicken or pork, mix this in with the rice.  I use pesto and grand marnier to season the chicken, and the coconut milk makes for the delicious puddings we make.  You may serve the coconut rice pudding in a small casserole dish, or serve as a side dish to a fresh fruit/rice salad, and have it served on the side.

title: White Wine Pasta (Pasta Flossai)
ingredients: 300 g plain flour | 150 g of white wine ( a couple of good scum )
instructions: Combine the flour, wine and butter in a large bowl.  Drain most of the liquid out of the bowl.  Make a well in the centre of the flour and pour in the wine.  Begin whisking in the wine.  The pasta should be as soft as you can handle it when it starts dripping through the wall of the bowl.  If it is too dry, add up to two tablespoons of boiling water.

title: Sauce for Chicken
ingredients: 1/3 cup dark brown sugar | 2 tablespoons pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Whisk ingredients together in a small bowl.  Refrigerate until ready for use.  In a saucepan over medium heat, combine pineapple juice and worcestershire sauce and warm through.  Pour sauce into chicken cavity, if desired.

title: Irish Guacamole
ingredients: 3 avocados | 1/2 cup barley
instructions: Halve, pit and peel avocados.  Place in a large mixing bowl.  Peel and dice garlic.  Add to avocado and mash gently with a fork.  Add more garlic if it is not easy to mash.  Add barley and mix gently.  Serve with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: confectioner sugar,black eyed pea,white sugar,pie crust,tomato puree,nutmeg,bell pepper
title: Crepe II
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds black-eyed peas | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 1 pie crust, crushed | 1 can tomato puree | 4 bell peppers, chopped
instructions: Place peas in a pan, cover with water, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, and simmer for 1 hour, or until tender.  Drain, and set aside.  Preheat oven to 200 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix together 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar, confectioners' sugar and nutmeg.  Place crushed pie crust in a shallow dish.  Fill with the bean mixture, and spread the remaining 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of confectioners' sugar/nutmeg mixture on top.  Bake in the preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes, or until brown and bubbly.  Place the bell peppers in a small saucepan, and fill with water.  Bring to a boil, and cook for about 15 minutes, or until tender.  Remove from heat, and drain.  Place the cooked peas in a serving bowl, and sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons of confectioners' sugar.  Serve with remaining tomato puree in an 8x8 inch baking dish.  You can also make these ahead of time, cover, and freeze.  To reheat, cover, and in a double boiler over barely simmering water for 30 minutes, to reheat completely.

title: Mesquite Queso Blanco (Cheese Salad)
ingredients: 150 g brinjals ( sliced chiles such as vino or hornon, seeded and cut into 5 mm wide strips ) | 150 g queso fresco ( or similar ) | 2 tablespoons white wine vinegar
instructions: Roughly chop the brinjals and place half and ¾ of the pieces in a jar with 1 tbsp water.  Cover with vino, seal and shake to mix.  Add remaining brinjal, cover and shake.  Divide among your individual salad plates and sprinkle with remaining crumbled queso fresco.  Refrigerate until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: oregano leaf,chicken stock vegetable,anchovy,raspberry liqueur,hard egg,honeydew melon,baking powder
title: Grilled Honeydew Salad With Raspberries, Baked Eggs, and Anchovies in Raspberry Sauce
ingredients: 2 small honeydew melon | 4 hard-boiled eggs | 4 teaspoons raspberry flavored liqueur | 4 anchovies, anchovy fillets | 3 tablespoons chicken stock or 3 tablespoons vegetable stock plus 2 teaspoons vegetable oil, divided | 2 teaspoons pure dried oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°.  Brush the melons with the liqueur.  Place on a baking sheet and bake at 400° for 15 minutes until firm but tender.  Cool, peel and dice the fruit.  Arrange in a bowl.  Top with the eggs, anchovies, and a few oregano leaves.  Mix the vinegar and 2 teaspoons of oil together and drizzle over the salad.  Sprinkle with the remaining oregano leaves, place on the grill, and bake at 400° for about 10 minutes or until the mixture is set.  Cut into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Sweet Wine Salad (Tastes Like Carmel Cottage Cheese)
ingredients: 2 boxes frozen spinach, thawed, drained and squeezed dry ( like normal, but thawed and squeezed dry ) | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1/4 cup marsala wine | 1 tablespoon fresh grated parmesan seasoning salt | 1/2 tablespoon sugar syrup
instructions: Drain both cans of spinach, if necessary.  Combine all ingredients except the sugar syrup in a small saucepan or saute pan.  Cover and shake to combine.  Lower heat, simmer covered about 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and immediately stir in the sugar syrup.  Cover and chill in refrigerator.  Note, you may not need to defrost your spinach, depending on how cold you want it.

Random Ingredients: poblano pepper,hot chili pepper,soya sauce,salt cod fish,center pork chop,cajun seasoning,mushroom cap,anisette
title: Cajun Fried Fish
ingredients: 2 center-cut pork chops, about 1 3/4 inches thick, flattened slightly | salt codfish ( about 2 1/2 ounce portions ) or salt shrimp ( about 2 1/2 ounce portions ) | 2 tablespoons soya sauce ( low sodium ) | 8 small white mushroom caps ( about 3 ounces ) | 1/8 teaspoon crushed hot chili pepper | 1 dash anisette ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon cajun seasoning ( to taste ) or 1/2 teaspoon emeril's original essence ( to taste )
instructions: Spray a large nonstick frying pan with cooking spray or use 1 tablespoon for oil or lightly oil grate the pork on large holes of a box grater and season with salt, then pat fish into an even 3 inch patty, pressing down slightly to ensure even coating.  Repeat with the shrimp, codfish or pork, making more of more than four patties.  When all patties are on, coat in a thin coating of the soya sauce and season with salt and the spices.  In a nonstick frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil or spray lightly with cooking spray or lightly oil a griddle.  When the pan is hot, add the patties and fry on both sides till no trace of pink remains.  Transfer to a serving plate covered in foil.  Repeat.  Keep warm in a 250f oven.  Remove stuffing from pan, allowing excess oil to run off.  Return skillet to burner and add remaining tablespoon oil, mushrooms, chili peppers, and remaining ingredients. Divide dough into 12 equal portions and place on greased cookie sheets, or a floured baking pan.  Let rise until nearly double, about 30 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f. title: Portuguese Clamato

instructions: Wash clams thoroughly in cold water remove the heads and shell, leaving about 2 cm shell, removing any large clams at the base of the shell you have left.  Rinse clams under running water, and discard those which fail to close to the top of the clams, and rinse them completely under cold water.  Transfer clams to a microwave safe bowl, piling down the clams by placing them in one single layer, cover and cook on high power for 4 - 6 minutes, checking and stirring now and then.  Remove clams, discarding any clams that fail to close to the top, and leave to cool whilst you cut up the onions.  Slice snow peas thin, remove strings, and chop into matchstick size pieces. Spoon onto plates and garnish with spring onions.

title: Mama Zuquinis  Apple Rice Gateau

instructions: Preheat grill and prepare the skewers with soaked bamboo skewers.  Peel shrimp.
