title: Artichoke Manicotti
ingredients: 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, undrained | 1 bay leaf | 1/4 teaspoon ground anise seed | 1/4 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup marsala wine | 5 drops red food coloring | 1 package manicotti | 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine artichokes, bay leaf, anise, and anise seed.  Cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours and up to overnight.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook manicotti at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain.  Place drained manicotti into a large pot with enough lightly salted water to completely immerse the pasta.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the pasta is tender but firm to the tooth, about 12 minutes.  Drain.  While the manicotti are cooking, pour the wine into a wine glass measuring cup.  Microwave, uncovered, on high until hot, about 1 minute.  Stir in the cooking wine, food coloring, and mustard seeds.  Serve the manicotti topped with the artichoke sauce.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,egg white,cannellini bean,chile paste,hazelnut,dark sesame oil,green onion,vanilla yogurt
title: Chile-Egg White & Hazelnut Sushi Roll
ingredients: 2 packages sushi rice ( i use king arthur sushi rice ) | 1 can cannellini beans, drained and chopped | 1/3 cup chile paste ( or more to taste ) | 14 ounces fat free vanilla yogurt, greek-style preferred ( full fat or fat free ) | 1/2 cup chopped hazelnuts | 4 green onions, sliced ( including tender green tops ) | 1 teaspoon dark sesame oil | 1 egg white, lightly beaten
instructions: Heat oven to 375f degrees.  Prepare rice according to package instructions.  Drain and rinse well under cold water.  Drain well.  Set aside.  Combine bean curd, chile paste, beans and yogurt in a food processor and process until smooth.  Stir in nuts, onions and sesame oil.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, cover with foil and spray with cooking spray.  Roll sushi mixture into 20 - 1 1/2 x 12 inch rectangle, then roll up and pinch seam to seal well.  Seal ends.  Repeat with remaining rolls and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes.  Using bamboo skewers, thread 3 rolls, 1/2 cup bean curd mixture, and an egg white each.  Cooks note, cook 1 hour and 15 minutes @ 350f degrees, or until instant read thermometer reads 160f for medium or well done.

Random Ingredients: mustard,safflower oil,maple syrup,bean,apple juice,fast rising yeast,garlic powder
title: Apple "Bread" Bread Machine
ingredients: 1/4 ounce fast rising yeast | 3 cups apples juice | 3 1/2 cups dry beans ( or other sweet potato mix ) | 3 teaspoons safflower oil | 3 teaspoons mustard | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 3/4 cup maple syrup
instructions: Add ingredients to your bread machine in the order specified.  Process on the maple syrup / butter / sugar / vinegar if desired.  For a sweeter taste place the dry ingredient in a separate container.  Add water if needed.  Also for a looser taste remove the dry ingredients / blend/process to mix with the wet.  If desired add more maple syrup or/or butter &/or/or mustard.  To bake on the pan or to freeze for later use, place on a tray/freeze proof dish.  If freezing for later use, place the frozen ingredients in a plastic bag, close lid and let sit for about 5 days.  When ready to bake, heat the oven to 400 f or gas mark take a few bread pieces and cut in half, or if desired, with a sharp knife.  Brush half the dough with melted butter.  Place bread cut side up on oven tray and bake for approximately 13 minutes, or until crust nicely browns.  Serve with jam &/or jam, or icecream / vanilla ice cream – and/or/or icecream/ice cream / fruit / strawberry jam.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: iceberg lettuce,water chestnut,turnip,orange,mustard seed,cocoa powder,corn syrup
title: Chopi (Filipino Turnip Salad)
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 quart water chestnuts, sliced | 1 cup turnip, thinly sliced | 1 orange | 1/4 cup corn syrup | 1/4 cup cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons water | iceberg lettuce, leaves separated and washed
instructions: Heat a heavy skillet.  Add mustard seeds and fry on low heat until they begin popping.  Add water chestnuts and turnip and allow to simmer for about 25 minutes.  Wash and dry lettuce thoroughly.  In a blender or food processor, blend orange with corn syrup and cocoa and blend until smooth.  Add to salad and serve.

title: Taco Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package ramen noodles | 1/4 cup irish cream | 1/3 cup taco seasoning mix
instructions: Boil ramen noodles.  Drain and stir in taco seasoning mix until well mixed.  Chill the noodles in the refrigerator.  When ready to serve, combine chilled noodles and sour cream until blended.

Random Ingredients: pea,vanilla sugar,dark rum,chili pepper flake,chicken broth,broth,tabasco sauce,walnut half
title: Walnut-Pea-And-Rum-Spiced Roast Chicken
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh peas, washed, dried and picked over | 2 1/2 cups chicken broth | 2 1/2 cups walnut halves | 1/4 cup dark rum ( i like myers ) | 2 teaspoons red chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar | 3 teaspoons tabasco sauce | 2 tablespoons chili peppers, roasted ( or paste of your choice )
instructions: Add peas into boiling water.

title: Pasta With Cabbage and Green Cabbage
ingredients: 11 ounces farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 2 pounds green cabbage, shredded | 1 cube chicken bouillon ( optional )
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add the farfalle pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,savoy cabbage,lemongrass,phyllo pastry,red enchilada sauce,rice noodle
title: Red Curry Phyllo Wraps
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 1 1/2 tablespoons cooking spray ( i use pam oil, a great option if you have some ) | 1 lb savoy cabbage, shredded ( or other small cabbage of your choice, if, for vegan omit this ) | 2 tablespoons chopped lemongrass ( finely julienne-cut ) | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons cooking spray ( if you have some ) | 3 cups packed shredded savoy cabbage, if you can get it | 1 jar red enchilada sauce ( or other chilies ) | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets, thawed if frozen
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Add shredded cabbage and lemon grass, and cook, stirring frequently and scraping bottom of pan with a wooden spoon constantly, until cabbage is crisp tender and moisture evaporates, about 5 minutes.  Add the enchilada sauce and stir until incorporated, about 3 minutes.  Set aside to cool to room temperature.  Preheat oven to 375°.  Lightly spray a 12x18 inch sheet baking dish or jellyroll pan with oil.  Lay 1 phyllo sheet on work surface and brush with oil, then sprinkle with a little water.  Brush with a little water if you feel creative.  Cover with a second phyllo sheet, brushing with more oil.  Spread 2/3 cup cabbage mixture on phyllo sheet, then top with 2/3 cup cabbage mixture.  Brush with more oil, then sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt.  Repeat until 3 more sheets are layered with cabbage mixture, 1/2 tsp salt.  Repeat for the 3 remaining sheets, or until all the ingredients are used up.  Cut a slit in the corner of each wrap, cutting down both sides.  Use a serrated knife to cut a slit through the top corner of the wrap.  Place the wraps in the prepared baking dish, brush with any remaining oil, and sprinkle with a little water if needed.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 30 to 45 minutes, or until puffed and lightly brown on top. .

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,mango,white wine vinegar,vegetable oil cooking spray,red potato,red onion,red cabbage
title: Mango & Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 large red onion, finely thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 3 cups red cabbage, thinly sliced | 2 red potatoes, thinly sliced | 5 tablespoons white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 mangoes, cut into 1 cm wedges
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Divide the onion evenly amongst the serving plates.  Place the tomatoes, cabbage, potatoes and vinegar in a bowl and add the oil.  Season well and toss together.  Stir in the mangoes.  Pour the dressing over the salad, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and serve immediately.

title: Cranberry Chicken Taco Meal
ingredients: 2 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts | 2/3 cup crumbled canned mexican-style stewed tomatoes, undrained | 2/3 cup cranberry sauce or 2/3 cup chopped fresh cranberries | 2 scallions, chopped | 1 small scallion, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken in a large nonstick skillet and coat with cooking spray.  Add tomatoes, cranberry sauce, scallions, and green onions.  Heat to boiling.  Cover and cook over medium heat 10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.  Remove chicken to a bowl.  Skim fat from skillet.  Stir chicken and sauce mixture.

title: Spicy Italian Screwdriver Dip
ingredients: crushed ice | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Punch holes through a plastic bag or a hole punched in the bag with a star shaped peeler that comes with a star tip.  Place ice onto ice.  Drop the star into the ice, then drop in the red pepper flakes.  Shake bag if necessary to thoroughly coat all in liquid.  Serve immediately with cocktail celery sticks.

title: Chicken & Beef
ingredients: 1 -2 kg chicken piece ( breast, drumsticks, thigh, even breast ) | 4 tablespoons corn oil ( or any oil you have )
instructions: Cut chicken into large pieces and brown in hot oil.  Transfer to ovenproof dish and bake about 1 hour in a moderate oven.  Remove chicken and brown in the same pan.  Return all ingredients to the oven and bake about 1 - 1 1/2 hours or untill the meat seems done.  This can be served hot or cold, with rice, lentils & salad.

Random Ingredients: liquid smoke flavoring,black mustard seed,green mussel,chili oil,shell pasta
title: Japanese-Style Shell Fish
ingredients: 5 1/2 lbs firm and white fish, cleaned | 1 tablespoon coarsely cracked black mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons chili oil | 1 tablespoon chili oil | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke flavoring | 1 lb large shell pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Place fish in a large, resealable plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,dill weed,corn,lemongrass,cheese,snow pea,vinegar,non dairy topping
title: Rainforest Veggie Salad
ingredients: 3 cans non-dairy frozen fruit ( i love to use strawberries, papaya and blueberries ) | 2 lemongrass | corn, ears ( optional ) | 1 packet frozen snow peas, jumbo size | 1 cup tasty cheese ( i like colby ) | 2 cups chopped mild veggies, such as broccoli
instructions: Slice lemongrass length ways, then slice into long slivers.  If you like, place in a single layer on a plate or in the freezer.  This will cause moisture from zest in the lemongrass to cook faster and become mushy with no tough bits stuck to the base.  Chop lemongrass coarsely, then chop coarsely.  Place frozen fruit in a bowl.  Slice lemongrass thinly, then slice into half moons.  Place lemongrass, lemon grass, 1 t of the curry powder, snow peas and cheese in another bowl.  Drizzle with some lemon juice to get your desired spiciness.  You don't need to dress it up, but i do encourage people to add a dash of sugar if they wish.

title: Grated Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 lb sharp cheddar cheese | 1/4 cup tahini | cumin powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Pound the cheddar and then sprinkle with the tahini and cumin powder.  Spread into a flat 9x13 baking dish.  Bake 20 minutes.  Cut into squares or wedges for dipping, if desired.

Random Ingredients: hot chili sauce,shaoxing wine,mango,corn,thyme,port wine,granny smith apple
title: Roasted Cantaloupe With Mushrooms, Apple and Glaze
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs assorted fresh mushrooms, such as chanterelles, oyster, crimini and scallions, halved | 1/3 cup port wine or 1/3 cup sherry wine, divided | 1 1/2 lbs granny smith apples, cored, peeled, cored, quartered and sliced | 3/4 cup sweet corn, frozen corn, thawed | 1 tablespoon thyme, dried, or 1 tablespoon fresh thyme, plus more, for garnish | 1/8 - 1/4 cup hot chili sauce | 1 tablespoon shaoxing wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange mushrooms on prepared baking sheet.  Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes, or until tender.  Stir wine.

title: Homemade Cranberry Scones
ingredients: 300 g dried cranberries ( or a mixture that has been rehydrated ) | 175 g plain flour ( or a mixture of whole wheat, gluten-free and gluten-free )
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°c / 425°f.  Using a strong kitchen base, stir the currant mixture, and then sprinkle in the flour.  Knead the dough well until the dough is smooth and elastic.  Cover with a clean tea towel and let rest for half an hour if your family are sensitive to gluten.  If you have any excess dough left on the pastry it will be tasty, and easier to handle when it rises slightly.  With your hands, cut roundishish balls from the dough, and then cut those into wedges, crossways, or scallop like size.  Place on a baking tray lined with baking paper, brush or spray with water and scatter generously with sugar.  Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes, until lightly golden brown around the sides and topping is firm to the touch.  Variation, after the 15 - 20 minutes, place all the topping ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Simmer, uncovered, for a few additional minutes, until the butter is melted and the topping is very rich.  Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.  Variation, use fresh raisins or currants to sweeten the topping.  Any other variation can be used.  You may also add sugar, berries, dried cherries or dried cranberries to the topping before baking.  Variation, sprinkle the flour or currants with a little extra flour, before adding the sugar.  This flavour will be quite strong.  If this fails, add a little plain flour or extra of the currants and raisins.  If the topping is too oily then add a little melted melted butter.  Variation, instead of adding dried cherries or dried cranberries, use cranberry jam.

title: Matzo-Lime Ice Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 cup matzo meal | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream ( whipping cream is best ) | 1 cup lightly packed mixed candied fruit | 1 package kale, stemmed and coarsely chopped ( can sub italian salad dressing for kale ) | 2/3 cup tamari
instructions: In a double boiler over simmering water, mix matzo flour and cream, whisking constantly for 8 to 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and add fruit, cook and stir 2 minutes, or until heated through.  Stir in tamari.  Pour into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions.  Remove in a plastic container and place on serving plate, let settle for 5 minutes.  Turn out and serve.  Garnish with additional tamari if desired and serve with warm berries, crackers, or toasted sliced puddings.

Random Ingredients: english cucumber,garlic salt,white chocolate,american cheese,italian bread,chicken stock
title: White Chocolate and Garlic Soup
ingredients: 3 cans chicken stock | 1 tablespoon instant minced garlic salt | 1/4 cup english cucumber, diced small | 2 slices american cheese | 1 slice of toasted italian-style bread | 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine
instructions: Combine chicken stock and garlic salt and bring to boil in saucepan over medium heat.  Stir in cucumber and toast cheese slices.  Pour mixture into bowl and add toasted bread.  Melt butter in skillet over medium heat and add to bowls.

title: Jicama & Grapefruit Smother
ingredients: 1/2 medium jicama, peeled cored | 1/4 cup pink grapefruit juice | 2 tablespoons boiling water | 1 cup buttermilk | 1 tablespoon rose water
instructions: Cut jicama lengthwise into 1/8 inch wide slabs.  Cut slabs in half lengthwise, then diagonally into 1/4 inch thick slabs about 1/4 inch wide and 2 inches long.  Dissolve jelly in boiling water, and set aside to be used later when recipe will be served.  Toss grapefruit slabs in jelly and marinate at least an hour.  Place on waxed paper lined cookie sheet and grill until desired doneness, stirring occasionally, 1 to 2 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: onion powder,macaroni,black peppercorn,self raising flour,taco seasoning,pastry shell,kosher salt
title: Baked Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 2 teaspoons black peppercorns, cracked | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, your favourite store bought | 1 cup self-raising flour, measure out with a pinch of salt | 1 tablespoon chopped onion powder | 2 tablespoons macaroni | 1 tablespoon taco seasoning, your favourite store bought | kosher salt | 1 pastry shell
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f place one teaspoon of pepper on the rim of an oven proof dish, place dish on oven rack.  Combine peppercorns, taco seasoning and flour in a bowl.  Add salt, onion powder, and 2 tablespoons of water and mix until well combined.  Then add half of the mix into the dish, sprinkle topping over the top of sauce until coated.  Cover dish with a lid for the first hour.

title: Penne Pasta With Sea Salt and Salt
ingredients: 1 lb penne pasta | 3 tablespoons sea salt
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package directions.  When pasta is done, drain, and return it to the pot.  While the pasta is cooking, heat 1tbsp of oil in a frying pan over medium high heat.  Stir the sea salt into the warm pasta.  Toss and serve with grated parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: sourdough bread,creole seasoning,phyllo pastry,apple cider vinegar,marshmallow,chickpea,milk
title: Vegetarian Apple and Mushroom Strudel
ingredients: 2 cups chopped fresh mushrooms | 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons creole seasoning, or to taste ( optional ) | 4 cups soureddough bread | 1 package frozen miniature marshmallows | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets with thawed pastry sheet | 1 1/4 cups milk
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Stir in mushrooms, and cook and stir until mushrooms are tender, 5 to 7 minutes.  Stir in vinegar.  Remove from heat.  Cut bread in half lengthwise.  Spread one half evenly with marshmallows, and top with another slice.  Brush a 14x12 inch baking dish with some vegetable oil.  Layer half the bread, half the marshmallows, half chickpeas, and half the pastry.  Repeat to fill remaining ingredients.  Bake for 20 to 30 minutes in the preheated oven, until phyllo is crisp and lightly browned.

title: Tasty Layered Mexican Cheese Spread
ingredients: 1 jar mexican blend cheese | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1/2 cup kahlua | 1/2 head lettuce
instructions: Lay lettuce on serving platter.  Shred cheese.

title: Torshi Lift-Ahead Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 1/2 to 2-inch cubes ( rump or shin ) | 4 large red potatoes, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes ( russet is best, but any potato will do ) | 1 cup grand marnier, plus | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 2 teaspoons oregano leaves
instructions: Put beef in a shallow soup pot.  Add potatoes, grand marnier, and oregano.  Bury a couple of oregano leaves into the top of the meat.  Bring everything to a boil& then cover.  Simmer on very low heat, about 2 1/2 hours, or until the potatoes are tender.  If a thicker gravy, stir 1/4 cup of hot milk into some of the gravy and pour into hot meat.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cardamom seed,pork loin,white potato,beef brisket,cooking spray
title: Crock Pot Cardamom Pork Brisket
ingredients: cooking spray | 2 lbs boneless pork loin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
instructions: Lightly spray a non stick 12 inch skillet with cooking spray.  Heat the pan over medium high heat until the oil shimmers, about 2 minutes.  Add all of the pork and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.  Transfer the pork and any accumulated juices to the slow cooker set to low.  Cover and cook for 7 - 8 hours, or until the meat reaches the desired tenderness.  To cook over a gas flame, pour 1 3/4 cups water into the skillet, and swirl to make a glaze.  Serve with pilau, accompanied by mashed potatoes.

Random Ingredients: flour,foglie d'autumn pasta,broccoli,kalamata olive,taco meat,dark brown sugar,baby spinach leaf
title: Mexican Fiesta
ingredients: 1 bag cooked foglie d'autumn pasta | 1 pound ground round | 1 package taco meat, cut into smaller pieces ( see foglie's italian noodle dinner ) | 2 tablespoons light brown sugar, more to taste | 12 baby spinach leaves, or to taste | 6 leaves fresh basil, thinly sliced | 1/2 cup kalamata olives, halved or sliced | 1 jar kraft dark brown sugar, divided
instructions: Cook foglie d'autumn pasta according to package directions.  Drain and set aside.  Heat a large skillet over medium heat.  Cook and stir beef and brown sugar until beef is fully cooked and crumbly.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,buttermilk,lemon juice zest,garlic powder,sunflower oil,lettuce,italian plum tomato
title: Italian Plum Tomato Soup
ingredients: 10 italian plum tomatoes, skinned ( a 4 cup measure ) | 3 tablespoons sunflower oil | 20 -25 g fat free buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice, zest of, grated | 5 celery ribs, chopped into 3/4 inch pieces | 1/4 tablespoon garlic powder or a dash dried garlic | lettuce ( to garnish ) or rocket ( to garnish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce or rocket.  Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer slowly for 15 minutes, until tomatoes begin to break down.  When soup is ready, gently stir in lettuce leaves or rocket.  I just eat that instead, and serve with warm crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: lime juice zest,wheat flour,egg bread,ginger garlic paste,iceberg lettuce,cumin,catsup,marjoram
title: Crunchy Chinese Sandwich
ingredients: 1/3 cup catsup | 1/3 cup sweetened flaked wheat flour | 1 pinch ground cumin | 1 pinch ground ginger-garlic paste ( or komodo paste ) | 2 teaspoons fresh marjoram | 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice, zest of | 1 egg bread, cut unto 3 slices | 2 -3 tablespoons sliced iceberg lettuce
instructions: In a small bowl combine the catsup, flaked wheat flour, cumin, cayenne and marjoram.  Mix well.  Stir egg into catsup mixture.  Spread a little batter on one slice of bread.  Dip sandwich into batter, and place onto a plate.  Heat frying pan on medium high heat.  When hot, quickly slide cooked toast out of batter onto hot pan, then add lettuce to slices and enjoy.

title: Mexican Chile Pepper Asparagus and Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus spear, trimmed on both ends | 6 ounces mexican style hot chocolate, chopped | 1 1/2 lbs yellow sweet peppers, halved cored and seeded
instructions: Preheat and broiler.  Line a broiler pan with foil.  Arrange a single layer of asparagus spears on the pan, then sprinkle with a few pinches of salt.  Place the broiled pan under the broiler and broil for 8 minutes, or until the asparagus is just tender and crisp.  Transfer the asparagus to a serving dish and sprinkle with 1 cup of the hot chocolate.  Heat the remaining chocolate in a small pan over low heat until melted.  Pour the melted chocolate over the asparagus.  Serve warm.

title: Easy Shrimp Bouillon Made Easy
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless beef top sirloin steaks | 6 pounds raw large shrimp | 1/4 cup bay leaf, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat the broiler.  Cut steak into 3/4 inch thick diagonal strands and place in a shallow baking dish in one layer.  Cover and let marinate in the refrigerator overnight.  Slide shrimp out of the marinade with a slotted spoon onto a rack set onto a broiler pan.  Broil, watching carefully and turning frequently, until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.  Transfer to a platter, and place in the refrigerator.  Preheat the broiler.  Remove the beef and shrimp from the marinade and pat dry.  Discard the marinade.  Bring 1 cup of water to a boil in a heavy pot.  Add the shrimp and bay leaf.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer until the shrimp are just opaque, about 5 minutes.  Transfer the shrimp and meat to a platter and cover with foil.  Return the reserved marinade to the pot, bring to a simmer and simmer for 10 minutes.  Strain the liquid, or skim off the solids.  Cool and use in recipes calling for shrimp bouillon.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,angel hair pasta,chickpea,worcestershire sauce,margarine
title: Mexican Beef Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 1 box angel hair pasta | 1 tablespoon margarine | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1 can fat-free chickpeas, rinsed | 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.  Drain pasta.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,black bean,allspice berry,white pepper,red cabbage
title: Baked Beans, Slaw and Cabbage
ingredients: 4 1/2 lbs small red cabbage, cut into wedges | 1 lb canned tomato puree | 1 cup tomato puree | 8 black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon white pepper
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Arrange the cabbage in a large ovenproof casserole dish, then spoon over the tomato puree.  Cover with boiling salted water and bake for 1 hour.  Stir in the beans during the last 5 minutes of baking.  Sprinkle with the pepper and bake for a few minutes longer until the slaw is lightly browned and has softened.  Slice the cabbage wedges into thick pieces and serve with the cabbage.  Make ahead, the beans can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 10 days.

title: Salmon With Artichokes & Spicy Peanut Sauce
ingredients: 2 salmon fillets | 8 ounces mixed-colored artichokes ( or a combination of artichokes, black olives or pimento stuffed with marinated artichokes ) | 3/4 cup peanut oil | 2 tablespoons catsup | 2 tablespoons tamari | 1 slice orange peel ( about 1/4-inch thick ) | 2 serrano chili, slices thinly
instructions: Mix the oil, catsup, vinegar, salt and pepper in a bowl, and dip the fish in the mixture a few at a time.  Set aside and let stand at room temperature for 20 minutes or refrigerate for up to 2 hours.  Meanwhile, heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat, and sear the fish on both sides until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes.  Serve the fish in the pan with the artichokes.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,shell pasta,pomegranate seed,red curry paste,marshmallow,green pepper
title: Prawn and Noodle Raufia (Prawn Stuffed Pasta Filler)
ingredients: 12 large raw prawns, peeled & deveined, tails intact | 8 marshmallows | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( to your taste ) | 8 ounces dried shell pasta ( or pasta of your choice ) | 2 tablespoons pomegranate seeds ( to your taste ) | bread flour, for coating
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place prawns in a pan of boiling water and cover and return to the boil and cook for 8 minutes or until just cooked.  Drain and set aside and while they are still cold slice them into half again lengthwise & remove the hard skin.  Slice the prawns in half again and set aside.  Place marshmallows and curry paste in a large bowl and stir in the prawns.  Place a large oven proof dish on a tray.  Add the pasta and prawns, then sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of pomegranate seeds.  Add the bread flour and pomegranate seeds and then coat the prawns in bread flour making sure the prawns are well coated in flour.  Place in the oven and cook for 20 to 25 minutes or until prawns are just cooked through.

title: Italian Sausage with Veggies
ingredients: 3 pounds hot italian sausage links, casings removed | 2 pounds frozen mixed vegetables | 1/2 cup prepared mustard
instructions: Place the sausage links in a large dutch oven or heavy pot with a lid.  Cover, and cook over medium heat until browned on all sides.  Remove sausage from pot, and place into a slow cooker.  Cover pot, and set aside for 6 hours.  Stir the vegetables into the pot, and continue cooking for 3 additional hours, until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally, and the sausage links are cooked through.  Discard vegetables.

title: Fruit, Mole and Soy Dip
ingredients: 2 mangoes, peeled, pitted and chopped | 50 g plain yogurt | 1 packet onion soup mix | 1/4 cup chocolate syrup | 1 packet papayas, peeled and diced
instructions: Put mangoes, yoghurt, onion soup mix and hot chocolate syrup into a food processor and blend to a smooth, spreadable consistency.  Add papayas and blend until well combined.  Serve with crackers or slices of baguette.

Random Ingredients: extra sharp cheddar cheese,caper,miso,vegetable stock chicken
title: Cheddar and Miso Soup
ingredients: 1 -2 ounce extra thick cheddar cheese ( or other hard cheese ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons miso | vegetable stock or chicken stock | fresh caper
instructions: Shred cheese into small pieces.  Bring 3 - 3 qts of water to the boil, add the cheese the soup spoons to give a good slosh of melted cheese.  Taste and add more miso and stock as you go until the soup is smooth and creamy.  Add capers, adjust seasonings.

title: Soy Sauce for Fish
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 2 cups shucked and coarsely grated fresh fish ( scrod and sole work best in this )
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  Pat fish dry with paper towels, and cook in the hot oil, stirring constantly until it becomes golden brown.  Sprinkle fish with salt and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,garlic clove,red pepper flake,orange juice,pork loin chop,swiss cheese,sage leaf
title: French Grilled Pork Loin
ingredients: 2 -4 fresh sage leaves or 1/4 lb dried swiss cheese, sliced | 6 -8 thin-sliced pork loin chops | 4 slices thin swiss cheese | 1/4 cup grated fresh italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon dried crushed red pepper flakes | 1/2 cup orange juice | 1 garlic clove, minced
instructions: Toast bread crumbs in skillet over medium low heat, about 3 minutes until golden then remove pan from heat.  Lightly brush one side of each pork chop with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle pork chops with a little salt and pepper and then place on baking sheet with bread crumbs.  Grill until internal temperature reaches 160°f and internal temperature measures 160°f.  Top with slices of swiss cheese.  When internal temperature is 160°f brush both sides of each pork chop with hot olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and grill until cheese is melted and lightly browned, about 3 minutes per side.

title: Cashew Crunch
ingredients: 150 g cashews, chopped | 1 medium red onion, chopped | 1 medium green pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons romano cheese, grated
instructions: Combine the cashews, onion, green chili and cheese in a dry frying pan.  Heat until the cashews and onion are dry and golden brown.  Watch the level of the mixture at the start and watch for any sign of burning.  Once the mixture becomes golden brown stir in the red onion and nuts.  Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature.  Serve as an appetizer or a main course with other indian flatbreads, bread or pasta.

title: Tuscan Beans

title: Hot Chile Rellenos Con Chunky Salsa

In a small bowl, stir 1 3/4 cups salsa with remaining 1 1/2 cups salsa.  Stir in 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon and cardamom.  Dissolve yeast mixture in liquid sauce. title: Low Fat French Shiitake Mushrooms

title: Basic Powder for Nuts and Dipping Sauces
ingredients: 1/2 cup saltine crackers | 1/8 teaspoon fennel seed | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Place saltines in a large bowl.  Pour enough ice water into bowl to cover crackers.  Stir in fennel and sugar.  Mix well until evenly mixed.  Dip in vanilla extract.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Beef Tenderloin With Peppered Mint

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon cube,jalapeno,rice flour,frito corn chip,chickpea
title: Easy Fiesta Stuffed Jalapenos
ingredients: 10 jalapenos | 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup rice flour | 1/2 cup frito corn chips | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Prepare a 9 x 13 baking dish with a cooking oil spray as needed.  Line a large baking sheet with foil.  Cut the top off 2 jalapenos and remove the seeds.  Pull the seeds out the inside by placing them in the middle of a double thickness of paper towel in a sink, pulling the paper towel out over the jalapeno to remove any dirt.  Rinse the pepper inside out and pat dry with your hands.  Remove the blackened skin from the inside of the pepper and chop up smaller pieces.  Set aside.  You should have at least 3 cups of the cooking oil which will be about 2 or 3 tablespoons.  Drain chickpeas well.  Rinse the chickpeas under cold water to get rid of any excess juice. Place the stuffed jalapenos on the foil lined baking sheet.  They should sit about 1/2 inch apart on the foil.  Mix the flour and the bouillon with about 1/4 cup of water to make a thin paste and brush the tops of the jalapenos with this mixture.  Sprinkle the top with frito chips on top and bake until the edges are lightly browned, abot 15 - 20 minutes.  Let sit for 10 minutes.  Cut into 8 wedges or 4 triangles and serve.  The frito chips can also be broken in half to make it easier to eat, depending on the size of your jalapenos.

title: Homemade Buns II

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the worcestershire sauce, veal and yeast.  Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. Allow the dough to rise for 1 hour.  After it has doubled, prick holes in the dough with a fork, and bake in a preheated 400 degrees f oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until the bottoms are lightly browned and the tops are slightly crispy. instructions: Mix well and stuff the chicken with it being careful not to make a hole or opening the lid, just cram it inches. title: Vegetable Risotto With Kielbasa

instructions: Clean the rice, removing as much of the starch as possible, and soak for 10 - 20 minutes.  Add the chopped herbs, mix, leave for 5 min to allow it to absorb flavours. title: Lily Pies

instructions: Heat oven to 200c degrees.  Using a 5 ounce measure, measure out 1 cup of the meat mixture. Brush the broccoli with a little of the olive oil.  Place in a medium hot preheated grill, turning once, until the cheese has melted and begun to turn golden, about 12 minutes.

title: Lentils With Almonds and Barley
ingredients: 4 cups lentils | 1/4 lb pearl barley | 3/4 cup pasta sauce | 1/2 cup heavy cream ( i prefer whipping cream ) | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted
instructions: In a large saucepan, with a tight lid, add lentils, barley, and sauce.  Cover pot, and bring to a boil, and then reduce heat to lowest setting and simmer gently for at least an hour without removing the lid.  Do not overcook the barley.  Stir in cream.  Tightly cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or up to 2 days.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,plain white flour,apricot,taco sauce,wine,egg noodle
title: Noodle and Fruit Kebabs
ingredients: 2 cups plain white flour, sifted | 1 egg noodles, cooked | 1/4 lb dried apricot, washed, peeled | 1 tablespoon taco sauce | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 tablespoons sweet wine
instructions: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl and make a well in the centre.  Break the egg noodles into pieces and toss in the flour to make a smooth batter.  Cover the bowl with clingfilm and stand for 30 minutes to 20 minutes, stirring the noodles to ensure they don't stick together.  Break up the apricots into smaller chunks with your hands and toss in to the batter.  Dip the noodles into the batter and gently push into the flour to coat.  Heat a wok over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and add 1 tablespoon oil.  Cook the noodles in batches for 2 minutes on each side, until they are cooked but not tough.  Heat the remaining oil in a non stick frying pan and fry the cakes for 2 minutes each side, or until richly coloured.  Transfer to a warmed serving platter.  Season well with salt and pepper and serve with sauce.

title: Creamy Pistachio Pesto
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 2 tablespoons paprika or 2 tablespoons smoked paprika | 1 lb shelled pistachio nut, husked and coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the cream with the paprika and chopped pistachios.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.  The cream should be light and fluffy.

title: German Style Green Beans
ingredients: 12 ounces green beans | 1 tablespoon dry oregano leaves | 1 tablespoon vegetable shortening | 1/4 cup stock | 2 tablespoons molasses or 2 tablespoons maple syrup, i recommend | 1/2 cup water | 1 tablespoon mayonnaise | 1 -2 tablespoon cider or 1 -2 tablespoon sherry wine
instructions: Trim green beans from the stalks and set on two rimmed baking sheets.  Place in oven.  Bake until tender, 30 to 45 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat vegetable shortening in heavy small saucepan on medium heat.  Add oregano and saute 1 to 2 minutes.  Add stock and molasses and simmer over medium heat, stirring frequently, until liquid thickens slightly.  Add green beans and cover.  To serve, add may and water to desired liquid volume.  Cover and let stand 5 minutes.  Serve garnished with mayonnaise, chopped red onion and celery.

Random Ingredients: porcini mushroom,spring onion,dill weed,tomato paste,thyme sprig,ranch dressing mix,head cabbage,taco sauce
title: Spicy Mexican Cabbage and Chives
ingredients: 1 small head of cabbage, cored and shredded | 1 small bunch rosemary sprig, leaves included | 3 cups prepared ranch dressing mix | 2 cans ranch dressing mix | 1 cup chopped fresh dill weed or 1 cup dried dill weed | 2 3/4 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 package of dried porcini mushrooms, stems removed | 1/2 head of cabbage, cored and shredded ( about 2 1/2 cups ) | 2 spring onions, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients except mushrooms and cabbage.  Place the vegetable in the colander over the cabbage and push down lightly.  When the cabbage starts to wilt, remove it to drain off excess liquid.  Toss cabbage with the dressing mixture and place on platter.  Sprinkle with the mushrooms and serve.

title: Chocolate Gravy for Meat
ingredients: 2 cups strong beef flavored beef bouillon | 2 -3 tablespoons cocoa powder ( i prefer dutch process for this ) ( optional )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and use as your gravy.  Pour over cooked meatballs and serve over boiled potatoes or zuccini.

title: Easy Tenderloin for Two
ingredients:
12 ounces beef tenderloin | 2 tablespoons dried onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon seasoning ( recommended mrs.
    - dash onion chowder mix )
instructions: Score tenderloin on both sides with knife and place on roasting pan.  In a small bowl, mix dry onion soup mix and seasoning and spread over the roast.  Place tenderloin under croiler for 2 to 3 minutes per side.  Do not over cook.  The tenderloin should register 150 degrees f when done.

Random Ingredients: vegetable cooking spray,baking powder,arborio rice,mace,ham,bicarbonate soda
title: Ham and Mince Risotto
ingredients: 225 g arborio rice | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 350 g diced ham | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | vegetable cooking spray
instructions: In a saucepan, cook the rice, bicarbonate of soda and mace together, stirring for 2 minutes.  Add the ham, baking powder and a little water, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.  Heat a splash of oil in a frying pan on high and fry the mince until browned.  Remove from the pan and serve immediately.

title: Fiery Mexi-Rub Seasoning
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons cumin seeds | 12 lime wedges ( optional )
instructions: Mix the salt and cumin in a small bowl.  Rub into the salt.  Store in a cool dark place.  Use as you would store spice in olive oil, fish, beef or chicken.

title: Cabbage Soup - Rachael Ray
ingredients: 1 bunch cabbage or 1 bunch baby cabbage | 2 tomatoes, diced | 1 1/2 cups prosciutto ( optional ) | 4 tablespoons diced green chili ( optional )
instructions: Wash all the cabbage.  Quarter the head.  In a large soup pot, steam the cabbage for around 5 - 8 minutes.  You can cook it in the microwave, or use the oven.  Add the tomatoes.  When the cabbage is almost done, combine them with the prosciutto.  The soup gets thick, thin and very creamy.  If the soup is not creamy enough, add a tablespoon or two of water the soup should be slightly sweet.  If needed, use a handful of shredded cabbage for a few minutes to thicken.

title: Grape Tomato Asparagus Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups grape tomatoes, chopped | 1 tablespoon yeast | 1 cup asparagus spear, chopped | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup diced fruit
instructions: Place the tomatoes and yeast in the bowl of a stand mixer, add 1/2 cup warm water and mix to dissolve the yeast.  Add the asparagus and aniseed.  Add the remaining warm water.  Mix until the asparagus is fully coated.  Cover and place in a warm spot until doubled.  Then immediately add the diced fruit and stir.  Let set 10 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: club soda,tomato green chilies,vegetable broth,eggplant,chunky salsa,mayonnaise,anchovy
title: Spicy Eggplant (Aubergine) Dip
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into 1/4 and 1/2-inch slices | 1 can chopped tomatoes with green chilies | 2 cans vegetable broth | 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 3/4 cup mayonnaise, lowfat okay | 2 cans no-salt-added tomato and green chilies, drained | 1 anchovy ( optional )
instructions: Place eggplant in a 5 to 6 quart crockpot.  Top with diced tomatoes with green chilies, broth, salsa and mayonnaise.  Stir.  Top with anchovies if desired.  Cook on low for 2 hours.  This makes enough for one large eggplant.

title: Vegan Kima Recipe - No Mayo!
ingredients: 10 cups potato flour | 2 liters coconut milk | 4/5 cup boiling water | 3/4 cup daikon radish, grated ( korean ) | hot sauce ( sriracha ) | coconut oil ( for frying as desired - vegan option omit )
instructions: Combine coconut milk and boiling water in a large saucepan over low heat until the coconut milk is completely absorbed.  Stir in the grated daikon and hot sauce.  Keep stirring and cook for 1 minute longer.  Place in ice cold water overnight for best results. .  After 1 hour, take kima mixture out of the freezer and add the potato flour.  Knead vigorously until thoroughly mixed together and can be turned out onto a floured surface several times to form a firm dough.  Roll out until very thin.  Cut into 1 inch squares.  Repeat the process with both more squares.  Wet hands and brush the dough with oil.  Place 1/2 cup kima mixture onto each square.  Fold the dough over the filling so that the kimasa are closed.  Deep fry until golden brown on the outside and very crisp on the inside.  Serve with hot sauce.  Coconut oil can also be used to fry kimas.  For vegan option omit coconut milk or a vegetarian version.

Random Ingredients: italian breadcrumb,bacon bit,vegetable oil,oregano leaf,soya sauce,cream cheese
title: Quick Italian Bread Crumb Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb bacon bits ( bits ) | 2 cups shredded italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3 packages cream cheese | 1 tablespoon soya sauce | 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | vegetable oil
instructions: In a large bowl mix the bread crumbs, cream cheese or gorgonzola cheese, oregano and a bit of olive oil.  Use your fingers to make sure all the crumbs are thoroughly blended in.  Coat well.  If there is excess, gently toss flour into egg mixture.  Add more olive oil or water until it is completely covered.  If it seems dry, add additional crumbs.  Form mix into 1 inch balls and place on a greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 325 degrees f until they are golden brown.  Cool on a rack.  They can be frozen or frozen for use the next day or fry right away.

title: Cajun Spice Dressing
ingredients: 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning | 2 tablespoons salad dressing or 2 tablespoons ranch dressing, if needed
instructions: In a small bowl, combine garlic powder, cajun seasoning and salad dressing.  Chill well before using.

title: Coq Au Vin
ingredients: chicken leg | brandy
instructions: Rinse the chicken leg.  Score the skin under running water, and leave it inside.  Leave the chicken in a cool place for a few hours.  Put the chicken legs into a roasting pan and cook in high temperature oven 450 degrees f/230 degrees celsius.  Cook for 45 minutes.  Brush with brandy during the last half hour of cooking.  The skin should still be crisp and the solids should be golden brown.

title: Simple Taco Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken meat, or | 1 lb ground turkey | 1 cup shredded mexican blend cheese or 1 cup mild cheddar cheese | 1 cup shredded lettuce | 2 tablespoons vegetable protein, such as textured vegetable protein | 1 teaspoon dried mexican oregano
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Mix all ingredients together except the bread and spread them on the bread.  Place on a large nonstick baking sheet and bake at 350 for 40 minutes.

title: Sauce With Seafood in Pasta
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce | 2 carrots | 1 can seafood sauce ( any brand ) | 2 tablespoons seafood seasoning or 2 tablespoons mixed spice | 1 jar marinara sauce
instructions: Wash and dry the romaine lettuce and carrot.  Dice the shrimp and mix with the shrimp and shrimp in a large casserole.  Spice the seafood with your favourite foods, sprinkle with spice mix and pour the marinara sauce on top.  Bake in a 400 degree oven for 20 minutes or until the seafood is cooked through.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,acorn squash,raspberry,ketjap manis,chicken gravy mix,rotel,orange flower water
title: Raspberry Chicken
ingredients: 1 acorn squash, peeled | 2 cups cubed fresh raspberries | 1/2 cup frozen orange flower water | 1 envelope chicken gravy mix | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon red currant jelly | 3 teaspoons drambuie hot paprika, or to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Bake squash on a baking sheet in the preheated oven until tender, about 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and cut into wedges.  Pour orange water into a bowl.  Stir squash and raspberries into the bowl, then mix in orange flower water, gravy mix, ketchup, red currant jelly, and hot paprika.  Pour into a 9x13 inch casserole dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until hot, 1 to 2 minutes.

title: Tamari Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 packet reduced fat frozen soup, thawed ( i use campbell's ) | 1/2 cup watercress, chopped fine ( i use about 1 tablespoon ) | 1/8 - 1/4 cup papertowels, crushed fine | 1 -3 teaspoon tamari, spice blend
instructions: Combine mushroom soup packet and watercress and refrigerate.  Add papertowels, tamari and optional spices.  If not using immediately, store in refrigerator in a small container.  I use only 1 teaspoon of tamari for 2 tbs soup.

title: White Lasagna
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dried oregano leaves | 1 cup mushrooms stems and pieces, chopped | 3/4 teaspoon sugar | 8 ounces queso fresco, crumbled | 12 lasagna sheets
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f.  Spray 13x9 inch glass baking dish with cooking spray.  In medium bowl, mix together oregano leaves, mushrooms and sugar.  Spoon mixture into prepared baking dish.  Top with cheese.  Cover generously with foil.  Bake 15 minutes, then uncover and bake an additional 10 minutes.  Let cool slightly.  Cut into 8 serving pieces or 3 smaller servings.

title: Lucky Baked Beans
ingredients: 10 cups black beans, rinsed and drained ( green beans ) | 2 limes, juice of | 1 cup chopped pitted prunes | 1/2 cup cornflour | 1 tablespoon poultry seasoning ( like mrs dash maggi ) | 1/2 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Place the beans in a large crockpot or pan.  Fill in the rest of the ingredients with water.  Mix well, cover and cook on high for 2 hours.  Stir occasionally to prevent sticking in the crockpot/pan.  Check on the beans to see if they are cooked through, but if not continue cooking for the remaining time.

title: Yogurt-Dolmathes
ingredients: 1/2 cup greek yogurt ( or plain yogurt, but greek for a smoother texture ) | 3 tablespoons quick-cooking oats ( or old-fashioned, ground oats in a coffee grinder ) | 1 package phyllo dough ( frozen phyllo dough, thawed in refrigerator overnight, but not overnight ) ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  In a medium size bowl, combine the yogurt, oats and yogurt mixture.  Cut each sheet of phyllo dough into three equal pieces.  Working with one piece at a time, brush each piece with some of the yogurt mixture, then roll it up into a long sausage shape with some tips hanging over the edges.  Place on a baking sheet or baking pan, brush with more yogurt mixture, and lay in the over.  Repeat until all phyllo dough has been used, or you've used all of the five sheets.

title: Jalapeno Pepper Chocolate Candy
ingredients: 1 cup sweetened cocoa mixed with 1/4 teaspoon of hot-tolerance jalapeno pepper | 4 -6 jalapeno peppers, preferably with seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 175°f.  Line a loaf pan with parchment paper with a piece of parchment paper.  Using a rolling pin, slice the rounds into 1/4 inch pieces.  Place the pieces on the baking tray in one layer. .  Bake at 175°f for 3 minutes, turning halfway through.  Cool, and serve the hot chocolate candy in soft, drizzled plastic cups with a little melted butter. .  Can be refrigerated for up to 8 days or frozen for up to 3 months, and baked at 350°f for 2 to 3 tablespoons of candy after a few hours.  Store the chocolate in an air tight container.

title: Baked Mangoes with Creole Seasoning
ingredients: 4 large mangoes, quartered ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/4 cup canola or 1/4 cup olive oil
instructions: Cut large mangoes in half with a sharp knife.  Remove and discard pit.  Slice fruit in half through center to form 2 pices.  Heat oil in a medium skillet over medium heat.  Cook fruit until lightly browned and soft, 10 to 15 minutes, turning once.  Remove fruit with a slotted spoon and arrange on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Smooth surface with back of a spoon.  Sprinkle paprika of creole seasoning over mango slices and bake in an oven, heated to 375°f, 5 to 10 minutes, or until hot.

title: French Bread
ingredients: 2 1/2 - 3 lbs chicken thighs ( or breasts or whatever your like ) | 4 liters of your favorite bread yeast
instructions: In a large pot, add all the ingredients and mix together.  Cover with a towel and leave to ferment overnight.  The next day, when ready to bake, take off the cover.  Preheat oven to 425°f take out the dough and put the dough back into the pot.  Mix and heat to a boil, then take out the pan of the oven and let rise for an hour in there.  The dough will rise substantially and be sticky.  Punch down, form into loaves, and place on greased baking sheets.  Let rise again.  Bake for about 45 - 60 minutes, until the center of the loaf sounds hollow when kneading.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,pesto sauce,mexican rice mix vermicelli,enchilada sauce,paprika
title: Rice-Cooked Pork Carnitas
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless pork shoulder | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | 2 cups shredded mexican-style rice mix or 2 cups vermicelli | 1 can enchilada sauce | 2 teaspoons smoked spanish paprika
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Rinse and pat dry the pork shoulder.  Cut into 2 inch cubes and place into a large casserole dish.  Rub with 1/2 of the pesto.  Cover and bake for approximately 4 hours or until tender.  Turn the pork cubes every so often so they brown evenly on all sides.  Remove cover.

title: Easy Cheater's Easy Cheater's Fish
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1 1/2 teaspoons fish | 1/3 cup brown sugar
instructions: Stir cream of chicken soup, fish, and brown sugar, until smooth, stirring constantly.  Pour into small casserole dish and chill for at least 1 hours before serving.

title: Pasta With Water Chestnuts & Raisins
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 cup warm water | 10 ounces pastas, cooked | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1 large green chili, chopped | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Sprinkle dry yeast with the warm water in a large bowl, and stir in the uncooked pasta.  Cover, and set aside in a warm spot to prove for 1 hour.  Stir again, and add the cooked pasta, water chestnuts, chile, and raisins.  Let rise for 5 minutes, and then refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Tast again, and add more green chili if desired.

title: Grilled Zucchini Stir Fry
ingredients: 1 zucchini, halved lengthways | 12 ounces field mushrooms, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil
instructions: Steam or microwave zucchini until tender.  Remove seeds and roughly chop.  Add to a bowl.  Add mushrooms to bowl.  Add sesame oil and toss to coat.

title: Angel Hair Pasta With Winter Squash
ingredients: 1/2 lb butternut squash, trimmed and cut into 1 inch long sticks ( and peeled if desired )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine squash and water – heat to boiling.  Cover, turn heat down and simmer 20 minutes or until squash is tender.  Drain pasta and squash well and add to squash.  Toss just until heated through but do not boil.  Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,beef bouillon cube,poblano pepper,salmon fillet,cucumber,triple sec,chicken broth
title: Paparilla Fish & Pepper Tarts
ingredients:
2 poblano peppers | 12 ounces smoked salmon fillets, sliced ( i use 2 pkg.
    - of pillsbury famous salmon fillets ) | 1/4 cup beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1/4 cup hot chicken broth | 1 1/2 cups cucumbers, halved thinly | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth | 1/2 teaspoon triple sec | 2 puff pastry sheets, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f line 6 muffin cups of cups with pastry.  Cut poblano peppers into thin strips.  In a very large frypan, add salmon, 1/4 cup of beef bouillon concentrate, and poblano peppers.

title: Beef Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 tablespoon reduced fat dry topping ( i use kraft ) | 4 beef tenderloin steaks
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f coat a sheet pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Spread about 3 tablespoons of the reduced fat topping on each steak.

title: Tofu (Filipino Version)
ingredients: 1 package firm tofu or ( 7 ounce ) package firm tofu, rinsed | 1/4 cup tomato ketchup | 3 fresh thyme sprigs, finely chopped
instructions: Drain tofu on absorbent paper towels.  Cut tofu into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place on a shallow baking pan.  Drizzle with tomato ketchup.  Sprinkle thyme over.  Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Thai Basil Noodles
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fish sauce | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Refrigerate, covered, for at least 30 minutes.

title: White Bean Dip
ingredients: 2 cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon lemon juice
instructions: Drain beans and rinse with cold water, then drain again.  Cover the bottom of a medium sized bowl with lemon juice.  Spread the drained beans in the bowl over the lemon juice.  Then add the cannellini beans.  Mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder roast,self rising flour,balsamic vinegar,black pepper,kalamata olive,chinese five spice powder,margarine,cream tartar
title: Spicy Pork Roast
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs boneless pork shoulder roast | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 1 teaspoon margarine | 1/2 cup kalamata olive | 3 tablespoons self rising flour | 1 1/2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
instructions: Using a vegetable peeler, peel off white fat from roast and cut into about 8 to 12 slices.  Season the fat with black pepper, cream of tartar and 5 spice powder.  Heat margarine in a frying pan.  Quickly place the pork on top, and sprinkle with sugar and a pinch of black pepper.  Place the pan in a preheated oven for about 45 minutes.  While the pork is cooking, drain the olives.  Mix flour and vinegar together.  Take the pan from the oven, and turn off the oven.  Do not remove the lid during this time.  When pork has finished cooking, take off the lid and turn the meat over in the pan.  Remove excess fat from the pan.  Place the sliced olives in a plastic bag.  Let the bag sit for 3 minutes before removing the meat, then slice them in half lengthwise.  Place on platter, and cover with aluminum foil.  Allow to cool.  When serving, take out of the oven, and place in fridge to retain juices.  When serving, slice meat into thin pieces, and spoon on balsamic gravy and onions on the side.  These are great with rice, noodles or salad.  You can do the sandwich in the oven, if the person eating the sandwich is eating from the sandwich, or on the side with a fried onion sprinkled with cheese.

title: Russian Meat Patties
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground beef | 1 cup croutons | 2 tablespoons farina
instructions: Preheat an oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix the beef, croutons, and farina in a large bowl.  Shape into 6 patties.  Place on an unprepared cookie sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until cooked through, about 30 minutes.

title: Green Enchilada Sauce - Molasses Free
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon molasses ( optional )
instructions: Blend until completely smooth and no chunks can form.  Spread enough enchilada sauce over all of the soft cooked soft taco shells into the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.  If desired, mix remaining enchilada sauce with molasses to create an even pourable consistancy.  Ladle sauce over taco shells and green enchilada sauce, dividing evenly between each taco shell, and dividing entirely between the 8 shells.  Chill and bake in oven at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes.  Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

title: Quick and Simple Pizza Apples
ingredients: apples ( sweet potato, cherry, cannel, purple or pink lady finger ) | maple syrup, to taste ( to taste, not diet ) | sliced fresh apple ( to taste, or use fresh apple juice ) | lemon wedge, to serve ( to serve )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/400f degrees.  Put enough sliced apples to cover surface of dish.  Add sauce, to taste and lemon wedges to taste.  Heat for approximately 10 minutes, or until sauce is bubbly and apples are slightly softened.  Enjoy.

title: Portuguese Sweet Sausages
ingredients: 1/4 cup spanish onion, chopped | 1 medium yellow bell pepper, halved, seeded and chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons tomato puree | 1 tablespoon dry spanish oregano or 1 tablespoon fresh oregano | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | 1 bay leaf | 16 ounces smoked sausage casings
instructions: Combine all ingredients except casings in non aluminum fry pan.  Cover and cook on low heat for 30 minutes.  Strain mixture through a fine mesh sieve to remove solids.  Mash casings and puree into sausage mixture.  Cook over low for 20 minutes longer.  If sausage mixture becomes too dry to stir, add a few tablespoons of water.  Remove bay leaf and serve warm.  Note, you can substitute your favorite sausage casings for the casings.

title: Wild and White Chocolate Crumble With Peach Lettuce
ingredients: 2 cups fresh breadcrumbs, from a baguette | 1 cup wild rice | 2 large ripe peaches | 1 head iceberg lettuce | 1 1/2 ounces dark chocolate
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Line a baking tray with parchment paper.  Combine breadcrumbs, rice and peaches in a medium bowl.  Cover with a clean tea towel and press onto greased oven tray to form an 8 inch diameter circle.  Wet hands slightly in cold water and roll out small balls.  Place on top of rice and bake for 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and place a peach in the centre of each crumble.  Roll to enclose the peach and then insert the toothpicks to make an opening.  Place on a baking tray in the oven and cook for 20 minutes or until crust is lightly browned.  Remove from oven and leave to cool.  Melt chocolate in saucepan over a low heat and pour over the breadcrumbs and set aside to cool.  Serve with a dollop of whipped cream.

Random Ingredients: yogurt,plantain,brown rice,vanilla sugar,chocolate syrup,self raising flour,serrano chilies
title: Granny's Vegan Brown Rice Pizza
ingredients: 100 g brown rice ( or plain rice ) | 1/2 cup yogurt ( whole milk or reduced fat can be substituted ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla sugar | 1 tablespoon yogurt ( half fat or skim milk works too ) | 1 -2 teaspoon brown sugar ( or honey ) | 1 -2 serrano chilies, seeded and finely chopped ( depends on your taste, but any hot chiles are really good for this ) | 200 g plantains, cooked ( very ripe, peeled and grated using a grater attachment ) | self raising flour ( or all purpose flour ) | brown sugar or honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Dry fry the rice first.  Add the milk, sugar, vanilla sugar, yogurt, chillies, and finally the plantain.  Mix well and place in oven safe dish. Spread some slices of the pizza on your pizza with a sprinkling of brown sugar or honey.  Return the pizza to the oven and let it sit until the surface is a little crisp on the edges, which will take about 3 or 5 minutes.  Enjoy.

title: White Asiago Cheese With Lime and Asiago
ingredients: 1/2 lb asiago cheese, drained | 1/2 lb mild italian cheese, shredded | 1 lime, cut in wedges
instructions: Mix cheese, asiago, and lime.  Spread on a greased casserole dish.  Bake at 350°f for 25 - 30 minute or until hot and bubbly.

In a separate bowl, toss through the walnuts and pickle.  Slice diagonally into wedges and place on serving platter.  Remove cling film from bowl, add the lime zest and juice and pour over the salad.

title: Gourmet Potato Salad - Worthy of a Kook and Eat!
ingredients: 3 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup pitted prunes | 2 tablespoons palm sugar or 2 tablespoons brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice, plus | 2 tablespoons lemon juice, for dressing | 32 ounces simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1/3 cup unsweetened cocoa ( dutch won't do either )
instructions: Combine all ingredients except potatoes and cocoa in a large bowl.  Toss to coat evenly.  Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour and up to overnight.  When ready to eat, toss again.  Add simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion and cocoa to the dish.  Toss gently to combine.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Southern Pickles - a Beautiful Blender Recipe
ingredients: 1 quart pickling spices | 1 tablespoon coarse salt | 1 small onion ( use as much or little salt as you wish )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a crock or porre.  Keep refrigerated in a dark, cool place for 2 - 3 months or longer before using.

title: Picante Roasted Pecorino Cheese
ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs pecorino cheese, shredded | 0.
    -5 can picante sauce | 1/4 cup honey | 1/2 cup oyster sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Combine pecorino and picante sauce.  Spread evenly in a shallow baking dish.  Combine honey, oyster sauce and 1/2 of the cheese mixture in a small bowl.  Spread on top of cheese and bake 1 to 2 minutes, or until cheese is light brown about 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and let cool for about 5 minutes.  Turn on broiler.  Sprinkle cheese with remaining cheese and broil for 2 to 3 minutes, or until melted.

title: Chinese Orange Peel Chips
ingredients: 4 ounces orange peel, cut into slivers or 2 slices blanched almonds | 1/4 cup sesame oil
instructions: Place the orange peel in a mixing bowl and pour the oil over the peel.  Sprinkle the strips with salt and place on a small, flat serving platter.  Using tongs, hold the platter, turn and shake the peel, coating all sides, cover the bowl loosely, and refrigerate overnight.  When ready to use, remove the peel and discard the strips.
