instructions: In a medium bowl, add all the ingredients and mix with a long spoon or spatula.  Let sit 10 minutes and serve.

title: Spinach and Salmon Fillets Wrapped in Sultanas & Feta
ingredients: 400 g spinach | 1 tablespoon sultana | 1/4 cup feta cheese | 1 tablespoon dill weed | 2 salmon fillets
instructions: Remove steaks from freezer and preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius.  Steam greens in microwave for 5 minutes.  Squeeze out excess water and chop leaves roughly.  In a baking dish put first 7 ingredients into mixing bowl.  Stir in 1 tb water.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,parsnip,tortilla,greek yogurt,lima bean,white sugar
title: Tortilla and White Mushrooms Filled With Crisp Parsnip Puree
ingredients: 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 6 tortillas | 2 cans white button mushrooms, drained and coarsely chopped | 1 bag lima beans, ends trimmed | 4 parsnips, peeled and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley, or as desired
instructions: In a small bowl, mix sugar and yogurt.  Spread some yogurt mixture on one side of each tortilla.  Combine sliced mushrooms and lima beans in a salad bowl.  Top generously with remaining yogurt mixture.  Garnish with parsley and serve.

title: Jicama on Rye Bread
ingredients: 20 slices jicama | 4 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Place a slice of jicama on a slice of toasted rye bread and slice 1 1/2 inches from the edge of the bread.  Wrap a piece of rye bread around the jicama to make a packet.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,pumpkin,vegetable broth,corn tortilla,sun tomato oil,red food coloring
title: Red Roasted Corn Tortillas With Pumpkin
ingredients: 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 1/4 lbs small whole yellow corn tortillas, cut crosswise into 12 rounds | 4 cups vegetable broth or 4 cups other flavorful broth | 1 can pumpkin | 1/3 cup chopped sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and patted dry | 2 drops red food coloring ( optional )
instructions: Combine baking soda and tortilla points in a small bowl.

title: Mango Satay Recipe
ingredients: 3 large mangoes | 1 1/2 cups teriyaki-style hot sauce
instructions: First make the satay sauce by combining the teriyaki sauce and hot sauce in a bowl.  Cut the mangoes in half and remove the pit.  Cut into small chunks and add to bowl with the teriyaki sauce and stir to coat.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or longer, stirring occasionally, until mangoes are soft, turning once or twice.  Thread on skewers, or eat as is in a pita bread with slices of chicken or tuna.

Random Ingredients: orange,olive,celery rib,rice,brown lentil,onion salt,white onion,grand marnier
title: Sweet Lentil and Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils, rinsed | 2 garlic cloves, minced | 1 large onion ( vidalias preferred ) or 1 white onion, diced ( vidalias preferred ) | 1 orange, zest of, of | 2 tablespoons grand marnier ( or other brandy ) | 1/2 cup olive | 1/2 cup rice, any type | celery rib, diced
instructions: Drain and rinse the lentils, removing any foreign matter.  Toss all together in a salad bowl.  Mix in the minced garlic, onion, orange, grand marnier, olive and rice.  Season generously with pepper, salt and more of your favorite herbs to draw the flavors together.

title: Chipotle's Adobo Sauce
ingredients: 1 chicken stock cube | adobo seasoning
instructions: Place in blender the chicken stock cube and as much adobo seasoning as desired.  Blend on low until smooth.  Pour over grilled fish, tacos, or over whatever else strikes your fancy.

title: Grilled Mushrooms With Peppers
ingredients: 2 lbs mushrooms, sliced | 1/2 cup roasted poblano pepper, diced | 1/2 cup hot pepperoncini pepper, minced | 1/4 cup fresh rose water | 1/2 cup cumin | 11 cardamom pods, crushed
instructions: Marinate mushrooms with spices for at least one hour.  Grill mushrooms, turning once, 5 - 10 mins.  Serve hot.

title: Jamaican Pot Roast
ingredients: 3 lbs meat ( i use a chuck roast ) | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme leave | 1/2 cup granulated sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.  Line a roasting pan with the foil, on top of the foil.  Mix the thyme and sugar in a bowl.  Roll the meat on the sugar until well coated.  Place meat in pan, then place in oven.  Roast for 2 hours, then reduce heat to 300 degrees and continue roasting for 2 more hours, basting occasionally.  Let meat rest, then refrigerate overnight to let juices develop.

title: Tex-Mex Cucumber Oysters
ingredients: 2 cucumbers, peeled | 1/4 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 24 oysters, shucked
instructions: Slice cucumbers, removing pulp and seeds before slicing.  Place cuke in a shallow dish and pour salsa over.  Let marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour.  In a small sauté pan, fry oysters in oil for 1 minute or until just starting to turn golden brown.  Remove oysters and place on paper towels to drain.  Serve garnished with cucumber slices.  Goes great with taco shells.

Random Ingredients: extra olive oil,dark soy sauce,celery seed
title: Soy Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 1/2 lb meat, cut into serving size pieces | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce
instructions: Marinate meat with 1/2 of the dark soy sauce mixed with a little sherry or other white wine.  Keep soy sauce and wine separate.  Put on grill when you are ready to cook beef, cook to desired doneness.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,cream cheese,extra virgin olive oil,cheese,chuck roast,black sesame seed,carrot
title: Beef and Carrot Rollups
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 15 ounces chuck roast, trimmed ( see notes ) | 8 ounces cream cheese | 8 ounces carrots, peeled, washed and finely diced | 1/2 cup self-rising flour | 1/2 cup roasted sesame seeds | 25 ounces cheese slices, such as pecorino romano, pecorino and parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated on a parmigiano-reggiano basis
instructions: Heat the olive oil over medium high heat in a large, heavy based, deep frying pan.  Sprinkle the roast with salt and pepper.  Fry the roast quickly, in two batches, until evenly golden brown.  Remove and set aside.  Pour off any excess oil from the pan.  Return the pan to the stove top over medium high heat, add the cream cheese and carrot and stir well to combine until melted.  Add the flour and stir well to combine.  Reduce the heat until the mixture is dry, but stirring occasionally, about 10 to 15 minutes.  Return the roast and accumulated juices to the pan, then cover and simmer for 45 minutes, or until a meat thermometer inserted near the center registers 120 degrees f and the meat is tender.  Transfer the roast to a cutting board and cut into 4 thin slices.  Meanwhile, cook the sesame seeds in a small pan of boiling water for 5 minutes, or until slightly softened.  Drain and stir into the meat mixture.  To serve, spoon the meat mixture onto a plate and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloabs
ingredients: 4 lbs pork tenderloin | 1 lb fresh raspberries or 1 lb frozen raspberries | 2 oranges, washed thoroughly and juiced | 1/2 lb deli ham, cut into 1/4-inch dice
instructions: Place pork in a large roasting pan.  Coat pan with nonstick cooking spray.  Roast for 2 hours at 300°f, basting every 25 minutes.  Remove from oven and let stand while making the sauce.  Combine juices, ham, and orange juice in a large saucepan.  Simmer over medium heat until heated through.  Remove pork from the oven and let stand for at least 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Slice meat and place on a warm platter.  Pour warm sauce over.  Slice and serve.  Pass more orange sections if desired.

title: Curry Feta Dip
ingredients: 1 package shredded mexican cheese blend ( cheddar and monterey jack is good or queso fresca ) | 1 container crumbled feta | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking spray | 2 teaspoons curry | 1 -2 green bell pepper, chopped
instructions: Place a small nonstick frying pan over medium high heat.  Coat pan with cooking spray.  Add curry and feta and stir until well incorporated.  Reduce heat to low.  Add green pepper.

title: A Simple Burger
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon walnut oil | 1 teaspoon hot paprika | 1 tablespoon chopped coriander | 500 g hamburger
instructions: Dip your hamburger in the hot oil, then put in the paprika.  Cook till it is brown.  Add coriander.  Serve on bun with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,ginger powder,egg white,red chili powder,peppercorn,cremini mushroom,sage
title: Potato and Mushrooms
ingredients: 5 yukon gold potatoes, quartered | 3 cremini mushrooms | 11 ounces baby yukon gold potatoes or 12 ounces white potato sticks | 1 tablespoon cremini mushroom | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger powder | 1 teaspoon red chili powder | 1 teaspoon dried sage | 5 egg whites
instructions: Place potatoes and mushrooms in a pot big enough to handle them and fill 2/3 full with water.  Bring to boil and cook until potatoes are soft, 3 - 5 minutes depending on size of potatoes.  Drain water and cool potatoes in a colander for 10 minutes to rid of excess moisture.  Slice potatoes thinly.  Using a mandoline or a chef's knife, slice potatoes in 4 - 5 diagonal lines on a mandoline.  Cut mushrooms in half from stem to tip.  If using a pizza cutter, put a 1/4 round in each end.  Place sliced potatoes in a large bowl and add cold water to cover potatoes.  Set aside.  Drain potato water and pat dry with paper towels.  Place in bowl and coat with egg whites.  Set aside.  Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat.  When hot, add butter and ginger powder.  Cook for 5 minutes, until ginger is fragrant and slightly brown.  Add mushrooms and cook about 3 - 4 minutes until mushrooms are starting to brown slightly.  Stir in potato water.  Add chili powder, sage and eggs.  Toss until well mixed.  Spread potato mixture into pan.  When top is brown, carefully place a paper towel on top to keep it from sticking.  After about 2 - 3 minutes, flip bottom and let rest a minute.  Remove paper towel.  Place other skillet with hot butter on top of skillet and put lid on skillet.  Cook 4 - 5 minutes.  Remove lid and turn potato mixture.  You can eat this with chutney or other topping or even serve with a side of fresh fruit.

title: Homemade Spicy Nacho Rounds
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes ( adjust to taste )
instructions: Grind the chuck.  Put chuck and chili powder in container and press with fingers to mix thoroughly.  Heat a heavy frying pan or skillet on high heat.  Dip one side of the nacho rounds in the molten oil, then fry until light golden brown, adding more oil as needed.  Let cool and sprinkle outside with your choice of shredded cheese.

title: Cherry Guacamole
ingredients: 1 avocado, peeled and chopped | 1 cup diced onion | 1 can diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained | 1/2 teaspoon mace | 1/2 cup chopped fresh cherries
instructions: Mash the avocados in a bowl with a fork or spoon.  Stir in the onion, tomatoes with green chilies, mace, and cherries.

title: Pea Soup with Potatoes, Fritters and Vegetables
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup shortening | 1 lb potato, peeled and cut into 1 inch chunks | 2 quarts vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 cup frozen peas or 1 cup fresh peas, defrosted
instructions: In a large soup pot, heat oil.  Fry potatoes for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add stock and baking powder.  Bring to high and boil, partially covered.  Reduce heat and continue cooking for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.  With slotted spoon, remove potatoes from soup and put in a serving bowl.  Add peas or peas to soup while stirring.  Heat and stir for another 2 to 3 minutes.  Pour soup into warm soup bowls and serve.

title: Rice With Beef
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain rice, washed | 1 lb tri-tip steak, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons dried greek oregano | 1 tablespoon celery salt ( can substitute celery or balsamic )
instructions: Soak rice in warm water for about 30 - 45 minutes.  Add salt.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat.  When pan is hot, pour about 1 1/3 cups of luke warm water into the pan.  Put it in the skillet, close the lid and let steam for about 1/2 or until water in the pan evaporates.  Remove from heat and let stand for a few seconds.  Uncover the pan and, while still hot, pour a little more water into the pan.  Add a tablespoon of dried oregano.  Stir and cook for 1 minute to give the rice time to absorb most of the water.  Drain rice well in a colander.  Serve rice topped with beef slices, drizzled with remaining oregano.  Garnish with remaining dried oregano.

title: Thai Steamed Orecchiette
ingredients: 200 g orecchiette | 425 g sweet port wine, chilled ( i used a nice fruity red ) | 2 tablespoons thai red curry paste
instructions: Cook orecchiette in boiling, slated water until just tender.  Drain.  Meanwhile, empty 200 ml of chilled port out of a colander into a small bowl and add the red curry paste.  Microwave on high for 1 min until fragrant.  Pour the contents into a large bowl.  Add the orecchiette and stir to mix.  Serve warm with freshly steamed green vegetables such as fresh sweet onions.

Random Ingredients: cottage cheese,onion,cream mushroom soup,baby spinach,beef brisket,ricotta cheese
title: Crock Pot Creamy Beef and Spinach
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs large beef brisket, fat trimmed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1 can cottage cheese | 12 ounces fresh baby spinach, coarsely chopped | 1 medium onion, chopped | 1 cup ricotta cheese
instructions: Rinse beef inside and out, and pat dry.  Place brisket on the bottom of a 5 qt crockpot.  In a bowl combine 1 cup of mushroom soup, cottage cheese, spinach, onion and garlic.  Pour mixture over meat and sprinkle with remaining 1 cup of soup.  Stir to coat.  Cover and cook on low 7 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,egg yolk,aubergine,salmon fillet,garlic red chile paste,nutritional yeast,beef stew meat
title: Stuffed Aubergines
ingredients: 4 aubergines - medium size | 2 green bell peppers | 4 ounces smoked salmon fillet, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon garlic-and-red chile paste | 1 tablespoon nutritional yeast | 4 egg yolks | 12 tablespoons beef stew meat, browned
instructions: Wash the aubergines under cold water, removing the hard peel then score the top of 1/4 and remove the pulp with a sharp knife.  Peel the skins then cut each length ways into 3 equal halves.  Wash the green peppers and cut into 3 lengths each then cut into 4 pieces.  Cut 2 slits on the top of each half and prick all over with a fork, place them into a saucepan and cover with cold water.  Bring to the boil, and cook for 3 - 5 minutes, then drain.  Rinse the fish, and pat dry.  Place the flesh in a bowl, add the chopped salmon, garlic chile paste, nutritional yeast and egg yolks.  Beat the yolks slightly, then stir into the onion mixture.  Put half the egg mixture in a greased ovenproof bowl, and top with the stuffed aubergines.  Place another baking tray on top of each and pour boiling water into the oven until the water comes to room temperature before placing the baking tray on top of the aubergines.  Bake on middle shelf of your 180c for 40 - 50 minutes or until the aubergines are tender.  When cooked, run a knife around the edge of the baking tray and tip them out on to your serving platter with the onion on the bottom of the aubergines.

Random Ingredients: chipotle chile,lasagna noodle,sumac,dark soy sauce,gingerroot,marinara sauce,red curry paste,parsley sprig
title: Spicy Thai Red Curry Lasagna
ingredients: 12 ounces lasagna noodles | 2 cups marinara sauce | 1 -2 tablespoon red curry paste | 1 -2 tablespoon dark soy sauce | 1 -4 cup light soy sauce | 1 chipotle chile, crushed and minced | 3 -4 fresh parsley sprigs or 2 teaspoons dried parsley | 1 teaspoon grated gingerroot
instructions: If you are planning on making ahead, remove noodles from refrigerator and leave on counter for 30 minutes.  Drain and rinse noodles with cold water and dry thoroughly.  While noodles are still hot, stir red curry paste, dark soy sauce, dark soy sauce, chipotle pepper, parsley or crushed chilli in a small bowl into a smooth paste.  In a greased 9 x13 baking dish, spread a few teaspoons of the sauce mix on bottom of dish.  Layer noodles, then half of cheese sauce, then rest of noodles, then rest of sauce mix, then the last of cheese sauce, then top with reserved cheese.  Bake, covered, in a preheated 350f oven for 25 minutes.  Remove cover, sprinkle with salt and bake uncovered 5 - 10 minutes, or until bubbly and hot.

title: Tavuk Na Nazi (Dissolve Your Favorite Jelly)
ingredients: 1/2 ounce unflavored gelatin, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek ( or more )
instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups of rum or liqueur.  Stir together with a spoon, until a clear yellow foam appears on the surface.  Pour into a glass preserving jar and refrigerate for at least 5 days.  Bring out to room temperature before using.

title: Cabbage and Hazelnut Relish
ingredients:
1 large red cabbage ( approximately 2 lbs.
    - ) | 2 tablespoons hazelnuts
instructions: Separate cabbage leaves.  Cut cabbage leaves into 1/2 inch shreds and then separate shreds lengthwise.  Place hazelnuts in a medium bowl.  Toss with cabbage shreds and set aside.  Repeat with remaining shreds and hazelnuts until all are evenly coated.  Serve immediately.

title: Asparagus With Chile and Jack Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh asparagus, trimmed | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat broiler.  If asparagus is large enough, cut lengthwise into 1 pieces.  Place asparagus on baking sheet and broil 2 to 3 minutes or until tender.  If asparagus is very young, move them as they cook, 3 to 5 minutes per side.  Drain asparagus well on paper towels and keep hot.  Sprinkle asparagus with salt.  Place 2 tablespoons cheese in microwave safe bowl.  Microwave on high power 1 minute or until melted.  Top with asparagus.

title: Simple Taco Salad
ingredients: 5 tablespoons sesame seeds | 2 tablespoons tamari | 2 tablespoons apple juice | 1 head lettuce | any bottled picante sauce
instructions: In small bowl, toss mustard with sesame seeds.  Mix in tamari and apple juice.  Toss lettuce with dressing, and garnish with sesame seeds.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white mushroom,molasses,tortilla chip,ricotta cheese,sun tomato oil,cardamom pod,corn oil peanut,avocado
title: Mushroom and Avocado Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs white mushrooms, cleaned cleaned, sliced, cooked and drained | 2 ripe avocados, peeled, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 lb ricotta cheese | 6 medium sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, chopped | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained | 2 tablespoons molasses | 1 tablespoon corn oil or 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon crushed cardamom pod, crushed ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fine corn chips
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.  Serve with corn chips.

title: Roasted Escarole Sauté
ingredients: 1 medium head escarole - rinsed, dried, and chopped | 4 medium baking apples - peeled, cored, and chopped | 4 tablespoons cornmeal | 5 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme | 2 tablespoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Spread the escarole into a roasting pan, and cover completely with foil.  Place the pan on the center rack of oven, and bake until tender, about 40 minutes.  Place the apples into a bowl, and toss with cornmeal, thyme, and red pepper flakes.  Set aside.  Remove the foil, and spoon the vegetables over the escarole.  Sprinkle all with olive oil, and broil until crispy.

Random Ingredients: red chile sauce,hazelnut,fish stock,cocoa powder,basil,irish cream,fontina cheese
title: Hot Chocolate with Chilli, Hazelnut and Hazel
ingredients: 1 cup hazelnuts | 4 ounces fontina cheese or 4 ounces other mild white cheese, cut into 1 cm cubes | 1 teaspoon red chile sauce | 1 liter fish stock | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons sweet basil | 1/2 cup irish cream, warmed slightly
instructions: Roast the hazelnuts and cheese in a dry frying pan over medium heat, shaking the pan frequently, for about 8 minutes, until the nuts are just beginning to color.  When done, transfer to a bowl, cover with a damp towel and set aside to cool.  Grind the ground hazelnuts to a coarse meal using a food processor, blender or spice mill.  Mix in the chilli sauce, fish stock and cocoa powder.  Stir in the basil and spread the mixture over bread.  Serve immediately with chilled irish cream.

Random Ingredients: rom tomato,nonfat milk,soy sauce,rice noodle,stewing beef,corn kernel,cheddar monterey jack cheese
title: Rice Noodle Beef Soup
ingredients: 1 lb stewing beef, trimmed | 1 can corn kernels ( with water ) | 8 cups nonfat milk ( use low fat for this recipe ) | 1/4 cup low sodium soy sauce | 1 roma tomato, chopped, seeds removed | 1/2 cup cheddar/monterey jack cheese blend, shredded | 6 ounces rice noodles, cooked, hot
instructions: In a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker, combine beef, corn, milk, soy sauce, tomato and cheese.  Cover and cook on low 8 hours, or on high 1 - 1 1/2 hours, or until meat is tender.  Stir in noodles.  Serve with shredded cheddar and slices of cheddar cheese.  Variation, substitute beef or chicken for the meat.

title: Peas and Cognac Appetizer - Peas, Peanuts or Rice
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups peas ( canned or frozen ) | 2 tablespoons cognac or 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Cook peas and cognac on the stovetop or in an electric frying pan for about 2 minutes over medium heat.  Remove peas from pan and place on a serving platter.  Pour the cognac on top and serve immediately.  Variation, make your own microwave popcorn using cooked peas and replace the label with 1 tbls.  Ground almonds for added flavor or serve with freshly made bread or toast.

title: Ahi Poke
ingredients: 2 pounds ground chuck | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 1/2 cup ice water
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together the ground chuck, teriyaki sauce and ice water.  Cover, and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.  Cook on the grill over medium high heat until evenly browned, and very hot.  Be careful as the beef can easily burn.  Serve hot.

title: Steamed Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm white fish fillets, such as cod, halibut or salmon, rinsed and well drained | 2 -4 cups tortillas, wrap warmed
instructions: Place fish in a steamer basket.  Cover and steam over water in medium covered pot or large skillet about 20 minutes or until just barely opaque.  Uncover.  Arrange on heated platter or plates.  Garnish with tortillas, if desired.

title: Namasu - Donburi Bunt
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken wings | 2 pounds beef round steak, sliced | 4 large beetroots - peeled, halved, and cut into cubes | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1 dash ground cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Bake the chicken wings in the preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until they are completely cool enough to handle.  Split the beef in half, and slice into thin round slices.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and cook the beetroot cubes until tender, about 8 minutes.  Reserve cooking water for the soup.  When the chicken wings are cool enough to handle, remove the flesh from the thick skin.  Slice the meat into cubes, and set aside in a large bowl.  Cut the shredded beetroot into thin slices.  Add the sliced beetroot to the bowl with the beef, and toss to combine.  Place in the refrigerator.  Place the sliced beef and beetroot cubes into a large bowl.  Mash the beans with sesame seeds.  Add the sesame seed mixture, onion powder, and cinnamon to the chicken meat.  Mix well.  Place all the contents of the bowl into a 3 - 3 1/2 quart casserole.  Place in the preheated oven, and bake for 1 hour.  Remove from the oven, and sprinkle with additional sesame seeds.  Serve from a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,red curry paste,snow pea,whipping cream,water chestnut,portabella mushroom
title: Red Curry Snow Pea Fritters
ingredients: 1/2 large portabella mushroom ( finely diced ) | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 2 tablespoons water chestnuts ( finely chopped ) | 1 cup fresh snow peas | 1 cup self-rising flour | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminium foil.  Chop mushrooms finely and combine with curry paste and water chestnuts in a bowl.  Add snow peas and mix well.  Add flour and mix well.  Form a well in mixture and add cream, mix well, and form little balls with hands.  Drop onto the prepared baking tray and bake for 7 - 10 minutes.  These fritters will be firm and crispy on the outside but will crisp in the middle and will be tender in the center.

title: Simple Spanish Dip
ingredients: 8 ounces thick & chunky salsa | 1 1/2 cups white breadcrumbs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, stir together the salsa and bread crumbs.  Serve with baked tortilla chips or other flatbreads.

Random Ingredients: flax seed,dark chocolate,egg,red food coloring,apricot preserve,half,bell pepper,plain yogurt
title: Homemade Flax Nuts
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground flax seeds or 1 tablespoon cornflour | 4 ounces plain yogurt | 2 eggs | 1/4 cup half-and-half | red food coloring ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons extra-virgin dark chocolate or 2 tablespoons unsweetened chocolate chips | 2 tablespoons apricot preserves | 1 1/2 english cut bell peppers or 1 1/2 poblano peppers, seeded and finely chopped
instructions: Mix the crumbs and spices together, then using a tablespoon press the mixture evenly over the bottom and sides of a greased 1 1/2 pint glass measure.  Leave it in the measuring cup.  Beat the yogurt and eggs until light and frothy, then mix with the half and half.  Transfer the yogurt mixture to the bowl and mix with the food coloring.  Add the choc chips and preserves and mix well.  Add the red bell pepper and mix well.  Pour the yogurt mixture evenly over the breadcrumbs and sprinkle the top with the white chocolate chips.  Bake in a pre heated 180c/350f oven until the topping has browned and the nuts are just barely golden, about 25 minutes to 1 hour.  Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes.  Invert and leave the nuts on kitchen paper lined oven trays, then cut the cooled nuts into wedges and serve warm for breakfast.

title: Gator Shrimp
ingredients:
2 lbs shrimp, unpeeled, cleaned ( i have used 2-3 lbs of shrimp, although i like to use fresh ) | 1 pint mild green chili, chopped.
    - ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons dried hot pepper flakes | pickled jalapeno pepper ( optional )
instructions: Cook shrimp.

Random Ingredients: juniper berry,vegetable stock,soy sauce,anchovy paste,red rice,golden syrup
title: Korean Fried Red Rice
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped anchovy paste | 3 1/2 tablespoons reduced sodium soy sauce | 1 1/2 tablespoons golden syrup | 3 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 1 1/2 - 3 1/2 cups instant red rice | 2 teaspoons juniper berries
instructions: In medium size bowl, in small bowl, toss anchovi paste with soy sauce, golden syrup, stock and 1 1/2 cups water.  Cover bowl and microwave for 12 minutes, stir well.  Cover and leave in a warm place.  Heat pan over medium high heat until sizzling.  Add rice and stir fry, moving rice around in pan for a minute or two.  Add 2 tbsp water and the juniper berries, cover and continue to fry another 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Lori's Indian Style Quiche
ingredients: 1 unbaked pie shell ( i used baking sticks ) | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 white onion, chopped ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon garlic powder | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 1 teaspoon white onion, grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f for the baking pan used for cooking the pie inches.  Combine the yogurt, white onion into a bowl, and add the onion, garlic powder, coriander and white onion.  Stir well.  Pour into the crust and bake for 20 minutes, then remove quiche from the oven and bake for 10 minutes more.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,pork tenderloin,ricotta cheese,bacon,black bean,hungarian paprika,splenda sugar substitute
title: Pork Paprika Beef or Tenderloin With Black Beans
ingredients: 8 slices bacon, chopped small | 2 1/2 lbs lean beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch pieces | 1/4 cup hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute | 1 can fat-free refried beans, undiluted | 32 ounces fat free ricotta cheese | 1 1/2 lbs pork tenderloin, sliced or package frozen pork loin
instructions: Cook the bacon in a large skillet until the outside is crisp.  Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain.  Drain most of the bacon fat from skillet and set aside.  Reserving a small amount of bacon drippings in the skillet, brown the meat quickly in the bacon drippings.  Return the drained bacon, paprika, and splenda to the skillet and add the refried beans.  Bring to a boil and simmer about 10 minutes, uncovered, stirring frequently.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Spread the ricotta cheese on the pork slices/loins and pour half of the beans over them.  Place pork slices on top of the bean mixture.  Cover with the final cheese layer, cover loosely, and place the loaf in the oven for approximately 1 hour.  Remove from oven, uncover the loaf, let sit to firm and cook a few minutes more.

Random Ingredients: vanilla extract,tarragon,oriental sesame oil,chocolate,red kidney bean,chicken bouillon cube,cotija cheese
title: Makaron's Famous Beans
ingredients: 1 tablespoon tarragon, chopped | 3 tablespoons cotija cheese, cubed | 1 tablespoon unsweetened chocolate | 1 teaspoon oriental sesame oil | 1 cup red kidney beans ( drained, rinsed and mashed ) | 2 chicken bouillon cubes, crushed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine all ingredients except for the kidney beans and bouillon and bring to a boil.  Lower the heat, and simmer for 20 minutes.  Add the beans and allow to remain on medium low heat until the water releases naturally, about five minutes more.  Turn off the heat and serve immediately.

title: Broccoli Cheese Appetizer(Appetizer)
ingredients: 10 ounces cheese, grated or 10 ounces farmer's cheese | 1 tablespoon rum extract | 1 bunch broccoli floret, halved if large | 1/8 cup walnut halves, toasted and chopped or 1/8 cup pecans
instructions: Process all ingredients except the nuts until smooth, about 1 minute.  Form into a ball.  Roll the ball in peanuts or nuts.  Serve as an appetizer at room temperature.  Store in refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,peanut oil,sun tomato oil,baking powder,salmon
title: Pound Fish With Sun-Dried Tomato Chutney
ingredients: 2 lbs skinless boneless salmon | 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 1/2 teaspoon baking powder | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil
instructions: Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl.  Rub the cut surfaces of the fish with the mixture of wet and dry ingredients, using hands to rub to coat the fish well. title: African Bean Salad With Apricot Glaze
ingredients: 1/2 cup caster sugar | 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin | 3/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 cup black beans ( drained and coarsley chopped ) | 50 g broccoli ( chopped ) | 1/4 cup apricot jam | 4 tablespoons iceberg lettuce ( rinsed, dried and finely chopped ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons black peppercorns
instructions: Combine sugar, cumin, turmeric and bean paste in a saucepan and stir over medium heat until sugar has dissolved.  Increase heat to high and boil, uncovered, for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in the broccoli and apricot jam.  Remove from heat.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Divide lettuce among serving plates and top with bean dressing.  Sprinkle with peppercorn.  Note, apricot glaze can be prepared up to 2 hours ahead, stirring before serving.

title: Persian Pork Meatballs With Avocado-Date Dip
ingredients: 500 g ground pork | 1 teaspoon wasabi powder | 1 tablespoon grated orange zest | 1 teaspoon grated orange peel | 1 tablespoon dried dates, finely chopped or 1 tablespoon dried dates, finely chopped | 1 avocado, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except avocado and mix well with hands.  Using 1/3 cup of mixture for half the meatballs mix ¼ cup of chopped avocado with the other half and roll into a ball flatten with your hands.  Cook on a tray lined with foil paper for 20 - 25 minutes until done.  Serve with dipping sauce or dip.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,jumbo shrimp,beef sirloin steak,broccoli floret
title: Prawn and Beef Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks, sliced thinly | 1 lb fresh broccoli floret | 1/4 cup thinly sliced orange peel, strips | 8 jumbo shrimp, peeled
instructions: Cook broccoli according to package directions, then rinse under cold water to stop it from cooking further.  Remove broccoli from refrigerator.  Mix beef slices with about 1/4 of the orange peel to make bite sized strips.  Heat wok over medium high heat until hot, then add 1 tablespoon oil.  Add meat and stir fry for 2 or 3 minutes.  Push meat to one side of wok, then add 3 or 4 shrimp, then stir fry for 1 minute.  Push meat to one side and add 1/2 cup of the broccoli sprouts.  Cook and stir until beef is cooked through and vegetables are crisp tender.  Stir in meat.  Stir in remaining 1/2 cup broccoli sprouts and orange peel, then reheat to serving temperature.

title: Honey Corned Silken French Fries
ingredients: 2 lbs hucks frozen black corn on the cob | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to about 400 degrees f and grease a 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking pan.  Cut the husk into 1 1/2 x 2 inch strips and cut deep slits in the top of the corn corn with a sharp kitchen knife about 1/2 inch deep.  Insert your fingers into the slits and push them through the slit.  Combine honey and 2 tablespoons of the honey mixture and brush on the cut surfaces of the corn.  Place in the preheated oven and bake until tender, about 25 minutes.  Note, it should not be soupy at this point.  Do not stir the corn until it is dry.  Be careful, this will burn very quickly and ruin the oven.  Allow to cool completely, about 30 minutes.  Serve immediately or store tightly covered if desired.

title: German Sausage Roll
ingredients: 1 dough ( bread dough or a roll, approximately 2 3 pounds ) | 1 package hokkien noodles ( you can buy this in bulk at a drug store ) | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed
instructions: Heat water to boiling and prepare the noodles according to package directions.  Drain and rinse the noodles.  Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8.  Using a 3/4 inch round cookie cutter, cut the sausage into 1/2 inch slices.  If using a roll, cut the slices at an angle into a half moon shape shape.  Use a spoon to fill the holes with noodles.  Place on a greased or parchment lined pizza pan, leaving about 1 1/2 inch space at the top of the dough.  Sprinkle the sausage on top and bake at 400° for 15 - 20 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.

Random Ingredients: hot pepper,mascarpone cheese,navy bean,beef bouillon cube,flour tortilla,green cabbage,rotel tomato,duck breast
title: Quick and Easy Duck Tacos from Tuscany (Or Country Cookbook)
ingredients: 6 flour tortillas | 4 slices duck breast | 1 can rotel tomatoes, diced tomatoes with jalapeno or ( 28 ounce ) can diced plum tomatoes with basil | 3 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 small head green cabbage, shredded | 1 can navy beans, drained | 6 tablespoons mascarpone cheese or 6 tablespoons cream cheese, divided | 3 -4 hot peppers
instructions: Lay one tortilla on work surface.  Spread the rotel tomatoes evenly over the tortilla.  Layer the chicken and duck breasts evenly over the tomatoes.  Sprinkle the diced tomatoes with the cubes of beef, salt, pepper, and garlic powder, depending on your tastes, and add the green cabbage.  Sprinkle the mascarpone cheese.  Close up the tortilla with a toothpick if using, and microwave for 1 to 1 1/2 minutes on high until cheese has melted.  Spoon some of the cheese filling down the middle of each tortilla.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: green grape,beef sirloin,picante sauce,corn chip,oatmeal,extra virgin olive oil,olive
title: Picante Beef Skewers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin, cut into 2 & quot, pieces | 2 tablespoons oatmeal | 2 tablespoons corn chips | 4 tablespoons green grapes or 4 tablespoons red grapes, halved | 1/4 cup sliced ripe olives | 1/2 cup picante sauce | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Combine oatmeal, corn meal and grapes.  Toss with beef.  Spread beef in center of a shallow, 2 quart baking dish.  Place grapes along edges and cover with picante sauce.  Seal dish tightly.  Set aside 1 hour.  Preheat broiler.  Remove beef from marinade and reserve marinade.

Random Ingredients: icing sugar,lamb chop,yellow pepper,bourbon whiskey,ginger,heirloom tomato
title: Heirloom Tomato Chops
ingredients: 6 lamb chops, trimmed | 2 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 tablespoons bourbon whiskey | 1 1/2 - 2 tablespoons crystallized ginger, minced | 3 -4 medium heirloom tomatoes, thinly sliced, seeds removed if desired | 2 large yellow peppers, grilled, halved, seeds removed
instructions: Sprinkle chops of chops with icing sugar.  Toast under the broiler, then turn and cook until done.  Meanwhile combine bourbon, ginger and tomatoes.  Arrange chops on plates and pour sauce over top.  Serve with vegetables on the side.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,pear,non vanilla yogurt
title: Homemade Pear Yogurt
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 pears, peeled and sliced in half ( approximately 24 oz, i've also used apples ) | 2 tablespoons non-fat vanilla yogurt ( or 1 1/2 teaspoons each of vanilla and almond flavor )
instructions: Place sliced pears in a steamer and cook.  Heat a little bit of water in a small pan to loosen any browned particles.  Lightly brush or spray pan with vegetable cooking oil.  Place half of pears on a cutting board.  Using a knife, score slices in half.  Place slices flat on cutting board.  With the cut side of a knife, smash some of the pears to release juice.  Place yogurt on top of pear slices.  Place more sliced pears on top.  Place lid on steamer and set timer to remind hersheys get all that yogurt is being squeezed, approximately 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,pork chop,jalapeno pepper,ice,ketchup,kielbasa,liquid smoke flavoring,apple
title: Apple Jalfardin' Kielbasa Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs cooked pork chops, cubed | 1 can apple chunks, drained ( i use a combination of the apples - they tend to be soupy ) | 1/4 cup lemon juice, freshly squeezed from 1/2 lemon | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 teaspoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1/4 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon minced jalapeno pepper | cracked ice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a crock pot, stir well to combine.  Cover and cook on low for 4 - 6 hours, remove from crock pot and stir.  Cover for 15 minutes.  Enjoy.

title: Orange Sweet Potato Fondu
ingredients: 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 tablespoons soft wheat germ | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 3 tablespoons liqueur | 1 large sweet potato | 4 tablespoons fresh orange juice | 2 ounces soft wheat germ
instructions: Dissolve the sugar in 1 tablespoon of the orange juice.  Stir in the liqueur.  Heat oven to 200c/gas peel off the potato and slice in half widthways, then dice them into 1cm cubes.  Lightly spray an ovenproof dish with cooking oil and pour in half the crumb mixture, then sprinkle over another half of the crumb mixture.  Dough should be completely moist.  Scatter half the sliced sweet potato over the crumb.  Scatter over the other half of the crumb mixture and press down so all the bread falls onto the potato.  Mix together the remaining 2 tablespoons orange juice with 2 teaspoons of water, then pour over the bread.  Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve with ice cream, whipped cream and creme fraiche.

title: Topping & Cheese for Vegetables
ingredients: 1 bag frozen cheese-filled green beans | 1/3 cup prepared horseradish | 1/2 cup prepared pizza sauce | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided | 1 cup shredded lettuce or 1 cup iceberg lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Cook the green beans for 8 - 10 minutes on each side or until crisp tender.  Drain and rinse with cold water to remove as much as possible from the green beans.  Coat the bottom of an 8x8 inch baking dish with the prepared horseradish.  Place frozen green beans on top, then spread the prepared cheese cheese on top.  Spread pizza sauce over the green beans.  Sprinkle with 2/3 cheddar cheese.  Cover with remaining cheese.  Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is golden & bubbly.

title: Grilled Herring
ingredients: 1 herring, in the shell | 2 cups heavy cream | 2 teaspoons cumin powder
instructions: Put your fish into a pan, fill with cold water, add 1 teaspoon of cumin powder and place over moderate heat.  Bring to the boil.  Turn the fish over from time to time.  You can tell it is cooked when it flakes easily.

Random Ingredients: beef stew meat,beef chuck,fennel,white zinfandel wine,chili paste
title: Easy Beef for Learners
ingredients: 1/2 cup chili paste | 1/2 cup fennel, chopped | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 2 1/2 cups dry white zinfandel wine | 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cubed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine dry chili paste and fennel.  Add beef and stir all to coat well.  In slow cooker, place beef mixture and wine.  Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 5 hours.  Remove meat from slow cooker to a serving platter and let cool.  When serving, stir in a small amount of chili paste sauce from slow cooker.  It should be the consistency of a thick paste.

title: Homemade Polish Sausage #SP5
ingredients: 1 lb sausage | 1 pound baking potatoes
instructions: Wash and peel potatoes, then boil until just tender.  Remove sausage and slice into 1 inch coins.  Cut sausage coins into 1 inch lengths.  Drop into boiling potatoes, drain and rinse with cold water.  Deep fry until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.  Eat with hot, crusty bread.

title: Sweet Pork and Cashew Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1/2 cup cashews | 1/2 cup lettuce, shredded | 2 tablespoons spaghetti sauce ( canned or homemade ) | 1/8 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1/2 lb cooked pork tenderloin, cut into thin strips | 1 tablespoon celery, minced | 2 teaspoons cocoa
instructions: Grind cashews in a coffee grinder or food processor until finely ground.  In a large skillet, heat spaghetti sauce over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Add cashews, lettuce, pork, celery, and cocoa.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,lasagna noodle,pomegranate seed,pecan,graham cracker crumb
title: Pesto Pesto
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles | 1 pint chicken stock | 1 cup chopped pecans | 1 cup pomegranate seeds | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the lasagna noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.  Drain.  When the noodles are still hot, stir in the chicken stock and 1 cup of pecans.  Cover the noodles and let the mixture stand at room temperature until the mixture is absorbed, about 20 minutes.  Drain the noodles and pecans.  In a medium bowl, stir together the pomegranate seeds and graham crackers.  Sprinkle half of the pesto onto a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Spread the noodles and pesto evenly over the pesto.  Stir the remaining pomegranate seeds and graham cracker crumbs into the pesto.  Spread the pesto evenly over the noodles.  Sprinkle the remaining grated cheese over the noodles.  Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven until the cheese is melted and the crust is bubbly, about 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg beater substitute,guacamole,chili powder,beef stock,barbecue sauce,chicken breast half
title: BBQ Chicken (With Egg Beaters)
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons chili powder | 1/2 cup beef stock | 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 6 tablespoons egg beaters egg substitute | 1 teaspoon chili powder, blend | 2 tablespoons guacamole
instructions: Place chicken breast in a ziploc bag with 2/3 sauce and chili powder.  Reserve remaining sauce.  Turn to coat, cover and place in fridge for at least 4 hours.  Heat barbecue to 375 f.  Remove chicken from ziploc bag.  Brush chicken with egg/beaters egg beat together egg, 2 tsp chili powder and 1 tsp chili powder blend in a bowl.  Heat a medium sized nonstick saute pan over medium high heat.  Place chicken in pan and cook for 5 minutes per side or until chicken is white and cooked through.  Brush reserved sauce over chicken and serve with reserved 1 tsp chili powder.  Note, you can also substitute any raw or boneless chicken for chicken, but this will make a prettier finish.

title: Aussie-Style Turkey Burgers
ingredients: 4 -6 small thick cut hamburger buns | turkey, steak
instructions: Divide the meat into four portions.  Grill or broil the meat until medium or don't over cook.

title: Italian Macaroni With Hot and Sour Peppers
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs elbow macaroni | 1/2 lb pepperoni or 1/2 lb spicy salami | 1/2 lb pizza-style hot pepperoni | herbs ( to taste ) ( optional ) | worcestershire sauce ( optional )
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and cool to room temperature.  Meanwhile, cut and combine peppers and hot dogs.  Add worcestershire sauce to taste.  When pasta is cooled, drain and mix all together.  Stir in hot pepper dogs and herbs if starting with the pizzas and/or pepperoni.

Random Ingredients: egg,hot sauce,tomato green chilies,apple juice,chili pepper flake,streaky bacon,kaffir lime leaf
title: Sour Cream and Sweet Chile Eggs
ingredients: 8 slices streaky bacon, chopped into small pieces | 250 g tomatoes and green chilies, peeled, seeded and chopped ( fresh or canned ) | 1 tablespoon hot chili pepper flakes ( i use pimenton de la vera ) | 2 kaffir lime leaves, chopped ( dried leaves ) | 1 handful kaffir lime leaf, leaves chopped | 4 eggs | 1 teaspoon apple juice ( optional )
instructions: Fry the bacon in a wok over a high heat until golden.  Remove to a bowl.  Fry the chilies, tomato and hot pepper flakes.  Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the kaffir lime leaves, lime leaf and eggs.  Scatter over the bacon and serve immediately, garnished with a sprinkling of apple juice if desired.

title: Pumpkin Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 lb velveeta cheese, diced | 1 cup pumpkin pie spice | 3 cans cherry tomatoes
instructions: Melt cheese add pumpkin cook on low.  Stir occasionally till brown and bubbly.  Add tomatoes and stir till warm enjoy with crackers, crackers or pretzels, rolls or pita bread.  Enjoy.

title: Quick and Easy Curry Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice, cleaned and uncooked | 10 fresh curry leaves, cut into 8 pieces ( optional ) | 1 -2 jalapeno, seeded, deveined, and thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce, more to taste
instructions: Rinse the rice and then set aside until needed.  Bring a 3 to 2 inch depth of water to a boil.  Add the rice, bring back to a boil and cover. .  Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 5 to 6 minutes, or until all of the water is absorbed.  Drain off the liquid, remove the cover and fluff with a fork.  If needed, add a little water.  Add the curry leaves, jalapenos, and worcestershire sauce and toss.  Refrigerate for about 30 minutes, or until all of the water is absorbed and the rice is fluffy.  The salad can also be served hot or chilled.

Random Ingredients: kernel corn,greek yogurt,chicken tender,white rum,vegetable oil peanut,pork sausage,horseradish,red leaf lettuce
title: Grilled Chilled Pork Sausages With Horseradish Slaw
ingredients: 1 tablespoon horseradish | 4 pork sausages | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil or 2 tablespoons peanut oil | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt | 2 leaves red leaf lettuce, torn | 1 can whole kernel corn, drained | 1/4 cup white rum
instructions: Preheat grill.  Prepare grill for cooking over medium high heat with tongs.  Grill the sausages, using tongs, turning, for 12 to 15 minutes, or until cooked through.  Remove from grill.  Slice them as thinly as possible, then cut the slices in half crosswise.  Combine the horseradish with 2 t.  Of the oil.  Spread half of the horseradish mixture evenly on each slice of sausage and place 1 lettuce leaf on each piece of sausage.  Spoon 2 tablespoons of the yogurt over the salad.  Sprinkle the remaining 1 t.  Of horseradish mixture, the corn and rum on top.  Grill, turning, until lettuce is warmed.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,bean,white bean,asian sesame oil,tilapia fillet
title: Asian Fish Chili
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned white beans, drained | 1/2 cup canned sweet bean sauce or 2 tablespoons white rice vinegar | 1/4 lb boneless skinless chicken leg | 1 tablespoon asian ( toasted ) sesame oil | 2 lb tilapia fillets
instructions: In medium saucepan, combine the white and sweet beans with the water.  Bring to boil over medium high heat until mixture boils, then reduce heat.  Simmer until reduced to 1 cup, about 15 minutes.  In large skillet, heat sesame oil over medium heat until hot.  Remove chicken from pan.

title: Lebanese Pasta
ingredients: 500 g white flour | 1 jar pesto sauce, of your choice
instructions: Blend the flour with your pesto in bowl.  Once mixed, add sauce of your choice and mix together.  Put your pasta on to boil and when it starts boiling turn the heat down.  Cook for 15 - 20 minutes and it's done.

Random Ingredients: thyme sprig,hard salami,apple juice,peppercorn,basil,superfine sugar,cumin powder
title: Basil and Walami Spiced Apples
ingredients: 1 lb hard salami, cut into 2in thick slices | 1 cup apple juice | 2 tablespoons superfine sugar | 3 fresh thyme sprigs | 2 teaspoons ground cumin powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns, cracked | 3 -4 fresh basil
instructions: Put all the ingredients except for the basil into a saucepan and cover.  Cook over low heat for 5 - 6 hours, until the mixture reduced and thickened.  Strain the apple mixture and discard the thyme sprigs.  Mix together with the salami until well coated and refrigerate.  Keep the sauce warm until ready to serve.  To serve, cut a cross on the top of each salami slice, to provide a decorative garnish.

title: Indian Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: Mix the first two ingredients well and pour over bread.  Stir every few minutes.  If you have any leftover fish dip, dip it in to the sauce to coat.

title: Spiced Dessert Nuts
ingredients: 30 g grated palm sugar | 10 ml curry paste | 1 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Melt the palm sugar in a pan over medium heat.  Add curry paste and ground mace.  Bring to a boil, stirring continually.  Boil for 2 - 3 minutes.  Pour into a greased shallow ovenproof glass or ceramic pudding basin.  Cover with foil and bake in the preheated oven at 160c for 1 hour.  Allow to cool at room temperature before serving.

title: German Style Salisbury Steak
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck-stuffed french-style cheese sandwich steaks
instructions: Slice a 6 x 8 deep pocket in both sides of cheese.  Open and place 1 side of cheese open faced on each of the pockets of bread, and fill the pocket with some of the meat from the sandwich.  Seal the cheese well with a toothpick or two of a pick.  Repeat until the sandwiches are filled to your preferred size.  Place in a large casserole dish & add water to a depth of 3/4 to 1 of the depth.  Bake in a pre heated 350 degree oven for 90 - 120 minutes or until meat is fully cooked and very hot.

title: Hot Maryland Crab
ingredients: 1 can crabmeat | 1/2 cup cooking wine | 1 cup beer
instructions: Drain crab meat.  Add wine and beer to crab.  Cover.  Simmer 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,red snapper fillet,white miso
title: Miso Fish
ingredients: 1 red snapper fillet | 1 green chili pepper, chopped | 4 teaspoons white miso
instructions: Score slits in the skin of the fillet.  Place the fillet under a hot grill for 6 to 8 minutes depending on the thickness of the fillet.  Sprinkle with scallions and fresh chilies and drizzle with miso.

Random Ingredients: green chilies,sherry wine vinegar,mexican cheese,anaheim chili,ranch bean,beet,stevia,coriander seed
title: Chicana Salad (Serves 4)
ingredients: 1 can ranch style beans, drained | 1/2 cup diced beets | 1 large ripe anadheim chili, seeded and chopped | 2 ounces diced green chilies | 4 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar | 8 tablespoons mexican cheese, shredded | 1/4 teaspoon ground coriander seed | 1/8 teaspoon chile seeds
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the beans and beets.  Add the chilies, vinegar, cheese, coriander and chile seeds.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,mexican cheese,flour tortilla,turkey,plum tomato
title: Cheesy Turkey Flatbread
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 1 cup shredded mexican cheese blend | 8 ounces cooked turkey, chopped | 3 plum tomatoes, chopped | 1 medium green cardamom pod, crushed
instructions: Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.  Place the tortillas on a plate and cover with damp paper towels.  Microwave on high approximately 45 seconds.

Random Ingredients: penne pasta,dijon mustard,egg white,chicken breast,dill,strawberry,seashell pasta
title: Chicken and Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 package bow-tie pasta, uncooked | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1/4 cup dijon mustard | 3 skinless chicken breasts, cooked and chopped | 1 package frozen strawberries, thawed and sliced | 2/3 cup seashell pasta | 1 package fresh sweetened pepperberries, washed and sliced
instructions: Cook pasta to pare.  Drain and cool under cold water.  In a large bowl combine egg white with mustard.  Add chicken, tomatoes, salad and seashells and vegetables.  Toss.  Serve.

title: Garlicky Garlic
ingredients: 15 pounds fresh garlic | 2 tablespoons pickling spices
instructions: Place the garlic into a covered container, and let it sit until the water becomes cloudy, about 12 days.  Rinse the garlic from the water.  Pour the water over the garlic, in the container.  Mix the pickling spices into the solution to make a thin paste.  Keep in the refrigerator until all of the water has drained off.  Cover with remaining water, and let stand for 3 days in a dark, cool place.

Random Ingredients: buttermilk,chicken strip,pork tenderloin,sun tomato oil,macaroni noodle,garlic powder
title: Quick and Easy Chicken and Shrimp Macaroni
ingredients: 4 bone in pork tenderloins, cut 1 1/2 inch thick | 14 ounces macaroni noodles | 4 teaspoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and sliced thin | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried minced garlic powder or 1 dash garlic powder ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup buttermilk ( optional ) | 2 -3 1 -2 ounces chicken strips or 2 -3 shrimp, in chunks
instructions: In a large frypan, heat 1 1/2 tsp of oil over high heat.  Place the coated pork tenderloins in pan and cook for 4 minutes on each side about 1 1/2 to 1 3/4 inches thick.  Set aside and remove all other unwanted ingredients except macaroni noodles.  Add remaining oil and sun dried tomatoes to pan and heat, cooking for one to two minutes.  Meanwhile, in a 1½ qt casserole coated with nonstick spray, combine macaroni noodles, tomato sauce, chicken and cooked beef and pork and heat to boiling, stirring constantly.  Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 5 minutes or until the noodles are tender.

title: Gefilte (Swiss Chard) Cured Meat With Capers
ingredients: 4 cups swiss chard | 1 kg swiss chard | 2 tablespoons capers | 8 cardamom pods | 1/4 cup coriander clove
instructions: Chop chard into 3cm cubes.  Place in a bowl with the capers.  Soak the whole cardamom pods for 5 - 8 minutes in enough water to cover the chard, then break them down into a tea ball.  Add to the chard.  Leave to sit for 1 hour depending on how stiff the chard is.  Remove the cardamom pods.  Pound the coriander.  Add the whole lot to the chard.  Chop the chard into 1cm slices.  Pour into a jar and leave for a week, shaking it so that the mixture gets well mixed.

Random Ingredients: chocolate coffee bean,vanilla essence,pork loin chop
title: Pork Chops With Spicy Chocolate and Vanilla
ingredients: 2 pork loin chops ( about 300g per person ) | 4 ounces of organic vanilla flavoured chocolate and coffee beans, drained well | 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla essence ( optional! )
instructions: Trim excess fat from pork chops.  Place pork chop slices in a shallow baking pan and sprinkle pork with vanill flavoured chocolate and coffee beans, if using.  Sprinkle liberally with a little vanilla essence.  Bake in pre heated oven about 100 degrees for about 20 - 30 mins on each side or until cooked.  Enjoy.

title: French Revolution Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 container whole milk ricotta cheese | 1/3 cup rice vinegar | 1/4 cup minced fresh fig ( about 2 tablespoons ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons minced prosciutto ( about 3-4 ounces ) | 1 pinch paprika
instructions: Combine the ricotta cheese, rice vinegar, figs, prosciutto, paprika, and a dash of sugar in a bowl.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours, or overnight, to develop flavor.  Toss with additional paprika and serve.

title: Smoky Baba
ingredients: 2 eggplants | 1 pint heavy cream | 1 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Cut eggplants into rounds, about 1/2 inch thick.  Bake until the skin bubbles, and is starting to brown.  Let cool.  When cool, split lengthwise on the side.  Slice into 1 1/2 inch slices.  Combine cream, chili flakes and fenugreek in small bowl.  Fry the slices in this until browned, using 1 tbsp cream for each.  Serve with plain white rice.

Random Ingredients: pork shoulder,teriyaki sauce,peach,grain white rice,beef stew meat,olive oil
title: Budget Stuffed Peaches for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 2 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch chunks | 3/4 cup olive oil | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 3 -4 fresh firm peaches, cut in half, then in half again, crosswise | 1 teaspoon butteryaki sauce ( or soy sauce to adjust flavor ) | 3 cups minute long grain white rice
instructions: Remove the pork cubes from the freezer, place into the crock pot, and add oil, teriyaki sauce, and salt and pepper.  Wash, peel and cut a pocket in each peach half about 1/2 an inch deep, and stuff with one half of each meat.  Insert the meat with a toothpick.  Put the peaches into the crock pot, and cover with the remaining meat mixture.  Cook on high for 4 hours, and then turn to low and cook for a total of 3 - 5 hours.  Serve over rice.

Random Ingredients: pork,flat leaf parsley,celery leaf,sunflower seed,half,chili sauce,clove garlic,granny smith apple
title: Porcen
ingredients: 1/4 cup sunflower seeds | 3 tablespoons sunflower seeds | 2 garlic, peeled and crushed | 1 kg ground pork | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 2 granny smith apples, peeled, finely diced | 1 cup coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley | 1 1/2 cups light cream or 1 1/2 cups half-and-half
instructions: Place all the ingredients except the cream in a bowl and mix well.  Form the mixture into 2cm thick balls and place on a non metallic plate.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Preheat the oven to 190°c.  Remove the meat mixture from the refrigerator, and place on an ovenproof frying pan, then cook for 10 minutes on each side or until browned and cooked.

Random Ingredients: beef stock,dijon mustard,cremini mushroom,beef bouillon granule,pork loin,icing sugar,white vinegar
title: Mushroom & Pork Rollups
ingredients: 500 g cremini mushrooms, sliced | 200 g pork loin | 250 g boneless lean beef short ribs, chopped | 1 teaspoon dijon-style mustard | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon granules | 1 tablespoon white vinegar | 5 teaspoon icing sugar | 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
instructions: Place mushrooms, pork & beef in a bowl and sprinkle with dijon style mustard, beef bouillon granules.  Mix well & set aside for at least 15mins or over night.  Place remaining ingredients except icing sugar into a shallow jug.  Put equal amounts onto each roll.  Poke holes in the top with a skewer & sprinkle with icing sugar.  Roll each roll in icing sugar, then drizzle each roll with a little dijon style mustard & cover with cling film.  Keep aside for 15 minutes.  Cut into slices as required then serve immediately or allow to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: daikon radish,chinese cabbage,sharp cheddar cheese,water chestnut
title: Chinese Coleslaw
ingredients: 4 cups shredded cabbage | 1 cup shredded sweet chinese cabbage | 1 can sliced water chestnuts, drained | 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.  Garnish with shredded cheese.

title: Broiled Brown Rice (Broeth Met Witteela)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons soy sauce, divided | 2 cups brown rice, uncooked ( or white ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves
instructions: Mix equal amounts of soy sauce and white rice in a bowl, making sure the rice is completely coated in mixture.  Set rice aside to marinate.  Preheat broiler.  Place rice on a baking sheet.  Lightly toast under the broiler.  Watch carefully.  After about 1 minute toss the rice so that it is all coated with soy sauce mixture.  Sprinkle the mint leaves on top.  Broil till golden brown.

title: Kari Nuts (Deep Fried Cuts)
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 teaspoon coconut powder, or more to taste ( optional )
instructions: Coat a deep fryer or large saucepan with cooking spray.  Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Add coconut powder if using, stirring to coat evenly.  When it is to your liking, toss nuts with coconut powder until coated thoroughly, just long enough to lightly fry them.  Remove nuts with a slotted spoon, and let cool.

title: Peperonato
ingredients: 1 kg sweet gherkin or 1 kg flat-leaf italian parsley | 4 sprigs thyme | 50 ml cognac | 2 teaspoons mild balsamic vinegar
instructions: Slice open the parsley sprigs and remove the stems.  Place in a sterilized lidded jar and close with twine.  Place in the refrigerator and leave for two days, then strain.  The longer this time keeps the flavour of the herbs and the liquor is released, the stronger the flavour becomes.  The idea is to remove the herb residue by placing the lid on and making sure that a little of it remains.  It is up to you how strong your flavour really is.  After two days, take the jar out of the fridge, take off the twine and place on a serving plate.  Stir up the brandy from it and bottle back into the fridge.  The flavours will develop.

title: Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 3 sheets phyllo pastry | vegetable oil | 1/3 cup triple sec
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Place a sheet of phyllo dough onto a baking sheet and brush with a little oil.  Sprinkle with triple sec.  Place another pastry sheet onto this and brush with more oil.  Cut into 3 or 4 triangles.  Bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: egg white,lychee,black eyed pea,apple cider vinegar,thyme,marinara sauce,avocado
title: Blackened Black-Eyed Pea Salad
ingredients: 1 can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed | 1 apple cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons minced fresh thyme | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 42 fluid ounces prepared marinara sauce | 1 avocado, cut into thin slices | 42 fluid ounces chilled cocktail or 42 fluid ounces carbonated beverages, such as sprite
instructions: In a small bowl combine black eyed peas, apple cider vinegar, minced thyme and beaten egg white and mix well.  Layer salad ingredients in bottom of large clear glass serving dish.  Add black eyed pea mixture.  Pour prepared marinara sauce over salad.  Cover and chill at least 6 hours.  Serve with chilled cocktail soda or carbonated beverages.

title: Mexican Potato Shreds (Potato)
ingredients: 16 -24 medium-large potatoes | 1 cup masa harina | 1 tablespoon potato starch | 1/2 teaspoon cracked black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f in a large bowl beat potato starch on high with a fork or spoon.  Mix in masa harina with a fork or spoon and mix well with a fork.  Add more flour if mixture is dry and a little more water if too dry.  Dough will be firm and slightly moist.  Turn dough out onto a clean surface, knead lightly, and pat or roll to 1/2 inch thickness.  Cut dough into squares or diamonds, and place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet.  Sprinkle tops with pepper.  Bake for 10 mintues, or until tops are lightly browned.

title: Moorish Salmon Patties
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces fresh sorrel, chopped | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon corn oil | 1/4 cup dry breadcrumbs, made from day-old breadcrumbs ( dry bread crumbs ) | 1 cup strawberry jam or 1 cup sour raspberry jam | 1 teaspoon sriracha sauce ( optional )
instructions: Rinse and drain sorrel well, place in bowl, stir in turmeric and set aside.  Chop sorrel.  Add oil to pan over medium high heat.  When just a shimmering bubble, drop in sorrel mixture and stir.  Add bread crumbs and stir continuously over medium heat until mixture looks dry, it is ok.  Add salt and pepper to taste and stir until liquid has been absorbed.  Remove from heat.  Place mixture on a sheet of greaseproof paper and flatten slightly with meat mallet.  Repeat until mixture is no longer sticky.  Dust with additional bread crumbs.  Serve with your favorite jam and/or dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: brandy,pickling salt,apple cider vinegar,ginger paste,stew meat,tomato green chile pepper,chicken bouillon granule
title: Indian Shredded Beef
ingredients: 2 pounds stew meat, cut into 2x2 inch pieces | 4 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 1/4 cup pickling salt | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon granules | 5 teaspoons beef flavor dark paste, or more if needed | 2 teaspoons ground ginger paste | 1 can diced tomatoes and green chile peppers
instructions: Place beef in a large pot, and add enough water to barely cover the meat.  Add cider vinegar, pickling salt, chicken stock, dark tomato paste, and ginger.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.

title: Greek Black Olive Chicken

instructions: Preheat the oven broiler.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Arrange half of the chicken over the foil.  Cover with olives, cover with remaining chicken, and place under the oven broiler.  Broil for 45 to 60 minutes, or until meat is no longer pink in the center.  You want to broil a little at a time during this time to ensure that the olives cook evenly.  Allow to rest for about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Jungle Green Beans
ingredients: 2 cans large green beans, drained, cut in 2-inch lengths | 1/2 cup dark rum | 12 large whole grain wheat tortillas
instructions: Place half of the beans in a bowl.  Drizzle with rum, tossing to coat.  Set aside to marinate.  Top 1 tortilla with remaining beans.  Wrap and secure loosely with 2 toothpicks.  Brush each with remaining rum.  Wrap tightly in aluminum foil or waxed paper.  Refrigerate overnight.  Preheat grill to medium high heat.  Lightly oil grill grate.  Grill rolls about 3 minutes per side or until lightly browned and warmed through.

title: Classic Italian Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 lbs mozzarella cheese, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1/2 cup loosely packed fresh basil leaf
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the mozzarella with the basil leaves, until all is well mixed and covered.  Refrigerate the mixture at least one hour before serving.

title: Vegan Cabbage-Onion Korma
ingredients: 1/2 red cabbage, cut into wedges | 1/2 cup plain soy milk | 2 teaspoons instant coffee creamer | 3 garlic cloves, finely minced | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place all ingredients in a ziplock bag.

Random Ingredients: nam pla,chicken breast fillet,grain rice,tea,rice wine,american cheese,ancho chilies
title: Chicken in Pho (Aubergine) Soup
ingredients:
4 ounces rice, washed, soaked in water 10 minutes and drained | 5 cups chicken breast fillets ( or turkey, etc.
    - ) | 2 ounces nam pla ( thai fish sauce ) | 2 tablespoons long grain rice wine ( or sake ) | 2 ancho chilies | 5 slices american cheese
instructions: Grind whole ancho chilies in a mortar and pestle.  Marinate chicken in chilis for 10 minutes, then rub chilis lightly with chile soaking.  In a stock pot, arrange chicken and marinated chicken in single layer to make sandwiches.  Bring stock to simmer, add nam pla and rice and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.  Garnish with slices of american cheese and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,onion,cranberry sauce,oyster sauce,spaghetti sauce,milk ricotta cheese,red wine
title: Savory Ricotta Sauce

instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, mix ricotta with milk, sweetened condensed milk, italian sausage, onion and red wine and oyster sauce.  Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often.  Remove from heat, stir in cranberry sauce and spoon into bowls.

title: Chew-Cashew-Nut Yeast Bread
ingredients:

    - ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 2 1/2 cups unsalted cashew nuts

Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead for 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic.  Place in a greased bowl, and allow to rise 1 1/2 hours, or until the dough has doubled in bulk.

Random Ingredients: szechuan bean sauce,yellow pepper,chick pea,horseradish,mccormick taco seasoning,coconut oil,cottage cheese,white pepper
title: Yummy Cottage Cheese and Vegetable Patties
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 2 1/4 cups prepared horseradish | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 packet mccormick's taco seasoning | 1 teaspoon szechuan hot bean sauce | 1 package yellow peppers | 1 package frozen chopped sweet peppers | 1 can chick-peas
instructions: Whip cottage cheese until lumpy.  Combine remaining ingredients, mix into cottage cheese and add to meat, if desired.

title: Grilled Swiss Cheese over Yellow Bell Pepper
ingredients: 1 lb swiss cheese, grated | 1/2 large yellow bell pepper
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.  In a heavy gauge skillet or griddle, grill the yellow pepper skin side down, about 1 minute per side.  Cool slightly and slice into 1/2 inch wide strips.  Top each slice with cheese, pepper strips and any remaining vegetables.  Grill until melted and bubbly, about 1 minute per side.

title: Quick Carrot Beef Stew for Two
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck | 3 -4 medium carrots | 2 -3 cups grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Cut meat into 1 cubes.  Put meat cubes in the bottom of a dutch oven.  Sprinkle carrots over meat.  Add the bottle of grape tomatoes.  Add enough water to come to just come about half way up the sides of the dutch oven.  Cover tightly and bake for approximately 15 minutes.  If there is excess liquid in the dutch oven, just sprinkle some more water and some more tomatoes to compensate.

title: Chilly Chicken
ingredients: 4 small apricots | 2 tablespoons lemon grass | 2 tablespoons ground pepper | 2 tablespoons ground poultry seasoning | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 2 cups self-rising flour | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherry, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Cut the apricots in half, and remove the pits.  Wash the skin off of the apricots.  Roughly chop the fruit, if necessary.  Place the fruit in a blender, and blend until it forms a fine paste.  Combine the pepper, poultry seasoning, and tomato powder with 1/2 cup of water to make a smooth paste.  In a separate bowl, mix together the flour and the maraschino cherry.  Dip each apricot half into the flour, then the maraschino cherry mixture, and finally coat each fillet with the paste.  Place the fillets on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes in the preheated oven, or until brown.

title: Blueberry, Trout &  Berry Scented Fish
ingredients: 4 trout fillets or 1 whole other fish, about 1 1/2 inches thick | 2 cans or bottles frozen blueberries, defrosted | 2 vanilla beans or 2 -4 teaspoons freshly grated vanilla bean paste ( to taste )
instructions: If using fresh blueberries, remove the seeds and the strings if using berries.  Arrange frozen blueberries on a serving platter so they resemble a flat crown.  If using frozen blueberries, remove them from the freezer, defrost in microwave and set aside.  Split open the vanilla bean and scrape out the pulp and seeds.  Strain as much vanilla bean as possible from the beans and discard the bean seeds.  Sprinkle some salt over the berries and let stand for 15 - 30 minutes.  Remove any bones or skin from the fish if using whole fish, if using fish it's easier to remove when they leave the skin on.  If using canned blueberries, drain in a colander, pat dry with paper towels.  Rinse fish well under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  Rub a few grindings of vanilla bean paste all over the fish.  Place the fish on the platter and spoon some blueberry sauce over the fish.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cod,bulgar wheat,beef sirloin,crabmeat,pork loin roast,red chilies,green pepper,thai basil
title: Spicy Sausage and Broth  With Chilli & Crab
ingredients: 3 cups bulgar wheat, uncooked | 1 lb boneless pork loin roast | 1 lb pork loin roast | 1/2 lb beef sirloin | 10 cups beef stock ( i use beef bouillon ) | 1 green pepper, chopped | 1 -2 chopped red chili | 1 bunch green basil or 1 bunch tarragon
instructions: Rinse bulghur wheat in a mesh colander.  Cut meat into 5 slices and then cut diagonally across the grain.  In a large dutch oven or soup pot, boil water and cook meat until browned.  Put meat back in pot with bulghur wheat and add 3 cups of stock.  Add chilli & basil. .  Cover and simmer on low medium heat, about 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: pear,dark brown sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,taco seasoning,sage,salmon fillet
title: Steamed Whole Pear and Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 1 whole pear, cut into 4 wedges each | 1 ounce smoked salmon fillet, skin discarded | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 2 teaspoons dark brown sugar | 1 packet taco seasoning | 80 g parmigiano-reggiano cheese, shaved and divided | 2 tablespoons dark brown sugar
instructions: Place tuna, sage, 1/2 tsp sugar in food processor.  Process until fine.  Divide salmon between 2 microwave safe ramekins and top with pear and 1/2 tsp each of the grated cheese and shaved parmesan.  Sprinkle top with remaining 1/2 tsp sugar, cover and microwave on high for 3 minutes.  Let stand in the microwave for 2 minutes then stir to break up any clumps.  Top with remaining cheese and shaved parmesan, if using, and serve.

title: Spicy Thai Ginger and Shrimp Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon finely chopped peeled galangal ( ginger ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( light ) | 20 large raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Add the ginger and soybean liqueur to a wok or heavy skillet over medium high heat.  Stir fry the shrimp for 2 minutes.  Remove the shrimp with a slotted spoon over a bowl and set aside.  Stir fry the ginger until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Stir the shrimp back into the wok and stir in the liqueur, a few seconds, then toss the shrimp with the ginger and soy bean liqueur.  Cook for a minute or two, tossing the shrimp to coat all the shrimp with the flavor.

title: Irish Spaghetti Strips (Cook's Il Harnie)

instructions: Prepare all ingredients.  Mix thoroughly.  Let sit 10 minutes and serve on a large platter.

title: Baked Parsnips With Tomato and Orange Zest
ingredients: 2 2 medium parsnips or 150 g sweet potatoes | 1/3 cup mascarpone | 2 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, coarseley, finely chopped | 1 orange, zest of, grated | 2 italian tomatoes, very small, cut in thin wedges, about 3/4 cup
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f grease a large shallow ovenproof dish with some of the remaining oil.  Place the parsnips in a large pan of boiling water and simmer for 5 minutes or until just tender.  Rinse with cold water and pat dry.  Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the parsnips for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.  Remove the parsnips from the pan and arrange them into a deep, buttered shallow baking dish.  Cut the mascarpone into 12, 2cm lengths and scatter each with 1/2 tsp of salt in a bowl.  Make the zest through the zest and cut the rest into 5mm lengths and scatter over the parsnips.  Drizzle the tomatoes with the zest and sprinkle over the remaining salt.  Bake the parsnips for 25 minutes or until the zest is golden and the tomato is bubbling and hot.

title: Beans and Mushrooms on Lettuce
ingredients: 1 tablespoon corn oil ( sunflower or other flavourless oil ) | 1 small bell pepper, seeded and chopped ( or both, any colour, your choice ) | 1 small fresh button mushroom or 1 small asian sweet potato, washed and sliced | 1 1/2 tablespoons butter lettuce or 1 1/2 tablespoons gouda cheese, grated | 1/4 cup fresh bread, cut into small cubes ( crusty italian bread works best ) | 2 tablespoons parsley, chopped
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet.  Add the bell pepper and mushrooms.  Gently stir and cook for about 3 - 4 minutes. Serve at once.

instructions: Cook collard greens in a small amount of boiling water until tender, about 2 minutes.  Transfer to a bowl and mash with a potato masher.  Pour beef stock, lemon juice, gelatin, and espresso powder into skillet, and cook over high heat until gelatin is dissolved.  Bring to a boil.  Pour into collard greens and toss to coat.

title: Cuban Pork and Peppers

instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the red bell peppers in a single layer on a baking sheet and prick with a fork.  Roast the bell peppers in the oven for about 45 minutes, until charred from the outside.  Remove from the oven and place in a bowl of ice water.  When cool enough to handle, drain.  Remove the peels, cores and all, and discard.

instructions: Place a melon baller or other small spoonful on a piece of lemon peel to make a pliable round platter.  Using a very sharp knife, carefully cut a circle around the outside edge of the platter from stem to round base.  Repeat process with other lemon peel and herbs.  Place the platter platter in a baking dish lined with parchment paper, drizzle with amaretto or other alcohol, then cover and chill until serving.  The polenta should be slightly soft and pliable but not oily.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Working with one lemon and one amaretto at a time, spread the polenta on a flat surface.  Spread about 1 tablespoon of olive oil evenly over each piece of polenta and top with slices of lemon, olive, and basil.  Top with remaining amaretto.  Keep in mind that the final product will be thick and grainy.  Place baking dish on the middle rack of the oven and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Grilled Chicken & Spinach Sandwiches (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1 )
