instructions: Divide spinach among 6 slices of bread.  Top with chicken and spinach.  Sprinkle with thyme and remaining bread slices.

Random Ingredients: sea salt pepper,apple juice,skirt steak,plain yogurt,sushi rice,cocoa powder
title: Crock Pot Sizzlin' Beef Jerky
ingredients: 1 package boneless skirt steaks, cut into 3 by 2-inch strips | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder ( dutch process is really good ) | sea salt and pepper | 3 cups plain yogurt, strained to remove excess liquid | 1/4 cup apple juice | rice ( optional ) or steamed greens ( optional )
instructions: Put the beef in the crock pot.  Sprinkle the cocoa powder over the meat.  Add a small pinch of salt and pepper if desired.  The sauce adds quite a bit of zip and adds moisture.  Cook on your crock pot for 6 hours on high.  About 3 hours before serving mix together and let stand at room temperature for at least 20 or as long as overnight.  Remove meat and cut into thin slices.  Toss with yogurt or steamed greens and/or rice/wine.  This adds some moisture to the juice, so if you feel it needs more liquid you can add some apple juice or sour cream.  This is delicious served with warm bread or crusty french bread and is definitely best served at room temperature.  You can add more cocoa to the yogurt and sour cream to give it a kick.

title: The Easiest Ever Easy Apple Pie - and Really Yummy!!
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs apples or 3 -4 lbs pears | 1 1/2 - 2 cups unsweetened apple juice or 1 1/2-2 cups apple juice | crispies or cookie dough, to make sure they stay 'together'
instructions: Core and thinly slice apples or pears.  If using pears, peel, slice and then boil down the apple juice.  If using apples, peel, core and cut into eighths or fourths.  If using pears, peel, core and cut into eighths.  Put into a large freezer container with about one inch of water in the bottom of the container to keep apples 'tight' while preparing pears. .  Put about one tablespoon full of apple juice into a large nonstick frying pan and cook over medium low heat until water disappears. .  Add apples and turn heat up to medium.  Cook approximately 5 - 10 minutes until apples are starting to soften.  Then turn heat to medium low.  Do not brown.  If using pears, remove any pared skin and/or core.  If using apples, remove any additional water and/or juice and put into a bowl or large measuring cup.  Stir juice with juice to loosen the apple mixture then set aside.  Make sure to stir so that the bottom of the bottom doesn't burn.  When water is almost boiling away, put baking sheet into the oven at 450 degrees f.  The oven should also be ready.  Pour a half cup of apples or pears on the dough.  Place in oven, and bake approximately 20 - 30 minutes.  Serve apples drizzled with juices while still warm but not soggy.  Anyhow, make sure they don't get burnt.  Enjoy.

title: Dirty Beef Crostini

instructions: Mix all in crockpot.  Cook on low 10 hours or low 4 hours.  Garnish with cherries to serve on top.

Enjoy a glass of bailey's irish cream.

title: Roasted Basil Lettuce

title: Lumpia Recipe

title: Vegan Poached Lemons

instructions: Heat the stock.  After 5 mins add yeast.  Heat a frying pan until hot, add lobster and cook for 5mins on high heat stirring constantly.  Pour in the farfalle and cook on medium heat for 20 mins.  Serve with rosemary sprigs.

instructions: Dry the whiskey with a dry towel or folded towel and sprinkle it generously into a 1 cup glass measuring cup.  Sprinkle the cilantro leaves over the whiskey.  Chill the glass cup and cup filled with whiskey until ready to use.

instructions:
Name:- ##
 Easy Weeknight Pho  Rolls,  Chinese Style 
 
## Ingredients ##
 1 bag frozen collard greens, thawed ( I use Trader Joe's frozen, thawed ) | 1/2 cup shredded icing sugar | 1 teaspoon instant rice noodles, I use Goya brand and look for the brand `` Oriental '' brand in the market.  I cook a small package of rice noodles according to the directions on the package, drain and set aside.  If using frozen collards, thaw and drain well.  You want the collards frozen in their water to be easy to remove them from the frozen cubes.  If using fresh collards, rinse and remove the stems and any bad looking green matter in your area.  When the noodles are thawed, drain well and dry with paper towels.  I have no real measurements, but you should measure noodles and swish them around in the palm of your hand until you reach your desired texture.  Lay out your rice noodles and spray lightly with cooking oil spray.  Lay 3 - 4 sheets of foil in the same size pan you will be using.  Place a colander over them.  I like to place a plate in the pan and run a long sharp knife around the outside edge of the foil to prevent the noodles sliding around.  Place noodles on the plate, drizzle with about 1/2 cup of icing, cover with 2 - 3 tablespoons of rice stick and 2 - 3 mint leaves in between your fingers, then sprinkle with about 1/2 cup of icing.  Add about 1 1/2 cups of collards, a drizzle of your favorite flavoring, a few mint leaves and about 1/3 cup of sauce mixture.  Repeat with noodles and another drizzle of your favorite flavoring, ending with the remaining 1/2 cup icing, and a drizzle of your favorite liquid flavoring.  I use a small can of peanut oil flavored sprouts, but they are much much prettier when made just as quick as the packaged brand.  Place in a large freezer bag and freeze.  Thaw if you have made your own rice sticks, just leave it in the freezer for an hour, and then slice into 1 inch thins or smaller pieces using a very sharp knife.  You can use fresh rice sticks, but they require longer to cook, and they do tend to cook much quicker than the dried rice sticks.  The noodels should be frozen, or at least partly frozen, in a ziplock bag.  Once frozen solid, transfer to an airtight container with waxed paper on top to keep warm for up to a week. .  I usually get about 1 1/2 to 2 - 3 cups from this point, but you may have to repeat this twice or three times depending on thawing.

Place the turkey slices under the oat batter and coat with the jam.  Using a meat pounder or the back of a large spoon, gently roll the turkey slices to completely coat.  Arrange the turkey in a slow cooker.  Top with the remaining 1 ounce rolled oats, followed by the remaining 2 ounces of rolled oats.  Cover and cook on high 4 hours.  Serve warm with jam.

title: Roasted Vegetables With Leek
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots or 1 lb swiss chard | 1 large leek
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Cut leek in half down lengthwise.  Remove and discard outer leaves of leek.  Slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices, about 1/4 inch thick. .  Wash and dry leek well with paper towels, if any.  Arrange vegetables evenly in a shallow baking dish.  Scatter leek over vegetables and sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place dish in a large roasting pan.  Squeeze leek lightly but firmly to remove excess water.

Random Ingredients: coffee liqueur,kalamata olive,onion,backfin crab meat,mango chutney,vanilla,vegetable juice,flour tortilla
title: Chef John's Crab Quesadillas With Mango Salsa
ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable juice | 2 tablespoons coffee liqueur | 2 tablespoons mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla | 20 ounces creme de cajun-style prepared mango chutney | flour tortilla | 1/2 small onion, diced | 2 lbs backfin crab meat, cooked and flaked | 3 kalamata olives or 3 other brine-cured black olives, chopped
instructions: To make the mango salsa, combine the creme de cajun style mango chutney, mango chutney and vanilla in a bowl.  Place half of the salsa in a blender and pulse until smooth.  Gradually stir in the creme de cajun style mango chutney without breaking it up too much.  Spread half of the mixture evenly over half of a tortilla.  Top with half the onion and half of the crab.  Sprinkle with the remaining salsa.  Garnish with the olives.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Place a tortilla in the pan, flip it over and place it, uned side, on the pan.  Place another tortilla on top of each and cook until golden brown on the bottom, 1 - 2 minutes, and the cheese has melted and begun to lightly brown.  Cut into 4 wedges and serve, passing the wedge of cheese on the side.

title: Beef or Pork Kebabs
ingredients: 600 g ground sirloin ( or nz ground chuck ) or 600 g lean ground pork | 3 cups frozen peas ( or pkg frozen pea pods, mix ) | 1 1/2 cups corn on the cob, chopped fresh or frozen, for roasting or roasting | 20 -30 pieces pork legs with thigh ( or whatever other meat you like )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large bowl until everything is well incorporated using your hands, and form small patties that will fit into an oiled baking dish in a similar size or shape as meatballs, and freeze.  When you're ready to cook them, preheat the oven to 220c/425f/gas place a few wooden skewers into your ovenproof dish to keep them warm while you make the barbecue meat,.  Place the skewers onto a preheated oven shelf, and bake for about 15 – 20 minutes, or until the barbecue is bubbling and a little crusty around the edges.  Serve straight away with plenty of yoghurt, a green beans and some crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: sirloin steak,celery seed,hard egg,gingerroot,shallot,grainy mustard,kalamata olive,fusilli
title: Lite Beef and Olive Pasta Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces fusilli | 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into strips | 1 tablespoon minced shallot | 1 tablespoon minced fresh gingerroot | 1 teaspoon celery seed | 1 jar kalamata olives, drained and chopped | 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons grainy mustard
instructions: Cook pasta according to instructions on package.  When done, drain and set aside.  Pat steak dry & sprinkle with garlic, ginger and celery seeds.  In a large salad bowl, mix together olives, bread crumbs, hard cooked egg & mustard.  Toss with drained pasta.  Add beef & tomato mixture and toss until well mixed.

Random Ingredients: grain white rice,lasagna noodle,green cardamom pod,sunflower oil vegetable,icing sugar,spinach leaf
title: Nalesnabe Palikki (Spinach and Rice Lasagne)

instructions: Cook the lasagne in boiling water with 4 fl ozblsp of water for exactly 7 minutes.  Meanwhile, trim the spinach.  Put into a large pan with a little extra water.  Bring to the boil and simmer for 7 minutes.  Drain and squeeze into a bowl with a little more water.  Set aside.  When ready to serve, fry the cardamon pods in enough oil to cover them, for 1 minute.  Turn up the heat, add the rice in a single layer and fry for 2 minutes.  Pour over the spinach and fry for another minute.  Sprinkle over the icing sugar and stir inches set aside to cool.  Put a few tablespoons of the mixture at a time onto a warmed dish and roll up.  Place in a freezer bag or tin, cut into 4 pieces or 4 squares and steam them for 3 - 4 minutes until they're soft.  Remove from the oven, put in your serving plates and serve with tomato basil and a leaf salad.

title: Beef & Artichoke Sliders
ingredients:
3/4 cup cream of coconut | 3/4 cup strong black coffee | 1 lb thinly sliced deli roast beef | 5 medium thin sliced veal shanks | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained-diced | 1/2 cup chopped of fresh mint sprig ( not dried.

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk the cream of coconut and 2/3 cup of the coffee.  Spread evenly over the roast beef and veal shanks.  Cover and chill at least 3 hours. Repeat dipping in batches, working in batches if necessary, until the meat is cooked and the mint is coated lightly, about 4 to 5 minutes.  Drain the meat and vegetables well and set aside.  Cut each roll into 4 slices and spread 1/4 cup of the reserved mint sprigs on each slice.  Place 1 slice of meat on each of the 2 toasted hoagie buns.  Top with 2 tablespoons of the antipasto cream of coconut cream and 1 tablespoon of the artichoke hearts.  Return the top of the rolls to the skillet and press down firmly.  Bake 1 minute.  Carefully remove sandwiches from the skillet and serve.  This recipe can be made and frozen for up to 6 months.

title: Stuffed Bean Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces refried beans | 3 ounces cream cheese, at room temp, softened ( neufchatel cheese doesn't work as well ) | 3 ounces monterey jack cheese, shredded ( more for sprinkling on top )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Spread softened cream cheese on bottom of small baking dish.  Spread refried beans on top of cream cheese.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Bake at 300 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Serve warm with crackers or tortilla chips, or use in your favorite recipes.  If you're going to serve this with a green salad, serve with sour cream, guacamole, lettuce, tomatoes, green onion, etc.  This dip is also good as a delicious dip for green veggies or vegetables such as potatoes.

title: Shrimp Fra Diafra
ingredients: 1 jumbo shrimp ( or shrimp in shell ) | 2 tablespoons shortening, melted | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/8 teaspoon harissa | 1/8 teaspoon sea salt | 1 sprig fresh basil leaves, finely chopped
instructions: Place shrimp in a saucepan and add half and half, harissa and salt.  Cover and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer until almost all of the liquid has evaporated.  Stir in basil leaves.

title: Taste of Home
ingredients: 1 cup ice cream | 1/2 cup cornflour
instructions: Soak corn flour in cold water for 3 hours.

Random Ingredients: spinach,pomegranate molasses,mustard powder,lamb,egg noodle,yellow bell pepper,dark sesame oil
title: Chakchoukha Bi Laban (Egyptian Salad)
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 1 cup chopped yellow bell pepper | 2 cups chopped spinach or 2 cups escarole | 1/2 cup dry pomegranate molasses ( optional ) | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 4 teaspoons dark sesame oil | 2 packages fresh egg noodles, cooked | 1 1/2 teaspoons coarse ground mustard powder
instructions: Cook ground lamb in medium skillet until no pink remains in meat.  Add chopped bell pepper and cook 30 seconds.  Add chopped spinach or escarole and cook until wilted.

title: Chocolate Filled Easter Fingers (Ganache)
ingredients: 1 box red potatoes | 1 lb filling | 2 eggs, separated | 1 cup chocolate
instructions: Boil potatoes in enough water to cover them for 15 min, drain.  Mash slightly until they are somewhat smooth.  Mix potatoes with enough egg yolk to make 4 puffs of dough.  Mixture should be thick but not dry.  Cover potato mixture in wax paper and chill 2 hours.  Form puffs by rolling dough, using the tines of a fork, into 1/4 inch thick strips.  Place on wax paper in a freezer freezer bag and freeze until puffs are firm.  When ready to make your glaze, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, fold into potato mixture.  Place 1 tbsp of chocolate in a small bowl with the egg yolks.  Microwave for 1 minute, watch carefully.  Dip each hole on paper towel into chocolate, coating all sides.  Place on a wax paper lined cookie sheet, allowing excess chocolate to run off.  Top with more chocolate if desired.  Allow chocolate to harden completely before removing from freezer.  The amount of chocolate may vary.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice zest,green bell pepper,chinese mushroom
title: Chinese Foil Wrapped Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 fresh green bell pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice ( about 1/4 lemon ) | 1 tablespoon finely chopped chinese mushrooms or 1 tablespoon chinese dried mushrooms, or to taste
instructions: Pipe about two long thin, straight strips of green bell pepper into eight long strips, 1 in length at the wide end of each strip.  Wrap each strip with a strip of green bell pepper and a dry chinese dried mushroom or chinese dried mushroom.  Tie each strip with kitchen string to knot.  In a wok, heat enough oil to cover vegetables.  Deep fry stuffed strips for about 5 minutes, turning once, or until the bell pepper strips are softened, but not browned.

title: Baked Spanish Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice ( short ) | 2 teaspoons anise seeds
instructions: Brown rice on the bottom of your oven for 20 minutes in about 1/4 cup oil.  While rice is brown take a small baking dish, line it with a piece of wax paper, and grease it with some of the rest of the oil.  Pour rice on the large baking dish.  Scatter the anise from can over it and sprinkle with salt.  Drizzle the rest of the oil over the top of the rice.  If possible just sprinkle the salt on now.  Bake about 30 minutes at 400 degrees, or until crispy and slightly browned.

title: Chive Oil
ingredients: 1/3 cup chives, snipped | 2 tablespoons italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the chives and parsley in a small bowl.  Gradually add oil to the parsley.

title: Italian Stuffed Meat
ingredients: 2 lbs ground meat | 1 slice white bread, cut into small pieces | 2 tablespoons minced serrano peppers | 2 tablespoons minced fresh basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Divide minced bread into four equal sized portions.  To each piece of bread, place about 1/3 cup of the meat mixture, along with pepper and basil.  Form into a ball.  Using hands, place in an oiled casserole.  Cover and bake for about 30 - 45 minutes or until stuffing is browned and meat is heated through.

title: Tropical Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cups brown rice, cooked in water | 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped | 2 teaspoons cornflour | 1/2 teaspoon fennel bulb, finely chopped ( or a mix of the two ) | 1 1/2 large bananas, sliced
instructions: Place the rice and enough water to cover in a deep frying pan and bring to the boil.  Cover and simmer over a low heat for 15 minutes.  Stir in the cilantro, and add the cornflour and fennel.  Cover and simmer for another 8 minutes.  Add the bananas and stir to combine.  Serve hot.

title: Minted Ham Hock
ingredients: 1 ham hock | 3 -4 oranges, rind of | 1 handful freshly picked mint leaf (, to garnish )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees.  Place ham hock under the broiler on high and cook until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and transfer to a bowl.  Add orange rind and 1 handful of mint and toss gently until mint is lightly colored.  Remove from bowl and transfer to the oven.  Cook until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes.  Transfer to a serving platter or individual plates.  Garnish with some of the remaining mint leaves.

title: Sago in Filets or Tender Broth
ingredients: 3 -4 inches sago | 1 1/3 lbs chuck roast
instructions: Trim all excess fat from meat and cut into about 1 inch pieces.  Cover and refrigerate.  Bring sago to a boil in cold water.  In a kettle, remove the beef cubes or slice with a knife, and place them in the boiling water and stir constantly or use fork to stir it up.  After all the sago is floating to the top, it is done and ready to use or can be used as a broth for a soup or served over rice.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,liquid smoke,filling,mango chutney,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Smoky Eggplant Puree
ingredients: 1 large eggplant | 1 1/2 cups mango chutney | vegetable oil cooking spray | filling : | 1/2 cup mango chutney | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice eggplant crosswise into 1/4 inch thick, 2 to 3 inch pieces.

title: Welsh Sausage #2
ingredients: 4 large idaho potatoes, scrubbed, peeled and cut into chunks | 1/4 lb kielbasa, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 head fresh broccoli, cut into florets | 4 ounces unsalted butter | 3/4 cup superfine sugar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f degrees.  Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat and then cook until tender when pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from the heat and drain.  While partially cool, combine the kielbasa in a large skillet and sauté over medium high heat until brown and cooked through.  Remove from the heat and drain.  Preheat the oven to 425f degrees.  Using the same pan, melt half of the butter or margarine over low heat.  Add the sugar and stir until dissolved.  Add the potatoes, broccoli and sausage pieces and stir until heated through.  Turn the mixture into a 9x13 baking dish coated with cooking spray.

title: Steamed Eggs With Green Tea, Garam Masala & Turmeric Green Eggs
ingredients: 1 tablespoon green tea | 6 hard-boiled eggs | sea salt
instructions: Crack open three hard boiled eggs, scoop out the yolks & place them in a bowl.  Chop the green tea very finely.  Place half of the tea & the chopped coriander in a steamer pot.  Cover & steam for 6 - 8 mins or until the eggs are cooked & the shells are crisp.  Break the eggs into the pot & warm through.  Add salt & serve immediately.

title: Spinach, Pineapple & Pineapple Nutella Recipe
ingredients: 3 cups whole mixed spinach leaves | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1/2 cup buttermilk | 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Remove 1/4 from its can of pineapple for a milder dish.  Rinse out the can of it.

title: Pumpkin Noodle Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 1 1/2 cups uncooked noodles | 2 teaspoons xanthan gum | 1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained ( garbanzo beans ) | 1/2 cup canned bamboo cooked chicken breast, diced | 1/2 cup shredded sweetened coconut | 3 tablespoons prepared whipped topping | 1 mango, diced small
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, omitting sodium if desired.  Meanwhile, in small bowl combine chickpeas, rice bran, chicken, coconut and topping.  Arrange in bottom 3/4 inch of a greased 2 quart casserole dish.  Top with noodle mixture.  Sprinkle with mango or other desired garnish.

title: Wild Rice Salad
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice ( uncooked ) | 1 1/2 lbs pork shoulder, with bone or boneless | 1 cup currants ( optional ) | 2 cups fresh blackberries ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon marjoram ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon basil ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f & grease a deep shallow 10x15 inch baking dish, set aside.  Brown pork on both sides, remove to casserole.  Add currants & cover with more water, cook in preheated oven for 1 - ½ to 2 hours, or until pork is cooked & tender.  Add blackberries & marjoram, if using.  Remove lid, raise to bake, stirring occasionally for 30 - 45 mins.  Or till water absorbed & rice is done.

title: Easy Nacho Dip
ingredients: 1/4 cup tomato sauce | 1/4 cup salsa
instructions: Pour tomato sauce into a medium bowl.  Fill with salsa if desired.  Refrigerate up to 3 hours.

title: Celery and Broccoli With Noodles and Lemons
ingredients:
4 medium stalks celery, cut on the thick end, about 3 inches long ( about 1 lb.
    - ) | 1 leafy, wide leaf fresh broccoli, cut on the thick side | 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice or 3 tablespoons lemon juice | 4 ounces cellophane noodles, soaked in warm water 30 minutes
instructions: Using a paring knife, remove the thick stalky portions of celery, leaving 3 inches celery root intact on a stalk.  Rinse and drain the noodles and set aside in a large bowl.  Slip celery crosswise through the stem end and cut into 3/4 inch lengths.  Cut celery crosswise into 1 inch lengths.  In a heavy pot with a lid, combine the celery, broccoli, celery root, lemon juice, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.  Cook over high heat, stirring and tossing with a wood spoon to loosen the veggies and salt, until celery is just tender, 6 to 8 minutes.

title: Irish Grain Bread with Watercress and Whiskey
ingredients: 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 1 tablespoon irish whiskey | 1 bunch fresh watercress, washed | 4 slices whole wheat bread, cut into 1 `` slices
instructions: Preheat broiler.  In a small bowl, combine 1 tbsps whiskey and 1 tbsps watercress.  Set aside.  Brush 1 slice of bread with remaining 1 tbsps whiskey.  Top with second slice.  Remove one sandwich from the oven and brush with remaining 1 tbsps of whiskey mixture, place on a cookie sheet and broil until lightly toasted and toasted, about 5 minutes.

title: Flour for French Fritters
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1/2 cup corn oil
instructions: Combine flour and aniseeds in bowl, rub in corn oil until well blended.  Knead until dough no longer sticks to hands.  Cover, refrigerate for 20 minutes.  Divide dough into 2 parts, roll each half into a ball.  Cover and let rest 20 minutes.  Preheat electric griddle, griddle, or frying pan to medium high heat.  When griddle is hot, roll 1 ball of dough out to about 1/4 inch thickness.  Spread on center of griddle with grain facing and press down firmly.  Grill until golden brown, flip and continue to cook until golden other side.  You may need to press the sides with the bottom of a glass or paper towel first to get rid of the excess moisture.  It can be done on a well floured surface but it should not be sticky.  Remove from griddle and allow to rest for about 5 minutes then cut into rectangles.

title: Cilantro Relish
ingredients: 1 cup of chopped fresh cilantro | 3/4 cup white onion | 1 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1/2 cup italian dressing
instructions: Puree cilantro into a fine paste.  Add remaining ingredients.  Use as required.

instructions: Rinse the chicken well under running water and pat dry with paper towels.  Turn on broiler and set a large heavy skillet on the rack about 2 inches from the heat. Place the broccoli among the loins.

title: Italian Veget and Hazelnut Salad

instructions: Combine the parsnip and tomatoes in a serving bowl.  Add remaining ingredients.  Dressing, combine oil, milk, lemon juice and sugar in a small bowl until sugar dissolves.  Stir in the dressing and mix well.  Cover.  Place in fridge for up to 2 days.

title: Baked Beef and Onions for a Steak, Crock Pot

instructions: Mix broth and meat in a 4 quart slow cooker.  Add lid, cover and cook on low for 7 hours or on high for 3 1/2 2 hours.

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Wash pomegranate with cold water until the water runs clear, and remove from the peel.  Rinse skin off pomegranate.  Sprinkle outside of pie shell with salt. instructions: Split hamburger and split buns in half.  Mix all other ingredients until blended together well.  Shape into 4 burgers.  Cook on a hot griddle for 5 to 6 minutes on each side.  Brush with remaining olive oil while cooking until browned.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment.  Place wings whole in a large pot of lightly salted water, and bring to a boil. instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Saute chili until dark golden and aromatic.  Remove chili from heat and add yoghurt and mix well.  Drain pasta and add chili to it and combine.  Spoon mixture into bowls and top with minced fresh parsley.

instructions: In a bowl, mix together the garlic paste and cumin powder, 1 tablespoons of bread crumbs, saffir lime leaves.  Remove the stems from the leaves leaving the stems whole and tear into strips with a knife.  Sprinkle the garlic paste mixture over the grape leaves and mix lightly.  Transfer 1/2 tablespoon of bread crumbs onto the grape leaves.  Form the leaves into round balls then coat each ball with the bread crumb mixture.  Refrigerate for one hour or two.  Brush a little oil in a frying pan and cook the grape leaves just long enough for them to brown, turning once.  Drain any excess oil and serve hot.

title: Tandoori Masala (Ginger Salad)
ingredients: 2 bunches fresh curry leaves | 1 lime, juice of | ginger, in paste or 1/2 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated | 1/8 - 1/4 cup fresh lime juice
instructions: Place curry leaves in a tea cup.

title: Spice Islands Pasta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon poppy seed | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds | 8 ounces cooked spaghetti or 8 ounces other pastas | 1/4 cup fresh coriander, chopped | 3 cups cooked red kidney beans | 3 ounces cod, shredded or steamed japanese fish | 1 teaspoon sage
instructions: Toast poppy seeds and sesame seeds according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: margarine,angel food cake,coleslaw mix,dark raisin,chipotle powder,french baguette,thyme leaf,lemon juice
title: Chipotle Cream Cheese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter, melted | 3/4 cup dark raisin or 3/4 cup golden raisin | 1/8 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chipotle powder | 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 french baguette, cut lengthwise on the diagonal & cut 1 1/2 '' thick | 2 cups coleslaw mix | 3/4 teaspoon dried parsley or 1/4 teaspoon dried cilantro
instructions: Beat margarine or butter or butter with an electric mixer on high speed until creamy.  Add raisins or golden raisins, thyme or cilantro, chipotle powder, and lemon juice.  Add french baguettes in a shallow 1 to 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Spoon filling evenly over baguettes, using up the mixture from the can into the opening of the french baguette.  Cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  To bake, preheat oven to 400°f bake uncovered on a baking sheet covered with foil for 17 minutes.  Uncover and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until crisp and golden.  Cool slightly and serve.

title: Pasta e Fagioli
ingredients: 500 g farfalle pasta | 2 cups cooked meat ( from a rotisserie cooked from a rotisserie cook )
instructions: Turn on the oven to 180°c/350°f/gas boil the farfalle for 2 - 3 minutes add the meat and cook until heated through.  Drain the farfalle pasta, return it to the pan and pour a little bit of the cooking liquid from the rotisserie into the sauce, stir well and cook for another minute or two.  This pasta should be rather dry and not liquidy, so you may need to add a little more pasta water.  Serve immediately.

title: Kesari-Style Bread
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder | 4 slices rye bread, cut 1/4-inch thick
instructions: Place one slice of bread on a plate, and top with 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida.  Top with another slice of bread, and sandwich with the same technique.

title: Japanese Egg Salad II
ingredients: 3 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 4 green onions, minced
instructions: Mix egg, green onion, and soup together.  Add salt and red chile powder to taste.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,chicken bouillon,chicken breast meat,garbanzo bean,pie crust,bean,gouda cheese,penne
title: Baked Chicken Picnic Empanada
ingredients: 1/2 package dried garbanzo beans | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 tablespoon low-sodium instant chicken bouillon | 2 cups cubed cooked chicken breast meat | 1 package refrigerated pie crust | 1/4 cup low-fat shredded gouda cheese | 1/4 cup fat-free refried beans ( optional ) | 1 jar sliced italian-seasoned pimento-stuffed olives ( optional )
instructions: Place garbanzo beans in a large pot.  Add enough water to a boil to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain, cool and chop.  Place chicken, soya sauce, and chicken bouillon in a bowl.  Stir to coat.  Place the chicken mixture in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish, and cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 475 degrees f.  Roll out the pie crust dough on a floured surface.  Place the dough in the center of the baking dish.  Layer the feta cheese over the dough, and top with refried beans, olives, if using.  Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.  Cut into wedges to serve.

title: Potato Crusted Cheese
ingredients: 2 cups frozen hash browns, thawed | 3 tablespoons corn oil | 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese or 2 tablespoons romano cheese | 1 -2 teaspoon fresh mint leaves, chopped
instructions: Lightly coat baking sheet with cooking spray.  Place hash browns on sheet.  Combine oil, cheese and mint in medium bowl.  Using your hands, squeeze potato into mixture.  Using hands, press ingredients well into potato.  Sprinkle with more cheese, if desired.  Using your hands, stretch potato several times to help press and pat evenly.  Heat on baking sheet until golden brown and crisp 12 to 15 minutes.

title: Sesame Seeds and Sea Salt Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed salad greens | 2 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 teaspoons sesame seeds | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the mixed greens and mayonnaise.  Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sea salt.  Serve immediately.

title: Rye Bread
ingredients: 500 g rye flour | 3 sprigs fresh sage leaves
instructions: Mix the rye flour with the sage leaves and work into a soft dough that can be handled easily.  Shape into a round or oval shape.  Flour hands and knead well with dry ingredients.  Place on lightly greased baking tray which has been sprinkled with melted semolina flour and buns, or any other bread crumbs and lightly brushed with oil.  Brush with melted margarine.  Bake in moderately hot oven 45 min until golden.

title: Ricotta and Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs ricotta cheese | 3 garlic cloves, peeled and minced | 1/3 cup heavy whipping cream
instructions: Heat oven to 300 degrees.  In a medium mixing bowl combine the ricotta, garlic and cream.  Stir until well combined.  Place mixture in ungreased 2 quart shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle sauce with oregano and top with parmesan if using.  Bake in 275° f oven for 30 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cheese tortellini,ketchup,beef bacon,egg noodle,greek yogurt,black eyed pea,chicken thigh
title: Greek Style Chicken Noodles
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated cheese tortellini ( the kind you buy or get from the deli ) | 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 package refrigerated egg noodles | 2 cans black-eyed peas | 1/3 cup greek yogurt or 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt | 3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Pour 1 can of beans with liquid into large pot until liquid just covers the beans.  Do not drain.  Add chicken and all of the other ingredients except tortellini and noodles.  Bring to low boil.  Cook 10 minutes.  Drain the tortellini and noodles and stir everything together in a large bowl.  Enjoy.

title: Gravy With Smoked Salmon & Ricotta!
ingredients: 2 lbs stewing beef, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 tablespoon margarine | 4 large ripe pears, diced | 1 jar rinsed well drained pears, juice strained out, chopped ( reserve juice ) | 1 teaspoon mixed italian herbs or 1 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1 teaspoon sage leaves | steamed rice, to serve | 1 package ricotta, for topping
instructions: Brown meat in margarine, add rest of ingredients except ricotta.  Simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.  Season if necessary and top with ricotta.

title: Gkaiyum Ka Rayi (Fenugreek Snack Balls)
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground fenugreek seeds ( methi ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dry sakuki's sake
instructions: In a mini mortar and pestle, grind the fenugreek seeds lightly.  Stir in the sakuki.  Using an ice cream scoop, stir the gaiyum to form a 1 inch circle or to desired size.  Remove as many circles as possible.

Random Ingredients: white flour,salad oil,apricot,salmon fillet,flat leaf parsley,adobo sauce,lemon zest
title: Grilled Salmon With Citrus-Apricot Stuffing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons salad oil | 600 g salmon fillet | 25 g white flour | 1 lemon, zest of, grated | 3 tablespoons minced fresh flat leaf parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricots | 1 tablespoon chopped adobo sauce
instructions: Place the oil and lemon zest in a small saucepan and cook gently over a low heat until aromatic.  Remove and discard the lemon zest.  Sprinkle the salmon fillets with flour to coat and cook to desired thickness, about 3 minutes per side.  Remove from the grill and leave to rest for 5 minutes.  To make the stuffing, combine the herbs and herbs in a bowl.  Stir in the apricots.  Arrange the orange pieces neatly on top of the salmon and cover with the stuffing.  Grill to desired degree of doneness, about 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,peanut oil vegetable,fine salt,coriander seed
title: Chorizo (Tapas) Fritters
ingredients: 3/4 pound chorizo sausage, sliced � to 1/4 inch thick | 3 tablespoons peanut oil or 3 tablespoons vegetable oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons crushed coriander seeds | 2 teaspoons fine salt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice the chorizo diagonally into 1/4 slices.  In a heavy medium skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil on medium heat until very hot.  Add the chorizo and stir frequently, cooking until crisp and brown.  Remove to a paper towel lined plate.  Wipe out skillet with a paper towel.  Heat other 2 tablespoons oil in the skillet.  Add the coriander and fry over high heat until aromatic, 30 seconds to 1 minute.  Scrape in the fried chorizo.  Stir well.  Sprinkle with salt and transfer to a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until the fritters are hot and crisp, about 10 minutes.  Note, store in an airtight plastic bag.

Random Ingredients: melon liqueur midori,feta cheese,seasoning salt,barley,liquid honey
title: Melon and Feta Barley Salad Mix
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups coarsely chopped seeded melon or 3 1/2 cups coarsely chopped sweet melon | 1 1/2 cups crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 can liquid honey | 1/2 cup liquid honey | 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped barley
instructions: Combine melon and feta completely in food processor or blender and puree.  Stir into pureed mixture.  Gently stir in all remaining ingredients.  Store salad in tightly covered container in refrigerator until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: garam masala powder,pod tamarind,italian plum tomato,anchovy,italian parsley,beef cap,pepperoni
title: Pomodari Meat Kofta
ingredients:
1 lb beef cap | 1 can italian plum tomatoes | 0.
    -5 packet pods tamarind | 6 tablespoons fresh garlic | 3/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley | pepperoni, slice slices ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice cap into ½ inch thick pieces and reserve.  Rinse out the can of tomatoes.  Discard the seeds and any liquid from the tomatoes.  Slice tomatoes into small squares, discard any tomato skins.  Cut off all the pulp from the tamarind, scrape out the seeds and place into a large bowl.  Measure out the tamarind pulp and place into a blender or food processor along with the drained cap tomatoes, 5 cups of water, the garlic, garam masala and parsley and process till desired consistency.  The mixture will need to be stirred occasionally.  Place in a large plastic bag and freeze.  When ready to use, place meat through a meat grinder, making sure it is partially frozen.  Take kofta out of the freezer and break into 6 inch pieces.  Place the meat into your freezer.  You may also take out extras and freeze them if there is any leftover meat.  Place the meat pieces on a baking sheet coated with olive oil or cooking spray and cover with foil.  Bake at 400 degrees f for about 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes or so.  Serve with your favorite bread.

title: Best & Easiest Black Beans
ingredients: 1 can drained black beans | 1 - 1 1/2 cup irish whiskey | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1 - 1 1/2 cup applesauce | 4 ounces canned fat-free liquid honey | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Combine all ingredients except honey and cinnamon in a large bowl.  Place honey in a small saucepan over low heat and bring to a simmer.  Reduce heat and simmer, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes.  Add cinnamon to honey and stir.  Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.  Stir in hot honey mixture until well mixed.  Cover and keep warm.  Stir as needed until heated through.

title: Creamy Cauliflower & Salmon Sandwich
ingredients: 1 cauliflower, chopped into florets | 300 ml reduced-fat mascarpone cheese, softened | 20 slices rye bread | 1 tablespoon chargrilled bermere, drained and finely chopped | 30 g reduced fat smoked salmon, chopped | food coloring | 2 tablespoons bottled clam juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees.  Pour 1/2 cup water into a large shallow baking dish.  Place the cauliflower in the baking dish & bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until just starting to soften.  Reserve the cauliflower.  Place the mascarpone & rellllen the heat under the pan, tilting the pan until the cheese melts.  Spread half the cheese mixture onto 1 side of each slice of bread.  Place the sandwich on a plate & spread with the remaining cheese & herb mixture.  Heat the chargrilled bermere in a small pan, over a medium heat, for 1 - 2 mins, until warm & soft.  Add the salmon & cook for 1 - 2 mins, then turn & cook for 1 - 2 minutes more.  Spread on the reserved cauliflower & salmon mixture & finish with the remaining cheese mixture.  Cut the sandwich into 6 wedges & serve.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,brown sugar,yellow squash,russet potato,flour tortilla,tapioca flour
title: Veggies and Chips
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, cut in 1/2-inch chunks | 1 medium yellow squash, cut in 1/2-inch chunks | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon brown sugar | 10 flour tortillas, burrito size | 1/2 cup tapioca flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place potatoes and squash in a pot of lightly salted boiling water.  Cook until tender but not mushy, about 10 minutes.  Transfer potatoes and squash to a large baking dish and toss with ginger garlic paste, brown sugar, and 1/2 cup water.  Bake in the preheated oven until tender and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, heat a grill pan to high.  Coat the tortilla shell with tapioca flour, dip it in the remaining 1/2 cup cold water, and place on the grate over the open grill for about 1 to 2 minutes or until lightly browned.  Place chipotle mixture on a serving platter and top with tortilla.

title: Chidis' Mushrooms and Parsnips Wraps
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained well | 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsnips | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh limes leaves or 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 2 large flour tortillas ( buradillas ) or 2 large soft tortillas ( buradillas ) | shredded lettuce ( optional ) | 1 cremini mushroom, stem removed, sliced
instructions: Heat beans, parsnips and lime juice with a pinch of salt and pepper to taste in saucepan over medium high heat.  Fold in tortillas until heated through.  Spread one sixth of mushroom mixture on each warm tortilla and drizzle with another sixth of bean mixture, if desired.  Roll, folding in sides as necessary, and place each folded tortilla on serving plate.  Serve at once and sprinkle with lettuce and crumbled mushroom.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,marjoram,chicken bouillon cube,beef chuck roast,chinese wine
title: Chinese Beef Cubes
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck roast, cut into cubes | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram ( or other herb combination ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 2 cups chinese wine or 2 cups dry sherry
instructions: Trim any fat from the beef.  Place in large baking dish.  Mix all remaining ingredients, except wine, and pour over beef.  Cover and place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours and up to overnight.  Bake at 300 f for 3 hours or until meat is tender.  Pour wine over beef cubes and bake, uncovered for 1/2 hour to 1 hour and 45 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Homemade Beef Sausages
ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef | 2 lbs white sauce
instructions: Grind beef using the coarse blade of a meat mallet or rolling pin.  Make sure the meat does not stick.  If not mix the meat well with the hand.  Form into small, flat meatballs about 6 inches in diameter.  Place in a plastic bag and add white sauce.  Coat with a light coating of oil, and place in the refrigerator to marinate.  This will make the meat easier to clean and it can then be stored.  You can put the meat in the crockpot and cook on low for more hours, but i do not recommend cooking for more than 30 minutes.  The meat can be frozen and frozen.  I make these in my little crockpot as they freeze well in a ziploc bag.  They freeze well in a ziploc bag and thaw overnight in the fridge.  When in a hurry, take out meat, let cool to thaw inside, then remove all fat and gristle, including excess fat.  When done, drain the meat and coat with marina for later use.  I don't use a meat grinder, just a meat grinder.

title: Lamington-Toblerone and Chocolate Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 cup kosher salt or 1/2 cup fine sea salt | 1 1/8 kg pork loin, cut into 8 pieces ( pork loin roast ) | 1 3/4 liters loblerone chocolate bars
instructions: Mix salt and salt in a large plastic zipper bag.  Add pork.  Turn to coat well in salt.

title: Irish Basil & Irish Lettuce
ingredients: 1 head iceberg lettuce ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/4 cup irish whiskey | 1/4 cup freshly chopped thai basil
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite sized pieces.  Add some of the whiskey to the lettuce.  Toss lightly but quickly.  Garnish with chopped basil leaves.

title: Achiote Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried ancho chile powder | 3 cups fresh blueberries
instructions: Crush ancho chile powder into a small ball.  Place the frozen blueberries in a food processor, add a drop of water if needed to get it to the consistency of a liquid about the consistency of light molasses.  Process until smooth.  Transfer to a bowl, cover, and set aside until completely cool.  Transfer the mixture to the freezer until hard and frozen.  Once frozen, it's okay to freeze to use as needed.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,self rising flour,part mozzarella cheese,pita bread,picante sauce
title: Quesadillas I
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour | 2 tablespoons shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 pinch cayenne pepper | picante sauce | 2 pita bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºf.  Put the flour into a bowl and set aside.  Bring 2 - ½ cups of water to a boil.  Add mozzarella cheese and cayenne then whisk to soften.  Remove from heat and stir in flour, one tablespoon at cupful at a time until dough is soft.  Roll the dough out on a floured surface to a ½ inch thick rectangle.  Cut into 2 - ½ - 3 inch squares.  Brush with a small ladle or pastry brush.  Place approximately 1 tablespoon of the cheese mixture in the center of each dough square.  Seal dough completely and enclose cheese.  Repeat with remaining dough squares and cheese mixture until all the cheese mixture is gone.  Place pita on a baking sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Turn over to the other side and bake for an additional 5 minutes until pita is browned and crisp.  Let them cool for 5 minutes before removing and serving.

Random Ingredients: ginger garlic paste,grain rice,maraschino cherry,butter margarine
title: Buddha's Rice
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter and margarine or 2 tablespoons margarine | 1 large long grain rice | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 1 1/2 cups maraschino cherries, drained and patted dry ( optional )
instructions: Heat butter or margarine on medium heat.  Add rice and ginger garlic paste.  Cook rice 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add cherries if using.  Cover and cook about 10 minutes, or until rice is tender and juices have been absorbed.  Serve hot.

title: Fabulous Fennel and Maple Leaf Salad
ingredients:
4 fennel bulbs, trimmed ( approx.
    - 2 pounds ) | warm maple syrup ( optional ) | fennel leaves ( optional )
instructions: Trim the fennel bulbs of the stalk leaving the stalk intact.  Quarter the fennel bulbs lengthwise and core it.  Core the fennel stalks leaving just the stalks attached.  Cut the feathery tops into 2 inch segments.  In a wide, deep bowl, toss the fennel with enough maple syrup to coat the fennel.  Add fennel pods and/or fronds.  Cover and chill several hours, stirring occasionally.  Serve garnished with flowers if desired.

title: Cannoli Bars (Dairy Free)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups pearl barley | 1 1/2 cups dates ( or other dried fruit ) | 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice | 1 1/4 cups plain flour | 1 1/4 cups cocoa | 1 egg white
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius.  Mix the first 8 ingredients evenly.  Press the mixture into a square tin and bake for 25 minutes or until the top has browned.  Cool completely in tin.  Mix the egg white with a little water and brush over the surface of the bar bars.

title: Peaches and Onions - My Way
ingredients: 1 can sliced peaches | 1/2 cup chopped onion rings
instructions: Heat oil in skillet.  Drain peaches, reserving liquid.  Add onion and onion rings.  Stir fry over medium heat until onion is tender.  Serve warm or cool on counter top and dig in.  These taste great at room temp too.

Random Ingredients: steak,lime wedge,orange juice zest,cellophane noodle,cherry,chipotle chile
title: Spicy Steak With Noodle & Cherries
ingredients: 1 1/2 1 1/2 lbs flank steaks or 1 1/2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1/2 ounce cellophane noodle ( cellophane noodles may be used for this recipe ) | 1 1/2 cups orange juice ( i use orange zest ) or 1 1/2 cups lemon juice ( i use orange zest ) | 6 ounces cherry, halved ( may use mixed baby cherries ) | 2 dried chipotle chiles | lime wedge ( optional )
instructions: For the steak preparation place the steak in a nonreactive dish.  Add enough water to cover and marinate for 20 minutes turning occ.  Remove the steak from the marinade, cover with plastic wrap, and chill while preparing the noodles.  Soak the noodles in warm water for 15 minutes or until softened.  Drain when ready to start cooking, place in a serving bowl.  Slice the steak on a diagonal diagonal against the grain as thinly as you can.  Place it on top of the noodles.  Pour the cherry juice over the steak and sprinkle with chopped chipoltes.  Serve with lime wedges.

Random Ingredients: steak,french dressing,taco sauce,shrimp,phyllo pastry,almond liqueur,rice vinegar
title: Sloaked Beef Triangles
ingredients: 3 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 lb flank steak | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 3 tablespoons french dressing | 3 tablespoons honey raspberry-flavored liqueur | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar | 1 lb peeled deveined shrimp
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Cut each sheet of phyllo into four equal squares.  Layer half of the phyllo in a 9x13 baking dish and top with half of the steak.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,onion flake,beef tenderloin,asparagus,glutinous rice flour,pea,corn flake
title: Glutinous Rice Cracker Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 package frozen peas | 2 1/2 cups raw glutinous rice flour, divided | 2 tablespoons all purpose wheat flour or 2 tablespoons all-purpose wheat gluten | 2 tablespoons minced onion flakes | 2 tablespoons corn flakes | 1 box frozen asparagus, thawed and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Combine rice, 1/2 cup salt, beef through asparagus and 1 1/2 cups water in a large saucepan.  Bring to a boil, cover and reduce heat to gently simmer.  Cook, turning once, until water is absorbed, about 30 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in remaining 1/2 cup salt.  Transfer to a bowl and cool completely.  Meanwhile, heat oven to 300 degrees f.  Shape cold rice mixture into 2 inch diameter crumbs.  Place crumbs in a shallow metal pie plate.  Place crumbs on a cookie sheet.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 15 minutes.  Cool completely and store in airtight container.

title: Hot & Sassy Hot Sauce
ingredients: 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 2 jalapeno peppers, sliced
instructions: Combine the onion soup mix with jalapeño slices or minced chile peppers in a small saucepan.  Bring to boiling.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice | 4 cups prepared enchilada sauce | 2 cups catsup | 2 tablespoons rice, uncooked | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Spinach Stuffed Calzone (Guy Fieri)
ingredients: 6 ounces baby spinach | 3/4 cup grated tasty cheese | 1/2 peach ( small, halved and seeded ) | 1 tablespoon crushed dried pizza or 1 tablespoon ham ( crumbled ) | 2 teaspoons chopped peaches
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Place the spinach, cheese, peach, peaches and ham in a bowl.  Mix well.  Line a baking sheet with foil, and lay out the spinach mixture.  Cut a hole in the center of the mixture, and fill the hole with stuffing or nuts.  Bake for about 20 minutes, or until a nice brown crust of the cheese begins to brown.

title: Lamb Saffron
ingredients:
4 lbs lean lamb or 4 lbs pork | 1 teaspoon sea salt | 1 1/2 lbs imitation crabmeat ( preferably st.
    - amandes brand ) | 12 ounces ro-tel tomatoes | 2 tablespoons dried cilantro | 1 orange, juice of | 10 dates, finely chopped
instructions: Cut lamb into 1-inch cubes and brown in a heavy pan in a layer of olive oil, on low heat, turning as necessary.  Remove from heat.  Return to heat.  Add salt and simmer for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile cut tomatoes in half and puree in blender or food processor.  Add tomato puree and 1 cup water and simmer covered, stirring occasionally, until very thick and creamy, about 1 hour.  Strain meat juices and discard solids.  Return meat to pot.  Add cilantro and orange juice.

title: Beef and Green Chili Burritos
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 10 flour tortillas, 6 inch | 3 tablespoons margarine or 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 can diced green chili
instructions: Cook stew meat in 1/2 inch oil in dutch oven until brown.

title: Walnut, Walnut & Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped into bite size pieces | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1 cup shelled walnuts, coarsely chopped
instructions: Divide romaine lettuce evenly between 4 large serving bowls.  Melt walnut pieces and pour over salads.

title: Baked Saffron Cream
ingredients: 1/2 lb sour cream or 1/2 lb table cream | 1/4 teaspoon saffron thread ( about 20 threads ) or 3 tablespoons turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 1/2 teaspoons brown sugar, packed, stirred
instructions: Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 325 degrees.  In bowl of electric mixer fitted with medium speed, beat sour cream with saffron until smooth.  Add turmeric, thyme and sugar and mix well.  Add sour cream and beat until well blended.  Transfer to pie plate, spreading evenly.  Cover with foil.  Place tart on rack in roasting pan and bake about 30 minutes or until lightly brown and almost set in center.  Cool until firm enough to slice.

title: Spanish Tomato Paste (M'chácio Echarado)
ingredients: 1 lb ripe sweet tomato, such as plum | 1 cup tomato paste
instructions: Peel tomatoes and cut them into 1/2 inch slices.  Place the tomatoes onto paper towels to dry slightly.  Place the tomatoes in a clean cloth bag or strainer and squeeze out excess moisture.  Place the tomato slices on a plate and use your hands to squeeze the pulp into a heavy soup kettle.  Add enough water to cover the tomatoes by an inch and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 20 minutes.  Puree the tomatoes in a food processor or blender until smooth.  This sauce takes about 20 minutes.  Return the tomato puree to the pan, stir in the tomato paste, and simmer for 5 minutes.  Remove from the heat and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: white button mushroom,kernel corn,fennel bulb,parsley,graham cracker crumb,vanilla sugar
title: Sicilian Nests
ingredients: 3 tablespoons white button mushrooms, finely chopped | 1/2 cup grated fresh parsley | 1 large fennel bulb, tough outer leaf removed ( or 2 large bulbs ) | 4 cups graham cracker crumbs ( or your favorite biscuit crumbs ) | 3/4 cup vanilla sugar ( or splenda ) | 1 jar whole kernel corn, drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine mushrooms, parsley, crumbs and sugar in a bowl.  Roll 1 tablespoon or less of mixture into a ball.  Roll in melted chocolate, press lightly with a fork to coat, and flatten into a uniform cone shape.  Arrange 1/3 cup corn on the bottom end of each nest.  Top with 1/1 jar of each ingredient, and a little bit more melted chocolate if you want.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Spaghetti All'Amatriciana (Savory Spaghetti)
ingredients: 1 lb spaghetti | 12 quarts hot pickle juice | 3 cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon of crushed cardamom
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Add spaghetti and cook al dente.  Drain spaghetti and set aside.  Combine hot pickle juice and cardamom and pour onto pasta.  Toss well and serve hot.

title: Garam Masala
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas | 50 g garam masala powder | 1/2 teaspoon juniper berries
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over very low heat.  Add the garam masala powder and juniper and stir.  Add the tortilla and microwave for 15 seconds, until heated through.  Cut into wedges and serve immediately with pulao.

Random Ingredients: black cardamom pod,pasta sauce,oregano leaf,rice wine,monterey jack cheese,mexican cheese,hungarian paprika,red cayenne pepper
title: Cheese & Rice Mac 'n' Cheese
ingredients: 1/3 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon oregano leaves, minced | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika, plus | 2 teaspoons hungarian paprika | 8 green cardamom pods | 5 -6 teaspoons red cayenne pepper | 4 -5 cups monterey jack cheese | 1 1/2 cups mexican cheese or 1 1/2 cups edam cheese ( 1 1/2-2 cups to taste ) | 1/3 cup pasta sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f combine rice wine, oregano, ¼ tsp of the paprika and the cardamom pods in a medium bowl.  Mix well. ingredients: 8 cups beef stock ( home made or from a can ) or 8 cups vegetable stock ( home made or from a can ) | 1 bunch chives, chopped | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic salt | 1 pinch nutmeg | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1 cup orange lentils, soaked and rinsed | 8 romaine lettuce leaves | 1/4 cup chopped fresh chives, for garnish
instructions: Bring stock and chives to a boil in stockpot over high heat.  Add garlic salt, nutmeg and margarine.  Transfer soup mixture to a slow cooker or dutch oven.  Cut lettuce through each lettuce leaf, into 3 or 4 pieces.  Transfer to soup pot over low heat.  Bring water to a boil and add red lentils.  Lower heat and simmer, partially covered, for 2 hours or until lentils are tender.  Transfer soup to serving bowl.  Top with chopped chives.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,ancho chile,ciabatta,plain yogurt,asparagus,baking soda,kumara,vanilla extract
title: Ancho Asparagus Mini Muffins
ingredients: 2 medium asparagus, trimmed | 1/8 teaspoon saffron thread, crushed | 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/8 teaspoon baking soda | ciabatta, loaf cut into eight 1/2-inch by 1/4-inch slices | 1 medium kumara, halved horizontally, cut crosswise into 8 wedges | 1 small dried ancho chiles or 1 small dried ancho pepper, stemmed, seeded, and crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Line a large baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Place asparagus and saffron in a medium bowl and set aside. Combine asparagus mixture and yogurt mixture with an electric mixer in 1 large bowl until smooth.  Arrange bread slices in a single layer on baking sheet.  Bake 18 to 18 minutes, or until bread is puffed but not dry.  Remove from pan and cool 5 minutes.  Turn out onto a paper towel lined plate.  Arrange kumara wedges on a platter.  Spoon yogurt mixture and 1/2 cup of the asparagus into each bread slice.  Spoon remaining asparagus mixture on top of yogurt.

Random Ingredients: lemon juice,dark rum,herb,baby spinach,green cardamom pod
title: Baby Spinach With Special Mixed Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 3 ounces baby spinach, cleaned and dried | 1 green cardamom pod, cracked open | 6 fluid ounces dark rum | 1/2 teaspoon mixed herbs | 2 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Put the whole package of Baby Spinach in a large saucer and sprinkle the cracked cardamom pods over the top.  Leave to drain out all excess water and to squeeze out as much moisture as possible.  Put all the other ingredients except the dried baby spinach in a big saucepan and bring to the boil over a high heat.  Stir well to combine.  Turn down the heat and leave for 10 minutes.  Turn off the heat and leave for another 2 - 5 minutes until the juices have cooked away, stirring frequently.  Serve with freshly cooked whole baby spinach as an au jus on the side.

title: Chickpea and Apple Parcels
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, drained | 2 tart apples, such as granny smith | 3 tablespoons cranberry jelly | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried chilies, crushed | 1 1/2 teaspoons dijon mustard | 1/4 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Chop apples or granny smith.  Combine apples, cranberry jelly, chilies, mustard, worcestershire sauce and allspice.

Random Ingredients: sage,cream corn,bay seasoning tm,red chile,parmesan cheese,pecan,cream cheese,red chilies
title: Creamy Corn Dip II
ingredients:
1 1/2 cups canned cream-style corn | 1/3 cup cream cheese, softened | 1/2 cup crumbled pecans | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 1/4 teaspoon chile seasoning ( or 1 tsp.
    - seasoned salt ) | 1/4 teaspoon bay seasoning ( or 1 tsp.
    - seasoned salt ) | 1/8 teaspoon crushed red chilies or 1/8 teaspoon dried crushed chilies | 1 -2 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the first eight ingredients.  Mix well.  Put into a lightly greased 3 quart casserole dish.  Cook uncovered in a 350 degree f oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned and bubbly.  Cool in the casserole.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,serrano chili pepper,pimento pepper,rum extract,chive,green chile
title: Ronnell's Pisco De Cinta
ingredients: 1 pint heavy whipping cream | 3 tablespoons minced green chiles | 2 teaspoons minced serrano chili peppers | 1 teaspoon rum extract | 1/2 teaspoon minced chives | 1 pimento pepper, seeded and finely minced
instructions: Bring the cream to a simmer over very low heat, stirring constantly with a spoon to prevent any curdling and curling, until the cream is reduced to a thick cream.  Stir in the green chilies, serrano chilies, rum extract, and chopped chives, and remove from heat.  Serve immediately.

title: Chef John's Grilled Fruit Crumble
ingredients: 1 cup graham crackers or graham cracker crumbs | 1/3 cup dried currants | 1 tablespoon coarse salt and pepper for sprinkling
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil a metal metal or glass baking dish with cooking spray.

title: Homemade Seasoning
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1/2 teaspoon dried minced white onion
instructions: Stir all ingredients together well.  Store in a tightly closed lidded jar in the refrigerator.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,watermelon,vanilla,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Creamy Watermelon and Raisin Soup
ingredients: 1 cup seedless seedless watermelon | 2 cups fish stock | 1 tablespoon vanilla, or to taste | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 2 -4 tablespoons raisins ( optional )
instructions: Trim any large stems from the watermelon.  Cut the watermelon into chunks and place in a blender.  Add fish stock, vanilla and ras el hanout and process to puree.  Puree until smooth, thick and creamy.  Add 1/4 cup puree to each bowl and garnish with raisins.

Random Ingredients: rosemary leaf,phyllo pastry,bicarbonate soda,mini chocolate chip,lettuce,pepperoni,vegetable stock
title: Chocolate Filled Phyllo
ingredients: 500 ml vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 150 g phyllo pastry | 1 - 1 1/2 cup finely chopped pepperoni or 1 -1 1/2 cup finely chopped ham | 1 - 1 1/2 cup chopped lettuce | 2 -4 teaspoons finely chopped mini chocolate chips ( optional ) or 2 -4 tablespoons finely chopped walnuts pieces, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Heat oven to 200c/180c fan forced/350f/gas line a sheet tray with paper, allowing some extra overhang on edges.  Dissolve the bicarb in the stock.  Place 2 sheets of filo in a large bowl with a sprinkling of pepperoni or ham and 1 tablespoon of the chopped lettuce.

Random Ingredients: mozzarella cheese,anchovy,sesame oil,almond,bread,gruyere cheese,lime juice,lemon juice
title: Caesar Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/4 cup grated gruyere cheese | 2 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh lime juice | 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil | 1 anchovy, minced | 6 crusty bread slices | 1 lemon, sliced
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Place one of the bread slices on a work surface.  Top with equal amounts of the mozzarella cheese, the gruyere cheese, the almonds, lime juice, lime juice, sesame oil, and chopped anchovy in a large mixing bowl.  Roll up the other bread slice and place in the bowl.  Gently press with your hands and shape the bread into a round loaf.  Repeat with the remaining bread slices.  Squeeze lemons over the bread.  Place on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.  Bake for 5 to 7 minutes in the preheated oven, until the edges are well browned and the bread is bubbly.

title: Spiced Creamy Seed Pudding
ingredients: 1 cup sunflower seeds ( toasted skins removed ) | 1 cup low-fat soymilk or 1 cup buttermilk | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice ( to taste ) | 1 small red chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup picante sauce
instructions: Spray a 1 1/2 pint glass measure with pam.  Place the sunflower seeds with their skins on the cutting board and cut them crosswise into 1/2 inch thick slices.  Scatter a little sunflower seeds onto the work surface and put a 1/2 teaspoon of ground allspice into the center.  Roll up the slices of sunflower seeds, overlapping them slightly, into a spiral about 1 1/4 inch thick and about 6 inches long.  Place 1 inch of soymilk in a small saucepan and bring just to a boil over medium heat, stirring.  Add the chili pepper and continue to boil, covered, until the soymilk is thick and syrupy, about 2 minutes.  Remove from the heat and stir in the picante.  Cool for at least 4 hours before using.

title: Lentil and Green Onion Soup
ingredients: 5 spring onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons sherry | 500 -568 ounces green lentils, picked over and washed
instructions: Heat 1 tblsp of oil in a pan, add spring onions and fry for about 5 mins, stirring.  Add sherry and fry another minute.  Pour the vegetable stock into the pan and bring to a boil.  Add the lentils and heat through.

Random Ingredients: double cream,fennel bulb,walnut,extra sharp cheddar cheese,asparagus
title: Asparagus Au Fondue With Walnut Crumble
ingredients: 500 g asparagus | 150 g extra-sharp cheddar cheese | 150 ml double cream | 1 fennel bulb | 1 cup walnuts
instructions: Bring a saucepan of salted water to the boil.  Add the asparagus and boil until tender but still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain and leave to cool slightly.  Cut the ends off the fennel and cut in half lengthways, then slice the fridel down the centre.  Place the tips and fronds into a processor and blitz until they are finely chopped.  Place the crumble into a large pan and add the cream.  Stir everything together, then bring to the boil, stirring all the time.  Then reduce the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes until the fennel is tender.  Stir the cooked fennel fondue through a fine sieve.  Drain the asparagus and asparagus and place into a bowl.  Add the walnut crumbs and gently toss so that the cheese is distributed throughout the fondue.  Serve at once, with crusty bread or crudites.

title: Enchiladas De Frijoles
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1 container sour cream | 4 large dates, pitted and chopped | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 cup chilled whipping cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In a 9x13 inch baking dish spread refried beans.  Top with sour cream.  Sprinkle with dates and green enchilada sauce.  Whip the chilled whipping cream with a fork.  Spoon over the top of the enchiladas and sprinkle with a dash of salt.  Bake for 45 minutes.

title: Lentil and Rice Pie (Takes One)
ingredients: 2 cups green lentils | 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 3 large egg whites | 1 large egg white
instructions: Place lentils and rice in a large saucepan and cover with water.  Bring to the boil and cook uncovered for 1 hour over low heat.  Remove the lid, raise the temperature to medium high, and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes.  After 45 minutes, remove from the heat and let the rice rest in the water for 5 minutes.  Stir to combine, add 1 egg white and stir until blended.  Place into a floured pie crust and cover with a clean dish towel to prevent the dish drying out.  Preheat oven to 425°.  Beat the egg whites until they are stiff peaks, then fold them into the lentils and rice.  Place on a greased baking sheet and bake 25 - 30 minutes or until browned and firm.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,pappardelle pasta,stevia,vermouth,pizza crust,white wine vinegar
title: Pappardelle with White Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 3 ounces dry vermouth | 2 teaspoons tomato paste | 1 pinch stevia | 1 cup dry white wine vinegar | 8 ounces pizza crust, frozen bread | 5 tablespoons v8 dry vermouth
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425º.  Stir vermouth, tomato paste, stevia, and white wine vinegar together in a large bowl. Random Ingredients: red curry paste,bean thread noodle,onion,currant,cornstarch,black olive,cinnamon
title: Creamy Curry Noodles (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 8 ounces dried bean thread noodles | 2 tablespoons cornstarch | 1 small onion, finely diced | 2 tablespoons red curry paste ( hot or mild ) | 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 1/4 cup currants or 1/4 cup raisins, to garnish | 3 -4 tablespoons water | 1 tablespoon finely chopped black olives, to garnish ( optional )
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions, drain and set aside.  Saute the onion in a frying pan over medium heat, stirring frequently, until tender. Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,vegetable,farina,macaroni,sharp cheddar cheese,green curry paste,chocolate

instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package.  Rinse and drain.  Combine all the ingredients in a large bowl and toss.  Serve on a bed of rice.

title: Caribbean Style Longan
ingredients: 500 g sweet longans | 100 g papayas | 1/2 of a lime, juice of | 80 g mascarpone | 3 teaspoons of cajun sweet tandoori hot sauce ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon tabasco sauce | salt & pepper, for seasoning
instructions: Cut longans into thin slices/discs like french fries, so they're easier to work with.  Cut papayas into matchsticks then mix with rest of ingredients.  Chill until ready to use.  When ready to use, coat the longans with the spicy tandoori sauce.  Dip in kosher salt if desired.  Cook on medium high for 3 - 4 minutes, until the bottoms turn dark green.  Enjoy.

title: Dirty Your Deep-Dish Sandwich Spread
ingredients: 1 package cottage cheese | 1 pound ground beef | 3 tablespoons garlic paste | 4 jalapeno peppers, chopped | 2 tablespoons coffee | 2 tablespoons instant coffee
instructions: Place cottage cheese in a bowl and cover with boiling water.

title: Beets With Peas
ingredients: 1 lb beet | 1 english cucumber | 8 ounces frozen peas, thawed | 1 lb flank steak, trimmed
instructions: Peel beets, then cut off root ends and remove beets if desired.  Core beets and cut into 2 by 6 long pieces.  Place in a large bowl.  Cut cucumber in half with 2 or 3 slicing blades.  Cut cucumber into quarters with 2 or 3 slicing blades.  Cut steak diagonally into strips about 1/4 inch thick.  Place beef on top of beets, pressing edges to seal.  Cover bowl and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.  Drain beef well.  Skewer beef, cut off excess fat, then grill.

title: Frescavena (Sweet Indian Candy)
ingredients: 3 cups light corn syrup | 1 cup dark corn syrup | 1 cup syrup
instructions: Put all of the ingredients in a very clean, dry pan and set on the stove top over medium heat.  Stir the mixture constantly until it boils.  Once it thickens, it will become more like corn syrup and it will become a slightly hard candy.  Do not stir constantly.  When the candy reaches 70 degrees f on a candy thermometer, it should be able to be run over a wooden spoon.  Once the candy starts to harden, it is ready.  You can then store it in an airtight container until it is 3/4 to 1 month.

Random Ingredients: basil pesto,white chocolate chip,apple pie spice,picante sauce
title: Mortar's Favorite Italian Appetizer Bars
ingredients: 1/2 cup apple pie spice | 2 cups white chocolate chips or 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips | 1/4 cup basil pesto | 1/2 cup picante sauce, for topping or 1/2 cup salsa, for top
instructions: Place cookies in a small baking pan and bake at 300°f just until brown.  Mix together cookie crumbs, pesto, and picante sauce and put into a plastic bag until mixture is covered with sauce.  When cool, spread on top of cookie mix and sprinkle with chocolate chips.

title: Thai Polenta Wedges
ingredients: 1/2 cup raw cornmeal | 4 stalks lemongrass | 2 tablespoons kalamata olives or 2 tablespoons other black olives | 10 juniper berries ( may use dried thyme if desired ) | 1 teaspoon celty sesame seeds or 1 teaspoon almond meal | 1 pinch ground mace | 1 1/2 tablespoons sprite | 1 tablespoon roasted peanuts, cut in half
instructions: Cut the lemongrass on an angle into 2 inch pieces.  If using dried thyme, crush to release the flavor.  Rinse and dry the lemongrass.  Place the cornmeal, olives, juniper berries, celty sesame seeds or almond meal, mace and sprite in a medium sized pot and stir to combine.  If using peanuts, stir to combine.  Place about a 1/4 cup of the cornmeal mixture in a small bowl and smash to a coarse meal with your fingers until coarse meal forms.  Mix this meal into the pot.  Using a fork, gently mash the potato mixture.  Toss with olive oil to coat and spread the wedges.  Sprinkle with the whole, chopped peanuts.  If using dry parsley, toss.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Steamed Pork with Spinach and Parsley
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork butt | 200 g spinach leaves | 200 g flat leaf parsley | 4 tablespoons oil
instructions: Prepare the stuffing at least 20 minutes before using.  Using a vegetable peeler cut the pork into approximately 1 x 2 cm / 1 cm / 1 inch cubes.  If using a food processor process the pork into 1 cm / 1 inch / 1 inch cubes.  Heat the oil and then add the pork.  Cook until the pork turns brown.  When it is cooked, throw in the spinach, parsley and cook for a few minutes until the spinach is cooked.  Remove the pan from the heat and add the stuffing.  Place in an ovenproof dish that has been placed into a wok.  Add boiling water until it just covers it and put in the oven at 180 degrees for 15 minutes.  Serve with steamed basmati rice.

Random Ingredients: oil,chipotle powder,dill weed,pimento olive,chicken bouillon powder,butter
title: Fried  (Pimento) Olive  Spread
ingredients: 12 pimento stuffed olives | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder | 6 tablespoons dill weed | 4 tablespoons oil | 4 tablespoons butter, softened | 1 tablespoon chipotle powder
instructions: Blend the bouillon, paprika and dill, add the oil and set aside.  With an electric grater, shred olives into a fine julienne or fine crumb.  Add the butter and chipotle powder and blend all together.  Add the olive mixture to the cheese mixture and mix well.  Serve with crackers and salsa.

title: Pork Chops and Pasta with Plantain and Pistachios
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 4 bananas with pimento peppers, drained and diced | 1 package rotini pasta | 1/2 cup pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place pork tenderloin in a large roasting pan with holes punched in the middle.  Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes. Spread pork chops with the bean mixture.  Sprinkle pistachios over the chops.  Return to oven, and bake for 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Hazelnut Pasta
ingredients: 1 package farfalle pasta | 1 jar roasted hazelnuts | 1 jar mild green chiles, chopped ( wear gloves ) | 2 bottles grand marnier ( or other liqueur )
instructions: Cook farfalle according to package directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  In food processor or blender, puree hazelnuts with green chiles and 2 t of the grand marnier until smooth.  When pasta is done, add to hazelnut mixture.  Return to sauce pan.  Add remaining grand marnier, stir well.  Do not boil the pasta, as it will become hard to remove.  After a few minutes, mix in remaining 1/4 t grand marnier.  The sauce is excellent either hot or cold.

title: Cheesy Mexican Polenta
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup shredded cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a bowl stir cornstarch with a little water until fully incorporated.  Transfer to a pie plate.  Sprinkle cheese on top.  Bake for 40 minutes or until cheese is golden brown and bubbly.

title: Healthy Low Fat Caramel Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup coconut milk ( i've found that they do this to a medium consistency-i normally only use skim milk ) | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Pour the coconut milk into a pan and bring slowly to the boiling point.  Boil for a few seconds and discard the foam.  Add the baking soda and stir.  Serve with a little bread, milk, and other vegetables.

title: Totally Fried Veggies (French Fried)
ingredients: 2 lbs frozen mixed vegetables ( use your own or any combination that is suitable ) | 1 -2 lb deli smoked turkey ( cut 1/2 inch slices or use leftover deli )
instructions: In large pot, put all in except turkey and mix well.  Cover and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Italian Sausages - Low-Carb
ingredients: 1 lb ground sirloin | 1 package hot italian sausage ( any flavor ) | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: In a large skillet, brown sausage, and remove from skillet and set aside.  Brown sausages in same skillet.  Drain off excess grease and then return skillet to stove.  Add worcestershire sauce and stir.  Place in a serving dish and cover with foil covering with foil.  Remove foil and place under medium/high broiler until the sausage is a little crispy on top.

title: Arugula and Arugula Salad
ingredients: 2 cups baby arugula leaves, chopped | 4 sheets nori ( dry seaweed )
instructions: Mix together the arugula and nori.  Eat on individual serving plates.

title: Chicken Margitzan
ingredients: 1 whole-wheat penne, uncooked ( about 3 cups ) | 1 store-bought pizza crust | 4 eggs | 2 cups 2 % fat milk or 2 cups light cream | 3 tablespoons sherry | 10 ounces frozen cooked chicken | 1 pinch of crushed dried instant yeast ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups half-and-half cream
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, omitting salt and fat.  Drain noodles and rinse with cold water.  Drain.  Mix the eggs, milk, sherry and chicken in a small bowl and set aside.  Spread half the pasta on the pizza crust.  Spread the chicken, noodles and cream mixture over the pasta, and sprinkle with the remaining pasta and sherry mixture.  Bake until hot, about 15 minutes, and hot throughout, 10 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Chinese Sweet Bacon & Pork Sausages
ingredients: 4 lbs pork | 2 ounces sea salt | 2 ounces chinese five spice powder | 1 ounce currants or 1 ounce sultana | pickle, slices ( optional )
instructions: Place all ingredients in a large dish.  Make sure the salt is in the salt.  Turn out onto a piece of greaseproof paper and roll over until well coated.  Refrigerate, it goes fast so be careful when doing this.  Cut into 6 or 8 sausages.

Random Ingredients: spaghetti sauce mix,grain brown rice,salt pepper,cheddar cheese,pesto sauce
title: Pesto & Brown Rice
ingredients: 1 lb uncooked spaghetti sauce mix | 1/4 - 1/2 cup prepared basil pesto sauce ( i use one or two cans of basil pesto sauce ) | salt & fresh ground pepper | 1 cup uncooked long grain brown rice | 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
instructions: Sauce, heat the sauce, pesto and salt and pepper in a large sauce pan.  Bring to a boil.  Stir in the rice until hot.  Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until the rice is tender.

instructions: Make the syrup by melting together the sugar & grainy mustard.
