Add the caramelized sugar syrup cook & stir over a low heat until sugar has dissolved, continue to stir to prevent burning add the pears & pears.  Cook for 5 mins or until the mixture is thick & golden.  Spoon the mix into the baked chips and top with the crispy apples & crushed tortilla chips.  Allow to cool to room temperature & cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: romaine lettuce,beef bouillon cube,anise seed,custard powder
title: Ribollita
ingredients: 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 beef bouillon cube, crushed | 2 tablespoons custard powder | 1 head romaine lettuce, washed and spun dry
instructions: Heat a skillet over high heat.  Pour oil into a small bowl and set aside.  Add the aniseed in the hot oil.  Once the aniseed is fragrant, pour oil into another small bowl.  Place crushed bouillon in bowl with aniseed and whisk for several seconds.  Pour the flavouring mixture into the bowl with aniseed and whisk.  Remove the bowl from heat.  Separate the romaine lettuce leaves from the skin.  Coat a clean salad bowl with nonstick spray.  Take a lettuce leaf and place in bowl with a dollop of custard.  Flip it as you pile it onto the lettuce leaf.  Roll tightly, place on serving platter and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,baking ammonia,cream corn,coffee granule,phyllo,beef bouillon cube
title: Pretend Pie (German Meat Pie)
ingredients: 4 cups cream-style corn ( use light corn, or use canned corn ) | 1 cup low-fat coffee granules ( liquid from the corn ) | 1 beef bouillon cube ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant chicken bouillon granules ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon baking ammonia ( ammonium ) | 1/8 teaspoon cream-style corn or 1/8 teaspoon evaporated milk | 1 package phyllo, thawed ( i used my own )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Combine 2 cups of the cream style corn, coffee granules, beef and bouillon into a saucepan and bring to boil.  Do not boil.  Remove from heat and add ammonium or milk, cream style corn and refrigerate overnight.  Pour one sheet of phyllo on a cookie sheet.  Brush with some of the cooking spray, then roll up the length of the sheet.  Repeat with the remaining phyllo.  The phyllo will be used to cook the meat pie later.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and dried herbs.  Bake for 45 minutes.  You will need to keep a watch, or oven mitt in the oven for the next half hour or so.

title: Linguini with Rose Water and Sugar (Linguini Con Mandorle)
ingredients: 8 ounces linguine | 1 teaspoon crushed dried rose water | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup water
instructions: Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add linguini and cook for 8 to 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon,celery seed,corn kernel,lime wedge,mushroom,pork loin,sea scallop
title: Corn and Rice Smoked Sausage
ingredients: 1 -2 lb smoked pork loin, cut into bite-size pieces | 2 cups frozen corn kernels, thawed | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 8 mushroom, sliced | lime wedge, for garnish
instructions: Place pork in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Cook until evenly browned, turning to brown evenly.  Drain off any fat from pan and stir in corn kernels, bouillon and celery seed.  Place mushrooms in pan.  Cook just until mushrooms are softened, then remove from heat.  Spoon sauce onto a platter.  Garnish with lime wedges.

title: Cherry Tomato and Sage Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 4 bunches cherry tomatoes or 4 bunches grape tomatoes | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves or 1 tablespoon fresh sage leaf ( optional ) | 1 pint low sodium grape tomatoes or 1 pint cherry tomatoes | pesto sauce ( optional )
instructions: Put the tomatoes on the work tray or on your grill with plenty of good quality grill marks.  Turn when both sides are nice and charred. Remove the tomatoes from the tray.  Place the tomato skins in a plastic bag with the sage leaves.  Leave for 5 mins for the flavours to mingle.  Wash & trim the cherry tomatoes.  Remove some of the black skin if desired.  Cut into small chunks if not already done.  In a large pan or saucpan, bring some water to a boil.  Add the cherry tomatoes to the water & cook for about 30 seconds.  Drain, plunge into a bowl of cold water to cool.  After a couple of minutes, drain again & put into a bowl.  Pour the dressing over the tomatoes.  Serve with pasta or with your favourite side.

title: Scallop Tempura(Fry)
ingredients: 2 fluid ounces ice water | 2 lbs sea scallops
instructions: Boil the rice in the ice water until the scallops are just cooked, then drain them and pat them dry.  In a frying pan on the stovetop put the scallops in and fry them on each side for a minute or two on the underside.  When they are fully cooked, remove them and place them on a warming dish, let them cool slightly, then remove most of the white pith.  Put them on a bowl, pour the rice down the middle and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: green grape,clove,chicken bouillon cube,parmigiano reggiano cheese,pineapple,sage leaf,black olive
title: Italian Green Grape Soup
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon dried sage leaves ( not fresh ) | 1/2 garlic, bulb | 1/2 teaspoon finely grated fresh parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 10 -12 canned chopped black olives | 4 green seedless grapes, halved ( or red or yellow ) | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 tablespoons pineapple ( optional ) or 2 tablespoons apple juice ( optional )
instructions: Finely chop the sage and put in a large pot and bring to a boil.  Add the garlic, sage and cheese.  Then add in the black olives and grapes, if using.  Bring back heat to a boil.  Place the crushed bouillon cube in a separate bowl or cup, and pour into the soup pot.  Add in the pineapple or apple juice, cover and heat through.  You may adjust the seasoning with a bit of salt, pepper, or even the oregano and cilantro.  Serve warm.

title: Kielbasa and Lentils Spread (Bamiae)
ingredients: 1 cup canned lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon butter, or to taste | 1 tablespoon grated kielbasa | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint leaves | 1 tablespoon coconut flakes | 1 container cheese spread

title: Homemade Corn Chips Cookies
ingredients: 500 g self-raising all-purpose flour | 100 g corn oil | 3 tablespoons poppy seeds | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 tablespoon white flour | 3 tablespoons brandy or 3 tablespoons rum
instructions: Sift flour and five spice powder with a rolling pin.  Add oil and mix quickly.  Cover with a towel and leave to rest for about 20 minutes while you work with the dough.  If its not quite enough, refrigerate until you can roll up the dough.  Roll dough to about 1mm thick.  Using a pastry bag fitted with small decorative cutters, cut into strips about 5x12 inches.  Place about 1 teaspoon of the poppy seeds in a dry frypan.  Quickly dribble about 2 tablespoons of brandy on top, then quickly stir and let it sizzle until it has been slightly brown.  Immediately stir in about 1 tablespoon of brandy and stir, breaking it up a little with a fork.  Keep stirring.  Turn the heat down low and stir in the reserved poppy seeds and the second batch of sugar, one drop at a time, stirring briskly after each addition.  The dough will be slightly dry.  When this stage is done, the dough should be dry and very flakey, with a few air bubbles.  Place flour in a bowl and add the poppy seeds.  Add flour slowly, as little as possible, stirring with a wooden fork until the dough is smooth and the dough starts to clump.  Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and use lightly floured hands to knead the dough a good 1 - 2 times, drawing in extra flour to get the right consistency.  Cover dough with a towel and rest for 5 minutes.  Roll the dough out to about 1cm thickness, then cut with a 3mm cutter, making a heart shape.  Line a large tray with parchment paper.  Roll the hearts out again so they get bigger and stick more readily.  Put the heart shapes on the tray and cover completely with remaining flour.  Cover each cookie with a clean tea towel and leave to rest for 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 180°c and bake the cookies for 20 - 25 minutes, until crisp.

title: German Mustard Cheese Pastry
ingredients: 12 ounces sharp cheddar cheese | 12 ounces rye flour | 12 ounces mustard powder
instructions: Use one of the following methods from the original recipe for rye flour, rye flour.  Method 1, mix 12 ounces of the old style cheddar cheese with 12 ounces of the rye flour. Repeat with the remaining 12 ounces of cheddar mix and rye mix.  Add mustard powder and mix in well.  Do not knead by hand.  Grease the bowl/cake.  Turn dough on to a lightly floured pastry surface.  Knead lightly.  Roll out to 1/8 inch thickness and cut with a round or circle.  Cover dough with a cloth and refrigerate for an hour of at least. instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place lamb in a dutch oven, sprinkle with salt and cover with water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce heat to low, cover and simmer on lowest setting for about 2 hours or until lamb is very tender and falling off the bone.  Combine soup, splenda and coriander seeds in a medium bowl and set aside.  Add walnuts or pecans to meat in pan and cook until they start to turn golden brown.  In a small bowl, cover meat with the soup mixture.  Arrange meat on bottom of a 11x15 baking dish.  Stir soup mixture and apricots into meat and bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until meat starts to bubble.  Serve in bowls, drizzling reserved soup mixture over top.

title: Cuban Ham With Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine | 1/4 cup marinade | 6 pieces ham
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix marinade with enough water to be a thin glaze and set aside to let flavors blend.  Lightly oil a baking pan and place the ham pieces in it.  Spread sauce on them and place in the preheated 400 degree oven.  Bake uncovered for 25 minutes.

Random Ingredients: basil,red capsicum,white wine vinegar,vegetable oil,sun tomato oil
title: Basil, Sun-Dried Tomato & Roasted Capsicum Salad
ingredients: 1 medium red capsicum | 2 medium sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and cut crosswise into strips | 2 tablespoons sun-dried tomato oil | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil
instructions: Cut capsicum into thin wedges, place on absorbent paper, sprinkle with salt & allow to dry in a non reactive bowl.  Place sun dried tomatoes and oil in a mortar.  Using pestle or a mortar, pound the ingredients until a rough paste forms.  Stir in reserved capsicum pieces & sun dried tomato strips.  To make dressing, stir together the vinegar & oil.  Gradually stir in reserved capsicum pieces.  Season with salt & pepper then chill well.  To serve, arrange salad on plates & drizzle the dressing over the salad.

title: Brown Beans and Rice
ingredients: 2 cans brown beans and rice, undrained | 2 cups dry bread, cut into 3 cubes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Place the beans in a 2 quart casserole dish.  Cover with enough water to come halfway up the sides of the dish.  Place the pieces of bread over the beans.  Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, until browned.

title: Vegetable Korma
ingredients: 2 lbs ground veal | 2 pinches lemon pepper | 1 cup cashews ( optional ) | 1/3 cup soy milk | 200 g cottage cheese | 1 tomatoes jalapeno, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup roasted salted cashews
instructions: In a large frying pan or wok, cook the ground veal in a little oil.  Add lemon pepper, cashews, cottage cheese, and diced tomato.  Mix well until the veal is heated through.  Add the jalapeno.  Enjoy.

title: Easy Crock Pot Chicken
ingredients: 1 boneless rump roast or 1 boneless bottom round roast | 1/4 cup icing sugar | 1/4 cup chicken stock | 16 ounces frozen vegetables ( of your choice, ie potatoes, carrot, celery )
instructions: Place roast in crock pot.  Place vegetables in bowl, then pour over gravy mix.  Cook on low 7 hours or high 4 hours.  If i'm using veggies with the last hour of cooking i add one.  Serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: rice bran oil,serrano chile pepper,head cauliflower
title: Roasted Cauliflower with Chile Peppers
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, cut into florets | 3 serrano chile peppers, seeded | 1/4 cup rice bran oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place cauliflower in a baking dish and sprinkle with chile peppers.  Roast in preheated oven until cauliflower begins to soften and brown, about 25 minutes.

title: Tofu & Sweet Green Peppers
ingredients: 300 g firm tofu | 15 teaspoons raisins bread | 15 teaspoons sweet green peppers | 1 teaspoon dried italian parsley | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream
instructions: Cut tofu in 1/2 inch pieces.  Arrange on a shallow serving dish.  Sprinkle with raisins and italian parsley.  Sprikle with green pepper slices.

Random Ingredients: head cauliflower,venison roast,chicken bouillon,phyllo pastry,turmeric,sea scallop
title: Azerbaijani
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, rinsed | 1 1/2 pounds lean ground venison roast | 3 cubes chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric | 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 1 pound sea scallops
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the cauliflower in a large pan with enough water to cover.  Bring to boil and stir in venison.  Bring to a boil and drain.  Place broth in the bowl of a food processor or blender.  Add turmeric.  Cover and blend.  In a large skillet, layer 1/2 cauliflower florets per package of phyllo, cover and heat through.  Stack 6 sheets in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Top with 1/3 of meat mixture, then cover with filo.  Repeat until you have used the remaining sheets and meat mixture.  Spread remaining sauce on top of the filo.  Cover and bake until sauce has thickened a bit and Phyllo is no longer crunchy, 50 to 55 minutes.

title: Brown Lentil With Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 cup brown lentils | 100 g snow peas
instructions: Wash and remove root ends from snow peas.  Cut pods into pieces about the size of an index finger.  Drop into a pan of just enough water to cover the peas.  Bring to boil, then turn down and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, until tender.  Use a slotted spoon to take the snow peas out of the pan and arrange on a serving plate, along with the lentils.  Sprinkle with a little extra sugar to make the snow peas pop and serve at once.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground pork | 10 teaspoons fat-free frozen whipped topping, thawed | freshly grated nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine pork and whipped topping in a bowl, toss gently to mix.  Garnish with nutmeg.  Roll into 1 inch balls the size of walnuts.  Place on waxed paper and refrigerate until ready to use.  Heat a greased or nonstick pan over medium heat.  Coat with cooking spray.  Place meatballs in pan, brown on all sides and put in a baking dish.  Cook about 10 minutes or until done.

title: Lazy Kielbasa and Mandarin Orange Pasta
ingredients: 1 package dry fettuccine pasta | 1 pound kielbasa ( polish or scotch boneless with skin removed ) | 2 cans mandarin orange segments
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 8 minutes.

title: Langsoire's Irish Breakfast
ingredients: 1 package dried vermicelli rice noodles | 1/2 cup apple juice | 2 packages dried rigatoni pasta | 1 can or bottle irish stout beer
instructions: Place vermicelli in a bowl, and cover with warm water.  Allow standing time of 1 - 2 centimeters to soften.  Drain, and rinse with cold water.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  Add pasta, and cook for about 8 minutes or until al dente.

title: Homemade Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup hot sauce | 1/3 cup dill, chopped
instructions: Place hot sauce in a blender or food processor with dill and blend until it is well mixed.  Store in refrigerator until needed.  You may want it to be stored in refrigerator in a sealed jar with tight air.

title: Baked Salmon & Cream With Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 4 salmon steaks, about 200g ( skin on, about 175g ) | 8 ounces smoked salmon | 1/2 cup table cream | 2 tablespoons plain flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 220 degrees c / 375 degrees f.  Line a shallow baking tray with foil and cut two slits in the base of each salmon steak.  Place each salmon fillet into the oven and bake for 20 - 25 minutes, depending on thickness of skin, until just cooked through.  Cool fish on a cutting board.  Slice the salmon into slices and place onto a plate.  Arrange the smoked salmon over each piece of salmon and top with the cream.  Dust your plates with flour and serve.

title: Shami Kebabs
ingredients: 100 g chicken thighs, cut into chunks | 1 large lime, halved | 1/4 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Thread chicken on skewers, lengthwise.  Place in a large marmite, cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 5 minutes or overnight.  In a small pan, add marmite and bring to simmer.  Cook about 10 minutes or until chicken is browned and tender.  Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with ground cardamom.  Serve with steamed carrots or cabbage.

Random Ingredients: olive,yellow cornmeal,romano cheese,fontina cheese,cooking wine,double cream
title: Easy Mexican Polenta Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups uncooked yellow cornmeal | 2 1/2 cups double cream | 2 tablespoons cooking wine, plus more | extra olive, to grease | 1 3/4 cups diced fontina cheese | 1/2 cup grated romano cheese | 1/3 cup coarsely chopped ripe olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Place cornmeal in a large bowl, and add warm cream, wine, and 1/2 cup olive oil.  Beat thoroughly to combine.  Stir in fontina& romano cheese.  Pour mixture into a 2 1/2 quart greased casserole dish.  Cover tightly with foil.

title: Rice With Bacon and Arborio Rice
ingredients: 4 slices bacon | 4 cups arborio rice
instructions: Place the bacon in a large frying pan.  Cook over medium heat, turning often, until crisp.  Remove bacon.  Add the rice to the bacon grease in the pan.  Cook, stirring, until it begins to brown on the bottom.  Stir in 2 cups of hot water.  Heat to boiling over high heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 45 minutes until rice is tender.

title: Rhubarb and Manchego Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 12 ounces rigatoni pasta or 12 ounces penne pasta | 3/4 lb manchego cheese ( or cotija ) | 1 lb fresh rhubarb, stalks finely chopped | 16 skewers, trimmed of fat | 1 tablespoon parsley flakes | 6 ounces arugula or 6 ounces boston lettuce
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to package directions.  Rinse under cold water and drain.  Toss with manchego and rhubarb in large bowl.  Place skewered skewers on a large piece of aluminum foil and coat with cooking spray.  Cook skewers, 4 at a time, at a moderate grill for 6 - 8 minutes, turning over 2 minutes.  Transfer on a large platter and tent with foil and continue to grill remaining skewers.  Sprinkle with parsley flakes then drizzle with reserved manchego dressing.  Serve topped with arugula leaves.

title: Orange Balsamic Roast Beef
ingredients: 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar | 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar | 8 large boneless sirloin steaks, cut 1 inch thick | 1 medium celery rib, thickly sliced | 1 medium orange peel, cut into 1/4-inch wide strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f, and place rack in the top third of the oven.  Tuck the steak under the skin and brush entire surface with balsamic and vinegar.  Place in a baking dish, top with a tight fitting lid and drizzle with any remaining balsamic glaze.  Roast uncovered in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, basting every 10 minutes.  For the beef, reduce heat to 325°f when timer rings for 45 minutes, add the celery and pea pods.  Recover and continue to roast uncovered for 15 to 20 minutes, or until meat thermometer registers 150°f for medium rare.

Random Ingredients: vinegar,grain white rice,bean sprout,black bean,sea bass fillet,pea,cottage cheese,strawberry
title: Strawberry-And-Cottage Cheese Sushi
ingredients: 120 g cottage cheese | 1/2 cup low-fat dry beans | 1/2 cup peas | 1 cup long-grain white rice, washed | 1/2 cup iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces ( can also use white cabbage, chives of your choice as well ) | 1/2 cup sweet bean sprouts ( optional ) | 1 cup diced wild pacific sea bass fillet or 1 cup dark ocean bass fillet, cut into cubes
instructions: Soak the rice in 3 cups boiling water 30 minutes or until it is completely cooked.  Drain and set aside in a large bowl.  Drain all the water from the rice.  Place the cottage cheese in a bowl with the sweet bean sprouts and rice.  Stir in the salad dressing, then spoon into the bowls and serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: chicken,chinese five spice powder,red onion,vegetable stock,cooking spray,basmati rice,red bean
title: Red Bean Chicken
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 red onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon chinese five spice powder | 750 g skinless chicken | 1 cup roasted red beans | 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups cooked basmati rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Heat a non stick frying pan over medium heat.  Cook chicken 4 - 5 mins each side or until browned.  Transfer to a plate.  Place onion in the pan.  Sauté for 2 mins or until soft.  Add spice powder and cook for 1 mins or until fragrant.  Stir in chicken to coat with spices.  Heat for 3 mins or until chicken changes colour.  Add beans and stock.  Bring to boil.  Return chicken, sauce and onion to pan.  Return to boil.  Transfer to an oven proof dish.  Bake 30 - 40 mins or until chicken is cooked and tender.

title: Torti
ingredients: 1 packet pre-made vanilla flavored torilla ice cream biscuits ( such as oreo or cannoli, just enough ice cream to make them hold together well ) | 1 can tomato sauce | 1 dash vanilla essence ( optional )
instructions: Break the biscuit into little squares.  Put one spoonful into the centre of a tin of ice cream.  Spread half the tomato sauce on top.  Add the remaining biscuits, pour the remaining tomato sauce on top.  Add a dash of vanilla essence if using.  Refrigerate for 2 - 3 hours.  Turn onto a serving platter and serve with the reserved ice cream ice cream.

Random Ingredients: feta,clove,lime juice zest,green chilies,crawfish,tamarind pulp,cocoa powder
title: Caribbean Crawfish With Chili and Chocolate
ingredients:
4 lbs crawfish | 3 ounces canned diced green chilies | 2 ounces tamarind pulp ( pulp of 3 c.
    - chopped and seeded ) | 2 ounces unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 lime, juice and zest of, only | 2 teaspoons unsweetened dried shredded feta ( for garnish )
instructions: Cook the crawfish and green chilies in boiling, salted water about 10 minutes and drain.  Place in casserole dish.  Cover with tamarind and bake in 350°f oven for 20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.  Remove from oven and spread out on a flat surface.  Allow it to cool.  Stir in cocoa and set aside.  To serve, place a small amount of feta crumbled on each of 4 serving plates.  Spoon the crawfish mixture on top and garnish with lime juice.

title: Chocolate Mashed String-Green Beans
ingredients: 1 package uncooked string beans, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons milk chocolate chips | 1 pinch onion salt
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the green beans and return to a boil.  Cook the green beans uncovered, stirring occasionally, for about 8 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Whisk the chocolate chips into the green beans.  Stirring constantly, allow the chocolate to melt.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,bread flour,cream chicken soup,cake flour,brown sugar
title: Easy Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/2 cup cake flour | 1/2 cup brown sugar | 1 green chili pepper, chopped and seeded | 1/2 cup bread flour
instructions: Pour soup into blender and slowly add all other ingredients.  Blend on high or low until smooth.

title: Ciabatta With Rhubarb, Lime, and Pistachios
ingredients: 1/2 lb rhubarb, coarsely chopped | 1/4 bunch parsley, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon lime zest | 1 tablespoon sunflower seeds, toasted | 1 loaf ciabatta | 3 -4 fluid ounces whipping cream
instructions: Place the rhubarb, parsley, zest, and sunflower seeds in a large bowl with the chopped rhubarb, and mix well.  Cut the ciabatta into 2 inch slices, and cut a slit in the top of each into half.  Spread cream around the top, and dip the bread slices in it to soak up the cream.  Arrange the bread slices on a serving platter, and sprinkle with the chopped rhubarb and pistachios on top.  Serve at once.

title: Zucchini Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 large zucchini | 3 tablespoons miracle whip
instructions: Cut zucchini in halves.  Slice halves lengthwise.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,rom tomato,ghee,cauliflower,potato,taco seasoning mix,green peppercorn
title: Spicy Vegetable and Potato Burros
ingredients: 1 small potato, peeled and cut into quarters | 1 cup sliced cauliflower | 1 cup sliced jalapenos or 1 cup chopped green peppercorn | 2 tablespoons ghee | 1 can bamboo shoots, sliced | 1 packet taco seasoning mix | 2 roma tomatoes, sliced
instructions: Place potato, cauliflower and green chili in microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for 5 minutes, stirring twice or place potatoes on paper towel towel if microwave is not available.  Heat ghee in skillet over medium high heat.  Cook mixture until oil starts to separate and then add taco seasoning and stir well.  Pour mixture into bowl and set aside for one to two hours.  Cut roma tomatoes into eight pieces and arrange on plate.  Add vegetables and tomato to tortillas and spread a light coating of taco seasoning mixture over them.  Serve alongside refried beans if desired.

Random Ingredients: white cake mix,porcini mushroom,rice noodle,baby green
title: Green Fairy Cakes
ingredients: 1 box white cake mix | 1 package dried porcini mushrooms, rehydrated | 2 cans baby greens | 1 package dry rice noodles
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  In a medium bowl, mix together the cake mix and porcini mushrooms.  Spread 1/2 the mushroom mixture over the bottom of the prepared baking dish.  In a large bowl, toss together the greens and rice noodles.  Spoon the green vegetable mixture in dollops over the green vegetable mixture.  Cover with the remaining cake mix, and top with remaining mushroom mixture.  Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean, about 40 minutes.

title: Sun Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 12 fresh tomatoes, sliced | 4 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained
instructions: Toss the sun dried tomatoes and basil with a little olive oil in a bowl.  Serve.

title: Spice Rub
ingredients: 1 lb beef tips or 1 lb sirloin tip, cubed | 2 tablespoons basmati rice ( i use jasmine rice ) | 3 1/2 teaspoons minced jowain ( optional ) or 3 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients well then rub all over beef.  Let sit 8 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.  Works well with lamb too.  Enjoy. .

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,tomato juice,bran cereal,orange peel,onion soup mix,beef sirloin steak
title: Beef Sirloin Steak 'n' Bran
ingredients: 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 3 cans seasoned tomato juice | 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks | 3 large oranges, peeled, sectioned, and cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1 teaspoon orange peel, grated ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.  Combine the grand marnier, onion soup mix, and tomato juice in 3 1/2 to 4 quart slow cooker.  Layer steaks alternately with orange wedges in slow cooker.  Divide orange marinade between steak.  Cover.

title: Mexican Cheese
ingredients: 4 ounces colby-monterey jack cheese, chopped | 1/8 teaspoon garlic, powdered | 1 tablespoon orange slice, finely cut
instructions: Sprinkle colby jack cheese with garlic powder.  Spread orange slice over cheese.  Microwave for 1 minute or until cheese is melted.  Enjoy.

title: Irish Cottage Cheese and Water Stew
ingredients: 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine | 1 cup cottage cheese | 1 1/2 cups water | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon coriander ( optional ) or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Add spices, cottage cheese, and water.  Simmer 2/3 hour.  Serve over hot cooked rice.  Delicious. ,.

title: Honey Glazed Baked Spareribs
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger | 2 tablespoons honey | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 teaspoon horseradish | 2 cups chicken broth | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Melt honey, turmeric, and horseradish in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Stir in the chicken broth.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.  Add spareribs and stir to coat.  Place in a shallow baking pan.  Make sure the spareribs are well sealed.  Cover with foil.  Bake for 1 hour or until heated through.  Meanwhile, return pot to a boil and boil for 1 more minute to reduce the sauce.  Pour sauce over spareribs and bake another 30 minutes or until spareribs are heated through.

title: Scotch Whiskey Glaze
ingredients: 2 ouncesscotch whiskey | 2 ounces hot italian sausage, chopped | 2 tablespoons pecan pieces, toasted
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to boil.  Boil rapidly for 2 - 3 minutes to reduce.  When glaze starts to bubble, remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: irish cream,poultry seasoning,brown onion,egg noodle,red apple,rye flour,orange juice zest
title: Spiced Noodle Pancakes With Apples & Nuts
ingredients: 8 ounces egg noodles | 1/4 cup brown onion, finely sliced | 1 red apple, cored & finely grated | 1 teaspoon orange zest, finely grated | 1 1/2 tablespoons rye flour | 1 teaspoon poultry seasoning or 1 teaspoon your favourite seasoning | 3 tablespoons irish cream, warmed
instructions: Toast the noodles in a pan.  Cook the onion, apple & zest in boiling water for 2 minutes.  Stir in flour, herbs & orange zest.  Cook, stirring, for 1 minute.  Add cream & then warm to serving temperature.

title: Tasty Quinoa With Port and Stilton
ingredients: 1 cup port wine | 1 teaspoon dried cherries | 3 cups arborio rice or 3 cups arborio rice, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup crumbled stilton cheese | 1 cup coarsely grated pecorino romano cheese
instructions: Combine port and cherries in medium saucepan.

title: Escacied Melon Scallops
ingredients: 12 cantaloupe, tops and bottoms removed | 2 bay scallops
instructions: Preheat grill for medium heat or under the broiler.  Place cantaloupe halves in a baking dish with the tops about 1 inch apart.  Sprinkle each melon with the bay scallop.  Place on the grill and cook 10 minutes, or just until the scallops are beginning to grill.  Serve immediately.

title: Canadian Bacon Bean Spread
ingredients: 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 8 ounces canadian bacon, diced | 1/2 cup coarsely grated hazelnuts | 3 tablespoons sugar
instructions: In a bowl, combine pinto beans, canadian bacon, hazelnuts and sugar.  Transfer mixture to an ungreased 1 1/2 qt.  Baking dish.  Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 40 - 50 minutes, or until slightly golden brown and hot in the center.

title: Masala Oil for Bread or Burfi
ingredients: 1 gallon corn oil ( for frying ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom powder
instructions: In a deep frying pan, put corn oil to 350 degrees f.  When the oil is hot enough to form a light haze, pour the oil in slowly and carefully into the fat.  When a light haze forms, remove from heat.  In one by one, make a lengthwise slit into the bread/burfi with fingers and open to expose the dark oil.  This will take approximately one hour to 2 hours.  When the oil is very hot and solidified, quickly pour the masala all over the bread/burfi.  The oil should be 1 inch deep in the pan.  The masala should become brown around the edges, not dark.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Dip With Turkish Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup plain greek yogurt | 1/3 cup peanut butter | 1/8 teaspoon turmeric | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
instructions: Stir together yogurt, peanut butter, tumeric, and half the sesame seeds until well blended.  Fold in remaining sesame seeds.

title:
Apple Breakfast With C.
    - H.
    - O.
    - S.
    - F.
    - Shirataki
ingredients: 2 large apples - peeled, cored and coarsely chopped | 2 medium ripe papayas - peeled, seeded, and coarsely chopped | 1 pound filet mignon, cut into small pieces | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup black tea, brewed
instructions: Place apples, papaya, and filet mignon in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: green pepper,canola oil,sun tomato oil,cooking sherry,cornmeal,lettuce
title: Tortilla Stack
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1 tablespoon canola oil | 10 green peppers, sliced | 1 medium red pepper, sliced | 12 sheets lettuce
instructions: Combine cornmeal, cooking sherry and canola oil, spread evenly over one side of ten sheets of reynolds wrap aluminum foil lined pizza pan or ten 12 inch pizza pan.  Arrange peppers, lettuce and sundried tomatoes on top of cornmeal mixture.  Wrap tightly in aluminum foil in two layers.  Place dish in oven and allow to bake at 400f for 50 - 60 minutes or until tortillas are crispy and golden brown.

title: Easy Pesto Wrapped Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 4 slices prosciutto | 1/4 cup pesto sauce | 1 cup shredded coconut
instructions: Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice each chicken breast into 3 or 4 strips, and place onto a baking sheet.  Place in the preheated oven, and cook until the chicken is cooked through, 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven.  An instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f.  Remove from oven, stir in prosciutto slices, and cover with plastic wrap.  Allow to rest and set about 20 minutes before serving.

title: Spicy Spiced Almonds for Fish
ingredients: 1 kg blanched almond | 1 medium red onion, peeled and grated | 2 red chili peppers, deseeded and finely chopped | 1 1/2 tablespoons cracked peppercorns
instructions: Heat oven to 180 degree c and line a shallow ovenproof dish with baking paper.  Place almonds on a lightly greased baking tray and bake for about 30 mins, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned.  Place onion, chili peppers and ground peppercorns in a bowl.  Add remaining ingredients.  Toss to combine.  Spread over the almonds.  Bake in the oven for about 15 minutes or until golden.

title: Pinchos
ingredients: 400 g fresh pork belly | 1/2 cup goat cheese
instructions: Cut off most of the fat from the pork belly with a sharp knife.  Slice the meat into large slices.  Place the pieces into a bowl and cover with sea salt and cracked black pepper.  Leave at least overnight to marinade.  Preheat the oven to 180c, 190ºc or gas wash the pork belly, removing all stray bits of skin, then brush some oil over the top.  Cook the meat in a large oven proof dish until just cooked through, then transfer it to a baking tray.  Place the baking dish on a baking tray.  Add the goat cheese to the tray with the marinade and mix well until it is completely absorbed into the pork.  Spread this evenly over the pork.  Bake the pork in the oven for 50 minutes, checking and stirring occasionally.  Serve with fresh potato chutney.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,penne pasta,accent seasoning,five spice powder,pimento olive,marinara sauce,cooking sherry,cooking oil
title: Al Capone's Famous Pasta
ingredients: 24 ounces penne pasta, uncooked ( or spaghetti ) | 2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/4 cup cooking oil | 1/2 teaspoon five-spice powder | 1 jar red pimento stuffed olives, undrained | 1/4 cup cooking sherry | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | chili paste | marinara sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain well and reserve.  Meanwhile, heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat.  Add onions and season with five spice powder and continue cooking for two minutes or until onions are golden.  Add olives, sherry and chili paste.  Cook for 2 minutes or until heated through.  Add pasta and sauce and toss to thoroughly coat.  Serve immediately.  Pass extra marinara sauce for a special look.

Random Ingredients: rotel tomato,chili paste,cherry,anise seed,red food coloring,black pepper,italian sausage
title: Chef John's Chili Sausage in Red Eye Gravy
ingredients: 8 links hot italian sausage | 1 can rotel tomatoes | 2 cans diced plum-style tomatoes | 1/4 cup chili paste | 2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper | 1 teaspoon anise seeds | 1 teaspoon red food coloring
instructions: Pour the rotels and chopped tomatoes into a large pot over medium low heat.  Stir the chili paste, black pepper, anise seeds, and red food coloring into the rotel tomatoes.  Cook for at least 15 minutes, or serve in a bowl over plain spaghetti.

title: Basil and Feta Braid
ingredients: 12 cups fresh basil | 1 package yellow split peas | 5 cups fresh sage leaves | 5 teaspoons ground allspice berries ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups egg yolks | 1 pinch saffron, crumbled ( or other cardamom )
instructions: Place basil, split peas, sage, allspice, and egg yolks into a large pot of lightly salted boiling water.  Cook 8 minutes or until spinach is tender but not mushy.  Drain, and transfer to an 8 x 8 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle with saffron.  Cover and set aside at room temperature.  Bake, uncovered on top of a gas flame or in a preheated 375 degree f oven for 35 minutes, stirring once or twice, until a golden brown crust has formed on the surface.  Remove from oven, and cut into squares while still warm.  Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week.  Note, to freeze, freeze, cover and chill the soup at least 6 hours, preferably overnight.  To reheat, bring a kettle of water to a boil, then reduce heat to low.  Stir in basil, and refrigerate about 10 minutes until basil is softened.  To serve, reheat soup in a 325 degree f oven about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, and stir in toasted garlic bread, 1/2 cup basil mint leaves, and a sprinkling of saffron.

title: Vanilla Bean Creme
ingredients: 2 large vanilla beans | 1 cup lemon peel, finely chopped | 1/4 cup good-quality vanilla bean paste or 1/4 cup flavored vanilla oil
instructions: Wash the vanilla beans, reserving a few of the seeds for later.  Split up vanilla pods.  Place the pods in a glass bowl and add 1 cup of hot water.  Leave in a warm place for 30 to 60 minutes.  Strain, discarding the strained seeds, and then pour a little of the hot water over the top and stir into the vanilla pod pulp.

title: Linguini Pasta Shells
ingredients: 4 1/2 ounces linguine | 1 teaspoon maple extract
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add linguini and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,whipping cream,double cream,milk,pork chop,cardamom,corn syrup
title: Tender Pork Chops Salad
ingredients: 2 pork chops, 1-inch thick, bone-in | 4 tablespoons corn syrup | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 2 tablespoons milk | 1/2 tablespoon white vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 f.  Lightly butter a 1 1/2 quart dish.  Place chops in dish, and bake for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, in a saucepan, combine corn syrup, whipping cream, milk, vinegar and cardamom.  Cook over medium heat, without boiling, until mixture starts to boil.

title: Easy Mango Fritters
ingredients: 3 large mangoes | 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda | pam cooking spray
instructions: Cut mangoes in half, or in slices.  Place in the bowl of a food processor with the baking soda.  Add the mangoes with a little water or juice and pulse until it's almost smooth.  Add more juice if it's not enough until it's right for you.  Form into patties with your hands and sprinkle little pam on top.  Variation, leave out the baking soda and dip in melted margarine, or drizzle with butter, or brush on pam, but don't press them in very gently.  You can even drizzle them with a little balsamic or a touch of honey, if you prefer.

title: Italian Marinated Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breast fillets ( cut into 1/2 inch thick strips ) | 4 cups grape tomatoes ( halved ) | 1/4 cup amaretto liqueur
instructions: Combine the amaretto and grape tomatoes in a nonreactive bowl.  Marinate the chicken in the mixture, refrigerated, for at least 1 hour and up to 48 hours.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Place the chicken strips on a foil lined baking sheet and baste with equal amounts of marinade.  Bake for 40 - 45 minutes, or until chicken is cooked and no longer pink in center.  Serve with rice and a green vegetable.

title: English Muffins ( Breadmaker )
ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast | 1 lb fresh fruit, ripe
instructions: Add yeast to the 2 1/2 tsp of yeast and set the machine to the dough setting.  While the dough is rising in the oven, slice up fruit and put them through a strainer into a bowl.  When the dough is ready, take out the dough and poke it several times with a fork to make small holes, then place it back in the 1lb.  Mix and then put it in the bread machine.  When dough comes out of the bowl, knead it for 5 - 6 minutes or until it is smooth and elastic, adding water as needed to keep the dough from getting sticky.  Place into a clean bowl, coat with flour and let rise 30 minutes or until doubled in size about an hour.  Preheat oven to 350°f/180°c line two loaf tins with non stick baking paper or you may cut them into muffin tins.  If you don't, they will not stick together.  Punch holes in the tins.  Place onto greased/sprayed cooling racks and let rise for one hour.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the muffins are brown and crusty.  Let cool on wire rack.  If yours are thicker, let cool in the pan for an additional 5 minutes or so before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,shallot,red pepper flake,purple onion,sugar,mango chutney,rotel tomato chilies
title: Mango Chutney Dip
ingredients: 32 ounces rotel tomatoes & chilies | 8 ounces mango chutney | 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes ( or to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon sugar ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon dried shallots ( or a few dried, chopped shallots ) | 3 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Open all the contents of the rotel tomatoes & chilies.  Add the sugar, red pepper, shallots & garlic to the tomatoes, chile and/or chile.  If you find the mixture too loose and add more liquid, it will help with blending the ingredients.  Refrigerate for at least two hours.  Serve with chips of your choice and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: lemon wedge,taco shell,mushroom stem,lettuce leaf,bitter melon
title: Mushroom Tacos with Sweet Sour Cream
ingredients: 1 bitter melon, peeled, seeded, and chopped | 10 large lettuce leaves, washed and dried | 1 can mushroom stems and pieces, in syrup | 4 mushroom stems and pieces, washed and dried | 1/2 cup prepared sweet sour cream
instructions: Cut the bitter melon in half, scoop out seeds with a spoon, and finely chop.  Toss the melon, lettuce leaves, and hot water in a bowl.  Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of the melon mixture into each taco shell.  Mix in the sweet sour cream.

title: A Sauerkraut-Reindeer
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sauerkraut | 2 ounces italian style breadcrumbs | dijon mustard ( we use whole grain, and 2 tbsp if you want it very sweet ) | 1 pinch ground cloves | 1 pinch ground ginger | 1/2 - 1 large pinch red pepper, dried
instructions: Drain the sauerkraut well, and press it through a sieve.  Cut it into 1 inch pieces.  Put the breadcrumbs, seasonings and ground ginger into a small bowl.  Add a little more olive oil if necessary.  Place sauerkraut in the bowl, and mix till coated.  Cover with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate for 1 hour or longer.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, and coat lightly with cooking spray.  Remove the sauerkraut from the refrigerator, and lightly oil the foamproof platter.  Spread the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the top of the sauerkraut.  Bake for 10 minutes, or until toasted and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: shrimp,mango chutney,cauliflower floret,ciabatta,chunky salsa,red wine,ra el hanout spice mix
title: Tuscan Seafood Sandwich (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 14)
ingredients: 1 ciabatta, cut into 2 cm slices ( 1 inch thick ) | 1 cup cauliflower floret, steamed ( about 1/2 large stalk ) | 400 g jumbo shrimp, thawed, peeled | 1/3 cup chunky salsa | 1/4 cup red wine | 1 teaspoon ras el hanout spice mix | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: Grill ciabatta until light golden, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Cool, cut into small squares.  Arrange on serving plate.  Combine cauliflower, shrimp, salsa, wine and spice in large microwave safe bowl.

title: Mango Chutney by Kerry Simon
ingredients: 1 lb lean pork, diced into small pieces | 1 jar mango nectar | 2 tablespoons red pepper flakes | 1/4 teaspoon stevia
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Store in refrigerator until needed.

title: Easy Low-Fat Fried Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil or 1/2 cup cooking spray | 1 teaspoon kosher salt ( or sea salt )
instructions: Place the spray into a dry, non stick fry pan over medium heat.  When it has begun to puff up and flame, about 2 minutes, stir in the salt.  When it’s ready, place 2 - 3 vegetable in near the middle of your pan, and invert the pan over the veggies to form a semi circle.  Cook them for 2 minutes on each side, flipping and flipping over every 2 minutes.  If you’re frying in batches rather than holding them by hand, they will only take half as long.

title: Confectioner'Sugar Canezzola (Lime) and Citrus Margarita
ingredients: 1/2 package frozen limeade concentrate, thawed, drained ( use concentrate can in asian markets ) | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar
instructions: Place limeade concentrate and confectioners' sugar in a large glass or ceramic bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator for 3 hours.  Pour the chilled limeade concentrate mixture into margarita glasses and serve.

title: Baked andouille Sausages
ingredients: 1/3 cup teriyaki or 1/3 cup louisiana hot sauce | 1/4 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning | 10 -12 slices andouille sausages
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a bowl mix warm teriyaki and lemon pepper.  Set aside.  To prepare pan, lay sausages over 1 side of pan or coat with a little oil, and place in oven, and bake about 25 minutes, or until browned and crumbly.  Remove to serving plate.  Drain juice from pan, scraping all the browned bits away.  Add hot sauce and remaining juices.  Heat for a few minutes to pour over sausage.

title: Cafe Rio Blue Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup half-and-half, milk or 1/4 cup milk | 1 1/2 teaspoons blue curacao | 1/4 cup diced tomato with onion and garlic, drained
instructions: In a slow cooker combine half and half, milk and curacao.  Stir until well blended.  Add tomato and stir well.  Cover and cook on low heat setting 10 - 15 minutes, or until heated through and smooth creamy.

title: Spiced Mocha Rounds
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely chopped green onion ( whites and light green part only ) | 1/3 cup finely chopped orange peel | 2 1/2 teaspoons instant espresso, dissolved in | 3/4 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a small bowl, stirring until well blended.  Cover and chill until ready to use.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Yummy Chilli Rice
ingredients: 1 cup jasmine rice | 1 1/2 cups souther-style sweet mixed chilli rice | 3 chilies, chopped | 1/2 cup worcestershire sauce | 1 tablespoon coriander | 1 teaspoon arrowroot | 2 tablespoons dill ( dried or fresh ) | dill, to garnish
instructions: Cook rice.  Steam chillies and coriander.  Cook souther style chili, stir fry with rice and chillies in a little oil over a medium heat.  Add worcestershire sauce and arrowroot.  Add dill and stir for 1 minute add chilli rice.  Garnish with dill.

title: Spinach with Pineapple and Sausage
ingredients: 5 lbs fresh baby spinach | 3 lbs small parsnips | 4 links sweet italian sausage | 1/2 crushed cardamom | 1/2 cup diced pineapple
instructions: Cook the spinach and parsnips in a large pot until just tender.  Cut sausage in bite size pieces, and add to spinach.  Cook until sausage is well done, add crushed cardamom and pineapple, and stir to combine everything in the pot.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: corn oil,beef eye,walnut,sun tomato oil,peach,metal skewer
title:
Beef Rib Eye Sticky Whole Peaches and Walnuts, St.
    - James Style,
ingredients: 1 beef eye round, center cut, in 1/2 inch thick slices | 12 fresh peaches, peeled and cut into 8 pieces | 12 medjool sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained well | 1/4 cup walnuts, coarsely chopped | 24 metal skewers, soaked in water 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high.  Brush meat with oil and season generously with salt and pepper.  Grill, turning once, until meat is brown and charred on all sides, about 10 minutes.  Place 1 slice of pork breast side by side on each skewer.  Drizzle tomatoes with 1 teaspoon sun dried tomato oil and spread over meat.  Sprinkle nuts over tomatoes.  Grill skewered plank 4 inches from heat until skewer is crisp and hot, about 3 minutes per side.  Place 2 skewer halves on top of each skewer and sprinkle reserved 2 slices of pork with remaining sun dried tomato oil.  Grill 2 minutes.  Turn and sprinkle with walnuts.  If using oak, soak in hot water for 1 hour or submerge in warm water for 30 minutes.  Drain well.  Serve with fruit and drizzled with remaining 1 teaspoon sun dried tomato oil.

Random Ingredients: kosher salt black pepper,cardamom seed,cooking oil
title: Tandoori Paste
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups tandoori cooking oil ( or other oil ) | 1 tablespoon cardamom seed | kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a heavy bottomed pan bring about 1 1/2 cups tandoori cooking oil to a temperature of about 140°f.  Add the cardamom seeds and, using a pestle, add about 2 tablespoons oil and the kosher salt and pepper to taste, mixing well after each addition.  When the oil is hot and smoking, add the tandoori paste and turn at least every couple of minutes.  When it is golden brown, about 20 to 30 minutes, move it out of the pan onto a plate.  Serve at room temperature with pita breads or with naan bread.

title: Healthy Beef Kabobs With Moghlai Sauce and Avocado
ingredients: 1 lb lean stewing sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 tablespoon cocoa | 2 tablespoons dark chocolate, melted | 1 -2 tablespoon apricot preserves | 2 tablespoons alfredo sauce | 1 tablespoon instant couscous | 1/8 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup diced avocado
instructions: Mix together the first 8 ingredients and marinate at least an hour.  Thread the beef on to skewers alternating with the avocado.  Prepare the moghlai sauce by combining the ingredients, adding the avocado at the point of addtion if desired.  Let the skewers sit for 15 - 20 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,date,dark brown sugar,teriyaki sauce,bay leaf,marinade,cognac,syrup
title: Steak Frites With a Kick!
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steaks or 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 8 ounces marinade | 2 ounces dark brown sugar ( or palm sugar ) | 2 ounces cognac | 2 large red bell peppers | 14 ounces crushed dates ( or dates that have been crushed by hand ) | 1 bay leaf | 2 tablespoons low syrups
instructions: Cut the steak into thin strips.  Place the marinade, sugar and cognac in a ceramic bowl and stir in pepper.  Add beef strips and marinade mixture to skillet and gently stir fry over high heat for 3 to 5 minutes, or until meat is just cooked and marinade mixture is syrupy.  Strain and serve with hot cooked rice and a salad of warm red vegetables.  This is also a nice dipping sauce for fried potato wedges.  A bit sweet and savory i know but this is a good choice for keeping to eye on.  This is the only time i make this in my area, so i don't miss anything.

Random Ingredients: ancho chilies,jumbo shrimp,cardamom pod,canola oil,soymilk,pesto sauce
title: Shrimp Pesto with Ancho Chili
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk | 1 lb jumbo shrimp | 1/2 cup canola oil | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce ( homemade or commercial ) | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chilies, crushed | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom pods
instructions: Combine the soy milk, shrimp, oil, pesto sauce, chilies, salt and cardamom in a bowl and whisk.  Add the marinade and stir to combine.  Place the prawns in the mixture and coat in the pesto.  Refrigerate for about half an hour.  Transfer the prawns, shrimp and marinade to a baking dish and sprinkle with chopped coriander.

title:
Hajar's Yummy Yummiest Pasta.
    -
ingredients: 1 lb angel hair pasta | 1 can diced tomatoes with sauce | 1 can mixed beans, drained ( i like bean curd ) | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1 teaspoon harissa ( optional )
instructions: Boil pasta with salt until al dente drain & set aside.  While pasta is cooking, prepare tomato sauce, combine canned & mixed beans & water chestnuts in a pot & bring to a boil.  Add harissa if desired.  Serve over hot cooked angel hair or hot cooked tortilla shells.

title: Steak for Two (Pate)
ingredients: 250 g sirloin steaks | 1 tablespoon caster sugar | 60 g fresh roasted peanuts, chopped ( optional ) | 1 refrigerated shortcrust pastry
instructions: Place steak in shallow ovenproof dish and sprinkle with sugar.  Bake at c for 20 - 25 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

title: Cashew Nut Stuffed Date Chops (Dees)
ingredients: 1/2 cup dates, pitted and finely chopped | 2 tablespoons cashew butter
instructions: Wash and dry the dates and remove the pits.  Stuff the cashew nuts with the dates and keep aside.

title: Chilli Glaze
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon crushed red chile ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Apply to chicken, meat, veggies or pork before grilling.

title: Homemade Ricotta With Daikon
ingredients: 12 ounces fresh ricotta cheese | 2 medium lemons, zested and juiced
instructions: Put the ricotta in the top of a double boiler over simmering water.  Whisk the lemon juice into the ricotta.  The key is getting the water very warm to the lemon juice, so no large pieces of lemon peel form.  When the rinsed off ricotta forms a paste, strain through a cheese cloth lined sieve, pressing on it with the back of the spoon.  It should form a thick, somewhat creamy sauce in the bottom of the bowl.  Discard the lemon peel.  Wet your hands, and gently squeeze the lemon juice into the ricotta.  Mixture will be thicker than a pancake batter.

title: Turkish Radishes
ingredients: 12 large radishes, washed | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 2 slices fresh turkish bread
instructions: Trim and wash the radishes.  Sprinkle them with sea salt.  Preheat griller or a small, heavy skillet over medium high heat until the radish tops are toasted and the bottom lightly black, 10 to 15 minutes.  Place a damp paper towel, then a clean dish towel over the dish.  Sprinkle the radishes with ground cloves.  Place the toast on top.  Let cool for 3 to 5 minutes.  Slice and serve.

title: Swiss Strawberries
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh cleaned strawberries ( approximately 31 pieces ) | 1/2 gallon whipping cream | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
instructions: Place fresh strawberries in a large bowl.  Cover with cheesecloth and let sit overnight.  Next day, prepare a large glass bowl, place a clean tea towel on top until ready to use.  Squeeze out excess liquid and toss strawberries with the towel.  Return to fridge.  In a large bowl beat whipping cream until soft peaks form.  Add salt, coriander and toss gently.  Fold cream gently then spoon mixture into plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.  Turn out onto serving plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,halloumi cheese,double cream,greek yogurt,poblano chile,mustard
title: Baked Stuffed Chiles - Chiles Roka Salata
ingredients: 6 large green poblano chiles | 125 g halloumi cheese | 2 tablespoons mustard | 2 tablespoons double cream | 1/2 red chili pepper flakes | 1/2 cup fresh greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c.  Place chiles, cut side down on a baking tray.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until dark & softened.  Remove & slice into thick slices.  Slice the halloumi into 1 cm thick slices.  Place in a bowl with mustard & cream.  Set aside while you preheat the oven to 200c.  Using the broiler or a grater to grate chiles using vegetable peeler, place the slices onto the tray & sprinkle with chili flakes.  Place the baking tray on a baking tray & bake approx 5 minutes or until light & soft & turning.  Remove from the oven & set aside to cool.  Place the yoghurt in a small bowl and stir in 2 tbsp of the chile & mustard.

title: Achiote Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup peanut oil | 2 tablespoons tamarind paste | 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Stir peanut oil and tamarind paste together in a saucepan over medium low heat until hot and the mixture has reduced by a third to form thick peanut butter, about 10 minutes, stirring constantly to avoid burning the seeds.  Continue cooking until the mixture is thick, about 30 minutes.  Serve warm or refrigerate.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,graham cracker,sharp cheddar cheese,heavy cream
title: Gran Smith Appetizer (Gran Smith Appetizer)
ingredients: 8 ounces graham crackers | 1 cup heavy cream | 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, grated ( about 1 1/2 cups ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Using a food processor, finely grind graham crackers to fine crumbs.  Using medium speed, cream graham cracker crumbs and cream in food processor.  Add grated cheeses and grated parsley using 3/4 cupfuls for each cup of mixture.  Transfer mixture to a medium bowl.  Stir in more cream to make a stiff dough.  Transfer dough to a parchment lined baking sheet.  Shape into a round, 6 inch circle.  Press indentations into the crust with the tip of a paring knife.  Bake until crust is golden brown and crust is just firm, about 1 hour 15 minutes.  Let stand until slightly loosened, about 5 minutes.  Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.  Cut into wedges and serve warm or room temperature.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Spicy Swiss Fonduta With Cabbage
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, country-style | 1 medium zucchini, sliced | 2 large tomatoes, fresh baked | 2 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/2 teaspoon chili, flakes | 1/2 cup mixed nuts
instructions: Toast the french bread in toaster oven or on the stove until golden brown.  Cut each slice in half lengthwise.  Brush with about 2 tablespoons of oil and sprinkle with a few whole nuts.  Remove toasted bread and cut into small squares.  Break the baked tomatoes into bite sized chunks, adding enough water to just cover the tomatoes.  Bring the skillet to medium heat, add the zucchini, and cook for 1 minute or so.  Add tomatoes to the skillet and simmer, covered, for a few minutes.  Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the sugar, tomato puree, and chili flakes.  Place the fonduta on a serving plate, and sprinkle with a few whole nuts on top.  Serve family style.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,rice,pesto sauce,chick pea,sea salt,cabbage leaf,gruyere cheese
title: Pesto Pastry (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 1/2 cup canned chick-peas, rinsed and drained | 8 large fresh rice sheets | 1 cup grated gruyere cheese | 1/4 cup finely shredded cabbage leaves, preferably napa cabbage | all purpose pesto sauce | sea salt, to taste | 2 sheets frozen phyllo pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  In a bowl, mash the peas with a potato masher.  Stir in the rice, cheese, cabbage and pesto until thoroughly blended.  Spread 2 sheets of phyllo in the bottom of a baking sheet coated with cooking spray.  Cover with a second sheet of phyllo, brushing with spray, and top with the remaining sheets.  Cover with a third sheet and brush with spray and sprinkle the top with sea salt.  Repeat to make three additional layers.  Spread 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons of the pesto over each layered pastry sheet to within 1/2 inch of the edges and top with the final sheets of phyllo.  You want the top layer to be completely covered.  Cut a few slits in the top of each layered pastry sheet with a sharp knife.  Bake the pastries with the tips of the knife at 375° f for about 40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

Random Ingredients: bacon,grapefruit juice,cashew,beef stew meat,margarine,sea bass fillet,vanilla bean
title: Seared Chilean Sea Bass With Cashews and Grapefruit Juice
ingredients: 1 sea bass fillet, 4 steaks | 2 ounces cashews | 2 ounces bacon | 1 pint grapefruit juice | 1 vanilla bean, halved lengthwise | 1 ounce margarine | 1 tablespoon unsalted dry roasted cashews | 1/4 cup raw cashews
instructions: Combine cashews, nuts, and bacon in a food processor or blender, pulse till finely minced and well mixed.  Place fish in shallow glass pan or baking dish.  Stir grapefruit juice into reserved juice and pour over fish.  Add vanilla bean and stir to dissolve.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Remove fish from marinade.  Remove sea bass fillet from marinade and dry with paper towels.  Cut diagonally into 4 pieces, place one piece on a skewer and sprinkle tops with cashews and roasted cashews.  Heat a bbq to medium and grill sea bass for 1 - 2 minutes each side.  Serve with sweet and sour sauce.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,prickly pear,double cream,garam masala,creamy peanut butter
title: Peppery Pear Cream Sauce
ingredients: 500 ml double cream | 250 g creamy peanut butter | 750 ml grand marnier | 250 g peeled prickly pears | 2 teaspoons garam masala
instructions: Heat cream, peanut butter, grand marnier and curry paste in a sauce pan over a low heat, stirring, until well blended and warm.  Core and roughly chop pears, and add to cream sauce.  Simmer for 5 minutes, then add garam masala.  Ladle into bowls and stir.

Random Ingredients: tartar sauce,green bell pepper,steak,onion,salad green,burrito flour tortilla
title: Mexican Steak Tacos
ingredients: 6 burrito-size flour tortillas | 1 container salad greens | 1 tablespoon steak, shredded | 1/2 green bell pepper, diced | 1/2 onion, diced | 1/2 cup tartar sauce
instructions: Cut the steak into chunks and brown in pan.  Combine all the ingredients and mix well.  Place a little lettuce on the tortillas and wrap up tightly with the tortillas.  Heat up the taco iron.  Spoon some of the steak mixture evenly across the tortilla.  Cook for 2 or 3 times until steak is browned.

title: Crock Pot Mild Sweet Beef
ingredients: 1 large boneless beef chuck roast | 10 fluid ounces sweet chutney ( i prefer applejack, but any will do ) | 1 1/2 ounces palm sugar
instructions: Place chuck roast in bottom of crockpot.  Cover with sweet chutney.

Random Ingredients: pea,stilton cheese,celery,rice wine,hash brown,sea salt black pepper
title: Baby Pea, Stilton and Potato Saffron Hash
ingredients: 2 cups frozen peas | 4 ounces stilton cheese, crumbled | 1 lb potato, peeled | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 tablespoon celery, chopped | 3 tablespoons rice wine or 3 tablespoons sherry wine vinegar
instructions: Place the defrosted peas in a microwave safe bowl and microwave on high for approximately 2 minutes, until the peas are tender.  Meanwhile, cook the potatoes in boiling water for approximately 10 minutes and allow to cool slightly.  Cut the potatoes into ½ inch thick slices.  Place the potato slices in a large frying pan with the cheese, pepper and celery, and drizzle with a little sherry or sherry vinegar.  Gently heat on a medium heat until the cheese is melted and starting to caramelise.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Serve warm.

title: Low Fat Calzones
ingredients: 1 yellow squash, cut into small cubes | 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt | 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt | 1 1/4 cups white flour, sifted
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°c.  Wash squash.  Cut off ends.  Slice the squash into 1 cubes.  Mix all of the wet ingredients together.  Add to the flour and toss to coat evenly.  Grease a nonstick frying pan lightly.  Add the calzones.  Cook for 15 minutes.

title: Almond Almonds
ingredients: 1 cup blanched almond ( whole or slivered or chopped ) | 1 red bell pepper, chopped ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Heat almonds in skillet on medium heat until they begin to colour.  Watch frequently to stir.  When they start darkening, stir in bell pepper and continue to cook for about one minute.  If you want the bell pepper to soften, just add another tiny bit of oil to the pan.  Be careful not to burn the bell pepper.  Stir in the almonds and heat for another few minutes or so, until the almonds are hot and coated.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,vegetable broth,thai red curry paste,sage
title: Spicy Thai Red Curry Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons vegetable broth | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh sage | 3 tablespoons thai red curry paste | 1 cup brown rice, rinsed
instructions: Combine broth and sage in a medium saucepan, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium, and simmer 10 minutes, or until liquid is reduced by half, stirring often.  Stir in curry paste, and continue cooking 5 minutes, or until mixture is slightly thickened.  Stir in rice until coated with mixture, then cook, covered, 5 minutes, then remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

title: Easy Crock Pot Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 package cauliflower florets, drained | 1 cup plain yogurt | 1/2 cup mango chutney
instructions: Place enchilada sauce in 5 - 6 qt crock pot.  Add cauliflower and yogurt.  Cover.  Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours.  Stir to blend.  Cover.  Enjoy.

title: Gruyere Steak Sandwich for 2
ingredients: 2 tablespoons yogurt | 4 slices gruyere cheese | 1 slice pear | 1 pinch liquid smoke flavoring | 1 clove, crushed
instructions: Combine the yogurt, gruyere cheese, pear, liquid smoke, and garlic.  To thin, add a little water if mixture is too thick.  Slice the sandwich in half horizontally, and fill with equal amounts of the sandwich.

title: Mango Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 3 slices green mango | 1 clove celery, minced
instructions: Slice mango in small cubes.  Remove seeds from garlic clove.  Dry the diced mango with paper towel.  Heat oil in the microwave and fry the cubes until golden, and cooked through, about 3 minutes.  Add mango to the fried tofu mix and stir until smooth.  Serve and drizzle with celery.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,oxtail,farfalle pasta,bailey irish cream,penne,chicken breast fillet
title: Bow Ties With Chicken and Irish Cream
ingredients: 300 g bow tie pasta | 2 chicken breast fillets, cubed or strips | 1 cup fat free greek yogurt | 1/2 cup baileys irish cream | 600 g oxtails, cooked | 400 g penne
instructions: Cook pasta according to the instructions on the package.  Meanwhile, heat oil in a fry pan and fry the chicken for about 5 minutes on each side.  Add the yoghurt and fry for about 2 minutes to heat through.  Add the chicken and the irish cream, and bring to a boil.  Lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce reduced.  Cook the pasta and oxtail in a large pan of boiling water until al dente.  Drain.  Serve the pasta and oxtail mixture over the noodles.

title: Baked Parsnips (French Parsley-Puff Pastries)
ingredients: 1 lb parsnip, peeled and cut into 1 inch pieces ( about 5 medium ) | 2 cups flour | 1/2 cup maple syrup
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f in a medium bowl combine the parsnips, flour, and maple syrup.  Using floured fingers, blend into a smooth ball.  Place on parchment or wax paper lined cookie sheets.  Using a spatula, score each piece into small squares about 2 inches wide.  Bake until lightly browned but not crisp, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Pasta With Noodles
ingredients: 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1/3 cup catsup | 1 tablespoon mixed spice | 1 tablespoon dried spices | 1 tablespoon italian spices | 1/3 cup small cellophane noodle | 1 lb farfalle pasta
instructions: In a saucepan, stir together cider vinegar, catsup, mixed spice and italian spices.  Bring to a boil.  Cook over medium heat until it thickens, stirring often.  Meanwhile, cook noodles in boiling water until al dente.  Drain and return to pot.  Add the sauce and toss to coat.

Random Ingredients: mexican cheese,sun luck chili garlic sauce,vinegar,yellow bell pepper,rhubarb,whiskey,fish sauce
title: Rhubarb & Jack Swiss Cheese Skewers
ingredients: 2 bunches rhubarb | 1 box shredded mexican blend cheese ( mild, medium or low-fat ) | 1 yellow bell pepper, diced | 2 tablespoons whiskey ( i prefer jameson ) | 1 teaspoon vinegar | 2 teaspoons fish sauce | 3 -4 teaspoons worcestershire sauce
instructions: Cut rhubarb into 1 inch pieces.  Put rhubarb in bowl or bowl of a slow cooker, breaking it up as you go.  Add the rest of the ingredients except the worcestershire sauce.
