instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a medium casserole dish, combine spaghetti, chickpeas, and pineapple.  Mix with almond paste.  Combine bread crumbs and egg, and add to casserole.  Bake on top of casserole for 40 to 45 minutes, or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Antipasto
ingredients: 1 lb fettuccine pasta | 1/3 lb genoa salami, thin slices | 1/3 lb giardiniera deli italian sweet salami, 1/3 lb | 1 red onion, 1/2 inch strips | 3 stalks celery, 1/4 inch slices | 1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  When cooked, drain, run cold water through colander and set aside.  Meanwhile preheat oven to 300 degrees.  Using a slotted spoon, layer half the salami, half the onion and half the celery on each of four warm tortillas, making sure there are no pockets of water.  Ladle 1/4 3/4 cup pasta water into a saucepan and add 1 tablespoon cocoa.  Heat over medium heat until hot.  Do not boil.  Repeat with remaining tortillas, salami, onions and celery, and finally cheese, making certain cheese melts over the top.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf parsley,mustard seed,purpose flour,chunky salsa
title: Salsa Crackers
ingredients: 1/2 cup chunky salsa | 1/3 cup all-purpose flour | 2 teaspoons prepared mustard seed | 1/4 cup snipped flat leaf parsley
instructions: Heat salsa in small saucepan to boiling.

title: Tomato Rice
ingredients: 1 can tomato puree | 1 bay leaf | 1 cup cherry, cut in half 'dried'| 1 cup rice krispies, crushed | 4 hard-boiled eggs, shelled
instructions: Place the tomato puree, bay leaf and cherry in a medium saucepan, bring to the boil, then remove from the heat, cover and set aside for 20 minutes.  Remove bay leaf, stir through rice krispies and stir and set aside for 5 minutes, or until rice is well coated.  Set aside for 5 minutes longer to allow rice to thicken slightly.

title: Bengal Dal Dessert
ingredients: 2 1/2 pints bengal gram dal | 1 tablespoon chives, chopped | 2 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice | 200 g fresh lemon juice
instructions: Put the dal and a little water in a pan and bring to boil.  Boil for about 6 minutes.  Then add the lemon and the chives, cover and turn off the flame.  Allow it to sit in a warm place for about 1 hour or until the flavours come together.  You may need a bit more water.  The dal should be a thick yellow color.  Turn out onto a serving dish and garnish with the lemon/herb mixture.

title: Oriental Noodles (Cook's Country)
ingredients: 5 tablespoons apple butter | 1 tablespoon rice noodles ( or more ) | 2 1/2 tablespoons carrot juice | 1 tablespoon fresh thyme ( chopped, dried can be substituted ) | ice
instructions: In a small sauce pan, combine carrot juice and thyme until well warmed.  In a large bowl stir together butter, rices and carrot juice mixture.  When noodles are softened, mix into cheese sauce.  Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Wings
ingredients: 8 chicken wings | 1 small cucumber, sliced | 1/4 stalk celery, chopped | 4 medium yukon gold potatoes, cut into 4 to 6 pieces
instructions: Cut chicken wings at the joint.  Alternate pieces in a ziplock bag with the cucumber and celery.  Marinate overnight in the refrigerator.  Remove wings from bag, discard marinade.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Arrange the chicken wings in a roasting pan.  Toss potatoes around, then scatter with salt and pepper.  Bake for 40 minutes in the preheated oven, or until chicken is tender and potatoes are golden brown.

title: Crustless Chicken
ingredients: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves | 2 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese, divided | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley | 2 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish.  Pour 1 cup of cheddar cheese onto the chicken breasts in the dish.  Sprinkle parsley over the top of the chicken breast.  Bake for 30 minutes in preheated oven.  When chicken is done, sprinkle remaining 1 cup of cheddar cheese over the top and put back in the preheated oven to melt the cheese.

Random Ingredients: orange zest,salt,beef chuck,beef bouillon cube,cremini mushroom,romaine lettuce,dark rum
title: Carne Asada II
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck or 3 lbs blade steaks, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 orange, zest of | 3 tablespoons dark rum | 1/2 cup beef bouillon cube, crushed, with | 1 teaspoon salt | 2 cans cremini mushrooms | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Sprinkle meat with one teaspoon each of salt and zest.  In bowl, mix rum, beef bouillion, and 1 teaspoon salt.  Place half of the mushrooms in the bottom of 6 quart crock pot, followed by half of the meat, and repeat layers.  Top with remaining mushrooms and cover.  Cook on very low heat for 10 to 12 hours.  Just before serving, in medium size, heavy skillet, sauté chopped lettuce over moderate heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until lettuce is lightly golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,vegetable oil,bacon,malt vinegar,baby spinach,poblano chile,orange marmalade
title: Spinach Salad With Chiles
ingredients: 3 garlic chilies | 2 tablespoons orange marmalade | 1/4 cup sherry wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 2 tablespoons fresh baby spinach | 3 poblano chiles, roasted, peeled, seeded, and sliced into thin strips
instructions: In a small bowl, coarsely grind the chiles to release flavor.  In a large bowl, mix the marmalade, vinegar, oil, and the chile puree.  Add the spinach or collard greens, pepper strips, and reserved chile bits and toss until well blended.  Season with salt to taste.

Random Ingredients: beef chuck roast,cooking spray,ketchup,vegetable oil cooking spray
title: Korean Barbecue Pot Roast (4 -5 Ww Points)
ingredients: 10 lbs beef chuck roast | vegetable oil cooking spray | ketchup | cooking spray
instructions: Coat the pot roast with cooking spray and allow to sit at room temperature for 5 hours.  Heat a large dutch oven over medium high heat and sear the roast on all sides in the hot oil.  This will take about 10 minutes for medium rare, 12 to 15 minutes for medium well.  Transfer to a platter and cover to keep warm.  Add about 1/2 cup water to the pot and deglaze, scraping up the browned bits on the pan bottom.  Add 1/2 cup of ketchup.  If the sauce is too thick, stir in a little ketchup.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Allow the pot roast to rest and then cover to keep warm.  Serve with rice and veggies.

Random Ingredients: sherry wine vinegar,oyster sauce,spring onion,baby spinach,egg wash
title: Steamed Spinach With Oyster Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 2 spring onions, chopped | 4 spring onions | 20 ounces fresh baby spinach, washed, picked and spun dry | egg wash
instructions: Lightly grease a steamer.  Combine all ingredients and stir.  Put on the rack of a steamer over a saucepan of water, bring water to boil and steam for 5 minutes.  Remove lid and steam for 5 minutes or until spinach is just tender.  Scatter fried spring onions around the spinach and serve.

title: Garlicky Chick peas (Chick Peas)
ingredients: 2 cups dried garbanzo beans | 1 whole orange peel, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch strips
instructions: Wash and sort chick peas, and place into a large container.  Cover with water by 2 inches, and let soak overnight.  The next morning, drain the soaked chick peas, rinse with cold water, and set aside.  Place the orange peel into a deep skillet, and add water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and then turn off the heat.  Place the orange peel into a cloth lined colander over the drained chick peas.  Place the soaked chick peas into a large container with a lid.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, drain the soaked chick peas, rinse, and set aside until the next day.  Place drained peas into a large pot, and cover with fresh water.  Bring the water to a boil, and then turn heat to low.  Simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.  The easiest way to test for doneness is to place a spoonful of split peas in the center of a square piece of aluminum foil.  If the peas show signs of resistance when a finger is inserted in the center, it's ready.  Serve hot.

title: Pasta & Coconut-Jelly Shots
ingredients: 8 ounces small shell pasta | 3 tablespoons crisco ( i've used all-butter ) | 6 -8 teaspoons wasabi | 1 1/2 cups desiccated coconut, divided | 8 small ladyfingers | 1 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Cook pasta according to the directions on package.  Meanwhile, melt 1 tablespoon crisco in a small skillet.  Cook 8 ladyfingers in hot crisco over medium heat until light golden, 3 - 5 minutes, turning once.  Drain & set aside.  Remove cooked pasta from refrigerator & set aside.  Add 2 tablespoons crisco to skillet with remaining crisco, wasabi, & 1/4 cup coconut, mixing well.  Dip warm pasta in coconut mixture, coating evenly.  Fill with hot, drained pasta mixture.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.

Random Ingredients: guinness stout,mustard powder,pork sparerib,philadelphia cream cheese,dark rum,cucumber,baby spinach leaf,flour tortilla
title: Creamy Sweet Mustard Pork and Spinach Wraps
ingredients: 1 package baby spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cucumber | 2 tablespoons guinness stout | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 teaspoons dark rum | 2 teaspoons unbleached flour | 8 low-fat pork spareribs | 4 large flour tortillas, warmed
instructions: Thoroughly mix together the mustard, guinness, rum and flour in a medium bowl with a wire whisk.  Add the spareribs, turning to coat.  Refrigerate for approximately 2 hours or preferably overnight.  Cook the pork until cooked as desired and then shred with two forks.  Reserve 1/2 cup of sauce.  Warm the tortillas in a skillet for 1 minute each side.  Spread a few tablespoons of the reserved cheese sauce on each warm tortilla, top with a tablespoon of the shredded pork, roll and serve accompanied by the remaining sauce.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: red chili pepper flake,chunky salsa,apricot jam,italian parsley,salad green
title: Mexican Salad
ingredients: 2 medium size lettuce leaves | 1 1/2 cups chunky salsa, prepared ( salsa verde or salsa verde ) | 2 tablespoons apricot jam | 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, minced
instructions: Tear lettuce into bite size pieces.  Pour about 1/3 cup of salsa into a shallow dish, and stir in jam, chili flakes and herbs.  Tear lettuce into bite size pieces, add to dish, and toss.  Serve on lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,bean,kaffir lime leaf,beef stew meat,sirloin beef
title: Quick Beef Pho
ingredients:
2 1/2 lbs pork stew meat ( or cut up ) or 2 1/2 lbs top round beef, cut into 1-in.
    - cubes | 1 can low sodium beef broth | 1 can fat-free refried beans | 10 slices kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce
instructions: Brown meat in a 12 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Spread beef over the bottom of the dish, and pour all remaining ingredients over the meat.  Cover the pan tightly with foil.  Bake in a preheated 375f degrees oven for 1 1/2 hours.  When done, remove foil.  Serve with rice.

Random Ingredients: taco shell,yeast,rose water,reynolds wrap foil,mexican cheese,apple,lard,chili oil
title: Yummy (And Easy!) Pizza - Apple Taco Filling!
ingredients: 3 lbs thinly sliced fresh apples | 1/2 cup chopped fresh mexican cheese | 1/3 cup lard, melted | 2 teaspoons dry yeast | 1 teaspoon chili oil | 3 lbs reynolds wrap foil | 1 can of mexican style taco shells, heated | 2 teaspoons rose water
instructions: Cut top off each mexican cheese slice and stuff the shell with cheese.  I like to top the cheese in the shape of an onion.  Place the stuffed mexican cheese slice over the cheese slice on your counter.  Dip the top or the bottom of the cheese in melted lard.  Then sprinkle yeast over them and a teaspoon of chili oil on the top of your mexican cheese slice.  Mix up the melted lard and mexican style taco filling and spread over the cheese.  Place into a 9x13 pan and top with the remaining taco filling and bake in a 250 degree oven for 90 minutes.  Let cool and enjoy makes great appetizer sized appetizer sized pizza.

title: Scallions and Apricots
ingredients: 1 boneless pork roast, cut into 2-inch strips | 1 cup dried apricot, halved | 5 scallions, chopped | 1/3 cup slivered, toasted almond | 1/3 cup low-sodium teabags
instructions: Heat oven to 325º.  Place all the ingredients in a bowl and toss together.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.  Bake, turning occasionally, in a preheated 350º oven for 3 1/2 to 4 hours or until cooked through.  Serve with couscous.

Random Ingredients: teriyaki sauce,gouda cheese,dill weed,cream mushroom soup,cilantro leaf,brown lentil
title: Easy Lentil Casserole
ingredients: 1 can low-fat cream of mushroom soup | 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 2 cans brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 1 cup finely shredded gouda cheese ( about 4 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Set oven to 400 degrees.  Grease an 8x8 inch glass baking dish.  In a bowl, combine soup, teriyaki sauce, and lentils.  Stir in the cheese, dill weed, and cilantro.  Transfer to the prepared baking dish and refrigerate at least 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until bubbly.  Serve with crackers or veggies.

title: Cheesy Easy Dip
ingredients: 16 ounces cream of chicken soup | 16 ounces rotel | 12 ounces refried beans sprouts | 1 teaspoon dried basil | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Meanwhile, mix the cream of chicken soup, rotel and basil together in a bowl.  Add the refried beans and mix well, or put the mixture in a crockpot to warm through.  Once warmed, stir in the cheese and pour onto your cooked rice or noodles and then top with salsa.

title: The Mango-Pepper Bread
ingredients: italian bread, cut crosswise in 3/4-inch slices | 1 cup potato flakes | 1/2 cup yellow sweet pepper, thinly sliced | 8 ounces mascarpone, at room temperature | 1 teaspoon mango powder
instructions: Preheat oven to in a small bowl, mash potato flakes with a fork.  In a medium bowl, combine sweet peppers and mascarpone.  Grease a baking sheet and arrange bread slices atop it.  Brush bread with a little water.  Sprinkle with mango powder.  Bake in the preheated oven for 7 minutes, or until bread just begins to crisp around the edges.  Serve at once.  Serve slices warm from the oven.

title: Chile Roast Legs (Bifes De Chile Rojas)
ingredients: 4 whole chicken legs | 1 cup unsweetened cocoa, dark chocolate, dutch-processed | 1 cup parmesan asiago and romano cheese blend, cheese blend | 1 chilies, julienned
instructions: Combine the cocoa, cheese, and chilies in a bowl and mix well.  Stir in the whole chicken legs, being careful not to dislodge the skin beneath the skin.  Rub the marinade all over the chicken legs.  Place legs tightly in the steamer, cover, and set over simmering water.  Cover and cook for 45 - 50 minutes, turning over once.

Random Ingredients: garlic powder,almond flour,epazote,rigatoni pasta,cinnamon sugar,salt pepper
title: Homemade Rigatoni Pasta in Almond-Honey Sauce
ingredients: 1 box rigatoni pasta | 1/2 cup almond flour | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 2 1/2 tablespoons salt, pepper, garlic powder, and cinnamon sugar | 1 teaspoon epazote ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons cinnamon sugar ( for dusting )
instructions: Pour 1 1/2 to 2 cups boiling water over pasta.  Add salt, pepper, adzote and cinnamon sugar in increments you can and combine thoroughly, stir and let sit, while preparing your sauce.  Place almonds and flour in a bowl and mix.  Add about a ½ cup of the cooking water to the bowl with the flour to make a ‘Dough’ texture.  Add this to the bowl with the almonds.  Add baking powder and mix until well blended.  Dip the rigatoni pasta into the almond flour mixture and let sit until all the pasta is covered with flour.  Then, toss the coated pasta into a frying pan and cook over high heat for 5 - 7 minutes.  If the pasta is dry, drain the rigatoni, return it to the pot, and toss with some butter, letting it sit and heat for another 2 minutes.  Once the pasta is well coated with the butter, add more or less of the cooking water to cover.  Scoop out a large serving from the frying pan, sprinkle lightly with cinnamon sugar, and serve with more cinnamon sugar if desired.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil,red bean,coconut milk,lemon zest,extra virgin olive oil,navy bean,marshmallow
title: Portuguese White Bean and Mmmm Rice Cake
ingredients:
1/3 cup vegetable oil | 1 cup shredded coconut ( about 12 oz.
    - ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1 can navy beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can small red beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons unsweetened coconut milk | 1 package miniature marshmallows
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a 2 - 3 qt.  Saucepan, heat the oil over medium high heat.  Add the coconut, lemon zest, navy beans and red beans.  Stir fry just until heated through.  Spread the marshmallows on a baking sheet and drizzle the warm bean mixture over them.  Bake, stirring once, for 8 - 10 minutes until marshmallows are crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: bouillon,spinach leaf,serrano chilies,orange bell pepper,orange liqueur,salmon,couscous,gruyere cheese
title: Bouillon With Orange and Smoked Salmon #5FIX
ingredients: 1 package spinach leaves, cleaned, dried and coarsely chopped | 1 large orange bell pepper, chopped | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur, preferably cointreau | 1/2 - 1 serrano chilies, with seeds ( optional ) or 1/2-1 cayenne pepper, to taste ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon instant chicken stock ( can use bouillon ) or 1 tablespoon vegetable stock ( can use bouillon ) | 3/4 cup couscous | 3 -8 ounces smoked salmon, sliced | 2 tablespoons shredded gruyere cheese or 2 tablespoons emmenthaler cheese ( or cheddar, may sub other kinds of cheese )
instructions: Preheat oven 350 degrees.  Place spinach in a medium bowl and drizzle with orange liqueur.  Toss to distribute oil and vinegar.  Set aside for 10 - 15 minutes to wilt the spinach.

Random Ingredients: salt black pepper,sugar snap pea,chicken bouillon cube
title: Soy Snap Pea and Sugar Snap Peas in Microwave
ingredients: 2 cups sugar snap peas, ends trimmed | 4 chicken bouillon cubes ( i prefer knorr ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Microwave the snap peas on high for 3 minutes, remove, cut into quarters and place on a microwave safe dish, cover and cook on high for 3 minutes, remove and cut apart.  Bring water to a boil and remove pot from microwave.  Place the snap peas in a bowl with the remaining ingredients and water to cover and then pour into a microwave safe bowl with a lid.  Microvave on high for 2 minutes, then on high for 15 more minutes, remove and discard the lid.  Microwave on high for 15 more minutes, remove and stir to ensure that there are no strings of peas or juice remaining, serve.

title: Tampa Toast
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons seasoned stuffing, or more to taste | 1 slice fresh pineapple, chopped | 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish-seasoned stuffing, or to taste
instructions: Spread 1 tablespoon seasoned stuffing onto the half inch opening of a round, oval shaped glass baking dish.  Put 1 slice pineapple and 1 tablespoon horseradish seasoned stuffing into the center of stuffing.  Cover with remaining slice of pineapple and top with remaining 1 tablespoon prepared horseradish seasoned stuffing.

title: Crunchy Chicken Bites from KAF
ingredients: 1/4 cup oat bran | 2 teaspoons red pepper paste | 4 chicken tenders
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°c/325°f.  Put the oat bran and pepper paste in a small bowl.  Dip the chicken in the mixture one piece at a time then coat with the bran mixture.  Place on a greased baking tray with the seam on the sides.

Random Ingredients: creamy ramen noodle,yeast,cider vinegar,margarine,prosciutto,salt black pepper
title: Mama's Crunchy Ramen
ingredients: 4 ounces creamy ramen noodles or 4 ounces egg noodles | 1 tablespoon margarine or 1 tablespoon butter, melted | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/2 cup cream ( you may not use it all ) or 1/2 cup sour cream ( you may not use it all ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper | 1 slice prosciutto or 1 slice salami, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Heat a little water in a 1 quart pot and pour in the ramen noodles.  Break them apart, cover and set aside.  In a small bowl, melt the butter or margarine with the yeast in a small cup.  Add to the melted butter/margarine mixture along with the vinegar and cream.  Stir well and allow everything to bubble together.  Cover and set aside in a warm spot for 15 minutes.  Add pepper to taste.  Add more vinegar if you don't want the flavor of the ramen.  Drain the noodles of any excess liquid and divide among 4 serving bowls.  Divide the noodles among the serving bowls and top with chopped prosciutto, if desired.

title: Spaghetti With Mace and Pimenton (Stove Top)
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti | 2 pinches mace
instructions: Cook spaghetti to al dente according to package instructions.  Drain spaghetti and transfer it to a large serving platter.  Mace is optional but makes a great difference to the flavor.  Serve hot, on the side or cool completely and slice.

Random Ingredients: lemon extract,barbecue sauce,mustard powder,green bell pepper,margarine,onion salt,no boil lasagna noodle
title: BBQ-Vegetable Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package no-boil lasagna noodles | 1 teaspoon olive oil | 1 tablespoon mustard powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon extract | 1 small green bell pepper, seeded and finely diced | 1/2 cup margarine, softened | 1/2 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package directions, then rinse with cool water to cool.  Drain and set aside.  In a small bowl, stir together the olive oil, mustard powder and lemon extract until well blended.  Set aside.  In a medium saucepan over medium high heat, melt the margarine and mix in the barbecue sauce.  Add the ground mustard mixture.  Reduce heat to medium, stirring constantly until bubbly and bubbly.  Add the bell pepper and stir to combine.  Spread one third of the sauce mixture in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish.  Place a few noodles over the sauce, then top with one third of the vegetable mixture, and another third of the sauce and vegetables.  Repeat layers.  Finish with a final layer of noodles and sauce.  Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.

title: Sauce Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 400 g spaghetti squash | 1 cup barbecue sauce | soya sauce | your favourite hot sauce
instructions: Cook spaghetti squash for 40 - 50 minutes or until soft.  Slice into 1/2 inch slices.  Combine ingredients and bake uncovered at 220c for 25 minutes.  Serve with your favourite side dish.

Random Ingredients: ha avocadoes,golden syrup,mozzarella cheese,baking chocolate,grain rice,garlic,lettuce leaf,cranberry
title: Rice, Avocado and Chocolate-Rice Wraps
ingredients: 2 cups long grain rice | 2 heads lettuce leaves | 225 g grated mozzarella cheese ( store-bought, preferably low fat ) | 1/4 cup crushed dried cranberries | 2 avocadoes, ripe and chopped | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 teaspoon minced garlic | 2 tablespoons halved, thinly sliced fresh mozzarella cheese | 100 g roughly grated baking chocolate
instructions: First, make the rice.  Pour a steamer basket into a saucepan.  Cover and bring to the boil.  Cook rice in the steamer over boiling water until tender, about 15 minutes.  Turn rice down to low, and fluff with a fork.  Spread rice on a piece of plastic wrap.  Make the guacamole, put the first 4 ingredients in your food processor, and process until very smooth.  Mix through the dried cranberries, avocado, golden syrup and garlic.  Spread half the cheese on each lettuce leaf, and roll up tightly and secure with stringy toothpicks.  Serve rolled, topped with extra cheese, and drizzle with remaining syrup, to taste.

title: Tiny Spud
ingredients: 2 cans shredded cabbage ( packed ) | 1 package refrigerated pizza crust | 1 jar salsa | 1 can refrigerated pre-made taco-size prawns ( in olive oil, no heads ) or ( 5 ounce ) can shrimp ( 1/4-1/2 ounce ) | 1 apple, peeled & diced ( optional ) | 1/3 cup dried pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Divide cabbage among the 2 pizza crusts, spreading evenly.  Heat salsa in a small saucepot over low heat.  Divide prawns among crusts, spreading evenly.  Distribute evenly among crusts.  Sprinkle with pecans.  Cover with pizza crusts and press down.  Cut into four long strips, place on a cookie sheet, & bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

title: Mixed Vegetable Medley
ingredients: 1 can enchilada sauce ( velveta ) | 1 1/2 cups orzo, cooked | 1/4 cup chopped onion | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1 cup frozen broccoli | 1 cup cauliflower floret, sliced | 4 ounces orzo, cooked
instructions: Combine enchilada sauce, orzo, onion, cayenne pepper, and broccoli and cauliflower in a slow cooker.  Cook on low setting for 8 hours.

title: Easy Pea and Onion Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 package frozen green peas, thawed | 1 package dry onion soup mix | 2 tablespoons chili powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Stir green peas and onion soup mix together in a microwave safe bowl.  Sprinkle chili powder over the top.

title: Easy Blueberry Romano
ingredients: 1 lb fresh blueberries | 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese
instructions: Put all ingredients into a bowl with a lid or strainer in it.  Let it stand for 3 hours or longer, stirring carefully every so often.  Just mix until the romano is smooth and has the consistency of a sweet toothpaste.

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Grape Tomatoes and Musrooms
ingredients: 1 medium grape tomatoes, halved | 1/2 cup toasted cashew nuts ( optional ) | 1/2 cup toasted pineapples in light syrup | 8 ounces prosciutto ( or ham bacon ) | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Wrap the tomatoes, nuts, bacon and pineapple in heavy duty foil.  Secure ends to form a pouch of string.  To make the sauce, combine the wine and half and half in heavy nonreactive saucepan and bring to rolling boil over high heat.  Pour into tomato and bake 20 - 25 minutes, or until reduced by half.  Add water and simmer 2 minutes.  Remove foil, arrange tomato and sauce on serving platter.

Random Ingredients: cumin,cooking oil,chili powder,spice,pecorino romano cheese,french dressing,basil leaf
title: French Dressing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1/2 teaspoon basil leaves | 1/2 cup crumbled pecorino romano cheese | 1/4 cup french dressing
instructions: Whisk first 4 ingredients together and pour over dressing.  Add pecorino and toss well.  Chill before serving.  Best made the night before and the next day.

Random Ingredients: russet potato,palm sugar,prawn,vegetable stock,asiago cheese,arborio rice,onion,apple cider vinegar
title: Prawns With Asian Cheese
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg prawns, tails intact | 450 ml vegetable stock | 1 apple cider vinegar | 100 g grated asiago cheese | 500 g russet potatoes | 100 g grated russet potatoes | 80 g grated palm sugar | 1 tablespoon finely chopped onion
instructions: Rinse and remove the heads from the prawns, removing any muscle and the eyes.  Using the back of a knife, remove the meat from shells, removing any large shells.  Cut the meat into short, thin strips.  Place the stock in a pan in a large enough shape so that you have just enough space at the top of the dish to cover the prawns, adding about 1 tablespoon of the liquid.  Stir.  Add the prawns and stir to coat in the juices.  Bring to the boil, then simmer over gentle heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, make the potato chipoltes, place the potato in a pan of boiling water.  Drain, then peel and cut into rounds.  Place the potatoes in a large bowl, add the sugar and mix lightly, then add the onion and stir.  Add the prawns and stir to coat in the spice.  Season with salt and pepper.  Set aside for 25 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the pasta until al dente.  Drain.  Cut the meat into thin strips and reserve.  Add the oil to the pan that had been heated, add half the prawns, then brown them quickly, turning once.  Add the potato chipsoltes and stir.  Pour the stock into the pan, and bring to the boil.  Simmer for 2 minutes.  Gently stir in the cheese, then remove from heat.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Cheese Sauce
ingredients: 1 can soy milk | 1/4 cup red chili, chopped | 1/4 cup dried soymilk
instructions: Place the soy milk and chilli in a saucepan and heat until boiling.  Lower the mixture into a small ball that just lightly sticks to the side of the saucepan, and stir in the soymilk.  Continue to cook, stirring constantly until the mixture is thick and creamy but leaving a light, even coating of sauce on the surface of the sauce.  Add more soy milk if it's too thick before the sauce is finished cooking.

Random Ingredients: red pepper,chili oil,green enchilada sauce,buffalo mozzarella,turnip,pistachio,nonstick cooking spray
title: Mozzarella and Turnip Enchiladas
ingredients: 6 turnips, peeled and cut into chunks | 2 green enchilada sauce | 12 ounces roasted red peppers, drained and chopped | 12 ounces buffalo mozzarella, shredded | 1/4 cup chopped pistachios or 1/4 cup other nuts | 2 tablespoons chili oil | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Spray 3 quart baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil.  While water is heating, toss turnip chunks with red peppers in hot water.  Let sit for 20 minutes, drain and remove skin and seeds from turnip pieces.  Toss turnip with enchilada sauce, roasted red peppers, cheese, pistachios and chili oil.  Pour into baking dish.  Cover tightly and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until turnip is done.  Let set for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

title: Soup Stiles
ingredients: 1 green curry paste | 4 button mushrooms | 500 g scallops | 1 mango
instructions: Cut the mango into squares and scoop out the flesh.  Cut the carrot into thin strips.  Slice the mushroom caps into thick strips.  Cut the mushrooms into very long strips.  Slice the mango into cubes.  Use a mortar & pestle or sharp knife to mash the curry paste into the mango flesh and mix well.  Put all of these into the soup stiles and cook for 4 - 5 minutes.  Serve immediately.

title: Lunching Rookworst With Peanut Butter and Ancho Chiles

instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.  Slowly stir in the red wine and stir in the stir fry sauce until the cheese is melted.  Transfer the mixture to a fondue pot.  Serve hot, warm, warm, or room temperature.

title: Mexican Rigatoni and Poblanos

instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place potato slices on a foil lined baking sheet.  Broil 3 to 5 inches from heat, turning once, 3 to 5 minutes or until evenly browned. title: Jalisco Onion and Apricot Salad

instructions: Place the jalapeños in a large nonstick skillet, sprinkle with salt, and cook over medium heat, turning frequently, until barely tender and beginning to brown, 10 to 15 minutes.  Transfer to paper towels.  Wrap each jalapeño tightly with a slice of onion.

title: Spiced Pickled Herbs

instructions: Pour all the ingredients into a pan over very gentle heat.  Stir vigorously until the herbs are softened.  Keep stirring until the liquid has reduced by a third to almost a third.  Chill for about 2 hours or until it is ready to use.

title: Ginger Beer
ingredients: 1 cup club soda | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 quart ice
instructions: In a tall glass pour club soda and ginger garlic paste.  Pour ice then top with club soda.  Mix and serve.

Random Ingredients: beef bouillon granule,vegetable bouillon cube,apricot preserve,rice noodle,chili bean,harissa
title: Noodles with Diced Beef & Apricot Sauce
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rice noodles | 1 cup apricot preserves | 4 cups beef bouillon granules | 3 tablespoons harissa or 3 tablespoons paprika | 2 vegetable bouillon cubes, plus extra for serving | 2 cups chili beans
instructions: Remove the rissole from the refrigerator for 30 minutes, then rinse under hot water and drain well.  Heat 2 - 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil in a small pan over high heat and sauté rice noodles until golden brown and translucent, 4 - 5 minutes.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, in another small frying pan, toast the sautéed rice noodles in hot oil for 1 - 2 minutes, or until crispy brown, taking care they do not burn.  Remove the pan from the heat and allow to cool for at least 5 minutes.  Stir the apricot preserves into the rice noodles and set aside.  Meanwhile, in a small heated saucepan, heat the beef bouillon cubes over high heat and bring to a boil.  Add the chili beans and stir for 1 - 2 minutes or until the beans can be stirred.  Take the pan off the heat and place it over low heat.  Add the cooled rice noodles and stir well to mix.  Serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Chilies
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa | 4 -6 dried red chilies
instructions: Pour 1 tbsp of the cocoa onto your wooden rolling pin.  Slice off all the stems, and cut the chilies into thin slices and discard the seeds and membrane.  Place the sliced chili slices in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade.  Add the rest of the cocoa the process on the steel blade and process until a smooth paste forms.  Spread the paste onto waxed paper and chill for 5 minutes.  Cut into squares and chill for another 5 - 6 hours.

title: Pepperoni Wraps
ingredients: 4 slices pepperoni | lettuce leaf, to serve
instructions: Place 4 slices of pepperoni and 1/4 cup of lettuce on each tortilla and roll up tightly.

title: Beef Tongue Tacos
ingredients: 1 -2 beef tongues | 2 tablespoons butter | 1 pinch thyme | 1 pinch msg | 1 cup coconut creamed coconut | 1 cup coconut cream | 1 lime | 1/2 lime ( to squeeze from lime )
instructions: Trim tongues to about 1/8 of the width.  Place in pot, cover with water and medium heat.  Cook over medium low head until tender about 45 - 60 minutes.  Once tender enough remove the skin.  Take off tongue from skin and set aside until cool enough to handle.  You can use your fingers to pull away any remaining blood, but be careful to separate them.  Discard tongues.  Cut tongue in half and remove any thick bones if desired.  Add butter and creamed coconut until melted and then stir in meat.  In another bowl mix coconut cream, lime juice and msg and add to pot.  Slice tongue into 1 1/2 thick slices and add to the pot.  Add in the coconut creamed coconut at this time to the pot.  Taste and add more coconut creamed coconut if needed.  It should have some sourness to it.  The flavor should be mild enough but not overpowering.  Enjoy with your favorite toppings and salad.

title: Bread and Beef Sausages
ingredients: 2 lbs extra lean ground beef | 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed | 8 slices french bread | 12 ounces beer
instructions: In frying pan, brown ground beef and caraway until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,cannellini bean,nonstick cooking spray,american cheese,peel
title: Sizzlin' White American Noodle Bake
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1 can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained | 1 tablespoon peel, grated | 1/2 cup cooked rice noodles ( wide noodles like linguine ) | 6 slices american cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray 4 round loaf pans with non stick cooking spray.  Set aside.  Combine beans, grated peel and noodles in a large bowl or casserole.  Top with 1/2 of the american slices and some of the cheese.  Cut remaining slices in half and place on top.  Cover with foil and bake 40 minutes.  Serve.

title: Baked Shrimp Brioche
ingredients: 1 phyllo dough | 8 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined | 15 large shrimp - peeled, deveined and cut in half | 1 teaspoon instant yeast | 8 ounces quark, room temperature | 2 cups plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish.  Place the phyllo dough into the baking dish over a bowl of lightly greaseed rice or buttermilk.  Cover and allow to rise in a warm place until phyllo dough becomes puffy and beginning to bind together.  This may take up to two hours.  Meanwhile, sprinkle the shrimp with a little salt and set aside.  Place 1 shrimp and 1 shrimp half in a small bowl, and add the shrimp to the buttermilk and stir until shrimp are evenly distributed.  Remove shrimp from buttermilk and reserve.  Place 1/2 teaspoon yeast in a small bowl, and sprinkle over the hot buttermilk.  Stir until dissolved and then quickly stir in the yogurt until fully incorporated.  Place dough in the buttered bowl and cover with a cloth.  Allow to double in size.  This helps the dough rest and becomes stringy.  Uncover the dough and punch down, and place on a lightly oiled clean work surface.  With your hands, punch down the dough to remove excess air and make sure it isn't sticking to your hands.  On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough out to about 1/4 inch thick.  With a 3 inch biscuit cutter, cut circles of dough into triangles.  Place half the triangle in the bottom of the loaf.  Brush the shrimp mixture over the triangles, and then fold in the next half of the triangle over the shrimp and bread mixture and smooth out the top.  The dough should be almost covered.  Cover the loaf and rest in a warm place for about 30 minutes.  Place the baking dish on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes, or until dough is golden brown and bubbly.  Cut the brioche into 4 servings.  Make ahead, brioche can be frozen for up to 4 days.

title: Homemade Pizza
ingredients: 2 packages dry yeast | 1 cup water | 1 lb sweet italian sausage, casing removed | 1 lb mozzarella ball | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1/3 cup dried chives | 2 large orange peels, cut into large chunks | 1 large serrano pepper, sliced thin, for garnish
instructions: Dissolve yeast and ½ cup water in ½ inch of hot water.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Combine sausage, mozzarella cheese, currants, chives, orange peel, and serrano peppers in large mixing bowl.  Pour yeast mixture over top.  Beat until smooth.  Cover with plastic wrap.

title: Polenta Bread
ingredients: 3 slices bacon, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon vegetable oil | 2 cups polenta | 2 cups mixed vegetables, diced
instructions: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet.  Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown, and crisp, about 10 minutes, breaking it into bits with a spatula.  Drain bacon on a paper towel lined plate.

Random Ingredients: white,italian herb,water,hazelnut,dark sesame oil,sage leaf,vegetable stock,egg yolk
title: Roasted Sage and Hazelnut Soup (Sagna Bittman)
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable stock | 1 bunch fresh sage leaves | 3 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup dried italian herbs | 2 tablespoons finely chopped hazelnuts | 3/4 cup dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup water | 1 cup finely chopped white sweet potato
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the large soup kettle or soup pot over medium high heat.  Add the sage and herbs and saute over medium low heat for 10 minutes.  Add the egg yolks and whisk together using a rubber spatula.  When all the ingredients are incorporated, reduce the heat to low.  Scatter the hazelnuts into the mixture and cook, moving the sage and herbs through the mixture a few times, stirring constantly, for 4 minutes more.  Pour in the water, reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer, stirring from time to time, for 20 to 30 minutes or until the mixture is very thick.  Add the sweet potato and season with salt and pepper.  Serve the soup hot.

title: Karyn's Mediterranean Style Calamari
ingredients: 25 large squid, cleaned and scaled | 2 cans cream of chicken soup | 12 slices of stale bread flour ( like greek ) or 12 slices regular bread flour ( like greek ) | 2 cups grated romano cheese | 1 large yellow pepper, diced | 1 medium yellow squash, diced | 1 small small radicchio, diced small ( optional ) | 1/2 cup shredded coconut or 1/2 cup shaved coconut, toasted ( optional )

title: Polenta Apples

instructions: In a medium skillet, heat 1 tbsp of the oil over a medium heat.  Cook apple slices until lightly charred on all sides, turning often.  Remove from skillet and let set aside. Remove from the heat, sprinkle with parsley, clove, and cardamom and serve.  Note if your polenta is to thick, add a little water or another 1 tbsp of oil, if it needs to thin, add a little of the hot water.  Adding water only makes a difference.

title: Jamaican Fried Rice

instructions: Mix the dry ingredients.  Toss with the rice.  Heat oil in pan until hot.  Sprinkle with paprika, add fried rice and stir fry until light brown.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Remove meat from bones.  Place the broccoli, lobster, radishes, green chili and cumin powder in a bowl.  Add yogurt and chili sauce.

title: Simple Pizza

instructions: Place the cheese in a medium bowl and add the yeast.  Add the chili sauce to your taste.  Knead the dough in the bowl until the dough gets to a soft ball stage. title: Breading, Okra Oven Breakfast

instructions: Preheat oven to 200c/gas lightly grease an oven proof non stick cake tin with a little more bicarbonate of soda before adding bread cubes. Bake in the oven for 30 - 45 mins or until topping is golden brown and crisp and crisp.

title: Pecan Penne Pizza

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Spread the pizza crust with prawns in a circle.  Arrange the penne in a single layer over the prawns.  Sprinkle chopped pecans on top.  Bake the pizza for 10 mins or until crust is golden.

title: Smoked Salmon and Raspberry Bean Soup

instructions: In a medium sauce pan over medium heat, add all ingredients, except the fish and cook for 15 minutes on low heat.  If not using all of the ingredients just add the milk now. Heat 1/2 jar of pesto sauce in a 2 quart pot, stirring occasionally.  Set aside.  When the sauce is done, add the cream of chicken soup, and spread evenly in the bottom of a small serving bowl.  Set aside.  Heat the remaining jar of pesto sauce in pot, stirring occasionally, until warm, but not boiling.  Add the black cardamom pods and the coriander seeds.  Remove seeds from pods, and mash the pods to break them up a bit.  Stir into mixture and warm thoroughly.  Spread on top of the hot polish sausage mixture, and sprinkle with bacon.

title: Nogales With Tahini Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/3 cup finely chopped green chili | 1/2 head lettuce, outer leaves discarded, leaves coarsely chopped
instructions: Place a small plate on top of each head of lettuce so that it rests flat.  Drizzle the tahini onto the lettuce.  Sprinkle with the chili and garnish with a few sprigs of green onion.

title: Pecorino, Pecorino, & Pecorino Cheese
ingredients: 1 lb pecorino romano cheese, grated | 2 -3 cups sweet chili sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.  Stir.  Pour into a shallow bowl.

title: Lemon Garlic Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup panko breadcrumbs ( bread crumbs ) | 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix panko, lemon zest, and garlic powder together.  With a pastry brush or your fingers, gently rub panko mixture into cheese to form a patty shape.  Bake 20 to 30 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

Random Ingredients: dark beer,poppy seed,milk chocolate,pesto sauce,onion powder,yellow onion
title: Passion Carpaccio - Parma Fritter
ingredients: 8 ounces milk chocolate, melted | 1 medium yellow onion, medium, chopped finely | 1/3 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1 cup dark beer | 1 dash poppy seed
instructions: Pour melted chocolate in a large bowl, add chopped onion.

title: Chicken and Couscous
ingredients: 2 cups dried couscous | 1 lb chicken breast, boneless and skinless ( about 1 pound )
instructions: Place 1/2 cup of couscous and 2 cups water in a 2 cup glass baking dish.  Cover and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is tender, about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, spread remaining couscous in a 12 inch nonstick skillet and rub top with a paper towel to remove as much excess moisture as possible.  Fluff up chicken with a fork and season with salt and pepper.  Stir couscous and 2/3 cup of water in pan with meat.  Cover and cook over low heat until chicken is heated through and water is absorbed, about 5 minutes.

title: Berry Salad With Flowers
ingredients: 1 kg berry | 3 spring onions, chopped or 3 bunches scallions, finely chopped | 100 300 g cherries or 100 300 g raspberries ( 4 to 6 ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons dressing
instructions: Place the berry in a large bowl and add the spring onions or scallions, crème fraîche or other tasty cheese.  Crush the cherries or raspberries and add now.  Add the dressing to taste.  Cover and leave in the fridge to chill.  When ready to serve, make sure the dressing is just right with your tasting buds and if it's not, then don't take off the lid too soon or they'll become soggy.

title: Sweet Spaghetti Chips
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb spaghetti | 1 baking potato, peeled and cut to desired size
instructions: Preheat oven to 425f.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add salt.  Add the spaghetti to the boiling water and cook until al dente, about 7 minutes.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,chicken breast half,rosemary sprig,fish sauce,turmeric,shrimp
title: Island Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pure maple syrup | 2 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons minced fresh rosemary sprigs | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, pounded to 1/2 inch thickness | 1 pound medium shrimp, shelled and deveined
instructions: In a skillet, combine maple syrup, fish sauce, rosemary, and turmeric.  Gradually mix in the chicken breasts, coating evenly.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Prepare an outdoor grill for high heat, and lightly oil the grate.  Grill chicken until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.

title: Chili Rellenos
ingredients: 1 can dry breadcrumbs | 1 teaspoon finely chopped red chile
instructions: Mix together all ingredients.

Random Ingredients: dark sesame oil,macaroni,black olive,black tea,vegetable oil,pepper,clove
title: Spiced Macaroni Salad
ingredients: 3 cups cooked macaroni | 1 3/4 cups mixed greens ( such as arugula, green salad leaves, spinach and red endive ) | 1 cup black olives, thinly sliced | 2 tablespoons vegetable oil | 3/4 1/4 cup dark sesame oil or 3/4 cup light olive oil ( to taste ) | 8 whole cloves ( to taste ) | fresh ground pepper ( to taste )
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions and drain.  Combine vegetables and macaroni in large bowl.  Add salad dressing and mix well.  Season with salt and fresh ground pepper to taste.  Serve in small tupperware containers in a decorative manner.

title: Pesto
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups pesto ( from basil of your garden ) | 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese | 4 cardamom pods, bruised with a mallet ( or 12 smaller ones if desired )
instructions: Boil pesto with cardamom pods, stirring frequently for approx 2 minutes.  Strain pesto and discard cardamom pods.  Stir in cheese and pour into serving bowl.  Chill several hours or over night and enjoy.

title: Chilli Bellies
ingredients: 7 pieces fresh shortcrust pastry | 1 small fresh green chili pepper, sliced
instructions: Place two pieces of shortcrust pastry on to a greased tray which has been greased and floured and cut into two unequal squares.  Spoon the chilli pepper slices in the middle of each square.  Roll out the remaining square and arrange the two portions on the bottom of the pastry.  Fold the pastry over leaving the chilli inside the pastry which should be about 3/4 inch deep.  Seal the edge and bake on low heat in a very hot oven 220°c/425°f/ gas mark 7 for about 15 minutes.  Cool on a cake rack and cut into 12 slices.  Variation, after scoring each pastry sandwich with a star shaped cookie cutter, slice the pastry twice, then fill the centre with red food coloring, such as jelly or essence.

title: Wontons
ingredients: 1 lb oyster, drained | 1 package wonton skins | oyster sauce, to taste
instructions: Cook oysters in boiling water until cooked through, about 5 minutes, depending on how soft the yolks are.  Using a slotted spoon, drain oysters, then remove meat from shells.  Chop roughly.  Spread a small amount of oyster sauce on each wonton wrapper, leaving about 1/2 inch of wonton wrappers attached at each end.  Place a few slices of meat at one end of the wrapper and fold over to form triangle.  Press edges together to seal.  Refrigerate until you want to serve them.  To reheat, steam on medium low heat for 10 minutes, until hot.  Use as your sauces.

title: Basic Broth
ingredients: 6 cups chicken stock | 8 saffron threads | 6 ounces dried bamboo shoots, soaked in water for 20 minutes
instructions: Place the chicken stock in a large saucepan and add the saffron.

title: Tomato and Grape Tomatoes Crush Crush
ingredients: 3 -4 pints grape tomatoes, halved | 1 1/2 cups ice | 1 cup dark soy sauce | 1 cup crushed ice, for scooping into serving dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Scatter tomatoes in a ovenproof plate with some ice and top with some crushed ice.  Drizzle over a little dark soy sauce or fresh cracked black pepper.

Random Ingredients: pork butt,ginger garlic paste,oil,cumin seed,sherry wine,onion
title: Chinese Roasted Pork  Loin - Tyler Florence
ingredients: 3 pounds pork butt | sherry wine | 1/2 cup chopped onion | 1 small onion, chopped | 1 tablespoon cumin seeds | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Trim the fat from the pork.  If necessary, cut into 3 to 4 wide strips.  Rinse and pat dry.  Place in a large, heavy or enameled roasting pan.  Add 1 cup water, enough to cover, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until tender, approximately 2½ hours, brushing frequently with more water.  Meanwhile, to brown the onions and onions, saute the 1 small chopped onion with 1 teaspoon finely chopped ginger garlic paste and 1 teaspoon cumin seed until golden brown, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  When cool enough to handle, slice off the root end of the pork and discard.  With a sharp knife, cut the skin from the pork with a sharp, flexible knife.  Make diagonal cuts, across the meat, across each slice.  Cut through the top layer of fat, making a pocket or opening.  Add a tablespoon of olive oil and about 2 cups of water to the pan, and bring to a boil, scraping any browned material from the pan.  Simmer uncovered until pork is tender, about 1½ hours.  Baste occasionally with pan drippings.  Remove meat and onions from pan and discard solids and juices.  Let stand for 15 minutes, then carve into desired serving size.  Pour reserved pan juices back into pan.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Mix remaining 1 tablespoon ginger garlic paste and 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds with the drippings that have formed in the pan juices into a dark syrup.  Spoon over the meat and onions.  Bake in preheated oven until heated through, about 30 minutes.

title: Lamb Cutlets With Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 3 1/2 ounces lean lamb cutlets, thickly sliced | 2 tablespoons fresh dill, chopped | 1/4 cup broccoli floret, chopped | 1 cup red seedless grapes, halved | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Combine lamb, dill, and broccoli in a small bowl.  Sprinkle grapes with cornstarch.  Heat large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium high heat.  Add half of lamb mixture.  Cook 3 - 4 minutes or until top is dry.

title: Grilled Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 12 eggs | 4 tablespoons drained capers | 1 fresh red chile pepper, chopped
instructions: Place eggs in a saucepan in a single layer and fill with 2 inches of cold water.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to low.  Cook, covered, 10 minutes.  Drain.  Cool completely and shell.  Halve eggs lengthwise.  Remove yolks and arrange yolks on a plate.  Sprinkle the capers on top of the yolks followed by chile.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: nori,wine vinegar,chicken soup base,monterey jack cheese
title: Cheesy Vinegar Chicken Rolls
ingredients: 4 pieces nori ( dry seaweed ) | 1 1 tablespoon chicken soup base ( use only half ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 2 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees f.  Cut the nori sheets in half lengthwise, then place lengthwise, shiny side down on paper towels.  Lightly brush each piece of nori with some of the soup base.  Lay the sheets lengthwise on counter, with the shiny side of the nori toward the center, and then use two fingers to lightly but thoroughly pat the sheets together so they resemble 'pita breadsticks.  Bring each side of the nori with the soup base to a second side of the nori sheets, and transfer them to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake for about 12 minutes in the preheated oven, until the tops are golden.

title: German Beef and Barley (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs stew meat | 2 -4 cups pearl barley | 1/4 cup dry vermouth or 1/4 cup dry white wine | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar
instructions: Spray crock pot with cooking spray.  Toss meat in crock pot with 2 cans of barley, white wine, or cider vinegar.  Cook on high 4 - 5 hours.

Random Ingredients: orange flower water,cream mushroom soup,cream corn,vegetable oil,cucumber,sage,broccoli carrot cauliflower mix,green cabbage
title: Vegetables in Mushroom and Vegetable Juice
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 can cream-style corn | 1 cup broccoli carrots cauliflower mix | 1 cup green cabbage, chopped in large pieces | 1/2 cucumber, peeled, deseeded and chopped | 1 teaspoon orange flower water, optional ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage
instructions: Saute broccoli, bell pepper, carrots, cabbage, and spices in oil in a heavy 4 to 6 quart pot over high heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until crisp and tender stir in cream corn or mushroom soup until blended then serve.

title: Ancho-Belt Wheat
ingredients: 1 cup bulgar wheat | 1 1/2 cups unsweetened pineapple juice | 2 teaspoons ground ancho chile powder
instructions: Place bulgur wheat in a large bowl and pour boiling water over the wheat.  Stir and cover bowl with a cloth or towel.  Set aside to soak, about 20 minutes.  Prepare pineapple syrup by heating a small saucepan over medium heat.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,cayenne pepper,flour,rotini pasta,chicken broth
title: Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 2 packages refrigerated rotini pasta or ( 16 ounce ) packages penne pasta | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth or 1 1/2 cups homemade chicken broth | 3 cups refrigerated crumbs ( about 10 ounces ) | 1 cup flour | 1 dash cayenne pepper
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.

title: Kebabs (Beef Kabobs)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef stew meat | 1/3 cup sweet paprika | fresh cashews, for garnish
instructions: Place the meat, paprika and cashews in a large bowl.  Pour the marinade over the meat and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight.  Thread the meat onto skewers.  Grill over boiling hot coals on a medium heat, basting every 3 minutes, for 8 - 10 minutes or until cooked to your liking.

title: Herbal Glaze Soy Balls
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups japanese soy sauce ( i love soy sauce, but any type will do ) | fresh herbs ( optional )
instructions: If you're concerned that your soy sauce has been absorbed by your herbs, soak them first in warm water, then drain and put them on a towel.  I don't use any fresh herbs that we're afraid.  Add in your herb or soy sauce.  Form into small balls.  Add to a pan of slightly salted water, stir and let them cook for about 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Caribbean Nuts
ingredients: 1 lb stew meat | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon curry powder | 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds
instructions: Brown stew meat in a skillet with curry powder and pomegranate seeds until meat is browned.  Add the drained bean juice.  Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours.

title: Oven-Baked Potatoes & Fresh Herbs Appetizer
ingredients: 2 lbs tiny new potatoes | 10 tablespoons mint leaves, chopped | 4 teaspoons fresh tarragon vinegar | 1/2 cup crouton, coarsely crumbled
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper, or drizzle with cooking spray.  Wash and dry the potatoes thoroughly and place in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a 1/2 inch steady blade chop until thoroughly smooth.  Stir in the mint leaves, vinegar and tarragon and process until combined, stopping a few times to scrape down the sides.  Spread half of the croutons evenly on the parchment or baking sheet.  Scatter half the herb mixture over the croutons.  Repeat with remaining croutons and herb mixture.  Place potatoes on top and sprinkle over salt and pepper to taste.  Bake until potatoes are tender when pierced, 45 to 55 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Bacon Gravy
ingredients: 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 1/2 cup finely chopped cooked bacon ( or 2 tablespoons finely chopped cooked turkey ) | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Melt bacon fat over low heat but do not let it smoke.  Add bacon and cook a few minutes until crispy and dry.  Season with salt & pepper.  If using turkey, add now & cook in bacon fat over medium heat, stirring constantly until nicely browned.

title: Pink Grapefruit Gravy
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups pink grapefruit juice | 1/2 cup plain flour | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Simmer juice in a saucepan, stirring.  In a bowl, stir flour on low heat until warm and pale, about 2 minutes.  Slowly blend warm juice through flour.  Add rum and whisk until well combined.  Adjust seasoning.  Serve over cooked noodles or with vegetables.

Random Ingredients: serrano chile pepper,taco seasoning,malt vinegar,english mustard
title: The Tornado
ingredients: 1 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup sweet english mustard | 2 serrano chile peppers, finely chopped | 1 packet taco seasoning, such as mccormick's | 1 - 1 1/2 teaspoon prepared dry english-style mustard
instructions: Place vinegar and remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl, and stir well to combine.  Adjust seasoning by adding more mustard for a creamier mixture, or more salt.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally.  Note, the Tornado is best when served with tomatoes and lettuce.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,extra wide egg noodle,artichoke heart,onion soup mix,pimiento,taco,tortilla
title: Artichoke Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 package extra wide egg noodles | 1 package onion soup mix | 3 containers refrigerated artichoke hearts | 6 ounces sliced pimientos | 1/2 cup white onions | 8 medium tortillas or 8 large flour tortillas, cut into 1/2-inch-1/2-inch slices
instructions: Cook and drain noodles according to package directions, adding sour cream and butter in the last minute of cooking.

Random Ingredients: chorizo sausage,cottage cheese,beef stew meat,espresso,orange marmalade,strawberry gelatin,mix,white cake mix
title: Tiramisu Cupcakes with Chorizo and Strawberry Jello Swirl
ingredients: 1 package white cake mix | 1 package instant chocolate-strawberry gelatin | 2 pounds cooked beef stew meat, thinly sliced | 8 ounces chorizo sausage, casings removed | 2 packages frozen whipped topping mix | 1/2 can espresso | 2 tablespoons orange-flavored marmalade | 1/2 cup brewed espresso powder | 1 pint fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease muffin cups lightly.  To make cupcakes, using the package of white cake mix, pour the cake mix into a mixing bowl.  Using a wooden spoon, mix in the chocolate and chorizo until melted and all ingredients are evenly distributed.  Set aside.  Prepare the espresso bar using an instant espresso powder and a 1/2 cup warmed espresso.  Pour the bar into 3 shot glasses.  Fill a bowl with cold water, and stir a portion of the whipped topping mix onto the espresso bar to soften.  Fill a small bowl with ice water, and stir about 1/4 of the cooled cupcake mixture into the frosting, and set aside.  Cover the bottom of a muffin cupcake mold with the remaining frosting, and carefully start making the cupcakes.  Place the cupcakes on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until set, 15 to 20 minutes.  Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes, and then run a knife around the edge of the cupcake with a toothpick to loosen the sides.  Run a long knife around the edge of each cupcake hole, and carefully remove the muffin cups.  Cool completely before topping up each cupcake cup with marmalade frosting.  Repeat this process with each cupcake, piling the frosting between the cupcakes.  Spread a half cup of the strawberries and the remaining whipped topping on the top of each cupcake, and then top each with remaining strawberries.  Chill the filled cupcakes in the refrigerator at least 6 hours before serving.

title: Sambot Chili from Quickcookers
ingredients: 1 ounce kidney bean ( soaked overnight or dried ) | 1 egg yolk | 3/4 ounce green beans ( cooked ) | ketjap manis ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Cover and refrigerate for at least half an hour prior to serving.  Serve chilled over cooked white rice.

title: Black Eyed Peas and Crawfish Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh cranberries | 5 medium black-eyed peas, washed, drained, and chopped into halves | 1 can diced green chili peppers | 1/4 cup caramel sundae syrup | 1 tablespoon ginger powder ( bottled or bottled ) | 1 teaspoon white pepper | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, finely minced | 1 teaspoon fresh gingerroot, finely minced | 1 teaspoon green chili pepper, finely minced ( green part only ) | 1 1/2 lbs crawfish tails, cooked, shelled and deveined
instructions: Rinse the cranberries and peas in cold water, drain.  Combine the drained, chopped black eyed peas, chile peppers, caramel sundae, ginger, pepper, ginger, and white pepper.  Mix well.  Add the minced fresh ginger and green chili and mix.  Add the crawfish tails.  Refrigerate several hours to allow flavors to develop.  Serve chilled.

Random Ingredients: dijon mustard,milk,miracle whip,chicken wing,tomato paste,apple cider vinegar,grape tomato,emeril essence
title: Baked Goose With Remaining Tomato and Aged Dijon Mayonnaise
ingredients: 32 lbs chicken wings or 32 lbs goose wings | 1 can tomato paste | 10 cups grape tomatoes, quartered lengthwise | 6 tablespoons dijon mustard | 2 tablespoons meril essence | 1 can evaporated milk or ( 18 ounce ) can cream of wheat | 4 teaspoons apple cider vinegar | 2 cups miracle whip
instructions: Directions, place whole chicken wings in a large 9x13x2 inch baking dish, skin side down, and cover with water.  Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer, cover and cook for about 45 minutes or until tender.  Remove from simmer and cool.  Place chicken wings and tomato paste in separate bowl and allow to sit while you prepare the canada sauce.  Heat remaining tomato ingredients in small saucepan over medium low heat until boiling.  Remove from heat and add evaporated milk or cream of wheat.  Remove chicken from pan and arrange in single layer on a large baking sheet.  Brush each piece of chicken with mustard and place under the broiler on both sides for 15 to 20 minutes or until cooked through, turning several times for even browning.  Remove from oven and sprinkle mustard evenly over the chicken.  Set aside.  Directions, spoon the tomato and aged dijon mayonnaise evenly over the chicken.  Reserve tomato and aged dijon mayonnaise.  Place remaining chicken wings and tomato paste in separate baking dishes and cover with water.  Bake at 400 degrees until tomatoes are starting to break down and wings are beginning to split.  Remove from heat and cool.  Place the tomatoes into the baking dishes, close the cover and bake in a 450 degree oven until chicken has cooked through.  About 45 minutes.  Remove cover and spread a dollop of miracle whip over top.  Serve with extra crushed new potatoes, salad or crisp, crusty crackers if desired.  Yields 24 servings.  Notes, mayonnaise can be substituted for the mayonnaise or served at room temperature.

title: Cousin Pete's Fried Green Beans
ingredients:
3 -4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 lb fresh green beans, washed and trimmed ( about 12 oz.
    - ) | 1 medium onion, finely chopped | 2/3 cup coarsely chopped fresh broccoli florets | 1/2 cup sliced ripe olives
instructions: In large frying pan, warm 1 tablespoon oil.  Add onions and stir over low heat until they are soft, about 8 minutes.  Add green beans and continue to stir.  Reduce heat to medium.  Cook 10 minutes or until the beans are just slightly cooked outside of the blade.  Add remaining two tablespoons oil, broccoli and remaining ingredients.

Random Ingredients: yukon gold potato,turbinado sugar,baking powder,asiago cheese,mesclun
title: Turbinado Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs yukon gold potatoes | 3 1/4 ounces asiago cheese | 1/8 cup turbinado sugar | 1 tablespoon baking powder | 32 -36 cups mesclun
instructions: Boil potatoes and peel while warm.  Drain potatoes, and mash them with the sugar, baking powder and cheese.  Add another 1/4 cup turbinado sugar, and beat in 1/2 cup asiago at low speed.  Drain potatoes and add in one cup of squash cooking water to moisten.  Spread potatoes in a greased casserole dish and bake 350 for 40 - 50 minutes until potatoes are golden brown.

Random Ingredients: plum tomato,rump steak,pizza crust,icing sugar,sun tomato oil,puff pastry,broth
title: Steak Rolls
ingredients: 1 tablespoon icing sugar | 1 1/2 lbs rump steak, cubed | 3 tablespoons sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained and chopped | 1/2 cup canned plum tomato, chopped | 1 cup pre-made pizza crust ( or ready made pizza crust and frozen ) | 1 package frozen puff pastry | 1 cup chicken stock or 1 cup canned broth
instructions: Make the crust by cooking the frozen puff pastry according to the instructions on the package, until the pastry is no longer shiny and has the texture of flour.  Meanwhile, put the broth into a saucepan and reduce until just simmering.  Put in the tomatoes and leave to cool completely.  Cut the steak into 1/4 inch cubes and add to the saucepan while the dough is still warm.  Stir in the sun dried tomatoes and allow everything to get some color and texture.  Put aside.  Preheat the oven to 400°f roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut into 3 - 4 circles.  Spoon the chicken mixture onto the center of the crust, then bring the edges together and crimp the edges with your fingers.  Place on a tray lined with cooking parchment paper or lightly oiled baking paper and bake for 10 - 15 minutes, until crust is golden brown.  Serve with a spoonful of warm tomato stock and a nice green salad.

title: Cabbage Rice and Arrabiis
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1 cabbage
instructions: Wash the cabbage, remove the outer green leaves.  Cut the core off.  Put the rice in a strainer.  Add a small amount of water or oil to rinse and drain the cabbage.  Boil the cabbage over medium heat in a pot until just slightly wilted.  Drain and set aside.  Put the cabbage into a mixing bowl.  Dressing, put the ingredients together and pour over the cabbage.  Toss until all ingredients are combined.

title: Anchovy on Nuts (Pete Brith)
ingredients: 5 cups ripe hulled salted peanuts | 3 teaspoons salt | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 6 -7 anchovy fillets
instructions: Drain the peanuts and, using the back of a spoon, make small holes in the peanuts, going down the sides a few times, until they are all in.  The more you crush the peanuts, the more each nut will smell.  Add all the salt, the baking powder, a couple of tablespoons of water, and mix together.  Turn out onto a platter and leave for 30 minutes at room temperature.

title: Pineapple and Shrimp Calzones
ingredients: 3/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 3/4 teaspoons fast rising yeast | 1/2 cup unsalted chicken stock or 1/2 cup canned broth | 1 cup raw shrimp | 2 teaspoons dry mustard
instructions: In bowl of mixer fitted with dough hook, whisk pineapple juice, yeast, stock and shrimp until smooth.  Beat in mustard.  Divide dough in half and roll out each half until 10 x 14 inches.  Transfer halves to ungreased 12 inch diameter nonstick cookie sheet sprinkled with cornmeal.  Cover with clean towel and let rise in a draft free place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour.  Preheat oven to 425°f.  Bake until golden brown and puffed, about 20 minutes.  Place on wire rack to cool 2 minutes.  Transfer to cutting board.

title: Spicy Alfredo Skillet Salad
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter lettuce leaves, softened | 1 red capsicum | 1 jar alfredo sauce
instructions: Heat the butter in a small pan on medium heat.  Halve the peppers, remove the seeds and finely dice them.  Stir in the salad and the alfredo sauce.  Cover to heat through, then remove from heat.

Random Ingredients: soya sauce,rice flour,salmon,red chilies,wild rice,rosemary,cooking apple
title: Seared Salmon and Apples
ingredients: 4 salmon, fillet | 4 teaspoons rice flour | 4 red chilies, sliced thinly | 4 slices cooking apples | 4 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon soya sauce
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c.  Place salmon on oven tray.  Combine chilli sauce ingredients and drizzle over fish.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily.

title: Smoked Beef and Pasta Soup for One
ingredients: 375 g smoked beef and steak prepared stuffing | 1/3 cup plain flour | 4 tablespoons good quality liquid smoke | 1 liter beef broth
instructions: Cook pasta for 10 minutes or according to instructions on packet.  In a large soup pan, combine the beef and beef broth, liquid smoke and flour and bring to the boil.  Simmer for approximately 15 minutes or until pasta has softened.  Stir in the smoked beef and serve.

title: Crabmeat Stock
ingredients: 4 cups fresh cooked crabmeat | 10 basil leaves, chopped
instructions: Place crabmeat into 8 cups or 6 ramekin dishes.  Sprinkle with basil leaves, and gently pour in enough hot water to cover.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the crabmeat is cooked and crabmeat is no longer translucent, about 2 1/2 hours.

title: Pineapple-Hot Pepper Salad
ingredients: 4 tomatoes, halved | 1 head iceberg lettuce ( not the big head, just one large head ) | 4 red-leaf pepper, halved lengthwise | 4 yellow sweet peppers | 1/2 cup cold water | 120 g grated provolone cheese ( for sprinkling ) ( optional )
instructions: Arrange lettuce on serving plate.  Arrange tomatoes, peppers and sweet red leaf in rows on lettuce.  Place sweet pepper strips over pepper.  Pour water around pepper strips.  Sprinkle cheese on top or serve with additional cheese.  Enjoy.

title: Mandarin Oat
ingredients: 1 package quick cooking oats | 2 tablespoons nonstick cooking spray | 1 can mandarin oranges, with peel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f degrees.  Spray large baking pan with cooking spray over medium high heat.  Add oats and stir until mixture is coated with oil, 2 - 3 minutes or until oats have darkened slightly, about a minute.  Drain mandarin oranges into large bowl of food processor.  Add oranges, and 1/2 cup water, or as needed, and puree with hands or blender until smooth, 1 - 2 minutes.  Add remaining 1/2 cup water as needed, until thickened.  Pour into baking pan and bake 30 - 40 minutes, or until browned and top springs back when lightly touched.  Let cool 10 minutes before removing from pan.  Store covered in refrigerator.  This freezes well.

Random Ingredients: chicken bouillon granule,beef stew meat,pecorino romano cheese,bulgur wheat,cayenne
title: Crispy Beef With Bulgur Rice
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, trimmed ( i used 1/2 the beef, 1/2 the beef's ) | 1 cup bulgur wheat | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1/2 teaspoon beef bouillon granules or 1/2 teaspoon mushroom powder | 1/4 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese ( divided )
instructions: In a skillet over high heat, melt 2 tbls butter or margarine.  Add beef and cook until no longer pink.  Remove from skillet.  Heat remaining tbls of butter or margarine in skillet.  Add bulgur wheat and cayenne and stir to coat until mixture is dry.  Add beef and stir to coat with pan mixture.  Cover, reduce heat to medium low and cook at a slow simmer, stirring every couple hours, until bulgur is tender and meat and bulgur are very liquidy. title: English Corned Beef for Tea or Picnics

ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 5 dried red chilies | 1 tablespoon garlic, crushed | 4 cups chicken tenders, sliced thinly | salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1 package egg noodles | 2 tablespoons gherkins, chopped or 2 tablespoons dried chives, chopped | cooked jasmine rice, for serving
instructions: To make the cholent oil, heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.  Fry the chilies until softened.  When cool, remove the stems, seeds and membrane.  Set them aside.  Place the chicken, salt and pepper in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover and cook on high power until the meat is no longer pink in the center and no longer translucent but cooked through, about 8 minutes.  Set aside.  To make the noodles, bring 3 inches of salted water to a boil then add the noodles and cook uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the noodles are tender but firm.  Drain, cool slightly and transfer to a bowl.  Toss with the cholent oil.  Add the gherkins to the noodles and mix to combine.  Top with the chicken mixture and serve with rice.

title: Mexican Zucchini
ingredients: 1 lb grated zucchini | 1/2 cup fat free half-and-half | 1/8 teaspoon red chili powder | 1/8 teaspoon splenda sugar substitute
instructions: Heat oven to 400ºf.  Combine zucchini and fat free half and half to a large bowl.

title: Homemade Sweet Onion Rings and Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 onion ring ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 3 tablespoons red-wine vinegar
instructions: Peel onion rings.  Slice thin with cookie cutters.  In a mortar and pestle or food processor, pound the onion rings with the vinegar to make a finely textured paste.  The onion rings should be slightly thinner then regular onions.  This will probably not entirely coat the rings in the vinegar, but it adds a bit of the flavor.  Add salt and pepper, to taste.  Serve in small bowls.

title: Pine Nut and Tequila Cured
ingredients: 6 ounces gold tequila | 10 ounces pine nuts ( lightly toasted or raw ) | 5 ounces pickling spices
instructions: Pour the tequila into a sterilized highball glass.  Cover with pine nuts.  Cover with pickling spice.  Serve over ice.

title: Beef Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin steak ( cut into 1/2 inch cubes ) | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained | 1/2 head green cabbage, sliced | 1/2 cup enoki mushrooms, sliced ( or 1 oz of dried enoki ) | 1 tablespoon dried oregano | 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese | red pepper sauce | 2 packages frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until just beginning to smoke.  Add beef.

title: Simple Spinach and Chard (Kochabari) Paratha
ingredients: 200 g kochabari wheat flour or 200 g spaghetti sauce ( 3/4 cup ) | 1 inch fresh ginger juice | 200 g chopped chard leaves ( coriander leaves ) | 3 cups cooked spaghetti ( chard leaves )
instructions: Slightly crush the kochabari flour with a rolling pin.  Make a well out of the flour, put in the ginger ginger juice and kochabari and blend this, into a thick paste which should be like cornflour.  Set this aside.  Fry the chard and coriander leaves in a little olive oil.  Keep aside.  Put spaghetti in a pan of boiling water for a few minutes.  Add kochabari paste and cook on low heat for 5 minutes.  Add spinach and cook until the sauce is dry.  Serve with cooked spaghetti and paratha.

title: Baked Parsnips With Lime & Parsley Pita Breads

instructions: Pre heat your oven to 220c.  Line a baking tray with baking paper.  Combine the parsnips & limes in a bowl & mix well.  Spoon the mixture into a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Bake for about 75 minutes or until tender & golden brown.  Serve drizzle with the parsley mixture.

ingredients: 1 lb plum tomato | 1/2 lb unsalted butter | 1/4 cup peanut butter | 2 tablespoons basil pesto | 2 tablespoons chinese sweet wine | 1/4 cup miracle whip
instructions: Core the chopped tomatoes by cutting them in half and putting them through a grinder.  Slice tomatoes in half again, making sure you do not slice too thickly.  Cut tomatoes into slices 1/2 thick on the diagonal.  Place the butter, peanut butter, basil pesto, chinese sweet wine, and miracle whip in food processor and mix until smooth. instructions: Put cloves of ancho pepper into blender and add clams, onion, fennel seed, and 1/2 cup ice water.  Puree until smooth.

title: Spanish Inspired Stove Top Pork Ribs

instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Place ribs in a glass baking dish and scatter with mushrooms.  Pour tomatoes over ribs.  Roast until done, about 1 hour about.  About 10 minutes before serving, remove carrots from pan, let cool slightly and slice into 4 1/2 thick slices.  Serve as a side dish to cooked rice.  Top ribs with mushrooms and carrots.

title: Chinese Duck With Fresh Fruit

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f place duck breast on a rack in a roasting pan.

title: Chili-Garlic Rellenos

instructions: Roast chilies, skin side down on wire rack over broiler pan.  When skin blister and eyes begin to char, tent with foil or place in plastic bag and let steam for 10 minutes.  Remove chilies from bag and peel off charred skin.  Slit lengthwise and remove seeds.  Slice into strips. In bowl, combine cooked chilies, drained kidney beans and remaining ingredients.  Stuff each chile with 1/2 cup mixture, reshaping to cover filling.  Place on foil sheet.  Broil until edges are lightly browned.

title: Spinach Parfait

instructions: Drain the defrosted spinach, then squeeze out as much excess moisture as possible.  Place the spinach in a large serving bowl. title: Silverbeet (Beef) Noodle Salad

instructions: Boil the rotini in salted water for around a minute or 2.  Drain the pasta and return to the pan.  Add the butter and blend for about 1 minute to allow the flavours to meld.  Add the vanilla, cardamom, and white wine.  Toss the chips in the chocolate sauce until coated all over.

title: Beef & Cabbage

instructions: Preheat oven to 425&deg.

instructions: Brown in a large pot meat and drain excess fat.  Mix the ginger/garlic paste, soya sauce, red grapes, cumin and beef into meat.  Pour into crock pot.  Boil water and add the crushed graham crackers.  Cook for 5 minutes.  Serve with white basmati rice.
