title: Baked Pork Roast
ingredients: 3 1/2 lbs boneless pork shoulder, trimmed of fat | 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup irish cream ( baileys ) | 2 tablespoons egg substitute | 1/4 cup green cardamoms ( bruised and remove seeds ) | 2 teaspoons powdered honey | 1 teaspoon mint | 2 teaspoons dried mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Place pork roast skin side down in an oven safe baking pan, fat side up.  Sprinkle with almond extract.  Combine baileys, egg substitute, cardamom, honey, 1 teaspoon mint, and 1 teaspoon dried marjoram.  Pour glaze and marjoram mixture over pork roast.  Cover tightly with aluminum foil.  Bake about 2 1/2 hours or until pork is tender when pierced with a fork.  Remove from oven.  Let stand 30 minutes before slicing.  Serve over mashed potatoes, with the sauce.

title: Roasted Pork and Raspberries
ingredients: 1 whole cold pork fillet | 1 pint fresh raspberries ( or strawberries ) | cold water | 1 plum tomato, sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f.  Place pork fillet on a sheet of aluminum foil on top of a small roasting pan in a single layer.  Tear some of the raspberries and scatter over the top.  Pour around the pork fillet to cover all of the sides and place on the pan.  Tuck the raspberries around the outside of the pan with your fingers to make a foil packet.  Roast the pork for 30 minutes per pound of cut or chicken meat or until it is cooked and has a nice internal temperature of 145 degrees f when measured with a meat thermometer.  Let it rest another 15 to 20 minutes before slicing.  It should practically fall off the pork.  While warm, sprinkle with a little of the remaining raspberries in the pan.

title: Jicama and Sesame Seed Pudding
ingredients: 2 -3 teaspoons sesame seeds | 2 -3 slices whole wheat bread, crusts removed ( about 3/4-inch ) | 4 -6 cups water or 4 -6 cups water | 1 small raw jicama, peeled and chopped
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the sesame seeds, raw jicama and salt.  Process until mixture resembles a coarse crumbly mixture, about 1 minute.  Place the bread in a pot large enough to hold the pudding in a single layer.  Pour the water over the bread and toss to coat, about 2 minutes.  Cover with a lid, and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, or until the pudding thickens slightly.  Serve warm, or refrigerate until cold, about 2 hours.  Garnish as desired with mint leaves.  Note, if using raw jicama, cover with foil to prevent overbrowning.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,veal,topping,triple sec,red cabbage
title: Veal Bolognese
ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil, divided | 2 teaspoons triple sec or 2 teaspoons white grape juice | 1 lb veal, sliced into 1/4 inch slices | 1 medium red cabbage | 1 1/2 tablespoons triple sec or 1 1/2 tablespoons white grape juice
instructions: Saute veal over medium high heat in 1 teaspoon olive oil for 2 - 3 minutes per side, or until browned.  Remove from pan and slice thinly.  Combine remaining teaspoon olive oil and triple sec and pour over vegetables.  Reduce heat to low.

title: Quick Hungarian Noodle Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 1 lb gouda cheese | 9 ounces rice noodles
instructions: In the crockpot, mix the soup, the gouda cheese and the uncooked rice noodles together.  Cover and cook on low.  Cook for 3 to 4 hours or until rice noodles are done. .

title: Dough Boys (Yum Yum)
ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour | 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
instructions: Sift the flour into a mixing bowel.  Add the rice vinegar into the bowl.  Use a pastry brush to lightly grease your hands.  Knead by hand for a few times, then knead the dough a few times until the dough is smooth enough to roll out.  Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured board.  Roll it out with a rolling pin until it has a straight consistency.  Using a rolling pin, roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thick, adding flour until dough is all used up.  Cut a small hole in the top of the dough using your thumb and place a teaspoon of jam in the center of the dough.  Fold the dough over the jam and seal tightly by pressing the underside with wet fingers.  Repeat with the remaining dough.  Spray the tops of the dough rounds with a little oil.  Transfer the cookies to a nonstick cookie sheet.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes, or until the tops are lightly browned.

title: Baked Beef Hash for a Rainy Day, Just Like Mom Used for
ingredients: 1 rump steak, weighing 600g | 2 -3 tablespoons ketchup | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon hing | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 teaspoon beef bouillon | 1 teaspoon crushed tomatoes | 1 teaspoon chopped sweet cherries ( optional ) or 1 teaspoon strawberry jam ( optional )
instructions: Score the fat of the rump steak and discard any visible fat.  Place the steak, fat side up, between 2 layers of baking paper, with sides or a flat surface.  Place the dish in the freezer, and freeze.  To serve, remove meat from the freezer and defrost completely, then slice.  Serve the hash in the dish with any tomato gravy or sauces you prefer, using cherry sauce or jam.

title: Apple Kafta
ingredients: 2 cups apple juice | 2 teaspoons garam masala | 1 can diced tomatoes with juice | 1 cup toasted walnut halves
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, mix apple juice, garam masala, diced tomatoes with juice, and toasted walnuts.  Cover, and refrigerate overnight before serving.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,cream tartar,sharp cheddar cheese,apple cider,tomato sauce,red chili pepper flake,dill
title: Karen's Smokin' Hot Cheddar Sour Cream Applesauce
ingredients: 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/4 cup mushroom, sliced ( optional ) | 1/4 cup onion, chopped and sauteed | 6 apples, peeled, cored and diced | 10 ounces tomato sauce | red chili pepper flakes | 6 tablespoons sour cream or 6 tablespoons light sour cream
instructions: In a skillet on medium heat cook and stir half the cheddar, salt, and remaining cheddar, mushroom, onion, and saute in oil, stirring frequently until all of the cheese has melted and the onions are translucent.  Add apples and tomato sauce and blend well.  Stick the sauteed mix into the apples and return to medium heat.  Turn down the heat and stir.  Simmer until mixture is thickish, about 5 minutes.  Serve warm or chill at once, and add to your tastes when ready to eat.

title: Tikka Masa Bread
ingredients: 2 cups masa harina | 1 cup plain yogurt | 2/3 cup water | 1 pinch celery salt | 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup or 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Whisk together the masa harina, yogurt through to remove lumps.  Add water and soy/honey blend until smooth.  Pour into well buttered 8x8 oven proof or oiled 9 x 5 loaf pan.  Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 1 hour or until firm.  Heat oven to 250 degrees f.  Remove plastic wrap and bake 50 to 60 minutes.  Remove plastic wrap and cool completely.  Cut into 1 x 3 inch slices.

title: Easy Chicken (Or Tuna) Stuffing
ingredients: 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled | 1 1/2 cups plain white flour
instructions: Combine egg with breadcrumbs.  Add chicken boullion cube.  Stir in flour.  If mixture is too stiff to stir, add water.  Pour into a lightly greased, 12 cup shallow dish, or 2 or 3/4 cup ovenproof bowls.  Bake in a moderate oven for 30 minutes.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Mushroom Mustard  With Lemon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh mushrooms | 10 tablespoons grainy mustard | 1/2 tablespoon vegetable oil ( canola or olive oil ) | 2 bay leaves | 2 tablespoons corn oil ( or canola or olive oil ) | 4 lemon wedges ( optional )
instructions: Heat grill.  Trim the mushrooms, cut in half, and clean the stems.

title: Grilled Raisin Bread
ingredients: 2 red onion, sliced into slivers | 2 cups cinnamon raisin bread | 1/2 teaspoon celery salt
instructions: Brush the onion slices with pan spray.  Place in non stick pan, grill until lightly browned.

title: Roasted Sirloin Tips With Caramelized Onion

instructions: Place roast in a large roaster or heavy duty plastic bag.  Drizzle with caramelized onions.  Place bag in a pan of cold, salted water.  Cover and marinated roast at least overnight.  Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Bake in a preheated oven for 3 to 3 1/2 hours.  Shred with two forks.  Place beef tips in roaster or plastic bag and pour onions over top.  Bake for 2 hours in preheated oven.  The top of the beef should be a deep brown color.

title: Pistachio Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pistachios, crushed | 1 dash white pepper
instructions: Mix together.  For a richer look put powder in a 1/2 pint jar, cover with a teaspoon to cover or 2 to 3 tablespoon portions of mixture to form a ball, then roll up tight like a cigar. .  Store in a cool dry place.

title: Beef and Asparagus Alfredo
ingredients: 2 tablespoons asparagus, chopped | 1/3 cup alfredo sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Lightly grease a 2 quart shallow baking dish.  In a large skillet cook asparagus until tender crisp.  Drain.  Place in the prepared baking dish.  Pour the alfredo sauce over the asparagus and bake for 30 minutes, or until heated through.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,salmon fillet,spicy sausage,cream celery soup,tahini,sage,ice water,mustard powder
title: Baked Smoked Salmon With Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound smoked salmon fillets | 1 -2 tablespoon spicy sausage, sliced | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/2 cup distilled white vinegar | 1 teaspoon dry mustard powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1/3 cup ice water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place smoked salmon in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Pour sauce over fish.  Cover loosely with foil.  Bake 30 minutes.  Remove foil and stir.  Continue baking 15 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork and cooked through.  Brush with sauce while breading.  To prepare tahini sauce, in a small bowl combine, cream of celery soup, vinegar, dry mustard and sage.  Mix well.  Add water and blend until thickened.

title: Easy Authentic White Beans (Fagioli)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups dry white beans | 1 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 teaspoon dried yeast
instructions: Place the white beans in a large bowl and sprinkle with the salt, then add the yeast.  Allow to proof until the white beans become frothy, about 1 to 2 1/2 minutes depending on the type of beans you used.  Use the back of a spoon to carefully separate them and break apart.  Add just enough water so that the beans are fully submerged.  Cover the bowl with a towel, and leave to ferment in a warm place until the beans are fully fermented, 8 to 10 hours.  When ready to use, remove the beans from the refrigerator and allow to set.  When ready to use, place the cooked white beans in a large container and fill with water so that they are covered by at least 1 inch of water.  Cover the container, and refrigerate overnight.  Drain the white beans, and place in a large bowl.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,sea scallop,swiss chard,great northern bean,date syrup
title: Seafood Parfait
ingredients: 200 g swiss chard | 1 can great northern beans, drained | 200 g dates syrup or 200 g sugar maple syrup | 20 large sea scallops | 1/3 cup grand marnier
instructions: Chop chard leaves and trim as much stems from them as possible.  Discard stems.  Break chard leaves into bite size pieces and set aside.  Drain beans in colander and rinse with cold water.  Drain well and set aside.  Wash and trim scallops.  Set aside.  Add sugar and maple syrup to chard leaves, reserving liquid.  Marinate the seafood in about 5 cups of the liquid for at least 10 minutes or up to two hours in the refrigerator.  Drain and reserve liquid.  In large fry pan of medium heat, add seafood and enough reserved liquid to lightly coat seafood, but not cook or soften.  Cook at medium heat, stirring seafood until cooked through and shrimp turns pink when is thumped, and crab claws are done.  Serve with french fries.

instructions: Combine all ingredients and store in the refrigerator in a plastic storage bag.  Shake or stir to combine.  Serve warm or cold.

instructions: Mix the curry paste with the remaining ingredients.  Marinate the pork roast overnight in the refrigerator.  Cook as preferred then grill.  Remove from the oven, cover, and bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes.

instructions: Zest the lemon.

I recommend letting it sit a few minutes so that each slice can absorb heat evenly.

title: The Migas (Beef With Pear)

instructions: The night before, place tenderloin on rack in broiler.  Put under broiler just enough to lightly brown.  Broil, 4 inches from heat, until a meat thermometer reads 125f for rare steak or 125f for well done.  Let stand at least 8 minutes and up to 24 hours before slicing.  Slice and serve on a bed of lettuce leaves.

Random Ingredients: king prawn,red chile pepper,muenster cheese,parsley,bell pepper,green chile,fenugreek leaf
title: Prawn and Pepper Fritters
ingredients: 24 raw large king prawns | 3 ounces muenster cheese | 1/2 bell pepper | 2 ounces green chiles | 1 pinch dried fenugreek leaves | 2 fresh red chile peppers | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Heat a frying pan over medium heat.  Cook and stir the prawns in the hot pan until they are lightly browned on the outside, 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, and cut cheese into cubes.  Place the pepper, chile, fenugreek, and parsley in a mortar, and pound until finely chopped.  Toss with prawn and cheese.  Taste for seasoning, and top with additional green chile and red chili pepper.  Serve immediately.

title: Cranberry-Mango Chicken

instructions: Preheat bbq.  Combine first 6 ingredients in a saucepan and simmer 10 minutes.  Add chicken, cover and cook over medium high heat 25 minutes or more if the chicken browns over low heat.  Stir cranberry juice and kaffir lime leaves into pan, cook 2 minutes or until heated through.

title: Quick & Easy Smoky Cream
ingredients: 2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring
instructions: Pour cream into a microwave safe bowl, then add the liquid smoke.  Microwave on high for 30 seconds, then microwave on high for 15 - 20 seconds, stirring every 20 seconds to keep from sticking to the bottom of the bowl.  Remove bowl from microwave and stir for 1 minute.  If desired, you can microwave the cream for a few seconds until creamy, but if you like it more liquidy, stir that in too.

title: Hot Dogs With Empanadas
ingredients: 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 1 cup shredded escarole | 8 -12 ounces beef hot dogs | 1/2 papaya, peeled and sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f and lightly oil a baking sheet.  Mix remaining ingredients in a glass bowl.  Arrange the hot dogs in the baking sheet.  Spoon the cheese mixture on top of hot dogs and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot dogs are hot.  Serve with warmed bread.

Random Ingredients: japanese cucumber,vegetable stock,dark sesame oil,linguine pasta,spinach,red wine,beef stew meat
title: Spinach Soup III
ingredients: 3 packages linguine pasta | 1 package thinly sliced japanese cucumbers | 2 pounds beef stew meat, thinly sliced | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 1/2 cup red wine | 5 cups torn fresh spinach
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add pasta, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.  Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking liquid.  Rinse noodles under cold water, drain.  Place noodles into a large bowl, and add 1/2 cup reserved cooking liquid and the cucumber slices.  Toss to coat with reserved cooking liquid, and toss again.  Place beef between sheets of waxed paper, and pound until thin.  Drain beef on paper towels and set aside.  Place stock in a medium pot, and bring to a boil.  Stir in 1 tablespoon sesame oil, red wine and cooked noodles.  Cover, and simmer 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Place spinach in a colander over a large bowl, and squeeze out excess water.  Place spinach in a steamer over boiling water, cover, and steam until just wilted, about 1 minute.  Drain.  Stir drained spinach into soup, cook for about 2 minutes, or until heated through.

title: Tropical Mango & Corn Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb mango nectar ( or syrup ) | 1/2 cup fresh corn kernels or 1/2 cup frozen corn kernels | 2 tablespoons prepared horseradish | 1 tablespoon sesame seeds
instructions: Sherry, honey & corn are both good.  To finish, stir in sesame seeds & refrigerate until ready to serve.  Note, the longer it ages, the more flavorful this salad will be enjoy & even re heated.

title: Blood Orange Salad With Cumin (Zwt 1)
ingredients: 1 cup blood orange, raw | 4 celery ribs, sliced | cumin powder, to taste
instructions: Peel and rinse the oranges and celery.  Slice very thinly, if not already done, place in a wide bowl along with a pinch of cumin.  Toss gently with the dressing and serve.  Also wonderful topped with fresh fruit.  Note, this is lovely cold, not hot.  Enjoy.

title: Smoked Salmon With Cashews or Truffles
ingredients: 1/2 lb smoked salmon fillet | 1/2 lb rump roast, in 1-inch cubes ( or use smoked salmon ) | 1/2 cup roasted cashews ( or raisins ) | 1/2 teaspoon sage ( or mixed fresh herbs )
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 f and lightly oil a baking sheet.  Line sheet with parchment paper and put in oven for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, place smoked salmon in a pan.  Top with 1/2 cup salted water and 1/2 tsp sage.  Stir and simmer for about 30 minutes, until the fish is barely opaque.  Drain, discard water, and let rest on the baking sheet for 10 minutes.  Remove parchment, and discard.  Spread cashews evenly over the surface of the salmon, and place in the oven.  Place the baking sheet with the salmon under the hot broiler and broil for about 6 minutes, or just until the cashews become just lightly toasted and aromatic.  Set aside to cool slightly.  Wash and pat dry the salmon.  Remove skin and bones, and slice into thin slices.  Serve with cashew and mixed fresh herbs.

Random Ingredients: wine vinegar,anise seed,nonfat milk powder,chicken breast fillet,apple cider,red chilies
title: Spicy Chicken Kebabs
ingredients: 800 g chicken breast fillets | 1 teaspoon oil or 1 teaspoon pure oil | 1/2 tablespoon nonfat dry milk powder | 1 teaspoon wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 medium red chilies or 1 medium green chilies, diced
instructions: Cut off any fat or large pieces of chicken.  Cut into thin strips then cut into 1cm cubes.  Put chicken in a shallow bowl and rub all over with the oil.  Mix all of the ingredients together and add to the chicken.  Cover and leave for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Irish Cowboy Pepper Tea Snack
ingredients: 1 cup dried ear corn on the cob, husked | 4 green onions, chopped | 1 can sliced peaches, drained | 2 cups sweetened tea | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Rinse the kernels from the cob, and let them dry overnight or over night.  In a medium saucepan, combine the ear corn, green onions, and peach slices.  Cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer 20 minutes.  Remove from heat, and let cool until easy to handle.  Place the cooled ear corn kernels in a medium bowl, and stir in tea.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Waldorf Salad
ingredients:
1/2 lb bacon, cooked crisp, cut into 1/4-inch pieces | 2 heads napa cabbage ( about 1.
    -5 pounds ) or 2 heads white cabbage, with leaves ( about 1.
    -5 pounds ) | 1 cup raisins or 1 cup dried fruit ( optional )
instructions: Cook bacon to desired crispyiness.

title: Dorito Dorito (Dietetic Oranges & Puts in Cream and Vinegar)
ingredients: 6 small oranges | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 3/4 cup vinegar | 1/4 cup crushed nopales or 1/4 cup crushed fried dorito | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Grate the zest from one of the oranges using a vegetable peeler, removing all of the membrane/seewy white pith.  With a sharp knife cut the orange zest, including all of the zest, into thin slivers.  With a spoon, drop a tablespoonfull of the orange juice into a bowl and set aside.  Repeat with the remaining oranges as necessary, keeping juice.  Working quickly, pour the juice into a saucepan and heat to a simmer and barely simmer.  The orange zest is cooked only if liquid dries out.  When the juice has nearly all evaporated, add the cream and stir constantly until reduced and thickened.  While still stirring, add the vinegar and remove from the heat.  Place a small plate over a saucepan and use the back of a spoon to scoop out the oranges and put them in, or in a bowl with the orange juice.  Press the zest into the cream to flatten it a little.  Transfer to a dessert dish and garnish with the dorito and pine nuts.  Note, to eat dorito dorito in cream, scoop out the entire orange with a fork and use it to lightly crush the rind before removing it.  This recipe is particularly good with a sprinkle of finely grated parmesan or romano cheese on top, especially if you're not strictly on a low fat diet.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,vegetable juice,italian seasoning,hazelnut,sun tomato oil,pinto bean,onion soup mix,penne pasta
title: Italian Pasta Beans and Puff
ingredients: 1 package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed | 2 cans pinto beans, drained | 1 envelope dry onion soup mix | 1 tablespoon italian seasoning | 1 tablespoon vegetable juice | 2 tablespoons dried sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, chopped | 1 package dry penne pasta | 1 tablespoon ground hazelnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place frozen puff pastry sheets on the baking sheets, and stack them with waxed paper between each sheet.  Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until golden brown.  Heat pinto beans, dry onion soup mix, italian seasoning, vegetable juice, sun dried tomatoes, and pasta in a saucepan over medium heat until heated through, about 10 minutes.  Remove bay leaves, and spoon a generous amount of beans on each puff pastry sheet.  Top each with several tablespoons each of remaining beans.  Sprinkle hazelnuts on top, and continue baking puff pastry sheets until golden brown, about 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,steak,yogurt,garlic paste,seasoning salt,red chili pepper
title: Sweet Steak Fajita Skillet
ingredients:
2 lbs round steaks ( or fillets, etc.
    - ) | 1 tablespoon seasonings salt or 1 tablespoon white salt | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 dried red chili pepper | 3 tablespoons yogurt ( natural, not miracle whip ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons grand marnier
instructions: Mix the seasonings together and coat the steak well with it mix the seasonings in a bowl and leave it for at least 15 - 30 minutes.  Grill the steak or fillets on a hot griddle.  Put the yoghurt in a small bowl and mix it well with the grand marnier.  Take each steak and spread half the yoghurt over the top of the steak.  Add chopped up chili and the top with the rest of the yoghurt.  Turn the meat over and repeat the process.

title: Batida De Cerdo Com Molcaina (Tomato Cocktail)
ingredients: 1 ounce cachaca, or as needed | 1 cherry tomatoes, diced, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Run a long handled match or saucer around the edge of a cocktail glass to wet the rims of the cocktail glasses.  Fill each glass with 2 to 3 tablespoons of diced tomatoes, 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of cherry tomatoes, and 1 1/2 to 1 1/2 teaspoons of cachaca.  The cocktail should be thin enough to easily drop from a spoon into a glass of ice.

title: Sushi Roll (Mushi)
ingredients: 1 lb yellow squash, cut lengthwise into 1 inch pieces and crosswise into 1/4 inch slices | 1 cup sushi rice, short short-grained ( preferably japanese )
instructions: Arrange squash slices in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Roast under a preheated broiler for about 10 minutes, until lightly golden brown and soft.  Set aside to cool and set aside.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.  Cook rice in the boiling water for 3 minutes.  Drain rice in a strainer set over a bowl.  Cool completely and set aside.  While rice stands, heat a grill pan to medium high heat.  Cook squash in the boiling water for 2 minutes.  Transfer to a plate and let cool completely.  Squash should still be firm but still crisp.  Dice cooked squash.  Spread 1 cup rice, about 1/8 inch thick, over the bottom edge of a bamboo sushi roll or nori.  Sprinkle diced squash over rice evenly and top with remaining 1/4 cup rice.  Cut a slit in the top to allow steam to escape.  Roll edges of rice lightly inward toward the exposed part of the roll.  Cut roll into 6 pieces and serve warm or cold with fruit, pickles or soy sauce.

title: Croutons for Dogs Too
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry | 2 tablespoons croutons, coarsely chopped ( i use the frozen-croutons )
instructions: Place a sheet of the dough on a board, slightly overlapping it, and using a rolling pin, roll out dough into a rectangle.  Cut into four squares, each square about 2 in depth.  Sprinkle croutons inside each square, but not overlapping.  Fold the squares in half, leaving the folded edges slightly flattened.  You should have a triangle shaped pastry.  Preheat oven to 200 degrees f/170°c/gas 6 and put on a pizza tray.  Bake at 200 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden and puffed, and serve hot with melted butter or honey.

title: Kielbasa With Bok Choy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons cumin seeds or 3 -4 teaspoons ground cumin | 2 tart apples, unpeeled and thinly sliced | 2 1/2 tablespoons kielbasa or 2 1/2 tablespoons turkey kielbasa, coarsely chopped | 3 tablespoons basil leaves | 3 tablespoons prepared pesto sauce | 1 ounce kerrygold irish ale or 1 ounce coffee-flavored carbonated beverage
instructions: Heat a griddle over medium heat.  Toast the cumin.  Toast until fragrant.  Set aside.  Coarsely chop the apples.  Combine with the kielbasa and the spices.  Use a small scoop.  To make the berrygold or ale, heat the kielbasa and pesto over medium low heat in 1 tbl.  Saucepan.  Stir constantly until the sausage and kielbasa are completely tender and brown.  Spoon the mixture into a warmed serving plate.  Ladle the berrygold over the top of the sausage/kielbasa mixture.  Serve.

title: Marshmallow Crusted Calamonic
ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck | 1 lb shredded sweet sesame squash or 1 lb shredded hot pepper | 24 miniature marshmallows
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground chuck and squash or hot pepper.  With your hands or a fork, mix everything together until evenly combined.  Fill molds about 1/3 full of the mixture, place a little dough in the middle of the filling and gather and roll to make a roll about 16 long.  Place in a 9x13 baking dish, and cover with aluminum foil.  Bake for 35 - 40 minutes in a 350°f oven, until the tops are lightly browned.  Remove from the oven and allow to set.  Cool uncovered before removing the foil and placing the molds on a rack to cool completely.

Random Ingredients: red snapper,celery salt,white tequila,spaghetti sauce,rump roast,mango
title: Mexican Beef on a Salt Crust
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti sauce | 2 lbs rump roast | 4 ounces red snapper, skinned and boned | 4 tablespoons celery salt | 4 tablespoons white tequila | 1 mango, cut into 1/2-inch wedges
instructions: Preheat large dutch oven or roasting pan on stovetop until hot.  Place rack in middle of oven.  Rub salt over meat.  Combine spaghetti sauce, rind, sauce, and vegetables, stir to thoroughly mix well.  Add meat and turn in salt mixture to coat.  Pour contents of roasting pan into pan.  Cover tightly with foil.  Bake at 300°for 2 hours, basting occasionally with pan juices.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 20 - 30 minutes before serving with mango.

title: Prosciutto-Wrapped Stuffed Shiitake Mushites (Funghi Udang Manis)
ingredients: 14 ounces mushrooms, coarsely chopped ( about 8 ounces ) | 1/2 cup peeled and grated fresh gingerroot | 1/4 cup packed chopped italian parsley | 1 lb prosciutto, rind cut from one of the slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Wash mushrooms thoroughly under cold running water.  Place the mushrooms, ginger, parsley, and prosciutto in a medium size bowl.  Add enough salt to the mushrooms to lightly coat them.  Lay out a sheet of reynolds wrap non stick aluminum foil.  Using the same reynolds wrap as you would wrap the stuffing, gently stuff 4 - 5 mushrooms in, leaving 1/2 inch of mushroom flesh on the sides of the foil.  Place the stuffed mushrooms in the foil lined oven safe pan.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until the internal temperture of the mushrooms reads 165f.  If cooking earlier, tent with foil and let the mushrooms steam for 5 - 10 minutes.  Use a sharp serrated knife to check to see if they’re done by cutting the foil at an internal temperature of 160f on a chopping board.  If not, tent with foil and allow to cook for 5 more minutes.  Remove from the oven and slice into quarters.  Serve piping hot or warm.

title: Fantastic Focaccia
ingredients: 1 teaspoon yeast | 1 clove minced garlic | 6 cups unbleached all purpose flour | fresh mint sprig
instructions: Pour the sugar into a large mixing bowl and sprinkle the yeast over the top.  Let stand for 10 minutes or until foamy and then stir to dissolve it.  Stir the garlic into the yeast mixture and add 1 cup of the flour.  Stir to mix.  Add enough flour to make a stiff dough.

Random Ingredients: salt pork,maraschino cherry,brandy,macadamia nut,lemon juice zest,salad green,serrano chilies,white sugar
title: Macadamia Nut and Sauerkraut Salad
ingredients: 2 loaves macadamia nuts | 1 lb salt pork, cut into 1/2 in cubes | 2 lemons, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/2 lbs mixed salad greens, washed and picked the mixed greens | 5 serrano chilies, seeds removed and chopped | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | salt
instructions: Toast macadamia nuts in a single layer on a baking sheet in 350°f oven, stirring occasionally, for about 7 minutes.  Cool.  Pound macadamia nuts to a coarse powder.  Transfer ground nut and lemon rind to a large bowl and add olive oil and brandy.  Stir to combine, then add salt, chiles, parmigiano reggiano cheese and chopped macadamia nuts.  Mix thoroughly.  Refrigerate, covered, for 1 hour or longer.

title: Veal or Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 liter veal stock | 3 -4 cloves | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon cardamom
instructions: In a pan, heat the veal stocks so they're hot enough that they start to simmer.  Add spices.  Stir the broth to dissolve any clumps and dilute the lumps.  If you like a thicker, thicker sauce, add a little warm stock or water.  Bring to a boil and cook gently.

Random Ingredients: mace,green cardamom pod,yellow pepper,broccoli floret,sage leaf,fontina cheese,raisin
title: Broccoli in Cream & Raisins
ingredients: 2 large broccoli florets | 1 large yellow pepper, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup raisins | 1/4 cup snipped fresh sage leaf | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pod, plus | 1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh sage leaves | 8 ounces fontina cheese, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
instructions: Cook broccoli and yellow pepper in 3 tablespoons water until tender crisp.

title: Chilli Rolled Nori - Shushi
ingredients: 4 nori | chili sauce | of fresh mint
instructions: Lay flat nori on clean work surface.  Spread with thinly sliced chili sauce.  Wash your hands and fingers well so the roll doesn't get dry.  Place a fresh mint on top.  Roll up and slice finely.  Serve hot or cold.

Random Ingredients: prawn,kosher salt,bow tie pasta,strawberry preserve,grape tomato,coriander seed,olive,red wine vinegar
title: Quick and Easy Pavlova Salad
ingredients:
2 cups small round grape tomatoes | 2 cups medium raw prawns | 1 tablespoon coriander seeds | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons kosher salt | 1 jar strawberry preserves | 2 cups bow tie pasta, cooked.
    - | freshly toasted olives, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 450º.  Place grape tomatoes on a baking dish.  Toast coriander and seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant.  Watch them closely, because they can burn easily when you add these to the oven.  Add vinegar gradually, stir and reduce heat to low.  Cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally with a spatula, for 10 minutes.  Add salt and cook about 5 minutes more, until the vinegar almost evaporates.  Remove from heat.  In a large bowl, toss together, prawns, coriander/seeds, red wine and tomatoes, stirring to combine.  Toss in cooked bow tie pasta.  If there are excess dressing, stir it into the salad just before service.

Random Ingredients: molasses,taco sauce,nam pla,ginger garlic paste,feta cheese,coriander seed,flour,ramen noodle
title: Tilapia(Mild Asian Noodles) With Nantes (Vegetable Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 cup light molasses or 1 cup dark molasses | 2 tablespoons nam pla | 1 tablespoon dried coriander seed, crushed | 2 teaspoons grated ginger-garlic paste | 4 teaspoons flour | 16 ounces ramen noodles ( i like the brand name ngi ) | shredded feta cheese | nuoc cham sauce or sriracha hot sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Line the counter with a piece of aluminum foil and arrange noodles directly on the foil.  Combine molasses, 1 tbs.  Pla, coriander, grated ginger and 1 tspn.  Flour in a mixing bowl.

Random Ingredients: beef broth,bibb lettuce,beef chuck roast,coconut milk,queso blanco,dijon mustard,asparagus
title: Beef Asparagus and Coconut Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs trimmed chuck roast | 10 ounces asparagus, trimmed and cut in thirds diagonally | 1 box beef broth | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 cup coconut milk | 4 slices queso blanco, grated | 2 leaves bibb lettuce
instructions: Place chuck roast in dutch oven and coat well with cooking spray.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Place meat on top of asparagus and add broth.  Cover and cook at 300 for 60 minutes.  Remove meat and reserve pan juices.  Skim any fat.  Shred meat.  Return meat and broth to dutch oven and heat to boiling, stirring in remaining ingredients.  Bring to simmer and remove from heat.  Place half of shredded cheese on each plate and divide asparagus among them.

Random Ingredients: juice jalapeno,white cornmeal,self rising flour,nutmeg,european cucumber,fruit,orange zest,monterey jack cheese
title: Cheese Slice
ingredients:
40 g self rising flour | 20 g fine white cornmeal or 20 g breadcrumbs | 3 tablespoons finely shredded monterey jack cheese ( about 1 c.
    - ) | 3 tablespoons finely shredded peeled european cucumber | 3 tablespoons chopped dried fruit | 1 egg, lightly beaten | 1 grated orange, zest of | juice of 1/2-1 jalapeno | grated nutmeg
instructions: Grease and line a 20cm x 23cm lamington tin.  Preheat oven to 180c.  Combine the flour, cornmeal, cheese, cucumber, dried fruit and egg in a large bowl.  Stir in the zest until well combined.  Spoon the mixture into the tin and sprinkle evenly with the grated nutmeg.  Bake for 35 - 40 minutes, or until top is golden and crisp, covering with foil if using immediately after the first 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and allow to stand for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack to cool slightly before slicing.

title: Chicken Satay (Simple)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs or 2 lbs pork butt | 2 packages wooden bamboo skewers
instructions: Dice chicken and pork and place in freezer bag.  Seal bag with sliplock.  Let it come to room temperature about 30 minutes.  Place on foil lined baking sheet about 6 inches from heat source.  If using the skewers i prefer them to be on my kitchen counter to test if they are dry or not, but watch them closely after cooking.  Place bag on baking sheet and let defrost before continuing with the recipe.  The next day, preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Bake covered about 1 hour, or until done to your liking in the middle of the skewer.  Remove bag from oven and skewer the meat using picks and string, about 1 1/2 tablespoons per skewer.  Serve immediately with steamed rice, dipping sauce or a side salad.

Random Ingredients: bulk italian sausage,accent seasoning,french bread,dark rum,thyme leaf,creamy italian dressing,genoa salami
title: Famous Miami Street Sausage Bread
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1/4 lb genoa salami | 1/2 teaspoon thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon accent seasoning | 1 cup creamy italian dressing | 1/2 cup dark rum
instructions: Wash and cut bread into 1 to 1 1/2 inch slices.  Grill the sausage, italian sausage and salami over low medium heat till both meats are cooked and the sausage is no longer pink.  Slice the meats into thin pieces.

title: Rosti With Charred Chilies and Pistachios
ingredients: 10 -12 small red chilies ( or more ) | 1 lb cooked rotini pasta | 1/4 cup pickle ( chopped ) | 1/2 cup pistachios, chopped
instructions: Remove seeds from chilies and slice.  Drain pasta and place in microwave.  Add salt and chilies to taste and microwave for 3 - 5 minutes or until just hot.  Add pistachios and cook in microwave about 1 minute or just until slightly soft and slightly brown.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: coriander,purpose flour,chipotle chile,white flour,clove,vegetable stock,dijon mustard,guinness stout
title: Guinness Sauce
ingredients: 1 liter guinness stout | 1 sprig coriander, tied | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 6 ounces all-purpose flour | 1/4 ounce dijon mustard | 7 ounces white flour, for dusting | 7 ounces vegetable stock | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles
instructions: Pour the guinness into a saucepan and add enough water to cover the bottom.  Place on the stove and bring to the boil, then boil rapidly until the liquid has reduced to about 3 tablespoons.  Add the coriander, cloves, and flour, then whisk in the mustard and set aside.  Sift the flour into a bowl and add the stock, chilies, and chipotle.  Mix thoroughly and add them to the guinness sauce.  Cover and keep warm.  When ready to serve, divide the sauce between 4 individual ovenproof bowls.  Pour the sauce over the meat and leave to bubble gently for 5 - 10 minutes.  Taste and adjust the seasoning.

title: Basshopper
ingredients: 1 cup mixed salad greens | 2 tablespoons finely chopped toasted almonds or 2 tablespoons chopped slivered almonds | 1/3 cup currants | 3 tablespoons tomato sauce | 1 dash angostura bitters | 1 dash dry mustard greens, for color
instructions: Place mixed greens in a microwave safe bowl cover with water and microwave on high power setting for 30 seconds.  With tongs, remove the greens, cool at room temperature for 5 minutes or till tender.  Blend the drained greens, almonds, currants, tomato sauce and bitters in a food processor until smooth.  Arrange greens in shallow serving bowl and pour over bean mixture.

Random Ingredients: no salt tomato,hamburger bun,xanthan gum,sherry,stir fry sauce,pecorino romano cheese
title: Quick & Easy Pizza
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups no-salt-added whole tomatoes | 6 hamburger buns | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 tablespoon light-colored stiry-type cooking sherry | 1 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese ( can use parmesan ) | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum, or 1 tablespoon other gluten-free seasoning blend
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Pour the tomatoes into the bowl of a blender full of the liquid products.

title: Beer Stew
ingredients: 1 can refrigerated sourdough starter | 12 ounces cooked cod fillets | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 cup ketchup | 1/4 cup bottled ketchup
instructions: Place sourdough starter in a large bowl and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups starter.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, reduce heat, and simmer for 15 minutes.  Remove starter from heat and allow to cool to lukewarm.  Place cod fillets and barley in crockpot, pour starter on top.  Cover and cook on low heat for 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: tomato green chilies,brown mustard seed,extra tofu,apple cider vinegar,butter bean,chocolate shaving,lemon peel,baby spinach
title: Hot Brown and Tofu Salad (Veggie Version)
ingredients: 2 cans peeled tomatoes and green chilies, drained | 1 can butter beans, rinsed and drained | 1 package extra firm tofu, cut in half | 2 teaspoons prepared apple cider vinegar | 2 teaspoons finely shredded lemon peel | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate shavings | 2 tablespoons butter flavored bean sprouts, for garnish
instructions: Set a large wok over medium heat.  Pour 2/3 cup of water into the pan and swirl to coat the wok.  Heat just until the water boils, then set aside to cool.  Mix the tomatoes and green chiles in a bowl, then add the cooked butter beans, tofu, vinegar, grated lemon peel, mustard seeds, and chile sauce.

title: Macadamia Nuts (Stuffed Pork Rolls)
ingredients: 1/4 lb ground lean pork | 1/2 lb macadamia nuts | 2 cups rolled oats
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Using your hands, carefully break the macadamia nuts into smaller pieces, discarding the nuts.  With a spoon, scoop out the most of the center of each macadamia nut.  Stuff the center with ground pork.  In a small, dry skillet, toast the rolled oats, stirring occasionally until a light golden color, about 5 minutes.  Using a spatula, transfer the cookies to a rimmed baking sheet.  Bake until the tops are golden, about 10 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cookies to a serving dish.

Random Ingredients: brown sugar,garlic salt,white wine,red chile,beet,water chestnut
title: Quick Beet Relish
ingredients: 1 1 lb raw beets, scrubbed ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 cup water chestnut, chopped | 1 fresh red chile, chopped | 1 teaspoon brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 2 teaspoons white wine
instructions: In a large heavy saucepan over medium high heat, place beets and cover with water.

Random Ingredients: italian herb seasoning,picante sauce,sharp cheddar cheese,irish cream
title: Mexican Cream Cheese Dip II
ingredients: 1 package sharp cheddar cheese, shredded | 6 ounces picante sauce | 1/2 cup irish cream or 1/2 cup creme fraiche | 1 teaspoon dried italian herb seasoning
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Serve with crackers.

title: Apricot and Tomato D'edger
ingredients: 2/3 cup apricot jam | 1/4 cup tomato puree | 1 cucumber, sliced
instructions: Stir together the apricot jam, tomato puree and cucumber slices in a bowl.  Serve right away.

Random Ingredients: ginger juice,sage leaf,green bean,espresso powder,turmeric,yogurt,cilantro leaf
title: Green-Bean Pancakes With Indian Spices
ingredients: 1 lb green beans, ends trimmed, slit diagonally to yield 1 1/4 cups of fresh green beans, about 6 cups ( or less ) | 3 tablespoons brewed espresso powder | 1/4 cup yogurt ( low gi, low fat or non-fat ) | 1 ounce ginger juice ( from the jar of ginger ) | 1 pinch turmeric | 2 tablespoons cilantro leaves, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon ground sage leaves
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the green beans, espresso powder, yogurt, ginger juice, turmeric and cilantro.  Heat a little non fat or oil in a frying pan until hot but not smoking.  Tip spiced mixture into the oil and cook until golden brown, 3 - 5 minutes per side.  Transfer the spiced pancake to a plate and keep warm in a low oven.  Spoon the hot spiced oil into the pan.  Cook briefly until the oil has been absorbed.  Add the spiced spiced pancake to the pan and spread to cover the bottom.  Pancakes should be a bit crisp on top.  Remove from the pan and serve hot, with yogurt and garnish with the fresh herbs.

title: Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 3 lbs lean beef brisket | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil ( white ) | 1 1/2 cups vinegar | 1 cup cashews ( unsalted, dry roasted, see directions )
instructions: Place meat in a large bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Refrigerate, covered, at least 4 days.  Remove meat from the refrigerator about 30 minutes prior to serving.  Bring to room temperature to serve on warm or room temperature plates.

title: Simple Beef Curry
ingredients: 1 can panang curry paste | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp | 1 lb flank steak | 30 peppercorns | 3 pears
instructions: Drain the liquid from the can of panang.  Place the liquid in a saucepan.  Break the flank steak into bite size pieces.  Add meat to liquid.

title: Scoopitos (Spanish Snack Eggs)
ingredients: 4 large white potatoes, scrubbed | 1 large orange twist | 12 mini marshmallows | 1 1/2 cups sweet rice wine, or more to taste
instructions: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain and allow to steam dry for a minute or two.  Slice the orange zest into thin strips and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the mini marshmallows in boiling water until softened, 3 to 5 minutes.  Peel the eggs and slice them in half lengthwise.  Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle about 2 tablespoons of rice wine along the edge.  Stir until the mixture coats the back of a spoon.  Spoon about half of the sweet rice into the center of each potato slice.  Fold the potato slices together, forming a half moon.  Arrange the filled potato rounds on a platter so that the filled potato rounds resemble tree ears or star shaped wedges.  Serve with your favorite vinaigrette, such as citrus zest, sherry, or apricot puree.

title: Chow mein Chicken
ingredients: 1 package chow mein noodles | 1 can green apples | 1/2 cup golden raisin
instructions: Wash and core the green apple and slice into 2 inch pieces.  In 6 quart dutch oven or equivalent, cook chow mein noodles according to instructions on the package.  Drain and toss with green apple, raisins.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: black olive,white vinegar,vanilla extract,lemon juice zest,shortening,almond extract,italian sausage,penne
title: Sweet Italian Sausage and Penne
ingredients: 3 tablespoons shortening | 12 ounces italian sausage | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract | 1 lb hot cooked penne, preferably dried | 1/2 cup sliced black olives ( to garnish )
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Dip first 4 ingredients in melted shortening and place in a small 9x13 baking dish, overlapping to fit.  Bake 10 minutes, turning after 3 minutes.  Remove sausage mixture from oven and place in a large bowl.  Stir in vinegar, lemon juice, vanilla and almond extracts.  Cover with a damp towel and let stand at least 30 minutes.  Cook penne in a large pot of boiling salted water until just al dente.

title: Balsamic Glaze for Chicken, Tuna and Fish
ingredients: 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar or 1/4 cup distilled vinegar | 2 tablespoons minced canned pineapple | 1 teaspoon garam masala | 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the vinegar, pineapple, garlic, garam masala, cumin and marjoram.

title: Creamed Vegal
ingredients: 4 1/2 cups thick vegetable stock | 1 1/2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 large egg, beaten | 1 lb veal, chopped small | 1 1/2 cups water
instructions: Boil stock, add tomatoes.  Lower heat a little and simmer 10 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Stir in beaten egg.  Add veal and water.  Cook until veal is done.  Remove from heat and serve.

Random Ingredients: white onion,mirin,salad green,red wine vinegar,malt vinegar,thyme,rice,cooking oil
title: Japanese Steamed Salad
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chopped white onion | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon minced fresh thyme | 9 ounces mixed salad greens | cooking oil | 1 tablespoon malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon mirin | 4 cups cooked rice
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°f in a nonstick ovenproof saute pan over medium heat, warm the cooking oil.  Add the onion and thyme and saute, stirring often, for 8 minutes or until onions are slightly soften.  Divide the salad greens among 4 serving bowls.  Top with the onion mixture and drizzle with the malt vinegar and mirin.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,rice wine,salt black pepper,puff pastry,adobo seasoning
title: Chipotle-Arrabiata (Cheese Appetizer)
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | salt and ground black pepper to taste | adobo seasoning to taste | 1/2 cup rice wine, or as needed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread rice wine into the center of each sheet of cooked puff pastry dough to cover the entire surface.  Sprinkle cheese generously on top.  Starting at one end of the pastry sheet, roll out the dough to a 6 inch square.  Roll away all the air, creating a 2 inch border around each pastry button.  Press the border of the dough together, creating a 2 inch border with flecks of dough that have no points.  Tuck the border between your hands as you roll.  Place on a baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven until the pastry border is browned, 20 to 25 minutes.  Cut into 5 inch squares with a sharp knife.

title: Easy Fish Nests in Spicy Black Sauce
ingredients: 2 lbs cod | 3 tablespoons black tea, strong | 1 ounce dark soy sauce | 3 ounces milk | 1/4 lb yellow onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar
instructions: In a double boiler, or in a bowl, add water and soak the cod overnight.  Place the cod on the lower rack of the double boiler until dark enough to move and it steams away from the fire.  This will stop the fish breaking off any bones that float and can be picked off with a needle and thread.  This can now be done in the oven, and makes removing any scales that may have leaked back to the pot clean.  Preheat the oven to 375°f put the fish in a roasting pan, pour boiling water over it to keep the fish submerged, and place it under a preheated broiler.  Turn and broil on one side only.  When the fish is done, take it out and let it cool a bit.  Slice very finely.  Place the pieces in bowls, and top with black tea, black soy sauce, milk, and chopped onions.  For the spiced black sauce, in a medium saucepan over medium heat, mix all the ingredients, except the vinegar, together till the liquid is reduced a little bit.  The amount of vinegar will depend on how much of that liquid is used.

title: Mint Margaritas
ingredients: 2 ounces tequila | 1 ounce italian herbs | 1 fresh mint leaf
instructions: Shake well and strain into a salt rimmed martini glass garnish with mint.

title: Turmeric and Pickle Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 75 g smoked salmon, roughly cut | 4 fresh white mushrooms, roughly sliced | 1 green pickle, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 teaspoon turmeric
instructions: Place the smoked salmon, mushrooms, pickle, golden syrup, and turmeric in a large, wide frying pan.  Place over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, for 5 to 6 minutes, or until mushrooms are softened.  Remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Chinese Water Chestnut Soup
ingredients: 6 water chestnuts ( canned, undrained ) | 1 bay leaf ( or other, fresh or dried )
instructions: Drain canned water chestnuts, reserving liquid.  If using fresh garlic press the clove into the water chestnut liquid and use the water chestnut water to rinse off the garlic clove before using.  This will take about 2 tbls.  Water.  You want the saltiness of the water to come out the same as the garlic.  Add water chestnuts to the soup and add bay leaf if using.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: caper,brandy,lime juice,green cardamom pod,oil,heavy cream,corn tortilla
title: Tacos de los Cacatore (Tacos de Costenas)
ingredients: 5 -6 fresh green cardamom pods | 3/4 cup sour dark brandy | 4 tablespoons oil ( neutral flavored ) | 1/4 cup lime juice | 1/4 cup heavy cream ( or half and half ) | 1 -2 cup corn tortilla, finely ( about 10 to 15 ) | 1 -2 tablespoon capers
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix marinade ingredients with a fork then mix.  Set aside.  Heat oil in skillet and fry tortillas several seconds each side to soften, but not crisp.  Place tortillas on paper towels to cool.  Slice tortillas into thin strips or squares.  Arrange strips on a platter.  Spoon some of dipping sauce over tortillas and top with capers.  Serve immediately.  Note, one of the great things about the tacos de las cacatore, the brandy has italian herbs and spices added to it.  It has also taken on a lot of the spice level of other citrus flavings like paprika, basil and anise seeds.  If this is not your ingredient source it would make sense to use a sweeter orange, lemon or lime juice and a a hotter orange.

title: Chinese Cabbage and Potatoes #5FIX
ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes | 8 cups shredded chinese cabbage
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Peel potatoes.  Place on oven rack in a pan sprayed with non stick cooking spray, then place in preheated oven.  Bake, stirring every 10 minutes or so, until soft, about 30 minutes.  Cool, then cut into 1/2 inch rounds about 1/2 inches long.  Return potato slices to pan in slices, coating completely.  Top with cabbage.  Reduce oven temperature to 200 degrees.  Place on a baking sheet.  Bake, uncovered, for 15 - 20 minutes or until cabbage is golden brown and hot.  Serve.

title: Real Simple Cheese
ingredients: 5 ounces grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 hard-boiled eggs
instructions: Put the cheese in an earthenware bowl with the hard boiled eggs.  Beat them together with a spoon and put on top of the cheese, until it is totally covered in cheese.  Microwave for a few minutes in microwave.  Serve hot, room temperature, with a good strong white wine such as a pecorino.

title: Pesto and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups mixed berry ( red onion ) | 1 cup diced red onion | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper | 1 can tomato soup | 3 tablespoons pesto sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Coat a casserole dish with cooking spray.  Layer the vegetables in the baking dish along with the pesto sauce until they are all covered.  Pour the tomato soup over the vegetables.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,lasagna noodle,bulb fennel,spaghetti sauce,italian bread crumb,italian bread,cornstarch
title: Fennel Lasagna Rolled in Noodles
ingredients: 2 cups italian-style dry bread crumbs | 1 1/2 cups chopped bulb fennel | 2 -3 jars spaghetti sauce | 1 tablespoon cornstarch | 2 teaspoons italian bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 9 lasagna noodles, cooked | 9 -12 tablespoons spaghetti sauce | 2 teaspoons seasoned italian bread crumbs | 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/4 cup cornflour
instructions: To make the filling, combine 1 1/2 cups crumbs and 2 - 3 cups of spaghetti sauce.  Cover and refrigerate.  To prepare the noodles, heat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place a layer of noodles so that the sides are covered with a single layer of noodles.  Spoon about 2 tbsps.  Of pasta sauce on each noodle.  Roll up the noodle and place in baking pan.  Repeat with remaining noodles.  To prepare the rolls, dredge the rolls in 1/2 to 1 tsp each cornstarch, seasoned breadcrumbs and remaining 3 cups spaghetti sauce.  Pour the remaining 1 and/2 cups sauce over the rolls.  Top with remaining 3 c.  Sauce.  Bake in the oven for about 1 hour, or until cooked through.  To prepare the cheese sauce, combine 2 tbsps.  Spaghetti sauce and 1/2 tsp of seasoned italian bread crumbs.  Mix well, and cover.  To serve, sprinkle the noodles with the remaining italian bread crumbs.  Drizzle the rolls with sauce.

title: Apple Cauliflower Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 lb mozzarella cheese, diced | 2 tablespoons leeks, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon rice vinegar | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl & add cheese mixture.  Chill until cold.  Roll small amount of mixture into ball or oblong shape, depending on how large the roll is.  Place on cookie sheet & bake at 350° 25 - 30 minutes or till golden brown.  Serve with assorted vegetable accompaniments.

title: Asian Corn Niblets
ingredients: 5 cups frozen corn niblets | 1 piece fresh ginger, peeled grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Mix corn niblets, grated ginger, and 1 cup of water together in a bowl.  Bake in the preheated oven until warmed, 6 to 8 minutes.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,cilantro leaf,black bean sauce,peach,ketjap manis
title: Chilled Sweet Peanut Soup
ingredients: 1 can chopped peaches | 2 tablespoons black bean sauce | 2 tablespoons ketchup or 2 tablespoons chili paste with mango | 1 green bell pepper, chopped | 1/2 teaspoon chopped cilantro leaf
instructions: Drain and reserve juice.  In mixing bowl combine peaches, black bean sauce, ketchup or chili paste and green pepper.  Heat in microwave for 1 minute, or until heated evenly.  Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves.  Serve warm.

title: Mustard-Anise Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1/2 cup dijon-style mustard | 2 tablespoons anise seed
instructions: In a small bowl, mix dijon style mustard and anise seed.  Add mustard mix to your favorite salad dressing, and remix immediately.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,tamari,white bread,baby bok choy,squash,red currant jelly
title: Trinidad Seafood Soup
ingredients: 400 g firm white fish fillets, cut into 2 inch pieces | 2 tablespoons tamari or 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 400 g baby bok choy, quartered and washed ( or other green vegetable ) | 50 g red currant jelly | 5 cups fish stock | 4 slices white bread, toasted, thickly sliced
instructions: Place fish pieces, tamari or soy sauce and bok choy in a large saucepan or large pan and add the stock.  Bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.  Cut the bread slices and toast briefly.  Laddle a cup of the soup into a sieve lined with cheese cloth.  Gently squeeze out excess liquid, then leave to macerate for 5 minutes to cool, then drain.  Serve the soup with toast soldiers or as it is, or slice the pieces and slice the crabsticks or fish.  This soup can also be eaten as a meal at room temperature.

title: Bruschettta on Rye Bread - Filled Pasta
ingredients: 500 g spaghettini | 3 cups icing sugar | fresh basil | 375 g rye bread
instructions: Heat oven to 180c/350f.  Bring a large saucepan of water to boil with 2 tablespoons of salt.  Add the spaghettini and cook according to package directions, or until tender.  Drain well, then set to one side to cool.  Meanwhile, heat the oven to 230 degrees centigrade.  Grease 1 1/2 cup capacity jelly roll pan.  Cut 6 - 6 slices of rye bread, 1/2 inch thick, on the diagonal into 3mm thick slices.  Using a spoon, place a small spoonful of the ryogurt in the centre of each piece of bread – brush the tops with olive oil and spread evenly with the remaining ryogurt.  Using your fingers, gently press a slice of yoghurt between your fingertips to make it spread evenly around each bread slice.  Repeat with the rest of the bread.  Transfer the pastries onto the lined baking sheets and brush the tops with olive oil.  Sprinkle with the basil.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden.  Allow to cool.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: vanilla ice cream,pigeon pea,garam masala,sage leaf,za'atar spice mix,extra virgin olive oil
title: Chef John's Scented Koori
ingredients: 15 ounces pigeon peas, drained and rinsed | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 3 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 4 sage leaves | 1 pint vanilla ice cream
instructions: Place the pigeon peas in a large saucepan with enough water to cover by at least ½ inch.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer gently until they are soft, about 20 minutes.  Remove from the heat and set aside to cool, about 10 minutes.  Process the cooled pigeon peas in a food processor until finely ground.  Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Stir in the garam masala, za’atar, and sage leaves.  When the mixture begins to sizzle, stir in the ground pigeon peas and simmer until the mixture is thick and fragrant, about 10 minutes.  Place the vanilla ice cream onto a plate, and carefully roll a handful of vanilla ice cream into one portion until completely covered in the ice cream.  Set aside until the ice cream has frozen, and then scoop the ice cream into plates.  Serve immediately.  This can be served warm, room temperature, or, store in the refrigerator.

title: Baked French Bread
ingredients: 1/2 lb italian sausage, casings removed | 1/2 lb lean ground veal | 2 loaves soft croissants | chocolate syrup, to drizzle ( optional )
instructions: Brown the sausage over medium heat until almost fully cooked but not crumbed.  Transfer to a small bowl of electric mixer.  Add the veal and mix with well.  Spray the inside of two of the loaves.  Layer with half of the mixture.  Fold the loaves in half, then in half again.  Press the bread closed with an oiled metal spatula using a fork or the back of a rubber spatula.  Slip the folded bread onto a parchment lined baking sheet, using a sharp knife.  Brush the top and sides of the bread with chocolate syrup, if desired.  Bake in a 350 degree f.  Oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes.  Let cool for 10 minutes, then slice.  Serve with additional drizzle of chocolate syrup.

title: Meat Taters
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb ground meat | 2 tablespoons broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Brown meat thoroughly in butter.  Pour into casserole dish and add broth.  Do not remove cover.  Bake 45 minutes.

title: Easy Beef Stir-Fry
ingredients: 2 lbs sirloin, sliced to an even 1/2-inch | 1 teaspoon ginger paste ( or more to taste )
instructions: Put the beef in a bowl with about 1 cup of water.  Toss and marinate at least two hours before cooking, stirring occasionally to make sure the beef is covered in water and getting tender.  Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a skillet over high heat.  The oil should sizzle immediately upon contact, then immediately move the beef and its browned juices into a bowl or baking pan large enough to hold the beef and vegetables.  Toss the beef well with slurry paste.  Serve hot.

title: Mushrooms in Cream (Champignons)
ingredients: 1/2 lb white mushroom, cleaned and chopped ( can use mixed varieties ) | 4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 2 tablespoons heavy cream | 1/4 cup butter or 1/4 cup margarine, melted
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Combine all ingredients except butter in a large bowl.  Stir well to combine.  Divide evenly among 4 individual pie plates.  Top with butter.  Bake in the lower and upper thirds of the oven for 25 minutes, or until top is lightly browned.

title: Lebanese Pizza Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup greek-style dried oregano | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 1 cup greek-style dried pizza sauce
instructions: Mix oregano and ginger paste together in a bowl.  Spread onto pizza dough.  Brush on pizza sauce.

Random Ingredients: fenugreek seed,pesto sauce,nutmeg,grain rice,mango chutney,dark soy sauce
title: Rachael Ray's Yummy Indian Stuffed Rice Balls
ingredients: 1/2 cup long grain rice, cooked ( white or brown ) | 1/2 cup mango chutney ( use mango chutney for authenticity ) or 1/2 cup kalamata olive, chopped ( use mango chutney for authenticity ) | 1/4 cup dark soy sauce or 1/4 cup tamari | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce ( available in asian or indian specialty food stores ) | 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f stir the cooked rice and chutney together until mixed well.  Stir in soy sauce, pesto, fenugreek, nutmeg and additional chutney to taste.  Place rice mixture in a greased 9 x 9 glass baking pan and bake until rice is tender and mixture is bubbling, 30 to 45 minutes.  Cool and break into balls once cooled.  Enjoy.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Stuffed Beef
ingredients: 1 large head outer green cabbage or 1 large head green cabbage, about 1-1/2 pounds ( 3 1/2 pounds each ) | 4 lbs trimmed filet of beef
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f.  Open the cabbage, remove the stalk of the cabbage, and finely shred the leaves.  Cut the head in half crosswise and place one half and half of the chopped cabbage in a roasting pan.  Cut the remaining head of cabbage crosswise into 1 1/2 lengths and place on top of the cabbage in the pan.  Wrap the beef tightly in foil, put a lid on and bake until the beef is fork tender, about 1 hour and 20 minutes for a medium rare beef.  Let beef sit for 15 minutes before carving.  Discard the foil.  Serve with crusty bread and salad.

title: Crock Pot Apricot Chickpeas and Olives

instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot.  Cover and cook on low for 4 hours.  Serve with chapati, naan bread, rice, or with pita bread.

Random Ingredients: grenadine,broiler fryer chicken,heavy whipping cream,banana,mango,orange,farfalle pasta
title: Farfalle Chicken in Avocado Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 broiler-fryer chickens | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1 large ripe mango - peeled, seeded and cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 bananas, sliced | 1 orange, juiced | 1 dash grenadine
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the bow tie pasta at a boil, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, but still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.  Drain and transfer to a serving bowl.  Pour enough pasta water into the saucepan to cover the chicken.  Bring the cream to a boil in a large skillet over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer until the sauce reduces by half, about 5 minutes.  Stir the mango and banana into the cream sauce.  Remove the chicken from the sauce and set aside until cool, about 10 minutes.  Heat an oven proof skillet over medium high heat.  Brush the chicken with olive oil.  Cook chicken in the hot skillet until browned and no longer pink inside, about 5 minutes on each side.  Remove the chicken from the skillet.  Add the orange juice to the sauce.

Random Ingredients: cocoa powder,tahini,black pepper,celery rib,dill pickle,curry paste,peanut
title: Curried Cabbage
ingredients: 2 celery ribs, diced | 2 tablespoons dijon style cocoa powder | 2 tablespoons sesame tahini | 1 -2 tablespoon curry paste | fresh ground black pepper | 1 small dill pickle, diced ( optional ) | 4 -6 tablespoons unsalted dry roasted peanuts, roughly chopped ( optional )
instructions: Gently mix the celery with the cocoa, tahini, curry paste, and black pepper.  Add the diced pickle and peanuts and stir with a knife to incorporate.  Serve immediately.

title: Cafe Rio Mocha

instructions: Combine coffee and chili pepper in a cocktail shaker.  Shake and strain into a highball glass filled with ice.

title: Crisp Mustard with Oatmeal
ingredients: 500 g oatmeal | 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast | 1/4 cup rice vinegar | 1/2 cup dijon mustard
instructions: Toast oatmeal until golden.  Combine all ingredients together in a large bowl, cover and set aside in a warm place.  When the mixture has cooled, place on baking paper and bake until the ryemeal is dry.

title: Phulk-Beef Satay

instructions: Cut the meat in 4 slices and then cut those into strips.  Mix the peanut butter, ketchup, cumin, and thyme together and then add the meat strips, one piece at a time. Cover the satay with the satay wrap and enjoy.

instructions: Combine all ingredients except greens and refrigerate overnight to allow flavors to mingle. title: Chinese Salad Salad With Vegetable Frying Oil
ingredients: 2 2/3 cups mixed salad greens or 2 2/3 cups mixed salad greens | 1/4 cup vegetable oil | 4 teaspoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to boil.  Put 2 tablespoons of the chopped vegetables or herbs with all the dressing and mix together.  Pour over the salad and toss all ingredients together.

title: Pineapple Raisin Bread  for Breakfast or Dinner
ingredients: 1 cup raisin bread, stale, cut into 1/2-inch cubes | 1/4 cup pineapple juice | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon
instructions: Put all ingredients into a small microwavable bowl, and microwave on high for 50 seconds.  Stir and serve.

title: Italian Hot Chocolate

instructions: Spray an 11x7 glass baking dish with non stick cooking spray.  Spread chopped tomatoes in dish.  Place bacon and cocoa powder in a small bowl. title: Hot, Sweet and Creamy Pineapple Cranberry Chip Dip
ingredients: 15 fresh crushed pineapple | 1 can ranch-style beans, drained | 1 jar salsa | 1/2 cup white flour | 2 tablespoons crushed hot red pepper flakes | 16 slices graham crackers, crushed, or as needed ( optional )
instructions: Place the crushed pineapple into a saucepan along with the ranch style beans and salsa.  Cover, and heat over medium heat until hot and bubbling. Let cool thoroughly, and pour into a serving bowl.  Serve with crackers for dipping.

title: Coriander and Onion Ricotta Balls - Reduced Fat
ingredients: 400 g low-fat ricotta cheese | 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix | 1/3 cup coriander powder ( dry )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Shape into balls that are roughly the same size as your palm.  Bake at 150 degrees for about 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Kangaroo Mince Casserole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon savoy cabbage, shredded | 1 beef roast | 250 ml milk powder | 1 serrano chilies or 1 jalapeno, deseeded and chopped | 600 ml milk
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°c/fan 160°c/gas combine the cheese, coriander leaves and chillies/jalapeno in a large, shallow ovenproof dish.  Stir in the meat.  Pour in the milk.  Cover the dish with foil and bake for 1hrs.  Remove the casserole and remove the foil.  Leave for a further 30 mins to thicken the sauce.

title: Asian Style Steak Salad

instructions: Mix rice and sugar in a bowl.  Combine water and demerara sugar in a small pan.  Bring to the boil and simmer for 3 minutes, or until sugar dissolves. Sprinkle with the shredded iceberg lettuce just before serving, or if you don't have this option, just use any other greens you like.

title: Spicy Mexican Chili Dip
ingredients: 1 can green enchilada sauce | 12 ounces hamburger | 1 tablespoon amaretto, almond or almond oil | 5 -6 cherry tomatoes, sliced ( optional! )
instructions: Brown hamburger in a medium amount of oil in a frying pan.  Once the hamburger is browned add the cherry tomatoes and simmer for 2 minutes.  Add the green enchilada sauce and simmer on low for 5 minutes.  If necessary, stir to keep from burning.  The taste and texture should be a little different.  Pour into a glass bowl and serve hot.

title: Macaroon Cheesecake
ingredients: 2 cans macaroon macaroons, drained thoroughly | 2 packages philadelphia cream cheese, softened | 2 teaspoons lemon juice
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Mix softened cream cheese, lemon juice, and macaroon until well blended.  Spread into a 9x9 inch cake pan, spread evenly.  Bake at 350f for 25 to 30 minutes, or until light brown.  Cool.

title: Simple Platanos Maduros
ingredients: 4 peeled plantains | 2 tablespoons sugar | 4 -8 tablespoons cherries
instructions: Peel the plantains.  Slice lengthwise, then slice crosswise into about 1/2 inch thick rounds.  Place in a bowl or baking dish with plenty of water in which they have been soaking overnight.  Drain off the water and pat plantains completely dry.  Place them again in the bowl.  Sprinkle the slices with plenty of sugar and plenty of cherries inside, or toss them all in the bowl before arranging the plate or other individual serving bowls.  Cover and keep overnight.  The next day, remove from the bowl and allow to cool.  You can eat them, or keep in your refrigerator until served as a snack.

title: Totally Sinful Coffee
ingredients: 3 tablespoons instant coffee ( instant-hot ) | 1 3/4 cups boiling water | 2 cans condensed tomato puree | 1/3 cup icing sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped tomato concentrate
instructions: In a medium bowl, stir the instant coffee and boiling water.  Pour into a 2 cup capacity slow cooker.  Add the tomato purée, icing sugar and tomato concentrate.  Mix well.  Cover and cook on low heat setting for 4 hours to make a firmer consistency.  Stir well before serving if desired.  This can be reheated in a slow cooker.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,simple syrup,thyme sprig,tea,italian turkey sausage,oregano,french bread cube,food coloring
title: Italian Turkey Sausage Stuffing
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fish stock | 1 3/4 cups hearty brioche bread cubes | 8 ounces mild italian turkey sausage, casings removed | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh oregano or 2 tablespoons chopped fresh oregano | 2 tablespoons simple syrup | 2 tablespoons snipped fresh thyme sprigs | 1 1/2 teaspoons clear non-alcoholic coffee or 1 1/2 teaspoons strong tea | food coloring ( optional )

title: Chickpea Burritos

Bake at 425 degrees for 20 - 25 minutes, or until crisp and light golden.

title: Mexican Meat Chowder

instructions: Peel potatoes.

title: Taco Bell Oil for Home Frying

instructions: In a large frypan, combine the sugar, olive oil and the olive oil.  Stir to dissolve the sugar.  Heat over medium heat until the sugar has completely dissolved and the mixture forms a creamy golden syrup.  Stir frequently to prevent burning.  Cover and let stand until cool, at least 24 hours, stirring occasionally.  Pour into airtight containers and serve, or store in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

instructions: Combine rolled horseradish with steak, fat side up, using just enough horseradish to coat each side of the roll.  Place rolls, fat side up, on baking sheet.  Remove fat on meat.  Bake at 400°f.  For 20 to 25 minutes or until fish is heated through.

Random Ingredients: maple syrup,granny smith apple,ranch dressing mix,provolone cheese,red wine vinegar
title: Spicy Apple Dip!
ingredients: 2 granny smith apples | 3 tablespoons maple syrup | 3 tablespoons ranch dressing mix | 3 slices provolone cheese | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Peel the apples and cut them into 2 or 3 wedges depending on size.  I find it easier to get one of the apple wedges and a wedge of one of the apple buds then roughly chop the other wedge to fit into the food processor or whiz.  Dice the cheese and drizzle into a small serving bowl.  In the food processor add the maple syrup, ranch dressing mix and vinegar.  Pulse a few times to combine.  Pour apples, cheese and syrup over the cheese, then stir gently so that everything gets coated.  Serve warm or chilled.

title: Duck With Bean Threads
ingredients: 1 duck, small pieces | 2 teaspoons baking soda | 4 teaspoons sugar cubes | 5 tablespoons strong fresh coriander, coarsely chopped | 200 g bean thread noodles | fried bean thread noodles
instructions: Remove any excess fat or skin from the duck and slash it along the back with sharp knife marks.  Place the duck in a roasting tin, skin side up.  In a small bowl combine the baking soda and 3 teaspoons of the sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves.  Sprinkle the egg and sugar mixture over the duck and then scatter the coriander over the duck skin.  Roast in a preheated oven, 200c 375f grades fahrenheit for 45 - 60 minutes, basting regularly until the duck is tender when pierced with a skewer.  During the last 10 minutes of roasting, make the bean thread noodles following the recipe instructions.  While the duck skin is cooking, boil a pot of water.  Add the bean thread noodles and cook until tender.  Drain the noodles.  Pour the noodles into a serving bowl.  Spoon the duck skin onto the noodles.  Serve with fried bean threads.

title: Spiced Bacon Wrapped Bakery
ingredients: 1 package phyllo pastry sheets | 375 g bacon drippings | 600 g saffron | 250 ml plain flour ( i use cornflour ) | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat the oven to 230oc/450of/gas line a baking tray with baking paper or oiled clingfilm.  Lay 1 phyllo onto each other, one at a time.  Using a large knife, cut down the length of each phyllo sheet so they form 18 sheets.  Place 2 sheets on top of each other and brush lightly with the bacon drippings.  Sprinkle with a pinch of saffron.  Mix the flour and a pinch of saffron and rub in a knife.  Add the liquid smoke and a good pinch of salt.  Spread some into a sausage shape on each phyllo sheet.  Cut a half inch slash in the centre of each.  Bake for about 20 minutes.  Allow to cool on the baking tray.

Random Ingredients: cheddar cheese,cooking oil,pecorino romano cheese,green cardamom pod
title: Aunt Jenny's Favorite Cheese
ingredients: 1 head cheddar cheese, shredded ( about 1/2 pound ) | 1 package pecorino-romano cheese, grated ( about 4 ounces ) | 10 green cardom pods, thinly sliced | 1/4 cup cooking oil
instructions: Cut a slit down one side of each cardamom pod and scrape out the bitter white pulp with a spoon.  Fill a large skillet with enough cooking oil to cover the bottom and heat over medium heat.  When the oil is hot crack the cardamom pods in half, being very careful not to pierce the pods.  Remove the seeds with a slotted spoon and press the pulp against the oil to flatten.  This should take no more than 5 minutes.  If the oil is not smoking, stir in just 1/3 cup of the cheese and set the heat right down.  When the oil is hot pour the oil into a large heatproof casserole dish or frying pan and place the coated cardamom pods and scraped pulp into the skillet.  Cook, shaking the skillet a few times, until the cheese has melted, about 15 minutes.  It seems likely that most of the cheese still has some moisture in it, so add more oil, a few tablespoons at a time.  When the cheese is nice and creamy transfer to a serving bowl and serve hot.

title: Cauliflower Deli With Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Pimento
ingredients: 2 heads cauliflower florets | 10 ounces frozen chopped spring onion | 2 ounces pimiento, chopped | 1/4 cup red wine, such as merlot | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato, coarsely chopped
instructions: Place cauliflower florets on a baking pan, drizzle with olive oil and bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees f/190 degrees c for 30 minutes.  Drain excess oil from pan, then add onions and pimentos and cook on low heat for 3 - 4 minutes.  Pour red wine and sun dried tomatoes into pan.  Heat to boiling, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.  Stir in spring onions & pimento and cook for 3 - 5 minutes more.  Serve warm.

title: Ski Slice
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 1 tablespoon liquid honey | 1 ounce apple juice ( optional ) | 3 apples, finely diced | 1 tablespoon splenda granular ( granular )
instructions: Brown ground beef, drain and leave in pan.  Add liquid honey to pan, apple juice and sugar and boil until sugar dissolves, add the diced apples.  When the mixture almost reaches the boiling point, pour into a greased loaf pan, put a tin pie dish on top then sprinkle with splenda.  Bake at 350f for 1 hour or until set.  Turn out onto cooling rack.  Let sit for one hour before slicing.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Breakfast Muesli

instructions: Place the bacon, soy milk, and tomatoes in a blender or food processor and blitz to a medium creamy consistency.  Spoon the muesli into 6 dessert dishes, about 1/2 centimetre thick.  Top with the sun dried tomatoes and serve immediately.

title: Chili & Coriander Rice

instructions: Place rice in a non metallic bowl.  Add chillies and ginger.  Sprinkle with sweet rice wine until combined.  Refrigerate and serve.

Toss the asian parsnips in just the sesame dressing and store in an airtight container.

title: Rich Choclo

instructions: Trim fat from meat.  Cut meat across grain into thin slices that are 1 inch x 2 inches.  Combine meat and remaining ingredients in a shallow baking dish or roasting pan, making sure meat is covered.  Cover and place in the refrigerator for 2 hours and up to overnight.  Preheat oven to 350°.

instructions: Mix cheddar cheese, red chile peppers, chipotle chiles in a bowl.  Serve warm.
