instructions: Trim fat from goat meat.  Place in crock pot.  Add bacon, onion, and chocolate pieces.  Add vinegar.  Cover and cook on low for 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.  Remove meat from bone and slice cross grain into strips.  Remove meat and slice into thin triangles or strips as desired.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Press matzoh cookies into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Mix apples and mushroom soup together in a bowl.

instructions: In a food processor or blender, mix the margarine, ranch dressing, and enchilada sauce until smooth.

title: Mini Spareribs With Fresh Strawberries, Parsnips and Snow Peas
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/4 lb fresh flat crab, cleaned | 3 -5 large parsnips, peeled and sliced lengthwise into 1/2 inch rounds | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs spareribs | 1 jar taco sauce ( store bought or homemade ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh mixed cut strawberries | 1 1/2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided
instructions: Preheat grill.  Bring large pot of generously salted water to boil.  Using a slotted spoon, remove crab and remove any excess water.  Tear crab meat into rough bite size chunks.  Arrange the ribs in a glass baking dish.  Spread taco sauce evenly over the ribs.  Top evenly with parsnips, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours.  Drain and discard any remaining taco sauce.  Remove plastic wrap.  Rinse and pat dry the spareribs.  Lightly brush both sides of the ribs with taco sauce, using some of the marinade.  Grill ribs over hot coals of medium heat, brushing once with remaining marinade, until crispy, about 10 - 15 minutes, turning once.  Set aside to cool.  Cut a slit down each shortrib in half through the length to within 1/2 inch.  Reserve ends, removing as many pieces as possible.  Starting at the wide end, wrap each meatball in a strip alternating with one slice of parsnip, and one sunday roll, securing with a tooth pick.  Place in a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish, alternating with remaining ingredients, and brushing as you lay them in the pan.  Cover the dish with foil and cook until heated through, turning the ribs half way through cooking, about 20 minutes.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, 5 to 10 minutes.  Can also be served with a salad and garlic bread or crusty bread.

title: Pesto Raisin Salad Dressing

instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the pesto and raisins.  Cover tightly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or for up to 2 days.

title: Cremini Mushrooms

instructions: Preheat the oven broiler and place the mushrooms on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle each with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon oregano.  Broil until the mushrooms are light golden brown and the stems are crackling, about 10 minutes.

title: Apricot & Basil Spread
ingredients: 150 g apricot preserves | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 1 tablespoon finely shredded basil ( optional )
instructions: Place apricot preserves & 1 tbsp of the garam masala in a food processor & process until smooth.  Add remaining ingredients & process until smooth & mix well.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

instructions: In a salad bowl, toss the romaine with the sun dried tomatoes.  Heat the sun dried tomato paste in a non stick frying pan in a few drops of cooking oil until very warm, add it quickly to the salad and toss well.

instructions: In a pot melt brown sugar, add paprika, green cardamom pods, and tomato paste.  Stir to combine.  Add can of condensed soup to mixture in pot with brown sugar mixture.  Heat thoroughly.

Serve immediately accompanied by your favorite hot sauce.

instructions: Drain the soaked beans and place in a large saucepan with the boiling water.

title: Dill Filling for Pancakes
ingredients: 1/3 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/3 cup coconut milk | 3 tablespoons dried dill
instructions: Place the confectioners' sugar and coconut milk into a small saucepan over medium heat.  Heat and stir until the margarine is melted.  Stir in the dill.  Refrigerate until chilled, about 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: dark chocolate,creamy peanut butter,dill seed,sirloin tip roast,paprika,pasta,ginger root
title: Aunt Margaret's Savory Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1 sirloin tip roast, fat trimmed and sliced into thin strips | 1 cup chopped fresh dill seed | 1 can chopped dark chocolate | 1 package dry pasta | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger root | 1 can creamy peanut butter
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, stir together the dill seed, dark chocolate and paprika.  Place the sirloin tip in a saucepan with the chocolate mixture.  Cover and cook over medium heat until meat is browned, about 10 minutes.  Remove meat and set aside.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

title: Beef With Lime (Aquagrill Variation)
ingredients: 1/2 cup fresh turmeric ( gulin or turmeric is ok ) | 1/2 lb beef roast, cut into 1 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch rectangles or 1/2 lb beef stew meat, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2 thick slices
instructions: Preheat oven to 300ºf.  Place 2 inches worth of water on the bottom of a large baking dish and set aside for beef.  Place the turmeric in a blender and blend until it has formed a thick paste about 10 minutes.  Put the beef in the prepared baking dish and coat it well with the paste.  Cover tightly with foil and foil and transfer to the oven.  Bake, covered, until medium rare, about 90 minutes.  Remove the pan juices and discard.  Skim any fat from the surface and serve the broth warm.

title: Ravioli
ingredients: 3 cups whole wheat flour | 1 cup whole rotini pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Stir flour and pasta together in a bowl.  Add more if it seems very dry.

title: Lettuce With Bechamel Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 head boston lettuce | 4 tablespoons butter, divided | 1/2 cup canola oil
instructions: Remove the outer leaves from the lettuce and pat it dry with paper towels.  Slice the lettuce crosswise into 1/4 slices.  Whisk 1 tablespoon of the butter with the oil.  Put the remaining tablespoon of butter and oil into a small skillet over medium heat.  When the butter has melted, add the lettuce and stir to coat with butter and oil.  Spoon over the greens and toss to coat.  Serve immediately.

title: Peach and Ricotta Filling
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs firm ripe peaches, peel removed and pit removed | 1 lb ricotta cheese
instructions: Slice all the pieces of peaches and slice in half again.  Mix ricotta cheese with a little water to make creamy consistency.  Add a couple of pieces of plastic wrap and put in freezer for about half an hour while making the filling.  Poke holes all over the cheese with a fork and pour in the olive oil to coat.  To serve slice thinly and put on plate.  The filling will thicken and look a bit runny.

title: Bittersweet Chocolate Chips Bread
ingredients: 16 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips, cut into pieces ( preferably bittersweet ) | 1/3 cup anise seed ( or a small pinch ground sesame seeds ) | 2 cups toasted bread or 2 cups other flat bread, crusts removed | 1 1/2 cups finely chopped green or white chocolate pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 400°f on a baking sheet, lightly grease and flour the baking sheet.  Whisk together the chocolate chips and anise seeds in a small bowl until well combined.  Toast bread in the oven, watching closely for it to turn a rich golden brown.  Cool, and toss with the chocolate mixture.  Spread mixture on a cooling rack, and let cool completely.  Chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour or overnight, or until thoroughly chilled.  Melt chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water.  Remove from heat, cover, and let set for 5 minutes or until melted and smooth.  Stir in the green or white chocolate pieces and remove from heat.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Blueberry Rice - Arroz Con Leche
ingredients: 1/3 cup light brown rice | 1/2 - 1 cup ginger ale | 1/3 cup blueberries | 4 tablespoons sliced ripe olives
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot.  Bring to boil, cover and reduce to simmer.  Leave for 10 - 15 minutes to allow flavors to infuse.  Remove from heat and fluff with fork.

title: Shredded Beef
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 2 tablespoons apple or 2 tablespoons apricots, coarsely chopped | 1 teaspoon onion powder | 2 cans pineapple chunks, drained and reserve juice
instructions: Place meat in a crockpot.  Add all remaining ingredients.  I sometimes add a little cayenne pepper.  Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours.

Random Ingredients: pepperoni,sea salt,greek yogurt,iceberg lettuce,jalapeno chile,poblano pepper,bouillon cube,white wine vinegar
title: Parsley Pepperoni Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 16 ounces shredded iceberg lettuce | 4 ounces crumbled pepperoni | 1 ounce chopped poblano pepper ( roasted ) | 1 ounce chopped jalapeno chile ( optional ) | 6 beef bouillon cubes | 1/3 cup dry white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup low fat greek yogurt | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt ( or to taste )
instructions: Place lettuce on platter.  Mix remaining ingredients.  Toss with lettuce.  Enjoy.

title: Smoked Turkey and Grecian Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1/3 lb leftover turkey ( i used frozen cooked italian turkey ) | 1 1/4 cups leftover rice, i used leftover rotisserie | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1 cup shredded monterey jack cheese | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1 teaspoon dried chopped chili | 2 teaspoons dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Combine the turkey, rice and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 2 quart shallow baking dish.  Sprinkle the 2 teaspoons dried tarragon, chili, 1/4 teaspoon cayenne and 2 teaspoons dried tarragon over the turkey mixture.  Cover tightly and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until rice is tender.  Uncover.  Sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella and 1/2 cup monterey jack cheese over the cheese.  Bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until cheese starts to brown.  Remove dish from oven.  Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese over the cheese.  Cover and return to the oven to melt the cheese. .  Let sit for 5 minutes before serve.

title: Cucumbers With Maple Syrup
ingredients: 1 tablespoon maple syrup, plus more to drizzle | 1 teaspoon sesame seeds, toasted | 1 large cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, and seeded | 1/3 cup pomegranate molasses ( pomegranate liqueur )
instructions: Heat maple syrup and sesame seeds in a heavy small skillet over medium heat.  Set aside to cool, about 5 minutes.  Halve cucumber lengthwise, scoop out seeds with a spoon, and cut each half into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Spread pomegranate molasses on a large plate.  Add cucumbers, and season with sea salt and freshly ground p.  Hint, p.  S.  As in p.  J. , seeds and membrane from syrup may be removed if desired.

Random Ingredients: olive oil cooking spray,pecorino romano cheese,date,chili garlic sauce,brown onion,bean sprout
title: Spicy and Delicious Party Dessert
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil flavored cooking spray | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 medium brown onion, diced | 1/2 cup frozen miniature dates, cut in half ( i like the ones from trader joe's deli's ) | 3/4 - 1 cup bean sprouts | 3 tablespoons pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated | 1 -2 dash chili-garlic sauce ( optional )
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, heat 1 - 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat.  Add onions and cook until translucent, about 3 min, stir in the dates, and sauté, stirring often, 4 - 6 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in bean sprouts, 1 tsp grated pecorino romano, and chili garlic sauce, if using.  Spray a small bowl with cooking spray.  Toss the topping with warm onion mixture and refrigerate in an airtight container, for a few hours to chill.  Can be served either warm or chilled.  Serve with crackers.

title: Parmigiana (Pita Bread)
ingredients: 250 g cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed if possible ) | 100 g fresh ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 1 teaspoon sweet hungarian paprika
instructions: Place the drained cannellini beans in a bowl and cover with cold water.  Allow to soak for 20 minutes.  Drain well and squeeze out excess water.  Place the drained cannellini beans in a food processor or blender and puree thoroughly.  Meanwhile combine the ricotta, soda bi carb, and paprika in a bowl and mix well.  Add the cannellini bean puree and mix well.  Divide into 4 serving sized mounds onto a baking tray.  Heat a griddle, griddle pan, or frying pan to medium heat.  Pour a couple of teaspoons of oil onto the griddle, or alternatively place your griddle inside the serving plates with a small flameproof bowl on top.  Gently cook each of the mounds of cannellini bean puree for 5 minutes on both sides until crisp and lightly coloured.  Serve straight away.

Random Ingredients: chuck,white sugar,sherry,red chili pepper,thai chile,lemon,spinach leaf,jicama
title: Thai-Style Mini Meatballs
ingredients: 12 spinach leaves, washed, drained | 12 large jicama, peeled and julienned | 1 red chili pepper, chopped | 6 dried thai chiles | 1/2 cup white sugar | 12 ounces ground chuck | 1 tablespoon dry sherry | 1 lemon, juiced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Place spinach leaves, jicama, red chili pepper, thai chiles, and sugar in a large bowl.  Stir in sherry and lemon juice.  Stir until dissolved.  Divide dough into 12 balls.  Place 1 meatball in center of each spinach leaf.  Roll, then pinch the edges firmly closed with a fork.  Place on the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven, 20 minutes.

title: Baked Pork With Orange and Chilli
ingredients: 1 red chili pepper | 1 small orange pepper | 3 tablespoons rice wine ( shao xe ploy ) | 4 pork fillets
instructions: Preheat oven to 180c/355f.

Random Ingredients: rice noodle,chicken bouillon granule,shrimp,baking powder,chard leaf,dill,clam
title: Clam Soup (From Vegweb)
ingredients: 2 cups raw shrimp, finely chopped | 6 cups water, divided ( if using canned shrimp use more or less ) | 2 packages shrimp bouillon granules | 8 -10 small chard leaves, cleaned and shredded ( or 1 medium sized bunch cilantro chopped ) or 1/2 lb chopped green onion ( 1 medium sized bunch cilantro chopped ) | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1/2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules or 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 tablespoon fresh dill ( or 1/2 teaspoons dried dill ) | rice noodles or wide egg noodles ( optional )
instructions: If using shrimp, chop them, and set aside.  In a saucepan, bring 5 cups of water to boil over medium heat.  Mix 1 pkg.  Shrimp bouillon granules and enough water to just cover shrimp, and add to boiling water.  Add all other ingredients plus chopped shrimp, mixing well.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat.  Cover and simmer 45 minutes.  If using frozen shrimp, defrost in microwave and add now, mixing well.  Serve in bowls or with cooked rice noodles.

title: Strawberry Oyster Nests
ingredients: 24 large fresh oysters, shucked | cooking spray | fresh strawberries, washed and stems removed | 2 tablespoons pesto sauce | wasabi powder, as desired
instructions: Place oysters in a medium size bowl.  Lightly brush 1/2 teaspoon wasabi on tops of oysters.  Sprinkle pesto on tops of each oyster.  Sprinkle lightly with wasabi.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight.  Spray cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Uncover and bake in 450 degree oven for 10 to 12 minutes or until tops of oysters are lightly browned but centers are still slightly soft.  Remove from oven and stir to loosen oysters from shells.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Taramosalata
ingredients: 1/2 lb red skinless trout, in the shell | 5 -6 fresh chili peppers | 4 -6 tablespoons chervil, coarsely chopped | 1 lb egg noodles or 1 lb vermicelli, cooked and drained
instructions: Using a sharp paring knife, pick out the coarse intestinal vein.  Rinse the trout, removing the gills.  Cut each in half crosswise.  Remove the head and tail.  Chop the body into small chunks.  Cut the chilies in half.  In a deep frying pan heat 2 tablespoons of the oil with the chilies, stirring well.  Remove from the heat and add the liver to the pan.  Stir well and saute the liver on one side until it begins to brown.  Turn the heat back up and add the trout pieces.  Quickly roll the trout pieces around in the liver pan, turning the contents occasionally to coat them with the hot oil.

ingredients: 4 tortillas ( green, brown or white ) | 2 chicken stock cubes | 200 g chicken | 1/2 cup crushed ice water | 3 tablespoons ground mace | 1/2 cup red bell pepper, diced
instructions: Chop the chicken and peppers and saute in a pan till soft.  Drain on paper towels.  Add the chicken back to the pan and mix.  Add 1/2 to 1 cup of the crushed ice water and mix.  Once all the ingredients are mixed, put everything into the blender and blend till smooth like you do no food processor.  Pour into bowl and serve.

title: Mung Bean Sprouts and Sausage Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 large apple | 4 cups mung bean sprouts | 2 tablespoons za'atar spice mix | 1/4 teaspoon chili sauce | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 1/8 teaspoon chili sauce | 3/4 teaspoon dried fenugreek seeds | 2 teaspoons dried italian sausage or 2 teaspoons kofta ( indian or kenyan-style sausage )
instructions: Peel and core apple, then cut into chunks.  Place apple in 6 quart dutch oven or 6 quart pot. instructions: Combine vinegar and mushroom soup.  Heat until boiling and pour over crawfish.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Stir in chiles, mustard and shrimp.  Chill 15 minutes.  Place in shallow serving bowl, cover and refrigerate up to 5 hours.  Sprinkle shrimp over soup.

title: Lettuce and Triple Sec

instructions: Wash the lettuce and watercress and dry.  Wash triples sec in a cheese cloth.  Place tri triples sec, herbs, margarine and a little crushed juniper in a deep non stick pan.  Cover and let stand for about 20 minutes stirring gently so herbs do not burn.  When mixture begins to bubble, drain excess liquid.  Let cool and store in refridgerator.

title: Chocolate-Cucumber Bean Curd
ingredients: 6 cups refried beans ( i use homemade ) | 1/2 english cucumber, thinly sliced | 4 ounces semi-sweet chocolate chips | 2 teaspoons monosodium glutamate ( optional ) | 2 teaspoons vanilla beans ( optional )
instructions: In mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients and mash together into the refried beans.  Cover and chill for 2 hours or overnight.  Just before serving, break apart the chocolate chips into smaller pieces and sprinkle over the top of the curd when serving.

title: Emotion
ingredients: 2 tablespoons millet flour | 1 medium avocado, ripe | 1 1/2 cups tomato puree | 2 tablespoons irish whiskey | 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons liquid smoke
instructions: Combine millet flour, avocado, tomato puree, whiskey, worcestershire sauce, and liquid smoke.

title: Pistachio Pasta With Chorizo

instructions: In a large pan on a med low heat, put the chorizo in with 2 tbsp water.  Cook on both side, until golden.  Set aside.  Meanwhile cook the penne to your liking.  Drain the pasta, then put it aside to dry.  Remove the casing from the chorizo and slice it like you would pizza dough for pizza dough.  Set aside.  Place the pistachios in a small pan, cover and toast for 8 10min.  Set aside.  Increase the heat under the pan to medium and cook the pistachios for about 5 minutes on each side.  Drain the excess fat, then set aside.

title: Cashew Riced Vermicelli With Marsala
ingredients: 3 cups vermicelli ( not short pasta ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 1/4 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Cook vermicelli in a large pot of boiling, salted water until al dente.  Drain.  Coat a 12 cup ramekin inside with spray of oil.  Toss vermicelli with 1/4 cup hot marsala and 1/4 cup parmigiano and sprinkle over the vermicelli.  Top with remaining vermicelli and remaining 1/4 cup hot marsala and 1/4 cup cheese.

Random Ingredients: fine sea salt,chipotle chile adobo,butter margarine,poblano chile,soymilk,root beer,potato
title: Smoky Chilli Cream
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter or margarine | 1 poblano chile, minced | 2 poblano chiles, minced | 1 bag simply potatoes diced potatoes with onion | 1/2 - 3 cup root beer ( i used labne ) | 1/4 teaspoon fine sea salt | 1 chipotle chile in adobo, minced | 2 tablespoons sainty fine sea salt or 2 tablespoons kosher salt | 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted
instructions: First day ahead of making the brine, melt butter in frying pan, add poblano and chiles and saute a couple of minutes.  Remove from heat and allow poblano mixture to cool. Add remaining potato liquid into blender and puree until smooth.  Add chipotle pepper in adobo.  Mix well.  Serve chilled.

instructions: Cut the potatoes lengthwise into halves and then into quarters.  Place in a pot and cover with water.  Bring to a boil and then simmer over medium heat until fork tender.  This will take about 20 minutes.  Drain well and then cool under cold water before peeling.  Cut the potatoes into quarters and boil until tender.  Drain well and rinse the lettuce if desired.  Cut the basil leaves in half, and then half into bite size pieces.  Shred the strawberries and place in a bowl with the grated potatoes, black olives, basil, brandy or Bourbon if using.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Celery, Vinegar & Celery
ingredients: 2 celery ribs | 4 2 pints veg stock or 4 pints vegetable stock
instructions: Remove the leafy outer leaves from the celery & discard.  Place all of the ingredients in a large pan & cook gently, on the low heat or in an oven heated to 190c for about 3 hours, or until the celery is tender.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,chile,yogurt,gelatin,yukon gold potato,baking powder
title: Chocolate Chilled Potato Enchiladas
ingredients: 2 pints yukon gold potatoes, peeled and cut into bite size pieces | 8 ounces containers low-fat yogurt, plain | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 tablespoon unflavored gelatin | 1 teaspoon baking powder | 1 teaspoon canned diced chiles ( optional )
instructions: Mix potato and yogurt in medium saucepan over medium heat until potatoes are warmed through.  Remove from heat.  Let sit until potatoes reach room temperature.  Pour warmed potato mixture in bowl and sprinkle gelatin over, then stir to combine.  Pour hot potato mixture over yolks and stir until incorporated, then set saucepan over low heat.  Stirring continuously, cook mixture to soften, 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove from heat, stir in enchilada sauce, gelatin, baking powder, chiles and salt and pepper to taste.  Set aside, covered, until serving.

title: Veal Salad (Muamba Namju)

instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.  Toss and refrigerate until serving at once if you wish to serve it cold.

title: Chile Sprouts - Ww 4 Points
ingredients: 3 tablespoons salsa or 3 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 teaspoons dried ancho chiles or 2 teaspoons dried pasilla chiles | 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped arbol chiles or 1 1/2 cups coarsely ground chiles | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups coarsely chopped bean sprouts ( i prefer chafing onions and red bell peppers )
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the chili and arbol.

title: Japanese Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 quarts water | 1 pound beef chuck, thinly sliced | 2 packages ramen noodles | 1/3 cup anchovy paste | 1 tablespoon almond flavoring, or to taste | lettuce
instructions: Divide beef between 2 large soup bowls, and pour water over them.  Bring a saucepan of water to a boil, and stir in ramen noodles.  Boil until noodles are tender and are easy to remove, about 2 minutes.  Drain, and transfer noodles to soup bowls.  Place anchovy paste in a small skillet over medium low heat, and heat the anchovy paste until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,cider vinegar,baby carrot,farfalle pasta,mint leaf,plain yogurt,ice water,fruit
title: Chicken and Wild Rice Salad

instructions: Boil the pasta, drain, rinse with cold water and set aside.  Cut the chicken into 6 - 6 pieces each and boil for 7 minutes until the water has mostly evaporated. Add the yogurt to the bowl, and stir until combined.  Mix in the mint leaves and fresh mint leaves.  Place the drained pasta in an ovenproof bowl and spoon the chicken on top of the pasta.  Pour the marinade over the chicken and vegetables.  Cover with the lid of the dish and microwave on high for 10 minutes.  Leave for 5 minutes.  The chicken will still be cooked if you like a bit of bite.  To help cool for a few minutes, remove the lid and stir in the ice cold water to get the dressing right.

title: Quick and Easy Cabbage Barley Raita
ingredients: 6 cups finely shredded red cabbage | 2 1/4 cups pearl barley | 1/4 teaspoon fennel
instructions: Drain cabbage well and stir in barley.  Let stand for 4 to 5 hours and serve.

title: Shrimp and Rice Salad on Spinach for 2

instructions: Combine juice, 1/4 tsp.  Spice, and 1/4 tsp.  Cajun seasoning in a large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Cover and refrigerate for up to six hours.  Serve chilled.

Remove from oven and cool in pan.  Serve warm with apricot syrup.

title: Brown Beans Extraordinaire
ingredients: 2 cans brown beans, including liquid | extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Pour enough boiling water into a large bowl to cover the beans.  Drain the beans in a colander.  Mix the reserved liquid with just enough olive oil to make a smooth paste, adding a little more if desired.  If you like a thinner sauce, whisk the mixture into the beans and gently stir to mix.  Chill a few hours, then serve warm.

title: Broccoli & Spinach
ingredients: 12 ounces sliced fresh broccoli florets | 2 green onions, sliced | 2 packages frozen chopped spinach leaves
instructions: Preheat broiler.  In a large skillet, combine broccoli, green onions & spinach.  Cook over high heat until spinach is cooked.  Serve.

title: Crispy BBQ Fish

instructions: Preheat barbecue to medium high.  Slice fish in half.  Sprinkle both sides of fish with bread crumbs and place in a baking dish coated with cooking spray. title: Italian Bread for Sizzling
ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread, sliced or to your preference | 1 - 1 1/2 cup bacon fat or 1 -1 1/2 cup fat ( i just use a little more ) | paprika
instructions: Place sliced or diced bacon and fat in small frying pan.  Cook bacon over medium low heat until just about crisp.  Take the bacon fat out and set aside.  Place sliced or toasted buns on an oven proof plate.  Place the slice of bread in the hot fat and fry approximately 2 - 3 minutes with paprika on one side only.  Flavor with salt and pepper and slice bacon crosswise.  Top with bacon fat mixture and sprinkle generously with paprika.  Enjoy.

title: Taco Sauce with Oranges

instructions: Stir taco seasoning mix, orange juice, and orange juice together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.  Heat a small amount of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until hot.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Dip
ingredients: 1 pound fresh spinach leaves, chopped | 14 ounces fresh white mushrooms, chopped | 3 cans chopped green chilies | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 5 tablespoons dried italian herb seasoning | 18 cornhusks | 10 slices french bread
instructions: Place spinach in a large bowl.  Add mushrooms to the spinach, and mix in the chilies.  In a separate bowl, whip cream to soft peaks.  Stir in 1/2 tablespoon of herb seasoning.  Prepare a medium hot fire in the grill, and lightly oil the grate.  Dip cornhusks in the sour cream, and arrange the bread slices on the hot grate.  Sprinkle the top with remaining herb seasoning.  Toast the cornhusks in the preheated grill until lightly browned, about 1 minute.

title: Eating over Ice
ingredients: 8 ounces boneless skinless chicken thighs | 1 container refrigerated thawed frozen octopus or 1 large octopus | 2 ounces toasted deluxe grated chocolate | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon midori melon liqueur
instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Line 3 - 9 x 13 inch baking pans with foil and set aside.  Cut chicken and octopus into cubes.  Place in freezer and chill for 20 minutes.  Drain in strainer and toss with the cheeses, nutmeg and midori.  Place in prepared pans on two foil lined baking sheets.  Bake for 15 minutes or until very hot.  Remove foil, bake for another 5 minutes or until bubbly around edges.

Random Ingredients: phyllo pastry,caster sugar,parmigiano reggiano cheese,monterey jack pepper cheese,tomato paste,vodka
title: Tomato Phyllo Pizza With a Kick
ingredients: 12 sheets phyllo pastry | 1 cup caster sugar, plus extra for sprinkling | 1/3 cup vodka ( optional but recommended ) | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 1 kg ripe tomatoes and green pecorino cheese, finely diced | 200 g shaved monterey jack pepper cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c/375°f or gas mark roll out the pastry to 5mm thick, cut out circles and place on a baking tray.  You have to brush/sprinkle the pastry circles with some caster sugar, just enough to brush down the edges of the circles.  Put them aside.  In a small saucepan, heat the vodka and tomato paste until it's syrupy, then stir in the diced tomatoes.  Pour the tomato and tomato paste filling over the pastry circles on the baking tray.  Sprinkle the shaved pepper over the pizza.  Dot the top with extra caster sugar and bake for 25–30 minutes or until the crust is golden.  Watch it doesn’t burn.  Serve hot with more butter.  Variation, you can use a roasted potato or a grilled veg.  Substitute with the pecorino if you would like.

title: Sonoran Eggs
ingredients: 2 serrano chilies | vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 eggs, beaten | 1/4 cup picante sauce | 1 can baked beans, drained | 1 cup triple cream
instructions: To make sauce,.  Cut slit open chilies and remove seeds and membrane, discard seeds.  Remove membrane from interior.  Slice open lengthwise and slit open lengthwise.  Remove seeds.  Lightly spray chilies with cooking oil spray.  Place in medium bowl.  Toss with egg.

title: Caribbean Pea Pods
ingredients: 4 whole green-brownish shelled pea pods, or yellow green peas | 20 slices frisee | 1 1/4 teaspoons ground allspice
instructions: Soak pea pods on paper towels in a large resealable plastic bag for 30 minutes to plump them up.  Arrange pea pods in a layer in the center of a large, 12 inch square piece of heavy plastic wrap.  Top with another sheet of plastic wrap to cover the pods.  Squeeze bag to compact pea pods tightly.  Use a sharp knife to slice all of the way around to the bottom of the plastic to slice down through the pods on the plastic.  Lay a flat table spoon or platter over the pea pods to catch any food residue and to prevent them from sticking to your hands.  Add about 1 quart of water to the bag to a depth of about 2 inches and place it over the peas.  Fold plastic tightly over the peas.

Random Ingredients: black pepper,fenugreek leaf,pumpkin pie spice,tart apple,soy sauce,chili paste
title: Papaya Apple Curry

instructions: Peel apples, core and dice into 1/4 inch cubes.  Place apples in blender with the pumpkin pie spice.  Blend on high until the apples give off a marbled trail, about 10 seconds.  Turn the blender on low, add chili paste if using and blend again briefly.  Add soy sauce or dry sherry.  Adjust seasoning, adding salt and pepper as desired to taste.

title: Goat Cheese Wrapped Chicken Breasts
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts, 1-1/2 inch thick | 1 tablespoon walnut oil, can use olive oil | 1 tablespoon fine dry breadcrumb | 1 tablespoon chopped brown onion | 8 1/2 ounces goat cheese | 1/2 cup fresh kale, chopped and leaves chopped
instructions: Preheat oil in 12 inch skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle chicken with bread crumbs, chopped onion and cheese.  Place chicken in skillet.  Cook, without disturbing, until underside is golden, 2 to 3 minutes.  Place spinach over chicken.  Cook, until spinach is tender, 1 to 2 minutes.  Cut cross hatch slit in center and remove backbone from chicken breasts.  Stand at end of cutting.  Stand breast on end of cutting.  Place chicken breast on cutting board.  Surround chicken with 1/2 inch of kale.  With tenderloins, wrap around breast and cheese.  Arrange in lightly buttered baking dish, seam side down.  Brush with remaining oil.  Bake, uncovered, in 425°f oven about 10 minutes or until thermometer registers 165°f for thickest part of breast.  Let stand about 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sambal-Pepper Salad

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.  Serve as is or with other dishes and enjoy.

title: Pollo Alentejana (Pollo Alentejo)
ingredients: 1 poblano chile, finely chopped | 8 pimento stuffed olives, chopped | 1 cup cooked meat, chopped ( i cooked a sausage so i can add as much meat if i have access fresh ) | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leave | dressing : | 1 1/2 cups soymilk | 1/3 cup fat-free thousand island dressing
instructions: Grind poblanos, pimentos, olives, meat, thyme leaves, 1/4 cup dressing, and 1/2 cup water in a food processor until smooth.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Bake Salmon and Potato Sticks

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f bake potatoes until very tender.  Meanwhile, heat a non stick frying pan and spray with oil.  Add the salmon and cook around 6 minutes each side, until cooked and flaky.

title: Mild Green Tea
ingredients: 4 fresh turmeric powder or 4 green cardamoms | 5 kaffir lime leaves ( powdered, known as 'hing' from the indian spice section of your local store, in powder form ) or 5 -10 green cardamoms ( powdered, known as 'hing' from the indian spice section of your local store, in powder form )
instructions: Take a pot on the stove, pour in just enough water to come up above the level of the water.  Put the turmeric or green cardamoms in the water to make a paste.  Add it to the boiling water and boil it until as froths.  Drain and keep aside.  In the meantime, heat a tea towel.  Apply one teaspoon of the powdered cardamom powder on the tea towel and spread the paste over the tray.  Make sure the paste stays on top of the bowl.  Leave it for a minute.  Remove from stove.  Pour the boiling tea over the prepared paste.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: lettuce leaf,pork butt,peanut butter,msg,olive oil,cayenne pepper,cake flour
title: Lettuce Wrapped Pig With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 2 lbs lean pork butt, trimmed of fat and cut into 2 x 1/8-inch rectangles ( about 8 ounces per rectangle ) | 1 1/2 cups peanut butter ( creamy or crunchy ) | 1 1/2 cups cake flour | 1 teaspoon msg | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper | 1/2 cup olive oil | lettuce leaf, washed and dried if possible
instructions: Place the peanut butter in a mixing bowl.  Place the flour, msg, cayenne and 1/2 cup water in a small saucepan.  Over medium heat, bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and stir in the hot peanut butter and the oil.  Let rest about 4 minutes.  Dip pork in flour mixture and let rest 1 - 2 minute then roll in the remaining flour mixture, coating completely.  Line 1/2 of a well greased 12x15x2 inch pan with the lettuce leaves, then add the rolled meat and roll up.  Serve with dipping sauce.  For dipping sauce, warm dipping sauce,.  Use a small bowl or hand held mixer to beat the dipping sauce ingredients until smooth.

title: Red Cabbage With Caraway
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage, finely shredded | 1 tablespoon caraway seed
instructions: Cut off the ends of the cabbage.  Using a large knife, make diagonal slits in the cabbage and place in the sink.  Sprinkle the head of cabbage with the caraway seed.  Repeat with remaining cabbage.  Place in a steamer or a large, heavy skillet and press with a spatula until slightly wilted or lightly browned, about 3 - 5 minutes.  Variation, a variation can be made using green cabbage.

title: Aegean Potato Cheese (Aegean Potato Tart)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Cook the farfalle or ziti in lots of salted boiling water until tender.  Drain, rinse in cold water and drain again. Remove the dough from the oven, cool on a rack, and sprinkle with the green jam.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.  Sprinkle with the cheese.  Cool, and cut into squares. title: Honey Pesto Colcannon

Spread remaining noodles over noodles.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Pour wine over cheese and noodles.  Sprinkle remaining noodles over top.  Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.

title: Chicken and Spinach Tenderloin (Bamiaeet Mit Paneer)
ingredients: 3/4 lb beef tenderloin steak, cut 1/2 inch thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons salt | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning | 1 1/2 teaspoons saffron, soaked and drained | 1 1/4 teaspoons black cardamom pods | 1 cup apple cider or 1 cup low sodium beef broth | 1 tablespoon pine nuts ( plus additional, toasted, pine nuts may be used to top the meat and garnish )
instructions: Cut the steak crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices, 1 inch thick.  Combine with the poultry seasoning, saffron, and cardamom.  Mix well.  Pour the cider into a resealable plastic bag.  Add the steak slices, turning to coat evenly.  Refrigerate at least 6 hours, turning the meat several times.  Lightly toast the pine nuts, either in a frying pan or a griddle over medium heat.  As the slices are being toasted, dip in just enough oil to coat the meat.  Working quickly, transfer the meat to a shallow platter.  Place the platter in a 250 f oven to heat through.  Serve with extra toasted pine nuts.

Random Ingredients: chili paste garlic,brown mustard seed,mango,baguette,kosher salt black pepper,sausage
title: Lazy Hot Dogs With Mango Relish
ingredients: kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper | 10 -12 sausages, your favourite kind, i use organic, but your favourite kind will do | brown mustard seeds | 1 tablespoon chili paste with garlic ( i use sounth ) | 1 jar mangoes, reserve 2/3-1/2-3 of the pit ( ripe or pure mangoes ) | baguette or other hearty bread
instructions: To prepare mango relish, put the mango flesh and reserved pits at the back of a spoon, they should come off easily but do not mash the mango flesh.  Combine the reserved mango pit with a teaspoon or so of olive oil or balsamic vinegar.  Mix well.  You want to get that mango sticky pulp with no big chunks of skin.  Add the mustard seeds on top, if that is how you want it.  Season with salt and pepper.  Wipe out the grill and set the heat to high.  Preheat a non stick griddle on high.  Woil the sausages until cooked through and nicely browned on all sides.  If using a smoked sausage, remove the chiken.  You should be able to handle them through the grill, as the sausages will be cooked when they are done.  When the cheese has melted and started to stick to the bread, take the sausages and slice diagonally.  Place on the grill.  Add a few tsp of the mango relish and some more relish.  Serve with baguette/sausages.

instructions: In a bowl, mix together the vinegar, thyme, and rice noodles.  Brush the steak and mushrooms with the vinegar mixture, place into a lightly greased baking dish, pour over the noodles and sprinkle with the cheese.  Bake at 425°f for 45 minutes.

title: My Big Fat Greek Phyllo Pastries
ingredients: 1 lb phyllo dough, thawed if frozen for a couple of hours | 1 cup vanilla yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1/8 cup wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f and lightly butter a cookie sheet.  In a bowl, mix the yogurt, salt, and vinegar and set aside until needed.  Lay out frozen phyllo sheets on a clean, dry surface.  Add the phyllo sheets to the cookie sheet in a single layer, keeping them covered with wax paper.  Place the sheets on the work surface and brush each with a small amount of the yogurt mix.  Sprinkle a little bit of the yogurt mix on the top layer.  Fold one half of the phyllo sheet in half crosswise to form a triangle.  Place the pastries on the baking sheet and brush the top with another small amount of yogurt mix.  Sprinkle on a bit of the yogurt mix if desired.  Repeat this process until all the phyllo sheets are used.  The pastry should be so thin that it will cling to your finger.  Bake at 375f for about about 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Vegan Quesadillas
ingredients: 2 cups raw yellow squash, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 small poblano chile, chopped | 1/4 cup brown rice | 1/3 cup slider | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°f.  Combine the squash, poblano pepper, rice and sugar in an open saucepan.  Scrape in the slider and add enough water to cover the mix and bring to a boil.  Boil over high heat for 15 minutes, or until the mixture is tender.  When done, it will fall apart in the bowl and be difficult to stir.  Remove the squash mixture from the heat, place it on a cutting board and cut into 1/2 inch chunks.  You should have about 1 cup of cooked squash.  Spread the rice mixture on one half of a tortilla, then top with the other half.  Heat a nonstick skillet to medium high heat.  Place the quesadillas on the pan and cook until lightly browned, about 1 to 2 minutes on each side, being careful not to burn or break the quesadillas.  Serve hot.

title: Indian Style Scrambled Nachos
ingredients: 6 corn tortillas | 1 ear of corn or 1 head corn kernels | 1 leek | 1 1/2 teaspoons cardamom seeds | 1 spring onion | corn flakes
instructions: Wash and dry the leek.  Slice into fine rings.  Place in a clean teacup and cover with boiling water.  Leave to soak for 5 minutes.  Drain water, and drain leek/sugar/oil from leeks.  Heat the same pan over medium heat.  Add noodles/chow mein noodles.  When noodles crackle and become crisp, add leeks.  Stir for 3 minutes.  Add the corn flakes and stir.  Serve immediately.

title: Cheesy Andotch Cappuccino
ingredients: 1 large green pepper, chopped | 1 box butterscotch pudding mix | 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 can baked beans | 2 cups cola-flavored carbonated beverage | 1 package shredded mozzarella cheese
instructions: In a large saucepan, cook all ingredients except for mozzarella cheese over medium heat, stirring slowly so it will melt completely.  Pour into four 8 ounce ramekins sprayed with cooking spray.  Top each with one cup of cola and half of cheese, and bake at 350f for 15 - 20 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Serve with pumpernickel bread and enjoy.

title: Greek Grilled Garlic
ingredients: 2 large heads garlic, peeled | 1/2 cup yogurt | 1 1/2 tablespoons finely chopped shallots | 1/4 cup grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Place the garlic in a small non reactive baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.  Heat a gas grill or a grill pan over medium high heat for 1 to 2 minutes.  Wrap the foil tightly around the garlic and grill until garlic is soft and beginning to blacken in some areas, about 30 minutes.  Cool the garlic for 5 minutes, then peel and halve lengthwise.  Remove and discard garlic and discard garlic cloves.  Place yogurt, shallots, pecorino romano cheese, and parsley in a blender and pulse until creamy and smooth.  Stir the yogurt mixture into the garlic, season with salt, if desired, and serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: curd,penne pasta,beet,russian salad dressing,key lime juice
title: Russian Beef Salad
ingredients: 1 lb top sirloin steak | 16 ounces canned red beets, drained, cut in 1/2 inch slices | 2 tablespoons russian salad dressing ( fat free is okay ) | 2 tablespoons fresh key limes, juice of | 1 cup tiny dried small penne pasta, cooked according to package directions
instructions: Slice beef into bite sized pieces.  Place in large bowl.  Add beets and russian dressing and toss to mix.  Toss with hot cooked pasta and top with fresh limes.

title: Mexican Corn (Stove Top)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn kernels | 1/4 green pepper, chopped ( optional )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until heated through, about 2 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Asparagus Tomato Salad
ingredients: 4 plum tomatoes | 4 lbs asparagus spears ( italian long thin tips )
instructions: Preheat grill to about moderate.  Wash and dry asparagus.  Grill asparagus until just tender crisp, about 3 - 5 minutes on each side.  Transfer to bowl and toss with tomatoes.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Hot and Cold Sorbet
ingredients: 3 cups fish sauce | 1/4 cup apple cider or 1/4 cup apple juice | 3 cloves garlic powder | 1 tablespoon sesame oil | 1 1/2 - 2 cups cold strong tea
instructions: Combine fish sauce, cider, garlic and sesame oil in a large saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Add cold tea.

ingredients: 500 g smooth greek yogurt | 3 ripe red chili powder | 2 teaspoons dried italian seasoning | 2 teaspoons paprika or 2 teaspoons salt | 1 tablespoon clear honey | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 ounce coconut milk | 3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Place all the ingredients together in a blender and blend until smooth.  Pour in a mould or flat plate and leave in the fridge to set.  Once set, remove from the mould and drizzle with the oil.

title: Easy Chicken Taco Filling
ingredients:
1 packet dry active yeast ( one pkg.
    - ) | 8 cups ice water ( divided ) | 6 -8 boneless skinless chicken breast fillets | 1/4 ounce taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon italian seasoning
instructions: Dissolve the first envelope of yeast in the ice water for about 5 minutes.  Place the chicken in the freezer a few at a time, until the thawed out chicken is cold, about 12 - 14 minutes.  In a bowl combine the taco seasoning with lemon juice and italian seasoning.  Drain the chicken and add one half to the taco mixture.  Place the remaining taco mixture into a freezer bag, removing excess air.  Place into a ziplock freezer bag with the back of a large spoon and place the chicken in the freezer, thawed out, for about 1/2 hour, or until you want the meat cooked through.  Pre heat oven to in a large frying pan melt a little oil, add the second envelope of yeast and cook for another half hour stir and remove from heat, and add remaining water in a slow, steady stream.  Once the second envelope of yeast is incorporated, stir constantly to prevent browning.  While yeast is coming to a boil, heat up a medium skillet, on range high or medium high heat until it is very hot and very lightly spritz the sides with oil.  Coat the chicken with the taco mixture, shaking off excess oil, and place onto the hot skillet, seam side down into hot skillet.  Cook on each side until it is golden and bubbly.  To do this with the chicken breasts can be done on a pan in an oven, on top of a bed of steamed rice, or in a crockpot cook on high heat for about two to three hours or until the chicken is cooked through and crusty and juicy.  Place chicken onto a plate and drizzle with taco seasoning mixture and enjoy.

title: Zesty Steak
ingredients: 600 -500 g sirloin, cut into thin slices ( sirloin steaks, about 1 '' thick ) | 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons white sugar
instructions: In a large bowl combine the lemon and sugar and whisk thoroughly.  Add the steaks and mix well.  Pour over bread or toast and leave to marinate for at least 20 minutes.  To serve, remove steaks from marinade and discard the marins.  Return marinated beef to wok and sear until just cooked through.

title: Blueberry Topping Dessert
ingredients: 1 pint fresh blueberries or 1 pint frozen blueberries | 1 cup blueberries or 1 cup frozen blueberries | 1/2 cup mixed spice | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract ( optional )
instructions: Wash and dry blueberries.  Combine with other ingredients in an attractive sized bowl.  For a large bowl, use a spoon dipped in water to moisten berries while they are softening.  You should end up with a nice, thick topping.

title: Beer and Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 can beer ( british or italian ) | 1 -2 ounce plain yogurt | 1 teaspoon coriander seed ( crushed, if possible ) | 1 1/2 lbs pig's feet or 1 1/2 lbs calf's feet
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit.  Mix all ingredients together in a baking dish lined with parchment paper.

title: Alfredo Sauce for Pasta
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tequila | 3 tablespoons ricotta cheese | 3 1/2 tablespoons sage ( fresh, crushed ) | 2 cups vegetable shortening
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 3 tablespoons tequila, ricotta cheese and sage.  In a saucepan, melt 2 cups shortening on low, then blend in the remaining tequila mixture 1 cup at a time until well blended and creamy.  When thickened, stir in the shortening mixture.  Keep on low heat and stir continuously until thick.

Random Ingredients: dill weed,frying chicken,tortilla,chocolate syrup,green food coloring,yeast,new potato
title: Greek Chicken and Potato Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup brown low-fat chocolate syrup | 4 cups tiny new potatoes, about 2 medium | 1/4 cup dried yeast | 1 1/4 cups warm water | 12 small fried artichoke heart cutlets ( about 2 cups ) | 3 pinches powdered instant yeast | 1 large frying chicken, patted dry ( or 2 - 3 whole chickens ) | 1 teaspoon dried dill weed or 1 teaspoon chopped fresh dill | green food coloring ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix lukewarm chocolate syrup with 8 cups of cold water until dissolved.  Add yeast, then stir in 1 1/4 cups of potatoes.  Dip chicken pieces into the chocolate soaking liquid and place in a single layer on a greased baking sheet.  Let rise until doubled in bulk.  Bake in a moderately hot oven for 25 minutes, or until golden.  Meanwhile, heat a few drops of red food coloring on a large skillet until almost smoking.  Turn chicken pieces once, and brush with a thin film of cooking chocolate.  Broil chicken in the middle of a hot skillet for 1 minute on the first side, then turn and broil the second side, about 30 seconds.  Transfer chicken to a wire rack to cool, then arrange pieces on a platter.  Spoon off all but 2 tablespoons of the skillet drippings.  Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the drippings, and heat over medium low heat, stirring constantly, until it begins to boil.  Add the dill, then stir in the reserved potato mixture, then pour the sauce over chicken.  Serve with warm french bread, or use as described above.

title: Yogurt and Mint Pull Apart Mini Pies
ingredients: 150 g self-raising flour | 1 teaspoon celery salt | 1/4 teaspoon cayenne | 1 bunch of fresh mint leaves | 600 ml milk yogurt | 100 g greek yogurt | 3/4 cup coffee | 100 g fresh mint leaves, roughly chopped roughly
instructions: Whisk together the flour, celery salt, cayenne and half of the fresh mint leaves.  Add the rest of the mint leaves and stir. Store in a cool, dry place, and allow to cool completely.  You must leave the mint tea cups in the tea before serving.

title: Bacon Wrapped Beef With Broccoli and Chocolate

instructions: Pre heat the broiler.  In a saucepan cook broccoli for 3 - 5 minutes until just tender and crisp tender.  Remove to a clean cutting board and pat dry.  Using a sharp knife cut the broccoli into thin strips with scissors, or slice as desired in the machine directions.  Place bacon, barbarqueed beef, and chocolate shavings in a dish or platter.  Add about 1/4 cup of hot sauce to the beef and broccoli.  Serve at once with steamed or fried rice.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.  Place the shredded cabbage in an ungreased, non stick baking dish.  In a small bowl, mix together all the topping ingredients.  Pour the topping over the cabbage, and bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Slow Cooker Baked Italian Fish

instructions: Place the fish chunks in the slow cooker.  Season with italian seasoning, and mix with apple juice.  Pour on beef broth.  Cover, and cook on low for 5 hours.  Pour cream into slow cooker, and stir in black eyed peas.  Cover, and cook on high for another 2 hours.

title: Wilted Spinach

instructions: Heat anchovy paste on low in saucepan.  Add spinach and cook till spinach is wilted and water absorbed, stirring about 3 - 4 minutes.  Add limoncello and stir to combine.

title: Japanese Pickled Kaffir Lime Leaves

instructions: Place the parsley leaves in a large pot of clean water.  Bring to a boil, and set leaves over medium heat to steam. Place the drained leaves and leaves in a jar of a clean jar that measures 4 pounds, or use any appropriate sealable container.

instructions: Cook veal in a large skillet over medium high heat until a golden brown crust has begun to form, about 2 minutes.  Drain on a paper towel lined plate and sprinkle with cheese.

instructions: Remove skin and fillet from bones and slice as thinly as possible.  Mix all ingredients well, except salmon, and marinade for 10 - 12 hours in refrigerator, or up to 2 days in freezer. instructions: In a medium bowl mix the beef broth with the orange zest.  Use your hands to mix well until well blended. title: Grilled Turnip Ricotta (Zwt-8)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turnip, peeled ( i prefer purple and rinsed turnip ) | 2 1/2 cups ricotta cheese | 1 teaspoon salt | 1/4 cup buttermilk or 1/4 cup milk powder | 1/4 cup kahlua ( optional ) or 1/4 cup nutmeg, and ( optional )
instructions: Wash turnip thoroughly then cut off any damaged stems or shriveled leaves.  Remove any white stem or damaged white pith from the peeled turnip.  Cut stem and rind into 1/3 to 1/2 inch chunks.  Cut rind into 1/4 inch pieces.  Remove hulls if needed and discard ends of turnip.  Using your fingers, press and gently work the turnip and rind chunks into a well buttered shallow dish.  In a large bowl, combine ricotta, salt, buttermilk, and vanilla, if using.  Spoon over turnip, cover, and refrigerate for 15 to 30 minutes.  Heat grill to high or preheat broiler to 375.

title: Rhubarb Stuffed Apple Ladyfingers
ingredients: 6 -8 large yellow bell peppers | 4 -6 lbs rhubarb ( fresh or frozen ) | 6 -8 ounces mcintosh apples ( peeled, cored, and chopped ) | 1 bay leaf | 3 lbs ladyfingers | 1 beef bouillon cube | salt and white pepper
instructions: Place peppers on foil in large roasting pan in order given.  Cover vegetables with water and boil on low about 7 hours.  The water will reduce to a gravy like consistency.  About 45 minutes before peppers are done remove the foil and add apple and bay leaf.  Remove peppers from water, let cool and peel.  Cut stems of peppers lengthwise from top.  Remove stems and set aside.  Remove and discard outer, central leaves of rhubarb and place about 1 1/2 tsp seasoning mix in the base of each pepper.  Cut around the stem and fill with rhubarb filling.  Repeat until all the pepper mixture, along with filling and meat is used up.  Cut lengthwise through tops for a slit.  Cut around the stalk again to make a hole in the inner core.  Place in hot water bath for 15 minutes until tender and remove.  Boil for about 20 minutes and drain.  Serve with gravy or sour cream.

title: Celeriac (Celeriac With Pepper Sauce)
ingredients: 1 3/4 lbs celeriac ( preferably white ) | 3 large red bell peppers ( or assorted ) | 1/2 lb kielbasa, in 1 inch slices | 10 cups defatted chicken stock or 10 cups broth | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander or 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Cut celeriac into 3/4 inch slices.  Peel the bell peppers.  Heat the stock in a medium saucepan to boiling.  Add celeriac, cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes.  Add red peppers, kielbasa, coriander and bell peppers and simmer until vegetables are tender, about 1 hour longer.  Stir in the stock and check seasonings.  Transfer to a crock, cool to room temperature and store refrigerated, covered, until use.  This is wonderful served with crusty bread or toast.

title: Italian Gator Salad With Star Anise
ingredients: 2 lbs fine sea salt | 1 tablespoon fine sea salt | 4 ounces lime jell-o gelatin | 1 small star anise | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 8 cups assorted green seedless grapes, coarsely chopped ( i prefer ruby reds )
instructions: Place salt, sugar, and lime in a medium saucepan and fill with water.  Bring to a boil and simmer slowly for about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and allow to cool.  Dissolve jelly in cold water, then transfer to large bowl.  Add star anise and oregano to the jelly and mix well to combine.  Stir in the grapes.  Line 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 inch loaf pans with parchment paper.  Dip the pans first side to fit and then the other to make sure both sides of the loaf are covered with the jelly.  Pour the jelly mixture into the pans and evenly sprinkle top with sea salt.  Refrigerate overnight, but at least 2 hours or overnight the jelly will set up.  Turn out of pans onto a plate.  You can also slice it and serve the salad later, but will be harder to deal with.  Note, the anise has a subtle flavor without significant holes.  If you want a stronger flavoring of the star anise, you may add 2 tablespoons of anise to the cold water.  The flavor improves with time and cold cuts.

title: Greek Tofu Skewers
ingredients: 200 g whole free range greek yogurt | 180 g butter | 400 g ground lamb | 200 g low-fat cheese, grated | 200 g firm tofu, cut into 8 triangles
instructions: Skewer the tofu.  Thread 3 triangles onto the skewers.

title: Tortilla Chips
ingredients: 2 lbs russets potatoes, peeled but still in slices | 10 tortillas | 2 lbs zucchini, ends trimmed, chopped into 1/2 inch dice
instructions: Peel all the excess moisture out of the potatoes, leaving 1/2 inch of flesh and leaving the potatoes in their skins.  Cut each potato into 3 - 4 long chips.  Boil the potatoes until the skins turn crisp and can be pierced with a fork.  Remove the potatoes from the heat and cool.  Drain and rinse off the skins, dry well, and cut into long strips.  Lay out the chips on a clean plate and cover with a damp towel or a bowl.  Using a sharp knife, make a slit into one side of each chip.  Dip the chips into the water.  The potato skins should cover the chips completely.  Spray a large non stick skillet or a griddle with non stick spray and heat over medium high heat.  Spray each chip generously with non stick spray.  Shake the skillet or griddle and return the chips to the skillet.  Sauté the zucchini for about 2 minutes.  Remove the potato skins from the pan, draining the excess water from them, and toss the zucchini with the crispy potatoes and zucchini until combined.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: chili paste,thai chili paste,egg white,pecorino romano cheese
title: Piri Reinagel
ingredients: 2 large egg whites | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 1 tablespoon finely grated pecorino romano cheese | 1 tablespoon minced hot thai chili paste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper.  Place your piping machine in the bowl of a standing mixer.  With the beater on low speed, add 1/2 cup water and 1 tablespoon chili paste gradually.  Stop the beater and scrape down the sides with a rubber spatula and mix until incorporated.  Add the remainder of the 1/2 cup water, another tablespoon or so, and beat until fully incorporated.  Set aside.  Place one egg whites and the remaining 1/4 cup flour in a medium bowl or in a separate container.  Beat until thoroughly combined and foamy.  Gradually add the remaining 1/4 cup flour in a shaggy stream, continuing to mix until the dough reaches the consistency of soft play dough.  If the dough seems dry and sticky, add more flour.  Place dough, about 1/2 cup at a time, on the parchment paper lined cookie sheet and pipe 3 inch rounds onto the parchment.  Bake for 10 minutes or until puffed and golden.  Remove from the oven and transfer onto a plate.  Serve while hot, or store at room temperature in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Figs Fried in Rice
ingredients: 6 small figs, whole | 12 -14 whole fish fillets, about 6 lbs total weight | 3 sprigs parsley flakes | 1 -2 1 -2 tablespoon dried minced parsley flakes | 2 cups arborio rice or 2 cups jasmine rice, about | 3 -4 cups fish stock or 3 -4 cups fish stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.  Trim the figs and carefully remove any membrane from the base of the figs.  Place half of the figs, in their halves, on a paper towel, and lightly squeeze the flesh out of the shells.  Place the fish fillets in a casserole about 6 ounces in size.  Cut up the remaining figs and place in the casserole.  Sprinkle with the parsley, and drizzle with 2 tablespoons of stock.  Cover the fish and figs with the remaining parsley, cover with aluminum foil, and bake for 30 minutes.  Turn off oven and let sit for 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, bring a pot of water to a boil.  Add rice and return to a boil, stir.  When rice is almost done, place in oven, cover and turn off oven, and let sit covered for 20 - 25 minutes to finish steaming.  Check for doneness, and add more broth if necessary.  It should be loose loose in the middle but firm enough to slice easily.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease and flour a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Mix apples, sugar, orzo or other small pasta sauce together in a bowl until the sugar dissolves.  Stir coconut extract, chili seasoning mix, and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean into apples.  Pour the flavored apple mixture into the prepared baking dish.  Bake in the preheated oven until the apple butter melts, and the topping is browned, 45 to 50 minutes.

title: Pueblo Pepper Soup

instructions: Place chiles, kielbasa and onion into 4 to 5 quart slow cooker.  Pour in stock, mint and cumin seeds. .  Cover and cook on high for 5 to 6 hours or low for 5 to 6 hours or until well heated through.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Roasted Okra

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the okra in a small baking dish.  Pour the hot pepper sauce over the okra.

title: Curried Rice

instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly under running water and pat dry with towel.  Combine the rice with the curry powder in a medium size bowl and cover with 1 1/2 cups of water.  Bring to boil and cover immediately.  Remove from heat and let rest until the time for rice to be served.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper.  In a bowl using an electric mixer, combine the chocolate chips and vanilla sugar. title: Families
ingredients: 8 ounces italian sausage or 8 ounces hot italian sausage | 1/3 cup nonfat plain yogurt | 4 -6 flour tortillas
instructions: Cut sausage into bite size pieces.  Brown the sausage over medium heat.  Drain well.  When cool, crumble and place in blender or food processor.  Add yogurt.  Blend on high until smooth and creamy.  Fill tortillas with mixture and roll and place in parchment paper lined jelly roll pan or tin.  Refrigerate 1 hour.

Random Ingredients: cornflour,pecorino romano cheese,red lentil,dill,broccoli stem,ladyfinger,tomato puree,soy sauce
title: Lentils With Broccoli, Tomato and Pecorino Cheese
ingredients: 100 g red lentils, soaked overnight | 400 g broccoli stems, halved | 400 g tomato puree | 1 tablespoon light soy sauce | 1 tablespoon red milli pepsi instant minced garlic ( or more ) | 2 teaspoons chopped dill ( or more ) | 8 ladyfingers ( or your vegan biscuits, or other eggcakes ) | 50 g fresh pecorino romano cheese, shaved
instructions: Drain all the ingredients from the soaked red lentils into a bowl and put aside to cool.  Cut the broccoli into florets and blanch them in boiling lightly salted water for 5 to 10 minutes drain the water and put aside.  Heat the oil in a pot and when it's quite hot, put in the pepsi and garlic, fry for just a few seconds.  Add the soaked red lentils and stir for a minute or two.  Add the tomato puree, soy sauce, and seasoning.  Simmer over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until it has thickened sufficiently.  Arrange the lady fingers or eggcakes on a plate with some lentils in the centre of the plate, and spoon over the tomato sauce.  Place the béchamel on top and scatter shredded cheese and chopped dill.  Serve warm.

title: Grammie Miller's Favorite  English Pea Cheese
ingredients: 1 package frozen peas | 8 slices of white american cheese
instructions: Thaw peas and remove the strings.  Place 1 strip of cheese on the plate.  Place peas on the cheese.  Place a second strip of cheese on the top of the peas and cheese.  Close the top with the cheese.  Place platter with peas and cheese under it without turning.  Serve on toast.

Random Ingredients: black sesame seed,pinto bean,wide egg noodle,cooking spray
title: Spicy Baked Noodles
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed | 1 tablespoon black sesame seed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray.  Cook the egg noodles according to package directions.  Drain, drain, and rinse pinto beans with cool water to remove excess water.  Combine drained noodles with beans.  Pour in a half inch layer of crushed green chilies and sesame seeds.  Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Brussels Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breasts | 1/2 cup brussels sprouts | 1/4 cup water | 1/4 cup reserved maraschino cherries
instructions: Place chicken, brussels sprouts, and water in a saucepan over medium high heat.

title: Mexican Party Tray (Granitos)
ingredients: 1 pink grapefruit, sliced | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 1 can red grapefruit | 30 graham crackers, crushed
instructions: Line a 7x11 inch baking dish with the graham crackers.  Combine the drained, rinsed, black beans, and pink grapefruit in a bowl.  Spread the cheese over the crackers, and top with the rinsed grapefruit mixture.  Serve immediately.

title: Pistachio Beef
ingredients: 10 dates | 1 kg stewing beef | 45 g cornstarch | 30 g pistachios
instructions: Slice beef into thin slices.  Mix corn starch and cold water until it starts boiling.  Stir in cornstarch/water mixture and boil for 5 min.  Stirring continuously.  Slice pistachios into slivers.  Serve with basmati rice / naan bread.  If using basmati rice, brown beef in some oil in a skillet.

title: Chinese Spareribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups bottled sweet chili sauce | 4 pounds spareribs | 1 cup half-and-half | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 1-inch cubes | 8 chicken drumsticks
instructions: In a large saucepan, stir together sweet chili sauce and spareribs.  Bring to a boil over high heat and reduce mixture by half.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, turning over occasionally.  Stir in half and half.  Arrange chicken in a crockpot, and stir to coat.  Cook on low 2 1/2 hours.  Turn crockpot to high and return to the cooking temperature, and cook 45 more minutes, until chicken is no longer pink in center and juices run clear.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,grapefruit,cooking oil,almond,kosher salt pepper,chilies,coriander seed
title: Molho Chillies
ingredients: 6 mild chilies, such as jalapeno or pasilla, seeded | 3 grapefruits | 1 lb velveeta cheese | 2 tablespoons cooking oil | 2 teaspoons coriander seeds, cracked | 1 teaspoon kosher salt and pepper | 1/2 cup slivered almonds
instructions: In a mixing bowl, blend together chillies, grapefruit, velveeta and coriander seeds.  In a small skillet, heat oil.  Place the whole mixture in hot oil and fry for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat and drain off the oil.

title: Easy Peasy Artisan Style Pizza Dough
ingredients: 3 cups plain homemade yeast ( not the kind with gummy stuff, just a regular white loaf ) | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon instant dry yeast, mixed with the water
instructions: Dissolve the 1 teaspoon yeast in 1/4 cup of water in large, heavy saucepan.  Allow to cook at 15 to 20 bubbles until bubbly and foamy.  Remove the pan from the heat, and stir in ground ginger.  Allow the yeast to become foamy, 5 to 10 minutes, but do not mix too hard.  Place the 3 cups of dough in a large mixing bowl, and add the glaze.  Mix in until very thoroughly mixed.  If the dough is too sticky or has difficulty getting it to blend with your hands, cover it with a damp cloth and allow the dough to rise until doubled.  Once risen, punch down the dough, scrape on the sticky yeast, then knead on a floured board for 5 to 10 minutes.  Place dough into an oiled bowl, cover, and allow to rest for about 1 hour in a warm place.  If necessary, use a floured fingers to punch down the dough and stretch it into a round shape.  Allow it to rest for 5 to 10 minutes before adding toppings and other toppings.

title: Harissa Mushroom Tagine
ingredients: 1 lb button mushroom, washed and trimmed | 2 -3 tablespoons harissa ( paste, see harissa paste note )
instructions: Cut a piece of heavy foil, approximately 1 in x 3 in length.  Place mushrooms on foil and spray with a little oil over the mushrooms to prevent sticking and smushing the mushrooms.  Add paste and bring to a boil, stirring to mix through the paste.  Turn heat down to a simmer, cover and leave for 15 minutes, shaking the pan every 5 minutes.  To unmould, turn off heat and leave for five minutes.  Place on plate, garnish with sprigs of fresh parsley and serve warm with bread.

title: Spicy Fish With Chili-Glaze
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped anaheim chilies | 4 tablespoons glaze | 7 white fish fillets ( approx 1 to 2 pounds ) | 1 cup farfalle pasta
instructions: Pre heat oven to 350f degrees.  Place a small amount of glaze in a pastry bag, add fish fillets and shake to coat.  Place coated fish on a baking sheet.  Bake about 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

title: Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa ( or other sausage you like ) | garlic powder, to taste | 1/2 cup malt vinegar
instructions: Cut the sausage into 1/2 inch pieces.  Sprinkle with garlic powder and mix.  Place in a large bowl and add the vinegar.  Cover and leave at least 2 hours in the refrigerator before using.

title: Rice with Eggs and Jalapenos
ingredients: 3 cups arborio rice | 2 cups red wine | 1/2 cup pickled jalapenos, sliced 1/4-inch thick | 1 teaspoon msg ( optional )
instructions: Wash first 3 ingredients under cold running water and let dry for 30 minutes.  Drain and rinse well with cold water.  Bring wine and jalapenos to a boil.

title: Quick Tamarind Tamale Polenta
ingredients: 2 cups yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 cups polenta | 1 cup tamarind pulp | 1 tablespoon dried oregano leaves | catsup, to taste
instructions: Place tamarind pulp in a coffee filter or other container with a tight fitting lid.  Pour boiling water over the tamarind to soften the tamarind and make it a little more liquidy.  Remove the block of tamarind and cut off any hard stalks.  Place the tamarind pulp and the oregano in a large saucepan or roasting pan.  Bring the mixture to a boil, then add the cornmeal and stir to combine.  Continue cooking on medium heat, stirring constantly.  When the mixture thickens, add a small amount of boiling water to loosen it.  It shouldn't be too watery just pour it into a bowl of ice water to cool it.  Cover and refrigerate, and beat every once in a while.  When the mixture is cold, it should lose its structure and not break.  It should be fairly firm, and slightly softer after about 45 minutes.  It may take as little or as much as 10 hours to reach this stage.  If it breaks apart, re mix in some water.  To make tamaggy tamarind tamale polenta, place the tamarind pulp in a large bowl and mash it with a fork.  Add the oregano and mix.  Add more boiling water as needed to achieve a creamy consistency.  It should have the texture of cream cheese.  You can cover the bottom of a large loaf pan with plastic wrap to prevent drying out.  To make polenta tamarind sauce, bring 2 cups of water to a boil, then add the polenta.  Once it starts to boil, remove from the heat and stir to break up any lumps.  Cover until the polenta is cooked.  When it is done, remove the plastic wrap.  Stir in the tamarind sauce, and season with the catsup to taste.

title: Couscous Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup couscous | 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar | 2 medium sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Place couscous in a mesh strainer.  Rinse with cool water, and drain.  In a small bowl, combine the vinegar and sun dried tomatoes.  Lightly stir the mixture into the couscous.  Chill.  Just before serving, scatter with some parsley.

title: Miyaki Tofu
ingredients: 8 ounces firm tofu cream | 1/3 spanish onion, sliced | 1 3/4 teaspoons pickling salt | 14 ounces dried adzuki beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Place the tofu sour cream in the freezer for 20 minutes to chill the sour cream.  Cut the sour cream into small cubes and place it in a blender.  Add onion and pickling salt.  Blend until finely chopped.  Add the adzuki beans and blend until everything is coated.  Place tofu on a plate and cover with plastic wrap.  Freeze for a few hours or overnight.  The longer it freezes, the more it separates from the flavor of the other ingredients.  Shake the container every time you can, it will thaw.  Break the tofu into pieces and transfer to a resealable container.  To use, remove one or two pieces at a time and place in a bowl of ice.

title: Veal  (Mexican Style Veal in Gravy)
ingredients: 2 lbs veal | 4 tablespoons icing sugar | 2 teaspoons cold water | cilantro leaf, for garnish
instructions: Cut the veal into about 2 inch cubes and coat with the icing sugar.  Pour the water into a frying pan about 3 tbsp deep.  Place the veal on top of the icing sugar in the pan and cook over moderate heat stirring all the time.  Turn frequently with a wide spatula, this is the longest step.  When the meat is golden brown and cooked to your liking, remove from the pan.  Place the frying pan over high heat, reduce the heat enough to simmer the meat, just enough that the meat browns.  Add the chopped cilantro to the meat and cook for another minute or two.

title: Pumpkin Seeds and Golden Crumble
ingredients: 2 cups raw whole pumpkin seeds | 3 cups plain white flour | 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds, extra to sprinkle
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c / 160°c fan forced.  Lightly grease a 1 1/2 cup capacity baking dish.  Combine the pumpkin seeds and flour in a bowl.  Stir in the extra pumpkins and stir.  Spoon the mixture into the baking dish.  Sprinkle over the pumpkin seeds.  Bake on preheated oven for 30 - 40 minutes until golden.

instructions: Place bread crumbs and 2/3 teaspoon curry paste in a large, resealable plastic bag.

instructions: Mix cottage cheese until it melts.  You can even add an equal portion of water or cream cheese to the pot.

title: Tossed Potatoes with Apples

instructions: Preheat an oven to 450 degrees f.  Cut a layer of unpeeled potatoes into 3 thick slices.  Place the apples, pear and fish sauce into a baking dish just large enough to hold everything.  Arrange the potato slices over the top and lightly salt and pepper the surface of the potatoes.  Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden, about 20 minutes.

title: Hot Pepperoni Sausage Linguica

instructions: In a large saucepot over medium heat, cook the sausage with marjoram until cooked through.  Using slotted spoon, remove sausage from saucepot.  Using slotted spoon, remove sausage from saucepot.  Cut into bite size pieces and return sausages to sauce pot.  Reduce heat of hot sauce to medium low.  Toss hot pepperoni and cheese with sauce.  Serve and enjoy.

title: Raspberry Rice Jam Porridge
ingredients: 3 cups white rice, washed ( i like rice krispies ) | 4 tablespoons raspberry jam
instructions: Put all the rice and jam in a deep pot and bring to a boil.  Cover and turn down the heat so the water doesn't boil out, leave to simmer on a very low heat for 15 - 20 minutes or until all the rice has absorbed all the liquid and cooked until all the liquids have been absorbed.  Put 1 - 2 tbsp of the cooking liquid into a small bowl and stir it in and serve.

title: Baby Bok Choy and Pea Soup
ingredients: 350 g baby bok choy | 100 -200 g whole green peas | 2 whole mixed bok choy | 10 g baby leeks | 1 teaspoon instant beef bouillon | 5 g minced fresh italian parsley | 3 teaspoons brewed coffee ( optional ) | 100 -200 g plain yogurt ( optional )
instructions: Remove the leaves from the baby bok choy.  Wash thoroughly in cold water and soak for two hours in some cool water.  Slice the heads over, then roughly chop the stalk into large pieces on a cutting board with the middle core only.  Drain the water and set aside.  Trim the ends of the bok choy, wash thoroughly in cold water and drain thoroughly on paper towels.  Blanch the peas in plenty of boiling water for 2 mins, remove from water and dry thoroughly in a clean towel.  Wash the mixed bok choy very thoroughly in cold water and chop roughly.  Wash and trim the baby leeks.  Cut off the ends and clean the ends from the green pea pods, trim off any tough tops, wash well in cold water and drain thoroughly.  Chop the boiled heads of bok choy and whole mixed bok choy leaves in a food processor or by hand, depending on size of bok choy and the size of peas.  You will need a broad, flat bottomed pan or a large pot.  Dissolve the beef bouillon in water.  Add the beef bouillon to the water and boil gently for 5 minutes.  Wash and trim the bunches of baby leeks, wash in cold water and drain well.  Wash the baby bok choy thoroughly in cold water and cut into 2 pieces.  You will need about 5 -6 leaves.  Remove the leaves from the mixed bok choy leaves and stir fry the baby bok choy leaves in 1/2 tsp of olive oil or cooking spray for 2 - 5 mins.  Remove the baby bok choy leaves from the hot cooking pan, drain on kitchen paper and cut off any woody parts from inside the bunches.  If using plain yogurt, stir the soup base and beef broth into the boiled bok choy leaves add the chopped bok choy leaves.  Heat up some extra oil or cooking spray in the pan or soup pot, or if using a non stick frying pan, add a few leaves of bok choy.  Stir well until the leaves are lightly toasted.  Remove from the frying pan and serve very hot with the toasted bread on the side.

title: Creamy Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 16 ounces heavy whipping cream | 1/4 teaspoon dry mustard powder
instructions: Put 1/4 cup cream and dry mustard in a saucepan and heat over low heat.  When the cream is warmed, stir in the remaining 1/4 cup cream, a little at a time.  Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened but not boiling.  Do not let it boil, or the sauce will curdle.

title: Crispy Greek Salad
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb cooked lean ground beef | 1 tablespoon fresh minced fruit or 1 tablespoon dried fruit, of choice | 1 tablespoon crumbled feta cheese | 1/4 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/4 teaspoon sugar | 1 beef bouillon cube | 4 pieces lettuce
instructions: In small bowl combine beef, fruit, cheese, oregano and sugar.  Break up beef mixture with hands as it cooks.  When beef is cool enough to handle, shred beef with two forks until fine.  Dissolve bouillon in 1/4 cup water.  Drain grease from beef mixture.  Stir in 1 cup shredded beef mixture and lettuce.

title: My Scones

instructions: Sift the flour into a bowl.  Make a well in the centre.  Add the pico de gallo.  Add another tablespoonful of flour and give this a nice mix until the mixture is the consistency of a pie crust dough.  Turn out onto a lightly floured surface.  Knead well, divide into 6 - 8 saucers.  Use two greased baking sheets as well.  Roll out the balls slightly, about 2 apart, for scones or 2 smaller ones for heart shaped scones.  Mark the tops with a biscuit cutter or a fork.  Place on a lightly greased oven tray.  Bake at c for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Let cool on a wire rack and serve with butter.
