title: Kebabs With Moroccan Spices
ingredients: 600 g topside steak, cut into cubes | 4 tablespoons taco seasoning | 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1 tablespoon ginger paste | 4 green cardamom pods | 1 red capsicum, finely sliced | 3 serrano chilies, seeded and finely sliced | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar | 4 tablespoons fat-free topping, your favourite sauce
instructions: Toss all ingredients together and let sit for 30 mins or so.  Thread onto metal skewers and barbecue for 2 mins each side.

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a 4 - 5 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on lo heat for 12 to 14 hours.  Serve warm with crackers or tortillas.

title: Thai Chicken With Raspberry Stir-Fry

instructions: Preheat an oven to 200 degrees centigrade.  Place the potatoes in a large roasting tin and cover with cold water.  Bring to the boil and boil for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender. Season and bake in a preheated oven for 20 to 30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is bubbling.  Serve straight away with plain boiled rice and a green salad.

title: Homemade Sausage for Peroshky
ingredients: 2 lbs spicy pork sausage | 1 chicken bouillon cube
instructions: Poke holes on both sides of the sausage.  Pour the chicken oxo in a large pot.  Add the oxo to the meat.  It should cover the entire meat.  If it doesn't cover it, you can add a bit of water.  Let simmer for 1 hour on high until meat is tender.  The longer it simmers the better.  When your sausage has simmered for 1 hour, take it out of the pot, let cool a little and slice to desired size.  You can add other spices like, pepper sauce, salt, paprika etc.  I like to add a teaspoon of dried thyme.  I've also added ground sausage, worcestershire sauce, celery salt, garlic powder, oregano, basil, and other spices that you have on hand.  These spices are all different tasting, unlike regular smoked.  I prefer spicy, but can add more if you prefer.

title: Pumpkin Seed and Raisin Chicken

instructions: In a pot, bring the beans to a boil over high heat.  Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 15 minutes.  While the beans are cooking, combine the meat, raisins, tomato puree, vinegar, cardamom, and cardamom in a large bowl and toss to coat.  Add the prepared chick and stir until well combined.  Serve immediately over rice.

title: Chili & Garlic Soup
ingredients: 6 cans italian-style stewed tomatoes | 4 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce | 1 leek, roughly chopped | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder
instructions: Pour the tomatoes into the canning process with all the other ingredients in the canning machine.  Put in a small saucepan and place on medium heat.  Simmer for 25 to 40 minutes.

title: Chicken Pot Sticks - Veg, Carrot and Chocolate Sauce - Vegan
ingredients: 1 lb baby spinach leaves, washed and drained ( approximately 8 cups ) | 4 vegetable stock cubes, such as maggi | 1 1/2 ounces dark chocolate ( approximately ) | 1 pinch salt
instructions: Heat the oven 200 deg celsius or 130 deg c if using a fan oven/gas mark 2 or the normal temperature will do.  Put the spinach in a bowl of cold water for a few minutes until it is just starting to soften.  Drain.  Place the stock cubes in a small saucepan with a lid and bring to a boil.  Place the spinach in the saucepan and stir in the stock cubes.  Return to the heat, partially cover and simmer for a couple of minutes until the stock cubes have dissolved.  Set aside to cool for a couple of minutes, then remove from the heat.  Place the chocolate in a small bowl and set aside for the sauce.  Melt the chocolate in the microwave for 3 minutes using 600w but leave as is, stirring every 30 seconds until it is smooth.  Strain through a clean cloth to remove any of the solids, then add the chocolate and salt to the spinach.  To use, wash and dry the spinach and stir in the chopped fresh leaves and the melted chocolate.  Leave to sit for 5 – 10 minutes to soften, then serve.

title: Butter Sauce for Lamb, Chicken, and Fruit!
ingredients: 1 jar mixed pulses ( fresh or frozen and not dried ) | 4 ounces unsalted butter, melted | 2 chicken bouillon cubes | 3 ounces double cream | caster sugar or superfine sugar
instructions: Heat your oven to 300°f.  Put the pulses into a saucepan with cold water to cover the pulses.  Bring to the boil then simmer for 2 minutes.  Drain the rinsed and picked pulses into a large mixing bowl.  Dissolve the stock cubes in the cream.  Add these to the pulses, making sure the cream gets into the pulses and stir so the stock gets mixed inches.  Put into a roasting tin or small baking dish and put into the oven to warm up, stirring occasionally, for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve with plain boiled rice.

title: Taco Bell Home Fries

instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees on a jelly roll pan.  Cut stem from chiles, remove seeds and membrane from stems, then cut into strips lengthwise.  Put 1 teaspoon taco seasoning into a bowl.  Dip chiles in soy sauce and then into soy sauce, then place into oven.  The chili strips should stay in their long strips of orange peel.  Turn the oven temperature down about 2 inches to keep warm, and check the strips frequently and to ensure they don't burn.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Mix together all dry ingredients.  In a separate bowl, mix together dry milk powder and watercress.  Mix in dressing and pistachios. This recipe can be baked using either a 12x18 inch pan, or other type of baking pan which is designed to fit all of your items at the same time.  Place all the flatbreads on a greased cookie sheet, or in one round pan or two separate pans which are designed to fit all of them.  Bake for about 30 - 40 minutes, until the breads are crispy and golden on the bottom.

title: Baked Rigatoni

Break the rigatoni into 1 inch pieces.  Combine the rigatonis and thyme in a large bowl.  Transfer to the dish and sprinkle with the reserved oil.  Bake in the preheated oven 15 minutes, until the top is lightly brown.

title: Saki Sauce, for Bologna

title: Italian Sausage Bolognese
ingredients: 500 -7 lbs extra lean ground beef | 2 boxes frozen broccoli rabe, chopped
instructions: Put the beef on to cook on the stove top over low to medium heat for about two hours.  The amount of time you are cooking depends on the size of the rabe, if it's too lean, that is too close for it to cook.  You do want to break it up a little bit while you cook, and cook it for about 10 to fifteen minutes until it is cooked throughout.  The broccoli is cooked so it's just soft, or it will start tasting very mushy while it's cooking.  Add the broccoli, cook for just a moment, and take it off the heat.  This is your finished sausage, and you are going to want it to stick.  The broccoli will soak up all the excess moisture.  You are going to want it to be very soft, or it might fall apart.  When you remove the sausage that has been added to the pasta, it will be very hard after first.  It will have to sit and steam for about ten to fifteen minutes after cooking.  Do not worry, it will be done when your sauce is thickened.  Stir until it thickens a little more.  Stir in the package of broccoli rabe.  You may want to let it thaw a little at this point to get it to thicken up a little bit more.  There will be a lot of sauce on top, so don't be tempted to do this a day or two before serving the sausage.  This sausage is wonderful either way.  This is also good if you add a tablespoon of tomato sauce or a little fresh basil and tomato paste.  I think the tomato sauce is really good with the broccoli rabe and tomatoes.  This does add a lot of flavor.

Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.

title: Easy Beef and Tomato Pasta

instructions: Prepare your beefsteak to your taste by slicing the very top off of the tomatoes.  Slice tomatoes into thin strips about 3 long and 1/4 inch wide. Quickly start boiling some pasta water.  It will be at a boil so add water as need.  Stir the pasta periodically into the boiling water. Stir and remove the raspberries with a slotted spoon or a strainer.  It just takes a minute and a half to cook until they're a bit mushy.  Do this a few times to make sure all the raspberries are floating in the sauce.  Don't worry, it'll soak up the sauce a little bit.  You can add a bit of more sauce if it tastes dry. ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon cooking oil | 1 can navy beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup green chili salsa, plus extra for topping | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon cocoa powder | 2 -3 drops tabasco sauce | 1 tablespoon cornflour
instructions: Heat oil.  Add beans & salsa.  Stir all together.  Stir in vanilla, cocoa & tabasco.  Cook for 7 minutes or until hot.  Stir, serve plain over hot coffee or tea.  Tip, for those who like a lot of bean chunks, add a couple tsp of cocoa powder into the mix.  Note, this chili beans are particularly good with dried red chillies & may be served with toasted popcorn kernels or crushed biscuits, but the flavor is more enhanced the longer you let it rest.  Also, the chili bean chocolate mix lends itself to any chili you like.

Random Ingredients: japanese eggplant,sun tomato oil,serrano ham,liquid smoke,linguine,anise seed,pork sausage
title: Linguine With Fried Pork Sausage and Smoked Eggs
ingredients: 1/2 lb linguine | 1 tablespoon liquid smoke ( i use olive oil ) | 1 lb lean pork sausage | 6 slices sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, cut into thin strips | 12 slices serrano ham or 12 slices prosciutto, cut into thin strips | 6 ounces serrano ham or 6 ounces prosciutto, chopped | 6 large japanese eggplants, halved lengthwise ( about 2 pounds total )
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Place linguine in boiling water and cook until al dente.  Drain and set aside.  While linguine cooks, warm two to three tablespoons of the liquid smoke in a large nonstick skillet, breaking it up as it cooks.  Sauté sausage, about 5 minutes on each side, until browned.  Transfer sausage to a small bowl and set aside.  Heat two tablespoons of the reserved liquid smoke in the skillet and cook one slice of the sun dried tomato strips until tender, stirring to cook evenly, about three minutes.  Remove the pan and tomato strips to a plate lined with paper towel.  Add ham or prosciutto and eggplant strips to the pan and sauté briefly until just tender but still crisp, then set aside.  Cook linguine in boiling water until al dente.  Drain and toss linguine with sausage, peppers, sun dried tomatoes, onion and reserved sausage juices.  Divide among warmed plates.  Top with remaining sliced sun dried tomato slices and prosciutto leaves.

title: Cajun Beef Short Ribs
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs short rib of beef | 1 tablespoon cajun seasoning | 7/8 cup beef stock | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped pecans | 1/4 cup reduced fat sour cream or 1/4 cup whole-milk sour cream
instructions: Coat meat with seasoning.  In a large skillet, stir beef stock and pecans in.  Over medium heat, cook meat, covered, 15 minutes or until heated through.  Turn ribs and add other ingredients, simmering over high heat 5 minutes or longer.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,meat broth beef water,phyllo pastry,bell pepper,kidney bean
title: Easiest Burritos
ingredients: 1/2 lb stew meat ( i used the beef and pork stew that i have always tried ) | 1 bell pepper, diced | 1 can kidney beans, drained | 1 jar marshmallows, diced ( any variety ) | 1 package low sodium beef broth ( or 2 beef if you have it on hand ) | 3 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Brown stew meat and bell pepper in skillet with beef broth and diced marshmallows.  You may need to add more broth, depending on what your crockpot is.

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: 300 g gruyere cheese, shreaded | 1/2 cup marinara sauce | 2 tablespoons gochujang
instructions: Blend cheese with marinara sauce, set aside.  Pour dipping sauce over cheese until fondue is covered evenly.  Do not turn on fondue until fondue is heated through or cheese may curdle.  Serve hot, with chunky fresh bread for dipping.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,quinoa,heirloom tomato,golden syrup,chili paste,baking potato,mustard seed
title: Vegan Spiced Heirloom Tomatoes
ingredients: 300 g baking potatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 tablespoons dark rum | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 150 g mixed heirloom tomatoes | 30 g heirloom tomatoes | 60 g quinoa, to sprinkle on when serving
instructions: Preheat the oven at 180c.  Place the potatoes in a large roasting tray.  Sprinkle over the rum, golden syrup, vanilla paste, mustard seeds and mixed tomatoes.  Sprinkle with quinoa.  Bake, covered tightly with foil for 20 - 25 minutes or until almost tender.  Serve with a light squeeze of lime.

Random Ingredients: marshmallow,hot italian sausage,cherry,mexican cheese,cream tartar,soda cracker,prosciutto
title: Sausage Sandwich
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, remove bulk casings and crumble | 1 cup unsweetened marshmallows | 1/2 cup shredded mexican blend cheese | 2 tablespoons sour cream or 2 tablespoons creme fraiche | 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar | 3 baked soda crackers | 1 round provolone cheese piece
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray cookie sheet with non stick spray.  In large bowl, mix sausage, marshmallows, the cajun seasoning, sour cream, cream of tartar and crackers with hands.  Form into 4 logs, place on cookie sheet.  Bake until heated through and golden brown, about 15 minute cool 10 minute slice and serve on crackers.

Random Ingredients: worcestershire sauce,wine vinegar,wheat flour,bow tie pasta
title: Whole Wheat Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1/3 cup wheat flour | 2 tablespoons wine vinegar | 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce | 1 lb bow tie pasta ( bow `` or '' farfalle pasta )
instructions: Place flour in bowl.  Add vinegars.  Dough should be a little crusty.  Drain noodles.  Put in large mixing bowl.  Pour sauce over top.  Mix well.  Serve.  This recipe goes well with parmesan cheese.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,superfine sugar,rock salt,vanilla extract,cashew,tomato juice,sage leaf
title: Tomato Cashew Sage Dressing
ingredients: 3 cups fresh tomato juice | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon strawberry-flavored rock salt | 1 teaspoon vanilla extract | 1 teaspoon chopped sage leaf | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 teaspoon vanilla | 1/2 teaspoon rock salt | 1/4 teaspoon chopped sage leaves | 1/4 teaspoon superfine sugar | 6 ounces unsalted cashews
instructions: In small saucepan, bring tomato juice, ½ cup sugar, rock salt, vanilla, sage, ¼ cup of superfine sugar, rock salt, vanilla extract, sage leaf and superfine sugar to boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 1 hour.  Meanwhile, for the dressing.  Puree mixture, cashews, ¾ cup sugar and ¼ teaspoon of vanilla in blender, food processor or blender for 10 to 15 seconds, or in large bowl for 2 minutes using electric mixer at high speed.  Refrigerate dressing for 30 minutes before serving.

Random Ingredients: green onion,salmon,beef stew meat,yeast,parmesan cheese,white vinegar,triple sec
title: Seared Salmon Wrapped in Rolls
ingredients: 1 container sourdough bread ( about 1 pound ) | 2 1/2 cups sifted all purpose flour | 1 package yeast | 1 1/2 cups white vinegar | 1 1/2 cups grated parmesan cheese | 1 cup chopped green onion | 1 1/2 lbs cubed cooked salmon
instructions: Combine first 4 ingredients in pan of 1 - 2 inches of salted water until bubbles begin to form around crust.  Cover pan and let stand over low heat for 1 1/2 hours.  Drain and cool in refrigerator 30 minutes.  Combine next 5 ingredients in bowl except salmon.  Spread out salmon on top of bread.

title: Chicken & Pudding  Stove Top
ingredients: 6 bone in chicken breast halves | 1 package vanilla pudding | 1 teaspoon ground sage ( optional ) | 1 unbaked pie shells ( i use trader joe's easy sage pie crusts )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place chicken breasts on counter top.  Sprinkle with cinnamon and sage if using.  Slice chicken breasts in half and pound to 1/8 thickness.  Place the flattened chicken breast halves in the bottom of a greased pie plate.  Sprinkle with vanilla pudding.  Sprinkle chicken with sage.  Put pie plate on a rack in oven and roast for 30 - 35 minutes.  Take oven off, turn oven up to 400°f and place frozen pie plate on it until ready to serve.  If needed, remove pie plate and bake for 15 - 20 minutes more, or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.  If there are any pieces of chicken that don't fit with the size it makes, bake for 15 - 20 additional minutes, then cool on racks.  It can be made up to 3 days in advance if you have time, store in airtight container.  If using frozen pie crust and/or pie crust, let thaw before using, just until you want to keep your oven going.  If using fresh crust, let thaw before using, and store in freezer until ready for use.

title: Lettuce Wrapped Beef Tenderloin - Tiao Tang
ingredients: 2 lbs beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1 cup cold water | 3 tablespoons ground cumin | 2 tablespoons wafers | 1/2 head lettuce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f.  Slice the beef at an angle as if you're slicing it thin, stopping about 1/2 inch thick.  Insert a knife or meat tenderizer into the center of the slice and carefully push the center to the outside edge.  Arrange slices on a tray large enough to hold them in a single layer.  Place the tray in the oven and roast for about 25 minutes.  Turn slices over and roast for an additional 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool until you can easily touch the sliced beef.  Remove the slices to a platter and cover loosely with foil or a lid as you're preparing the rest.  After 25 to 30 minutes, remove the foil and allow the slices to cool completely before slicing.  Toast thewafers in the oven until lightly crisp, about 10 to 20 minutes.  Combine the cumin and the water in a small bowl and stir to dissolve.  Use a slotted spoon to lift the meat from the pan onto a cutting board.  Spread each slice with 1 teaspoon of the cumin mixture and a few wafer crumbs.  Top with a lettuce leaf.  Roll the meat around the lettuce and secure with toothpicks.  Serve with steamed white rice or noodles.

title: Citrus Squares
ingredients: 2 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 2 1/2 tablespoons simple syrup | 1 tablespoon cornflour | 2 cans kale, drained | 4 leeks, white part only sliced | 1 orange, zest of, grated | confectioners'sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f in a medium mixing bowl, place the flour, simple syrup, cornflour and kale.  In a 9 inch square baking dish, add the leeks and orange zest.  Cut the kale leaves crosswise into 6 pieces.  Sprinkle with confectioners sugar.  Pour the batter evenly over the greens.  Bake in preheated oven until golden, about 35 minutes.  Cut into squares.

Random Ingredients: green chili pepper,romano cheese,brown sugar,miso,romaine lettuce,kielbasa,island dressing,yogurt
title: Yogurt-Green Chile Sausage Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup light sour cream or 1/2 cup regular sour cream | 3 tablespoons yogurt | 1 tablespoon brown sugar | 1 tablespoon kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces ( or other hot sausage ) | 3 teaspoons miso | 1/2 teaspoon dried romano cheese or 1/2 teaspoon parmesan cheese | 2 -3 leaves romaine lettuce | 1 fresh green chili pepper, seeded and finely chopped, to taste
instructions: Slice sausage thinly.  Combine sour cream, yogurt, brown sugar, sausage, miso, cheese, and romano in salad bowl.  Mix lightly.  Arrange lettuce leaves on a serving platter.  Dress salad with tomato salsa and fresh green chile peppers.

title: Peach-Marjoram Cake
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh peaches, ripe and washed | 1 cup cake flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram | 1 1/4 cups malt vinegar
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and beat until smooth.  Spread on a greased and floured pan.  Bake at 375 degrees f.  For 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Cauliflower-Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 -3 medium jalapeno chiles, seeded and cored | 1 -2 head cauliflower floret | 6 cherry tomatoes | 10 large crispy tortilla chips | 1/2 cup coriander | coriander
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 c.  In 9x13 baking dish or roasting pan, add the jalapeno to the sliced jalapenos in the dish or pan, roast until dark red and a little bit black on top.  Take out and allow to cool.  Slice the cauliflower thinly.  Wash tomatos and slice crosswise, don't cut all the way through.  Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and remove the cores.  To make this a little bit easier, leave out the seeds and seeds.  Wash cauliflower and slice crosswise into 1cm cubes.  Add cauliflower to the pan roasted jalapeno and roast until starting to soften, add cherry tomatoes, roast about 10 minutes and take a bite and remove the cherry tomatoes if they look to thick.  Remove from the oven, taste and check how they'd like to heat, and salt and stir in coriander to serve.

title: Frogs' - the Lights
ingredients: 2 lbs of minced boneless chicken ( minced chicken breasts also can be used as well ) | 2 teaspoons real vanilla essence | 1 teaspoon real ketchup | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 -3 bell peppers, diced
instructions: Mix in blender the ketchup, bbq and vanilla essence.  Marinate faggers and eat or store in fridge.  Grill, broil, barbeque.  Fry or grill until light brown in colour and crispy.

title: Mock Devonshire Cheesecloth (Smoked Soy Smoked Soy Wursts)
ingredients: 6 cups cheesecloth | 1 1/2 lbs smoked kikkoman soy sauce | fresh raspberries,, to decorate
instructions: Preheat oven to about 450 degrees.  Place the cheesecloth in a large, heavy bottomed bowl which contains a few slices.  Dump the contents into hot water and soak for 30 to 60 seconds.  Remove the cheesecloth from the water and place on a plate.  Cut the cheese into slices about 3 inches long and about 1/4 inch thick.  Slather a couple of slices into each cheesecloth jar.  Bake for 1 hour, stirring periodically, and garnish with raspberries as desired.

title: Rum Ziti with Marinara
ingredients: 1 package ziti pasta, broken into 2-inch pieces | 2 tablespoons rum | 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, or more to taste | 1 can tomato paste, drained | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh ginger, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Place ziti in a large saucepan, and cover with salted water.  Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium low, and simmer until ziti is cooked through but still firm to the bite, about 10 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  Pour rum into a saucepan, add 1 tablespoon ginger, and set over medium low heat.  Simmer until ginger is fragrant and fragrant, about 3 minutes.  Pour tomato paste into saucepan over the ginger in saucepan, and stir in remaining 1 tablespoon ginger.  Bring to a low, and simmer until flavors blend, about 15 minutes.  Ladle sauce over pasta, and serve.

Random Ingredients: cooking oil,wheat bread,nori,lamb loin chop,ice cube,cardamom seed
title: Methi Lamb Chops With Rice (Bread and Egg)
ingredients: 2 lamb loin chops | 2 teaspoons cooking oil | 1 teaspoon cardamom seed | 4 whole grain bread ( flatbreads ) | ice cube | 2 sheets nori
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the chops and trim the lean tops and bottom of the chops.  Heat the oil in a frying pan on high heat and fry the chops until browned and crispy turning once.  Lower the heat to medium.  Spread the cardamom seeds on the loins and fry the slices for about 12 minutes, turning once or so.  Toast the bread under a hot broiler for 1 - 2 minutes or until crisp.  Spread on rice and allow to sit for 3 - 4 minutes, if desired.  Take out of the pan and top with the chops.  Serve while still hot cut into quarters.

title: Mushroom Burritos
ingredients: 1 package mixed mushrooms ( i use crimini ) | 1/2 lb button mushroom, cut off stems | 4 flour tortillas ( burritos or corn tortillas, about 3 inches in diameter )
instructions: To make sauce, cook mushrooms in a little water until soft, about 20 minutes, drain.  Place mushrooms back in pot and stir and heat over medium heat until all juices evaporate and mushrooms release their liquid, about 5 minutes.  To serve, place a portion of mushroom mushroom sauce in the center of a warm tortilla.  Wrap tortilla around mushroom and sauce and fold in half.

title: Fish Soup With Veggies
ingredients: 1/4 cup self-rising flour | 2 cups bread crumbs | 3 tablespoons fish stock | 1/4 lb fish fillet ( skinned and cubed ) | 1 can broccoli ( drained ) | 1/4 cup cooking sherry
instructions: Mix flour, bread crumbs and stock together.  Dip fish fillet into flour, then into bread crumbs.  Fry in a non stick skillet until golden brown.  Drain on paper towels.  Add vegetables to broth.  Bring to a boil, and then simmer for 15 minutes.  Add sherry and serve.

title: Hungarian Beef for the Crock Pot
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chuck ( i use brisket ) | 2 quarts stock or 2 quarts chicken stock | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 3 teaspoons poppy seeds
instructions: Put the chuck roast into the crock pot with the stock mixed in a saucepan and add the mustard powder and poppy seeds.

Random Ingredients: taco seasoning,green bell pepper,baking potato,mustard seed,cremini mushroom,fish sauce,pork shoulder,pearl barley
title: Hawaiian Pork Hash
ingredients: 3 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 packet taco seasoning | 12 cups pearl barley | 6 large baking potatoes, peeled and cubed | 1 package cremini mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup chopped green bell pepper | 3 tablespoons dry mustard seed | 2 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Place the pork in a large saucepan or stock pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until the pork is cooked through.  Drain, and return to the saucepan.  Stir in the taco seasoning and continue boiling until well mixed, about 20 minutes.  Turn off heat, cover, and set aside.  Place the potatoes in a large pot and cover with water.

title: Devil's Food
ingredients: 4 lbs pork shoulder or 4 lbs butt pork | 4 lbs shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined | 2 lbs pimento stuffed green peppers, sliced thin | 12 ounces yellow mustard, dijon preferred but any will do | 6 slices smoked sausage | 2 limes, wedged
instructions: Cut pork in slices & place in large ziploc freezer bag with shrimp, green peppers, yellow mustard, sausage, and lime wedges.  Refrigerate overnight.  Remove meat from bag and dry well on paper towels.  Pour off any excess marinade and place in broiler pan with lid on.  Place uncovered in 400°f oven for 20 - 45 min, or until meat turns golden brown.

title: Cashew and Walnut Topping for Pide
ingredients: 150 ml extra virgin olive oil ( or you can use regular olive oil for a milder taste ) | 225 g roasted salted cashews
instructions: Preheat the oven on the highest setting and grease an oven tray with some good quality olive oil.  Using 1 tsp of oil per slice, brush the top of each slice with a little extra virgin olive oil, then bake for around 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown.  When done, transfer to a serving bowl or slice and toast briefly in a toaster.  Tip, i like to toast the cashews a little in my electric grinder, then sprinkle the nuts over the top to give the nuts the quick burst of flavour.  They're brilliant on toasted cashews.

Random Ingredients: celery rib,tart apple,champagne,whipping cream,stewing beef,white bread
title: Beef & Tart Applesauce-Poached Apples
ingredients: 2 medium tart apples | 4 celery ribs, trimmed | 300 ml dry champagne, such as sauvignon blanc | 3 tablespoons whipping cream | 2 cups stewing beef, peeled and cut into 4 chunks | crusty white bread
instructions: Cut the apples in half and scoop out the seeds.  Cut away the core and peel the meat and place the in the bottom of a large pan.  Add 3 tablespoons of the wine.  Cover and cook on a medium heat until the apple shells open a little, this will take roughly 15 minutes.  The temperature of the apple mixture will drop it's own temperature by and it will eventually rise to the top.  Turn the heat down and, if necessary, add a little more wine.  When the shells open, remove the meat and reserve it in a bowl.  Add the rest of the wine in which the meat had cooked, the cream and the chopped beef to the pan and simmer for 15 minutes on a medium.  Meanwhile, place the bread cubes in a heatproof bowl, add 1/4 cup water and salt and pepper and make sure all water is absorbed or, if the bread turns a little crunchy, it will fall apart.  Preheat the broiler.  Ladle the meat and sauce into the hollowed out core of the macaroni.  Re cover with cracked white bread and place under the hot broiler until lightly browned and bubbly.  Serve hot and accompanied by a green salad.

title: Quick and Easy Meatballs With Noodles
ingredients: cooking spray | 1 lb hamburger | 1 lb egg noodles | 1/4 cup sherry wine | 1/8 lb whiskey ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon cognac | powdered sugar ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  Place noodles on baking sheet, spray with cooking spray then place in oven and bake for 15 minutes.  While noodles are baking, brown meat in a large frying pan with a tablespoon sherry and a dash of cognac.

Random Ingredients: tri tip roast,tofu,coriander powder,rice noodle,orange,naan bread,tomato juice
title: Bali Fried Veggies
ingredients: 4 slices naan bread | 1 -2 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 -2 tablespoon sunflower oil | 3/4 lb tri-tip roast | 3/4 cup dry rice noodles, washed | 3/4 cup orange juice | 1 bunch fresh coriander powder, for garnishing | 1 package firm tofu, cut into 12 squares
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok.  As the oil is heating up, spread the naan breads out in a single layer on a baking tray.  It is very important to put both the breads together.  It helps it to spread evenly.  Toast under a preheated broiler.  Be careful not to burn the bread or fry the slices.  It can really come undone, so use a spatula.  Remove and let cool for 2 minutes before taking off the bread slices.  Slice diagonally across the grain.  Place the cooked sliced breads on a large serving platter, and spread out on another serving platter.  Set aside.  Cut the tri tip into 12 equal pieces and keep aside.  In a small bowl, mix the orange juice, coriander powder, and tofu.  Set aside.  Heat the sunflower oil or sesame oil in a large frying pan, or in a wok.  Add the tri tip pieces and fry over high heat till golden on both sides.

title: Nutty Pineapple Spread
ingredients: 32 ounces fat-free mayonnaise | 1 cup crushed pineapple with juice | 1/4 teaspoon cardamom seed ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian herb
instructions: Combine mayonnaise and crushed pineapple.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate 5 to 8 hours before serving.

title: Black Vinegar Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 can pimientos | 1/4 cup black vinegar | 2 tablespoons mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice
instructions: Drain excess liquid from jar of jalapenos.  Add vinegar & mustard seeds.  Mix well & refrigerate at least 1 hour.

title: The Best Butternut Squash in the World!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons corn oil | 2 lbs butternut squash, peeled, cut into small chunks | 1 1/2 cups heavy cream | 2 tablespoons salsa | 1 cup peanut butter | 1 teaspoon crushed peppercorns, garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Heat oil in a large ovenproof pan on the stove.  Cook squash over medium heat for about 15 minutes, or until tender but not mushy, stirring every 5 minutes.  Pour cream into pan and heat over medium high heat until almost boiling.  Drain squash and set aside.  Dissolve peanut butter and peppercorns in warm cream and set aside.  When cool enough to handle, mash reserved cream into peanut butter and cream liquid until smooth, adding remaining cream and squash.  Cover dish with foil and bake for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Coconut Salad
ingredients: 1 lb fresh coconut, cut in cubes, peeled, deseeded | 1 green cucumber, halved and sliced | 100 g chopped green olives
instructions: Mix all of the salad ingredients together in a large bowl.  Serve with steamed rice.

title: Korean Barley Bread Rings
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups light barley flour | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Put everything into a medium saucepan except for the barley flour.  Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.  Add barley flour.  Turn down heat to low and leave to simmer for 20 minutes stirring regularly to prevent sticking.

title: Roasted Asparagus
ingredients: 2 pounds fresh asparagus, trimmed | cooking spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Combine asparagus, and lightly spray with cooking spray.  Bake in the preheated oven 20 minutes, until tender and lightly browned.

title: Chana Chaat (Chana Beans With Yogurt)
ingredients: 1 lb dried navy beans | 2 bunches spinach leaves, washed and chopped | 1/4 lb fresh sage, chopped | 4 -5 serrano chili, chopped | 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar | freshly-mint yogurt, to serve
instructions: Soak beans in a large pot with 4 - 5 cups water.  Cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Turn off the heat and let them rest about 20 minutes.  Drain the drained beans, reserving the cooking water.  Bring 2 quarts of water to a boil and add the beans.  Simmer until just tender.  Drain and rinse the beans, then set aside.  Bring 4 quarts of water and the salt to a boil.  Add the spinach and boil until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain well and coarsely chop.  In a very large bowl, combine the spinach, sage and chiles.  Add the sieved beans and reserved cooking liquid plus the vinegar, tossing together gently to combine.  Adjust the seasoning and serve with extra grated yogurt if desired.

title: Angel Hair Pasta (No Peek)
ingredients: 2 1/2 pounds fresh linguine pasta | 1 pound shitake mushrooms | 1 teaspoon salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of water with a pinch of salt to a boil.  Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain and transfer pasta to a large bowl.  Toss mushrooms with a pinch of black pepper, salt, and remaining black pepper using your hands.  Stir in cooked spaghetti and mushroom mixture.

title: Easy Cream Sauce With Chili Garlic
ingredients: 3/4 cup whipping cream | sweet chili-garlic sauce ( chili cream sauce or hot sauce )
instructions: In a medium size skillet cream cream the whipping cream.  Add chili garlic hot sauce to taste.  Place in refrigerator till ready to use in recipes.

title: Black Bean Salad
ingredients: 8 tablespoons cooking oil | 8 ounces medium raisins | 3 ounces dried apricots, drained and sliced | 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed | 2 cups low-fat plain yogurt
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and process until smooth.  Cover and refrigerate.

title: Thai Basil Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 dried ancho chiles | 6 cans low-sodium chicken broth | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh thai basil | 1 package uncooked linguine | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat ancho chiles in a skillet over medium heat until fragrant and beginning to smoke.  Place warm chiles in a blender and blend until smooth.  Measure broth into a large pot.  Stir in the basil and pour in the chile basil mixture and chicken broth.  Bring to a simmer over medium high heat and cook 15 minutes.  Cook linguine until al dente.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,green olive,chili oil,corn chip,panko breadcrumb,sherry wine,turmeric powder,italian parsley
title: Mexican Rice Balls (Aka Rice Balls or Panko Bread Crackles)
ingredients:
1 cup panko ( japanese breadcrumbs, if you can't find these, use regular bread crumbs.
    - ) | 1/2 cup corn chips | 2 cups dry sherry wine ( to be sweetened if you don't do it, sweet soya sauce is a must imho ) or 2 cups dry white wine ( to be sweetened if you don't do it, sweet soya sauce is a must imho ) | 2 cups panko breadcrumbs ( can also use cornflake bread or wheat bread crumbs, same as panko ) | 1/2 cup dried italian parsley | 1 teaspoon ground turmeric powder | 1 tablespoon chili oil ( or other cooking oil ) | 1 teaspoon ground anise seed
instructions: Combine all ingredients thoroughly. .  Form into small meatballs or other type of bread/toast/bake, place in a shallow bowl, close to the source of hot grease then turn while the meatball is cooking.  When meatballs are cooked, set aside and allow to drain for few minutes. .  Note, while italian bread crumbs contain a little water it is ok, if there are no more than 2 cups of leftover bread crumbs or flakes.  So they can be refrigerated/baked in the container for up to 1 week or frozen for up to 3 months.  Makes about 50 meatballs.  Note that these are made by a combination of different types of bread/toast/beaks/bread crackers, italian bread crumbs, panko, bread crumbs/bread crumps, dried parsley, tumeric, chili oil and anise.  So all of these ingredients need to have been prepped before adding the meatballs or other ingredients.  Any type of bread/toast/bread cracker should also be toasted. The oil is also a good one, i have been told, but it may still be a tad salty to balance.  I just find that the bread/toast tends to absorb the oil fairly quickly so i had to add a bit more water when mixing and re mixing.  You can also add a bit of egg yolk if you want and it is very good with milk and sugar also.

title: Tasteful Herb Butter(Vegan)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dried flat-leaf parsley | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint | 3 tablespoons vegetable oil or 3 tablespoons margarine | 1/3 cup sake
instructions: In the bowl of a food processor, combine the parsley, mint and oil.  Using the blade of the food processor, coarsely chop until the mixture forms a fine paste.  Add the sake and pulse to blend.  Transfer the herb paste to a glass storage container.  Keep in the refrigerator.

title: Bailey's Irish Cream Nachos
ingredients: 1 ounce baileys irish cream | 4 ounces tortilla chips, broken
instructions: Heat the tortilla chips in a microwave on high for 1 minute, stirring to ensure they are not sticking.  Divide the chips among warmed mugs.  Add the bailey's to the chips and mix well.  Serve very hot.

title: Potato and Yukon Gold Fondue
ingredients: 12 yukon gold potatoes, such as russets | 1/8 teaspoon cream of tartar
instructions: In a medium saucepan of boiling salted water, cook potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain and allow to cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes.  Cut potatoes into 1/4 inch cubes.  In a 4 to 5 quart crock, toss potatoes with cream of tartar.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: chili garlic sauce,red pepper,chocolate,red lentil,celery,olive,bacon,red chile pepper
title: Chilli Red Lentil and Bacon Dhal
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups red lentils | 1 red pepper, diced | 1 red chile pepper, diced | 2 slices bacon, chopped | 1/3 cup chopped celery | 1/3 cup crushed olives | 1 -2 tablespoon chili-garlic sauce | 2 tablespoons grated chocolate, or to taste
instructions: Place lentils and red peppers in a large pot with cold water.  Bring to a boil, then turn down heat and simmer for 10 minutes.  Strain off any excess water, then transfer lentils and peppers to a serving bowl.  Dice bacon and peppers using kitchen shears.  Stir fry bacon pieces in a skillet over medium heat.  Remove bacon from skillet and set aside, and add the celery, olives, chili garlic sauce and chocolate to the skillet.  Heat through, and serve.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,anchovy paste,salt,vodka,chicken meat,meatball,chicken bouillon cube
title: Peperonata Sicilian
ingredients: 1 chicken bouillon cube | 3 chicken meat, of your choice | 1/4 cup basil leaves, chopped | salt, to taste | 1 tablespoon dried anchovy paste | 24 meatballs | 1/4 cup vodka
instructions: In a large skillet fry the chicken meat until lightly brown.  Add salt, anchovy paste, meatballs and basil.  Add 1/4 cup vodka.

title: Spicy Thai Basil Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 bunch fresh thai basil | 1 1/2 lbs medium sweet potatoes, unpeeled, cut into bite sized chunks | 1/2 cup dry sherry | 1/2 cup icing sugar | 2 teaspoons vanilla
instructions: Wash and dry basil leaves, chop and put into a blender or food processor.  Blend well.  You may need to add more sherry.  In a large bowl, mix sweet potatoes, basil and 1/2 cup plus 1/2 cup of the sherry together.  If it seems too dry, add more sherry.  It should have a chunky texture, similar to play salad dressing.  Mixture should hold together when you press it with your finger.  Divide mix between 4 individual gratin dishes, spreading over top in an attractive manner.  Refrigerate for at least an hour.  Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup icing sugar over potatoes and bake in a 400º oven for 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from oven and let cool completely before serving cool to room temperature.  Serve warm, or cold at room temperature.  Can be served in individual serving dishes.

Random Ingredients: yeast,phyllo pastry,milk,italian salad dressing,black olive,lemon zest,kernel corn
title: Italian Cheese-Olive-Streusel Kugel
ingredients: 2 packages frozen breaded fresh phyllo pastry sheets ( 3 sheets, thawed ) | 2 tablespoons skim milk | 1/4 teaspoon lemon zest | 1 tablespoon dried italian salad dressing ( i used newman's own mediterranean ) | 1/2 cup whole kernel corn, drained | 1/2 cup pitted medium black olives, drained and coarsely chopped ( i used greek black olives ) | 1 tablespoon dried unbleached cane sugar or 1 tablespoon light brown sugar ( for sprinkling )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a medium bowl, combine the breaded sheets with the skim milk, lemon zest, italian dressing, corn, olives, cane sugar and 1/4 teaspoon salt.  Arrange the frozen phyllo mixture on the baking sheet, brush top generously with cold water, then cover with a towel.  Leave phyllo sheets in a warm spot until you have doubled the space you use it on, about 1 hour. .  Uncover and bake until top is bubbly and golden brown, 10 - 12 minutes.  Watch closely, because phyllo is extremely chewy.  Allow to cool on a wire rack.  Cut into 24 squares or diamonds, then refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Vegetable Lasagna-Lasagna
ingredients: 4 thin sliced red onions | 1 1/2 lbs uncooked lasagna noodle, cut in half | 2 tablespoons dried oregano
instructions: Preheat over to 400°f place one onion slice and half on each of 4 of the noodles.  Season with salt and pepper.  Top with 2 or 3 sliced and 1/2 cup of fresh oregano.  Top with the other 2 or 3 onions.  Spray a 14 cup cast iron grill with cooking spray and place one of the lasagna halves in the bottom, overlapping by half, if necessary.  Spray the remaining slices with cooking spray.  Pour 1½ cups of water into the pan.  Cover with foil and cook indirectly for 20 min or until water has evaporated and noodles are tender.  Remove from heat and serve while hot.

title: Asian Wrap
ingredients: 3 -5 lettuce leaves | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 teaspoon white sauce | 2 slices firm tofu ( optional )
instructions: Using a small knife, tear off excess thick parts of lettuce.  Remove any large leaves of the lettuce.  Slice tofu into thin strips about 1/4 inch long.  Place pieces on foil on a cutting board or other area of your choice.  Using your fingers, squeeze the tofu pieces and place them onto the tofu slices.  Make sure they are all in the same area.  Sprinkle with salt.  Sprinkle the turmeric and white sauce all over the tofu.  Wrap tightly in the aluminum foil and place on grill on medium heat.  Turn once or twice so each side is well cooked.  Take off heat when wraps become crispy and warm.  Serve with soy sauce or dipping sauce.

title: Creole Clam Cocktail
ingredients: 1/4 ounce cointreau liqueur | 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper ( i prefer black pepper ) | 1 ounce clam juice
instructions: Pour all ingredients into mugs of clam shaker and shake vigorously.  Chill till party time.

instructions: Set oven at 350 degrees.  Spray 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray.  Sprinkle sausage over cuts and roll up.  Place in baking dish, and bake in pre heated oven for 40 minutes. instructions: Clean off the stems of the mushrooms, and cut off any dark and exceedingly tough stems, leaving just the caps and stems attached to each other. Place the pancetta in a small frying pan, or skillet over mediumheat, and cook, stirring, until golden brown, and then add the mushrooms, turning gently and constantly, until tender and browned, approximately 10 minutes total, and remove the pan from the heat. Remove and discard the cap of the mushrooms.  Remove the meat from the chicken breasts if desired, and cut them into 1/2 inch cubes if the shells are large.  Remove all skin and vein from the shrimp, reserving the shells.  Place equal amounts of the shrimp shells on the bottom side of a 2 - 3 quart casserole dish or individual plates.  Place half of the chicken cubes in the hollowed out mushroom caps, arranging them side by side, and top them with the rest of the shrimp shells.  Sprinkle the remaining chopped pancetta over the shrimp.  Dollop the reserved reserved shrimp/crumetta sauce from the reserved mushroom caps into the dish.  Add the tomatoes and the lime rind, and then spoon 1 tablespoon of vinegar over the dish.  Place the dish, covered, over medium heat and cook until the casserole begins to bubble.

instructions: Heat the oven to 425°f.  Place the parsnips in a roasting ovenproof dish.  Combine the mustard and tarragon in a small bowl and spread over the parsnips.  Bake, uncovered, for 20 - 25 minutes, basting occasionally.  Serve sprinkled with the parsnips.

instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook spaghetti in the boiling water, stirring occasionally until cooked through but firm to the bite, 12 to 16 minutes.  Drain.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°.  Toast bread slices in oven.  Sprinkle generously with mexican cheese.  Place on serving platter and serve immediately.

If cheese mixture is too crumbly, add more blue cheese.  Serve with fruit and/or chips if desired.

Remove the bowl from the microwave and pour the sauce over.  Use 1 more teaspoon of hot sauce or less if necessary to cover the top of the bowl.  Let stand for 15 minutes.  Serve.

When the noodles become golden brown, stir in the almonds.  Spoon the noodles into serving bowls and sprinkle the remaining 1 1/2 tsp.  Extra virgin olive oil over top.

Reheat gently, taste for seasoning, and serve on warmed soup plates with a knob of butter.

title: Raspberry and Mushroom Loaves

Place dough in sprayed large loaf pan.  Let rise until doubled.  Bake at 400°f for 30 minutes.  Turn out and cool before slicing.

title: Chocolate Mince

title: Lemon Bread Filling

instructions: Cut bread in half diagonally and hollow out each bread half.  Mix together lemon juice and lard.  Tear off bread chunks if they are large enough.

instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c.  Grease a baking dish.  Place lamb pieces, carrots and olives in a large casserole dish.  Sprinkle over any remaining ingredients.  Pour any remaining tomato juice over everything.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours or until the meat and vegetables are tender.

title: Ranch Beans Salad
ingredients: 12 cups romaine lettuce ( washed ) | 1 can white beans
instructions: Boil beans until tender crisp.  Chill.

title: Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1 cup graham wafer crumbs | 1 cup diced unpeeled plum tomatoes | 4 tablespoons freshly rendered lard, melted | 8 cups red potatoes, cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  In a large bowl, mix graham wafer crumbs and tomatoes.  Add lard, and knead dough gently until firm.  Turn out onto a floured surface, and press wedges into wedges.  Arrange wedges in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Brush with some of the melted lard.  Bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.

Turn the shrimp over about 2 minutes, until the shrimp are coated, but not cooked through.  Place the shrimp on the hot, lightly oiled grill grate and cook for 1 - 2 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and just firm to the touch.  Serve the prawns warm or at room temperature.

title: Charishma's Veggie Salad

instructions: Wash and cut tomatoes into wedges.  Place 2 tbsp.  Of oil in a bowl and coat the tomatoes.  Add a sprinkle of cumin and a little cumin powder, stir, cover and allow to marinate for 10 - 15 mins.  Remove tomatoes from the marinade, add the green pepper and lime, mix.  Toss with salad.  Serve with bread or rice.

title: Spiced Peppers

instructions: Heat a wok, add oil and swirl to heat.  Add red bell peppers and stir fry for about 2 minutes.  Add water and salt and cover.  Simmer on low. Chill atleast one hour before serving.

title: Spicy Green Chili Sauce

instructions: Pour 1/2 cup juices from tomatoes into a medium sauce pan.  Heat over medium heat until mixture begins to bubble and is slightly thickened, 2 - 4 minutes. Pulse the remaining 1/2 cup tomatoes through the holes in the blender until chopped up.  Stir this chile sauce into the saucepan with the reserved juice.  Heat over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in peanut oil.  Serve hot over your favorite pasta or rice.
