ingredients: 4 cans great northern beans | 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 4 cups frozen corn | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 24 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Melt beans and red pepper flakes in a large saucepan.  Cover to boil on high.  Reduce heat to low and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.  Drain and cool.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Remove corn from freezer and thaw.  On a greased baking sheet, spread about 1/3 of beans and 1/3 of corn mixture in the middle.  Top with a second layer of phyllo.  Repeat process with remaining phyllo, beans and corn mixture.  Bake in preheated oven 40 minutes, or until golden brown.  Remove from oven and serve warm.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,banana,half,marsala wine,black pepper,whiskey,salmon,dark sesame oil
title: Alton Brown's Smoked Salmon
ingredients: 12 ounces smoked salmon, thinly sliced crosswise | 4 firm-ripe bananas, thinly sliced | 1 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup dry marsala wine | 6 tablespoons whiskey | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | freshly ground black pepper | 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: Preheat the broiler to high.  Line a sheet of parchment paper with foil.  Arrange the bananas on the prepared sheet, cut side down, and sprinkle with the 1 cup of the half and half.  Place the salmon on top.  Top with the remaining half and half.  Drizzle with the whiskey.  In a small bowl, stir the half and half, marsala, sesame oil, pepper, and 1/2 cup of the parmigiano.  Spread the mixture evenly over the salmon slices.  Sprinkle top with the remaining 1/2 cup parmigiano and cover loosely with foil.  Broil until the fish flakes easily when pierced with a fork, about 4 minutes.  Serve at once.

title: Grenadine Whole Wheat French Toast
ingredients:
2 cups low-fat whipping cream | 1/2 teaspoon lemon zest, finely grated | 1/4 cup regular whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons grenadine, can use 2 tbs.
    - if desired
instructions: Whisk whipping cream until stiff peaks form.  Stir in zest and sifted flour.  Dip each slice of bread one at a time in mixture and fry in medium nonstick skillet.  Serve immediately.

title: Crunchy Parmesan Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 1 package pork tenderloin | 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced | 1 cup fresh snow pea or 1 cup frozen snow pea | 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan | 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon peel
instructions: In a bowl, combine pork tenderloins, onion and snow pea in a single layer, tossing the vegetables with salt and pepper to taste and set aside.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spray a cookie sheet with non stick cooking spray.  Divide the tenderloins mixture into portions and place on the cookie sheet.  Bake about 25 minutes or until cooked through.  Turn the tenderloins and bake an additional 5 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle the parmesan and lemon peel over the entire tenderloins.  Serve with a salad or your favorite meal.

title: Cheesey Chickpea (Bean Dip)
ingredients: 1 can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed | 1/2 cup diced deli ham | 1/2 cup cubed mexican cheese | 1/2 cup chilled tahini | 1/2 cup chilled champagne or 1/2 cup sparkling wine
instructions: Combine beans, ham and cheese in a medium mixing bowl.  Using a blender or food processor, process until mixture forms a smooth paste.  Stir in tahini, champagne or sparkling wine.  Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Pumpkin Dutch Baby Onions
ingredients: 4 medium sized onions, cut on the diagonal in 1/4 inch slices | 10 ounces pumpkin puree | 10 ounces tomato puree | breadcrumbs or plain breadcrumbs | vanilla ( optional )
instructions: Mix pumpkin purée and tomato puree, season with a light dash of vanilla if desired.  Coat the onions in plenty of breadcrumbs or plain breadcrumbs then sprinkle with the breadcrumbs or plain buttermilk.  Cover and leave to marinate in the fridge for an hour or so on the very day making sure they are all covered or somewhere cool for about 24 hours at this stage but it is up to you.  Heat a small frying pan on low heat until very hot, pour a small amount of oil into frypan and heat to the smoking point, if the pan is too hot the contents of the pan may splatter.  Gently cook the onions for about 5 minutes, turning once, until deep golden brown.  Drain on kitchen paper, serve warm or cold.  If left for a longer time than this is suggested.

Random Ingredients: green onion,scallion,butter,part mozzarella cheese,cream mushroom soup,green pepper,pork steak
title: Pork Swiss Rollups
ingredients: 4 pork steak, cooked and cut in 4 equal portions ( i use very lean pork steak but use whatever you like ) | 8 slices part-skim mozzarella cheese | 4 scallions, chopped ( or other veggies you like ) | 1 1/2 cups swiss-style swiss onion, coarsely chopped ( i use a food processor to chop up the onions ) | 2 tablespoons green peppers, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons light cream of mushroom soup ( not cream of chicken ) | 2 tablespoons butter | 1/4 cup shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese | 3 green onions, sliced
instructions: Cut each portion of the swiss cheese into 4 equal portions.  Place one portion of the cheese at one end of each piece of pork tenderloin.  Roll up jellyroll style, place seam side down on a baking sheet.  Repeat with each portion until all of the swiss style swiss style swiss roll up is used up, packing the remaining swiss style swiss style swiss roll into a freezer bag to make them freeze solid later in a week.  Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Brown rolls on all sides, then set aside.  Mix together soup, green onion and green pepper in a saucepan until soup is hot, then stir in cream of mushroom soup.  Spread soup mixture evenly over cut surface of rolls, and top with reserved swiss style swiss cheese.  Roll up jellyroll style, and place seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Preheat oven to 400°f.  Sprinkle each roll with mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese is bubbly and melted, about 10 minutes.  If desired additional swiss cheese can be sprinkled over the top to make a pretty top layer.

Random Ingredients: basil leaf,garlic clove,single cream,peanut oil,extra virgin olive oil
title: Roasted Garlic Pepper Spread
ingredients: 2 1/2 pints fresh basil leaves | 1 garlic clove, peeled and finely chopped | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 cup single cream | 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Place the basil, garlic and 2 tablespoons of the olive oil in a food processor.  Process until finely chopped, about 10 seconds.  With your machine running, pour in the single cream through the feed tube and process until smooth.  Transfer to a clean bowl and using the blade of the food processor, process for 2 minutes.  Transfer the pepper mixture to a bowl, season to taste and serve with roasted garlic prawns and roasted vegetables.

Random Ingredients: paprika,taco sauce,lemongrass,parsley,plum jam,olive oil,grand marnier,cooking oil
title: Tangy Thai Lemongrass and Portabello Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil | 1/2 teaspoon paprika | 1 tablespoon lemongrass, minced | 1 teaspoon grand marnier | 1 teaspoon lemongrass, minced | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1/2 cup plum jam | 1/3 cup sweet soy sauce | 1/4 cup fish sauce or 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce | 2 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a 10' round or other deep frying pan.  Mix in the 1 teaspoons each of chile powder and paprika and add the grand marnier.

Random Ingredients: nonstick vegetable oil cooking spray,pear,orange zest,vegetarian worcestershire sauce,vanilla sugar
title: Vanillek Krumkake
ingredients: 100 g vegetarian worcestershire sauce | 100 g pure vanilla sugar ( i use pure vanilla ) | 1/4 teaspoon orange zest | 2 teaspoons nonstick vegetable oil cooking spray | 50 g unpared pears
instructions: Preheat oven to 200c.  Coat a baking tray with cooking spray.  In a glass bowl, combine the worcestershire sauce, vanilla sugar, orange zest, and vegetable oil.  Pour over the pears.  Bake for 20 minutes, then turn off the oven and leave the pears for 20 minutes.  Serve immediately with french fries or savoury bread.

title: Spicy Mexican Red Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long-grain rice or 1 cup brown rice, rinsed well | 1 cup mild salsa | 1 -2 1 -2 whole red chile ( optional )
instructions: Boil water in large, small skillet with tight fitting lid.  Add rice, mix well, reduce heat to simmer, cover and simmer 15 - 18 minutes, till creamy and slightly dry.  Add salsa and chillies, cover and cook 5 - 10 minutes till hot and rice has absorbed the water.

Random Ingredients: bread flour,madeira wine,white sugar,american cheese,lemon zest,philadelphia cream cheese
title: Cheese With White Wine (Madeira)
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups finely chopped white american cheese | 2 tablespoons madeira wine | 2 tablespoons bread flour, plus additional for dusting | 2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 teaspoon finely chopped lemon zest | 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon zest
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly.  Preheat your oven to 400 degrees f.  Using a rolling pin, roll out the cheese slightly, and roll it into a log about 1 inch in diameter.  Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and prick with a fork or a skewer.  Bake the cheese for about 12 minutes, or until it is lightly golden.  Remove the cheese from the oven and use a spatula to spread it out evenly.  Let it come to room temperature before cutting to serve or store the cheese for up to 2 months in airtight containers or freezer bags.

title: Hot Curry Powder
ingredients: 1 teaspoon coriander seed, crushed | 1 teaspoon amchur powder | 1 cup pineapple juice, from concentrate | 1 1/2 teaspoons curry powder ( i use penzey's curry powder ) ( optional )
instructions: Grind coriander and amchur in to a fine powder.  In a small frying pan, heat the pineapple juice till very hot then add the remaining ingredients.  Turn down the heat and allow to simmer for 5 minutes.  Mix well.  Keep on stovetop and serve hot.

title: Crock Pot Kielbasa
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon cumin | 1 teaspoon chili powder | 1 -2 teaspoon dried chili powder | 2 -4 links kielbasa, depending on size
instructions: Place all ingredients in a slow cooker, mix well, and cook on high for 90 minutes.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,worcestershire sauce,taco sauce,currant,hazelnut,basil leaf,king prawn,peanut oil
title: Spicy King Prawns
ingredients: 500 g king prawns | 1/2 cup coriander | 1/4 cup hazelnuts | 1 pinch chili pepper flakes | 1 pinch dried basil leaves | 1 tablespoon curry powder or 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce | 1/4 cup taco sauce | 1 tablespoon peanut oil
instructions: Peel the prawns leaving just the tail intact or buy them raw as usual.  Place in a bowl and cover with water.  Add in all other ingredients.  Leave in the fridge for at least two hours to develop flavours.  When ready, remove prawns and run under cold tap water.  Drain.  Heat in a little oil until pink then serve immediately.

title: Antipasto
ingredients: 1/4 lb genoa salami ( about 1/3 of a 10 count, sliced very thin ) | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 2 tablespoons adobo sauce ( from a can of chipotle peppers ) | 1 teaspoon turmeric | 1/2 tablespoon rubbed rosemary, minced | toasted balsamic vinegar, for brushing | fresh chives, for garnish
instructions: Whisk together the ingredients, add more or less to taste.  Pour over steak.  Marinate.  Serve over noodles or pizza dough.

Random Ingredients: fruit preserve,lime wedge,spanish onion,aji amarillo chili paste,baby spinach
title: Spinach and Fresh Lime
ingredients: 10 ounces fresh baby spinach, packed | 1 small spanish onion, julienned | sliced fresh fruit preserves, such as preserves | 2 teaspoons aji aji amarillo chili paste | 1 lime wedges
instructions: Thoroughly wash the spinach with fresh water.  Drain well, then place in a bowl with a little of the water clinging to it.  Toss to combine.  Cover with plastic and let stand for 20 minutes at room temperature.  Drain well and pat dry with a paper towel.  In a large saute pan set over medium heat, warm 1/2 the olive oil.  Add the onion and cook for a couple of minutes, until softened.  Add the spinach, reserving some for a garnish.  Pour the remaining olive oil into the pan and cook, stirring, until wilted.  Spread the spinach mixture over the spinach.  Scatter the sliced jalapenos over top.  Sprinkle with amarillo aji aji and serve immediately.

title: Apple Cider
ingredients: 4 ounces parmesan cheese | 2 1/2 cups apple cider
instructions: Pour the apple cider into a small, non reactive bowl, place bowl into freezer to speed up the process.  Grate the parmesan cheese into the bowl with 2 tbsp.  Of the parmesan cheese.  Add 1 teaspoon of the grated cheese to the bowl of cheese.  Repeat with the rest of the cheese.  Makes about two cups, depending on whether you are serving a loaf of french or french bread for dinner, or whether you are making small curd curds for dinner, it is a pretty sight to serve it with a bit of the remaining parmesan cheese alongside.  If the loaf or curds aren't thick enough for dipping, you can add about 2 tsp.  Of flour to about 1/4 cup water.  If the loaf or curds make it too thick, you can add a little more water.

title: Peeled Shrimp in Lemon
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg medium raw shrimp, peeled | 16 strips lemons, cut in half
instructions: Place shrimp in a shallow, non metallic, glass pan.  Arrange 3 lemon peel slices on top of the shrimp.  Drizzle the lemon juice over.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 - 6 hours minimum.  Remove shrimp from refrigerator and turn twice during this time.  Heat oven to 180c then grill for 6 - 8 minutes on each side.

title: Italian Soft Taco Nachos W- Okra and Chiles
ingredients: 1 lb ground pork | 3 cups cooked okra, chopped | 1 can hot chinese mushrooms, sliced and drained | 1 can italian-style petite diced tomatoes | 1/2 teaspoon all purpose greek seasoning | 3 tablespoons catsup | 1 tablespoon dried epazote ( found in indian specialty stores ) or 1 tablespoon cilantro | tortilla chips
instructions: Place all ingredients in a frying pan and heat thoroughly until all ingredients are mixed well, stirring often.  Serve warm with chips.  Note, use a lot of chopped okra.  This recipe also works well with potatoes and corn.  I often serve with tortilla chips.

title: Spiced Fish on Toast
ingredients: 2 1/4 - 3 lbs white fish fillets | 4 slices of medium white bread, toasted
instructions: Remove fish from skin and pat dry with paper towels.  Arrange on a large platter or baking sheet and set aside.  Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper.  Spoon off any remaining fat.  Place toast in a large, shallow serving dish.  Heat griddle or nonstick skillet over medium heat.  When hot, add fish and continue cooking, turning fish over once until it is cooked through.  Serve immediately.  Serves the fish with dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: red wine vinegar,fruit,wine vinegar,graham cracker crumb,red pesto sauce,cilantro,yellow squash,cucumber
title: Grilled Squash and Summer Squash Salad
ingredients: 3 zucchini, about 1 pound | 3 cups yellow squash, about 3 pounds | 1/4 cup red pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce | 2 teaspoons wine vinegar | 2 teaspoons chopped fresh cilantro | 1/4 cup red wine vinegar | 1/4 cup coarse graham cracker crumbs
instructions: In a large steamer basket, combine zucchini, squash, pesto, worcestershire sauce, and wine vinegar.  Cover and steam over high heat until vegetables are tender crisp, about 5 minutes.  Cool for 4 minutes.  Transfer to a large bowl.  Stir in cilantro.

title: Bamboo Shoot-Sakura Shoot Soda
ingredients: fresh soda water | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained and canned
instructions: Fill a large glass with ice.  Pour about 1/4 cup soda into the glass.  Pour in the canned bamboo shoots and then pour in carbonated soda to fill the glass.  The soda will make the glass cloudy.  Scoop up the soda with a spoon or other convenient device to make the soda cloudy or carbonated.  Serve as straws to your guests with the hot soda.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker,anise extract,cherry tomato,mozzarella cheese,penne pasta,kielbasa,shrimp
title: Penne With Kielbasa, Shrimp, and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 package dried kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 1 quart cherry tomatoes, quartered | 1 cup miniature graham crackers | 1 tablespoon anise extract | 1 tablespoon kosher salt | 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 4 fresh shrimp, cleaned
instructions: In a large stockpot, cook kielbasa and cherry tomatoes until the sausage is browned, about halfway through.  Drain in a colander.  Stir graham crackers into sausage mixture, and cook on medium heat until the crackers begin to turn light brown, 1 to 2 minutes.  Remove from heat, and stir in anise extract, salt, and half the shredded mozzarella cheese.  Place shrimp in a large bowl, and pour sauteed cheese over.

Random Ingredients: pea,maida flour,chinese five spice powder,thai chile,snow pea
title: Spice Chinese Pea Soup
ingredients: 5 ounces peas ( frozen, thawed ) | 4 ounces snow peas | 1 teaspoon chinese five spice powder | 3 thai chiles, deseeded and finely chopped | 3 tablespoons maida flour
instructions: Heat 5oz of the peas and 3oz of the snow peas in a saucepan over a medium heat.  Add five spice powder and chinese 5 spice powder.  Cook for 1 minutes.  Add the peas and snow peas.  Cook for about 2 minutes.  Whisk the maida flour in a little water and mix into the soup.  Cook for 3 - 4 minutes.  Serve hot.

title: Pork Fried ribs (Chicken Wings)
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings | 1 lb chicken leg, tips and wings trimmed | 1 cup heavy cream | chili flakes | 1 -2 cup broth
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together chicken and leg tips until they are thoroughly covered with liquid, leaving about 1/4 inch thick layer on all sides.  Lay chicken wings flat on cutting board and, using a sharp knife, cut down the center portion of each wing.  Using a teaspoon or 2 of heavy cream on each wing, spread the cream over the top of these pieces.  Use enough to coat most of the chicken.  Using a fork, poke deep holes into the chicken meat in which it was studded with strips of chili flakes and place them in the chicken.  Heat a large, heavy bottomed pot with a tight fitting lid over high heat.  When the coals are very hot, place the chicken in the pot.  Add enough chicken stock to just cover the chicken.  Cook until the chicken is cooked through, and the liquid is reduced by almost half.  Cut chicken into 6 pieces and place back into pot.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: chicken tender,celery rib,peanut oil vegetable,cod,self raising flour
title: Seed Bakes
ingredients: 500 g cod, skinned and cut into 4cm pieces | 60 g self raising flour | 1 celery rib, chopped | 2 teaspoons peanut oil or 2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 60 g roasted peanuts or 60 g dry roasted peanuts, chopped
instructions: Place fish in a heatproof bowl and pour over enough water to cover.  Leave for 15 minutes.  Drain and dry with paper towel.  Combine flour, celery and 2 teaspoons oil and the remaining oil, mix well.  Add water if batter is dryening.  Stir in peanuts.  Dry fish in hot oil and fry until lightly browned.

title: Egyptian Beef Stew Recipe
ingredients: 1 package frozen mixed vegetables | 2 lbs beef stew meat, cut in 1/4 inch strips or 2 lbs fresh beef bones, cut up | 6 -10 saffron threads | 1 jar beef-and-vegetable juices ( optional )
instructions: Combine stew meat and saffron seeds in large, heavy kettle.  Cover and cook over medium low heat for about 1 - 2 hours, or until meat falls of easily when pricked.  Remove meat from kettle and put in large dish.  Pour any remaining broth into kettle and mix with the beef.  Add saffron flavor packets, if desired.

title: Potato Mushroom Pancakes
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs small firm ripe white mushrooms | 1/2 ounce bourbon | 1 -2 slice bacon ( not traditional, i used just 2 slices of bacon for the 2 ) | 3 tablespoons milk | 1/4 lb thick cut bacon, chopped into small chunks | 1 1/2 cups boiling watercress | 1 large potato, peeled and cut into 1/4 to 1/2 inch dice | 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar, packed | 1/4 cup shredded prosciutto
instructions: Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid.  Set mushrooms aside.  Pour reserved liquid in a saucepan and add bourbon.  Scrape the bottom of the pan to release any browned bits and bits left by the bacon.  Cook over medium heat until reduced by about half and pour into a bowl.

title: Simple Indian Pork Tenderloins
ingredients: 6 pork tenderloins | 1 pinch asafoetida powder, or to taste
instructions: Heat an iron skillet over medium high heat, and cook the tenderloins, turning occasionally, until browned, about 20 minutes.  Sprinkle the asafetida powder over the tenderloins to taste.

title: Easy Low Fat French Bread Coconut Dip Mix
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread or 1 loaf sourdough bread, cut in half lengthswise ( about 16 ounces ) | 1 can coconut cream | 1 -3 tablespoon mustard powder ( to taste ) | picante sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor.  Process on lowest speed setting until paste forms fine bread crumbs.  The longer it is blend and the more creamy the mixture the tastier the dip will be serve with fresh fruit, vegetables, crackers, bread or toast pieces.

title: Shrimp and Vegetable Couscous With Crisp Prosciutto
ingredients: 1 jar barberries, whole, frozen | 1 cup roasted red cabbage, shredded | 1/2 cup diced prosciutto, sliced thinly | 1/4 cup red anaheim chilies, sliced thinly | 6 ounces shrimps, uncooked or 6 ounces shrimp, fresh if you have it | 1/2 cup couscous | 2 garlic cloves, minced
instructions: Combine everything but couscous.  Put in a covered bowl and let sit for 15 minutes or more.  Fluff with a fork.  Serve warm over couscous.

title: Irish Corned Beef Brisket
ingredients: 3 lbs corned beef brisket, with lots of room to move | 1/2 cup fish sauce ( such as a&k ) | 1/4 cup onion powder | 1 -2 teaspoon savory | 1 -2 teaspoon saffron | 1/4 teaspoon onion powder | 1/4 cup irish cream
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Place roast in a large, oval, glass baking dish and cover with a tight fitting lid.  Add any remaining seasonings.  Place a heavy plate on top and weigh it down tightly.  Bake for 45 minutes, remove, tenting with foil, and allow to sit 10 minutes.  Uncover and continue to bake for 15 minutes more.  Remove corned beef and let sit for another 15 minutes or so.  Cut against the grain in slices approximately 1/2 inch thick.  Heat the fat in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering.  Cook brisket slices on all sides until they are browned.  Remove from skillet and place in a warm dish.  Brisket may be served at room temperature with some horseradish sauce poured over the meat.  You can use any commercial prepared horseradish sauce.  Keep refrigerated after cooling for about 24 hours so the flavors can develop.  Serve with horseradish sauce for dipping the meat.

Random Ingredients: hot water,plain yogurt,tomato juice,egg,parmigiano reggiano cheese,za'atar spice mix,italian dressing
title: Greek Yogurt & Za'atar Egg Kugel (Pizza With Veggie Mayo)
ingredients: 2/3 cup fat-free plain yogurt | 1 egg, slightly beaten | 3/4 cup za'atar spice mix | 2 cups hot water | 3/4 cup dry italian-style salad dressing | 1 cup diced tomatoes with juice | 1/2 cup grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: First prepare the kugel filling.  Combine the yogurt & egg in a bowl & set aside.  In a measuring cup, mix the za'atar & hot water until smooth.  With a spoon, stir in the yogurt mixture & add in the za'atar mix.  Refrigerate until ready to use.  Prepare the salad dressing, combine the tomato & parmigiano in a bowl & set aside.  Cut 2 or 3 deep slashes in the base of the kugel, spacing them about 1/2 apart.  Brush the inside of a 10” springform skillet with a little bit of water & place it in the oven for 8 – 10 minutes, until hot.  Remove from the oven, then drain the kugel on a paper towel.  Brush the kugel with a little bit of the olive oil, then top it with the za'atar mixture, tomatoes & parmigiano then broil it in the oven for about 5 minutes, or until the kugel is lightly browned.  Remove from the oven & cut in half.

title: Passion Dessert
ingredients: 1 cup passion fruit, pulp | 1/2 cup plain yogurt, beaten
instructions: Place passion fruit pulp, yogurt and passionfruit pulp in a small bowl.  Top with crushed ice and serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,ginger garlic paste,chinese white rice wine,almond extract,roasting chicken,rice
title: Chinese Restaurant-Style Almonds-Rice
ingredients: 1 roasting chickens | 2 teaspoons ginger-garlic paste ( i used fresh garlic, i can find it at asian grocer ) | 2 cups white rice, soaked for 30 minutes and drained | 6 cups tomato sauce ( i used hunts ) | 6 tablespoons chinese white rice wine | 1 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Pre heat oven to 400°f place chicken in an oven proof skillet or baking dish.  Sprinkle with ginger garlic paste and lightly toss with your hands to coat chicken evenly.  Spread rice on chicken and put in oven for 45 - 60 minutes.  While chicken is cooking combine remaining ingredients in a mixing bowl, pour over chicken and return to oven, uncovered and continue cooking until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.

title: Cake of Heaven Noodle Cocktail
ingredients: 2 ounces rice noodles, rinsed | 8 ounces half-and-half | 1 serrano pepper | 1/4 cup bourbon | 1 dash cayenne | 1 dash dry sherry
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl with a tablespoon or so of bourbon as it slowly heats up.  Serve with ice or paprika to your taste.

title: Pimentón-Huitres Con Ajo
ingredients: 1 lb pine nuts | 1 teaspoon baking soda, dissolved in | 1 cup salsa | 1 scotch bonnet pepper, minced
instructions: Pour the pine nuts into a colander and set aside to drain.  In a small pan, add the dissolved baking soda, and mix until dissolved.  Add the salsa and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.  In a small frying pan, heat the chile pepper over medium heat.  Remove from heat when the chile pepper is soft, and drain them on a clean paper towel.  In a large, deep skillet over medium heat, toast the pine nuts until you can smell the aroma of the garlic from the smell behind.  Spread the nuts on a large plate, and sprinkle the pine nuts over them.  Use a spatula to scrape up any the nuts, and spread the salsa right along the top.  Let the mixture cool before serving, and serve it as a condiment with fried fish tacos or grilled chicken.

title: Yummy Yummy Vegan Browned Tomatoes-Celts
ingredients: 4 roma tomatoes | 50 g quick-cooking barley ( see intro ) | 1 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/4 cup chervil ( optional )
instructions: Cut tops off tomatoes, and cut into cubes.  Place in microwave safe bowl.  Add the barley into bowl and microwave on high 1 minute.  Stir until all vegetables are softened.  Sprinkle with xanthan gum and chervil or both.  Microwave on high for 20 seconds, stir and microwave for 2 minutes more, or until tomatoes are cooked, stirring from time to time.

title: Fried Eggplant With Shrimp
ingredients: 500 g eggplants, peeled and coarsely chopped | 2 egg whites, lightly beaten | 300 g medium shrimp, cleaned | cornmeal
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or deep fat fryer over high heat.  Add the egg and cook for one minute or until it starts to colour.  Add the shrimp and fry for one minute.  Remove with a slotted spoon and place on paper towel lined plate.  Keep warm in the 180°c oven.  Heat the oil to 180°c once its hot, add the eggplant to the hot oil and fry for one minute or until golden.  Drain on absorbant paper.  Sprinkle with cornflour and serve with the shrimp.

title: My Favourite Italian Cheese - Paula Deen
ingredients: 16 ounces velveeta cheese, cut into 1 by 1 sticks | 1 bag confectioners'sugar | 1 dash of italian seasoning or 1 dash seasoning salt, to taste | 1 1/2 cups velveeta cheese, cut into 1 by 1 sticks
instructions: In a large bowl combine 8 ounces of the velveeta sticks, the confectioners sugar, italian seasoning and seasoning salt.  Grate the 1 1/2 cups of the remaining 2/3 of velveeta sticks.  Place the mixture in a large ziplock bag and add the cheese to the bag and place in the refrigerator for 2 hours.  After 2 hours the cheese has become more soft and the texture a little bit smoother the cheese should still be warm.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place the bag of cheese onto a paper lined cookie tray, flatten slightly.  Place ziplock bag with the cheese into the oven.  Turn the oven off and the cheese will be golden brown and bubbly.  The cheese should be warm and bubbly throughout.  Remove the oven from the oven and place in the refrigerator to cool for at least 30 minutes.  Cut the bag of cheese into 1/2 slices.  Place each slice back onto the baking tray.  Place back onto the oven and bake for 10 - 12 minutes until the cheese is melted and a little crisped.  Place on a rack to cool for 3 - 4 minutes.  Place the slices onto a cutting board.  When all you are done with the cheese and cheese, cut the bag of cheese into small pieces and roll each slice in the bag of cheese.  Enjoy.

title: Mama-Somma (Aunt Marie's Recipe)
ingredients: 4 swordfish steaks | 4 teaspoons corn flakes | 1 cup grape | 2 ounces pimientos, sliced | 4 teaspoons greshbow greek hamburger, crumbled
instructions: Grill swordfish.  Serve in a bowl with corn flakes mixed with grape and pimientos.  Serve with a salad.  Enjoy.

title: Mint-Baked Applesauce Popsicles
ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened applesauce | 1/2 cup dark brown sugar | 1/2 cup corn oil | 1 2/3 cups miniature marshmallows | 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/4 teaspoon ground mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Lightly grease the insides and sides of four 4 ounce ramekins with vegetable cooking spray or butter.  In a blender or food processor, puree appleauce, sugar, oil, marshmallows, ground cloves, and mint together until smooth.  Place about 1 1/2 teaspoons of the mixture into each ramekin.

Random Ingredients: cod,macaroni,broiler fryer chicken,serrano chilies,burrito flour tortilla,anaheim chili
title: Broiler-Fryer Stew With Smoky Cod (Crock Pot)
ingredients: 8 ounces broiler-fryer chickens | 1 serrano chilies | 4 ounces anaheim chili, roughly sliced | 16 ounces macaroni | 16 burrito-size flour tortillas
instructions: Place chicken in crock pot.  Cut up serrano chilies into 1/2 pieces and place over chicken.  Place anaheim chili in crock pot with the remaining ingredients.  Cook on low until the stew is hot, but not boiling.  Serve with flour tortilla and remaining sauce for dipping.

title: Chutney and Fruit Dip
ingredients: 410 g mango chutney | 1 jar apricots, chopped | chili oil
instructions: Combine ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate.

title: Corn Flakes With Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cups corn flakes | 1 1/2 cups whipping cream | 1/2 lb plum tomato ( seeded, dicing is optional but i prefer it )
instructions: Dry corn flakes in oil.  Heat cream& tomatoes in microwave.  Add flakes & gently mix.  Pour over hot corn flakes, toss lightly & serve.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,yellow pepper,ancho chilies,golden syrup,honey,brown sugar
title: Yummy Sweet Peppers
ingredients: 5 medium yellow peppers | 16 ounces tomato paste | 1/4 cup brown sugar | 1/4 cup honey | 2 tablespoons golden syrup | 2 dried ancho chilies ( dried red chilies - 1/4 inch long )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Wash and core bell peppers.  Cut into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place pepper slices in oiled baking dish and lightly coat with water.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.  Place tomato paste in a small bowl. .  Add next 4 ingredients.  Mix well.  Pour over peppers, bake 30 to 35 minutes until bubbling.

title: Farfalle Pasta With Caramelized Butter Beans
ingredients: 10 tablespoons butter beans, warmed | 3/4 cup quick-cooking oats | 2 teaspoons baking powder | 1 teaspoon dried savory | 7 ounces farfalle pasta or 7 ounces penne pasta, cooked
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons butter beans in large skillet over medium heat.  Stir in oats and baking powder.  Sprinkle with savory.  Stir to mix.  Stir in pasta.  Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons butter beans before serving.

Random Ingredients: cake flour,butter,balsamic vinegar,pesto sauce,celery seed,masa harina
title: Pesto Muffins
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups masa harina | 1 cup cake flour ( all purpose ) | 2 2/3 cups milk or 2 2/3 cups soymilk | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 3 tablespoons butter | 2 tablespoons celery seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  In a large bowl mix 1/2 cup masa harina, cake flour, milk and vinegar, using a fork.  Stir in butter.  Using hands or a pastry blender, scrape dough into 3 to 4 muffin cups, pressing slightly to flatten each cup.  Sprinkle reserved 1/2 cup masa harina over each and bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes.  Cool for 5 minutes on a wire rack.  Spoon pesto into a bowl and drizzle with 1/4 cup pesto and sprinkle with celery seeds.

Random Ingredients: arbol chile,hard egg,italian breadcrumb,red wine vinegar,scallion,masa harina,chipotle chile,beef
title: Spicy Chipotle Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried arbol chile | 1 cup tomatoes, chopped | 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar ( to taste ) | 2 tablespoons masa harina | 1 1/2 lbs ground beef ( or turkey ) | 1/4 cup scallion, chopped | 1 egg, beaten | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs
instructions: In a small pan, combine the chiles, tomatoes vinegar, and masa harina.  Boil, stirring, for 3 minutes.  Remove pan from heat.  Add ground beef, breaking up into small pieces until it is the texture of coarse crumbs.

title: Hot Chocolate Shrimp
ingredients: 10 medium shrimp, cleaned cooked, tail on
instructions: Remove shells and heads from shrimp and put in clean bowl.  Cut tails lengthwise then crosswise into 1 slice.  Save heads for stock.  Place in medium size bowl.  Break shells so shells are not open when stirred.  Discard shells.  Dip shrimp in vinegar to coat.  Transfer to large covered dish and cover with plastic wrap.  Chill for 1 hour or until sauce is thick and syrupy.  Chill again in refrigerator.  Unwrap shrimp and serve.  Variation, for a change, instead of mace, replace 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon with 1/4 teaspoon ground white pepper.

Random Ingredients: half,salmon fillet,red cabbage,whipping cream,pinto bean,grand marnier,basmati rice
title: Creamy Cabbage Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup basmati rice | 3 cups chopped red cabbage | 1/2 cup canned pinto beans, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup whipping cream | 1/2 cup half-and-half | 2 teaspoons grand marnier | 2 salmon fillets, skin removed
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.  Meanwhile, place cabbage in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover with 1/4 cup water.

title: Apricot Squash on the Half Shell
ingredients: 1 small yellow squash, unpeeled | 1/3 cup apricot jam ( or apricot preserves, your choice )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Slice off and discard the stem ends of the squash.  Slice the squash into rounds about 1/4 inch thick.  Spread 1 tbsp of jam on each round and place on a baking sheet.  Bake in oven, turning once, about 45 minutes or until tender.  Serve warm.

title: Cellophane Noodle Salad
ingredients: 4 ounces cellophane noodles | 2 ounces radishes, diced
instructions: Fill a large frying pan or wok with boiling water, and bring to a boil.  Add the noodles, and continue to boil over medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes, until the noodles have turned light golden in color.  Drain the noodles, and toss with the radishes.  If you like, you can serve the dish in lettuce leaves or green salad leaves for dipping.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,white vinegar,nonstick cooking spray,maraschino cherry,madras curry powder,pearl barley
title: Barley Pudding
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups pearl barley ( i use brown or red ) | 2 teaspoons madras curry powder, plus more | 1 tablespoon madras curry powder and 2 tablespoons madras curry powder | 2 tablespoons nonstick cooking spray | 1/3 cup nonstick cooking spray, and | 1 dash white vinegar or 1 dash cider vinegar | cornstarch | maraschino cherry
instructions: Bring water to a boil.  Place barley at the pot.  Drain water from pot and add curry powder.  Simmer until tender, about 15 minutes.  Turn off heat if you are using the liquid.  Spray puddings thoroughly with nonstick cooking spray.  Coat them in batter.  Spray a 1 1/2 quart oven proof casserole or other 2 quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray.  Place the cornstarch in a small bowl.  Add vinegar and pour into the milk/water.  Whisk until clear.  Return the mixture to the pot.  Cook over low heat until thickened.  Remove from heat.  Spread the puddings over the tap and let sit for 3 minutes before serving.  Top with cherries or more of your choice of garnish.

title: Authentic Tajine
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, coarsely chopped | 2 teaspoons saffron powder
instructions: Combine the beef and the saffron powder in a slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low overnight.  Remove the meat from the slow cooker and set aside to cool.  Cover the slow cooker and place it on a solid, level surface.  In a small bowl, mix together 2 tablespoons of water with the saffron mixture.

title: Bread and Lentils
ingredients: 7 cups bread, crustless, chopped stale bread | 3/4 cup frozen green lentils | 1 cup light cream or 1 cup fat-free milk | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules | cookie, cut up
instructions: In medium bowl, use a food processor to chop bread into cubes.  Add lentils, cream and bouillon.  Cover and process until all ingredients have been blended, about 1 minute.  Spread into 8 inch square baking dish.  Refrigerate 30 minutes.  Remove dish from refrigerator and turn over onto serving platter.  Arrange around edge of platter with small knife blade.  Cut into wedges.  Makes 8 servings.

title: Sushi Shimi
ingredients: 3 pie shells | 1/3 cup spring onion, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons sherry | 1 dash five-spice powder
instructions: Cook the pie shells following the package directions.  Allow 10 minutes to cool.  Drain, then add the spring onions and sherry and five spice powder.  Mix thoroughly.  Serve with rice, sushi sticks, sushi nori or fried tofu.

title: Kosher Taro Roots
ingredients: 1 lb fresh taro root, peeled | 5 1/2 - 6 cups kosher kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped | green peppers, roasted or red, sliced, roasted, if desired
instructions: Place the roots in their pods on a cutting board, leaving a little flesh on top.  Place the root ends up on a cutting board and with the root end cut in half lengthwise.  Using your fingers, scrape the scallion pulp with a knife down the sides of the root.  Slice the root into about 1/4 inch thick slices and place them under running cold water until tender.  Transfer the taro roots to a colander, cover and place in a medium bowl.  Toss with the olives and toss thoroughly.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.  Serve at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: sultana,jumbo pasta shell,rump steak,lasagna noodle,apricot preserve,sirloin,garam masala
title: Jumbo Beef Stuffed Shells with Sesame Flavours
ingredients: 8 ounces jumbo pasta shells | 1/2 lb sirloin, cut into bite sized pieces | 1/2 teaspoon garam masala | 8 ounces apricot preserves | 1/4 cup sultana | 12 ounces lasagna noodles, cooked | 3/4 lb rump steak, trimmed and very finely chopped
instructions: Cook shells according to directions.  Drain and set aside.  In a medium sized pan melt the apricot preserves with sultanas on medium high, stirring often.  Add the meat, stirring to combine, cook until the meat takes on color then set aside.  In an oven proof dish, add the meat mixture and the cooked shells and top with the sesame flavouring.  Add any remaining stuffing to your liking of stuffing.  Cover and bake in 375f degrees.  For 40 minutes.

title: Simple and Tasty Garlic Salmon
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs salmon fillets | 6 garlic cloves ( or more if you prefer )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Line a rack with foil, with parchment paper or tin foil, and grease the foil with vegetable oil.  Wash the fish thoroughly under cold water and put the flesh in the shallow tray.  Smash the 6 cloves of garlic with the flat side of a knife or with your fingers in a pestle and mortar.  Push the garlic through a sieve into a bowl.  Pour about 1/4 cup of the oil into the pan and place over high heat.  When it shimmers, quickly add the salmon fillet and stir.  Turn the fillet and fry on medium high for 5 - 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Transfer to the foil lined baking tray, sprinkle the garlic over it and bake for 12 minutes or until the fish is just cooked through and the garlic is fragrant.  If you have a grill, heat the broiler and broil fish.

Random Ingredients: french bread,coriander seed,puff pastry,mung bean sprout,walnut
title: Muamba
ingredients: 2 sheets puff pastry, thawed | 1 package mung bean sprouts | 1 packet coriander seeds | 4 ounces walnuts, chopped | 1 loaf french bread, slices cut into 1-inch thick diagonal slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f.  Line a roasting tin with baking paper.  Place the puffs on a baking tray.  Roast for 5 minutes.  Place the sprouts on the pastry with the coriander, nuts and bread.  Brush with a little milk and bake for 20 minutes.  Serve immediately.  Makes 4 servings.

title: Chili Hazelnut Spread
ingredients: 2 cups hazelnuts | 3 cups packed brown sugar | 2 cups mild chili pepper flakes | 2 cups vinegar | 1 cup coarsely grated fresh mozzarella cheese
instructions: Combine hazelnuts, sugar, chili flakes, vinegar and cheese.  Blend until smooth.  Pour into lightly buttered 8x8 pyrex dish.  Bake in 350 deg.  Oven 20 to 30 minutes.  Serve warm with crackers.

title: Grilled Bananas for Two
ingredients: 2 large bananas | 1 tablespoon brown sugar
instructions: Peel the bananas if they are any thicker then bite size.  Slice the bananas lenghtwise.  Grill on both sides with the brown sugar.  Watch them take about five minutes or so.

Random Ingredients: kiwi fruit,iceberg lettuce,arborio rice,red bell pepper
title: Fruit Romany(Costa Rican, Caribbean)
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 red bell pepper, sliced | 2 kiwi fruits, peeled and sliced | iceberg lettuce or other small lettuce leaf, for serving
instructions: Preheat grill pan or stovetop grill pan high.  Place rice on hot grill or burner, and toast rice quickly, moving rice around continuously with a fork.  Turn heat to low, and cook until rice is dark golden in color, 10 - 15 minutes.  Spread rice with red bell pepper, kiwi fruit pieces, and lettuce leaves.  Serve immediately.

Place packages on baking sheet and microwave on high 8 minutes until heated through.  Remove from microwave and cut packages in half, remove air pockets and serve.

title: Green olives, Cornflour and Comino Cheese Mold
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornflour ( cornstarch ) | 300 ml light coconut milk | 140 g grated gruyere cheese (, about 1/4 of grated ) | 6 scallions, finely chopped ( green shallots or spring onions ) | 3 tablespoons green olives, sliced ( optional )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 200c.  Mix cornflour and 1 litre coconut milk in a saucepan, heat gently, stirring until mixture boils and thickens.  Remove from heat, stir in cheese and sprinkle over scallions, if using.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,red potato,frisee,oregano leaf,pickle,extra beef,tomato puree,ginger ale
title: Guinness Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 lb extra lean stew meat | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 2 teaspoons finely diced peeled fresh ginger ale | 1/4 cup seeded chopped mixed pickles | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely chopped fresh oregano leaves | 1/2 teaspoon coarsely chopped fresh rosemary leaves | 2 tablespoons finely chopped golden raisins | 1 lb small red potato, scrubbed, scrubbed, halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Coat a baking dish with cooking spray.

title: Cashew Crackers (Gobhi Roti)
ingredients: 200 g rye flour | 1/4 teaspoon garlic, powder | 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon | 1/2 teaspoon dried cashews | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix all the dry ingredients together.  Add cashew nuts and vanilla essence and mix well.  The dough should have the texture of french mayonnaise.  Heat a flat based pan.  If it is too hot, the dough will not absorb any air, but instead it must remain a little moist.  Spread cashew batter in the pan.  After 15 minutes, check the underside of your dough.  If you feel that the dough is drying out, remove the dough from the pan.  If it is, then wait for another 10 or 15 minutes, if your dough is dry, it should be dry in areas.  You may need to add a few drops of water.  Slice the dough into 1 - 2 inch squares or desired shapes.  Remove any cashew seeds in the cracker by placing them over a small saucepan of boiling water for a few seconds.  Drain them.

title: Noodles in Banana Syrup
ingredients: 1 medium firm ripe tomatoes ( about 1 pound ) or 1 medium red capsicum ( about 1 pound, chopped ) | 1 medium ripe banana ( about 1 pound ) | 1 teaspoon hot cocoa | 1 tablespoon sunflower oil | 1 lb fresh sausage, sliced | 4 hot cooked noodles
instructions: If using a tin, trim the top and base discarding the ends and centre ribs.  If using fresh tomato or pepper, slice fairly thickly and halve the length.  Cut up the banana lengthwise and cut into thin slices.  Put the tin of tomatoes through a coarse grinder with the hot cocoa and sunflower oil.  Grind the mixture, adding a generous amount of water, into the tin, using a spoon this process should get the consistancy of pure cream.  Cut sausage into chunks, fry in a large pan until crisp and drain well, add to sauce, mixing well, simmer for about 5 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly.  Taste and correct for seasoning, set aside, serve cold.  Ifusing fresh tomato or red pepper, saute it in a little oil, then drain.  Stir into sauce, heat and then serve hot with noodles.

Random Ingredients: hot green chili pepper,sherry wine vinegar,oxtail,jalapeno pepper,oyster mushroom,soymilk,red potato
title: Soy and Chilli Oxtail Stew (Kong Manis)
ingredients: 1 lb oxtail | 1 cup fresh oyster mushrooms | 2 fresh hot green chili peppers | 2 fresh jalapeno peppers | 1 bunch fresh jalapeno pepper | 1/2 cup sherry wine vinegar ( to taste ) | 1 cup soymilk or 1 cup coconut milk
instructions: Cut the oxtails into pieces approximately 3/4 inch square and remove any extra fat and discard or use less broth if desired.  Cut mushrooms into 1/2 to 1/2 inch wide pieces and deseed and devein the peppers.  Slice the chilis thinly into half moons and set aside.  Remove the tips of the coringles and discard.  Cut the corlingles into thin slivers.  Remove any remaining fat from the oxtail and wash them thoroughly under cold, running water until dry.  Drain thoroughly.  Heat a large, heavy bottomed pot over high heat and add the oxtails, mushrooms, chilies, pepper and jalapenos.  Stir fry for about a minute, then reduce the heat to medium and add the vinegar.  Cover with a lid and simmer for about 15 minutes.  Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  You may have to press it down a bit while the liquid cooks out as the pot will cook on the bottom.  You may uncover the pot and cook it for another 15 more minutes, but it's okay if there is just a tiny bit of liquid remaining that has accumulated in the pot.  If there is more then a bit of that liquid left in the pot, add the soy milk a tablespoon at a time until it reaches the desired consistency.  Serve immediately, over rice.

Random Ingredients: chocolate chip,clove garlic,corn kernel,red pepper flake
title: Spicy Grilled Corn (Or Shucked) With Chocolate Chip Crusted Chips
ingredients: 1 cup fresh corn kernels ( or frozen corn kernels ) | 2 teaspoons finely minced whole cloves garlic ( or 10-12 cloves fresh garlic, peeled ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons chocolate chips
instructions: In medium bowl, add corn kernels, minced garlic, and crushed red pepper.  Stir until all ingredients are well coated.  Place chocolate chips in a metal bowl.  Dip corn or shuck into the chips, coating both sides.  Cover bowl with a double layer of plastic wrap, and refrigerate until chocolate is completely set, at least 1 hour but up to one day.

Random Ingredients: baby spinach leaf,cooking apple,green onion,mango,brown mustard seed,lemon juice,wild mushroom,vanilla yogurt
title: Wild Mushroom Salad With Mustard Seeds
ingredients: 8 ounces wild mushrooms, halved | 14 ounces baby spinach | 2 green onions, white parts only, thinly sliced thinly | 2 ounces sliced fully cooked baby spinach leaves | 1 lemon, juice of | 1 teaspoon brown mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons low-fat vanilla yogurt | sliced mango ( optional )
instructions: Place mushrooms, spinach, onions, and spinach leaves in a large serving bowl.  Whisk together the lemon juice, mustard seeds, yogurt, and mustard seeds until combined.  Pour over the salad and let marinate.  Serve at room temp, or chilled.  If desired, garnish with slices of mango.

title: Sangria Sorbet
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, chopped | 10 lime wedges
instructions: Place wine, brown sugar and lime wedges in a medium bowl.

title: Macaroni Pudding with Green Olives
ingredients: 400 g macaroni, cooked | 80 g pineapples in juice, chopped | 2 tablespoons demerara sugar | 100 ml pineapple juice | 80 g chopped walnuts
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a large bowl, stir well, cook on low heat for 1 hour 30 mins, serve on plates.

title: Simmered Tater-Taco Salad
ingredients: 2 pints fresh cucumbers, finely sliced | 3 teaspoons taco seasoning mix | 3 tablespoons icing sugar, sifted
instructions: In a medium size bowl, mix together the taco seasoning, cucumber, icing sugar.  Serve hot.

title: My Favorite Burger
ingredients: 2 lbs hamburger, hamburger bun | 2 cans ready-to-serve corn tortillas
instructions: Heat griddle over med.  High heat.  Place corn tortillas on griddle.  Top with remaining burger.  Cook 7 - 10 mins or until hot.

title: Perfect Ricotta
ingredients: 1 lb fresh ricotta cheese | brandy
instructions: Shake cheese with a little brandy at one time for a light flavor.  This will keep well in the refrigerator for a few months.  Use a heavy duty, heavy bottomed pan that has been well rinsed out of cold water and generously buttered on the sides for an ever last minute or two.  Place in the oven and turn the temperature up to about 400 f the entire time you intend to bake, so that when they're done they will be golden brown in color.  Once a light speckling bubble forms on the top of the cheese, check for doneness.  This will only take a half or so sample and a few minutes of shaking will be enough.  Remove from the oven.  When you take the pan out of the oven, immediately pour the brandy into it.  The liquid will start to bubble out of the baking process.  With a spoon stir the mixture around so that it is evenly distributed throughout the surface.  Set back onto a plate to cool and set your oven shelf at the lowest temperature.  The brandy will help keep this cheese soft for about a day.  Once you are ready for the next step, you can easily pour about three times the brandy into a small container or bowl just enough to keep it from scorching.  This should give you a lovely, full flavored ricotta.  When you are ready to eat, transfer the container to a bowl and place it under the broiler to just melt the brandy right.

title: Simple Thai Style Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 1 lb beefsteak tomato, sliced in 1/2 inch thick slices | 3 small fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1/2 lb fresh broccoli floret
instructions: Stack tomato and spinach leaves and put on plate.  Top with vegetables and beefsteak.  Sprinkle with lime leaves.

title: Sausage Sandwich Filler
ingredients: 500 g fresh ground beef or 500 g ground turkey | 100 g prosciutto, finely minced | 100 g sliced fresh fruit | 100 g sliced gruyere cheese | 1 beef stock cube, dissolved in 1/2 cup of cold water | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 tablespoon cornstarch
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°c.  Fry the sausages in a bit of oil until nicely browned and cooked through.  Keep them warm.  To make the sandwich, mix all the burger ingredients together.  Pour the sausage on bottom half of bread.  Place two slices of prosciutto on top of the sausage.  Top with a slice of cheese.  Return the other slice of bread on top to make sandwich.  Make sure to slice the bread into soldiers with a spatula.  Place the soldiers on a baking paper lined tray.  Bake under the grill until cheese has melted.  To serve, slice and wrap in paper towels.

title: How I Glazes a Sugar Body Sweet Thing
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar ( or use 3/4 cup sugar, 1/4 cup raw sugar or cinnamon ) | 5 -6 tablespoons cooking oil
instructions: Dissolve the sugar in cooking oil enough to cover the sugar completely or just lightly browned the sugar.  Once the sugar has melted and turned a deep amber brown and is starting to turn a shade darker, add the cinnamon and turn off the heat.  When the carmel has completely turned a deep amber color, take it off the stove and let it sit for a couple moments.  This is what i like best when i have it sit on the counter for about an hour.

Random Ingredients: corn chip,honey,feta cheese,flat leaf parsley,wheat flour,avocado,yellow pepper,turkey breast
title: Corn Chip Turkey Nests
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey breast | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 1/2 cup corn chips, coarsely crushed ( about 2-3 tablespoons ) | 1 1/2 large ripe avocados, diced | 1 -2 tablespoon fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese | 1/2 cup whole wheat flour | 2 tablespoons honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 400f.  Wear disposable foil and lightly oil the foil.  In the bowl of a mixing bowl, mash the turkey, pepper, corn chips, avocados, parsley, feta, and honey.  Season with salt and pepper to taste.  Stir in the flour until mixture just holds together until the edges of the corn chips are nicely moistened.  Drop tablespoons of the batter one at a time onto a lightly floured baking sheet about 1 inch in diameter.  Cook until browned, about 4 minutes.  Remove and let cool.

title: Beer Battered Beer Can
ingredients: 1 can beer, of your choice | dark soy sauce or chili sauce, of your choice
instructions: Pour the beer can onto your canning rack in a medium sized non reactive pot.  Add the dark soy sauce or chili sauce and stir to distribute it evenly.  Turn the heat to low and leave to brew for about 20 minutes or until the canning can is cold and ready.  Seal and keep at room temperature for up to 3 days and occasionally shake and stir.

title: Taco Muffins
ingredients: 2 cups shredded chicken or 2 cups turkey, of your choice | 1 cup shredded taco blend cheese | 1/3 cup fat free egg substitute | 1 1/2 tablespoons cocoa | 1 1/2 teaspoons instant chicken bouillon | aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to spray muffin pans with nonstick cooking spray or spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Combine all ingredients.  Spoon into muffin cups, placing 1/4 tsp of batter in center of each cup.  Place muffins on baking sheet.  Bake at 375 for 12 to 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and allow to cool 15 minutes in pan.  Repeat for all muffins.

Random Ingredients: allspice,egg noodle,porridge oat,sesame oil,dark sesame oil,brandy,provolone cheese
title: Jalapeno's Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 lb egg noodles | 4 tablespoons sesame oil | 4 pints strong coffee or 4 pints hot plain coffee | 4 ounces provolone cheese, grated | 1 ounce dark sesame oil | allspice | brandy or cognac
instructions: Put a large pan on the heat, and then add the sesame and allspice.  Leave for a couple of minutes, then put in the noodles to cook.  Put the 2oz.  Of provolone and 2ozSesame oil in a bowl, or a container with a pouring consistency.  Mix.  Put the mixture all together really well, and then add 5 pints of water and the grated cheese.  Put the lid on the bowl, and leave it there for 20 minutes, while you cook the rest.  At this point you can keep, covered, in the fridge until you're ready to eat it.  The following day, drain the noodles.  Put in a large bowl and mix with the sesame oil, pepper, a drizzle of sesame or brandy or cognac to taste.  Add freshly squeezed brandy or brandy or cognac, depending on taste.

title: Red Pepper and Rice Crispy Squares (Gramma Bonneena)
ingredients: 2 lbs red peppers ( fresh or canned, with some of the inner seeds removed ) | 1 package jell-o instant vanilla pudding mix | 3/4 cup white wine ( not sweet ) | 2 cups all-purpose flour
instructions: Prepare your red pepper grill.  Slice the peppers thinly on the diagonal and lay them on a baking sheet.  Spray the whole time with cooking spray.  When the peppers are done, spray the grill with more cooking spray and preheat the grill with the burners on medium.  Sprinkle the puddings out at the grill.  When the peppers are ready, slice them in half, remove the seeds, and tear them apart with your fingers so that there are long strips of skin and no large chunks of skin left.  Mix the red pepper shreds and the red pepper shreds.  When they are all chopped up, drizzle the puddings from the grill in a large measuring cup.  Add the wine and the flour until the mixture is wet and sticky but does not stick to the spoon.  Pat the mixture onto a greased, floured baking sheet, about two inches high.  Chill overnight.  When ready to use, place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and refrigerate.  Remove the dough from the refrigerator and spread onto a lightly greased cookie sheet.  With a fork, lightly prick the crust to vent steam.  Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes, until they are slightly dark and puffed, and firm.  Allow to cool before cutting into 1 x 8 pieces.

title: Grated Ricotta (Ricotta)
ingredients: 500 g ricotta cheese | sea salt
instructions: Mix the ricotta coarsely.  Add salt to taste.  This can be made into balls about 5 - 8 pieces.  Place on a tray and cover with plastic wrap.

title: Greek Baked Tomatoes
ingredients: 4 cups peeled seeded tomatoes from canned tomatoes | 3/8 cup tomato paste | 2 tablespoons chopped parsley | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt
instructions: Cut a lengthwise slit in the tomato top and carefully, scoop out the pulp and seeds with a spoon, leaving as much flesh behind as possible.  Place the tomatoes in a casserole dish & cover with the tomato paste.  Stir in the parsley, rosemary & salt.  Cook in a preheated oven on the lower shelf of the oven, basting every 30 minutes or so, until bubbling and beginning to darken, about 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Filipino Style Tomato and Coconut Stew
ingredients: 1 medium baking potato, washed ( peeling potato if you are concerned, otherwise skin will be too ) | 1 can coconut, with 1 can of coconut water | 1 can tomato paste | 1 tablespoon sugar
instructions: Peel potato and cut into bite size pieces.  Boil potato in plenty of water with salt and sugar, for 20 minutes or so.  Then add tomato paste and fry on low for 2 or 3 minutes.  Drain potato and mix with tomato mixture.  Serve with hot basmati rice.

title: Spanish Pork Wings and Chicken
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs chicken wings | 1 large spanish onion | 1 lb rice vinegar | spanish rice vinegar | 10 ounces pork roast
instructions: Trim wings of all visible fat and place in pot of water, onion and rice mix.  Bring to boil and simmer for about an hour stirring often.  After about an hour take the meat out of the pot and remove it from the water.  Let it cool slightly then invert it onto a cutting board.  Cut into bite size pieces.  Add to the pot and cover.

Random Ingredients: mustard,green pepper ring,lasagna noodle,lime juice zest,red pepper sauce,pineapple juice,rye flour
title: Swiss Roll

title: Tamarind Volumetrics
ingredients: 1/2 package frozen phyllo pastry sheets, thawed ( i use pepperidge farm ) | 1/2 cup tamarind juice | 1/4 lb cremini mushrooms
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and finely dice up the caps.  Heat water on the stove to boiling and line a 9x12x2 inch pan with parchment paper, making sure that the paper doesn't come in contact with water in the microwave, then lay phyllo sheets in the pan in a single layer.  With an 11x4 inch star shaped cookie cutter, press phyllo sheets out to the edges of the pan, making sure that each sheet is evenly spaced.  Pour in 1 cup of tamarind water.  Microwave on high power until it is bubbling and has melted and looks creamy and creamy, about 45 seconds.  It should look creamy, but should not be entirely smooth.  Spread tamarind mixture evenly over phyllo sheets.  Sprinkle mushrooms over the top.  Sprinkle the top sheet with more paprika if desired.  Set pan on parchment paper and let sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes, stirring every now and then to keep sheets from drying out.  Cut into strips 1/4 inch wide, cutting in strips crosswise to make diamond shaped pieces.  I use a ziploc baggy or a zip top plastic bag and place in freezer for at least 10 hours, or you can keep in the fridge all day.  This is the basic recipe, but if you don't have an airtight container, you can just heat up a wok or large skillet over medium high heat and add a few drops of cornstarch and vegetable oil.  Add as many pieces as it will fit into the pan, then let sit undisturbed for a few seconds, or until the bottom layer is crisp on the outside and very moist looking in the middle.  Flip and tilt the pan so that it is evenly hot when you put it in.  Remove from heat.  Slide a serving knife between layers of phyllo pastry, keeping a few pieces uncovered.  Cut in strips, then put on top of eachother so they will all fit neatly.  I use a serrated edged knife, which is not necessary, to cut them all the way through this process.  Cut the strips crosswise into 3 inch wide strips, then put each one on top of the tofu.  You can also cut strips lengthwise along the width of the tofu, though those work best.  You can also use a very sharp knife or a knife with a very sharp knife.  Slide a second piece of sharp serrated knife onto the top and gently press the strips together, cutting all the way to the rim of the pan.  Slide a third piece of serrated knife back onto the empty strips of phyllo pastry in the pan, cutting through the strips to make the strips like mini hedgehogs.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f.  Add lemon flavored oil, garlic, and cheese.  Stir well until cheese is melted and incorporated.  Place in pie pan and pour lemon juice all over it.  Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes then remove from oven.  Let cool for 20 min, then dig in diggy.

Random Ingredients: masala,plum sauce,blue curacao,mexican cheese,pineapple chunk,red chili,sage leaf
title: Blue Crab Dip
ingredients: 1 jar pineapple chunks, drained and flaked into bite-sized pieces | 1/4 cup dry mexican cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons masala | 1 tablespoon red chili, roasted, crushed | 1 tablespoon dried sage leaves | 3 tablespoons plum sauce | 2 tablespoons blue curacao or 2 tablespoons other orange-flavored liqueur, if desired - divided
instructions: Place the pineapple chunks in a bowl.  In a separate bowl, stir together the cheese, masala, red chili and sage.  Add half of this mixture to the drained pineapple and mix well.  Add the remaining cheese mixture, stirring to thoroughly combine.  Divide among 6 crocks, and top with remaining pineapple chunks.  Top with blue curacao or other orange flavored liqueur.

title: Yummy Rice Ball in a Pond - Mango Chutney
ingredients: 1 box-made success rice | 2 cups mango chutney | 1 package feta cheese, cubed ( i use more ) | 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder | jam ( to garnish ) ( optional ) | fruit ( to garnish ) ( optional )
instructions: First, add mango chutney to rice.  Freg it up a little, if you want add any.  The recipe is fairly forgiving and sometimes i add more mango chutney.  Next, place feta cheese cubes in a large bowl and add mango chutney.  Pour mango chutney on top of the feta cheese.  Mix in cumin powder. .  Roll each ball in cheese mixture.  Wash your hands and pat the balls down with hands a few times until completely filled with the mixture.  If you have any leftover cheese in the cloth, then add a teaspoon of the mixture to a bowl of excess cheese and coat hands with one teaspoon.  Then dip your hands in cold water and let the cloth weten up a little bit and pat each ball in the cloth again until they are completely wet.  Next, cut steam holes in the cloth and place balls into a steamer.  Steam for 45 to 50 minutes.  If desired, serve with fruit and/or jam.

title: Hazelnut Oil
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs hazelnuts | 3 cups oil or 3 cups vegetable oil
instructions: Peel hazelnuts.  Melt 3 cups of oil using a blender, a food processor and mortar.  Place hazelnuts in a bowl.  Pour oil over nuts.  Blend until well mixed.  Let stand several hours or overnight before using.  You can store hazelnuts covered in fridge for up to 2 weeks.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,meatball,penne,nonfat milk,extra sharp cheddar cheese,papaya,plum tomato
title: Penne with Raw Papaya and Meatballs
ingredients: 2 cans nonfat milk | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1 package penne | 1 can no-salt-added meatballs, drained | 2 plum tomatoes, seeded and diced | 1 package shredded nonfat sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup chopped peeled papayas ( can use frozen )
instructions: In a large saucepan, mix milk, vinegar, and meatballs.  Heat to boiling over high heat.  Reduce heat, and simmer until hot, about 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes, and cook 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook pasta for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: cucumber,chicken stock vegetable,italian tomato,red chilies,kosher salt,coconut milk,vegetable
title: Creamy Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 4 ounces unsweetened coconut milk | 1/2 cup thinly sliced cucumber | 4 ounces chopped mixed vegetables | 1 can italian-style diced tomatoes, drained | 3 canned red chilies, chopped | 1 quart chicken stock or 1 quart vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon kosher salt
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a blender or food processor.  Blend until smooth, then stir in salt.

title: Olive Garden Refried Beans
ingredients: 1 can red kidney beans or ( 16 ounce ) can pink kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 2 tablespoons romano cheese ( or asiago ) cheese
instructions: Heat beans on stove top until hot.  Stir in cheese and stir until melted.

Random Ingredients: chili,chicken bouillon granule,celery,yellow bell pepper,milk,chinese egg noodle,garlic salt,flounder fillet
title: Chinese Baked Noodles with Seafood and Chicken
ingredients: 12 ounces chinese egg noodles, broken into half | 1 package flounder fillets, chopped | 1 small yellow bell pepper, chopped | 1 stalk celery, chopped | 1 tablespoon chicken bouillon granules | 3/4 cup milk | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1/4 teaspoon ground chili
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add egg noodles and cook for 8 minutes or until tender.  Drain.  Meanwhile, spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Place egg noodles in a large bowl, and pour boiling water over noodles.  Allow noodles to sit 5 minutes, or until tender.  Drain.  Mix pasta and bell pepper with cooked noodles.  Stir in celery.  In a small bowl, mix chicken bouillon granules, milk, garlic salt and ground chili.  Pour over noodle mixture.  Mix well.  Spread mixture into prepared baking dish.  Bake 35 minutes in the preheated oven, or until thoroughly heated.

title: Chocolate Chilies Rellenos
ingredients: 2 -4 ounces baking chocolate, chopped into small pieces | 5 ounces green chilies, chopped into small pieces
instructions: Place all of the ingredients into a greased pan and stir constantly for 10 minutes or until melted.

Random Ingredients: heavy whipping cream,pimiento,egg white,yellow pea,apple,sage leaf,head cauliflower,brown sugar
title: Wild and Good Stuff
ingredients: 2 medium heads cauliflower, broken into florets | 1/2 cup yellow split peas | 1 apple, cored, chopped | 1 jar large pimientos, diced | 2 tablespoons dried sage leaves | 2 tablespoons sweet white and light brown sugar | 3 large egg whites | 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream | 8 fresh sage leaves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Spread cauliflower, peas, apple, pimentos, sage, and brown sugar into a 13x9 inch baking dish.  In a blender combine the egg whites and cream, whisking until egg whites form stiff peaks.  Gently fold in the beaten egg whites and gently pour over the dry ingredients.  Sprinkle with more brown sugar and sage leaves.  Bake in the preheated oven until bread begins to brown, about 45 minutes.

title: Onion and Garlic Loaf
ingredients: 2 packages yeast | 1 package french onion soup | salt and pepper
instructions: Dissolve soup and yeast in lukewarm water.  Add salt and pepper and mix together adding flour until dough is workable and easy to handle.  Set aside to rise in a warm place for about 5 hours or until doubled in size.  Punch down to get out air pockets, or shape into loaves.  Pierce with a sharp fork or use a sharp knife to make indentations in the loaf.  Bake at 425 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: peanut butter,apple cider,chicken bouillon,red pepper,chipotle chile
title: Chipotle Peanut Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 roasted red pepper | 1 chipotle chile toasted chipotle piece | 1 chicken bouillon, chopped | 1 cup peanut butter | 1/2 cup apple cider
instructions: Grind the roasted red pepper, roasted chipotle chile and chicken bouillon together into a smooth paste.  Combine all the peanut butter ingredients in a small food processor and puree until smooth.  Add the peanut butter mixture to the bowl, and fold to mix well.  Serve at room temperature over your favorite cooked pasta.

Random Ingredients: garlic paste,chicken bouillon cube,olive,chicken stock cube,poundcake,bok choy
title: Otakodon
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock cubes, with | 3 cups chicken stock cubes, with | 1 medium chopped poundcake | 1 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon olive, paste | 1 frozen pound cake
instructions: Place your soup bones and a few cubes of butter inside a saucepan and over medium heat until the stock cubes and butter are melted.  Add the garlic paste and stir until it begins to brown.  Add both stocks into the pan and cook on a medium heat until the soup starts leaving the sides of the pan.  When the soup is almost completely cooked take the whole pound cake from the freezer and tear into 1 chunks and add to the soup.  When the cake is almost completely shredded stir in your marinated pound cake.  Once a good bite is in the soup just remove the pound cake from the soup and add to the soup, stirring thoroughly so the pound cake gets coated in the soup.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,italian pork sausage,rotini pasta,penne pasta

instructions: Line a 9 or 10 inch tart plate with ungreased plastic wrap.  In a food processor combine the cheese and the bread crumbs.  Process until fully combined.  Stir in remaining ingredients except the vanilla, then spoon the mixture into the prepared tart plate.  Refrigerate until set, about 1 hours.  Serve at once, or refrigerate up to 3 days.

title: Ginger-Garlic Dip
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 3 tablespoons soya sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Serve with garlic bread or bread.

Random Ingredients: lemongrass,pesto sauce,serrano pepper,chili flake,onion powder,green bean,egg
title: Green Beans With Lemon
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh green beans | 1 teaspoon minced onion powder | 1/8 teaspoon lemon grass | 1/8 teaspoon chili flakes | 1/4 teaspoon dried red chili flakes | 1 egg, beaten | 1/4 cup pesto sauce
instructions: Wash, snap the green beans into 1 inch segments.  Boil in water until tender.  In a skillet, add all other ingredients except the green beans and pesto and fry for about 5 minutes over medium heat.  Add the green beans to the skillet with the pesto mixture and cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Aussie Sultana (Sour Beef Skewers)
ingredients: 1 sultana, fresh picked from the jar | 1 lb bottom round beef roast
instructions: Trim beef and rub with about 1/4 cup or so of salt and let sit at room temperature for about 10 - 15 minutes.  Cut sultanas into 3 - 4 thick slices.  Thread sultanas onto a skewer.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,green enchilada sauce,red pepper,heavy whipping cream,cornmeal,oatmeal

instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f.  In a large bowl, combine the cornmeal, oatmeal, coriander, red pepper and red pepper flakes.  Mix well. Scrape into a greased and lightly floured 13 by 9 inch baking dish.  Bake for 40 - 45 minutes, or until lightly browned and cooked through.  Let cool for about 10 minutes before eating.

Random Ingredients: savory,egg substitute,green chili salsa,chipotle pepper adobo sauce,mascarpone cheese
title: Tex Mex Dip
ingredients: 2 cups egg substitute | 1 cup mascarpone cheese | 1 teaspoon savory | 2 tablespoons green chili salsa | 1 small chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, seeded and minced
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the egg substitute, mascarpone cheese, savory, and green chili salsa.

Random Ingredients: apple,italian salad dressing mix,chili powder,asafoetida powder
title: Apple Shredded
ingredients: 2 large apples, peeled and cut into about 1 inch cubes | 1 envelope italian salad dressing mix | 1/4 teaspoon ground asafoetida powder | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: In a large bowl, toss apple chunks with salad dressing mix, asafoetida, and chili powder until apple chunks are coated with dressing mix and apple pieces are evenly coated.

title: Homemade Cornflour Bread
ingredients: 4 cups unbleached cake flour | 1 cup cornflour | 3 teaspoons instant coffee | 2 garlic cloves, crushed | 1/4 cup ice water
instructions: Mix, sift, flours and coffee together and set aside.  Mix, garlic and ice water.  Use as needed during dough mixing to mix the two dough ingredients completely and evenly.  Dust hands in flour while kneading.  Place dough in oiled bowl and let rise 1 hour minimum.  Using a rolling pin flatten the dough until it is as thin as possible.  Slice the dough into approximately 1/16 thick cookies.  Brush with coffee and sprinkle with a little coarse salt or pepper before baking.  Keep in mind your oven is relatively hot.

instructions: Place aubergines, fennel bulbs and stock in large frying pan and simmer gently, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until aubergines are tender, but still a bit firm, about 15 to 20 minutes.  Add crab, golden syrup, and mustard.

Random Ingredients: corn syrup,garlic,spring onion,kosher salt,baby bok choy
title: Baby Bok Choy with Garlic and Sugar
ingredients: 1 bunch baby bok choy, trimmed, washed and trimmed | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup light corn syrup | 3 cloves garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon finely chopped spring onion | kosher salt to taste
instructions: Place the bok choy in a large pot of lightly salted water and bring to a boil.  Boil for 2 minutes, then drain.  Combine the light and light corn syrup, garlic and spring onions in a medium skillet and bring to the boil.  Pour over the bok choy and toss to coat.  Add salt to taste and serve.

title: Mildly-Ginger Sour Cream and Ginger Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar | 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger ( or very finely minced fresh ginger ) | 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a small bowl, mix the sour cream with the tartar and spices.  Whisk in the olive oil in a slow, steady circular motion until you have a loose smooth paste.  Add some water if necessary.  Keep the mixture covered while preparing main dish.  When you're ready to use the mixture, keep in mind that this will thicken the sauce as it cools.

Random Ingredients: serrano pepper,grand marnier,rosemary sprig,broccoli floret,chicken breast half
title: Broccoli Chatea and Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 cup grand marnier | 4 medium broccoli florets | 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 serrano peppers, seeded | 6 rosemary sprigs
instructions: Rinse the fillets in cold water and pat dry with paper towels.  In a medium bowl, combine the grand marnier and 2 cups water to make a thin dipping sauce.  Set aside. Arrange the broccoli over the chicken in the slow cooker.  Add the remaining 1/2 cup of water.  Set the cooker on low and cook, covered, for 5 hours.  Carefully remove the chicken.  Stir the chicken and vegetables with remaining 1/2 cup of water into the the pot.  Cook for about 15 to 30 minutes, or until the sauce thickens slightly.  Serve over cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: green enchilada sauce,red pepper flake,cauliflower,golden syrup,rice wine
title: Green Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower | 1 jar green enchilada sauce ( i use old el paso ) | 1/2 cup golden syrup | 1/2 cup raw rice wine | 1 pinch red pepper flakes ( to taste )
instructions: Break off the ends of the head of cauliflower and remove the leaves to a bowl.  Set aside to cool.  When cool enough to handle, chop off the woody core and cut into bite sized pieces.  Set aside.  In a saucepan, place the cauliflower pieces in boiling water and bring back to a boil, immediately drain and place into a bowl of ice water.  Place the enchilada sauce into a blender, add the golden syrup, rice wine, dried red pepper flakes and stir well.  Pour sauce into a medium saucepan and serve.

title: Saffron Picnic Skewers - Nigella Lawson

instructions: Wash the olives and place in large metal bowl.  Sprinkle over the ground ginger and enough of the limoncello to lightly moisten them.  Toss. Soak the cloves and saffron in 30 ml water.  Thread onto skewers.  In a pan heat the oil and fry the saffron soaked olives, turning, until golden.  Place 1 - 2 tbsp of the sherry syrup or water, the 2 cloves crushed garlic and the 2 tablespoons sherry or water.  Bring to boil and then simmer for 5 minutes.  Place the skewers on a tray and baste with the baste.  Grill the nuts, turning frequently, for 6 - 8 minutes.  Remove from the pan, pour over remaining sherry and serve warm.

instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f or just below the very top.  Place the sliced eggplant pieces on an oiled baking sheet and poke them down with the tops of a fork. Rinse the garlic pieces and pat dry.  Using a mortar and pestle, pound the eggplant slices with the saffron and ground cloves.  Transfer the garlic to a bowl and pour just enough water over to cover.  Let sit for 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, soak the fennel bulbs in a large bowl of hot water for about 1 hour. Stir in 1/4 cup water and allow to rehydrate until the mixture is syrupy.  To serve, combine the fennel, noodles, brandy, tapioca, or cornstarch and hot pepper and noodles. title: Saffron Pickles

instructions: In blender mix sauce ingredients.  Place ramekin in bottom of crock pot, add ramekin and sauce on top.  Cover and cook on low 7 - 10 hours.  Remove lid, mix, serve.

title: Chilled Yellow Squash With Chinese Peas Pods
