With your hand crush or blend until the mixture is somewhat smooth.  Spread the pea pods and squash onto plates, cover and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour.  Place the vegetables in a serving container and cover loosely with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate to chill.  Before serving serve, let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to let the flavor develop.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Easy Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 1 package bow tie pasta | 1/2 cup chopped apple ( i like granny smith ) | 1 package monterey jack cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Grease a 9 x 13 pan and arrange pasta and apples on it.  Sprinkle with cheese and bake 30 minutes.

title: Raspberry Baked Chicken Legs With Pepperoni and Chocolate Chips

title: French Cafe Cake With Fresh Herbs

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Line the bottom of a 12x8 inch pan with parchment paper, then layer with parchment paper, jelly roll or waxed paper if necessary.  Sprinkle parchment well with salt.

instructions: Heat a large skillet over a medium high heat.  When hot add red pepper, scallion and green onion.  Stir often, about 2 minutes.  Pour over water and reduce heat.  Simmer for five minutes, stirring often.  Stir in cardamom pod.  Serve hot or warm.

ingredients: 1/2 cup light peanut sauce | 1 tablespoon chat masala | 1 lb broccoli rabe, trimmed and cut into 1 inch pieces ( or other green vegetables )
instructions: Heat peanut sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat until warm and warm throughout, about 2 minutes.  Stir in chat masala and cook 1 minute longer.  Add broccoli rabe and stir fry 2 - 3 minutes until tender.  Serve over steamed rice.

title: Peanut Butter & Cheese Bread Pudding

Process until basil and capers form a paste.  Stir into the boiling water.  Cook 30 seconds, or until tender.

title: Saffron Pepper Mix

instructions: Wash and dry all peppers.  Place peppers in a shallow dish.  Mix the salt free salt free red peppers with the saffron and pour or pour enough into a pan to reach boiling point. title: Wasabi Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 teaspoon wasabi | 1 1 red chili peppers or 1 green chili pepper, cut into thin strips ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons rice wine or 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 1 tablespoon amaretto or 1 tablespoon almond-flavored liqueur ( optional ) | 1 head romaine lettuce, chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender or mortar and pestle, blend for 15 seconds or so, until it achieves a smooth and creamy consistency.  Transfer to small dishes or jars, seal and refrigerate until needed in sauce.  This can be frozen for up to 3 months.

title: Dynamite Apricots and Rice Noodles
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles | 2 tablespoons chopped dried apricots | 2 sheets spring roll wrappers | 1/4 cup dried apricot, chopped | 3 teaspoons coriander | 2 teaspoons rye flour
instructions: Place rice noodles in a large heatproof bowl, cover and microwave, covered on high for 3 minutes or until tender.

title: Honey Black Beans and Honey Fish
ingredients: 2 white fish fillets | 2 cans black beans | 3 tablespoons molasses | 3 tablespoons honey
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, saute the fish in 3 tablespoons each of molasses and honey until the fish is just heated through.  Place the black beans in the food processor.  Process the fish until smooth, approximately 1 minute.  Drain any juice from the fish and add to the black beans.  Stir well.  Bring to a boil.  Lower heat and simmer, covered, for approximately 10 minutes.

title: Pesto Enchiladas

instructions: Using a food processor or blender, process cashews and 1/2 cup of the dill pickle until finely chopped.  Add remaining pickle, onion soup mix, tomato puree, and sugar. title: BBQ Pastrami
ingredients:
2 tablespoons golden syrup | 4 tablespoons barbecue sauce | 1 lemon grass, chopped ( about 2 sticks, or use 2 tsp.
    - dried minced ) | 2 teaspoons grated ginger | 1 lemon, zest of | 1/4 cup capers, drained | 2 tablespoons bread, dry, crumbed ( or chewy ) | 1/4 lb pastrami
instructions: Combine ingredients to make the pastrami.  Cook until lightly golden.  Serve topped with warm bread crumbs or chewy bread crumb.  Note, you could use cooked beef, pork, and turkey but you might not need any of these.

Random Ingredients: french bread lengthwise,jalapeno pepper,green bell pepper,thai basil,artificial sweetener
title: Nana's French Bread Dip
ingredients: 1 loaf french bread, halved lengthwise | 4 ounces light chewy jalapeno peppers, diced | 4 ounces small green bell peppers, diced | 2 tablespoons artificial sweetener | fresh chopped thai basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 375.  Arrange bread halves in a casserole dish.  Stir jalapenos, bell peppers, and sweetener into jalapeno mixture.

title: Grilled Eggplant With Tropical Salsa
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs ( from 16 slices ) | 1/4 cup breadcrumbs ( from 4 slices ) | 1/4 cup maple syrup | 1 cup pineapple chunk in juice, 1/2 cup | 3 -4 tablespoons tea ( optional ) | 2 slices bread, toasted and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to medium.  Trim ends of eggplant 2½ - 3 inches below grid.  Slice crosswise into 1/4 in thick slices lengthwise.  Cut each slice lengthwise into 1/4 in thick slices.  Brush both sides of eggplant with oil and place on preheated grill.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,lemon,pepper flake,beef stock cube,maraschino cherry,head garlic,beef sirloin steak,ketchup
title: Low Fat Marinated Steak!
ingredients: 1 1/4 lbs boneless beef top sirloin steaks | 1 beef stock cube | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 teaspoon lemon rind, grated | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice | 1/8 teaspoon pepper flakes | 2 tablespoons self rising flour, mixed with | 1 tablespoon ketchup | 1 tablespoon maraschino cherries
instructions: Trim fat from steak and cut into 6 serving size pieces.  Place all marinade ingredients in a 3 cup container or bowl and mix thoroughly.  Rinse steak and pat dry.  Place one piece of steak between two sheets of waxed paper and pound into 1/2 inch thick round patties.  Repeat with second piece of steak.  Place steaks in the marinade, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to 3 days.  Preheat grill to moderate or medium high and put a large plate on top to hold steaks in place.  Pour liquid from steaks into a pan.

Random Ingredients: sorrel,red bell pepper,vanilla bean,puff pastry,cardamom pod,cooking spray,vinegar,berry
title: Sorrel and Red Pepper Tartlets - Vegan, Free-range!
ingredients: 500 g sorrel, fresh | 500 g red bell peppers | 1/2 cup berry | 3 cardamom pods | 1 vanilla bean, split ( or 2 teaspoons vanilla extract ) | 4 sheets puff pastry ( i use a log or half a sheet, but i've found that half can be plenty ) | cooking spray, for baking
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius, and line a tray with baking paper.  Remove the sorrel from the stalks, if you do not have them, and discard the ribs from the red bell peppers, if you didn't.  Cut the peppers into thick slices, removing some seeds if you prefer.  Place slices in a small container with a lid and add a teaspoon of vanilla extract.  Cover the container and shake to combine, and set aside.  Remove the seeds from the cardamom pods, put them into a mortar and pestle, and crush them to a rough powder.  Put the crushed cardamom and the scraped cardamom in a small bowl and rub together.  Line the tray with the pastry sheets, lightly butter or spray with oil.  Place a layer of sorrel onto each sheet of pastry, then cover that with a layer of red bell pepper and sliced berry.  Add a drizzle of vinegar and finally a dust of cardamom powder.  Cook for 10 - 15 minutes until the pastry is cooked and the sorrel has crisped and turned a lovely golden colour.  Cut into wedges or squares to serve.

title: Mashed Potatoes with Cream
ingredients: 5 yukon gold potatoes, peeled | 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: In a medium pot, cover the riced potatoes with water, and bring to a boil over high heat.  Simmer until the potatoes are tender when pricked with a fork.  Drain the potatoes into a bowl, and mash while warm with an electric mixer.  Add cream, and mix, until potatoes are warmed, but not hot.  Serve hot.

title: Spicy Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 small cauliflower, shredded and coarsely chopped | 1/4 cup plain flour | 1 ounce sliced spicy salami
instructions: Preheat oven to 400&deg.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,egg noodle,feta cheese,cardamom seed,cannellini bean
title: Easy Feta Noodle Kugel
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 5 ounces feta cheese, crumbled | 1 egg noodles ( dry weight cut into halves ) | 2 cardamom seeds | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar ( packed )
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl.  Spread noodles in an oven proof dish, top with cheese & then sprinkle with cardamom seeds, bake, uncovered, 30 minutes or until golden brown & bubbly.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,pizza crust,creme fraiche,red bean paste,almond,asparagus,picante sauce
title: Asparagus Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves ( about 10 oz ) | 2 tablespoons red bean paste ( for basting ) | 4 slices creme fraiche | 4 thin slices asparagus ( about 7 oz ) | 2 tablespoons picante sauce | 2 teaspoons sliced almonds | 1 pre-baked pizza crust ( see below )
instructions: Brush the chicken with red bean paste.

Random Ingredients: sausage,iceberg lettuce,coconut flour,extra virgin olive oil
title: Cambodian Patties
ingredients: 2 large hard-cooked eggs, chopped | 1 -2 teaspoon coconut flour | 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil | 4 medium sausages, cooked and thinly sliced | 1 head iceberg lettuce
instructions: Stir together eggs, coconutflour and olive oil until well combined.  Shape 1/2 tablespoons mix into 4 patties.  Heat griddle on medium heat for about one minute each side, until browned.  Keep warm until serving.  Garnish with lettuce.

Random Ingredients: cayenne pepper,cooking spray,green olive,mung bean sprout,orange peel,roast beef,caraway seed,spring onion
title: Nigerian Beef and Bean Sprout Salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 kg sirloin steak, cut into 1 cm chunks | cooking spray | 5 green olives, stoned cut into 1 cm pieces | 2 spring onions, chopped | 2 tablespoons caraway seeds, ground | 1 tablespoon candied orange peel | 400 g mung bean sprouts | cayenne pepper, to taste
instructions: Place sirloin in a shallow dish and pour over the remaining marind.

title: Mango Raita
ingredients: 8 ounces lemon pudding, plain | 3 pints mangoes, peeled and cut into chunks | 4 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Empty lemon pudding into a large bowl and sprinkle with parsley.  Mash the mango with a fork.

title: Easy Norwegian Fish Cakes
ingredients: 375 g frozen crabmeat | 1 cup fresh or prepared minced crabmeat | 1/2 cup olive oil | 2 tablespoons beef consomme | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Using a food processor, process crabmeat until finely chopped.  Add crabmeat and mix well.  Heat olive oil in a frying pan over a moderate heat, and fry the crabmeat mixture, stirring, for 5 minutes.  Add the consommé, and cook for 1 minute.  Remove from heat, and drop tablespoons of the mixture onto hot, lightly buttered nonstick frying pan.  If the tops are darker than a quarter turn the oven on to high, and leave the pan on the element until it is bubbling.  Leave for 5 minutes before flipping.  Serve immediately with toast cut into 1 inch cubes and dipping sauce.

Random Ingredients: bean sprout,half,rosemary leaf,polenta,fennel bulb,brown lentil,water chestnut
title: Healthy Lentil and Rosemary Polenta
ingredients: 2/3 cup brown lentils | 1 small fennel bulb, sliced | 1/2 cup chopped water chestnut | 1/4 cup chopped fresh rosemary leaf | 2 1/2 cups water | 2 cups half-and-half | 1 tablespoon ground fennel powder | 2 cups polenta or 2 cups yellow cornmeal
instructions: Place lentils and 1 1/2 cups water in a large saucepan.  Bring to a boil over high heat, covered, and reduce heat to simmer.  Simmer until Lentils are tender, 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and stir in fennel.  Remove fennel with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Reserve fennel fronds for later use.  Slice and reserve fennel fronds.  Bring 4 cups water to a boil along with 2 cups cornmeal.  Gradually stir in fennel fronds.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 5 minutes.  Remove lid, add remaining water, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until thickened.  Stir once.  Stir in reserved fennel fronds.  Serve polenta sprinkled with ground fennel and remaining fennel fronds.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: 5 cups pearl barley | 2 cups cucumbers, coarsely chopped | 1 cup of fresh mint, coarsely chopped | 2 cups liquid honey | 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Cook barley in boiling water for 15 minutes, then drain.  Toss with cucumbers, mint, honey and nutmeg.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Chipotle Chile Paste
ingredients:
2 1/4 cups dry white wine ( a good quality spanish wine is the closest ) | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1 -2 chipotle chile, minced ( use more if you like them.
    - i just use lots! )
instructions: Grind the chipolte chiles either by hand or with your pestle or coffee grinder.  Store the cholte in a sealed jar.  Add a little bit of the cholte wine at a time to the hot paste, stirring as well as you mix.  Don't use all the cholte until the sauce is used.

Random Ingredients: grand marnier,apple juice concentrate,vanilla bean,peanut butter
title: Peanut Butter Grand Marnier Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups peanut butter, smooth | 1/4 cup frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed | 1/2 vanilla bean, split ( or 1 or 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon ) | 1 ounce grand marnier
instructions: Sauté peanut butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until smooth and lightly browned.  Add apple juice concentrate and vanilla bean.  When mixture begins to bubble, stir in grand marnier.  Serve over hot cooked rice.

Random Ingredients: white onion,mung bean sprout,dark soy sauce
title: Nama Nama
ingredients: 1 cup mung bean sprouts | 15 ounces dark soy sauce | 1 small white onion, sliced
instructions: Toast nama in a hot skillet.  Meanwhile, combine wok and water.  Add onion.  Cover, reduce heat then bring to a boil.  Cook 2 - 3 minutes until water boils off and onion is crisp tender.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,cherry preserve,chicken meat,dijon mustard,spinach leaf
title: Spinach Wrapped Chicken and Spinach
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb chicken meat, cut into 10 serving pieces | 6 large spinach leaves | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1 -2 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 -2 ounce cherry preserves, warmed
instructions: Lay out 4 dinner plates for each serving, laying leaves shiny side down.  Put 1/4 portion of the chicken on the leaf top with 1 - 2 teaspoons mustard and a little chili pepper flakes, then roll up the leaf and tie with kitchen string.  Heat skillet on stovetop on medium heat.  Turn off heat.  Dip each roll into the warmed preserves, then roll up, tucking in ends and cooking until lightly browned.  Serve immediately.

title: Prawn and Beet Stir Fry
ingredients: 20 -25 raw large prawns ( or small shrimp if necessary ) | 1/3 cup madeira wine ( any brand ) | 2 packages spaghetti ( i prefer the whole package ) | fried shallots or fried shallots ( for garnish, to serve )
instructions: Peel/halve the prawns and remove the heads/discs.  Devein/scallop prawns.  Make sure all prawn heads/discs are under the water, if necessary or else these will break as they cook.  Place the cleaned prawns on a serving dish and pour on the madeira.  Set it on a low fire in the oven to pre heat.  Cook the spaghetti until cooked al dente.  Drain the spaghetti.  Place the prawns on a heated platter in a single layer and sprinkle them with fried shallots, if using.  Top with fried shallots/dill sauce and serve immediately, in this case, the shrimp will have turned grey at the dish.  Also serve with warm spiced white wine and a green salad.

Random Ingredients: cornmeal,phyllo pastry,garlic paste,cottage cheese,brown onion,pork shoulder,beef shank,parsley leaf
title: My Big Fat Greek-Canadian-Hungarian Beef and Cheese Samosas
ingredients: 3 pork shoulder, beef shanks weighing about 3 pounds | 1 can cornmeal | 2 tablespoons cornmeal, for dredging | 2 tablespoons cornmeal, extra-virgin | 2 tablespoons garlic paste | 1 large brown onion, halved and thinly sliced | 1/3 cup chopped fresh parsley leaves, extra-virgin | 1/2 lb low fat cottage cheese | 2 sheets phyllo pastry, thawed under warm water
instructions: Preheat oven to 325º.  Cut each piece of meat crosswise into 4 pieces.  Remove fat from grilling surface if it threatens to burn and set aside.  Dredge meat in cornmeal for 20 seconds per side.  Spread meat on lighly oiled jelly roll pan lined with parchment paper.  Bake until meat is very tender and is browned, stirring every 30 to 45 minutes and adding salt and hot water when necessary.  Meanwhile, in a food processor, combine 1 cup water, 1 cup of reserved juices, cornmeal, 2 tablespoons cornmeal garlic paste, brown onion and parsley with remaining 1/2 cup water and process until mixture forms moist crumbs, scraping sides of bowl as needed.  Drain meat, and return it to the pan and stir in mixture to coat all of it.  Cover tightly and refrigerate until ready to use.  Remove meat mixture from fridge 45 minutes before cooking.  When meat mixture has chilled, preheat oven to 375º.  In 2 1/2 to 3 quart baking dish spread 3 phyllo sheets, brushing each one generously with water before placing in the oven.  Cook samosas for about 3 minutes, until golden on top.  Transfer to a rack and cool to room temperature.  Cut each samosa into 6 equal squares and serve immediately.

title: Pickled Barley
ingredients: 1 cup pearl barley ( white ) | 1/2 cup malt vinegar | 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1 tablespoon anise seed ( crushed & cracked, optional )
instructions: Soak the barley for 12 hours in water.  Shake the beans several times.  Drain before using or leave until a dark green colour.  Drain.  Place barley in a non metallic bowl & pour the vinegar & oil over.  Add anise & crushed anise seeds & leave to soak for 2 days.  Shake off excess water before using.  The liquid in this step can then be used as needed for the next time.  Bottle in sterilized jars & store in the fridge.

Random Ingredients: sharp cheddar cheese,madeira wine,italian herb,beef,fine breadcrumb,salsa
title: Easy Nacho Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef, extra lean | 1/2 cup fine dry breadcrumb or 1/2 cup cracker crumb | 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh italian herbs | 1 jar salsa, mild, medium | 1/4 cup madeira wine | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese or 1 cup mexican blend cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.  Shape into patties.  Place on hot griddle.  Cook on medium heat.  Cook only as many as will fit without burning and turning as needed, 3 to 4 minutes per side or until done.

title: Sirloin Fried Spareribs
ingredients: 1 lb lean sirloin | 1 lb sirloin | 4 eggs | cooking oil | 14 ounces pork spareribs, cut into 6x12 inch pieces
instructions: If making beef mixture, cut beef into 4 pieces or smaller and beef into 3 x6 pieces.  If making pork mixture, prepare as above and cook 3 hours.  Serve on skewers with pork sparerib pieces and fresh vegetables.

Random Ingredients: corn tortilla chip,sake,chocolate chip,celery rib,kaffir lime leaf
title: Yummy Chocolate Chip Nachos
ingredients: 1/2 large celery rib | 1 small chocolate chip, divided ( i recommend hershey's ) | 6 ounces kaffir lime leaves ( refrigerated limes and limes ), finely cut peel and pith removed | 10 ounces corn tortilla chips | 1 -2 tablespoon sake ( optional )
instructions: Line bottom of a cookie sheet with parchment paper.  Place celery in the middle of a piece of parchment paper to cover the paper.  Overlap the carrots on the paper on the parchment.  In a small bowl, mix half the chips with the lime peel, half of the lime leaves, and half of the chocolate sauce.  Spread a thin layer of sauce over the celery, and sprinkle with remaining chips.  Fold up the ends of the parchment paper and roll the tortilla chips up into a log.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,cellophane noodle,sharp cheddar cheese,chili,puff pastry
title: Mexican Pastry Appetizers
ingredients: 1 sheet frozen puff pastry | 1 chili, chopped | 1/2 ounce cellophane noodle | 1/2 ounce white vinegar | 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
instructions: Thaw puff pastry sheet and unfold.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Combine chili, cellophane noodles and vinegar and set aside.  Roll one sheet of pastry into a 12 inch circle on a lightly floured surface, leaving a 1/4 inch edge.  Spread half of the chili noodle mixture on the pastry, then sprinkle with half of the cheese.  Add the other half of the pastry, again brushing with the chili mixture.  Top with the remaining chili noodle mixture.  Cut into 12 fingers.  Seal the ends by pinching together the fingers with a fork.  Place on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 30 minutes, or until pastry is puffed and golden brown.  Cool on wire rack.

title: Japanese Meatballs
ingredients: 1 kg mutton | 2 tablespoons chopped onions | 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar
instructions: Cut mince into 3/4 inch cubes and place in a large pan.  Add chopped onions and rice vinegar.  Mix well and simmer, until meat is cooked.  Note, if you are not using a meatball pressurized bowl, add a little water.  This adds a serum to the meat before serving.

title: Green Miso
ingredients: 3 3/4 cups white miso ( i just use 2 1/2 cups of white miso ) | 1/2 teaspoon green cardamom pods or 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom | 2 mint sprigs, to garnish optional ( optional )
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together green miso and cardamom until smooth.  Stir in mint sprigs and serve hot or chilled.  Store in tightly covered container to mellow out excess liquid.

title: Chuy's Mexican Hot and Sour Borracho
ingredients: 12 ounces beer, corona or anjeel, chilled | 12 ounces ro-tel tomatoes, canned | 2 -3 small handfuls of fresh grape, seed and moisture discarded ( can use more ) | 1 tablespoon fennel seed, cracked or 1 tablespoon ground fennel | 3 spring onions, trimmed, very finely chopped ( green onions ) | 1/3 cup dry sherry
instructions: In a tall glass, make an indentation with 2 inch diameter from the lip of the beer.  Add beer, tomatoes and fennel.  Stir gently.  Pour in sherry, stir.  Cover with greased aluminum foil or parchment.  Put in a cooler off the heat setting over the sink.  Let stand at room temperature for about 1 to 1 1/2 hours, stirring now and then.  The beer should be very liquid. .  After one to two days, taste beer mixture, adding more water, salt, pepper and other spices to taste.  Enjoy beer can be kept, well covered in the refrigerator, up to 3 days.

title: Sparkling Cherry Figs
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped dried fruit ( cherries, apricots, apples, dried apricots, etc ) | 1 cup chopped candied pineapple or 1 cup dried apple | 1/4 cup coarsely chopped onion flakes | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 2 tablespoons chopped toasted pine nuts ( optional )
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.  Chill until cold.  Spoon mixture evenly into 4 1/2 cup glasses or decorative containers.  Sprinkle with pine nuts, if desired.  Chill 2 hours.

title: Nasi Goreng
ingredients: 1 cup short-grain white rice, washed and drained ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon port wine | 1/2 white onion, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon msg, such as saffron ( optional )
instructions: Place the rice and a small amount of the port wine into a bowl and leave it to soak while you prepare the other ingredients.  Drain the rice in a colander for ten minutes.  While you wait for the water to boil, prepare the onions and saute the mixture in a pan on medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring often.  Pour the rice into the pan and stir over the onion.

Random Ingredients: salt pepper,extra virgin olive oil,white bread,cardamom pod,prosciutto,black mustard seed,fish sauce,coconut flake
title: Vietnamese Bread Rolls - Authentic
ingredients: 1 cup unsweetened coconut flakes | 3 slices white bread | 1 teaspoon black mustard seeds | salt and pepper | 1 teaspoon freshly ground cardamom pod | 1 bunch prosciutto | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Toast bread in a preheated 450 degree f oven for 2 minutes.  Remove from oven and rub each slice with mustard seeds.  Place the bread in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: artichoke heart,corn syrup,extra virgin olive oil,quinoa,red capsicum,confectioner sugar
title: Tropical Quinoa Pone Fritters
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 1 teaspoon corn syrup | 1/2 red capsicum, diced small | 1/2 red artichoke heart, chopped small | 1/2 cup quinoa, cooked | 1/2 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, to brush
instructions: In a non stick frying pan, heat 1 1/2 tbsp oil.  Add corn syrup and stir until the corn syrup is dissolved.  Add the capsicum, artichoke hearts and quinoa.  Stir for 5 minutes.  Gradually add 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar and stir until everything is well combined.  In a large non stick frying pan, heat 1/4 cup of olive oil until smoking.  Drop about 2 tsp of the mixture onto the frying pan.  With a slotted spoon or spatula, lift the pone fritters into the hot oil and fry, turning over once, until golden brown, about 1 1/2 minutes.  Transfer to paper towel lined plate and repeat with the remaining fritters.  Invert onto a plate and drizzle with the remaining confectioners' sugar.

Random Ingredients: white flour,dill weed,beet,gold tequila,white wine vinegar,taco seasoning
title: Beets With Tequila Chips
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups white flour | 1/2 cup shredded fresh tater tots or 1/2 cup frozen tater tots | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco seasoning | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 1/2 cup white tequila | 1/2 teaspoon dill weed
instructions: Add all ingredients in order to make the chips.  Use a pastry brush to coat the chips.  Deep fry in a hot oil.  The chips are done when the chips look clear and they turn light brown on the underside with a slotted spoon.  Remove the chips from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: dark brown sugar,pork shoulder,beef brisket,soya sauce,vodka,coriander powder
title: Filipino Beef Brisket II
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder, cut into 2 to 3 inch pieces | 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder | 1/2 teaspoon dark brown sugar | 1/2 teaspoon dried coriander powder | 2 tablespoons soya sauce | 1 bottle vodka
instructions: Pour enough water into the pot to cover the meat.  Add all other ingredients and stir to mix well.  Bring to a boil on high heat, stirring occasionally.  Reduce heat to medium and let simmer uncovered for 1 1/2 hours.  Skim excess fat and reduce the sauce.  Serve over cooked rice.

title: Bhoona
ingredients: 500 g small shrimp | 200 g yogurt ( strained ) | 5 cm ginger ( cut into thin strips ) | 4 coriander ( chopped )
instructions: Clean the shrimp by rinsing them in a mesh strainer under running water.  Keep them dry.  Put the shelled and deveined shrimp into a bowl.  Wash the yogurt under running water for 10 minutes to remove any excess water.  Now add yogurt and grated ginger.  Mix well.  Add chillies.  Cover and let marinate in a refrigerator for 1 hour.  Sprinkle chopped coriander over top.  Serve with chapati.

title: Banana and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 1 large banana, peeled, halved, then thickly sliced | 3 tablespoons chinese fish sauce
instructions: Place the banana in a colander and press it to release the juices.  Place the squeezed banana on a bowl or two of ice in the freezer for 1 hour.  In a small bowl, stir together the fish sauce and vegetable oil to make the chunky paste.

Random Ingredients: salmon fillet,steel oat,bean sprout,peanut,orange,italian sausage,rock salt
title: Sausage, Oat and Peanut Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 ounces italian sausage ( casings removed and cut into thin slices ) | 4 ounces salmon fillets ( skin removed and cut into 3/4 in dice ) | 1 large orange ( use zest and juice to season ) | 1 cup bean sprouts | 12 slices quick-cook steel cut oats | peanuts ( coarsely chopped or roasted, unsalted ) | rock salt
instructions: Place a large non stick frypan on the table with a few inches of water below to get hot.  Meanwhile, brown the sausage, breaking up any meat that clings to bone with a fork, breaking into small chunks.  While the sausage cooks, stir through the orange zest and juice with a whisk.  Drain the sausage of any excess fat and return it to the pan.  Add the bean sprouts, oats and peanuts.  Stir well.  Remove from the heat and serve with plenty of crusty french rolls.  It tastes even better the following day with this recipe.

Random Ingredients: marjoram,romaine lettuce,beef roast,serrano chilies,celery seed,mustard green,collard green
title: Mexican-Style Steak Salad
ingredients: 5 lbs boneless beef roast, cut into 2-inch cubes | 20 -25 medium collard greens, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces | 20 -25 medium mustard greens, trimmed and cut into 2-inch slices | 1 cup thinly sliced celery seed | 2 serrano chilies, chopped | 1/2 - 3/4 teaspoon marjoram | 1 -2 teaspoon celery seed | 16 -18 rinsed washed and dried red snipped chilies, soaked in water to soften ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°f.  Place roast in 3 1/2 gallon zipper lock plastic bags.  Add celery seed, serrano chilies, marjoram, and celery seed.  Combine well.  Place bag in large roasting pan.  Add warm water to pan.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap tightly.  Place in oven, and place in roaster, and place in oven.  Set timer for 60 minutes.  Remove from oven and allow to sit at room temperature for 1 hour.  Slice beef and arrange on platter.  Surround with collard greens.  Pour juices evenly over the greens.  Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.  Drain the vegetables well before serving, and serve with the meat.

title: Labaneh (Yogurt-Lassi)
ingredients: 16 ounces yogurt | 1/2 package cream cheese
instructions: Whip together the cream cheese and yogurt with an electric mixer.  Serve on chilled stilita sticks.

title: Copycat Olive Garden Arrabbiata
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon sazon goya seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 3/4 cup vodka | 2 tablespoons dried currants | 1 loaf french bread, cut into 2 rounds | 1/2 cup half-and-half
instructions: Place 1/4 cup of vodka, 1 tbs of oregano paste, 1 tsp of seasoning, and the grated lemon peel in a glass bowl and stir with a fork.  Pour 1/4 cup vodka/russian mixture over bread slices and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes or so.  Meanwhile, place currants in a small bowl of 2 - 3 cups boiling water and let soak 5 - 10 minutes or so.  Remove currants and put them in a bowl.  Slice the soaked bread and set aside.  Add reserved vodka mixture and half and half to bread and stir until blended.  Place in an oven proof dish with a lid, and bake according to package directions.

Random Ingredients: hot italian sausage,rye bread,onion flake,beef stock
title: Chicago Style Meatballs  - Real Chicago Style
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb hot italian sausage, sliced | 1 medium onion, diced small | 3 tablespoons beef stock | soft rye bread ( optional )
instructions: Dice and brown sausage and mix all ingredients together.  Roll into small balls and place in crock pot.  Top with warm rye bread if desired, this is your bread crumbs, but you may also roll dough in it if necessary for a crock pot freeze, refrigerate and brown your crock pot to serve your meatballs.  You may need to add a little hot water to the crock pot to keep moist if to moist.

title: Veal Chops in Tuna Sauce
ingredients: 2 veal chops, 1 inch thick slices, cut 1/2 inch thick | 1/2 teaspoon ground round | 2 packages sliced firm tofu
instructions: Spread the cut side of the veal chops with salt, if desired.  Sprinkle the round with salt, if desired.  Place a tofu slice on each side of a slice of tofu.  Place a slice of veal over the tofu.  Place a lettuce leaf over the veal in one layer on a plate.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,almond butter,thyme sprig,shortbread cooky,rump roast
title: Rump Roast With Raisins and Almonds
ingredients: 1 lb rump roast | 1 tablespoon sweet almond butter | 6 sheets shortbread cookies, cut into pieces | 1 teaspoon fresh thyme sprig | 1/3 cup golden raisin
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f put oven rack in middle position in oven.  Put rump roast in shallow roasting pan.  Prick roast all over with a fork, being careful not to cut all the way through.  Sprinkle with salt.  Bake 40 - 45 minutes or until thermometer reads 130 degrees.  Turn roast over, cover tightly with foil and set aside.  Remove foil and thyme sprig, place raisins in a medium bowl and pour boiling water over.  Let sit 10 minutes.  Drain raisins well and pat excess moisture out onto a clean sheet of foil.  Invert into a flat ovenproof platter.  Remove thyme sprigs and serve with roast.

title: Snow Peas With Mushrooms
ingredients: 1/2 lb snow peas | 1/2 lb mixed mushrooms
instructions: Cut the mushrooms into bite size pieces, and wash the snow peas so that they're just covered by a little bit of green.  Heat a skillet, dry with paper towels, and add the green parts of the snow peas.  When they are crisp and brown, remove them from the skillet with a slotted spoon to drain on paper towels.  Add the mushrooms to the skillet so that they are all covered.  Let the mushrooms cook for about 2 minutes, or until they are cooked through, then stir to mix in the mushrooms.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: green bell pepper,active yeast,sea salt pepper,salt black pepper
title: Spanish Bread for Bread Machine
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups warm, but not warm water | 1/2 teaspoon active dry yeast | 2 1/4 teaspoons salt and black pepper blend | 1 green bell pepper, seeded and diced
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Prepare the dough by stirring the yeast and salt in a large bowl.  Add the bell pepper and 2/3 cup warm water, and stir until the dough is well mixed.  Cover with a towel, and let rest until the dough has doubled in size, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Roll out to make a large rectangle about 1/8 inch thick.  Grease the top of your bread machine with cooking spray, and spread the bell pepper over the dough.  Turn the bread over to let the dough rise, about 8 minutes.  Bake in the preheated oven until a light brown, about 30 minutes.

title: Ginger-Crusted BBQ Satay with Capers
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry onion flakes, divided ( about 1 ounce per skewer ) | 1/2 cup finely chopped ginger-caper | 1/4 cup capers ( optional ) | ground black pepper and coarsely ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.  Lightly rub the grilling surface with oil.  To prepare the berbere, in a large bowl, stir together 1/4 cup onion flakes and 1/2 cup ginger crumbles, capers and pepper.  Spoon into wet fingers, working as needed, then press the mixture into the finger holes to form a 1/2 inch thick patty.  Turn and tap the bread to remove any excess liquid.  Transfer the patties to the grill, close lid, and cook over high heat until the grill marks appear, about 2 minutes per side.  The basting will take about 2 minutes between each side as it cooks.  Use a sharp knife to cut the remaining patty into long strips about 1 inch wide.  Spray the grill rack with non stick cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: green cardamom pod,sea salt,chili sauce,rice noodle,plain nonfat yogurt
title: Yogurt Capsicum
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chili sauce | 1/4 teaspoon sea salt | 4 green cardamom pods, lightly crushed | 100 g rice noodles | 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Place all of the ingredients together in a bowl, except the yogurt, and mix well together.  Set aside for 30 minutes, uncovered, to allow flavours to develop.  Serve as a snack for the adults.

title: Tofu With Chestnuts and Peppers(Vegan-Friendly!)
ingredients: 150 g chestnut puree ( chestnut puree ( approximately ) | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon tamari or 1 tablespoon gluten-free soy sauce
instructions: Cut the chestnut puree into 2 x 3 cm.  Use a mortar and pestle to pound the puree into a smooth paste.  Transfer the chestnut paste to a mixing bowl and add oyster and tamari or gluten free soy sauce together.  Mix to coat and allow the flavours to mingle in the puree.  Add the chestnut puree and mix lightly.  If you want to make your chestnut paste in advance, add a few drops of cooking spray or extra tamari and leave in the fridge to marinate for at least 1 hour to develop the flavours.  Alternatively you can whisk the chestnut paste and the pureé for 2 – 3 minutes.  Stir to coat and allow the flavours to develop.  Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Potatoes Chip Casserole by Chef Spike Mendelsohn
ingredients: 1/2 cup light potato chips | 1 medium apple - peeled, cored and diced | 2 medium red tomatoes, diced | 1 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.  Stir potato chips, apple, tomatoes, garlic salt, and remaining 1 teaspoon black pepper together in a bowl and serve immediately.

title: Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thigh fillet | 1 small yellow bell pepper, julienned | 2 teaspoons ground cumin
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Coat the chicken with the mixture, pressing firmly with your fingers.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place on a tray and roast in oven for approximately 20 mins until juices run clear.

title: Vietnamese Beef
ingredients: 4 -5 lbs stewing beef | 1 tablespoon fish sauce
instructions: Trim any fat from beef.  Cut slits or pockets if desired.  Add to a large non metallic bowl, fish sauce, and stir to coat meat.  Cover bowl tightly with plastic wrap.  Refrigerate 12 hours, turning meat occasionally.  Place meat in a pot and cover with enough water to reach the bottom of the bowl.  Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer until meat is tender, about 40 minutes.  Remove meat from pot to remove all solids.  Cover again with plastic wrap.  Cook for about 10 minutes.  Slice meat, and serve on large hoagies or rolls.

title: Alfredo Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon instant espresso coffee powder | 1 tablespoon fresh oregano leaves, minced
instructions: Combine coffee powder and oregano in small bowl.  Heat small saucepan over medium low heat until hot.  Pour espresso mixture into empty pan with espresso.  Cook for about 30 seconds, or until almost boiling.  If liquid in pan dries up, stir with a wooden spoon to loosen any crystals from the bottom of the pan.  If there are too many bubbles, remove from heat.  Pour into a small bowl.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,iceberg lettuce,green lentil,garlic,tagliatelle pasta noodle,mango
title: Tagliatelle Pasta Salad II
ingredients: 10 leaves iceberg lettuce | 2 leaves red leaf green lentils | 2 cloves garlic, minced | 1 mango - peeled, pitted and diced | 1/2 jar cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1 package tagliatelle pasta noodles
instructions: In a salad bowl, layer the lettuce, red leaf lettuce, lentils, garlic, mango, refried beans and pasta.  Cover.

title: Savory Dill Broccoli Roll-ups
ingredients: 2 cups cooked broccoli cuts | 1 1/2 cups low fat, fat cottage cheese ( drained ) | 1 1/2 cups low-fat, fat-free yogurt | 1/2 cup canned bamboo shoot ( sliced or not ) | 2 3/4 cups broth or 2 3/4 cups water
instructions: To steam, bring broth to boil in medium saucepan.  Add broccoli and cook 10 - 12 minutes or till broccoli is cooked through but still firm.  You may use microwave steamer and bring broth to boil.  When broccoli is done, place all ingredients in a large bowl.  Add hot broth.  Stir with wooden wooden spoon until blended and evenly mixed.  Cover tightly and refrigerate several hours or overnight.  Place a portion of the mixture on a clean work space.  Roll up starting at shortest side of roll ups, then roll up tightly.  Cut roll ups into 4 - 10 pieces.  Serve warm.  Enjoy.

title: Fruit Cheese Mousse
ingredients: 4 cups plain greek yogurt | 1/2 pound roquefort cheese, chopped | 8 canned fruit cocktail, drained and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the yogurt and cheese until well blended.  Mix in the lemon peel until thoroughly blended.  Stir in the fruit cocktail.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

title: Asian Meatloaf
ingredients: 6 large challah | 2 pounds lean beef rump, cubed | 1 pound red currant jelly | 2 teaspoons chile paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Cut a 10x12 inch baking pan into twelve 1/2x1 inch sticks.  Insert bread sticks into baking pans with a 2 inch gap between each one, creating 6 loaf pans.  Stick the sticks about 1/2 inch apart to prevent them from falling out while baking.  Bake meat loafs until a thermometer inserted into the middle of the loaf reads 140 degrees f, 30 to 35 minutes.  Meanwhile, place jelly, chile paste and 1/2 cup water in a medium saucepan, bring to a simmer over medium low heat.  Add meat loafs and cook, uncovered, turning meat once, until heated through and tender, 2 to 2 1/2 hours.

title: Wasabi Peanut Butter Hash Browns
ingredients: 500 g russet potatoes | 4 tablespoons peanut butter | 1/2 teaspoon salt | 1 teaspoon wasabi
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes into 4 even sized pieces.  Place the potatoes onto a microwave safe plate.  Cover with cling paper and allow them to stand up in the microwave for 15 - 20 minutes.  Once the potatoes are cooked and soft, drain the potato slices and return them to the microwave and add the peanut butter and mash until smooth with a fork.  Add another teaspoon of salt and wasabi and mix thoroughly.  Allow this mixture to cool and then transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least 15 - 20 hours before serving.

Random Ingredients: stewing beef,wheat flour,coleslaw mix,cornflour,chipotle chile adobo,paprika
title: Baked Beef & Cabbage
ingredients: 3 lbs stewing beef | 1 tablespoon paprika | 1 tablespoon sweet paprika | 1 teaspoon coarse salt ( or 1/2 t salt ) | 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour | 3/4 cup cornflour ( or 2/3 cup all purpose flour ) | 1 -2 chipotle chile in adobo, chopped finely
instructions: Preheat oven to 275 degrees f.  Place meat in bowl, pour over paprika and stir.  Mix well & press into 2 or 2 1/2 quarts baking dish.  Bake 3 hours, turning the meat once.

Random Ingredients: tomato puree,chili paste garlic,bean sprout,white flour
title: Tasty Bean Sprouts
ingredients: 200 g white flour, sifted | 300 g fresh bean sprouts ( about 10oz ) | 1 teaspoon tomato puree | 2 teaspoons chilli paste with garlic, sifted
instructions: Cut the bean sprouts into quarters, leaving the stalk ends intact.  Drain the sprouts and place in a bowl.  Mix the flour, salt and tomato puree, and add to the bean sprouts, mixing well.  Cover and set aside at room temperature for 1 - 2 hours.  Preheat the oven to 200°c.  Line an ovenproof baking tray with aluminium foil, or lightly oil baking paper.  Bring the mixture to the centre of the tray and using your fingers press down until well combined.  Use the baking paper to help press the mixture outwards.  The mixture should be very slightly smaller than an average springform tin.  Bake the trays for about 15 minutes, until golden brown and crisp and crisp on the top.  Leave to set for another 10 minutes and serve warm or cold with chunky dipping sauce.  Note the bean sprouts will keep, refrigerated, for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: phyllo dough,liquid smoke,pineapple juice,portobello mushroom cap
title: Sweet Heart Portabello Mushroom Triangles
ingredients: 2 portobello mushroom caps | 2 packages frozen phyllo dough | 2/3 cup pineapple juice | 2/3 cup liquid smoke
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay mushroom caps on a baking sheet layered with wax paper and brush with juice.  Bake at 350 degrees f about 10 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.  Unchill phyllo sheets in a warm oven.  Remove mushroom caps from sheet, spread with a layer of dough over them.  Lay a mushroom cap and some pineapple sauce around cap.  Top with remaining dough.  Cover with wax paper and dampen top with cold water.  Bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes, or until phyllo has dried onto the bottom and is starting to brown.  Slice diagonally and serve.

Random Ingredients: brown rice,black eyed pea,white wine vinegar,anise seed,tabasco sauce,spinach leaf,beef brisket,ginger paste
title: Oriental Beef on the Run
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb beef brisket or 1 -1 1/2 lb venison, cut in 1 -1/2-inch cubes | 1 1/2 cups long-grain brown rice, washed and drained | 1 cup white wine vinegar | 2 tablespoons anise seeds, crushed | 2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 -2 dash tabasco sauce | 8 -10 spinach leaves | 1/2 cup black-eyed peas, drained
instructions: Place the meat, vinegar, aniseed, ginger and tabasco into a slow cooker, and stir to blend.  Add the spinach leaves, and cook on high for 2 - 3 hours or on low for up to 6 hours.  Stir often.  You may need to skim off fat at this point, as the liquid in the pot will be too salty for some to drown into your food.  Add more salt and pepper to taste.  Serve over rice and enjoy great on italian bread, with a greek salad and fresh garden vegetables.

Random Ingredients: almond extract,saffron thread,peach,orange juice zest,parmigiano reggiano cheese,peanut,heavy whipping cream
title: Almond Ice Cream With Saffron and Peach (Sbd P2)
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe peaches, peeled, pitted, and chopped ( about 8 cups ) | 1 1/2 cups orange juice, fresh squeezed is best ( about 3 avg oranges ) | 1/3 cup toasted unsalted peanuts, chopped | 1 teaspoon almond extract ( or to taste ) | 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese ( plus more for table ) | 3/4 teaspoon saffron threads
instructions: To make the ice cream, place the peaches in a 2 1/2 quart saucepan with enough water to cover and bring to a boil over high heat.  Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer slowly, partially covered, until the peaches are very tender, about 15 minutes.  Drain, set aside, and keep warm.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the orange juice and 3/4 cup of the sugar until the liquid is thick and smooth.  Stir in the almond extract.  Whisk in the cream, 1/2 cup of the cheese, and the saffron.  Fold in the peaches, then stir in the hot syrup until just blended.  Let stand at room temperature.  Place another 1/2 cup of the remaining cheese in a small, heavy skillet.  Heat over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until the cheese just starts to soften, 4 to 6 minutes.  Drain the peaches, reserving the syrup.  Dip each peach in the warm cream and sprinkle with salt, to taste.  Arrange on a serving platter and drizzle with the reserved syrup.  Transfer the platter to a cutting board and slice diagonally, about 1/8 inch thick.  Serve warm, sprinkled with the remaining 1/4 cup cheese, and with the additional 1/4 cup of cheese passed at the table.

Random Ingredients: vegetarian oyster sauce,baguette,orange juice,red kidney bean,hard egg,serrano pepper
title: Red Kid Bean Crookneck Oyster Sandwich
ingredients: 2/3 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons vegetarian oyster sauce or 2 tablespoons oyster sauce | 1 baguette ( thin-cut ) | 8 eggs ( hard-boiled ) | 4 -6 cups cooked red kidney beans ( drained ) | 2 cups crispy cooked hard-boiled eggs | 1/2 cup serrano pepper, finely chopped
instructions: Combine orange juice, oyster sauce, and oyster sauce in small bowl, set aside.  Split baguette on the diagnal and cut in half lengthwise.  Make an indentation in the bread with the tip of a knife.  Fill the hollow with half of the drained kidney beans, a pinch of bread crumbs, and a quarter of the orange juice mixture of eggs and hot pepper flakes and salt.  Dice 2 eggs into small cubes.  Mix bread cubes with remaining liquid ingredients, then dip into egg mixture.  Place on cookie sheet and make sandwiches with remaining oyster sauce mixture of eggs, beans, and hot pepper flakes.  Bake at 350°f for 25 minutes.

title: Homemade Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots, washed and drained | 1 jar sliced pepperoncini peppers
instructions: Cut the tops off the carrots, but leave the tops.  Drop them into boiling water for about 5 - 10 minutes for soft or 15 minutes for a firmer carrot.  Rinse the carrots in cold water until the water they were boiled in or you will risk breaking up the carrots.  Drain the carrots well and place into a bowl of cold running water.  Drain well again. .  Place the jar of pepperoncini peppers into a large bowl.  Add about 2 1/4 cups of the hot water.  Stir well to combine.  The carrots should not be very soft but should not break up.  Cover tightly and put in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to allow the carrots to soften somewhat.  Then drain and use as a side dish or fill for sandwiches.

Random Ingredients: bicarbonate soda,asparagus,chili pepper flake,pizza sauce,chicken stock vegetable,purple onion
title: Roasted Veggie Slice
ingredients: 2 cups chicken stock or 2 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda | 50 ml sweet pizza sauce ( use your favourite pizza sauce ) | 1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh chili pepper flakes | 1 purple onion, peeled, coarsley chopped, then separated into rings | 1 1/2 cups chopped fresh asparagus
instructions: Turn on the oven to 220c/425f/gas mark heat the stock in a frying pan and add the bicarb soda.  Once the bubbles have started to appear, stir in the sweet pizza sauce and chili flakes.  Simmer for 10 minutes, whisking occasionally.  Add the onions and continue to simmer for 2 minutes until the onions start to soften.  Turn off the heat and stir in the asparagus.  Leave to cool in the oven, then slice the slice into 1/2 inch slices, using a very sharp knife.  Place the slices of the sauce in a shallow dish or on two serving serving plates.  Add the slices of asparagus to the sauce, cover and refridgerate for an hour or two.  Once the sauce is ready serve them with your favourite bread.

title: Chinese Snow Pea Salad With Cherries
ingredients: 16 snow peas | 4 cups cherry, sliced in half on the diagonal ( or fruit, or nuts of choice ) | 1/3 cup fresh lemon juice | chicken or vegetable oil, for frying ( optional )
instructions: Wash and pat dry the snow peas.  Cut the pods in half with a sharp knife.  Heat the oil in a deep fryer or a large pot.  When it is just beginning to smoke, drop in the snow peas.  As soon as the snow peas are golden, and tender but not crisp, drain on paper towels, and place in a large serving bowl.  Add the cherries or fruit of choice, tossing to coat evenly.  Serve warm or cold.

title: Molho de Bonne (Salmon with Hearts of Palm)
ingredients: 1 kg heart of palm | 1 kg natural salmon fillet | 2 slices fresh gingerroot, finely grated ( thick and finely sliced ) | 1 1/2 cups plain unbleached flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°c.  Use a very sharp knife to cut a horizontal hole in the middle of each piece of salmon fillet and remove the dark membrane that has formed.  Using a vegetable peeler, remove the soft white flesh of the palm.  Cut away the hard white lining and most of the greenish peel and remove the white vein with the skin and finely julienned white flesh.  Cut 2 x 2 inch squares of ungreased baking parchment and cover the top with a sheet of overlapping parchment and bake in middle of the oven for 15 minutes.  Carefully remove the paper and parchment, remove the fris centre from the oven, and using a spatula remove the fris centre and place inside a bowl to drain any excess moisture.  Turn the oven up to 400°, and once the oven has reached 400° lay the cooked heart of palm on the baking parchment square.  Sprinkle with grated ginger root and spread on the mixture.  In the centre of the palm, place a square of the heart of palm with the skin, and then, using a spatula, gently fold over the mixture.  Roll up the pastry to enclose the filling.  Repeat with the remaining trimmings and serve alongside the smoked salmon.

title: Snow Peas Au Lait
ingredients: 1 french baguette, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 package snow peas
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 degrees f.  Arrange baguette cubes in a 9x5 inch pan.  Sprinkle snow peas over the dough.  Bake in the preheated oven until the top looks dry and toasted, 10 to 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: picante sauce,sage,cubanelle pepper,mascarpone cheese,avocado,flour,coriander powder,chicken bouillon powder
title: Cheese and Avocado Tortilla
ingredients: 2 cubanelle peppers, seeded cut in 1/2 cubes | 1 cup picante sauce ( mild or medium ) | 1/2 avocado, peeled seeded and cubed | 2 teaspoons flour | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder or 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon powder | 1/2 teaspoon dried sage | 3 -4 tablespoons mascarpone cheese
instructions: Brown pepper cubes in pan with a little olive oil.  Add picante sauce and reduce.  In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, cardamon powder, sage, coriander and bouillon powder.  Add flour mixture to onion in pan.  Simmer until sauce thicks a little, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Mix avocado with cheese and mix with sauce.  Add picante to help melt cheese, if necessary.

title: Pollo a La Gringo
ingredients: 4 pounds pork shoulder | 4 pounds chicken thighs
instructions: Season the pork shoulder on all sides with a little salt.  Insert the pork legs into a 5 gallon plastic bag.  Rinse the bag a little bit with hot water, and pat dry.  Refrigerate the pork and chicken for at least 4 hours.  Heat a smoker to 325 degrees f.  Smoke the pork for 4 to 5 hours, until well browned.  Remove from smoker, and set aside.  Discard any browned bits off of the pork, and slice as desired.  A meat grinder works nicely for this.  Serve with white rice, or browned bread.  Note, for a smokey flavor, stir in some corn tortillas or tortilla chips, for a more authentic chorizo flavor, leave some corn in the bag for added flavor, and for added richness, you can spread it into one 10x15 inch loaf pan.  Place the bag of pork shoulder into the pan, and add enough smoke to cover the pork.

title: Cashew Nut Sticks (Prawns) With Almonds
ingredients: 1/3 cup cashew nuts | 1 1/2 teaspoons olive, mixed with the nut oil | 1/4 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 teaspoon mixed dried fruit of your choice ( such as dates, papaya, zucchini, apricots, figs )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300f/190c.  Pulse the cashews in a food processor until finely ground.  Add the remaining ingredients and process until the mixture becomes a thick paste.  Spread the mixture on a baking tray lined with baking paper.  Bake for 15 - 25 minutes, turning once, until the nuts turn a light golden colour.  Allow to cool before serving with ice cream or cream.

title: Venison Noodle Salad - Vegetarian
ingredients:
250 g dried okra | 200 g smoked venison | 200 g smoked pork or 200 g stew meat | 1 -2 serrano pepper, chopped | 150 g mixed salad greens | 150 g fresh bean sprouts ( or fresh leaves ) | 3 dried apricots, sliced | 1 cup cooked udon noodles, cooked ( can substitute any dried textured protein you wish to sub.
    - if your tastes don't really care for noodles, the amount of noodle noodles you like is up to you )
instructions: Cook noodles according to packet directions, drain, rinse and allow to cool.  Cut venison into bite sized cubes.  Slice up meat, including the ribs if using.  Saute beef, pork or venison in a little oil or butter until beef is browned.  Remove from heat and allow to cool, and cut up into chunks.  Rinse and rinse beans and stems.  Mix all the salad ingredients but the croutons, noodles, and meat.  Pile onto a serving platter, top with croutons and fruit slices.

title: Healthy Orange Mushrooms
ingredients: 4 ounces mushrooms, cleaned, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup nonfat plain yogurt ( reduced fat okay ) | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 tablespoons nonfat plain yogurt, for garnish ( low fat okay )
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a bowl, cover and chill in the refrigerator for about 8 hours.  Remove the mixture before serving.

title: Taquitos
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas | 3 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup caster sugar
instructions: Heat the grill.  Lay the corn tortillas flat on the grill tray and lightly brush with the olive oil.  Grill until golden on both sides.  Meanwhile, place the castor sugar on a large plate.  Dip the tortillas in the sugar and let them sit for 10 seconds and then invert and put the sugar on the same side.  When the sugar melts, remove from the grill and put on absorbent paper to dry.  Serve on toasted tortillas with lettuce and fruit.

Random Ingredients: white flour,nutritional yeast,kaffir lime leaf,garlic paste
title: Vegan Japanese Pickles
ingredients: 2 cups white flour | 1 -2 tablespoon garlic paste | 1 -2 teaspoon nutritional yeast | 1 -3 tablespoon kaffir lime leaves ( optional )
instructions: Place flour in mixing bowl and make a well in the center.  Add all remaining ingredients.  Knead until smooth and well blended.  Cover and let rest for about 20 minutes.  Form into 8 small balls, or a loaf approximately 1 inch thick.  Place on plastic wrap and refrigerate to let dry all day.  Use in a recipe for kebabs, salads, meats or meat patties if desired.  Can be frozen for later use.

Random Ingredients: orange juice,baby swiss cheese,tomato green chilies,beet,anaheim chilies,cool whip
title: Cheesy Beet and Sliced Swiss  With  Green Chilies
ingredients: 1 cup shredded iceberg swiss cheese | 3 tablespoons diced ripe tomatoes with green chilies | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh anaheim chilies | 2 ounces canned diced tomatoes with green chilies ( i use rojos brand, but you may use any canned green chilies that don't come out the can ) | 1/4 cup orange juice | 2 small fresh beets ( about 1 1/2 lbs ) | 4 tablespoons room temp light cool whip ( or frozen yogurt )
instructions: Set the oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the broiler.  If you wish to use fresh chilies, rinse and remove the seeds.  Set the broiler pan about 6 inches from the heat source.  Broil until the edges are browned, about 5 minutes.  If you use canned tomatoes, place the can in a heavy plastic bag and shake to rinse the contents and let them fall off the bag into the bowl with the tomatoes, chiles, and orange juice.  Cut the beets in half lengthwise and then slice into 3/4 inch thick slices.  If using fresh chile slices, slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick half moons.  Place the beets onto a rimmed baking sheet and place under the broiler about 3 minutes or until the tops are light brown.  Transfer the beets to a plate and sprinkle them with salt.  Set aside.  Slice the beets into 3/4 inch wide strips.  Return the slices to the baking sheet and broil on both sides just until they start to release their aroma, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Remove from the oven and place the beets into a large bowl.  Mash the beets until they are creamy and slightly chunky.  Add the shredded cheese and mix.  Fold in the tomatoes, and mix well.  Divide the cheese sauce among 4 plates.  Top with the beets and green chile slices, then top with your favorite toppings.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,red bell pepper,apricot jam,paneer,cornflour,grand marnier
title: Sweet and Sour Paneer Chutney
ingredients: 3 lbs paneer | 1 red bell pepper | 1/4 lb red paprika | 1 -2 jalapeno pepper | 18 ounces cornflour ( maize cornflour or rice flour ) | 1 tablespoon grand marnier
instructions: Heat the oven to 325 degrees f.  Cut the paneer into chunks and boil for about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile cut the bell pepper and chile into very long strips.  Mix together the cornflour and grand marnier and add to the pan.  Stir and simmer for half an hour.  Cut the paneer into 1/2 inch pieces.  Add to the pan and mix well, cooking for 20 minutes.  This chutney will not last long enough to be served, as it will get thicker.  Serve in bowls with fresh crusty bread and jam.  It is delicious when made on the barbecue, or poured into a bowl.  The texture should not be too runny or too watery, however you like your chutney.  You can mix in a little bit of british cream.  Use sparingly, though it may seem like it is not.

title: Spiced Broccoli
ingredients: 1 cup broccoli floret | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom | 1/8 teaspoon mace
instructions: Combine all ingredients into a skillet, cover and simmer over low heat until broccoli is crisp tender, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Place in a large serving dish or plate and serve.

Random Ingredients: apple juice,baking powder,red chilies,beer,mint leaf,green cardamom,scotch whisky,dark sesame oil
title: Yemeni Beer
ingredients: 2 cups dark sesame oil | 2 cups apple juice ( i use a good brand heinz or mathilde ) | 12 ounces beer ( i use budweiser ) | 16 ounces apple juice ( i use a good brand heinz ) | 2 dried red chilies or 2 green cardamoms | 2 tablespoons roughly chopped fresh mint leaves | 2 teaspoons baking powder ( i use keens brand ) | 1 teaspoon ground sherry or 1 teaspoon scotch whisky
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small pot and heat on medium.  When very hot, pour into beer cups to serve.

title: Cornbread
ingredients: 1 cup cornmeal | 1/4 cup sherry wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Pour cornmeal in a large bowl and stir in sherry.  Turn bread onto a lightly greased or baking sheet and coat top with cornmeal mixture.  Sprinkle cornbread with salt and pepper.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown and crispy, about 15 minutes 15 minutes.

title: Chipotle Popcorn (Microwave, or Roasted)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal ( regular or quick cooking, depending on preference, or whole wheat, you might not like that much in my house ) | 1 -2 canned chipotle chile, roughly chopped to preference ( optional )
instructions: Combine the cornmeal and chilies and add to dry ingredients.  Microwave on medium low heat setting, stirring regularly until the mixture resembles popcorn.  Remove from microwave, add more cornmeal if it seems dry, this should take about 5 minutes.  Let cool.

title: Jicama and Thyme Mini Tarts
ingredients: 2 sheets frozen puff pastry, thawed | 1/2 cup apricot jam or 1/2 cup apricot preserves, chilled | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 1 tablespoon dried thyme | 1 - 1 1/4 lb jicama | 1 cup rolled oats | 1/2 cup diced sweet paprika
instructions: Place cooled pastry sheets on a work surface.  Stir jam or preserves into pastry sheets and spread evenly with jam or preserves.  Sprinkle creole seasoning and thyme over jam and sprinkle evenly with jicama.

Random Ingredients: tomato paste,barberry,ice water,peanut,green chili pepper,hot italian sausage,marsala wine,garlic
title: Hot Italian Sausage With Hot Marsala Wine & Marsala Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb hot italian sausage, casings removed | 3/4 pint ice water ( or more ) | 2 tablespoons chopped green chili peppers ( i use anaheim ) | 1 clove garlic, chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped raw peanuts, or | 1 jar dry marsala wine | 1 can tomato paste | 1/2 cup dry marsala wine | 2 tablespoons barley or 2 tablespoons red wine
instructions: In a large saute pan, warm the sausage over medium high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.  When the sausage is browned, add the ice water, green chiles, garlic, and peanuts.  Add the marsala wine and tomato paste.  Stir well.  Add the marsala wine and barramundi or red wine.  Stir well.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionaly, until the liquid is reduced and syrupy.

Random Ingredients: prune,wheat bread,chicken broth,cranberry,pecorino romano cheese,tomato puree
title: Italian Bread Casserole With Prunes
ingredients: 1/3 cup whole wheat bread, unsliced | 1 can condensed chicken broth, undiluted | 1 can canned tomatoes in puree, undrained | 1 cup shredded pecorino romano cheese, divided | 1 cup dried prune, roughly chopped | 2 tablespoons dried cranberries ( optional )
instructions: Position rack in the center of the oven and heat to 325°.  Spray a 13x9 baking dish with cooking spray.

title: Rosemary Raspberry Vinegar
ingredients: 4 cups fresh raspberries ( or frozen ) | 1 cup white vinegar, chilled and chilled ( not vinegar dressing ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rosemary | 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: Wash and destem the berries, then split them in half.  Place them in the blender and puree until smooth and slightly fluffy.  Place the raspberries, vinegar, rosemary, and salt in a nonreactive bowl and stir well.  Pour into a nonreactive 2 cup chilled glass jar and refrigerate for 2 hours, until the mixture begins to set around the berries.  To use, remove from jar and shake vigorously to loosen the raspberries.  Serve with breads or chips.

title: Spanish Rice With Dates and Eggs
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups long grain rice or 1 1/4 cups brown rice, washed and drained | 2 egg yolks | 1 jar chopped pimiento, drained | 1 jar dates, drained | freshly whipped topping
instructions: Boil rice until just soft and has absorbed most of the water.  Drain.  Combine rice, egg yolks, pimiento, dates and 3 tbsp of the cooking liquid in a bowl.  Spread into a lightly greased 9 cake pan and bake, uncovered, at 375 until top is golden brown, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove from oven.  Drizzle with remaining 1 tbsp of cooking liquid.  Cover with a tight lid.  Let stand on pan a few minutes before cutting.  Serve with garnishes.

Random Ingredients: portabella mushroom cap,lasagna noodle,corn oil,red wine,cauliflower
title: Roasted Vegetable and Mozzarella Cannelloni
ingredients: 6 cannelloni noodles ( thin whole leaves or just a little bit of both to fit the cannelloni ) | 6 sheets lasagna noodle sheets | 1 1/2 tablespoons corn oil | 6 large portabella mushroom caps, trimmed, chopped | 1/2 cup red wine
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f.  Bring a large pan of water to a boil, add 1 tbsp salt and the noodles and cook according to package directions.  As pasta cooks, spread each sheet of noodles with oil and spread with a thin layer of the roasted mushrooms, sprinkle with 2 tbsp salt and the red wine and arrange the cannelloni on a parchment lined baking sheet.  Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown the mushrooms are the most tender.  Note, if using dried cannelloni, rinse under hot water and divide the cooked shells between the cannelloni and re brown the filling.  Note, you can also layer the cannelloni with the roasted mushrooms and red onion from the top of the cannelloni.

title: Spiced Pasta with Cashews
ingredients: 6 ounces penne pasta | 1 1/3 cups unsalted cashews | 4 ounces unsalted peanuts | 3 cardamom seeds | 1 cup chopped fresh mint sprigs
instructions: In a heavy skillet, toast cashews over medium heat, shaking the skillet frequently, 5 to 8 minutes until lightly browned.  Remove the cashews with a slotted spoon and transfer cashews to a bowl.  Add remaining ingredients to the cashews and cashews.  Toss to coat, then transfer to a platter.  Tear off six 1/4 inch wide strips of aluminum foil large enough to fit the pasta bowls.  Using a pastry brush, spread the pasta shells in a single layer on the foil.  Bake 15 minutes at 400 degrees f, or until barely tender.  Serve topped with cashews and drizzle with a little more of the cashew oil.

title: Cheese & Beans
ingredients: 1 can great northern beans ( rinsed, drained ) | 1 lb velveeta cheese ( cubed ) | 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
instructions: Combine all ingredients.  Put in crock pot on high and cook all day.

title: Brazilian Cucumber Soup
ingredients: 1 cucumber, seeded | 3 cups canned fruit, drained | 1 cup bucatini pasta, broken | 4 cups boiling chicken bouillon cubes | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | crushed ice
instructions: Mix cucumber, fruit, and bucatini in a large bowl.  Pour boiling chicken bouillon into bowl, then add cocoa powder, stirring until thoroughly mixed.  Serve in serving bowls.

title: Chickpea Beef Stew
ingredients: 2 tablespoons fennel seeds | 800 g beef chuck | 400 g chickpeas | 1 cup desiccated coconut ( not dried ) | fresh mint sprig ( optional )
instructions: Combine fennel seeds and beef chuck in a large heavy bottomed pan, cover and cook over a high heat for several minutes or until the beef is browned lightly and the onion and garlic are soft.  Remove mixture, draining on paper towel.  Wipe out the pan and return it to high heat.  Add chickpeas and turn down the heat to medium and cook for a further 30 to 40 minutes, or until meat is extremely tender and beginning to darken slightly.  Stir in coconut and taste and correct seasoning.  Cover and simmer for another 15 to 20 minutes or until chickpeas are soft and flavours of coconut are just beginning to blend inches remove from heat and stir in mint leaves.

title: Chinese Sweet-Sour Dipping Sauce!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 3 tablespoons sesame oil
instructions: Stir the sherry and the sesame oil together until it turns into a paste.  Serve at room temperature or at room temperature.

title: Mushroom Beef Shanagari from the Times of the London Fog
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 cup cream of mushroom soup | 1 lb fresh shrimp, deveined, cleaned, tails removed and patted dry, tail off | 1/2 teaspoon fenugreek seeds, crushed | 1 fresh new york strip oarth-thin shrimps, with shells on ( or 3/4 cup oarndo-grade beef from the store ) | 1 -1 1 piece radish, chopped
instructions: In a saucepan heat the soup, about 5/6 cup at a time, until the soup is bubbly and very hot.  Remove from the heat and stir in the shrimp.  Stir in the fenugreek and crushed red pepper.  Cool about 10 minutes.  In a glass bowl with a lid, place the shrimp mixture and place in the freezer.  After 3 hours have passed, remove the shrimp from the freezer, place it back in the freezer.  Return the shrimp mixture to the freezer and freeze completely.  Just before serving, remove from the freezer 1 hour before serving and place on a platter.  Top with shrimps, garnish with radishes.

title: Crazy Boneless Chuck-Aribs
ingredients: 2 lbs beef short ribs | 1 cup coffee or 1 cup water
instructions: Cut short ribs into 1 inch pieces.  Place meat, fat side up, on a rack.  Pour coffee/water over pieces.  Cover and place in refrigerator overnight.  Bake uncovered at 300º for 2 hours.  Bake uncovered for another 1/2 hour or until meat is darkly browned.

title: Gramma's Easy Microwave Po Casserole
ingredients: 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 1 package instant graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup chopped celery ( optional )
instructions: Spray a 9x9 inch glass casserole dish with veggie oil cooking spray.  In a small bowl combine the soups and cracker crumbs.  Stir the soup until smooth and pour over the cracker crumb mixture in the casserole dish.  Place uncovered microwave on high for 5 minutes until bubbly.  Turn, and continue microwaving for an additional 3 minutes or until casserole is bubbly again.  Remove from microwave and sprinkle celery over the top.  Cool, then refrigerate for 1 - 3 hours to set.

Random Ingredients: fennel seed,bailey irish cream,screwpine leaf,dark sesame oil,cremini mushroom,herbes de provence,american cheese
title: The Snowy Boulevard
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fennel seed | 1/2 teaspoon herbes de provence | 8 ounces cremini mushrooms, quartered | 1 tablespoon dark sesame oil | 8 ounces american cheese, chopped | 2 tablespoons baileys irish cream | 3 dozen screwpine leaves
instructions: Preheat your oven to 425 degrees.  Place the fennel seeds and herbes de provence in a small pan over medium heat.  Cook until fragrant and lightly golden, about 2 minutes.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Place mushrooms, sesame oil, and grated American cheese in bowl.  Stir thoroughly to coat the bottom of an 8 inch round saucer with the sesame oil.  Place mushrooms in bowl with cheese.  Add the herb de provence and gently stir until cheese is evenly melted.  Garnish with some chiffonade of horseradish.  Place on a parchment lined cookie sheet and bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes.  Remove from oven and sprinkle with more cheese.  Return to the oven for 5 - 10 minutes longer, or until the cheese is melted.  Let cool a minute or so before removing to a cutting board.

title: Ginger and Ice Cream Lasagna
ingredients: 1 package lasagna noodles ( about 20 sheets ) | 3 1/4 lbs gingerroot | 2 pints chocolate ice cream
instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook lasagna until just crisp tender but firm to the bite.  Drain and set aside.  Meanwhile, heat oven to 400 degrees.  Grease a large oven proof baking dish and set aside.  Cut the ginger in half lengthwise and place on a cutting board with enough strength to cut into slices, about 1/2 inch thick.  Place the slices and ginger in a food processor or blender and process until finely and roughly chopped.  Place about 1 1/2 cups of the garlic/ginger mixture into a separate bowl.  Spread about 1/2 cup of the coconut mixture over the bottom of the baking dish and cover with some of the noodles.  Repeat the layering by making the second batch of noodles and topping them with the remaining coconut mixture.  Top with 1 1/2 cups of the ice cream and bake for 45 minutes.  Uncover and return to oven and bake an additional 45 minutes until sauce is bubbling and the top is golden.

title: Creamy Tomato Broth
ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced cabbage | 1 can diced tomatoes | 1 celery rib
instructions: Pour cabbage and tomatoes into a saucepan, and place over medium heat.  Simmer until cabbage is tender and liquid has cooked off.  This could take about 10 minutes.  Stir occasionally, and keep an eye on it.  To thin, stir in a little water until the mixture is desired thickness.

Random Ingredients: white breadcrumb,red chili,chicken bouillon,tea,hoisin sauce,dark brown sugar
title: Soy Choy's Chilli Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken | 1/3 cup soft white breadcrumbs | 1/3 cup dried white breadcrumbs ( panko ) | 1 teaspoon instant chicken bouillon | 1/2 teaspoon hoisin sauce | 1 teaspoon dark brown sugar
instructions: Combine ground chicken and onion in a large bowl.  Add the rest of the ingredients.  Mix well with hands, making sure it takes on all the ingredients.  Form into burgers or hamburgers.  Place in fridge for 4 hours or overnight.  Cook over barbq or grill with a good cooking spray.  Grill or bbq using desired method.

title: Basic Custard Sauce
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 egg, for sealing the custard
instructions: Pour all ingredients into a pan and stir.  Cook over a very low heat for 20 minutes.  Place the lid on the pan.  Allow for the mixture to heat through and the custard to set.  Allow to set for another five to ten minutes then remove the lid.  Churn in an ice cream maker and serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,italian breadcrumb,salt pepper,cold water,lemon juice,oregano
title: Crusty Italian Breaded Loaf
ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour | 1 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper | 1 tablespoon lemon juice | 1/2 teaspoon dry oregano | 1 1/2 cups cold water
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Combine the flour, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, lemon juice and oregano.

Random Ingredients: egg noodle,red pepper flake,large shrimp,orange marmalade,sirloin
title: Easy Beef and Shrimp
ingredients: 1 lb sirloin, in 1 inch cubes | 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined | 1/4 cup orange marmalade | 1 1/2 teaspoons red pepper flakes | 1 lb egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: In a large non metal pan, place meat cubes, shrimp and marmalade.  Cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, or until meat is browned and shrimp are cooked through.  Sprinkle with red pepper flakes.  Serve over cooked egg noodles.  Garnish with grated parmesan cheese if desired.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,rigatoni pasta,serrano pepper,celery salt,mint leaf,golden syrup,radicchio,english muffin
title: English Muffin Melts With Rigatoni and Radicchio
ingredients: 12 slices english muffins | 1 cup farfalle pasta | 4 tablespoons radicchio or 4 tablespoons bolognaise sauce | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt | 1 teaspoon chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/4 teaspoon finely chopped fresh serrano peppers or 1/4 teaspoon chipotle chile | 1 lb ruegrante hollow pasta such as rigatoni pasta | 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves
instructions: Preparation, place the farfalle pasta in a large pot of boiling, salted water.  Keep the pot covered and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until al dente, drain.  Place the hot cooked farfalle in a large serving bowl and set aside.  In a small bowl, combine the remaining ingredients.  Add the dressing to the pasta and mix well.  Divide the farfalle among your 4 plates and top with the radicchio and the dressing.

title: Peach Bacon Wrapped in Peaches
ingredients: 1 fresh peach, peeled and halved | 8 pieces bacon, chopped
instructions: Preheat your broiler.  Wrap the peach halves with pieces of bacon, and place on a baking sheet.  Broil, turning occasionally until the bacon is crispy, about 10 minutes.

title: Orange Peel and Ginger Tartlets
ingredients: 6 ounces candied orange peel | 12 ounces cooking oil | 5 ounces crystallized gingerroot, sliced | 1 egg white | 2 ounces double cream
instructions: Place the orange peel, oil, ginger, egg white and cream in a bowl and whisk well until thoroughly mixed.  Divide the mixture between the tartlet shells and bake at 160°c for 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Daikon Salad
ingredients: 8 ounces daikon radishes, sliced | 1/3 cup dry roasted peanuts, chopped | 1/4 cup french mustard ( not creamy or salty )
instructions: Toss all ingredients together with remaining dressing ingredients.

title: Blackberry Salsa
ingredients: 1/2 cup white vinegar | 1/2 cup italian dressing | 4 cups blackberries, washed and drained | 1 scallion, minced | 1 chicken bouillon cube ( dissolved ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary or 1/2 teaspoon oregano | 2 -3 ounces small blackberries, rinsed and dried
instructions: Add vinegar, dressing, blackberries, scallions, bouillon and oregano to blender and process until mixed and smooth.  Pour mixture into large bowl.  Add blackberries, toss well.  Chill several hours or overnight before serving.  The longer it sits, the more the flavors meld.

Random Ingredients: queso fresco,fennel seed,nonstick cooking spray,cannellini bean,pumpkin puree,flake coconut,ginger,red chili powder
title: Tropical Grilled White Beans With Mexican Pesto Sauce
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 3 pints canned cannellini beans ( drained and rinsed ) | 1/2 tablespoon red chili powder | 1/2 teaspoon fennel seed ( freshly ground ) | 1/2 teaspoon ginger ( fresh ground ) | 1 tablespoon pumpkin puree | 6 ounces nonstick cooking spray | 1 cup crumbled queso fresco | 1/2 cup toasted flake coconut
instructions: Combine beans and next 4 ingredients in food blender and puree.  Transfer puree and beans into a saucepan.  Place over medium high heat.

title: Easy Baklava
ingredients: 2 cups cornflakes cereal | 1/2 cup sherry | 24 sheets phyllo pastry
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f and butter a cookie sheet or 9x13 inch pan.  In a mixing bowl, mix cornflakes cereal, sherry and enough cornflakes to coat cereal.
