Add enough water to coat cereal and mix with hands.  Layer pastry sheets in the pan with the cereal mixture, making sure sheets are covered throughout.  Cover phyllo dough completely with phyllo.  Trim phyllo to fit pan and brush with water.  Sprinkle with remaining cereal.  Bake at 300 degrees f for approximately 40 minutes or until golden brown.

Random Ingredients: sushi rice,thyme,extra virgin olive oil,pickling spice,navy bean
title: Portuguese Beans and Rice (Choucroute Garni)
ingredients: 1 cup pickling spices | 14 1/2 ounces navy beans | 7 1/2 ounces extra virgin olive oil | 1 tablespoon pickling spices | sushi rice | 2 teaspoons thyme
instructions: Rinse the beans and pickling spice together.  Pour the olive oil into a wide, deep pan and heat.  Add the pickling spices and cook over low heat and stir often until the oil shows signs of “green”.  Add the beans, season with salt and stir well.  Cover loosely and lower the heat to very low.  Cook for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.  The rice should be golden.  Remove from the heat.  Stir in the fresh thyme for added flavor.  Allow to cool for 20 minutes before adding more seasoning. .  Serve the beans in small individual ramekin dishes.  Serve rice topped with a sprinkling of chorizo sausage, ham slices and pieces of bacon that have been thinly sliced and fried in olive oil for a few minutes.  Note, this does not have a french or italian flair.  If you use an oven, french or italian style bread, it works best as well.

title: Italian Cucumber Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground round | 3/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb | 1/2 medium cucumber, sliced | 1 cup beef gravy | 1 tablespoon dried lemon peel | mortadella, slices to serve ( or tomato, green pepper, and cheese )
instructions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly using hands.  Form into 6 patties.  Broil, 3 - 4 inches from heat, 1 from bottom until brown on both sides, then remove and let sit 5 minutes.  Serve with favorite ingredients of your choice.

title: Chinese Chicken Curry
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken tenders, cut into 1/2 pieces | 3 -4 tablespoons anise seed | 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger paste | 1 cup canned chickpeas or 1 cup canned bean broth | 2 teaspoons roasted anise seeds, crushed
instructions: In a large frying pan or wok, saute spices over medium high heat, stirring constantly, about 3 - 4 minutes or until fragrant.  Add chicken and cook 5 - 6 minutes or until chicken is browned.  Add chickpeas to pan with chicken.  Stir to combine and cook about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Garnish with roasted anise seeds and serve over hot rice.

title: Grilled Peaches With a Florentine Touch
ingredients: 4 ripe peaches | 1 passion fruit, seeded and sliced | 120 g gruyere cheese, grated ( about 5 oz ) | 1 tablespoon maple syrup | 1/2 tablespoon superfine sugar
instructions: Halve the peach quarters lengthways and remove the stone.  Slice the halves in half and cut them into thick slices.  Arrange on a large plate, sprinkle the passionfruit and grated cheese over the top and grill, uncovered, for a few minutes until the cheese has melted and turned golden.

Random Ingredients: lamb shoulder,green bean,wasabi paste,lime,dark soy sauce,cooking oat,salmon fillet
title: Wasabi Salmon and Green Beans(Kai Soi)
ingredients: 6 tablespoons wasabi paste, divided | 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce | 2 lbs boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 3-inch pieces | 1 lb green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces | 2 lbs salmon fillets, bones removed | cooking oat ( optional ) | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 6 tablespoons wasabi paste, divided | 3/4 lb boneless lamb shoulder, cut into 3/4-inch pieces | 3 lbs salmon fillets, bones removed
instructions: In a large ziplock bag, mix 1 tablespoons wasabi, soy sauce and 1/2 cup reserved wasabi mixture.  Add lamb pieces.

Random Ingredients: yellow onion,green food coloring,chicken breast,yeast,pepper,kosher salt black pepper,onion powder
title: Chicken-Onion Braid
ingredients: 1 cup yellow onion, chopped | 1/2 cup green food coloring | 1 teaspoon yeast | 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1/4 teaspoon pepper | 3/4 - 1 cup warm chicken breast, cut in 16 pieces ( about 3/4 pound ) | 1 -2 teaspoon instant yeast | 1 teaspoon onion powder
instructions: Place first 4 ingredients in a food processor, process until mixture comes together into a fairly uniform ball.  Place on a well floured surface and roll into a cylinder about 14 inches long, approximately 7 inches wide and about 1 1/2 inches diameter.  Place in a large, greased bowl.  Sprinkle with the instant yeast and onion powder and mix well to combine.  Cover with a towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 1 hour. .  Meanwhile preheat oven to 350°f.  Place 1 - 2 inches of water in a 3 qt shallow baking dish, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and place dough inside the baking dish.  Place the dough on a baking sheet and transfer to the oven.  Bake on center shelf in the oven until the center of the loaf registers 350°f on an instant reading thermometer, about 45 minutes, remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes.  Place on rack to cool.

title: Beer and Stout Blond
ingredients: 2 slices rye bread, toasted | 8 ounces light lager beer | 1 teaspoon dark rum | 1 teaspoon ground mace | 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
instructions: Preheat broiler.  Place rye bread in a small bowl.  Pour in beer, rum, mace, and stock.  Mix well.  Heat an iron griddle to 300 degrees f, or heat skillet to moderately hot.  Spoon mixture evenly into bread, and brown quickly.  Repeat to serve.

title: Roasted Roasted Sweet Apple & Marinated Apricot Preserves
ingredients: 1 jar apricot preserves | 1/2 cup diced red bell pepper | 1 jar diced jalapenos, drained | 1 tablespoon fresh basil leaf | 1/2 teaspoon ground mace | 1 medium apple, cored and cut into wedges
instructions: Line the bottom of a 8x8 inch glass baking dish with preserves.  Dollop apricot preserves onto the preserves & arrange peppers, limes & basil over them.  Cover with the remaining preserves & cover with aluminum foil.  Cook at 325 for 1 1/2 2 hrs or until tender.

Random Ingredients: fish stock,tabasco sauce,vanilla extract,turkey breast,mexican tomato,flour tortilla,yellow pepper
title: Quick and Easy Fish Tacos With Yellow Peppers
ingredients: 1/2 lb thinly sliced turkey breast | 2 teaspoons vanilla extract | 1 dash tabasco sauce | 1/4 cup fish stock | 2 flour tortillas ( for burritos ) | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes | 1/2 yellow pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Season the turkey and pepper with the vanilla extract and tabasco sauces, then saute over med heat for about 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Combine the fish stock and warm water in a large skillet and over med.  Heat slowly, bring to a boil.  When it begins to boil, pour about 1 1/4 cups of the hot broth over the turkey and pepper and combine.  Place the tortillas on a microwave safe plate and warm in the microwave for about 1 minute.  Spoon 1/3 of the turkey mixture onto each warm tortilla and top with the tomato and pepper.  Roll tightly.

title: Tofu Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza crust ( recommended -- boboli ) | 1/2 lb firm tofu | 1/2 cup mango chutney, to taste | 1/3 cup ketchup | 3/4 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced | hot sauce
instructions: Pre heat the oven to 425°f cut a thin, rectangular slab of cheese cloth and stretch the center out to the edges of a pizza pan.  Stretch the cheese cloth to cover the pizza bottom.  In a saucepot, cook the tofu on a lightly oiled hot pan.  Turn the tofu over and let it brown slightly on the edges.  Remove tofu with a slotted spoon and transfer it to a plate and let it cool for a minute while you make the sauce, in a small saucepan, combine the mango chutney, ketchup and mushrooms and simmer for 5 - 10 minutes.  Place the crust in the pizza pan and spread a thin layer of the sauce on the crust.  Sprinkle the tofu on top and spread the sauce on top.  Drizzle the tofu with any remaining sauce and top with remaining sauce.  You can decorate the pizza with additional sprinkles of mozzarella cheese if needed.  Bake for 10 minutes or until crust is crisp and golden.

title: African Ginger and Spice Mix
ingredients: 4 ounces fresh gingerroot, peeled and thinly sliced | 1/2 teaspoon ground vanilla essence
instructions: Place all the ingredients into a glass or ceramic container and stir well to combine.  Store in a cool dry place, in the fridge.

title: Basic Tandoori Fish Masala
ingredients: 1 teaspoon lemon juice | 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour | 1 1/2 cups vegetable broth, or as needed ( i used a mixture of half milk and half cream ) | 2 tablespoons fresh coriander powder, or to taste ( optional )
instructions: Whisk lemon juice and flour into warm vegetable broth.  Stir in the coriander, or to taste, before serving.  The recipe calls for lemon juice, but i've never actually had to.

title: Lettuce, Nuts and Vegetables
ingredients: 6 cups torn romaine lettuce | 6 cups mixed vegetables | 3 cups dry egg noodles ( i prefer multi-grain ) | 1 -2 tablespoon flour | 1 teaspoon cumin powder | 2 tablespoons dry sherry | 2 tablespoons pumpkin seeds
instructions: Fill 3/4 full of the lettuce and lay out flat on a platter.  Tear up the remaining lettuce and place on top of the lettuce.  Slice up the veggies, rinse eggs well and place in a large, shallow glass bowl.

Random Ingredients: chili powder,white rice,vegetable shortening,chunky tomato onion garlic sauce
title: Easy Mexican Rice
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice | 3/4 cup chunky tomato onion with garlic sauce | 1/2 cup vegetable shortening | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder
instructions: Place rice in large bowl of a rice cooker.  Add enough water to rice to cover the rice, about 1/2 inch above rice.  Cover, and bring rice to boil over high heat in a large non stick skillet.  Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes.  Remove cover, and stir tomato onion with garlic sauce into the rice.  Cook, covered, for an additional 10 minutes.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.

title: Red Lentil Salad With Peaches
ingredients: 1 can red lentils, drained | 2 -3 ounces canned sliced peaches, drained | 2 -3 tablespoons fish sauce
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.  Toss with remaining ingredients in serving dish.

title: Ginger Potatoes (Batatas)
ingredients: 3 large baking potatoes | 2 tablespoons ginger garlic paste | 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh italian parsley
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Place in a heavy pot and cover with water.  Bake at 400 degrees f for about one hour.  Remove from heat and stir potatoes.  Cover and let stand until tender.  In a small bowl, combine ginger garlic paste, parsley and about 1/2 tablespoon of the hot liquid.  Spoon into potatoes and stir.  Cover and let stand 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir and serve.

title: Cheese Stuffed Onions
ingredients: 14 medium swiss cheese | 12 coriander roots
instructions: Clean your coriander root.  Slice off part where the root was put.  If it has the root cut out of the coriander roots it just makes it easier to remove.  Take the outer coriander root and cut in a half to make sure you separate the root, but make sure you don't remove anything that would be on the top layer of the root.  Repeat the same process for the outer roots.  Cut the coriander roots in half, and make slits or diamonds to take around 1/4 of the outerRoot.  Take the entire amount of cheese and coriander roots and work them in with your hands until they get the size of a small egg.  Use a spoon to stuff all of the mixture in the hole.  Grate the cheese and mix with the coriander roots.  Place on a pan and cover with a towel until you are ready to serve this is not necessary at all.  You can also make your own steamed vegetables.  Let it cool and store in the refrigerator.  This freezes well for a few days and is excellent served as a side dish.

title: Moo Shu Vegetarian
ingredients: 3 cups mung bean sprouts | 4 cups bean sprouts | 3/4 cup marshmallows | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder
instructions: Wash and destem bean sprouts and set aside.  Heat the tumeric in a wok or large skillet.  Add the mixed sprouts and cook until it brown.  Add the bean sprouts and combine.  Serve with hot steamed jasmine rice.

Random Ingredients: italian salad dressing mix,soymilk,apricot,white wine vinegar
title: Low Fat Apricot Mayonnaise
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot, drained and chopped coarsely for consistency | 1 1/4 cups soymilk | 1/4 cup white wine vinegar | 5 teaspoons low-fat italian salad dressing mix
instructions: Place apricots and the remaining sauce ingredients in a blender and pulse till mixture is creamy and slightly chunky.  Add more vinegar, soymilk or fruit juice.  If desired pour into bowl that it is packed in marinade and refrigerate.

title: Pissaladiere (An American Marinated Beef and Noodle Shells)
ingredients: 5 large uncooked manicotti shells | 1 can mandarin oranges | 1 container plain sweet pickled onions
instructions: Place manicotti shells into a large glass jar, cover with plastic wrap, and shake well until manicotti shells are covered.  Remove and discard plastic from jar contents.  Cover the jar with plastic wrap and shake until manicotti shells are coated with plastic.  Drain oranges into a colander set in the sink so the liquid drains out a bit.  Combine oranges and beef in the jar with 1/4 cup of the orange liquid.

title: Kiwi Beef & Bacon Fondue
ingredients: 2 slices bacon | 1 lb stewing beef | 1/8 cup ice water | 1 kiwi fruit, peeled and diced | plain yogurt, to serve
instructions: Cook bacon in large frying pan over medium heat until crisp and remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Add stewing beef to bacon fat in pan.  Cook for 2 minutes, turning occasionally.  Add the ice cold water.  Bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes or until mixture has thickened slightly.  Add kiwifruit and kibut juice.  Transfer to a warmed serving dish and serve with plain yogurt.

title: Cabbage Kewpie
ingredients: 1 head napa cabbage ( about 1 1/2 pounds ) | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup, undiluted | 1 teaspoon chopped cumin seed ( optional )
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit.  Core cabbage, removing the seeds.  Cut cabbage into slices 1/4 inch thick.  Transfer cabbage into casserole dish sprayed with non stick cooking spray.  In medium bowl, combine soup and cumin and spread over cabbage.  Bake uncovered for about 1 hour or until cabbage is tender.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Faux French Fries
ingredients: 1 tablespoon salt | salt & freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Mix all ingredients in medium heavy cast iron frying pan.  Cook over high heat till oil begins to sizzle.  Watch carefully when the edges are golden brown, about 2 - 3 minutes.  Carefully invert onto plate, cut in wedges and serve while still warm.

title: Beef and Cashew Casserole (Omurice Yarxa
ingredients: 1 beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1 lb fresh pineapple chunk | 2 tablespoons nam pla ( fish sauce ) | 2 ounces cashews, finely chopped | bread, to serve ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325°f.  Place the meat in a large, shallow ovenproof dish.  Add the pineapple chunks and nam pla, and mix.  Cover with a thin layer of water and pour over the meat.  Cover tightly and bake for 2 - 2 1/2 hours, until the meat is very tender.  Transfer the meat to a plate and keep warm.  Add the cashews to the pan juices, and cook over low heat, stirring, for 1 minute without letting them burn.  Stir the cashew mixture into the meat juices and heat, stirring, for 1 minute.  Serve hot with bread.

title: Creamy Balsamic Watermelon Soup
ingredients: 2 cups vegetable stock | 2 cups cubed watermelon | 1/2 teaspoon balsamic vinegar
instructions: Place stock and watermelon in a blender or food processor.

title: Canadian Bacon Spread
ingredients: 1/2 lb canadian bacon, cut into 1/4-inch slices | 1 1/2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: In medium bowl, gently toss canadian bacon with vinegar.  Sprinkle with marjoram.  Chill at least one hour before serving.

Random Ingredients: baking soda,bouillon cube,dashi,apple cider,pork loin,spinach leaf,cocoa
title: Sinful Spinach Cake(SMS)!
ingredients: 2 lbs pork loin ( or you can use your favourite pork ) | 6 ounces frozen chopped spinach leaves, thawed | 4 ounces instant dashi | 1/2 ounce baking soda | 1 cup apple cider | 1 bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon cocoa
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Slice the pork into 1/4 inch slices and place in bowl with 1 tbls.  Chopped spinach.  Add the 2 tbls.  Bouillon cube.  Blend well.  Pour into a 9 x 13 inch baking pan and bake for 15 minutes.  Stir every so often so they cook evenly.  Remove from oven and stir in the cocoa, then spread evenly over the pork slices.  Return to the oven for 25 minutes, then let rest for 5 minutes before serving.  Note, i do not recommend baking for pork loin, or other cuts of meat, and recommend leaving out the bouillon cube in the mixture.  Also, if you are using apples, remove the peel and cores from the apples, and you can chop them and slice them, but it will not be necessary.  You can also use an electric grinder that has been ground to very slightly browning and flavor the mixture rather than the blade.

title: Eggplant with Pepper Cracker
ingredients: 2 beef tenderloin, filet and tied | 1 eggplant | 1 cup sliced fresh snow pea | 1/2 cup cracker crumb
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place beef tenderloins on wire rack in roasting pan and prick all over with fork.  Insert toothpicks into meat with a serrated knife.  Arrange eggplant on rack and poke with fork.  Roast in preheated oven 30 to 45 minutes, or until thermometer reads 160 degrees f.  Cool and cut into thin slices.  Remove toothpicks.  Place meat on plate.  Cut in 1/2 inch slices using a serrated knife.  Top with snow peas.  Mound cracker crumbs on beef slices.  Top with crumb mixture.

Random Ingredients: colby cheese,cubanelle pepper,white sugar,turkey bacon,bouillon cube,ham,pistachio nut,sesame oil
title: Pistachio Chicken Burgers
ingredients: 1/2 lb lean ground turkey bacon | 1/2 cup dry roasted pistachio nut, chopped ( about 2 ounces ) | 3/4 cup shredded colby cheese | 1 1/2 tablespoons white sugar | 1 large bouillon cube ( made with 1 teaspoon instant bouillon ) | 2 tablespoons sesame oil | 2 cubanelle peppers, seeded and chopped | 8 slices fully cooked ham
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high and lightly oil the grate.  In a medium skillet over medium heat, cook the turkey bacon until crisp and evenly browned, about 5 minutes.  Drain, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings, crumble, and set aside.  In a medium bowl, mix together the pistachios, cheese, sugar, bouillon cube, and sesame oil.  Add the reserved turkey bacon drippings and the cubanelle peppers to the skillet and saute just until beginning to soften, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat and add ham to the skillet.  Divide the pate into 8 portions and shape into patties.  Grill burgers to desired doneness, about 3 minutes per side, and serve hot.

Random Ingredients: kielbasa,cooking spray,chicken wing,romaine lettuce,broccoli floret,chinese egg noodle,cardamom,clove
title: Kielbasa Soup with Noodles, Broccoli, and Kielbasa
ingredients: cooking spray | 6 pounds chicken wings, tips sliced crosswise | 3 packages kielbasa, halved lengthwise and sliced crosswise 1/2 inch thick | 1 bunch romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried and coarsely chopped | 6 rinsed, dried, and coarsely chopped rinsed, dried, and coarsely chopped romaine lettuce | 1 cup chinese egg noodles | 1 teaspoon ground cloves | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom ( or 1/2 if you don't mind a lot of cardamom ) | 2 cups lightly packed grated kielbasa
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  Coat 2 jelly roll pans with cooking spray and arrange them on the bottom and up the sides.  Layer the chicken wings in one layer between the pans, starting with a layer of noodles as before, and finishing with a layer of noodles.  Spray the kielbasa slices with cooking spray and place them on top of the noodles.  Sprinkle the lettuce evenly over the kielbasa.  Sprinkle the noodles evenly as before with the clines, cardamom, and kielbasa pieces on top of the lettuce.  Pour the boiling hot soup over the top and add the kielbasa slices on top.  Cover the pans with foil and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.

title: Tamari and Tomato Appetizer
ingredients: 1 box quick-cooking oats | 1 can stewed tomatoes or 3/4 cup tomatoes, drained | 8 tamari
instructions: Mix all ingredients and store in a covered container.  To prepare tamari scones, use quick cooking oats as a dry rub, as tamari can vary.  The texture of the tamari is not a wet texture.  Cook in water bath, or in microwave, about 1 to 2 minutes, stirring to combine.  Pour into a paper bag, and refrigerate until ready to use.

title: Walnut Feta Spread (Kathmandu)
ingredients: 1/2 lb walnut, finely ground ( about 4 walnut sized balls ) | 2 -3 teaspoons fresh oregano leaves | 1/4 cup walnut pieces
instructions: Place ground walnuts in a food processor or mortar and pestle and process to finely ground.  Using the pestle and a spoon, add the oregano leaves and process until finely ground and moistened.  Add walnut pieces just before serving.

Random Ingredients: confectioner ' sugar,asian fish sauce,pepper,red chilies,olive oil cooking spray,rice,vanilla
title: Holy Basil Fried Rice
ingredients: olive oil flavored cooking spray | 1 cup raw converted rice, rinsed well ( not quick cooking, see note ) | 2 large red chilies, halved lengthways, seeded | 1 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 cup roasted red chilies, shredded ( about 3 tablespoons ) | 1/3 cup fresh sweet peppers or 1/3 cup jalapenos, chopped ( about 1/3 ) | 1/4 cup light-colored asian fish sauce | 1 -2 teaspoon minced fresh sweet pepper | 1 pinch vanilla or 1 -2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Note, cook 1 cup rice according to package directions.  If using quick cooking.

title: El Charro's Jalapeno Beer
ingredients: 10 1/2 fluid ounces jalapeno peppers, or more to taste, cut in half and seeded | 5 fluid ounces light beer | lemon wedge, for garnish
instructions: Pour jalapeno peppers, beer and lemon wedges into a large glass pitcher, or serve immediately.

title: Cod Baked With Citrus Preserved Lemons (Paleo)
ingredients: 1 cup finely diced orange zest | 1/2 cup finely diced lemonade | 1/2 teaspoon grated fresh mace ( optional, to taste ) | 1 lb fish fillet, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks ( such as cod or pike ) | 1 3/4 - 2 cups halved radishes or 1 3/4-1 cups scallions, sliced halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  In a glass baking dish, stir the orange zest, lemonade and mace together.  Add the fish pieces and turn until they are coated with the marinade.  Add the radishes and stir together.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.  Serve with crusty bread.

title: Crazy French Bread
ingredients: 8 loaves white bread | 8 tablespoons tortilla flavored tortilla dip
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees f.  Slice bread in half lengthwise.  Cut a slit into 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch deep, going one end through the cut at each end, almost all around to one side.  Stuff bread with mix of dip and warm tortilla.  Bake at 400 for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly.

title: Cherry Pepper (Cantaloupe)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs small baby cherries ( about 2 cups ) | 1 cup tequila, chilled | shichimi pepper, stemmed, seeded, and cut into strips
instructions: If using a nonreactive tequila, make sure it is glass.  Cover the rim of a cocktail mixer.  Halve the cherry pieces.  In a large mixing bowl, combine cherries and their juice, tequila, and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.  Run cherry skewers through skewers.  Garnish with strips of pepper before serving.

Random Ingredients: dark rum,coriander,oregano,chuck,red currant jelly,pine nut,chive,worcestershire sauce
title: Rum-Spiced Burgers
ingredients: 500 g ground chuck | 1 pinch oregano | 1 pinch chives | 1 pinch fresh ground coriander | 1 pinch worcestershire sauce | 200 ml dark rum | pine nuts ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly
instructions: Preheat the grill or bbq to medium high.  Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mix well, form into burgers and grill.

title: Guacamole Potato Casserole
ingredients: 5 medium red potatoes, sliced | 4 ripe avocados | 1 can refried beans | 1 cup double cream
instructions: Layer potato slices in a large baking dish in the following order, refried beans, avocado, cream and lastly refried beans.  Gently mix together and lightly grease a shallow oven or casserole dish.  Top with remaining potatoes, bake at 180c for 25 minutes until golden.

title: Lemon Herbed Onion Rings (Tapas)
ingredients: 1 spanish onions or 1 yellow onion, sliced | 2 lemons | 2 limes, cut into wedges | 2 green onions, chopped
instructions: Heat large skillet over medium high heat.  Add white onion and 1 lemon peel and cook, stirring often, 1 minute.  Add sliced zest from lemon.  Cook until zest turns white, about 30 seconds.  Add 2 more lemons and 2 limes and cook until zest crisps, about 1 or 2 minutes, then remove from heat.  Transfer to serving bowl or crock.  Cut remaining onion crosswise into rings.

title: Beef, Banana, and Asparagus Wraps
ingredients: 2 lbs chuck, diced to 1/2-inch cubes | 2 -3 beef bouillon cubes | 1 lb asparagus spear | 2 slices bananas, peeled and sliced in half | 1/2 cup sultana | 1 lb vermicelli
instructions: Brown beef with bouillon cubes.  When halfway through browning add sultanas and bananas in simmering broth.  Meanwhile boil pasta according to package directions and drain.  Stir pasta into beef, bananas and broth in pot and simmer 5 - 10 minutes to thicken the broth.  Serve with rice or vegetables of your choice.

Random Ingredients: cream chicken soup,strawberry gelatin,vegetable oil,yellow bell pepper
title: Elegant Strawberry Jell-O
ingredients: 1 package strawberry gelatin | 3 yellow bell peppers, seeded and chopped | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup | 5 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Sprinkle 2 tablespoons gelatin over boiling water in 1 quart pan.  Let stand 1 minute then stir until completely dissolved.  Stir in bell peppers.  Pour into a greased and floured 8x8 inch pan.  Cover and chill in refrigerator until firm, about 3 hours.  Break up remaining pieces of the jello.  Remove from heat and stir in soup.

title: Strawberry and Prosciutto Lamb Burgers With Prosciutto
ingredients: 2 lbs lean ground lamb | 4 slices prosciutto or 4 slices pancetta, thinly sliced and slightly flattened | 4 ripe whole strawberries, hulled | 1/3 cup freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: In a large bowl combine lamb, prosciutto, strawberries, and cheese, and season with salt and pepper and mix well.  Wet hands, form mixture into four burgers, and form each into a well.  Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to infuse.  Heat a grill pan over medium high heat and grill each burger, about 3 minutes on each side for medium rare, about 8 minutes on each side for well done and no longer pink.  Serve burgers warm, either on toasted pita bread or hoagie rolls.

title: Goat Cheese and Chiles - Green Chile Peppers & Poblanos Filling
ingredients: 2 green poblano chiles | 4 fresh poblano chiles | 4 ounces soft fresh goat cheese, cut into slices | 2 tablespoons finely chopped and roasted poblano peppers
instructions: Roast green chilies over a gas flame or under broiler until the skins blister lightly, turning with tongs, until charred all over, 10 to 12 minutes.  Remove chilies from the oven and place in a bowl of warm water to cool.  When cool enough to handle, carefully remove the burned skin but do not make the skin bitter.  Rinse chilies under cold water to clean.  Set aside in the bowl of cold water to cool.  Place 1/4 cup of the green chilies at one end of each pepper half and slice off the stem ends with scissors.  Cut 1 green poblano chile in half and then in half again lengthwise along its length.  Cut the stem ends into 1/2 inch strips, then crosswise into 3 thin strips.  Heat the broiler.  Place the cheese slices and 2 tablespoons of the roasted poblano peppers in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle chilies with pepper and remaining goat cheese slices.  Broil in the preheated broiler until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 4 minutes.

Random Ingredients: self raising flour,sesame oil,pecorino romano cheese,chili flake,radish
title: Radish Fritters (Crisp Fritters)
ingredients: 1 cup red fresno chili flakes | 125 g self-raising flour | 2 -3 grated carrots or 1 medium grated zucchini | 2 -3 radishes, sliced thinly ( optional ) | 1/2 cup grated pecorino romano cheese ( or any other dry cheese of your choice )
instructions: Combine all the dry ingredients in a medium bowl and mix to a soft dropping consistency.  Knead lightly until the mixture will be smooth.  Place the mixture on a slightly floured surface and roll out to about 1/2cm thick.  Cut into strips about 12 cm long and 8cm wide.  Heat a large frying pan on a medium heat.  Place 2 or 3 strips of fritter in the pan and cook over a low medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side or until light golden.  Remove the fritters from the pan and serve either hot or cold.

title: Queso Blanco  (Cheese and Red Sauce)
ingredients:
2 lbs cheese ( mexican or mexican blends ) | 2 cans red enchilada sauce ( i prefer mild.
    - i like my cheese slightly tart )
instructions: Heat a large saucepan over medium high heat.  Cut cheese into small cubes and drop into pan.  Keep doing this until all the cheese has been used.  Add the enchilada sauce in small pieces until the saucepan is covered.  When the cheese is covered with sauce, put on a lid and lower heat to simmer for 10 minutes.  Serve with tortilla chips or warm flour tortillas.

title: Homemade Basil Bacon Chips
ingredients: 2 cups cheese, shredded | 2 tablespoons bacon drippings | 2 teaspoons dried basil leaves | 1 -2 tablespoon cointreau liqueur, to taste
instructions: Fry bacon in skillet along with bacon drippings until crispy but not burnt.  Mix cheese, basil, and cointreau till smooth.  Add bacon to chips in a small bowl and serve.

title: The Secret to a Trinidad Delight
ingredients: 3 cups coconut cream | 1/8 teaspoon ground red chili pepper | 3 tablespoons tea, base ( i prefer the rinaldi )
instructions: Boil coconut cream in a heavy bottomed pan.  When boiling, stir frequently so the base does not burn.  When the cream starts leaving the sides of the pan, add a tbs of hot tea base and stir.  When it is absorbed again, remove from heat.  Pour into the bowl of a tea cup.  Sprinkle with red chili pepper and serve.

title: Welsh Mushroom Toast
ingredients: 1 white bread | 1/2 lb sliced mushrooms
instructions: Preheat grill to high, setting tray to the lowest heat level.  Open bread and cut into 3 equal parts.  Toast the bread well and spread each half with butter.  Place on grill.  Grill the mushrooms, turning, until brown on all sides.  Watch carefully to ensure they don't burn.

title: Gingerbread Balls
ingredients: 2/3 cup softened butter ( not tub-style ) | 1 1/2 cups fresh white breadcrumbs, crumbs | 3 teaspoons unflavored gelatin
instructions: Soften the gelatin in 2 tb water in a small pan over medium heat.  Let cool then stir in the 2/3 cup of softened butter.  Add the bread crumbs and the jelly to the crumbs.  Dissolve the gelatin in 2 tb water and roll into 1 balls then place in freezer for 3 to 4 hours.  After the 3 hours, remove the balls to a plate and chill in the freezer until firm.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: sesame oil,black mustard seed,picante sauce,scallion,chicken wing,sea salt,half cream
title: Chicken Wings Bretonnaya
ingredients: 1 lb chicken wings, tips discarded ( use a whole chicken as you don't want a spoiled baby ) | sea salt, to taste ( i use gray salt ) | 4 teaspoons black mustard seeds | 2 tablespoons scallions, finely minced ( spring onions can be substituted, white and green parts can also be sub ) | 2 tablespoons picante sauce ( or more, to taste ) | 1/2 cup half-and-half cream | 1 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Prick the skin of the chicken wings with a sharp knife several times and salt liberally.  Place in a large, heavy bottomed baking dish.  In a small skillet over medium high heat, toast the mustard seeds until fragrant, about 1 - 2 minutes.  Do not let them burn.  Remove from heat and set aside.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and add the scallions.

Random Ingredients: pinto bean,oyster sauce,onion soup mix,key lime juice,cream mushroom soup,red curry paste,cherry,linguine
title: Sweet Curry Pasta
ingredients: 1 package linguine, or more to taste | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 can pinto beans | 2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1/3 cup chopped onion | 1/4 cup chopped fresh key lime juice | 1 tablespoon oyster sauce | 1 tablespoon red curry paste | 2/3 cup chopped fresh cherries, for garnish ( optional )
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the linguine, and return to a boil.  Cook the pasta uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the pasta has cooked through, but is still firm to the bite, about 11 minutes.  Drain well in a colander set in the sink.  Meanwhile, spoon cream of mushroom soup into a large serving bowl, and mix with pinto beans, 2 tablespoons red curry paste, onion, lime juice, oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon red curry paste, and cherries.

title: Salsa Omelets
ingredients: 20 egg roll wraps | 2 -3 cups baby carrots | 1 jar salsa | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom ( optional )
instructions: Cook carrots with about 1/2 cup water for 15 min or until just softened.  Drain well and set aside.  Place egg roll wrappers on a board sprinkled with a little salt or flour, and brush with a little melted butter or oil of choice.  Spread on a thin layer of salsa and add carrot mixture.  Fold and seal sealing the ends with a fork.  Repeat until all ingredients have been used.  Fry in oil until golden brown, turning once before it crisps up.

title: Fritters
ingredients: 2 cups cornflour | 2 cups white flour | 1 cup cornflour | 2 1/2 - 3 small dried hot green chili peppers, seeded and chopped | hot cooked tortillas
instructions: Mix the flour and dry ingredients together in a bowl to make a batter.  Dip the tortilla into the batter and fry in oil.  Serve with your favourite sauces.

Random Ingredients: coconut milk,vegetable broth,cooking sherry,heavy whipping cream,rosemary leaf
title: Easy Rosemary Coconut Soup
ingredients: 32 fluid ounces coconut milk | 12 fluid ounces double-strength vegetable broth, such as swanson | 2 tablespoons quick-cooking sherry | 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary leaves | 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
instructions: Pour coconut milk and vegetable broth into a large saucepan and bring to a boil.  Stir in sherry and rosemary leaves.  Return to a boil, reduce temperature, and simmer for about 15 minutes to thicken.  Whisk in heavy cream and heat through.

title: Walded Calamari and Calamari in Thick Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 pound squid, cleaned under running water | 1/4 cup plain yogurt | 1 1/2 cups superfine sugar
instructions: Place the squid in a small bowl.  Drizzle 1 teaspoon of olive oil over it, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.  Slightly wet a plate.  Drain squid, reserving as much water that can be left in bowl.  Use a small knife to score the tentacles at the head and tentacles.  Slide the squid onto the plate.  Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with superfine sugar.  Repeat with remaining squid and sugar, coating squid once more.  Refrigerate for up to 6 hours before serving.

title: Chinese Sausage With Saffron ( Satsas beni Hsiang Manis )
ingredients: 12 links chinese sausages, sliced thick on a diagonal
instructions: Marinate the sausages in salt for 2 days.  Grill the sausages and serve hot.

title: Hot German Wine Vinegar
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups apple cider vinegar | 3 tablespoons red wine, any sweet variety | 3 tablespoons vinegar, any variety
instructions: In a 3 - 4 quart enameled cast iron skillet, combine the vinegar, wine and vinegar.  Bring just to a boil, reduce the heat, simmer slowly for about 20 minutes, stirring often.  Pour into bottles, seal and place in cool dark place.  Discard the remaining liquid, cool to room temperature and store in the refrigerator.

title: Lemongrass Pasta
ingredients: 2 medium russet potatoes, peeled | 1 fresh lemongrass | 1 cup frozen peas | 1 garlic clove, minced | 16 ounces farfalle pasta, uncooked
instructions: Scrub potatoes and cut them lengthwise into 1/4 sections.  Trim lemongrass and cut off ends.  Wash lemongrass very well in cold water.  Slice lemongrass into 1/8 inch pieces and squeeze out any excess water.  In large pot, lightly salt farfalle and boil in salted water until soft.  Drain pasta and cool under cold running water.  Place lemongrass and peas into a bowl and mash with your hands.  To serve spoon about a third of pasta onto serving platter, sprinkle with crushed garlic and add fresh lemon grass and serve.

Random Ingredients: apricot jam,red currant jelly,sherry,white sugar,chinese five spice powder
title: Apricot Bites
ingredients: 1/2 cup apricot jam | 1/2 cup red currant jelly | 1/4 cup white sugar | 1 teaspoon chinese five-spice powder | 2 teaspoons sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  In a medium bowl, mix jam, currant jelly, sugar, five spice powder, and sherry together in a small microwave safe bowl until sugar dissolves.  Spoon jam mixture into a pastry bag.  Insert a toothpick through the middle of each apricot shell to hold the filling.  Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to 1/4 inch thickness.

title: Chinese Spring Rolls
ingredients: 1/4 cup dark sesame oil | 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 1 head finely shredded lettuce
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in flour and slowly stir in the shredded lettuce.  Cook until lettuce is warmed through and slightly crisped, about 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: cannellini bean,orange juice,soya sauce,chili paste,cocoa powder,canola oil,chicken wing,malt vinegar
title: Cocoa Glazed Chicken Wings
ingredients: 4 teaspoons cocoa powder, heaping | 4 tablespoons orange juice | 4 teaspoons low sodium soya sauce | 1 teaspoon malt vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon chili paste | 2 tablespoons canola oil | 2 1/2 lbs chicken wings, defrosted if frozen
instructions: Preheat the oven to 475 deg f.  Combine the cocoa powder, orange juice, soya sauce, malt vinegar, chili paste and oil in the bowl of a stand mixer or a food processor and mix until smooth.  Spoon the mixture onto a large sheet of foil and spread it all over the foil so it’s slightly raised.  Bake the wings in the oven for 40 minutes or until they are cooked through in the center.  When the chicken is done, remove from the oven and transfer to a warmed oven dish.  Drizzle the glaze over the chicken and serve.  Note, to reheat, place a baking dish on a lower rack and set the baking dish upside down over a larger baking sheet.  Place the baking sheet in the over and bake at 475 deg f for 20 minutes or until the glaze is glazed.

Random Ingredients: zucchini,chicken breast,tomatillo salsa,chile pequins,chicken leg,chihuahua cheese,mozzarella cheese
title: Grilled Mexican Zucchini Chicken
ingredients: 4 skinless chicken breasts, bone-in | 1 1/2 zucchini | 6 tomatillos salsa | 8 ounces tomatillo salsa | 12 chihuahua cheese, grated | 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 cup chopped fresh chile pepperquins
instructions: Preheat grill to high heat.  Place chicken breast and 2 1/2 tablespoons salsa on a baking sheet and grill for 5 - 9 minutes or until meat is just cooked through.  Remove from heat and allow to rest for 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, cut zucchini in half.  Remove and discard the pit from tomatillos.  Slice open the ends and scoop out the center of the zucchini halves.  Cut the halves lengthwise into slivers, then cut these slivers into wedges.  Place zucchini in a bowl and add remaining salsa and remaining 2 tablespoons salsa and season with salt and pepper.  Place the chihuahua cheese, mozzarella cheese, chile peppers, and remaining 2 tablespoons salsa in a bowl.  Toss with the cooked chicken breast and serve warm.

title: Rhubarb & Green Chile Gazpacho
ingredients: 14 ounces tomato sauce | 1 green chile | 2 serrano chili, stemmed | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | 2 tablespoons watermelon, diced | 1 1/2 cups rhubarb, sliced thin | 1 1/4 cups champagne, chilled
instructions: Put all ingredients in crock pot on high for 1 hour, stir.  Serve over ice.

Random Ingredients: mushroom,shortening,ginger powder,orange juice zest,lettuce leaf,triple sec
title: Ginger Mushroom Rolls
ingredients: 36 medium mushrooms, such as oyster, shiitake or shiitake, stemmed | 1 tablespoon shortening or 1 tablespoon butter | 1/2 cup triple sec | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice or 1 tablespoon orange zest | 1 teaspoon ginger powder | lettuce leaf
instructions: Clean mushroom under running water and remove dirt and sand.  Place stems, stems, and all, into a bowl.  Rinse and pat dry mushrooms.  Melt shortening over low heat in a 12 inch heavy skillet that has a tight fitting lid.  Add mushrooms, in batches, and saute until lightly browned, about 3 minutes per batch.  Transfer skillet to a platter.  In same skillet, add triple sec, orange juice, and ginger.  Stir until blended and hot.  Drizzle over mushrooms mixture in skillet.

title: Mustard Powder
ingredients: 1 scotch bonnet peppers, cleaned | 1 cup olive oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1 cup unsweetened chocolate
instructions: Using a paring knife or pestle, grind the scotch bonnet pepper in the olive oil and mustard seeds to a fine powder. title: Spinach with Peas
ingredients: 6 cups fresh spinach | 1 1/2 cups frozen peas, thawed
instructions: Cook spinach in large pot of boiling salted water until tender, 12 to 15 minutes.  Drain well.  Chop coarsely.  Transfer spinach, peas and 3 cups to large bowl.  Toss with hot cooked greens until heated through, 3 to 4 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Champagne Fruit Compote
ingredients: 1 large red rose grapes | 2 cups broth | 1/2 teaspoon sugar ( if using splenda ) ( optional )
instructions: Wash grapes and stems.  Wash and remove seeds if using grapes, discard stems if using splenda or use splenda for extra flavor.

title: Grilled Hawaiian-Style Sandwiches
ingredients: 1/2 loaf fresh bread, sliced | 1/4 cup hoagie roll frosting with garlic and herbs | 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice
instructions: Spread hoagie roll frosting onto bread slices, then sprinkle with allspice.  Place bread slices on grill or under broiler.  Grill for about 4 minutes or according to your preference.

title: Lamb in Cream (Kurczakotel)
ingredients: 2 lbs lean lamb, cut into pieces | 1 teaspoon anise seed, crushed | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped and seeded | 1 cup whipping cream
instructions: Put lamb pieces in a saucepan and cover with cold water.  Bring to a boil, then simmer for 30 minutes per pound, skimming frequently to prevent burning.  Skim foam and add crushed anise seed.  Add yellow pepper and cream.  Heat to boiling, then reduce heat, cover and cook for 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: mustard powder,button mushroom,white wine,parsley,rosemary,cream chicken soup,spinach leaf,red potato
title: Italian Potato and Spinach Soup
ingredients: 6 large red potatoes ( i like to use yukon gold, about 2 pounds ) | 8 ounces button mushrooms or 8 ounces white button mushrooms | 2/3 cup chopped fresh spinach leaves | 1 can condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted | 2 cups white wine ( i like merlot ) | 1 teaspoon dried rosemary | 1 teaspoon mustard powder | 1 teaspoon dried parsley
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into wedges.  In a large saucepan, cook potatoes in boiling water for about 15 minutes, or until just tender.  Drain, rinse and set aside.  In a large saucepan, saute mushrooms and spinach in olive oil, over medium heat and stirring, until tender.  Add soup, wine, rosemary, mustard and parsley.

title: Lobster Pie
ingredients: 1 pound cooked lobster, chopped | 1 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 2 tablespoons white corn, drained | 36 round graham crackers for topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f.  In a large bowl, mix the lobster with graham cracker crumbs, corn, and lobster mixture until thoroughly mixed.  Place half the graham cracker crumbs in the bottom of a 9 inch pie dish.  Layer half the lobster mixture over the graham cracker crumbs, then top with remaining graham cracker crumbs.  Bake for about 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until bubbly and the crust is browned.  Let cool before cutting.

title: Pancakes - Spicy Baked Macaroni & Apple
ingredients: 1 lb lean ground turkey or 1 lb ground pork | 1 lb granny smith apple, shredded | 6 ounces macaroni cheese, dry, about 2 cups | 2 tablespoons dark sesame oil | 1 teaspoon ground coriander powder | 1/4 cup sweet baking chocolate
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°f lightly butter 4 - 6 oz.  Casseroles or non stick muffin pans.  Set aside,.  Wash and dry your hands.  Place your meats and apple in a large bowl.  Mix thoroughly.  Add your macaroni and mix until well mixed.  Add the sesame oil, coriander and cocoa powder.  Knead the mixture until your dough comes together.  Divide dough into four pieces.  With hands form each piece into a 6 inch round with 2 long ends.  Flatten the flat edges and cut a small slit.  Bake 25 minutes.  Remove from heat and bake 5 more minutes and remove.  Let cool.  Remove all rinds.  Cut each rasher into 2 - 3 inch pieces.  In a mini muffin tin, spoon an equal portion of the meat mixture on the bottom, then top with a little of the cheese mixture. Cut into 24 squares.

Random Ingredients: saffron thread,grain rice,dark brown sugar,almond essence,cream mushroom soup,nonstick cooking spray
title: Spanish Rice
ingredients: nonstick cooking spray | 1/2 cup raw rice | 2 teaspoons saffron threads, crushed | 1 can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar, firmly packed ( packed ) | 2 teaspoons almond essence
instructions: Spray a 1 1/2 quart casserole with cooking spray.  Microwave rice, uncovered, on high 3 minutes, stirring once or twice, or until rice is tender or.  Add saffron, cream of mushroom soup, sugar, almond essence and stir.  Microwave on high 2 minutes, tossing once.  Add fluff and stir.  Spray casserole.  Microwave on high 25 seconds or until hot through, stirring once or twice.  Note, if desired, serve over browned or flaked chicken or turkey.

title: Fig and Garlic Herb Loaf
ingredients: 1/3 cup crouton for snacking bread crumbs | 1 teaspoon dried savory or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme | 2 cloves garlic and herb seasoning | fig, 1/4 1/4 inch squares
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f line a 9x5x3 inch loaf pan with aluminum foil.  In a small bowl, combine the crouton, savory, and garlic herb seasoning.  Dip each piece of soaked bread in crouton mixture, letting excess drip off.  Arrange about 5 pieces of soaked bread on the foil lined pan.  Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden brown and crisp.

title: Lila's Traditional Paella
ingredients: 3 -4 lbs chicken drumsticks | 2 lbs fresh whole-leaf fresh parsley, tied with cotton string | 4 pounds bone-in chicken drumsticks | 4 teaspoons saffron | 18 toothpicks
instructions: Lay the drumsticks on a cutting board.  Using your fingers, lightly mash the chicken and parsley and place into a large bowl.  Trim the stems and tear off any strings or loose pieces of parsley and place both into the bowl.  Gently mix in the saffron.  Heat a wide frying pan or griddle over medium low heat.  Place 4 pieces of chicken onto the pan and sprinkle with salt.  Turn after about 2 minutes and continue cooking until the meat is no longer pink in the middle and the juices run clear.  Remove the chicken pieces to a plate.  Turn the heat back up to medium high and place a toothpick in the center of each piece of meat.  Cook for about 5 to 7 minutes until the chicken is browned on both sides.  Serve immediately and let each diner open their own surprise jar, removing the toothpick before eating.  Note, if you are unable to manage to find saffron, use a mortar and pestle.

Random Ingredients: green curry paste,garlic clove,poppy seed,coffee powder
title: Green Curry Powder
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( available at most indian grocery stores, or make your own on the internet! ) or 2 tablespoons green curry paste ( available at most indian grocery stores, or make your own on the internet! ) | 1 1/2 tablespoons instant coffee powder ( available at most indian grocery stores, or make your own on the internet! ) | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder ( available at most indian grocery stores ) | 1/4 teaspoon poppy seed
instructions: In a small bowl mix together the green curry paste, coffee powder, garlic powder and poppy seeds until blended.

Random Ingredients: urad dal,semolina,bay leaf,bread flour,summer squash,butter lettuce

ingredients: 1 1/4 cups semolina | 2 tablespoons bread flour | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh summer squash | 1 teaspoon dried active dry yeast | 2 cups unseasoned bread flour | 1 bay leaf | 2 sprigs butter lettuce
instructions: Place the semolina in a bowl, stir it in the 2 tablespoons of flour, and let rest at room temperature for 15 to 20 minutes.  Warm the cooking pot over low heat.  Add a spoonful of water to the inside of a measuring cup until the pot reaches the bottom of the cup.  When the water reaches the rim of the cup, stir in a handful of the yellow squash and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.  Mix in the yeast, and let sit until just past the creamy, but not mushy stage, about 5 minutes.  Mix in the remaining ¾ cup of flour.  Sprinkle the inside of the pot with more flour to help keep it from sticking.  Carefully pour in 1 cup of water, and stir to mix.

title: Spicy Cheese Tacos
ingredients: 4 large corn tortillas | 1/2 tablespoon sea salt | 2 tablespoons green chili peppers, diced
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium high heat.  Lightly coat the tortillas with cooking spray or spreadable coating.  Add 1/2 tablespoon of the sea salt to the pan and swirl to coat the entire tortilla.  When the tortillas become slightly golden underneath and slightly blackened in spots, flip over on the other side.  Spray the exposed side of each taco with cooking spray and place in preheated skillet.  Cook the taco until the tortilla is golden brown and heated through, about 10 seconds.  Remove the taco from heat.  Slice and top with chilies if desired, serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: graham cracker crumb,oregano leaf,lebanese cucumber,water chestnut
title: Cheating Gator Cucumber
ingredients: 2 large lebanese cucumbers or 2 large regular cucumbers, cut crosswise into 8 slices | 12 ounces water chestnuts, thinly sliced ( about 5 1/2 cups ) | 1/2 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1/2 cup fresh oregano leaves
instructions: Combine cucumbers, water chestnuts, crumbs and oregano in medium bowl, breaking up clumps.  Spoon evenly into ungreased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Bake at 400°f for 25 minutes, or until mixture is firm.  Cut into squares and serve warm.  Serves.

title: Budae (Japanese Cheese Dip)
ingredients: 2 cups dashi | 1 1/2 cups cheese, grated ( kelp, kelp, mani )
instructions: In a large pot combine dashi, cheese, and about 1/2 cup of water.  Bring to a simmer over low heat and continue to simmer until cheese is melted and dashi/cheese sauce has slightly reduced.  Serve warm topped with a sprinkling of sesame seeds.

Random Ingredients: flat leaf italian parsley,green onion,cumin powder,green chili pepper
title: Homemade Green Chili
ingredients: 3/4 cup green chili pepper | 1/4 cup whole green onion ( white parts only ) | 2 -3 tablespoons cumin powder ( depending on how spicy you want it ) | 2 tablespoons flat-leaf italian parsley
instructions: Finely chop ingredients, reserve 1/4 cup green chilis for the garnish.  Place remaining green and green chillies in a tea ball or small frying pan, crush finely.  Stir to mix, add the ground cumin and garnish with green onion.  Garnish with extra chopped parsley and serve. .

title: Lentil and Noodle Nests
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs green cabbage, finely shredded | 1/2 cup lentils | 1/4 cup fine egg noodles, crumbled
instructions: In a medium size mixing bowl, combine all the ingredients.  Stir until well combined.  Let stand 15 to 30 minutes.  Spoon into parchment lined muffin tins.  Or muffin or paper lined muffin pan.  Serve with fresh chopped dill or chives if desired.

title: Homemade Coffee
ingredients: 3 tablespoons butter | 1 tablespoon instant coffee | 1/2 cup hazelnuts, lightly toasted and finely chopped
instructions: In a mug stir together butter and instant coffee.  Stir in hazelnuts.

Random Ingredients: radish,bacon dripping,cumin seed,black peppercorn,dark soy sauce
title: Grilled Radish, Crab, and Soy Mustard for Two
ingredients: 2 large radishes, coarsely chopped | 1 tablespoon ground cumin seed | 4 cups coarsely chopped smoked bacon drippings ( from above ) | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon whole black peppercorn
instructions: Place radishes in a large mixing bowl.  Sprinkle with cumin.  Add remaining ingredients and stir.  Place in refrigerator to marinate, 4 to 6 hours, stirring occasionally.  Grill or broil until desired taste is achieved.

title: Spiced Orange Peppered Pork and Beef
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon ground gingerroot | 12 ounces beef sirloin steaks ( thinly sliced ) or 12 ounces pork chops, cut crosswise into 4 diagonal slices | 1/8 teaspoon sage ( finely chopped ) | 1 can crushed pineapple, undrained | 1 tablespoon pineapples ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon unsweetened applesauce ( optional )
instructions: Toast cardamom seeds a minute or so before cooking.  Place in ziploc bag with meat, herbs, pineapple and pineapples.  Marinate a minimum of 3 hours before serving.  Cook pork slices in skillet, turning to brown evenly, and remove and place on serving platter.

title: Stilton
ingredients: 1 lb mozzarella cheese, grated ( approx 2 cups ) | 3 ounces mixed spice ( spice hunter )
instructions: Rub the cheese with mixed spices, or coarsely grated.  Sprinkle over cooked spaghetti or other cooked pasta.  Store in airtight container.

title: Pineapple Beef Carnitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch cubes | 4 tablespoons capers | 1 jar guacamole, well drained ( or sour cream ) | 1 can pineapple chunks ( drained or tidbits ) | 1/3 cup fresh parsley, chopped | 1/2 cup tequila
instructions: Spray crockpot with a nonstick spray and lightly grease.  Place meat cubes on bottom of crockpot and sprinkle with capers.  Combine guacamole, pineapple, parsley and tequila in blender and blend until smooth.  Pour over casserole and cook on low for 8 hours.  If canned pineapple pieces are used, place on top just before serving and simmer until meat is tender.

title: Quick and Easy Fettuccine W- Tofu and Jelly
ingredients: 1 package extra firm tofu | 1/4 cup prepared pectin | 1 cup processed cheese, preferably your favorite cheese
instructions: Drain the tofu on a plate with paper towels or a cloth towel for about 10 minutes.  Sprinkle with salt and let stand for about 10 minutes.  Drain the tofu on paper towels.  Cut into 1/2 inch slices and transfer to a bowl.  Crush the tofu with your hands into crumbly pieces and toss with the pectin until the pieces are thoroughly coated with pectin.  Cook the fettuccine according to package directions.  Drain fettuccine and transfer to a serving platter.  Spoon on the cheese and serve immediately.

title: Turnip Squash and Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 ounce whole wheat spaghetti | 1 1/4 cups turnips ( peeled and sliced ) | 1 ounce cremini mushroom ( sliced )
instructions: Place pasta into a large pot of boiling water.  Cook until tender, but with a little undercooked pasta still attached, 4 to 8 minutes.  Drain pasta.  Place mushrooms back over medium heat and saute about 3 minutes.  Add peas, mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.  Serve hot.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,cannellini bean,bisquick,garbanzo bean,lime zest,pickle,kielbasa,orange liqueur
title: Bisquick Kielbasa W-Bean & Sweet Potato
ingredients: 1 lb kielbasa ( cut 1/4-1/3-inch thick ) | 4 tablespoons orange liqueur ( your choice ) | 1 1/4 cups bisquick, can use whole wheat ( or 1 whole wheat ) | 1 1/4 cups bottled garbanzo beans ( drained & amp ; rinsed ) | 1 cup cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon lime zest ( if you like really lemony taste add in a small piece of orange zest ) | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1/4 cup orange-flavored liqueur ( or 1/4 cup white wine vinegar )

title: Thai-Spiced Shrimp

title: Spicy Bagels

instructions: Warm buns.  Spread each cut side of the split hoagie rolls with 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds.  Top each with the toasted scallion seeds.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: tamarind pulp,red bell pepper,limeade concentrate,pork tenderloin,baking soda,oil,pomegranate,kahlua
title: Tamarind Pork Skewers
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into about 1-inch cubes ( cut into about 3 by 2 by 1/4-inch sticks or strips ) | 1 cup pomegranate | 1/2 cup tamarind pulp ( concentrate ) | 1/4 cup kahlua | 1/4 cup frozen limeade concentrate ( or plain ) | 3 -4 tablespoons fresh lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon baking soda | oil ( for frying )
instructions: Combine all of the ingredients in a medium bowl and add the pork.  Thread the meat sticks onto cocktail pins or soaked wooden skewers and skewer on metal or bamboo skewers. .  Coat with the marinade.  Place skewers on the grill or in a broiler rack set on medium high.

title: Mac and Cheese Steak Coconut
ingredients: 2 beef steaks, 1-inch thick | 1 can coconut milk | 1 lb sharp cheddar cheese
instructions: Pour the coconut milk into a shallow dish and put the steaks in it.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Preheat a grill or grill pan to its lowest setting.  Grill/fry the steaks for about 7 minutes per side, or to desired doneness.  Remove meat from the pan and top with cheese and enjoy.

title: Tandoori Masala
ingredients: 1/2 cup yellow fenugreek seeds ( kasoori methi ) | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder
instructions: Wash fenugreek and soak in 2 tsps.  Of water for a few hrs before using, to make a fine paste.  Grind the fenugreek seeds to a fine paste.  If your kitchen has time, skip this step, as we have never had this problem before.  Add turmeric and mix well.  Heat a small saucepan over medium high heat, adding 2 tsps.  Of water.  Add the fenugreek mixture.  Cover.  When the fenugreek starts to swell, lower the heat to keep it at a low simmer.  Do not add water at this stage.  Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oil separates from the masala.  Remove fenugreek mixture from the heat.  Keep covered.  After 20 minutes, remove cover and let it stand for 10 minutes.  Serve hot with rotis/parathas or rice.

Random Ingredients: walnut oil,turmeric,biscuit baking mix,cornmeal,kosher salt,ham,white onion

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf.  In a large bowl, mix cornmeal, minced onion, salt, turmeric and biscuit baking mix.

title: Saffron Pudding
ingredients: 5 tablespoons palm sugar | 1 pinch saffron threads, crushed
instructions: Combine sugar and saffron in a small saucepan.  Bring to the boil over medium heat, then reduce heat and simmer until the sugar is completely dissolved.  Stir occasionally, and continue cooking for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and strain through a fine sieve, or use a cloth or coffee filter to filter the liquid through a coffee filter.  Return processed sugar to saucepan, and heat until it has reduced to 2 1/2 tablespoons.

Random Ingredients: cider vinegar,white fish fillet,yellow squash,vanilla ice cream,chicken stock cube,garlic clove
title: Grilled Whole Fish With Filipino Seasoned Veggies
ingredients: 1 whole white fish fillet, skinned & scaled ( about 2lb each ) | 2 chicken stock cubes | 1 -2 garlic clove, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon cider vinegar | 1 can yellow squash | vanilla ice cream ( you can use soy, black soy, soy, or vanilla )
instructions: Spray the fish fillet with olive oil cooking spray.  Place on a hot griddle pan or griddle pan over high heat.  Grill for 2 minutes perside or until medium rare.  Take out & set aside.  Put the stock cubes into a small pot over medium heat.  Add the garlic & simmer until just starting to colour.  Stir in the vinegar & heat for 3 minutes stirring constantly.  Add the vegetables & cook for a further 5 minutes or until tender.  Meanwhile, preheat the grill & cook the fish fillet for about 3 minutes per side or until cooked to your liking.  Serve the fish fillet topped with the vegetable mixture & drizzle with the extra vinegar sauce.

title: Salsa Beef
ingredients: 1 lb steak | 2 lbs cubed stew meat | 10 ounces soymilk | mildly sliced radish, green peppers, onions | 1 cup chunky salsa ( i use pace ) | 1 teaspoon oregano leaves | 1/2 cup milk
instructions: Brown meat in frying pan.  Cut beef into 2 or more portions.  Heat milk and salsa and mix well.  Add marinated meat, onions, salt & pepper.  Put into 2 greased 9x13 pans.  Bake at 350f for 1 hour.  Serve with warm flour tortillas, cheese& guacamole.

Random Ingredients: bell pepper,marsala wine,flat leaf italian parsley,sauerkraut,orange peel
title: Sauerkraut and Wine
ingredients: 1 jar sauerkraut, drained | 8 ounces sweet vermicelli or 8 ounces linguine, uncooked according to package directions | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 2 tablespoons chopped candied orange peel | 4 -5 ounces sweet bell peppers or 4 -5 ounces red peppers, cut into thin strips
instructions: Cut 1/4 cup of drained sauerkraut into pieces and heat in a large skillet over medium high heat until it just begins to bubble.  When it boils, add the sauerkraut and stir.  Add the vermicelli and quick cook according to package directions.  When the vermicelli is to al dente, remove from heat, drain and rinse with cold water to cool.  Pour the noodles into a 2 to 3 quart serving bowl.

title: Spicy Corn and Sultana Pasta
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn, each cut crossways into 2-inch lenghts | 8 ounces thin squid roll or 8 ounces white fish fillets | 8 ounces light red snipped dark chocolate | 1 large sweet corn ( such as red russet ) | 1/2 cup sultana | one tablespoon coarsely crushed onion flakes
instructions: Place the corn, squid and the fish in a large pan of hot water, and bring to the boil.  Simmer over medium heat for 3 - 4 minutes, until just tender.  Drain off and discard the fish.  Meanwhile, melt half of the chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water.  Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the sultanas and the remaining dark chocolate.  Dip the pasta into the chocolate, then divide between 4 serving plates.  Top with the sultanas and plenty of crushed onion.

title: Fettuccine Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package fettuccine pasta | 1 pound sandwich bread, cut into cubes | 1/2 package dry fennel | 1 pint heavy cream | 1 pound prepared sandwich bread, cut into cubes, or as needed
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Cook the pasta in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until cooked through but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.  Drain.  Cool under cold water.  Place 1/2 of the fettuccine pasta and 1/2 of the bread cubes into a large bowl.  Place the remaining fettuccine pasta, bread, fennel, heavy cream, and remaining bread cubes into a large pot.  Bring to a simmer over medium heat.  Serve.

title: Smoked Pork Loin Grilled
ingredients: 1/2 kg pork loin | 2 teaspoons bicarbonate of soda | 1 1/2 cups dark brown sugar | 1 1/2 tablespoons rosemary leaves | 2 -3 tablespoons unsalted cheese, grated
instructions: To make the rub, combine the sugar, rosemary leaves and bicarb soda in a small bowl and set aside.  Slice the pork into slices about 3/4 inch thick.  Brush with the remaining bicarb/brownie mix and brush with remaining bicarb/brownie mix.  Grill over medium coals until desired degree of doneness, basting regularly with pan juices.  Serve with thick slices of potato, or roasted vegies.

title: Raspberry Beef Steak With Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 lb beefsteak tomato | 1 teaspoon red food coloring | 2 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1/2 cup cold water | 1/2 cup red wine, divided | 1 lb raspberry, stemmed, halved | 4 small mint leaves, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons chives, minced
instructions: Cut tomato in half crosswise and thinly slice crosswise into 1/4 inch slices.  Sprinkle both sides of beefsteak with food coloring, and roll in sugar.  In medium saucepan, combine 1/4 cup water, wine, and tomatoes with tomato juice.  Bring to boiling.

Random Ingredients: mexican chocolate,shallot,stock,coconut milk,marshmallow creme,italian sausage,green peppercorn,brown rice
title: Mexican Sausage Rioja

instructions: Cook and remove sausage from casings under cold water until cooked through, about 10 minutes.  Drain, then let cool and chop finely.  Combine stock and coco lopez or cream of coconut milk in pot and cook over medium heat.  Cook, stirring constantly, until milk comes to a simmer and coconut is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Rinse under cold water and drain.  When ready to serve, spread rice evenly over individual serving bowls.  Top with sausage mixture, topping with chocolate crumbles.

title: Ziti With Ziti
ingredients: 1 lb ziti pasta | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram
instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions.  Drain.  Heat skillet over medium high.  Add ziti.  Sprinkle with marjoram.  Cook stirring until all ziti is browned and tender.

title: Chicken Turnovers - Paneer Cheese Rolls
ingredients: 1 packet puff pastry, thawed | 1 chicken bouillon cube | vinegar ( enough to make the roll very wet )
instructions: Lay thawed puff pastry sheet on counter top and lightly grease the surface.  In a small bowl, add the chicken bouillon cube, chicken bouillon, or any other seasoning that you think would like.  Roll the pastry out to about 6 - 12 in long.  Cut out the rolls to make approx 3 rounds, then roll each round over the top.  Set the rounds aside.  Add about 1 tblsp of the vinegar to the remaining 1 tblsp of vinegar which has been added.  Cover them with the remaining 1 tbls.  Of vinegar.  Heat up the oven to 200c and spray baking sheet lightly with veg oil or olive oil spray.  Place one round of pastry in the middle of your oven tray.  Add the remaining rounds of pastry onto the tray, overlapping the rounds.  This step can be done as is by rolling out each pastry round in a pastry bag fitted with a star tip and placing on baking sheet.  Repeat steps 7 - 8 until all you've used up the pastry in the pan.  When you've made 2 batches, place each tray in the oven on your back rack.  Bake for approx 30 - 40 minutes, until golden.

title: Prawns-Shrimps
ingredients: 500 g raw prawns or 500 g shrimp, peeled or 250 g shrimp, cut in small pieces | 3 tablespoons tamarind pulp, mixed with | 3 tablespoons chopped pimientos, plus extra ( to garnish )
instructions: Soak the tamarind pulp in about 5 cups boiling water for several minutes.  Put shrimp cubes and tamarind in a heavy frying pan or wok.  Fry over low medium heat, stirring, to seal.  Add the prawns to the pan or wok and fry over low heat for several minutes, stirring often.  Remove the prawns to an oven plate.  Increase the heat and fry the prawns over low heat for another 5 minutes, stirring often.  Remove from the pan, add the pimentos and fry them over low heat for about 15 to 20 minutes, until they turn pink.  Add more tamarind pulp if necessary.

title: Zucchini Ribbons (Zucchini Appetizers)
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs zucchini | 1 tablespoon catsup | 1 teaspoon coarsely chopped garlic | 4 fresh serrano peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup crushed pepperoncini peppers | 1/2 cup cocoa
instructions: Cut zucchini diagonally into 1/2 inch cubes.  Combine remaining ingredients except cocoa in large bowl.

title: Mango Chutney and Horseradish Sauce for Beef and Lamb Satay
ingredients: 1/4 cup mango chutney | 1/4 cup beef broth ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon horseradish ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon heavy cream ( optional )
instructions: Whisk chutney, broth, horseradish and cream in a medium bowl until creamy.  Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend.  Serve with beef or lamb satay.

title: Super Easy General Tso's Wonton Ginger Tons
ingredients: 1/2 cup ice water | 1/4 cup chili paste | 1 tablespoon xanthan gum
instructions: Place all the ingredients in a mini bag.  Shake gently until fully mixed and the ingredients are evenly distributed. .  Heat a non stick frying pan.  To test if the heat is right add a 1 tb of water in the pan.  If the mixture bubbles, tap the pan on the counter a little and the water should evaporate.  Add about a teaspoon full of the mixture to the pan and stir quickly to form a mass and move the coated mixture to the side.  Cook for 3 - 5 minutes, until the surface begins to brown then flip the entire package into a large paper log shape log.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: head endive,saffron thread,canola oil,peppercorn,coconut oil,cream cheese,vanilla yogurt,butternut pumpkin
title: Sweet Peppered Butternut Pumpkin Soup With Boursin Cheese Dip
ingredients: 15 small heads endive, peeled and chopped | 1 pinch cracked peppercorn | 1 pinch saffron thread | 3 1/4 liters homemade or 26-minute double boiler flavored yogurt or 3 1/4 liters canned yogurt | 20 ounces butternut pumpkin, cut into medium chunks ( about 1 kg ) | canola oil ( for deep frying, if in a hurry ) | 8 ounces cream cheese | 1 cup flaked coconut oil
instructions: Wash clean, large ridged tubs of dirt and sand and dry very well.  To do this, put the butternut pumpkin into a bowl of simmering water and set it aside.  Put about 2 - 3 tablespoons of canola oil into the pot and turn to medium.  When the oil is hot, add the butternut pumpkin and fry for 3 - 4 minutes, or until it's almost cooked through but not soft.  Take care to not let the mixture darken too much.  Remove all the butternut pumpkin to a clean bowl of food processor.  Place the yogurt in a large bowl and mix with the butternut pumpkin with a fork.  Add 5 cups of the simmering water and whisk until well blended.  Let it sit for about 10 minutes and stir.  After 15 minutes, you want the pudding to thicken a bit, but not yet smooth.  Turn off the heat and stir in the cream cheese and coconut oil.  Serve with crackers or fresh strawberries on top.

title: Easy French Fry-Cooking Marinade and Basting Sauce for Shrimp and Chicken
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ketchup | 1 1/2 lbs cooked shrimp or 1 1/2 lbs thawed shrimp | 1 -2 teaspoon ground chili pepper
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a small saucepan.

title: Italian Nacho Dip Mix

instructions: Whisk all ingredients together in a small bowl.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Sarasota's Pineapple Spritzer

instructions: Drain the pineapple and place in a medium sized freezer bag.  Add in, rum, onion powder, parsnips.  Seal and place in the freezer.  To serve, place one large tortilla in the skillet, spoon 1/2 cup of drained pineapple in the middle of the tortilla, add 2 tablespoons of the pear sauce on top of the pineapple.  Serve immediately.

title: Apple Pie Crackers
ingredients: 1 apple, peeled, cored and grated | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Place grated apple in a bowl.

title: Tropical Fruity Prawn Salad
ingredients: 350 g fresh prawns | 400 g fresh prawns | 1 tablespoon chili paste | 1 small chili, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons rice noodles | 1 cup fresh strawberries, sliced | 1 tablespoon mixed spice
instructions: Shell prawns, removing heads, tail and shells, removing any membrane, and chop into fine pieces.  Combine prawns and chopped chilli paste in bowl with chilli, sweet chilli sauce and noodles, stirring to combine.  Place in refrigerator for a couple of hours to marinate.  Bring to boil a large saucepan of water, and add mixed spice.  Simmer for 2 - 3 minutes or until aromatic.  Remove from heat and pour over salad.  Toss to coat well and serve cold or warm.

title: Spanish Rice Pudding
ingredients: 1 lb risotto rice, rinsed well | 29 ounces beef broth | 2 jars mild diced jalapeno & serrano peppers | 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg | 2 pinches paprika
instructions: Place rice and broth in a large sauce pot.  Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat and simmer approximately 15 minutes, stirring occasionally until broth is absorbed and tender and rice is tender.  Mix in peppers, nutmeg and paprika.  Cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Italian Vegetable Patties

instructions: In a bowl, combine the bread crumbs 1/2 cup or more of the chopped vegetables, the egg substitute, and canola oil.  Stir well to mix. 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into 1-in.

title: Lamb Flambe
ingredients: 150 ml double cream | 500 g lamb shoulder, trimmed | 1 small apple, peeled, cored and cut into chunks

Pour over the cream, dot with butter and sprinkle with the grated cheese, and put in the oven for 10 - 15 minutes, until the cheese is golden and crispy.

title: Beef Tenderloin on Prosciutto
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin | 2 cans cream of mushroom soup | 4 slices prosciutto, chopped finely
instructions: Place tenderloin in roasting pan.  Cut meat off any tough fat, and place on top of meat.  Spoon can of soup over all of the meat, and then top with chopped prosciutto.  Bake at 350 degrees for one hour.

title: Mediterranean Lentils
ingredients: 8 ounces dried lentils, picked over | 3 ounces black olives ( or a combination, of your choice ) | 3 tablespoons golden syrup | 1 tablespoon honey ( or agave syrup )

title: Fried Quesadillas

instructions: Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot.  When it shimmers, add the tortillas.  They should not brown. title: Mixed Sage and Saffron Powder

instructions: Place dried sage, chiles and saffron in a small bowl.  Stir to evenly distribute spices.  To serve, shake bowl until salt is dissolved and leaves are evenly spattered over the outside and toasted.

title: Pork Wrapped Eggplant - Mexico

title: Rugelach With Rigatoni and Ricotta

title: Bourbon Pizza

title: Irish Pea and Quinoa Salad

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Coat a 9 loaf pan with cooking spray.  Place quinoa in a rice cooker and cook according to package directions.  Set aside. title: Babka's Famous Beef Lovers Baked Beans
ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast | 1 jar dry pinto beans | 1 1/2 quarts beef brisket, room temperature & slightly expanded | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 1 1/2 teaspoons peach peppercorns in puree or 1 1/2 teaspoons peppercorns, chopped fresh | 5 bay leaves | 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract ( optional )
instructions: Dissolve yeast in 1 quart of the pepsi in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water and allow to foamy.  In a 1 1/2 quart saucepan combine the beans, 3/4 cup of the raisins, 1 cup of the peppercorns, the bay leaves, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.  Cover and allow to sit in a draft free place until the frothy foam in the center of the frothy foam doubles in volume, about 2 hours.  Add a little of the remaining pepsi solution to the beans.  Place the remaining raisins in a small dry glass casserole dish and cover with a piece of buttered parchment paper.  Heat oven to 500 degrees f. title: Tofu Shredded Beef over Rice
ingredients: 1 medium rump roast | 16 ounces extra firm flake ground tofu
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f, then spray the inside of a baking tray with cooking spray.  If your roast has a bone in it, remove the bone, but leave it there, otherwise remove just the pink interior from the roast.  Use the tip of a sharp knife to poke holes all over the roast with your knife.  Make sure the hole is at least 1/2 inch deep.  Spread the bean curd with olive oil, or if the pan is dry, oil canola spray if you have it.  Insert the roast into the hole of the roast.  It can be as compact or as small as you like.  If you like, you can poke a piece of string down the meat's surface once it has been in the shape of a chopstick.  If you need to, make sure you've covered it, to help catch any drips of fat that leaks out while baking.  Bake the roast for about 1 1/2 hours, or until fork tender at one end of the cooking time.  It can also be frozen for a couple of hours.  Remove the meat, drain the liquid, and place back in the roasting pan.  Heat the reserved liquid in a small pot over medium low heat.  Slice the meat with a very sharp knife into 1/4 inch strips.  Toss the strips of beef over the meat with a fork to thoroughly coat the meat with the sauce.  Serve with rice, and garnish with a sprinkling of chopped olives and/or chopped green onions.

title: Roasted Red Chilies Vienettes

instructions: Remove the stems and seeds from the chillies.  In a large, heavy frying pan over medium heat, warm the cream to almost boiling.  Place the chillies on a plate, close the lid and roast them to a rich dark brown color, about 5 minutes.  Watch carefully until the center of the chillies is tender and the liquid has cooked away, about 10 minutes.  With a slotted spoon, transfer the chillies to a paper towel lined dish to drain.  Reserve the juices in the frying pan.  Place the remaining 1 cup of cream in a small saucepan and bring it just to boiling over medium heat.  Pour the hot cream over the chillies and let cool to room temperature.  When cool, stir in the reserved chillies and serve at room temperature.

Sprinkle 1 teaspoon of the hot sauce on the top of the tortillas.  Fold tortilla in half again.

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees.  Heat the vermicilli on the stove in the microwave or on the grill until dry on the surface and tender in the inside, about 3 minutes per side. title: Coca-Rice With Beef

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a 1 quart casserole dish, combine all ingredients.

title: Bourbon Chili Jam
ingredients: 1/2 cup good bourbon | 1/2 cup cream of tartar | 1/4 teaspoon chili
instructions: In a medium glass bowl, combine the bourbon, cream of tartar and chili.  Mix well to ensure that the cream doesn't clump.  Stir in the cream a little at a time to blend.  Fill 1/2 cup cold water, making sure it is completely dissolved.  Heat the water slowly over medium heat.  Bring to a rolling boil for several minutes, stirring continuously, but don't let boil dry at this point.  The secret, and most attractive, and yet cheap, is to dip your pointer finger into the pot and move it around until it is in a clear and slightly grainy ball.  Lift the bowl off the stove and immediately pour in the hot jam.  Immediately roll the ball around until the jelly ball is completely covered by the liquid.  If the pan can keep its lid off, your jam is now ready.  If you store it in the fridge, it will last several weeks after months.  I know this makes about 1 bottle of chili from any variety of chili and works quite well for this.

title: Homemade Gratinees

instructions: Wash, remove and trim any damaged or withered stalks and cut the celery lengthwise into 1 inch pieces.
