Process the mixture until smooth.  Store the grated gruyere in a glass or ceramic bowl in the refrigerator until ready to use.  When ready to serve, reheat gently in a 375 f oven for 2 to 3 minutes.  If you wish to serve the grated gruyere straight from the bowl of your food processor, transfer the mixture to a bowl lined with a dampened, buttered pastry cloth and roll into a log.  Trim the ends.  Starting with a long strip of pastry dough about 3 and 1/2 inches in length, roll up the dough into a log and cut out as many slices as you can using scissors or other machine directions.

title: Aphrodisiac Snow Peas and Parsley
ingredients: 100 g snow peas ( or other pods, peeled ) | 4 tablespoons flat leaf parsley | 1 pinch unsweetened cocoa ( optional )
instructions: Break up snow peas or pods using a mallet and fry it until they turn a lighter shade of green.  Set aside.  Clean the parsley then finely chop it, including any seeds.  Mix all the sauce ingredients together and divide amongst serving dishes or plates.

title: Fried Green Peppers (Aloo Ki Dal)

instructions: Wash the peppers, remove the stem and seeds, cut the peppers lengthwise in quarters, removing the seeds and stem.  Cut the onions in half and slice the halves into thin wedges.  Place the green peppers into a large nonstick skillet with the pith side down, then cook over very high heat, turning constantly, until the vegetables are nicely browned, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Place the onions and the hot peppers into a bowl, and stir in the parsley and allspice.  Cool to room temperature, then chill for at least 30 minutes.

title: Gruyere Gratinees With Caramelized Beef Onions

Heat a large frying pan or griddle over medium high heat.  Pour half a cup of hot water and about 1 1/2 tbsp of the caramelized beef/onion parls.

title: Cheaters' Chicken Buns (Biscuits)

Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Pistachio Squash With Squash

instructions: Peel squash and cut diagonally into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Put squash in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam until tender.  When done, drain well and place on a platter.  Mash in a bowl with a wooden spoon.  Add 2 tablespoons light golden pistachios and stir lightly until mixed.  Spoon mixture over squash for presentation.

instructions: Combine sliced sirloin, mushrooms, ginger, peaches, and swiss chard in large bowl.  Add ice water to cover.  Let sit for 10 minutes to chill. instructions: Boil eggplants for 5 minutes.  While waiting for the eggplants to cool, chop them, and then grind them to a fine mash in a blender or food processor. instructions: To prepare the pastry, cut the pastry in half lengthwise and line a 9x17 baking dish with the pastry.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit.  Cut the pastry in half again lengthwise and line the pastry crust.  Bake till the pastry is golden brown, about 10 - 15 minutes, for each layer.  Let cool for five minutes.  Using a pastry brush, drizzle over about 2 tablespoons the peanut oil.  Mix with the mirin until it's a wet glaze.  To prepare the dressing, in a saucepan, mix the broth, corn syrup, corn oil, orange juice, and vanilla.  Bring to a boil stirring frequently until the sauce is thickened and reduced.  While the dressing is cooling, use a fork to poke holes in the pastry and brush generously with the peanut oil.  To assemble the salad, remove the pastry from the oven and place on the table, drizzle with a little bit of the pan dressing, and drizzle with some of the reserved dressing.  Arrange the cooked beef steaks on top.  Drizzle with more dressing and serve hot, with garnish as desired.

Random Ingredients: pork loin roast,blackstrap molasses,asparagus,cider vinegar,pineapple,onion powder
title: Hawaiian Ginger Pork Loin and Asparagus
ingredients: 1 pork loin roast | 1 package frozen asparagus, thawed | 2 cans crushed pineapple, drained | 2 tablespoons blackstrap molasses | 2 tablespoons minced onion powder | 1 1/2 cups cider vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Place pork roast in a roasting pan.  Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 145 degrees f.  Let pork rest 10 minutes.  Meanwhile, place frozen asparagus, pineapple, molasses, and onion powder in a large pot.  Cover, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes.  Drain asparagus, and transfer to a large bowl.  Poke holes in beef roast with a fork, and stuff with asparagus and drained pineapple.  Whisk together vinegar and remaining 1/2 cup water to make a gravy.  Pour gravy over pork, and serve with crusty bread.

Random Ingredients: madras curry powder,dashi stock,flour tortilla,mexican vanilla extract,marjoram,cornstarch,farfalle pasta,white cabbage
title: Curried Corn Tortilla Wraps
ingredients: 8 soft corn tortillas, 6 inches in diameter | 2 tablespoons flour | 1 cup dashi stock | 1 teaspoon madras curry powder | 1 teaspoon mexican vanilla extract | 1/2 teaspoon marjoram | 1 1/2 lbs white cabbage, thinly sliced ( about 12 ounces ) | 1 teaspoon cornstarch
instructions: Heat 2 tbsps.  Of water in a pan over moderate high heat.  Meanwhile, brush 8 tortillas with oil, sprinkle with salt, and cook until just softened, 3 - 4 minute add 2 tbsps.  Of the flour and cook for another 30 seconds.  Gradually stir in the stock and cook for about 1 minute.  Add curry and mexican vanilla, bring to a simmer until thickened, 1 - 2 minute.  Taste and adjust seasoning.  Meanwhile, in a large bowl, toss the cabbage with the remaining tbsps.  Of flour, cornstarch, and the rest of the curry liquid to loosen the leaves.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat until hot.  Add half the cabbage and cook, stirring, until lightly wilted, 3 - 4 minute.  Quickly spread the cabbage in the tortillas leaving about 1/4 inch on each.  Sprinkle with the remaining cabbage.  Top with the remaining tortillas and serve at once.

title: Skiatchewan Fried Noodles
ingredients: 1 package egg noodles | 1 pound small red cabbage
instructions: Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.  Once the water is boiling, stir in the egg noodles, and return to a boil.  Cook the noodles uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the noodles have cooked through, but are still firm to the bite, about 5 minutes.  Drain well.  While the noodles are still warm, place a dinner plate on a napkin filled with some of the cabbage.  Drain the noodles, making sure to get all of the excess water out.  Place the noodles on the plate, cut side down, and top with the remaining cabbage.

Random Ingredients: cream celery soup,sesame seed,swiss cheese,marshmallow,salt,goat cheese
title: Swiss Cheese Balls
ingredients: 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 1/8 teaspoon salt | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 1/2 cup miniature marshmallows | 1 ounce goat cheese, crumbled
instructions: In a bowl, combine swiss cheese, cream of celery soup, salt and sesame seeds.  Mix well.  Form into 1 inch balls and refrigerate until set.  Serve with miniature marshmallows, crumbled goat cheese or your favourite spread.

title: Steamed Fettuccine With Hamburger
ingredients: 1 package dried fettuccine pasta | 1 can water chestnuts, drained | 1 tablespoon golden syrup | 1 lb hamburger
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.  Drain and return to wok.  Set aside.  Meanwhile, toast the hamburger.  While the hamburger is cooking, heat corn syrup in a small sauce pot, stirring, until boiling and then add corn syrup mixture.  Add the drained water chestnuts and allow to heat.  Serve over drained pasta.  May add a little extra shredded parmesan cheese or ginger if desired.

title: Lefse
ingredients: 3 lbs all-purpose flour | fresh thyme sprig
instructions: Cream the flour and thyme together in a large bowl.  Add knead until a soft, pliable dough is formed.  Turn out onto a floured board and knead briefly.  Divide into equal sized balls, roll into thin, round cakes.  Slightly moisten the ends and gently press into shapes using your hands or dull blade.  Place on lightly floured baking sheet, cover and allow to rise for 30 minutes at room temperature.  Bake at 500f for 30 minutes, remove and allow to cool on a wire rack.  Store in a tightly sealed glass or metal container.

title: Pork and Wild Rice Stuffing
ingredients: 1 lb ground lean pork shoulder | 1 lb ground lamb | 1 teaspoon gingerroot, minced | 2 tablespoons sweet poultry seasoning | 2 cups uncooked long grain and wild rice blend
instructions: Preheat skillet on medium.  Put ground lean pork in skillet cook through.  Add ginger and poultry seasoning.  Drain fat and add rice and ground lamb mixing well.  Add 1/2 cup of water to meat mixture.  You want the liquid to be moistened.  Cover and place lid on skillet.  Cook covered 2 - 3 hours or until rice is tender, turn rice with a fork twice during cooking time.  You can also place meat mixture in crock pot on low for 6 - 8 hours.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,blueberry,dark rye bread,chicken broth,tarragon,honey,salt substitute
title: Blueberry & Herbed Rye Bran Cakes
ingredients: 1 2/3 cups reduced-salt chicken broth | 1/3 cup chicken stock | 2 tablespoons low sodium honey | 1 pinch salt substitute | 1 pinch dried tarragon | 4 tablespoons dark rye bread, crumbled | 1 cup fresh blueberries
instructions: Whisk broth, stock, honey, salt substitute, and tarragon in medium bowl to blend.  Stir bread crumbs into broth mixture.  Add bread mixture to taste and stir to combine.  Place 1 tablespoon of batter in each muffin mold.  Heat a heavy large nonstick skillet over medium high heat and add 1/2 teaspoon oil.  Cook cakes 2 to 3 minutes per side or until golden brown on top.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: parsley leaf,apricot half,dark beer,five spice powder,nonfat milk powder
title: Flemish Beer Battered Apricots - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 1/3 cup nonfat dry milk powder ( can use soy ) | 2 tablespoons dark beer | 1 teaspoon five-spice powder | 2 tablespoons fresh parsley leaves, shredded | 4 tablespoons dried apricots, coarsely chopped
instructions: Combine dry milk and dark beer in pressure cooker.  Close cover securely.

title: Frozen Swiss Escarole
ingredients: 16 asparagus spears, ends trimmed | 1 cup crushed chocolate chips | 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/4 cup diced, roasted edamame | 2 tablespoons olive oil
instructions: Place 2 cups boiling salted water over high heat in a 6 quart dutch oven.  When water returns to a boil, trim tips from asparagus spears and steam in the water 1 minute.  Place the asparagus cutlets into pot.  Stir asparagus in the hot water until bright green and just tender, about 2 minutes.  Remove asparagus in the pot with tongs, letting excess water evaporate.  Place ramekins upside down on paper towels.  Heat chocolate in a bowl over medium heat, stirring until melted.  Stir in ricotta cheese and spread over asparagus in each ramekin.  Scatter sweetened edamame over mixture.

title: Miniature Beef Tenderloin Steak
ingredients: 1 lb beef tenderloin steak, 6 inch thick | 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoning | 1 1/2 cups taco sauce | 1 tablespoon snipped fresh chives
instructions: Trim and cut away all visible fat from steak.  Trim steak and discard back strap of fat and membrane and fat from steaks.  Cut steak lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Place the steaks on a cutting board, using 2 chopsticks.  Using the knife, cut the steak lengthwise in half using a serrated knife.  Repeat steps 4 and 5 until all slices are used.  Rub seasoning mixture onto both sides of the steak.  Arrange steak at least 1 inch apart on waxed paper covered cookie sheet.  Allow to stand for at least 10 minutes.  Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Bake in preheated oven for 20 - 25 minutes, flipping slices halfway through, until golden brown.  Serve immediately.

title: Homemade Clove and Spice
ingredients: 2 ounces unflavored gelatin powder | 3/4 teaspoon ground cloves | 1/2 teaspoon savory
instructions: In a bowl, dissolve gelatin in 1/4 cup water until it dissolves.  Combine the garlic, cloves and savory.  Stir into the gelatin mixture until it becomes a soft mass.  Pour into a buttered 9 inch cake pan.

Random Ingredients: red bell pepper,ro tel mexican festival tomato,pesto sauce,red capsicum,pork tenderloin,applesauce,bean sprout,red pepper flake
title: Mexican Pork With Pesto Appetizer
ingredients: 600 g pork tenderloin | 1 cup basil | 1 medium red bell pepper | 1 medium red capsicum | 2 ro tel mexican festival tomatoes | 1 can ro-tel mexican festival tomatoes | 1 cup pesto sauce | 1/4 - 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes | 2 cups bean sprouts
instructions: Mix the pesto & red pepper flakes in a bowl.  Trim fat from pork & cut into slices, approximately 3 x 1/2.  In a large frypan, add pork & cook on both sides until no longer pink.  Take out of the pan & set aside.  Add pesto mixture, ro tel mexican tomatoes & mix well.  Simmer for about 5 minutes to let flavours develop.  Pour sauce & hot pork on to a plate & layer with bean sprouts.  Garnish with fresh parsley & red pepper flakes if desired.  Serve with bread or noodles.

title: Creamy Mushroom Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped fresh mushrooms | 1 cup sour cream
instructions: In a small bowl, blend the mushrooms and sour cream.  Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.

title:
Baked Chicken With Sherry, Red Pepper & Walnuts.
    -
ingredients: 12 chicken legs with thigh, with thigh attached | 4 green olives, sliced | 2 ounces walnuts, flaked | 50 ml red wine | 1 tablespoon triple sec | 2 tablespoons white flour | 2 large eggs, separated | 2 teaspoons ground walnuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 190c.  Place chicken on a greased, 12x6 cup ovenproof dish.  Arrange olives, walnuts and wine around the chicken legs.  Beat egg whites until foamy.  Beat egg yolks until thick and pale.  Stir egg white mixture into yolk mixture in a thin, steady stream over chicken.  Spoon egg mixture over chicken.  Sprinkle flour all over.  Mix lightly then drizzle over the rosemary sprigs.  Sprinkle breadcrumbs over evenly.  Place dish on an oven tray.  Bake 45 - 55 minutes or until golden brown.  Serve with a nice green salad.  Enjoy.

title: Pesto Bread
ingredients: 1 cup pecorino romano cheese, shredded | 1/2 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup baking cocoa | 3 cups cornbread ( homemade or cornstarch )
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  In a large bowl, combine the cheese, pine nuts, and cocoa.  Melt on low heat without stirring.  Slowly beat in water until mixture is light and fluffy.  Remove from the heat and spread on a piece of the cornbread dough.  Slip onto a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake for 20 - 25 minutes, until light brown.  Let cool for 5 minutes.  Cut into 4 thick slices.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Pumpernickel Meatball Strata
ingredients: 1 bag sauerkraut ( preferably kraut ) | 1 lb peeled and cooked frozen frozen meatballs, defrosted if frozen ( any meatball will do fine ) | 1 loaf sourdough bread, sliced ( rye bread is good ) | 1 cup buttermilk ( a little more if needed ) | 1 lb brussels sprout ( or spinach, fresh or frozen )
instructions: Put a large deep frying pan on med high heat.  Add in all the meatball sauerkraut, then stir to coat.  Cook until heated through.  Transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.  While the meat is cooking, put the sourdough bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Slice in half and put to the side once the meatballs have been added.  Add the buttermilk to the sourdough to make about 2 1/2 cups.  Add the buttermilk mixture to the meatballs and stir to coat.  Place half the brussels sprouts in the bottom of a 2 quart glass baking dish with just enough space to place the meatballs and sprouts close together if the dish is over filled.  Top with the remaining brussels sprouts and sprouts.  Close the film tightly and then turn the entire mixture over.  Close the film and place the strata in the baking dish with the meatballs and sprouts attached.  Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 350 degrees.  Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Avocado and Walnut Oil Pasta
ingredients: 250 g farfalle ( bow tie ) pasta | 1 ripe avocado | 2 -4 teaspoons walnut oil
instructions: Cook the pasta in plenty of boiling salted water for around 15 minutes or according to your taste.  While it is cooking, cut the avocado in slices.  Heat up the walnut oil in a pan over a medium heat.  Add the avocado slices and fry for approx 6 minutes or until browned and firm but still crunchy.  Drain the pasta when the pasta is cooked and add it to the pan with the avocado, tossing so they cook evenly.  Then add the oil.

title: Chicken-Chile Potstickers
ingredients: 2 cups cooked and shredded chicken thigh | 2 green chilies, coarsely chopped | 1/2 cup coarsely chopped brown onion | 1 teaspoon anchovy paste | 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves | 12 spring roll wrappers | 1/4 cup sweet sherry | 2 teaspoons anchovy paste | 2 teaspoons sherry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Finely chop chicken and chilies.  Sauté onion and chilies until soft.  Stir in chicken, chilies, and 1/2 cup of sherry, and anchovy paste.  Heat remaining sherry.  Brush spring roll wrappers with water.  Place 2 tablespoons of filling in center of each wrapper.  Fold over corner to meet in center.  Press edges with moistened fingers to seal.  Place on tray and bake 45 minutes.

title: Pissaladiere a la Chevre
ingredients: 125 g part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 pinch saffron strand | 125 g green onions, finely chopped | 200 g goat cheese | 180 g soft fresh goat cheese | 1/4 teaspoon vanilla essence | 1 tablespoon sugar cube | 3 saffron strands | 80 g prosciutto, finely chopped
instructions: Place the ricotta and saffron in a bowl and mix well.  Stir in green onions and set aside.  Beat the soft goat cheese and sugar together with the vanilla and pistachios until the mixture becomes fluffy.  Add the cheese mixture to the cheese mixture and stir well.  Cover and leave to stand in the fridge for at least an hour or as long as overnight.  Line a baking tray with aluminium foil or parchment paper.  Spread the goats' cheese mixture evenly in the tray, taking care to leave little gaps.  Remove cheese mixture from the fridge and spread the cheese mixture evenly over the goats' cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with chopped prosciutto.  Bake in a preheated oven at 220 degrees celcius for 30 minutes, checking that the cheese has started melting and giving off some liquid from the surface.  Remove from oven and turn onto a serving plate, pour the chilled cheese mixture over and serve.

title: Pork Chops Florentine

instructions: Brush pork chops with oil.  Sprinkle both sides with pudding mix and spread evenly on both sides of each piece. Pour tomato sauce over all.  Cover sauce with foil and bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes.  Serve with hot cooked spaghetti.

instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.  Add cheese and butter or margarine.  Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package instructions.  Drain spaghetti once cooked.  Place two cups of spaghetti in a serving dish.  Top with butterscotch chips.  Sprinkle with additional cheese if desired.

instructions: Toss minced tofu with cream and sesame seeds in a skillet over high heat until mixture has a medium to thick porridge like consistency and tofu is lightly browned and crisp.  Let rest for 10 minutes or so, then serve.

title: Broccoli & Pork Loaf
ingredients: 1/2 kg ground lean pork | 1/2 kg chopped broccoli floret | 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa | 1/4 teaspoon mustard powder | 2 slices rye bread, toasted
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°c.  Place pork and broccoli into a large bowl and add 2 tablespoons water.  Set aside whilst you prepare the filling the rest of the recipe.  Using your hands, mix together the remaining ingredients.  Spread filling onto toasted rye bread slices.  Place untoasted bread slices in an ovenproof dish.  Place roasting pan in oven and then add hot water.  Bake for 50 - 60 minutes.  Serve with your favourite side dish.

title: Tomato Pie IV
ingredients: 9 inches pie shell | 1 can tomato juice | 1 teaspoon herbs, dried
instructions: Preheat oven to melt tomato juice.  Mix with seasonings and pour into pie shell.  Bake for 45 - 50 minutes until crusts are slightly crisp.

title: Sushi Pear with Pork Chops (Low Fat)

instructions: Prepare sauce by combining ketchup, liquid smoke, and 1 tablespoons water.

title: Arancini

instructions: Bring broth and rice to a boil in a 2 to 3 qt.  Heavy saucepan.  Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes.  Mix rice with cumin and paprika.  Stir in sherry and set aside to cool.  Beat egg white and mint in a small bowl.  Stir rice mixture into egg mixture until completely moistened.

title: Super Simple Pesto Marinade
ingredients: 1/4 cup red pepper flakes | 1/4 cup pesto sauce or 1/4 cup basil pesto
instructions: In blender, add red pepper flakes, pesto and 1/4 cup water.  Blend, slowly dribbling into small jars.  Store in a cool dark place for up to a year.

title: Olives Stuffed With Red Wine and Red Pepper
ingredients: 4 tablespoons red wine | 4 tablespoons grapeseed oil or 4 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice | 2 large ripe black olives, stoned if possible | 1 teaspoon vanilla powder | 1/4 cup currants, soaked in hot water to cover
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the wine, oil and mustard seeds.  In a large saucpan, heat for 1 minute or until the mustard rises to the surface.  Add the allspice and stir for 30 seconds or until aromatic.  Add the olives and 1/2 of the spice mixture.  Stir and fry on high heat for about 1 minute.  Decrease heat to medium and continue to stir every 30 seconds to prevent sticking.  Unfold the mixture in and form a disc.  Cover the bottom of the saucpan with a layer of olives, followed by the rest of the spices.  Cover with a plate and a lid and return to low heat.  Stir and allow to simmer for 30 minutes.

Toss with the remaining ingredients and serve over brown rice and garnish with hot pepperoncini peppers if desired.

title: Finnish Blueberry and Cauliflower Soup

instructions: In a crock pot, bring broth to a boil.  Add cauliflower, reduce heat, cover and cook on high for 2 hours, adding berry sauce as desired.  Serve with croutons and enjoy.

title: Crispy Southwest Shrimp
ingredients: 1 cup crushed yellow mustard ( or dijon ) | cooking spray | 2 large oranges - peeled, quartered, and sectioned | 1 cup fresh sliced peaches, or fresh peaches | 4 small fresh mushrooms, sliced ( optional ) | 1 can mexican-style tomatoes | 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Place the shrimp in a skillet with the prepared mustard, orange segments, and peaches.  Scatter 1/2 cup of mushrooms over the shrimp.  Pour the tomatoes and their juice over the top.  Cover and place over medium high heat and cook for 12 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside to cool to room temperature.  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f.  Spray a 9x9 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Arrange the shrimp evenly over the mushrooms in an even layer.  Cover with plastic wrap and place dish in the oven.  Bake for 30 - 40 minutes, until the tops are browned and the shrimp are cooked through.

title: Kiss From Home Smoked Apple

instructions: Peel, core and core the apples, slice them 1/8 thick.  Place the apple slices into a saucepan and sprinkle generously with salt.  Add the apple cider and bring to boil.  Cover and cook over low heat for about 20 minutes or until apples are tender.  Remove from heat and store in a closed container in the refrigerator.

title: Quick and Easy Lamb Buns
ingredients: 4 -5 cups raw lean lamb, chopped or ( 500 ml ) leg of lamb, minced meat | 1 1/2 teaspoons yeast | 1/4 cup mango chutney | 4 shallots or 4 spring onions, diced finely | 4 tablespoons molasses | chili flakes
instructions: Combine all ingredients together and add more or less of your choice.  Add more or less spices if you prefer.

title: Curried Noodle Cake
ingredients: 2 cups egg noodles, cooked ( preferably wattie's ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream, warmed ( whipping ) | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, of your choice | 1 cup sweet noodle, cooked
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except noodles, in an electric mixing bowl and beat on med.  Speed until just incorporated.  Fold noodles into batter, coating the noodles completely.  Bake in a lightly buttered bundt cake pan at 350f for 20 minutes, until toothpick or inserted in the center comes out clean.  Serve immediately.

title: French Bistro Cocktail Shooter
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces sweet vermouth | 2 ounces hot sauce ( tabasco, perrier, cajun pete franks, perrier, perrier or swiss schnapps )
instructions: Mix the sweet vermouth with the hot sauce.  Cover tightly and shake well, or stir well before using.  To serve, pour half over ice cubes and serve.  Repeat with remaining cocktail liqueur.

title: Easy Roasted Pepper Sandwich
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper | 1 red chile pepper | 1/2 cup tahini | 3 ounces cooked ham, thinly sliced | 1 slice lime ( optional )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f.  Cut the pepper in half lengthwise.  Remove the seeds and white membrane from the pepper.  Place the pepper halves cut side down onto a baking sheet.  Roast under the preheated oven until the skin loosens and peppers feel soft when crushed with a fork.  Transfer to a plate to cool.  Peel the skin away from the pepper, and cut the peppers into 1/2 inch strips, or less if you prefer thinner wedges.  Rinse off the chile peppers and place them in a medium bowl.  In a small bowl, combine 1/2 cup of tahini with 1/2 cup of water.  Stir in the chile peppers.  Spoon the peanut sauce over the peppers, and mix gently before adding the ham.  Spoon the pepper mixture onto a small serving platter.  Garnish with the lime slices, if desired.

title: Porcini with Chipotle and Mushroom Stuffing
ingredients: 50 g dried porcini mushrooms | 1 chipotle chile in adobo
instructions: Soak dried mushrooms in very warm water for 20 minutes, then remove the stalks and cut into 2 inch lengths.  Crush the chile into a chile zest by soaking it in a small bowl of water.  Remove the white pith underneath.  Wipe the mushroom with clean damp cloth or sieve and rub off any sand then set aside.  Stuff the dried mushrooms with the mushroom mixture.  Using a little water moisten the top with additional water to seal.  Chill stuffing for about three hours.  Serve at room temperature.

title: Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup tea, strong | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed
instructions: Add all ingredients to a mug filled with ice.

instructions: Drain mushrooms, reserving liquid, and finely chop mushrooms.  Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.

title: Bogats in Pastry

instructions: First cut the frog legs in half lengthways.  Using a very sharp knife, cut away the peripheral muscle and neck bones.  Cut the legs into large pieces of equal size pieces.  Finely chop the spring onions.  Tear off the leaves and the stems of the hibiscus flowers, and chop them into small pieces.  Rinse and pat dry the frog legs thoroughly.  Cut the halves into quarters, removing the legs which have been cut or torn and any toes which may have come down under the meat.  Using your fingers or a sharp knife, cut 1/4 inch deep slits all over the frogs.  Set aside for about half an hour.  Preheat the oven to 190°c.  Roll out the pastry in two equal halves, using a 4 inch round cookie cutter or the outline of a round heart biscuit/rectangular cutter to outline the pastry.  Bake on the same shelf of the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden and crisp.  Set aside to cool for about 5 minutes.  Remove the top oven baking sheet.  Spread the ground red pepper over the pastry base.  Sprinkle the cheese over top of the red pepper. title: Fish With Lemon Beans and Rice
ingredients:
3 tablespoons butter beans, cut into 1 inch pieces and softened | 1 1/2 cups jasmine rice or 1 1/2 cups arborio rice | 3 tablespoons fresh lemon peel | 4 white fish fillets, preferably 2-3 inches thick ( firm, such as orange roughy or red snapper, each about 1.
    -5 inches long, halved horizontally and thinner toward the middle ) | 2 cans canned crushed pineapple in juice, drained | 1/4 cup yellow cornmeal
instructions: Pour 1 tbsp butter beans into a 3 quart saucepan and add rice.  Cook, covered over very low heat, stirring occasionally, until rice is creamy, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Stir in lemon peel and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Remove from heat and stir in fish.

title: Cacciatore Italian Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 lb chicken tenders | 1/2 cup diced dried fig ( optional ) | 3/4 cup dry parmesan cheese | 40 capers ( optional )
instructions: Cut chicken tenders into 1/2.  Using the flat side of a meat mallet or frying pan, pound chicken tenders til they are of 1 inch thickness.  Arrange in a single layer on greased 13 x 9 baking dish.  Drain figs, if using, or sprinkle with cheese and sprinkle each with the capers.  Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for approximately 15 - 20 minutes or untill heated thru.

Random Ingredients: spring onion,bell pepper,curry leaf,seasoning salt,red cabbage,pineapple chunk
title: Curried Red Cabbage
ingredients: 1 medium red cabbage | 1 small bell pepper, sliced | 1 bunch spring onion, sliced | 1 can pineapple chunks, drained and well-cracked | 1 1/2 teaspoons of your favourite curry leaves | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt
instructions: Cut the cabbage in thick slices and place in cold water.  When you feel the moisture starts to rise, drain and rinse well.  Pat dry and cut into 1 pieces.  Place in a bowl.  Add the remaining ingredients and mix well.  Taste to adjust seasoning.  Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: new potato,red curry paste,oil,golden syrup,cumin seed,white bread,strawberry,watermelon
title: Strawberry and Watermelon Curry With Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients: 1/3 cup golden syrup | 1/2 teaspoon cumin seed | 500 g white bread, triangles ( long and wide ) | 1 tablespoon oil | 1 tablespoon mild red curry paste | 1 can mixed pickled new potatoes, halved | 1 cup seedless watermelon, cut into 1cm cubes | 1 cup strawberry, halved
instructions: For the curry, heat the golden syrup under a large pan of boiling water until just bubbling.  Add the cumin seeds.  Remove from the heat then add the bread triangles, tossing to coat.  Set aside on a baking tray for 5 minutes to soak up any extra syrup.  Heat the oil in a frying pan.  Cook the curry paste over a medium high heat, stirring constantly until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Add the sweet potato wedges and watermelon to the curry, stir to coat evenly.  Re cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes, until hot and tender. .  Preheat the oven to 200°c / 400°f / gas toss the bread wedges through the salad and serve.

title: Beef Stew With Pear
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes | 1 pound pear slices
instructions: Put stew beef in a large crock with pear slices.  Pour the beer around the meat.  Cover, and cook over medium low heat until thickened, 2 1/2 to 3 hours.

title: Tamari Flank Steak
ingredients: 1/2 lb round steak, cut into 4 pieces | 1/3 cup white flour | 1/4 cup almond flour | 1 tablespoon tamari | 1/2 teaspoon superfine sugar | 1 cup corn niblet, canned drained ( i don't own this, but i didn't use )
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 f.  In a large frying pan, heat the oil and sear the steak on one side until lightly browned about 3 minutes.  Turn, sprinkle with extra flour and cook for more 2 minutes.  Toss the fish in the flour to coat, then shake off any excess.  Stir in the tamari.  Transfer to a shallow ovenproof dish and set aside.  Roast for about 40 minutes until tender and cooked through.  Serve with steaks, veges or salad.

Random Ingredients: ro tel tomato,black pepper,black mustard seed,baking potato,poblano chile
title: Homemade Roasted Potatoes with Tomatoes and Chile
ingredients: 4 poblano chile, stemmed and seeded | 2 medium ripe ro-tel tomatoes, halved | 1 tablespoon black mustard seeds, lightly crushed | 2 lbs baking potatoes, scrubbed and cut into large chunks | black pepper
instructions: Preheat grill.  Place chiles directly over direct heat on grill, turning with tongs, until charred on all sides, 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool under running water, peel and cut into bite size pieces.  Put potatoes in a large bowl.  Season with cracked black pepper, drizzling with about 2 tablespoons remaining olive oil from the tomatoes.  Toss to combine.  Spoon tomatoes and chiles over potatoes and toss.  Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour.  Grill vegetables about 20 minutes, or until tender and lightly charred, turning frequently.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: glace cherry,taco seasoning,corn flake,chicken stock,tortilla chip,yellow pepper
title: Sweet Corn Fritters
ingredients: 1 package taco seasoning | 1 can chicken stock | 1 package corn flakes | 1 yellow pepper, sliced | 1 can glace cherries, in can | tortilla chips ( optional )
instructions: Season the chicken, pepper and corn flakes with taco seasoning as directed on package.  Combine chicken stock and taco seasoning.  Spoon into heated fryer basket or saucepan until just barely hot.  Serve with tortilla chips if desired.

title: Japanese Beef Cutlets (Mimigarayaki) - (Mimigar)
ingredients: 5 lbs sirloin or 5 lbs flank steaks | 1/3 cup half-and-half | 1/4 cup mirin or 1/4 cup sweet rice wine | 2 cups breadcrumbs
instructions: Cut steaks across width into thin slices.  Mix half and half, mirin or sweet rice wine and bread crumbs and pour over steaks in a medium mixing bowl.  Cover with a double thickness of plastic wrap and shake well to coat.  Marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.  Heat a frying pan until very hot.  Add marinated beef and cook about 3 minutes over high heat.  They may have blood on the meat or do not cook at all.  They just continue to cook and when removed from heat, they will hold their shape.  Serve immediately with white or fried rice and a green salad.

title: Turkish Apricot Nests
ingredients: 12 dried apricots | 1/2 cup apricot jam or 1/2 cup apricot preserves | 1 lime, juice and grated lime, zest of | 1 teaspoon ground cumin | confectioners'sugar or powdered sugar | 1/8 teaspoon salt
instructions: Place whole apricots on a cloth or paper towel, then cover them with cold water and allow to soak for 10 minutes.  Remove the apricots, removing the stones, peel and cut them into quarters.  Spread the cut apricots in a sieve over a bowl, leave for ten minutes.  To clean the fruit, drain them, reserving the water, then rinse the apricots under cold running water.  Pat dry and chop finely or place in a food processor.  Add the jam, lime juice, cumin, 2 tbsp of the chopped dill and process to a smooth paste.  Transfer the mixture to a bowl and mix well.  To decorate the nests, place two spoonsful of the apricot mixture on the lower half of an apricot, top with the remaining apricot mixture and sprinkle with 1 tbsp confectioners sugar or powdered sugar.  Place in the refrigerator.

title: Egg and Radish Salad (Erdbeer Marillen)
ingredients: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 1/4 cup half-and-half cream | 1/4 cup dark seedless raisins | 1 -2 whole radish
instructions: Halve eggs lengthwise and scoop yolks.  Slice egg whites oranges in halves or quarters, depending on size of eggs.  Line large platter with radish halves or zest of an whole radish.  In tall glass bowl, place egg whites oranges, raisins or seeds and cream.  Add more or less to taste.  Let rest for 15 - 20 minutes or so before serving.

Random Ingredients: flour,vegetable,parmigiano reggiano cheese,salt pork,kielbasa sausage,onion powder
title: Polenta with Sausages
ingredients: 1 lb flour | 1 tablespoon salt, to taste | 1 large onion | 2 ounces sliced salt pork | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs kielbasa sausage | vegetables | parmigiano-reggiano cheese
instructions: On a deep cutting board, make a shallow cut around the inside of a heavy skillet with a sharp knife parallel to the bottom, about 1/4 inch deep.  Into the cut out hole in the center of your slit, sift the flour, 1 cup of the salt, and 1 1/2 to 3 cups cold water.

Random Ingredients: cornstarch,head cauliflower,garlic clove,pork shoulder blade roast,graham cracker crumb,yellow squash,tequila
title: Tequila Pork Roast
ingredients: 4 large bone-in pork shoulder blade roast | 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs | 1 head cauliflower | 1 large yellow squash | 3 garlic cloves | 2 tablespoons cornstarch, disolved in | 1/2 - 3/4 cup tequila
instructions: Make the crust by making crumbs set aside in a shallow bowl place cranbebi in cold water until ready to use.  In a deep bowl combine the graham cracker crumbs with the cracked graham cracker crumbs set aside.  Slice roast into 2 - 3 pieces place roast in crock pot, add all remaining ingredients to crock pot.  Cover with lid, cook on lo heat for 7 hours, or on hi heat for 4 - 5 hours or until fork tender.  Serve over prepared potato masher or rice.

title: Raspberry Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough | 1/4 cup rice wine
instructions: Spread rice wine over dough and rub it into a 12 in pizza dish.  Place pizza on bottom rack on your baking stone and preheat oven to 500 degrees f.  Place pizza on your rack on top rack and bake for 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and top with more rice wine.

title: Lebanese Mint Popsicles
ingredients: 6 -8 tablespoons grated coconut-flavored flavored coconut | 1/2 teaspoon dried mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  In small bowl, combine coconut powder, mint and coconut extract and mix well.  Use an ice cream scoop to scoop the foam from a rounded teaspoon of mixture into a cup with a spoon, forming small puffs of the rounded coconut on top.  Carefully remove the top cup.

Random Ingredients: spelt flour,chocolate liqueur godiva,parmesan cheese,lentil,thyme sprig,canola oil,peach,tahini
title: Lentil and Chocolate Crunch
ingredients: 1 bag dal and brown lentils, rinsed and drained | 3 tablespoons canola oil | 10 peach slices | 1/4 cup chocoholic gold chocolate liqueur ( i use godiva ) | 1/2 cup spelt flour, all purpose | 4 tablespoons tahini | fresh thyme sprig | freshly grated parmesan cheese
instructions: In a deep nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat.  Add lentils, brown lentils and stir to coat with oil.  Cover and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until lentils begin to color a little and lentils are crisp tender.  Stir in chocolate liqueur, flour, tahini and thyme.

title: Phyllo Triangles
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour tortillas, cut into squares | 24 sheets phyllo dough, thawed according to package directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper.  Place one sheet of phyllo dough, cut side up, on a stack of the two sheets of layered phyllo in front of each other.  Place 1 square of the tortillas on the tortillas and top with 1 tablespoon flour, allowing the edges to crimp slightly.  Repeat for the remaining two sheets of phyllo dough.  Repeat to make two additional triangles.  Place one pastry triangle on a baking sheet, and brush with the leftover 1 tablespoon of flour.  Repeat until the triangles are all layered.  Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon flour, and cover with another sheet of phyllo dough.  Press the triangles together with a fork.  Bake for about 8 minutes in the preheated oven, until crisp and golden brown.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper flake,kosher salt,parmigiano reggiano,chicken stock vegetable,celery root,swiss cheese,mint leaf
title: Minty Ricotta Soup
ingredients: 1/2 cup celery root, peeled cubed | 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced green swiss cheese | 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint leaves | 1/2 cup low-fat parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt | 1 pinch dried chili pepper flakes ( optional ) | 1 can reduced-sodium chicken stock or ( 10 1/2 ounce ) can vegetable stock
instructions: Place the celery root in a colander.  Press out the excess water.  Place the celery root in a large pan with the swiss cheese.  Sprinkle the mint, cheese, salt and chili flakes over top.  Add the stock.  Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer soup slightly covered for about 5 minutes.

title: Blackened Salmon With Spicy Spices
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, skinless and boneless | 1 tablespoon cocoa powder | 1/2 cup halved walnuts | 1/2 cup bamboo shoots, chopped | 1/2 cup carrot, finely shredded
instructions: Spread the cocoa evenly over the salmon fillets and set aside for 10 minutes.  Preheat an oven to 325° f.  Place walnuts in a small food processor and process until finely ground.  Add the walnuts, bamboo shoots, carrot, and cocoa powder and process until smooth.  Place fish on a rack in a roasting pan.  Spoon remaining sauce over fish.  Roast for about 20 minutes, basting once or twice during the cooking process.  Note, to make roasted walnuts, preheat the oven to 375°f place walnuts in a metal or glass baking dish and roast for about 5 minutes or until golden.

title: Rice, Swiss & Swiss Cheese With Jasmine
ingredients: 1 box jasmine rice | 4 ounces swiss cheese | 1 bunch of fresh mint
instructions: Put rice on to boil, add mint and boil for about 5 minutes until all water is absorbed and rice is cooked.  Drain and fluff up rice with fork.  Add swiss cheese and mix until cheese is melted.  Serve on plate with a fresh green salad.

title: Stove Top soymilk and Goat Cheese Fudge-Soy Dip
ingredients: 3 cups soymilk | 2 tablespoons smooth goat cheese, such as manchego | 1 brown onion
instructions: Preheat the grill pan to 325 degrees f.  In a large bowl, whisk soymilk, cheese, and onion together.  Scrape the dip into a pie plate or shallow soup bowl.  Place a piece of cheese on top, and press until the dip is slightly flat around the edges.  Let sit for about 10 minutes, then wrap the plate or bowl around it, and return it to the grill or set on the rack over a burner.  Grill until the cheese is melted and bubbling, 3 to 5 minutes.

title: Meatball Patties
ingredients: 1 lb cooked ground lamb | 6 egg whites | 3 large carrots, finely chopped
instructions: Mix together the meat, egg whites and carrots.  Shape into patties about 1 - 2 inches in diameter and 1 1/2 inches in diameter.  Cook over hot coals, turning over once, until cooked through.

title: Chinese Pork and Snow Peas (Oma's Recipe)
ingredients: 4 thick-cut pork loin chops | 4 slices bacon, chopped | 8 ounces snow peas, trimmed | 2 tablespoons shortening or 2 tablespoons oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Line a 9x13 inch baking dish with aluminum foil, then spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Place the pork chops in a shallow baking dish.  Place the bacon, snow peas and fat in a separate dish.

Random Ingredients: poultry seasoning,brown rice,red chili paste,vegetable,pearl barley
title: Nana's Vegetable & Pepperbar
ingredients:
1 cup brown rice | 1 cup pearl barley | 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables ( i like a mix of red, green & red cabbage ) | 1/2 - 1 teaspoon red chili paste ( depending on taste pref.
    - i use 1 ) | 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning
instructions: Brown rice and barley in skillet with vegetable oil.  Add chili paste and stir all ingredients together.  Simmer 20 - 30 minutes or until vegetables are softened.

Random Ingredients: black mustard seed,red raspberry preserve,cream celery soup
title: Roasted Red Raspberry Mustard
ingredients: 1 teaspoon black mustard seed | 1 can condensed cream of celery soup | 2 1/2 cups diced red raspberry preserves
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Sprinkle mustard seeds onto the prepared prepared baking sheet.  In a bowl, mix together the cream of celery soup and the preserves.  Fold mustard seed mixture into the celery soup, and spread evenly onto the prepared baking sheet.  Bake in the preheated oven 25 minutes, or until mustard is crisp and mustard is lightly browned on the edges.  Cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes.

title: Marinated Oysters With Canola Oil
ingredients:
12 cleaned oysters | 1 tablespoon coarsely chopped fresh marjoram ( or 1 tsp.
    - dried ) | 1 -2 tablespoon canola oil
instructions: Clean the oysters, removing any cracked shells and mollies.  Place in a plastic bag.  Add the marjoram and mix to mix.  Let stand 1 - 2 days, shaking occasionally.  Prepare canola oil by heating oil to 365 degrees fahrenheit and shaking gently.  Drain oysters and toss with marjoram mixture.  Serve at room temperature with oysters.

title: Gujarati (Beef Tenderloin With Green Tomatoes)
ingredients: 3 tablespoons chat masala ( available at indian stores ) | 4 garlic cloves, minced | 3 -4 firm green tomatoes, sliced | 1/2 cup sliced fresh banana | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed of fat
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the chaat masala over the beef and coat evenly.  Set aside at room temperature for 30 minutes, turning occasionally.  Preheat broiler.  Broil the beef in a baking dish in a preheated oven about 3 - 4 inches from the heat as close to the heat as possible for 5 - 7 minutes and watch carefully so the dish does not burn.  Turn the beef over and broil another 2 - 3 minutes, and check again for doneness.  It should practically fall apart when cooked.  Transfer the beef to a platter, cover and keep warm in the oven until all the juices have dried up.  Pour off the accumulated fat from the pan onto a paper towel to drain.  Use a slotted spoon to discard the fat from the meat and discard it.  Toss the meat gently with the juices that have collected.  Add the garlic and the sliced tomatoes and allow to sweat inches.  Slice the beef thinly and serve over plain rice and warm indian curries, or with any curry.  Note, feel free to prepare this in advance to allow flavors to blend in the lamb.

title: Baby Red Potatoes in Coriander (Deeh)
ingredients: 10 small baby red potatoes | 1 teaspoon coriander powder | 2/3 teaspoon chili oil
instructions: First, add the coriander, chili oil and salt to the potatoes and wash them well.  In a deep fry vessel of medium high heat, add a tablespoon of oil to it.  When the oil is ready, add the baby potatoes until just about half cooked or slightly less cooked, turning them over a few times.  When the potatoes are a little crisped on the outside, the oil is ready.  Serve the baby red potatoes on a plate with a crunchy salad and chopped fresh chutney if you like.

Random Ingredients: sugar,milk ricotta cheese,egg noodle,egg white,apple cider vinegar,grain dijon mustard
title: Apple-Ricotta Noodle Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 cup whole grain dijon mustard | 1/4 cup whole milk ricotta cheese | 1 egg white, lightly beaten | 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar | 1/3 cup granulated sugar | 1/2 cup sugar | 1 lb egg noodles, cooked and drained
instructions: Whisk together mustard, ricotta, egg white, vinegar and 1/3 cup granulated sugar until blended.

title: Pumpkin Sausage
ingredients: 5 lbs pumpkin, cleaned | 3 -5 teaspoons garlic powder
instructions: Heat oven to 325 f.  Cut pumpkin into chunks.  Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper.  Place pumpkin in 2 large roasting pans.  Sprinkle generously with garlic powder.  Bake 1 hour and 15 minutes.  If you want to make a thicker gravy, roast 1 hour longer at 300 degrees f.  For a thicker gravy, simmer to reduce in half.

title: Pine Nut & White Baked Green Peas
ingredients: 3 cups canned english peas, rinsed and drained | 4 whole wheat hamburger buns, split and toasted | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, toasted
instructions: Combine peas, bread, and pine nuts.

title: Spanish-Style Broth
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable broth | 2 yellow peppers, thinly sliced | 2 teaspoons mixed herbs
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the broth to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium.  Add the yellow peppers and season with pepper.  Cover and simmer 10 minutes.  Stir in the mixed herbs.

Random Ingredients: tea,baking potato,button mushroom,serrano pepper,cheddar cheese,peanut oil,mandarin orange,romaine lettuce leaf
title: Potato-Mushroom Fritters
ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, sliced | 1 package sliced fresh button mushrooms | 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 4 fresh serrano peppers, sliced | 8 slices cheddar cheese | 8 large leaves romaine lettuce leaves | 1 can mandarin oranges, drained | 1/2 cup brewed tea
instructions: Cover potatoes with salted water and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes.  Drain, and set aside.  When cool enough to handle, remove skin and coarsely chop.  Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Add mushrooms and serrano peppers.

title: Tex Mex-Styled Tilapia
ingredients: 4 tilapia fillets | 2 tablespoons sunflower oil | 1 cup taco seasoning mix | 2 tablespoons cornstarch
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle fish with taco seasoning.  Saute for 3 to 5 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,nectarine,jalapeno,apple juice,corn kernel,pita bread,chunky salsa
title: Apple Nectarine Salsa Salad
ingredients: 2 pita bread, cut into wedges | 2 tablespoons chunky salsa | 1 small nectarine, cut into small wedges | 1 can sliced bamboo shoots, drained, rinsed and cut crosswise into thin slices | 1 jalapeno, sliced -or- | 1 apple -peeled apple | 1/4 cup frozen corn kernels
instructions: Arrange pita wedges onto a serving platter.  Place nectarines, bamboo shoots, jalapeños and sliced apple in a small bowl.  Pour salsa over the top and toss lightly with a fork.  Transfer to plates and top with corn kernels.

title: Asparagus Espresso Muffins
ingredients: 1 teaspoon unflavored gelatin | 1/2 cup espresso coffee | 2 tablespoons champagne | 2 -3 limes, juice of or 2 -3 lemons, juice of ( to taste ) | 1 ounce baking chocolate, semisweet or 1 ounce bittersweet chocolate, chopped | champagne or espresso cordial, to serve
instructions: To prepare the gelatin, dissolve unflavoured gelatin in a little boiling water and cool to room temperature.  Measure the brewed coffee into a small bowl.  Dissolve it in the coffee and then set aside.  Wash the two limes, remove the peel and then slice them into thin rounds.  Bring the champagne and lime juice to a boil over high heat.  Remove from the heat and add the berry rounds.  Cool for 5 to 10 minutes.  Add teh chocolate and stir very lightly.  Fill 12 to 16 muffin cups with the asparagus mixture.  You can chill them until you want, up to 5 days.  Serve with champagne or espresso cordial.

title: Chinese Steamed Coffee (Chai Ew)
ingredients: 1 cup hot coffee | 1 teaspoon ground coffee, or as desired | salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Prepare your steamer baskets by placing the steamer basket on the table in the sink, and cover tightly with cheese cloth.  Place the basket in the dish with water to just below the bottom of the steamer basket.  Bring water to a boil, and immediately move the cover over the steamer basket to carry steaming water, creating steam holes and steam holes in the steamer.  If your steamer baskets aren't big enough, cut them into 3 or 4 smaller lengths.  Place the covered steamer basket into the sink, and steam for 3 minutes to loosen the grounds of coffee.  If you would like a thicker chai, use a strainer or a fine mesh sieve to collect some of the grounds off the sides of the cloth.  Rinse under cold water, and remove the strings.  Slice the remaining chai into long, thin strips, and place near the end near the base of each serving plate.  Spoon 1 teaspoon of ground coffee onto each warmed chai strip, and sprinkle with salt and pepper to serve.

title: Tunisian Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil | 2 -3 lbs lamb shoulder, trimmed of all fat
instructions: Heat oil in a medium sized pot adding lamb shoulder.  Cook meat slowly uncovered slowly until meat is tender and most of the fat has drained off.  When meat is tender, transfer lamb to a baking dish that will hold it together and cover with aluminum foil.  Pour oil over it and refrigerate overnight for better penetration.  The next day, transfer lamb to a roasting pan, and bake in preheated 400°f oven for about 3 hours.  Check the internal temperature of the meat at this point by removing the thickest part of the meat.

title: Baby Bok Choy Soup
ingredients: 10 -11 baby bok choy | 1/2 cup of minced meat ( i use beef ) | 3 egg yolks
instructions: Steam the baby bok choy for 3 - 4 minutes.  Mix egg yolks with 2/3 cup of water.  Add to bok choy and boil covered for 3 - 4 minutes.  Mix meat with egg yolk mixture and pour into bowl.  Enjoy.

title: Cranberry Gravy
ingredients: 1 cup cranberry juice | 1/2 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, diced | 1/8 teaspoon pepper ( to taste ) | 1/8 teaspoon caraway seed | 1/2 cup broth ( i use the meat )
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a small saucepan, and cook over low heat, stirring slowly just above the liquid, until the flavors have blended and the caraway seeds are very fragrant, about 20 minutes, depending on the thickness of your cranberry gravy.  Use as you like with your favourite vegetables.

Random Ingredients: oil,russet potato,pear,nori,chili pepper flake,peanut oil vegetable,margarita mix
title: Nori Onigiri (Potatoes With Pear)
ingredients: 4 -5 russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/4-by-1/2-inch strips | 1 pear, peeled and sliced | 1 -2 tablespoon oil | 4 tablespoons peanut oil, divided, divided | 1/2 teaspoon pepper flakes | 1/2 onion | 4 nori ( dry seaweed ), sheets
instructions: Slice potato and pears into thin strips about 1/4 inch wide.  Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium heat.  Add 2 tbsp oil and the potato and pears.  Gently fry the seasoned potato strips about 3 - 4 minutes or until crispy.  Remove the strips, keep hot.  In a separate pan, heat the remaining oil.  Add the pepper flakes and the onion.  Season with salt and pepper.  Sweat the onion until translucent, about 3 - 4 minutes.  Add to the heated bowl with the vegetable mixture.  While stirring constantly, cover and let stand for 1 - 2 minutes.  Fill a bowl with warm water and stir in the nori sheets.  When the nori is softened, drain off any excess water and quickly dry.  Sprinkle with more coarsely chopped peanuts or dried nori.  Cut nori sheets into squares about 4 inches wide.  Dunk the square in the warm water and remove as much water as possible.  Place a nori square on a cutting board and cut into 4 wedges and place in a warm serving platter.  Serve at once.

title: Tortilla Chips With Veggies
ingredients: 1 can bean sprouts | 1 whole grain tortilla
instructions: Take a tortilla.  Smear it with about 2 tablespoons of bean sprouts and 2 tablespoons of veggie mix.  Put it on a large baking sheet.  Bake at 325º for 10 minutes.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,colby monterey jack cheese,fontina cheese,pineapple juice,corn syrup
title: Chiles Verde
ingredients: 1/4 cup light corn syrup | 1/2 cup unsweetened pineapple juice | 1/2 cup shredded fontina cheese | 1/2 cup shredded colby-monterey jack cheese | 4 poblano chiles, stems and seeds removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 degrees f.  Pour pineapple juice into a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle the fontina cheese and colby monterey jack cheeses onto the juice.  Using tongs, poke holes in the chiles with a fork.  Pour pineapple juice over the chiles.  Bake in the preheated oven 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted and dark, bubbly and a little browned.

title: Chocolate Tisane
ingredients: 3 unsweetened chocolate squares, chopped | 1 ounce jamaican jerk spice
instructions: Heat a small saucepan over medium heat.  Add all of the chocolate and let melt.  Remove from heat and, stirring occasionally, set aside.  Break each square into pieces with a rolling pin.  Coat each piece of chocolate with the jerk spice and place onto parchment paper lined tray.  Let them set at room temperature for about 2 hours.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: ra el hanout spice mix,catsup,ginger garlic paste
title: Parsley Pesto Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup catsup | 1/4 cup ra el hanout spice mix | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste
instructions: Stir all of the ingredients together.  Let flavors meld, then store in a container.

Random Ingredients: maraschino cherry,lime wedge,coffee,pea,gruyere cheese,pecorino romano cheese,cottage cheese
title: Miniature Cappuccino Nests
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups light fat cottage cheese | 1/2 cup freshly grated gruyere cheese | 1 cup freshly grated pecorino romano cheese | 1/2 cup finely chopped maraschino cherry | 3/4 cup freshly brewed strong coffee | 1 large lime wedge | 12 miniature party size fresh pecorino romano cookies or 12 small romano cookies ( 6x3 inches to fit the bottoms of the loaves )
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f degrees on a baking sheet.  In a food processor, combine the cottage cheese, gruyere and 1 cup of the pecorino romano cheeses, 1 cup of the cherry cherries, and 1 tablespoon of the coffee until well combined.  Place in an airtight plastic bag, and squirt in the lime wedge at the neck and body cavities.  Seal the bag, and leave the mixture in the bag, turning over once.  Place the bag, inside the bag, on the baking sheet.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until just heated.  Remove from the oven, and add the mini party size pecorino romano cookies.  Serve immediately, piling each mini romano cookie atop another crumb or two.

title: Mock Cheddar and Avocado Sandwiches
ingredients: 2 slices rustic country bread | 1 avocado, peeled, pitted and sliced | 1 can bamboo shucked with juice | 1 lemon, juiced | 1 tablespoon peeled grated fresh ginger | 3 slices pickled ginger
instructions: Cut the bread diagonally into triangles and place them on a baking sheet.  In a small bowl, mix together the avocado, bamboo shucked juice, lemon juice and freshly grated ginger.  Spread half the bread triangles with the avocado mixture, then top with the rest of the bread triangles.  Chill until serving.

Random Ingredients: poppy seed,tahini,focaccia bread,purpose flour,olive oil,thyme leaf
title: Focaccia Bread with Tahini and Tahini
ingredients: 1 package refrigerated crumb-coat focaccia bread | 1/2 cup all-purpose flour | 1/4 cup light olive oil | 1/4 cup light tahini | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme leaves | 1 tablespoon poppy seeds | 1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Sprinkle both sides of focaccia bread with 1/4 cup all purpose flour, and shake off any excess.  Cut focaccia into 16 slices.  Place bread onto prepared baking sheet.  In a medium bowl, whisk 1/4 cup light olive oil, tahini, and thyme leaves together with a fork. instructions: Cut the brisket into 12 pieces, 1 inch thick.  Place the beef in a deep, heavy dutch oven.  Add enough ice water to cover the beef, and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer partially covered, over low heat, for about 2 hours.  Pour off any excess water.  Drain the beef and discard the bones and skin.  Set the beef on a cutting board and slice thinly across the grain.  Heat the oil in a 10 - 12 inch skillet over high heat until a deep golden brown crust forms on the top, about 5 minutes.  Quickly invert a dinner plate on the beef.  Drain off any excess oil.  Spread some sliced beef on the plate with your fingers.  Arrange some rice on top.  Place a few dried dates on top of that.  Sprinkle slices of beef on top and garnish with a few dried dates, if desired.

title: Pork and Shrimp Stewed in Green Ginger Choy
ingredients: 500 g shrimp, small to medium size | 150 g pork and shrimps | 6 medium dried shrimp, heads and tails discarded, peeled | 200 g canned italian tomatoes or 400 g canned tomatoes, including juice | 200 ml vinegar | 1 teaspoon ground ginger | 1 teaspoon garlic, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon crushed gingerroot | 5 -6 mint leaves | capers, for sprinkling
instructions: Peel and devein the shrimp.  Rinse in a cup of water.  Rinse.  Shell and devein the shrimp.  Using a small sharp knife, slice the shrimp in half lengthwise.  Remove shells and heads from the shrimp.  The shells should be just slightly open.  Heat a small amount of oil in a wok or large frying pan.  Add the shrimp and shrimps.  Stir fry for 5 minutes.  Add the tomatoes, capsicum, ginger, and garlic.  Stir fry for 3 - 4 minutes.  Add the shrimp heads and heads and the wine.  Stir fry for 3 - 5 minutes, or until the shrimp and shrimps have all changed color.  Add the ginger and garlic, stir, add the mint leaves, and continue to stir until heated through.  Turn off the heat and serve with hot steamed rice, garnished with capers.

title: Smokey Mexican Penne Pasta
ingredients: 3 tablespoons island dressing | 1 tablespoon flour | 3 -4 tablespoons liquid smoke | 2/3 cup canola or 2/3 cup canola oil | 2 cans whole kernel corn, drained | 1 cup grated parmesean cheese | 1/2 - 1 large red fresh lime, cut in 8 slices
instructions: Saute corn in dressing over medium heat in a large skillet.  When corn is almost done add corn to skillet and blend it together and cook, stirring occasionally until sauce is thick and creamy.  Continue to add canola oil over the corn mixture.  Stir in corn and continue cooking until heated through.  Dish and top with parmesean croutons and fresh lime slices on the side if desired.

title: Homemade French Fries (Peppered Onions)
ingredients: 1/2 white onion | 2 1/2 pumpernickel bread rounds ( you may use pumpernickel for that extra spice ) | olive oil
instructions: Peel a small, heavy onion, slice the onion into thin half moons, then slice very thinlly and then cut in half again and then cut in half again, again this way you have the same length between slices, if using pumpernickel cut out the thicker slice, and then slice the slices into thin strips, about the width of your pointer finger.  Brush with a little olive oil, and allow to sit at room temp.  This is nice, and a nice way to fry, too.  Heat some oil in a fry pan, on medium low.  If you want, you can just fry the onion strips until they are just starting to turn slightly golden, then take them out and set them aside.  Remove onions from oil and allow to cool slightly.  If using pumpernickel cut out the thicker cut, and then coat with some olive oil, so they look like this.  Heat about 1/3 cup olive oil in pan, and fry the onions until lightly golden brown, then remove from the pan.  Allow onions to cool slightly before you fry the bread, about 20 - 30 minutes.  Drain bread on paper towels.  Reheat pan to medium low, and fry bread slices until they get crisp and golden.  This will usually take about 5 - 10 minutes.  Note, if your oven is not big enough, you may want to use a convection bake, so you may need to cook the bread at a faster temperature.  If you use pumpernickel cut out the thicker slice or your slices will get mushy.  You may also turn up the heat a little towards the end, so the breads will sizzle and get crisp.  They may also look very crispy, so make sure to watch them carefully before flipping them.  If frying the bread slices first, you may have to turn up the heat, this is easy, just let the heat get slightly more intense and then turn the heat up again just a few minutes to get that deep brown finish, and then set aside.

title: Spanish Pepper and Artichoke Stew
ingredients: 2 1/4 lbs fresh ripe sweet bell peppers | 2 tablespoons tapioca flour | 3/4 cup vegetable stock | 1 cup dry marsala or 1 cup sweet marsala | 1/2 cup cold water
instructions: Wash the peppers well under running cold water, being careful not to let the skins touch.  Slit the pepper lengthwise, scrape out the seeds and white membrane, and cut into 1/2 inch dice.  Place the peppers and salt in a heavy large pot.  Add the water, cover the pot, then cook over low heat until the pepper is soft, about 20 minutes.  Drain, discard the cooking liquid, and set the pepper aside.  Pour off 1 cup of the liquid from the pot, and heat the pot over moderately low heat, stirring, to dislodge any browned bits.  Stir the flour into the hot pepper liquid, then cook over moderately low heat, pressing the flour over the surface with a wooden spoon, until the mixture is well blended but is still colored.  Boil the mixture 10 minutes.  Add the marsala and cook, stirring constantly, until it is thickened.  Stir in the pepper, cover, and set aside to cool slightly.  Transfer the pepper stew to a serving bowl.  Cool completely, then cover and chill 3 hours or up to 3 days ahead.

title: Beef Tarragon
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless beef chuck, cut into 1-inch slices | 2 tablespoons lemon juice ( fresh is best- not canned ) | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon, dried
instructions: Lay beef slices into a glass baking dish in a single layer.  In a bowl, combine the lemon juice and tarragon.  Pour over beef in dish.  Cover tightly and refrigerate for 2 to 4 days.  Turn oven to 375 degrees f.  Uncover beef and bake about 3 hours or until meat is tender.

title: Southern Fried Cabbage
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups milk | 10 ounces of finely shredded green cabbage | 2 medium tomatoes | 1 can whole green cabbage, drained | 1/4 cup dry white wine vinegar | 4 teaspoons ground black pepper
instructions: In a saucepan of a double boiler, heat the milk on medium heat.  When the milk is nearly to boiling, stir in the shredded green cabbage and chopped tomatoes.  Cook gently but steadily until the cabbage is cooked to your desired texture.  Stir in the whole green cabbage, cover, and remove from the heat.  Allow to stand for approximately 20 minutes.  Drain cabbage thoroughly, but not too often as it may get sticky.  Place the cooked cabbage back in the saucepan, stir in the vinegar, and season with pepper.  Heat the sauce until it is bubbling again, and serve warm, with additional freshly ground black pepper.

Random Ingredients: garlic clove,green chilies,broccoli,marjoram,corn oil,parsley leaf,turkey gravy

title: Spinach and Pineapple Pie
ingredients:

Allow to rest 10 minutes before cutting into squares.

title: Garlic Croutons, Breaded Dry French Fingers

title: Tequila Raisin English Muffin Rounds
ingredients: 1 package fast rise yeast | 1/2 cup tequila | 2 cups hot brewed tea | 1 can pineapple chunks | 1/4 teaspoon red chili pepper flakes | 2 english muffins
instructions: Dissolve yeast in the tequila.  Then put it in a large mixing bowl and add 2 cups warm water.  Mix well, cover and set aside for 10 minutes.  Drain pineapple, reserving tidbits.  Pour tea into a large, heavy sauce pan, add pineapple slices, chili flakes and red pepper flakes.  Bring to a boil, then let it boil until it has thickened enough to coat the back of a spoon.  Keep warm.  Beat the reserved pineapple juice until thick enough to make a pouring consistency, adding it gradually until you have a creamy consistency.  When the yeast mixture has foamed, gradually stir it and into the tequila and warm water, beating as you go.  Cover and set aside to rest for 20 minutes.  Lightly grease a large baking sheet.  With a floured hands, shape the dough into round or oval patties.  Cut the dough into strips with scissors.  Place about 1 - 2 teaspoons of pineapple, 1 tablespoon of red pepper flakes, 1 tablespoon of tequila or 1 tablespoon other seasoning, 1 tablespoon of red pepper flakes or seasoning, 1 teaspoon of tequila or seasoning and 1 tablespoon of red pepper flakes in the center of each.  Fold up the outer circle of the dough around the pineapple to enclose the filling.  Fold the bottom corners over the filling.  Lightly oil the tops of the patties.  Place the patties on the prepared baking sheet and cover with a tea towel.  Let rise until tripled in bulk, about 45 - 60 minutes.  Heat a grill.  When hot, grill the patties 5 - 6 minutes, turning once, until browned.  Remove and place on a paper towel lined tray to let cool.  These should serve great on their own or with ketchup and salsa.

title: Spicy Cabbage Rolls & Prawns
ingredients: 1 packet brown rice | 4 slices white bread | 1 packet red curry paste ( i use thai kitchen brand ) | 2 tablespoons crushed diced peeled pimiento | 2 spring onions, spring onion greens ( optional ) | 1 teaspoon curry powder
instructions: Cook rice according to packet instructions.  Meanwhile, heat a small non stick frying pan over low medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes, or until hot.  Add curry paste to the pan and then stir fry for 30 seconds or until fragrant.  Remove from heat.  Drain any excess water off the dry rice, then spread the rice evenly on a chopping board.  Cut each slice of bread into three thick slices.  Arrange over the rice on a cutting board.  Using your fingers, gently push together the rice to make a flat shape – this will hold shape.  Place a handful of prawns, prawns or other raw side meat into the centre.  Wrap the bacon rashers around the rice and prawns.  Secure with wooden picks or toothpicks, if using.  Heat a non stick frying pan over high heat for 2 - 3 minutes.  Add the curry paste and cook for a second.  Stir in the pimento and spring onion.  Stir fry for 1 minute.  Stir in the curry powder and serve immediately or cool completely and serve straight away.

title: Pomegranate Baked Pizza
ingredients: 1 pizza dough ( homemade or store bought ) | 2 pomegranate, seeded | 1/3 cup pomegranate juice ( pomegranate granate ) | 2 teaspoons coconut extract | 4 slices pepperoni
instructions: Preheat oven to 500 degrees fahrenheit.  Brush pizza dough out onto a pizza pan lined with parchment paper.  If there is any dough left in the pan, use it to bake on a pizza pan.  If not use your hands to press it on the dough.  Cut rounds with a pizza cutter about 10, or your fingers.  If there is any dough left on the pizza, slice the dough rounds into quarters, making sure the ends are connected.  If not, cut the dough circles into quarters.  Place pomegranate seeds in a small bowl.  Sprinkle with pomegranate juice and coconut extract.  Place pizza dough quarters on pizza pan.  Bake for 8 minutes, or until crusts are lightly browned.  Remove from oven and top with pepperoni slices.  Serve warm.

title: Easy Honey Glazed Beef Burritos
ingredients: 1 - 1 1/2 lb boneless chuck roast, 2 3/4 | 1 bell pepper, sliced | 3/4 cup honey | 3 3/4 - 4 teaspoons beef bouillon cubes, 2 1/2-3 ( or 3 beef bouillon cubes ) | 1 -2 tortillas ( depending on size )
instructions: Place the roast under a broiler and brush with enough of the honey to coat.  Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes.  Remove roast from oven and tent with foil to rest.  Remove the foil, stir the beef broth.  Heat broth to boiling and pour over the meat.  Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 hours or until meat pulls apart with a fork.  To assemble your burritos, place the tortillas on warm tortillas and top with a few slices of roast, a drizzle of honey, some of the broth from the roast and some of the beef broth.  Roll up tightly and serve.

title: Tarragon Style Chili Bites
ingredients: 12 ounces hamburger | 2 ounces tahini | 2 cans minced clams with juice | 1 large onion, finely chopped | 1 small red chile pepper, seeded and chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh tarragon vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Place hamburger, tahini, and minced clams into a 9 x 13 inch baking dish and mix well.  Gently mix in onion, red chile pepper, and chopped tarragon vinegar.  Bake in preheated oven until warm, about 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: greek yogurt,lobster meat,rice wine vinegar,chili pepper,garlic,red chile pepper
title: Lobster and Chile Salad
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked lobster meat | 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt | 1 tablespoon chile-pepper seasoning blend, or to taste | 1 clove garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar | 1 fresh red chile peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Place lobster in a large pot of boiling water.  Cook for 1 minute, then rinse with cold water.  Chop fine and place in a bowl.  In a medium saucepan over low heat, stir together yogurt, hot pepper seasoning blend, garlic, and rice wine vinegar until smooth and creamy.  Place chile pepper in a mini chopper or food processor.

Random Ingredients: olive oil,orange liqueur,chicken stock powder,cream chicken soup,peanut oil
title: Creamy Peanut Garlic Roasted Chicken
ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil | 1/2 cup peanut oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons chicken stock powder | 1 can cream of chicken soup ( or cream of mushroom soup ) | 1 tablespoon orange liqueur
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°.  In a small bowl, mix together peanut oil, chicken stock salt and pepper.  Add broth powder to cream soup.  Mixture should just be in the thickest bits of food on top.  Spread mixture on a foil covered cookie sheet.  Place in oven, and when ready to go on, heat the remaining soup mixture on low until it boils.  Remove foil, then whisk mixture into soup.  Place chicken on the warm cookie sheet.  Sprinkle the peanut sauce on top of chicken.  Do not bake.  Place in oven and bake for around 35 minutes.  Serve over rice.

title: Creamed Celery
ingredients: 20 thick slices white bread, crust removed | 5 sticks celery, with leaves | salt and ground black pepper to taste | 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce | 8 biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Slice bread into cubes.  Place in a bowl, and coat bread cubes with Worcestershire sauce.  Lay out about 1 tablespoon of celery on a piece of bread.  Cover with about 1 tablespoon of celery, and squeeze some more than you can.  Top with a second piece of bread, and squeeze more celery.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.  Place one biscuit on top of a stick of celery.  Fold over, and seal to create a closed lid.  Repeat with remaining slices.  Bake in the preheated oven until browned on top, 15 to 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: vegetable,white wine,white onion,kaffir lime leaf,milk chocolate chip,cocoa powder,wine vinegar
title: Chocolate Lullaby
ingredients: 1/2 small white onion | 1 1/3 cups milk chocolate chips | 1/3 cup sweet wine ( chardonnay ) | 1 green cardamom ( pod ) ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 5 fresh kaffir lime leaves | 1/4 cup vegetable oil or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, for deep frying
instructions: Put onion in a medium sauce pan.  Pour over chopped chocolate chips.  Boil for 5 - 10 minutes or until chocolate has completely melted.  Add 1/3 cup sweet wine and cook for 1 minute or until mixture is smooth, stirring constantly.  Add chopped lime leaves and continue cooking until the liquid boils off.  Remove from heat.  Dip kaffir leaves in hot oil.  Dry on paper towels, or in a paper bag, set aside.  When ready to serve, stir in remaining sauce ingredients.  Serve warm.

title: Scroggin' (Cocktail)
ingredients: 8 hard-boiled eggs, chopped ( not hard boiled eggs ) | 1 lb rye bread, sliced into 1/3-inch slices | 1 lb turnip, cubed | 1 bottle apple juice
instructions: Crack egg yolks and set aside.  Boil cornbread in water with salt.  Turnip is cooked when tender and breaks apart.  Place rye bread on cookie sheet and let cool until light brown.  Drain and dry with paper towels.  Slice egg whites and stir into cornbread.  Fold egg whites into mixture.  Refrigerate one hour before serving.  Note, rye bread may be used in place of hard boiled eggs.

title: Grilled Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium baking potatoes, peeled | 3 medium whole canned tomatoes | 12 slices bacon ( or turkey bacon ) | 12 slices turkey breast | 1/3 cup pecans or 1/3 cup walnuts | 3 tablespoons tamari | 4 tablespoons tamari | 3 tablespoons oil
instructions: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a skillet and fry the potatoes until the potatoes are soft with a hint of color, 1 - 2 minutes on each side.  Take the potatoes and drain them.  Dice the tomatoes and put them in the skillet.  Cut the bacon into 1/2 slices and add to it.  Add the turkey and pepper.  Add the walnuts.  Cut the tamari into 1/2 strips and add it to the tomato mixture.  Add the remaining tamari to the tomato and herb mixture and stir well.  Cover and leave to marinate for 3 - 4 hours or overnight.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: pita bread,sesame oil,tuna oil,olive,picante sauce,lettuce,hamburger,tomato paste
title: Spanish Style Burger
ingredients: 1 lb hamburger ( i used 1/4 lb but i like to add more ) | 8 ounces tuna in oil | 1 tablespoon tomato paste ( i think heinz is the best ) | 6 pita bread ( i use the whole package ) | 1/4 cup olive, chopped | 1 teaspoon sesame oil | 4 teaspoons picante sauce | 1 lettuce, shredded
instructions: Prepare pita bread slices by preheating them in a pan according to the directions on the pita package.  Set aside.  Combine hamburger, tuna, tomato paste, olives and sesame oil.  Pulverize mixture well by pulsing in a food processor or blender.  I used two forks, but you may need even more of anything.  If you use wooden hands, it shouldn't be sticky but the texture should be fairly firm.  I used my mini food prep chopper, not your regular pita bread.  Sprinkle a little sesame oil at a time onto the pan, and place burger onto pita to form a bun.  Top with lettuce and tomato and enjoy.

title: Taco Bell  Spanish Bread Skillet
ingredients: 4 navel oranges | 1 medium bell pepper, diced | 1 packet taco seasoning | 1 cup polenta, for polenta | 1 tablespoon fresh grape | 1 -2 chipotle chile, chopped and seeded ( more or less to taste )
instructions: Cook peppers in boiling water for 5 - 7 minutes, remove and set aside to cool.  Cut all orange zest into quarters and put into food processor or food processor along with orange zest and cook slowly for 3 - 5 minutes or until the oranges are soft but not completely transparent.  With processor running add taco salt or other desired seasonings, and pour into large bowl.  Add bell pepper, taco seasoning and polenta, and pulse until combined.  Add grape, and pulse until blended.  Put mixture in large casserole dish that has been sprayed with non fat cooking spray.  Cover with tin foil and bake at 400 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes.  Remove from oven and spread mixture of orange and corn mix onto bread, sprinkle with green onions and enjoy.

title: Avocado & Veal Fritters
ingredients: 2 compressed yeast cakes | 1 1/2 cups vegetable juice cocktail | 2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 avocado, peeled, seeded & broken into bite sized chunks | 1 bunch fresh basil, roughly chopped
instructions: Crumble yeast into a large mixing bowl.  Add veggie juice cocktail & vanilla & mix thoroughly.  Work in the avocado & season to taste.  Cover & allow to ferment in a warm place for 10 - 12 hours.  When ready to use roll handfuls of the mixture into balls approx the size of large walnuts, then flatten slightly & place on greased baking tray.  Cover & allow to prove in a warm place for 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve as an appetiser or as an accompaniment to savoury meat dishes.

title: Raspberry Salsa for Two!

title: Cauliflower and Beef Brisket

instructions: Cook spaghetti in a pot of boiling water till al dente.
