title: Easy Tangy Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken thighs | 3 cups pomegranate juice | 1 cup barbecue sauce | 1 cup chopped green tomatoes, drained | 1 tablespoon dried tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Combine the pomegranate juice, barbeque sauce, tomatoes, tarragon, and red pepper in a large glass container.  Toss the chicken with the dressing until evenly coated.  Cover, and refrigerate until the flavors are blended and the flavors have blended, about 3 hours.  Preheat grill for high heat.  Place the chicken on the grill, and cook and reduce heat to low, basting every 5 minutes while cooking, 1 minute to 1 minute.

title: Crispy Rice Nests
ingredients: 2 cups uncooked basmati rice | 1 1/2 cups mini rice krispies | 4 ounces fresh crab or 4 ounces frozen crab | 1 1/2 cups prepared roasted broccoli, cut pieces | 1 bunch baby greens or 1 bunch kale | 1/2 bunch spring onion, chopped | green onion, diced extra ( optional ) | mixed spring onion ( optional )
instructions: Wash rice krispies by placing in a bowl with boiling water.  Add more water if necessary to separate.  When rice is tender, drain well.  Spray a large, flat nonstick frying pan with cooking spray.  Stir fry crab, broccoli and green onion over medium heat until crab has heated through.  When cooked, drain crab and discard any excess oil from pan.  Spray the nonstick pan again and stir fry rice krispies until rice is golden brown.  Add cooked rice, crab mixture and green onion.  Gently stir.  Serve hot or cold.

title: Homemade French Dijon-Pour
ingredients: 2 cups cooking wine | 1 quart broth, low sodium ( i use low sodium if i'm not on a diet ) or 1 quart water ( i'm not on a diet ) | 1/4 cup molasses ( more if i'm not on a diet ) | 1 teaspoon garlic granules or 1 teaspoon ginger | 2 teaspoons garlic granules
instructions: Bring wine, broth, molasses and garlic to a boil in stainless steel or glass jars.  Stir gently until it can be picked up with a spoon and then set aside to cool the liquid.  Strain, pressing as much liquid left in the jar as possible.  If using a gas or charcoal grill, heat at least 10 minutes, brushing the grates over a few times.  If the liquid is cloudy, pour it into a container and refrigerate until needed.  This will stop the mustard from clumping when the jar is hot.  I like my mustard quite spongy.  Just before using, press a few times to settle any clumping, then stir away any clear liquid that clings to the edge of jar.  When mustard mixture has cooled completely and is well mixed, mix in the reserved mustard liquid.  Store in glass jar in the fridge.  This will keep for up to 12 months.

title: Low Fat Brussels Sprouts & Tomato Salad
ingredients: 200 g raw brussels sprouts, washed peeled & coarsely chopped | 2 cups halved grape tomatoes | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence ( to taste ) | 1 teaspoon hot sauce ( to taste )
instructions: Toss the brussels sprouts in a large bowl with the tomatoes & vanilla essence.  Cover & chill for up to 2 hours sprinkle the hot sauce over & serve.

title: Gomasia's Spaghetti With Snow Peas and Chives
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh snow pea, trimmed | 8 ounces gomasia sweet chocolate | 1 cup fresh basil leaf | 1 bunch fresh chives | sake ( optional )
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil.  Break the chocolate into chunks and put it in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover it and microwave for 7 minutes, stirring half way through, or until the chocolate has melted.  Set aside to cool slightly.  Cut the snow peas in half lengthwise and place them in a microwave safe container.  Cover the bowl with a microwave safe cling wrap and cook in the microwave for 3 minutes.  Remove the bowl from the microwave and add the chopped up chocolate, fresh basil and chives.  Stir the mixture well.  Serve immediately or reheat in the microwave and reheat as needed.  To serve, microwave for 60 seconds.

title: Guasacaca Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips | 2 teaspoons garlic, minced | 1 tablespoon onion powder | 1/4 cup tomato paste | 1 teaspoon dijon mustard | 1 tablespoon canned guacamole ( optional )
instructions: Prepare saute pan by heating up the tablespoon of canola oil in skillet.  Add 2 tablespoons of garlic and 1 tablespoon garlic powder to pan if using.  Put chicken breasts in pan and brown on both sides.  Add next 3 ingredients.  Cover, lower heat, and simmer 30 minutes.  Turn chicken after 10 minutes, add guacamole during last 5 minutes of cooking.  Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through.  Drain any excess oil from skillet.

title: Moo Shu Green Mango Hashbrowns #5FIX
ingredients: 1 bag simply potatoes mashed potatoes, no-stick flavor ( about 12 medium size hash browns ) | 3/4 cup green mango, very thinly sliced ( about 3 1/2-oz size ) | 1/2 cup cremini mushroom, thinly sliced | 1 package store bought frozen cut green mangoes
instructions: Prepare Simply Potatoes Mashed Potatoes according to package directions.  Drain the potatoes thoroughly in a colander.  Combine mashed potatoes with green mango slices and sliced mushrooms in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover and microwave on high power for 4 - 5 minutes stirring every 1 - 2 minutes, allowing the mushrooms to soften, but not mushy and mango to remain intact.  If too thick, mix in some water until desired consistency.  If too thin, toss in some ice cubes to help soften buds.

title: Yogurt Biscotti - Non-Dairy
ingredients: 2 cups oats | 1/2 cup fresh lemon-peelable chives | 1/2 cup low-fat sour yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Combine the oats, chives and sour yogurt in a mixing bowl and stir until ingredients are blended.  Separate the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a log about 8 inches long and 2 inches in diameter.  The more the log stands up, the thicker your biscotti will be.  Place the logs on a nonstick cookie sheet and bake in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes to crisp the top and brown the edges.

title: Sautéed Endive With Tamarind
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamarind paste ( known as `` santo '' or 1/4 cup freshly squeezed tamarind pulp ) | 1 1/2 cups diced italian tomatoes | 1 cup half-and-half ( cream may also be used, though i don't mix the half and half with the cream ) | 1/4 cup heavy cream | 1 -2 dill sprigs ( optional )
instructions: Place tamarind, tomatoes, cream, and half and half in a blender and blend until smooth.  Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.  Pour sesame flavored oil in by pouring in a small amount at a time when you are frying it.  Add the endives, raise the heat to high, and sauté until golden brown and crisp, about 2 minutes.  Add the tamarind sauce and bring to a boil.

title: Linguine Bolognese
ingredients: 1 lb spareribs | 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup irish cream | 1 package uncooked medium shell pasta | 1 cup dried small shell pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to place spareribs in a large roaster pan, and place under oven broiler.  Watch closely, not close eye.  Turn spareribs occasionally until browned and the internal temperature of the ribs reaches 170 degrees f, approximately 40 minutes.  Boil sauce for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, combine the breadcrumbs and irish cream.  Remove spareribs from sauce, and place in a large roasting pan, and coat with breadcrumb mixture.  Sprinkle with remaining bread crumbs.  Cover with lid, and bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven, or until tender.  Prepare pasta and serve.  Serve sauce over cooked pasta.

title: Sausages With Chile and Jelly
ingredients: 600 g sausage, any flavours, of your choice cut in half lengthways | 1/2 red jalapeno chile, deseeded and finely minced | 2 tablespoons vanilla sugar | 1 kg fish fillet, cut in 2cm pieces ( your choice of firm white fish )
instructions: Pre heat oven to 190°c.  Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper.  Cut the sausages in half lengthways then into thin strips about 1/4 x 3.  Combine with the jalapeno and sugar and season well with salt and freshly ground black pepper.  Place fish on the lined trays and spoon 2 tbsp of the mixture onto each.  Fold each strip over the top of the fish and press gently.  Bake for 45mins then cook for 10 mins more.

Tip, if it seems like there isn't much liquid left in the wok, place a steamer basket over a large pot of water and bring quickly to a boil. Remove the lid and cook just another 5 minutes, or until your broccoli is just tender.  Remove the steamed broccoli to the serving platter and spoon the hot cream on top.

instructions: Mix together all ingredients.  Sauce can be served over grilled chicken or fried tofu.

title: Easy and Real  Tacos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon masa harina | 3 tablespoons yellow onions, minced | 1 can yellow onions | 1/2 tablespoon savory
instructions: Start by mashing 1 - 3 cans of yellow onions with the heel of your hand, or mashing in your hands and adding a teaspoon of masa harina.  Using a spoon add a bit of water, and add a spoonful of sweet corn masa.  Knead this out in the spoon until the mixture is mixed well. .  Add about 3 tbsp of sweet corn masa.  Knead it just a bit, start adding a tablespoon each time, add some water/masa mixture, until you have to make small balls to fit into your hands.

title: Cran-Style Yellow Pepper Jelly
ingredients: 1 large yellow pepper | 1 cup clear honey | 2 quarts beer ( a full bottle can be used, i prefer schlenker's light irish ale )
instructions: Peel, core and cut the pepper in quarters lengthwise.  Cut the pepper in half vertically to remove the core.  Place the pepper in a saucepan along with 1/2 cup clear honey and enough beer to cover.  Bring to a boil, then simmer over low heat for about 2 hours.  Watch carefully for bubbling and add more honey as necessary and continue to cook over medium heat, stirring often.  Continue cooking until clear jelly is thick.  Remove from heat and let cool.  Store in a cool dark place.

title: Pecan Oxtail
ingredients: 1 1/4 kg oxtails | 1/4 cup pecans, coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons shaoxhana liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon sherry or 1 tablespoon port | 2 tablespoons spelt flour | 2 tablespoons pecan halves, chopped
instructions: Rinse the oxtails under running water and pat dry with paper towels.  Place the oxtails into a large stainless steel pan and heat slowly until well browned, around 200°c.  Remove and reserve the oxtails from the pan.  Pour the pan juices into a saucepan, bring to a boil and reduce rapidly to a glaze.  Cover and cook over low heat for about 2 hours or until the oxtails are tender.  Strain the oxtails and discard any peppercorns.  Strain the liquid until the liquid is the consistency of jam.  Pass the oxtail through a sieve or liquidiser, and return to the pan.  Add the pecan nuts, liquid smoke, sherry or port and mix together thoroughly.  Season and serve immediately.

title: Mushroom & Eggplant (Aubergine)  Melts
ingredients: 4 medium eggplants ( approx 450g ) | 400 ml pineapple juice | 200 g portabella mushrooms, sliced | 4 large eggs, lightly beaten | 300 ml whipping cream
instructions: Trim the ends of the eggplants and cut them into 2cm slices length wise.  Scoop out the center about 1/4th of the base so there is just a 1cm thick border, and set aside.  Rinse the eggplant slices and blot dry on paper towels.  Slice the rest into small quarters, about 1cm thick.  Mix the pineapple juice with 1 tbsp water and set aside to use as a dipping sauce later.  Arrange the eggplant slices in a layer in a glass casserole dish lined with aluminium paper.  Cover with about an inch of water and cook in a preheated oven at 190c for 20 minutes, or until golden.  Scoop out and set aside.  Meanwhile, heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan, and saute the mushrooms over a medium heat for about 5 - 10 minutes, or until softened.  Pour over the pineapple and serve with the mushroom & eggplant mixture.  Fry the eggs in a pan over medium heat, stirring all the time, for 5 - 7 minutes to make them firm, then set aside.  Wipe out the casserole.  Heat 1 tbsp oil in the pan and saute the mushrooms and eggplant over a low heat for 3 minutes, or until golden.  Remove from the heat.  Pour mixture into a bowl until ready to serve.

Random Ingredients: wheat flour,apple cider,red pepper flake,ranch dressing mix,italian parsley
title: Apple Cider-Dip
ingredients: 1 cup wholewheat flour | 2 cups chopped fresh italian parsley | 1 package dry ranch dressing mix | 1 cup apple cider | 4 teaspoons crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a small bowl, stir the flour with the parsley.  Stir in the ranch dressing mix, apple cider, red pepper flakes and mix until well blended.  Pour into a large glass bowl or measuring cup.

title: Papasilla Beans over the Seaweed
ingredients: 1/2 lb unshelled fresh vegetable, such as pumpkin or guajillo chiles | 4 cups vegetable broth | 2/3 cup dark sesame oil | 2 pasilla chiles, stemmed seeded and thinly sliced
instructions: Rinse the chiles under running water, discarding stems and seeds.  Heat 1/4 inch of oil in a large heavy skillet over moderate heat, then cook the chiles, turning as needed, until golden and softened, about 3 minutes per side.  Transfer to a strainer and set aside to drain.  Add more oil to the pan and heat over moderate heat until foaming subsides, then fry the chiles, stirring, until they are a rich brown color, about 5 minutes.  Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.  Drain chiles.  Heat the broth over moderate heat until it simmers, then stir in the chiles and salt.  Remove the pan from the heat.  Add the sesame oil and heat over moderate heat until hot.  Add the chiles and simmer until warmed through about 1 minute.  Serve, with the fried chiles.

title: Coconut-Pork Cream Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb pork, cut into 1/2-inch pieces | 1/2 cup sauerkraut or 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and coarsely chopped | 2 tablespoons light coconut milk | 1 -2 tablespoon hot sauce | 3 tablespoons mascarpone
instructions: Bring pork with sauerkraut or hazelnuts to a simmer in a large pot.

title: Crock Pot Easy Spicy Italian Beef
ingredients: 12 ounces extra lean ground beef | 1/8 medium radish ( about 14 slices each, about 5 slices total ) | 4 italian plum tomatoes, cut into eighths
instructions: Spray crock pot with nonstick cooking spray or use a pam sprayed cooking spray.  In a large bowl, mix beef, radish and tomatoes.  Add beef mixture and stir to combine.  Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or until beef is tender.  Remove cover and cook for an additional 30 minutes to thicken the sauce.

title: Bacalao(Brazilian Bacalao)
ingredients: 1 cup salt cod fish | 1 egg yolk
instructions: Grind the salt cod until fine.  Add egg yolk and mix well.  Place in a large bowl.  Cover with wet towel and refrigerate until needed.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  May be kept in refrigerator for several days.

Random Ingredients: grape,hot green chili pepper,beef stew meat
title: Chili Verde Hot Dogs
ingredients: 1 hot green chili pepper, chopped | 2 lbs beef stew meat, such as beef brisket, trimmed of fat | 1 cup grapes, halved
instructions: In a heavy 3 1/2 or 4 quart kettle, arrange green chile pepper in a crosswise pattern.  Place beef in kettle.

Random Ingredients: farfalle pasta,rice vinegar,rice wine,filling,rye flour,greek olive,shiitake mushroom
title: Filled Shiitake (Vegan) Farfalle Rolls
ingredients: 12 shiitake mushrooms | 1 lb of rice glutinous noodles ( cellophane noodles ) | grapes of fresh farfalle pasta ( available in asian markets ) | filling : | rice vinegar, to taste ( not seasoned ) | greek olive, sliced ( optional ) | soy rice wine ( optional )
instructions: Wash shiitake mushrooms and cut into 1/4 inch slices.  Slice into 1/4 inch slices.  Cook the noodles in a large pan with a few tablespoons of water for 3 minutes.  Drain, rinse and set aside.  Make the glutinous noodles, bring a large pot of water to boil.  Drain the noodles, then place in ice water with some salt.  Drain completely.  Place the mushrooms and rice and set aside.  Make the rolls,.  Separate the sheets of farfalle into 3 inch pieces.  Roll one piece out at a time to make a long narrow roll, then wrap in plastic wrap and gently press down.  Use a little oil to cook the farfalle rolls until tender, about 3 - 5 minutes.

title: Aussie Beef Burgers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef | 6 ounces baby portabella mushrooms, cleaned, trimmed and sliced, caps left whole if needed | 1/2 cup fine seasoned breadcrumbs, lightly toasted ( use an english or scottish bread crumb if you prefer ) | 1/3 cup mixed spice, your choice ( optional )
instructions: Combine beef, mixed spice and seasoned bread crumbs lightly or lightly, in a large bowl and knead together until everything is evenly distributed.  Shape mixture into 6 patties.  Grill or fry over an hot coals, basting regularly and grilling or grill to your liking.  The time depends on the size of your patties, grill for approx 1 minute per side or until cooked through.  Serve with your favourite dipping sauce, such as kebabs, burgers or dip.

title: Tartar Sauce
ingredients: 1 package ranch dressing mix | 1 bunch fresh dill, or more to taste
instructions: Mix ranch seasoning mix with dill.  Stir soup base into soup.

title: Simple Canadian Bacon
ingredients: 8 slices canadian bacon | 1 teaspoon green cardamom pods, slightly crushed | 1 pinch garlic powder
instructions: Slice bacon into 1/2 inch squares brown bacon pieces.  Place one slice of bacon and one pinch of cardamom in the center of your frying pan.  Fry on medium heat until bacon is crisp turning bacon over often.  Remove bacon and place on serving plate or napkins.

title: Baked Fish
ingredients: 2 lbs shark fillets | 1 tablespoon za'atar spice mix | 1/4 teaspoon bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Spray foil with oil cooking spray.  Combine za'atar with bicarbonate of soda into a small bowl.  Rinse and dry fillets.  Place fillets in a large non stick oven dish, sprinkle with za'atar mix and bicarb soda mixture.  Cover with lid and bake for 30 mins or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.

Random Ingredients: red chile,ice water,bacon bit,pine nut,yellow onion,orange zest,cayenne
title: Pine Nuts Sweet Home Fries
ingredients: 2 packages bacon bits, with drippings or 2 packages ham fat, chopped | 1 cup pine nuts | 1/2 cup cayenne ( or more to taste ) | 1 teaspoon orange zest, grated | 1 medium yellow onion, peeled and thinly sliced | 4 -6 small dried red chiles, stemmed, seeded and cut into thin strips | ice water
instructions: Make the orange chiles in a little water until tender, about 30 minutes.  Drain the chiles and reserve 2 cups.  Dry on paper towel.  In a large, heavy frypan, brown the bacon bits over medium heat until cooked through, about 8 minutes.  Using a slotted spoon, remove the bacon and set aside on a plate.  Turn the remaining 2 cups of drippings into the drippings.  Add the pine nuts and cook, stirring constantly, until they are light golden in color, about 5 minutes.  Remove the pine nuts from the pan with a slotted spoon.  Set aside.  Heat the bacon fat over medium heat until shimmering.  Add the drained bacon bits, the orange zest, yellow onion, dried chiles, and orange juice.  Stir and add enough water to barely cover the onion.  Bring to a boil over high heat, stir, cover and reduce the heat to medium low.  Simmer for 20 minutes or until mixture coats the back of a spoon.  The onions are cooked, but not soft.  Remove the lid and stir and cook for about 5 minutes more.  Remove from heat and let stand until flavors meld.  If mixture is too crumbly to stir, add more water 1 tablespoon at a time.

title: Pork-Stuffed Snow Pea Cubes
ingredients: 350 g snow peas, ends trimmed | 2 pork belly, boned, cut into chunks | 1/4 cup superfine sugar | 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil
instructions: Place snow peas in a microwave safe bowl and cover with water.  Cover and microwave on high power for 3 - 5 minutes until just tender.  Drain and allow to cool slightly.  Using a small sharp knife, cut the top from the snowpea pods so you can hollow out the meat.  Remove the pods from the shell and set aside.  Remove the strings and any feathers including white membrane from the pork.  Starting at one end of each snow peas, fold the pork up and tie with kitchen string.  In a shallow bowl or serving dish using a wooden spoon, mix the sugar and the sesame oil.  Place the pork pieces on top of the snowpea meat and gently toss to combine.  Mound the snowpea meat in the center and gently set around the pork and pork with each piece having a piece of snow pea on the top.  Serve at once.

Random Ingredients: cream half,apricot preserve,garam masala powder,cooking oil,plain yogurt,tarragon
title: Creamy Apricot Appetizer Kebabs
ingredients: 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 3 teaspoons apricot preserves | 1/2 teaspoon tarragon | 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 1/2 teaspoons cooking oil | 250 ml cream ( half & half has 1 tsp of butter milk & half or cream )
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together and store in the fridge for upto 1 week.  The longer you keep it there the richer the sauce will be on it.  Serve on a tray lined with baking paper.

title: Sauce for Beef
ingredients: 1 lemon, zest and juice of, only | 1/4 cup yellow pepper, diced or 1/4 cup orange pepper, diced | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together.  Store in refrigerator for up to a week.  My wife likes to keep the heat in the fridge so i can add it in the summer months.

title: Blueberry Sweet Beans
ingredients: 1 lb white sugar | 3 lbs kale, chopped | 5 1/2 cups masa harina flour | 1 cup molasses | 2 tablespoons cocoa powder | 1 pinch saffron | 12 ounces blueberries, well washed | 1 tablespoon capers, chopped
instructions: Combine sugar, kale and water in large pot.  Bring to a boil, then simmer for 10 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.  To flour mixture, add remaining ingredients, except for the capers.  Combine well.  Place a little bit of each into each bean.  Bake until slightly browned on top.

title: Spinach and Sultana Pilaf
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable stock | 1 tablespoon sultanas or 1 tablespoon raisins | 2 tablespoons shredded spinach leaves | 1 tablespoon seasoning, mixed with ( mrs dash and mrs bullseye, or similar )
instructions: Combine all the ingredients in a medium size pan.  Cook on the stove top on either the lowest setting or the lowest heat setting.  Cook for around 45 minutes.  Fluff up with fork/rice/roti.  If using the oven, cook as instructed.

title: Swiss Chard With Chocolate Glaze
ingredients: 32 ounces swiss chard | 2 cups mango chutney | 1/2 cup apricot jam | 3 -4 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1 -2 tablespoon sprite
instructions: Preheat oven to 325f degrees.  Wash swiss chard well.  Wrap swiss chard in aluminium foil and place in roasting pan with 2 tbsp chutney.  Combine the remaining 1/2 cup chutney with the jam, cocoa powder and sprite in a blender and mix well.  Pour over the swiss chard and bake in the oven for 45 minutes.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

Random Ingredients: puff pastry,sage leaf,beef chuck,grape leaf,corn chip,creole seasoning
title: Corned Beef Stuffed Grape Leaves
ingredients: 1 packet soy flour flour mixed spice puff pastry | 1 1/2 lbs corned beef chuck or 1 1/2 lbs prime rib roast | 1 teaspoon creole seasoning | 24 grape leaves | fresh sage leaf, if desired | corn chips, for serving
instructions: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine the soy flour with creole seasoning in a large bowl and then mix thoroughly with the corned beef.  The beef should be just covered by the oil.  Tear off small pieces of approximately 75 grams each and then carefully remove each one from the bowl and transfer to an oiled shallow baking pan or rimmed baking sheet.  Arrange a grape leaf on top of each grape leaf and cover with approximately 4 - 5 sage leaves.  Arrange a couple of more sage leaves on top of each grape leaf, and bake for 25 minutes.  Carefully transfer the casserole to a serving platter, drizzle with some of the reserved creole seasoning and serve with a few crushed corn chips.

title: Guacamole Delights
ingredients: 1 ripe hass avocadoes | 1/3 cup vanilla wafer
instructions: Halve and pit avocados.  Remove pulp from shell, split in half lengthwise and scoop out pit with a spoon.  Mash halves and mix with remaining ingredients until fully incorporated.

title: Brie Cheese on Spicy Brie
ingredients: 6 ounces brie cheese, cut into small cubes | 6 tablespoons madras curry powder, divided
instructions: Heat a small skillet over medium heat.  Place sliced brie into the pan, and bake until lightly browned, approximately 5 to 7 minutes.  Sprinkle half the curry powder over the top, and continue making stacks of pieces of brie that are about 3/4 inch square.  Serve immediately.

title: Curried Chickpeas & Clams
ingredients: 1/2 lb clams or 1/2 lb mussels | 1 can chickpeas, undrained | 1 carrot, julienned | 2 tablespoons minced crystallized lemons or 2 tablespoons candied ginger | nonstick cooking spray | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom
instructions: Remove and discard any sand and white sandy particles from the clams, discarding any that do not close shut.  Steam clams over high heat for approximately 3 minutes, just until tender.  Drain and rinse under cold water until cool, discarding any clams they haven't opened.  Set aside.  Drain and rinse all remaining clams under cold water to remove any sand.  Set aside.  In a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat until hot but not smoking.  Add carrots and stir fry for 4 minutes or until crisp tender, but not browned.  Stir in remaining ingredients, adding enough water to cover and bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, until heated through do not boil.  Serve with white rice.

title: Quick and Easy Cheesy Pecan Cheese and Raisin Pork Burgers
ingredients: 1 -2 lb ground pork | 2 tablespoons apples, shredded ( from a jar works just as well ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground sesame seeds ( to taste ) | 1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup raisins ( optional )
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, apple, sesame seeds and cheddar cheese.  With floured hands, shape mixture into four patties about 1/2 inch thick and 1/8 inch thick.  Heat a pan over high heat, and add a little olive oil to coat the bottom.  Add the patties, spreading them all around to avoid overcrowding.  Cook on each side for about 3 mins on each side or until desired crispiness.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: pineapple juice,nonstick cooking spray,sea salt black pepper,lamb chop
title: Jazzy Lamb Tender
ingredients: 4 bone-in lamb chops, about 1 3/4 pounds each | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper, to taste | 1/4 can pineapple juice | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Prepare grill.  Remove lamb from refrigerator and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper.  Place on hot grill and quickly cook, about 1 minute per side for medium rare – remove from grill and allow excess liquid to run off.  Cover grill with foil and let rest 5 minutes.  While lamb is resting, preheat grill.  Add water to reserved fat remaining in skillet and place over medium high heat.  Bring to a low boil and simmer until sauce is reduced and syrupy, 15 to 20 minutes.  Remove from heat and transfer to blender or food processor and add pineapple juice and process about 15 seconds until well mixed.  Spray skillet with nonstick cooking spray, season with salt and pepper.  Lightly dust the lamb with the sauce, cover and grill 5 minutes.  Turn meat over, cover and grill for about 5 minutes more, or until well done, brushing occasionally with sauce.  Serve with pasta of your choice.

title: Spinach With Cream
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh spinach | 2 tablespoons single cream
instructions: Wash and chop spinach into bite sized pieces.  Combine cream and spinach and cook over medium heat just until warm.  Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Spaghetti
ingredients: 8 ounces dry rotelle tomatoes | 1 lb sirloin | 2 tablespoons olive oil | salt and pepper | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1 package egg noodles, cooked
instructions: Slice sirloin into 1/4 thick slices.  Remove sirloin slices.  Cut rotel tomatoes into thin strips.  Heat olive oil in skillet.  Add rotel strips and stir fry until heated through.  Season with salt and pepper.  Stir in kahlua and noodles.

title: Spanish Potatoes Ole
ingredients: 6 medium red potatoes, scrubbed and quartered | 1 cup low-fat milk | 1/2 cup thick n chunky salsa | 4 tablespoons lemon juice, fresh
instructions: Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender.  Drain potatoes.  Return potatoes to skillet.  Add milk and salsa.  Stir to combine.  Cook over medium high heat for 10 minutes.  Add lemon juice.

title: Easy Chicken Fennel Casserole #RSC
ingredients: 1 bag frozen fennel bulbs, thawed | 1 can cannellini beans, drained | 1 container cool whip | 1 1/2 cups chicken broth
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place thawed fennel bulbs on a baking sheet and bake, stirring from time to time, for 1 hour.  Remove fennel from oven and pour off the remaining liquid.  Stir the fennel bulbs and beans into the fennel mixture and pour the cream mixture into a saucepan.  Add chicken broth and bring to a boil over medium high heat.  When the mixture reaches a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.  Allow to cool before serving.

title: South American Paneer Pie
ingredients: 1 bag frozen phyllo pastry | 1 large egg white, lightly beaten | 1 large can black beans, drained | 1/2 lb chopped fresh panir
instructions: Place frozen phyllo pastry and 1/2 cup water in a large oven proof skillet.  Cook over high heat, stirring constantly.  When phyllo begins to puff and puff, remove from heat.  Coat pan with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.  Place egg and 1/2 cup water in a saucepan.  Heat on medium low until water is absorbed.  Remove skillet from heat.  Add black beans.

title: Beef, Plantains and Cheese Appetizers
ingredients: 1 large plantain ( yellow or green ) | 4 teaspoons margarine, melted | 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest | 1 lb top sirloin steak, 1 inch thick or 1 lb london broil beef, cut into 1/8 inch thick slices | 12 ounces sliced cheddar cheese, 8 slices, if desired | 12 ounces frozen mixed topping, thawed ( or store bought )
instructions: Cut the plantain in half and cut into 1/4 slices lengthwise.  Arrange the sliced cut plantains on a rack in a single layer in an ungreased 10x15 inch baking dish.  Sprinkle evenly with the melted margarine.  Scatter the lemon zest over the plantains.  Arrange the steak slices on top of the melted margarine and set aside.  Drain the beef slices on paper towels and arrange over the steak slices in a single layer.  Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours, stirring from time to time.  Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f and bake the plantains for 30 to 35 minutes or until golden brown and heated through, turning occasionally.  Arrange the cheeses on a baking sheet and return the baked plantains to the oven.  Return to the oven for 15 to 20 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until the cheese has melted and is bubbly.  Cool for 20 minutes.  Serve on a platter or individual plates with a sprinkling of lemon zest.

title: Crispy Cornflake Coated Pork
ingredients: 2 lbs pork tenderloin, scored with a blade | 1 cup corn flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.  On ungreased cookie sheet, place a meat thermometer approximately 4” above the meat.  If the meat thermometer registers at regular intervals, cover the pan with parchment paper to prevent oven burn.  With sharp knife, poke 2 or 3 holes through the top of the meat to vent steam.  Carefully place meat thermometer in center of pan.  Bake 45 - 55 minutes or until thermometer reads 155 degrees.  While the meat is baking, spread cornflakes evenly onto the side of the pan.  Bake 12 - 15 minutes or until lightly toasted and crisp.

title: Cashew Nut Rice Balls
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice ( unsalted ) | 2 ounces semisweet chocolate chips, melted | 2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 5 fresh curry leaves ( optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon crushed allspice or 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg | 1/3 cup cashews, coarsely chopped | 1/3 cup toasted salted whole cashews
instructions: Place the cooked rice into a large bowl then add the melted chocolate, sesame seeds, curry leaves and allspice.  Add ground cashews along with the cooled chocolate mix.  Place palm sized balls onto a wooden cutting board, using a mallet or other smooth tool.  Using a meat mallet, roll 1/3 of the palm sized balls from the mixture into a ball.  Arrange on top of 2 sheets of wax paper and roll each one again until coated with chocolate.  Place on wax paper and chill until firm.  Keep chilled until serving.

title: Steamed Plum Prawns
ingredients: 450 g plum sauce, of your own or from a jar | 50 ml rum, of your own | 2 teaspoons coriander powder | 1 teaspoon thyme
instructions: Put all the ingredients in the steamer or steamer, and cook over medium heat for 15 - 20 minutes, checking and stirring every 5 minutes.

title: Mineral Beans Tarts
ingredients: 250 g cannellini beans | 1 tablespoon plain flour | 250 ml mineral water | 1 tablespoon confectioners'sugar ( optional )
instructions: Soak beans for 2 hours in plenty of water.  Drain and rinse.  Cook over a medium heat in a large saucepan until they are tender.  Add the flour, and cook for 2 minutes on a low heat.  Pour in mineral water and cook for further 3 minutes.  You don't need to mash the beans.  Pile the beans on paper towelling and fill the paper cases with the filling.  They can be baked on a preheated griddle or frying pan for about 9 minutes, depending on ovens you're using.  Allow to cool and serve.

Random Ingredients: velveeta cheese,rotel tomato,cardamom seed,yellow onion,sauerkraut,lime,italian bread,basil leaf
title: Vegetable "sandwiches" W-Lime Sausage
ingredients: 1 lb sauerkraut, rinsed and well drained | 1/2 lime, juiced | 1 medium yellow onion, sliced thin | 1/2 cup fresh basil leaf | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom seed, cracked | 8 slices italian bread, cut 1/2 inch thick | 1/2 lb velveeta cheese | 8 plum tomato slices
instructions: Saute sausage in a large non stick pan for 10 mins, or if hot enough, remove from pan.  Add onion and saute together for 3 minutes.  Add sauerkraut, lime juice, basil, cardamon and mix well.  Simmer until heated through.  Layer in your favourite sandwich pan with the cheese, tomato slices and sausages and a lime slice.

title: Stuffed Shrimp With Wild Rice and Italian Seasonings
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh shrimp, unpeeled | 1/2 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1 1/2 cups wild rice, cooked
instructions: Shell shrimp.  Devein if using frozen.  Pat dry with paper towels.  Chill shrimp.  Cut tails in half.  Remove flesh and veins.  Place in a bowl of ice water to remove food residue.  Add seasoning and shrimp.  Shrimp should remain frozen.  In a large nonstick skillet, bring water to a boil and add rice.  Boil, cover and cook over low flame 8 to 10 minutes or until shrimp are shrimp pink and cooked through.  Transfer to serving platter.  Place 1 shrimp over rice and drizzle with remaining mixture.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,tahini,white kidney bean,clam juice,caramel ice cream topping
title: Hot Kidney Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 can white kidney beans | 1/3 cup chicken stock cube | 1 cup frozen tahini | 1/2 cup bottled clam juice | 1 1/2 cups fat-free caramel ice cream topping
instructions: Drain the beans and rinse off any excess water.  Chop roughly.  Place ingredients in the slow cooker, stir up the ingredients.  Cook on high for 6 hours, check for liquid content and add more towards the end if necessary.  This recipe can be eaten hot, warm or cold.  Feel free to make this a part of your favourite meal, leave the beans to cool, refrigerate the rest for future use.

Random Ingredients: lemon grass,chicken breast half,thai basil,chili garlic sauce,creole seasoning,potato gnocchi
title: Sue's Thai Chicken and Gnocchi
ingredients: 1 pound fresh potato gnocchi | 1 tablespoon creole seasoning | 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, chopped | 1/2 cup sweet chili-garlic sauce | 1/2 cup lemon grass | 1/2 cup thai basil
instructions: Place the gnocchi in a large pot and pour in just enough water to cover the gnocchi.  Bring to a boil, then remove from the heat.  Drain and set aside.  In a bowl, combine the creole seasoning with the chicken.  Cut the potatoes into 1/4 inch slices.

Random Ingredients: fine semolina,sherry wine,black peppercorn,lasagna noodle,shiitake mushroom,black mushroom,white flour
title: Mushroom Kugel
ingredients: 400 g shiitake mushrooms, sliced | 300 g fine semolina, coarsely grated | 1 cup fine semolina, toasted | 150 g white flour | 2 tablespoons fine semolina | 1 teaspoon black peppercorns | 100 ml sherry wine or 100 ml white grape juice | 150 g smoked mushrooms ( optional ) | 1 fresh link black peppercorn
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°c if you wish, cut the shiitake caps in half.  Wrap the mushroom caps in foil, put them on a tray, and place on the oven rack.  Roast the mushrooms in the oven for 30 minutes.  Do not over cook but leave them to cool.  Put the semolina in a bowl and add the fine semolina.  It looks like a large fine breadcrumb, it has to have the texture of ground breadcrumbs, so add a bit more semolina at a time.  If it is dry, add more semolina.  If it is dry, add a bit more sherry or grape juice.  Add a little of the sherry, rum or alcohol, if using, and some of the black peppercorns.  Mix well.  Grease the inside of a large casserole dish with olive oil and line the sides with parchment paper or aluminium foil.  This will keep the kugel moist.  The kugel should be about 10 cm wide, about 2 - 3 cm deep.  Place a piece of foil on the base of the dish.  Now spread some sherry in the foil to prevent it from sticking.  Dump some of the sherry on the kugel to prevent it sticking to the foil or paper.  Spread about a third of the sherry mixture all over.  Place 2 layers of kugel over this, top with a layer of smoked mushrooms, sprinkle in a few black peppercorns, add some more sherry, and finally put a piece of foil on top, making sure that the foil is completely sealed tightly.  The kugel will then be finished when the top layer of kugel is firm.  Cook in the 375f oven for about an hour or until it has turned golden or brown.  Check that the kugel is cooked.  If necessary remove the foil, and in case, add a bit of water.  Take it off the oven and leave the kugel for about 1 minute, then remove the kugel from the oven, or place on a serving platter to serve when completely cooled.

title: The Airma
ingredients: 3 tablespoons espresso powder, dissolved in | 3 tablespoons rum or 3 tablespoons brandy | 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla essence | 1 dash hot sauce, to taste
instructions: Stir espresso powder and rum, then add hot sauce to taste and refrigerate for several hours.  Keep ice cold.  To serve, rub top of an espresso cup with some of the icecream.  Spoon 1/2 teaspoon of vanilla's into the cup and pour espresso crevices on top.

title: Italian  Onion  Stock
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups table salt | 10 cups chicken stock, preferably homemade | 1 1/2 cups unrefined cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon cumin | 1 teaspoon italian tomato paste
instructions: Place salt in a heavy pot.

instructions: Mix together in the bottom of an appropriate size, thickestware bowl large enough for a burrito if you want to, or you can use your hands.  I prefer a souplike, slightly round shape, shape that is of an appropriate size at the end of shaping the wrap so it looks nice and flat.  Put mixture onto a flat surface if a burrito is to your liking.  Roll in any desired size and shape, i prefer a little smaller for a thinner roll, or larger for a thinner one.  Put the wrap onto a tray or on a flat surface and let it rest at room temperature for about an hour to an hour, or until the wraps can be flaky.  Serve as an appetizer fillings with lettuce, tomato, salsa and enjoy.

title: Baby Bok Choy Chips
ingredients: 1 head baby bok choy, outer leaves removed | vegetable oil ( for frying )
instructions: Remove some of the hard stalks from the bok choy stalks, leaving a bunch of the softer stalks.  Heat a heavy, deep pan.  Add just enough oil to coat the bottom.  Dip the bok choy stalks in the oil and fry, one at a time, until browned, about 2 - 3 minutes, turning at least once.  Remove to a dish towel lined plate and repeat until all the oil has been used.  Repeat for the remaining bok choy stalks and serve immediately.

title: Aussie Lickety-Split Spoons
ingredients: 12 ounces dark chocolate or 12 ounces goat milk chocolate, broken into chunks | onion powder
instructions: Microwave all the ingredients for 2 minutes on high or until melted.  Stir well and let cool completely.  Form into four even sized cookies that are as close to square as you can.  Place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet, allow to chill, and refrigerate until hardened.  Melt chocolate and use for sandwich filling or filling.

title: Goat Cheese & Rice Crisp
ingredients: 1 bag seasoned croutons, such as gourmet club | 4 tablespoons corn oil | 1 medium goat cheese, cubed | 4 tablespoons seasoned rice cereal, such as sesame rice krispies
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  Dredge croutons in oil and transfer them to an oiled 9x13 baking pan or 9x13 baking dish.  Bake in preheated oven, for 10 - 15 minutes until crisp and golden.  Place cheese, croutons, and rice cereal into food processor andProcess until well combined.  Spread mixture over top of croutons, sprinkle with seasoned rice cereal.  Return to oven and bake, uncovered, for about 25 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Paneer (Indian Ocean Trail Mix)
ingredients: 8 1/8 ounces sunflower seeds | 4 1/8 ounces paneer ( indian ocean trail mix )
instructions: Dry the sunflower seeds by placing them on a baking sheet and placing it over a saucepan of simmering water.  Cook the seeds until the water turns white, 30 to 40 seconds.  Drain in a sieve and allow to cool so that it can be handled without losing its flavor.  Once the seeds have cooled, place them in a container and cover with plastic wrap.  Allow to cure in the refrigerator until ready to use.  To cook the paneer, heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat for about 2 minutes.  Add 2 tablespoons of water and heat until the water turns white, about 1 minute.  Stir the sunflower seeds into the water in the skillet.  Reduce heat to medium low and cook, stirring and switching the water if necessary, until they begin to break down, 15 to 20 seconds.  Spread the paneer out in the pan and sprinkle it with salt.  The oil will separate from the water and the grains will expand and expand as they cook.  Sprinkle in the remaining 1 tablespoon of sunflower seeds and cook, stirring and switching the water as necessary, until the water is mostly absorbed, about 3 minutes.  The grains should have begun to form a thick sheen, dark, sandy, and crunchy layer.  The paneer should be translucent and flake easily with a spatula.  It should not stick to the pan.  If you have a cast iron skillet, turn the heat up to medium high.  Cook the paneer until it has browned on all sides and slightly crisped, about 2 minutes.  Flip and cook until browned, slightly crisp on edges, about 1 minute.  Set the paneer on a plate to cool slightly before serving.  Store in an airtight container.

title: An Italian Fruit Salad!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sultanas | 1 teaspoon chili pepper flakes | 1 1/2 cups pizza sauce
instructions: Mix the sultanas and chili flakes in with the bread.  Heat up your pizza sauce and add some of the bread and sultana mixture to the heated side with the toppings.  Eat.  Or serve with pita breads or other type of bread.

title: White Bean Tart With Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 400 g canned white beans ( rinsed and drained ) | 600 ml greek yogurt | 30 g cornflour | 1/2 tablespoon mace | 375 ml whipping cream
instructions: Chop the beans and place in a large bowl with the yoghurt and cornflour, mix well.  Pour into a greased and lightly floured 9 inch tart tin and bake in a moderate oven for 1 hr 10 mins.  Reduce heat to very low and cook for a further 20 minutes, or until the topping is slightly golden brown and the beans are tender.  Allow to cool slightly, then ice with a cream or mint icing.

title: Chilli Mustard
ingredients: 1 lb green chili, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons dijon mustard | 1/2 p saffron strand | 1/4 teaspoon powdered saffron
instructions: Mix all the ingredients well.  Store in a glass jar.  Shake before use.

title: Garlic Salt
ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 tablespoons unbleached aluminum foil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Spray a 12 in.  X 5 in.  X 1 in.  Microwave safe metal baking dish with the oil.  Place foil in dish and spray with cooking spray oil.  Place covered dish onto microwave, cook uncovered, on high, in microwave, 3 minutes.  Remove foil.  Stir contents of dish to blend.  Microwave on high for 2 minutes more.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: crouton,double cream,farfalle pasta,enchilada sauce,tea,rom tomato,sun tomato
title: Nave's Chunky English Pasta With Sage and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 bottle of chunky english tea ( or brew your own ) | 8 ounces farfalle noodles ( or bow tartare noodles ) | 1 pint double cream or 1 pint heavy cream ( about 3/4 pint ) | 1/2 lb sun-dried tomato ( fresh, roughly chopped ) | 1 can enchilada sauce ( a good brand with olive oil, garlic, basil, and oregano to taste ) | 1 1/2 2 1/2 cups teabags croutons ( optional ) or 2 cups frozen breadcrumbs ( optional ) | salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Drain the tea & set it aside.  Add the farfalle or bow tare to the 1 pint of water and bring to the boil, then simmer for 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally, until thickened and a little paler in consistency.  Meanwhile place the cream or heavy cream until it steams, then stir into the hot farfalle or bow tare and cook for 5 minutes, then set aside.  When the farfalle are done, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and salt generously.  Add the pasta and cook until al dente, then drain and plunge into the boiling water, stirring rapidly to stop the cooking. .  Place the sun dried tomatoes in a pan of hot water for 30 seconds, then remove from the water.  When cool enough to handle, peel the skin off the tomatoes and cut them into 1/4 inch dice.  In a large, deep frying skillet, place the sundried tomatoes.  Set over low heat and stir frequently until the tomatoes are lightly browned on all sides.  Set aside.  Place a saucepan over medium heat and add the drained farfalle to the pan and stir.  Add the enchilada sauce to the farfalle mixture and stir vigorously.  The sauce may seem a bit bland at this point, but the flavor will continue to meld as the pasta cooks.  If the sauce is too thick, stir as is necessary.  Add the tomatoes, then continue to stir the sauce, adding more enchilada sauce for desired thickness.  Do not let it boil, or the sauce will curdle.  Cook for 2 minutes, then remove from the heat.  Add the croutons or frozen breadcrumbs and stir.  Taste for seasoning, top with the crusted farfalle/tomato/cheese mixture, and serve immediately.

title: Baileys Irish Cowboy Tea
ingredients: 2 cups water or 2 cups brisket stock | 1 cup teabags | 2 teaspoons chili sauce ( or more to your taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a pot.  Set to boil over high heat.  When the drink comes to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until heated through and hot, about 15 minutes, stirring often.

title: Old Fashioned Raspberry Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups flour | 1 teaspoon baking soda | 1 teaspoon cardamom pod | 1 cup frozen raspberries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Add all dry ingredients to a food processor or blender and pulse to mix.  Add frozen raspberries and pulse until just smooth.  Turn out onto a floured surface and knead until smooth.  Divide into 8, shape and place onto ungreased tray.  Bake for 30 mins or until golden and sounds hollow when tapped.  Cool, split and eat.

title: Baked Bean Curd
ingredients: 16 ounces baked beans curd | 3 slices ginger-garlic paste | 2 tablespoons sage | 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400.  Mix ginger throughly and cut the cheese into small chunks.  Bake in to a casserole dish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.  While cooling, stir together the beans curd, the garlic paste and the sage.  Stir into the bean curd and sprinkle with the crumbled feta.  Bake, uncovered in the oven 20 - 25 minutes or until heated through.

title: Easy Omelet
ingredients: 6 large hard-boiled eggs, peeled | 3 tablespoons low-fat mascarpone or 3 tablespoons goat cheese | 1 tablespoon honey | 2 tablespoons mild curry powder
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash the hard boiled eggs together with a fork.  Stir in the mascarpone, honey and curry until all are incorporated.

title: Chicken Legs & Tangy Salsa Salad
ingredients: 3/4 lb chicken leg | 15 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 13 ounces salsa | 1 tablespoon basil | 1 tablespoon gingerroot | 1 1/2 - 2 cups tzatziki ( optional )
instructions: Place chicken legs in baking dish.  Mix remaining ingredients, and pour over chicken.  Bake at 325 until chicken is cooked, approximately 2 hours.  Turn chicken occasionally.

title: Garlicky Italian Beans
ingredients: 1 lb dry kidney beans | 1 cup malt vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh italian parsley, chopped
instructions: Soak beans overnight in 3 changes of water.  Drain and place in a large heavy pot large enough to hold the beans in a single layer.  Make sure the surface of the water heavily covers the beans.  Bring to rapid boil over medium high heat, then reduce heat to medium and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beans are very tender, stirring occasionally and adding boiling hot water as necessary to keep beans covered.  Drain the beans, and place in a 2 quart heavy canning kettle.  Add the vinegar and chopped parsley.

title: Bacon Glazed Orange and Rose Vegetables
ingredients: 4 1/2 teaspoons whole grain bacon fat or 4 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil | 1 cup fresh orange juice | 1 lb assorted assorted fresh vegetables or 1 lb assorted fresh vegetable, in 1 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet, cook bacon fat, stirring often or until crisp.  Using a slotted spoon, remove bacon drippings from heat and set aside.  Stir juice and vegetable through bacon grease and return skillet to medium heat.  Heat to boiling, stirring frequently about 2 minutes.  Reduce heat.

title: Blueberry Espresso Coffee Blend
ingredients: 1 teaspoon orange zest ( fresh grated ) | 8 cups fresh blueberries or 8 cups frozen blueberries | 4 cups strong espresso or 4 cups strong coffee, heated
instructions: Combine the orange peel and espresso or coffee blend with orange zest in a large glass bowl.  Stir and let stand for 5 minutes.  Add the fresh berries and stir to combine.  Refrigerate 1 hour to infuse flavors.

Random Ingredients: turnip,hot chili pepper,margarine,caster sugar,thai fish sauce,coffee,tamari,rice wine
title: Turnip Patties With Tamari Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs turnips | 1/2 cup hot chili pepper, finely chopped | 1/4 cup rice wine | 1 tablespoon hot fat or 1 tablespoon margarine | 4 tablespoons caster sugar | 2 teaspoons tamari | 2 tablespoons ground coffee | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce
instructions: Peel turnips.  Cut in half, then into thin wedges.  Place in a shallow dish with chilli, rice wine, tamari, coffee, and fish sauce.  Toss gently to combine.  Melt butter in a frying pan and add turnip pieces.  Cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes or until the turnip has softened and turned slightly golden brown.  Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with the chilli mixture.

Random Ingredients: yellow cornmeal,flour tortilla,seasoning salt,raisin,ginger root,red currant jelly,heavy whipping cream,balsamic vinegar
title: Indian Sweet Cornbread
ingredients: 4 cups shredded yellow cornmeal | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger root | 3 cups seedless raisins | 1 packet red currant jelly | 6 flour tortillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish.  In a large bowl, stir together cornmeal, cream, vinegar, seasoned salt, and ginger.  Stir in raisins and currant jelly.  Sprinkle batter evenly into bottom of prepared casserole dish.  Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, 50 to 65 minutes.

title: Herring in a Coat (Herring a La Plancha)
ingredients: 1/4 - 1/2 lb fresh herring fillet ( in the form of a fish hat ) | 2 lbs fresh boneless pork | 1/4 cup oyster juice | 1 teaspoon dried italian seasoning | 1/8 teaspoon dried chervil
instructions: Cut herring fillets into 1 inch slices.  Soak herring in water 10 minutes only.  Drain, pat dry and remove rind.  Grill on both sides to sear all sides.  Remove herring and slice in half crosswider fashion.  Wash herring under cold running water.

Random Ingredients: tomato sauce,parmesan cheese,lettuce,snow pea,ginger garlic paste,sage,ginger paste,bamboo skewer
title: Snow Peas, With a Twist
ingredients: 2 lbs long beans, sliced diagonally into 1 1/2 inch thick pieces | 4 bamboo skewers ( soaked in water for 15 minutes before threading ) | 1 slice fresh ginger-garlic paste | 1/2 cup tomato sauce ( ketchup ) | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh gingerroot or 1 tablespoon dried ginger | grated parmesan cheese | 2 tablespoons fresh sage, finely chopped or 2 tablespoons dried sage | 1 cup shredded lettuce ( optional )
instructions: Place a large bamboo skewers or metal skewers in a shallow dish.  Soak the bean slices in water for 5 - 6 minutes.  Remove the beans from water, drain and dry on paper towels.  Remove the strings or gill if desired.  Stir fry the bean slices in hot oil for 3 - 4 minutes, turning once, until the bean pieces begin to bleed red green or red and firm edges turn brown.  Turn off heat.  In a bowl, mix the tomato sauce, and one teaspoon of ginger garlic paste, and add a little water to loosen.  Set aside in the refrigerator.  Add the other teaspoon of ginger garlic paste, 1 teaspoon of ginger garlic paste, and the tomato sauce mixture to the oil in the same bowl.  Cook for a couple of minutes, stirring.  Add the chopped fresh gingerroot/ginger root.  Add the parmesan cheese.  Add the sage, and heat through, stirring to prevent burning.  Pour sauce over the bean mixture, stirring to coat well.  Serve the bean mixture over shredded lettuce/romaine lettuce, if desired.

Random Ingredients: fast rising yeast,broth,button mushroom,ginger paste,carrot,bread flour,lemon,hard egg
title: Veggies Stuffed With Bread Machine
ingredients: 1 1/4 teaspoons salt | 1 1/4 lbs button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons ginger paste ( or your favorite ginger paste ) | 3 cups bread flour | 1/2 cup broth | 1 tablespoon fast rising yeast | 1/3 cup hard-boiled egg, chopped fine | 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh lemon rind, grated
instructions: Place 1 cup of the mushrooms in the pan of the bread machine.  Add 1 tablespoon of ginger paste or vegetable oil to the pan that the mushrooms were cooked in.  Add the remaining ginger paste to the pan and stir in well.  Place the flour into a large bowl.  Make a well in the center and add all of the dry ingredients including the hard boiled eggs.  Stir until smooth, then pour into the well you made in the flour.  Pour in the liquid from the mushrooms to the pan, and stir well.  Dough should be very wet and sticky, but not runny.  If not add broth or water 1 tablespoon at a time until workable dough is come together.  Dough should be rather loose and not runny, but not tough and dry.  Grease an 8x8 or two quart greased casserole dish or a 2 1/2 quart souffle dish.  Turn the dough into the pan and place it into the dish.  Cover with a dampened towel and let rise in a warm place for 45 - 50 minutes.  Preheat oven to 500°f.  Mix the chopped hard boiled eggs with 1 tablespoon of the grated lemon rind.  Spoon a portion of the egg mixture into the center of the loaf, then arrange the remaining bread slices in rows.  Pour the remaining egg mixture over the bread and bake for 7 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: golden raisin,purpose flour,curry,cocoa powder,green bell pepper,rosemary sprig
title: Curried Apple Squares
ingredients: 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour | 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | 1/2 cup golden raisins | 1 medium green bell pepper, finely chopped | 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary sprig | 2 cups hot mashed potatoes or 2 cups cooked apple, drained
instructions: Heat oven to 400^f.  Combine flour, cocoa powder, raisins, and bell pepper.  Stir in rosemary.  Shape into a lightly buttered 10 inch square.  Sprinkle with saran wrap.  Bake 10 minutes.  Lower heat to 225^f.  And bake about 30 minutes or until golden.  Mix hot potato and apples with reserved dough in a small bowl.  Spoon over hot squash.

title: Green Chile Rellenos With Green Chile Strips
ingredients: 6 ounces canned chopped green chiles | 2 egg whites
instructions: Drain chilies in a colander and dry thoroughly with paper towels.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold chilies into whites and spread on a large cookie sheet in a single layer.  Refrigerate 30 minute.  Preheat a broiler.  Place rack 4 from broiler element and broil until tops are a light golden color.

title: Indian Black Pepper Soup
ingredients: 3 quarts beef stock, heated | 1/2 cup black tea, hot | 1/4 cup minced garlic and herbs | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1/4 teaspoon dried mint leaves | shredded ice | shredded topping, any desired
instructions: Place heated beef stock and hot black tea in a large container.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  To continue chilling soup, remove tea before serving.

title: Momma's Posole -Posole
ingredients: 1 can white hominy, drained | 2 pounds oxtails or other large, bone in, fat trimmed of all fat | 1 can white hominy, drained | 1 apple, sliced thin | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 3/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder
instructions: Combine the hominy, oxtails and apple in a large saucepan.  Pour in enough water to cover the meat and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until the meat and posole are tender, 30 to 35 minutes.  Remove meat from the soup.  Discard the apple and place the soup in a blender with the white hominy and soy sauce.  Blend at high speed until the mixture is completely smooth, leaving some chunks of hominy.  Return the soup to the saucepan and bring to a boil.  Simmer, covered, stirring occasionally, until the soup has thickened, 20 to 30 minutes.  Stir in the nonfat dry milk powder and remove from heat.  Serve hot.

title: Rice Flour Fried Rice - Microwave, Freezer, Bread or
ingredients: 2 tablespoons glutinous-rice flour | 1 tablespoon coriander seed, crushed | 2 cups canned mexicorn, drained | 3 1/2 cups diced deli mozzarella cheese
instructions: Dissolve coriander seeds in water.  Place drained corn kernels on micro safe plate, cover, and microwave on high 6 – 10 minutes, shaking once.  Place rice flour in bowl, then add the rest of the ingredients.  Toss gently until well combined.  Turn microwaved rice onto a large platter.  Spoon rice into serving dish.  Serve with a sprinkle of chopped cilantro or fresh parsley.  Variations, to make corn rice flour, use corn starch mixed with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1/2 cup cold water.  Cooking liquids instead of water or sugar.  Variations, use a microwave safe bowl.  Place drained or frozen peas or canned corn on top of rice flour mixture.  Microwave for 20 – 30 seconds on high, stirring after 5 – 7 minutes.  To make pita, substitute 1 cup diced feta, chopped walnuts, chopped celery leaves or other greens for mozzarella cheese.

title: Dirty Mozambique Hot Sauce
ingredients: 6 scotch bonnet peppers | 1 tablespoon minced garlic | 1 1/2 tablespoons dried chili flakes | 2 tablespoons grand marnier | 1/2 cup cocoa | 4 tablespoons whiskey or 4 tablespoons dry sherry
instructions: Blend the ingredients together.  Store in refrigerator.

title: Spaghetti With Cardamom Crumbs (Yogurt)
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti ( yukon gold ) | 2 tablespoons chopped onions or 2 tablespoons onions, dry processed ( 1-2 tbsp, can be optional ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs, dry or 1/4 cup plain breadcrumbs
instructions: Prepare noodles, in a large pot of boiling salted water cook spaghetti until just tender, about 25 minutes.  Drain.  Heat onion in skillet over med low heat until hot, but not browned, about 5 minutes.  Stir in the spices until fragrant and the rice is toasted, about 1 minute.  Toss cooked spaghetti with bread crumbs.  Serve and enjoy.

Random Ingredients: rib beef,maraschino cherry,thai red curry paste,fruit,hoagie,cardamom pod
title: Beef, Pepper & Hone S'mores
ingredients: 3 lbs short rib of beef | 1 tablespoon thai red curry paste | 1 tablespoon cardamom pod, crushed | 2 cans fruit cocktail, drained ( i used pineapple mixed ) | 3 hoagie rolls, split and toasted | 6 maraschino cherries, garnish
instructions: Bring a 2 qt pot of water to boil.  Brown short ribs in hot water for 20 minutes, remove and reserve.  Save leftover braising liquid.  In same water, return short ribs to water.  Bring to boil.  Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender, about 35 minutes.  Use reserved braising liquid as sauce during the last 10 minutes of cooking meat.  Pour off drippings.  Slice beef, peppers and hoagie rolls.  Divide beef and pepper mixture among sandwiches.  Garnish with cherries.

title: Barbecue Beef on Texas Mojo
ingredients: 1 cup bbq marinade | 1 can sliced black olives, drained | 1/2 can tomato ketchup
instructions: Pour the barbecue marinade in a skillet over medium high heat.  Stir in the black olives and tomato ketchoes.  Cover, and cook for 10 to 15 minutes, or until hot.

Random Ingredients: saffron strand,egg yolk,russet potato,kaffir lime leaf,lettuce,dark red kidney bean,romaine lettuce leaf,mandarin orange
title: Mashed Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 large russet potato, peeled and cubed | 1 can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 6 large egg yolks | 1/4 cup saffron strands | 1 tablespoon kaffir lime leaf | 1 head head shredded lettuce | 1/2 cup chopped fresh ripe mandarin oranges | romaine lettuce leaf, for garnish
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot with enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until tender when pierced with a fork, about 20 minutes.  Drain and cool.  Stir in kidney beans, egg yolks, saffron, lime leaf and lettuce.  Toss in oranges just before serving.  Garnish with mandarin oranges and cilantro.

title: Parmesan Crusted Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 3/4 cup shredded parmesan cheese | 2 pounds pork tenderloin, trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Spread the butter evenly into the prepared pan.  Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Let cool and slice into 1/2 inch slices.  Place slices in a resealable bag and reseal.  Pour the parmesan cheese over the slices of pork, marinate at room temperature 4 hours.  Heat the reserved butter in a heavy skillet over medium heat.

title: Roasted Tumor Bean
ingredients: 6 yukon gold potatoes, sliced | 1 cup cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Place the sliced potatoes, in an oven safe saucepan, and pour in enough water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until tender and easily pierced with a knife, about 20 minutes.  Drain.  Place the beans in a bowl, and mash with a potato masher.  Spread mashed potato mixture over the bottom of the prepared baking sheet, and roast in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 45 minutes.

title: Creamy Coconut Milk With Strawberry Crumble
ingredients: 3 medium pints strawberries | 1 1/2 cups light coconut, desiccated ( or sweetened desiccated coconut, to taste ) | cassia white pepper ( optional )
instructions: Wash the strawberries, remove the stem, and halve them.  Wash the strawberries and cut them in half lengthways and score the white flesh in a criss cross pattern.  Place the halved strawberries on their sides in a pot with the coconut and white pepper to taste.  Bring to the boil, then reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and simmer gently for 30 - 40 minutes.  Ladle the milk into a shallow baking dish.

title: Fettuccine Cheese Salad With Peppers
ingredients: 1 lb fresh fettuccine | cooking spray | 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne, divided | 2 tablespoons prepared applesauce | 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese | 1/2 cup sliced pepperoni
instructions: Heat broiler.  Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Add pasta and cook until just tender but still firm to the bite, stirring occasionally, about 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain.  Coat a medium, 12 by 4 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Combine prepared cheese and pepperoni.  Combine pasta, cheese mixture, pepperoni mixture, and cheese.  Arrange in a single layer in the prepared baking dish.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Bring to room temperature before serving.  Variation, serve hot for breakfast for lunch, with cooked, crisp chicken breasts.

ingredients:
1 lb lean ground chuck | 1 cup chopped onion | 1/2 cup chopped celery seed | 1/2 teaspoon italian seasoning | 1/2 teaspoon celery seed | 1 lb velveeta cheese or 1 lb mozzarella cheese, shredded | 1 large tart apple, chopped | 2 packages fast cook chicken ( i just use 2 1/2 lb whole chickens, about 2.

instructions: Brown ground chuck with onions, celery seed, salt, italian seasoning, and celery seed in large skillet.  Combine with meat.  Spoon into slow cooker.  Top with cheese and diced apple.  Pour hot soup into slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for about 6 to 8 hours until hot throughout enjoy.

title: Mexican Beets
ingredients: 2 lbs potatoes | 1 teaspoon dried thyme leaves | 1/2 teaspoon cumin | 1 1/2 teaspoons chili powder | 3/4 cup dried chipotle powder
instructions: Cook potatoes as specified on package.  Drain well and cool.  Meanwhile, combine all ingredients, except for salt, potato and beets, in a crockpot.  Toss potatoes with spices and refrigerate on low for 4 - 8 hours.  Garnish dish with a sprinkling of fresh parsley.

title: Chicken Satay With Peanut Sauce and Rocket
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts | 1/4 cup beer or 1/4 cup water | 1 chicken bouillon cube | 1 tablespoon chicken tenderizer ( found online at the internet 'kitchen bouquet or bouquet garni ) | 1 cup shucked sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, rehydrated | 1/4 cup chunky peanut butter | 1/4 cup red bell pepper, shredded | saffadilla thin strips of fresh lime wedge ( see photo for recipe )
instructions: If you want to make the satay ahead of time, remove any fat and sinew from the chicken, rinse well and pat dry with paper towels.  Place the chicken in a large bowl.  In a blender, combine the marinade ingredients, and puree to desired texture.

title: Faux Chilled Plums
ingredients: 1/2 cup ground whole plum, pitted | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod
instructions: Place the plum into an ice filled popsicle gun lined with cheese cloth until the surface of the plums appears to be opaque, about 5 seconds per side.  Sprinkle with ground cardamom and press to remove any unappetizing bits on the surface of the plum.  Let cool to room temperature before popping the lid.

title: Fiesta Cauliflower
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups dried cauliflower florets | 1 tablespoon plain nonfat yogurt | 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 dash cajun seasoning salt | 1 dash chili powder | 1 can black olives, chopped | 1/3 cup cubed provolone cheese | 1/2 cup plain nonfat yogurt
instructions: Place the cauliflower in a large bowl with 1/4 tablespoon seasoning salt, ¼ teaspoon cajun seasoning salt and ¼ teaspoon chili powder.  Mix well to coat.  Let sit for 30 minutes.  While cauliflower is soaking, mix olives, provolone cheese, nonfat yogurt in a small bowl until well combined.  Place remaining 1/4 teaspoon seasoning salt and ¼ teaspoon minced chili powder in a nonstick skillet.  Turn the burner to medium low and place the olives in the mixture.  Stir occasionally until the cheese has melted and starts to brown, about 15 - 20 minutes.  Add cauliflower.  Cover and cook for 15 minutes over medium low heat.  Stir every 5 minutes.  After 15 minutes, test for doneness by inserting a knife test.  It should have a crunchy texture.  If it does not, replace lid and cook another 5 minutes.  You may need to add more of any of your favorite seasonings.  If the cauliflower doesn't appear dry on the bottom, sprinkle additional toppings on top.  Let sit for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Django's Taco Spaghetti
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self-rising flour | 1 1/2 cups taco seasoning ( i use penzey's brand ) | 1 1/2 1 1/2 cups spaghetti sauce or 1 1/2 cups picante sauce | 1 teaspoon dill seed | 2 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder | pam cooking spray or butter or margarine, for pan
instructions: Combine flour and taco seasoning.  Stir until combined, making sure that all dry flour is coated with taco seasoning.  Add spaghetti and mix until coated.  Spray or grease a 9x13 baking dish.  Stir dill in sauce and spread into pan.  Bake at 350°f for 35 - 40 minutes.  Serve by itself with warm tortilla chips.
