title: Chickpea Pie
ingredients: 4 potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks | 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed | sea salt and black pepper to taste | 1 egg white | 1 sheet puff pastry, defrosted | 1 lime wedge
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Place potatoes into a large saucepan with enough lightly salted water to cover.  Bring to a boil, and cook until tender enough to pierce with a knife, 8 to 10 minutes.  Drain, and allow to cool completely.  Once they are cool enough to handle, toss with chickpeas to coat.  Season with salt and pepper.  To roll out the pastry, place 4 or 5 pieces of prepared pastry onto a flat, slightly floured surface.  Top with 2 tablespoons or less of potato/pea mixture to cover the bottom of the pastry.  Place 2 or 3 tablespoons of the chickpea/water mixture over the chickpeas.  Fold over the edges of the pastry, and crimp with a fork to seal.  Place the pie on a baking sheet.  Cut a few slits across the top of the pie for steam to escape.  Beat egg white in a shallow bowl.  Roll the pastry out to the desired thickness.  Cut into desired shapes.  Brush the top and a little of the beaten egg white with remaining beaten egg white.  Bake in the preheated oven until the crust is golden, about 15 minutes.

title: Quick & Easy Chicken Naan
ingredients: 1/2 cup za'atar spice mix | 1/16 - 1/4 cup hot water | 1 cup biscuit, your preference | 1/2 cup sweet red pepper, chopped | 1/4 cup pear, chopped
instructions: Mix zaatar, water, biscuit.  Spray a cookie sheet with cooking oil.  Drop heaping spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Top with bell pepper and pear.  Bake in 400°f oven for 45 - 60 minutes or until hot all the way through.

Random Ingredients: scotch whisky,graham cracker crumb,brussels sprout,urad dal
title: Smashed Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1 bag brussels sprouts ( large size ) | 1 cup graham cracker crumbs | 1 cup urad dal, dried skinned | 1 teaspoon scotch whisky
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit.  Clean and rinse sprouts, dry well with paper towels, place in an ungreased pan, and sprinkle with cracker crumbs.  Combine the drained urad dal and whiskey.  Pour all over sprouts, tossing to coat evenly.  Transfer sprouts to a greased baking sheet and bake in center of oven about 1 hour, or until hot, stirring sprouts from the center.

title: Salmon and Potato Curry
ingredients: 1 kg fresh salmon or 1 kg fish fillet, cut into chunks | 1 kg potato, cut into large chunks | 1 teaspoon garam masala powder | 1 tablespoon ghee ( if using salted butter, substitute for oil ) | 2 mandarin oranges, sliced
instructions: Cut the fish chunks and potatoes into thick wedges.  Sprinkle garam masala powder over fish, add ghee.  Place potatoes and salmon into baking dish and roast in oven at 160°c for 60 minutes, or until fish is just cooked.  Remove from oven and add mandarin oranges to tomato sauce.  Cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes.  Serve with rice.

title: Grilled Artichokes
ingredients: 1 cup artichoke heart, cut into wedges | 3 poblano chiles, seeded and finely chopped | 1 inch piece ginger, finely chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in a shallow nonstick skillet, sprinkle with salt.  Cover and grill on medium heat for about 10 minutes, or until hot.  Serve on a pool of warm cheese.

title: Frank and Toblerone's Super-Duper Hot Sauce
ingredients: 2 tablespoons corn oil | 14 ounces fresh sliced pepperoni, drained | 19 ounces green enchilada sauce | 1 bunch italian parsley
instructions: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat to medium high heat.  Add pepperoni and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.  Add hot enchilada sauce and parsley and simmer until heated through.

title: My Mango Chili
ingredients: 1 package rotini pasta | 1 can mangoes, diced | 1/2 cup juice | 1/4 teaspoon chili powder | 1/4 cup shredded tortilla
instructions: In a pot cook pasta according to package directions till “cooked”.

title: Cranberry Churros
ingredients: 1 can cranberry juice | 1/2 cup cocoa | hamburger bun
instructions: Open can of cranberry juice on counter top.  Take a small bowl and place cranberry juice in it.  Take a fork and break it up a bit so that it is like the juice.  Chop 2 tablespoons of the cranberry juice to make it smoother.  Place cocoa in bowl with cranberry juice.  Heat in microwave 1 minute so that it melts but doesn't burn.  Dip hamburger buns in cocoa mixture, then place on a sheet of wax paper.  Spread cranberry juice evenly on bun.  Cut burger buns in half.  Spoon some cranberry juice onto each bun, and serve.

title: Artichoke Dipping Sauce
ingredients: fresh artichoke heart, sliced thin ( can also use frozen or canned as needed ) | pepper ( to taste ) | 1 tablespoon vanilla | 12 cups ice cubes
instructions: To serve, place about 1 1/2 cups of sliced artichoke hearts in a small bowl.  Sprinkle with about 1 tbsp pepper and a tablespoon of vanilla.  Stir well.  Place the remainder of the artichokes in a food processor or a blender and process until coarsely chopped or.  Add to the bowl and stir.  The water should be just about enough to coat the artichokes.  Serve at room temperature.  You may have leftover artichoke juices and chopped artichoke hearts in the refrigerator too if desired.

title: Crusty Caraway Cheese
ingredients: 8 ounces part-skim mozzarella cheese | 1 tablespoon caraway seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Cut cheese in half, then in half again lengthwise, making sure it has all the cut on the inside of the piece.  Put a piece of cheese in an 8x8 inch glass pie plate.  Cover with a layer of the caraway seed.  Repeat with the other half of the cheese.  Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is bubbly, and the edges are golden brown, about 15 minutes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: allspice berry,lemon zest,kaffir lime leaf,paprika,tortilla,yellow pepper,turmeric powder,provolone cheese
title: Tunisian Quesadillas
ingredients: 4 -6 large soft tortillas | 1/4 lb thinly sliced provolone cheese | 20 -25 whole allspice berries | 1 tablespoon lemon zest | 1/2 tablespoon turmeric powder | 1/2 tablespoon paprika ( sweet for color ) | 1 small yellow pepper, chopped | 1 kaffir lime leaf, chopped ( optional )
instructions: In a nonstick pan, coat the bottom and sides with a thin layer of spray oil.  Put a few slices of the provolone on the center tortilla.  Spread a generous amount of the cheese all around the tortilla.  Add some of the kaffir lime leaves.  Layer with a few thinly sliced pepper, a few pieces of sliced zest, and a few spices.  Fold to enclose the cheese and pepper, and put in pan.  Keep turning down the tortillas a few times, until all the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crisp and golden.  Put on a plate and let cool for about 15 minutes.  Cut into quarters and serve with salsa, hot coffee or ice cold pickled jalapeno.

Random Ingredients: chinese five spice powder,chili,salt pork,potato flake,orange liqueur,red chili paste
title: Spice Pork With Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1 red chili paste | 3 tablespoons chinese five spice powder | 3 tablespoons dried chat cake flakes | 1 -2 pinch salt | 1 -2 orange liqueur | 3 lbs chat potatoes, scrubbed | 1 small chili, julienned finely
instructions: Mix red chili paste, five spice powder, chat cake flakes and salt together in a bowl for the sweet potato.  Spread a little oil onto a rack in the baking pan at 220°c heat remaining oil in the oven.  Using 2 tbsp of sweet potato mixture per pound of meat, roll each pound of meat into a log, about 6 - 7 inches long.  Wearing clean gloves, make little slits on the meat, taking care not to tear the membrane from the thick wall of the meat.  Seal the slit with the orange liqueur.  Repeat with remaining meat, adding a little more oil to the pan when necessary.  Put the meat into a preheated oven heated to 220°c and bake in the oven, turning once, for 1 1/2 hours until browned.  Baste during this time with any pan juices to make sure it does not burn and caramelize.  Remove and discard the ginger and onions after 2 - 3 hours at 150°c.  Add chilli and cook for a further 15 minutes at 220°c.  Cut off the sweet potatoes from the stalks, then use a paring knife to cut into large 3/4 inch cubes and return to the saucepan.  Add a little water and toss in to the sweet potato.  Bring to the boil and simmer for another 15 minutes.  Remove from the heat, add more sweet potato mixture and serve.

title: Italian Tuna Soup
ingredients: 1 can tuna, drained, flaked and flaked | 2 cans canned chicken broth or ( 15 ounce ) cans vegetable broth and water
instructions: Combine the tuna and chicken broth in an electric blender.  Cover and blend for 5 minutes.  Stir in the cherry tomatoes.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: hot water,plain yogurt,radish,potato starch,rice wine vinegar,parsley
title: Sweet Potato and Radish Soup
ingredients: 3 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced | 10 cups hot water | 1/2 cup rice wine vinegar | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground radish | 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped | 2 cups plain fat-free yogurt
instructions: Cover sweet potatoes with water in large pot and bring to a boil.  Cook until tender when pierced with a fork and the inside is firm, about 50 minutes.  Drain and transfer to processor.  Add hot water, vinegar and radishes and process until smooth.  Season with salt, if needed.  With machine running, add yogurt in a thin stream, through a slit in potato, cutting down sides as needed.  Continue processing until the mixture is chunky and creamy. .  Pour into soup bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: nutmeg,boston lettuce,deli roast beef,wine,black pepper,pine nut,ham,onion powder
title: Roast Beef, Ham and Lettuce Bites
ingredients: 3 -3 lbs deli roast beef | 3 -4 lbs cooked ham | 3 -4 heads boston lettuce | 1/2 lb pine nuts | 1 bunch minced fresh onion | 1 bottle dry white wine | 1 teaspoon black pepper | 1 teaspoon nutmeg | 3 packages deli roast beef ( in foil )
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Toss ham with bread crumbs, spices if desired.  Tear off a long strip of foil about 12 x 2.  Put roast in middle, then ham and top with lettuce and pine nuts.  Dress with a good helping of white wine and remaining drippings from roast beef.  Seal ends of foil, and bake 20 minutes.  Remove foil, raise heat to 400 and bake about 1 hour to crisp edges and crisp out.

title: Easy Microwaved French Fries
ingredients: 2 large russet potatoes | 1 1/2 cups processed cheese ( your choice ) or 1 1/2 cups cubed mozzarella cheese ( your choice )
instructions: Turn on microwave and leave in for about 10 minutes.  Peel your potatoes.  Cut into sticks about 1 1/2 1 wide and 4 long.  Cut sticks in half or thirds if they stick out of all four corners.  Cut cheese into 1/4 or 1/2 cubes.  Using a pastry brush, coat each potato sticks with the goat cheese, making sure you coat all the cheese but not it too long the cheese will make the fries chewy.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes or until crispy.  You may need to cover every minute or 2 to ensure all are cooked.  The cheese will melt and look shiny and golden brown.  You may need to cover more than one time.  Allow to sit for 5 more minutes so the fries absorb the grease and turn a little golden in color.  Remove to paper towels to serve warm or at room temperature.  My friend adds finely chopped carrots and red pepper flakes to this recipe and it makes a huge, crunchy dinner.

title: Roasted Cheese
ingredients: 1 bottle dry red wine vinegar | 1 1/2 lbs grated cheese ( emmenthaler, gruyere or similar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Bring vinegar to a boil just below boiling point, then remove from heat.  Stir in cheese, cover and let stand until cheese is melted, about 15 minutes.  Spread cheese on cookie sheets and toast lightly.

title: Nido's Flavour Enhancer for Flavoring Sizzles
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, sifted | 100 g brandy | 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder | 200 stalks celery, chopped
instructions: Add brandy to flour.  Add turmeric.  Mix until dough is manageable.  Place in bowl.  Cover, let rest 10 minutes.  Roll out to about 5 mm thickness.  Cut to desired size.  Use as desired with scissors.  Bake or fry.  If desired with any flavoured chutney.  Keeps indefinitely.

Random Ingredients: wheat bread,coriander leaf,garlic,beef roast,nigella seed,cider vinegar,butter cooky,lemon peel
title: Sizzling Beef Sandwiches With Nigella Seeds
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons nigella seeds or 1 1/2 tablespoons sesame seeds | 300 g beef roast or 300 g sirloin tip steak | 2 slices whole wheat bread | 125 g pickled mushrooms | 1/4 cup coriander leaves | 1 teaspoon cider vinegar | 1 teaspoon grated lemon peel | 1 teaspoon minced garlic
instructions: Dry fry the nigella seeds in a small frying pan over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until aromatic.  Alternatively, you can crush them with mortar and pestle, place in a small plastic bag, and leave for another 15 - 20 minutes.  Trim any excess fat from the beef and slice into thin strips.  Grill or broil the slices of beef for 2 - 3 minutes on each side, until lightly charred.  Combine all the accompaniments together in a small saucepan.  Divide between 4 warmed dinner plates.  Drizzle with a few drops of cider vinegar or use a bbq brush to drizzle the sizzling beef over the top.  Serve immediately.

title: Macaroni and Pork Casserole
ingredients: 4 lbs pork butt | 1/4 cup caster sugar | 3 tablespoons port wine | 1 can macaroni ( i prefer penne rigate ) | 1 yellow pepper, diced | 2 cups cooked rice
instructions: Cut the pork butt into chunks in a ziploc bag or large bowl.  Add the sugar, port and half the macaroni.  Squeeze the contents of the ziploc bag into the bowl and mix with the pork.  Coat the contents of all the bag in the red papper oil on all sides and shake the bag a few times, but do not throw out the contents of the bag unless wanted.  Pour the pork mixture into a greased 10 x 5 loaf pan.  Top with the remaining macaroni, the yellow pepper and the remaining macaroni.  If you want it to sit at room temperature it can be done this way.  Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees f for 1 hour.  Remove the foil and cook, covered, for the final 35 to 40 minutes.  I'm really trying to go as quickly as possible, take the foil off and let it sit for ten minutes before slicing.  Serve with warm pianogurt on the side.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: white onion,wide egg noodle,farmer cheese,gruyere cheese,farfalle pasta
title: Farfalle Cheese Fettuccine
ingredients: 1 package wide egg noodles | 1 package farmers cheese | 1 package farmer's cheese | 1/4 white onion, chopped | 8 ounces dry wide egg noodles | 1 package gruyere cheese, shredded
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook egg noodles until just tender, about 8 minutes.  Drain, and rinse to cool.  In a large bowl, mix together farmers cheese, farmer's cheese, and white onion.  Mix in drained noodles, and mix in the egg noodles.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Transfer half of the noodle mixture into the prepared baking dish.  Sprinkle with half the gruyere cheese.  Repeat with remaining noodle mixture, then top with remaining gruyere cheese.  Bake in preheated oven 30 to 35 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Honeydew Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces fresh haphdew | 7 ounces spaghetti | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Start boiling your pasta for the following recipe.  Chop the honeydew and put it into a skillet over a medium heat.  As soon as the honeydew begins to bubble, put in the mustard seeds.  Then sprinkle over the honeydew and let it all fry on the very top of the stove.  When the honeydew starts to swell, drain the pasta right away.  Immediately, toss your pasta with a little olive oil to get the pasta soft to your desired thickness.  You will need to stir occasionally to prevent the honeydew from sticking to the bottom of the pot.

Random Ingredients: asian sesame oil,cayenne pepper,cocoa powder,red chili pepper,flat leaf parsley,raisin,icing sugar,cardamom pod
title: Mixed Christmas Blend Recipe and Add Ins
ingredients: 3 cups icing sugar ( confectioners, not sifted, but sifted ) | 2 teaspoons good quality cocoa powder | 10 cardamom pods | 3 tablespoons flat leaf parsley, finely chopped | 3 tablespoons raisins, dried | 2 tablespoons raisins, finely chopped | 1 1 red chili peppers, seeded, minced or 3 ounces minced red chiles ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon asian sesame oil | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Prepare meringue.  Chop cardamom pods into pieces that are 3 inches long and 3 inches wide, and the small green cardamom pods for a half moon works best.  Place in a small saucepan with just enough water to cover.  Bring water to a boil and lower into the bowl with the icing sugar and cocoa powder.  Add the cinnamon, parsley, raisins, dried red chiles, sesame oil and cayenne pepper.  Remove the saucepan from the heat and allow the mixture to cool slightly.  With wet hands, fold the icing into the meringue until all of the icing has been absorbed.  Spread out the mixture on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden.  Allow to cool completely.  Cut into squares or diamonds, or cut into fingers after removing the paper around the edge of the square and removing the meringue.  Keep warm in a low oven if storing.  Store in an airtight tin in the fridge for up to 1 week.

Random Ingredients: nut,bamboo shoot,raspberry,fine breadcrumb,vanilla extract,rice noodle,red pepper flake
title: Raspberry Truffles
ingredients: 4 ounces fine dry breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1/8 teaspoon fine dry breadcrumbs ( optional ) | 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes | 1 can bamboo shoots, undrained | 1/2 cup frozen raspberries, thawed | 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract or 1 teaspoon almond extract | 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together first seven ingredients.  With hands, form crumbs into ball.  Place on a paper towel lined plate.  Flatten slightly with the palm of your hand.  Dust hands with fine crumbs.  Cover with a clean towel and set aside for 15 minutes.  Roll ball into crumbs, pressing gently with a fork.  Cover top of ball with a clean towel and set aside for at least 5 minutes.  Roll balls in fine dry bread crumbs.  Cover with a clean towel and set aside for 15 minutes.  Heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Place 1/4 cup of crumb in a paper bag with a lid.  Moisten inside edge of bag with water.  Holding bag on a work surface, lightly press crumbs into crumbs until all crumbs are moistened, about 1 minute.  Add truffles to hot pan with a lid and cook until crisp or set aside on a plate.  Repeat with remaining truffles.  Drain truffles on paper towels.

Random Ingredients: eggplant,turnip,tortilla,beef sirloin steak,yellow bell pepper,anaheim chilies,black eyed pea,sugar
title: Enfrijoladas
ingredients: 6 ounces beef sirloin steaks, trimmed | 1/2 teaspoon sugar | 1 1/2 cups canned black-eyed peas | 1 1/2 cups yellow bell peppers, diced | 1 1/2 cups red anaheim chilies, diced | 8 6-inch tortillas | 4 small turnips or 3 small rutabagas, peeled and diced, for garnish | 4 small eggplant or 4 other semi-ripe plantains, quartered ( 1 1/2 lbs )
instructions: Place beef steak in a large nonstick skillet.  Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.  Cook over high heat until brown, 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and slice thinly across the grain.  Return beef to skillet along with the sugar.  Stir in the peas, peppers, chiles, and tortillas.  Spoon some meat mixture into each tortilla.  Drizzle with some of the hot juice from the skillet.  Sprinkle with onions and serve with green salads.

title: Sauerkraut and Cabbage
ingredients: 3 lbs cabbage, sliced | 1 lb sauerkraut
instructions: Boil cabbage for 20 minutes.  Drain cabbage, add sauerkraut, simmer for an additional 5 minutes.

Random Ingredients: catsup,lemon twist,asparagus,rye bread,rice wine vinegar,whipping cream,quinoa
title: Rye Bread Salad with Dressing
ingredients: 3 cups cooked quinoa | 1 tablespoon rice wine vinegar or 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar | 3/4 cup catsup | 1 1/2 cups warm whipping cream | 1 teaspoon lemon twists or 1 teaspoon dried lemon rind | 12 thin asparagus | 6 slices rye bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°f.  Combine all ingredients except asparagus and rye bread in a large bowl.  Slice thin asparagus.  Place on a lined baking sheet and bake 25 min at 300°f.

title: Capers and Noodles in Tamari
ingredients: 6 tablespoons water chestnuts, drained | 1/3 cup capers, drained | 6 -8 ounces rice noodles | 1 tablespoon tamari
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to boil.  Add rice noodles and cook according to package direction.  Drain.  Mix tamari into cooked noodles.  Add 2 - 3 tbs of water into the noodles and noodles and mix well to coat.

title: Easy Hummus
ingredients: 1 can chickpeas, rinsed and drained | 1 cup dry breadcrumbs | corn chips, for dipping
instructions: Place the chickpeas in a food processor, making sure they fit.  Add the breadcrumbs, and pulse until the breadcrumbs are mixed into the chickpeas.  Transfer onto a plate, and dip a few chips into it.  Refrigerate until serving.

title: Easy 5-Minute Cheese Appetizer
ingredients: 1 cup lowfat swiss cheese, shredded | 5 tablespoons lowfat greek yogurt | 1/2 cup frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained | 2 -3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves, chopped
instructions: Arrange a layer of frozen veggies on the bottom of a casserole dish such as a small crystal.  Top with another layer of frozen veggies.  In a small bowl stir together the yogurt and cilantro.  Pour over veggies.  Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or longer, until cheese is bubbly.  I like to broil briefly and watch carefully.

title: Smoking Subs
ingredients: 4 hoagie rolls | 2 -3 tablespoons accodido seasoning | 1 teaspoon argon chironol tablets
instructions: On each slice of hoagie roll, spread accent congo over the hoagie roll and close the sandwich.  Spray skillet with cooking spray and place sandwiches in to it.

Random Ingredients: asafoetida powder,garlic paste,fire tomato,iceberg lettuce,tarragon,marinara sauce
title: Fettuccine In Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 1/16 tablespoon tarragon | 1/16 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( known as hing ) | 1 pinch garlic paste | 1 tablespoon minced marinara sauce | 2 fire-roasted tomatoes, sliced | 2 cups finely shredded iceberg lettuce | 1/2 cup crushed iceberg lettuce
instructions: Using a mortar and pestle, pound the tarragon, asafoetida and garlic paste into a paste.  Combine in a small bowl and pour over the diced tomatoes.  Cover and chill for 1 hour.  Cook noodles in boiling water, according to package directions.  Drain and divide among individual bowls.  Drizzle with sauce.

Random Ingredients: beer,cabbage,white cornmeal,cardamom seed,red chili pepper,lime twist
title: Cucuzza (Colcannon)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage ( about 2 pounds ) or 1 head bibb lettuce, shredded ( about 2 pounds ) | 1/3 cup fine quality dry white cornmeal | 2 1/2 fluid ounces very hot beer ( such as guinness ) | 1/8 - 1/4 teaspoon crushed cardamom seed | 1 small dried red chili pepper | 1 lime twist, cut into thin 1 inch pieces
instructions: Wash, core and shred cabbage, and place in bowl of electric blender, or food processor.  If necessary, add more beer, to thin.  Add cornmeal, beer, cardamom and chile, and pulse just until mixture is fairly smooth.  Transfer to nonstick skillet and place over medium heat.  When it is hot, add lime twist pieces and stir quickly.  Serve warm, not hot, with pita chips.

Random Ingredients: parchment paper,cranberry,non dairy coffee creamer,broth,chili paste,pork chop,cool whip
title: Chili, Cranberry and Pork Tops
ingredients: 1 bag frozen non-dairy coffee creamer | 1/4 cup cold non-dairy coffee creamer | 1/4 cup broth | 1/4 cup chili paste | 4 ounces pork chops | 1 cup frozen cranberries | parchment paper
instructions: Put dried cranberries in a bowl, add a little water to cover, set aside.  In a saucepan, stir in the 1/4 cup of water and 1/4 cup of the non dairy creamer, cook over high heat until mixture comes to a boil.  Remove from heat, add the hot coffee creamer.  When boiling, return to low and stir with whisk until very thick.  Pour into serving dish, and coat pork with remaining non dairy creamer, dip in chocolate, and set aside.  Remove chops from parchment paper, brush with remaining non dairy creamer.  Fry over medium heat until golden on both sides, remove from heat.  Spoon some sauce into a bowl and top with pork and cranberries.  Repeat as many times as you can until all chops are used, topping off with more sauce.

title: Beef Rolls for Two
ingredients: 3 lbs beef tenderloin, cut in one inch cubes | 4 teaspoons dry mustard | 4 -4 lbs cooked shrimp, peeled, deveined | 6 habanero peppers, seeded and minced ( with or without oil or salt ) | 2 packages active dry yeast ( one whole envelope ) | 1/4 cup yellow split peas
instructions: In large skillet, warm 2 cups of water and dry mustard over low heat.  Add meat and saute until very tender and cooked through.  Drain.  Place 2 cups of warm water and habanero chilies over medium heat, stirring frequently.  Dissolve yeast in remaining 2 cups of warm water, and add to skillet.  Let stand until creamy, about 10 minutes.  Add sauteed meat and chilies.  Dissolve yeast in dissolved yeast.  Add 2 cups of the hot broth, 1/4 cup of the flour and 1 tablespoon of the salt.  Stir well.  When all is incorporated, turn onto floured surface and knead until very smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes.  Divide into 8 equal portions.  Working from one side of center, roll each portion out to a thin oval.  Repeat with remaining portions.  In a large roasting pan, combine rolls with all of the ingredients except the peas and the rolls. .  Cover with wax paper and add 1/4 inch of water.  Place in a preheated 350°f oven for 30 minutes.  Sprinkle with peas and return to oven uncovered for 30 minutes longer.  Uncover and turn off oven.  Allow to cool at least 20 minutes before slicing.  I like to serve these in the winter and eat them on the same day.  The longer they stay in the fridge, the spicier they get.

title: Indian Spiced Applesauce
ingredients: 2 medium tart apples | 1/2 cup golden raisin | 2 teaspoons fresh coriander, chopped | 2 teaspoons vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt | 1 egg white | 1 teaspoon fresh coriander, chopped | 1/4 cup pineapple, chopped
instructions: Peel apples and cut into quarters place slices in bowl and sprinkle with raisins and other spices, mix till evenly mixed.  Beat egg white and add to apples.  Let sit for 15 minutes then stir in fresh coriander, pineapple.  Cover and chill 1 hour then serve.

Random Ingredients: lebanese cucumber,red leaf lettuce,vanilla pudding,baby spinach,butternut squash,red chilies,baguette,pecorino romano cheese
title: Cucumber,  Vegetable and Grilled Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 200 g butternut squash, peeled & cut into 2 cm cubes | 200 g lebanese cucumbers, peeled & cut into 2 cm cubes | 500 g baby spinach | 100 g red leaf lettuce | 4 -6 pieces baguette | 150 g store bought vanilla pudding | 50 g grated pecorino romano cheese | 2 small red chilies
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat & line w/greaseproof paper.  Combine together with all of the other ingredients except the paprikas & cheese.  Put in a shallow dish, cover & chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour.  Remove from refrigerator & cut into squares.  Combine with the pesto until well mixed & put in a serving dish.  Serve with bread & a green leaf salad.

Random Ingredients: monterey jack cheese,green bean,peanut oil,topping,allspice,sherry,flour tortilla,mirin
title: Green Bean Chimichangas
ingredients: 12 small flour tortillas | 1 cup frozen green beans, thawed and drained | 3 tablespoons dry sherry | 4 tablespoons peanut oil | 1 1/2 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded | 3/4 teaspoon ground allspice | toppings : | 1 tablespoon mirin or 1 tablespoon dry white wine
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Spread 6 tortillas flat.  Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges and arrange on rimmed baking sheet.

title: Halloween-Baked Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 16 ounces sirloin steaks | 1 cup breadcrumbs | 2 cups lettuce | 1/2 cup onion, thinly sliced | 1 package semi-sweet chocolate chips or ( 6 ounce ) package salted peanut butter chips
instructions: Slice sirloin steaks.

Random Ingredients: pepper,serrano pepper,lemon zest,ice water,crabmeat,chili paste,fish stock,tilapia fillet
title: Fish in Spicy Coriander Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup lemon zest, finely julienned | 1/4 cup fresh serrano peppers or 1/4 cup green jalapeno pepper, chopped | 2 tablespoons chili paste | 1 tablespoon fish stock | 1/2 tablespoon fresh ground pepper | 2 lbs fish fillets, cut into 6 pieces | 1/2 cup crabmeat, coarsely chopped | ice water
instructions: Place fish in a bowl, cover with cold water, then refrigerate for 1 hour.  Drain fish and pat dry.

Random Ingredients: vegetable oil cooking spray,button mushroom,white bean,beef roast,serrano chilies,cheddar cheese,orange
title: Mushroom & Frijoles
ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef roast | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil cooking spray | 2 large serrano chilies or 4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and sliced lengthwise | 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese | 1 can white beans, drained | 1/2 cup drained well-rinsed canned button mushrooms | 1/2 teaspoon grated orange rind
instructions: Trim fat from meat.  Spray inside of crockpot with oil cooking spray.  Place chiles in food processor.  Cut meat into about 1/4 pieces.  Spray crockpot with oil cooking spray.  Add meat with chiles, cheese, beans, mushrooms, and orange rind.  Add enough water to just cover meat.  Cover crockpot and cook on low heat setting 8 - 10 hours.  Or on high heat 3 1/2 hours.  Or until meat is very tender about 2 hours.  Before serving, shred meat with 2 forks.

title: Tortilla Style Melt
ingredients: 1 lb american cheese | 1/2 cup corn chips | 1/2 teaspoon xanthan gum | 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
instructions: Heat skillet on med.  Heat.  Spread corn chips and cheese onto pan and top with a little bit of the xanthan gum and garlic powder.  Micro cook until cheese is melted and the spread has nice creamy consistency.  Serve.

title: The Only Real Beef Stew Ever!!!

instructions: If you are having this on a go, do this step first, then put a good sized pot on your stove top and put a very heavy bottom on the stove and begin to heat the beef slowly.  If your wok is not really going to be able to hold a lid add ice water a little at a time so your water doesn't get too hot, then take the beef out of the pot and add a bit of the hot liquid.  I usually add about a tablespoon of cooking liquid into the liquid, and then take all of that liquid out and discard any solids.  Add the rest of the ingredients and stir well.  Turn your stove to a very slow simmer.  You will need the liquid to cover the meat by about ½ inch or so.  When the meat is nearly done add another 1/2 cup of water and stir.  Don't worry if it doesn't cover completely.  The water will be absorbed.  You'll need this to continue cooking and tasting every so often to make sure there is enough liquid if you need to.  Simmer for several hours stirring a good amount of time before you start to add the water.  If you are in a hurry and need to add more water, stir.  The liquid will reduce to a soupy consistency.  If your wok gets hot enough, the liquid will evaporate and be no longer cloudy.  You can add a dash of worcestershire sauce after ¾ hour to thicken the soup, if you like.

title: Maple Bacon-And-Jelly Ham Appetizer!
ingredients:

    - ) | 4 -6 tablespoons lard or 4 -6 tablespoons bacon fat, warmed | 1 tablespoon coriander seed | 2 tablespoons maple syrup | 2 tablespoons black pepper
instructions: Place ham in a pan and pour over enough pan dripping to cover the ham.  Add all other ingredients and enough pan drippings to cover everything.  Turn down the heat to low, cover tightly, and set in a very low oven for a couple of hours.  When i start smelling this it will be dark in colour and a little crusty on the outside.  I remove the lid and check, it should be tender enough to slice very thin on a diagonal, moist and no longer runny when cooked though.  To test if it is done, carefully remove ham from the oven and place slices on a large platter or slice into strips and place on a board or pizza stone.  This method gives the ham more flavor and allows texture to penetrate more deeply.  Slice into thick slices and keep warm in a low oven on low heat.  This technique produces a much thicker bar of crispy ham, which is good and needs no drying time.  Also it tastes much better after this stage for left overs.  The traditional method is to lightly fry the ham in a large pan using the fat for 3 minutes each side so as not to overload the pan when frying the ham.  A nice thick slice is achieved by making a sandwich shape that has a high enough amount of fat to support a piece of ham and has a crispy crust on it and a crispy texture.  The ham has the required texture and texture to adhere to the fatty slice that flows out during frying the ham when you slice it up into crispy strips and the crispy one does not have an 'oatmeal texture'.

title: Baja Empanadas (Traditional Mashed Potatoes #5FIX)
ingredients: 10 -12 simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes | 3 cups masa harina, divided
instructions: Cook simply potatoes traditional mashed potatoes according to the package directions in a large pot.  Add approximately 6 ounces of white flour to simply potatoes, mixing well to avoid gummy flouring the mixture.  Add approximately 1/4 cup of masa harina to simply potatoes and mix.  Add approximately 2 tablespoons of masa harina in small increments until the dough is not sticky.  Wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate for at least 2 hours prior to making potatoes.  When dough is ready, pre heat oven to 375 degrees f.  On baking day, place dough on baking sheet and flatten it out with a rolling pin so that it is flat and manageable to drop in your hands.  Use your hands to gently squeeze out any dough that is not holding together.  Using a fork, mash mixture with masa harina all the time so that it will not stick to the bowl.  If dough is too wet to work with, continue mixing using your hands until you have your dough all worked out.  Once dough is formed, using a dough wheel or spoon, make a thumbprint in the dough, and pull up sides of the dough, to tighten the hole.  Place in refrigerator to rest while making the rest.  Once all all the dough is rested, lightly flour your hands and fingers.  Using a 3 - 6 to 4 inch round cookie cutter, cut off doughnuts approximately 1 1/2 by 2 inches.  Bake the doughnuts for 12 - 15 minutes or until nicely browned.  Remove doughnuts from oven, brush tops with butter and let cool slightly.  This will ensure your doughnuts will keep their shape and won't fall apart as they continue to bake.  Once cooled completely, sprinkle with more masa harina to coat.  Allow to cool completely.  Store cooled doughnuts out of direct light so they may not be eaten by your family.  It would not be wise to add any salt to the potato mixture.  Makes approximately 8 - 10 servings.
