Remove from oven and place on the baking sheet.  Sprinkle with salt.  Repeat with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil.  Spray with cooking spray again.

title: Truffles
ingredients: 12 serrano chilies | 2 1/2 cups self raising flour
instructions: Clean and deseed the chiles and cut them into thin slices.  Put the chiles in a pestle dish with two tablespoons of hot water and leave them for five minutes.  Now stir in the flour to make a stiff dough.  Now knead the dough for 15 minutes until it is soft and smooth.  Keep aside for about ten minutes.  Divide the dough into twelve sections.  Use 2 teaspoons of the mixture to make the truffle buds.  Bake in a moderately slow oven for five minutes.  Turn out on a clean teflex paper towel or a greased baking rack.  Keep warm in a low oven until required.  These can be sliced or fried right away if you do so.

title: Cheese Triangoon
ingredients: 1/3 cup brown onion, diced | 1 1/4 cups jasmine rice | 4 fresh red chilies, stemmed deseeded, halved | 1/3 cup cheese, shredded | 1/3 cup fresh cheese, shredded | 18 ladyfingers
instructions: Cook rice and chiles in 2 1/2 cups boiling water for 5 minutes.  Drain water.  Cover and chillies 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, in small saucepan, heat cheese until melted.  Cut a slit in a ladyfinger at 2 inch intervals.  Fill each slit with 1 tablespoon cheese.  Arrange 8 ladyfingers on a plate.  Spoon 1/4 cup rice mixture over.  Sprinkle a little cheese on top to prevent rice from sticking together.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: chunky salsa,anchovy fillet,marsala wine,black bean,halibut fillet,cake flour
title: Pan Seared Halibut
ingredients: 1 halibut fillet | 2 anchovy fillets, drained | 1 cup chunky salsa ( salsa verde ) | 1 cup cooked black beans | 1/3 cup marsala wine | 1/3 cup cake flour ( plain confectioners'sugar )
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f.  Place the fillet over an unlined baking sheet.  Sprinkle with anchovies.  In a bowl, combine beans and 1/3 cup marsala wine, mix.  Spoon salsa mixture over the top, then top with remaining fillet.  Bake about 15 minutes until fish flakes easily when prodded with a fork.  Make icing while fish is roasting.

Random Ingredients: white vinegar,kaffir lime leaf,german cooking chocolate,okra,dill
title: Hot Okra Appetizer
ingredients: 1 lb frozen okra | 1/2 lb german cooking chocolate, melted | 2 tablespoons white vinegar | 1 tablespoon fresh dill or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried dill | 3 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Cut okra in half crosswise and then crosswise so it will spread itself evenly.  Place cut out pieces in a baking dish coated with cooking spray.  In a small bowl, combine melted chocolate, vinegar, half of the dill and lime leaves.  Mix until chocolate and dill blend well.

title: Quick and Easy Layered Cottage Cheese Dip
ingredients: 1 pint half-and-half | 1 container plain low fat yogurt | 1/3 cup kahlua | 1 envelope ranch dressing mix | 3/4 cup apricot nectar
instructions: In a medium serving dish, mix together both halves and half, yogurt, kahlua and ranch dressing mix.  Dilute in 1/4 cup of apricots with remaining t milk or water to get a spreadable consistency.  Serve with crackers, toast rounds, and fruit for a more substantial dip.

Random Ingredients: cashew,velveeta cheese,button mushroom,limeade concentrate,hungarian paprika,creme fraiche,oregano
title: Pressed Cheese Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 package button mushrooms ( preferably wild ) | 2 tablespoons creme fraiche or 2 tablespoons yogurt | 1 can frozen limeade concentrate | 1 cup cashew pieces | 1 tablespoon hungarian paprika | 1 teaspoon dried oregano | 1 package velveeta low-fat cheese
instructions: Place the mushrooms into a medium saucepan and cover with water.

title: Sweet and Spicy Pickled Jalapenos
ingredients: 3 -4 canned jalapeno chiles ( depending on how spicy you want the mixture ) | 1/4 cup dark brown sugar | 1 teaspoon salt
instructions: You will have to wear gloves and be careful if they get into your eyes this should take about 20 - 30 minutes to an hour.  If your chiles are sensitive to pepper, you need to wear rubber gloves to protect yourself from drying out.  Soak the chiles in hot water until soft, about 20 to 30 minutes.  Drain the chiles.  Cut away the stem and seed the chiles, and cut them into thin strips.  Stir together all the ingredients.  Store chiles in an airtight container.

title: Pine Nuts
ingredients: 1 pound seasoned stuffing mix | 1/4 cup pine nuts
instructions: Place rice in a large, resealable plastic bag.  Pour seasoned stuffing mix over top of rice.  Close bag and massage stuffing from both directions.  Refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Remove the bag of stuffing mix before placing on a rack in an 11x18 inch baking dish or baking sheet.  Fold pine nuts in half over the stuffing, then in half again.  Sprinkle top with more pine nuts.  Bake, covered, in preheated oven for 45 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jalapeno pepper,asafoetida powder,cauliflower,cardamom pod,sole fillet,water chestnut,cranberry
title: Thai Spiced Sole
ingredients: 1/2 lb sole fillet, cut into 3/4-inch strips | 2 teaspoons ground dried sweet red peppers or 2 teaspoons jalapeno pepper | 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | 1 slice thin cauliflower | 1 can chopped water chestnuts, drained | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 can sliced canned water chestnuts, drained | 1/4 cup diced canned apricots or 1/4 cup other dried fruit
instructions: Heat heavy non stick skillet over medium high heat until very hot.  Add fish to skillet.

Random Ingredients: parmigiano reggiano cheese,genoa salami,serrano chilies,chive,cornflour,extra virgin olive oil
title: Salsiccia Alla Genovese (Genovese Rounds of Spicy Genoa Salami )
ingredients: 500 g ground mild sardines | 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil | 4 slices genoa salami | 1/4 cup chives, chopped | 1/4 cup parmigiano-reggiano cheese, grated | 1 tablespoon cornflour ( cornstarch )
instructions: Cook the sardines for a few minutes in boiling salted water.  Drain and pat dry.  Cut thin slice crosswise with the sharp side of a cleaver for extra flavour.  Keep warm.  Grease a 4 x4 inch baking tin with a little olive oil.  Cut salami in half horizontally.  Place on baking dish.  Sprinkle with chives, cheese, salt and pepper.  Cover with grated cheese.  Sprinkle chives over cheese.  Dissolve cornflour in a little cold water and gently stir into other ingredients.  Pour into prepared dish and evenly spread.  Bake in 350 degree oven until golden approx 30 mins.  Cut into 4 slices.  Variation, substitute thinly sliced hard boiled eggs for sardines.

title: Easy Swedish "bread"
ingredients: 3 slices rye bread | 3/4 cup whipping cream | 1 tablespoon milk | 1/4 teaspoon mccormick's montreal brand steak seasoning
instructions: Combine whipping cream, milk and steak seasoning in a small bowl.  Dip one slice of the rye bread at a time into the cream mixture until covered.  Place on griddle or large skillet.  Turn over and repeat with remaining rye bread.  Turn until cooked through.  Serve with sour cream.

title: Mild Hot Beet and Sultana Salad
ingredients: 500 g beets, cooked, peeled, chopped ( red fingerling ) | 10 -15 sultanas | lime zest, as required
instructions: Place the beets into a pan of boiling water and boil for 5 - 5 minutes or until tender.  Drain and cool slightly.  Drain well and slice thinly or, with a mandoline, finely dice into matchsticks.  Place all the hot beets into a large bowl and sprinkle over plenty of lime zest.  Toss to combine.

title: Melon with Coconut Milk
ingredients: 1 cantaloupe, in 2 cm cubes | 14 ounces coconut milk
instructions: Cut off any green pith from the melon and carefully scoop off the flesh with a spoon or melon baller.  Cut the flesh into cubes and place back into the coconut milk.  Bring it to the boil, then turn down the heat, cover and simmer for 30 minutes or just until the melon is tender.

Random Ingredients: red currant jelly,dark chocolate,sunflower seed,cilantro,beef stew meat,soy sauce,brandy
title: Tandoori Beef
ingredients: 3 lbs cubed beef stew meat ( i've used lamb, you can use all beef ) | 1 ounce sunflower seeds | 1/4 cup chopped cilantro | 1/4 cup brandy | 1 tablespoon low sodium soy sauce | 1 tablespoon red currant jelly | 1 ounce dark chocolate, grated
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the sunflower seeds and cilantro.  Add lamb and let sit at room temperature for about an hour or so.  Sprinkle each serving with the brandy and soy sauce.  In a heat proof bowl or skillet, combine the jelly and chocolate and heat over low heat, stirring often until chocolate has melted, about 5 - 10 minutes.  Pour hot glaze over meat and sprinkle with seeds/cilil.

Random Ingredients: red onion,cardamom pod,feta,lemon peel,straw mushroom,chipotle chile adobo,cream cheese,tart shell
title: Straw Mushroom Dip - Chipotle
ingredients: 2 packages cream cheese at room temperature | 1 cup plain canned tart shell | 2 teaspoons chipotle chiles in adobo | 2 medium tomatoes, seeded and finely chopped | 1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped | 1/4 cup lemon peel, finely chopped | 1/2 cup roasted and crumbed feta | 2 teaspoons ground cardamom pods
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºf.  In a medium bowl, blend cream cheese until smooth.  Stir in tart shells.  Stir in chipotle and tomatoes.

title: Spanish Gravy for Meat
ingredients: 3 tablespoons gluten-free flour | 1/2 cup low sodium chicken broth | 1 can canned tomatoes | 2 tablespoons soy sauce | 1/8 teaspoon ground mace
instructions: Mix flour and broth in saucepan.  Bring to boil.  Pour soup over flour mixture and stir.  Simmer 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes and soy sauce.  Simmer 2 minutes.  Serve with meat or vegetables.

title: Chilice (Parmesan and Pecorino) Bread
ingredients: 350 g fresh breadcrumbs | 2 pinches pecorino romano cheese | 8 radishes, sliced | 1 serrano chili, thinly sliced
instructions: Place bread crumbs in a bowl, add cheese and stir to combine.  Place a layer of radishes in a shallow bowl, sprinkle with a little more cheese, then spread with the cheese mixture on top.  Repeat process with another layer of radishes and repeat process.  Keep it covered with saran wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Cut into slices and serve.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,beef rib,currant,kosher salt pepper,purpose seasoning
title: Chiles Colorado Style
ingredients: 4 large poblano chiles, seeds and veins removed | 1/2 cup dried currants | 2 tablespoons all-purpose seasoning | salt and pepper to taste | 1 pound beef short ribs, cut into small pieces
instructions: Roast the poblano chiles on an ungreased baking sheet in the preheated 500 degrees f oven until beginning to char, 10 to 15 minutes or until charred on the outside and tender insides are mostly black, about 20 minutes.  Remove from heat, cover tightly with aluminum foil, and set aside to steam for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, remove the skin and seeds from the chiles and pulse in a blender or food processor with the currants and seasoning until coarsely chopped.  Place the short ribs in a large pot, and pour the chile mixture over to coat.  Bring to a simmer over medium low heat, then cover and simmer for 30 minutes.  Remove from heat and allow to cool, about 30 minutes.  Poke holes in the ribs with a fork.  Preheat the broiler.  Remove the ribs and pan from the heat.  Place the ribs on a platter and broil in batches until browned and crispy, about 10 minutes.  Brush with the chile sauce.

title: Snapper With Avocado and Black Olive Omelette
ingredients: 4 medium eggs | 1/3 cup black olives, chopped ( such as nicoise ) | 2 cooked red snapper fillets, cut into pieces | 1/3 cup jicama, thinly sliced
instructions: Poach the eggs in a saucepan of boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain.  Whisk or beat the eggs until frothy and slowly pour in the olive oil while continuing to whisk.  Remove from the heat and stir in the olives and the red snapper.  Divide the fish mixture among plates and top with the omelettes.  Serve straight away.

title: Curried Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 300 g tomato sauce | 250 ml black vinegar | 1/2 teaspoon curry powder | 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
instructions: Cook tomato sauce with black vinegar and curry powder for 10 minutes.  Add vanilla and stir.

Random Ingredients: poblano chile,jasmine rice,currant,heavy whipping cream,kielbasa sausage
title: Kielbasa and Rice in Cream
ingredients: 1 can jasmine rice, drained | 1 cup heavy whipping cream | 1/2 cup chorizo sausage, diced into 1/2 inch pieces | 1 can poblano chiles, chopped, drained | 1/4 cup dried currants
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.

Random Ingredients: black eyed pea,feta,creamy peanut butter,bamboo shoot
title: Black Eyed Peas and Bacon Salad With Peanut Butter
ingredients: 400 g canned black-eyed peas | 2 slices bacon, chopped | 1 can bamboo shoots, drained | 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter
instructions: Drain the black eyed peas and place in a salad bowl and add 1/4 cup of water.  Bring to a boil over medium high heat, then reduce to a medium heat, cover and simmer for 15 - 20 minutes or until the black eyed peas are tender. .  If necessary, drain liquid.  In a large non stick frypan, cook the bacon until crispy, then remove and drain.  Add the black eyed peas to the bacon oil and then add the drained bamboo shoots.  Season with pepper and peanut butter and mix well.  Serve warm or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: red potato,hazelnut,chambord raspberry liquor,rye bread,chow mein noodle,egg white
title: Chocolate & Hazelnut Fondue
ingredients: 1 jar chambord raspberry liquor | 1/2 lb small red potatoes, cut in chunks | 1/2 lb hazelnuts, coarsely chopped | 1/4 lb chow mein noodles | 4 ounces egg whites | 2 loaves rustic rye bread, cut in 1-inch cubes
instructions: In a double boiler over high heat, combine the chambord, potatoes, hazelnuts and noodles.  Heat, stirring constantly, until the potatoes are fork tender, 3 - 5 minutes.  Set aside to cool.  In an electric mixer fitted with the whisk, whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt until smooth and stiff.  Fold the whites into the cooled fondue until incorporated.  Arrange the bread cubes on a serving platter.  Dip the bread into the fondue and let it soak up all the fondue for 2 - 3 minutes.  Serve with the reserved fondue.

title: Orange Vinaigrette
ingredients: 6 medium green onions | 2 tablespoons orange juice, fresh squeezed | 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice, bottled or from jar
instructions: Pour the orange juice into a bowl.  Finely grate the green onions into the green onion.  Whisk in the remaining ingredients until blended about 3 minutes.  Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving.

title: Sushi Airma-Ish (Artificial Aromatic Airma and Corn) Salad
ingredients: 1/2 cup baby corn, trimmed | 1/8 cup baby arugula leaves | 1 teaspoon garlic paste | 1/2 teaspoon white sugar
instructions: Place baby corn in a skillet over medium heat.  Bring just to a boil, then remove from heat.  Place baby corn, arugula, and garlic paste into a bowl with cold water.  Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least an hour.  Allow mixture to sit at room temperature to absorb flavors, about 30 minutes.  Drain excess liquid, if any has gathered on the bottom of bowl.  Sprinkle sugar over the arugula and serve.

title: Puffy Taco Shells
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups masa harina | 1 1/4 cups almond meal | 3/4 cup syrup | 1 1/2 cups milk or 1 1/2 cups water | 1/2 teaspoon cayenne powder | salad oil ( optional )
instructions: In large bowl, whisk dry ingredients with milk or water until fluffy.  Add oil to make batter.  Add masa mixture.  Mix dough until smooth.  Cover and let rest one hours or overnight in a cool spot.  Flatten to make patties about 2½ inches high on greased baking sheets.  Bake at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes.  Serve with salsa and desired toppings.  Salsa, mix all ingredients and store in airtight container in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Cod Scallops
ingredients: 400 g cod, sliced | 1/3 cup parmesan cheese, grated | 1/3 cup sea scallops
instructions: Heat oven to 190°c.  Line a 12x4 cm slice tin with baking paper, allowing enough extending over 5cm above the paper to cover the edges of the tin completely.  Toss fish with cheese and season lightly with salt and pepper, then lift onto the baking paper lined baking tray and bake for 5 minutes until golden.  Meanwhile, warm a grill pan over medium heat.  Cook scallops, without turning, until golden and just cooked through.  Serve fish topped with the scallops and serve with pasta of your choice.

Random Ingredients: ice cube,serrano chili,basmati rice,coriander leaf,mint leaf,kidney bean,hot paprika,orange juice concentrate
title: Arroz Verde
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups basmati rice | 4 cups ice cubes | 1/2 cup orange juice concentrate | 1/2 cup canned kidney beans, drained | 1 medium serrano chili, finely chopped | fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped | mint leaf, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon hot paprika or 1 teaspoon paprika powder
instructions: Wash the rice thoroughly and place in a bowl.  Pour enough boiling water over the rice to cover and soak until water is absorbed 15 to 20 minutes.  Drain in a sieve and place in a large, deep pot or casserole.  In a small bowl, mix together the orange juice concentrate, kidney beans, chilli, coriander, and a little water to make the dressing.  Pour dressing over cooked rice.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 40 to 50 minutes, or until rice is cooked and water is absorbed.  Allow rice to stand 5 minutes and spoon onto a serving platter.  Garnish with mint leaves and serve at once.

Random Ingredients: bamboo shoot,cumin seed,vegetable stock cube,egg noodle
title: Cumin Veggie Noodle Soup
ingredients: 250 g egg noodles ( uncooked ) | 3 cups vegetable stock or 3 cups vegetable stock | 1 teaspoon cumin seed or 1 teaspoon jeffron powder | 400 g bamboo shoots, canned or 400 g fresh canned tomatoes, chopped
instructions: Prepare rice using the instructions, set aside.  In another pot, simmer vegetables as directed.  Stirring occasionally, boil stock, stirring occasionally, until it is reduced by 1/ return vegetables to the sauce, let sit for 5 minutes, strain solids.  Heat up soup in a soup pot.  Add rice, and stir.  Reheat briefly.

Random Ingredients: tahini,hard egg,pepper,turmeric,golden raisin,basmati rice,broccoli floret,cooking spray
title: Indian Egg and Veggie Rice With a Hake Potent Sausage - Kha'ar
ingredients: 1 box basmati rice ( kha'ar ) | 6 cups cold unsalted chicken stock or 6 cups cold unsalted chicken broth, about | 1 cup tahini ( sesame seed paste ) or 1 cup olive oil | 12 hard-boiled eggs, quartered or 1 1/2 cups chopped egg whites, left whole | 1 1/2 teaspoons ground turmeric | 1 tablespoon golden raisin | chopped fresh basil or parsley, as garnish | nonstick cooking spray
instructions: Prepare idahoan signature™ russets mashed potatoes according to package directions.  Meanwhile, bring hot chicken stock to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat.  Add uncooked rice and boil, uncovered, until it is tender and almost dry, about 20 minutes.  While rice is cooking, make the hake.  Heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add 3/4 cup of the liquid from the boiled rice to the skillet and bring to a boil.  Cook for 2 minutes, then stir.  Transfer skillet to a bowl and stir in remaining liquid remaining in bowl.  Place hake pot and chicken stock in a large microwave safe measuring cup.  Microwave on high for 5 minutes, or until liquid is absorbed.  Pour liquid into skillet and whisk in tahini.  Cover and cook for 30 seconds, then remove from microwave and stir well.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  While skillet is still hot, spoon in egg halves.  When eggs are almost done, spread half of the egg mixture on the bottom of a 9x8x2 baking dish.  Spread evenly over top of egg.  Arrange 1 cup of the broccoli over egg and then arrange remaining broccoli with some of the raisins and chopped tomatoes.  Spray kha'ar with nonstick cooking spray.  Bake until set and golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes or until crisp and golden, 12 to 14 minutes.  Serve hot, garnished with basil/parsley, if desired.

Random Ingredients: grain rice,chipotle pepper,chili paste,chili pepper flake,dill
title: Furitas De Arroz (Chipotle Rice)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups long grain rice | 1 -2 chipotle pepper | 1 teaspoon dried ground dill | 1 teaspoon dried chili pepper flakes | 1 teaspoon chili paste ( or to taste )
instructions: Pour boiling water over the rice in a large pan.  Stir.  Turn down heat to a gentle boil and cover pot.  Let sit for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and let stand for 5 more minutes so water to reboil.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Using either your hands, squeeze the juice from the chipotles into a bowl until water has disappeared.  Heat up the chipotle chile over medium heat in the microwave or your blender until mostly melted and all of the flavors come together.  You may need to do this in 2 - 3 batches depending on your microwave and oven strength.  Add the juice from the chipotle chile mixture into the bowl with the rice.  Stir gently.  Add all of the optional dried chili flakes and dill and mix to coat completely.  Adjust seasoning.  Note, if the rice is really dry add a bit of water to rinse if necessary.  Place the rice in an oiled bowl, cover, and allow to sit in the refrigerator for an hour.  It can be eaten warm or cold.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: sun tomato oil,grapefruit juice,beef stock,beef stock bouillon
title: Fruit Juice Beef Stock
ingredients: 300 ml beef stock | 300 ml grapefruit juice | 1/3 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, chopped | 300 ml beef stock ( homemade is best )
instructions: Put all ingredients in a pan to simmer, cook slowly for around 20 minutes.

Random Ingredients: salad green,anchovy,velveeta cheese,chili oil,kielbasa,serrano chili pepper
title: Kielbasa and Provolone Salad
ingredients: 1/4 lb kielbasa, cut in 1/8 inch slices | 1/4 inch piece serrano chili pepper | 2 tablespoons chili oil | 1 package mixed salad greens | 2 ounces velveeta cheese | 1/2 anchovy, drained of oil
instructions: Cook sausage in oil over medium heat until browned all over, about 4 minutes.  Combine all ingredients except salad greens in serving bowl.  Pour over salad greens.  Serve immediately.

Random Ingredients: half cream,brown sugar,bread machine yeast,green olive
title: Cuban Olive Bread II
ingredients: 2 packages bread machine yeast | 1 1/4 cups half-and-half cream, warmed | 1 cup packed brown sugar | 8 pitted green olives, coarsely chopped
instructions: Add yeast to warm tepid water in a large bowl.  Add half and half, brown sugar and olives to yeast mixture.  Turn dough onto lightly floured surface, knead until smooth and elastic but not sticky.  Place dough in an oiled bowl, turn to grease top, cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled and light, about 1 hour.  Punch down.  Turn into a greased 10 x 3 inch baking dish.  Cover.  Let rise for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to low, and let rise until light and light, about 15 minutes.  Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 25 to 30 minutes, or until golden brown and loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.  Allow bread to cool slightly before slicing and serving.

Random Ingredients: self rising flour,balsamic vinegar,chicken broth,sherry wine vinegar,cherry tomato
title: Easy Dijon Cherry Tomato Dumpling Soup
ingredients: 1 cup self-rising flour, plus extra for dusting | 3 cups chicken broth | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1 tablespoon sherry wine vinegar | 9 cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°f line 2 baking trays with non stick baking parchment.  Make the dumpling batter, sieve the flour into a large metal bowl.  Make a well in the center and stir in the chicken broth, balsamic vinegar, and sherry vinegar.  Bring to a boil and ladle into the bubbling soup.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Transfer the soup to a food processor or blender.  Add the halved cherry tomatoes and pulse until finely chopped.  Adjust the seasoning with salt, pepper, and the vinegar, to taste.  Allow to rest for about 10 minutes, then ladle into hot soup bowls and serve.

Random Ingredients: chicken breast half,yellow bell pepper,iceberg lettuce
title: Garlicky Southwest Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 1 chicken breast half, skinned and boned | 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced | 1 head iceberg lettuce, shredded
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Arrange chicken breast halves in a baking dish.  Place bell pepper slices on top of chicken breast halves.  Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until chicken is no longer pink and juices run clear.  Allow to cool for 10 minutes, then cut into strips.

Random Ingredients: black bean,beef tenderloin,cognac,snow pea,rye bread,cumin seed,corn
title: Grilled Steak With Cured Black Beans, Corn and Snow Peas
ingredients: 2 tablespoons cumin seeds, slightly crushed | 1 lb beef tenderloin, trimmed | 1/2 cup cognac | 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained | 1 cup corn | 1 cup frozen snow peas, thawed | 4 slices dry rye bread, toasted
instructions: Toss the cumin seeds with the beef.

Random Ingredients: virgin olive oil,plain yogurt,saffron thread,pepperoni,cooking oil,beef tenderloin,vegetable shortening
title: Persian Beef Kebabs
ingredients: 1 package fresh beef tenderloin, cut in 1-inch cubes | 1 jar sliced pepperoni, drained | 1/3 cup plain yogurt | 1/3 cup vegetable shortening | 1/3 cup virgin olive oil | 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads or 1/4 teaspoon turmeric | 1 tablespoon cooking oil
instructions: Place beef in resealable plastic bag with pepperoni, yogurt and 1/3 cup oil.  Toss until blended.  Heat remaining oil in heavy large skillet over medium high heat.  Sprinkle beef with saffron.  Brown in oil about 10 minutes, turning often, until brown on all sides.  Place beef on cutting board.

Random Ingredients: italian parsley,green curry paste,chuck roast,tomato puree,arrowroot,molasses,corn tortilla chip,cilantro stem
title: Beef Tamale Satay
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chuck roast, excess fat trimmed | 1/2 cup light molasses | 1 tablespoon green curry paste or 2 teaspoons hot green curry paste | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1/4 teaspoon arrowroot or 1/4 teaspoon cornstarch | 1/2 cup cilantro stem | 1 tablespoon italian parsley | 1 cup crushed corn tortilla chips
instructions: Cut chuck roast into 1/2 inch chunks.  Place all ingredients except for crushed tortilla chips in crock or slow cooker.  Cover and cook on low for 10 to 12 hours or high 4 to 5 hours.  Stirring occasionally.  Remove roast from slow cooker and discard fat and bones.  Using 2 forks, shred meat into fine shreds and return to slow cooker with any accumulated juices.  Serve immediately with crushed tortilla chips for dipping.

title: Jalapeño-Green Olive Barley and Barley Dip
ingredients: 1/2 cup pearl barley | 1/4 cup green olives, chopped | 1 large jalapeno, seeded and minced | 1 tablespoon chopped dried leaf oregano | 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter | 1 tablespoon wine vinegar
instructions: Cook the barley according to the package directions, but instead of boiling, cool before adding to a blender or food processor.  Combine the first four ingredients and blend until smooth.  In a small bowl, cream margarine or butter with the vinegar, stirring until blended.  To serve, spread in a shallow serving dish that is lined with lettuce leaves.

title: Spinach and Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 package fresh spinach | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 5 tablespoons sliced black olives, drained | 6 radishes, sliced on the diagonal
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil, and add spinach.  Cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.  Drain, and refrigerate.  Whisk onion and black olives together in a bowl, and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Mix spinach and onion mixture into onion and black olives.  Garnish with radish slices.

Random Ingredients: anise seed,orange flower water,ziti pasta,courgette,green bell pepper
title: Spicy Ziti With Courgette and Bell Peppers
ingredients: 4 cups ziti pasta, broken into 3 pieces | 1 - 1 1/4 lb ziti pasta or 1 -1 1/4 lb other medium pasta | 1 large green bell pepper | 5 -6 teaspoons freshly grated orange flower water | 2 teaspoons anise seeds | 3 teaspoons orange flower water
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit, and set a large pan of water to boil.  Bring a large pot of water to a boil, and stir in ziti pasta.  Cook until al dente, about 15 minutes.  Drain.  Using a fork or slotted spoon, remove peppers, onions and ziti from water.  Reserve in a large oven safe casserole dish and pat dry with paper towels.  Cut ziti into 3/4 inch cubes.  Place bell peppers in the casserole and sprinkle with 1 or 2 tsp each of anise seed, 3 tsp orange flower water and 1/4 tsp of salt.  Spread half of the squash evenly over the peppers, and half of the ziti over that.  Repeat the same procedure with remaining squash and ziti.  Stir the reserved ziti pieces, orange flower water, and remaining 1/4 tsp each of anise seed and 1/4 tsp of anise seed into the pan with the peppers.  Cover, put in the oven and bake for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.  Serve.

Random Ingredients: golden syrup,brown rice,green lentil,sage leaf,oregano,grain white rice,brandy
title: Lebanese Lentil and Rice Mix
ingredients: 250 g green lentils | 350 g brown rice ( see notes ) | 100 g whole grain white rice | 85 g golden syrup ( see notes ) | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaf, finely chopped | 1 teaspoon dried oregano, finely chopped | 2 tablespoons brandy ( optional )
instructions: Cook the lentils in a large pan of boiling, salted water until almost tender, 1 hour.  Transfer the lentils to a large bowl and rinse under cold water.  Shake out any excess water, then drain.  Place the lentils and rice in a large, heavy based pan.  Put on the golden syrup and sage, and stir to combine.  Pour in the brandy and mix well to combine.  Cook over a medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring, until it smells toasty.  Increase the heat to high and stir in the brown rice until coated with fragrance.  Cook, uncovered, over a low heat for 15 minutes, stirring.  Then, increase the heat to high and stir occasionally for 3 minutes or until the rice is just turning golden brown before the end of cooking.

title: Homemade English Muffins
ingredients: 8 ounces whole wheat germ ( not the kind in the supermarket ) | half-and-half cream or double cream
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Line muffin pans with foil in a circle and place in oven.  Mix with a fork the nut and wheat germ together the until you have a moist and smooth mixture.  Use a slotted spoon in the pan to dip the muffins into the cream or leave plain.  Place in oven until they've turned golden brown.

title: Italian Sausage Rolls
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs sweet italian sausage ( or substitute another sausage such as hot, sweet or spicy ) | 1 can fresh orange juice | 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder or 1/2 cup paprika
instructions: In large skillet, cook sausage over medium heat for about 10 minutes or until no longer pink.

Random Ingredients: pistachio nut,cranberry juice cocktail,serrano pepper,basil leaf
title: Spiked Cranberry Vinaigrette
ingredients: 1 cup cranberry juice cocktail | 1/2 cup diced fresh cranberries ( may sub frozen or frozen cranberries ) | 1 tablespoon minced serrano pepper | 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil leaves
instructions: Combine all ingredients in medium bowl.  Refrigerate until well chilled, about 3 - 4 hours.

title: Pesto Dip (Pesto) for Veggies
ingredients: 1/2 cup basil pesto | 2 cups chickpea flour or 2 cups bread flour
instructions: In medium bowl, mix the pesto and chickpea flour.  Set aside.  Form the mixture into flat, oval shaped patties about 1½ inches thick.  If using bread flour, dredge the patties in bread flour, shaking off excess.  If using bread flour, coat and let dry.  Heat a griddle or skillet.  Add the patties and cook until lightly browned, about 4 minutes per side.

Random Ingredients: chocolate liqueur,topping,red curry paste,spinach,baby spinach leaf,tomato juice
title: Spinach in Red Curry
ingredients: 1 handful of fresh spinach leaves | 1 1/2 tablespoons red curry paste | 1 -2 tablespoon chocolate liqueur | 1 1/2 cups tomato juice | 1/2 cup of shredded coconut ( optional ) | 1 1/4 cups of prepared topping, thawed ( cool whip )
instructions: Bring tomato juice and red curry paste to a boil in a skillet, then lower the heat, and let simmer for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Add spinach and cook for a further 10 - 12 minutes, or until wilted.  Add coconut if using.  Remove from the heat.  In a bowl, combine the thawed topping, and thawed whipped topping.  If making the sauce too thin, add a little water to thin the mix.  Serve immediately, over steamed jasmine rice.

title: Easy Tofu-Carne
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into thin 2/3-3-x1/2-inch strips | 1 package firm tofu, in 1-inch cubes | 1 can enchilada sauce
instructions: Place bacon in large, deep skillet, and cook over medium heat until just beginning to brown, about 15 minutes.  Add pork and cook, stirring, until coated lightly with bacon fat and beginning to show some color, about 5 minutes.  Add tofu and cook, stirring, until coated with bacon fat and beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.  Pour sauce evenly into skillet.  Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until pork is cooked through and sauce has thickened, 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Random Ingredients: tofu,cannellini bean,plain yogurt,rigatoni pasta,red onion,wild rice
title: Vegetarian Yummy Vegan Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 4 cups cooked rigatoni pasta | 4 tablespoons plain yogurt | 6 ounces soft tofu | 16 ounces cannellini beans ( drained ) | 1 small red onion, chopped | 1 cup wild rice, cooked
instructions: Cook rigatoni according to directions.  Drain and rinse with cold water.  Place in a large bowl.  Add tofu, chickpeas and onion.  Mix.  Spread pasta mixture into a casserole dish.  Top with yogurt.  Cook in the oven at 350°f for 30 minutes.

title: Creamy Asparagus
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus ( about 5 cm in length ) | 1 can cream of mushroom soup | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 1 teaspoon white wine
instructions: Cook the asparagus until tender but just crisp.  When cool, slice into 1 cm pieces and mix through the cream of mushroom soup.  Add the cornflour mix.  Serve immediately.  Variation, for a twist, sometimes i add 2 tbls.  Cornstarch and 1/4 cup cold water to the mushroom soup and stir well.  Add to the asparagus just before serving and stir through.  You may also saute the asparagus with a small amount of oil until just beginning to brown.  Variation, if you like the asparagus thinner, mix between 1 tbls.  Water and add in more cornflour and cornflour until desired thickness is achieved.

title: Puerto Rican Poertor (Pigeon Peas With Pork)
ingredients: 2 lbs fresh pigeon peas | 2 green bell peppers, chopped | 1/2 cup capers, drained and rinsed | 1 pork tenderloin
instructions: Fill a large pot about 2/3 full with water.  Bring water to boil.  Blanch pigeon peas for 1 minute.  Remove with slotted spoon and plunge into ice water.  Set aside, then rinse under cold water.  When cool, transfer to a large bowl.  Refrigerate over night.  About 2 hours before serving, drain peas, reserving 1/4 cup of the liquid and place in a blender or food processor.  Blend until smooth.  Return liquid to pot with reserved liquid.  Add green peppers and capers.  Simmer over medium low heat 15 minutes or until peppers are tender.  Place pork tenderloin in a single layer on a clean work surface.  Pour reserved liquid over the meat.  Pat peels off with paper towels, then place pork in a baking dish.  Add pepper mixture to pot, cover, and bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven until meat is tender, about 2 hours.

Random Ingredients: coriander seed,italian sausage,bean sprout,apple cider vinegar,lemon juice
title: Breaded Sausage and Sprouts Salad
ingredients: 1/2 lb apple cider vinegar - 12 ounces, white | 2 1/2 teaspoons coriander seeds, lightly crushed | 2 packages italian sausage, hot | 6 cups mixed sprouts | 4 tablespoons lemon juice
instructions: Mix vinegar and coriander seeds.  Dry the italian sausage and fry lightly in a nonstick skillet until cooked through, approximately 5 - 10 minutes.  Set aside.  In the same skillet, add the hot italian sausage and brown lightly.  Remove from skillet and add the remaining dressing.  Bring to boil and simmer for two minutes, drain, and cool a bit.  In a large bowl, toss the mixed sprouts.  Place sausages, sprouts, and dressing mixture in a serving bowl, sprinkle with lemon juice.

title: Minted Beet Salad
ingredients: 2 large beets | 1/2 cup beet greens, shredded ( or green beans ) | 3 tablespoons cottage cheese | 2 ounces parsley and mint leaves, chopped | seasoning
instructions: Boil the beets in lightly salted water until the beets are very tender, drain.  Place the beet greens in a salad bowl, add the beet greens to the beet greens, stir.  Sprinkle with mint.  Add seasoning to taste.

title: Rum and Chambord Cabbage
ingredients: 1 head cabbage | 1 tablespoon hing ( to taste ) | 6 ounces heavy cream | 6 ounces chambord raspberry liquor ( i've used raspberry flavored liqueur, but it's up to you ) | 3 ounces water chestnuts
instructions: Boil up cabbage and place in large mixing bowl.  Add hing and cream then pour into cabbage and chill in refrigerator.  This will allow time for the flavours to meld if refrigerated.  When ready to serve, stir in chambord and chopped water chestnuts.  This can be served warm or cold.  Note, any type of cabbage will depend on how large the head of cabbage is.  I prefer a large head.

title: Green Chili Gravy (Dressing)
ingredients: 1 cup prepared gravy mix | 1 can green chili salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 teaspoon cornstarch | 1 teaspoon powdered sage | 1 teaspoon gravy mix | 1/2 teaspoon almond extract
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and whisk well.

title: Crispy Asian Cornbread
ingredients: 3/4 cup italian seasoned breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup finely chopped sweet pepperoni | 1 lb pillsbury refrigerated crescent dinner rolls | 3 large tablespoons cornflour | 1 lb finely chopped pepperoni | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet pepperoni | 1/2 cup finely chopped sweet pepperoni | 1 tablespoon finely chopped zest of 2 galangal or 1 tablespoon thai chili paste
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°f.  In a small bowl, combine the bread crumbs, pepperoni and finely chopped pepperoni.  Using your hands, press 1/2 the bread mixture into the bottom of a 13x9x2 baking dish.  In the bowl, combine the 2 rolls and the cornflour and toss until the dough is evenly mixed.  Spread the mixture evenly over the breadcrumb crust.  Top with the 3 remaining rolls.  Pour the remaining prepared cornflour mixture over all.  Sprinkle evenly with the finely minced pepperoni and sweet pepperoni.  Bake in preheated 500f oven for 5 minutes.  Remove the tray of breadcrumbs.  Serve warm with your favourite dipping sauce.  Note, make sure the cereal is completely cool before storing away.  If not using the cornbread recipe, it will keep warm and crispy in the oven.

Random Ingredients: white onion,black bean,green enchilada sauce,ruby port,cream,pickle,radish
title: Taste of Mexico's Favorite Layered Dip
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups refried black beans | 1/2 cup sour cream | 1 can green enchilada sauce | 1 cup diced red onion | 1/4 cup diced white onion | 3/4 cup diced pickle, drained | 3/4 cup ruby port
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f.  In a bowl, stir together refried beans and sour cream until well combined.  Spread bean mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Top with enchilada sauce, red onion, white onion, pickle, and port.  Bake for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until heated through and bubbly.  Serve warm with tortilla chips.

Random Ingredients: beef brisket,cream chicken soup,vegetable,tomato paste,rosemary,tamarind pumpkin seed,pine nut,watermelon
title: Crock Pot Sweet and Sour Corned Beef - Low Fat
ingredients: 1 corned beef brisket, trimmed of all fat | 1 can cream of chicken soup | 1/4 cup tamarind pumpkin seeds | 1/4 cup tamarind pumpkin seeds | 2 tablespoons tomato paste | 5 cups watermelon, sliced | 1 loaf frozen mixed vegetables | 2 tablespoons pine nuts, chopped
instructions: Place corned beef in crock pot, with juice.

Random Ingredients: chickpea flour,millet,green onion,romaine lettuce,parsley,turkey bacon,thyme sprig
title: Crispy Bacon and Chickpea Wraps
ingredients: 4 slices smoked turkey bacon, chopped | 2 ryves lettuce, washed and dried ( leaves if any ) | 4 parsley sprigs | 3 green onions, sliced ( including green tops ) | 1 -2 tablespoon chickpea flour | 2 tablespoons millet | 1 teaspoon dried thyme or 1/2 teaspoon fresh chopped thyme, to taste
instructions: Saute bacon pieces in a nonstick pan over medium heat until crisp.  Remove cooked bacon from pan and chop into small chunks.  Reserve fat from frying pan.  Cut lettuce leaves into strips.  Divide or distribute each leaf with 2 tbsp of the bacon fat, parsley, green onions, chickpea flour, thyme, and reserved bacon fat.  Wrap tightly in heavy duty aluminum foil or parchment paper and secure with toothpicks that fit snugly inches.

title: Green Chile Pepper Dip
ingredients: 4 ounces green chili peppers
instructions: Clean, wash and chop the chilies.  Blend all ingredients until smooth.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,pie crust,orange juice,turmeric powder,dill,spinach leaf,garlic clove
title: Spinach in a Creamy Tart and Tomato Appetiser
ingredients: 500 g fresh spinach leaves ( stems left on ) | 50 g fresh dill ( leaves left on ) | 6 teaspoons tomato ketchup | 1 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1 small garlic clove ( chopped or 1 1/4 teaspoons bottled minced garlic ) | 1 tablespoon orange juice | 4 -5 teaspoons pie crusts
instructions: Clean, wash and dry the spinach.  Remove and discard the hard stems.  Cut the spinach leaves into 2 or 3 centimeter circles.  Wash and dry the dill.  Wash, remove stems and chop the dill.  Heat the oil in a large pan or wok.  Stir fry garlic for 2 or 3 minutes.  Add the chopped spinach and cook until it just begins to wilt.  Transfer spinach to a bowl and combine with remaining ingredients except the pie crusts.  Spread half of the spinach mixture into the pie crusts pressing down so it covers the bottom and sides.  Cover the bottom and sides of the crust with the rest of the spinach mixture.  Place in a preheated oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until golden.  Serve straightaway.

Random Ingredients: sage,cashew,green curry paste,tea,coconut oil,pie filling choice
title: Green Curry Pies
ingredients: 1 box frozen pie filling ( can be from a 17 ounce box refrigerated pie filling of your choice ) | 1 tablespoon green curry paste ( or more if you prefer, i've used it for about 20-25 ) | 1 cup strong brewed tea ( or 1 large-hole can ) | 1/4 cup unsalted cashews | 1/4 cup chopped, toasted pumpkin seeds ( or use 2 1-ounce cans of pumpkin ) | sage ( to garnish ) | vegetable oil, for brushing
instructions: Mix the curry paste paste, brewed tea and cashews together.  Add the pumpkin seeds and mix gently.  The mixture should be almost pourable.  Fill each doughnut half with curry filling, roll up and place in a plastic tub, or refrigerate until ready to use.  Brush top and sides of each roll with oil and set on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  If using a microwave safe bowl, place on low power on a microwave safe plate.  Place a toothpick in the centre and microwave on high power for two minutes.  It should sound slightly hollow when stirred.  This will help seal them closed if the mixture leaks out during cooking.  Preheat the oven to 425°.  Note, these can be frozen until ready to use then refrigerate.  When ready to bake, heat the oven to 400°f with the toothpick inserted in the centre of each roll.  Bake for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown on top and filling is bubbling around the edge.  Serve warm or room temperature as a side dish or filling for vegetarian patties.

title: Easy Microwave Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups arborio rice | 1/2 cup cider vinegar
instructions: Put rice, vinegar and salt/pepper mix in a microwave safe bowl.  Cover and cook in microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring after 2 to 3 minutes.  If rice starts drying up too quickly, recover with a dish towel.

Random Ingredients: orange peel,white wine,ricotta cheese,flour,mandarin orange segment,sea salt
title: White Wine and Mandarin Orange Ricotta Balls
ingredients: 1 cup ricotta cheese | 1/2 teaspoon sea salt | 4 teaspoons fresh orange peel, cut in fine strips | 1 teaspoon flour | 1/2 cup white wine | 1 can mandarin orange segments, drained
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.  Place on floured board and roll/mix until well mixed.  Using a rolling pin, roll on all sides to 1/4 inch thick.  Cut into 1 inch pieces.  Place on wax paper lined cookie sheet.  Bake at 425 for 25 minutes.

title: Cranberry Crunch Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 1 package uncooked small shell pasta | 1/2 cup dried cranberries | 1/2 cup dark soy sauce | 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 cups rice krispies
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil.  Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente.

Random Ingredients: coriander,flat leaf parsley,green cardamom pod,orange zest,liquid honey,green enchilada sauce,pasta,rump roast
title: Lombo Ka Salan (Shredded Beef with Pasta)
ingredients: 8 ounces rump roast, cut into 1-inch cubes | 1/2 cup orange zest, cut into matchstick pieces | 1 cup canned green enchilada sauce | 1 cup liquid honey | 1 teaspoon ground coriander | 6 green cardamom pods, crushed | 1 teaspoon ground black pepper or 1 teaspoon paprika | hot cooked spaghetti or linguine, pasta for serving
instructions: In bowl, toss the cubed rump roast with orange zest, enchilada sauce, honey, coriander, cardamom, and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Preheat oven to 350°f transfer the roast to a large roasting pan.

title: Frozen Artichoke Lasagne
ingredients: lasagna noodle, uncooked | 8 -10 canned artichoke hearts, drained and washed | 1 pint dark beer | fresh strawberries, chopped ( to garnish )
instructions: Cook the lasagne noodles according to package directions.  Drain.  Remove artichokes from can, or save liquid, and set aside.  Place artichoke hearts in saucepan of boiling water for about 5 minutes, or until cooked.  Drain and rinse artichoke hearts in cold water, then cut into 1/4 inch slices.  Return to saucepan.  Add beer and remaining artichokes.

Random Ingredients: tomato soup,red capsicum,thai fish sauce,curry paste,white vinegar,juice,chicken
title: Thai Chicken
ingredients: 3 kg chicken pieces | 1 tablespoon thai fish sauce | 1 red capsicum, deseeded and diced | 1 teaspoon hot curry paste | 2 teaspoons white vinegar | 2 tablespoons tomato soup | 1/4 cup juice
instructions: In a large skillet, pour boiling water over chicken, add capsicum and curry paste.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cover and simmer about 30 minutes or until chicken is tender.  In a separate pan, mix all remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat until sauce is reduced by half.  Remove chicken from pan and spoon over sauce.

title: Cinnamon-Chilled Artichoke-Chop Suey
ingredients: 1 package chocolate cake mix | 1 tablespoon ground gingerroot | 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon | 2 cans sliced artichoke hearts, drained | 1 package old fashioned oats | 1/3 cup lard, melted | 1/2 cup dried basil | 1/4 cup shredded aged cheddar cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f.  Spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with cooking spray.

Random Ingredients: salsa verde,quark,margarita mix,applesauce,farfalle pasta,red bean,parmigiano reggiano cheese
title: Quark and Bean Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 box quark or 4 ounces cream cheese at room temperature | 1 jar salsa verde ( salsa verde is best ) | 2 tablespoons grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese | 1/8 teaspoon margarita mix | 1 can red beans | 1 can great northern beans ( drained or rinsed and drained ) | 3/4 cup canned red beans, with liquid
instructions: Prepare quark and bean dip by combining quark and bean dip ingredients and blending well.  Chill the dip for 20 minutes or longer.  Just before serving, add the roasted or canned beans and serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti with Orange and Cinnamon (Lidia Bastianich)
ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked spaghetti, cut crosswise into thin strips | 1 orange, halved, plus | 12 -15 ladyfingers, split crosswise | 3 cups orange-flavored bouquet garni, or ( 6 ounce ) | 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
instructions: Cook the spaghetti according to package directions, except use cooking oil to prevent sticking.  When pasta is al dente, stir in the orange and 1/2 bunch of ladyfingers.  Drain well.  Add the bouquet garni.  Simmer until the pasta is slightly cooked and the flavors combine, about 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove the pasta to plates and sprinkle with cinnamon and remaining ladyfingers.

title: Rum and Ham Burger
ingredients: 2/3 pound hamburger bun | 1/2 red cabbage, shredded | 2 tablespoons light rum | 4 tablespoons confectioners'sugar | 4 tablespoons sliced pimiento | 1 can mushrooms
instructions: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium.  To make the hamburger bun, place the hamburgers in a skillet over medium high heat.  Cook, turning once, until well browned, and crumbly, about 10 minutes.  Spread the browned hamburgers on the inside of the bun.  Top with cabbage, rum, confectioners' sugar, and pimento.  Top with mushroom slices, and cut into 4 wedges.

title: Healthy Low Fat Ricotta Cheese
ingredients: 2 ounces part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 tablespoon vanilla essence
instructions: Mix well and either freeze or heat in microwave.  To serve, spread over warm toast.

title: Jicama Bean and Prawn Soup
ingredients: 4 anaheim chilies or 4 poblano chilies, seeded and cut into 2 slices | 1 orange, peeled, sliced thin | 2 cups heavy cream | 1 can reduced-fat evaporated milk | 1 can kidney beans, drained and rinsed | 1 1/2 cups fat-free half and half | 3 tablespoons orange juice | 1 1/2 cups jicama, peeled, grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°f line a sheet pan with foil.

title: Mexican Beans
ingredients: 1 can kidney beans | 1/2 yellow pepper, diced | 1 teaspoon dried sage leaves
instructions: Rinse and sort the beans.  Place in a crock pot and add enough water to cover.  Cook on high 8 hours, low for 8 hours.  During the last 30 minutes stir in the sage and serve.

title: Tahini Cheese Spread
ingredients: 3 cans cream of chicken soup | 2 teaspoons minced dried saffron or 3/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg | 4 tablespoons tahini | 1/4 cup confectioners'sugar | 1/2 lb provolone cheese | 3/4 cup ground walnuts
instructions: Mix the cream of chicken soup and saffron in a small bowl and set aside.  In a small bowl, mix together the tahini, sugar, cheese and nuts and set aside.  Slice provolone cheese into 1 1/2 inch slices and set aside.  In a medium size serving bowl, mix the cream of chicken soup and sauce mixture together.  Stir until combined.  Spread the cream of chicken soup on the provolone slices.  If using walnuts, sprinkle them on top of the cream of soup.  Place slices in a baking dish and top with remaining shredded provolone cheese.  Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven until the cheese has melted and the top of the cheese is slightly browned, about 40 minutes.

Random Ingredients: veal cutlet,pecorino romano cheese,chocolate chip,focaccia bread,pepper,cornichon
title: Baked Veal and Focaccia Sandwiches
ingredients: 4 veal cutlets, 6-7 ounces each | 3 ounces semisweet chocolate chips | 1/4 lb thinly sliced pecorino romano cheese, grated | 4 -12 slices focaccia bread | cornichon
instructions: In a shallow glass baking dish melt chocolate, then spread over cutlets.  Sprinkle each cutlet lightly with cheese.  Set aside.  Arrange bread slices, cut side up, on microwrowave and heat at high heat for 2 minutes.  Remove bread, cut side up, and top with cutlets.  Cover and microwave one minute longer or until golden brown.  Serve with warm cornichons.

title: Rhubarb & Mussels in Phyllo
ingredients: 15 mussels, shucked ( about 5-6 lbs ) | 1 large rhubarb, cut into 2-inch pieces | 2/3 cup watermelon, diced small | 12 sheets phyllo dough, thawed
instructions: Place mussels & rhubarb in a large pot and cover with water.  Put lid on pot & bring to a boil over high heat.  Once boiling, reduce heat to medium & simmer uncovered for 2 minutes.  Drain mussels & rhubarb, discarding any remaining broth.  Discard any remaining liquid or water to make 3 cups of broth.  Meanwhile, place half the phyllo sheets in bottom of a 11 x 7 inch baking dish.  Cover with plastic wrap and a damp cloth towel to prevent drying out.  Place 2 sheets of phyllo across the phyllo & gently stretch to cover phyllo entirely.

Random Ingredients: no salt corn,molasses,chicken thigh,sage leaf,curry powder,espresso,italian sausage
title: Spicy Sausage-Smoked Chicken
ingredients: 12 pieces no-salt-added black or yellow chinese-style smoked sausage, cut into 1/2-inch slices | 1/2 teaspoon finely chopped fresh sage leaf | 1 -2 - 1 -2 tablespoon instant espresso or 1 -2 tablespoon instant coffee powder | 1 tablespoon chili-flavored molasses ( optional ) | 1 pinch curry powder ( optional ) or 1 pinch cayenne pepper ( optional ) | 1/4 cup unsalted chicken fat ( optional ) | 1 can no-salt-added whole tomatoes with spice, drained and chopped, juice reserved ( i like san marzano brand )
instructions: Set oven rack about 8 inches from the broiler element and to the middle of the oven.  Line a roasting pan with foil and spray with nonstick cooking spray.  Arrange sausage on the foil.

Random Ingredients: cream mushroom soup,radiatore pasta,active yeast,chicken thigh,swiss cheese,soymilk,nonfat milk powder
title: French Onion-Stuffed Chicken Croquettes
ingredients: 1 envelope active dry yeast | 1 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, sliced into chunks | 16 ounces light sour cream ( no milk ) | 10 ounces cream of mushroom soup | 8 ounces swiss cheese, shredded | 1/2 - 3/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 2 1/2 cups uncooked radiatore pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°f.  Sprinkle yeast over 2/3 cup of milk powder on a plate.  Add the chicken pieces and mix well with a spoon.  Set aside to proof until yeast begins to foam, about 5 minutes depending on the size of the pieces.  In a large mixing bowl mash the sour cream and cream of mushroom soup together with a fork.  Add yeast mixture and remaining milk powder.  Add the swiss cheese and stir until cheese is melted.  Add swiss cheese mixture and stir until it is mixed into the cheese, it will look a little wet, but keep mixing around the bowl until all the cheese has been added.  Mix in the cooked pasta and allow to sit in a warm spot covered with slightly damp kitchen towels for 30 minutes.  Use the remaining milk powder to moisten the sides of the bowl while mixing.  If it is too wet, add a cup or 2 of water at a time, until it is moist enough to work with.  If it is too dry, add more milk powder.  Preheat oven to in a 9x13 glass baking dish, spread about 3 tablespoons of the cheese filling mixture in the dish.  Add the chicken pieces and the rest of the cheese, spreading evenly over the cheese in the dish.  Make sure the rest of the cheese is covered, and bake in the preheated oven for 45 to 75 minutes.  Serve with a loaf of french onion bread on top.

Random Ingredients: avocado,quinoa,taco cheese,kalamata olive,serrano pepper,coconut milk,yellow pepper,red chilies
title: Mexican Quinoa and Cheese
ingredients: 1 cup quinoa ( or rice if you like spicy ) | 1 cup coconut milk | 1 cup yellow pepper, julienned | 1 cup red chilies, chopped | 1 serrano pepper, seeded and diced | 2 medium avocados, diced | 1/2 cup kalamata olive, sliced | 1/4 cup taco cheese, crumbled
instructions: Cook quinoa in a large pan of boiling water until just tender, about 15 minutes.

title: Quick and Easy Indian-American Hummus
ingredients: 3 cups plain cold water | 1 1/2 cans chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Stir cold water into the chickpeas in a saucepan over medium heat until the water is completely absorbed.

title: Pilaf With Kale
ingredients: 1 bunch kale, fresh, washed and cut into wedges, stems removed | 1/2 cup plain flour | 4 cloves | 1 large clove celery, finely diced | 1 lemon, zest of, finely grated | 150 g pepperoni, finely diced
instructions: Bring salted water to the boil, add the kale and cook for a few minutes.  Drain.  Combine the flour and cloves in a bowl, add the chopped celery and pepperoni.  Mix well and stir into the kettle.  Simmer in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.  Serve straight from the kale.  Makes about 250g or 4 servings.

title: The Best Gluten Free Option
ingredients: 1 cup soymilk ( dairy free ) | 1/4 teaspoon clove ( ground )
instructions: In a blender add 2 cups of dairy free soy milk.  Blend till fully mixed to the consistency you prefer.  Enjoy.

Random Ingredients: hazelnut,active yeast,orange juice,flat leaf italian parsley,saltine cracker,heavy cream,enchilada sauce,kaffir lime leaf
title: Chilean Hazelnut Bread by Todd Wilbur
ingredients: 1/4 cup active dry yeast | 1/2 cup warm heavy cream | 1 can enchilada sauce | 1 pinch salt | 1 cup cracked hazelnuts | 1 cup crushed roasted whole-milk-wheat saltines | 1/4 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf italian parsley | 4 kaffir lime leaves, crushed | 1 cup chopped hazelnuts ( optional ) | 1 1/2 cups crushed saltine crackers
instructions: Mix the yeast, cream, enchilada sauce and pinch of salt in a clean bowl and set aside for 10 to 15 minutes until foamy.  Put the hazelnuts, crushed saltines, parsley and limes in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.  Add the hazelnut meal, crushed saltines, and chopped parsley.  Process for a few seconds to chop and combine.  Pour in the warm cream, and mix again.  Set in a warm, draft free place for about an hour.  Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and knead for 4 to 5 minutes, adding more liquid as needed.  Place into a lightly oiled bowl, and shape into 6 to 8 round loaves.  Cover with a cloth or a light towel, and leave to rise in a warm, draft free place until doubled in bulk.  Deflate the loaf, and divide it into 2 parts.  Wrap each piece with plastic, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or up to 3 days.  Preheat an oven to 375 degrees f.  Place the two loaves in the bottom of a 9 inches by 5 inch loaf pan.  Cover the loaf with 1 cup of crushed saltine crackers, and spread the crackers over the top of the loaf.  Top with the remaining crackers.  Sprinkle more crushed saltines on top.  Cover with aluminum foil, and bake the bread in the middle of the oven for 45 to 60 minutes.  Remove from oven and spread hazelnut stuffing evenly over the top of the loaf.  Return to the oven, and bake for 1 hour, or until crust is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean.  Remove the loaf from the oven, remove plastic wrap, and let cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Mexican-Style Pizza
ingredients: 20 pieces rolled phyllo dough | 1 can hunt's tomato-based prepared pizza sauce | 16 tomatillos, diced | 1 medium yellow onion, diced | 1 medium head cabbage, thinly sliced | 1 cup pizza sauce, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Spread 1 cup sauce on a lightly greased cookie sheet.  Layer 10 tomatillos, 1 onion, 1 tomato and 1/4 package taco seasoning on a sheet of phyllo dough.  Spread 1/3 of the sauce on top of the tomato layer, leaving an inch or two of bare.  Layer cabbage on top of the tomato layer, layering onions and ending with the remaining sauce.  Top with remaining 1/4 package taco seasoning.  Poke holes all over the crust with a fork.  Bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Somalian Tomatillos
ingredients: 2 tablespoons kosher salt ( for tops of tomatillos ) | 6 green cardamom pods | 1 lb firm tomatillo
instructions: Bring 3 quarts of water to a boil.  Meanwhile, coarsely chop the tomatillos in a food processor.  Add cardamom pods and salt and process to form a fine paste.  Add tomatillos and process to a coarse paste, about 1 minute.  Dip tops of tomatillo husks in boiling water for 2 minutes.  Remove from water and drain.  Serve with a spritz of kosher.

title: Lebanese Deviled Pimiento (Zigeunersalat)
ingredients: 1 jar pimientos, drained, rinsed well | 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Cut pimentos into julienne strips.  Combine in a small jar with remaining ingredients.  Pour into a 2 qt.  Baking pan and bake 325f degrees for 20 - 25 minutes.  Remove from oven, pour julienne strips over tortilla, and serve hot or warm.

title: Egusi's Egg Noodle Stew (Mujadarra)

title: Smoky Chipotle Baked Oatcakes

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f and grease and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  Mix the oatmeal, chilies, gravy mix and saffron in to a bowl until well blended and the chilies are well distributed. Fill the hole with the chilies and tomatoes and spread the chipotles evenly.  You should have about one third of the mix.  Sprinkle the cilantro and saffron over the top.  Spread the melted chocolate or maple syrup over everything and bake until the crust has puffed and the tomatoes are hot, about 20 - 25 minutes.

title: Tartar Sauce

title: Mustard With Yellow Squash and Yellow Squash

instructions: Prepare the yellow mustard at least one day ahead, or up to 3 days ahead.

title: Cheesy Sausage and Pasta Casserole
ingredients: 2 loaves frozen rye bread | 1/2 cup fat-free evaporated milk or 1/2 cup fat-free fat-free half-and-half | 1 package reduced-fat cream cheese, divided | 1 package shredded mexican blend cheese ( such as kraft ) | 1 package dry farfalle pasta or ( 16 ounce ) package spaghetti | 1 lb bulk italian sausage | 1 can fat-free curd cottage cheese or ( 16 ounce ) can other dairy product ready-to-use cheese of your choice
instructions: To prepare lasagna, preheat oven to 375°f.  Cut 2 loaves of frozen rye bread into bite size strips and place in greased 13x9x2 inch pan.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup milk and cover with foil.  Bake for 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, to prepare cream cheese, heat small saucepan over medium heat for 1 minute.  Stir in 1/2 cup cream cheese and 2 cups of cheese.  Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.  Bring to boil.  Remove from heat.  When loaf is removed from oven, layer with 1 1/2 cup each cottage cheese and remaining cream cheese mixture.  Continue layering until all ingredients are used, ending with 1/2 cup cottage cheese.  Top with remaining 1/2 cup cream cheese mixture and remaining 1/2 cup cream cheese mixture.  Cover with foil, and bake for 45 minutes.  To prepare sausage, remove sausage from heat and drain from skillet.  Cut into 1/2 inch pieces.  Brown with 1 1/2 tablespoons oil and 1/8 teaspoons salt and pepper.  Let cool.  Drain, if desired.  Add sausage mixture to cheese and stir until well blended.  Spread in a 9 x 9 inch baking dish.  Top with remaining 1 1/2 cup cream cheese mixture and sprinkle with 1/2 cup each of montreal, cheddar and any other desired toppings.  Cover dish, and bake 25 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.  Note, to prepare pasta, cook pasta per package directions, or cook with label directs.  Drain pasta, and return to pot.

title: Champinollo Espanolagru

instructions: Put the mushrooms through a sieve.  Heat oil in a frying pan and fry the mushrooms quickly on high heat.  Remove them from the pan and put them in a bowl. title: Raisin and Barley Salad

instructions: In a small saucepan, pour vinegar on raisins.  Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer until the liquid thickens to a syrup.  Transfer to a bowl and set aside.  In a serving bowl, combine the rice and fruit and toss with rice mixture.  Add vinegar and fish sauce and toss well.  Serve cold.

title: Manchego Cheese Balls
ingredients: 14 ounces manchego cheese, coarsely grated | 2 tablespoons corn flakes, crushed | 1 cup grapeseed oil or 1 cup grapeseed oil | 1 cup soya sauce ( i just use 2-3 tbsp soy sauce ) | 2 cups homsey milk

title: Tropical Squash Roll-Em-Ups

Arrange the slices on a platter.  In a small bowl, stir together the chocolat syrup and the basil.  Spread the chocolat mixture evenly over the squash slices.  Top with the red pepper slices.

title: Mexican Fried Bananas

title: Maggie's Festive Bean Sprouts

instructions: Pre bake the bread round in a 425°f oven for approximately 40 minutes, until crusty and golden.  Set aside. Place the vegetables evenly over the top of the bread, drizzle with the remaining enchilada sauce, and top with arugula or greens.  Serve warm.

title: Mexican Quinoa and Cabbage Soup

title: Stovies, Goulash, Potatoes, Shanks, Roast Beef and Bacon

Brush with extra extra milk or melted butter.  Bake for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked through.

title: Broccoli and Potatoes with Broccoli

Spray potatoes with cooking spray.  Bake for 40 to 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until potatoes are tender and broccoli is bright green and lightly golden.

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Mix the yogurt, refried beans, enchilada sauce, and creole seasoning together in a bowl until thoroughly combined.  Spoon the mixture into an 11x7 inch baking dish and sprinkle with the whipped topping.  Bake in the preheated oven until the dip is bubbling, about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Greek-Style Spinach

ingredients: 3 3 lbs andouille sausages or 3 lbs hot italian sausage links | 2 tablespoons sake | 3 tablespoons chicken bouillon cubes | 1 cup heavy cream ( whipping cream is a healthier option ) | 2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves
instructions: Place the sausage links in a heavy skillet or pot and add water to cover the sausages by 1 inch.  You should be able to submerge them by 1 inch.  Bring to a boil and boil for 20 minutes.  Drain and set aside.  Boil the cream until it is reduced, then add the basil and stir until it is completely incorperated into the cream.  Cut each sausage link in half, lengthwise.  Place in a small bowl and add 1/4 cup cream of cream to each half and set aside.  Pour 1/2 of the cream mixture back into the skillet you used to cook the sausage links.  Turn the heat to medium high and begin to sear the sausage.  This will allow the cream to seep through the sausage, allowing it to bubble gently.  You will have very thick and delicious sausage.  When the cream starts to bubble around the sides of the pan, turn down to a simmer on low setting and simmer for 20 minutes or until a thick sauce appears.  Continue to stir frequently over medium heat.  To serve, place equal amounts of the 2 tablespoons of sausage cream to each plate, top with 2/3 cup of each of the 2 basil leaves and top with equal amounts of the 2 tablespoons of sauce.  You may wish to serve the finaly one with fresh basil.

title: Grilled Shredded Citrus Vegetables
ingredients: 1 whole yellow squash | 1 whole yellow bell pepper | 6 large spinach leaves, cleaned | 8 large bamboo shoots | 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle chile pepper | 1/4 cup simple syrup | 1/8 teaspoon vanilla | 1/4 teaspoon chopped orange rind ( optional )
instructions: Cut the squash in half lengthwise, seeds removed and cut each half into 8 pieces.  Cut bell pepper into 8 slanted wedges.  Slice the leaves into 8 slanted wedges.  Remove the cores and stem from spinach if desired.  Place all vegetables on a grill rack or wooded plate, close lid and cook over direct medium heat in direct heat until all vegetables are lightly charred, about 5 to 7 minutes.  Remove from grill and cover tightly to prevent burning.  When vegetables are cool, coarsely chop the spinach leaves.  Remove cores from bamboo shoots.  Dice the remaining ingredients.  Arrange the vegetable mixture in a medium glass bowl.  Garnish with orange rinds if desired and serve.

title: Russian Green Tea

title: Easy, Deliciously Spicy Fried Onions
ingredients: 1/2 ounce salt ( use kosher salt, don't use regular salt please ) | 1 tablespoon peanut oil | 1 cup grated white onion | 1/4 teaspoon tabasco sauce | 1 2/3 cups ice water ( approximately ) or 2 2/3 cups water ( approximately )
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the salt and oil.  Cut the onion in half lengthwise and scrape out the central core.  Carefully, make a hole in the top of the onion and poke a hole in the bottom to release the water.  Fill the hole with water to the depth of one third and add the salt and oil mix.  You can use a mortar and pestle for the salt.  Let the water or spices dissolve while you continue in the next step.  Heat 2 - 4 teaspoons of oil in a wok on med heat, add about one half cup of the onions, and stir fry for three 4 - 8 minutes until the onions look nice and golden.  Add the other half and stir fry 2 - 3 more minutes, adding more oil as necessary.  Stir the onions into the wok with the rest of the oil and cook until the oil is absorbed.  If your wok has a heating pad, do not heat the wok or frying pan at a time.  You may need to add a little oil as you stir the onions into the oil.  Use a metal spoon and a spatula to stir the onions into the heated oil.  Let the onions cook on medium high for about seven minutes, stirring every three minutes to ensure that they cook evenly.  Once they look nice and golden.  When the onions are cooked through, remove them to a plate and set aside for use in another recipe or just eat while they're still hot.  You may also leave them there and serve them as a side dish.  Add salt to taste.  You may also add some more seasoning if desired, i prefer garlic, cayenne, salt, paprika, nutmeg, onion powder, or other spices.

title: Broiled Scallops

Drain liquid out of the pan, and place the artichoke hearts in the pan.  Pour a little of the liquid from the pan over the artichokes, then sprinkle the slices of strawberry over everything and heat under broiler for 2 minutes, or until just beginning to set. instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Bring pineapple juice and saffron to a boil in a medium saucepan.  Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes.  Cut potatoes in half lengthwise and slice into 1/2 inch slices.  Cook potatoes in boiling, salted water until tender but still firm, about 10 minutes.  Transfer to a plate.  In the same large saucepan, bring pineapple juice and remaining saffron to a simmer.  Remove from heat.  Stir in confectioners' sugar, parsley, and vanilla.  Dip drained potato slices into the mixture and place on parchment paper lined baking sheets.  Bake in preheated oven until crust is golden brown and edges are bubbling, 10 to 15 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Green Beans with Lemon and Zest
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh green beans | 2 cups water | 1 teaspoon lemon zest
instructions: Trim and wash the green beans and snap into pieces that will fit inside the pot of boiling water.  Place them in a large pot and add just enough water to cover the beans and bring to a boil.  Cook 3 minutes.  Remove the pot from the heat, cover and let stand until tender, about 5 minutes.  Drain.  Transfer the beans to a serving dish, toss with the lemon zest and serve.  Cook's note, you can also pour the lemon oil in, but you will not have the crisp coating of fat and will have to cook the beans longer.

title: Easy Turnip Chowder
ingredients: 2 large turnips or 2 large sweet potatoes, cubed | 7 ounces yogurt | 1 tablespoon sugar | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Wash and peel turnips and cut them into bite size chunks, discarding ends.  In a large kettle, cover turnip with cold water and bring to boil, turn down heat and simmer about 5 minutes.  Cook the turnip in the boiling water 1 minute and drain thoroughly.  Place half of the turnip, along with the rest of the ingredients, in a food processor or blender.  Blend till smooth, adding more water as necessary to obtain desired consistency/taste.  Chill and serve over basmati rice and/or plain curries.

title: Mexican Lamb
ingredients: 2 lbs lamb shoulder, cut in half | 1 can salsa ( mild, medium or hot ) | 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce
instructions: Combine all ingredients, except the lamb.  Coat pan with cooking spray.  Add lamb and stir well to coat with cooking spray.  Spray pan again and place in 350 degree oven.  Bake 45 minutes, until meat is tender.  Serve on platter with a nice side vegetable.

title: Italian Wedding Soup (Tortellini Soup)
ingredients: 1 package frozen cheese tortellini | 1 whole rotisserie-cooked chicken
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

Random Ingredients: red lentil,black pepper,season salt,rice wine,raspberry,rigatoni pasta
title: Roasted Red Lentil Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils, rinsed and picked over | 1 tablespoon light rice wine | 1 1/2 tablespoons season salt | 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper | 1/2 lb raspberries, quartered | 8 ounces rigatoni pasta or 8 ounces other small flat-leaf pasta
instructions: Place the lentils, rice wine, season salt, and pepper in a large baking dish.  Add the raspberries and marinate overnight.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Roast lentils until tender and lightly browned and mushy, stirring frequently, about 45 to 55 minutes.  If the raspberries start cooking too soon, transfer the lentils to a food mill and purée them into a fine puree or pass them through a sieve.  Set the puree aside.  Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente.  Drain.  Add to the roasted lentils.  Top with lots of crusty bread crumbs and the optional grated cheese of choice.

title: Quick Moroccan Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon pepper
instructions: In a sauce pot, combine oil, lemon pepper, and garlic cloves.  Mix well.

Random Ingredients: muenster cheese,rotelle pasta,head cabbage,baking soda,cherry pepper,corn tortilla
title: Quick, Easy, and Healthy Low Cal and Cheesy Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage | 1 jar halved cherry peppers | 24 corn tortillas | 1 large head of shredded muenster cheese ( or monterey jack ) | 1 package dry rotelle pasta | 1 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: If you have 12 toothpicks, leave the excess toothpicks in your head of cabbage, then cut the cabbage into wedges as close to the size of the tortillas.  Otherwise, if any of your cabbage is exceptionally lean, cut up enough small pieces to use as a garnish, about 1/4 inch wide sticks.  Boil your pasta according to package directions.  Drain pasta, rinse with cold water, and cut in half.  Cut up the peppers into quarters, then set on paper towels to dry out while you start making the rest of the vegetables.

title: Rough and Flavorful Almonds
ingredients: 4 large almonds | 2 beef bouillon | 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon | 1 cup chicken broth, or more
instructions: Place almonds in a deep skillet.  Bake, stirring constantly until lightly colored.  While still hot, rub 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon on the blanched almonds toasting almonds until golden.  Remove from heat and set aside to cool.  In a medium bowl, dissolve the bouillon in the chicken broth.  Pour into the skillet.  Stir in the blanched almonds and, stirring gently but thoroughly, cover.

title: Pina Colada
ingredients: 1 cup pine nuts ( pecan not finely ground ) | 1 cup crushed ice cube
instructions: First cut the pine nuts in half and remove the nuts.  Then set a couple of walnut sized pieces of ice in a small bowl.  Dry the pine nuts with a paper towel and lightly salt them.  Take the nuts out of the bowl and stir them in with the pine nuts.  Pour the bowl of ice over the pine nuts and set the ice in the ice cube slot.  Let the ice solidize for around an hour or so, shaking well until the ice is chilled.  Enjoy.

title: Chipotle Blueberry Bread Crumb Mix
ingredients: 8 teaspoons chipotle powder | 8 ounces whole wheat breadcrumbs | 1 cup blueberries, frozen
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix thoroughly.  Press the mixture into a loaf pan.  Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool.

Random Ingredients: kaffir lime leaf,golden mushroom soup,ketchup,serrano chili
title: Easy Ketchup Sauce for Japanese Pasta
ingredients: 1 can condensed golden mushroom soup | 1 serrano chili, chopped | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 -3 kaffir lime leaves
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.  Makes 3 - 4 servings or 2/3 cup.  Note, may be made with any kind of vegetables, ie.  Fish/shrimp, onions/carrots etc.  May also use as marinade for a thicker sauce.

title: German Sausage Calzone
ingredients: 1 tablespoon german mustard | 500 g sweet italian sausage | 1 teaspoon cornflour | 100 g chunky salsa | 1 pizza dough
instructions: Heat bbq.  Cut the sausage into long strips.  Brown the sausage until done.  Mix the cornflour, salsa and italian mustard together.  Add 1 tsp of this mix to the sausage.  Roll the dough out on a floured surface until it's thinner and less stretched.  Slice the dough about 2cm long.  Spread the sausage mixture evenly across the dough and spread all over with the rest of the mix.  Place in a frying pan, cook in batches and turn after one minute.  When golden brown, remove from heat and place on a plate and serve with a tomato based dressing on the side.

instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Place cumin in a shallow pan.  Bake in oven until fragrant, about 1 minute.  Remove.  Heat a large skillet over medium high heat.  Add shrimp.

title: Pepper-flavored Crepes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vanilla extract | fresh ground pepper | lemon wedge, for garnishing
instructions: Whisk vanilla extract and pepper into the crepe batter.  Heat 1 tablespoon batter for each crepe.  Garnish with lemon wedges or sprinkles.

title: Crab-Crusted Catfish
ingredients: 1/2 lb fresh lump crabmeat, picked over | 1/2 lb fresh tart apple, peeled, halved lengthwise, sliced 1/4 inch thick | 3 medium egg yolks | 1 pinch salt | 1 tablespoon dark rum | 1 lb linguine or 1 lb spaghetti, cooked according to package directions | 1 can mexican-style stewed tomatoes, drained well and coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the crabmeat, apples, egg yolks, salt, and rum.  Spoon half the crab mixture into the center of a cooked pasta.  Sprinkle with a little more rum if using.  Top with tomato slices.  Garnish with croutons and serve.

title: Pasta With Meyer Lemon Peaches (Pasta D'abricco)

instructions: For the peachy pasta, place the pasta in a large pot of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes or until just tender.
