Toss with the pasta in a large warmed serving bowl.  Serve with the peach slices.

title: Raspberry and Honey Rub
ingredients: 4 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 teaspoons hing | 2 tablespoons dried fruit | 1 lb fresh raspberries
instructions: Using a mortar & pestle pound half the fennel seeds to a fine powder.  Add the hing, dried fruit and 1 teaspoon of the spice rub.  Let stand for 1 hour to allow flavours to blend.  Pour herb mixture into a clean jar with a tight fitting lid.  Seal, and refrigerate for at least 1 week.  Drain raspberries, reserving liquid.

title: Gramma's Spring Rolls
ingredients: 20 spring roll wrappers ( found at asian grocery store ) | 1 1 tablespoon ground serrano pepper ( mince )
instructions: Mix together serrano pepper and ground mince.  Heat up frying pan to high and let it get hot.  Drop a small amount of the mixture at a time into the frying pan.  Cook each one on one side for a minute or two until they form a flat, even shape.  Remove to a plastic bag and roll them up starting the long way.  Take to a wire rack.  Store them in a single layer on a cookie sheet for later use.

title: Pasta in Spicy Red Chilli Sauce
ingredients: 500 g dried penne pasta | 125 g red chiles, deseeded | 125 g caraway seeds | 125 g dates, pitted | 125 g pure vanilla sugar, divided | 200 g romano cheese, shaved | 150 ml thick mustard seeds
instructions: Cook pasta al dente and drain.  Place in large heat proof shallow dish.  Boil chillies and caraway seeds for around 5 mins, remove.  Add dates and cook for a further 2 mins, remove from heat.  While pasta is cooking combine oil, mustard seeds and 1 tsp vanilla sugar.  Brush over hot pasta to coat and chillies from oil and toasting.  Toss with romano cheese for 3 mins, or leave to italian style.

instructions: Combine pears, olives, vinegar, orange juice concentrate, lemon juice and cardamom in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. instructions: Heat oven to 375 degrees.  Stir the thawed meatballs, cherry pie filling or canned pie filling, apple cider vinegar and cayenne until combined. instructions: In a bowl, lightly grate orange zest.  Add marmalade, cream cheese, cauliflower and tomatoes.  Stir to coat, and let sit for 15 minutes.  Toss with lime juice.  Enjoy.

title: Gujarati (Fruit Loaf' for Crock Pot)
ingredients: 2 cups self-raising flour | 1/4 cup sugar | 1/8 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( known as `` hing '' in hindi ) | 1 tablespoon soy sauce
instructions: Mix flour, sugar and asafoetida together well.  Add soy sauce and mix well until it forms a firm mixture that will easily turn out onto a lightly oiled plate.  Form into a firm loaf on a floured plate or baking paper.  Cut the loaf into 12 even pieces.  Make a slit lengthwise in each piece with a serrated knife and gently pinch along its length till you have cut each into very small squares.  Place on a baking tray lined with a dampened baking paper.  Bake at 180c for about 20 minutes till browned on the outside.

title: Macadamia Beet and Lemongrass
ingredients: 2 lbs red beets | 1/4 cup lemongrass ( with some liquid from lemongrass ) | 6 tablespoons macadamia nuts | 2 tablespoons white pepper | 4 teaspoons cayenne pepper, more to taste
instructions: Peel the beets and set them aside.  Cut away the root part and cut into small cubes.  Trim off outer white pith and remove the root end and the bottom, so it remains intact.  Wash the shredded beets and cut into 1/4 cubes.  Add to a large pot over medium/low heat of boiling water.  Cover the pot, and allow the cubes to cook for 30 - 45 minutes, or until they're soft when tested with a fork.  Remove them from the pot, and remove the beetroot from the water with a potato masher.  Using the back of a large spoon, remove the beets from the liquid and set aside to retain their cooking water.  Cut off and discard the lower stem part of the lemon grass and cut out the white ribs and roots from the lemongrass using the blade of a knife.  Cut the lemongrass into slices across the width and then into pieces.  Cut the lemongrass into thin slices.  Add the macadamia nuts to the pot, followed by the white pepper and cayenne.  Saute the lemongrass for several minutes, or until golden.  If the mixture becomes dry before it becomes dry, add small amounts of water or a splash of olive oil.  Add the beets and allow to cook for 10 minutes, or until they are soft and tender.

title: Chipotle Puffs
ingredients: 250 g ground figs | 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs | 2 tablespoons sweet chili sauce | 2 tablespoons chipotle paste | 1/2 tablespoon oyster sauce
instructions: Mix all the ingredients together.  Form into 1 balls and deep fry in the oven at 220°c for 20 minutes until browned.  Allow to cool.  Enjoy with a sauce.  Store in an airtight container.

title: Melt-In-Your-Mouth Beef Stew
ingredients: 1 cup onion, chopped | 2 lbs chuck, in 1in pieces | 1/4 cup tomato passata | 1 can refried beans
instructions: Stir fry onions in 2 tbsp of oil over medium high heat until soft.  Remove from pan.

title: Lamb and Chorizo Samosas

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°f.  To prepare crust, line a 10 inch safflower pan with parchment paper.  Roll out pastry into a 17 to 24 inch circle.  Place pastry circle on greased pizza pan, allowing edges to overhang.  In a large bowl, combine lamb, sausage, cumin and currants.  Divide evenly among crusts, evenly.  Sprinkle with cilantro, pressing the leaves of the cilantro into the meat mixture as desired.  Bake, approximately 45 to 50 minutes, or until crisp and nicely browned.  Cut into eight or ten squares.

title: Irish Stew
ingredients: 500 g stewing beef ( cut into 5cm pieces ) | 1 tablespoon dried yeast ( or 1 teaspoon instant dry yeast inst ) | 250 ml chicken stock | 125 g sliced rye bread
instructions: Place beef and yeast in a large saucepan.  Mix in all remaining ingredients.  Bring to the boil, lower the heat and simmer, covered, for 40 - 50 mins until beef and veg are tender.

title: Pasta With Cheese and White Wine
ingredients: 250 g ready-made ricotta cheese | 150 ml white wine ( a white wine such as a zinfandel )
instructions: To make your own non aluminium pasta it is best not to use an italian pasta machine.  First, to soften the dough, cut it into cubes of varying size.  The dough should be quite slightly elastic.  If it is too soft, add water, a teaspoon at a time.  Use your hand to stretch the dough until it is fairly thin.  You can use a cookie cutter or a pasta roller to do this if you wish.  If you have the time, the pasta will be different from traditional fresh pasta and the dough will be very difficult to do even with.  Once you get it to the right thickness, dust generously with parmesan or a little almond oil.  For the best results, cover with a clean non aluminium towel.  Cook about 10 minutes.

title: Salt and Season Vinegar
ingredients: 2 tablespoons seasoning salt | 4 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Place the salt and vinegar in a small bowl and mix well.  Store in the refrigerator.

title: Radishes With Swiss Cheese and Radishes (21 Day Wonder Diet: Day 1)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 450°f in an oven proof dish layer the swiss cheese and radishes, ending with the swiss cheese.  Bake in the oven for 15 minutes or until golden, and the swiss cheese is melted.  Remove the dish from the oven and leave for 5 to 10 minutes.  Serve hot, drizzled with extra virgin olive oil and sliced radishes.

title: Slow-Cooker Parsnips
ingredients: 1 1/2 - 2 lbs eye of round roast, cut into 2 to 3 inch chunks | 1/4 - 1/2 cup fresh parsnip, coarsely chopped | 1 chicken bouillon cube | kosher salt
instructions: Put all ingredients except for the roast in a 6 or 8 quart slow cooker.  Cover and cook on high 7 to 9 hours or on low 7 to 9 hours.  Shred by pulling the meat apart into very nice, pretty chunks.  Keep in mind you can eat this without it, too, or can just leave it on there and enjoy some crunchy veggies if you do as above.  Note, no cooking instructions given above can make it dry enough that it can be served without cooking, but without needing to cook.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock cube,flat leaf parsley,ladyfinger,garlic paste,berry,iceberg lettuce,fine breadcrumb
title: Tasty Berry and Mushroom Dessert
ingredients: 1 -2 tablespoon garlic paste ( use a bit more if you like ) | 2 teaspoons fine dry breadcrumbs | 1 tablespoon finely chopped flat leaf parsley | 200 g sliced berry ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon chicken stock cube | 200 g frozen mixed berries ( optional ) | 1 iceberg lettuce | 1 packet ladyfingers
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°c or 180°c fan forced.  Line a baking tray with non stick muffin paper.  Place all the ingredients except for the dressing and lettuce in a large bowl and mix together.  Spoon a little mix into the base of a serving dish or on dinner plates.  Arrange the lettuce leaves over the top.  Dollop half the dressing over the lettuce and then cover with a layer of mixed berries.  Repeat twice with the remaining salad leaves and berries.  Drizzle over remaining dressing and sprinkle with a little more salt and freshly ground black pepper.

title: Crostini Sandwiches for the Holidays
ingredients: 1 croissant | 3 cartons beef consomme soup | 1 teaspoon vanilla bean | salt substitute | romaine lettuce leaf, to garnish
instructions: Split croissant and toast it on a hot griddle or pan.  While it is toasting, combine consume, vanilla bean and vanilla extract in a saucepan.  Simmer for a few minutes, then pour immediately over croissants and serve hot with lettuce leaves for dipping.

title: Meat Pies
ingredients: 125 g shortcrust pastry | 300 g ground beef mince | 125 g corn | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 tablespoon brandy | 2 teaspoons chopped kielbasa | 1 can biscuits | 2 tablespoons brandy | 2 tablespoons brandy
instructions: Preheat oven 200°c roll out the pastry with a rolling pin till 2mm thick and cut into 2 3cm long 2cm squares.  Fry mince in a pan and remove.  Add corn and brandy and let simmer till liquid evaporated.  Roll out dough with a rolling pin till 5cm thick and cut into 2 3cm squares.  Spoon 1 teaspoon of pimento into the centre of each square and spoon in mince/corn mixture.  Fold in the ends and pinch the sides together.  Place on an oven tray and bake for 30 minutes.  Brush tops of pies with brandy glaze while warm.  Crumble over biscuits before serving.

title: Spicy Red Curry Beef Rolls
ingredients:
750 g hamburger | 3 teaspoons red curry paste | 1 tablespoon red wine | 3 -4 tablespoons mayonnaise | 6 sheets rice stick sheets, approx.

instructions: Heat a non stick frying pan and add curry paste.  Cook, stirring, until fragrant.  Add meat.  Cook until brown, breaking up chunks.  Add wine and stir until just to bubble. Spread a small pat of mayonnaise all around the meat.  Top with remaining rice stick, then top with caraway seeds.  Roll up from the narrow end of the rice stick.  Secure the roll with 2 toothpicks.  Cut the roll into 8 pieces.  Serve cut side up.

title: Takikake (Bun Bread) - Japanese Bread Bread
ingredients: 3 lbs sandwich buns | 1 lb yellow cornmeal | 1 1/2 ounces bonito flakes | 1 1/2 teaspoons white sugar
instructions: Cut the tops off of the buns, and cut a hole in the center.  Bake the buns for 6 to 8 minutes in a 325 oven. .  When done, cut the bottoms into 1/2 slices.  In a mixing bowl, thoroughly combine all the ingredients in order as shown above.  Spread one portion on the buns, then top with the remaining portion, using the grated cheese of your choice.  Note, if you like, you can also use bread crumbs with a little less fat.

title: Guatemalan Limeade

instructions: Place all ingredients in blender and run on high, until it begins to become a thick puree.  Pour into pitcher and serve.

title: Lardy Bacon & Capsicum Bread

instructions: Preheat the oven to 170c/350f/gas mark 4, 200c/375f/gas mark 4, and grease a large loaf pan.  Heat 2 tbsp lard in a large non stick frying pan. Add the garlic to the pan and cook over a high heat for 30 seconds to warm slightly.  Sprinkle over the capsicum and chervil leaves and transfer to a large bowl. Turn out the bread mixture into the hot pan and flatten to a level on top of the mixture.  Bake in the centre of the oven for around 60 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and a loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the tap.  Dust with extra bread flour to serve.

title: Kielbasa and Avocado Appetizers

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lightly spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with cooking spray.  Place kielbasa sausage into a skillet over medium heat, and lightly brown.  Mix in mango, and cook until heated through.  Stir almonds into the skillet, and pour in half and half.  Dab kielbasa with a fork to coat, and stir in poppy seeds.  Spread the yogurt sauce onto the baking dish, and sprinkle with poppy seeds.  Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, 30 to 40 minutes.

2 japanese eggplants, stems and ends trimmed ( about 8 oz.

title: The Best Beef Rollups

title: Homemade Gravlax (Sailor-Type)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon hot chicken broth | 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin, trimmed of fat | 1/2 cup soymilk | 3 tablespoons dark molasses | 1/4 teaspoon dried juniper berries
instructions: Pour the broth into a small bowl, add the roast and turn to ensure even soaking.  Incorporate both sides of the roast well.  Cover and refrigerate for about 30 minutes, or overnight.  Preheat the oven to 350° and position the rack in the center.  Slice the roast lengthwise in half to make 3 1/2 inch thick pieces.  Place the roast into an oval loaf pan placed in a roasting pan.  Arrange the slices in a single layer against each other in a single layer, leaving enough space between each slice for the liquid to seep into in the cuts.  Pour the soymilk over each piece of roast.  Rub the dried juniper berries over the meat and bake until well browned, about 1 1/2 hours.  Do not turn off the oven as the roast must be turned every 30 minutes or so.  Remove the roast from the oven and let cool slightly, then carefully remove the roast and slice.  It should be rather thin, therefore reduce the oven temperature if desired.  Let the meat rest before slicing.

title: Pommes Aux Fruits Recursites

title: Roasted Butternut Squash With Rosemary

title: Pasta With Lemon and Zest (Kathleen's Kebabs)
ingredients: 1 1/3 kg spaghetti | 4 1/3 kg lemon zest ( optional including inside zest of 2 lemons ) | 1 kg skewer
instructions: First you want to have a kabob bowl with a diameter of about 7cm or so.  For easy removal of zest you can try removing the bottom part with a sharp knife or the back part with your fingers.  Rinse the pasta, drain and place it between two paper towels, leaving about 2cm between each clean dish which i had no time to get it cold.  Soak it to room temperature for about 40 minutes.  This will give you about 40 zest.  Remove zest using a pair of sharp scissors and cut the zest longways to remove the bitter pith that collects at the bottom.  Discard the bitter pith.  This is the key if your kabobs aren't going to eat immediately.  If you soak them in cold water for 2 - 3 hours they will get mushy and not cook at all.  They should be cooked on the same day as the pasta.  If you are using kabobs cut them lengthwise and then cut all the way through the kab in the zest.  Add a little more water if needed and salt if needed.  In a large pan, bring water to boil and add about a teaspoon of salt.  Dump the kab in and cook for about 90 seconds to a minute turning occasionally until the top of the kab is golden.  Dump the water out and drain the pasta.  Put back on the heat and add a little more salt if needed.  Place the pasta in the oven and cook for 5 mins.  Check the time on the water, if it has absorbed add a little more.  The zest will be ready and the pasta should be ready in about 3/4 minutes depending on how old it is.  The pasta should also be slightly soft and the kabab will cook perfectly in those moments no matter how long it says no longer smells like something.  Add a bit of water if pasta is sticking.  Serve with any other side dish and enjoy.

instructions: Trim excess fat from brisket and discard.  Make slits in brisket with a sharp knife.

title: Spicy Chicken Toast
ingredients: 1 french baguette | 4 -5 whole chicken thighs ( depending on size ) | 1 inch gingerroot | 2 tablespoons dark soy sauce
instructions: Slice off some of the ginger root and discard.  Slice the ginger root thinly.  Cut the baguette in half.  Use a serrated knife to slice down the center, creating two equal portions of cut up baguette.  Trim chicken parts of any fat at the bone and discard.  Using the knife remove each piece of cut up chicken and reserve.  Slice the chicken in half across the grain.  The slices will eventually end up on your counter top and your clean up will be easier.  If your slice is more than 1/2 inch, cut it down to 1/2 inch more.  If you slice the baguette into this shape with the chicken in it, lay it on a cutting board or a cookie sheet.  It's better to cut it so that as much of the dark soy sauce as possible will form into a sauce, but if you cut it with a slicing knife, you can still have some solids.  Place a couple of slices of chicken in a large shallow dish.  Sprinkle with about a quarter of the soy sauce.  Spoon half the ginger slices evenly in the middle of the chicken.  Spread the rest of the ginger and soy sauce onto the chicken.  Take the top portion of the baguette cut to fit in a sandwich size plate.  Then place the pieces of chicken on top of the ginger.  Heat up a wok over a medium flame.  When it's getting hot, add a tablespoon of oil to coat it with soy sauce.  When oil is hot, pour out the chicken pieces and sprinkle with more soy sauce, followed by the more ginger slices.  Place the chicken in the pan, making sure to get a good coating of oil on all of the chicken.  Cook the chicken on high for 5 minutes while turning.  The chicken will need a bit of crunch from the cooking process to cook on the desired level of crunchiness.  Serve immediately.  Note, you can also use 2 servings of any type of meat you would like to have.  If your slice of bread was not to your liking, just substitute about 1/4 of each of chicken, pork, or chicken.  You can also use bread or bread of your choice in place of ginger.

title: Homemade Korean Steak Sauce
ingredients: 1/3 cup light teriyaki sauce | 3 tablespoons prepared mustard powder | 1 1/2 - 2 lbs sirloin steaks | 1 small yellow onion, finely chopped
instructions: Prepare mustard powder according to package directions.  Trim fat from sirloin steak and slice thinly across grain, then lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices.  Cut meat in half on the diagonal.  Sprinkle mustard powder over slices and set aside for 20 minutes to allow flavor to mingle.  Arrange onion on plate.  Thread slices on long soaked bamboo skewers, alternating as desired.  Pour teriyaki sauce over meat.

Random Ingredients: vanilla,seasoning italian salad dressing mix,orange peel,sushi rice,black olive,deep,beef
title: Santa Fe Shreds #2
ingredients:
2 lbs shredded beef | 1.
    -5 boxes sushi rice | 3 teaspoons vanilla | 1 envelope seasoning italian salad dressing mix | 1 can black olives | 1 orange peel, chopped | deep dish pie shell, baked according to directions
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Grease a 9x13 pan.  Combine beef, rice, vanilla, salad dressing mix and olives in a large bowl, mix well.  Divide meat mixture evenly among the baked pie shells.  Dip edge of each pie shell in water then place crust side down on top.  Bake at 400 degrees for 45 - 60 minutes.

title: Lentils with Creamy French Bread Croutons and Noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry lentils, rinsed and drained | 1/2 cup french country style shredded bread | 1 tablespoon butter | 3 tablespoons bourbon | 6 hokkien noodles ( japanese sweet rice noodles, soaked in water for 15 minutes, then drained ) | 6 french bread rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil.  Add lentils, and cook uncovered for 10 minutes, or until tender.  Drain.  Combine cooked lentils, bread, butter, and bourbon.  Spread mixture out onto a baking sheet, and top with hokkien noodles.  Place bread slices on top, and bake about 10 minutes in the preheated oven.  Cut into wedges, and serve.  If desired, serve with maple syrup or a drizzle of cream and a drizzle of bourbon.

title: Quick Banana Peppers
ingredients: 6 tablespoons red pepper flakes, crushed ( to taste ) | 3 bananas, sliced | 2 teaspoons vanilla flavoring, optional ( i like mine in the orange flavored )
instructions: Mix together and put in a paper or plastic bag.

title: Roasted Tomato and Ricotta Biscotti
ingredients: 28 ounces whole milk ricotta cheese ( room temperature ) | 6 plum tomatoes, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced crosswise | 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram, crushed | 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°f generously coat a 13x9 in baking dish with cooking spray.  In medium bowl, blend ricotta with 2 teaspoons marjoram and baking soda until combined.  Spread mixture evenly into prepared baking dish and arrange tomatoes and their thinly sliced crosswise over ricotta.  Insert a serging knife into center of each biscotti and fill with 1/2 cup boiling water.  Bake for about 25 minutes, or until bottom is golden.

title: Hot Watermelon Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup diced watermelon | 1/2 cup diced onion | 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper | 1/4 cup mango chutney
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together watermelon, onion, cucumbers and red bell pepper.  Pour in mango chutney to taste.  Mix well.

title: Baked Salt Cod
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs baking potatoes | 2 teaspoons salt cod fish, rinsed until excess water is gone | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom seed | 12 sage or 2 teaspoons dried sage, crushed
instructions: Pre heat oven to 375 f.  Cut potatoes lengthwise in half from stem.  Remove excess potato skins and cut crosswise into 1/8 wide slices.  Place in a baking pan and pour enough water on to cover slices.  Sprinkle the salt cod with the cardamom and add to the pan.  Cover with greased aluminum foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until fork tender.  Remove fish and place on serving platter.  Surround with sage.  Enjoy.

title: Hungarian Cheese Spreads
ingredients: 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese | 1/2 teaspoon hungarian paprika | 1/8 teaspoon white pepper powder ( optional )
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the mozzarella cheese with the paprika and pepper powder.  When ready to use, spread on bread cubes that have been lightly browned and soaked in rum.  You can add any type of white meat if you like.  Store in refrigerator or freezer.

title: Bombay Bicycle Club: Indian Toasties
ingredients: 1 baguette, loaf | 2 cups brown rice | 12 curry leaves | 1/2 cup dark beer | 1/4 cup chopped pistachio nut | 3 tablespoons chopped tomatoes | 2 scallions, sliced on the diagonal | 1 medium banana, sliced on the diagonal
instructions: Wash and prepare the brown rice according to package directions in a saucepan.  Meanwhile, preheat the grill to high & butter a baking sheet.  Cut baguette in half lengthwise, then diagonally into 12 slices.  Brush bread with olive oil & grill on both sides.  Combine the rice, curry leaves & dark beer and bring to a boil.  Cook, uncovered, until liquid is gone, about 10 minutes.  Remove the bread from the oven.  Add the nut & tomatoes & fold in the scallions.  Spread a thick layer of the rice rice mixture on one side of the toasted bread slices.  Place 1 sliced banana on top of the rice mixture & top with the remaining toasted bread slices.  Grill until the bananas are heated through.  Serve hot with sour cream or fresh fruit.

Random Ingredients: beet,red wine vinegar,sea salt black pepper,white bread,brown rice flour
title: Roasted Beetroot Bread
ingredients: 1 large beet | 1 3/4 cups brown rice flour | 1/2 1/2 cup white bread or 1/2 cup wholemeal bread flour | sea salt & freshly ground black pepper | 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 220c.  If the beet is very fresh, peel and cut into large chunks.  Place into a large roasting dish large enough to fit all the ingredients.  Add the vinegar and season well.  Remove the beetroot from the fridge.  Wrap the bread or flour around the beets, making sure to completely enclose all the liquid.  Bake for 40 - 45 minutes to brown.  Turn off the oven and leave the beets on the top of the oven until completely dry to the touch.  Cut into wedges and serve immediately.  Note, beets can be replaced by beetroot and can be successfully roasted in the oven with mixed spice, herbs, etc.

title: Lidia Cruz's Infamous Parsley-Vanilla Sorbet
ingredients: 2 cups flat leaf parsley, coarsely chopped ( about 2 bunches ) | 1 vanilla pod, split lengthwise and scraped ( optional )
instructions: Place half the parsley in a blender or food processor, along with the vanilla pod and the remaining parsley, with 1 teaspoon of salt.  Blend until combined.  Place in an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions until just firm but no slushy around the circumference of the pod, 5 - 8 minutes.  Remove the pod form the sorbet and place in the freezer for 2 minutes to set.  Meanwhile, in a small saucpan of simmering salted water, blanch the remaining parsley for about 2 minutes, or until it starts to wilt.  Remove with a slotted spoon, and drain.  Using a slotted spoon, transfer the sorbet to a medium bowl and refrigerate until completely cold, about 5 minutes.  Serve while still warm or leave until room temperature.

title: Basil and Macadamia Nuts
ingredients: 2 cups basil leaves | 1 cup macadamia nuts
instructions: Wash, dry and roughly chop the basil and macadamia nuts, placing the basil and macadamia nuts in a food processor and process until chopped coarsely.

title: Pounded Tortillas
ingredients: 2 flour tortillas ( or equivalent ) | 10 peppercorns
instructions: Put about 1 teaspoon of peppppercorn in the center of each tortilla and place it on a wooden board which has been dusted lightly with flour.  Flatten it with the flat side of a rolling pin, pressing down gently with the flat back of a spoon.  The tortilla should now fall into the bowl of a mortar with a rounded teaspoon, so make it as flat as you can get it.  Punch the tortilla down and use a teaspoon or two to flatten it slightly.  Using the flat edge of a rolling pin, press the flattened tortilla out of the bowl and set aside.  Repeat with remaining tortillas.  Heat a charcoal chimney/beef grill on high for about 10 minutes, or until a bead of smoke appears on the side of one side of the tortilla.  Wearing rubber gloves, carefully place the tortilla on a hot griddle, close lid and turn the heat down to medium.  Leave the griddle for another 10 minutes.  If you don't have a grill, fry the tortillas in batches in a small amount of oil until crispy.  Remove from griddle and place on paper towels to drain.  Serve hot or at room temperature.

Random Ingredients: button mushroom,vegetable oil,vegetable oil cooking spray,rigatoni pasta,winter squash,tomato ketchup,brown rice
title: Lori's Rigatoni
ingredients: 1 lb rigatoni pasta ( about 2 cups ) or 2 lbs fettuccine ( about 2 cups ) | vegetable oil cooking spray | 4 cups button mushrooms | 1 1 cup winter squash, cut into 2 inch squares | 1/2 cup tomato ketchup | 2 tablespoons brown rice | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.

title: Cheese Stuffed Beef Rolls - Korma Style
ingredients: 8 slices swiss cheese | 4 slices filet of beef ( about 1/4 inch thick ) | 1 tablespoon mixed chervil ( flat leaf ) | 2 tablespoons ground roasted barley ( or yellow split peas ) | 2 teaspoons chat masala ( or curry powder, or chili powder )
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°f.  Place 1 slice of the cheese on each slice of beef.  Cover with 2 slices of the cheese.  Rub together the chervil and ground roasted barley or yellow split peas.  Top with remaining beef slices.  Dry roast in the oven for about 20 minutes, or until beef is tender.  Remove and spread each slice of meat with the roasted garli.  Re salt if needed to crisp the meat up.  Serve hot, warm or room temperature.  Variation, roast a little fresh cilantro instead of chopped fresh chervil and serve on the side, if desired.

Random Ingredients: savory,onion powder,limeade concentrate,rice wine vinegar,ham hock
title: New Orleans Sticky Rice Cubes
ingredients: 5 -6 lbs dried rice country-style sticky rice cube | 2 large sweet onions | 5 lbs smoked ham hocks or 5 lbs smoked sirloin steaks | 1 can limeade concentrate | 1 tablespoon papery savory ( optional ) or 1 tablespoon thyme ( optional )
instructions: Boil 4 cups water in a large pot to a rapid boil, then add the rice cubes, and return to boiling.  Stir, then immediately cover the pot and reduce heat.  Simmer for 50 - 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Meanwhile, rinse the onions in a very large colander under cold water to remove any sand particles.  Dry on paper towels and cut off and discard the hard stems.  Reserve the onions for other uses.  Cut the ham hocks into chunks about 1 1/2 inches wide, and remove the fat.  Add the onions and ham hocks to the soup, and simmer gently for 12 - 15 minutes.  Cool for 15 minutes.  Using a spoon, skim off any foam or impurities from the top.  Transfer to a large container and refrigerate overnight.  The next day, uncover and use a slotted spoon or a sharp knife to remove the rinds.  Reheat before serving in soup bowls, garnished with slivers of sweet onion, limeade concentrate, and savory.  These can also be frozen for future use.

title: Croustades for a Crowd
ingredients: 3 tablespoons hazelnuts, divided | 1 1/2 lbs lean salmon, cut into 6 small pieces | 3 cups part-skim ricotta cheese | 1 large smoked sweet potato flakes | 1 can smoked salmon, cut into thin strips | 1 small bell pepper, seeded, cored, deveined and thinly sliced | 1/2 medium red bell peppers or 1/2 medium green bell pepper, seeded, deveined, cored, deveined and thinly sliced | 1 medium whole vanilla bean, split lengthwise, seeds scraped | 1 large smoked salmon, skinned, deboned and cut into thin strips | 2 cups hot salted mashed potatoes

instructions: Place pears, capsicums, green chili salsa and cream in a large bowl and season to taste, then combine.  Stir through cilantro with cardamom pods.  Garnish with green cardamom pods.

instructions: In a large frying pan or wok, fry steak in 1 tablespoon oil until well browned and cooked to your preference.  Remove to a plate, keep warm. title: Bahama Mama Mary Ann's Bell Pepper and Bread

instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees f.  Arrange bell peppers and onion powder in a roasting pan.  Pour rum over peppers, then add enough water to cover.  Place pan in preheated oven. instructions: Boil 1/2 cup water in a large saucepan.  Remove from heat.  Meanwhile, heat remaining 1/2 cup water and remaining 1 teaspoon sesame seeks in a small skillet.  Cook fennel and fennel seeds until fragrant, then add to spaghetti and toss.

title: Ranch Beef and Barley Wedges

instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  In a 2 1/2 quart baking dish or other shallow baking dish, combine the barley and steak.  Cover tightly and bake until barley is tender, about 45 minutes.

instructions: Place lamb into a large, lidded, non metallic bowl.  Pour the vinegar over and stir well.  Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge for 6 hours or overnight.  Cut the reserved lamb into 5 slices from the lamb.  Cut the lamb into 6 portions and arrange on top of the vinegar.  Scatter the dill over the lamb slices.  Cut the cucumber into 6 thin slivers, and scatter over the lamb.  Leave to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes 30 minutes before serving.

instructions: Marinade, combine first six ingredients and toss with fish and marinate for at least 30 minutes or up to 8 hours.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees f. When it is ready to bake, pour half of the sauce over the liver and bake for 10 minutes, until bubbly hot.  Serve with the remaining sauce poured over the top.

title: The Best Watermelon Salad!

instructions: Peel watermelon, and slice into bite size pieces.  Put a generous amount of the soya sauce in the bottom of a serving bowl, and layer the watermelon slices.  Season with salt and pepper.  Serve with steamed rice.

title: Lobscouse- Chayote Dip (Zwt V)

instructions: Using a sharp knife, cut off and discard top half of chayote and then cut it lengthwise into 3 or 4 segments, scoop out seeds with a teaspoon and place in bowl.  Grate chayote using your large holes.  Finely mince mint leaf.  To assemble the dip, place chayote on plate and sprinkle with minced mint leaves and a sprinkling of mint.  Serve with bread or toast.

title: Cheesy Peanut Nuts

instructions: Heat oven to 250°f.  Pulse yellow pepper slices until coarsely chopped.  Combine all ingredients except for the peas in a large bowl.  Mix well with hands to combine.  Add peas.

Place 1/4 cup of the swiss Bliss mixture into the base of a glass bowl coated with cooking spray.  Drizzle with the cocoa mixture.  Repeat with remaining swiss Bliss mixture.  Chill for 1 hour, then serve immediately.

title: Caribbean Ginger Colada
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounces ginger ale | mint ( fresh mint leaves ) | creme de cassis | golden syrup or maple syrup | fresh coriander powder
instructions: Pour a couple of tablespoons of ice cold water into a cocktail shaker or other container.  Stir in the ginger ale, mint leaves and cassis.  Shake a couple of times, then strain into a martini glass.  Garnish with freshly coriander, and enjoy with other suggested drinks.

Random Ingredients: spinach,green peppercorn,vanilla sugar,vanilla yogurt,orange peel,dark soy sauce,vegetable
title: Spinach and Spiced Yogurt Salad
ingredients: 1 ounce vanilla yogurt | 1 ounce green peppercorns | 1/2 cup frozen spinach, thawed | 1/2 large orange peel, peeled and finely shredded into fine shreds | 4 cups mixed fresh vegetables, see notes | vanilla sugar, for sprinkling | dark soy sauce, for sprinkling ( optional )
instructions: To make the garnish, place 1/2 cup of the vanilla yoghurt in a bowl and stir in the peppercorns.  Spoon half of the yoghurt into a serving bowl.  Top with the spinach, orange rind and green onions and toss gently.  Top with the other half of the yoghurt and finish with the rest of the yogurt.  Pour the mixed veggies on top and sprinkle on a touch of sugar, soy sauce and vanilla sugar.  Note, if using the dark soy sauce rather than the sugar, pour it all into a small saucepan and cook over low heat until the sugar dissolves.

title: Brown Rice With Cheese and Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 4 cups short-grain white rice | 1 package part-skim mozzarella cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees f.  Bring 3 1/2 cups water to boil in a large stockpot over high heat.  Remove from heat and stir in rice.  Cover and cook about 20 minutes.  Uncover, and mix in cheese.  Continue cooking a minute or two longer.  Serve warm.

Random Ingredients: bulk sausage,ricotta cheese,chunky peanut butter,cranberry,vinegar,kielbasa,sesame oil,hard egg
title: Kelbasa With Nuts (Kelbasa With Sesame Dip)
ingredients: 1 lb bulk sausage | 1 ounce sesame oil | 4 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1/2 inch slices | 3 tablespoons vinegar | 1 lb sheep's milk ricotta cheese | 1/2 cup chunky peanut butter | 2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped | 1/2 cup dried cranberries
instructions: Mix in a large bowl the sausage meat, sesame oil and kielbasa.  Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes.  In a small bowl, blend vinegar, peanut butter and eggs.  Remove sausage meat mixture from refrigerator.  Preheat grill to medium high.  Prepare kellbasa.  Drain sausage meat from casings and slice into 1/2 inch slices.  Spread some marinade over the pan.  Cook, turning gently with tongs or a fork, until hot and brown and cooked through.  Serve with dip or on top of warm turkey or pork.

Random Ingredients: chicken stock,chilies,cranberry sauce,dark chili powder,vanilla sugar,mint,kahlua
title: Cranberry Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon dark chili powder | 3/4 cup chicken stock | 100 g cranberry sauce | 2 tablespoons kahlua | 1 teaspoon vanilla sugar or 1 teaspoon almond extract | 2 dried chilies | 1/2 teaspoon roughly chopped of fresh mint
instructions: Heat the chicken stock in a pot to boiling point.  Once boiling, add the chili powder and stir well.  Simmer over medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes, stirring well to ensure the chili powder gets into the meat.  Remove from heat, add in the cranberry sauce, cinnamon, and the kahlua.  Stir well and set aside.  When cool, transfer the chili powder into a jar, cover with a lid, and store in the fridge for upto one week before using.

Random Ingredients: chicken leg,egg noodle,thyme leaf,cocoa powder,chicken broth
title: Yummy Low Fat Tiramisù
ingredients: 8 chicken legs | 3 tablespoons cocoa powder | 3 tablespoons chicken broth | 3 tablespoons dried thyme leaves, divided | 12 ounces egg noodles, cooked, drained and buttered
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Place legs in a large oven safe dish.  Combine 4 tablespoons cocoa, coffee, and 1 tablespoon broth, and pour on top of chicken.  Stir to coat.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until chicken is no longer pink in center and juices run clear.  Serve with noodles.

Random Ingredients: chickpea,ketchup,italian tomato,spaghetti,golden syrup,golden raisin,tomato soup,chicken bouillon cube
title: Sweet Italian Spaghetti
ingredients: 400 g spaghetti | 1 can condensed tomato soup | 1 can condensed italian tomatoes | 1 can small chickpeas | 1 cup golden raisin ( i used kala cherries ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes | 1/2 cup ketchup | 1 tablespoon golden syrup or 1 tablespoon honey
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a pot and stir occasionally on med high until everything is mixed well.  Lower heat to med low and simmer until pasta is done, about 45 to 60 min.  Or until thick.  Enjoy with garlic bread to mop up the extra sauce.

Random Ingredients: tomato ketchup,artichoke heart,cucumber,beef stew meat,pecan,artichoke,spaghetti,cayenne pepper
title: Spicy Beef in Red Sauce
ingredients: 1 cup shredded pecans | 1 1/2 lbs beef stew meat | 1 jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained | 1 can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped | 1 small cucumber, chopped | 1 can tomato ketchup | cayenne pepper | 3 cups cooked spaghetti
instructions: In crockpot layer 1st, pecans, 1/2 of beef, artichokes, cucumber and artichoke hearts.  Pour tomato ketchup over everything.  Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high 5 - 5 hours.  Or, mix ingredients and serve over hot, cooked pasta, if desired, or bake in a 400 degree oven.  Sprinkle with remaining pecans to taste.

title: Arabic Spice Blend
ingredients: 1 tablespoon ground coriander | 1 tablespoon cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon allspice | 1 teaspoon ground cardamom pod | 1 teaspoon powdered saffron | 1 tablespoon vinegar | fresh herbs, of choice
instructions: Place all ingredients in a bowl, mix thoroughly and store in a covered container in the fridge for up to 6 weeks.  Keeps for up to a month.  Variation, substitute 1/2 teaspoon of ground nutmeg for the powdered saffron and 1 teaspoon ground turmeric, to taste.  Variation, omit the allspice and cardamom and simply omit the saffron and cardamom.  Note, if you're concerned about curry powder, stir 2 tbs of curry powder into 1/2 cup of warm water and shake well.  This can be easily replaced with a small amount of water.

Random Ingredients: ketchup,romaine lettuce leaf,dill,tomato puree,chipotle chile powder,salmon,pork tenderloin,vanilla bean
title: Chipotle Salmon Tacos
ingredients: 2 chipotle chiles powder, or more to taste | 2 pounds salmon, cut into thick strips | 1/2 cup ketchup | 2 tablespoons ketchup | 1 tablespoon grated romaine lettuce leaves | 1 tablespoon tomato puree | 1 teaspoon dried dill ( optional ) | 1/2 vanilla bean, split lengthwise | 1 pound pork tenderloin, cut into 1/4-inch strips
instructions: Mix chipotle chile powder with 2 tablespoons chipotle powder in a bowl.

Random Ingredients: black bean,buttermilk,corn tortilla,canola oil,sambal oelek,avocado,hard egg yolk
title: Costillas With Spicy Black Beans
ingredients: 4 corn tortillas | 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed ( white kidney beans ) | 1/3 cup buttermilk | 1/4 cup canola oil, heated | 2 hard-boiled eggs yolks | 2 tablespoons sambal oelek | 2 avocados, cut in eighths
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.  Toast the tortillas on the grill, turning each one often, until crisp and beginning to brown, 2 1/2 3 minutes per side.  Drain well.  Toss the beans with the buttermilk and oil until well coated.  Place the eggs in a small mixing bowl and turn to blend.

title: Almond Rice II
ingredients: 4 cups long-grain white rice | 1 cup white sugar | 1 can almond extract
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil.  Mix the rice and sugar together in a saucepan and place over medium high heat, stirring constantly.  Cook until the rice has turned light brown, about 30 to 40 minutes.  Pour the almond extract into the rice.

Random Ingredients: beet,peanut oil,chutney,rice,vegetable juice,taco sauce,passion fruit pulp,irish cream
title: Baked Sweet Potato Nests
ingredients: 2 teaspoons peanut oil | 2/3 cup sweet potatoes, sliced thinly | 1 small beet, sliced thinly | 1/2 cup vegetable juice | 1/3 cup light chutney | 1/4 cup passion fruit pulp | 1 cup fresh vegetable juice | 1/2 cup light chutney | 1 cup good quality chili sauce ( heinz ) or 1 cup hot sauce ( heinz ) | 1/2 cup light chutney
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees f.  Spray 2 baking sheets with cooking spray.  In a large skillet heat oil over medium high heat and saute sweet potatoes and beet in 2 tbspn oil 3 minutes.  Remove from heat, and transfer sweet potatoes to bowl of food processor.  Using the same skillet, add remaining 2 tbspn oil, passionfruit pulp, and 2 tbspn water and cook until pulp is hot and thickened, 3 - 4 minutes.  Add hot sauce to pan.  Stir, then stir in remaining ingredients.  Transfer mixture to bowl of food, coat well, and place in large baking or foil lined baking sheet.  Bake in middle of oven 10 minutes, and then remove tray and bake 5 - 10 minutes more.  Serve hot or cold with tortilla chips & chutney.

title: Spicy Melon Liqueur
ingredients: 1/2 japanese napa cabbage, washed and cut length-wise into small pieces | 2 tablespoons daikon radish liquor or 2 tablespoons melon liqueur | 2 teaspoons turmeric powder or 2 teaspoons saffron
instructions: In a small glass bottle, combine the daikon radish liquor and turmeric and shake to mix.  Add the napa cabbage and shake again.  Store airtight.

title: Quick Grilled Mushrooms
ingredients: 12 button mushrooms | 2 tablespoons black mustard seeds | 2 fresh pear, sliced, with peel on
instructions: Preheat grill.  Prepare grill with medium high heat.  Remove mushrooms, but leave stems and gills intact.  Place mushrooms, stem sides down, on grill rack, and grill about 5 minutes or until brown and soft.

title: Cilantro Rollups - Vegetarian
ingredients: 1 bunch cilantro leaves | 8 large tortillas
instructions: First make a roll, by putting tortillas on the counter a la planchaine lettuce and cutting them about 3 - 4 in slices.  You want to get them separated but still with a little of the lettuce.  You can also line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a large cookie sheet.  Lay tortilla slices on the sheet and sprinkle each side of each with a little of the cilantro.  You want some nice lines.  Spray one side of the roll with cooking spray, turn over and repeat steps above and below until all of the cilantro has been used.  Let stand until ready to make the rolls.  Heat a skillet over medium heat, add the rolls, sprinkle with the remaining cilantro and cook until the bottoms have begun to turn a light toasted color.  Flip the rolls about 1/4 turn so that the entire bottom is browned and the tops are beginning to crisp up.  Slide them carefully onto the lined baking sheet.  Let cool slightly.  Cut into slices and serve.

title: Pinesey Roasted Chillies
ingredients: 1 tablespoon butter | 1 tablespoon soy sauce | 2 teaspoons oyster sauce | 1 jar dried small red chilies
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pan over medium heat.  Stir in the soy sauce and oyster sauce.  Stir in the chilis.  Stir until heated through.

title: Mandarin Eggwash
ingredients: 2 large eggs | 1 teaspoon asafoetida powder ( optional ) | mandarin orange section ( to garnish )
instructions: Crack eggs into bowl and beat.  Beat until foamy.  Fold in asafetida.  Garnish with orange sections.

Random Ingredients: allspice,silken tofu,chicken bouillon granule,jasmine rice,garlic powder,potato
title: Spiced Indian Tofu
ingredients: 20 ounces soft silken tofu | 3 potatoes, cut into 1/4 inch cubes | 1/4 teaspoon allspice, ground | 1 1/2 teaspoons garlic powder | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules or 1 chicken bouillon cube | 2 cups instant jasmine rice
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a nonstick pan on a medium heat.  Bring to a simmer over medium high heat.  Reduce heat to low and cover.  Simmer until potatoes are tender and rice is cooked, about 10 - 15 minutes.

Random Ingredients: jasmine rice,tahini,seasoning salt,oriental sesame oil,salmon fillet
title: Simple Oriental Salmon
ingredients: 1 can whole salmon fillets, undrained | 1 tablespoon tabasco seasoning salt | 2 tablespoons tahini | 1 tablespoon oriental sesame oil | 4 cups cooked jasmine rice
instructions: Arrange salmon on top of rice, and sprinkle with seasoning salt and tahini.  Cover, and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight.  Remove salmon from the refrigerator about 15 minutes before cooking.  Drain as much water out of the can as possible.

title:
Salmon Florentine With Tampico Ham and Wilted Spin.
    -
ingredients: 1 salmon fillet | 4 leaves fresh spearmint | 2 slices prosciutto ham | 2 teaspoons tamari | 3 tablespoons chopped fresh spinach
instructions: Wash and dry the salmon.  Place the fish in a bowl with the spearmint, prosciutto and 1 tablespoon tamari.

Random Ingredients: dark soy sauce,turmeric powder,cider vinegar,cayenne,chile adobo sauce,vermicelli,green pepper,curry powder
title: Saurie's Vietnamese Noodles
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dark soy sauce ( a taste of tiger ray ) | 2 tablespoons cider vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder | 1/8 teaspoon cayenne, to taste | 1 dash curry powder | 1 tablespoon chile in adobo sauce, chopped ( optional ) | 1 lb vermicelli, linguine or 1 lb rotisserie egg noodles | 1 green pepper, cut into long thin strips
instructions: Stir all of the ingredients together in a large bowl with salt as you like.  If not using all the ingredients right away, keep tasting them now as the soy sauce may be too salty.  Let sit for at least 20 minutes prior to serving.  Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.  Drain well.  Serve over cooked noodles.  Garnish with green bell peppers.

title: Hot Chocolate Mix
ingredients: 1 package sweet pickled jalapeno peppers | 2 cups water | 1 cup water | 2 tablespoons grand marnier or 2 tablespoons orange liqueur
instructions: Place peppers, water, and grand marnier in a covered pan.

Random Ingredients: seasoning salt,caraway seed,sherry wine,chocolate square,penne pasta,greek yogurt reduce honey by half,frangelico
title: Greek Yogurt Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 lb penne pasta | 1/8 teaspoon caraway seed ( optional ) | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt ( reduced honey is ok ) | 4 ounces semisweet chocolate squares ( or another fine ) | 1/8 teaspoon seasoning salt | 1 tablespoon dry sherry wine | 1 tablespoon frangelico ( or other good-quality dry-roasted blackberry )
instructions: Prepare pasta in a large pot of boiling water until almost al dente.  When cooked, drain and reserve 1 cup of the pasta water.  In a large bowl, set aside 1/4 cup pasta water, return to the pot and toss with the caraway seed, add yogurt, chocolate pieces, seasoning salt and sherry.  Toss together till well combined.  Drain pasta and add to yogueghurt mixture, tossing well after each addition.  Add frangelico and toss till incorporated.

title: Brussels Sprouts and Pasta
ingredients: 2 heads green beans, halved and trimmed | 300 g brussels sprouts, trimmed | 150 g green capsicum, sliced | 250 g pasta, uncooked
instructions: Bring a large pan of water to the boil.  Add the green beans and sprouts and cook for 3 - 4 minutes until tender.  Meanwhile cook the pasta following packet instructions.  Drain the sprouts and transfer to a large frying pan.  Place the capsicum slices over the sprouts in the pan.  Cook for two minutes until peppers, stalks and capsicum are crisp.  Drain pasta and add to the frypan.  Pour in the green sauce and season to taste with salt and pepper.  Heat through.  Serve at once.

title: Quick and Easy Warm-Topped Warm-Topped Bratwurst With Apricot
ingredients: 8 bratwursts, about 1 1/2 lbs total | 1/2 cup sour cream ( mild or medium ) | 1 sprig fresh thyme sprig | fresh thyme sprig ( optional ) | 3/4 cup finely snipped dried apricot ( about 1/2 cup )
instructions: Slice bratwurst across grain into 1/4 inch slices with a sharp knife.  If desired, remove any excess fat.  Heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Combine sour cream and sour cream in medium bowl.  Add salt to taste.  Add bratwurst slices, dividing them equally.  Arrange bratwurst, overlapping, in shallow dish.  Spoon dollop sour cream mixture over bratwurst and sprinkle with minced thyme or fresh thyme.  Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or up to 1 day.  Uncover and bake at 400° for 10 minutes, or until bratwurst is browned.  Serve hot.

title: Easy Masala Masala
ingredients: 1/2 cup masala | 1 teaspoon fish sauce ( or braggs amino acids )
instructions: Mix the masala and the fish sauce together.  Spread the masala on a serving dish or a pizza board.  Using the fish sauce as an abrasive, squeeze the spiced masala in to your fingers and stir until it dissolves.  Store in a airtight container and use as directed in recipes.

title: Warm Potato & Vodka Rounds
ingredients: 3 lbs red potatoes, very thinly sliced | 1 1/2 cups vodka | 4 cups self-rising flour, for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees f.  Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.  In a bowl, toss the potatoes with the vodka.  Let stand 30 minutes.  Stir in the flour in thirds to make a stiff dough.  Transfer to a floured surface and pinch off small pieces of the dough.  Roll each piece into a ball and place on the prepared baking sheet.  Dampen the tops with egg white and then gently press to coat top of the rounds.  Allow to dry for 10 - 12 minutes before baking.

title: Paprika Canapes
ingredients: 1 can cream of mushroom soup ( regular can not can ) | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir until mixture is warm, but not hot.  Spread on a clean, dryed cookie sheet.  Spread out to desired thickness.  Spread more of the mushroom soup until mixture is very thin.  It will not be quite twice the amount of the regular can, so you may need to use more soup each time you spread the cream on the cookie sheet.  Allow to dry completely and then break into pieces.

title: Japanese Tofu and Barley (Nabe Kalatomi)
ingredients: 3 cups cooked pearl barley ( not quick-cooking barley here ) | 4 cups firm tofu, cut into chunks | cooking oil
instructions: Slice tofu into 3/4-inch thick slices.  Heat oven to 375 degrees f.  Coat a baking sheet with cooking oil.  Drain the barley and tofu slices in batches and place onto the baking sheet.  Bake for 8 minutes.  Turn over.  Bake an additional 8 minutes or until browned.  Serve tofu topped with barley sauce.

Random Ingredients: chili pepper,silken tofu,spinach leaf,mustard seed,grand marnier
title: Spinach Tofu With Grand Marnier
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups silken tofu | 1 teaspoon mustard seeds | 20 fresh spinach leaves | 1/8 teaspoon chili pepper | 1/8 cup grand marnier
instructions: Spread the tofu with the tulskohm leaves.  Cover with water and cook at the lowest possible heat until soft and mushy.  Take off heat and drain well and press the excess liquid off.  Put into large bowl.  Wilt frozen spinach according to directions on package.  When cool add to the spinach with chili pepper, the minced grand marnier and the mustard seeds.  Mix well.  Add cream if necessary.

title: Hazelnut Crumbs
ingredients: 3 packages dried mixed fruit | 1 pound ground hazelnuts | 3 cups dry bread crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees f.  Prepare a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Rinse fruit under cold water, removing any damaged or discolored areas.  Tear or dice the fruit.  In a medium bowl, mix together the hazelnuts, bread crumbs and fruit.  Turn out onto a floured board and knead, sprinkling with more bread crumbs as needed, until the texture is smooth and the fruit is coated.  Roll the mixture into 1 1/2 inch balls and roll in flour, then coat with remaining breadcrumbs.

title: Moroccan Phyllo Cups
ingredients: 1 cup orange juice | 1 teaspoon chicken bouillon granules | 1/2 cup ghee | 1 cup chopped cooked chicken or 1 cup ham | 1/2 cup chopped pimiento | 1 bag frozen cut broccoli, thawed and squeezed dry | 1/2 package frozen phyllo, thawed and patted dry
instructions: Heat orange juice and bouillon in small saucepan to boiling.  Remove from heat.  Heat ghee in a small frying pan over medium heat.  Add chicken.

Random Ingredients: creme de menthe,celery,cream corn,hatch chile pepper
title: Creamy Chile Sauce
ingredients: 1 can cream-style corn | 2 cans hatch chile peppers, with liquid | 1 celery, chopped | 1 can creme de menthe
instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the cream style corn, jalepeno peppers, and celery.  Heat, stirring occasionally, for 3 minutes.  Pour in creme de menthe, and chill to serve.

title: Homemade Turmeric Kofta
ingredients: 1 cup plain nonfat yogurt ( plain! ) | 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric | 2 tablespoons finely chopped green peppers or 2 tablespoons red peppers | 1 teaspoon amaretto ( almond-flavored liqueur ) | 2 tablespoons greek yogurt ( plain or low-fat )
instructions: Mix everything together in a container with a lid.  Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

title: Pickled Mustard
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mustard seeds | 3 tablespoons sherry wine
instructions: Spread mustard seeds on a sheet of waxed paper.

title: Quick and Easy Chicken Toss With Rice
ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders, chopped | 1/2 cup pecans, toasted and chopped | 3/4 cup long grain rice | 2 ripe pecan pieces | 1/2 cup manchego cheese, melted | 1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean or 1/2 teaspoon cardamom, crushed
instructions: Toss chicken with pecans and set aside.  Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl.  Toss with chicken, coating well with dressing.  Let stand at least an hour.

Random Ingredients: cardamom powder,lentil,green chili pepper,grapefruit juice,chicken stock,thyme,pesto sauce
title:
Lentils, Raisins, & Chillies.
    -
ingredients: 3 cups chicken stock | 1 teaspoon thyme | 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder | 1/2 green chili pepper, deseeded & chopped | 1/2 cup lentils, washed, ends trimmed & | 1 tablespoon pesto sauce | 2 teaspoons grapefruit juice ( optional )
instructions: Put stock, thyme, cardamom, chiles & lentils in a pan & bring to boil over medium heat.  Reduce heat & simmer for 10 minutes.  Add pesto and return to medium heat.  Stir & cook for 3 - 5 minutes, oruntil lentils are soft & hot.  Serve on top of couscous, couscous & pass extra grapefruit juice.

title: Bean Croquettes
ingredients: 1 can refried beans | 1/2 cup breadcrumbs | 3/4 cup green onion, slices ( including tops ) | 1/8 teaspoon mexican oregano | 1 teaspoon fresh basil, chopped
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and mix well.  Form into 6 small patties.  Heat a large nonstick frypan or fry pan over medium high heat.  Working in batches, add patties and toss to coat evenly.  Cook until golden brown, about 2 - 3 minutes a side.

title: Takiko (Egg Roll With Nori)
ingredients: 2 sheets nori ( dry seaweed ) | 4 large eggs ( room temperature ) | 1 1/4 cups nonfat milk | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano ( optional )
instructions: Heat a grill pan to medium heat.  Place nori sheets on the grill, cut side down.  Cook at a distance of 3 inches from the heat until the nori has a toasted appearance, about 3 to 4 minutes.  Carefully, flip nori over, sprinkle egg evenly, and let egg set for about 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove nori from the grill.  Using a spatula or other utensil, spread the egg mixture evenly over the nori.  Cover, and let stand 1 to 2 minutes.  Cut into 1 inch strips.  Sprinkle with oregano if using before serving.

title: Tarragon Oil Oil
ingredients: 4 sprigs tarragon | 1 cup extra virgin olive oil
instructions: In a small bowl, stir together the tarragon and 1/2 cup of the oil.  Set aside.  In a clean bottle with a tight fitting lid, shake together the remaining olive oil and tarragon.  Seal the bottle and refrigerate for up to 2 weeks.  Use in lamb chops, chicken, fish, and vegetables.  Serve with pita bread, pasta, or as a filling for sandwiches.

title: Shuockered Tomatoes
ingredients: 6 large but firm ripe toma tomatoes | 1 package wonton wrappers ( approximately ) | panko breadcrumbs ( optional )
instructions: Peel and slice tomatoes into small wedges, approximately 1/4 inch each.  In each tomato wedge, place an about 2 tablespoons of filling to form a small depression.  Brush the edges lightly with panko then dip the tips into the crumbs pressing firmly.  Place on ungreased baking sheet, spacing evenly.  Bake, one sheet at a time for approximately 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

Random Ingredients: red onion,cherry pie filling,rice wine,pearl onion
title: Vegetables and Vinegar (Sauce)
ingredients: 1 package frozen pearl onions, thawed | 1 can cherry pie filling | 2 tablespoons rice wine | 1 red onion, sliced thin
instructions: Heat oven to 375°f.  Combine all ingredients in medium bowl.  Line rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil.  Arrange vegetables on foil.  Cover with second package of frozen onions.

title: Lamb and Watercress Vol-Au-Vent
ingredients: 1 lb ground lamb | 2 teaspoons ground gravy or 2 teaspoons beef gravy | 1 teaspoon cajun seasoning ( i like penzey's ) | 1 package puff pastry sheets, thawed | watercress leaf, to decorate ( optional ) | 1 tablespoon vinegar
instructions: Cook lamb in a medium non stick frying pan, breaking up clumps, until no pink remains and drain.  Stir in gravy, cajun seasoning and bring to a boil.  Spread lamb mixture onto thawed pastry sheet, top with watercress and fold pastry over to enclose in a pouch, pressing down lightly if necessary.  Brush with vinegar.  Bake in a 400 degree preheated oven 15 minutes, or until crisp and golden brown.  Let cool slightly before serving garnished with watercress leaves.

Random Ingredients: white wine vinegar,turmeric powder,brandy,pecorino romano cheese
title: Pecorino Pecorino
ingredients: 1 cup firmly packed pecorino romano cheese, finely grated | 1 tablespoon brandy | 1 teaspoon white wine vinegar | 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder ( optional )
instructions: In a bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well.  Spread mixture on an ungreased baking sheet.  Bake at 350°f 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown.  Allow to cool at room temperature to avoid breaking into pieces.

Random Ingredients: curry powder,hard egg,iceberg lettuce,five spice powder,allspice berry,pine nut,tamari,tabasco sauce
title: Tibetan Style  Seven-Spice Salad  (Vegetarian)
ingredients: 2 medium hard-boiled eggs, cut to fit an egg beaters | 1 1/2 tablespoons curry powder | 2 1/2 teaspoons five-spice powder | 1/2 teaspoon allspice berries | 1 teaspoon tamari | 8 leaves iceberg lettuce | 1 large cup pine nuts or 2 cups cashews | sweet tamari
instructions: Place the egg, curry powder, five spice and allspice in a food processor and pulse until a coarse paste is formed.  To assemble, put in a bowl and lightly mash it with a fork.  Arrange 2 pieces of lettuce on a large platter.  Drizzle with some sweet tamari and scatter with the chopped nuts or cashews.  Repeat with 2 more salad leaves, salad and nuts until all ingredients are used up.

title: Cottage Cheese and Wild Rice Risotto
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese, preferably low fat | 1 tablespoon corn oil or 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1 cup wild rice, from package is okay | 10 ounces fresh spinach leaves, trimmed, about 3 cups
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat until shimmering but not smoking.  In a bowl, whisk together cottage cheese and half the wild rice.  Sprinkle in the spinach and half the hot oil and mix well.  When the cottage cheese mixture is warm, stir in the rest of the wild rice and spinach.  Note, you should have a creamy risotto with a little melted butter and some nice aroma.  Serve immediately.

title: Mexican Chili Powder
ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil | 1 teaspoon cumin
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet.  Add cumin.  Once it starts crackling, add chili powder.  Heat oil on low, stirring occasionally until mixture is reduced by half.  Serve with mexican rice, with other dishes.

Random Ingredients: asparagus,allspice berry,golden raisin,tomato green chilies,season salt,spanish olive,yellow onion,lettuce leaf
title: Green Chile Relish
ingredients: 1 lb asparagus, cleaned and trimmed | 1 lb tomatoes or can diced tomatoes with tomatoes, undrained | 1 cup chopped yellow onion | 1 cup spanish olives | 1 cup golden raisin | 1 tablespoon ground allspice berry | 1/2 teaspoon season salt | lettuce leaf
instructions: Combine all ingredients except lettuce in large saucepan.  Bring to boiling.

Random Ingredients: pear,extra sharp cheddar cheese,grape,vegetable oil cooking spray,vegetable oil,baby green,turbinado sugar,beef broth
title: Beef With Pear Risotto
ingredients: 1 lb boneless lean top sirloin steak | vegetable oil cooking spray | 6 cups mixed baby greens ( such as swiss chard, or kale ) | 1/2 cup grape ( or arugula ) | 4 ounces extra-sharp cheddar cheese, grated | 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar ( or regular sugar ) | 1 tablespoon vegetable oil | 1/4 cup beef broth
instructions: Cut steak crosswise into 3/4 inch thick slices.  Spray four 1 1/2 cup shallow baking dishes with cooking spray.  Arrange greens, cut sides down, on plates.  Top with grape and cheese.  Sprinkle both sides with turbinado sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoon vegetable oil.  Heat remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons vegetable oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat.  Add half of pork mixture and cook 2 - 3 minutes per side or until browned.  Top with 1/2 cup risotto and remaining pork mixture.

title: Smoked-Fried White Beans (And-Fun) - Fast!
ingredients: 2 lbs smoked hamburger | 2 tablespoons fresh mixed herbs ( minced ) | 1/3 cup cider vinegar | 1 tablespoon white sugar | 1/3 cup dry buttermilk | 4 tablespoons whole wheat flour | 2 cans white beans ( cannellini-type ) | 1/4 cup fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: Mix up the dry ingredients in a large bowl using a whisk.  Add the meat and mix lightly.  Place a large non stick frying pan over medium high heat, and add the flour.  In the pan, fry the meat until done to your liking, or you need to do this in batches in your oven.  Set aside and repeat until all the meat has been used.  Serve with mashed potatoes or fried onions and/or greens.  Great on buns and rice.

title: Zucchini with Tomatoes - Pressure Cooker
ingredients: 6 zucchini, with their stalks | 1 tablespoon tomato paste

title: Fasoulia

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°f in a large casserole dish, add the carrots, ras el hanout, beef, oregano, beef bouillon, and chicken bouillon and add the two crushed garlic cloves, dried oregano, and dried oregano. title: Cape Verde
ingredients: 1 tablespoon mild chili ( or to taste ) | 1 tablespoon pure annatto seeds | 4 heads belgian endive
instructions: Heat one table spoon of oil in small saute pan at medium high heat.  When smoking add small pieces of chopped endive.  Don't brown them, this is ok.  Immediately shake pan to coat well and then set aside.  The oil will start to smoke, when it hits the end of cooking remove from heat and place on a towel over a bowl.  Immediately shake and toss salad oil and chilli into dressing, coating well.  Taste, season with salt to taste, and garnish with fresh chopped endive, if desired.  Serve, and eat.  If dressing does not stick on endive, drain excess oil and remove endive leaves after washing.

title: Smoked Portobello Mushrooms Smorgashen
ingredients: 2 portobello mushroom caps, stems trimmed | 14 ounces smoked tomato puree
instructions: Preheat grill to high.  Lightly spray a medium size plate with cooking spray.  Using the tip of a paring knife, poke holes in the mushroom caps with a skewer.  Brush all four sides of each mushroom with tomato puree.  Using a large, deep frying pan or cookie sheet, lightly brown the mushrooms.  Remove mushrooms from pan and place on a paper towel covered plate to drain off excess fat.  Serve hot.

title: Bake Guy's Asparagus Rice Bread Rolls
ingredients: 2 loaves bread, cut into 1x3/4 inch thick slices ( any firm loaf will do, but the challah, pumpernickel and other cuts will do ) | 2 bunches asparagus spears, tough ends snapped off | 1 lb rice, cooked
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°f.  Line a baking sheet with foil.  Spread the bread slices onto the baking sheet in a single layer.  Place in the oven.  Bake for about 15 - 20 minutes, or until nicely browned.  Turn off the oven, and place asparagus cut side down in a skillet.  Cover, and allow to sit in the oven for 5 - 10 minutes until the asparagus has crisped and become tender.  Place rice on a plate, and place 2 asparagus spears on a plate, and cover with damp cloth to keep warm.  Place the asparagus spears in the baking sheet about two inches apart, face down.  Bake for about 30 minutes, or until rice is cooked.  Remove from the oven, and let cool slightly.  Place the warm rice on a cutting board, and spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons of cooked rice into the center of the rice.

title: Bread Pudding With Mint & Wine
ingredients: 3 cups bread flour | 1 cup white wine | 3 cups of fresh mint sprigs | 2 -3 brioche bread, cut into rounds
instructions: Stir the flour and white wine in a large saucepan till the mixture forms a thin paste.  Stir in the mint and cook for approximately 3 minutes over heat, stirring constantly.  Remove mixture from heat and place the bread rounds on a parchment lined baking tray and bake for 10 minutes at 190 degrees celsius.  Remove the bread and set aside to cool.  Stir the mint and wine into the flour mixture.  Return to a boil and stir constantly.  Turn heat down to simmer and cover the pan.  Allow to simmer for approximately 15 minutes or until the mixture has thickened.  Remove the tray of bread and place the bread rounds in a bowl of cold water in order keep the bread under cold water.  Lightly butter the tops and sides of the tray with melted butter.  Remove the mint sprigs before serving.

title: Hungarian Goulash
ingredients: 2 lbs steaks, cubed | 2 tablespoons grapes, cut | 1 can sauerkraut | 2 cans kidney beans
instructions: In a large pan brown the meat.  Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer slowly for 1 hour until the meat tender.

title: Paprika Beef or Chicken
ingredients: 1 kg white pearl onion | 3 tablespoons paprika | 3 tablespoons tomato paste ( i use my rj's brand )
instructions: Mix paprika, tomato paste and onions.  Roughly cut bag of chicken in 5cm pieces.  Place in crockpot.  Cook on high for 3½ - 4 hours.  Stir every 15 - 20 minutes.  Add a little more paprika if the sauce becomes too thick/tangy.

title: Fava Bean Salad

instructions: Roughly chop the prosciutto.  Toss all ingredients and serve cold.

instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees f.  Lay pepperoni slices on ungreased cookie sheet, spread with rice vinegar.  Bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, or until rolls are crisp and lightly browned.

title: Lamb and Fennel Stuffed With Jasmine Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil | 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds | 2 1/2 lbs leg of lamb | 2 1/2 teaspoons salt | 3 cups jasmine rice | 1 1/2 pints sizzling hot double cream or 1 1/2 pints tabasco sauce | 1/2 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In a large nonstick frying pan, heat half the olive oil.  Add the fennel and fry until fragrant, about 1 minute add the lamb and season well.  Sear the lamb on all sides until dark in colour all over.  Remove from the pan, cut into 1 inch pieces and set aside.  In a large saucepan of boiling salted water, add the rice.  Return the pan to the heat and cook for 4 - 5 minutes, stirring often.  Drain and cover.  Preheat the oven to 350°f heat remaining oil and remaining oil in a medium sized ovenproof frying pan.  Add the lamb and bring to the boil.  Return the lamb to the pan and cook until just to the tenderloin stage, 4 - 5 minutes.  Transfer all the lamb to a warm platter and set aside.  Add the cream to the pan and swirl around.  Season to taste.  Bring to the boil and add the rice and stir.  Cook stirring, until the liquid has almost evaporated.  Sprinkle with cilantro and cover.  Bake for 30 - 45 minutes or until the lamb is cooked through and no longer pink inside.  Allow to rest for 10 minutes.  Taste for seasoning and serve warm.
